column10: Such a wonderful and easy way to give your pet a pill.  And with Amazon, it's much cheaper than buying them at the vet's office or any store.  And, my picky dog loves the taste.
Product was exactly as stated and delivery was quick.  Would do business with again.

These are the smaller pockets, which I didn't expect, but they still work with the pills I have to give my ole' girl.  She loves them and it makes medicine time so much easier.  Truth be told, I have to keep these in the fridge to keep the cat from tearing into them.
This product is great for giving my little dog his medicine.  So much easier and less traumatic for the little dog.

column9: Dog loves them, makes life easier!
column10: I have a fussy eater on my hands and a VERY smart dog.  I've used hot dogs, banana, peanut butter, etc... he eventually figured out a pill was in every one of those and would either refuse it, spit it out, or eat around the pill.  My boy has to take pills twice a day probably forever; so far so good on pill pockets - it's been over a year and he hasn't figured it out.  He considers it a treat and LOVES them.  They are soft so I can form the pocket around the pill.  To make them last a bit longer, I split it in half since his pills aren't very big.

column9: Much easier - for all of us
column10: The dogs are getting a bit older, and on fairly regular meds.  Was using peanut butter on bread to hide them, as even the chewables they weren't interested in chewing, and wrestling them to get the pills down just makes it an unpleasant experience.  With Pill Pockets they actually COME for their meds when they hear me open the bag!

column9: It takes away the aggravation in feeding your pet pills
column10: Whoever invented this product is brilliant. Both my dog and cat love the taste. It makes giving them pills easy and fun. Because it's moist I suggest putting in the refrigerator after opening.

Most dogs I've had have no problem taking pills, except for my yorkie, very obstinant.  It is a whole lot easier just to pop her meds in one of these, and we are both happier for it.  These are great.  End of struggles, she doesn't try to hide from me at pill time.  What could be greater.  The price is worth it!

column9: Perfect for Giving Medications to Our Dogs
column10: Every month, we give our three dogs (two Aussies and a Golden/Flat-Coat Retriever mix) pills for flea/tick/worm repellant.  In addition, one of our Aussies needs daily thyroid pills.  We found Pill Pockets is the very best way to do this.  Opening the mouth wide and trying to put the pill waaay in the back of the mouth before clamping the jaws shut and massaging the throat until the poor dog swallows is a bad thing to do to a beloved pet.  It's bad because Pill Pockets make this chore a happy and delicious time for the dog involved.  The Pockets (in the pet store we use) come in chicken or beef flavors, so we alternate flavors every time we buy a new supply.  Everybody is happy, and the dogs get the required meds.

These are 12.99 plus tax at petco. They work wonderfully for giving dogs pills. I like to break them in half, then mold it around a large capsule for my pug. They work better than cheese, banana, wet food or other treats.
If need to give your dog medicine these pill pockets are the best. My dog loves them so there is no running around the house trying to give him his medicine.

My dog doesnt like the flavor of the duck but loves the peanut butter.  I was shocked because she loves duck dog food.  I gave them to my girlfriend and her dog loves them.  My dog is super pickey and somewhat of a treat perfectionist!  She is spoiled I will admit it.

column9: Great for pets that don't like to take pills.
column10: We have used the beef, chicken and the peanut butter Pill Pockets, we tried hot dogs before, but our dog would eat the hot dog and spit out the pills.  We tried the pill poctets and he actually ate the whole thing.  Great product.

It used to be a pain giving my dog two pills twice a day. With pill pockets, I fill several days worth at a time, so medicine time is quick and easy. Now I just grab one, and say "Medicine time", and he comes running.
I love whoever invented these.  My dogs are real stinkers when it comes to taking pills and these work great.  They line up waiting to get one!

We have tried all the various flavors of Pill Pockets for our dogs. One has a twice a day pill she takes and the other once a day. Chicken and Beef work ok most times but the dogs have never not wanted to take their pill when we use this Duck flavor.The consistency is excellent for being able to wrap around a small pill or to break apart and use only half at a time if needed. The smell is just enough to help hide the scent of the pills. The dogs just love it when I open up the pouch and come running to take their pills.

column9: Our cat loves them for his pills
column10: Our cat doesn't like the feline Pill Pockets so much, but he loves these canine beef ones. (Our vet said it was fine to give him doggie PPs.) And, the pieces are big, so I can use only half a Pill Pocket each day for his pills--saves me money. (I take the half Pill Pocket and split it in half, as he takes two pills a day.) Anyone who has ever had to "pill" a cat knows what a relief it is to just give a treat and the pilling is done. Great product.
Excellent product and transaction so glad I was able to find these on amazon. No more fuss about meds with our pup! She gobbles them down!

I had gone to the vet and I got these for my dog and she absolutely loves them! It has no foul smell although it does smell a little weird on your fingers so wash them but thats normal. Its as simple as you take a little bit or the whole treat and stick medicine or a pill inside of it and cover the pill and they will eat it right away!Its vet approved and very safe for dogs to eat so dont be worried but read the ingredients just in case. I love these soooooooo much. Thanks!

column9: Fabulous resource for the reluctant pill taker
column10: This makes giving daily pills a snap. Our dog thinks she is getting a treat all the time when all she is doing is getting her meds.
They work every time to hide a pill.  Great product that works very well. I buy the largest size and pinch off what I need to cover the pill.

column9: These are large, the cat size is smaller and has more
column10: I love these, we have a cat that is impossible to administer pills to, but she goes stark freaking INSANE for these pill pockets. We used the feline size, which has more pockets in it than the dog size. However at one point she had to take a couple of pills at the same time and I could not fit all the pills into the cat-size pocket, so I bought the dog size. All kitty knew was hey, I'm getting a BIGGER treat than normal!If you have a dog that takes micro doses of tablets or just one small tablet, get the cat size and they'll go much farther.I purchased the chicken dog pockets for my cat and she loved them. That seems to be the flavor most of my cats like.

column9: Very affordable and shipping is quick.
column10: I have used pill pockets in the past, and continue to use them. It makes it so easy to administer especially if you have a hard time giving medication to your pet.

My Maltese pup was given a chewable heartworm combo pill to use and the first time I offered it to him, he all but ran away.  Lucky me, I was prepared because I had already purchased these pill pockets.  I carefully slipped the heartworm pill into one and pinched it closed, then gave him the good boy talk.  He took the pill pocket and thoroughly enjoyed eating it, including the insert.  Problem solved.Whoever came up with this idea has my thanks.  These would have saved me a lot of trouble in the past with other dogs.  I just hope Puka doesn't catch on as he gets older.  I'm thinking about giving him a pinch of one every now and then to reinforce it being a treat instead of medicine.  They are very soft and sticky and apparently very tasty.

We have been buying this product for several years but at pet store or vets.This was first time ordered on line and had shipped. Each bag the pockets were wet/slimy upon opening and not sure if that was their original shipment condition or from sitting in my hot Florida mailbox till I get home. Of course the dogs could care less but they broke apart easliy as if all the mushy flexibility had leaked out and made them wet. So in trying to close the end over this giant capsule..., even in the large size, made pieces break off and made this mom a mess. were not expired or anything o/w good shipping and communication.

I have to give my do meds twice a day, and these pockets make it so easy. I prefill  at least a week at a time, and keep them in tuperware. Every morning and evening I say "Time for medicine." , and he comes running.

column9: Warning: using this product may have unintended side effects
column10: This is both a blessing and a curse.  The blessing part is these pill pockets are pretty much perfect.  They take a pill very nicely, cover it, and make it wonderfully desirable for the dog to eat the pills.  "Serve with food because it's so bitter your dog will hate you forever" is not a match for these little suckers.  Little dog loves these, and would happily snarf down the entire packet if she could.  As for the curse... well, you can no longer safely move pill containers anywhere.  With a keen ear and a taste for beef pill pockets, your dog will hear you shift your containers even one nanometer and come running, expecting you to give it a treat.  My Dad has to take pills twice daily... you can see why this is an issue.Sealed air tight for freshness.  Approximately 30 to a bag.  Suitable for small pills.  Tasty, yet functional.  A fantastic delivery system for an otherwise annoying problem.  5 stars.

I have great animals that are usually willing to do whatever I ask of them.  Unfortunately my male dog gets anal gland infections once or twice a year.  I have tried many ways of administering his antibiotics from coating with peanut butter/cream cheese or wrapping in slices of cheese.  All of these methods work for the first few days but over time he decides the treat isn't worth while so I end up forcing the pill down his throat and giving a treat afterwards as a reward for being tolerant.  Eventually he starts refusing his treat and looks at me like I'm abusing him, lol.  So this time I decided to try Greenies pill pockets.  I chose the capsule size since they are supposed to be larger and he needed to take three pills at a time.  I also chose the duck and pea formula to provide a unique flavor.  Each night he watched me place the antibiotics in the pocket and form a nice ball then eagerly took his treat.  They apparently smell very appealing as my female dog also begged for them and we have to store them in a cabinet because the cat tried to help himself by chewing on the bag.  By the end of the first week, all three animals would line up in the kitchen at the end of the night waiting for their treat!  They did leave a strong smelling oily residue on my fingers but washed off quickly and easily with just a little water and friction.  Purchased through Amazon with Prime shipping.  Arrive quickly in perfect condition.

column4: Merrin Folender "Seriously, I know what's good."
column10: I bought these at the vet's office when I needed to give my dogs pills.  They said dogs really love the beef flavor and they were right!  The pills and pill pocket were gone before I knew it!  I still buy the pill pockets as treats even though they don't need medicine because they really love them.  Since they're used to getting them, they won't realize there's a pill in there if/when the time comes that they have to take some medicine.  Highly recommended in beef flavor or peanut butter.
my dog wanted to do this review for you guys. i said sure. dog: "nom nom nom.... medicine!? what medicine???"
My dog loves both Chicken and beef.  Does not even notice her pill inside.  The ones for largrer dogs are too big for her.  I bought both sizes before.  Everything came quickly and was in good shape.
What a great idea!  I have to give my labrador thyroid medicine twice a day for the rest of his life. This makes it a breeze!

column9: Helpful to get pickey eaters to take their medication.
column10: My one doxie won't eat either the chicken or beef flavored pill pockets, but he will eat the "Duck and Pea" flavor; this is also the formula to buy if your dog has allergies.  The product smells quite strong when you first open the pouch; I suspect the peas give it that distinct odor. I don't need to use the entire pocket per pill, so I break a section off of the capsule just large enough to encapsulate the size pill I need to administer, forming the soft, pliable substance around it.  It is most economical to buy the capsule size, so I do so, but they also come in a smaller, pill size shape.I haven't purchased the pill pockets for my cats yet and don't know how they would be received, but this product has helped me give my dogs medication.  Even when the pill is supposedly chewable, and "liver-flavored," my dogs will generally not take their medication willingly unless I disguise it first.  These can make your life with your pet easier. Shop around for the best price as these can be a bit expensive if you have to use them frequently.

column9: Wonderful as always; my dog adores these!
column10: Although these don't have the most pleasant scent, their effectiveness render's my nose's experience immaterial. These Greenies never fail to fulfill their purpose; once thoroughly surrounded by the pill pocket, any pill, capsule, or necessity I'd otherwise have to battle to shove down my dog's throat gets gobbled up. Actually, swallowed without chewing is more accurate. My dog has become increasingly sensitive with age, and she has shown signs of mild to severe allergies, digestive, dermatological and other manifestations. Not once has she experienced any hint of an adverse reaction to these. Without hesitation, I strongly recommend this product and flavor. These are a staple in our house, and I will continue to purchase these pill pockets in the pea and duck formula monthly.

My dog loves these. Totally unaware that she is taking a pill. The pockets are nice and soft, and can be squished around to totally cover the pill. My dog doesn't seem to know the difference of flavors, so I just get the ones that gives me the most for the least dollars and cents. It's only a small price difference, but, hey, it is a difference.

column9: Probably A Good Product, Just Not For Sweet Girl!
column10: When I got these in the mail last Saturday and opened them up, put in a pill that she absolutely hates the smell of, offered it to her and she gulped it down we were thrilled to death!  We have not been able to get this dog to take this particular medication using everything from hot dogs to hamburgers and several kinds of cheese, so when she ate this thing like it was candy my wife and I were both excited.  Then that afternoon for her last dose for the day, same performance.  We thought we had found the answer to our prayers as she has a disease that can't be cured if she doesn't take this medication until it's all gone.  So this was a Godsend!But, the very next morning, before she had anything else to eat, my wife tried to give her a pill using a Pocket and she turned her nose up at it and walked away!!  She tried several times with varying amounts of the pocket cut off to make it smaller for her and easier to gulp down.  Still no go.  So we waited a couple of hours, without feeding her anything at all, tried again, same thing.So I saw a bag of Pockets in Walmart and the only thing they had besides Beef was Duck so I tried that.  Same thing.  Wouldn't even eat one so we're back to looking for something else that might work.  If your dog will eat them they are GREAT!!
My dogs LOVE these ! I have 3 dogs. 58 lbs., 15 lbs., and 10 lbs ! They ALL adore greenies. HOODIES as we call them !!
Giving my dog pills was a nightmare until my vet game me some of these to try. They smell good and my dog loves to take her pills tucked inside a greenie pill pocket. Problem solved : )

Pill pockets are fantastic! My old (13 yrs) dog has to take medication for Congestive Heart Failure and Arthritis daily. It was getting to be a chore to think of things to hide the 4 pills in...until I found pill pockets at my Vet's office. I highly recommend this product and do does "old dog." I found this product much cheaper on Amazon than at my Vet.

column9: Pill Pockets - Great Product - Good Price
column10: My dogs love these. They think they are getting a treat and eat their pills, no problem. This is a good price for a great product. Fast shipping makes it even better.

Pill pockets are ideal for giving drugs to dogs, much easier than squashing pills into a piece of cheese!  Our dog sees daily pill times as a treat now and comes and sits patiently waiting.  We are on our 4th packet of these and will definitely order more whenever we are giving drugs to dogs!

Our puppy (a bernedoodle) loves these duck treats.  We started using them for pills, but now use them to spread inside of kongs and other toys.  She has a sensitive tummy, so these are great for multiple uses.

My pets love these things, and they make giving medicine so easy!  I no longer have to chase my dogs down and hope that they take their medicine.  With these I KNOW the pill is going to get swallowed.My dogs love anything duck flavored.  They went wild over these!

If you've ever tried to get your dog to swallow pills, you know how wonderful these are.  We have four dogs (three Corgis and a mixed breed), and all like them, and these have been successful with them all.Our mixed breed dog was about 13, and her disease was terminal, and we weren't ready to lose her (not that anyone ever is).  We had medicines that would make her comfortable in her final stages, but the problem was getting her to take them...we tried all sorts of things: peanut butter, apple sauce, fruit, meat--all had a certain ability to disguise the taste, but she got wise to them pretty quickly.But the Greenies Pill Pockets ALWAYS worked.  We were able to extend her life, with comfort, for a couple of months longer, and for that I'll always be grateful.A NOTE: The Greenies come in several flavors (chicken, beef, duck & peas), sizes, and also flavors for cats.  If you need to be more economical, you can also "shave" them down by squeezing off a little of them (depending on the strength of the pill they're taking).

We have had a number of cats with medical problems and tried any number of ways to get pills into them.  Pill Pockets are by far the easiest method.Most of our animals have considered Pill Pockets as "treats" and readily eaten them.  Our current feline gets three pockets in the morning and three in the evening, so we go through a lot.One suggestion:  if your smaller pet needs to take many meds, buy the pockets designed for capsuls for dogs.  Product pricing seems to be related to the number of "doses", rather than the weight.  I believe the small package for cats is 1.6 oz and costs only a few $ less than this 6.6 oz package. If you go through the pockets like we do, the savings are substantial.  We simply tear off a piece of the larger pocket and wrap it around the pill.  It takes 15 seconds.Another suggestion is to get a selection of flavors.  Our cat goes through periods where certain flavors are unacceptable, so it is good to alternate and have backups.If you are really desperate, you can always use human meat baby food.  We haven't seen a cat yet that would't take that.Summary:  A much better way to give your pet meds than a pill shooter.

First off, I have found that buying these treats on Amazon is cheaper than purchasing them at PetSmart. I buy the capsule version of the Pill Pockets versus the tablet version because the bags are larger (it holds more ounces) and the cost difference is almost nothing. I then break that one capsule up into many pieces because they are soft & malleable. I am able to get that one bag to last me for many servings. I only use it to wrap up my dog's Prozac pill.  He will gobble it down with no problem. However, if I try to use any larger pill such as a Heartworm pill or Allergy pill in them, he will eat the treat part off & spit out the medicinal pill. For those types of pills, I just crush them up and stir them in some wet food for him.

we tried alot of things to hide pills in.  our dog would maybe fall for it once or twice, but then would spit out the pills and eat the cheese, peanut butter, hot dog, etc. that it was wrapped in.  But then we found pill pockets and he likes them enough to eat them and the pill inside.  the best thing is how easy it is to form them around different pills, and how you can only use pieces of one pill pocket on smaller pills to make them stretch farther.

These pill pockets are the easiest way to get a dog to take its meds.  My dog scarfs them down no problem.  They can be kind of pricey, especially if you have a dog that requires daily medication, as they only come 30 in a pack and retail for $7.99 (cheaper on amazon of course!).  I would definitely recommend them if you have a dog that has trouble taking his pills.
Finally something my german sheps can not get the pills out of !! They even work great @ the Pet Hospital for our patients.

I have been giving my dog all his medication using Pill Pockets. He just loves them. I prefer the smell of Beef over Chicken, but he doesn't care. They definetly were cheaper through Amazom. I will buy these again.

Like most dogs I have met, our dogs HATE getting their meds. These things take the headache out of giving medication to dogs.  The dogs get so excited for these pill pockets, and they are easy to use.  The pockets are very soft, so if you live in a hot and humid place, they will turn into a pile of mush.  However, you can easily just take a piece of mush and wrap it around the pill.  The dogs don't care if it is shaped properly or not.  Our dogs just swallow it hole and sit there waiting for another one.
Great product !  Finally me older dog will take her medicine without me trying to disguise it with some other treat.......

THE PRICE ON THE GREENIES PILL POCKETS WITH THE SHIPPING WAS ABOUT 22% LESS THAN THE PRICE AT PET SUPERMARKET OR PETS MART.  EXCELLENT DELIVERY TIME AS WELL. I WAS HOPING FOR A BETTER SELECTION OF FLAVORS. I CERTAINLY WOULD LOOK TO ORDER THIS AGAIN WHEN NEEDED.
I purchased six bags of the Greenies and were very happy with them.  The price was great and so was the product.  Carol

These smell worse than the regular chicken/beef Greenies pockets. However, I have a dog with a major stomach problem that the vet is narrowing down to a food allergy - to stop her pain I can definately withstand the brief smell. All three of my dogs think they are treats and actually beg for them, so does one of my cats lol.Anyhow the price of these keep skyrocketing in the sotres and at my vet,I am glad to find them on here at a better price considering how often we go through them!!!!!
Forget the peanut butter, cheese or whatever else you are using.  And stop shoving pills down the dog's throat.  These are a lifesaver!  Our cocker spaniel just gobbles it down, no muss, no fuss.
I have used this flavor - pea and duck for quite some time but the last 5 bags I have purchased smells HORRIBLE. I'm very disappointed and hope the manufacturer fixes the problem.

I would never order anything edible from Amazon again because both shipments had too many broken lollipops. I ordered the first bag and almost a third of the lollipops were broken and Amazon did send another bag for free but it came with even more broken pops than the first one. The packaging needs a lot of improvement in order for the shipment to come to you in good condition. They also had smaller numbers of the colors green, yellow and orange which I was hoping for an equal amount of each color which was the purpose of buying a assorted package,.

I received the order of 120 pops with 42 of them being broken / crushed. This item is not returnable. I do not recommend this item. I have purchased these from another company in the past and did not have this problem.

Sugar for the office!  Great tasting product, made in the USA!  Not the best price I've found on the internet, but still less than ordering directly from the manufacturer.  This is a semi-soft candy that has a great flavor (lemon) and everyone seems to like it very well.  It is not chewy, just melts slowly in your mouth.

column9: Not a good flavor. Tasted like chemicals.
column10: I was poorly surprised at how bad these taste. The after taste was horrible. This is just my opinion.Gave them to workers and they ate them up. To each his own, I guess.

I ordered 2 of these by accident at first but then I recieved 1 package of them by Fedex and it only took 1 day to ship and get to my house I was amazed and when I saw the Box came in great condition nothing was crushed I decided to take the other Box makes a great gift Im giving one to my boyfriend since his favorite candy is Butterfinger and you cant beat the price $23.00 for 36 full sized bars I love it so if you love Butterfingers or are thinking about buying these as a gift I recommend you order from here! :)
the product arrived a couple days after the max time, but the coffee is wonderful and I will reorder again but wont wait until I run out next time.

Living in the UK, my husband and I enjoyed Nando's frequently.  However, in The States, there are apparently no Nando's! I am trying to understand how this could be when there are a million other mediocre restaurants here.  KFC's nasty and fatty tasting chicken and sides could be well replaced with Nando's flame grilled peri-peri chicken dishes and their sides are better too... corn on the cob, chips(fries) with peri-peri spice which also taste great dipped in the Nando's peri-peri sauce, garlic bread, and my favourite spicy rice!Seriously, if you haven't tried Nando's sauce you need to because it's the best marinade I've ever tasted.  If you live in The States it will be unlike anything you've ever had before and you'll love it.  My only suggestion is that unless you like VERY spicy and hot foods, try the Medium Peri-Peri sauce first.  The medium is actually plenty hot enough for me.  However, I understand that the more hot chillis one can consume the better for their metabolism and health.  So, Nando's is not only a tasty choice, it is also a healthy one.

Everytime I visit Slough (UK) from the US I eat at Nando's.  In fact, I eat there nearly everyday.  Why? Well...the only other viable food choices in Slough are: spread meat sandwiches (with butter, sweet corn, free-range eggs, rocket, and mature cheese) at Amys (yuck!)..."unnamed" department store (made me sick)...or McDonalds/Burger King/Pizza Hut/Subway (I can get those down the street). But most importantly, it's the Peri Peri Sauce!Though created for Nando's chicken, Peri Peri sauce is especially tastey as a dipping sauce for french fries.  Thanks to Amazon.com, I can enjoy Peri Peri sauce everyday right here in the United States.Warning: the "hot" is plenty hot enough.  The extra hot is ridiculously hot!

column9: THIS IS TRULY A GOURMET HOT SAUCE!
column10: Peri-Peri means "pepper pepper" in Swahili, and the pepper referred to is the African Bird's Eye Pepper which was carried back by Portuguese traders in the 14th century to Angola and Mozambique, and has finally ended up on worldwide tables, lucky for us!The hot sauce is indeed hot.  In that aspect I would compare it to our own Tobasco Sauce.  It is not intolerably hot.  I find it to my taste.  It is particularly a delicious additive to shrimp and chicken.Alas to say, I do not have the courage to sample "Hot Hot Peri-Peri Sauce."It is sun-ripend, and the exotic mix of herbs and spices is what makes it pass with flying colors.  Really a treat.Be sure to keep it refrigerated after opening.  One warning:  check the shipping fees.  They are steep.  But since the seller's website has a $20.00 minimum on orders, unless you want to buy more than one item, Amazon seems the best way.

Nando's is a very tasty and different sauce from the norm. little bottle went quick though. too quick to see all uses. Rhino sauce with peri-peri may be a tad more useful but we'll be trying the hotter version of this one next to see if it'll stretch out the taste farther. if it only uses serranos (African?) for the increased heat it will NOT work with us.
The first time I tried this sauce was in London at Nando's Restaurant, since then I am addicted to Nando's sauce, goes great with anything grilled.

Very good and tasty product. A little hotter than I normally like on meats and eggs, but very good nevertheless. For those who have been to Portugal, or are dreaming about going there one day, and are fascinated by the Algarve's Guia Piri-Piri Chicken, this sauce is just the thing. I think that on a re-order I'm going to go with something a little less hot, but I still am planning on buying from Nando's.

There aren't any Nando's restaurants in my area (yet!) but I've long enjoyed their Hot Peri-Peri sauce.  It's one of the best of the many (well over 100) I've tried.  And while it's genuinely hot, it isn't overwhelmingly, inedibly so, as are some that vie for world's hottest honors.  But it's not just the right level of hotness that makes this so good.  It has a successful and unique recipe, which is rare, in my experience.  I more often prefer the simpler sauces that are little or nothing more than chili, vinegar and salt.  I've been to many other Portugese barbeque restaurants, and this would be ideal for the grilled chicken that is their specialty, so I'm definitely looking forward to my first visit to Nando's.
Nando's is a must for anyone who enjoys hot wings. This Peri-Peri sauce has a great hot flavor that taste great on any chicken. Enjoy South Africa's hidden hot sauce.

Nandos hot piri piri sauce is so delicious.  In the June Bon Appetit there was a recipe for Piri piri chicken and I used Nandos sauce.  Delicious and not very hot.  A friend sent it over from  England and was happy to find it on Amazon.  A must buy!

I don't agree with the other comment.  This hot sauce is not the hottest but does have a bite to it.  The main difference in hot sauces is the heat and the flavor.  If you want to burn your butt the next morning, get some mad dog 357.  Not much flavor but extremely hot.  This hot sauce has both.  Flavor and heat to it.  If you want something much hotter then purchase texas tongue torch from the same company.  I eat hot sauce on just about all my food. I visit the local hot sauce store who sells nothing but hot sauce on a weekly basis to check out new arrivals and purchase something different.  Fire in the hole is in my top 5.  Summary is, if you want something that is hot to the taste and has a great flavor then this is your hot sauce.

I bought this Hot sauce thinking it would be hot.  It is terrible.  Not only is it not hot at all, I doubt that there are peppers of any kind in it.  It tastes like colored Vinegar.  Regular Tabasco is 10 times hotter.  In fact, there is no Hot taste to it period.  BIG RIP OFF...  The only reason I gave it 1 star is because I could not give it any lower.

column9: Don's Chuck Wagon Mushroom Batter Mix
column10: Directions are very easy to follow and the resulting batter is easy to cook. The resulting fried Mushrooms were very tasty.

Lyle's Golden Syrup can be hard to find in my area. The new squeeze bottle works well. This is a critical ingredient in ANZAC biscuits. This vendor provides excellent service and speedy shipping. Items were perfectly packaged and I received a bonus tea sample with my order.
Lyles Golden Syrup is not only a great replacement of corn syrup, it is great on pancakes or oatmeal. Allergic to corn? Lyles has the answer.
It was not what it was reported to be. It was just plain syrup without the flavor of Cane Sugar. If you want true cane sugar syrup do not buy this product.

column9: Not what I remember, but still tasty...
column10: We used to be able to find this in Phoenix, but it has been out of the area for a long time.  I was very excited to find a case on Amazon and quickly bought one.  It came very quickly and made my husband a happy camper.I read the ingredients list and was disappointed.  I thought it was maple syrup years ago.  Maybe I was mistaken.  This case contains bottles mostly filled with corn syrup and flavorings.  However, it tastes just as good, so maybe that is the original recipe.I just wish that there were some "real" maple ingredients in the syrup.

My older Lhasa Apso is a very fussy eater.  She tended to want dog foods that were not rated as good for her.  I went on line and searched for healthy food and tried some of them.  Until I tried Hills which she loves and begs for more.  Thank you Hills for making a Great Dog Food!

I bought these grains for my boyfriend who needs probiotics but hates the taste of my milk kefir. These grains arrived quickly. As others have noted, the seller is thoughtful. They sent along over a sheet of information on rehydrating and culturing your water kefir. We followed the instructions to the letter, and it took about two weeks for these guys to plump back up. We had placed them in a jar with distilled water, a few drops of Liqumins ConcenTrace Trace Mineral Drops, Low Sodium, 8-Ounce Bottle, and some sugar and placed a lid loosely on the jar. Then we set the jar next to our crock-pot, because these microbes like the warmth. A few days ago, we strained the first batch of water kefir, and I'm happy to report it was a success! My fella said it tasted like apple cider. He's happy with the taste, and I'm happy he's getting the probiotics. We have started experimenting with adding various fruits to see how they alter taste, too.Terrific seller. Healthy kefir grains. You can't go wrong.

These grains came to me quickly and were packaged in sweet little containers. I began my ferment with the grains, water and palm sugar. The kefir turned out marvelous with a sweet taste and the grains plumped up with a golden sparkle.

I drink water kefir every day since I got these grains. They rehydrate in the time frame specified and produce a drink that really benefits your digestive system. The Keysands company (which seems to be just a family working out their home) is really helpful with any questions you email them about. Recommended.

A friend introduced my wife and I to kefir (most people pronounce it like the actor, Kiefer - but if you want to say it right, it's "ke-FEAR"). The grains she gave us were for milk, and we tried them, but got a bit of a tummy upset. Besides, we've been weaning ourselves off all dairy products. My wife read up on the water kefir grains and liked what she saw. The price+shipping gave us pause, but then we figured it was a one-time purchase, after all. The grains multiply, so all you ever need to do is buy them once.She ordered the Keysands organic crystals, and put them to work. We've tried all kinds of fruit juices, producing refreshing, mildly fermented, fizzy drinks - delicious!When I was a kid, my dad loved ginger beer - a non-alcoholic soft drink. We decided to make kefir ginger beer - which does have a little alcohol in the finished product, because kefir grains cause fermentation. We blend raw ginger root, add some sugar to taste (it should be sweet before the kefir does its work). We ferment it in glass gallon jugs to begin with, then transfer it to the Grolsch-type beer bottles (also called "swing-top" bottles) - the ones with the reusable caps that lock down on a wire hinge.1 Liter Round Italian Swing Top Glass BottleThe result is fantastic - a really flavorful kefir drink with all kinds of health benefits - ginger alone is said to cleanse the blood and tune up your digestive system, and the healthy fermentation bacteria kefir produces is said to excellent for your intestines as well.The kefit grains keep on multiplying once you get them going, and you just transfer them from one batch to another.If you're into healthy eating and drinking for you and your loved ones, you won't want to miss out on "water kefir"!Next up for us - kefir beer, a mildly alcohol containing drink, made with real hops and malt. Can't wait! The kefir adventure continues!Recommended.

The shipment arrived relatively quickly (1 week or so), and it came with twice the amount of grains that other places are selling for the same price.It arrived in a bubble envelope with the grains in a sealed plastic bag, with printed out instructions on how to rehydrate the grains and make water kefir. I rehydrated them according to the instructions and by the end of the first 24 hours they were looking rehydrated, by the end  of 48 hours the sugar water solution smelled like fermentation was starting.When fully rehydrated, it comes out to 8Tbs of kefir grains, or enough for 2qts of kefir brewing at one time (more than enough!).EDIT! After one fermentation (using 3T white table sugar and 1T molasses), I now have 11T kefir grains!  The molasses doesn't give the best taste to it, but definately makes healthy grains reproduce. So, if you're wondering if you'll receive healthy grains.... you will.

My husband and I have been enjoying the benefits of dairy-based kefir for a few years now, but maybe I wasn't enjoying it as much as he was, because frankly I don't care for dairy products - they feel heavy to me.  So I decided to give "water kefir" a try, and was thrilled to find out that you can get them online because they can be dried and shipped, unlike the dairy-based kefir grains.These came with very good instructions on how to get started, and it didn't take long at all - maybe two days - for the grains to reconstitute and get active.  Honestly - and maybe it sounds a bit silly, but - it feels like they are now a member of the family.  Members??  Anyway, they and I now  have a nice working relationship and I have successfully made many batches of fruit-flavored kefir that I use for a morning tonic.I was thrilled to find out that the drinks produced are NOT sweet.  I hate sweet drinks.  I suppose you could add sweetener to them if  you wanted to, but why ruin a good drink?  These are just plain refreshing!  And if anything, the probiotic benefits are even greater than those from the dairy-based kefirs (at least, they are for me.)After a couple of weeks in our home, the grains increased enough in size that I was able to drop a few into a gallon of apple juice and produce a really fine hard cider that everyone in the family likes a lot.Now that the grains in the cider have built up a nice population of yeast,  I am experimenting with making beer.  The probiotics produced by the grains prevents non-beneficial bacteria from forming, so that you don't have to be so scrupulous about keeping everything absolutely sterile during the brewing process.  Brewing beer with kefir is MUCH more forgiving than the "regular" way.  My results so far are OK, but I'm still working on finding a recipe that I really like.  (That may be hard to do, because well, let's face it, Guinness is hard to top!)Anyway, I'm so glad I have discovered these grains, and can't wait to learn more.

column9: Great holistic, easy to digest cat food
column10: Cats are strictly carnivores, they're not meant to eat a grain based diet, yet that is primarily what the mainstream cat food manufacturers make their dry cat food with. It causes all sorts of issues with allergies, poor skin and coat condition, and digestive upsets. I have a couple of cats who have a gluten allergy to corn and wheat, any time they eat any dry food containing those they would bloat up and have horrendous bloody diarrhea. One even got a skin allergy and would get an eczema-type condition and scratch bald spots on himself from the itching.My vet recommended this food and it does great for my cats. It's easily digested, high quality protein, and with the "Yucca Schidigera Extract", the litter box smell is reduced greatly. The price on Amazon, even with shipping, beats the one local store that sells it. And the best part is, my cats actually like it day in and day out. My cats no longer have skin allergies or digestive upsets, which makes everyone happier.

Lapsang Souchong - 'Russian Caravan' as it is commonly known - is a truly exceptional Chinese tea, and it is done proper justice by the ladies at Culinary Teas. A generous teaspoon of Lapsang Souchong steeped for about three and a half minutes in roughly 190-200 degree water will yield a strong, flavorful cup of the Fujian Province's most notable tea. What is so respectable about Culinary Teas' Lapsang is that it manages to contain immense flavor with very little of the aftertaste common to lower-grade Lapsang Souchong.But how does it TASTE? The answer is both mysteriously complex and blindingly simple. A quick sniff of the pine-needle-roasted leaves brings forth the aroma of a campfire; this flavor carries well into the brewed tea, creating a strong, smokey aroma and flavor that does not fade as the tea cools. Culinary Teas' evenly fired, full-leaf Lapsang Souchong ought to be placed at the top of any tea enthusiast's shelf as the strongest, most impression-making tea in Culinary's collection. One does not forget the first experience with Lapsang. Do it right by using this brand.

column9: A fine cup of smoky tea
column10: This Lapsang Souchong from Culinary Teas has a rich, complex flavor that surpasses quite a few other brands at a price that is comparable to or better than most.  A pound of loose tea can take a while to get through, though, so this may not be the best choice for someone looking to try smoked tea for the first time.  If you are already a fan of Lapsang Souchong and are looking for a satisfying cup, this is a great find.

column9: Less smoky flavor than some other Lapsang Souchongs
column10: What first attracted me to the Lapsang Souchong variety of tea leaf is the distinct Latakia-like smoky flavor. This particular variety strikes me as unusually light on the smokiness. Granted my experience has so far been limited to the Twinings variety that comes in tea bags and the variety sold by Le Pain Quotidien bakeries. I thought that perhaps letting this tea steep a bit longer might help, but I've found that by the 5 minute point, the tea becomes disappointingly bitter and sour. I guess if you're looking for a more subtle, mild version of Lapsang Souchong this might be perfect.

column9: Tasty Bangers, but shipping/packaging issues detract
column10: Our family loved the breakfast sausages that we had in Ireland, so I wanted to see if I could find them here. Tommy Maloney seems to be the leader in the States.My family and I really enjoyed the Moloney's sausages. Made in NY, they have much the same flavor and texture of the real thing in Ireland. I couldn't taste a difference. Note that these bangers are of the skinny variety -- about finger thickness. They brown up nicely in the skillet and have a satisfying snap when bitten. If you want thicker bangers, Maloney has those as well. We ordered five of the skinny link packages and two 8oz. tubes of the black pudding (also good, if you like black pudding of course).While we love the product, there is room for improvement in shipping. Our first shipment came on time, shipped by 2nd day air. Unfortunately, the meat arrived at a temperature of over 65 degrees Fahrenheit, not a safe temperature, so I had to discard the shipment. I should note that the temperatures in Texas at the time my shipment arrived were over 100 degrees F, and the package sat in the UPS truck all day long before being delivered to me. The meat was shipped in a cardboard box with a reflective bubble-wrap type of insulating bag. Inside of the bag were fully thawed ice packs and four fully-evaporated dry ice bags. The insulation just wasn't up to the challenge.I called Maloney's and received friendly customer service. They promised that they would reship the sausages when they could (they only ship to Texas on Mondays). I requested that they ship with more dry ice and insulation.The replacement package arrived as promised at a safe temperature. Still only one bubble-type insulating bag, but with extra dry ice bags. The dry ice had completely evaporated, but the standard ice packs were still mostly frozen.Maloney's has a great product, but shipping & packaging is critical to their mail-order customers. I'd suggest some improvements. First, consider double bagging the shipments in the bubble wrap or using styrofoam. Both of my shipments had a lot of condensation on the outside of the bubble wrap which made the cardboard box soggy. A lot of condensation on the reflective bubble wrap means that the bag isn't doing a good job insulating. I've had luck getting frozen pizzas and other meats shipped to me in styrofoam boxes with no problems. Styrofoam is probably more expensive, but when shipping in the summer, especially to the South, styrofoam is the right tool for the job. Second, consider using more dry ice; the dry ice isn't surviving for the two-day trip. Third, the plastic containers on three of the five sausage packages were cracked open in shipment. The plastic containers are too brittle to be stacked in a shipping box without some other kind of protection or support (cardboard, perhaps?). The cracked containers meant that juices from the sausages leaked into the bottom of the insulating bag, which made things a bit messy and required me to repackage the sausages for storage. Ultimately though, the sausages were delicious.Summing up, I love the product, and will order it again. If you miss your full Irish breakfast, now you can get it in the States. Customer service is great. Shipping, at least to hot parts of the country, could be improved. I hope that Tommy Maloney takes my suggestions in mind for its future shipments.

These foil covered coins shipped on time and were exactly what was expected. We scattered them on dinner tables at a Casino-themed party and most were happily consumed during the night. A few made their way into the ante but no one seemed to mind. A good value and great decoration.
It did the job. The chips were realistic looking and were a big hit at the party.

column9: Shockingly large volume of poker chips
column10: I bought this as a gag gift.  But then I was agog when I saw how many poker chips came in my order.  A large organization could do a casino night on one bag's worth alone.

My dogs love these and the smaller pieces are more appropriate for my little terrier than a whole pig's ear.  I also like to avoid raw hide since one of my previous dogs had stomach problems with raw hide.  I haven't noticed any issues with the ear pieces.After looking at grocery and the pet store chains, this is a good price in comparison. I paid about $12 for the pound of Grillerz.
Somehow I thought the mint flavor would be more...I don't know...intense!  And I found the same stuff on sale @ Costco for less, so...  I am underwhelmed by this product.

The problem with this Angel Hair Pasta is the texture of the cooked product. I boiled my first box cooking it on the low side of the recommended time on the box and the pasta still came out somewhat gummy. I ate half and saved the other half for the next day. It was still gummy the next day but I managed to eat it anyway. I will continue to experiment with times and see if I can improve on it, but unless I crack this nut, I won't be ordering it again.

I've just recently switched to GF cooking after my doc ran sensitivity tests (soy, milk, peanuts, the usual suspects). Gluten popped positive. Lucky me. Well, as one who still has recent (fond) memories of wheat pasta, believe me when I tell you that this tastes identical! Cook it, RINSE it, and smother with your favorite sauce. It can't be beat. I've tried a bunch of different GF pastas and this is the one I'm ordering in bulk.As with other GF pastas, it should be rinsed after cooking.  Then it's perfect. As a side note, this blend (brown rice with flax) doesn't leave nearly as much starch in my pasta pot as the others do. Not sure why, it's just something I noticed.

DeBoles Gluten Free Angel Hair pasta is great for people with gluten intolerance who don't care for thick spaghetti. My son and husband love it.  It  has a nice texture and good pasta taste.  We like both the angel hair with flax and without.

I've tried all types of GF pastas and since we are limited by other allergies as well we have a limited selection. This spaghetti is awesome. It's really more like normal spaghetti - not the super thin angel hair pasta the name implies. The poster "Lisa" may not know how to properly cook GF pasta, I'm not sure, but when this is cooked and rinsed properly it has the exact same bite, chew and feel as regular gluten-y spaghetti. Well, I guess that's relatively speaking. Nothing tastes as good as wheat pasta IMO but when you're GF this stuff wins in my book!

column9: There are much better gluten free pastas available
column10: This pasta tastes ok, but tends to get mushy VERY easily. If you are looking for a firm, tasty pasta this is NOT it.

I bought this because it seemed healthy, and I am an angel, or fine/thin pasta person.Maybe I need more practice, but even cooked al-dente it seemed chewy and mushy. I'm sure it is a great product, but I guess I am used to a little gluten for bite.  They make great little token gifts, since it is not readily available in this neck of the woods.  I love my Thai thin rice noodles, and get my flax (or omega3) in other ways.  But - hey, it was worth a try.  Just my humble opinion.
This is the best sugar free gum around -- no nutrasweet/aspartame in it & no bad "fake sweetener after taste"

column9: Just what I was looking for
column10: I ordered this gum a few days ago through a subscribe-and-save listing (however, today I glanced at that listing and it looks like that may no longer be an option for folks) and I got 96 pieces (eight 12-piece packs) for about 10 percent less than the price of this 100-piece container when shipping is included.  However, there is a third listing that offers 2 containers of this, which is the best deal of the three, per piece.---I received the gum today and like it better than I had expected to.I only chew 1 piece at a time (the serving size on the box says "2 pieces" and many customers who have rated it under other listings on amazon have said they chew 2 pieces at once) but it is big enough for my purposes.Also, I chew it only for about 15 minutes and the flavor lasts with no problem at all.I mainly wanted this specific gum because of the high percentage of xylitol it contains (because xylitol is good for the health of teeth) and because of its LACK of other stuff (which is in almost all other types of gum) that I don't want like aspartame (nutrasweet), saccharin, sorbitol, mannitol, artificial flavors, artificial colors, etc.---A few years ago I tried two brands of "natural" gum that didn't have any of those ingredients I'm trying to avoid, but they were awful - fell apart in the mouth, tasted bad, contained sugar, etc.So I grudgingly went back to chewing Orbit with xylitol because my dentist told me to chew gum for the sake of my teeth, even though in all other ways I scrupulously avoid aspartame etc.  I limited myself to one piece a day of Orbit because I didn't really want to be ingesting the unwanted stuff.Therefore, I'm really pleased to have found this gum this week.  Because it has the right blend of ingredients for me, even if the flavor had been nonexistent, I would have been happy with it, so I'm extra-pleased that there is a nice mint flavor and that it does last for at least 15 minutes (I only want to chew it for that length of time, so I didn't try it for longer).---Note that this gum is manufactured in Finland and the xylitol is sourced from birch wood [also, it's non-GMO (not genetically modified)], which is not the case with some other up-and-coming brands of xylitol gum, which source their xylitol from China and/or from corn.---Apparently if the mouth has 5 exposures to xylitol a day, its health improves greatly after only a few weeks.(My main concern is to reinforce the enamel of my teeth as much as possible, because they have been sensitive for years and the sensitivity is getting worse with age.)To that end, I'm going to order a 16-ounce package of xylitol crystals/powder soon (I found a cheaper offer on another site than I did here) and mix a little of the powder with water each day in a jar and swish the solution around my mouth a couple of times a day, so I can extend the lifespan of my stock of this expensive gum by chewing it just once or twice a day.If you want to avoid xylitol from China and/or from corn, also take care when purchasing the crystals/powder in either 16-ounce packages or small single-serving packages - I found very few brands that get their xylitol from birch.
This gum was a Godsend for a person like me with a severe dry mouth problem. It is MUCH better than Biotene gum.  I highly recommend all flavors.

column9: Flavor lasts VERY Long!  Best Xylitol gum I've tried so far.
column10: I bought the Peppermint flavor so far and I love it.  I chew it all the time...  People at work tell me I have the freshest breath in the building.  I normally spit regular gum out after just a few minutes, but I can literally chew a piece of this gum for hours without getting sick of it..  I have Spearmint ordered now and will review it when it arrives.  Well worth the money....

I bought this Xylichew Peppermint gum today at my local natural food store--never checked the price of $13.98--wish I did because I hate it. Flavor lasts about 10 seconds--kid you not. If you really want to try it see if it comes in a smaller size before committing to this container of 100. (What was I thinking when I bought it?)

column9: Just what I was looking for
column10: I ordered this gum a few days ago through a subscribe-and-save listing (however, today I glanced at that listing and it looks like that may no longer be an option for folks) and I got 96 pieces (eight 12-piece packs) for about a third less than the price of this 100-piece container when shipping is added in.  However, there is a third listing for two 100-piece containers which appears to be the best deal of the three, for cost per piece of gum.---I received the gum today and like it better than I had expected to.I only chew 1 piece at a time (the serving size on the box says "2 pieces" and many customers who have rated it under other listings on amazon have said they chew 2 pieces at once) but it is big enough for my purposes.Also, I chew it only for about 15 minutes and the flavor lasts with no problem at all.I mainly wanted this specific gum because of the high percentage of xylitol it contains (because xylitol is good for the health of teeth) and because of its LACK of other stuff (which is in almost all other types of gum) that I don't want like aspartame (nutrasweet), saccharin, sorbitol, mannitol, artificial flavors, artificial colors, etc.---A few years ago I tried two brands of "natural" gum that didn't have any of those ingredients I'm trying to avoid, but they were awful - fell apart in the mouth, tasted bad, contained sugar, etc.So I grudgingly went back to chewing Orbit with xylitol because my dentist told me to chew gum for the sake of my teeth, even though in all other ways I scrupulously avoid aspartame etc.  I limited myself to one piece a day of Orbit because I didn't really want to be ingesting the unwanted stuff.Therefore, I'm really pleased to have found this gum this week. Soft gum, good for my teeth, doesnt turn hard, not hard on my teeth, high in Xylitol, I actually allow my kids to have some... no complaints!!! Worth the money
A natural gum with real peppermint flavoring, not that fake stuff in commercial gums.

column9: Yellow Labs - the Ultimate Chewing Test
column10: Loquat and Leonard are brother and sister labs. I've been searching for the perfect edible chew toy since they were born (perfect= lasts an hour or so, dogs like the taste, inexpensive).The Himalayan chews got 1 out of 3 in my rating system. While the dogs clearly enjoyed their yaky goodness, my more chewy dog ate hers in under 10 minutes. She's a monster, granted. My other dog took his leisurely time licking the treat and lightly chewed it until it, too, was gone in under an hour. To give you a better picture, my dogs are both around sixty pounds and are under a year old.The chew toys that we've found work are hooves (cheap, but super stinky) and braided bullysticks. They last about as long as these crazy Himalayan cheese sticks, but they're like a dollar each (look for them online or at Costco).Final verdict, if I were rich, my dogs would get Himalayan dog chews, imported Spanish silver dog dishes, Italian wool beds and personal massage therapists. But as it stands, I can barely afford Ikea for even myself so hooves it is!

This is the best chew ever.  My dog won't put it down and they last a really long time.  The first time I gave her one she immediately ran away with it and hid it, now that's the sign of a good bone!  They are also all natural and good for your dog's teeth.

We had originally loved this Himalyan chew bone for our GSD.  She is about 8 months old, but she is one powerful chewer.  We got her a large bone, and at first, it took her a little while to get through it, but the last one we gave her (probably our 4th or 5th one now), she swallowed chunks of it and puked those up later on, and we had to get x-rays to make sure nothing was blocking her intestinal tract.Pros - GSD loved it, can last a while.Cons - Due to her powerful jaw and teeth, she can bite off chunks and swallow them.So, long story short, we no longer give these to her!  Peanut butter filled hooves it is!

My dog loved this treat, and it took days for her to get through it.  However, once she was 2/3 of the way through the bone, she swallowed the remiander.  She seemed fine until 4 days later, she vomited up the entire piece of the bone in tact.  This sat in her stomach for 4 days and was not digested one bit.  Fine for a chew toy but not for consumption.
Bought one of these for my Vizsla - She loved it, but went through half of it in a an hour or so and ended up throwing up breakfast, and later lunch.

column9: This review is actually written by my dogs!
column10: These treats are great! They're yummy! They have such a perfect consistency, not too hard, not soft at all. They don't get gummy when they're chewed for awhile so mom doesn't mind picking them up after they've been chewed on for a bit. Sometimes she has to do that 'cause we get obsessed with chewing them on occasion and we just won't put them down! (OK, I admit, that's me..."Banshee". I am a Himalayolic but I don't need help. I just need more Himalayan Dog Chews and mom found them at Amazon.com for the best price anywhere!)These treats are hard and crunchy and stay that way, they only get a tiny hint of softness as chewed. We have to work at it but small pieces flake off and we get our tasty reward! They make great dental bones because they have more flavor and have stiff edges to help rub along our teeth and break off the tarter. Oh, and they don't have the foul odor of hoof chewies or some others. Mom and dad gag when we chew hoofies but they love the Himalayan Chews.Did I say they are great? Well I meant they are outstanding! They are wonderful and all three of us love them so much that on occasion we have fought over them. That's because "Zac" likes to horde them and tries to hide them all. He's stopped that now since mom worked with him. That's great because now she can leave 4-5 out, (more than the number of dogs is smart), without worry of a fight.One warning is that you should watch your dog as they get down near the end of the chew. "Li" is a real aggressive eater and when he gets to that last inch he'll swallow it whole! One of these times I'm worried it may get stuck in his intestine and require surgery since I'm uncertain how well a large chunk will be digested. Regular chunks appear to be fully digested since it never hurts going poddy and mom never complains about chunks in our poops, BOL (Bark out loud).We've been receiving these fine treats since they first came on the market and we've had no trouble. We (mostly) are average to above average chewers with lots of experience with these chews and we'd recommend you try them with your dogs. Like any chew, you should stick around and observe us as we chew but for light to moderate chewers you might be watching for hours and even then we may not finish one since it's highly dependent on the aggressiveness of the chewer. Crazy mad chewers like "Li" have been known to bite down on even the large ones and snap it in two, which is great 'cause then I get another one! Our mom watches us well and picks the chews up when she cannot watch us. I think that's smart for ALL chews. Now, go on! What are you waiting for? Go buy some for "Max" and "Hannah"!

Yes, Himalayan Dog Chews aren't cheap.  Yes, some dogs won't like them.  Yes, some dogs will devour them in a few days (must have jaw muscles of STEEL!).  I gave my Siberian Husky grandpuppy a Himalayan Dog Chew summer of 2010.  I thought I'd get him another one for Christmas, but my daughter said he's still gnawing on the first one.Try it.  For most dogs, they will LOVE it.  For many dogs, it will last for months and months. Some crazed dogs will devour it in a few hours, still loving every minute of it - and some dogs will walk away wondering why you bothered.  But if YOUR dog is in the first 2 categories, it's a major treat.Go to the website and read the reviews.  It's very clear that some dogs chow them down and other savor every minute.  It's my grandpuppy's favorite toy/chew.

My older Lab mix was not interested in this chew. My German Shepherd took his immediately and hid it somewhere. Then he tried to steal the other one from the Lab. Kind of pricey but some dogs love them!

I have two large dogs (55lbs, and 85lbs), one picky and one will eat anything and they BOTH went crazy for these! When I first gave them these chews they were SO excited they didnt want to eat them! Eventually they got over it and really enjoyed these bones! Glad amazon has them!
Your Dog or Puppy will not be able to chew this one up quickly. The only product out there that will keep that puppy busy for at least three weeks.

column9: On the fence about this one
column10: I bought a package with 2 or 3.  I had a hard time finding my girl a chew that she enjoyed that wasn't edible or would at least last longer than 10 minutes.  Although my girl is a medium size dog, she is one powerful chewer, she can devour the largest Buzy Bone in under 30 minutes. So, I thought she might enjoy these, she did have minimal interest and would chew on it maybe a couple of minutes after she saw the cat licking it once in awhile, but then would leave it.  I started fostering a chihuahua pup, he found them and fell in love with them. So, of course now that my girl saw he liked them she had decided after all this time she needed just to go a head and eat one.  Now she has thrown up twice so far and what was in the vomit was the pieces of the chew.  After all the searching I did to find something, it was a 3 dollar hollow white bone, that doesn't seem to splinter, at Petsmart.  I put a spoon full of a wet food in there for a treat, she will grab that bone quite frequently and stay occupied for up to 30 minutes just chewing, she still has the original bone, plus a new one.  That's what I wanted, just something she enjoyed chewing without feeling like she was getting too much junk food.

With all the tainted meat dog treats in the stores lately, I started looking for a long lasting dog chew.  My terriers love this and it keeps them from chewing up valuable stuff around the house.  The medium chew lasts about a week (at least with my chewers) and when it gets down to a small size where you worry it might be a chocking hazard, just put it in the microwave for a minute and it puffs up like a hard cracker that they can chew on like dog food.Also, it is not a meat product so my dogs don't fight over this treat like they do the bones.

column9: Large Himalayan dog bone - arrived broken
column10: I recently bought one of these at a local pet store and my dog went crazy for it. It lasted a few days with chewing about an hour at a time. So when I saw this product on Amazon for $2 cheaper I jumped on it. The reason I only gave it 3 stars was I ordered 2 of the large bones one was fine and the other arrived broken in half. It is not a cheap bone and they should ship it with more packaging to make sure it does not break during shipping. I am a little apprehensive to give the broken one to my dog as she tends to swallow smaller pieces whole and I do not want her to choke on it.

column9: Excellent product, but they shipped the wrong size
column10: My dog adores these chews.  They are long lasting, don't splinter, don't stain carpeting or furniture, etc.The price here is much better than at my local high-end dog boutique, but I ordered 4 of the medium-dog-sized chews and they substituted 4 large-dog-sized chews instead.  They are too big for my pup :(

column9: Finally, something he doesn't get bored with!
column10: My 30-lb. Canaan dog mix came from a rescue with an unknown history and still doesn't really know how to play with toys. We've given him stuffed bones, hooves, and antlers, and as soon as he got out the good parts, he'd ignore the rest of the chew. Right away, when he got this chew, it became his favorite thing in the world -- he carries it around with him everywhere, takes it to bed, and was even smart enough to drop it in his water bowl to try to soften it up (that took most of the color out, but it must not have hurt the flavor because he seems even more interested in it now). Better yet, he seems content to sit a room away from me and chew it for hours, which has helped a lot with his separation anxiety. It's down to just a nub now, but I'll definitely be stocking up on more! So glad to finally find something he'll play with like a normal dog!

We first got this bone at a family friend's dog store - they tend to stock all natural, very healthy product. When I initially asked for a bully stick, I was given a little education on what exactly makes up a bully stick....needless to say I haven't bought one since! I was instead shown these Himalayan Dog Chews - what immediately caught my attention were the ingredients. Yak Milk? Lime Juice? Salt? I have to say, I wasn't too sure my pup would be into this, but boy was she ever! The unfortunate thing about these bones is that they crumble, and crumble BIG TIME. What we've started doing with them, though, is giving them to her outside when we are trying to relax at a park w/ a good book or are up on our roof-deck and need something to keep her occupied. They are magical for that purpose! She is a 30lb. pup and it takes her quite a while to get through a medium size bone. I would highly recommended them for this purpose if you want to treat your pet to a delish bone but want to avoid the huge mess in your home that they tend to leave behind!

My dog doesn't digest rawhide, and I found out the hard way that her body doesn't digest the elk antler chew toys. The Himalayan dog chew was a great alternative. She's a small breed dog, but I give her the 2.5 oz chew, because it lasts longer and keeps her busy. She'll spend up to an hour at a time chewing on it. When she's chewing on something she shouldn't, I give her the himalayan chew as an alternative. It's all natural, and Jozi easily digests the chew. Great product.

column9: not what I was hoping for
column10: my dog is a 3 yr old 70lb American bulldog/German shepherd mix. after buying the thicker 12 inch bully sticks for her I wanted to try something that might last longer. (she goes through a 12 inch bully stick in about 20 mins.) I also wanted something that would be good for her teeth. I started w the large bone but she got down to half of it in about 15 mins. i had read that its not a good idea to feed one that's  too large for your dogs size because it could fracture their teeth but i decided to try xl bone anyway (i think it says 80 ir 90+ lbs on the pckg) shes chewed on some pretty hard things before with no issues. but the XL (19.99 where i bought it) she managed to bite chunks off of so I had to take that away and trade her for a bully stick because I was concerned about her trying to swallow the large pieces. I'm sad it didn't work out for us because it is healthy and definitely would have been good for scraping her teeth. back to bulky sticks we go.

An excellent product, and of course, my dogs loves it.  It seems to last a long time, as she has just started to wear down the edges after constant chewing.  Not messy and has no odd odor.  Does not stain her hair or whatever she happens to chew it on.  A bit pricey, but since it seems to last a very long time for her, I will purchase again.

We have a 3 year old German Shepherd / Australian Shepherd mix and we had yet to find a chew toy that she would use at all.  She has some separation anxiety, so I was hoping that this would be something we could toss into her crate for her to enjoy for a couple of hours if we left the house.I ordered this 3 days ago & got it today!  When I gave it to Pixie, she paced around the house with it in her mouth for a few minutes - I don't think she really even knew what to do with it!  Finally, she flopped down onto the floor and held it between her paws and went to town.  She chewed HARD for about an hour and it still looks almost brand new.  When she went to get a drink, I grabbed it and put it away for another time.Then I logged into to Amazon & ordered the XL size.  I'm thrilled!

I gave this to my dog, hoping I found a bone that can slightly satisfy him. He finished a large in about 20 min. He puked it up along with half his tooth. He was fine until I gave him the chew. I had to spend 500 to get the rest of his tooth removed.

Both our Havanese puppies like to chew these dog chews.  We had purchased one but it broke in half due to a fall on tile.  That made it less desirable because a small piece is harder for them to hold in their paws.  We now have two longer pieces and each one can chew one.  Although my dogs are much smaller than 20 lbs, the length of this size is preferable than the shorter pieces.  They can chew many hours to wear down the pieces we have.  The teeth marks can be seen but the size decreases very slowly. I have not seen any pieces breaking off that could be choking hazards or bowel obstruction hazards.  We do monitor their chewing of anything, however. To give an idea of their chewing capacity, the 8 month old can take down about 1/2 inch of flossie in about 15 minutes. The price is worth the chewing time for us.  I do not allow them free access because the older dog has a tendency to hide things and we grew tired of rushing around the house searching for the second chew when both wanted to chew.

My dog had an unusual reaction with this one.  She hid this item twice while she normally consumes edibles immediately.  She was guarding it with her life, so she must have known it would be good.  I finally smeared some peanut butter on it and she settled in for a chew.  I have a beagle that's a little bit of a power chewer.  She worked on this chew for about 2 hours straight, leaving a small nub perhaps an inch long.  I'm sure she'll be back for the nub later.  I don't expect it to take much more than a half hour or an hour to finish the nub, so this chew yields around 3 hours of quiet time for us :)  While I was hoping for longer, this is a record in terms of edible chews.  If my dog were not possessive I would likely put it out for a smaller chewing break and then put it away for later.  I may try the chews for smaller dogs next time as I don't believe these are meant to be eaten in one sitting.Also, check out the (short!) ingredient list.  My dog is allergic to just about everything but this chew contains none of usual offenders.  It's basically made of milk.Two downers for me would be the price and the sound effects.  It sounds like teeth are breaking in there, although I don't think any harm was done and haven't seen any reports of breaking teeth with these chews.  Still, it's a little nerve-wracking to listen to.  I do anticipate buying these again for an occasional treat.

I was hoping to find another good chew for my puppy.  Initially she wasn't too interested in it but every once in a while I'll catch her gnawing on it.  She's a small dog and I'd think that this is a little too big for her but she has a few bully sticks almost as thick (she definitely likes them better).

column9: Yak bone made my dog YAK!
column10: Made my dog yak, but he certainly enjoyed it otherwise.  Me, not too much!  He seems to be able to tolerate the bone if he doesn't "eat" it and bite off chunks.  It doesn't smell like rawhide can and it is soft for the puppy teeth and gums.

This is hardened yak and cow  cheese which means a very high level of protein for your dog. Mine could have finished this in one day if I left it. He definitely likes it but it has to be monitored to make sure he doesn't eat the whole thing at one time

My Goldendoodle wouldn't touch one of these when offered repeatedly, nor would my neighbors dog or my friends dog.  Don't waste your money just because it is unique or you may well end up throwing them in the trash, as I did. They are too expensive just for garbage and the shipping is too high and all for naught.Thankfully, I only bought two.  Customer Service: extremely rude and overly condescending.

column9: To the customer that left a review
column10: You are ridiculous. Water that is alkaline is not going to cause your throat to burn, give you acid reflux OR send you to the hospital. Nothing about what you said even made an ounce of sense.

column9: My batch was a very low Ph.
column10: I'm hoping I just got a bad batch, because my test barely registered this above 7.0 Ph (see image I uploaded). I will be purchasing Essentia and Alka Pure from now on (The Essentia tested at 9.0 / The AlkaPure at 9.5). Neo water folks, feel free to send me a new batch to make up for the 50 BUCKS I SPENT ON YOUR LOW PH WATER. Might as well have bought Deer Park.

column9: Neo  water  9.5 ph ordered on Amazon.com
column10: I don't think it was the water to blame.  I think I just didn't research it well enough before I ordered it.  The ph 9.5 burned my throat, and sent me to the emergency room thinking I was dying of something respiratory.  The doctor said it was similar to a bad case of bronchitis and reflux.  He didn't know I drank a bottle of 9.5 ph alkaline water.  I think the 9.5 ph was just too strong.  I should have ordered 8.0 I think.  I also wasn't sure it was the water that caused my symptoms.  When I got home I started putting it all together.

The most delicious gummy candy out there. Forget about the artificial ingredient laden store candy, this is the real deal.Also the fact that it comes individually rapped makes it extremely convenient. Well worth the value.

column9: Betty Crocker Gluten Free Brownie Mix
column10: If you love chocolate you will love this mix. The only problem I have with cooking this mix is it will cook faster on the edges and slower in the middle, but this is common cooking gluten free mixes (bought or home made) and you learn to adapt cooking different gluten free foods.  I love my brownies a little moist in the middle so this works great for me.  I just had to learn how to set the oven so the brownies would not over cook on the edges and yet be just right in the middle.  Do I continue to purchase this brownie mix, Yes I do and I do recommend it.  Just remember as with all gluten free cooking it is a learning process at first so don't be discouraged if the first batch isn't just the way you want; take notes and keep trying because if you love chocolate you will love this mix.

column9: Gluten Free Brownies are better than those containing Gluten
column10: These brownies are moist and delicious just like we have come to expect from Betty Crocker.  They are the best tasting gluten free mixes I've found yet.

This mix was my first adventure into gluten free baking, and they turned out PERFECTLY. I actually think they are better than regular brownies. Rich, moist, and decadent, even my gluten-eating friends couldn't get enough.

Yes, you need to play with the liquid amount and your cooking time... But hey! Once you get those things pinned down, it is well worth it. The flavor is absolutely the best for any GF treat I have come across. You can either make according to directions, or play with it a little to enhance it further. I added mascarpone cheese (and reduced some of the butter) to this to make it even more rich and yummie. And the cooked texture is not like most GF mixes. It is solid and cakey versus sandy and crumby. I just talked myself into going to bake some more!!!! Enjoy!
This mix turned out brownies as delicious as the regular mix. Texture was great too - not cake like - but chewy.

column9: Remember "real" brownies before the gluten-free days?  Well...
column10: My wife learned to make gluten free brownies about 20 years ago (I thought I'd gone to heaven with those and pizza - entirely lacking for more than 10 years at that point).  She's made them from scratch, used various mixes (some not so good, some great), but this is about as close to what "real" brownies tasted like in my pre-gluten free days.  And if Amazon is out of them, there are other sources at reasonable prices (Wal-Mart in many locations, for example).  I still prefer Amazon, of course - no tax, no shipping if over $25, etc.  There is not much more to say - these are GREAT!  Just as with many gluten free items, they don't stay as moist as "regular" (gluten-containing) brownies, so they won't last quite as long.  But it'll likely be difficult not to finish them all in a couple of days anyway, so that hasn't been a problem.Note: we won't give 5 stars unless we consider a product at the top of the "best" list.  This is more than just a very good product.  Gluten free?  You'll love these!  Family of gluten free relatives?  You'll hardly be able to tell the difference if at all.  Just enjoy.
One dessert I serve to everyone regularly. They all seem to love it and are surprised to learn that the brownies are gluten-free.
These are so delicious and so easy to make. Just add 2 eggs and some butter, mix and bake.Packages like these help my life.
We have recently switched to a gluten free lifestyle for my son.  I love these brownies.  They are fast and easy.  They also taste very good!

column9: A gluten-free product that tastes like the original!
column10: Since my husband has celiac disease we are always looking for great gluten-free products.  This fits the bill.  It tastes just like original brownies and they are so easy to make.  Kudos to General Mills/Betty Crocker for finally creating products and re-formulating their cereals to make them gluten-free.

I have been so bummed since I was diagnosed with Celiac.  So many bread and cake items are so crumbly and smell... let's just say "unpleasant".  These are fantastic!
