My dog swallowed it whole within 30 seconds of giving it to her and choked on it.  She was fully unconscious before I could dislodge the bone and breathe into her nose to bring her back to life... We almost lost her over this bone.  If your dog is a greedy chewer or eater, then please don't buy edible Nylabones.

Boy our dogs go crazy for these treats, I buy the regular sized ones and cut them into thirds, they are easy to cut and our dogs are small Yorkies so the third portion is perfect for a treat. They are good for their teeth too. We have one 12 year old and her teeth are perfect. They are one of our dogs favorite treats that we buy. Your dog will love the flavor and they are made in the USA. Can't beat that, just wish they were a bit cheaper.

column9: Too expensive & made my dog puke!
column10: My German Shepherd is incredibly picky when it comes to treats... So I was incredibly excited that he was finally happy about a toy I had given him.I, however, was not happy that it only took him 8 minutes to eat the entire thing.I was also not happy when he puked the entire thing up (and his dinner) 12 hours later at 4AM... Customer reviews are pretty consistent that this product is too expensive for what it is, and is making the dogs sick.I would never recommend this product to anyone, and will be informing my fellow dog rescue colleagues never to buy this product.

column9: If you love your pet don't buy!
column10: Fed to dog and she got violently sick and vomited the whole this up after eating it. Don't buy this product if you love your pet!!Nylabone Healthy Edibles Bone, Roast Beef Flavored with Vitamins, Regular Size, Triple Pack
... but it's gone in 60 seconds :-).  Considering the cost of the bone and how fast it disappears I will only be buying intermittently,
Our black lab devoured this thing in 10 minutes, and at $6 a pop, that's way too much money for a dog treat.  Don't bother getting this.

I paid $7.99 for the colossal sized one I got my Great Pyrenees puppy.  In less than 7 minutes she had eaten the entire thing.  I cannot afford to entertain my dog for more than $1 a minute.  She loved it, but I will not purchase this product again.  My girl is actually very gentle with her toys too.  At 11 months old, she has yet to destroy a single one of her stuffed toys.  If it's an edible chew toy though, I've found nothing that can stand up to her jaws.

This bone is nothing more than a big dog treat.  I have a 2 yr old Pit who ate through the souper in 5 minutes.  After reading other reviews I took it away from him and will save the rest for a later date.  I was hoping for a bone that would last a little bit longer as a chew toy and not just be eaten like a treat.  Will not be buying this again.

column9: If you know what you are buying, these are great.
column10: Let me start off by saying I love these. My dog gets so excited when he gets one of these. These are not durable and go away within an hour or two, but they are meant to. These are not meant to be for a teething puppy or for a chew toy that lasts. These are supposed to be super special treats that you give your dog once in a blue moon (Like if you are leaving to go on a trip). Yes, they are expensive, but for a reason. They are made in the U.S. and for those of you that do not know, it is healthier to get treats from the U.S. if you can. They are also healthy. One Dentastix is about 300 calories and I read many reviews saying it gave their dog diarrhea and made them sick. Yes there is a review saying this made their dog sick, but he probably ate it too fast. Your dog may need to be watched while eating these. These are meant for a treat and not a bone that lasts. But my dog loves them and that makes me happy!

My puppy is teething so I had previously purchased the original Nylabone made out of flavored plastic. The dog loved it, not super excited about the regular bone but she did put a lot of work into destroying it. When she finally finished the original plastic bone I decided to go back to the store and grab some more. I was looking around and came across these, "natural," flavored bones and thought.... "SWEET!!! Same great bone but easier to digest!" How wrong I was. First off this is NOTHING like the plastic teething bones. They crumble easily... and by easily I mean my 3.5 month old Wheaten Terrier destroyed these in less than 30min, and she's only about 15 pounds right now. They are recommended for dogs 6 months + with pretty much a full set of permanent teeth because they can shred the bone more easily and to a finer debris. For my dog this was BS... she destroyed these into tiny little flakes that can be easily digested AND managed to get them all over her underbelly and tangled in her fur. The mess wasn't an issue.. the durability was. This is basically an expensive treat, I much rather give her bullysticks over this as a treat (and they last longer). If your dog is teething, this is def NOT the Nylabone version you want. Stick to the original plastic flavored bones or frozen towels. Both work great.

I was under the impression when I bought this at our local pet supply store (based on salesperson's advice) that this bone, while edible, would take several days of working on to be consumed.  Great.  It's a little pricey, but I have a teething 5 month old puppy who has recently been spayed; she can't get her regular course of exercise so I bought this as a nice treat to help keep her occupied in her restless state.  I took it away from her (mad dog!) after 45 minutes.  Just one end was left.  I had bought her the largest "souper" size.  After reading the other reviews, I count myself lucky that she got that much time out of it.  Yes it's a "treat", but at $6, it's a treat I cannot afford to give her very often.  Health wise it's not a treat I could make a habit of feeding often; I feel I have to give my puppy less dinner tonight to make up for the large amount of calories she just wolfed down.  I hope that it doesn't make her sick as it did another reviewer's dog.  I could take her kong, put a spoonful of kibble in it, break up a slice of cheese and shove it in there, stick the whole thing in the microwave for a few seconds to get the cheese melty, let it cool down, and THAT will take her a good 15 minutes to manage to get out.  All for a LOT less money.  That said, I give it 0 stars for value, 5 for "my dog loved it".  It gets a 2 overall from me and I probably would not buy again, nor would I recommend to a friend.

column9: Once in a while special treat
column10: My 9 month old 45 lb pit bull is an avid chewer who has and will eat just about anything he can find, including my hard wood floors.. while picking up bird food I grabbed one of these relieved that at least when he devoured it he wasn't eating chunks of plastic and hence wouldn't get mad when I had to take it away and throw it in the trash.  I came home, read a magazine, he sat quietly on the sofa beside me happily chewing and by the time I had finished my magazine he had finished his bone.  While certainly not a long lasting chew it is something I'd pick up again when I get bird food since I know he enjoys it.  I used to buy the stuffed regular bones but then I'd end up with him wanting to play fetch with the empty bone and would end up throwing it away so at least I know this isn't something that months later i'm stepping on getting out of bed.
My dog chewed it up & made it disappear in about 5 minutes, while I was emptying the box. He definitely likes it but its a little costly to go so fast.
The product was exactly as described.  Wolf is Healthy Edible's code for large.  I do wish that this vendor would sell more than 9 units of this item at a time.

I wish I had read the other two reviews here. I picked this up at a local store for about 6 bucks. My dog just ate half of it in 5 minutes and would be done with it now if I had not taken it away. And he is only 5 months old...so an older bigger dog could destroy this even quicker. I can't believe they actually sell these...at that price at least. He absolutely loved it and is quite mad I took it away...but not worth the money.

As the initial reviewer stated, the biggest issue with this product is its durability, or lack thereof.With the Nylabone brand name on it and a price approaching $10 you might be under the impression that this will last quite awhile.  I timed how long it took my dog to eat the largest one they make (the one shaped like a fist).  It took him 11 minutes to leisurely eat and about 2 minutes to 'clean up' the mess.  If he were actually hungry he probably could have done it a few minutes faster.  So, almost a dollar a minute for this product when viewed as an entertainment/chew toy product.  It's possible to get them for about half price from some of the amazon vendors but this only makes sense when buying large quantities due to the expense of shipping on small orders from them.I was hoping this might last awhile and be better for him than the 'plastic' Nylabone products which exit the dog in solid chunks (eww!).My dog thoroughly enjoyed this but at these prices I can't justify it.

I do NOT recommend these.  My six month old Golden Retriever, who is not a strong chewer, devoured this in less than five minutes.  It is a very expensive treat and I'm just hoping we don't have to pay a vet bill on top of the price of the Edible Nylabone.  I will never buy these again!!!

Great concept  & look forward to using the salt brick one day. If you decide to buy, insist on sufficient packaging. Although customer service tried to fill the order twice, brick arrived cracked or damaged due to insufficient packaging & weight of brick.

I grilled some salmon on this for the first time.  It was incredible tasting. My wife was sceptical when it arrived in the Amazon box.  However, now the proof is delivered in the taste of the fish.  I look forward to trying Chicken on the salt stone.  Make sure you give the salt stone 10 min on the grill to heat up before you apply the meat.

column9: Just like the ones in Belgium!
column10: I fell in love with the taste of Biscoff in Belgium, where they're called "speculaas" and bear no resemblance to the windmill cookies we know in the US.  In Belgium, they serve one or two cookies with every cup of coffee or tea.  When my stash from Belgium ran out, I remembered enjoying Biscoff on USAir, and found them online. These are individually packaged just like the ones on the airline or in the Belgian cafe.  The packaging, though wasteful, works well to keep them fresh if you're trying to make them last.

Rarely do I find a cookie outside of my own kitchen that I would assign 5 stars, but Biscoff is one truly deserving of a minimum of 5 stars!  Crunchy, sweet with a lovely caramel and butter finish, this is a cookie worth booking a flight for!  Better yet, log on and get your fix here.
I tasted them aboard KLM, kept the wrapper, and ordered them online when I again found the wrapper six months later. As delicious as I remember!

I first had these "treasures" aboard a flight on Delta airlines. These cookies really pack an incredible amount of flavor into their "unassuming" crisp exterior. Normally I would pretty much ignore a crisp cookie. These are crisp BUT buttery, sweet, subtly spiced and literally melt-in-your-mouth. with a cup of coffee DIVINE!( I also kept the wrapper to order online) however I can find them in the International section of Meijer and most other grocery stores. The Biscoff spread on top of a toasted English muffin or a Walker's shortbread cookie is nirvana! Enjoy!

column9: Biscoff, not a cake but a true cookie!
column10: I first tasted Biscoff cookies on a flight from California.  Wow!  This is what cookies are supposed to be, crispy,sweet,and full of pure flavor.  So often people call a flat round cake-like product a cookie.  If I want cake I will eat cake.  When I want a cookie it should be crispy.  Biscoff fills the bill.
These cookies are a great mid-afternoon snack. Not too sweet and very satisfying. And because they're individually wrapped, very convenient to keep in my desk drawer at work. Highly recommended.
This mix taste like you have cooked for hours.  It is delecious and i havebeen buying it for years.

column9: A wonderful, high quality food that is great for the cat!
column10: My cat has serious food allergies. She used to wheeze and breathe loudly--and was also bloated from my misguided, if well intentioned, attempts to feed her a very good quality chicken-based food (*see my other reviews for this brand.)Now, the food was excellent, but poor kitty was allergic to chicken. The vet put her on a veterinary diet that was supposed to be rabbit but seemed to be mostly vegetable. I tried the Nature's Logic Rabbit Dinner instead and the results have been phenomenal. The cat eats it with enthusiasm, has lost a pound, has a coat that is sleek and shiny, and her wheezing and bloated appearance are a thing of the past.Rabbit is an excellent food for cats since it is close to their natural prey (I call it 'uptown mouse')This is an outstanding brand of cat food made by people who seem to really care about what the cats eat. I am very pleased with the product and can recommend it very highly--and so can the cat!

It might be OK for small young cats who will eat about anything, but my large older cats ignored it after the first few bites, perhaps because the size, shape and texture of the individual bits is wrong for them. The bits are very small, hard,  and have pointed tips, perhaps making them uncomfortable to chew. My adult cats go for the kinds of dry food that have much larger and rounder chunks.

column9: Rabbit dry and canned is their favorite!
column10: The food this company makes is the closest I can find to raw until I actually get to feed mine raw more often. The value is amazing... actually because it is so dense with nutrients, my cats eat less and I spend less feeding them this brand of food than the other premium brands I was feeding them before.The Rabbit flavor is a favorite. I give them a bit of the dry here and there, but mostly wet. The kibbles are actually rounded and triangular. I am not sure what another reviewer received but it sounds nothing like what the product I have been getting looks like.My cats love this kibble! Their coats are magnificent! Their stools are small and odorless, similar to what it would look like if they were on a raw diet. My oldest cat who had mild digestive issues doesn't have them anymore. Hooray! I also noticed that while on this brand of food, the crusty sleepies in their eyes are just about non-existent. I hardly have to groom their faces anymore. And they are so active I can hardly believe they have that much energy for their ages.I honestly believe that having no synthesized vitamins makes a world of difference. I had to go back to my old brand of kibble for a short time because I was waiting for my next Nature's Logic order to arrive. On their old brand the cats were producing so much extra waste and it wasn't nearly as healthy-looking. The difference really is amazing. There is no doubt to me the Nature's Logic foods are truly easy to digest and the nutrients are absorbed and used! I hope they continue to grow and the product becomes more well known and available.Pros : Improves Coat, Increased Activity, Good Value, Likes It, All Natural, Good Taste, Nutritional, Easy To Digest, Odorless StoolsCons : Few Flavor Selections

I ordered the pecans through Amazon in time for Thanksgiving at what I thought was a good price, in a bundle of three bags. Thus I was horrified when the pecans arrived as only one bag (out of three). I immediately e-mailed the company (from my private acct) with a scathing message, and they handled my ire very well. As it turned out, had I checked my b'ness e-mail first, I would've learned a day before that they ran out of stock, were refunding my purchase price and shipping charges, and sending me the pecans as a "we're so sorry" concession (gratis). Sure, I had to buy more pecans at a brick and mortar store (inconvenience, higher cost), but the pecans they sent were fresh, sweet, well packaged, and Soap.inc's customer service was excellent. I'm only taking a star off because they should have been on top of their inventory--but I understand that what they offer on their own website comes in different quantities than what's offered on Amazon. I wouldn't hesitate to order from this company again.

this is my new favorite brand of raw pecans, nothing added just the way i like them. These are dated well ahead into 2012 and I love the taste, WOW QUALITY!!! Wish they would make larger packages, I would like double the amount. thank you for keeping this avail.
Got them fast. They were all double sealed/packaged, independently. I used some for trail mix, and candied and dehydrated the rest for salads.

Another great British Heinz product. No additives, but only the simple ingredients. It's nothing special Potato & Leek Soup, but home made taste, which I value most. What I usually do is to use a can of this and add broth and milk to make it in double the amount. I'll add freshly cut potatoes and green onions to the soup for more volume. As a matter of fact, you can add pretty much anything you want to make it a bigger batch!

I bought this to have on the shelf for a quick meal.  It is very very rich and I suspect would fare better as a cup appetizer before a full meal, and not as a meal.  I think most people would enjoy it.  I am not certain, however, that I will repeat the purchase.  I think I am more satisfied with a homemade potato soup.

This soup is tasty and arrived just fine with one small dent on a can.  I would expect a dent or two.  The soup is not as good as I anticipated and I may not order it again.  However, it is a very nice change for something different.  I added fresh sauteed leeks to one can and it did wonders.

My local grocery store had this product at one time, but I couldn't get them to order it again.  I ordered from Amazon because the soup is so good, I really wanted it for winter.  It was delivered promptly, and I have enjoyed it since.  It is creamy with a wonderful onion/potato taste.  Taste is a lot like my grandmother's soup.
I love this soup. Very hard to find in Florida. Thank You Amazon for stocking it

The soup is fine, it's the same soup we used to eat back in England which is why I ordered it. I was disappointed opening the package to find that every singe tin had been dented in, some in multiple places. As nothing else in the same box showed that kind of damage, I am forced to conclude that I was sent a package of pre-dented cans of soup.

This only has 3gr fat a serving.  That's not too bad for something that tastes so good.  This is very creamy and thick.  It has little bits of potato and leek that you can see.  This is also good in recipes where you might use a condensed soup.  I've use in in two different dishes I've baked.  Simple quick recipe: 1 bag of those sliced potatoes you get in the dairy case, one can of this soup and some bacon bits on top.  Bake at 350 for 1 hour.  Easy scalloped potatoes.

This soup is GREAT! I am a Celiac and finding good, creamy, gluten free soup is a challenge. This soup rivals the taste of the Potato & Leek soup served at Epcot Center in the England restaurant. My husband who is not gluten free also just loves this soup. Also makes a great meal by pouring over chicken breasts, baking and serving over rice.

column9: Soup is good, cans are dented.
column10: This is nice soup, however 7 out of 8 cans were dented, many were seriously dented.I would only buy this on extreme sale because of the dented cans. I give the soup 4 stars and the cans 0 stars.

column9: Mmmm. This is a Wonderful Potato Soup!
column10: I do a lot of grocery shopping at a nearby Fresh and Easy Market. They're a British company and a lot of their items (other than store brands) are imported from England and elsewhere in Europe. One such item I discovered was Heinz Potato and Leek Soup in 14.1-ounce cans. Boy is this stuff good! You don't taste the salt, but it's a bit higher in sodium than I'd like. It has fairly low fat content and no trtans fats. The protien content is low so you'd probably want to serve it as a side dish to a meal. But it would make a wonderful side dish, that's for certain. The soup has a nice creamy texture with little square pieces of potato (about 1/4 inch on a side) floating in the creamy  sauce. The potatoes are done to perfection. Mmmmmm. This is just a wonderful soup.Gary Peterson
I got these for a fall/winter quick meal but have been eating this summer! No adding water, just open can + heat!  Alot of potato and light on leek flavor.

column9: A tasty traditional british soup; Amazon's shipping destroys it
column10: VERY Good product. Its tasty and its also relatively low cal (check out the nutritional data). Its something served all the time in the UK that most Americans have never heard of. Most of my American friends kind of turn their noses up at the idea of it till I actually have them try it, and then they like it a lot and want to know where they can buy it. This stuff really is very tasty, think of it as being sort of like hot vichyssois only not quite.UNFORTUNATELY Amazon ships these not bound together in any sort of a secure way, they just put them in a box thats too big, with a few of those air pillow things. The weight of the cans is such that the first time they squash the pillows, the pillows pop, meaning 8 heavy cans are now in a box that is way to big for them flying around and slamming into each other. By the time the product arrives it looks like someone was using it to play kick the can, and the air pillows are now all flat.Food in dented cans does not have the same life expectancy (think days rather than months depending on how bad the dent is), and in fact its important that you eat it right away because botulism can develop and that stuff will kill you.Considering this is not a cheap item, as in seriously not cheap, its really disheartening that Amazon persists in not doing a better job of packing it before shipping. I've ordered it from them 3 times now and each time, the condition of the product is the same. The first time, I called to complain and Amazon reimbursed me for the damaged product but had none in stock to re-ship. The second time, same problem, only this time they still had product, so they reshipped it only again it arrived completely dented -- I was handing out cans to all my friends saying... "here great soup, only eat it in the next day or two 'cause its about to go bad."So the product is a great one, but how Amazon packs it for shipping it destroys it.Edit: April '09, I just noticed a NEW feature on Amazon's page where you check the status of your shipments. There is now a specific link for complaining about bad packing that resulted in a damaged product. YAY! They're listening!

Every can you receive will be dented significantly. It is obvious that these were set aside by the vendor as unsellable to the normal markets and grocery stores, and Amazon must have gotten them at a huge discount. They then turn around and sell them on their website. The fact is that damaged cans are supposed to be disposed of or donated to a food bank or shelter. You do NOT sell them. Don't make the mistake I made.

A friend gave me a few of these to try four years ago.  THEY WORK!  I have tried many different cough drops over the years and most work for a few seconds to a minute or so.  These work for hours.  They are not icky sweet, don't stick to your teeth and probably don't cause cavities, as they are sugar free.  I have been unable to find them in a store near me, so I order on line and love the convenience.

Herbs de Provence can bring many dishes to life. Baked chicken and root veggies are a good place to start, for those who are not familiar with this herb mix. Then expand the horizons by searching all the wonderful online recipes. Winter is coming; it's time to enhance those savory stews and one-pot dishes --- to take the plain to the extraordinary.I personally like this French gray salt and herb combination because I don't like to overdo it with the herbs. I prefer a more subtle flavor. However, if you prefer more herbal punch, you may want to stick with purchasing the herbs alone, or make your own mix, which is quite easy to do. Otherwise, you will be fighting with the salt.If you need to watch your sodium intake, you need to know that this product is heavy on the salt --- and the crystals are very large, so it is easy to over salt your dish. You will be fine, if you make adjustments for salt required for your particular recipe. This is just something to consider, when ordering this combo product.I can attest to the freshness of this product.  Upon opening the glass jar, the fragrance was very potent and lovely. I also prefer having the herbs in a jar with a twist-on-lid.  This will help maintain freshness.All said, I highly recommend this product, with the reservations mentioned. These concerns are manageable. Just remember that this product is predominately salt, with herbs as the secondary enhancement, but the herbs won't go unnoticed.

These are not the best gluten free brownies I've tried, but they are far and away the VERY best gluten free, casein free, egg free brownies out there.  They have a texture that is a tad light for brownies- more like chocolate cake, but good flavor.  Be sure to either eat them the first day or freeze leftovers.  Like most gluten-free goodies, they become gritty after sitting out for a day.
This mix is easy to make and tastes absolutely delicious!  I would use this as substitute for a cake recipe anytime.

My kids LOVE this product!  It can be crumbly, though, so I started pouring the batter into a cupcake pan, and the brownies turned out perfect!  They hold together much better, can easily be frosted and can be kept for days!  As a mom who has to make most everything from scratch, it is so nice to have found a "box" mix that I can throw together and bake in minutes!
I made this with a bit extra water, used olive oil instead of veg oil, cooked for more like 20-23 minutes and these were fantastic cake-like yumminess paired with vegan coconut ice cream!

This brownie mix is just ok, not great by any means.  Its more cake like and very crumbly without much flavor.  The next day, they are already very gritty and not worth eating.  These are almost impossible to add frosting too.

This is a great product with a really great taste. The only problem is, like with almost all gluten free items, it has a tendency to fall apart if you want to cut it into a shape or even if you ice it with a firm icing. Perfect if you are going to cut and serve on a plate with a fork, and again, the taste is awesome!

column9: Good Combination - if you really like rum
column10: The turtle, rum and salt combination is very good. The rum taste was quite strong which I found to be a good change from the norm.
This was very small. It was not as it is descibed 'large'. Otherwise, my dog loved it. He ate it up quickly.

These dog treats are great, especially if you have a larger dog who can chew any toy or treat to pieces in a minute.  This treats are tough, I have a pitbull and a boxer mix and they are strong and usually chew through a treat real quick but these last and last and they keep them entertained.  I highly recommend these for all dogs.  Plus the filling isn't gross sticky stuff that leaks out and gets on your carpet like some of those other filled dog treats.
My medium-sized mixed breed loved this bone.  I would recommend this--and maybe two cause they don't last long (at least at my house!)
The dog absolutely loved the bone, she had issues getting at the stuffing in the middle but i believe she enjoyed the challenge.

These bones are my dog's absolute favorite.  He is a SUPER strong chewer, although he only weighs about 60 lbs and is otherwise completely gentle.  It's sometimes hard to find bones and toys for him since he always chews them to bits within 5 minutes.  These bones last him forever, at least 3-4 months at a time.  He loves the filling and will lick it for hours.  Would recommend these bones to any large dog owner.
I have a large doberman and he spent sometime on this, not like most of the other bones he gets through to quickly... Great product.

My 8 month old Border Collie was able to get her lower jaw through the hole somehow and it was stuck. I thought we were going to have to pay a visit to the PETS emergency vet, but after some tense moments of gentle twists and turns it finally came free! Use your own judgement and decide if your dog could get his/her lower jaw through. I'm sticking to the longer filled bones from now on.
how come this is listed at $88.40?how come its so small?how come i got the wrong flavor? my dog don't care but come on.

This brown sugar syrup is so incredibly versatile! I've been using it on my pancakes (even better than maple syrup!), to sweeten my tea, in home made bran muffins, and in my baked beans. This is like the ultimate all-purpose sweetener and I really like that it's all natural.Excellent product!
If you love chocolate, get yourself a box!  The flavors are distinct and most unlike the usual chocolates you may be used to. Buy, buy, buy!

column9: Not as creamy as it should be.
column10: The bonbons were not as creamy as I had in Brazil.  Possibly processed (Dried out) for long lasting export, or old stock. Also the mix did not include a favorite of mine PELE (Large round multi chocolate) I will not be reordering.
Item shipped fast. Taste delicious. This is the second that I bought Graroto here. Highly recommend this to those love Brazil chocolates.
Got this for my brother for Christmas and he loved it.  I always get him Werthers and he always runs out too soon - he opened this and said "Wow, a year's supply!"

I have purchased Werthers candy several times on Amazon. Not only does taste great I am able to purchase in bulk. The candy arrived quickly, it was fresh & I'm completely satisfied. Thanks for making it available.
um...Awesome! These are a tasty treat for house guests - I'm addicted. My husband and I stopped smoking awhile back and these saved our lives!

I'm not a huge fan of the aftertaste that most sugar-free candies leave, but these ones are an exception. Same great flavor as the sugared candy, but without the calories. I put them in a candy dish and nobody knows the difference, but they're great because any guest can eat them whether they are diabetic or not.

What can I say about Werther's Originals-they are just plain tasty!  I haven't met anybody who could walk past a bowl of these without sampling one.  However, these are no value here-too bad I ordered these before I realized my grocery store had the same product-FRESHER-for under $10!!!!Yes, eat Werthers-but check out your own store before buying them on Amazon.
This is a very large bag of Werther's candies. I bought them for a Werther's addict for his birthday and he loved me for it. This is a great deal on these candies.
I bought these for baby shower favor bags and am happy to say there was plenty for me to bring home and eat.

column9: I Love this and will use it often
column10: I love this product and I would like more of it . Thanks for having it. I also would like to know if you have any more of it so I can place another order more of it.
LOVE IT!  Now addicted to it! I'd purchase even larger bags if I could. Does it come in cases maybe?

I learned that many people thinks the world of these hard candies. I know the person I bought it for gets kind of emotional when describing the quality imbedded on each and every one. Creamy, delightfully caramelly (I know its not a word but just had to throw it in) and buttery. Enough to make me, for one, shy away from them. I rather have a soft toffee with those qualities than hard candy, but since it is not me but the happy recipient of this bag that I am basically speaking for, I have no choice but to rate it at 4 Stars. There are definitely a little more expensive at the candy aisle but since its rewards are in the taste department must oblige and give them credit for that. Yes, Big Mama is so happy. Who cares if she has lost all her teeth and replaced with new fake ones, candy is an addiction she will never control while on God's Green Earth and since she has already paid a dear price for her vice and will not be deterred from her chosen path of candy please more candy, I have to give Werther's Original Hard Candies, 34-oz. a serious 4 Star rating, for even though it represents all that can go wrong with the world of teeth, specially if consumed every hour of the day including sleeping time can and will cause irreparable damage to the point that they will simply fall off, who can tell such an avid fan that perhaps some healthy fruit might replace that powerful craving? Certainly not me, I tried several times and failed each one. I bought this cat food because of the wonderful low price and I enjoy they catchy jingle from the commercials. My cats did eat this food, but after reading the ingredients I completely regret purchasing it and feel just awful for feeding it to my cats. The first three ingredients are (which indicates the most prevalent ingredients) are chicken by-product meal, corn gluten meal, and ground yellow corn. How disgusting is that?! The main ingredient is a corn filler. Basically, corn is just a filler and causes pets to actually eat more to feel full, poop out more (more for us to clean in the litter box), and retain less nutrients. Most inexpensive low-quality foods have lots of these fillers and cheap ingredients with little to no nutritional value. The only meat in Meow Mix at all is a by-product, its not even a real meat! By-products are the stuff leftover once all the actual meat is harvested. We're talking beaks, chicken feet, eyeballs, even chicken poop! I would not recommend this product to anyone, for any reason, ever. It is an absolutely awful cat food. I suppose you get what you pay for. I recommend to stay far away from Meow Mix, as it is simply a very low quality food. Even though the price is quite inexpensive, your cat will actually eat more than if you paid for a better quality food, because they will never feel full. Cats need to eat meat, and there just isn't real meat in this food. High-quality foods tend to be more nutritionally dense, meaning you will be feeding a much smaller amount for the same number of calories. If you do the math to figure out the cost for the number of calories you need to feed your pet, many premium foods are CHEAPER than the awful crap you're buying at the grocery store. When purchasing a cat (or dog) food, the most important thing to consider is the first 3 ingredients; just make sure those first three are decent ingredients that you would eat yourself- provided that you eat a typical (non vegetarian or other restricted) diet. Now that I know what to look for, I usually buy my pets all natural foods such as Blue Buffalo, Halo, Wellness or Natural Balance. All of those brands contain real, whole meats that I myself would eat, with no added fillers or corn.

Being a fan of the American candy bar, especially those that have been around a long time, I'd heard of Idaho Spud and had seen it on the stock lists of old-time candy sites but had never had one. I ran across them today and bought one after first perusing the ingredients.It seems to me that I read about a spud-shaped fudge from Idaho that actually contains potatoes, but this isn't it; Idaho Spud is made in potato country and is shaped like a potato, but the resemblance ends there. (Real) chocolate enrobes a cocoa-flavored marshmallow center and the whole is covered with dessicated coconut that keeps your jaws engaged longer than they'd otherwise be with something of this type. What's nice is that this marshmallow contains no gelatin--just agar agar and egg albumen. There's no hechsher but it's appropriate for lacto-ovo vegetarians (there's very little such marshmallow to be found).This is a nice, gentle sweet (translation: it's not sickeningly sweet) and I can understand why they've been around as long as they have. Will I consume them on a regular basis? Unlikely, because although my affection for candy bars is perpetual, my consumption is occasional--a little goes a long way with me (you know you've finally grown up when even the thought of consuming too many sweets is mildly nauseating). But I do think they're very good and I absolutely recommend them. I'm tempted to pick up another one so that I can try a previous reviewer's suggestion to freeze them. I suspect they'd be really good that way. :)I'd prefer to assign 4+ stars but I'll bite the bullet and give full marks.

column9: A Unique and Amazingly Delicious Candybar
column10: It's a coconut-crusted chocolate coating over chocolate marshmallow, in the shape of half an Idaho potato. Yes, it sounds strange, but if you like chocolate, coconut, and marshmallow (and it isn't truly marshmallow but a bit more jelly-like), you may just love the Idaho Spud like I do. I ate my first Idaho Spud candy bar in 1964 at age 5 at the opening of a new bank in Moscow, Idaho, and I have been enjoying them ever since. When I lived in Spokane I would buy them by the boxful at the local grocer's outlet; now I live in Phoenix, and yes, I could buy them from Amazon, but this time of year they'd arrive in a puddle of chocolate goo. So I'll wait out the summer and start buying them again, and this time I'll buy enough to last over the summer in the freezer. They freeze very well!

Many years ago I found these potatoe shaped chocolate-cocoanut-marshmallow delicasees at a news stand while boarding my train here in Chicago. I've been hooked ever since!  These bad boys are totally unique but so yummy!

Having been born in Idaho, I grew up with these.  I absolutely love them!!! I have not lived in Idaho for years but my grandmother and aunt used to send me a box of these every year for Christmas.  I guess my opinion may be a little biased because I feel a lot of sentiment toward anything that reminds me of home - but these are truly tasty.  If you can find them, this company also makes small, bite-sized Spuds that are pretty good as well.  I like the actual candy-bar sized Spuds better because you get more of the chocolate marshmallow flavor, but if you like the chocolate/coconut outer covering then you would probably really like the bite-sized ones a lot.

Dilettante Chocolate is from Seattle, where I moved away from about six months ago. I make my own Mocha in the morning and when I moved, I couldn't find any product, anywhere, at any price, that truly replicated the flavor of Ephemere. As an aside, this stuff tastes great on ice cream, on a spoon... or what have you. Anyway, I find the Semisweet better for coffee drinks than Bittersweet (even though I prefer very dark chocolate for eating- usually between 75-85%.) Somehow, the little extra sugar brings out the chocolate flavor in the drink better. I use less of this than the Bittersweet, which saves both money AND calories, and what's not to like about that?On the price front, the Dilettante Semisweet Ephemere Sauce, 22-Ounce Packages (Pack of 2) is less expensive than the best price I ever found at a store actually IN Seattle. I know, now that I've said this, that the price will go up, but I'm positive it will still be cheaper.Several years ago, Dilettante reformulated Ephemere to be ALL-NATURAL, which is awesome. The only drawback, if you can call it that, is that it used to be shelf-stable. Now, you have to refrigerate after opening, which makes it very, very dense. This observation leaves me wanting to share this little aside: My sister-in-law finds the visual texture of this stuff off-putting; I will not say what she compares it to. It's so thick, however, that you have to microwave it for about 15 seconds after about a quarter of the bottle is empty, so her unappealing comparison is moot. If you like dark chocolate IN things and not just for eating from a bar, you will not be disappointed in Ephemere. If you like milder chocolate, go for the Milk Chocolate version. If you like Bittersweet, your decision between semi and bittersweet, like mine, will be a little more difficult. I feel so strongly about this product that if I could give my phone number out to anyone who disagrees with my assessment to call and berate me, I would.WARNING: Do not be surprised if you find yourself pattering off to the fridge half asleep in the middle of the night for a dollop of this on a spoon. You've been warned.

This is my favorite chocolate sauce for topping ice creams.  Warmed for a few seconds in a microwave, it's far richer than mass-produced chocolate sauces, without being cloyingly sweet.  Somewhat thinner consistency than a fudge sauce.
I realize tastes differ, but to me this doesn't have an authentic rich, deep chocolate flavor.  A bit too sweet, a bit fruity -- almost a raspberry overtone, and just not chocolately enough.

I like chocolate in my coffee.But this chocolate is so bitter-sweet, you can't even taste it.And it is really, really difficult to squeeze it out of the bottle.Not gonna buy this again, that's for sure

Living in a small town full of ladies that do home canning, it is often hard to locate all the things you need.  Fruit Fresh is one of those items to use if making a fresh fruit salad or canning fruit.  Why lose all the fruit because it turns dark?  By using this you save a lot of money, time, and effort!

After the recommendaton I had received for the toy these treats were made for, I had high hopes for it.  Especially high hopes because I had recently purchased the Everlasting Treat Ball and expected the quality and texture to be as good and as durable as the cookie inserts for that toy.  My pup managed within a few minutes, to chew off and eat the cookie rod end and remove and eat both cookies plus the cookie rod.  The treats from the Everlasting Treat Ball last at least one week, but these didn't last one hour, so I was disappointed.  These cookie inserts appear to be softer and easier to eat and finish than the Treat Ball inserts.  I'll buy these inserts again, but will monitor his use of them.  I had hoped they would be as durable and difficult to finish as the other toy, but they aren't.  If my 6 month old beagle puppy was able to demolish these within an hour, I hate to think what an older, bigger dog could do with them!  In my case, it should have been "let the buyer beware" !
Just when I think I've found a treat to outsmart my lab she proves me wrong. It took her only 5 minutes to snap one end of the rod. She enjoys the treats, but it's just not worth the money.

Our shih-tzu loved this product!  It's nice that you have the option to give it to your dog separately or assembled as a toy.  At first we just gave him one end, and he enjoyed it, but the next day we put all 3 pieces together and he really loved it.  He seemed to like being able to hold on to it with his paws and loved the taste.  And the best part is that not only did it last him more than a few days, but it didn't upset his stomach!

My pup enjoys everlasting treats in or out of an everlasting treat ball. I decided to try the everlocking treat as something different, but it wasn't significantly different when used in the treat ball, and she ate the ends off the stick immediately. Overall they are treats she enjoys, but I will likely stick to the regular everlasting treats in the future (esp since she enjoys the various flavors).
NOT recommended!!!  Was advertised as long lasting. I bought the largest size and my small beagle ate it in ten minutes and she is ten years old. Plus it left a nasty stain.
my dog absolutely loved it but i wouldnt pay the money for it again because before i knew it she near finished it off in an hour.

column9: Dogs loved it, but it was anything but everlasting
column10: I bought this at the recommendation of someone at the pet store, who said it kept her pittie entertained all day long.  My corgi managed to chew off and eat both ends within 15 minutes, which makes this item a pretty pricey snack.  So I guess it got the canine two paws up for taste, but I'll stick to bully sticks and other treats that last a little longer.

column9: Good idea, but doesn't work like it should.
column10: I originally purchased the triple crown treats without the locking piece. That's how they come with the ball or toy. The first one worked okay and I thought I would have a great long lasting treat toy for my rottie. Well, he got the first treat out of the toy in about one hour. The second one was out in about three minutes. Reading the package instructions I saw that they offered the locking piece. Thinking this would be great, I purchase three packages of two treats and the locking piece (six treats and three locking pieces). When I received them, it took me all three packages to get the pieces to fit together without breaking the locking piece. Still, didn't work for my rottie. So, if you have a little dog without much spunk, this might be a good treat toy, but if you've got a big dog that won't stop until he gets what he wants, don't bother with this.

column9: Does not live up to claims
column10: I was very disappointed with this product after using the Everlasting Treat Ball inserts and really liking the Everlasting Ball.The initial problem was screwing the two ends onto the rod. I'm not sure if there is some special trick to this or what because I spent a longer time trying to figure out how to screw it all together than it took for my dog to chew through it.  The pieces don't seem to fit well together and the first time I tried to muscle the whole thing in place the end pieces cracked.One of my dogs who is admittedly a strong chewer was able to get through the  ends and rod in under 15 minutes.  She can pretty easily bite the rod down to the end cap and has figured out that if she licks the ends enough the two end pieces will easily pop out because they don't fit in as snuggly as the everlasting treat ends do for some reason.I would recommend skipping this and just using the Everlasting Treat Ball inserts if your dog is not a really aggressive chewer.

column9: Triple crown everlocking treat large, chicken flavor
column10: My dog loves the actual treat, but it doesn't lock well at all. The long part does not easily twist into the treat's screw shapes. It does not easily go into the everlasting treat ball. If you just insert the ends in as you would an original everlasting treat ball and have the end sticking out, that will work, but it definately defeats the purpose of it being "everlocking". I would just stick to the original.

column9: These pale in comparison taste-wise as compared with cheddar cheese flavor!
column10: These don't compare very favorably with the pinto bean with cheddar cheese flavor, however they make a good addition (believe it or not) crushed up in a cheese omelet and they'd probably be great with other spicy foods. On their own, they are very bland.

I was pleasantly surprised to find something that was good for you could taste so good!  I like vegetarian food best & this tasted like really good refried beans.  Also like the flax seed included along with the high fiber & 6 grams protein.  What a find!  I'll definitely buy these again...they are a real treat!

Completely opposite of other reviewer.  I love these cookies.  However, if you are looking for a cookie that is laden with sugar and chemicals, this is not it.  These aren't overly sweet.  And really not too much chocolate taste in these either.  But I like them.  Finally, a cookie that tastes good that I can eat.  No chemicals, very little salt (35mg) and only 5mg cholesterol.  Oh, and the sugar is only 3g.  So, definitely not sweet.

I rarely review products, however this time, I feel compelled to. We are big fans of Tasty Brand's gummies but these are some of worst tasting cookies I've ever had. The taste is so off that I don't even know how to describe it. It must have something to do with being 100 calories -- I'm not sure. Hopefully, Tasty Brands will rework this recipe and do some focus groups.

column9: Good sauce for those that are not vegetarian
column10: Mexican is one of my favorite foods and smothering a bean burrito with red sauce and onions is one of my quick, stand-by dinner options.  With such a simple meal, it is imperative to have fresh and tasty ingredients.  I've tried many red sauces and some were quite good.  According to my husband this has been the best sauce.  He says it beats the enchilada sauces he has had in most Mexican restaurants.Unfortunately, I cannot offer my own taste appraisal because this product is not vegetarian.  Frontera makes two red sauces -- one that is in a pouch Frontera Pouch, Enchilada Skillet Red Chile, 8-Ounce (Pack of 6)and this product that comes in a jar.  The product in the pouch is vegetarian.  The product in the jar is not.  After examining the ingredients on the pouch, I had made the assumption both products were equal and purchased the jar (because it was a better price) without rechecking the ingredients. The sauce in the jar has chicken in it.  If you are vegetarian, don't purchase the jar option unless it is for family/friends.My husband's rave reviews of this sauce have led me to order Frontera Pouch, Enchilada Skillet Red Chile, 8-Ounce (Pack of 6).  My husband says that the product has a rich tomato taste and the roasted garlic inside the sauce complements the sauce well.  The sauce spreads easily and is not thin or tomato paste thick.  The 16 oz. jar was perfect for covering eight burritos (using six inch tortillas).I purchased my Frontera enchilada sauce in the 16 ounce jar from my local co-op for about four and a half dollars.  The price on the vegetarian/pouch version on Amazon is cheaper than my co-ops (which was charging about three dollars for the eight oz. pouch).Ingredients:  Water, Tomato (fresh tomato, tomato juice, calcium chloride, citric acid), roasted tomato, New Mexico Chile Pepper, Apple Cider Vinegar, Salt, roasted onion, roasted red bell pepper, roasted garlic, sugar, chicken base (cooked chicken and chicken juices, salt, sugar, maltodextrin, chicken fat, dehydrated onions, citric acid, turmeric, natural flavors), vegetable oil, xanthan gum, and spices.Another good place to buy this item is iherb.com.  The company offers free shipping over certain thresholds. If interested in iherb, you can use code LEK375 for a discount.Made in the United States.

I ran across the Frontera Mexican products at Sprouts. I decided to give them a try. Best mexican products in grocery stores. I have tried their chips, salsa, enchilada sauce and hot sauces and I have not been dissapointed.
These are fantastic if you like Hungarian or Eastern European food.  Little egg "barley-style" noodles.
Needed a replacement for a Mrs. Weiss noodle and these were just what our recipe called for. This was the only source that really matched what our Hungarian soup recipe called for.

Oma made these for years, as she was a German who grew up on the Hungarian border.  We made these as part of what she called "Chicken Tarhonya,"  which used chicken wings, paprika, onions, and of course, tarhonya.  These are wonderful little gems, and even my American son LOVES these!!
I thought this would be the perfect cutting board for the Brezza but it's far too small I have a hard time cutting full size vegetable on it.  Another negative is it stains easily.

column9: Just a cutting board with a hole...
column10: This worked fine for the idea, but I found it to be way too small to use for very much food. If I even wanted to chop up a sweet potato I ran out of room on the board. So, I would say it is not worth the money at all!
There's nothing special about this board.  I don't find it any more useful than a regular chopping board.  I do use it but don't find it necessary to use with my baby food maker.
Yes you can use any cutting bored but I love this one. I this grippy stuff on the bottom so it does move on the counter it's easy to get everything in the Baby Breeza.

I LOVE my Baby Brezza, but I wouldn't recommend the cutting board.  The white surface absorbs colors and has cut marks all over it after only a few uses.  If I had to do it all over again, I would simply continue to use my regular wood board instead of spending money on this one.  The fit over the machine is handy, but not a necessity.  Generally, I would need to put the cut up items in a separate bowl while waiting for a previous batch to finish in the Brezza anyway, so the handy "fit" doesn't really do me much good.  A good idea, but would be better if made from a more durable, non-staining material.

I am really impressed with this cutting board.  As first I thought I wouldn't like it much (it was a gift). But, I have found I really like using it.  The hole is really helpful for putting the food into the brezza unit or blender.  I really like the grooves, too, because they really make cutting the fruit so much simpler.  The nonskid bottom really works well, too.  It's now one of my favorite kitchen items.

I like the cutting board it has rubber on the bottom so it doesn't slip and the groves help you cut the foods [kinda common sense but still helpful] The only qualm I have with the item was when I was cutting sweet potatoes it stained my board. I haven't tried anything to get it off yet, just soap.
The order was handled very professionally from the time I ordered until the day it arrived.  THANK YOU !!
I am happy with the timely and efficient service and I like the product very well.

column9: Flamin' hot is cheetos is the only way to go!
column10: Great price and overall value, if you like hot cheetos I would recommend this, especially since you can make good money off of it being in a hard to reach place. Love hot cheetos and these were up to par, they should have the lemon flavored ones as well!
i love hot cheetos and they don't have it at cornell. came very quickly and loved it. go but it
I shudder to think what these are doing to my sons's stomach and esophagus, but he loves them! This order comes promptly, nothing is crushed, product seems to be fresh.

Great product! Found them on shelves in Florida. Can't find them in NY suburbs. Kids take them in their lunches for school every day. A must for those who enjoy hot'n'spicy foods.Cheetos Flamin' Hot - 50/1 oz

My son loves Hot Cheetos and we try to minimize his consumption of junk food. On special occasions we will let him eat them, and over the past 2 times he has thrown up this red liquid afterward. He says he feels immediately better. The first time we figured he had a flu bug and he didn't eat the hot cheetos for weeks. Yesterday he came home from camp and as a special treat we let him eat some on the way home. Needless to say he threw up the same red stuff after his chest was burning and stomach hurt. The ingredients say they contain monosodium glutamate so MSG. Parents beware if your child has done the same with specifically the "hot" brands of chips .Cheetos Flamin' Hot Crunchy 2.0 oz (Pack of 5)Flamin' Hot Mix - 30 ctFlamin' Hot Mix - 30 ct
I received this golden delight as a Christmas gift.  This honey makes others pale in comparison!  The Savannah Bee Company Honeycomb Box

column9: Melted quickly, evenly - but very sweet, bad packaging
column10: The chocolate melted amazingly quickly and evenly. So much easier than cocoa or baker's chocolate with fats, etc, in a double boiler! Just put them in a microwave safe bowl, zap em, and set out some parchment paper for easy clean-up of the dipped items.However, it is much sweeter than other dark chocolates. Certainly it is sweeter than I would have preferred.In addition, the bottom of the container had broken just as I lifted it out of the box in which it had been mailed - it was extremely thin, thinner than the lid, and the sides are sharp and basically cut the bottom in a circular pattern. So the remainder is now in Tupperware and luckily I caught it before too much fell out.
It is an excellent product and though more expensive than Wilton's it was worth it. I would buy it again and again.
Very good for making chocolate peanut butter cups that are healthy.Very convenient as they melt very well.Soo good i have to keep them hidden so I dont eat them before baking with them.

column9: Finally a great snack bar for diabetics
column10: Both my husband and I really enjoy the ExtendBars.  They were recommended by my husband's diabetic counselor and they are a great snack at anytime.  The taste and crunchy texture are excellent and he doesn't have to worry about raising his blood sugar.  We have tried the peanut butter chocolate delight and mixed berry delight and have already re-ordered twice.  The only improvement would be to have a box of mixed flavors so we could try them all.

With so many products claiming to help with Blood sugars this is the first that actually does. I use them before excercise and if I need a little boost to get me through the night. Morning blood sugars have remained consistant and my last A1C was a 6.5. Not bad for a 25 year Type 1 diabetic. Great product

I've tried some of these bars, both getting a sampler from the manufacturer, and this box.  I like the bars, and they work for me as a diabetic.  I'm very glad that there are companies making products like this.  Unlike some others I do genuinely enjoy the taste.  But in the end I feel that at nearly $2/ea, they are pretty over-priced.  There are other products, like from Atkins and South Beach that are just as tasty and healthy, but much less expensive.
Good tasting bar that keeps my blood sugar around 120ish in the morning. I also eat one around 10am to keep me from snacking all day long.

I bought some of these a while back because they are gluten free; but because they're sweetened with alcohol sugars they give some people, myself included, terrible gas. Not the best meal bar to have if you are planning to go out on a date.

These are a staple in our house of one diabetic and one trying to lose weight. We do the subscribe and save here on amazon, and chocolate peanut butter delight seems to be the flavor we like the best.One unfortunate thing, as pointed out in another review, is that there isn't a mixed "sampler" box that could include 2 or so of each to try. We bought an entire box of the apple and they were really not good to us. If that was the only flavor someone ever tried, I could see a one star review.We had tried the chocolate delight and the peanut delight from our local Walgreens after reading about them online...both were good, but much more expensive there and only 5 in a box...and they only had those two flavors. So we ordered a box of the choc pb delight and the apple...we have been ordering 1 or 2 boxes a month of the choc pb delight for over a year.Wonderful for bedtime, as my DH struggles with high fasting BG readings when he sleeps too long, or for snacks [dips in his BG when he goes too long without eating].  We both use them as a quick and easy breakfast when we have no time to make something.  Decent protein amount and not much sugar, so no crash like with some high carb bars.I would love an almond flavor...maybe toffee almond? Maybe an oatmeal banana...? Anyhow. These are awesome, just need a sampler box.

column9: Great slow-acting carb for T1 kid who loves sports
column10: My son's diabetes educator recommended extend bars after we mentioned several low bg readings during swim meets and basketball games. He gave us a couple of samples and they worked great!  My son just eats a bar right before he swims and although we have to monitor him for a while afterwards, he no longer experiences lows during swimming.  He's now playing football and eats just a half bar since he has to disconnect from his insulin pump to play.  So far so good with football also.  My son has has type 1 diabetes since the age of 2 so it's really great when we find something to make his life a little easier and allow him to be as active as he wants without fearing low bgs. Bonus: he actually really likes how they taste!
I cannot find these bars at a better price. Shipping was timely. I like the product because of the ratio protein/sugar content. Keep selling them. Wish I could order greater quantity.

column9: The taste isn't great, but the stats are.
column10: I bought these to have a high fiber, high protein, low carb, low GL-impact snack. They meet those requirements. The taste isn't great, but its not horrible, either, and the price is about half of what I paid for a competing product. I do plan to order more, maybe trying a different flavor. I'd recommend these, but with the caveat that they're edible but not outstanding.
Works well, taste is good, about to order a new box.  If you are a diabetic this is nice to have around the house or office.

This one by far is my favorite as far as taste is concerned.  I use this as a snack to get me through to my next actual meal.  There is a good amount of fiber, low in sugar and very few net carbs.  I really like the taste too.

Have you seen how many bars are out there??? Makes my head spin with all the fat and no fiber and A LOT of calories!  Then I found Extend Snacks.  I love the Peanut Chocolate bar the best, but the berry delight and peanut delights are nice for a change.  ANNNNDDDD, they just came out with these wonderful snacks called "drizzles"  The Chocolate Dream is really great if you just want something crunchy sweet.  I am not diabetic and don't have weight issues (except for the holidays...ha).  I have turned my friends onto these snacks and they like them too THANK YOU EXTEND SNACKS! : )

column9: Great for controlling low blood sugar
column10: I've been using Extend Bars for a couple of years now. They really work in helping to control low blood sugar when I exercise. Great product.

Extend a bar appears to reduce my blood glucose number if i consume @8p.m.nightly. As a substitute for my normal nightly snack it appears toforce my number down. For the longest time my blood glucose number stayed the same at 7 .am. as it was at 10 p.m. with no food intake.I endorse this product based upon my experience. By the way,it is not to be confused with any candybar (powerbar) on the market.

I purchased this item with prior Item experience , This is the best product I have ever used.It is a must have for controlling blood sugar spikes IT WORKS GREAT my blood sugar stabilized after use of the Extend Bar!
Yes, these bars are expensive. But they actually work, stabilizing blood sugars in a very positive way.  I like the crunch and the taste, and look forward to having a snack I can enjoy guilt free.
These bars do everything that the manufacturer claims for diabetics.  I prefer this flavor because they taste just like a Reese's peanut butter cup.  ;)
I really like this flavor of the ExtendBar. First time I have tried them. I eat 1/2 of the bar before bedtime and my sugars are great in the morning. Definitely recommend this product.
Compare to other nutritional bars out there you'll find these are one of the few that are low in calories (150) and pack a good amount of protein (11 grams), and they taste great!  I love these bars.

column9: Very Good Tasting Diabetic Friendly Snack Bar - Highly Recommeded!
column10: The Extend "Peanut Butter Chocolate Delight" bars are among the best tasting low carb snack bars I have tried since becoming diabetic. While the Atkins bars are generally very good, these taste even better and also do seem to control my blood sugar longer.These bars have 150 Calories each, 11g of Protein, and only 1 Net Carb. The high protein load really helps to control my hunger, making this a great snack for mid-day munchies or after workout "pick me up", as well as a bed time snack.One note of caution, these do have Maltitol which can cause "gastric distress" in some people.Highly Recommended! I also like Extend Bar Chocolate Delight, 15-Count, 21.16-Ounce Box even more than these!CFH
These bars are great. They do exactly what they suggest; blood sugar levels remain stable. And, they taste terrific. The texture is good and they have great flavor.
Was looking for a snack that does just what this was purported to do.  It is not overly expensive and does leave you satisfied plus you feel that you are eating a healthy snack with this Extend Bar.
I enjoy these bars. They are a good source of protein, tasty, and only 150 calories. I often eat one for breakfast.

This is my favorite flavor of Extend Bar! It really holds you when you're on the run and don't have time for a meal but don't want to eat fast food or junk food snacks. I have recommended it to family & friends with only good feedback from everyone. It's also a great snack to have at night instead of cookies, chips, ice cream etc.One of my doctors sells them by the case at her office for diabetics and people needing to lose weight, since it's low calorie and low carb.

This is hands down the best bar for diabetics on the market.  I have tried them all and then I came across these bars on Amazon. They are clinically validated to help control blood sugar for up to 9 hours and are packed with nutrients.  I eat 2 bars a day and I control my appetite and blood sugar bette rthan I ever have.  I just wish they were on the auto reorder program.  You also need to try the Extend Bar Chocolate Delight, 15-Count, 21.16-Ounce Box and Extend Bar Peanut Butter Crunch, 15-Count, 21.16-Ounce Boxbars.

Of course, these are no substitute for a real meal. That said, this flavor is surprisingly tasty. My husband is diabetic and carries these with him in case he misses lunch at work. These bars keep glucose steady for hours. I eat them, too, when I skip lunch and start to feel hypoglycemic.
take anywhere, quick yet tasty almost like a brownie bar. they keep well and do not melt! great for celiacs as well as diabetics

Extend Bars are tasty, and the corn starch acts as a stabilizer for your sugar urges up to 9 hours.  Therefore, they are great on a GI diet.  These bars were developed for diabetics, altho they are used now for weight control & quick meals for athletes.  The chocolate peanut butter is the most popular flavor, altho there are several others.  Ed
why is it crunchy? It doesnt say cruchy like some of their other products so I thought it would be creamy.

column9: Very Expensive, Bars too smal, Good Taste, but Very Expensive
column10: I got the Peanut Butter Chocolate Delight.  The taste is good, but the price is ridiculous.  They are small and not sure what it means by maintaining my blood sugar for 9 hours.  I can eat one and then be starving a short time later.  I am a diabetic, so I am glad that they taste good, but $1.00 an ounce is way too much.  15 in one box and they are small.The only way I would buy them again is if they lowered the price.  They would be good if you eat a large amount for your meal and just want that taste of chocolate and you cannot eat the regular chocolate.  This has "sugar alcohol" instead of sugar.

Maybe other people don't have that *I want carbs* feeling when I stay up too late.  So I'd eat 3 of these within an hour & a half.  I don't think they are save for me to have until/unless I've lost my extra weight!

The sugar substitute and another ingredient used in all these products is a strong laxative, its unbearable and therefore uneatable. The bars taste great and would be the best out there except you will regret it within 30 minutes. For crying out loud, everyone knows maltodextrin AND maltitol is a serious diuretic/ laxative, use splenda.
This product may help with your blood sugar but I really did not like the taste .  I tried the Chocolate Peanut Butter, Peanut Butter, Apple Cinamon and their Berry flavor. Did not like any of them!

column9: For those  who like mild coffee
column10: I have a Keurig in the office for guests (and myself) but I learned that most of my guests prefer a lighter roast than I do. After tasting the Veranda Blend, I found it was light, but very aromatic and you could still add sugar and cream and it was very similar to a good restaurant coffee. So when supplying choices of blends for guests, I'm including Veranda as a milder blend for those who don't like French Roast or Sumatra or other bold blends. I find that there is a bit of woodiness, but also a slight flavor of nuts and cocoa. It's a pleasant blend of coffee and a very good cup if you don't want something awfully strong. Some lighter roasts are acid to me, but this one seems to be balanced.
I was so hoping that Starbucks would come out with a mild blend for k cups. Starbucks has exceeded my hopes. This coffee is delicious. THANKS STARBUCKS

column9: Caffeine Kick Without the Stomach Burn
column10: After trying this new roast at the store and loving it, I was thrilled when I was offered a free sample of the k-cups to try on my office machine.Same as the store brew, mellow taste (to me that means no burnt after taste) and a high caffeine hit.  I am not a coffee aficionado so I cannot tell you about the cocoa or toasted nutty flavors that they tout.  What I can say, is that if you are looking for a simple blend that will give you the morning or afternoon kick that you need without leaving an acid stomach burn, try this coffee.Yes, it is expensive as compared to brewing your own coffee from store bought beans in your Mr. Coffee, but that is the point.  You are brewing a fresh cup in the comfort of your own home without having to get out of your fuzzy slippers or in some cases, brushing your teeth.Treat yourself to a luxury and stop complaining.

column9: Best Coffee From Starbucks Yet, But, It Comes at a Price..
column10: Brewed on the 10 oz. setting on my Keurig Platinum brewer, the first thing I noticed was the very nice, enticing aroma.  Could this possibly be the perfect K-cup?  I had to have a sip before I even sat down.  In that first sip I tasted some strength, some choclate and nutty overtones, followed by a smoothness I don't typically find in a Starbucks blend.For  the most part I don't drink Starbucks for several reasons.  First and foremost, they tend to over roast their beans and the result is an overly strong and somewhat bitter brew.  This Veranda Blend "Blond" brew isn't roasted so darkly and finally I can taste the real flavors in the coffee.  This coffee actually reminds me of what a good "Donut Shop" coffee used to taste like; before everything became darkly roasted.  But I stray...  The first sip as I said was very inviting with lots of interesting flavors and a lively yet balanced acidity.  As the coffee cooled in my cup the flavor changed a little.  It became more woodsy and earthy but with a bit more acidity.  Still a good cup that comes close to my favorite K-cup, Millstone's Fog Lifter.  Foglifter is a blend of both dark and light roasts in which the flavor doesn't change as the cup cools, the first sip is as good as the last.  The acidity is always balanced whereas with this Veranda Blend the acidity becomes slightly more pronouncd.I usually prefer a light to medium roast in the morning and throughout the day.  In the evening I like to relax with a darker roast or better yet with a real espresso (which sadly cannot be made in a Keurig).  My verdict for the Veranda Roast is that it will fill the bill for my everyday coffee if and when the Millstone Foglifter either isn't available at a reasonable price or is out of stock.The price you pay for this good Veranda Roast is, well, the price, and this is my reason for the deduction of a star.  Starbucks has long been priced higher than other coffees and the Veranda is no exception.  This is only a 16-count box which means we're paying right at a dollar a cup.  At the Keurig website I can buy Foglifter for around sixty-two cents per cup when it is in stock.  Am I being cheap?  Maybe.  I just don't find Starbucks to be worth the extra money just to have the brand name.

column9: Very Good Coffee But Somewhat Expensive - Recommended
column10: This Starbucks "Veranda Blend Blonde" K-Cup makes a nicely smooth cup of coffee that tastes every bit as good as the in-store brew. I personally go for stronger and "bolder" coffee but most of the other coffee drinkers in my family prefer this over the much more affordable Donut Shop K-Cup packs for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 50) we typically drink.Recommended for the flavor (5 stars) but not at the retail price (3 stars).CFH

Starbucks must think their coffee is made of gold.  A much higher price, and only 16 in a box.  While I agree with most others here, the taste is very good, but not worth the money.  If you want Starbucks Blonde, buy a bag and get one of the ecobrew cups and make it that way.Update:  I went and kept track of the number of cups I could get from a bag, and you can easily get 25 cups from one bag which costs about half of what these k-cups do.  I won't post prices, but you can do the math.
I am an avid fan of this new Starbuck coffee. I hate the bitter dark roasts they usually sell. This is coffee for real people, not snobs, just people who want a good cup of coffee. Love it.
I was expecting it to have a stronger flavour, but still is delicious. when i want it to be stronger, i just set the cup size smaller so the flavour is more intense.
Love Starbucks coffee in the K-cups.  It is cheaper to buy it here then in stores.  It came right away and the coffee is great.

Great coffee not too strong. I got some not expecting much but after trying it I am hooked. I now have like 6 cups a day! I am pretty sure the stuff cures cancer. I love coffee but I never thought I could love it even more!

With all the hoopla, I decided to give this a try, without any great expectations. I was expecting this to be very bland, but surprisingly it wasn't.  I thought it was pretty medium in taste and not bad at all.

column9: A Treat in a Brown Box...
column10: First and foremost, having enjoyed the 'Blonde' variety of Starbucks since it's conception, it's pointless for me to tell you that I buy this product religiously and think it to be the best coffee on the market today.  What I can tell you is about the packaging for the 54-count package and my experience with K-Cups, in general.If you opt to go with the higher count package, please note that it does *not* come in retail box packaging.  Sure, the K-Cups are the same but, you get a brown box versus several 'retail' packages.  This, to me, isn't a big deal in the least.  It's not a large box and I'd rather recycle one box than several smaller ones.  My point - if this is an issue to you, buy in a different quantity.  Secondly, the K-Cup patent is a great one but, unfortunately for Keurig, it's days are numbered.  While I've tried to grind my own beans and use a ECOBREW reusable K-Cup filter to get the same results as the Veranda Blend K-Cup, I've been unsuccessful in getting it 'how I want it'.  As such, I've continued to pay a higher price per cup of coffee but, in the end, I still think it to be worth it -- it's a very unique blend.  What I can assure you is that the prices per cup will likely fall off upon the expiration of the K-Cup patent.  For that, I'll keep my wallet handy for these until they hopefully fall off in price due to competition in the near future.A+ service by Amazon, as usual, with PRIME!
This is a delicious mild variety of coffee. Not overly strong like most of Starbucks coffees. I order this one repeatedly.
Good brew - very low acid. Great service and price. I love this blend.  It's the best. Sign me up!
It's a nice, smooth blend and makes for a great morning cup of joe. I enjoy this every morning while reading the news before going to work.
I enjoy a smooth, flavorful cup of coffee especially first thing in the morning. Starbucks veranda blend blonde is my favorite. If you dislike the burnt taste of some beans then this is for you.

column9: Starbucks Veranda Blend Blonde K-cup coffee
column10: I love the taste of this coffee.  It is light but still has a very nice flavor and color, not bitter at all.
Starbucks Blonde Coffee is good, but still a little stronger than I like.  But, it does have a good flavor and hits the spot.

The Veranda Blend is a medium blend and brews extremely well in the commercial grade Keurig I have at my office as well as the Keurig Breville I have at home. I love the larger count boxes that are available on Amazon that bring the per K-CUP costs down. Highly recommended.
Starbucks Veranda Blonde K-cup is a perfect thank-you gift for friends with a Keurig coffee maker!Very satisfied with the level of service provided by AMZN.

I used to use Tassimo, and switched to Keurig when Starbucks went to Keurig (it's all family members drink).  Compared to other Starbucks blends, this one tastes less bitter, "smoother" perhaps.  I'll stop short of saying "watery," but it isn't quite strong enough for my first cup.
Great light to medium roast coffee A little stronger than a light roast but very good. Highly recommend. If you like starbucks you'll love this coffee

I usually brew a Lg setting cup and the first time I tried Veranda, it tasted like a coffee flavored Chai. Extremely weak coffee. For people who don't enjoy coffee. And of course, WAY over priced. Why is starbux almost 5 dollars more than all the other brands? In this economy? Guess he really needs the cash to fund more illegal settlements. The weakest coffee I've ever had. Horrible.Whats more? Theres a starbax on a corner not far from my house (go figure)...and it's amusing to see the lemmings line up around the building to pay $5 for a cup of coffee, when 3 blocks over is a small mom & pop Cuban grocery (family owned) that makes the best Cuban coffee this side of the everglades, made fresh to order. Not a soul in the parking lot, I jump out ask for a grande con leche with sugar. It's 16Oz. for $1, and not a penny goes to fund any illegal settlements in Palestine.

There are several things I like about this product, including that these are naturally shed antlers that are collected, cleaned, packaged and then sold without involving killing to get them.  Somebody goes out and collects these and that is probably part of why they are fairly expensive, even on-line...I first found these in our local pet store...but forget about the retail price, (IF you can even find them,) the price at the pet store was twice what I found on-line, and the antlers were not nearly as large.  None of the big chain pet stores carry these, at least not in my area so far. I ordered these through Amazon and was amazed and delighted that they arrived literally the next day.That said, my dogs simply ADORE these things.They keep my new, and very young 100# rescue lab busy literally for hours, but do not "slime" my floors or carpet, (or our bed or couch.)  He loves to set one on my desk as an "offering," which I actually don't mind since they are VERY clean compared to all the more traditional bones, hoofs and chews.Additionally, they double as a great "fetch" toy in the yard.Essentially my guys just chew them down to the nubbin's, but without any damage to my stuff. Highly recommend if you want a clean chew/toy that will keep your dog busy for hours without wrecking the party, and helps with tarter build-up on their teeth in the process.Really a great idea, and a great product.

My dogs like these.
