take Chewy Chips Ahoy, add some EL Fudge to the center, and this is the beautiful baby you get. while i'm not sure 'gooey' is the right word for the fudge in the middle, i am sure that tasty is the right word to describe this cookie.the fudge in the center adds a little extra chocolaty flavor without ruining the texture and deliciousness of the cookie. so good.

column9: Very crumbly, taste is only okay
column10: To begin with, I opened the package and found about 20% of the cookies had already crumbled into pieces.  That's how fragile these cookies are.  With homemade cookies, I've always preferred the soft and chewy ones, but these go beyond soft.  I found the taste of the cookie itself to be only okay, and the fudge filling wasn't what I would call gooey.  I tried eating these at room temperature, warmed in the microwave, and cold from the fridge, and there are still plenty of store-bought cookies I would prefer over these.

column9: Not Bad for a Grocery Store Cookie
column10: These cookies are okay for grocery store cookies made with preservatives.  They aren't as good as Nestle Tollhouse or Mrs. Fields but they're better than the unrecognizable brands one might buy at a gas station.  The "gooey" filling is surrounded by a chocolate "shell" within the cookie and makes for contrasting textures - soft cookie, chocolate shell and gooey center.  While these are in the Chips Ahoy line, they are quite different from the original.  Not better or worse.  Just different.

Huge biscotti fan. I have tried all different kinds over the years, from whole foods to Costco to all gourmet places and brands and these are AMAZING. Absolutely the BEST. Tried them from a shop in Florida. Now addicted. And less than 10 calories a biscotti. Nothing better!!!!
I really enjoyed this biscotti.  They are very light and taste delicious.  My kids love them.  I recommend trying them.

column9: Bought as a gift and receiver very pleased!!!
column10: My mother saw this product and was very interested. I found it on Amazon and decided to get for her for Christmas. She really likes it and is looking  to order more. She like the Salba so much that I am going to try it. Shipped in good time. THanks!

column9: not the best way to get your omega 3
column10: this product is messy,and is not the best way to take your omega 3. It calls for 2 Tablespoons for each serving. It is little seeds and they get cuaght in your teeth. I think they missed the mark om this one.

For whatever reason, I thought these were going to be bigger bags than 4oz.  That's my mistake.  By the time you figure in the shipping - well, anyway.  I can get the same chicken strips at Woodman's for less and they're made in China, too.  I can't stand it!  My GSP loves 'em, but I won't ordinarily spend $12 a pound on dog treats made in China.

column9: The Best Grapefruit Juice I Ever Tasted
column10: Lakewood Organic Pink Grapefruit Juice surpasses even fresh squeezed in balance and quality. It's perfectly balanced without a hint bitterness or unripe "green" taste. It does not disappoint. There was no separation or sediment in the bottle. The pulp was very fine and almost indiscernible in my mouth. This is really a "must try" product.By the way, my package arrived in 2 days even though it wasn't supposed to ship for a week. Also, those 6 bottles came in the best designed packing material I've ever received in an Amazon order - no peanuts and rolled newspaper here! This shipment will be gone in the blink of an eye so I plan to order more soon.
I bought this for my wife because she is pregnant and thought it's good for our baby, but about half of the nuts in the bags we opened are not fresh, like not well dried.
So delicious!  Hot!  Makes a perfect sandwich.  And the seller was very professional and honest with an order glitch.

I've waited years to find Amora mustard, a product I grew up with in France. I had just about giving up of ever finding it again.  I received it 3 days earlier than scheduled (thank you, thank you) and I wasn't disappointed in the great taste. Nice, smooth, bold, HOT..everything I remembered.  Thank you so much Touch of Europe!!([...]) I see more orders in my future.
Was introduced to this mustard in France last year and just love it.  Am glad to be able to get it through Amazon.
This mustard is the best, I use to travel to France often and always bring jars back!!! Beats any other dijon mustard.
I love this mustard!  Truly delicious dijon with just the right amount of bite.

This is the "Grey Poupon" of France, and I think it's better.  You get a really cute juice glass from the deal, and even though the shipping is almost as much as the mustard, if you love delicious mustard, then try this.  Use it as a basis for Julia Child's celery remoulade salad - you'll be happy you did. [...]

My dog is highly allergic, a picky eater and prone to dehydration. The quality of ingredients, moisture content and palatability of Natural Balance L.I.D. Sweet Potato and Fish has kept me a return customer even after trying more expensive fish-based grain-free canned foods. I now mix this in a 1:1 ratio with the Natural Balance L.I.D. Sweet Potato and Fish dry food and it has done wonders for my dog. She now can't wait to eat, no more itching/scratching, has a silkier coat and has a wetter nose (something the vet didn't think possible owing to some potential facial nerve damage). In addition to all of the benefits, I also have to praise Natural Balance for keeping such as high quality food affordable. For less than $2 a 12-ounce can, I can have it shipped directly to my door in a few days.

column9: My dog will not eat it : /
column10: Bloo is not a picky eater but for some reason he will not eat this.I got it for him because it had such good reviews.I'm going to take the remainder "11 cans" to our animal shelter.

column9: Great diet for Food Sensative Dog
column10: This dog food is great. My dog developed food allegeries as he got older. The vet changed him to a fish diet. The prescription dog foods are so expensive. Then I found Natural Balance. The price is right and the food is high quality. I won't feed him anything else. Lucky loves this food.
Dog loves it and despite sensitive stomach, does very well on it. Good price. Love having it arrive right at my door...and my cats like it too :)

I used to buy Pemmican brand jerky, and it was great.  Then they were sold to a different owner, and now the stuff is HORRIBLE.  I have tried other "store" brands, but it is all really nasty.  SO I decided to try Buffalo Bill's.  I went with the safest version, the mild country cut.  At first, I wasn't sure how I liked it.  Then I noticed half the bag was gone!  I would describe the jerky as very moist, and almost pepperoni-like.  After you are done eating, you notice a mild "burn" in your mouth.  I am not into hot food, but I could handle it. Every piece was tender, none were bad.  So I would say give it a try.  I will most likely purchase some more in the future.
Great product.  This is my second order and delivery was quick and complete both times

As the title says, consider this a "4.5 star" review, if such was possible here.  I do very much like their jerky, but I found this flavor to be the weakest of any of the ones I've tried so far.  (I've tried the Barbeque, Teriyaki and Honey Pepper in the country cut line, finding the Teriyaki to be my personal favorite, and also their vennison jerky).  I also found this jerky to be just a tad tougher then the other flavors, I don't know if that's due to the marinade used on the others or not.  Still, this is a very good product, and I can easily see this being a 5 star product for those who prefer their jerky to not have a slighty sweet taste.

column9: Best jerky I have had...And I've had my share of Beef Jerky!
column10: This is by far the best jerky I have had. I LOVE beef jerky and this has the best combo of spice and beef flavor. It is also super fresh out of the bag. I found this item at a local grocery store and fell in love. They are not carrying it anymore so I guess I need to get it off the web. The only complaint I could state is you must spend $125 to get free shipping! I would spend $75 for THIS beef jerky to get free shipping but not $125! Maybe the company will consider that.
This beef jerky is the best I've ever had! It's tender and moist. It's peppery and salty! Perfect. Yum.

Osem's Israeli couscous is some of the finest pasta I have ever had.The taste and texture that these little balls of yumminess produce is just amazing. There are some many different ways to prepare it and so many dishes and side-dishes you can make with it. I just can't say enough good things about this pasta.If you take a little bit of extra time to toast these babies before you cook them up, talk about a completely different level of taste.From entrées, to side-dishes, I have yet to find a way I couldn't prepare this couscous. Italian style, with chop suey (as a replacement for rice), even mexican style. This is probably one of the most versatile foods on the planet.You will not be disappointed.

column9: Very Versatile In Cooking Plus Delicious
column10: This is a starch, a grain product, used in North Africa, especially Morocco.  I now use couscous just like I use pasta.  I even use it in the microwave with my pasta cooker.  I've got perfectly cooked couscous in 18 minutes in the microwave.  I've used this in many non-traditional ways.  I've used spaghetti sauce on it, pesto sauce, quick sauted it in olive oil with pieces with cheese (after microwaving it), etc., Anything you do with pasta or rice, you can do with couscous.  You are not stuck with serving this as a Middle Eastern dish.I've used many varieties of couscous.  I don't know why this Israeli product is the best of the lot but it is really a standout.  Of all the varities I've tried, I liked the whole wheat the least.  This is not whole wheat.
My wife loves this stuff and can't get enough. She appreciates the low to no fat content and is always asking me to have it in the pantry.

Excellent product.  When  our local grocer no longer carried the 5-lb. bags of this item, I ordered the 22-lb. bag from Amazon and shared it with some family members.  We all now have enough of the couscous for a year or more!

This stuff is the best. It is what all of the Israelis use. Just fry up some onions, add in the couscous, add the water, and throw in a bit of chicken soup mix (preferably also osem), and you are good to go with a really tasty side-dish. We serve it all the time with meat...
Cant beat the price! This is large cous cous, slightly bigger than a BB. Really soaks up all the flavor you add! The treat so nice, they named it twice!
This Isaeli Couscous is a great deal.  It is a large amount, so I ordered it and split it with other family members.  Everybody loves it.
All of the teas I have had from Hawaiian Islands Tea Company are wonderful. I enjoy the Mango, Pineapple, and Guava flavors - but my favorite is the Coconut Macadamia.

I am a tea snob, I will freely admit it. But this is some of the best tea I've ever had, and it's so inexpensive. I purchase this regularly for myself as well as for gifts. I usually leave a box to share at work, and it goes very quickly (so I have to hide a little stash of tea for myself to make sure I get some too!)
I was looking for really good flavor.I could not even taste the coconut.For me this is another tea to add with the others I don't use.

I used to drink this all the time when i was stationed in Japan. Love it! Wish it was readily available on the shelves here in the U.S. Thankfully Amazon can bring it to my door. This drink is unlike anything I've ever tried before. It has a mild citrus taste with just a hint of saltiness. I ordered 4 bottles and drank them all within a week. Next time I'll be sure and order more.

column9: I love this Ghirardelli Mint Chocolate. Perfect for after dinner or dessert. It tastes just right
column10: This Ghirardelli Mint Chocolate tastes really good. The chocolate isn't too sweet nor too bitter. It is also not too creamy or milky. As far as the mint filling, it adds some more sweetness to the Chocolate, but at the same time the mint is very refreshing. Perfect to have after dinner or as dessert.If you like Mint Chocolate, you might also want to try the After Eight Mint Chocolate. they are very good too. Also try the Ghirardelli Peppermint Bark Chocolate which is kind of interesting taste (a combination of chocolate/dark chocolate with white chocolate and peppermint crust).

Monin did a good job of bait and switch.  No ingredients listed on Amazon.  No artificial ingredients listed on their website.  Lo and behold, the bottle arrived and on the label were both artificial flavor and colors.  Never again will I buy from this company. (They have since updated the list of ingredients on Amazon and their website.)

My husband and I both enjoyed the flavor of this tea so much!  We often receive oolong tea from our relatives in Taiwan as a present, but we have not been to Taiwan for a while so we ran out.  I ordered this tea hoping to fill the gap until our next trip.  It is of good quality with nothing but large whole leaves. It has a delicate flavor and lovely aroma.  It is as good as the high mountain oolong tea we get in Taiwan. I would recommend this tea to anyone who loves oolong tea or is interested in trying it.

column9: Easy to use, very pretty when applied
column10: I used both the gold and the white sparkle gels to decorate mini brownies (a photo is above).  The consistency is just right, the squeeze tube is simple to use, and the sparkles in the gel makes it a very pretty decoration.  Warmish and cool temperatures did not seem to affect the gel, either, because the brownies were made a week ahead of time and both kept in the refrigerator then, on display, in a room at about 68F degrees.The description above does not indicate how many tubes are sold in an "order", but I paid $3.99 for each 3.5 ounce tube in a craft store.

column9: did not receive bulk package in my order only received single bottle yellow  quanity 2
column10: Believe it or not, my daughter and I thought that this was hair jell. We received a single tube of the yellow color but no others.Also still waiting for lavender earrings that was ordered around May 19. Was charged for item and went ahead and ordered another set so that I would not loose the chance of having this item. Absolutely love it. Look of multiple holes but only need to use one ear hole.

I have been a huge fan of Jelly Bellys since I was a kid, which was about 25 years ago.  I have always had a favorite.  At first it was peach, then banana.  Juicy pear came along and that was my favorite for about ten years.  I thought nothing would top it, ever.  Then I tried red apple.  It is sweet and tart and really delicious, my new favorite flavor.  A ten pound box is surprisingly tempting and I am sorry they are currently all sold out.

column4: Clifton Watson "Jus' a simple man. Nothin' sp...
column9: A Surprising Blend of Bean and Apple
column10: I wasn't sure what to expect from this Jelly Belly flavor. I have eaten "red apples" before but they were usually in a fruit. This was a candied bean with "red apple" flavors put inside. Despite the obvious witchcrafts, I tried this confection because I am not afraid of the unknown like so many people in the RELIGIOUS RIGHT (WRONG). I was surprised to find that this "red apple" had a delicious apple-like flavor and a chew not unlike a finely prepared hamsteak. Would I eat more of these? Yes, I would. I would also recommend this "red apple" to anybody who is adventurous and wants to experience a new and exciting way to feel the best parts of the fruit eating process. RED APPLE JELLY BEANS, THEY DO TASTE LIKE APPLES KIND OF BUT NOT COMPLETELY. STILL PRETTY GOOD.

I purchased these k-cups a few weeks ago, and now I am hooked. I must have one every day. I am not a coffee drinker, but an avid tea drinker. From time to time, I try different k-cups. This vanilla is smooth tasting, creamy, yet not too sweet. If you are not into coffee, this will be a pleasant surprise. It has a little coffee in it.

column9: Worth going out of your way for.
column10: I discovered this coffee while in South Florida. This is not available in Connecticut, so I was thrilled to find it on Amazon. Fantastic taste and aroma, I am not a connoisseur but I know what I like. I used to make it in the mornings in the restaurant coffee pot and there were no worries of any being left by the time we opened. It was a special treat for the employees. One employee who did not speak English very well referred to me as "Best Coffee". Not a bad testament to the quality I would say.

Learnt that flavored coffee is the least quality coffee for the flavoring will disguise its faults. We drank the Millstone Ground Coffee, Vanilla Nut Cream, 1.75-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12) and grew tired of the smell and taste. Much better to add your own essence of your preferred flavor. Learning about good coffee takes a while and eventually one becomes discerning and somewhat more demanding in their choices. For the time the price was decent so 3 Stars for this one.
Our cats have traditionally lived between 18-22 years. We have been feeding them Iams forever. They enjoy the food and their waste is not overly stinky or big.

With 5 cats I need to buy cat food in bulk!!  Having it delievered to the door is a absolute must, so I love the delivery of Amazon.  Just switched cats to this food - females are weight ok but the males seem to eat too much so hope this will keep them trimmer. Have all long haired cats - and who likes hariballs coming up??  Not me. Have one cat show has been on this for year - and have not had hairball #1 out of her. Definitely recommend buying from Amazon - aLOT chaeper than any other place I have found.

When my husband first got our cat a few years ago, he started feeding her cheaper cat food.  She threw up one day all over the carpet, and it was really hard to get the "red" stains out from the color in the cat food.  He then switched her to Iams, and now on the rare occasion she has those problems, the carpet isn't stained like it was before.  Iams is a little more expensive than other brands, but it's definitely worth it.  Your cat doesn't cost that much money to keep anyway, so you might as well feed them better quality food.I defintely recommend buying this product from Amazon (the pack of 8 2-lb. bags).  You pay more up front, but it averages out to about the same, or maybe even a little less, as buying the 4 pound bags from the local stores.  Plus, your cat gets "fresher" food more often, which is especially good if you only have one cat and don't go through the bag as fast.  Yes, our cat is a little spoiled.

column9: My cats love the tuna flavored IAMS.
column10: I am no longer able to find original IAMS with tuna in my grocery store and I can only buy it online.  My cats love it.  I'm not sure why the stores only stock IAMS with Chicken.  I wish the manufacturer would continue making tuna available.  My 14 year old cat has eaten it exclusively for most of her life and turns her nose up at most other flavors.

My cat cannot get enough of this food - so it must taste great.With this as her regular diet, she gained 3lbs in a year; my vet said this is a fattening food.  I still give her individual pieces of kibble as "treats" but I feed her Blue Buffalo weight control now.

column9: Suitable for all types of cats
column10: I had a cat with renal failure who had 1 kidney removed several years ago. The doctor recommended the KD dry for her post-surgery. She live nearly 9 years on one kidney and this food alone! I now have three rescued cats of diverse backgrounds, including 1 longhair. They all eat the Iams dry food at will, with no portion control. None are overweight and though the longhair gets frequent hairballs, that is not a result of the food, but rather how frequently I brush him. More brushing = less hairballs.

This has been the only food we have found for our cat that he can digest easily. We have tried product after product but with this it stay down for him. We have 4 other cats and they all like this food too. Great price per pound when you compare it to the store price.

GREAT DEAL, CONVENIENT TOO.  Much cheaper than WalMart and I don't need to lug it home, it appears on my doorstep.  Cats hack up fewer hair balls and instead of adding petroleum products (ie-vaseline) like most HAIRBALL formulas, which causes diarrhea and blocks vitamin absorption, this one has probiotics, which make the digestive tract work better, thus eliminating most of the hairball problem in a healthy way.  (Nothing can prevent 100% of hairball hacking, it's just something all cats do once in awhile.)  A great deal on a great product, plus free shipping when you order over a certain amount.---Coos Bay Sandra
My cat has never turned up his nose at this product. He always has his choice at meal time and he eats both the chicken and this product without fail.

column9: Update: She got her first hairball
column10: I have been feeding my cat all sorts of cat food.  She has long fur and hasn't had any hairballs.  If she gets hairballs on Iams Proactive hairball formula, I would definitely update this review.This food is different from any cat food I've ever bought because the kibble is shaped like tiny balls.  Up until now, my cat has eaten foods shaped like starfish or "Y" and "X."  She doesn't seem to mind the shape, though.My main beef with cat food is some of them smell so horribly bad (dead fish).  This one is fine.  That's what I buy for -- that and price.  If it does what it says, make my cat lose weight and controls hairballs, I will be a happy cat owner.Will come back in the future to update.____________________________UPDATE:  Well, this formula must not work.  After being on it for two months, my cat suffered her first hairball.

My sister has been feeding our cat Zoe this product for a few months now, recently she started to get a few cysts on her body, one on her face which caused the hair to fall out in that area. when we noticed this occurring we took her to the vet asap. The vet asked what type of food we feed her and my sister informed that we use Iams Weight Control (she has trouble loosing weight) The Vet told us that she has had a few animals come in lately with the SAME problem and EATING the same food!!!! we were told to stop feeding her Iams and use an all natural cat food with only half a cup of food in her bowl each day.. I DO NOT RECOMMEND! or your pet too can start getting cysts on their body.. no good

If you have a multi-cat family and are struggling to find common ground to minimize digestion disturbances amongst all of them, this is a good bet.  My cats don't *love* this food, but they all tolerate it well and don't run away from it immediately after I pour it.Amazon's prices are unbeatable too, even for the small (2lb bags).  While it seems weird to get so many small bags, my cats appreciate it because the these bags don't reseal well, so with smaller bags, the food is fresher in general.As mentioned in the subject, this only applies to the Chicken flavor, my cats don't care for the others.

column9: Why Can't We Get TUNA Proactive Health Dry Cat Food
column10: IAMS Original with Tuna Proactive Health Dry Cat Food has been a wonderful food for our 4 yr old female Manx.  Suddenly after years of good health & a beautiful coat we have to find something else she likes besides occasional raw fish or shrimp.  She will not eat IAMS salmon & brown rice, barely will touch the Chicken Proactive Health. I've finally backed down to Purina Tuna & Fish but I know it is not as healthy as IAMS. Why is the IAMS Tuna suddenly not available in HEBs, WalMarts, K-Mart, Feed Stores nor on-line?

She has not thrown up yet after eating it(as she has with previous brands) so if all goes well this is her new food, excellent!! :D
Item just as it appears.  Its great, no last minute runs to the store.  I have enough food to last awhile.

column9: As advertised! Great option vs. retail stores
column10: Glad to see Amazon has so many products and suppliers. It is nice to have these products delivered right to the house. Getting ready to order some more for the (3) additional mouths to feed in the house!

column9: Always rated at the very bottom of unbiased reviews.
column10: Please do some research yourself to find out that they are ALWAYS rated the worst food for your pet in unbiased reviews.The top ingredients for this product are crude meal and loads of grains.. Grains = bad for pets and are cheap for companys like iams to use.

We purchased these chocolate cigars for (big surprise!) the birth of our first son.  They were very delicious and everybody we gave them to said they were pretty good!  The chocolate wafer was very crispy and the filling was very creamy and smooth.  I would buy them again.
It is crunchy.  I like the chocolate coating to be less sweet.  Most of my friends give thrumbs-up.  And many said it looks like a real cigar.

While they have been very well received, some people like the taste more than others.  (Not everyone has the same tastes.)  Funny part is that they are so realistic-looking, some actually thought they were tobacco.  Once told otherwise, they were pleasantly surprised and asked for another (one keepsake, second one gets eaten).  Certainly would purchase again IF the need ever presents itself.
Fast shipping. Delicious tasting-They look real. Creamy filling and crunchy on the outside. I highly recommend these over plain chocolate or bubblegum.

column9: I was skeptical but really blown away
column10: I have to admit I was very leery about getting "chocolate cigars" for the birth of our first child... I don't smoke nor do I feel like promoting smoking by giving away real cigars. well, I've seen them and ate them and every one looked very "kiddish" or over done wrapped in tin foil plus they tasted like cheap sugary chocolate. I found these on Amazon, read the reviews and tried to blow up the picts as much as I could to get the visual... I took the chance and ordered the 100 ct box. These things are spectacular! They look so much like a real cigar that I've had to tell several people that i've handed them to, "They're chocolate... no really, it's chocolate." And then the fact that the taste is really good... I mean it's not gourmet chocolate but it really is good. Not overly sweet, a bit rich but not in a bad way. I mean it's a celebratory chocolate cigar and it sure beats the others. I'm very happy with them and would purchase again (if we have another child).

I would totally recommend these cigars.  Most people we gave them to thought that they were real cigars at first, but were pleasantly surprised to find out that it was chocolate.  The flavor is great!  We had many compliments on the uniqueness of this favor.

column9: It's excellent, but there are a few things you should know (w/bonus lemon drop recipe at the end of the review)
column10: To begin, let me cut to the chase and simply say that Nestea Lemonade Sticks are excellent.  The product is tasty, has a natural flavor, is easy to mix and contains only about 5 calories per 8 ounce glass.You should however be aware that one packet is meant to be mixed with your standard-sized 500 ml (aka 16.9 ounce) bottle of water.  I first mixed a glass of this with about 8 oz of water and it was much too strong.  So expect one packet to make about two 8 ounce glasses.I've seen substantial price fluctuations on this product.  I paid around $16 with Subscribe and Save and I just saw that it went on sale for even less than what I paid.  So if your price is anywhere around what I paid, it's a good deal.What I can tell you is that you'll get a lot of "tea" for the money without a doubt.  Let's do the math.  You will get about two 8 oz glasses per packet and there are 12 packets per box and you'll receive 10 boxes from Amazon.  Thus 12, 16.9 oz servings per box times 10 boxes equals 2,028 ounces or 254 8oz servings.  You could drink a glass of tea per day for almost 9 months before you'd run out.  That's a lot of "tea" for sure!The reason that I've been writing the word "tea" in quotation marks is because I can't really taste the tea.  It doesn't really taste like a mix of lemonade and iced tea aka the "Arnold Palmer."  It just tastes like lemonade to my tastebuds, even though there is tea in it, according to the listed ingredients.  So it is very good, but do understand what you are purchasing.  The tea taste is very subtle.But again, I really like it.  Nestea Lemon Sticks have a natural lemon flavor and are sweet without having the usual artificial flavor or aftertaste.  It mixes quite easily and requires minimal stirring.  Plainly, as noted, you get a whole lot of tea with a Amazon's 10 box offering.  At less than 5 calories for an 8 ounce serving, it is refreshing and sweet while adding minimal calories.Let me also tell you something that it's great for if you drink adult beverages.  I have mixed this product with Sweet Tea Vodka and it's fantastic.  It's basically like an Arnold Palmer for grown-ups.  Just make the product like you normally would and blend to taste with the Sweet Tea Vodka of your choice.Finally, I'm very happy to report that this product contains *NO SODIUM*!  Sorry about the caps, but one of my pet peeves is the fact that nearly every diet beverage has a ton of added sodium.  If you don't believe me, just take a look at the ingredients on the diet soda of your choosing and you'll typically see 5% or more of your RDA of sodium in a 12 ounce can.  Who needs that?!  We consume far too much salt as it is!  I can understand a bit of salt with your dinner, but I don't want it in my beverages.  Even most iced tea that you'll find in the stores has a good dose of added sodium.  This product has none and it still tastes great.Thanks Nestea for an excellent new product!  I highly recommend it!OK, and here's the bonus low calorie lemon drop recipe (my own creation): 1. Fill a cocktail shaker with ice 2. Add 2 shots vodka 3. Add 1 packet Nestea Lemonade (10 calories) 4. Add 3/4 cup to 1 cup water to tasteShake like crazy.Tastes great and almost no calories other than what's in the vodka.
I bought this product on special for 27 and change.  Now I look and it is selling for 47 something.  ??? I know that it is not on sale but wow, 20 bucks more?  That seems a little off!

I'm not sure I would call it tea, to my taste buds, it's all lemonade.  But, they list tea as an ingredient, so it's in there.  One packet is too much for a regular bottle of water, so I usually rinse out a 24 oz pop bottle and use it.  Sometimes the packets are a little difficult to open, it's often easier to use a pair of scissors to open one.  Other than that minor complaint, it's my powdered drink of choice.
Better than I was expecting and everyone in my family likes them.  I can actually use 1/2 of one and that's plenty for me and my husband, but my girls like to use the full packet.

After trying this product - I love it.  When mixed with water and ice, or as the manufacturer recommend just add to a bottle of Bottled Water, it is very refreshing.  I am, in fact, drinking a glass while writing the review.

column9: I'll never buy Crystal Light again
column10: We drink a lot of Crystal Light and have for many years, and I had only ever tried one or two other similar brands.  Nothing else had measured up.  We usually make iced tea, and when that got a little boring, we started mixing half iced tea and half lemonade.  The thing was, we never really liked Crystal Light lemonade enough to drink it straight - it just has a side taste that is too srong.I just received this box from Amazon and took a chance and made straight lemonade.  We all tried it and were happily amazed.  It tastes so much like real lemonade!  It mixes well (better than Crystal Light) and has a delicious tart but sweet lemony taste that is surprisingly refreshing.  We make it by the pitcher now and find we need to refill it all the time it goes so fast. It says it has a mix of Lemonade and tea, but I don't detect anything but a lemonade taste.  At 5 calories a serving, it's a great way to pour some jazz into your water bottle.My nutritionist always advises that I drink as much water as possible. When I mentioned this, she said it's a great alternative.  Really happy to have something in the refrigerator that is delicious, that everyone loves, and is such a fabulous alternative to sodas and other sugary drinks.

These breadsticks were perfect with my Italian dinner.  They are crisp and crunchy and go well with salad.  They arrived in good time and were well packed and not broken, as I had feared they might be.They are Kosher and Vegetarian which is what I was looking for.

I am not too thrilled with some of the ingredients. I was hoping for no added sugar and they taste over baked, hard, and dry. They would be great with dips and soup but again I wish the ingredients were more simple.  It is very hard to clean up your diet and still keep it interesting.

column9: Great to have in spray but...
column10: I was thrilled to finally get this oil in a spray but it was 1/2 the cost at my local health food store .New Frontiers so disappointed that I overpaid

column9: More people should use coconut oil
column10: Coconut oil is a fat safe for cooking and a healthy alternative to man-made oils (vegetable, soy, canola) and other hydrogenated oils.  It can be hard to find in a spray alternative, which we use for making eggs and baking.

Great stuff!  6oz. sounds small but it's a big, lite can.  It has a good flavor that tastes more like butter than coconut.  I use it when I bake coconut/chia bread.  This is a product that I will buy again and again and again....

column9: NY Egg Cream Stable but get the Kosher product!
column10: Great item and a memory from childhood but be sure you get the Kosher variety and not the one made with Corn syrup

If you're from Brooklyn there's really only one chocolate syrup for your milk or egg creams. Fox's is THE cult favorite dating way back maybe even before trolley cars and the original TROLLEY DODGERS! No bona fide Brooklynite or ex-patriate, such as myself, would ever consider a substitute. Hershey be da----!This is the real deal; accept no substitutes. My only regret is the shipping cost from this purveyor. It's cheaper to get on a train and visit the nearest NYC Gristede's; and you get a day in Manhattan to boot! 5 stars plus for this wonderful, unbeatable product. Zero stars for the not to be believed cost to get it home. Demand it of your local super market manager.

My husband and I recently took a 1 day trip to NYC and while there we tried to get the best NY dining experience, so we ate at Carnegie Deli, where I had to try the "egg cream" - I loved it!  When I got home, I tried to replicate the drink with hershey's syrup - it was horrible!!!  I went on line and learned that true New Yorkers used only fox's u-bet, so I ordered some.  It did not disappoint!  This syrup is not gritty like Hershey's tends to be, has a fudgy taste and best of all stays emulsified in the milk and doesn't settle to the bottom of the glass.

column9: Fox's chocolate syrup is the best chocolate syrup I have ever used.
column10: Fox's chocolate syrup is by far the best chocolate syrup I have ever used. I saw it in the local grocery store here in Pittsburgh, PA and tried it. After using it for about six months, the local store here stopped selling it. I briefly tried the "other brands" and there's no way I can even go back to them after using Fox's.

column9: The Best Chocolate Syrup in the World
column10: To know Fox's U Bet is to love it!!  Nowadays, you generally can only get 'Chocolate Flavored' syrup.  But not this one, oh no, nothin' but the good stuff in here!!  Great on ice cream, milk, and oh yeah, Egg Creams!!!

As a born and raised NY'er, chocolate egg creams ( which contain neither eggs, nor actual cream) are a beverage delight. A true egg cream can onnly be made properly with U-Bet Syrup and since I am now in the Pacific NW, i can find neither egg creams, nor U-Bet (actually I have found one true NY deli that serves them), so this was a find and a treat for me. My fellow transplants from NY are delighted as well....when they drop by, I can offer them the real deal egg-cream and tell them where to find U-Bet. Thanks!

Full disclosure - I'm a New Yorker living in the south. I was raised on chocolate egg creams in the heart of Brooklyn. There was no better chocolate syrup for Chocolate malts, ice cream sundaes and egg creams. In the old soda fountains at Woolworth,s and local candy stores, U-Bet was the chocolate syrup of choice. It's still the best, and it's still in Brooklyn.

I ordered this syrup to try an egg cream. Excellent! Then I tried it to make plain chocolate milk. Also excellent! Since I live in northern Minnesota, and hot chocolate can be a year round drink, I tried it to make hot chocolate. Superb! The next step is to try it in coffee for cafe mocha. I'm also not ashamed to admit it tastes good directly from a spoon.

The only acceptable chocolate syrup for a Brooklyn-style "Egg Cream." I own an ice cream shop in Riverside, Illinois and have visitors from the East coast who are amazed to find egg-creams this far west of Brooklyn. If I didn't use U-Bet, I would be accused of being a charlatan.
Fox's u-bet chocolate syrup is great on ice cream or in milk.  Great taste!

I was born in Brooklyn and directly across the street from our apartment was a candy store with fountain.  My dad would always take in for a chocolate egg cream.  We moved to MA and unfortunately Fox's wasn't available.  My mom tried to make it with other syrups but the taste wasn't the same.  I now live in PA and had my friend bring me a bottle from NJ on her last visit.  Pure Heaven!  I thought I was a little girl again!  She now brings me a couple of bottles each time she comes to PA.  You don't know what you're missing until you use U-Bet chocolate for an New York Egg Cream!!!!!

An eggcream made with Fox's U-Bet...pure bliss! Nothing else even comes close. One sip and I am six years old and back in Brooklyn. Which considering I am pushing 50 and living in North Carolina is no small feat. Got me through law school!

column4: D. M. heintz "A man of letters"
column10: I heard of Fox's chocolate syrup in a discussion about the best chocolate syrup.  I was on a cruise and our dining companions were discussing the merits of various chocolate syrups when one of them remarked about Fox's.I told them I was partial to Bosco, the one I grew up with, but couldn't find where we live. She offered to send me a jar of Fox's when we returned to our respective homes.  She sent it, I loved it and so when the jar ran out, I ordered more.  Thank you!

This is the best chacolate,I order it on line every couple months. My husband grew up in the Bronx's and he loves to make egg cream's with it, just like he had at the soda shops. You can not get this brand in Pennsylvania so the postage is worth it,if we ever make a trip to New York I will buy him a case. He's been dying for a knish!!! So maybe we be making a trip soon.

I bought this product for chocolate milk.  I found it neither better, nor worse than any old store-brand chocolate syrup.  It's perfectly acceptable but not worth the huge online markup.  I think a lot of regional nostalgia is driving the raving 5 star reviews.

You can believe what everyone here is saying....for an Egg Cream, Fox's U-Bet is the BEST.  I have never been to New York - but - there is a soda fountain located at the Beach Club Hotel in Disney World which I have visited "many" times and on their menu they have the "Original New York Egg Cream" and the taste cannot be duplicated with any syrup other than Fox's U-Bet.  You can make a good egg cream with just about any chocolate syrup, but if you want it to taste like the ones you get at a soda fountain "this" is the syrup you need.  And it's sooooo easy to make.  I've been trying for years to make an egg cream at home that tastes like the ones I get at Disney World and I am finally able to do it.  There's just something about this syrup - the taste is unique - and it can't be beat.  You won't be sorry if you order it because it's good just to put on top of ice cream too!

This is 'the one.' Being a born and bred Brooklyn girl, still living in NY, and having attended the 1964 world's fair where this supposedly originated, I am all over this.  I remember going to the local 'soda fountain' as a young girl sitting at the counter and ordering egg creams with friends. I didn't realize then it was a "New York thing."  It's even waistline friendly to make; 1/4" of choc. in a glass, then add 3/4" of whole milk above that, then add up to a cup of seltzer. Mix vigorously to froth and drink. You can kick this up a notch by making what my dad always called a "black and white" ice cream soda.  Add a scoop of vanilla ice cream to your chocolate egg cream...although that will add a few more calories!  This is sold in some but not all grocery stores at under $2.50; so if you can't find it, you can buy it here--albeit at a bit more cost.
The syrup was a big hit.  Unfortunately,it cost 3 times as much to ship as the actual price of the product so won't get it again unless shipping becomes cheaper.

After living in New York most of my life (50 years)my wife and I moved to Maine, there are only three things from N.Y. that I'm having a tough time living without. good pizza, good Italian bread and Egg Creams, I have been going back to the city for these things for ten years now to get my fix, It looks like I'll never get the pizza or real italian bread up here so I'll have to live with that, but I pick up the U-Bets in the city so I can make egg-creams except seltzer in a store bottle doesn't compare to the real pressurized seltzer bottles, somebody tell me where I can get a real seltzer bottle - PLEASE
As a Brooklynite transplanted to Chicago, I really miss my Egg Creams.  Thanks to Amazon, I can now have my Fox's shipped right to my house.  Now if only someone could sell me a real Seltzer bottle.

column9: Seeking a West Coast egg cream
column10: Good stuff, I got it to make egg creams and find it good for everything else you'd use chocolate syrup for. Reminds me of Hershey's, but Brooklyn egg cream die-hards say this is the ONLY one to use. It's good, tastes like chocolate syrup, nothing strange or different about it.

Fox's syrup is  for egg  creams=most prefer  chocolate but i  find the  vanilla  makeas an even  finer  drink-ice  cream!!  you can use anything  for that  but to waste this  marvelous syrup on anything but an egg  cream is a  crime!!
Hassle free transaction.  Product arrived ahead of schedule and in good condition.
I recently purchases fox u bet chocolate syrup.It was awesome. thamk you for prompt delivery*****

We had this dressing when we went to a Luau and it was delicious, then I found this packaged dressing at Walmart and brought it home.  We love it, its sweet yet tangy and a delicious compliment to any salad.  Wish they sold it here locally!

Mmmmm.  This is yummy dressing.  A friend brought it back from Hawaii and then I searched it out on amazon so I could keep enjoying it.  I especially enjoy it on a green salad that includes a little fruit.  The dressing has a somewhat sweet taste to it, similar to poppy seed dressing.

This is absolutely fabulous.  Now I want more.  I would never purchase it at the price of $7.95 per pack. That is crazy. My grandaughter brought me a packet back from Hawaii and I loved it and was elated when I found that I could order it on line.  It is a very refreshing salad dressing and I might even try it as a marinade.  I would suggest anyone who likes something different that you make from scratch to try this dressing.

I am a loyal Ranch dressing eater but my brother brought the Papaya dressing as a gift from Hawaii and I am in love.  I tried it because I started a new diet and wanted something less in fat and big on taste.  It is amazing.  It is exactly what I was looking for.

With the free shipping, it's just like buying it in NJ yourself but with the convenience of not having to carry it to your door!

column9: To me this is the best taste of Gefilter fish but one  bottle was broken.
column10: I would say the gefilte fish is five stars quality but one bottle was broken. I left massage to amazon packing people but with on response to me. My pet goat and sheep respect my electric fences when I have one of these operating them, too.Key features: low impedance, solid-state, imtermittent current and a joule rating of 1 or higher.

column9: Qualit product for a good price
column10: Been very happy with this electric fence charger.  This fence charger gives a spark that will jump a 3/8" gap and my prior charger would only jump 1/8" or less.  With the other charger my horses were getting out routinely but with this one on the fence they stay in.  So I'm very glad to have this fence charger.

column9: The Force Will Be With You!
column10: The force will definitely be with you, if you install one of these chargers.  This fence charger is perfect for keeping predators out, and strong enough to pack a punch, for those enclosed by it.  After one or two times of testing it, my rough and rowdy bulldogs want no part of this system.  We've had this charger now for several months and it works like a charm.  Also, like the other poster says, this unit is what the old-timers used to call weed/grass burners.  It is not susceptible to shorting out, like other weaker units are, when it comes to taller grass or weeds.  The heavy duty definitely applies here.  If you are looking for a good, strong fence charger, look no further.  I would give it 6 stars if I could!

Neither the smoke flavor nor the heat overpower the underlying flavor of this paprika.  It's a perfect balance in my opinion.  This paprika is great in barbeque rubs or just sprinkled on any food to pop the flavors and add a little extra character.  Definitely a new favorite of mine.

I purchased this Paprika as part of my "fully authentic Paella" project recently.  It went in the Paella right along with the rabbit, chicken and snails.  The results were pretty sensational.  I've tried this paprika in many other dishes since then, including a Sunny Anderson Mac-N-Cheese.  Everywhere it goes, this paprika clearly outclasses it's rivals.  This paprika has some real punch.I have a big kilogram jar of inferior paprika from an small mom & pop shop around the corner.  I don't know what I am going to do with that stuff now.  It is flavorless and lifeless compared to the real thing.  Don't waste your life with the inferior stuff.  Buy this instead.

Amazing product.  Really good smoke flavor and HOT!  A little bit will definitely go a long way.Looking forward to trying it in my next batch of chili.The website listed on the can [...] has links to recipes.

column9: Delicious, smoky, subtle, not too hot
column10: As the description says, don't be put off by the word "hot" in the name.  It has a kick, but it's a lot less hot than cayenne.  I dipped a finger tip into it and put it on my tongue, felt a little heat rise slowly, then fade away slowly, leaving a nice sweet, rich smokiness on my palette that lingered for 10 more minutes or so, long after any trace of spiciness was gone.The smoke flavor is fantastic- sweet, mild, pervasive.  Just a small pinch in whatever you use it for is plenty for a subtle smokiness and a little kick, or you can use more if you really want smoke.  Mix it into a spice rub, sprinkle it on any kind of food before you cook it, add a pinch to a salad dressing, make your own BBQ sauce or hot sauce, add it to eggs, use it in goulash, whatever.  With few exceptions, I like to add just a little of any given dried spice to foods such that it adds complexity, if you search really hard you might pick it out, but unless you try or someone tells you, you wouldn't know it's there.  This is a great product for that purpose, if used very sparingly.  This is a very high quality spice, worth the money.  It was produced by artisans, not hacks.
A little hotter than I expected. A little bit for both the 'smokey' flavor and heat goes a long way!

Hot Smoked Paprika from La Chinata is delicious. It gives chicken, fish, eggs, vegetables like broccoli, spinach, caulifower, etc.a smoky taste that is moderately hot, (hardly for me) not overpowering the flavors of the foods and the other spices. I discovered it at a home of a cousin who let me cook in her kitchen. She did not tell me anything about it. I tried it first with chicken that was lightly fried and cooked maily with salt and pepper. it enriched greatly the flavor of the chicken and everybody in my family loved it and asked what I had used.

column9: Good Seasons Basil Dressing made lite
column10: This is a great dressing as well as a good marinate.  To make it lite all you have to do is add 1/4 cup of water to the bottle before adding the oil.  Very hard to find in my local stores so I resorted to buying on line.

column9: Best ever packaged Good Seasons salad dressing
column10: The Basil Vinaigrette Good Seasons salad dressing mix is the best ever.  Wonderful flavor and tastes home made.  Mix half and half olive oil/canola oil, use orange juice instead of water, and a pear infused white balsamic vinegar to create an incredible dressing.  Enjoy.

column9: Best dressing mix but hard to find
column10: We have enjoyed this dressing mix for years, especially when made with balsamic vinegar and served over a salad with tomatoes and fresh mozzerella, but when we moved could no longer find it in the stores.  Glad to find a source for it, although it will take a long time to work through 24 packets.

column9: The Best of Good Season's Dressings
column10: I believe this to be one of, if not the best of Good Season's dressings. When made with extra virgin olive oil and white balsamic vinegar, it's hard to beat!

column9: Kraft Good Seasons Salad Dressing & Recipe Mix, Basil Vinaigrette
column10: The dressing is good with any salad; however, I have found when it is mixed with Italian dressing it enhances the flavor of the Ceasar salad.  It is also good when baking chicken.

I like Good Seasons Italian dressing, but this has a little more flavor to it.  I make it with balsamic vinegar, a spoon of dijon, and olive oil- just yummy.  Easy to have on hand, no bottles to store, great price, and always fresh-tasting.

I ordered $40 worth of product.  When it arrived the chocolate was hot and completely melted.  It tasted bitter.  I immediately sent an e-mail to the seller.  They wrote me back requesting photographs.  I took photographs and sent them to the seller.  I have never received any response.  The final result is $40 spent and nothing to show for it as the chocolate was inedible being bitter and melted into the wrapped with a non-responsive seller.

I thought I ordered Lindt Swiss Classic White Chocolate, but as a surprise I got Lindt White Chocolate Pieces with smooth filling instead.  Since I had never sampled these before, I tried them and found that I really enjoy them for an occasional treat.

OK, let me start out by saying that chocolate is always in my house and office. I always have milk chocolate and dark chocolate, sometimes white chocolate. I bought this because I have tried a bunch of the Lindt flavors and sent them to my pen pal overseas. Yes, people in this day and age still have pen pals! I was explaining in one of my letters that our grocery store has a span of 5 to 6 Lindt bars in various flavors at all times. She asked me what I was talking about because chocolate comes in milk and dark where she lives. So... I bought up what my grocery store had then sent it off to Northern Europe. My pen pal's family loved trying the various flavors.So... when my local grocery store ran out of "new" flavors to send I came to Amazon for help. I put this in my cart, along with every other unusual chocolate flavor I could find (from Lindt and others). When each box of 12 arrived I shared a few bars with the office staff and sent a few bars to my pen pal. This box of chocolate bars DISAPPEARED right before my eyes! I think I sent 3 bars to Europe and the remaining bars were devoured at work. Any buyer of chocolate for an office crew KNOWS when the chocolate is way above par because the pleading eyes come from every corner of the building to grovel for more chocolate.I would buy this again, and again, and again. The box has 12 bars so it should last a few days depending on how many mouths there are to feed. I would certainly stock up in April or May for the warmer summer months (unless you live in the extreme south of the USA, then I would order in the coolest months and stock pile for all the rest of the year).This is a smooth, creamy chocolate. The aroma is fantastic and certainly reminiscent of chocolate. It has a subtle creamy, milk flavor without feeling or tasting burned. The bar is sufficiently sweet without being cloying. The vanilla aroma is pure and delicate but noticeable. If anyone likes white chocolate I think they will LOVE this particular white chocolate.
bought for my 15mo old who eats a lot of pasta. we wanted something healthful and nutritious. i was worried about buying six boxes but he eats them with both hands (a sure sign he likes it)!

Easy food. Open can, drain water from can, take product out, fill with steamed rice. It makes a great, easy lunch. I'm a big fan.I've just got to figure out how to get them out of the can without tearing the packets...

These are light and crispy and tart but sweet.  We originally ordered them in a fundraising catalog, and when they were gone, I had to hunt them down on the web.  My husband LOVES them and I order them special for him.  I have yet to find a Key Lime cookie that compares.  I'm a chocolate chip cookie gal, yet I really like these.  They are also dainty enough to impress friends when you serve them at luncheons or get-togethers.  I have tried all the flavors, and key lime is the best (although they are all good).

column9: Have something really good! Wonderful cookies! They hit the spot! Great snack, Great gift!
column10: These are wonderful little treats, elegantly packed. A treat has to be good, satisfying with 1 or 2 bites, and worth every calorie.  These certainly are!  Crispy, light and sweet-hope Amazon carries these always. The lime essence is in the powdered sugar, so be sure to enjoy that with the cookies.A collection of 6 nicely packed boxes  enables you to give a nice box to a deserving friend. And these certainly are appreciated!Note: freshness is not an issue.
Not the same drops from Flathau that I remember. The ones I was expecting had powdered sugar. I was disappointed.

These lemon snaps are some of the best cookies I've ever eaten.  They taste better than home-made, with a hint of cracked lemon candy inside each cookie.  I would serve them at one of my finest dinner parties.

These are great!  They taste very fresh and have the perfect bite of lime flavor with plenty of powdered sugar.  The packaging is very nice, which made these great gifts for our clients.  The boxes weren't packed very well for shipping to Amazon, so two of six had damaged corners, but the others were in good condition (original shipping boxes inside Amazon's shipping box).
Haven't gotten my shipment yet from Amazon but I've gotten these at TJ Max in the past and they are wonderul.  Sweet and soft.  The Key Lime ones are also fabulous!

When I received these key lime snaps I noticed they were ready to expire.  There is no way we can eat 6 boxes of these in 2 weeks.  They are very good and have a great taste.  I am very upset about this product.  I have never had a problem with any products I have bought on Amazon.  I hope Amazon does something about this. A very upset and disappointed customer.
Great Sauce! Not too hot, but the spice hits you on the palate and warms nice! The flavor is almost sweet!

column9: Much Hotter than expected -- JR sent a milder variety no charge
column10: I bought these because I ran out of the fragrant, fruity green peppercorns that I bought a couple of years back at Zabar's in NYC, and because at least one of the reviews made them sound similar.  The batch I got, however, are hot like a capsicum pepper (hot red pepper.)I wrote a note to JR customer service, and they sent me some pink peppercorns at no charge.

column9: Green peppercorns... great pepper taste without a harsh "bite"
column10: If you are like me and you tend to limit the pepper on your food because you don't like the "bite" of black pepper... try out green peppercorns. They have an awesome flavor that really adds to your plate and yet it doesn't have that bitter edge to it.  That being said, I've ordered green peppercorns from a couple of different spice companies and you can't beat the price of these!  They have excellent value and quality, and I can't recommend them more!Green peppercorns are especially good on fish, eggs, pasta and other light-bodied foods.  I will NEVER go back to black peppercorns again!

column9: Exactly what I was looking for...
column10: I have only one complaint, I would have ordered 10 lbs if they sold them in 10 lb bags that is...  Ok, time to be serious, this is exactly what I wanted and they arrived the same week I ordered them.  I highly recommend to you green peppercorn fans.  Now I just need to perfect my green peppercorn steak sauce...  (any advice will be greatly appreciated.)

I'm on a diet, eat right for your blood type and needed some green peppercorns, These peppercorns are of good quality and worked out great, I'm sold on these.They were a decent price, and this is where I'll buy them in the future.
Great product - super secure packaging.  Would purchase from this seller again.  Peppercorns price was less than other sites I visited.  I am very satisfied. Thank You very much!  Abby
Great flavor. What I needed in the kitchenThe packaging is HORRIBLE!! plastic bag ripped open in the box. I picked them out for 30min.but worth it....
Peppercorns are find, but the package is bad. Unable to open neatly and then it rips open and your berries are all over the floor.

Great peppercorns, fragrant and fresh! I use them in some of the recipes in "Nourishing Traditions", such as fruit chutney. Expensive, so I bought something that was the best value for the dollar and just give them to friends as little gifts. Sent some to a friend who is also interested in NT recipes.
My friends that received these as presents were delighted with getting an unusual but innovative and useful gift. They are good and adventuresome cooks.

These peppers have good color, aroma, and taste. I ordered a pound and am quite pleased with the amount of product per dollar. We use green peppers for many things: poaching salmon, flavoring corned beef, ground in salads, etc. So far I've found the peppers competitive with any other green peppers I've bought and they are less expensive to boot.

This is the best ever of making a great Chicken Ceasar Salad!  We have always found the bottled creamy dressings too thick and not tart ... I marinate chicken breats all day in the dressing, then grill them ... slice and top a tossed salad of romaine, shredded parm cheese and bacon ( we use bacon bits ) add coutons if you like them and you have a GREAT meal!  If the dressing for the salad is too tart or not creamy enuf for you, you can mix with a creamy variety of Ceasar dressing, we use Marie's.I am SO VERY EXCITED to have found this on amazon.com as it can't be found anywhere here in North Florida!  And at such a GREAT price!  Yea!!!!  :)

I had read the reviews and so I ordered the Good Seasons Caesar Dressing.  I was really disappointed that it didn't taste at all like Caesar dressing.  I do remember reading that one person said that he/she didn't think it tasted like Caesar, but with all the good reviews, I took a chance.  I am just as disappinted in all bottled "Caesar" dressings as well as in the many recipe's I've tried.  Wish this had been "the" dressing, but sadly, it wasn't.

This salad dressing is SO good...can't find it in my local store any more, so I was very happy when I found it here.  Not a heavy, creamy Caesar dressing like you get in a restaurant, but I think this is much better.

This is a delicious salad dressing that was not easy to find in my local stores.  It is also available in bulk plus free shipping makes it so very convenient to keep from running out. No wonder some people go into a panic when they occasionally find that it's out of stock of thier favorite things! So far, I've never run completely out before receiving that notice! Good Seasons Caesar is the only salad dressing my husband wants, & he eats LOTS of salad. This is my family's favorite dressing. I was so happy to finally find it somewhere, but not as happy as they were. I thank you & my family thanks you.
I love this product and none of the local stores carry it any longer. Thanks Amazon for stocking this item.

I've used this powdered dressing mix both as a salad dressing and a marinade for chicken. One of the things I like about it is that you don't need to use nearly as much oil for the marinade as is called for on the package directions.  I marinate boneless, skinless chicken so I can grill it.  The chicken stays moist and tender and has a great flavor.  I highly recommend this dressing.

(I purchased a case of 24 mixes)  When we have dinner guests, I am always asked about the dressing...to which I reply, "If you want an item, and cannot find it locally, go to Amazon...they will have it!
I can't figure out why this isnt sold in the stores anywhere but this is the best salad dressing.  I use different vinegars and oils and its just awsome.

column9: Best salad dressing I ever had!
column10: this is the best dressing I have ever had. It is so good, I could almost drink it by itself. I wish it were sold in the grocery stores. I used to be but for some reason they took it out. I can't understand why grocers would delete a product that so many people like to buy.
Unavailable in grocery stores in NC. You make this fresh when you need it. It is the best oil and vinegar type dressing. We buy this a case at a time, we go through case in 6 months! Thanks Amazon!

i don't know what's going on in the grocery stores but I use a lot of Good Seasons Italian and Caesar Salad Dressing Mixes. I intend to get more from this person.Thank you SO much.Try the recipe, it's delicious.Gail Thompson
This is the best dressing and is only available at HEB here in town.  I don't like shopping at HEB so I found I could order it online.  Well, worth it!
Good stuff,  Make with extra virgin olive oil and balsamic vinegar for a healthy mix.  Can't find it in local grocery stores.
This is an excellent salad dressing when mixed with good red wine vinegar and olive oil.  It is getting very hard to find in supermarkets and Amazon's price is also better.
I could not find this dressing in my local stores, so I ordered it from Amazon.com.  I received it quickly and it is delicious.  I would recommend it to anyone.  You just mix it with oil and vinegar.

column9: Great for when you can't find these in grocery store!
column10: Normally I buy these in a standard grocery store, but for some reason in NJ during the winter season I cannot find these on store shelves. Buying bulk was not a problem as the mix is not perishable. Delivery was quick.

You cannot find this dressing in stores around Michigan... for some dumb reason. I just love that I can buy it in BULK now. Thank GOD for amazon. This dressing is the most flavorful and tasty of all the good seasons dressings I have had! I dunno what I would do without it!!!

I love the Good Seasons Caesar Dressing, it is almost impossible to find in the local Grogery Chains, why I don't know!!  I believe it to be the best of all the good seasons dressings and always depend on AMAZON.com to come to my rescue and supply my family with this great product......i will continue to purchase my good seasons thru Amazon.com.thank you

Good Seasons Caesar is the only salad dressing my husband wants, & he eats LOTS of salad. I buy the Zesty Italian for myself; & I experiment with various vinegars, oils & added ingredients in both Caesar & Italian. I've read reviews that reported Good Seasons dry mixes to be the best-tasting salad dressings on the market, & I certainly can't disagree. I know I hadn't purchased this at the grocery store in a while. Much to my dismay they don't carry it. Christmas Eve and Caesar salad is what I was taking to dinner.  Luckily I found a couple of packages in the cabinet.  I am so excited to find they still make it.  I will be ordering a couple of boxes very soon.  I LOVE this stuff.

This dressing is loved by all my family.  My two daughters actually eat salad as snacks, because of this dressing.  When all the local stores stopped carrying it, they were upset.  Thanks to Amazon, we can know order it online.

This mix has been a staple in my kitchen for years because it is versatile and delicious, but the local stores no longer stock many varieties of the Good Seasons salad dressing mixes. It is fresh when prepared in your own home and can be used for both dressings and marinades. The mix keeps for a long time in the package until you make it fresh. Order the box of 24 and share them with your friends.

column9: BEST CESAR DRESSING THERE EVER WAS!!
column10: this product IS SO FREAKING HARD to FIND!!! I am so happy that amazon sells it in bulk! I have looked all up and down the state of Michigan trying to find this product in stores... I have no idea why more stores dont carry it as it is SURE to please anyone who LOVES making and eating salad.A staple in my house just like herbs, bread, butter or milk!Dont stop selling this product AMAZON!!
We received our case of Good Season Caesar Dressing.  It is very good on chicken etc - just sprinkle some on as you are cooking.  Also good for roast beef in a crock pot.  I use it as a spice.

column4: Esperanza Ortiz De Orell "John J. P."
column10: Good seasons is the best for salads, I always use them, and this is good one.

We have a salad every evening for dinner and the only salad dressing we use is Good Seasons Caesar Salad Dressing.  We are unable to find the product in the stores in our area, so we order the  24 pack from Amazon.

I'm so delighted I've found a place to purchase this dressing mix because none of the stores in my area carry it, and it is my favorite.  If you check online, you can also find some awesome recipes that use this mix as their seasoning.  I hunted long and hard to get access to this product at a reasonable price, and thanks to Amazon.com I finally found it.

Finally, I was able to purchase Good Seasons Cesar Dressing.  The grocery stores here don't carry it anymore!  Imagine my surprise that I was able to buy the dressing through Amazon.  The price is great and free shipping.  Mix with oil and vinegar and you've got the best dressing around!
This really is the best caesar ever and it is not sold in stores around me anymore.  A must try!

This is the BEST of all the Good Seasons dressing line. The name "Caesar" is a bit confusing because it does not taste like a classic Caesar dressing. It has a rich tasty flavor, much more interesting than Italian. I make it with olive oil and balsamic vinegar. Every time I serve it, I have people ask for the recipe. I can no longer find it in any grocery stores.
This is the only ceasar dressing my family will eat! I can't find it in the stores anymore, and this is a great buy! Try your salad with bacon bits, it's a great combination!
This is a excellant marinade for all meats.  My husband and I use if for making shish-ka-bobs (chicken, beef or pork).Our only problem is that we cannot find it in our local stores anymore.
Been using this for years and can no longer get it in grocery store. What a shame, it's a great product!

Nothing, and I mean NOTHING, is better than a nice bowl of caesar salad with a hot plate of homemade spaghetti after a long day of not eating anything.  Maybe some Italian bread, too.Caesar salad has a certain traditional taste to it that makes it better than other salads.  When you eat a caesar salad you just know you're eating something healthy and tasty.  This kit allow you to make your own caesar salads whenever it's convenient for you.  I recommend buying if you're a salad person (like me!)

column9: Good Seasons Caesar Salad Dressing & Recipe Mix availability
column10: This is by far the best salad dressing mix. We need to go to the store managers and ask that they stock the Good Seasons Ceasar salad dressing mix. If not we may find it unavailable to us that love it. We can order it online by the box, but how long will it be available if stores are no longer ordering it?
