column9: mix your own good season salad dressing
column10: excellent better then any other already prepared or mix your own taste. our discount food chain deleted this product, located it on Amazon at even a lesser price, plus free shipping.

Our little dog had really bad skin allergies and was on California Naturals for quite a while with no relief. We decided to switch her to the Innova and a week later she is not scratching anymore and her hair is growing back. Hopefully this is the last time we will be switching dog foods because she had a very sensitive stomache as well. Im not saying this will cure your dogs, but it had worked for us. It might seem a little expensive but all in all it will last you longer so its really not very much more in the long run and is nutritionally better for them than store brands. We are so glad we decided to give Innova a chance and she is too!

I own three Miniature Schnauzers and have fed them Innova's Evo chicken forumula for years.About a year ago the oldest dog showed signs of developing pancreatitis after a week in the vet's clinic due to extreme diarrhea and vomiting and the vet wanted me to place her on a Science Diet brand dog food which was extremely low in fat.  We fed her this for about two weeks until I found Innova's Low Fat formula and she's been fine since.Innova's Evo has extremely high amount of fat in it which my oldest can't take so I didn't want my second oldest to also start developing pancreatitis as well so I switched her to the next best thing in my book which is from the same exact company but with a formula which has grains in it.  I agree that dogs do not need grains however the formula helps to lower the amount of fat and protein which some dogs need.I have had no problems on this formula and my second oldest (the one who is on this) has never turned her nose up to it.I trust Innova, they are an independent dog food company which has their own manufacturing plant unlike hundreds of other dog food brands which produce their products in the same plant along side other brands. Some which maybe use the same exact recipe and call it different things or even the same source of ingredients.Innova also has won quality certifications from companies I've heard of before this shows me they really do care for their product.

I fed Nutro Lamb & Rice to my Min Pin for about 8 months because it was on the recommended list at the county shelter. Recently someone suggested that I stop feeding it to her, and I learned about recommendations at a DogFoodAnalysis site.While eating Nutro, my dog's pee was entirely clear and her poop was hard as a rock (she actually looked uncomfortable).Based on recommendations, I switched to Innova Adult Small Bites. Within a day, my dog's pee was appropriately yellow again and withn two days her poo was normal (not rock hard, with less straining). I don't know if there's a link, but I'm glad we switched.This is top quality food.

Our dog is now 13.5 years old.  In the past few years she had become slightly lethargic and her face has started to show her age (I can relate to that). I decided to start taking better care of her by giving her better food. She loves the Innova dry food and has been eating it for 4 months. Plus, the changeover did not upset her digestive tract. Perhaps my wife and I are experiencing the placebo effect in regards to the new dog food. But, our dog now looks and acts like she is 10 years old as opposed to 13.5.  Maybe I'll try some Innova myself (just kidding!).  If you don't mind spending a little more on your dog's food, plus the cost of shipping, I highly recommend Innova.  I just wish that the local stores carried it so that I wouldn't need to pay postage.Update:  As of mid-2011, "PetsMart" now carries Innova products in their stores.
People in the know, told me this dog food is excellant.  I agree.  More importantly, my dog does too.

column9: Love this tea!  Tastes as good as homemade
column10: I have been plagued with viruses & sore throats & sinus infections a lot this year. I'm not a big fan of hot drinks, but hot tea really does help soothe sore throats and helps sinuses drain, too.My favorite hot tea when I'm sick has been homemade Ginger-Lemon tea--heat the water, chop the ginger & lemon, put all in a teapot & let sit for 10 minutes and then add honey or sweetener.  It's great.  It tastes (and smells) yummy.  I would make it in big batches & put in the fridge to microwave by the cup.This Twinings Revive Herbal Lemon and Ginger tea brings the workload down to a simple heat water, steep tea bag, add sweetener. No chopping, no clean up.  No going to the grocery if you're out of lemon or ginger.When you are sick, faster and easier is way better.  This fits the bill nicely, thank you.  The taste is exactly the same as my homemade, too, and I was really surprised by that.  I was expecting it to be weak or either too lemony or too much ginger, but it's not.  It's very tasty.It's also caffeine free, of course, which is a good thing overall, but especially when you are sick and need to rest.There is a little overkill on the packaging.  The box is cello-wrapped, and each tea bag is individuall wrapped, too.  I don't know that it's necessary to do all that, but I'm sure it extends the shelf life considerably, and nobody wants "old, dried out" tea.  I think Celestial Seasonings has a waxed paper solution that seems to work and seems a bit more "green", but they didn't have this flavor.Highly recommended!

This definitely nails the flavor of a strong Gingerbread cookie! Lots of ginger of course, along with cinnamon and a touch of rich molasses. It's very spicy, much like a gingersnap, and makes a great latte--especially with a pinch of brown sugar, which really enhances the hints of cookie flavor. This is a great holiday treat, especially when combined with Red Leaf's Eggnog matcha!

I didn't eat a lot of gingerbread as a kid.  When I was growing up, gingerbread wasn't a huge tradition ... to me, gingerbread was nothing more than part of a story about a cookie that came to life and got the whole town running after it.But I did eat gingersnaps.  And I loved them!  And since my childhood, I've tried a few different gingerbreads - some were cookie-ish, some were more cake-y or bread-y than cookie ... but I've only tasted a very few that I would say tasted as good as the sharp, peppery snap of a gingersnap.  That warm, sassy spice of a gingersnap - that's what I like!And that's what I taste with this Gingerbread Matcha from Red Leaf Tea.  It is warm and spicy, but not in a hot spicy kind of way.  More of a warm, exotic spicy taste.  And while I did not taste a lot of "bready" or "cake-y" or "cookie" kind of notes to the Matcha when it is prepared traditionally with water, after preparing it traditionally and taking a few sips, and deciding it needed something more, I added just a splash of milk to it, and that did the trick!  Now I have a gingerbread Matcha latte that is absolutely ah-mazing!  I love it!

Ah gingerbread. Is there anything more comforting than a chewy ginger cookie around the holidays? Well yes, probably (haha realism!) but that is definitely one of my favourite things! My simple pleasure. One of my other simple pleasures is a perfectly golden brown grilled cheese! Hmm all of my simple pleasures soon to revolve around food... I digress!Simple pleasures in matcha form! Way quicker than to bake a cookies, cheaper than buying a batch, and I can drink it! YES! I am very pleased with this matcha. : )The first time I tried it was shaken in a waterbottle! This was not the way to go haha. It tasted like ginger water - definitely tasted like it was good for me! Just not too palatable.Whisking it up hot with a pinch of brown sugar is *definitely* the way to go! Holy moley that's good! Sweet and gingery (VERYgingery) with the depth of molasses. I tamed the ginger with a splash of cream and was more than happy with the result.

column9: Very nice for the holidays or anytime!
column10: If you like gingerbread but not all the sugary sweetness of it - this is the matcha for you. This has all the spices you would find in ginger bread - or ginger snap cookies without the sugar attack.For me its not sweet enough so I have to add a little something but it is good enough I could get away without adding it.There is a slight bakey flavor in this tea but its mostly ginger, and an all spice blend sort of spice note in it.

This tea gave me the best idea ever: Zombie Gingerbread Men. Every year for Christmas, I make cookies for my wife and sister-in-law to decorate and they are insane with it. In the past years we've ended up with Ed Wood, an Orion slave girl in a Star Trek uniform, a Purple People Eater, and many, many other cracked decorations. These two really shouldn't be trusted with pastry bags. But yes, this year I am definitely making sugar cookies with gingerbread matcha and letting them go at it. I should get some of those gingerbread men cookie cutters that look like they already have a bite taken out of it. I need to do a trial run to be sure they taste alright, maybe for Hallowe'en.Anyway, yes, on to the matcha. Well, one thing is for sure, it is definitely GINGER bread. The ginger is very, very strong, but I'm not entirely sure that's a bad thing. Maybe a touch of brown sugar will help round out the edges, because right now I can't really taste anything but ginger. I tried it witht he brown sugar and while it did bring out the molasses goodness of gingerbread, it's still a bit too gingery for me. But the taste that remains on my tongue is amazing...maybe I'll get used to that bite of ginger over time.

column9: This stuff is the crack of salad dressings.
column10: Seriously, this stuff is addictive.  My family argues when it runs out, the same way we would over who finished the last of the milk.  The flavor is hard to descibe but it inspires a certain fanaticism in most people and I've never heard anybody who wasn't impressed after trying it.  The Sesame and Miso has a stronger, spicier flavor, but this is light and really improves mild lettuces like iceberg.  Another advantage is that a little goes a long way.  It isn't the healthiest (but what dressing is?), as it's high in salt and has about 7.5 grams of fat per tablespoon.  On the other hand, it is cholesterol free and has no preservatives added.  I figure, since I enjoy salads now and wouldn't touch them before, that it's a good trade off.  And, really, it tastes amazing.

This dressing is absolutely delicious.  It is light on the palate, but fills your mouth with a pleasing richness that really compliments a salad.  I use it with arugula or watercress and spinach for a simple and easy to make salad that easily compares to restaurants.  Yes, the price is a little steep, but try it and you will LOVE it!!  And this is from someone who makes his own salad dressing.

column9: This stuff is addictive. You'll never use another dressing again!
column10: I found the Pietro dressing at a food show years ago and was so annoyed that I couldn't find it in stores. Now, thanks to Amazon it's available on line delivered to my door! Here's how I first got hooked. The demonstrator had a bowl of lettuce. He put two pieces of the cut up lettuce in a small cup and then added TWO DROPS of this dressing on top. I tasted it and it was HEAVEN! It has a VERY high fat content but that's not BAD. The secret is to use just a LITTLE. Don't just "pour it on". The flavor is so intense that you will taste it immediately. This is my favorite flavor of the 4 they offer. Miso & Ginger come next. Even the Pickled Plum is interesting.The company ships fast and has A-1 Customer Service. With the convenience of ordering on line, you don't need to search. Thank God for the internet.Steve
I'm a big fan of this salad dressing.  Made with tasty stuff.  Tangy without the vinegar taste. I won't eat anything else on my salads any more.

I love this salad dressing! I can't eat salad without it. It is very unique. If you like Italian dressing with a soy base you will love this. Amazon is the only place I can currently buy it. Love It!!!!!!!

I asked for this for Christmas, and received this as well as the ginger one.  It is so good!!  Good for salads, stir-fries, plain rice, marinades, etc... I am an Asian food lover, and this is the best product I have ever tasted.  I could eat it by the spoonful!!  I wonder if anyone has ever tried it in a soup??  I am sure it would be good in anything you put it on.  It is truly addicting........great product!!
Before discovering this dressing, I rarely ate salad. Now I eat it with a spoon.

I used to hate salad until I met this dressing. About 10 years ago, I tried this dressing for the first time, since then I have been enjoying eating salad. My husband had never liked salad either until my parents brought this dressing from Japan 3 years ago. This dressing really changed our eating habits.

Wow, I whole-heartedly agree with the two other reviewers.  I tried this dressing for the first time only a couple of days ago, in New York.  I have to say that I'm not big on American-style salads (i.e. and in general, a ton of lettuce with a bit of carrot and tomato, plus croutons and cheese) and am indifferent to most salad dressings (Ranch, Italian, French).  But when I tried this dressing on a rather average salad, I was so blown away that I had to stop the conversation at our table after the very first bite in order to ask what the dressing was.I am from Texas, so I was a little disappointed to hear that the dressing was purchased in New Jersey and that the person who had it has never seen it in New York City.  I was about to purchase the dressing online when I saw on their website that it appears they carry these dressings at Fiestas!  I'm really excited about that and hope it's really so, it's going to be the first thing I do when I return - run to a Fiesta and purchase that dressing.  I also should mention that the title might be a little misleading: I am not particularly fond of soy sauce myself, but I think that there is so much more than just soy going on in that dressing, that I'd recommend you give it a try even if you generally don't like soy.I'm never using another dressing in my home!

column9: Too heavy on the onions and garlic, but tasty otherwise
column10: I'll admit it: I'm a freak. I don't like onions or garlic. Shoot me.Other than the evil alliums in this dressing, though, it's like serious salad dressing crack. There's something sweet and salty and vinegary about this dressing that combine in perfect harmony to make a really awesome dressing.Strangely, I like it OK in salads, but I like it even better on a sandwich. Ever get oil and vinegar on your sandwich? It's like that, only better. There's gotta be MSG in this stuff, because - wow, it's addictive.The onions and garlic definitely cheapen the flavor to me, so it only gets four stars, but if you like dried or granulated onions and garlic, you'll dig this dressing. Also good to dip soybeans in.

We are so glad to be able to order Angelo Pietro salad dressings from Amazon.  We used to be able to buy them in Atlanta but the specialty food store that carried Angelo Pietro dressings closed and we have had a hard time finding them since.  As other reviewers have said, a little bit goes a long way so don't worry about the fat content.  It is delicious on salads or on sliced vegetables like home grown tomatoes or cucumbers.  The ginger dressing is just as delicious and is very low in fat.  Once you try Angelo Pietro dressings, you won't go back to your old salad dressings.  We highly recommend both the Shoyu Soy Sauce dressing and the Ginger dressing.

My office orders this K-Cup practically every week and since I am responsible for finding the best savings on our kitchen products, I have been continually impressed with Celestial Seasonings Green Tea K-Cups. It's a smooth tea that never disappoints.

column9: An Early Review: Biting In A Good Way
column10: I haven't had the chance to test this salt on a variety of foods:  this review is based on nibbling on little crystals right out of the bag.  I have just bought seven different salts and this salt (at first taste) seems to be the saltiest to me:  it bites my tongue as I bite into it:  I consider this a good thing.  I don't know if this is a mineral thing, a texture thing or even a 'my mind is playing tricks on me' thing.  4.25 Stars.I will update later with a more complete review (if I don't get lazy!).
This is the tea that helps clear gunk out of your lungs. I have lung disease and I usually drink a cup at bedtime.  It also happens to taste great hot or cold.

I love this stuff I get sinus infections a lot and it helps clear stuff out when I get bad, and I only really need it maybe once every couple days since it really has a strong cleansing effect for my lungs.

column4: Mary Jo Sminkey "15 years of Amazon Reviews!"
column10: Always one of my favorite Haribo gummi candies, these grapefruit slices are fairly large and because they are thin, have more sugar coating to gummi ratio than most. They have a nice grapefruity taste without being overly sour. They do however tend to get kind of hard if sitting around for awhile, so I was pleased that the bag I got from Amazon was very fresh and all the candy still nice and soft. 5 pounds though is a lot of candy! Vacuum packing 1 pound bags works well to keep them fresh a long time.

I love the flavor of this stuff, and managed to get several other people addicted to it, to.  At first, you think it's a crazy idea, but it grows on you.  The service of this company was great and the product was fresh and delivered timely and in great shape.
Probably because it is made in Spain for the S. American market? Some Haribos that I made are made in Hungary and I think they are for the European market, which is not as sweet, but very flavorful.
I swear these gummis are like some sort of euphoric drug. They should be a controlled substance they're so good. Buy a bag and a jar to keep them in (if you can resist eating them all at once)

column9: Best Gummie Candy Ever? Count on It!
column10: Haribo makes consistently good candy and they really outdo themselves with the White Grapefruit flavor gummies. The flavor has a wonderful, natural bite to it that is about as far from artificial as you can get. The thickness and sour sugar distribution all harmonize in what I find is the best candy PERIOD. I love to throw a bag of these on gift orders for friends or family to ensure I get free shipping and to blow their minds with 5 pounds of pure indulgent heaven.If you are hesitant to buy such a large bag of only one flavor don't be shy. You will wish you had bought two. If you really must insist on variety go for the Haribo Gummi Candy, Fruit Salad, 5-Pound Bag but I promise you the white grapefruits will be the first to go.

These were absolutely wonderful!  Very fresh and having it shipped overnight prevented the common issue of the sugar falling/rubbing off.  I'll definitely be coming back for more if I ever manage to finish this gigantic bag!
Always receive this candy fresh and timely. Definitely worth the purchase! Autoship rocks. 2 years of gr8 purchases on this candy.

The package arrived right on time! We opened the bag and the room was filled with a wonderful grapefruit scent. The candy was fresh, practically tasted like it had been made that day. Haribo is a genius with flavors! I highly recommend this. I'm so glad this stuff is available online, ever since the candy shop nearby closed I've been craving it. Great stuff!

Five pounds of gummy goodness is an impressive amount. Not over-sugared and perfectly textured, this product is as addictive as it is delicious. The five pounds lasted my wife and I about three weeks - and we ate several handfuls a day (you're welcome, dental hygienist!).
This is the best candy ever!  Even my friends who do not like grapefruit loved it! They are delicious! YUM!
Product was fresher the first order I placed last year, but theses were good too. Fast delivery and a very reasonable price.
The grapefruit candy gummis are awesome!  Amazing flavor.  Perhaps we'll try the pink ones next time!  Always delivered fresh and on time.

Our whole family loves these yummy grapefruit candies.  Don't order them in the summer though unless you will be home to receive the package because they will melt in the heat.  It is a great deal and we will buy them again!
These are for Christmas gifts in little jars...but I just feel like eating them! Thank you! We dont find these candies over here!
Very tasty, not too sweet but very real grapefruit taste.Very good just like I remembered them. I received them fresh and soft.

I purchased this online since we are no longer able to find this item at Walmart, it tasted GREAT however well more than 1/2 the bag was melted into on LARGE block, I am not sure if this is stored in a warehouse or if it was from traveling UPS in the Florida heat but it was basically a waste of money, we only got to eat about 1/3 of the bag and we discarded the rest :( This is my FAVORITE candy and to throw it away was such a waste.

Wow, I order it Tuesday in the AM and it shows up Thursday afternoon with free shipping! I was worried about ordering food items from Amazon, that it would come in melted and all stuck together because of the 90+ degree heat here in Florida. But no the bag was cool to the touch. The candy was fresh and what flavor! Thank you Amazon! I will be buying food items from you from now on !!!

These are the best candy and I needed them for a wedding candy buffet.  They were the first to be eaten and were a big hit.  They arrived two days after orderingthem and it was a great purchase.  They are so delicious and unique.  They Haribo grapefruit candy is amazing.

I discovered these grapefruit gummies several years ago when the mall had a bulk-buy type candy store. When that went out of business, it became hard to find these yummy treats. I was so happy to find them on Amazon!  They are just the right mix of sweet and sour and I love the sugary coating on them. Like other reviewers, I like to leave them uncovered so that they "harden" just a bit. I like these better than the pink grapefruit gummies because the pink ones tend to stay real soft and I don't care for that texture. I will have to "ration" these to myself or I will go thru this big bag in no time! I highly recommend this delicious treat!

column9: I love these.. and I love them even more after letting them harden a bit!
column10: I used to be able to buy these by the scope at my local grocery store, but they disappeared long ago.  I was ecstatic to find these on Amazon.  Others have mentioned them being bigger than they remember from Haribo's Fruit Salad.  I am not familiar with this offering, but these are exactly what I remember being sold separate from other flavors. They are tart but do not have the pucker factor or sour candy.  I think it is the perfect mix of sweet and tart, and now is what I crave when wanting gummy candy (hence this being my second order). I do like them immediately after opening, but I love them even more once I've left them open for a few days and they harden slightly and the center firms a bit.  Ahhh.. perfection! You will notice a decent amount of white sugar at the bottom of the bag, but when eating the individual pieces, I do not notice 'bald' spots or lack of flavor.
I've missed these since the bulk candy store went out of town a few years ago.  As good as ever and actually a lot cheaper then when I bought these back then.

i would give this product 4.5 stars. i like the chewy gummy texture and it has a decent grapefruit taste.  It is a little sweet and i would not mind some sourness in there too, but overall it still taste great and is a good snack.amazon shipped this ultra fast i ordered on sunday and it got here on tuesday (earlier than expected times of Wednesday and Thursday) and it came in great shape.

column9: The best, freshest, not-too-sweetest treat, EVER!
column10: I have an extended family of 17 who go crazy over these candies; about 5 of us are serious addicts, so Amazon's price point is a real bonus.  We love them fresh, we love them slightly stale (but it's hard to let them "air out" to that pleasantly al dente consistency unless we hide them for a few days), and we love them half-dipped in melted dark chocolate.  I'd like to try the pink grapefruit slices, but I'm afraid they won't be quite the thing.  Long live Haribo (and Amazon)!

I love Haribo grapefruit candies and have paid through the nose for them for many years.  This is the best grapefruit candy at the best price.  Thanks, Amazon!Haribo Gummi Candy, Grapefruit, 5-Pound Bag

column9: So happy to find these for a great price!
column10: These are my favorite candy, and they've become increasingly difficult to find in stores.  This is a great price, and the candies are a nice blend of tart and sweet!

This gummy candy tastes like fresh grapefruit without all the sticky mess. Each triangle shaped piece is lightly dusted with just the right amount of sugar to balance the tartness of the candy. Candy stays fresh for a long time if the bag is sealed in an airtight container after it has been opened. The flavor is excellent for all grapefruit lovers.

There is really not much to say other than this delicious candy is a sweet bargain!  This is the same candy you buy in the "dolled up" specialty candy store at the mall that they sell for 2-3 times the price per pound.  We have all gotten the little plastic bag at the store and thought we were going to buy just a little bit of this candy, only to find out it costs an arm and a leg when you checked out. This candy came fresh, delicious and at a money saving value.  Highly recommended!

These are the best candies ever!  I remember digging through the Haribo mixed fruit bag to fish out all the grapefruit pieces when I was a kid.  My mom and I both loved them!  I was completely surprised to find them in a bag all their own.  It made a wonderful gift to send my mom!  She said that they are even better than she remembers!  Sweet with a little tartness to them makes the perfect combination!  Oh and the bag is huge! ;)

these were exactly what i was looking for when i was in the mall. our specialty candy shop was going for $4.50 1/4 pound!!! i found another shop but still was $2.50 1/4 pound...these candies came fresh in a sealed bag by my ups man and he even approved the flavor...this big bag did not last long in my house better order me another...pink grapefruit is awesome too...

The candy was delicious, but it wasn't the same grapefruit slices I came to expect from the Haribo Fruit Salad.  They were larger and thinner. Honestly have the same taste but the ratio of surface area (powdered sugar) to volume (gummi sugar) was a tad off in my books.  Definitely worth purchasing, but didn't fulfill the void I expected it would (I miss living in NYC and finding them EVERYWHERE!)

The first time I bought these, I bought them for someone else who claimed them to be a favorite of theirs. Up until then, I had never tasted them. Wow, what a surprise they were to me! The flavor is tart and fresh and not artificial tasting as so many fruit flavored items are. Except for the actual chewy candy texture, they almost taste like eating that sugar-sprinkled morning grapefruit half I used to have for breakfast! Haribo also sells Pink Grapefruit candy like these, but I find the white to be much more 'authentic" and having that tart taste I like along with the sweet. The ones I have gotten through Amazon are a bit softer than ones I purchased elsewhere; the others were just as flavorful, but a bit tough and I much prefer the ones from here that are just a tad bit softer. Mmmmm......they make my mouth water thinking about them. I don't buy them for my friend now....I buy them for ME!!! If you like grapefruit, indulge yourself and buy these.
Great adult candy!  Who would have guessed by the name Gummi Grapefruit?  Tastes just like a fresh grapefruit slice.  Love it!

These are delicious.  They were very fresh and flavorful.  They have a very nice grapefruit smell but are not sour at all.  I was a little concerned about the sugar coating but it is pretty thin.  I would definitely order these again and will need to soon.  My girlfriend takes a baggie full every time she comes over so they are disappearing fast.

These are on my top ten candies.Unlike chocolate products, a characteristic of such sweets are that you never get sick of them.  A complete 5 lb bag of these was devoured in less than a week. Of course, with a bit of sharing with some select, close friends.will buy again. and again. and again.
The soft and fresh taste was better than when you would buy these by the pound in the mall for ten dollars a pound would reccomed to any one.

Personally I do not like gummi candy nor do I like grapefruit flavored anything, but OMG I love these! We are on our second bag and beginning to run low so we are conserving until they come available again(currently unavailable). I will only buy from Amazon so I can get the free shipping because the other companies charge as much in shipping as they do for the candy! They arrive very fresh and I have a food saver so I vacuum seal what's left and they keep fresh. My last order was in February and the candy is still fresh. Awesome product...but beware- once you try them you will be hooked!
These are just like I used to buy in the store, if you like grapefruit flavor you must try.  Excellent
HARIBO WHITE GRAPEFRUIT....It's like eating fresh grapefruit.  Not too tart, not sweet, just perfect !! I don't think Haribo could improve at all on these, that's how good they are.

I got this for my wife.  This is by far her favorite candy in the world.  It is a great deal compared to Mountain Man or other speciality candy stores/sellers.  They are kind of tart as well as sweet.  My kids really like them as well.

I generally buy these at the mall as a treat to myself.I broke down and bought the big bag.So glad I did.These are a lot fresher in both taste and consistency than the ones you might get at a candy store.They even have a great smell- I didn't know they had an aroma.I'm just hoping now that I will be able to ration myself and make them last a little while.
This is the familly favorite flavor for the gummi candies.  The only problem we have found is 'out of stock.'
This product is fabulous. Have been searching for this for some time, since it disappeared from the local market. Wonderful true grapefruit flavor. Love it!!

This candy is amazing!  I've always bought it from the pseudo candy shops in the mall, which charge nearly $10 for one pound!  Amazon hooks us up with this delicious treat for a fraction of the cost!  I will be buying this candy on a regular basis just for my own personal enjoyment.Thank you, Amazon, thank you!

I always get this candy when I go to the store back home, but can't find it out on the east coast.  These arrived softer than I've ever had them and more delicious than ever.  And the correct white kind too... I love them.
I love these delicious candies but,alas, my order arrived in one melted mass with no slices left. I will reorder when the weather is cool enough to allow them to be shipped and arrive intact.

column9: not as sour as I'd hoped
column10: they sent the pink kind, not the white kind.  Still tasty, but not what I ordered.

column9: Good product, but not when shipped.
column10: I love Haribo grapefruit slices generally. They've been awesome when purchased at a local store, with a nice grapefruity and sweet/sour taste.However, buyer beware when purchasing online or mail order - when shipped around a lot, it appears that the citric acid granules get shaken off the candy slices, leaving them far less sour than they are supposed to be. My big 5-lb bag has a pile of citric acid in the bottom, and it does not reattach itself to the candy, even if poured over. The end result is a rather bland tasting piece of candy.  So if you're a sour gummy lover, only buy these locally!!

column9: tasty, convenient, though sugary and high calorie
column10: These Oat Bars are very tasty, and extremely convenient. However, they do have a log of sugar and calories. Also, they are a bit expensive.  Strawberry is not as good as the Cranberry or Apricot flavors.

First ate these when hiking in the Rocky Mountain National Park with my niece.  They are so fresh tasting.  I was also hungry and needed energy and they sure helped to renew me so I could make it down the mountain.  My son and I ordered them and the box of 12 was gone quickly.  I can't wait to order more and try the other flavors. I obviously would buy again.

column9: I love Bobo's bars, but mine arrived EXPIRED!
column10: The date on the package was clearly 2 months expired. Item shipped from Amazon. They gave me a full refund, and were very nice about it, but still, I hope they correct the mistake in their shipping department. I actually took a bite out of one before I realized it was expired (tasted terrible).BUT - these are GREAT tasting bars, I will buy again.

I'm so excited to see Bobo bars here.  They are my favorite of all the healthy snack bars and usually have a hard time finding them where I live. Hooray for Bobo's!PS....Amazon DOES need to work out some of their shipping problems.

column9: Even my picky eaters (3 and 5 y/o) loved it
column10: I've been having an extremely hard time feeding my 3 and 5 year olds.  It seems no matter what I put in front of them, they turn their noses up.Although, I didn't notice any difference from any other pasta out there, because of the vibrant colors my kids gobbled this up.  The ingredients look all natural and it tasted great.I will be buying this again.
This was so good! I double the amount of everything and made a 4lb pork loin roast. My family loved it. I will be going back to stock up on this one!!

I have 3 cats, one with IBD, and this food is the absolute best food I have come across. It is appealing to all 3 of my cats, and all 3 seem to have differnet tastes, but still love this food. All the ingredients are natural, and my very trusted vet and folks at PetSmart all recommend this food. Give it a try!

column9: A bit sour but very filled with great vitamins!
column10: Taste:  A bit sour and it doesnt taste like there is any sugar whatsoever in it.  Cranberries are bitter by nature.  It has 8 grams of sugar per 6fl oz serving and 48 calories per serving. 3 grams Sodium 125mg Potassium 12g Carbs- 25% Vitamin C 14% Vitamin E and 4% B6.  3% B1, 2% Magnesium and Iron 1% A, Calcium,Niacin,Folate,Phosphorous,Zinc.Side Note: I am appalled at the price on Amazon!  You can get the Lakewood Pure Cranberry at Publix Supermarket for about 5 dollars!!  How can they charge this much for 6??  and then add 25 dollars shipping. Please people go to Publix, Harris Teeter or other higher end grocery stores to purchase this if you can. That's terrible to charge people  [...] plus [...] for shipping!
Best juice I have tasted, and so pure, just  what i have been looking for, i want to order some more.

column9: L&M is quite a bit better
column10: If you have never had pure cranberry juice, then you might find the Lakewood exceptional.  However, it is not nearly as good as  L&M.  Compared to L&M, the Lakewood tastes sort of watery and flavorless, as if Lakewood used a lower quality of cranberry in making their juice.  The L&M is alot crisper and full of good cranberry flavor. The L&M color is also nice and bright red, whereas the Lakewood is considerably more brown.  As far as I know, they are about the same price.

We purchase this at our Publix store when on sale at $1.00 less; the regular price is $10.00 which is very high for retired, elderly people.Any place near Lilburn, Ga where it is less?A great pure product.

I was delighted to be able to buy this product that was pure and no sweeters added to it. It was exactly what I was looking for...a healthy drink! Very fast shipment also! I enjoy adding it to water....lasts longer.

I bought these for my 8 year old daughter.  She loved them and my husband and I did a well.  They are pricey, but nice for a treat.  My daughter even said, 'Mom, do you realize I have not had ravioli for two years?  These are great!'We will be packing some in her lunch this week.
Wonderful - doesn't taste Gluten Free.  I really missed ravioli and this is great!

I thought when I was diagnosed with Celiac Disease that I would never get to enjoy ravioli again.  This is not only JUST ravioli, its really GOOD ravioli!!! I can't believe I was able to have ravioli for dinner again!It is quite pricey but it is TOTALLY worth it!! It's soo good!!

column4: Karen Fine "Author of How I Eat Without Wheat"
column9: You would never know it's gluten free
column10: Conte's gluten free cheese ravioli was a fantastic surprise. Did not expect it to taste "completely normal" and my husband (who doesn't eat gluten free) didn't believe me when I told him it was. Had to check the bag to make sure. That's when I KNOW it's good. :-)
Nice GF pasta, rice-emphatic flavour and texture; cook time takes some figuring out but pasta does hold together if you just slightly undercook. Freezes well.

We've been Gluten free for almost two years now. One thing we have really missed is ravioli. I debated on purchasing this because it's pretty expensive but I'm so glad we decided to give it a try! It's better than regular ravioli. It's really light and the cheese is really lovely... not that mushy watery cheese so many frozen ravioli brands offer. I only wish it was offered in a family sized bag. My son pretty much ate one bag by himself! Be sure to serve with a salad and some veggies to make it stretch.

It is so great to be able to eat cheese ravioli again. My son is a super picky eater and he loved them.  They are somewhat expensive compared to regular ravioli but the alternative is not having it at all.  Great for a splurge.

My daughter has celiac and has been complaining that the only thing she really misses is ravioli.  I hadn't been able to find any in my local stores-- so thanks amazon !!!  It arrived in a cooler pack, still frozen.  My daughter had it for dinner tonite and was so happy-- she loved it.  Worth every penny !
An excelent product.  A package should serve three, but it was so good, my husband (who is not GF) and I ate the whole thing.  Easy to cook and serve.  I definitely will buy more.
So yummy!  My son is Gluten Free and LOVES these!  And i have to stop myself from eating them - they are so good!
The ravioli is ok but not really to my liking. If you must follow a gluten free diet - I would give it a try. But don't set your expectations too high.

This is the only gluten free freezer ravioli I have found. They cook quickly and with a nice sauce are a great addition to my gluten free diet. They can be a little slippery though. Looking forward to trying the spinach ones soon. The price also seems a bit steep.

column9: What a treat for a celiac!
column10: My teenager who has now been diagnosed with celiac for 2 years loves these.  I make my own stuffed shells and lasagna but ravioli is something I don't make!  So these are a great treat for him!  HOwever they are very expensive.  HE will eat one bag per serving...so at approximately $12 per bag....it is a treat he only gets once in awhile. Thanks to conte's for making something special...just work on the price and you will get 5 stars from me!!!
WHEN YOU ARE ON A GLUTEN-FREE DIET AND HAVEN'T HAD RAVIOLI IN 7 YEARS, IT MAKES YOU SKEPITCAL WHEN BUYING - THIS RAVIOLI IS DELICIOUS BUT PRICEY - ONLY FOR SPECIAL OCCASIONS IN THIS ECONOMY

column9: A must try gluten free food.
column10: These are absolutely the best yet. I will never try making homemade ravioli again. They do not even taste gluten free.
These are really quite good for gluten-free, except they should be frozen, so I'm not sure I would purchase them online.  Gluten-free has come a long way!
I was at my house when the UPS guy got there and the package had a frozen ice pack in it, but none of the packs of pasta were frozen at all. THANKS A LOT
Soooooooo tired of being charged super-outrageous prices for products that are gluten-free.  Before you purchase this, please realize that you are paying $17.05 a pound.

column9: The Fabrege of the Gluten Free Pasta World
column10: I can't BELIEVE I'm being charge what amounts to 12.79 PER BAG for something that has ingredients that are easier to grow that wheat!!Someone gave me this bag as a present/treat. Yes, they are tasty. No I don't think it's worth it to pay almost 13 dollars to enjoy ravioli's again. I'd rather buy a pasta roller and make my own than pay this price.Disgusting that companies will take advantage of people like this and I won't support it.
I ordered flowers for Father's Day, and it was delivered within two days. But the carnations were wilted when they arrived.My uncle was not pleased with my gift.

column9: The best tea I have ever had the pleasure to enjoy.
column10: This tea is everything the package states - 'calming and refreshing to ease your soul'. It is organic in a pyramid shaped biodegradable tea bag. It is smooth and one bag makes several cups. LOVE IT!

Thought I would review this cat food and give a five star rating since the other rating was not on the food but on whether Amazon has this food consistently. My cat has been on this brand and type of food since he was a kitten. In fact, this is the only wet food he really likes. He is healthy and his coat is beautiful. When I can't order it here I get it online  at Mr Chewey.

column9: Something my Bengals will happily eat!
column10: I have two Bengal cats who eat a predominately wet food diet.  A year ago my vet was horror struck to find out that I was feeding them Fancy Feast.  It was the only thing I could get my two to eat consistently.  One of my girls is on the skinny side, so it was very concerning to switch foods.  They would only eat chunky food in gravy, nothing minced/paste like and no seafood!  They won't even eat tuna from a can!  I finally found a food they with Nature's Variety Homestyle.  If you are new to the brand, it is important to know that the Homestyle indicates the chunky meat in gravy, where the regular Nature's Variety will be the minced/paste like consistency.I am only giving this product 3 stars because I really wish this was consistently an Amazon Subscribe & Save Item.  I am overall very happy that I have found a cat food both my Bengals and Vet can agree on.

Since my cat was diagnosed with allergy to chicken, I have found this particular product its favorite. I have tried numerous sources, both local and online, to find a steady supply. Only Amazon.com has been able to fulfill this need regularly.

These peanuts are excellent. Nothing like the grocery store variety. Crunchy, fresh, perfectly salted and stay fresh in this size container. At a party, they are gone in a flash. Great product at a great price. I'm placing my second order.

This one was a little too sweet/strong for me. I think the other reviewer's reaction was very strong, but I can understand it. I actually ended up using this in a smoothie instead of juice- which was good because it added a hint of the vanilla taste, and I still got all of the benefits. If I'm thirsty, I would probably go for the Mojito KarmaLife Coconut Water, Mojito Green Tea (made with Real Green Tea), 12 oz glass bottles (Pack of 6) but this was definitely a good option for the smoothie

This coconut water tastes like a water and honey mixture, although there really isn't any honey in it! I love coconut water, so I wanted to try something with a hit of something sweet to it, like vanilla. But I don't like this all that much. I'm going to stick to plain coconut water next time!
These bully sticks were very good; in fact, too good for my dogs, they ate them too fast.
This stuff really works.  It is a little stronger than the original strength, so I can use less.  It worksmuch better than coffee in the mornings with no crash.

My finicky cat would not eat any wet food but Fancy Feasts. When I found out what ingredients went into that product, I decided to switch him to a different brand. The pet store that I went to recommended several different brands to me. I bought several, including Nutro. He did not like the Nutro at all, and left the whole can out to feed some ants. Then, I opened a Merrick can. As soon as I opened it, he was bothering me to hurry and feed him. He gobbled up the wet food like I'd never seen before. Since then, we adopted a second cat, and she also loves it. She has the same response when I open the can. We brought in a stray cat several months ago, and she took to this food right away, too. I have not heard about a cat that hasn't liked this brand of wet food. I have recommended it to many people that I know who are cat lovers. The cats enjoy it, but I like it because it's healthy. My cats have great looking coats, which the vet always comments about. The true reflection of a cat's health is their coat, apparently.
My finicky kitty loves both the Ocean Breeze and New England Boil.  His coat is shinier.  It is a great product if you are looking for something that isn't filled with grains.

Recently, I got as many varieties of Merrick's for my cat to try as I could. I usually feed him a custom raw chicken diet, but for travel or when friends are taking care of him that isn't practical. I used to use Wellness CORE dry and wet cat food but it was just getting too expensive. I was pleased when I found Merrick's, and love that it is made in Texas (my native state!).My cat did not experience any bowel problems with this food. His litter box did smell much worse than when he gets raw chicken, but that is easily fixed by cleaning. I do recommend researching how to switch your cat's food safely to avoid any possible digestive system issues such as diarrhea or vomiting.My cat LOVED the New England Boil. He leapt up on the counter when I opened it and nearly tripped me in his rush to his feeding spot. I fed him this mixed with the Wellness CORE to switch him over and he actually licked up all the Merrick's wet food immediately and searched around his feeding area (with his dish still containing Wellness CORE kibbles) and came begging over to me when he couldn't find any more wet food.Five stars from kitty!I also rate this five stars. It is made here in Texas, and with real quality ingredients, I can feel good knowing my cat isn't eating meat flavored corn and wheat!

If you're really gung ho on feeding this to your cat, you might want to pull up a litter box while they eat. Otherwise you could find yourself cleaning diarrhea out of your living room rug.I originally bought three cans of Merrick cat food. The first smelled spoiled and neither of my cats would eat it. The second was fine, though they didn't like the chunks and would just lick up the gravy. And the third one made one of them (and then me!) sick.One for three is an awful average, and I won't be buying this brand again. I'll stick with Wellness and Eagle Pack instead, thanks.

I bought this tea as a gift based on the fact that all the other stash teas I've personally tried have been good, and several months later after the initial disappointment we are still trying to make it come together right. The problem with this one is that the chocolate does not blend right with the actual tea. The flavors are all there, but the chocolate unfortunately feels filmy and leaves a weird lingering taste. The package suggests adding milk and sugar to bring out the hazelnut. This works for that purpose but the chocolate still does not come out right in either flavor or texture. Also, mixing the tea with hot chocolate overpowers the hazelnut. It helps to steep the tea bag in pure hot milk with no water added, though.

The tea bags are smaller than I'm used to getting from Bigelow, so the tea itself is weaker with the same steep time.  Sugar and cream are absolutely required however, as it is only boardline palletable straight.  If you are expecting something along the lines of hot chocolate in tea form, you will be dissappointed.  There is a hint of chocolate in here, but its overpowered by the "hazelnut" which itself isn't exactly like any other hazelnut flavor I've ever tasted.Don't get me wrong, it is actually an enjoyable tea, but no one I've given it to as a blind taste test have been able to guess "chocolate hazelnut" as the flavor.  Several got that there was chocolate in it, but that was the closest anyone could guess.Very good as a late night relaxation hot tea, I honestly could not picture drinking this cold (and do not intend to try).  Once I'm finished with the box though, I do not intend to buy more.  It was an interesting novelty tea, but it isn't something I would drink on a regular basis.On a side note, I bought this tea at a Target for far less than the listed price plus shipping here on Amazon.  Indeed try it for yourself, but don't buy from here.

These pickles are awesome! I love them! They are the perfect mix of hot, sour and crispy! I will keep buying these over and over. I absolutely love a good hot pickle and this one is great. They make my head sweat and I love that! Funny thing is no store in my area sells hot pickles, thank God for the internet!
Thick and flavorful! This is a large bottle, but gets eaten up fast ! I buy 3 bottles at a time.

This stuff is awesome. I bought a bottle of this a couple of weeks ago and it's almost gone. I used 16 oz. in place of diced tomatoes in a recipe for NEW MEXICO STYLE POSOLE and now I'm addicted. Just ordered 4 more bottles. Can't wait to make up some TEX-MEX CHILI. This will make a great base. If you don"t like cumin then you probably won't be thrilled with this. They sell a regular style of this at Walmart made by the same company but this is much better.

column9: Pinto Beans without "Bisphenol A" in the  lining of the cans
column10: This is a great product, healthy, low sodium, great taste... from the only manufacturer in the US which does not use cans lined with a Bisphenol A epoxy.None of the other "Organic" suppliers bother to use packaging without BPATry their garbanzo beans and black beans as well!

Not only are these beans the best tasting canned beans, they are the only ones I've found that us a BPA-Free can.  They are more expensive, but they do seem to have more beans and less water than others.
The best canned beans I've bought.  I make excellent soups and salads with it especially when I have limitted time to cook.
Great item. Love the fact that it's in a safely lined can. Just add some of your own spices and yummy!

column9: Good quality, but beans tend to stick in can
column10: The quality of all Eden organic beans is excellent.  Being preservative free with very little sodium (less than 100 mg per can), the flavor of the beans comes through and is excellent.The one complaint I have about Eden pinto beans is that they tend to chelate (leech their protein).  This causes them to stick in the can, and removing them requires one to force them out of the can with a spoon, knife, or fork.  The end result is that many of the beans get smashed, which doesn't work well if you want to boil or cook them, although it would save some time in making a vegan version of re-fried beans.Note that you'll find brown specks in some varieties of Eden beans.  Do not be alarmed: the specks are kombu (kelp), an organic sea plant that's used as a natural preservative.  The kombu can be consumed with the beans, or you can rinse it away.
When making homemade beans it is a pleasure to have a variety of beans and trhis is a very special dish knowiung it is of natural organic products

I have been purchasing Eden Organic products for years.  We are particularly interested in "no salt added" products and Eden puts out great quality beans, at a very reasonable price.  Amazon makes it easy to order with free super saver shipping.  Prices are better than at our Health Food store an hour away.

column9: Eden Organic Beans are great - no salt added + BPA free cans
column10: With Amazon's Subscribe & Save pricing, this order cost me less than $1.42 per can. At the local health food stores (HFS), the best price I can get is 1.83 on one discount day per week -- regular price at one HFS is 2.29, higher at the other.Our local Kroger affiliate stopped carrying 3 varieties of Eden Organic Beans in their health food and organic aisle. Perhaps this is because they offer store-brand organic beans in several varieties -- however, those are neither low sodium nor no salt added AND they don't use BPA-free cans.I have also purchased the Eden Organic dried beans through Amazon Subscribe & Save and they are excellent, but it's nice to have that better-than-fast-food convenience of just opening a can or two to make bean salad or other recipes.I like supporting organic farmers in the USA -- the dried organic red kidney beans in my local health food store are from China!Several of the cans in this dozen were dented and this may account for varying prices among Amazon's Eden Organic 12 packs. All perfectly safe.

A wonderfully, smooth and creamy bean.  The best I have ever tasted.  Filling and satisfying.  My "go-to" bean I can always rely on for a variety of meal ideas.  The Bispheanol-A free cans give me peace of mind.  Although the beans stick a little at the bottom of the can, it's no big deal for such a good product.  I just gently pry them loose with a spatula.  Only two cans arrived dented, but were not bulging.  No worries.  I will be ordering these again and again as soon as I run out.

I love these beans and Eden Organic is a great, trustworthy brand.However, more than half the cans arrived noticably dented. I've always heard dented cans can let in bacteria, so they shouldn't be used. Amazon is great about issuing a refund, though.

I was lucky enough to try these out as part of their Kickstarter campaign a month ago.If you like kettle corn as much as I do, you'll love this new way to enjoy both sweet and salty in one bite. The popcorn itself is delicious, and the flavoring just makes it outstanding.Maybe it's just the Canadian in me, but Maple flavour does conquer all simple sweets.

I really want to love this product.  First of all, the advertisement is wrong.  You do NOT get 3 boxes for this.  Essentially I paid $15 for one box which only has two bags inside.  That is 7.50 per bag.  Secondly, the bags would not pop.  After 8 minutes, not 3 minutes, I still had half the bag unpopped.  I microwave popcorn all the time so I can't figure out why it would not pop and the ones that popped started to burn.  Overall, great concept but poor quality and TOO expensive.
I am more than glad that I supported Quinn Popcorn's Kickstarter's project. Excellent, all-natural tasting popcorn at a slightly hefty price. You really do get what you pay for here.

column9: Lightly Sweet with a Touch of Salt: What More Is There To Love?
column10: The Vermont Maple & Sea Salt is VERY delicious. Just the right amount to sweetness with salt - you'll wonder why no one thought of this before.

I just popped a bag on my stove, and only nine kernels were not edible!  I used a 3-quart Revere Ware pan.  (The next time I'm going to try a stockpot.)  I put the heat on medium high and poured the oil in the pan.  I dropped three kernels in the pan with the oil and put the lid on.  When the three kernels popped, I poured the rest of the popcorn into the pan.  I put the lid on and kept the pan off the burner for 30 seconds (this brings all the kernels to the same temperature).  I put the pan back on the burner and shook it on the burner while the popcorn was popping.  It didn't take long for all the corn to pop.  (I found this how-to on YouTube.)The Quinn maple-salt popcorn was delicious.  The seasoning was light enough for me to taste the popcorn.  Popped on the stove, it was not oily.  If you are unsure how your microwave will pop the corn, I would encourage you to pop it on the stove.  Quinn Popcorn also has great customer service.
First time we made this, my wife and I ended up eating the entire bag ON THE WAY to the couch from the microwave. One taste and were reduced to silent munching. This is seriously delicious popcorn.

I avoid all forms of popcorn since they contain too much salt and butter to my liking. So when I heard of Quinn via kickstarter, I was all all excited and could not wait to get my hands on a box.I was lucky to try a box of Vermont Maple and Sea Salt and they were yummy! Perfect blend of salt and sugar and absolutely delicious.Its Quinn popcorn or nothing for me!
The only problem I have is that my daughter keeps eating it so I have to keep buying more! It is a little more work than the regular grocery store stuff, but so worth the effort!
We love quinn popcorn!! I couldn't ever get it to pop perfectly in the microwave, so I just use our air popper. My only wish is that they sold the popcorn and flavor packets in bulk.

I love popcorn, but I don't buy the microwave stuff because it is so bad for you! I would eat it everyday, but breaking out the air popper is a pain. I will be buying boxes from my local market and enjoying this whenever I am too lazy to break out my popper. The Maple & sea salt is just the right combo of sweet and salty. I also love the Parmesan rosemary. I made it at work and everyone was mad for it! One review said you get what you pay for: they are right, you are getting the highest quality and best product on the market. Thank you Quinn Popcorn.

Okay, I just inhaled a bag of the maple and sea salt. this is super yummy and doesn't taste all fake and greasy the way the other stuff does. I really enjoyed this and cant wait to try their other flavors. I especially liked that you added the grease yourself afterwards so you could control it. the maple is real and not fake. Try it!!!

My family loves Quinn's!  I saw them on Kickstarter, but not in time to be a backer.  I placed an order on Amazon when it became available.  It was a huge hit!  My sister, sil, everyone loved it.  I sent a packet to a sleepover and the mom was eating the stale leftover popcorn the next morning.  She said it was too good to waste.  I sprinkled some cinnamon on one of the bags to mix it up and that went over really well.  The other two flavors (lemon and sea salt + rosemary and parmesan)  are really good too.
I love maple so was looking forward to this.  I found it to be a bit bland, not bad tasting  just bland

good apple juice.  the  10 ounce bottle can be split between 2 people, especially children.  mixes well with other beverages including adult  alcohol.  can purchase at Costco for less, when they have it.

This is by far the best apple juice I have ever tasted.  Neither me nor my husband likes apple juice I originally bought this for my grandchildren because of it using Apples in the United States.  When we tasted it we were both drinking this juice.  So good  even the grandkids want the apple juice in the apple bottle not that box.  I always buy two cases at a time.

Plain and simple, this is the BEST apple juice that you will ever drink. It is not the cheapest juice out there but it is well worth it. It would be a good thing to give as a special treat to some kids (or adults). I keep it in the fridge. I PROMISE that you will go gaga over this.
Martinelli produces the most fabulous natural fruit juices you will ever taste.  The sparkling cider especially is superb!  Buy it you'll like it in any form.

We love Dale's so much we ordered it online when we couldn't find it in our local grocery stores. Give this a try instead of your regular beef marinade. Just don't leave it on too long. Great service from the vendor, too.

column9: YOU HAVEN'T TRIED TEA, UNTIL YOU'VE TRIED IMPRA!
column10: I was not a regular tea drinker until six months ago, when I spent time at my girlfriend's parent's home.  Her family is from Russia, where they culturally drink tea ALL DAY, EVERY DAY...  So, as you can imagine they offered me a cup of tea, and I said "sure", because I thought tea was nice to drink (but certainly not my favorite thing to drink).  I was blown away with how good this IMPRA KNIGHT tea is!  It is NOT bitter, but very smooth and gentle to the taste buds.  I am now a regular tea drinker!  I have also ordered the IMPRA EARL GREY tea, which is absolutely amazing tea as well (earl grey is spiced with a hint of bergamot - a small lime that grows in Europe).  The back side of the IMPRA tea boxes are written in Russian, the front side in English, so apparently they market the tea on both sides of the globe.  I guess it is fair to say, you haven't tried tea until you've tried IMPRA!  No joke.  To back up this claim, I've introduced IMPRA to my father, mother, sister, friends, etc...  all who are Americans - and not usual tea drinkers - and they've all been blown away with IMPRA.  They now drink it regularly.

Extremely easy to work with, i did not have any difficulty using this like others reported.  I used a large kitchen knife to cut off a small section and DID NOT microwave it to make it supple as recommended on the package.  I simply kneeded it in my hands and then rolled it out.  I like this product much better than the Wilton Fondant... much easier to use, better taste and it didn't 'sugar' or change color over time.  i made samples and left them out over a week and they still looked awesome a week later!

I thought I could save some money by buying in bulk. Unfortunately, I made a disappointing mistake. Compared to other stevia extracts, I found this to be a very mediocre product. I found its potency to be very weak. To get the sweetness I like, I have to use about 4 times the amount of my favorite stevia, and then the aftertaste becomes too bitter. The stevia extract that I really like begins with a K. It may seem pricey, but you will need MUCH less and it will have a much better aftertaste. If you really want to try this brand, buy the smallest amount you can, because it can't be returned once opened.
my pup loves these and i love that they are healthier than a lot of treats being sold, they are dry and won't mess up my pockets and they are high value for her so great for training!

column9: Yes gluten free and tastes GOOD!
column10: I have Celiacs disease and must eat a gluten free diet or I get very ill.  It is great to find a cereal that NEVER makes me ill! It is 100% gluten free!I also love the taste of this gluten free cereal! This cereal is like corn flakes but without being boring! In fact, I mix them with plain puffed rice to lessen the fruity flavor because I like milder tastes and do not have a big sweet tooth.Anyway, I love this cereal and highly recommend it to people on gluten free diets...BUT if you can eat whole grain cereals like wheat and oats EAT THOSE INSTEAD because they contain FIBER which is very needed in keeping your digestive tract healthy.This cereal is created and designed for those of us who cannot eat whole grains.MY FAVORITE CEREAL MIX:1. Gorella munch2. Gluten Free Rice puffs3. Amazon FlakesThe mixture is SO good that even non-Celiacs want to eat it!

I've been living gluten free for about a year, and I'm pretty much used to not being able to eat a lot of the foods I used to (wheat pasta, regular bread, etc). But cereal has been tough giving up, which is why I love the whole EnviroKidz line. This particular cereal is great because it's somewhat similar to Kellog's Frosted Flakes, but doesn't taste overly sugary. I've never liked cereals with lots of sugar, and this one doesn't contain a huge amount of sugar. It's also fairly low in sodium, cholesterol, and carbs, which is great. I'd also recommend Gorilla Munch, another EnviroKidz cereal. But these Frosted Flakes taste great (no pun intended.)

My son and daughter need to eat gluten free and after trying several cereals from the health food store, I think this is the best GF frosted corn flakes.  I eat them for breakfast even though I don't have to. The price on Amazon is great.  I'll definitely buy them again.
An excellent, crunchy cereal. I do wish there were more vitamins and minerals in it, as it contains tiny amounts of only vitamin A and iron.

column9: Wonderful GFCF cereal- the best out there.
column10: This is the best GFCF cereal out there.  There are not many.  Better than the Gorilla munch.  My 8year old loves it.

I have to agree with Sue's husband on this product.  I need gluten free products and have been searching for a cereal to enjoy both in the morning and as a snack.  This cereal and the others in the group are all excellent.While kids would enjoy them, they are not a sweet as other cereal's.

From my husband's mouth:  "The thickness, the crunchiness, the sweetness of this cereal makes this the best I have ever eaten" and he is far from a Kid!  He also said it makes a good snack for in between meals.We have been trying to find gluten free foods for him and there was only one other cereal - and it left a lot to be desired - so we were very glad to have found this!Frankie Sue Reed
This cereal is really good, a little less sugary than regular frosted corn flakes.  My grandson loves it.  The fact that it's gluten free makes this a perfect choice for us.

We have tried all the Enviro kidz cereals, this is the only one we give a thumbs up. We always order cases of this for our GF house full, 6 of us! We like it because it doesn't get soggy like traditional frosted flakes, so it stays longer in the bowl. It's worth buying, you will want more.

After reading several books about todays health issues I have decided to start my family on organic food so we gave this cereal a try both of my kids love it and eat it almost everyday I sweeten it a little more with either organic coconut sugar or organic blue agave syrup. If you want to start organic and healthy give it a try I have picky kids and they love it.
This is a great cereal and my family thinks it is better than Frosted Flakes.  Both my kids have to be Gluten Free and this has been an wonderful addition to our pantry.

I ordered this cereal based on the good reviews here and else where on the web. I also have tried and love the Envirokidz Organic Leapin' Lemurs Peanut Butter & Chocolate Cereal, 10-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6). Unfortunately the frosted flakes taste nothing like it's standard counterpart. The flakes are hard, but not crisp. They are also very lightly sweetened.This is the one environkids cereal that I couldn't find locally, and now I see why. Overall I feel like this was a waste of money.
My son loves this cereal. It's a great value for the money. It's not loaded with sugar- only 6gs, no fat and has 2gs protein. It's great for being gluten free.

Just enough sugar and alot less than any other regular frosted flakes I used to eat before being diagnosed celiac. Product stays crisp in the box withouth resealing. And stays crisp in a bowl of milk. It is not often that a gluten free product exactly mimics the mainstream item but this one certainly does. Tip: The manufacturer makes the same product for adults but it costs more! So get this one, the Kidz version!

I'm a GF newbie (late 20s.I've been surviving off this for about two months now. I eat it all times of day. When traveling, I fill Ziplock bags for the plane  don't judge) and zip one up in my suitcase. It is probably the only product I can eat and not complain about.Nowadays, they taste better than Kellogg Frosted Flakes!

column9: Healthier alternative to traditional frosted flakes
column10: Check out the ingredient list on these.  You can prononce all of them easily and count them on one hand.  We really liked this cereal after purchasing it because it is gluten free.  The flakes are a bit thicker and crunchier than regular.

This product is very similar to corn flakes, which I ate sometimes before I had to go gluten free. It's not my favorite product in the envirokidz line, but it was good. I wanted to also point out this little joke. AMAZON Frosted Flakes review for AMAZON.com. LOL! :)
These are bad, but they are great. They pretty much taste like corn flakes. Love the kinkajou, thats why I bought it!!
I have been eating EK GF Flakes for about 5 years and like them.  Is this price correct? $60/box of 6?  All the other EK products are about $20/box of 6.

I ordered the Traditional & Zesty Dukkah, not knowing what I would really be getting--it looked interesting.  When I got it, I loved it.  It's great on bread with olive oil, wonderful on tomatoes, vegetables. Will definitely order again.

column9: Excellent healthy delicious organic soup base! Great for kids!
column10: A friend told me about this product. She is very health-conscious when it comes to food for her kids. One of her kids has allergy, so she has also been looking for good gluten free food products. She first found this line of soup base in a high-end food store in the East Coast and tried it out. Her whole family loved (and still loves) it. She sent me one as gift a few months ago and we tried it out and my kids love it too. We used to boil meat and vegetable or 2-3 hours and used the soup to cook food for the kids. This was very time and energy consuming. We tried other soup bases in the past but the kids complained about being very thirsty after drinking those. This one is great. It saves us a lot of work and the kids still get healthy delicious soup! I recently found it on Amazon & bought 5 different flavors. The order arrived within 2 days with my Amazon Prime membership and we now can enjoy the different flavors.

I use this in a beef style marinade for portobello mushroom fajitas. Turns out great every time! I'm glad to finally have found broth flavorings in granule form, the cubes are such a pain to me. I also bought the chicken and veggie. All have tasted great.

This product is good, but not great. I don't really expect to repurchase.  The flavor is o.k but it seemed like I had to use alot of it to get the flavor I was looking for.  In a pinch I would use it again, but only because it is gluten free. I think some other gluten free brands work better for me.

I used this to make French onion soup for my vegan girlfriend. As an avid carnivore, I was pretty skeptical at first, but once it was dissolved in the water it smelled surprisingly good. I would definitely be able to tell the difference between this and beef stock in a blind taste test, but I was happy with it just the same. Very tasty!
Nice flavor..good addition to a vegetarian and/or vegan  diet. Good in beans, soups and stews. Will definitely buy again. Highly recommend.

i am a converted veggo and used to LOVE steak. (stopped eating meat because of the treatment of our animals and the fact that any meat that is NOT organic is basically a toss between fatal and toxic)doesnt taste like beef whatsoever. something good to compare it to or to say that its similar to would be chicken ramen noodle seasoning. Almost exactly the same taste.... not quite as potent since it has a much lower sodium content. If i were this product's company, I'd rename it chicken base. also, it's yellow..? the same exact color as ramen noodle seasoning-chicken. at east make it brown if you're going to claim it tastes like beef.it is tasty but the advertising is a bit misleading.
always on the lookout for things that are gluten free and can take the place of other off the shelf stuff. This works well and tastes good.

...okay you know the rest /// you might pick up some BEAN-ZYME on amazon.com if you buy this much BEAN.  Ha ha... I did.  Great deal for ORGANIC and delivered right to my home.  I hate to cook - even if it means boiling beans so this is a real life saver.  I'm happy... the beans are bright red, firm and DELICIOUS.  Love the cans... no rush to use them.  Thanks for reading.

These triple ginger snaps are wonderful.  They are amazing.  They are the best.  But at $500.00 per pound, they seem a bit pricey.  Surely one can find a lower price.  If not, buy them here.  They are great.

First of all, this stuff gives you energy, without the "cracked out" feeling other energy products give you. I drink it everyday to get me going. I've never been an energetic person, and I find it hard to get going every day. I also have a weak stomach so coffee and Red Bull(& the likes) are out of the question. I stumbled upon 5 hr energy at a gas station, but was taken aback at the price (around $2.50/bottle) but decided to give it a try...I know this may sound silly, but this stuff really has changed my life.I now have the energy that I need to get through the day. I describe it to others like this: after you take it, you don't even feel any different until you realize "hey, I'm not tired anymore." That's whats great about it. You don't get those shakes and other negative effects that some other energy drinks give you. It just gives you enough energy to wake you up, and get you motivated.****If you've never taken it before, just try drinking half of the bottle first, and see how you feel. It won't hurt you if you take the whole thing, but there's no sense in wasting the other half if you don't even need it!******

I purchased this product as an alternative to a rawhide. Our 5 month old German Shorthair Pointer puppy ate it in a matter of 6 minutes or less. She loved it, but it was more of an expensive treat.With a puppy, I needed something to satisfy her chewing urge. The treat fractured into small bits all over the floor but our dog was willing to pick those up. The pieces looked rather sharp and that was a concern. Others mentioned it was made in China and I would like to add the first ingredient is corn.  It might last longer for very small dogs.

Good product, but more of a treat for my dogs.  It took them just a matter of minutes to have the SmartBone gone.  Maybe good for dogs that are not big chewers.  I was hoping for something more digestible but as sturdy as rawhides

column9: Safer than rawhide, don't last as long but also cleans teeth
column10: I picked these up from my local pet shop for a bit cheaper than what they are on offer for from Amazon, so you might wish to shop around.Over all I am quite satisfied with these "bones." They are much safer than raw hide chews given they are made from dried chicken, which means unlike raw hide you know these are actually digestible. This is the biggest reason I bought them. My vet recommended not giving my Sheltie raw hide as they aren't properly digestible. Whether this is true or not, I've heeded her advice.Baird, my Sheltie, really seems to enjoy them. When he sees one coming out of the bag, his tail is wagging like crazy. He enjoys these as much as our old family Sheltie McGyver enjoyed raw hide. The only difference I see between these and raw hide is that raw hide lasted roughly 30 minutes longer in chew time than these. I'd say Baird can chew through one of these in about 30 or so minutes, while our old Sheltie could chew on a single raw hide for an hour, at which point we would throw away the little nub. There is nothing left of these bones after 30 minutes.As far as the dental application goes, it does smell of mint, so I assume it should, if nothing else, help with doggy breath, though to be fair Baird has never really had "doggy breath." I also use some dog mouth foam so I don't know what really keeps his breath "fresh" between the two.If you aren't too sure about raw hide for your dog and want something you know can be digested, these are definitely worth it.For those that try to keep track of where the things they give their dog come from, these are made in China. I've tried finding something similar not made in China, but it seems such a thing doesn't exist or I just can't find them.

Great product but made in China. Once I realized this after purchase, I got a little worried. Kind of over priced in the regular retail market. My dogs like it & have been ok but I wish I knew ahead of time where it was made.
SmartBones Dental Dog Chews are the perfect treat for my two pomeranians and one Pembroke Corgi. No rawhide, nothing to upset their sensitive stomachs. They "dance" when I give them their daily chew.

The girls lost their taste for rawhide, but were still looking for something to chew. They love these Smart Bones, and they are better for them as well. I will be reordering them when there gone!SmartBones Chicken Dog Chew, Mini, 24-Pack
Read your labels, people!!! SMART bones are made in China!!!!!! A neighbor told me how great these were. After buying them, I read the fine print in the back. "Made in China!!"
there wonderful, my dog loves them, and I feel good giving them to him, I will always get these for him.
My dogs just love these and the chews are safe for them. Their breath benefits from the mint and their dental exams show much less plaque . I must keep bags on hand; they expect them.
I have given this bone to several different breeds and sizes of dogs and it is a major hit! And I don't worry about them choking on it as you do with rawhides. LOVE this product and will buy more!

column9: picture of the package of the dog chew is not what I recieved
column10: If you open the link to the Smartbones you will see that it shows a picture of a package containing a 3-pack of dog chews.  I did not get this bag, I recieved a single dog chew.  I was under the impression by looking at the description on the bag I was getting a single pkg of 3, Not just 1 dog chew.  This made these quite expensive and I ordered two :-(

This is junk. Taste like water. No comparison with others like Bonsai Espresso Blend Espresso from Veltons or even the one that sells in Whole Foods. Try  different grind size (smaller size it gets better) and similar results. It goes to the garbage.

This coffee is perfect for espresso or even just for drip coffee with mild to rich taste. If you want more rich aromatic coffee, go for Lavazza Gran Filtro. This coffee almost does not have any characteristic, which I like the most, though.

I actually really loved these. I was looking for some dried raspberries that tasted like some that were mixed in with a Trader Joe's trail mix. I could not find the same raspberries anywhere but here. These were exactly what I was looking for! They don't taste like the freeze-dried raspberries, but are more moist. They are really easy to eat and taste amazing. The only reason why I gave this review a 4 is because of the price. I think the price is a bit steep, but my guess is because it might be difficult to dry raspberries. If the price were lower, I would literally have them on a repeat order basis. However, if you are looking to try these, definitely do so! I think you will be happy with your purchase.

column9: SOOOOO yummy. A little soft too.
column10: The raspberries are delicious. Not totally dry but soft like fresh raisins. No odd things in with the berries, high quality. The only way to make them better is all organic. Intensely good.

I have been a Lipton loose tea junkie for 50 years and as Lipton loose tea is getting hard to find locally I ordered some Lipton yellow label loose tea online thinking I was getting the same tea as I buy in the store. IT IS NOT THE SAME TEA! It's not bad but not as good as the "Lipton Loose Tea".

I have recently started drinking hot tea again (since my childhood when Grandma made us hot tea with milk & sugar) and have been trying different types and brands of tea to find my favorites.
