I really liked this Hazelnut coffee when it was sold in canisters as I can take exact qty I want for my cup and it was more or less reasonably priced.Now this one is exact opposite - I can NOT take exact qty I want for my cup and it is NOT reasonably priced.So knowing that it can't compete with their previous (canister) version they just discontinued canisters.DO NOT BUY IT - unless you want to encourage corporate greed and arrogance by Nescafe.Tasters Choice is well on its way to join a list of brands destroyed by greed and stupidity.

I love this stuff. Not acidic and amazing flavor. Not fake tasting at all. Simply amazing. But Nestle, stop trying to scam us with the way overpriced packets!! You are already suffering from the consequences and it will get worse!

I have enjoyed this coffee in the canisters for years, and have found it just as good as freshly brewed coffee with a wonderful hazelnut flavor.  The canisters are so convenient and reasonably priced.  Please bring them back.

I totally love this Hazlenut coffee and was shocked when I went to reorder the canister 3 pack and found it was no longer available.  These individual packs might be nice to have in my purse when I am out and about, but at approximately 25 cents a serving, they make absolutely no sense to have in my kitchen!  I did find some canisters for sale on a kosher grocery website and just stocked up.  A bit more expensive than what I was paying on Amazon, but still a way better deal than these high priced singles.  I hope Nescafe brings back the canisters or I will be looking for another brand of coffee.  So bummed out!

Unfortunately, I've been drinking coffee every since I was a baby, and I am now addicted to coffee to a certain point, but not too severely.  Sometimes I just have to have a coffee fix.Fortunately, I'm usually not too picky about the type or style of coffee I have for that fix.  Now sometimes I do have to have a cappucino, so I go to the natural store to get one (they are the only place I have found that will use coconut milk or almond milk, as I do not drink soy milk).When I am at home, sometimes I don't feel like making a whole pot, and one cup will be sufficient for me.  Therefore, these Tasters Choice Hazelnut Instant Coffee Sticks are very convenient (and tasty) for me.  I love the flavor of hazelnut.Not only do I drink these hazelnut instant coffees as just coffee drinks, but I also cook with them.  I also use them in my smoothies.  Coffee-flavored smoothies are wonderful, as I love the flavor of coffee.

This is an outstanding product.  The taste is unbelievable for a instant coffee.  If you match this with the Creme Brulee flavored creamer from Coffee Mate, it is fantastic.  You don't need at add anything else.  Right amount of sweetness and complexity as the (artificial) flavors intertwine in a sweet harmonic dance of awesomeness.  You can also drink this black and enjoy the nutty flavor.  None of the aftertaste or characteristics that accompany an instant coffee.  The vanilla and regular Tasters Choice is not even close to this one.  They got it right with this product.  If you enjoy coffee, you will love this product.The best is when you take your cup and jump in a cold car the sweet smell fills your car.  Step out of the car for a second and jump in again, it will be worth it.  Unbelievable.  Try it.  works good in a small car anyway.Such a great product thus it saddens me not to give it the full five star rating.  Just because of the packaging.This is great coffee that needs to be back in the canister.  Please take a moment to send a comment to Nescafe Tasters Choice website under the 'contact us' section.  Its more expensive in the packets under the guise of 'convenience' or 'freshness'.  Lies.  Don't be fooled people.Read a comments under the canisters of this coffee and you will see more.

I was lucky to stock up on the canisters last summer.  Now I have just three left.  I've written and called the company several times.  They don't listen well.  What a pity, this is wonderful coffee, but the sticks are too small and wasteful.I started a Facebook group for fans of the canisters who want to show their numbers, and hopefully get the company's attention.Amazon disallowed my first review with a link to the group.  If you're interested, just Search for "Nescafe" in Facebook.  You'll see it: "Please Bring Back Nescafe 6.1oz Canisters."

I almost hate to say it, but I really love this product. But Nestlé doesn't seem to care about what its customers want.  They care more about the higher profit margin that is generated by the new 20-pack box.  (Today's 20 cup of packets - $3.39, yesterday's canister used to get about 100 cups for $5.29 in my area.  I guess this is the way of the corporate world these days - just look at AIG and other lending agencies.Nestlé - please bring back the canisters...

column9: Love the Coffee, Hate the Package
column10: My mom and I have been drinking this coffee for years and absolutely love it.  It is well-priced, tastes great, and it's easy to keep in the office to make at work - not to mention way less money than heading to a coffee shop.  BUT, I really hate the new packet format.  First of all, one packet really isn't enough for me for a good cup.  Second, they are annoying to open.  And most importantly, these are the opposite of environmentally friendly.  Why do we need all the excess packaging?Bring back the canisters!

I love this.  It's just the right amount of flavor: not so much that it feels like I'm drinking coffee-flavored hazelnut syrup, but enough that I don't even bother with sugar.  And it's got enough caffeine to keep me going without burning a hole in my stomach.And, guys, I LIKE the packets.  I can throw a few in my bag without relying on the company's coffee pot or for when I'm travelling and they take up practically zero space.  I only wish the packets were a bit larger.  They seem geared for the 6 oz. place-setting "coffee cup" that no one really uses, so I need two for a regular 10-12 oz. mug or 3 for my oversized mug.  But they are a great size for adding to a mug of hot chocolate to turn it into hazelnut mocha.The only thing I dislike is the way people have downgraded this product because it's not their beloved canister.  Write a letter to the company instead.  People who look at reviews on Amazon are looking for information about -that- product, not about how you wish the company would bring back a different version.

column9: I am gonna throw these away
column10: very very terrible taste. The worst coffee I have ever tried. I am going to throw all these away. waste of money. Don't buy this product!

I have used Taster's Choice Hazelnut Singles for years.  I drink mine with honey. My family loves it sprinkled on ice cream or iced chocolate cake.  It mixes well with almost everything.  I even use it in marinades for steak,chicken and ribs.

Taster's choice hazelnut instant sticks are not available in any local stores.  It seems they are being fazed out.  This is unfortunate as the company already fazed out hazelnut in containers.  Too bad for hazelnut lovers!

I love this coffee.  Taster's Choice used to sell it in a jar and then it went into those little sticks.  Used to purchase them at Waldbaum's, but they closed.  Then purchased them at Target and they stopped carrying them.  Love that I can purchase it through Amazon.com.  It's cheaper and free shipping and I don't have to think about it.  Thanks Amazon.com.
The Taster Choice Hazelnut Instant coffee is this best thing for me in the morning, every morning rain or shine.THANKS for sending it to me so quickly.
I am not a coffee lover, and really enjoy this product.  It's enough to get caffeine, and I really enjoy in the mornings.

column9: Better than no Hazelnut instant coffee.
column10: This is my favorite instant coffee.  Still miffed that it is no longer available in a jar whereby you could measure the amount you were needing.  These sticks can get messy especially if your hand is none too steady.

This is my favorite coffee.  I just wish it was still available in a canister.  The "stick" packaging is a pain in the neck and extremely excessive (wasteful) packaging.  But the coffee is good.  I also use the Vanilla flavor and wish Amazon would make it available on a "subscription" basis also.

column9: Best Coffee You Can Buy for the Price Here or in the Store
column10: I've tried so many different types of coffee from whole beans to instant.  I've traveled to the coffee plantations of Central America and that is the only place where I've tasted better coffee.  But in the United States and what you can buy in the store, and for the price, this coffee is the best tasting.  I could probably drink this Hazelnut flavor all day if it didn't stain my teeth and put more caffeine in me than my heart can handle.  The aroma is out of this world.  The taste by itself is a perfect 10.  Add some flavored creamer like Vanilla or something else in the creamer section and you got yourself a $5 cup of coffee for less than a $1.My only complaint is that I can't find this in the large size.  Maybe it is to prevent customers from going overboard on this coffee at one time lol.

I personally do not like coffee of any kind, and I hate to be around people who smell like strong coffee. I started buying this brand for my husband because I like Hazelnut and love the smell. My husband likes the 20-Count Sticks because one package is perfect for a cup of coffee. If he travels the packets make it easy to take along without the mess.
My husband loves this product and we can't buy it locally I was so happy to find it on Amazon!

Very happy that these were available on Amazon.  We had a hard time finding them at any stores around our place.  It's a delicious dessert coffee and nice to make a cup every once in awhile when we don't want to make an entire pot of coffee!

What can I say except....Excellent, Excellent, Excellent!!  I've gotten this item several times in the past and have enjoyed it each time.  It arrives fresh every time!  The rapid fast shipping time is always a plus!

This coffee is my favorite. It used to come in a container. Then I was able to make it as strong as I wanted. Now I use about one and a half of a Packet. I wosh they would go back to the jar container. I have written to Nestles and even sent an e-mail to their company in Europe. It is still my favorite coffee. The taste and aroma are fantastic. Amazon is the only place that I am able to get Tasters Choice Hazelnut Instant Coffee.

I love the flavor of this instant coffee. While the regular Taster's Choice coffee is very strong and bitter, the Hazelnut is smooth and flavorful. I often combine it with my International Coffee hazelnut flavor, and the combination is great.I just wish they would bring back the jar, though, because it was cheaper by the ounce. Maybe that's why they discontinued it. They knew that those of us who are addicted to this stuff would pay the higher price rather than give it up. :-)
I love this coffee and am not happy that the manufacturer decided to kill the 6 oz. size.  This is the only choice, so I use it.....it's a five on taste.

I'm not a huge coffee drinker because I don't usually like the taste, I get wired really easily from caffeine sometimes, and certain coffee hurts my stomach. But sometimes I need something to wake me up in the morning. I love this instant coffee. Usually what I'll do is mix it together with artificially sweetened cocoa, one packet of splenda, 6 oz of water, and two tablespoons of french vanilla creamer. I only put one packet of the hazelnut coffee in as (like I said) I'm sort of sensitive to caffeine. It wakes me up quite well without any jitters or stomach upset. This is my favorite thing in the morning. I don't mind the packets...it stays fresh and it's easy to just rip the top open and pour in the cup. I wish it were available in more grocery stores though...the only place I can get it besides amazon is target.

Love the Hazelnut flavored instant coffee. I'm not a coffee drinker but when I do drink/need coffee I go to this. I do wish it came in the canisters though as these packets are sometimes difficult to open especially when I'm still half-asleep in the morning.

column9: Great instant coffee, but miss the big canisters
column10: I really like the flavor of this instant hazelnut coffee.  They stopped making the canisters, so I buy these little packets.  But with the auto delivery from Amazon every month, the discounted price isn't too bad.  I'm afraid the company is going to do away with the little packets too, so I'm hoarding the stuff!
This is the best coffee.  Would really like it if it came in a jar instead of single serve packets.

column9: Great product. Amazon seems to be the only place I can get it now.
column10: Great product. Wish the price wasn't so high, but given that Amazon is the only place to get it at this point, and I'm addicted, I'm stuck :-) Thanks, Amazon.

column9: Flavor is excellent and great for overnight guests
column10: My husband and I visited the UK over a year ago and each B & B we stayed in used Taster's Choice in the rooms for guest use.  While it's not as flavorful, obviously, as what we had at breakfast using the French Press makers, it was VERY good for instant.  We have since started using TC in our guestrooms (we own a B&B, also) and the Hazlenut and Vanilla flavors are big hits for that late night cup or for the very early risers who want a cup before 7a.m.

I was absolutely in love with Taster's Choice Hazelnut for many years.  But as GREED got hold of most of American corporations and in fact all multinationals, they started squeezing customers.  First they shrank the size of the hazelnut canisters, then they raise the price relative to the regular canisters.  Finally, they removed completely the option from the customers and offer them this incredibly expensive packaging.  The only effective way to fight them is to boycott Taster's Choice and its parent company.  Unfortunately I am still hooked on it. One star for cost and five stars for taste.  Three stars averaged.

This is a great tasting coffee, however since Taster's Choice has taken the canister off the market it is a terrible price for your basic cup of coffee.  You might as well walk over to your Coffee Beanery for your Hazelnut Coffee fix!

Such a shame.  It's such a quick and delicious product, but the single serving packets are a rip off.  I agree with others that you have to use 2 packets for the same flavor as the canister, and it's only for 6oz of water.  I too spoke with someone from Nestecafe and was informed they're no longer carrying that product in the canister.  I'm still hoping they bring it back after customer demand.
I really love this product, the taste is delicious. I recommend itCoffee People, Donut Shop K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers (Pack of 50)
The advantage of the sticks over the canisters is the freshness remains!  I just use scissors to open the sticks, it is mess-free.  I add one stick to my pot of coffee to add a hint of smooth flavor.
I used to buy this product in a larger container, at my grocery store but they no longer come that way. I can but this size at the store but it is a better buy on Amazon!

Please keep the packets!  The flavor is great and so is the price (compared to Starbucks at $1 a cup).  I am in Afghanistan, and it is impossible to keep the instant coffee in a canister.  You 'all should check Nadik Labs and use this as the instant coffee in the "Meal-Ready-To-Eat" the Marines and Soldiers have.  Thanks, msa
Holy cow this soda is amazing. If this was the only soda in the world, I'd be more than happy, 'cause this soda is awesome. Now I can see why Gamzee loves the stuff.
OMG!THIS IS A RIP-OFF!I LIVE IN TEXAS WHERE YOU CAN BUY A 12-PACK OF FAYGO FOR UNDER 4 BUCKS.  THIS IS REALLY GOOD SODA. THE PRODUCT ITSELF, IS GREAT BUT WAY 2 OVERPRICED. I AM DISAPPOINTED.

This a really good pop from Detroit that is hard to find elsewhere. So I had to buy some on here, cans were in really good condition, none crushed. It's like a carbonated liquid strawberry candy flavor. It's really good! I had two the day I got them.

I've bought this flour multiple times and it never fails me.  If you have pizza or calzones at home, this is the flour you want to use.  The vendor is reliable and the shipping is fast.  This IS the pizza snobs flour.
These are surprisingly tasty, and about half the calories of regular rice cakes.  Super crispy - the spelt and flax seed ones are my favorites!
These thin cakes are good alone or with anything you choose...cheese, preserves, peanut or almond butter, hummus.  They have a great taste and low in calories.

These cakes are delicious alone ,with a cheese spread or peanut butter.  They are low in calories, carbohydrates and are still very tasty.  It is much cheaper to purchase them at Amazon than at the store.

column9: Love as snack or carb alternative
column10: No fat, low sodium, low carb, some protein.  What more could you ask.  Flax?  Why yes, that too!  I am using to replace some bad habits; mini bagel in the morning, sandwich bread and chips in the afternoon.  Hope not to tire of them.  They satisfy my need for crunch.  Have a nice grain taste, but for me not cardboard at all.  Way better than a baked chip (what are those things anyway?).  Better than crackers (fat, salt and carbs).  Not really usable for a sandwich, but you can deconstruct and eat as separate items (did this when I was atkins, but now vegetarian, so....).  Also, half the price of buying retail, and the subscription will be a good idea to keep me supplied, at least until I tire of them.

If you're going to eat something with pure carbs and no fat -- this is clearly the only choice. Only 10 carbs for each 3 wafers and one or two servings is the closest thing I ever come to eating bread/pasta/rice. Sure, it looks like a cork board but it tastes like something that actually was planted and lived. It's apparent after the first bite that there are no "industrial binders" to hold its crumbly goodness together. In sum, it's the food equivalent of Claude Debussy's "La Fille aux Cheveux de Lin" on your tongue!
These are so delicious eaten alone! They have just a touch of salt and a great crunch. They're very light but a little bit rustic. Despite my best efforts, bits of flaxseed get everywhere.

I must have gotten a bottle from a great batch.  It's been almost a year, and I've barely put a dent in this stuff.  I worked my way up the tasting scale at All Sauced Up, the sauce store in Gatlinburg, TN.  They didn't even make me sign a waiver.  This was the second hottest sauce they sold.  The hottest didn't have the nice smokey flavor this one had, just pure burn (which I don't care for).  When I let people sample my jar, I put a little on a toothpick, just how it was sampled to me.  It makes everyone I know break out in a sweat, and some get hiccups.  One drop will heat an entire fajita or burrito to perfection.  I used a few drops in a sausage ball recipe and it gave a wonderful kick without completely overriding the flavor.  It's a great little bottle and will last a long time- use sparingly.I'm guessing quality control or whatever is a bit lax, or they don't mix it up really well before bottling if people are complaining... but I have no complaints.  I love this stuff!  One of my favorites!  If you like the smokey flavor, but want a lot less heat than this sauce (but still hot), there's a wonderful sauce called Dragon's Fury XXXHot (Red Eye brand) that I love.

column9: Fantastic flavor and heat if you get a good batch
column10: I've been on a hot sauce kick for a while and worked my way up to some of the 'ultra hot' sauces.  I love the Blair's Death sauces, Mad Dog 357 Ghost Pepper, Satan's Blood (for cooking), Dave's Insanity, Ultimate Insanity, Mad Dog 357, and various other extract-based sauces.When I tried this sauce, it really blew my mind.  Where this sauce really stands out is flavor.  It does not use extracts, but is still extremely hot.  This sauce is like a fine Bordeaux compared with extract-based sauces that are like fortified wines (or in some cases like vodka).  This sauce has an amazingly pleasing and complex flavor (aroma) that lures you into believing that you are tasting a wonderfully flavorful but mild sauce.  Then the heat kicks in.  It slowly builds up over the course of a dozen or more seconds and produces an intense but wonderful pain and endorphin rush.  I was shocked and amazed that a sauce could be this flavorful and still be this intense.I also really love PAIN 100% because it has a wonderful and complex flavor, but it is significantly less intense.  Mongoose Hot Sauce is hotter than Blair's Ultra Death (at least, based on my subjective taste comparisons with the bottles I got).The packaging of this sauce is really cool and includes an outer box, so it would make a nice gift.  The small bottle is compact enough to put in your pocket and take to restaurants.From the label, the ingredients are: * Bhut Jolokia Chiles * Fatalii Chiles * Vinegar * Natural FlavorsIf you are looking for something that is cheap and "stupid hot" for a practical joke, then look elsewhere.  If you are used to eating ultra hot sauces and want one with an excellent and unique flavor, then this is definitely worth trying.Edit: 11/25/11 -- I just started on a new bottle, and it is much milder and less flavorful than the first two bottles I tried.  It is even a different color and consistency (lighter color and much more watery).  Apparently some batches are a lot thicker and hotter than others.  Based on the 2nd batch, I am taking away a star.  The first batch was 5-stars for sure, but the 2nd is more like 3 stars since it isn't hot enough to be worth the high price for such a small bottle.
One of the few sauces that are both tasty and extremely hot. I only wish there were larger sizes.

column9: Nice flavor but not very hot...
column10: I bought this sauce looking for a insane over the top hot sauce and saw some sites out there that said this sauce had a scoville rating somewhere in the 2-3 million range.  It comes in a little 2 oz bottle for the price of what you'd pay for 5 oz of many other "super hot" hot sauces.  But that's what I'd expect for an extreme scoville rating in the millions.Well I finally got it and tried it out.  My impressions are that it actually has a very nice clean "fresh vegetable" flavor to it and a slightly fruity taste that actually makes it one of the better tasting hot sauces I've tried but, alas, it was not very hot.I compared it to some Mad Dog 357 Silver Collector's Edition which, according to the label, is 750,000 scoville units, and I found the Mongoose sauce to be quite timid in comparison.  In fact I'd say the Mad Dog was 3x to 5x hotter (purely subjective on my part).This wouldn't be such a problem except the Mongoose comes in that tiny 2 ounce bottle with a hefty price tag in a box that makes all sorts of claims about it's wickedly extreme heat.  Unfortunately it doesn't deliver -- I have several 5 oz bottles of hot sauce that are much hotter.It's a shame too because I like the flavor of Mongoose.  In fact the flavor is so clean and so friendly compared to other extremely hot extract sauces (which tend to have a bitter taste to them) it almost makes me wonder:Did they forget to put the pepper extract in this batch of Mongoose?
Could not get any flavors other than Lemonaide, Teas and Rasberry at Store.  Bought enought to last a very long time.
way cheaper than the grocery store, same great drink! mix two flavors together, This one and lemonaid go very well together.

column10: Great cereal @ a great price.  Taste good even though it is good for you.  Not like other cereals that claim to have raisins and really only have a small handful in the entire box.

column9: Nice crunchy cereal, but raisins are tough and chewy
column10: I was very surprised by how tough and chewy these raisins are, right from the very first bowl. I had to take a good second look at the carton to make sure I was eating from the right box and not the Kellog's Raisin Bran I had opened a few weeks ago. I don't remember ever remarking on the consistency of the raisins in my cereal before, so this was a first.The only times I've had raisins this chewy were when they'd been sitting out for a while and gone stale. This box was freshly opened, so freshness was not the problem. Without exaggeration, the raisins are almost as dense and tough as pencil erasers. (I squeezed both with my fingers to compare.) The flakes are good and satisfyingly crunchy, but the raisins will give your jaws a good workout.As for the health benefits of this cereal, I have no doubts. Health professionals recommend getting 25-35g of fiber a day for an average adult, so the 11g per serving in here goes a long way towards the total (28%). Unlike some of the other reviewers, I did not detect any fishy smell or odd taste. I am used to eating healthy foods (some of which are truly dreadful!) and have no complaints about this product other than the raisins.I love Nature's Path cereal. Just not this one. I recommend Nature's Path Organic Flax Plus Maple Pecan Crunch Cereal instead. Much better tasting and no rubbery raisins.

I agree with Barbara that the raisins are too hard, and rate this 3.5 stars as a result.  Their Flax Plus Multibran with some Trader Joe's raisins makes a great raisin bran cereal, though.  My current favorite is their Flax Plus Red Berry Crunch.

column9: Great tasting fondant, but hard to work with
column10: This fondant tasts great, I find myself eating the scraps as I cover my cakes with it. However, it stiffens up and begins to crack VERY quickly once rolled out. A trick I use is to kneed a little Crisco into it before rolling it out. This makes the fondant SO much easier to roll out and you end up using less because you can roll it thinner. It also covers cakes beautifully and doesn't crack around the cake's corners if you add the shortening. As long as you make the addition, it's a five star product that's suitable for beginners to work with.

The House of Tsang's Mongolian Fire oil is a critical and irreplaceable ingredient in my fried rice recipe, a staple of my diet which I eat nearly every day.When my local grocery store stopped carrying it, I tried a number of other oriental pepper oils but they couldn't hold a candle to Tsang's.  They either had way too much garlic or lacked significant "fire".I tried to make a similar oil starting from scratch: heating powdered cayenne pepper and fresh garlic in a mixture of  canola oil and sesame oil to about 120 C for 1 hr then allowing to stand over night.  After mixing and straining through a coffee filter, I got a product approaching the color of the original.  The taste was better than any of the other commercial products.  However, there was clearly something lacking.  Perhaps using canola oil made a difference but I suspect the key lies in a secret unlisted ingredient.Fortunately, I was able to find a source for the Fire Oil on line.  It is ridiculously expensive, more than my local grocer, not to mention the cost of shipping.  However, when you've gotta have it, you've got to have it!eesnyderIf there is anyone that might be put off by the "fire" oil name, it is worth mentioning that the flavor is much more complex than simply hot pepper.  In fact, it is not exceptionally hot; certainly less than the benchmark Tabasco, although they are very different condiments.

column9: Too much product; too little time

I am a coffee drinker of the first order. I used to drink a couple pots a day, but now I've cut way, way back, so now that I'm not into quantity, I'm into quality. I really enjoy, really savior a good cuppa joe. I've given up my Mr. Coffee and now have a Keurig Home Brewing System and I make my coffee a cup at a time and I really love it. It only takes a minute to make a cup and each cup is different, depending on my mood.I've been drinking K-cup coffee for a couple years now and have more of these little cups in my house than you can shake a stick at. For awhile I used a Chrome Carosel, made by Keurig, but I had to keep filling it and also it was kind of clumsy for me. Besides, my coffee affliction is way to huge to be held down to a little spinning coffee merry-go-round.For the first few months my coffee problem went spinning out of control. I had boxes and boxes of coffee in my pantry, refrigerator, cupboards, garage, even in the trunk of my car, but now I've sort of got my gourmet coffee disorder in hand and down to twenty-eight flavors.For Breakfast I have my favorite seven and they are:Timothy's World Coffee, Extra Bold Fair Trade NicaraguanTimothy's World Coffee, Midnight Magic, BoldTimothy's World Coffee, Kona BlendTully's French Roast CoffeeCoffee People Bold Black Tiger Dark RoastTimothy's World Coffee, Morning BlendCoffee People Coffee, Wake Up Call BoldFor Lunch I have my favorite seven and they are:Gloria Jean's Coffees Hazelnut CoffeeEmeril's Big Easy BoldGloria Jean's Coffees Black Gold Extra BoldTimothy's World Coffee, Private BlendTimothy's World Coffee, Extra Bold Parisian NightsTimothy's World Coffee, Colombian La VeredaGloria Jean's Coffees GJ Special BlendAnd for dinner, yes I drink coffee in the evening as well, but that's not so bad, considering I don't drink, don't smoke, don't eat sweets and eat very little meat. Sometimes I'll eat meat, but not often, so a cup of coffee with dinner doesn't seem so bad, considering. If it kept me up at night, well then that would be different, but it doesn't. Anyway for dinner I'll drink one of these seven:Tully's Full City Roast CoffeeGloria Jean's Coffee, MudslideTimothy's World Coffee, Italian BlendGreen Mountain Coffee Dark Magic Extra BoldGreen Mountain Coffee Nantucket BlendTimothy's World Coffee, San Lorenzo DarkGloria Jean's Coffee, Classic ReserveAnd then there is my absolute favorite, number twenty-two and that is Extra Bold Rainforest Espresso, a Timothy's World Coffee.I keep my k-cups in three large assorted tupperware tubs, marked in Sharpie, of course, "Breakfast", "Lunch" and "Dinner". So when I reach into the breakfast tub for example, I never know which of the seven flavors I'm going to wind up with.I don't drink coffee during my meal, but afterwards, instead of desert. It's a quiet time for me. I think and reflect over my coffee as I delight in each and every sip.I know for some, having twenty-two different flavors of coffee in my kitchen might seem a bit much, maybe even a bit quirky, well everyone's gotta have their quirks, besides, I've cut way down.Now, about that twenty-second flavor. When I absolutely have to have an extra cup during that quiet, coffee drinking them, then that's the flavor I go for. How often does that happen, when one cup isn't enough? Only about once a day. Still, from two pots a java a day, down to four cups, is a pretty good thing, I'm not as wired as I used to be, but let's face it, I'm still running on caffeine. That's not so bad though, better a coffee crutch than something else.In my opinion these are the twenty-two best cups of joy in the whole wide world. At least the best twenty-two flavors I've come across in the hundreds I've tried. But please don't take my word as gospel, everybody's different. You have to dive right right in, take a chance, try several flavors till you find the one or the twenty-two that you like best.

It is a medium-dark roast coffee that has very good flavor, and it can stand up to the flavored Coffee Mate creamers that we like to use. This is a K-Cup that we'll keep ordering.

This coffee has kind of an espresso after-taste that is liked by those who like Espresso. I like it, but I wouldn't want to drink it all the time. My boss hates it, hates the smell, hates the taste. He likes a strong, round flavored cup of coffee, so I'm sticking to Colombian for him.

This coffee is a dark roast blend that is smooth with great flavor. The only problem I encounter when ordering is occasionaly AMAZON is out of stock or they back order it.  Give yourself extra ordering time on this coffee or you will be sitting at home with an empty cup.
A surprisingly smooth-tasting coffee that is likely to please almost any coffee afficionado . I recommend it highly.

The problem I have is how slow the shipping was on this product.  Even though it states that it ships in 2 to 3 days, it's more like 2 to 3 WEEKS.other than that, the prices are good, and so is the coffee!

I love coffee and drink about 6 cups a day. Hazelnut is one of my favorite flavors, but since I get Hazelnut flavored coffee so often, I wanted something a little different. I was really happy I did. This has a great taste, with a blend of hazelnut and coffee cake taste. Also, no bitter after-taste.
This is now my favorite coffee! I put nonfat frothy milk and then some cinnamon on it. Best way to start my day!

It's not bad coffee. The taste is smooth. The aroma is decent. I do wish it was a little stronger though, but it's really not bad.  I would like to try some of the other flavors. I think this flavor is just not me.
I really love the flavor of this coffee.  It smells and tastes great.  Comparable to any high end flavored coffee.
A decent coffee with a nice, rich aroma.  Wish the coffee actually tasted like it smells.  Okay for the price.

Not the best coffee I have ever had, but - very adequate.  And it's really hard to beat the price for what you get.  As someone that drinks at least a pot (or more) every day, this is good at a good price.  I will order again and again.  Also tried their other varieties.  All good.
This was very nice coffee. The taste and the smell were delicious. It was not available in my local area. I am glad to have access to it through Amazon.com

I always by magnum brand whole bean coffee. The coffee was a pre ground coffee but I really enjoyed the flavor. I also bought their chocolate brownie coffee and loved it when I mixed the two together.

Basically, there is something wrong with this product. It has an aroma of pipe tobacco, and the packaging is incorrect. The tab that is supposed to hold the package shut is located where the package is glued tight shut so there is no way to open it before the closing tab.I think the people who package this are not competent to sell such a product.

column9: Wouldn't Buy These With the Titanium Dioxide and Chemical Colors
column10: Ok you might not get cavities but you'll definitely get some cancer causing chemicals in your body by sucking on the titanium dioxide, red 40, yellow and blue chemicals they colored it with. How hard is it to make a healthy product with all natural ingredients. Not that hard... just color the candies with natural dyes. Would never buy a product that claims it's healthy or "natural" and then adds unhealthy ingredients in with the ONE healthy one. I would just get XyliChew or Spry gum instead. There's just xylitol and 2 other natural ingredients in those and is waaay healthier for your teeth AND body than this stuff. Or if you want some really good organic lollipops with no chemicals in them get Yummy Earth hard candies or lollipops on here.(ADDED DEC 2011) They finally added a natural version of these same Xylitol lollipopos since I posted this... get them here SimplyXylitol All Natural Assorted Fruit Lollipops in a 1 lb. bag

Have you every felt like the biggest jerk going through your child's Halloween Bag or Easter basket and taking out all the lollipops because your children simply don't need more sugar laying against their teeth.  I have, and it didnt feel good.  Suddenly, I'm like Santa Claus.  Not that they eat lollipops all day-everyday; but if they did, it would only help their teeth, not rot them to nubs. Forget what you heard about sugar-free lollipops, these taste GREAT.  And the fact that they contain Xylitol which actually strengthens their teeth, how could you not buy these for your kids.  Sure they are a little expensive in comparison to the sugar on a stick that we're used to, but they are worth every cent. Note:  These were initially recommended to me by my Pediatric Dentist.  He keeps a bowl of them in his office.

I have very pleased with these lollipops.  My 3 year old son loves them.  The only thing I wish was that it didn't have any artificial flavors in it. I wish they were flavored with fruit flavors instead.

Research indicates that consuming xylitol is an important part of maintaining healthy teeth and gums.My children enjoyed having lollipops twice a day, I enjoyed not having to remind them to take their xylitol.The red tastes like cherry, orange like orange, purple was grape, green was lime and I never got to taste the blue...The only annoying part was picking up the little sticks that my younger daughter kept leaving out.  Not a fault of the product, just a warning that these may need a bit of monitoring.

I bought several different varieties of the dr. johns products and my family of four sat to have a few in front of a movie.  The adults had 4 and 5 pieces each and each of the children had 3 pieces.  All but one member of the family had terrible intestinal issues throughout the next 12 hours+.  I called the company to return the product and they would not return opened product.  I am shocked that even though less than the recommended serving was consumed and we got so sick. Awful experience!!!

I had Hapi mixed crackers at a friend's home and liked them so much that I began a search throughout Houston, TX for a supplier. Although I was told that Rice Supermarkets and the Hapi Website identified Walmart as a supplier, I found them nowhere. I finally found them on the Amazon web site and order a 6 package case. They are wonderful. Each time I open a can, my wife and I usually finish them the same day/night. They are vacumn sealed and therefore fresh. They do not have the off taste that I have noted for other rice-based crackers. Some of the crackers are "to die for", particularly the ball-shaped one. Have just ordered my second case and am still looking for a local supply.
this is the tastiest and lowest priced of all of the Hapi mixes I have bought in local grocery stores.

column9: Good for cats with Chronic Renal Failure
column10: Both my cats liked this flavor, even my finicky eater. Of course, there are no guarantees when buying food for a cat. You never know what they'll turn their noses up at!I decided to buy this after researching a bunch of low protein, low phosphorous foods for my tabby who has CRF. One of the best websites out there (felinecrf dot org) listed this specific Hill's flavor as a good choice. I'm relieved my cats also like it!You should be aware that this product is a 3oz can (the same size as a Fancy Feast can).

I bought this as a Valentine's gift back in '07.  Sorry for the late review.  The case was sturdy and elegant, the smoked salmon and other treats inside were delicious.  I wish there were more, but then again, when it's that tasty, there's probably never enough.

With six cats in the house, let me say I was THRILLED that Amazon.com offered this in their vine program. My cats eat anything that doesn't run away from them, but everyone from the year old cat, to the seventeen year old diabetic kitty LOVED this food. Even my mom's cat, who is known to be pretty finicky loved it.The food looks like "real" food, not the loaf-type food so often seen in canned cat food, and it smells great. Not stinky at all. The cats gobbled it right up, and I like that there is plenty of broth and liquid on the food, because that helps my eldest cat, who is missing several teeth, eat it just fine.I've been feeding wellness and Eagle Pack Holistic food in addition to prescription food. This ranks right alongside those expensive foods. Good stuff!!!!

This is a nice item -- chunks of meat, good gravy. My cat is not fond of all the varieties, but it is a nice little treat nonetheless.But I do think this item is a bit pricy ... about $1 per 3-ounce can.

column9: Mixed reviews from the house felines
column10: Dash loves it. Jasper does not. Dash Hoovered both his bowl and Jasper's, while Jasper took two bites and then moved over to the kibble bowl. We've tried three different flavors so far, and the verdict has been the same. So safe to say, not ALL cats want to eat "people food." I don't know much about this product except what's on the label. The fact that it's a product of Thailand concerns me a bit -- I don't know what their standards are for pet food, and after the scandal with the lead in Chinese-manufactured toys, well, I'm a little skeptical. It's also an expensive product. Since I don't have a consensus among the house felines, I doubt I will purchase any more of this product.

column9: My Two Cats Inhaled The Stuff
column10: OK, so I couldn't personally taste this cat food and give you a review. But all I can say is: my two cats (14 and 15 years old) virtually inhaled it. Clawdette is the older one and she is fussy. She likes a cat food that has seafood and tomato in it. Chappie is less picky, but he can turn up his nose at some supermarket brand cat foods. So more often then not I buy the canned cat food at petshops (or on Amazon). I fed them each of the cans in the Variety Pack...and its as if the food vanished off the face of the earth within a few minutes. The bottom line: they loved it, it left their coats nice and softy and glossy, and they had lots of energy. So I (or, rather my cats) give it five stars.

column4: Glenda Boozer "Live, live, live! Life is a ba...
column9: If your cat likes people food, this may be for you.
column10: My cat George never quite finishes a 6-ounce can of cat food, so I thought I would try these 3-ounce servings. However, George is not terribly fond of people food, and he has only finished one of the cans that I have given him so far - the Sesame Chicken, as it turns out. He clearly likes the broth in the Chicken Pot Pie, but he doesn't finish his vegetables, or even all of the chunks of chicken.Of course, we can hardly blame him for abandoning one can to attempt to get into the turkey liver I was cutting up. Some people food is too good for cats to pass up!

My fiancee brought this home from his moms and my cat went crazy! She inhaled an entire can in seconds and then begged for more. I completely grossed my fiancee out when I tasted it and let me tell you as someone who is an avid cook the Chicken Pot Pie is very good. I make chicken pot pie and reading the ingredients were like reading the ingredients in a chicken pot pie you would make or buy for yourself. The chicken did not taste processed. The first time I saw the can of food I thought it was gourmet tuna and had to read to make sure it was cat food. I can't say that I blame my kitty for enjoying this so much. We have a local health food store that carries it so it's easy to find for me but the deals online are amazing! I'll be going via Amazon from now on. My cat reacts to this the way she reacts to fresh tuna, she goes nuts!

Petite Cusine is the only canned food I feed my two cats Smokie and Elvira. Its natural products are my main cuncern. They let me know when it time to feed them. They both block my way in the kitchen till I feed them.

My Tigger was a kitten when he came to me (Dropped)he loved the outdoors but often got into some accidents that ended up at the Vet's office, needless to say he then wouldn't eat and was loosing weight. I had tried other cat foods but nothing he would even look at, then I tried Petite Cuisine Tuna & Shrimp to mine and Tigger's amazement he fell in "LOVE" and eats well now. He is now 2-yrs old and I have another (Dropped) 2-yr old male Cat and he also loves this cat food. Tigger and Ziggy are very "Happy Cats".

column9: Paris loves it and that's enough for me!
column10: My sweet cat Paris loves this kitty food and that's enough for me!  I can no longer find in my grocery store so very happy it is available on Amazon.  THANKS!

column9: More like "human" food than Cat Food
column10: My cats are crazy for this food, including the one that has turned up her nose at all wet food for 6 years! Unfortunately the price makes it prohibitive as an every day meal since I have 5 cats. Also, I've heard that too much fish is not healthy for cats, they need meat too and they aren't that crazy about the Petite Cuisine Chicken.  I still buy the tuna and just feed it occasionally as an extra treat. The food itself looks and smells just like tuna for humans, maybe even a little better. Some of it has tiny little (whole) shrimp and some pieces of codfish - it also has a lot of tuna oil, which I guess is what the cats like about it because the first thing they do is lap up all the "gravy". I thought maybe if I bought human tuna in oil and spiked their usual soft Friskies, they would enjoy it more, but that didn't work, so I continue to buy Petite Cuisine.

About six months ago they stopped carrying it. Amazon was the only place I could find besides the manufacturer that would sell me this at retail. Otis is what I call a very picky eater. The fact is, until now, he would not eat the same cat food twice! He is 10 years old.I was in the habit of buying food one can at a time for obvious reasons. I did that for the Petite Cusine as well....the Tuna and sole. He inhaled it. I bought 2 more. This time 2 different varsities of the same brand. My cats ate it but they didn't seem to like it to well.Wouldn't buy it again.

I wonder if other people's cats do. I couldn't find any fault with the food, but then again, I'm human. I'd say it probably depends very much on what your cat's taste is. If your cat enjoys fresh organic food... then buy this. If they like Fancy Feast - don't!!

Would of given this 5 star if it was cheaper. I love the small cans for convenience but not willing to pay for the cost of it. I liked that their was no gagging fishy smell as some cat foods have. My cats loved this food and would of eaten 2 cans at a time if I let her. I will consider keeping this on hand for those times when I need the small can convenience. However, can not afford to purchase this all the time.

The poor response from the cats means that this one will not make it into the rotation.

The only reason I gave this 4 instead of 5 stars because it is really expensive in the stores.  But if money is no object for your little 4 legged feline friends, then I highly recommend this cat food.

When you pull off the pop top, you can't help but get splashed by it. And it seems like you're not getting that much food for your money since it's so much liquid. The Chinese chicken is not as liquidy.I have no idea how to compare this to other brands price-wise because it is not sold in my state. I've never seen it in stores.

I take care of this cat for a friend of mine.  The cat is very friendly, but is an extremely picky eater.  I put this product in front of her and she ate the whole thing!  So, all I can say is this has to be good.The can are convient, but are single servings.  If you have more than one cat, the packaging is not "green" friendly, but the cat/cats will love the food!

I have four cats and they all like this food.  Since there is only one serving per can, it would be a better buy for a one cat family.  It doesn't smell bad and looks nice.  My daughter's kitten liked it very much.  The quality of the product seemed high.

column9: Pretty decent: but could be a little better
column10: Well my mother has a couple cats so I thought what the heck I'll get this stuff for her to feed them instead of hard food all the time.The cats who will eat anything and everything that you put in front of them were little apprehensive of this product. Granted the one cat does like spicy food but he did eat it throughout the days. They both like it but it's hard for them to get a hold of the pieces because the chicken is kind of stringy and not cut into smaller pieces and some of it ends up on the floor.But now that they kind of used to these they do definitely practically yell at me when I don't give them the stuff as soon as I open the can, lol. But it would be better if it were smaller cut pieces to reduce the amount that ends up on the floor.

According to the manufacturer's website, this (and many of their other products) contains menadione sodium bisulfite complex.Menadione is a synthetic precursor for Vitamin K and has been reported to have toxic effects. The use of menadione over the natural alternatives (such as leafy greens and kelp) is only for cost-saving reasons, hence usually only found in cheaper and lower quality animal food. It's surprising that pet food at this high of a price actually contains this substance.Menadione is banned by the Food & Drug Administration in over-the-counter supplements due to its potential for organ toxicity. It's also banned in Europe for human consumption.A study in rats showed that exposure to menadione "produced lesions in the kidney, heart, liver and lung." Chiou et al. Toxicology 1997.Menadione's toxicity seems to be due to its ability to induce oxidative stress in cells.Do an online search for menadione and you'll find more info from a pet food watchdog trying to stop the inclusion of this substance.In light of recent episodes of toxic pet food and the questionable behaviors of manufacturers and our regulatory agencies, I would advise you to avoid feeding this to your cats.

The ingredients in this seems to be better then "Fancy Feast" which is mostly fat. I have one finicky cat and one who will eat anything. Both love it. It is a good every other day [half way healthy] treat for them.

column9: She never turns up her nose
column10: I don't know if it's typical or not, but our cat gets tired of any flavor of canned cat food after a while. Sometimes she'll eat a flavor one day, but turn up her nose at it a week later. We vary the flavors, but she's picky. We've been trying the Petite Cuisine for several weeks now, and the four different flavors seem to give her plenty of variety -- she hasn't refused it yet. Here's hoping that continues!

Wow!!!  This cat food must have something like catnip in it.  After the first smell and taste, the cats have come at the first sound of opening another can.  My cats seem to really appreciate the taste.  It smells fine to me.  Cat food is cat food, to me, but, to my closest friends, at least my cats, they love this product.  It's a little more expensive than the cat food that I could purchase in a discount store, but, here again, I think that my cats seem to enjoy this a bit more.

My 2 cats loved this stuff! There are 2 kinds in the 24 pack, so you get 12 cans of each. Cans are small, 2.8 oz each, that is smaller than the fancy feast cans.The food doesn't smell like cat food and looks like people food. The sesame chicken and chicken pot pie were equally liked by my cats. They ate every bite of it, and they never do that with canned food.

I've got 2 cats that love their wet food!!  We figured this'd be a big hit & for the 1st couple cans it was.  My cats are used to your everyday  mushy cat food (Friskies I think), so when we opened this stuff I was surprised to see that this stuff actually looked almost some what edible.  It kinda looked like tuna with peas & carrots, although it was really juicy (seemed like almost half the can was just liquid).  Anyway long story short the cats devoured this food when we first gave it to 'em.  However I must admit the cans were a little small for 2 cats, but a can this size would be perfect for a 1 cat family.  (Here comes the only 3 star rating part)  Anyway, after the 1st couple cans it seemed as though the cats loved it, but then, all of a sudden they just stopped eating it.  I gotta tell you with my cats that's a rare thing to be sure.  Everytime we've tried to give it to 'em since they've completely turned their noses from it.  I can't really say that this stuff isn't good, all I know is that suddenly my cats stopped liking it, your cats might love it.  Granted, my cats are used to the mushy stuff I mentioned earlier, but to be fare they also like canned tuna/chicken (it could just be the big veggie chunks they didn't like, who knows).  I guess in closing, it's kinda up in the air as to whether or not you'll get the most out of your purchase or not, I know I won't ever buy it again, but again your cats might love it, kinda hard to come to a real definative conclusion:(.

column9: If it looks good, is it good for the cats?
column10: My two traditional striped cats eat mostly dry Science Diet cat food with a few NuCat vitamins added.  They also get Iams canned chicken, turkey, or beef once a day.  Brownie prefers the dry food but will eat some canned food only when the can is freshly opened.  Pi likes both.  We tried the Petite Cuisine Variety Pack (Yellowfin, Snapper, Tuna & Sole, Tuna & Shrimp) and the Petite Cuisine Variety Pack (Chinese Chicken & Chicken Pot Pie) over the course of sixteen days. Each cat got about one-quarter can each day.  I alternated cans of chicken and fish varieties.At first, the felines were enthusiastic.  After a while they tired of the chicken.  Pi would only lick up the gravy, while Brownie refused to even look at it.  The fish was better received.  They like the yellowfin and the tuna & shrimp.  The cat vote is for two of the six varieties.There is, however, a question of mercury in ocean fish.  A 1995 study in Japan found that cats that ate tuna had a higher concentration of mercury in their fur than cats that ate dry cat food.  The study and its results are discussed in an article that you can find on the web by using the search term "all about tuna fish".  I posted a question on the Petite Cuisine web site as to whether they had tested their products for mercury.  I have not received an answer.  My conclusion is that it may be ok to give the cats fish as an occasional treat but not as a steady diet.
