Being a type II diabetic is challenging when it comes to desserts. Concerned that I was consuming too many products using artificial sweeteners and while researching some other products (allergic to stevia and agave), I came across the SweetTree Blonde evaporated palm sugar which claims a glycemic index of 35. My body has had positive gylcemic reactions to sesame and coconut products and I made the purchase on faith that the glycemic load using this sugar versus artificial sweeteners would be similar. I made a batch of cookies using Splenda and another batch using the SweetTree blonde sugar and then tested my blood glucose.  I did this repeatedly over the course of about 7 days and was pleasantly surprised that my blood sugars in both cases were consistently within a few points of each other.  So, for my body I found this sugar to be just as good a substitute as splenda.  For my money, I would rather put something in me that is closer to nature. We use it now in our morning coffee and the company will be releasing a new liquid version of the product in the fall sometime.

Farmers produce coconut palm sugar by making slits in the buds of a coconut tree to collect the sap. The sap is boiled until it thickens and then dried into hard cakes, which are ground into powder (see photo of the sugar I posted above). Coconut palms grow under drought conditions in sandy soil. They not only use one-fifth the water and soil nutrients of sugar cane, they also enrich (vs. deplete) the soil and produce 50-70% more sugar per acre.The Big Tree Farms brand of coconut palm sugar is not mixed with any other type of sugar as some other brands are. It is a 100% organic, natural sweetener which is not filtered or bleached as white sugar is. When sugar is bleached, the process involves using ground up animal bones, thus, this non-bleached sugar is vegan.The major claim to fame of coconut palm sugar is that lab tests have apparently shown that this product has a glycemic index (GI) of 35, compared to agave nectar at 42, honey at 62, cane sugar (sucrose) at 64, and date sugar at 103. A low GI is 55 or less. A medium GI is 56 - 69. A high GI 70 or more.Those who are concerned about the environment and humane labor practices will approve of the fact that this product is sustainably produced by smallholder farmers on the island of Java, Indonesia. All of the money earned from growing, harvesting and processing this sugar stays in the local community that produces it, and Big Tree Farms states on their website that they work directly with international, non-governmental organizations to create and maintain supply chains for this product that are "transparent and socially equitable."I purchased this particular brand of coconut palm sugar as a substitute for white and brown sugar in dessert recipes because my husband is a vegan and I'm on a "mostly vegan" diet. I have uploaded photos above to show the chocolate cookies I made using this sugar. (Note that I also substituted coconut oil for butter.) My husband and I love the taste and texture of these cookies, and I will definitely continue using this product.If you are not a vegan or vegetarian, there are two issues that might affect your decision as to whether to invest in this product:First, the claim of a very low GI of 35: Big Tree Farms states on their website the following: "pure, organic coconut palm sugar is typically 70-79% sucrose, 3-9% glucose, and 3-9% fructose." They also state that they believe the high sucrose content is what makes the GI level so low. I find this explanation confusing, because this product is touted as a healthy substitute for table sugar, which is 100% sucrose. The logic of how this sweetener, which is 80% sucrose, can have only 55% of the GI rating of table sugar that is 100% sucrose makes no mathematical or scientific sense to me.Second, the high cost: If you are not a vegan or vegetarian, I'm not convinced that the presumed health benefits of this sugar make it worth the extra cost and hassle of obtaining it. You can conveniently buy brown sugar at your local supermarket for about 89 cents per pound and white sugar for about 38 cents per pound--and they often go on sale. That's really cheap, and the GI is not "high"--it is "medium" at 64. In contrast to that low cost, this product sells for between $4-$5/pound. Since a pound of any kind of granulated sugar consists of 2-1/4 cups, that comes to $1.78-$2.22/cup for this product compared to 40 cents/cup for brown sugar and 17 cents/cup for white sugar.But, you might ask, isn't refined sugar bad for you, and isn't this much-less-refined sugar good for you? Actually, few health experts believe that any sugar outside of that found in whole, unprocessed fruits and vegetables is healthy. But few of us have the willpower to completely give up sweets. Hence the goal of trying to keep the GI levels as low as possible while eating them. A much cheaper way to do that than buying this sugar is to use a couple of tricks I learned during the years I spent on the Zone and Atkins diets: (1) Bake your sweets with any sugar you please and consume protein at the same time you eat the sweets in a Zone or Atkins ratio. (2) Make the baked goods themselves have a definitely lower GI by decreasing the carbs and increasing the protein content. Substitute stevia, lo han guo and sugar alcohols for table sugar, and plain protein powder for wheat flour (which has a GI of about 71).If you are completely convinced that "natural" sugar is healthier than table sugar, this product is certainly less expensive than some other alternative sweeteners you can buy and doesn't have some of the problems they cause when substituting them for table sugar in baked-goods recipes. For example, lo han guo (Slim Sweet) sells for around $17-$22/pound and stevia sells for between $54-$70/pound (both of these are also vegan, by the way). Marketers of lo han guo and stevia claim that those sweeteners are over 200 times as sweet as table sugar. I personally find this claim to be grossly inflated. To my own taste and that of my family, lo han guo is about 8 times as sweet as table sugar, and stevia is about 16 times as sweet. Regardless, the fact that they are so much sweeter than table sugar means that if you try and substitute them for it in a recipe, since you don't need nearly as much of them, the texture and "mouth feel" of the finished product simply isn't the same. For uncooked foods, though, such as smoothies, tea and coffee, lo han guo and stevia are great.In contrast to lo han guo and stevia for baking, sucanat (at about $2.60/pound), date sugar (at about $4/pound), and this product have the same sweetness as table sugar and can be substituted in a ratio of 1:1 in recipes for cakes and cookies, allowing the recipe to retain a similar taste and texture to what it has when made with table sugar. Sucanat, however, has about the same GI as table sugar, and date sugar's GI is through the roof at 103, the same as for dates, because it is made from finely ground dates.

column9: Tastes good, but there's bugs in mine!
column10: This is my first ever product review. I did not purchase this product from Amazon, but my local Whole Foods market just a couple days ago. After reading rave reviews on Amazon about Sweet Tree Coconut Palm sugar, and doing a little research, I debated for 2 weeks, and then decided to just go get some even though it was $5 for a pound. (my health is more important) I started out by using some in my steel cut oats yesterday, which I really liked! I also used it in my coffee yesterday in place of regular sugar, but I noticed little dark things floated to the top. I know it's pretty raw, so I figured, maybe they were little fibers from the tree, or perhaps it was something with that batch of coffee? So I just scooped the little dark floaters out, and drank my coffee. Which tasted pretty good with the palm sugar! I was so pleased, that I was very excited to have my coffee this morning with my new found sweetener.This morning (not more than 10 minutes ago) I made some coffee again with my palm sugar, and before I even had a chance to drink it... more little floaters! As I pushed them to the sides of my white cup, one I noticed for sure had LEGS on it! Yes, my friends... it was a BUG!! I dumped my coffee imediately, and made some more with(unfortunately) my raw organic sugar that I still have. No floaters. So it's definitely not in the coffee... it's in the palm sugar! Has anyone else had an experience/noticed this? I know it's supposed to be healthier and all... but for $5 I'd like my sugar to not have little bugs in it. That's NOT the extra minerals I had in mind! Maybe I just got a bad bag?  It's not my intention to bad mouth this company -- but I would want someone to tell me if they knew I was eating/drinking little bugs. I haven't contacted the company just yet, as I just noticed it for sure this morning. I also looked in the bag that I have, and can see others... one is caked in sugar crystals, so they're hard to notice unless you really look for them.

column10: I was pleasantly surprised by the taste.  It's not as sweet as brown sugar, and it's more grainy, but it's a good substitute.  If you're looking for a sweetener that doesn't spike your insulin in a recipe that calls for brown sugar, this works.
Coconut palm sugar is unlike any other sweetner.good for the body and easy on the pancreas.use like regular sugar in baking etc.These doctors love it and so do their patients.

The price is right (especially compared to specialty grocery store prices), delivery was prompt and the product is very fresh.I've been using coconut palm sugar for over a year now primarily because coconut palm sugar is a tastier and possibly healthier and more sustainable substitute for granulated or brown sugar. There are also reports that it is lower on the glycemic index than processed cane sugar. While the recommended ratio is 1:1, I typically reduce the ratio by 25% to 50%. The flavor is similar to that of brown sugar.If I had a large family to feed it would be a harder choice due to the cost, but we are now empty-nesters, so the added cost is minimal.
The sugar tastes like sugar and melts well.  I sense no insulin spike at all when I use it in my daily late-night hot chocolate.  Excellent stuff.  Reasonably priced.  Highly recommend it.

I had read about the nutritional benefits of using palm sugar as opposed to refiined cane sugar and was intrigued.  I tracked down this product at a local organic food store and was incredibly pleased with the caramel-like flavor!  I have subsequently signed up for "subscribe & save" deliveries of the 6-pack offered here on Amazon, and have been enjoying this product ever since!
this sugar is amazing  it has a butter almond like taste with a sweetness to it i will always buy this palm sugar

coconut palm sugar blonde comes to you brown it looks like raw sugar...but diabetics can use it or people who have a allergic reaction to cane sugar...i gave 2 bags to relatves ,open one for sugar bowl..i do not like it  but my daughter uses it she likes it...i prefer raw sugar.i have diabetics in my family so i share with them..an 2 who have allergic reaction to cane sugar when they eat it....so it is helpful to them ..my daughter sweetens her herbal teas with it.she uses palm sugar or stevia.

column9: Great product, and fantastic customer service
column10: This is the  first time that I ordered Palm Sugar from Amazon.  The order arrived and there is a broken pack inside the box.  I sent an email to customer service and they handled it very quickly. A week later I got replacement and the Palm Sugar is awesome!!! I will definitely do business with this merchant again...Thank you!!!

This is a great product if you grind the sugar in a food processor or ninja. The crystals are too big as purchased and when baked will give off a bad taste. Once the grinding is done the baked goods are awesome!

Great to cook with and has a wonderful flavor, a better than brown sugar taste.  But it still causes a rise in my blood sugar, so I won't buy any more after I finish this $5 bag.  I'll just eat less white sugar from now on.

I get this for my Mother who has diabetes, she loves it and it has not cause her any sugar issues. She really likes it in her coffee. I have found it better than sugar for baking spiced cookies/cakes/breads/pies (it makes awesome zucchini bread), it imparts a rich sorta brown sugar (but better) taste and is great for anything you would use brown sugar in.I give most of my order to my Mom, but I have started keeping a bag or two for myself to replace brown sugar in my foods, I figure it can't hurt my family to diversify our sweetener sources.

Amazing difference using a low glycemic index "sugar". I experience hot flashs with 1-2 teaspoons of sugar in decaf coffee or tea.  When I switched to coconut palm sugar based on the advice of a friend not - no more personal summers. Just great taste. A little price, but worth the money, and worth the investment in my health.
This sugar is great for those who cannot have sugar.  It allows you to have sweets again when your diet does not.

column9: Big Tree Farms Coconut Palm Sugar

column9: Love it!  Will never eat white sugar again
column10: I am so in love with this product.  I have replaced using white sugar in my home and have been very pleased with this product.  I use it in my coffee everyday and I so enjoy the creamy sugariness (not a word, I know) that it brings.It is kind of brown sugar-like but not---so much better on every level!  It does tend to clump a bit but it is easy enough to break it up and it doesn't turn hard like brown sugar does.  I believe that I must have this product in my life.I haven't tried baking with it yet or anything so I can't speak to that at all.

column9: Sweet Tree Organic Coconut Palm Sugar
column10: Thank-you for offering this Coconut Palm sugar with Amazon.  Love the product, much more healthy than regular sugar, & comes so very fast!!

I have used the organic palm sugar only once since my purchase.  It does give a different flavor, but it's good.  I especially like that it has a low glycemic index.  I gave it only 4 stars because I haven't used it in a variety of recipes yet to see if the flavor difference is a plus or minus.  Amazon service was great.  Received the product in short time.

Be aware of what you are doing demanding this product[...]So please, let's NOT sacrifice our coconut oil for coconut palm sugar!What no one is warning consumers about is that coconut palm trees are meant to produce coconuts, not sugar! When the sap used to make coconut palm sugar is collected from the coconut palm tree, from the flower bud that will eventually form a coconut, that tree can no longer produce coconuts! Think about that for a minute. No coconuts = no coconut oil, no dried coconut, no coconut flour. Is coconut sugar worth giving up these other valued products that come from the coconut??

i am extremely diappointed that i ordered my product on nov 1st and was planning on serving it on dec 10th christmas party.i believe that products should not be offered unless available or let the customer know at the time of order

Nothing like the picture. I was disappointed because proflowers did a good job last year. Next time I am not going to be confident to make a purchase just because you don't know how the local florists is going to make it. But this one look promising...but it turned out bad. It was embarrassing and a waste of money. They do offer a replacement for not cost. Let's see how it turns out then.

I am allergic to wheat (not gluten, wheat). That makes it very difficult for me to bake. I can substitute the oat flour for wheat in most recipes and my family doesn't even notice the difference. If anything they think it tastes better. I serve it to guests and they rave!

A bit of disappointment in this bully stick due to lack of thickness.  Product Description is: 12" Select Bully Sticks - Pkg of 50. Select Bully Sticks are thicker and heavier than standard Bully Sticks.My 9 month golden retriever, who has spent a day or more on a competitor's 0.75" diameter bully sticks, tore through the first K-nine Kountry stick in ~15 minutes.  They are obviously very tasty to the dog, but they stunk up the house upon opening the bag (which we now keep out in the garage)Either K-nine Kountry sent me the wrong product or my expectations are out of whack.  A majority of the sticks average 3/8" or less in diameter.  I counted 6 of the 50 sticks that were 1/2" to 3/4" in diameter.  Personally, I can't imagine a bully stick getting any thinner than a majority of what I received, so the idea that they are "Select" is what concerns me.
My dogs loves bully sticks. The varied thickness was a little disappointing but the price was decent so it was not to much of a complaint.

Great rice - smells like popcorn, great with all kinds of beans.  Authentic all the way.  Great to buy in bulk.  Can't go wrong.  The rice is IN a plastic bag INSIDE the burlap bag - so it IS clean rice...they should tell you that...I think the burlap bag is cool, but I think people will think bugs could get into the rice...they can't it in a plastic bag inside.  Easy to cook - tastes good.

These are the best!  They are great in salads but I put them into everything...omelettes, hamburgers, meatloaf, etc.  They are flavorful and save me time in cutting up the peppers myself!  I also use the Jalepeno strips and the Onion verision (WAY better than French's).

column9: Gourmet-style equivalent of french fried onions (not in a can)
column10: Understand: this same brand sells crispy red onions in bags that are essentially French fried onions like in a can, only crisper and more flavorful.  (The type of onions one puts on green bean casserole).  Crispy red peppers are the same thing, only made from peppers instead of onions.  So the pepper is not the star here, only about 50% of the product.  For what they are supposed to be, they are quite good.  Do not buy them expecting a lot of pepper--they are half breading.  They are crisp, not greasy, and are tasty as a snack or a topping for other foods.  I add them to camping food and travel food for variety.

column9: Best way to eat a plum!
column10: Bought these after buying some fresh plums that were not pleasant to eat at all. I have concluded that plums were meant to be eaten after they are dried. These definitely hit the spot and were a pleasure to eat. On top of that, they're very healthy too. Great source of calcium. Highly recommended.
Fennel was stale and tasteless.  I love fennel and it is supposed to have a mellow but distinct taste. This fennel taste like cardboard.
This is great to add to veggies or any meat. Great alternative to salt. Received quickly, was packaged well. Would buy again!

I, too, always loved Old El Paso relish, and when I found this I was really excited!  I went ahead and ordered a case (which I received in 3 days!!).  I found it to be as close as I've ever found to Old El Paso.  It didn't have the "kick" (I really like HOT food), but I found it be a great substitute (after looking for something comparable for about three years).  I see there are only three cases left -- do we know if there will be more ordered to keep here at Amazon (for when we need our "fix"), or does anyone know where we can order directly if and when Amazon quits having it in stock?  Thanks again -- first thing I did was fix some Juevos Rancheros (probably spelled that wrong) and they were great!

We always loved Old El Paso Jalapeno Relish, and it is not longer made.  I saw this relish on the internet and ordered it.  It is wonderful.  I noticed that it was made in El Paso, so I wonder if maybe it is the same relish.  It is delicious. Don't hestitate to order it.  It was delivered quickly, and we have used two cans already.  Great!!!!!!!

Casa Fiesta Jalapeno Relish. Boy, did I get suckered. Anyone that thinks this product is even in the same ball park with Old El Paso must have taste buds that belong to the Ancients.  I used to mix a can of Old El Paso and a can of Contidina Tomato Sauce for the best hot sauce around.  My CASE of Casa Fiesta showed up today and I mixed the two cans. DISASTER!  I can't believe I let myself be influenced like that.  As the kids say, "my bad.". Now what am I going to do with eleven cans of £^>*<?  Look out,dumpster, here it comes.
So glad to find this product.  Can't find it in any stores and I need it for a favorite recipe.  Really good.

I too was an Old El Paso Jalapeno Relish user, and have been searching for a substitute for a long time. I searched everywhere for the Old El Paso Relish, and finally contacted the company and found out that the relish was no longer being produced. I was told an order was made, but no products were sent, and to keep checking. After two weeks of checking, the label was removed, and another product was in it's place, so the search was on again (website) and here it is. Casa Fiesta, please continue this product for all of us Jalapeno Relish lovers, it is delicious, now my spaghetti sauce will have that special flavor again.
This relish is sooo yummy made into dip and it is so simple.  One can of relish with 1 package of philadelphia cream cheese.  Mix well and serve with chips!  It is sooo good!
I order from several web sites and it doesn't get any better than amazon. Great service.
One of the best Jalepeno relishes we've come across.  A wonderful addition to almost any table fare.

These are nearly impossible to find by me, so I jumped at the chance to get them at a discount. Even though they are unsweetened, carob is naturally sweet, so you get the treat without the sugar. The almonds are always high quality, and tasted like they have been roasted a little prior to being coated with the carob. These aren't vegan, so if you are, sorry, but they are not for you.Overall, a good candy for those of us who cannot eat chocolate.
These are very hard to find and fantastic. 10 lbs is too much for most people and too expensive. Please carry smaller quantities, so more people can enjoy!Thanks!
These are really good and kids love them.  I like that they don't have corn syrup and don't contain gelatin.  They are extremely tasty.

I'm not sure why the micro bowls are better than the canned chili but they are. I always search Amazon before buying anything.
FOR STORE BOUGHT CHILI IT'S NOT BAD.  I WOULD ORDER IT AGAIN. I LIKE NOT HAVING TO WASH THE BOWL!!

I discovered garlic-flavored pistachios recently while standing in line at a local deli.  Pleased with the combination of flavors, I went on-line to search for more--and for a better deal.  Braga Organic Farms pistachios are HUGE, fresh and delicious, and a great value for your nut dollar.  You'll be happy if you try these.

This specific popcorn is tender white with just the right flavor for our tastes. There isn't much choice for the tender white popcorn from other brands. When we have found some and tried it, it just wasn't to our liking.
The last 3 months of Crispy n White have the same exp dates and are not poping as well. Evidensed by leaving more unpopped kernals in the bag.

I like to pop Jollytime white, hulless from scratch.  I use light, extra virgin olive oil and a tiny pat of butter added after the first kernal pops.  Each batch is fairly healthy and very tasty.  The Jollytime crispy & white microwave popcorn is the only microwave product that has ever come close to the taste of stove top made.  Super product. I bought a case of it.

I did not feel this sensation but my mother complained that the popcorn made her tongue feel numb. I did experience an odd aftertaste, though. Fortunately, amazon has wonderful customer service and I was able to receive a refund.

It's good popcorn but we wanted the lite which I think is sold only direct from Jolly Time - no grocery stores. So, in a crazy sense it's not a five because I didn't get what I wanted. On the other hand I was treated great by Amazon so I kinda settled on a 3.
If it is an old fashioned taste you want this is for you. At a time when microwave popcorns are simply candy or butter it is nice to find one that tastes like just popcorn!

It left a little grease on the paper towel it sat in. Unfortunately not too pleased with this but we bought a supply so will have to eat it/give it away!

I'm finding that I don't want to eat meat most days.  I stopped eating red meat back in 1999.  Now, I very rarely eat turkey or chicken.  Even fish, at times, is just too much to eat.  I love having an alternative that I can use in recipes and it's very satisfying.  I would recommend giving this product a try.  I even put it in my tossed salads.

I bought these carob chips with the intentions of using them in carob chip cookies.  They taste great but the quality of the chips for baking purposes, is poor.  The chips melt out of the cookies and burn on the pan.  These chips would be best used in trail mixes or other snacks.  I did however, melt them and drizzle some over the cookies.  That was ok except that the carob never really fully dried, but instead made the cookies tacky sticky.

column9: My dog loves these - they help his teeth stay clean
column10: I originally started my dog with Paragon Hedgehogs - made of the same substance at the toothbrushes, but in a larger form factor - when he was a teething puppy about a year ago.  At that time, he was really slow to finish an entire Hedgehog, but once his adult teeth came in, the thing would be gone in a day and that was way too much dental chew to be ingesting at a time.  Now we give him one toothbrush a day after dinner.  He'll spend half an hour looking for the perfect hiding spot for it and then give in and eat it.  He loves these "toothbrushes" and gets so excited when we give one to him.These treats are made from vegetable starch and have a mild smell like potatoes.  They are currently made in Holland.The "toothbrushes" come in a few sizes. Our pup is 15lbs and we give him the "toothbrushes" from the "small 28ct" bag.The one issue I have with these chews is that they contain titanium dioxide (for coloring) which some studies show is toxic in large quantities.  I'd prefer if they left this ingredient out but unfortunately I've found that nearly every dog chew has something questionable in it.

column9: My dog loves these - great price
column10: My dog refuses to let me brush her teeth, even though I bought the peanut butter flavored toothpaste.  I won't give her Greenies because they are hard for dogs to digest.  The Paragon chews keep her teeth very clean and are easily digestible.
These are the longest-lasting chews we've tried, and we've tried them all!  Much harder than greenies to eat up, and they don't leave stains on the carpet (even the green ones!).

column9: My dog almost died with this
column10: This is NO innocent product - my dog got one of those stuck on his throat and is now almost dying - esophageal surgery, aspiration pneumonia and other complications - and now I just hope he makes it and I can afford it - I already spent over $3,000 - and all because of a treat that claims to be highly digestible and natural.

Our three dogs love these chews, which we alternate with Sam's Yams Big Boyz Sweet Potato Dog Treats, 1-Pound Bag. A daily dose of these chew treats seems to minimize the tartar buildup. We usually feed this medium size to our two 50 pound-ish dogs and the large size to our 65-lb Aussie/Chow mix. We appreciate the all veg, highly digestible ingredients and great chewing action (they're good and chewy, but not hard enough a dog might break a tooth on them), and the fact they're made in Holland, while our dogs seem to appreciate the flavor and gum-massaging action. Be sure to have plenty of fresh water available for your dog, as ours always enjoy a good long drink after finishing their chew treats.This product comes in a variety of sizes, and the sizing information isn't always clear. The "product dimensions" given here describe the size of the PACKAGING, not the product. For clarification, these Paragon medium-sized Star Toothbrushes measure 4" long and 1 1/8th" wide at their widest point (the base of the "handle,") while the large size are 5 1/2" long and 1 1/2" wide at their widest point. I hope that's helpful.

I ordered these for my dogs because I thought they were vegan (no animal products are mentioned in the ingredients list) but I found out from the Paragon web site that they are not vegan. Next time I ordered Paragon's Rice Bones, which are vegan.

column9: Great buy for my dog's favorite treats!
column10: This product is of high quality and consistency, and my dog loves them.  This is a cheaper way to purchase them than individually from my local pet store.

column9: Great price for large 16 oz. Box! Crunch-a-tize me!
column10: Great price for the larger 16 oz. box! Not only is it a wonderful bowl of cereal to start me up and get me going, but its a great snack anytime of the day. I like to sprinkle it on my ice cream and it makes a great cheesecake pie crust too! I just love it with or without milk.

column9: WHAT??!! Is this price a misprint, or am I seeing things?
column10: C'mon Amazon...we all love you and we're willing to go the extra "dollar" for your convenience, but this is going too far...!! More than $15 for a box of cereal...??!!...not to mention the $8+ shipping fee...that's >$17 per pound for Captain Crunch cereal?Hey fellow-Amazon shoppers...I did the math...you can make a breakfast FOR A FAMILY OF FOUR using USDA choice NY Strip steak, jumbo eggs, whole wheat toast, home fries and OJ for what it costs you to buy just ONE box of CC cereal from Amazon and a half gallon of 2% milk.Oh yeah...and the diner down the street from me (I live in NJ...a convenience store and diner on every corner) has the same meal for $7.99...so TWO of you could eat out for the price of one Amazon box of Capt Crunch...that's disgusting and unethical.

column9: Other Chicken chili varieties ROCK!  Healthy, thick and satisfying!
column10: Most all ChiliMaster Chicken chili varieties ROCK!  Healthy, thick and satisfying!I like the white the best, this is different, IT'S WAY TOO SALTY and tastes like a whole packet of Taco seasoning mix is in it and I could see no visible chunks of tomato...just dark red salty taco.burito styled sauce.A good way to use the soup would be to have it as a topping on burritos along with real sour cream, etc...There are adequate chunks of real chicken that are tasty...but the sauce so dredges down this variety.

I have always loved Swiss Colony for all of their Petits Fours and Bonbons.  They are so delicious and mouth watering, you will absolutely love them!  I know they are a little expensive, but well worth it.  I would highly recommend Swiss Colony!
The cake was a gift to the office and I found it GREAT!  I searched and was happy to find it on Amazon and at a lower price than elsewhere.  ENJOY.

I do quite a bit of online ordering of all types, and especially of food items that are not available in the area where I live.  I had purchased this cake for Christmas and was very disappointed.  The appearance was segmented, like monkey bread, but that was not disappointing.  The texture of the cake was dry and leathery, and the flavor rather stale and bland.  I had never ordered one of these cakes before, and relied on the reviews written by others.  The packaging of the cake was great and arrival of the cake was very prompt.My advice to those who have never tried this cake before: If you want a stale leathery textured, bland flavored cake, you'd be wiser to go to Big Lots and buy one for $2.00.
The Rum Cake was excellent at first bite but we tired of it quickly. There was no doubt that it is a RUM cake! I think it was a bit overpriced.
Nice flavor, lower sodium than regular table salt.  Works well in recipes, and on grilled or broiled meat.

column9: Excellent Service on a hard-to-find product
column10: Morton Lite Salt, which helps to keep our family sodium intake down,  is difficult to find in supermarkets, at least in the Philadelphia area. It is easier and quicker to order it on line. The product arrived exactly as shown in in the on line catalog, and the service was fast and efficient. Well done, Peters Select, the reseller who supplied this item.
Perfect gift for my Mom who's been looking for lime infused oil for over a year.  Tastes great, smells even better.  Perfect for making a great chicken dish, or for bread dipping.

Product didn't work as advertised. Mixed solution strictly adhering to instructions. column9: If you want to waste your money,send it to me
column10: I used this product as per the label to help control rabbits and groundhogs.The next day I saw one of each. Seven days later they are still eating my veggies, and enjoying life under my shed. Amazon should be ashamed of selling this useless product.

column9: Works for Dogs in a City
column10: This works well for discouraging dogs in a city from using trees and such on your sidewalk as their regular bathroom spot.  It keeps them moving on.  This is important in a city, like New York City,  where many owners don't pick up their dog's poop.

Quick sale, received it right away! I was really hoping this product worked and I misread the size, so I was a little disappointed that the was so small, but it was concentrated and that was okay. I'm going to keep looking for something that will work to keep my neighbor's cats off my new cars.

I was hesitant to spend this much on a syrup but it is worth every cent. column10: I came across a review by Details Magazine last night: " Pumpkin ChipsPumpkins are higher in beta- and alpha- carotene than almost any other food, and recent studies have found that those who eat the most orange foods live longer. Pumpkin chips are really crunchy and refreshing...! Sure they are a bit on the pricey side, but better munching on these than on deep fried potato chips. I"ll finish a bag any time! These chips are REALLY thick.They are starchy and a bit dry.They taste OK, but I won't be tying them again.

My kids love these (ages 15 & 12). One of my kids doesn't really like apples and she loves these. Great to take to school for a snack. I even have some in my desk at work.
I found the caramel apple chips had the best flavor.  I felt it was a great product for me as I was  looking for alternatives to other crunchy snacks.

I was really looking forward to getting this coffee and it just doesn't measure up. It tastes good but it had very little pumpkin or spice flavor...it just tasked like coffee. I won't be buying this again.

column9: Not bad but not quite the pumpkin flavor expected
column10: I'm a coffeeholic and usually buy the Pumpkin Spice in another brand which is only available in Season. This brand to me had far more spice then pumpkin flavor. My mother loved it enough to take it off my hands so thankfully it wont go to waste. I took away one star ONLY because it did not fit with my personal taste.
This is the best pumpkin spice coffee I've ever had!  It tastes great and it's even better when I add my pumpkin spice creamer to it.  I'll be back for more!
No pumpkin or spice flavor at all. Worst Pumpkin Spice coffee EVER. Will never buy again and will NEVER recommend

column9: The Giant 11 Pound Can Of Diet Coke
column10: Think about it.  A 12 oz. can that weighs 11 pounds.  Packed with extra goodness, and heavy metals, or other amazing substances, this can of coke is a bargain at $11.92 + $56.96 shipping.  Yup, for $56.96, you can get this can of hard-to-find cola delivered to your home in about 2 weeks.  Imagine your joy.

This eleven pound serving of Diet Coke, tastefully ensconced in a convenient twelve ounce can, is perhaps deceptive. Its mass might lead the consumer to believe that it somehow tastes different than the usual nutrient-free, chemically-laden glop that comprises Diet Coke, which seems to have become the International Women's Beverage. (As a person with a Y chromosome, I do not have the gender qualifications to drink this beverage, but I tried one anyway, along with some yogurt, the International Women's Food, as suggested by The Lifetime Channel and their wonderful films.) After careful evaluation, I determined that the eleven-pound mass of this can was not achieved by the addition of fruit juices or any actual nutritional food-like ingredients to the chemical glop. I now realized that some of the carbonated "bubbles" are actually black holes, a de-formation of space-time caused by collapsing stars, formerly difficult to obtain for the consumer but now conveniently available in these handy eleven-pound cans of diet coke. (I tried to give this product a five-star review, but somehow the five stars collapsed into two stars that each weigh 5.5 pounds.) Buy it! Drink it! The Black Hole Diet will not make you lose mass (quite the opposite), but it is entertaining and educational, and you can participate in the International Women's Cuisine Mandate while watching films about deceptive men on The Lifetime Channel.
Love Diet Coke. But seriously, $10 for one can? Get Diet Coke, just buy it from somewhere else.

You are probably asking, "Why would you review Diet Coke?"  It's a damn soda. It costs almost nothing! We've all had it and are probably already addicted and strung out to D.C.  Well, the truth is that I am a true Coke connoisseur.  I have spent many hours discussing a good coca-cola versus a crap coca-cola. This is a drink that can draw out the flavors of a good meal, just like a fine bottle of wine or cold glass of milk.Originally I only drank regular Coke. But there is no need to have all that high fructose corn syrup. It will ultimately lead to your demise.  So make the switch to Diet Coke. You may need to do some 50/50 blends for a while, but in a couple of weeks you won't go back to regular Coke (it tastes way too sugary now).  In general, any soda from a can actually can taste pretty bad due to changes in carbonation, flavor of the can, etc.  But a soda from a bottle (glass or plastic) is the best.  You know the batch is good when there is a major burn in your mouth after a big gulp.  Pepsi won't do this the same, the pH is different and it has a different sugar content.  Diet Coke has the perfect burn.  Fountain soda almost universally sucks, so don't even go there.I recommend that D.C. accompany any rich, flavorful meal.  It may overpower meals that have subtle flavors (for example, some French cuisine is quite subtle in flavor to me, and D.C. may wash it away).  You already know D.C. will enhance the flavors of beef, fried food, pizza, potato chips (and most other snacks), most sandwiches, Italian foods of almost any variety, and greasy chili cheese dogs.So go buy a 2 liter, chill (4 degrees celsius at the lowest, preferably a degree or two warmer), go work off all that high fructose corn syrup you ate earlier in the day, and then getcha pull of D.C.If you don't like my review, you must be a Pepsi fan.  So be it.  Your teeth will rot sooner, it's got a lower pH.
If you like hazelnuts, marzipan, pistachios, dipped in milk chocolate, then in dark chocolate... WELL! Enough said. Uber delectable, divine, and delish!

These chocolates are my absolute favorite chocolate in the world and I used to have to wait for occasions to travel to Europe to get them.  Opening a box of these is like opening a treasure box.  Each ball when dissected reveals its multiple sinful layers--I love cutting them in half and appreciating their complexity before popping them into my mouth. Sometimes when I'm feeling particularly glutinous I just put a whole one in there and let it sit and melt for a couple of seconds before compressing it and eating it.  It's an amazingly satisfying feeling I get when I eat these. I have tried all kinds of chocolates (fancy ones from Brussels and the like) and I still love the Mozart balls the best!
Received as a gift from people who moved here from Germany. This combination is heavenly. I will definitely buy some more and share with friends. So So good!
Whenever you need a gift or just a delicious treat for yourself ... get those chocolates.I am not big on chocolate but I cannot resist this combination of marzipan, pistachio and chocolate :)

Received these in a gift basket. Wow, I didn't even want to share them with my olive loving wife. These are very mild meaty olives with a wonderful flavor. I now know why so many people eat olives, it was always a mystery to me before.

What separates these olives from the more common store-offerings is: their saline solution is mild so the salt flavor is not overpowering, but very slight; they are very large.  For me they are well worth the price, incuding the shipping cost.  I have found no other offering to be thier equal.Bella di Cerignola Olives by DeCarlo
DON'T !I purchased a 3 pack of these, all arrived leaking and tasted horribly. I threw them in the trash. Another waste of money for me.Please don't make the same mistake.

I like this product because I am sensitive to caffeine. I take it when I travel to avoid jet lag. When 4-6 pm rolls around and I need energy to complete my day, I take one of these and I can still sleep peacefully at 10 pm. This stuff is like gold to me. No caffeine jitters, no sleepless nights, no sugar crash; just a lot of energy. Great stuff!

I can't have caffeine so I was looking for a product that would give me energy when I needed it without the headaches caffeine caused me.I was very dissapointed. It didn't give me any energy at all and I had to gag down the severly sweetened tasting product to find that out.
I would have loved to have some energy minus the Caffeine, but this product simply doesn't work. It just gave me an unusual headache. NO ENERGY AT ALL.

well, most likely you will have already tried these before you order them in bulk, so my guess is you already know the magic that lies within those foily pink packages! i almost dont want to tell everyone how good they are for fear that there may be a shortage or something. seriously, i dont know why these little rings of sugar have captured my sweet tooth, but they are just plain tasty good and fun to chew. i used to eat a bag this size every day, but have cut back recently because of finances...but now, i have bulk from amazon! and with prime i get em in two days or less...which is less time than it would take me to get to a market to find them...they're not avail in every store like the five flavors...so do yourself right and order em here. best price and fastest shipping!!

column9: Great value, would love auto ship
column10: With the free shipping this is a much better value than purchasing them at the store.  My son loves them so I bought him a case for his birthday.  Just wish they have auto ship on this item.

I drive to different stores near where I live just to buy these for my husband.  He loves these.  I try to keep a stock on hand at home because we have the grandkids liking them also. I have to admit I like them too.
The product arrived exactly as described. It was just what I wanted and they are delicious! If you like this product in the store you'll love them from this vendor.

There's not really much to review here. This is a wholesale package that contains 12 LifeSaver Wild Berries Gummies. I admit that I am addicted to these @#$% things, and they are less expensive to buy this way via Amazon then at the supermarket or convenience store, especially since this was an Amazon Prime-eligible purchase. If, unfortunately, you're already hooked like me, this is a very good and economical way to purchase them.

column10: These little squishy, gummy, sweet, Lifesavers are going to get you - you will not be able to eat the recommended serving size of 10 pieces - you will inhale the whole bag quickly.  I have gained 5 lbs since I started on these things.  I am just hoping and praying that there is not 5 or 10 more coming.

column9: Sweet chewy deal for the price, and a whole box load!
column10: If you love Life Saver Gummies, you'll love a whole BOX of individually-wrapped ones! Fresh and on your doorstep! These were a gift, and myself and the recipient are loving them! Outstanding deal

I've been purchasing these gummies for Amazon for about 6 months now.  Love the taste and the convenience of on-line shopping.  A couple of local stores stopped handling the wild berries, so it saves me time and of course the gas.
I absolutely love these wild berries gummies.  Even better they don't hurt my teeth like most gummies do.  Now the question is do I want to get 12 bags because they could be eaten too quickly.

I got hooked on these about a month ago and I have craved these since then. These things are little pieces of heaven in a bag. They have so much flavor condensed in such a little gummy circles. Be careful, you will get addicted. In fact, if you don't mind Please do not buy any of these. If these ever go out of stock, I literally might have a heart attack.But on the serious side, these things are packed full of sugar and thats all. If you do like me and eat the whole bag in a day, thats almost 1400 calories. Not very good for my diet though. The deal on amazon is pretty fairly priced. If you buy these from the gas station, they cost $1.29 for only 2.5 ounce. They say that 10 pieces is a serving, yea right. I'm just getting started on 10 pieces. Stick with these instead of the original flavor, I find those taste like chewy pieces of rubber. I agree with the other person that we need an auto ship program for these. Amazon, please don't let these ever get out of stock!I'm on my way to the gas station to pick up a few bags because I'm out right now and stupid UPS doesn't deliver on Saturday or Sundays.
The berry mix is much better than the regular one, is it much better on the mouth to chew and not soft like jello.
Not quite a gummi but far superior in taste and freshness.  Anyone who likes the berry lifesavers should try the chewy ones.  Very tasty and extremely fresh.
This Jerky was delish. Also for the price nothing can compare. I take this camping and always have some on hand for snacking.

I have been enjoying Chartreuse Teas for three years.  Their blends are fantastic, their teas are hand packaged, and the flavors couldn't be more vivid.This is nothing like the teabag tea you are used to.  You'll actually see the petals, the berries, the clipped grasses, the small chips of real organic material that, when you soak them in hot water, release their all-natural oils, vitamins and amazing flavors.Highly recommended!

First of all, I'm a big fan of Chartreuse organic teas, due to their superb quality.  Because I'm a fan, I took a risk on this blend.The first ingredient listed is spearmint, and I guess I had my own notion of what spearmint would taste like.  To me, spearmint is more subtle than peppermint and maybe a little sweeter.  The expectations I had weren't met, however, because to me, this tea tastes of peppermint--and a vibrant peppermint at that.  I don't care for it, but maybe it's just me.To use up what I've purchased, I'm going to experiment with mixing this with other loose teas, to blunt the minty flavor.  I'm also going to try making it extra strong for iced tea, and adding some sweetener, to see how I like it. I figure this will be worth my time and effort, because of the high quality of the tea itself.
Interesting taste, sparks up any dish, good texture, fast delivery, gud price,clean and safe packaging, always buy this for my final sauce on most dishes
I will never buy another brand of Quinoa after trying this.  Someone told me this one was the best and now I believe it.  Easy to prepare and so good for you!  Fast shipping on this as well.

I love this stuff - and it's soooooo good for you.  It's been dubbed the world's perfect grain.  I use it in a cold salad recipe that is to die for - I love the fact that it's pre-rinsed.  In my personal experience - it's a pain in the behind to rinse Quinoa yourself - it's itty bitty!  Bob's always has the best, freshest products - love them - love the brand!  Love the prices!  Love that Amazon carries it!  That's a lotta love....

The package of quinoa arrived in great condition, well packaged.  Other products I have ordered from Bob's Red Mill have been of outstanding quality.  I prepared the quinoa as directed, but found it to be bitter.  Perhaps it is an acquired taste.  I don't know if I will order quinoa again, but I will order from Bob's Red Mill again.

I bought this for my Aunt Janet and Uncle George after visiting them. She always treats us so special and has piles of food. However my Uncle George has has recent health troubles including finding out he has diabetes so they are careful what they themselves eat. Rice is out for diabetics so I mentioned quinoa to her and she had never heard of it. I wanted to thank her for her gracious hospitality. Amazon and Bob's Red Mill made this a breeze as she called and said they really liked it. :D

I am an espresso lover, sometimes I try something different. Nescafe Espresso is a very pleasant surprise. Generally instant coffee doesn't have the nice intense aroma and flavour of espresso, but this one does! When I prepare it my house smells exactly like my favourite coffee shops. It tastes better when I put less coffee and make it without sugar. Take a small bite of chocolate, after it melts, take a sip of Nescafe Espresso, it is great. The bad news is that this is a limited edition...

Used to buy this coffee in Russia and was very disappointed to not find it here in the US. Amazon, you just made my day, once again. I love this coffee, it has just the right bitterness for me, and I really like the foam that it gets when you add water. Mmmm, getting it!

We bought ours in Barcelona, Spain. It's amazingly GOOD, as Sasha reports! Dark, creamy. We made ours strong, and added a tsp of sugar. Mmmm. Now I am searching for another jar on line.... I have not found it in any store here in the US (yet?)

I love coffee, especially Italian espresso, freshly made..and with this coffee, you can have such a good coffee at home. Smells good, taste is strong but smooth and it makes this nice coffee foam..just perfect. I will hardly ever buy different one.

column9: I found a long leg spider in the jar
column10: When I opened this jar to make my morning espresso, I found a skinny long leg spider (dead) in it. It spoiled my appetite for everthing...I guess I will have to return it.

This is the best tasting instant coffee you can find anywhere. Sometimes you just don't feel like whipping out the espresso machine, or if at work and just don't feel like drinking the nasty office coffee then this is a life saver. I only wish it was easier to find locally so that I didn't have to keep ordering it online.

It came without serving size as it is not for US; called the company and they helped. (They didn't know how to make the Mocha Cappuccino and put the recipe I gave them in their break room!) Anyways to make my size, I use 10 oz of milk-my choice-, 1 oz of Hershey's chocolate, and 3/4 tablespoon of Nescafe Expresso Instant Coffee.  Then whip it up with a mini blender-which can be purchases for under 7 dollars, or 30 dollars if you want the fancy ones, put all in microwave-minus the mixer :), and watch it heat. It takes about 2-2 1/2 min. in my microwave. In the meantime I have added hot water to heat the inside of the container I am using. When the drink is hot enough for you, put in the drinking container, add some whip cream from the can, sit, and forget about your troubles. The froth someone got in there and is excellent. Does this help? Only wish it wasn't so expensive, however, have a espresso machine-using same recipe, but 2 ounces of espresso instead-which is more work but less expensive. Do you suppose if we all wrote to Nescafe, they might sell it in stores?

Nescafe Espresso Instant CoffeeAn excellent coffee to start you day - I bought it the first time in aris and i could not find it in any store here in California - Then I found it by pure coincidence through Amazon.It sounds expensive but if you like a combination of a coffee and an espresso, it is worth it.I love it!!
Best instant expresso coffee we've ever had.  Too bad one can't find this product in the local stores it would be an instant hit with all coffee lovers
Overall a smooth taste. I have even used in making dessert. However, was hoping for a stronger flavor for my morning espresso.

The espresso is not bad. It's smooth, yet has a decent amount of bitterness to it. However, I wish it were a little stronger. I also found Jacob's instant espresso to be the better buy: a buck cheaper where I buy, a stronger kick, and overall more flavor.
I is not naything special. even it smells very week. I am not satisfied with this prodcut at all.... So I will not recommand this.

My family loves a variety of soups, but their favorite is beef & cabbage soup made with leftover pot roast and other fresh vegetables and it's always a problem not having enough beef broth. I have used others but this is absolutely the best. It is low in salt and high in flavor. There is always some in my refrigerator. I use it whenever I need beef flavor. Pacific Natural Foods Beef. 32-Ounce (Pack of 12)

I bought this brand because their chicken stock is awesome, but this was disgusting.  I can't believe it's the same company.  I used this with French onion soup, which should be impossible to taste bad, but it just has a weird flavor.  It's hard to explain.  It doesn't have a rich, beef flavor to say the least.  Not to mention that it smells nasty as well.  I will never buy this again, and if I can't find anything better I will make my own beef stock.

This salmon would be most appealing to those who like a strong salty taste.  Normally, such as taste would also come with a wood fire taste/smell.  Not here: this fish is a combination of heavy salt and a very light smoke.  It comes packaged in a brine and it has a briney flavor to it.  If you like a heavy smoke taste or conversely a fresh fish taste avoid this product.I give it a subjective 1 star.  Some people might like it but I found that the salt taste obscured all else and left a distinctive salty aftertaste.

Well, we just opened our box for a New Years breakfast.  Not what I expected.  First, there was no wooden box.  Secondly, it was not the typical smoked salmon we are used to.  As stated previously, this is packed in brine liquid.  The fish did not appear to be smoked in either flavor or appearance.  Although it is salmon, it tastes and smells more like a can of tuna.  I give one star only because ZERO is not an option.  I will not purchase this again.

This smoked salmon was excellent and a great value for the selling price. The only concern I wish to point out is the ad in Amazon specifically claimed this to be Alasken Sockeye Salmon but the package only made reference to it being "Smoked Alaskan Salmon".
This is a great product with plenty of smoked flavor.  The price when ordering monthly is very good, an excellent value.

column4: Valdis "I lie dreaming, waiting for the stars...
column10: Bought these on a whim, as I'm a huge HPL fan.  Mints were yummy, but the real draw is the Cthulhu tin.  The bottom has a tentalce to extend the fun.  Enjoy!

column9: Swanson vs Apricot Power apricot kernels
column10: Why do you want apricot kernels? If you want to lower your blood pressure, have a healthy snack... Swanson kernels are fine for that. If you want kernels to treat cancer you need Apricot Power kernels. Apricot Power kernels are very bitter compared to Swanson's.

I have ordered the organic apricot kernels. Proper research and understanding will dispel fears and knee jerk reaction about the cyanide component. Cyanide is used in table salt, fish industry and pesticides. So unwarranted fear is unnecessary. Unless someone eats way too many, it should not affect anyone. More people die of drug overdose such as taking aspirin and acetaminophen and than over consumption of food naturally made for us to consume and possibly heal naturally. Ironically organic also takes care of pesticides problem.

I've ordered these Apricot Kernels because they are organic. I was used to eating non-organic kernels and they are very bitter. These organic ones aren't. It tastes like raw almonds. Very interesting. I'd prefer they were bitter, but I think it's not a problem.

Purchased two bags of these - 2 pounds each. It's something like 1500 kernels per bag.  The packaging what very professional looking - sealed fresh. Once opened it has a ziplock press n seal thing to keep the bag closed.My wife and i take these up to 5 per day. Experience has taught us that unless you can handle the very bitter taste of these its best to take with some other form of food. You can also grind these in a coffee grinder which we've done and then sprinkle over salad, pasta or what have you.We came up with a great way to consume these without making you wince over the bitterness - buy a bag (or more) of organic, raw dried apricots (without sulfites or other additives) and take one of these with a kernel and chew it that way. Its like putting the kernel back in the apricot. Makes it a lot easier to eat the kernel if you are eating it whole and taste great that way.
These don't taste especially good, but not bad, either.  After reading A World Without Cancer, by G. Edward Griffin, I will probably eat these every day for the rest of my life.

column9: If they are not Bitter they do not containe enough B17!
column10: If the apricot seeds you are eating are not bitter they do not contain enough of the vitamin B17 to prevent or treat cancer. I have sourced this information on a few different websites while searching for a cure for my mothers cancer.

Apricot kernels do not taste very good, but they contain a supplement known as B17, which has been known to cure cancer.  I gave them to a friend with cancer.  Since she has been eating 7 a day along with taking the supplement in pill form, the doctors cannot find anymore cancer.  She also did 2 chemo sessions during this time, but was not able to finish chemo due to an allergic reaction to it.  This leads me to believe that the rumors are true...  B17 does kill cancer and you can get it through eating apricot kernels.  If the taste is too strong, I would also recommend chopping and mixing into other foods.  The package arrived promptly and in perfect condition.

Nice resealable package and doesn't taste bad.  Fresh quality product from one of the ----istan nations.  Only 8 per day recommended on the package.  G.W. Griffith's book, "World Without Cancer" is a must read to understand how this naturally occurring B-17 can kill cancer cells.

Apricot nuts are a very valuable part to a nutritious diet.  However in the Midwest they are nearly impossible to find.  These nuts are very high quality and were a great find for my wife and I.  If you can't find them locally, I would highly recommend these.

These seeds aren't that bad tasteing. I'm not sure what people are talking about when they say these seeds are so bitter.I think they taste as good as a seed should taste, and as for working well only time will tell.

They call them "bitter almonds" but to me they just tasted like nuts, not bitter at all, just like a generic nut.  I eat several in the AM and several in the PM. Amazon had the best pricing that I found. I hope they keep me cancer free.

I bought this product because I was told that the seeds contained a compound called amygdalin that could fight cancer and was like laetrile. I was eating about 7 seeds a day and after about 3 weeks my bones were aching and I couldn't get a good breath. After further researching, I found that amygdalin breaks down to cyanide in your system and I was sufferring from cyanide poisoning.  I have been getting steadily better since I discontinued using the seeds. Otherwise, they were fresh and well packaged, so your experience my not be like mine, but when fighting cancer you have to pick your poison apparently.

I had been using raw apricot seeds from another source for years, but when I found this product at this price (about 1/2 the price I was paying) I couldn't resist.  Immediately I noticed a brittle, crunchy texture like they were toasted or freeze-dried (both of which will destroy the B17).  The package clearly states "raw", which I suppose, however deceptively, does not exclude freeze-drying.  And after  popping the usual 7 kernels in my mouth, I braced myself for the wave of bitterness.  It never came.Too bad I ordered 2 packages.  I am using 9-10 instead of 7 until these are gone.  I am too suspicious to reorder.

This product was exactly as I expected.  The two bags came individually vacuum-sealed with resealable pouch for convenience.  I bought these as a health boost to my daily diet.  They are not the tastiest seeds in the world but if eaten with raisins, I find they take on an almost almond flavor.  This was the best value I saw for these seeds.
these came in good condition.  however, they are not bitter apricot kernels thus of no use to me as cancer preventive.  didn't research properly before ordering.
I WAS A BIT DISAPPOINTED AS I EXPECTED THE KERNALS TO BE BITTER AND NOT FLAT AS THEY TURNED OUT TO BE.

There are stories all over the internet about how Apricot Kernels contain naturally occurring levels of cyanide. If you eat enough, you'll get cyanide poisoning. The packaging on this product even states that you should not exceed 8 kernels per day but they do not explain why. Please don't buy this product. Do research before you start buying something and taking it because you assume it's healthy.[...]

We have 5 dogs and they absolutely love Nylabone Nutri Dent Filet Mignon. Indeed, in confirmation of "Pavlov's Dog" theory, they have even got the approximate time down for when they are to receive it, since they begin salivating and barking at me.
My bichon poodle mix is very, very picky about treats.  He is the only dog I know that will walk away or spit out treats.  But these Filet Mignon Dog Chews he LOVES. I am ordering another bag!

We have two bachon's Frise Dogs who just love these. They only get one a day due to cost, otherwise they would eat the whole bag. Originaly we got these at Costco, however they do not carry them anymore.
These are great. Not to hard not too soft. My dogs love them.They smell really good too. Wish they were bigger though.
Works to keep your dogs teeth clean and add much needed stuff to his diet. I am pleased withthe good prices and delivery.

column9: Nurti Dent Filet Mignon Dog chews
column10: This is the only bone my dog will eat.  Yes she is spoiled but I never knew I could only get one certain kind of bone.  So my dog is the poster dog for Nutri Dent dog chews.  I just hope they never discontinue them.  Great product and I am glad to find a bone chew my dog likes.

This is nearly the only treat that does not make my 8 month puppy sick.  Although a good value when purchased on Amazon they are still a bit expensive.  Since I don't brush my dog's teeth they are worth the money.
My cavalier king charles spaniel LOVES these. She's 3 months old and can have them gone in 15 minutes. Seem to digest well also

column9: Arguably but not defintively Better than Greenies
column10: My dog loves these. The doggie store suggested to me that these were more effective than greenies in cleaning teeth but who knows. Sage seemed more apoplectic when offered these vs. Greenies. The packaging is really nice and the idea of Fliet Mignon really appealed to Sage. slightly more expensive than greenies and fewer choices.
My dog loves these chews. He asks for them every night. Much cheaper to buy them here than try to find them in stores.

This product is wonderful.  My older Westie has always had some trouble with plaque build-up and this product really took care of it.  On top of that, both of the dogs love the flavor, its like a treat to them.  And since I don't have to clean their teeth as often, it is a treat for me as well.

Tried the angus beef flavored nutrident bones which dogs like just fine.  I may switch between the beef and green ones as one dog seems to like the green ones better.  All-in-all, highly recommended!!!
My little Chi-hua-hua is very picky and she just loves these.  I like them because they provide her some much needed fiber and vitamins and minerals, plus they help keep her teeth clean.

My dogs like these the best and I'm glad if it cleans their teeth.  I bought a 32-count for what I felt was a very reasonable price and will buy more, hopefully for the same price.  I have two VERY picky eaters of food and treats, a toy and a miniature poodle.  They turn down practically all treats offered them.  These are their favorite (except for the gourmet duck treats from Costco that I can't find anywhere else).  These are really worth buying.
My dogs loved these treats, but they are little expensive for no more than they give you.

column9: SHHH - Don't let them know these are good for them.
column10: My 2 MinPins love these chews. They each get one of the small size every morning after their walk and will drive me nuts until they get them. Their teeth are very clean and their breath doesn't smell either. I buy them by the case from Value Pet Supplies. Really nice people to do business with.
my dogs love the taste of these and they do help somewhat with keeping their teeth clean. This vendor has the best price. Much less than Petco.
My 3 maltese love these.  The product is great. J&B are a wonderful company to work with.  Thanks!

column9: Dog loves them, but I hate the smell
column10: I have a 70 pound lab mix, and he goes nuts for these treats. He'll devour one in less than 5 minutes, but it's awesome to see him so happy. However, they have a super strong odor, and I do not find them to be as appealing as he does. Recommended for dog's happiness, just hold your nose if you're sensitive to strong, funky, meat-like smells.

column9: Good, but try the Extra Fresh flavor
column10: My two maltese really like these treats. I like the Extra Fresh flavor much better. Both of my dogs have really bad dental issues- I brush them every day but I also give them a dental bone every day. The Nutri Dents have gone in their regular rotation. My dogs are pretty small- Romeo is about 11 pounds and Juliet is roughly 9 pounds. They used to be given these mini ones, but because they are pretty aggressive chewers- I now give them the medium version after some trial and error, as these mini ones were devoured too quickly. These treats aren't super soft- but they are relatively soft when compared to other, harder dental treats we have tried. These have a really similar texture to the Greenies brand, but we like these ones much better than the Greenies. These treats smell pretty gross to me, but my pups love them. I like the smell of the Extra Fresh ones- they really smell like parsley and eucalyptus oil, which both can be found on the ingredient list of that flavor. I like that these are gluten free. I like that they have added vitamins and omegas. These ones are okay nutritionally for a treat, and the chewing action is always a good thing, but I like that the other flavor has actual ingredients that are good for dental health. Most importantly, my dogs love the taste of both of the treats. I buy these ones rarely, as I much prefer the other flavor, but these are still good treats. The only negatives I have are that these are really pricey, and they are devoured quite quickly, even by my dogs who are 12 years old and missing nearly half of their teeth. They are still much better than many other treat brands out there and I do recommend them.
My maltipoo goes craaaazyyyy whith these treats! she doenst eat a lot, but she'll beg for these! Her teeth are very clean too! Ive purchased these treat 3 times now and I will keep purchasing them!
My Yorkie had very bad breath and since I have been giving him one of these every morning, his breath has improved so much that I don't mind his kisses on my face anymore.

While I don't particularly like the name Nylabone since it makes me think I am giving my little guy nylon as a treat, he could care less!! Bugsy, my mini poodle rescue dog, loves Nylabone and therefore so do I.
My dog is just addict, he love it. I cant stop buying it, even if I wanted to. It keeps his teeth clean and the veterinarian is happy with it.

I have a VERY picky 9.5 yr old German Shepherd that leaves anything but a milkbone on the floor to collect dust.  She LOVED this bone!!!  I was amazed to see her crunch it up the large bone so quickly!  She's always been very well disciplined until these bones arrived at least.  She went into my pantry and tore the bag open and ate 7 bones!!!  She had such a low hung head when I approached her about the issue all I could do was laugh!!!  Luckily, my 4 month old shephard got one before her sister ate the batch!)  I save about $5 ordering the bones on Amazon.

The medium size may be a little small for my wheaten but he likes them. They're US made and gluten free which supposedly is important for some breeds. Can't really attest to any teeth cleaning abilities as of yet, but he eats them happily.

column9: appear to be stale and moldy
column10: i bought these for the fist  time at Petco and they were brown and clean looking.I ordered the 125 count pantry pack nylabone filet mignon flavored minis and they had green and black spots and were very hard.Trying to return them = they look disgusting compared to the pack that I bought at Costco.

I first purchased a pack of Nutri Dent puppy chews for my Welsh Terrier when he was just a few months old. He LOVED them and they kept him busy for a while. Around the same time, he started itching and chewing on his paws incessantly and would not stop, even for a treat. Initially we thought it was the flee protection, then the shampoo, then the treats, then the peanut butter and lastly these. We continually phased each of the previous items out of his diet/lifestyle until finally we determined that the itching and scratching was related to these. We've obviously stopped giving these to him and now he rarely scratches or chews on himself. Your dog may have a different reaction to them but if he's experienceing any of the above symptoms, it may be related to these.

I bought this item assuming they would be authentic Southern grits(cooking time 10-15 minutes), however I was mistaken for Instant Grits. The cooking time on the bag says 3-5 Minutes. They taste fine, but I wouldnt waste my money on these grits when you can get the same quality from Quaker Oats.

I loved it, if at first it was unlike most other chai's i had, like Republic of Tea or Four o'clock, this was very light on the cinnamon heavier on cardamon and i like it well enough without any milk or cream too, unlike other chai's.

I normally love these chips when I buy them from the grocery store, however you can never find them in the small bags.  I was so excited to find them here on Amazon ... but these chips arrived very stale, I was so disappointed.  My guess, they were just old!***UPDATED Review*** Thank you Amazon for quickly handling this issue.  The next batch of chips that I received were fresh and delicious!  You guys get an A+ in customer service.  :-)

column9: The best chips in the world!
column10: These chips are great tasting and better for you than any others I've found. You can see the flax seeds and they have a great grain taste and just the right amount of salt. Crunchy and stand up to dips and cheese, but i like them plain. Perfect.
These are the best tasting chips. They're are addicting; great taste, healthy ingredients, what else can one ask for?

column9: Delightful surprise at the airport store!
column10: Was waiting for our airplane & wanted something healthy to snack on - to my delightful surprise, I found your product (Multigrain one), looked at all the numbers on the back of the package & was amazed how good they were; then was further amazed how good tasting they were.  To my further delight, I have now found them in my local market (Vons in California)and want to try all flavors - then I shall order from you via the internet for more savings.  Thank you so much for the people who developed this product!!  Tina in CA
Buffalo Chips from FoodShouldTasteGood are crispy and spicy, but they're too salty for me.  I wouldn't have ordered them if the description had included their salt content.
Want a quick snack that is healthy?  I have tried the multigrain, lime and chocolate chips.  EXCELLENT-E.  Why on earth do the grocery stores not sell these?  EXCELLENT.
Oh my gosh!  Who knew a "chocolate" chip would taste so good.  The only bad part is I ate much more ice cream so I could dip them then before.

column9: Best Chips EVER!...and they're GOOD for you!
column10: We found these at Costco and fell in love with them.  They're SO GOOD...and they're actually good for you.  Since I couldn't find them at Costco the past couple of times I went there, I searched online and found them on Amazon.  Funny...after I ordered them I now see them at my local grocery store chain (Ralph's)...and even on the flight I took across the country last month (United Airlines).  However, I'm still glad I ordered a big box of them because we go through them pretty fast.  :)

These tortilla chips are delicious!  And they don't contain any bad oils or artificial ingredients.  I am following the Perfect 10 diet (with good success) and these fit on the diet nicely (in moderation of course... it is a starch).  Only way this could be better would be if ingredients were all organic.
Love these chips. They taste great and I love knowing I'm getting in my grains while eating something that tastes good.
I love these chips! This is the best snack ever!  And on top of that, it's healthy.  What a combo.
These are one of the most delicious & healthy chips I have purchased.

It is nice to find good tasting snacks that are not loaded with salt and fat.  The multigrain are the only kind I eat regularly, but taste is a personal thing.  The price from Amazon is guite a bit lower than the grocery store too.

Oh, YUMMM!!These are THE best chips I have tasted in years.  I am allergic to lactose, gluten, soy, mint and grapes, which has made it hard to go through these past several years craving soda crackers or something akin to them, and even trying (unsuccessfully) to come up with a workable recipe I can make for myself.  Now I have found them!  These are my newest comfort food.  Wonderful with a chilled glass of Diamond Almond Milk, and I am that little kid back in the kitchen sitting with my milk and crackers.  The texture and tender-crisp "bite-factor" (to me) is so close to that of good, old fashioned crackers - - and the flavor is just deeply satisfying.  I will be up in the middle of the night snacking on these for sure.  I cannot rave enough about them, but I see that others agree with me in the quality and "yummy-ness" quotient of these wonderful chips!  To me they taste closer to crackers than tortilla chips and that is SOOOO yummy!Thank you AMZ for putting these on S&S!!!  Come next payday I will need to be getting a whole case, maybe 2!!  (Can't be running out of them.)FoodShouldTasteGood Tortilla Chips, Olive, An All Natural Recipe, 6-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)&Olive Tortilla Chips

I stumbled on the Multigrain chips at the little store where I work.  I love them and buy them by the box from Amazon now!  The ingredients are all words you would expect and no long chemical names you can't pronounce.  The Sweet Potato is very good too, but I did not like the Olive flavor.

As someone who has not been able to eat gluten for the past couple of years, this chip brought back memories of my favorite - everything bagels - that I used to eat regularly. They are quite delicious!
THESE ARE WONDERFUL CHIPS. THEY ARE GLUTTEN FREE AND HAVE A GREAT TASTE. I HAVE ORDERED TWO CASEES. EVERYONE HERE AT THE OFFICE LOVES THEM. I HAVE NEVER TASTED BETTER CHIPS.

My two year old son and I have Celiac Disease. We can't have gluten, because it makes us very sick. We also both happen to have issues with dairy too. It is very nice that there are AFFORDABLE, delicious snacks like this that we can eat and enjoy. My son loves them, and so do I. The multi-grain are the only flavor we have tried, and we are sold! They are so good. I am so happy to have found these!Most gluten free food is very expensive. Like, Betty Crocker's (albeit delicious) gluten free chocolate cake mix is $3.50 a box, and you get half the amount of a regular Betty Crocker cake mix at 98 cents! It is nice when I find great products that taste good and are inexpensive that we can eat. I am so happy that more companies are finally making gluten free foods!

What's there not to like??  I am not a "chip" person usually, but was looking for something yummy that would do justice to my homemade hummus.  These fit the bill!  Nutty, crunchy, full of flavor, fiber-rich.....even provide a protein punch with 4g per bag.  Will put these babies on subscribe and save!
If you have to eat gluten-free and wonder what to snack on, these crackers are wonderful.  I have tried to find tasty snacks and they are hard to find, however, these crackers are so good.
I've gotten three cases of these shipped to me already.  It's nice to always have great chips/crackers on hand.  Great with any kind of salsa and a healthy snack too.
This chip has a little tomato taste but the jalepeno seems mild. Good alternative to plain tortilla chips. Not overwhelmed by the taste but a good change.

I tried these for the first time about a year ago; then my market stopped carrying them (lack of shelf space).  So I took the web address off the package and ordered online.  No way I was going to miss out on this delicious and amazing chip.  I even saw a program on how they were made and loved it even more.  The best; not too spicy; CRISP AND CRUNCHY.  Simply terrific!!!
These chips are so delicious!  The flavor is perfectly balanced, and not overwhelming.  As a weight loss surgery patient, these don't bother my pouch!Everyone needs some chips from time to time!
These are quite good. I wasn't too sure about them at first, but the more I ate them the more I liked them.
I totally enjoyed these snacks and felt very good about the ingredients.  I would buy them again and again and again....

I bought these at a grocery store and I had all I could do to not eat the whole bag and then lick the wrapper.  So olive-y! So delicious!!!.  Amazon had all BUT Olive so I waited for notification which came pretty quickly.  I ordered a case and I was....disappointed.  While the lot I received is good, it is not shout-from-the-rooftops good like the first bag.  My case was quite garlicky and slightly burnt flavored, but not really olive-y.  That first bag was so good though, that I will try again.  But not maybe by the case.

column9: Tasty, but not the best chip ever
column10: The Olive tortilla chips are tasty, but I certainly would not rate them the best tortilla chip ever.  The olive pieces in the chips are very small and dried.  They impart a light earthy flavor in the background and in no way overwhelm.  These are excellent with dip and do not break easily like some other gourmet chips.

These chips were amazingly delicious!These olive chips were thin, crispy, tatsty, yet not too salty.My 2 year old son loved them.
