(one package), 140 calories.

Oh, my gosh, these things are almost too good. I love olives, and these Olive Tortilla chips from Food Should Taste good are salty, taste-texturey, and full of three kinds of olive flavor. Unique and utimate salty snack satisfaction. You could dress them up with a creamy or savory dip, but I think they are best in all their naked salty glory. Yum!

This chip is one of our family favorites to dig into chili, guac, or other hearty (meaning thicker) foods.Unfortunately Amazon has taken it off the subscribe-n-save, so off to the local grocery store during sales...

These chips are the BEST out there. Period. Love, love, love them. I haven't tried a flavor I don't like. Excellent with salsa, hummus, taco salads, or just plain. THe multi-grain is great, and I also like the blue corn. This weekend I just tried a couple of new flavors I found in a store, Sweet Potato BBQ and Sweet Potato with salt and pepper. Oh my gosh good. My husband likes the Jalapeno kind. I generally don't care for spicy things and was hesitant to try that flavor, but it wasn't bad spicy, and just had an all around great flavor like all the others. Add in the fact that they are gluten free, all natural, AND non-GMO.....goodness, if they were only organic I think I'd pass out!

Food SHOULD taste good and these chips live up to their name. But the best part is, they have a lot of healthy ingredients, including high oleic oils that may increase good cholesterol. The only problem is how to stop eating them once you start!
I love the taste of these chips! If you are looking for a healthy snacking alternative, this one definitely fits the bill!
Whoever thought of putting Chocolate with these chips is a guinus! The perfect amount of chocolate, not over flavored.  Awesome tasting chip!

These are excellent chips.  I have enjoyed them in larger bags and was happy to find these affordable smaller bags, as they are so good that I can easily eat the whole bag if I buy a big bag! They arrived fast and very fresh.  I also love that they are gluten free, so I was able to recommend them to my nephew.

The Jalapeno tortilla chips have a great taste, not too salty, and a pretty good nutritional profile. Since they come in 6 oz bags, they are great to enjoy while watching sporting events, etc. while not worrying about over indulging.

column9: FoodShouldTasteGood Multigrain Tortilla Chips, 1.5-Ounce Bags (Pack of 24
column10: These chips are great. I carry one or two bags around with me during the day so I can munch on them when I feel a little hungry and it's not the right time to have a meal. I found out about these chips from a vending machine in a waiting room when I felt a little hungry. What impressed me was that they are made with real ingredients, flax, sunflower, and sesame seeds to mention a few. Since you can find almost anything on Amazon.com, I went online and found that I can order them and receive them every month on auto-ship. I highly recommend them.

I love these chips.  They're crunchy, slightly sweet & salty, and really delicious.  I love that they're gluten free (because I wouldn't eat them otherwise) and free of a lot of other things too.  They have a great flavor!

These are really good- they aren't too salty but just salty enough.They aren't strongly olive flavored, it's very subtle with the corn chip coming through and just a hint of the multigrain as well.  They aren't too thick- they are crispy and really, just right.My husband can eat a big bag in one sitting, I have to watch him with a new big bag, or he doesn't leave any for the rest of us.

I like all of the Food Should Taste Good varieties that I have tried (Multigrain, Jalapeno, Sweet Potato, and Olive). They are delicious, but also low sodium, all natural, and vegan. They are great with hummus and on their own. Unfortunately, I love them so much that I usually pig out and eat an entire bag. Local stores do not offer the single serving bags, so I decided to order them. They have the same great taste and quality as the larger bags, but I don't have to worry about going overboard.
Foodshould taste good chips are the best ever.  This price here is incredible.  I love that every ingredient is something I know and can pronounce.
These are very addicting tortilla chips!  So good, in fact, that we get them automatically every three months now.  Yummy.  Good with just about anything or nothing.
I love these chips and they are expensive in the grocery store.  This was a great buy.

First, the chips arrived in perfect condition having been double-boxed by Amazon, with the outer box very sturdy.  I have share the chips with friends, and we all love them!  Very unique taste.  Highly recommend.

column4: Barbara V. Carrara "Addicted to Books & Jigsa...
column9: Best Tasting Chips ever & healthy too...Excellent price, too.
column10: They are so YUMMY that my family is on their third case order of the multigrain chips. (FIFTH case total) They are wonderful alone or with guacamole or salsa or other dips. They are lower in salt content than most other commerical chips and have 3 g of fiber. The multigrain is our favorite but we also like the sweet potato chips. As the local grocery stores sell them for $3.79 a bag...$2.36 a bag is a steal....and if you use the current coupon GOODFOOD it is a $1.83 a bag.  WOW!

column9: Good food and my dogs love the taste
column10: There are a number of dry dog foods that are nutritionally similar to this. We've tried several of them. My dogs like most foods, but they get bored eventually so we try something new. They love Dogswell Vitality! In fact, I bought this and two other new foods. They immediately preferred this one. No corn/wheat means my dogs won't have digestion problems. Also, one of my dogs needs more bulk, and this food has more fiber than others we've tried.

We adopted our border collie, Molly from the local humane society.  You'd think given her past she would eat anything.  Well, that was not the case.  We have tried over 50 brands of dog food with no luck - until we found this gem.  Molly eats this!!!!!  Need I say more?  Thank you, Dogswell for such a great, healthy product!

I have a Chinese Shar-Pei and he loves this! He's highly allergic to corn, wheat, and soy it doesn't have any of that.  What's also great is unlike petfood stores that charge an arm and a leg to ship dog food Amazon doesn't.  I hope they keep carrying this!

We have a Lab/Retriever Mix that we rescued from a shelter about six years ago.Baxter (the dog) developed an allergy to the food he was eating and began to lick and chew on his paws incessantly.  It was beyond annoying.....keeping us up at night..  We were given a suggestion to try Dogswell Vitality.  This was the best advice we had ever been given.  The licking and chewing stopped.  We were not feeding him cheap dog food to start with, but he did develop an allergy to it.  We have been using Dogswell for about 3 years.  I wish we had known about it sooner.Dogswell Vitality did cost more....however it lasts longer...considering the fact that you feed your dog less per meal.  I am very happy with Dogswell products.

This food is wonderful for our Shar-Pei mix.  He suffered from terrible skin allergies until we pinpointed the source as a food sensitivity.  The Dogswell food doesn't contain the ingredients (wheat, corn, etc.) that other foods contain that tend to be an irritant for sensitive dogs.  Not only has this alleviated his skin allergies - he seems to love the taste too!  Our other dog who does not suffer from allergies eats it too and she loves it. Being able to order this directly from Amazon has been wonderful and is SO much more cost effective than in the specialty pet stores!  Thank you Dogswell and Amazon!

My dog seems to be very picky, even with the all the other holistic brand dog foods, but she seems to keep eating this one. Its been about two months now and I think I will be sticking to this brand. Very good ingredients and less fillers. Great product and would recommend to picky eaters. It helps to put a little warm water with her food to moisten and have a hot meal. She seems to enjoy it much better!
They sell this product at CostCo now (in California at least), $30 for a 40lb bag!  Comparable ingredients to foods twice the price.

This is great food, quality ingredients and apparently delicious. Sydney, our Aussie mix usually struggles when we change her food, however that was not the case when we switched to Vitality, she loves this stuff.  The best thing about this food is how it is processed by her body - the resulting poop is small, solid and easy to pick up - while all poop stinks there is a huge difference between using a quality dog food like Vitality and something of less quality that you pick up off the grocery shelf. The other advantage to a higher quality food is I don't have to be overly concerned when my toddler decides it would make a yummy afternoon snack.  Overall we are very happy with this food.

Our three goofy newfies love this food.  It is highly digestible and their coats are shinier than they were before we switched from Blue Buffalo food to Vitality.  We really appreciate the fact that real chicken is the first ingredient.

column9: All Dog Food seems like a scam
column10: The dog likes the food. Seamlessley in fact switched frm puppy to this and a week later hes lookin good! Safe to buy, made in the USA!

My dogs LOVE this food.  They had a lot of intestinal problems before we started feeding them this food and all of those problems seem to have cleared up.  It is VERY expensive, but it is healthy and rated as one of the best dog foods.  Our boys love it and they seem to be doing better now that they are on a better diet.  The only complaint I have is with Amazon because the subscribe and save price has risen $5/bag since I started ordering the food from them 5 months ago.  But the price is mostly worth it because my boys are happy and healthier.

We love this dog food. When our Husky was adopted, he was underweight, had a dull coat and was lethargic.  After some trial and error with getting him to eat, and all the dog food recalls, we found Dogswell. Now his coat is absolutely beautiful, his weight is perfect and he has a ton of happy Husky energy. We get compliments all the time about how soft, shiny and pronounced his coat is. We also notice less year round shedding and just deal with the seasonal coat blow. He is a finicky eater, but always excited for mealtime on Dogswell food. He also used to scratch and lick his one leg raw in spots. Once we started Dogswell,his itches and rashes never came back.  He never gets an upset stomach, poops less often because there is no filler. I cannot recommend this food enough. We've tried other brands such as Blue Buffalo, AvoDerm, Organix and nothing has compared to how well our dog does on Dogswell foods. We go back and forth between Vitality and Happy Hips, depending on what Amazon has available with no ill effects.
EXCELLENT FOOD , GREAT VALUE, MY DOG LOVES IT AND IS GOOD FOR DOGS WITH ALLERGIES.  I WILL PURCHASE AGAIN.

The food was fresh and my dog loves this product. The expiration date is over a year away, so there was no problem here. I first tried a small bag from the grocery store. I will now buy the larger bags in this way. It is such a good product (no fillers, artifical colors, flavors or preservatives).

column9: The only dog food my dog eats without salmon oil on top
column10: I've had dogs my whole life and I've never seen such a picky eater as my pooch Sofia.  She's now 2, as healthy as can be, but won't eat.  I've tried tough love, going 5 days taking her bowl away when she refused food and I sorta believe she didn't like her food du jour for a reason (allergy, taste, something...).  I've tried at least 20 different kinds of high quality and expensive brands.  I had taken to squirting Salmon oil on the top of her kibble to make it more appealing and that generally worked for the types she was 'ok' with.However, Sofia eats this Vitality product without Salmon oil, days of starvation or visiting dogs which would sometimes prompt her to action.  For me and really for Sofia, this is the best food made.  Honestly I really can't believe a dog won't eat but she loves this!!!**2/20/12:  Updated ReviewThe picky dog is back, I had to buy more salmon oil so I can finish the bag.  Oh well it was nice while it lasted....It seems she liked the smaller bags much more than the large (22.5 lb) bags.  She didn't even give that food a second look but always ate the 4 lb bag food.

My dog Annabelle eats this food with relish. I like given it to her because of all the good ingredients it contains and all the vitamins and minerals to meet a dog's needs. What more could I ask for? (I only feed dry dog food because I want my dog to have clean teeth and gums. The wet food sticks gummy-like between the teeth which, of course, can cause tooth decay and gum disease.)
We have two 85-pound retriever mix dogs who really seem to enjoy the food.  They give it five stars!  The subscribe and save is a great deal for big bags of dog food--free delivery!

This dog food arrived quickly and was packed and wrapped well.  Food was fresh and smelled good which is why I gave it two stars.  However, I will not be buying again.  My dog has had the worst farts since starting this food.  I've had her on it for ten days hoping that she would adjust to it.  She rode with me in the car today and I couldn't get the windows down fast enough.  Whew!  Not recommended.

My dogs don't like this one as much as Happy Hips. Got it for their skin and coats but at least with one of my dogs there is some ingredient that causes her to scratch more. Wish Dogswell would look into what ingredient would cause an allergic reaction and make the change.

I ordered Drippin' Sauce to experiment with a variety of dishesSweet Onion Ketchup.  I received it within a couple of days - along with a companion bottle Hot Chipotle Ketchup.I've used both.  My spouse loves the sweet onion sauce. While I enjoy it, my preference is the chipotle.  These are both great on any grilled meat - adding flavor to my BBQ.  I've also used it with fresh and cold seafood (shrimp, oysters, etc.) - and recommend it over the standard seafood sauces.I'm breaking the 'same old, same old' ketchup habit.

There's only about 50 calories if I eat the whole pack, and there are 4 packs in this bag. I love them and so do my grandkids. An easy way to get seaweed in your diet. At one healthfood store the 4 pack is $10, I was looking for a better price because they go fast, like a bag of chips. The same pack is $14 on the seasnax web page, however.

column9: love the product hate the price!!
column10: it's not very often I get to say--Whole Foods sells it cheaper.  About $11.99; the ONLY difference is that at WF all 4 packs come in one larger pack...this was more like purchasing individual packages.

column9: Awesome for the low carb diets!
column10: For over a year now I have been enjoying this product. I eat very few carbs and, as anyone who limits carbs knows, there are very few snacks to bring on the go with you. This is the perfect solution! At first I thought "Seaweed? Really?" but figured I enjoy seaweed on sushi so why not give it a try. I have been hooked ever since! It doesn't taste fishy or have any funky "ocean" flavors and when it's paired with the olive oil and salt it really is as addicting as potato chips. I buy the family packs now and my entire family is hooked on seaweed. We bring it hiking, to the movies and to work! It has about .6g of carbs for the entire pack of 4 sheets. Thanks SeaSnax for giving us this awesome HEALTHY product!!
These are the best seaweed snacks... olive oil... better than Annie Chun, better than that other brand...however, I buy all of the seaweed snacks, I can eat em all.

Guilty confession: it disappears so fast you can't often find it on my pantry shelves.  I LOVE it and it is like eating air because it's so thin and melts onto your tongue like a snowflake of flavor.  One of my favorite snacks.  Thanks SeaSnax!

This is an extremely tasty seaweed snack.  The biggest plus to this product however, is the fact that it is roasted with Olive Oil.  Most commercial seaweed snacks are roasted in rancid, unhealthy canola oil or soybean oil.  So the only option for health conscious people was to buy the raw nori sheets and roast them ourselves, which is fine but a bit of a pain.  Kudos to SeaSnax for stepping in and filling the void.  The only downside is they are a bit pricey but that sometimes happens when a company is first to market with a compelling product.  Hopefully others will get in on the act and competition will drive the price a bit.  Also, there is no real "Amazon" discount vs buying at Whole Foods, but not everybody lives near a WF and not all WF's stock this product.

As anybody who grew up on Asian food, I love seaweed snacks.  I saw this at Whole Foods and tried it and loved it.  The lightly salted taste was perfect.  However, this is a bit pricey considering you can get the same thing at an Asian supermarket for half the price.  But if you don't live close to an Asian supermarket, this will have to do.My only complaint about this product is how big the sheets are.  It would be better if they cut it into smaller pieces.  Every time when I eat this, I get seaweed and salt all over myself.
I did have them the first time and order then now again they are not cheap but truly deserve 7 stars , a little thin for sushi rolls but wonderful to eat like sushi excellent !

I like rice cakes and all sorts of health food my husband would describe as cardboard, but this is probably one of the most unappealing things I've ever tasted. No, it does not compare to potato chips. I smells a little like gold fish food and I imagine the taste is not far off as this tastes terrible. However, my order was placed with vitacost.com and their service was good. This product even shipped 1 week earlier than expected.

If one attempts to rationlize this selection as I do, you conclude that the jalapeno in the jar is one expensive pepper, albeit beautiful, since it displaces one of the seven fillets of truly delectable yellowfin tuna.  Stated differently, it is a one dollar jalapeno.  However, less is more here because the flavor that results from steeping the tuna in that pepper and in the top quality olive oil is incomparable.  Worth every penny.  An awesome delicacy.

It is hard to find cereals when you have food allergies. I can't have dairy, soy, gluten, or nuts, and the options available were usually very bland and very low in fiber and other nutritional value. This granola, however, is both scrumptious and nutritious. There is flax so it's high in fiber and other nutrients, and the chocolate bits are very tasty. The only reason I don't give it five stars is that it has a slightly odd, almost chemical smell/taste at first. I don't know if I got used to it or if the smell dissipated, but after the first few bites I didn't mind it at all (and I have since finished the whole package). And as anyone with a food allergy knows, there's no perfect product out there.
Food allergy aware and awesome company. So good to eat & not worry about a reaction!  Recommended to anyone with or without food allergies!
It's a little too much chocolate for me...I know it's hard to believe that someone would find anything too chocolaty. But my grandchildren LOVE it!  They think it's a great gluten-free cereal.

These chocolates I first encountered on a trip to Hawaii.  They are absolutely delicious and addicting!  I can't say anything negative or positive about this vendor, but I do know that the product is superb!

I took a tour of the Numi facility in Oakland and I am totally sold on them as a company. If you are going to drink tea, drink their tea. Its a brother and sister operation, they are good to their suppliers all the way down the chain, they try to be really efficient with the way they ship and their products are all real - not "natural flavors" ie jasmine tea uses real jasmine flowers to scent the tea - most spray it on to get the smell.The Puerh bricks are really cool, like a choclolate bar. Break off the one chunk and drop it in the pot and you can get several steeps. Good rich flavor.
This is decent shu, but the amount you get for the price is meager. I've been using 3 sections in my small yixing pot. I guess if it was about half the price I would recommend it.

column9: A new tea adventure for me.
column10: I have never tried brick tea before, so I am going through a learning process.  Not bad for the most part, but now I need to try other types to compare this with.

This embodies a very earthy, malthy flavor. It's a nice change from the gen mai cha, and sencha tea's i normally drink. I'm intrigued, i will probably venture in some other subtle flavors. I'm enjoying this... nice to sip on while sitting on my balcony at night listening to the crickets.. soothing and hearty.

column9: Very well priced for what it is.
column10: This is very well priced for what it is. They aren't particularly large, but per ounce the price makes sense considering it has prime shipping and everything! Also, the tea itself is really good. Just a heads up, don't try and make this if all you have is a water heater and a cup, you need something to steep it in.
The add is miss leading Numi Tea Aged Puerh Tea Brick, 6 Units 13.2 oz.  The price is next and does not say one unit.  The tea is great the add is miss leading.

column9: More Fast Food Flavors AT HOME!
column10: Fewer trips to the drive-thru and more preparations to make a variety of at home meals possible is the goal. Tacos and Fajitas are fast food favorites. The Mexican spices in soups, stews, beans, tofu  are tasty and pleasing. These packets are just easier and the kids use them. Plus catching these at a good sale price is a bonus.

These are Turkish apricots that differ from varieties found in the U.S.  Dried Turkish apricots are moister and thicker and have a somewhat tangy taste.  Since these apricots are unsulphured, they are brown.  (Sulphur is used manly to make fruits look more attractive.  Sulphured apricots are yellow, just as sulphured "golden" raisins are.)Any bag of dried fruit (organic or not) will most likely have a piece or two that is drier and tougher than the rest. Made in Nature is no different.I find the fruit to be mostly sweet and chewy.  This is a good mid-day snack.  Dried apricots can also be finely chopped and cooked with oatmeal.  The reasealable bags are terrific. I will continue to purchase these as the price is lower than health food stores and shipping is free on orders of $25 and up.

We love this all natural, organic apricot.Very sweet and soft. Worth the money. You pay more at a health food store per bag. I,ve been shopping from the health food stores for over 25 years. Let me say that the color is not as bright and cheerful as the non- organic counterpart but keep in mind that this is all natural. It was not treated with chemicals, preservatives or colorings. This is good tasting and good for you. For me, it is good quality and deliscious. I will order this again and other natural fruit products by them. Enjoy!

One star.  These Apricots aren't dried all the way through.  Some of them were fine, but others were wet inside and tasted off.  They gave me a stomach ache and the runs.  They were even stored in the refrigerator after opening.  I ended up throwing out the rest of the first package.  I thought I just had gotten a bad batch.  When I went to open the second bag, I noticed that two of the remaining bags (out of the 6 pack) were fat with air - like they could explode eventually.  That is bacteria inside giving off their gaseous byproduct.  If you've ever seen a can of food that wasn't properly canned, you'll know what I mean.  They can rupture.  I threw out the remaining bags because Amazon only has a thirty day return policy.  Don't waste your money!  There are better dried fruits out there that won't make you sick.

These are not what I was expecting. They don't taste like any unsulfered apricots I've ever eaten before. Their texture is strange, too. They're soft and squishy, and not very chewey, which is what I'm used to.  Most importantly, they smell and taste awful.  Amazon doesn't accept returns on Grocery items, so it's money down the drain for me.

Based on the reviews here, there clearly isn't a consensus on these.  Personally, I really like them.  I tried them for the first time last week after buying them from Amazon, and after finishing my first bag of them, my opinion hasn't changed from my first bite - very tasty.  After raisins, apricots are my dried fruit of choice.  These are the first organic dried apricots that I've tasted, and they have a stronger flavor than the ones that I've had in the past.  They are less tangy, but they have more of a sugary taste to them that I think makes them great for a sweet snack.As mentioned, they are dark in color and therefore do not look like the dried apricots that most people are probably used to seeing.  However, I think they taste great, and I particularly like that they are organic.  People may want to try a single bag from the local store before ordering these seeing as how they appear to be a love them or hate them item.

column9: Didn't seem very fresh - too dry
column10: I have purchased these in the past from whole foods and everyone in my family loved it. They weren't  too dry, not too sticky gooey, just perfect. However I can't say the same about the package received from amazon (6 bags). Amazon bags are too dry, very chewey, no one at home wants to eat them. I am the only one trying to finish these 6 bags. Won't order again.

We normally buy organic dried unsulphured Turkish apricots in bulk 5# packages through a food club.  They are always plump and moist even after the package has been opened and put into smaller packages and stored in the refrigerator for a few weeks.  I decided to try these small bags because most of the reviews were positive.We were very disappointed. There is a difference between "dried" and "all dried up". Most of these Made In Nature brand individual fruits are all dried up!  In fact, they are closer to being like dried apples than to being like apricots.The apricots are "OK" when you first open the bag, with a few of them being as plump and moist as the bulk apricots we usually eat.  However, after being stored in the refrigerator for even one day a high percentage of them are extremely dry and hard to chew. This has been true of all of the 6 bags we received in this shipment.  We will not be ordering them again.  We are going back to ordering the 5# bulk bags of unsulphered Turkish apricots from our food club.

These apricots are absolutely delicious!  The flavor is so much better than the sulphured apricots.  I had a bag of sulphured apricots and these fantastic organic apricots and tried them out side by side... These won hands down!

This is an excellent quality product- dried, unsulfured, organic apricots. It arrived very promptly after the order in an airtight containers. It makes a perfect companion to breakfast due to all the nutrition benefits they provide. Sometimes they become too hard to chew after refrigeration so I soak them overnight to eat in morning and they stay fresh and tasty. I will certainly buy them again as long as quality stays same.

column9: Another wonderful product from Made In Nature
column10: I have enjoyed very much every Made In Nature product I have tried so far, including theseMade In Nature Organic Apricots, Dried and Unsulfured, 6-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6) which I really love. Made In Nature gives me everything I want in dried fruit ~ organically grown, unsulphured fruit.  These are Turkish apricots ~ moist, plump, sweet and with a lovely amber color.  The only problem I have with them is that they are too good and I can't control myself from eating the entire package in one sitting! I'm really bad that way...thank goodness I don't have a weight issue or dental problems!I also love Amazon's pricing.  These products are way overpriced at my local health food store and are a great value at Amazon.  Considering how quickly I can go through my stash, I should be ordering a larger quantity. Well, maybe next time...

column4: Chi "Who loves to find bargains and lives a g...
column10: I bought these mainly to make apricot oatmeal for my baby, and I have to say it has become my signature baby food because even my adult friends and family members love to eat my apricot oatmeal. I soak the apricots in water overnight, then boil them in another pot of water. The apricot water smells and tastes so good! Then I use the water to make oatmeal with it along with puree apricots. I love the fact is that they are organic and safe for my baby. They are also cheaper than those sold in the organic stores. I also like the bags are resealable, so they don't get stale first. I always look for ways to cut down my grocery budget, but these are just one of those things that you just have to spurge and eat right.

The dried apricots that I normally eat have a fairly strong (and quite  enjoyable)"tang."  However, these Made in Nature dried apricots are very bland.  This is the first time that I have had organic apricots, so I do not know if this blandness is typical of organic apricots or if it is just a problem with this brand.I do not recommend these unless you like very bland dried apricots.

The best price I can find for unsulfured organic (most important aspect for me)dried fruit. I have been buing fruit from Made in nature for years now. Amazon makes it even better with free delivery. Thanks

Good product, nice quality, but these are super juicy and sweet, not at ALL tangy like I'd hoped! I guess that's a good thing though, there is no way you can sit down and eat an entire bag of these, without the tang, they are better suited for baking!

I'm not a health nut or anything of the sort, but these apricots are great for snacks.  They do appear darker than the non-organic apricots that I have seen in the grocery stores or trail mixes, but they still taste great.  They keep alot longer than I thought they would, but I guess that's dried fruit for you.  Good pruduct for a good price.
Good product - no complaints, though my husband prefers Neumans (not sure why) so we've switched to buying Neumans. I cant tell a difference though. No complaints.

I was afraid of buying this product after reading some of the reviews.I am so glad I bought these. They are very delicious.They may not be the bright orange apricots you see in other products but at least you know you are not getting sulphites that may cause health problems.Apricots are one of the foods eaten by centenarians making them a wonderfull way to get vitamins and nutrition in your diet.

Unlike the conventionally grown dried apricots I bought at the grocery store these apricots are not just sweet but also have a delicious unique flavor I can describe only as oriental - they are from Turkey.

They are not a dry as I like my dried fruit which left me feeling a weird texture in my mouth as I ate these. I personally would not buy them again, but I would offer them to other people. My dislike is aesthetic and not based on product quality.
Sweet dried apricots.  No chemicals, sulfur, colors, other preservatives.  All natural.  Perfect for snacks between classes and on the trail.  I will definitely purchase again.  Highly recommended!

column9: Organic and unsulphured, but not without sacrificing something
column10: I've had the Mariani brand dried apricots, which always seem to be plump and moist; but they are not organic, nor unsulphured.  I wanted to try these to get a more natural tasting apricot. The taste of these apricots is not very much different to the brands I can get locally.  They taste pretty good.  However, the big difference is that many in each package are quite dried out, hard and tough.  I have yet to try to reconstitute them with warm water.  But I will definitely give that a try when I cook them up to make baby food.

The price is good and the fact that they are organic is good but the color is an unpleasant brown and the apricots are very dry and chewy. I stewed these for a few minutes in water with a squeeze of lemon and they were much more palatable but not really flavorful.These are not as soft, flavorful or pretty as the non-organic apricots I would buy in the grocery store. I was hoping the organic would be better.

Simply awful product if you are familiar with Sunsweet or other domestic brands.  I don't really care if they came from Al Sharpton's basement, they taste stale, colorless, not tangy like an apricot... OMG.  I write a lot of positive food reviews here and there is nothing to say about these.  I suppose if you were a very dedicated veg that you could mix them with some normal Sunsweet apricots and get them down.  I'm going to find a way to use them as a door stop.  Save your money, there's lot's of other brands of apricots on here including Newmans Own.
Not sweet like the bright orange ones available at grocery stores. I got a lot of something for cheap that doesn't taste good!
I love all the Magic Seasoning Blends, so this review may be biased.  The seasoning just perks everything up without it being overbearing.  It's a compliment to any vegetable!

I love this seasoning! I use it with a slight butter spray on asparagus before I grill it or in a steamer bag with frozen veggies. It brings out the flavor of everything without being too overwhelming. It will change the way you cook veggies.

I saw this at Whole Foods yesterday, and because I'm always up for trying something new, I bought this flavor.  I am so pleased with it!  It is so fresh and clean tasting.  It doesn't taste artificial, and it doesn't leave me wanting for more flavor.  It is really a fantastic 100% organic, sugar free beverage, and I'll be repurchasing for sure.  I can't wait to try the other flavors :)
It's easy to make and the shells last a long time.  We bought this with the bulk buy of Taco Bell taco seasoning.  Taco Bell is a better product than some of the other taco mixes and shells.

This is a delicious product for anybody, but if you are following a sodium restricted diet, such as those for high blood pressure, Congestive Heart Failure or Meniere's Disease, this product is for you. It is wonderful to see name brand manufacturers making products that are tasty, wholesome and that can be enjoyed by individuals seeking to protect and promote good health. With these taco shells, anybody can enjoy tacos. Heartily recommended.

column9: I ordered these for making smores on our camping trip
column10: These have a strange taste at first, but then it turns strangely pleasant. I would buy them again because they are a good price for packaged GF cookies and the flavor is unique. All 5 of my kids were begging for more! Now they did not ship so well, a few were broken but I dont mind at all. Most of them were still in tact.

I bought these cookies for my two-year old daughter who has multiple food allergies--AND SHE LOVES THEM! But she prefers the Enjoy Life Chewy Chocolate Chip Soft Baked Cookies, and so do I. It tastes great with Blue Bell Homemade Vanilla Ice Cream :)

column9: Great Improvement Over Their Cookie Line in 2007
column10: The first and last time I tried Enjoy Life cookies was back in November of 2007, when I was newly diagnosed. They were terrible. I believe I tried the Soft Baked Snickerdoodle and the Soft Baked Double Chocolate Brownie. I'm not sure if they have redeveloped those cookies since then but at that time I had decided never to buy Enjoy Life. Recently our Celiac Support Group leader returned from the CDF convention and had samples of the Enjoy Life crunchy cookies. I tried the Vanilla Honey Graham flavor and was pleasantly surprised. It would work really well for s'mores and is tasty plain. I will buy this one in the future.

These cookies are surprisingly good!  I haven't had a cookie that I liked this much since Pamela's lemon shortbread.I took 2 of these cookies and put a marshmallow on one and a sprinkle of chocolate chips on the other and microwaved for 15 seconds.  Then I made them into s'mores.  My kids have a ton of food allergies so this was a huge hit!

My son likes the taste of these cookies.  But they arrive very broken, with too many crumbs.  I buy these every so often - not as much as Enjoy Life's soft cookies, which fare better during transit & arrive in near-perfect condition.

My kids love these cookies, and I really like the flavor and the crunch, but I have to admit that the texture is a little grainy when chewing.  It's such a relief to give my children these cookies for a snack or dessert without having to worry about possible cross-contamination.  Two of my three children have nut allergies, and my husband and I grew up without any food allergies, so this has been a scary and trying experience for us, at times.  It's difficult to reassure your children when even you have doubts about the safety of their food and snacks.  Enjoy Life Foods really takes a lot of strain off of us by producing such thoughtful and tasty products.  Keep it up Enjoy Life because we need more products and more companies like yours!  :)

column4: FOREVER student of Life:D "Always learning co...
column10: Thought I wouldn't be able to have Graham "crackers' again! Nice if you want to have a cookie without Caffeine aka Chocolate :DMsaybe they'll make Ginger "snaps"  I'll be right there!

OMG! These cookies are great, great taste, healthy ingredients.  I amm gluten and lactose intolerant and it is not too hard to find cookies made with out gluten, but finding cookies with no eggs, lactose and gluten is difficult. Enjoy Life sugar cookies are even better!

Looking for a soy-free, gluten-free chocolate cake mix that actually tasted good, I picked this mix up on sale. The texture was great! It far exceeded my expectations as far as both texture and taste for the cake itself. The frosting was a disappointment. I should have followed my instincts and not added all the water at once, instead one Tbsp. at a time until I got the consistency right. It tasted fine- but was completely runny and watery! I ended up dumping it over anyway, which made it like a chocolate fudge cake- which honestly didn't hurt it! Despite not looking like it should have it tasted great and even NON-GF peeps were taking it rather than the regular cake at my daughters' birthday party. I'll be buying it again, because it's great to have a decent-tasting mix that EVERYONE in the family can enjoy! Next time I'll add the water to the frosting one Tbsp. at a time, though!

I have baked many gluten free cakes from scratch. This one ended up in the trash. The 'frosting' was so thin some of it soaked into the cake, the rest spilled onto the counter. None of it actually frosted the cake. The cake itself had this weird vaguely fishy taste. I checked my oil to make sure it wasn't rancid and the eggs were fresh. Maybe the mix was rancid, I don't know. It was in airtight plastic.
This is now my absolute favorite chocolate. Rich in flavor, not too bitter or sweet. I highly recommend. Perfect for eating and baking!Buy this!PoseManikin
Great priceGreat tasteFatty foodQuick deliveryMaybe recommend to a friend, But if you have braces i do not recommend this!!Hope my review helps

This was the second time I have purchased Tully's French Roast 108 K cups. The first time it arrived in a case with 6 boxes of the lil cups. This last time it came in as 108 loose lil cups in a case. The 'pile o cups' was a surprise. the quality of the Tully's French Roast was fine as always, and maybe the price was a little lower due to the 'pile o coffee' approach :-)
This coffee closely resembles the taste of expresso and is soooo much easier to make in my Keurig B60 machine.
This is a nice bold smokey coffee, that does not have a bitter finish. I enjoy this all day long and provide it to my customers.
So far, at least one of the packages is filled with defective K-Cups. When brewing, the top of the K-Cup separates, and coffee spills all over the place. Not happy about this.

As a diabetic, I am always looking for sugar free products that have real taste and not just some poor substitute for the "real thing."  This is a good option for anyone, diabetic or not, as the flavor is true and makes a wonderfully refreshing drink.

It's very easy to tear the top of a tube that has a powdery sugar-free cranberry pomegranate and dump the contents inside a water bottle. Shake the bottle, and wow! Drinkable juice! Did I say Sugar Free?!

column9: one of the best flavors of 4C Totally Light
column10: one of the best flavors and really handy i like to carry one every day at work and have a really good beverage

column9: For those of us who don't like plain ol' water . . .
column10: I've always kept powdered drink mix on hand for when I run out of my favorite bottled drink, juice or tea until the day I ran across these Totally Light 2go at a friend's house.  I filled my green tea bottle with cold water and added the pre-measured, pre-sweetened packet and the tap water instantly became an enjoyable, satisfying beverage!With an abundance of flavors, I actually look forward to having these drinks; they are that good!-Stephen

column9: Says Mudslide but doesn't taste like it
column10: I rarely complain about things but something is up with these K-Cups.  My wife and I got a few sample mudslide k-cups from a water distributor and really liked it.  We went looking around and found this great deal on amazon for the 50 k-cups.  Now they say mudslide on them, and I even checked the label against some other Gloria Jean coffee K-Cups we have and they appear to be the same.  However, they definitely do not taste like mudslide.  I tried cleaning my machine, running clear water cycles before brewing, etc and it doesn't help.  Not sure if it's just a bad box or something more but I definitely will not be purchasing them here again.

So not sure what gives with this but this ISN'T the same Mudslide I had in the variety pack..The normal mudslide smells/tastes so good and smells my kitchen up with the yummy chocolate coffee smell but not this.. As a hint of chocolate but that is about it- I would have returned but threw out the packaging... Anyways very unhappy with this product- I should have read the previous comment as they had the same result.. Order at your own risk...
It was very weak in flavor, not a full body coffee....had to make two to make at least a taste.

column9: Something is amiss with the K-cups f
column10: I love the Kahlua K-cup coffee so I thought I'd like Mudslide as well.  I do like it.  I prefer the Kahlua but the Mudslide flavor is not offensive.  What I do find offensive is that there is a flaw in the K-cups.  I've had to throw out several making this a poor value for my money.  Hopefully the box I got was a dud.  I don't think I'll be buying this again though.

I really like the mudslide coffee (and Gloria Jean's toffee coffee).  It has a "chocolate-y" taste to it that isn't too strong or too weak. column9: Brown Family Farm Pure Vermont Maple Syrup
column10: I just ordered a second jug of this syrup after finishing off my first jug yesterday.  There are some things upon which one cannot skimp, and real maple syrup is one of them. column9: Fake maple syrup is a crime against food
column10: When the food packaging laws were revised back in the 90s, the word "maple" disappeared off a lot of syrup bottles because they had no maple in them. Thankfully, this is the real stuff. You can get the most out of it by pouring the syrup into a small bowl, cutting the pancakes/waffles/French toast into pieces and dipping them in the syrup with a fork. That way it doesn't get wasted when you wash the plate.

column9: Fresh Lundberg rice cakes & how to read freshness date
column10: These rice cakes were very fresh -- made one month before I received.  Shipping was fast too.How to read freshness code found on each rice cake bag tie:  There is a 5 digit number, such as 05608.  The two digits on the far right are the year made.  The three digits on the left are the day of the year made.  The rice cakes in this example were made on the 56th day of 2008.

My wife first found this in Walgreen's and bought both Vanilla and Hazelnut flavors just to try them out. And here is our verdict: WE LOVED THEM. The Vanilla one, that is. We didn't care for the Hazelnut too much. And since my wife hates favors in her coffee you can say that the Vanilla flavored Splenda is really good. Now why would I mention by name where she bought it first? Well because you should know that it cost us a dollar more per box that what we would have spend here in Amazon. And since this product qualifies for free shipping it's a no lose situation. Here is a little more on this item:The Vanilla Splenda tastes like... well, Vanilla; the good vanilla, not the artificial stuff. It's delicate and subtle. You can easily taste both the vanilla and your favorite ground coffee separately and yet appreciate how wonderfully they come together. (Can you tell that I am sipping a hot cup of vanilla flavored coffee as I am writing?)The Hazelnut Splenda is a little too roasted for my taste, and in my opinion it kind of kills the otherwise nutty hazelnut flavor. But don't let that stop you from at least trying it. You might like it a lot more that we did.THERE IS NO AFTERTASTE. I hate Nutra Sweet because of that.Splenda No Calorie Sweetener comes in three flavors Vanilla, Hazelnut and Mocha. I give Vanilla 5 stars, Hazelnut 4 Stars and I have not tasted the Mocha yet. But if you are wondering if you should try this product, the answer is YES, go for it, you will love it. You will even impress a couple of friends too. Que te aproveche.

First of all, If you read nothing else, I have to say........BUY IT!Okay, that being said, here's more:For years I kept seeing flavored creams everywhere.  Why don't they make flavored sugars, I wondered.  Interesting that Splenda came out with flavored sugars, as it was about one year ago that I emailed the company with the idea.  Perhaps it is just a coincidence.  Anyway, it doesn't matter...it is really (really) good.I've tried them all.  Vanilla being my favorite.  Mocha a very, very close second, and hazelnut is a distant (but worth trying) third.All of the flavors are very (well...) flavorful.  So much so, that in a "travel mug" size coffee cup, I use one flavored packet of Splenda and one regular Splenda and it's plenty flavorful.The vanilla is very vanilla-y (which I happen to prefer to chocolate).The mocha is very chocolately and delicious, especially for me, not being a chocolate fan.The hazelnut I could take or leave and I would take it if the others weren't around.  It is not at all or in the least bit objectionable, however.My only objection to this Splenda is the packets themselves (those tall, skinny packets) are somewhat cumbersome to open the way they were intended to be opened, I think.You are supposed to fold over the top just slightly and then use the already slit part at the top to tear it apart.The problem lies in that when you tear it this way, it tears all the way down the packet and can spill out.  ...and if you stop tearing it at mid-package, you end up with a small "pocket" of torn package that you have to hold with one hand while dumping the contents out with the other.  Otherwise, the small torn part of the package gets filled with the sugar and you have to dump that out, too.So, I use my teeth to tear it across the top (the way you open a freeze pop) and that way avoid the whole "ordeal".It's REALLY not that big a deal, I'm just sayin', that's what happens.  (this is a review, afterall).Other considerations:I read that you can find the product at certain Walmart stores (just not one near me), which means that Sam's will have it soon (in bulk).It is a little expensive, about one dollar more per box than regular, but so is Starbucks, and frankly, it's worth it, and I hate Starbucks bitter (tastes like it's several hours old) coffee, anyway.I've also tried the vanilla Splenda in my Grape Nuts cereal, and didn't care for it as much as I thought I would.  I prefer plain Splenda for that, but you might really like it, and it wasn't too bad.I haven't tried it in hot chocolate, but I will and it will undoubtedly be good.The flavor is so concentrated that you could probably serve it in a cup of hot water, which I also haven't tried and am actually kidding about.You can tell how strong it is when you are opening it up with your teeth and you taste it.  You can also smell it in your coffee from across your desk. It's wonderful.I purchased one of each of these flavors on Amazon. (no doubt, it's a lot of Splenda, but there are no shipping fees, so it's a great deal).I am now the star of the office since it is not really out yet in the stores (around here) and everyone here loves it.The other thing I'd like to mention about Splenda (in general) is that it is the only "sugar substitute" made from real sugar.  The best thing about this is that it doesn't react in your body like real sugar does, but it tastes the closest to real sugar, in my opinion, than anything else.Most importantly, it does not cause an insulin response in your body, which is what happens when you eat real or (chemical) artificial sugar substitutes.This is a HUGE plus for your body since sugar is the BIGGEST EVIL in our weight gain problems in this country.  Sugar is many, many, many times more the culprit in weight gain than any fat could be, as far as making you fat goes, because sugar CONVERTS TO / BECOMES FAT upon our digestion of it.  So to have Splenda come out with a flavored sugar is just the greatest thing.  It's even better than sliced bread because I like my slices really thick and sliced bread usually isn't.Well, that's all folks...hope you enjoyed.Now, sit back and watch, all of the other sugar makers will be coming out with flavored sugars, soon, and then it will be everywhere.  Choose Splenda for your health!  Oh, and by the way, I do not work for Splenda, if that's what you were thinking, I just love it that much.Cheers!Anastasia

However, I tend to find flavored beans too strong when I use them at full strength, so usually I mix it half and half with unflavored coffee.As I've gotten a little soft around the middle in my later years, I've started using Splenda in my coffee.  When I saw the flavored Splenda packets, I thought it would be the best of both worlds.  I would have premeasured Splenda and I would be able to have flavored coffee on demand without buying a separate bag of beans.When I first opened a pack of the Splenda French Vanilla, I thought it had a strong, wonderful aroma.  The aroma reminded me of the scent of white cake batter.  Ready for a real taste treat, I put 2 packets in with about 12 ounces of coffee.The sweetness was just right, but the taste (or lack of) was quite surprising.  After being greeted with the wonderful pungent smell when I opened the packet, I expected something with a much stronger flavor.  The flavor of vanilla is very subtle, even for a person like me who doesn't drink flavored coffee at full strength.I would not go as far as to say these packets are a waste of money, but I do not think I'll be buying them again personally.  If you are looking for something to give your coffee a hint of flavor as well as sweeten it up, then these are the perfect product.  If you are looking for a quick and easy replacement for flavored coffee, then I would look for something else.

My favorite is hazelnut, not too sweet and no peculiar aftertaste - I would rank hazelnut 5 stars. The french vanilla is very sweet, taste is not so much "vanilla" as it is just very sweet almost syrupy taste - I would rank french vanilla 4 1/2 stars. The mocha has a slightly sour aftertaste, it smells very good but the aftertaste is a bit sour - I would rank mocha 4 stars.

I LOVE the product, BUT, because each packet has a different amount in it, I could not give it 5*. I wrote to the company, & they never replied. It's really a pain in the neck, not knowing how sweet my coffee will be, with each packet. I wish they made it in bulk, so I could use just the right amount each time,...........but, then the company wouldn't make ALL the $$$$$$they do on the small packets. :(

column9: Quick, convenient, tastes naughty but is oh so good
column10: I stash these at work and of course at home. Each small stick is enough for 1 large cup of coffee (I fill my to go cup all the way). The flavor is pretty strong - so some people who actually call 1 cup a cup of coffee (unlike my generous 3 cup "cups") may want to only use half a stick at a time. The taste is wonderful, very rich, no funny aftertaste. The sticks are very small and while easy to open, have stood up to weeks of riding around in my crammed full purse. Who needs sugar and cream anymore? I was less impressed with the caramel ones - but these have helped me kick my expensive and not so healthy caramel macchioto habit.
Our local Wal-Mart used to carry this product, it has just a touch of flavor to your coffee without all of the calories.  Would recommend this and have to a few friends.

I have been usiing the french vanilla and the mocha flavors for coffee for several years. Love the flavor boost it gives my coffee. My local grocery has stopped carrying it so I am very glad Amazon still carries it!

I was looking for a coffee sweetener/creamer with the least amount of calories possible, and this is the best I could ever ask for. It tastes just like vanilla, and makes the coffee sweeter, especially if you use two packets. I've tried the hazelnut, and it's great too, but I love the vanilla one more. The vanilla one seems sweeter.

If you like flavored coffee but don't want all of the sugar, these sticks are a great no calorie sweetner to add to your coffee.  I have been using them for a few years now.  I used to buy at Walmart, but I can only find them online now.

This has been a staple in my coffee for years now. Everyone (even people who hate the smell of coffee) always comment at how amazing it smells. :) You can definitely taste the vanilla and it's absolutely delicious!! I can't go without it and I would highly recommend it to anyone who is a fan of vanilla flavors.
I love this product.  I'm a decaf drinker so I seldom can get a flavored coffee out.  I just throw these in my purse and voila, French vanilla decaf!

I'm a freak of nature where I love my coffee with cream, please NEVER a grain of sugar and my tea with sugar and NEVER a drop of dairy.  That being said I really don't like plain tea but I'm a great fan of strong flavored teas.  Normally I'm a Cinnamon or apple/cinnamon tea drinker as they seem to have the strongest flavors, that was until I discovered the combination of Sleepytime Vanilla tea and Splenda French Vanilla sweetener.  Together they make music in my mouth.Since I came upon the Splenda FV by accident I haven't been able to find it in stores so I was very pleased to find bulk packages on Amazon at a price that makes my pocketbook happy.  Thanks Amazon!Now I'm wondering if the Mocha would taste just as good in my newly discovered chocolate flavored tea ... hm...

I had just found this product in my local grocery store when they quit carrying it.  Well I decided to check Amazon and yea! found it again and on auto-ship.  I make a full pot of de-caf coffee the night before, then the next day ... during the day I use two packets with coffee and ice and a splash of 1% milk in a 20oz cup 2 Aladdin Foam Insulated Coffee Mug 20 oz w/Lids Blue for a very satisfying "doesn't taste like diet" drink.The thing I like most about this flavor is that it doesn't have that cloying sweet taste that you get with so many "diet" products out there.  My only criticism would be that the packets are not always loaded equally and you sometimes get less product in your drink than you would like.  That being said, I hope they continue to make this product and Amazon continues to carry it and I will continue to buy it.
This stuff taste terrible.  Just like an artificial vanilla powder in your coffee......Will not buy again.  Actually, have several boxes in the pantry.

These little tubes of flavor turn my ordinary coffee into a delectable treat! I love the idea of having a Latte or coffee with a shot of some delicious flavor but my pocketbook and waistline cannot afford those lovelies. I can buy or make a coffee and add my Splenda Flavor Blend and enjoy the decadent to die for flavor without guilt. I carry them in my purse to use when I am out and I use them at home. A wonderful treat that is sweet in every way!

Not so great, but not bad. It is a mediocre product. I first got hazelnut flavor, amazed by the exceptional smell and taste, bought this one immediately, expecting a similar quality. A little bit frustrated. The taste is a little weak for 1 tube per 16 oz coffee; too sweet when 2 tubes per 16 oz coffee. Too many adjustments kill the purpose. Get a box from the grocery and then go for the 6-pack only if you like it.

I just started Weight Watchers and realized that I was drinking a LOT of points by putting flavored creamers into my coffee each morning. So, I found another solution to have a 0 point coffee. Instead of flavored creamer, I use Coffee-Mate Fat Free Original (only 2 tbsp per cup, no more than 4 tbsp a day), plus one of these Splenda Vanilla packets. It turns my 2 point cup of coffee into 0 points, without losing much of the flavor I previously enjoyed. Great product! I wish more grocery stores carried it.

i started useing the vanilla splenda a couple of years ago when i went on my diet,and loved the taste, i use to put 3 spoons of sugar in my coffee..there was a time i couldnt find it in the grocery store anymore so i looked on amazon, ordered it and it arrived in about 4 days! im stocked up now :-)

My sister,Pearlie, who lives in Canada requested that I try to find the Splenda Vanilla Coffee Flavored sweetner.  I searched in grocery stores in NY state and in PA and could not fine any.  Of course, Amazon was next on my list.  No Problem.  Amazon delivered 12 boxes in a few days and I passed it on to my sister the next time we went home.  I tried the Splenda and it was very great and a nice hint of flavor.  Hopefully, Spenda will widen their sales range. Thanks Amazon, I can always count on your services.

This product stopped being available at our local food market (aka Wal-Mart), so when we found this at Amazon.com, my wife was ecstatic!  We put this on a subscription order and are thrilled at the savings as well as knowing she's not going to run out of her coffee-doctoring substance!

column9: Not enough to do the job
column10: It is OK, but is not really strong enough to do the job of flavoring your coffee. It takes a lot of this item to make any difference at all.

column9: Subtle flavor, great aroma, portable low-calorie sweetener!
column10: Most stores discontinued selling this coffee staple--so happy to find it on Amazon!If you like flavored coffee sweetened without the calories, this is the product! I find that the French Vanilla enhances both unflavored and flavored coffees (we have Pumpkin Spice in the office; I frequently add cocoa powder to ground coffee at home). The French vanilla flavor is subtle yet authentic. Very aromatic, too! When I use it at work, cubicle neighbors come around asking what that vanilla cupcake smell is. I also use it to flavor low-fat smoothies.Obviously if you dislike the taste of sugar-free products, then you probably won't be a fan of, well, a sugar-free flavored coffee sweetener. But if you indulge in sugar-free sweeteners, then Splenda Flavors for Coffee French Vanilla is a soothing, portable option to flavor and sweeten your coffee without needing to use a flavored non-dairy creamer. I hope that Amazon keeps this flavor stocked for a long time!

column9: French Vanilla where have you gone?
column10: I absolutely love this product but for some reason none of the local grocery stores carry it anymore. I was so very glad to find it here and with free shipping its a win win situation. I use this in my tea and it makes for a wonderful alternative to regular sweetened black tea. Thanks Amazon for still having this product, you rock.
We really enjoyed the Splenda Flavored Blends for Coffee.  We thought it was great. Be careful how much you use in a cup for it taste sweeter than the plain Splenda.  Buy it and enjoy

This vanilla splenda really does taste good. And not only does it taste good in coffee, there are many other things you can use it to flavor also. My favorite way to use it is in diet soda (especially diet coke, diet mt. dew, and diet root beer!) It makes a really good diet vanilla soda! (*Note to anyone who may want to use it to make the vanilla soda, do not add it directly to a can or bottle, it will fizz over. You have to put the soda in a glass first. I learned that one the hard way!)

I use vanilla splenda in cafe au lait that I heat in the microwave every day.  I have it for breakfast.  Yum!  It sure is much handier, cheaper and less caloric than stopping at a coffee shop.  And, it's great that Amazon delivers it.

We use the Vanilla Splenda in our chocolate protein shakes and iced coffees.  YUM!Don't have much to say about the Hazelnut, it doesn't seem to add much flavor.I can no longer find these in Anchorage, so I am ordering them in bulk from Amazon.It ends up costing less this way anyway!

column9: Great Tasting Coffee Sweetener - Highly Recommended!
column10: I already use Splenda as a sweetener, so was thrilled when my wife brought home these Splenda French Vanilla Flavor for Coffee. The Splenda No Calorie Sweetener, Flavor for Coffee, Mocha, 30-Count Boxes (Pack of 6) is my favorite, followed by Splenda No Calorie Sweetener, Flavors for Coffee, Hazelnut, 30-Count Boxes (Pack of 6) and then the French Vanilla (but it is still really good!). This is only a sweetener so I still use a splash of "Half and Half" along with two of these in my morning cup. These have no calories and less than 1 Net Carb each, so it isn't bad for me to have more than one cup in the morning.Highly recommended!
Splenda flavors for coffee is sooooo yummy.  I love the french vanilla!  No calories.  I do not know how life would be without this product!!!  I highly recommend the flavor of french vanilla.

This is a great product - adds sweetness and vanilla flavoring to coffee, yogurt, anything you like! Have also sprinkled this on berries for added pizaaz. Try it - if you love vanilla - you'll like it!

Yummy flavors, but have had as many as 6 from one box empty. I'd say an average of 3 per box (out of thirty in a box). Thats too many. They average $.10 each, sometimes a little more.  So,  good but spendy!
Love love love this in my coffee- Is a must for dieting- keeps the calories low- and no need to give up the great flavor!
Mmmm! great to take with you.  I keep a couple in my purse. A little expensive for everyday use especially if you drink more than 2cups of coffee a day.
I'm always on a  diet. This gives me the great sweet taste of french vanilla in my coffee with out all the calories of using a flavor creamer
Thanks for the great service and the fast shipping.  I will be ordering more soon!

column9: I wish these were good for us!
column10: These are really good and I really wish they were good for us.

When I ordered the flavored sweetener I had high hopes for a great product but this Splenda French Vanilla Flavor Blend falls short, especially in black coffee.  I have tried it sprinkled on fresh popcorn which is a much better use than in coffee.  Looking forward to other uses.

It tastes too artificial for my liking when put in a small cup of coffee.  I have adjusted to put one packet in a large mug with about 1-1/2 cups of coffee and two tablespoons of fat free creamer, and it tastes a bit better that way.  I can tolerate it since I have been trying to eliminate calories and fat from my coffee, but it's not ideal.  I will not repurchase.  And I also tried the mocha but gave it away because I disliked it so much.  Try unsweetened cocoa and regular Splenda instead.

I just can't face black coffee but regular coffee creamers are so full of calories and fat. Even if you get the sugar-free kind you are still ingesting a whopping 1gm of fat PER TABLESPOON! Also the flavored creamers use hydrogenated or partially hydrogenated fats.Rather than being a creamer, this flavors/sweetens your coffee. Many times I've found that things sweetened with Splenda are too sweet but that's not the case here. It adds a subtle sweetness, not overpowering at all. If you need it creamy, just add a splash of fat-free half and half or better yet, a tablespoon of non-fat powdered milk or a tsp of fat-free evaporated milk.Even if you're not on a diet this is a great alternative to white sugar or fatty creamers.
Wonderful additative for your coffee, especially when travelling (and you never know the quality of coffee you are going to get in the hotel).

column9: Great flavor to spruce up that tired old cup of coffee!
column10: HI All,I already love Splenda so this may be a biased review.  :-)WE have a Keurig at home and usually buy the French Vanilla K-Cups....  I have recently switched to the Atkins plan and thus had to switch to the decaf French Vanilla K-Cups....they are great but very little French Vanilla flavor to be had.  I saw this product on Amazon and 'click to order'..it was here in a few days.  I tried it today with a cup of decaf and VOILA....it tasted great.  My coffee was back...without the caffeine.Excellent tase....very soft and not bitter to the taste buds.5/5

I have been using regular splenda for awhile now and I like flavored coffee, so I decided to try this product. It packs more of a "flavor punch" when I mixed it with another liquid flavored creamer. This product does not leave an after taste.

column9: Doesn't subsitute for flavored coffee creamer
column10: I was hoping to find a good-tasting, low calorie alternative to flavored coffee cream. Unfortunately this product really didn't really do that. It does sweeten black coffee but not to the extent of actually giving it a great vanilla flavor. I found it better to just use regular artificial sweetener. The WORST part about these packets is that they are IMPOSSIBLE to open! I had to keep a scissors next to my coffee pot to cut the tops off of the packets. Ripping them open requires some secret trick that they don't tell you about and I still haven't figured out...
I was estatic when I seen that Splenda was coming out with Flavor Blends for coffee. I wasn't to fond of it after I got it. More sugary tasting .. not as expected, Very disappointed
In a word--YUCK!!!!!!!!!!! Bitter tasting, not sweet at all with a weird aftertaste. I spent alot of money on this product and was very disapointed.
This is a pretty good amount for the price. This gum is really only good for the bubbles, not the flavor. After a while, it fells if you are chewingg a tire. Still a great gum, though.
This is the best gum on the planet. I received it in a timely manner with no issues. Blah blah blah

The first order wasn't packaged well enough and arrived broken, however they sent me a replacement right away. I love olives and these were very good but if you live near a Deli- (I don't) you could get more for your $ without the hassle of ordering.

Cannot find this onion ring mix in local grocery stores anymore, so was very happy to find on Amazon.  In our opinion, this mix makes the best fried onion rings possible.  Got quick shipping from vendor.  Very happy with this purchase.
I use to buy this product in the midwest. I cannot get it here in AZ. I am very happy to have a source where i can buy it.

I bought this candy as a gift for someone addicted to coke and trying to quit.  I also tried it and its great tasting and has the fizz of a cola.  It also lasts a long time in your mouth.  Its a great treat.

This is the BEST candy ever..it tastes jusy like cola and its fizzy like the old school fizz candies.. it is well worth the price and this company has SUPER fast shipping. It normally get to me in 2 days!

I have searched high and low for this candy, it is the best I have ever had!  It tastes like cola and it actually fizzes in your mouth like the carbonation in cola... yummy!  I'm so happy I finally found it somewhere!

I had some of these while I was in the Japan part of Epcot's international area, and once they were gone I needed more. They taste exactly like coke, and they're even fizzy! They're great, but don't eat too many at once (after about ten, the roof of my mouth starts to hurt). I'm always amazed by the ingenuity of Japanese candy.

i took 4 of these to a party/club and had them with friends at 3am and everyone liked them. they were sparkling as you suck them. and the taste was very familiar to coca cola. i enjoyed it and so did the my friends who were impressed because they never had candy that were so sparkling in they're mouth before. i dont think i will buy it again because it contains "corn syrup" which i'm allergic too.

I love Japanese candy, so this package was eagerly awaited. I liked the weird triangular shaped wrapper, and inside was a large, almost choking hazard-level sized brown candy. The initial taste varies from candy to candy, from a mild cola taste, to a soft fizzing sensation, to a taste so sour that you could fall off your chair. Overall, however, the candies had an adequately cola and soda feel to them, especially the fizziness factor, no doubt due to the baking soda in each candy piece. I'm glad I bought these, they were a lot of fun-- literally; each one lasted a LONG time.

column9: Do you like the roof of your mouth to become irritated? Okay, buy this.
column10: I was picturing an effervescent explosion of sweet cola flavor in my mouth. I love the taste of Coke, but I don't drink caffeinated beverages or sugared sodas anymore. So I thought this might be a pleasant way to get that delicious cola flavor every once in a great while.What I got was a flat little jolt of sugar and a sour cola taste. Also, for whatever reason, this candy scratched the roof of my mouth. It has a very unpleasant texture. I don't know what I was thinking when I ordered it. I stumbled across it and thought, "hey, that looks tasty".I was wrong. :(
