Out of all the different Cola candies I've eaten over the decades, this one definitely takes 1st place for taste accuracy & size. The candy tastes exactly like cola, and has a wonderful fizz surprise in the middle! Keep in mind that one bag doesn't look like it comes with much, however this is due to the fact that each candy is about double the size of a Warhead. If you're into cola candy, you definitely need to try this one!
It took me almost fifteen days to get the candies.It tasted not like the soda candies I had before.The deadline is only two months in the future.
I first tried these candies about 10 years ago.  Just happened to think of doing a search for them on Amazon and found them.  Yippee!  These are my favorite candy!

what can i say really? these were the awsomest candy (next to butterscotch) that i have ever had!!!! they arived on time and were very easy to open! they taste as if the only thing thier missing is a coke bottle!!!!!!

I LOVE gummy colas, and I enjoy pop rocks well enough.  So when I saw the rave reviews for this cola-flavored candy I thought I HAVE TO TRY THIS!!!  Alas, they were only okay.  They tasted fine, like hard gummy colas.  The faint fizziness was interesting.  But NOT worth eight bucks, nuh-uh.  Especially after sucking on two of them in a row caused the roof of my mouth to get sore.  Next time I want a candy cola flavor, I will go round up some of my gummies.  :(

I absolutely adore these candies. I had them for the first time when a friend in middle school took me to an Asian grocery store. They're addictive!They are fizzy and have a particular flavor. It's definitely a "cola" flavor, but not a typical American cola flavor. Because I love these so much, and because I rarely often have a grocery store that I can purchase these at anymore, I am often hesitant to share these with friends/JiwaJiwa newcomers only because I've had a few people spit them out and that horrifies me! They are definitely not for everyone, but those people are missing out. So ha.The 3 stars I gave this candy is not for the actual product (which is 5 stars!) but for the price! $7.89? Seriously? I can pick this size of a bag up in any Asian grocery store for under $3. Heck, I think that CostPlus World Market even carries them sometimes! If you can find a local Asian grocery, I encourage it, who knows what else you'll pick up? It might be very exciting!

column9: Picked up at a local store
column10: I have a very bad ^_^ habit of picking up Japanese candy and this one fell victim to that.  I found it slightly odd.  The package is very unique and adds to the over all cool idea of the candy.  At first glance it looks like a normal hard candy till you put it in your mouth.  My first reaction was wow what is this it's fizzy, then I spent the rest of the time trying to figure out what cola tastes like that.  I've shard this with my friends it's not a bad flavor, just different, and has a fun aspect like pop rocks. I still have a few left :P

I bought this product for the home because we have avid soda-flavored candy lovers. Just to be clear, this product is NOT worth the price listed here. The quantity is slim, and as you'll see in my review, the flavor pales in comparison to other brands.In terms of finding cola hard candy, it's difficult to find it anywhere in the US. You may find haribo soda-flavored gummies, but their taste is usually not as strong as the hard-candy substitutes, and the gelatin ingredient may be unwanted to certain people. This candy is interesting in that it has a very mild fizz in it. That said, the candy is is very rough on the tongue/palette (most likely due to this fizz-additive). Now taste-wise, I've had many cola-flavor candies, and this candy's taste is not as strong as say-- candyland's cola flavored candy.If you can find a lower price, then have at it, but at the price amazon has this candy listed, it's not worth it. Be it made in Japan or Antarctica, this candy is candy, and should never be so expensive for such a meager amount.
It was good, but I will not consume more than 2 or 3, tastes ok but the flavor is tooo synthetic! seems like tons of colorants and flavoring were added. The shipping time is realy fast!
got it for Christmas for my Japanese culture loving adult son.  He liked them!

Real Yerba mate is made from the naturally caffeinated and nourishing leaves of the celebrated South American rainforest holly tree, not a coffee bean. Yerba Mate can be used in place of coffee however, but is not real coffee. Don't be fooled.

column4: A Research It Maven "Just the facts please"
column9: HUGE candy bar! Fabulous price on Amazon!
column10: Box is 18 (3.4oz each) bars for $20.96 on Amazon! A huge candy bar and very, very FRESH. Nutrageous sells out constantly on Amazon, so you'll never get stale ones. One bar is enough for three servings, unless, of course, it gets into the hand of a teenager!

column9: one of my fav candy bars
column10: If you love peanuts, peanut butter, and chocolate, then this candy bar is for you. I would say that this candy bar is by far better than any other candy bars I've had.I can't remember when our local convenient stores sold these candy bars. Whenever I go on vacation, I look for these but lately can't find them. I am not sure why they are getting rid of them, maybe not enough sales. I love these candy bars. They were very fresh and tasty. The only problem (well not really a problem) is that some are broken. I don't mind because well, they are going to become broken (hehe). I will definitely be buying more in the future.I am glad I finally found a place to buy from. I am in love.
I was happy to find Nutrageous candy bars on Amazon.com, as I can no longer locate them at my local supermarkets. They are very delicious and fresh.

Snickers was my favorite for many years.  I couldn't believe the taste when I had my first Nutrageous bar. I now "settle" for Snickers when I can't find Nutrageous.  Sometimes hard to find, but well worth it.

Not generally a huge fan of candy bars. I don't hate them, I just don't love them with the exception of reeses related products. I prefer nutrageous over fast break and crispy crunchy. This has become hard to find but I still saw them at Lewis today.  Also like reeses sticks and obviously, peanut butter cups.
Got this as a 'joke' present for my husband.  It was one of his favorites.  He's now totally addicted to Nutrageous!

I at my first pop corner chip today . . . I finished the entire bag.  These are incredible!  I'm not a health food person, so it's just a bonus that these are also pretty healthy (unless you eat the whole bag).  Indescribably delicious.

Literally Pop Corners Kettle Corn are the BEST CHIPS EVER.  Until a week ago I have never had a thing for chips and then Pop Corners entered my life. *Aww* ..one word AMAZING. Okay, these chips deserve more words.  They are tasty, addicting, healthy, lightweight, addicting.  What is not to love about these chips? Nothing.  I've bought a new bag and brought them to work, co-workers loved them too (figures) and I left work empty handed. Need I say more.  ..Go buy yourself some

I first ate these snacks on a Jetblue flight down to Fort Lauderdale, FL. I actually didn't even ask for them. I stated give me the bag of snacks I have never seen before. When I opened them up I didn't even realize they were supposed to taste like popcorn because I didn't read the bag.When I took the first bite I was amazed of the suttle flavors hitting my pallet that reminded me of kettle popcorn. However, it wasn't the over sugared kettle popcorn you always remember. It was like the perfect coating aruond the popcorn that wasn't dripping in its own sauce. I went to look at the bag and it has very few ingredients and all of them are healthy. It is even advertised as gluten-free..............I was eating delicious..... HEALTH FOOD!!!!!!Believe me, health food is not my thing most of the time. All I care about is the taste. I am a food lover with a bottomless stomach to match. You won't find these most likely at your local corner store unless you live in the city. I highly suggest the purchase of the Kettle version. I have not tried the rest, but I intend too get a value pack next to try them out!

column9: Decent Balsamic. But not the thick syrup stuff
column10: I was trying to find the thick, syrupy stuff I bought a O and Co. The kind that drips out as thick as molasses. This isn't that stuff. Having said that, it's still pretty good. Would be great in salad dressing and price is decent. So it's not bad for what it is, but if you want the best of the best, molasses thick aged stuff, got to look elsewhere.

column9: The Taste of Childhood - Sugar Free!
column10: Remember when you were a kid, on those hot, hot summer days, how cool and delicious the fruity Fla-Vor-Ice freezer pops tasted? They were refreshing and thirst-quenching like no milky ice cream could be. Well you CAN go home again, even if you've kicked sugar and corn syrup out of your life. These Fla-Vor-Ice Light freezer pops are the real deal, and TWO of them have only 5 calories and 1 gram of carb. Do I sound like a commercial? I'm just an ordinary, middle-aged woman who needed to renounce sugar for the sake of my health. Imagine how delighted I was to find these treats from my childhood in a sugar-free version! I hope you'll try them, and enjoy.
This assortment of coffee is great.  I like different tastesso I don't get bored with one flavor, but still enjoy agreat cup of coffee.

This sugar is out of this world. I will always have some on hand from now on. The wonderful maple flavor is so natural and aromatic. I just substitute it for part of regular or brown sugar in any recipe. It is also incredible for "dusting" the tops of pies, scones and cookies. This is a fabulous product, I highly recommend if you love baking or just want to be more conscious about using highest quality ingredients. You might as well buy two pounds straight away, it's that good.

I sent this to my daughter because her son has autism and ADHD and cannot tolerate sugar or high fructose corn syrup.  She really liked it, and the kids liked it.  I only wish it were more readily available and not so expensive.  It is a good product, and she doesn't have to use much of it to have a nice sweet taste.  She doesn't use it all the time but for a treat it is nice.
Really liked the maple sugar at a reasonable price.  Packaging could be improved with resealable bags.

Although pricey, my husband cannot have processed sugar, and it's hard to find a really good tasting substitute for cooking and baking.  This works well for reciepes that need a granular sweetner that stands up to heat.

I cannot tolerate HFCS, artificial sweeteners or cane sugar. Maple sugar is therefore my only option for sweetening the herbal tea I drink constantly. This pure maple sugar is extremely refined and powdery. Don't get a spoonful in front of the fan or you will be breathing it in. The taste is very pleasant, and I absolutely love the smell. I understand that this type of sugar is expensive to refine, but I still wish it was a bit cheaper. However, for my particular needs, this is good stuff and I'll be buying it again.

I used these to make vegan peanut butter cups from Alicia Silverstones cookbook (which I highly recommend BTW). I have also used these to make granola. it is versatile. I do not like the price though.

...the sugar content of maple sap is very low, therefore it takes a LOT of sap to make one gallon of syrup (something like 50 to 1).  Maple sugar is a further distillation of this very labor-intensive process; hence, the cost.  Like so many things, much of what you pay for is for labor...think about getting your car repaired.  Real maple sugar will never be inexpensive, but it is a genuinely unique product for which there is no true substitute.  To me, something as special as maple sugar--which is not used in great quantity like white cane sugar--is worth the higher price.
Product is very grainy........not what I expected.  Shipping costs are out of line - $8 to send one pound.

The produce is sandy, grainy, not what i expected.  It is sweet but hey the cost is ridiculous.  I wanted to try it and now I have but never again.  Your money can be spent much more wisely.  If you haven't used Muscavado brown sugar give that a try, it's relatively expensive but definitely worth the money.
Product was fresh.  In a container large enough so the Post Office had to deliver it to the door so it did not sit in the heat in the mailbox. Arrived in a timely fashion.
Still the great tasting candy bar!  Good size and fresh.  Arrived promptly - used it as a reward for work well done - back when the World Series was on.

column9: Nice taste in a "blueberry juice drink blended with two other juices from concentrate"
column10: Ocean Spray Blueberry Juice Cocktail has a strong flavor of blueberries and a secondary flavor of grape juice with a nice finish and aftertaste of pure blueberry.  The balance between sweet and tart is perfect--Ocean Spray always seems to get this right.  It's not pure, fresh juice but then again, they aren't trying to fool anyone into thinking that it is.  Pepsi Cola actually distributes it.I was disappointed to see that the bottle was 15.2 fl. oz. or 450 mL when 16 oz. or 500 mL would seem to be much more logical and less chintzy, especially since the serving size is 8 oz.Overall, I enjoyed it but have to knock a star off for the tooth enamel-unfriendly  ingredients and almost total lack of nutrition as well as the tricky volume of the the bottle I tried.Ingredients:Water, Cane or Beet Sugar, Blueberry Juice from Concentrate, Grape Juice from Concentrate, Apple Juice from Concentrate, Malic Acid, Natural Flavor, Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C), Sodium CitrateNutrition Facts:Per 8 oz. this was a soory product.It was about the size of you thumb and my dog hated it and would not eat it.Waste of money and shipping.

I recently bought this product here at Amazon, feeling it was possibly a risk based on one bad review outof two. But personally, I have never experienced any problem with food items from Amazon so I trusted inthat fact when I saw these at great sale price after Easter. I do know people who love these eggs year round.They arrived well packed within Amazon box inside a Reese's 36-count display box. Two rows of 6 stacked 3 high.The same 1.2 oz size found in the popular 6-count packages. Purchased mid-April 2012 with a Best-Bydate of December 2012. i bought four days before easter on sale. bought with amazon prime two day shipping but the item arrived the next day. fresh, just like the store's individual wrapped and delivered early in the morning instead of the usual late afternoon delivery by ups here..

column9: Eggs had melted and cooled before delivery. Were mis-shapen with oil-soaked packaging.  and
column10: This was delivered while the weather was still quite temperate. We brought them in immediately and the package was not warm inside. I can't prove it but I find it hard to believe this was a 2012 product. The cardboard inserts in the packages were soaked with oil. The eggs had obviously melted partially and then cooled.All of the other chocolate candy delivered the same day was fine.Reese's eggs usually have the creamiest filling of any of their products, but these had crunchy crystals within the peanut butter filling.I was disappointed in the quality and if my suspicions were correct and they were sold in this condition, shame on you.

I'd encountered plum catsup on a trip and really liked the flavor.  A google search showed me that Amazon had the product and I ordered some for my daughters.  It was as good as I remembered and my daughters also developed an affection for it.  The taste is strong enough that a little goes a long way.  It's especially good with sweet-potato fries and I'm thinking of ways to use it as a base for barbeque sauce.

These nuts are Fantastic,great taste lots of flavor,just the right amount of heat.Sometimes when you see Jalapeno flavored things you think they will be to hot.These are perfect. Great with beer,Try them you'll like them.

These peanuts are fantastic.  My family likes spicy foods and these fit the bill perfectly.  Only be careful because they are addictive, if you are drinking a beer they are easy to go through quickly.  If you are just snacking the spice makes just a few handfuls very satisfying.

I was hoping these would have a lot more spice. To be honest, they taste more sweet/garlic'y than spicy in my opinion, though I do tend to prefer extra hot things. I wouldn't get them again, but I could see where others might like them.Also, but warned that they're not kidding when they say "super extra large Virginia peanuts". These guys are huge. I happen to like the larger, crunchier peanuts like these, but these are not for the Planter's fan.
These peanuts are just delicious; great munchie food; they are excellent with beer and not too spicy. You will definitely taste the difference from just regular brand peanuts.
We love these!  Will continue to order them as they are a family favorite.

I found this kit at target and bought them even though I don't like regular martinis.  I tried them with some Sky Vodka and now I'm in love with these mixers.  I have been unable to find anything as good since.  The blood orange is my favorite.  I even enjoyed the grapefruit mixer despite hating grapefruit.  I would definitely recommend this to anyone looking for a fun cocktail that isn't too syrupy.  It only will make you 5 martinis per kit but I think it's worth it.
I can only find them at Sheetz Gas Stations.  I searched for them online and found them and like that I can order them and get them sent directly to my house.
Ordered these for my husband for Valentine's Day.  They are one of his favorite candies and they are hard to find.  He was so excited when he opened them.  They taste and smell so good!

I got these first at my local gas station, and was hooked. I got my nieces hooked on them, and then they discontinued. I bought out the clearance Kazoozles, and then looked for them here.The candy outside is like a soft, smooth, sweet cherry twizzler, and the inside is a delish filling that really blends nicely with the outside. It's hard to describe, but if you really like good candy try it out.I wish they were a little cheaper, because I hate spending over $20 on candy, but the 24, 8 stick packages will be worth the price I think. They are about $1.60 at the store retail, and have 2 sticks. These have more per bag and are less then 1$ a bag. I haven't got them yet, so I will come back and comment on the freshness and size.

I actually stumbled across this chocolate by a stroke of luck when a friend offered me some.  I have to say - it was truly outstanding!  I'm a heavy Green Tea drinker so the thought of getting this same taste in chocolate was amazing.I consider myself a "foodie" with a broad palette, yet still, the taste profile caught me by surprise.  I have never tasted chocolate that finished with a clean, almost earthy finish.  I can only equate it to experiencing the essence of coco.  Not the heavy, weighted down version so prevalent in traditional chocolate products.Can't wait to try the other TOK products.

I love anything matcha & have a hard time finding matcha chocolate products in my area...I decided to shop around on Amazon & found this brand...They are great!...They don't add any crap to their products like hydrogenated oils or trans fat, fillers, etc to make their products shelf stable...I found that very nice...You are eating actual matcha...not imitation matcha or matcha flavor...It's absolutely worth the money if you enjoy matcha products or white chocolate with a unique flavor.
excellent taste very delicious! but 1/4 the size of a hersheys bar !!!! I was a little bit disapointed by the size of it

Exactly what I expected from this bar! Nce, ligfht, delicious green tea flavor. It's great, no regrets! Definitely get it if you like green tea, but order a few :-)

column9: WATKINS  PURE PEPPERMINT EXTRACT from Amazon
column10: Watkins product is as good if not better than I remember it as a kid, when my Mother bought it from the Watkins Man that visited all of the Rural homes in my home town of Arkansas years ago. I was so pleased that I could get this in an 8 ounce bottle, and not the 1 or 2 ounce bottle that you get at the regular grocery store. It is Pure, and the strength and flavor of it is phenominal. I really loved it in my Irish Mint Walnut Brownie Recipe, as well as my Peppermint Pattie Candy Recipe.For the recipes you can go to Just A Pinch Recipe Club, and type in my name, and you will find the recipe I used , with this top QUALITY INGREDIENT. I Rely on you and your great company for so many of my daily needs. Thanks so much.

column9: A quick and easy way to fix a low calorie meal!
column10: I love hot soup in cold weather.  It is good for lunch or dinner and for me it is a good way to help reduce calories.  One 12 ounce can of this soup is 135 calories and is low on sugar and fat.I have eaten Campbell's soup since I was a child and it is a quick and easy way to fix up a warm meal.  These cans come with a quick remove top which is also a nice feature.You can trust Campbell's as a reliable name to get a good and nutritious meal.  They sell 10 billion bowls of soup in America every year.

Campbell's Select Harvest Chicken Soup with Egg Noodles is absolutely delicious in my opinion! It reminds me of the home-made soup my grandmother used to make 50 years ago. One of the best soups Campbell's makes! Easy to open and heat in microwave for quick, nutritious meal in a hurry. So pleased that I'm able to purchase it on Subscribe and Save, too. Only negative I can say is that the price went up almost $10 in one month. A little bit expensive, but worth it.

column9: Worst Chicken Noodle Soup I've Ever Had...
column10: These are one of the new "light" soups Campbell has created. I wanted something with a little less salt, so I chose the Chicken with Egg Noodles. I shared this soup with a friend of mine. We both agreed that the chicken broth was horrible. Salt wasn't the problem, there was a particular herb flavor that just didn't belong in the soup. Everything else was fine. The egg noodles were still firm. The chicken were in big chunks though there just weren't that many. The veggies were good too, the celery and carrots were not mushy at all. However, I simply cannot recommend anyone purchasing this because of the horrible broth and the lack of chicken and veggies. It's mostly water in a can.

column9: Worst Can Soup I Ever Taste!
column10: I try many can soup before, other select harvest soup good, but this one is terrible. tasted very artificial, and i can't even finish half way is that bad.
There was prompt delivery, but the plant died after just one week.  I have many other ferns and carefully controlled soil moisture and humidity levels.

After receiving a gift card for Amazon, I had to buy this tea sampler box.  My wife and I both love tea and have it at least every other day if not more often.  We particularly love samplers too since we have different tea tastes.  I really love the Nana (mint) tea, the lemon and the raspberry.  She loves the English breakfast and Earl Grey.  My highest compliment is that these Wissotzky teas taste real, unlike many other flavored teas that often don't taste as you'd expect.  When you brew a cup of lemon tea - guess what... you get delicious lemon-tasting tea.  The box is nice.  Nothing special, but a nice clean look and I really like the inside lid's labeling that gives a little information on each tea flavor in case you're not sure what flavor you want any given day.  Oh yeah, the other great thing about this sampler are there aren't any "filler" flavors.  Each flavor is unique and delicious and I'm sure we'll happily finish the entire box and be back for more.

column9: Very Well Received Gift Beautiful Box and Delicious Teas
column10: Exquisite box and beautiful delicious teas.  My mother raved over this.  She wants to keep the box for her jewelry beading.

I ordered this Wissotzky Tea Box for a business associate (and close friend)who lives in another state. It has a beautiful latch and hinges and great art work. It is perfect. I love the tea selection. I am going to use the tea and box for my Christmas brunch for my family."  It is so reassuring to send a gift (without seeing it) and know it will be a quality purchase.

Great for personal use and for gifts. We've bought many of these and people always love them. It's a very good value and a nice surprise for tea drinkers. The herbal teas are the best that I've tried.
I was very happy with the selection of tea.  Especially liked the cherry.  Nice container to keep for future use.
Wissotzky Magic Tea Chest, Assorted Tea Collection w/ 80 Assorted Tea'sI was impressed with the selection and really liked the tea flavors. Delicious and aromatic. Attractive case.

I like most of the teas in the assortment, however the fruit teas are WAY too fruity, hardly taste like tea.

Excellent selection of both caffeinated and decaf teas, and delicious flavors. Appreciated a free upgrade to 90 teabags as opposed to the 80 originally identified. Lovely tea box with artful graphics and explanations of the various teas. Quite impressive to serve guests and family and fun to watch them work through the extensive choices. Prompt delivery.

column9: Great tea - upgraded for free - thanks - it made a great Christmas gift!
column10: The tea came in a wonderful box - the company upgraded to a larger sized box for free. It made a great Christmas present. Thanks again!
this product arrived on time and in perfect condition.  will definitely order from the vendor again.  thanks for such an easy process!

But it would be so much better if there were some way I could CHOOSE the flavors from a listing.

I first tried this mix about 6 years ago when I lived in Arizona. This is the most amazing margarita mix. Unfortunately, they no longer stock it.I can order on the web, but shipping is a killer, and no free shipping on this.
One of the best margarita mixes I ever had. The grapefruit juice puts a nice twist on the mix. I will purchase this again.

This top shelf stuff is Great. Just add a little Go Go Juice and you are ready to PARTY.  Bought it as a joke and what a surprise the joke was on me, really smooth taste goes great at all parties!
Does what they claim it will! I had a greyhound die from complications of anesthesia for a routine teeth cleaning. I am using this product along with brushing to avoid that scenario again :-)

Our pups are spoiled rotten.  When ever they've done something good, they expect a 'cookie'.  Our Husky, Taz turns her nose up to typical dog treats and biscuits, she wants her Dentastix.  I know, they're only supposed to get one a day, but she's very active and easily burns off the calories, and who can resist those brown eyes of hers?Yup, I get a monthly shipment of these bad boys, and the seller gets 'em here like clockwork.  We're very happy with this product and vendor.

This product has made my dog SO sick! She hasn't stopped throwing up for the past hour and is clearly in pain after eating a Dentastix. I recently found out about how bad of a brand Pedigree is. Before posting this I read about several stories of some other very sick dogs after eating Dentastix. Never again will I buy another Pedigree product. They clearly do not care about the well being of animals and shouldn't even be on shelves anymore if you ask me!

These are the 1st dental chews that are making a noticeable difference in my dogs' teeth.  They are also the perfect size (large) for my medium size shelties.  I have had problems in the past with detail sticks getting caught in one of my dog's intestines.  After a $200 vet bill, I was very hesitant to use them again, but my dogs have not had a problem digesting these.  The ridges force them to take their time chewing.  They are a little more pricey than other brands, but with the subscription price and easy digestion, they are WELL worth it!  These in combination with PetzLife Oral Care Spray, Peppermint, 2.2 ounces make health teeth and happy dogs!

column9: Dogs love them but beware, FATTY
column10: Our dogs love them and they do seem to have cut down on the plaque buildup on their teeth slightly. Just beware, our vet told us these are very fatty and should be used sparingly.

Our dogs can't wait to get these. Our old sheperd has hip dysplasia and doesn't move around much but, when he hears tha package on these rattle he is up in an instant. His teeth had a severe tarter problem and they are quite a bit cleaner now. The only problem I have with them is I found them at Kroger for $8.59 for 25. This is 10 packs of 7. I'll let you do the math. This is why the 4 stars, instead of 5.

I have treated my dog to these for years and my  veterinarian has always said she has great teeth.  My dog loves them and the ingredients in dentastix appear to be better than most treats. I also have signed up for auto delivery through Amazon and this makes them much more cost effective compared to store prices.

My aged dog has learned three new tricks because she loves these stix so much, prompting my daughter to ask "what's in them, crack for dogs?"  I love giving them to her because I know they are good for her teeth.  To me they smell like processed chemicals (yuk) but the doggy will do just about anything for one!  They are not cheap, but they are wonderful.

Our long hair chihuahua loves this treat.  It is what keeps her motivated for rewards.  It keeps her teeth healthy and she loves them!  We buy them in mulk.  The larger ones are a better value and we break them in 1/2 before giving them to her, as she is only 7 lbs.

Hi,Been using dentastix for awhile now and after the last few visits to the vet my dogs teeth are much much more cleaner a seeing a very good improvement.A very nice product and my dog loves them!Thanks

I've been feeding my dog these dentastix for at least 6 months. My dogs teeth are pearly white.She can't wait to get them she loves them I would give them a 10. Everybody comments on how white her teeth are. I just wish I could get more in a pack than 7.

my dog is very particular on what food she eats and is not very food motivated.  With the dentastix she is food motivated and helps to get her breath smelling better.  Never noticed if it cleans her teeth though.
Weve used Dentastix for years on our dogs!  Great results and happy dogs.  Our Vet recommended this product as an excellent alternative to brushing.

we bought dentatrix at amazon cosiderably cheaper than buying in the locl store and i think it is an excellent product for our pet, keeping the teeth clean.we thank amazon for offering this product at a reasonable price.thank you
These are way better than taking your dog to an expensive teeth cleaning.  they work, and you don't have to wrestle with your dog (unless they like that!)  I give him one every night.
My dog gets one Dentastix a day.  They seem to help her teeth stay clean & she really likes them.  I'm so glad I found someplace that sells them in bulk!
I have a poodle.  Lap dog.  She is the perfect dog in every way.  Her breath would make a freight train take a dirt road.  These sticks work.  Her breath is now great.  I give her one per day.
My 100# dog loves them, has one a day. If it cleans his teeth great, he doesn't care. I enjoy giving it to him as much as he enjoys getting them. And the teeth cleaning part does appear to help.

We have two street rescues that we adopted off the streets in the Bahamas.  Both came to us with yellow stained teeth...after using Pedigree Dentastix religiously each day for less than one month, both have sparkling white teeth!!  Their groomer and the vet have both commented on how clean their teeth are and I rave about this product to everyone!!

Before we end the day, I give my dog one of this DentaStix. She knows it's coming and gets so excited, jumping around...and she's 15 years old! They have helped keep her teeth in good condition. I can't always find the size I need in the stores so it has been great having a shipment from Amazon each month with the benefit of them being a bit cheaper than the stores.
our labradoole, misfit, loves this treat.  he thinks hes getting just a treat but they're really taking care of his teeth.
And so does my very fussy-eater Cavalier King Charles Spaniel. Someone reported that these have 300 calories per stick, but I was told by the company that each stick has 40 calories. Big difference!
I really do not need to say anymore, our dog loves this product and it helps her teeth. Good deal!

column9: My dog loves these but expensive here
column10: They are less than ten dollars for a package of thirty-two at Sams Club. How can they be $30 for only 10 here? My dogs love these and get one every night at bed time.

column9: Not very healthy but my dogs LOVE them
column10: These are horrible from a nutrition standpoint.  However...  my dogs go CRAZY for them.  They get one in their crate every morning when I leave for work.  They know it too and will run to their crate when it's time for me to leave.  I'm not sure if it's helping with tartar.  My Standard Poodle's teeth seem a little cleaner but both of my dogs chew on bones, etc so I'm not sure what is actually keeping their teeth nice.

My German Shepherd, who is 100 lbs., would chew up bones like a hot knife through butter, and naturally, I've decided not to get her simple bones since her sensitive stomach would force her to throw up. So, over time, she'll have tartar problems as evidenced on her teeth. Looking around the store, I've decided to try the Dentastix and gave one to my dog. I had my skepticism due to the size of sticks yet was advertised for large dogs. Needless to say, my dog literally ate the whole thing within seconds without attempting to chew. So, there went a wasted product. Time for me to return it for a refund.

column9: SENT EXPIRED PRODUCT - THAT'S WHY MY DOG WOULDN'T EAT THEM
column10: UPDATE - BEWARE ..... THEY SHIPPED EXPIRED PRODUCT TO ME.They appear exactly the same packaging, but for some reason my dog not only doesn't go crazy when I offer him one, he often turns his head away and rejects the 'treat'.He eventually will eat it if I place it in his bowel .... But this has NEVER! happened with every pack I've purchased at the regular supermarket (at 3x the price).My dog is not a fussy dog ... And this is STRANGE.

Kusmi Russian Morning Tea makes English Breakfast Tea seem like dishwater.  This Russian black tea is full of flavor, rich, deep.  I don't understand the popularity of English Breakfast Tea, at least as it is sold in the United States.  It's wimpy by comparison to this full-bodied Kusmi breakfast tea.

This is tea with courage; it is dark, full bodied, and strong. The air tight tin and the internal plastic bag all work together to keep this tea very fresh. The leaves are beautifully formed, this tea just looks special. Compared to Teevana, this is head and shoulders better tea.When the tea is all used up, the tin is very pretty.

column9: Now this is a morning tea!
column10: I have never been a coffee person, even in the morning.  Instead, I like a good hot cup (pot) of tea either before of after breakfast. Unfortunately, I never found a tea that kept my interest.I tried the normal supermarket brands.  The normal imports of English Breakfast and Irish Breakfast.  Nothing held my interest, so except on the really cold days, I skipped morning tea and had a flavored tea around mid-morning.One winter day, while ordering a couple of Kusmi flavored brands (Trioka & Prince Vladimir), I thought why not give their morning tea a try? My first pot full told me this was no ordinary morning tea.  Full flavored with enough caffeine to keep me alert, but without the wired feeling that coffee can give.Too often, flavored teas can give the hint that the creators are using flavorings to hide cheap tea leaves.  Not so with the Kusmi flavored blends, so I expected that I could chance this blend.  I was correct. The tea stands alone with a flavor that is a pure tea blend with a pleasant flavor.Now I should point out that I drink my tea in loose leaf form.  I cannot speak for how their Morning Tea is in the bag.  But if you are searching for a quality cuppa for your mornings, I would try Kusmi's blend loose or in the bag.
This tea is exactly what I was looking for in a morning tea.  Strong, well balanced flavor with no aftertaste.

I discovered this tea at a grocery store in Paris several years ago and have enjoyed drinking it ever since. It has a dark robust taste that I like better than English Breakfast Tea. Highly recommended.

column9: Taste great, but not worth $4.25 a bottle which is how much they are selling it with shipping.
column10: This taste good, and with all the news and the 60 mins. story on Resveratrol it should be healthy, but they are selling it here for $36.00 plus $15.00 a case of 12 which comes to $4.25 a bottle.  Way too expensive a drink!!!!

This is the best tasting health drink I have had. I wanted something with Resveratrol but did not want to have to take a pill. This tastes like grape Gatorade almost. Really good. Price wise, it is pricey. But I am only drinking one a day and it is no more expensive than some people's Starbucks coffee in the morning.

This makes the best strawberry lemonade. I used to take it to add to my waterbottle on hikes and at Cub Scout daycamp- after sampling a lot of different mixes. This is hands down-the best ever. I drink it at work and my son takes it in his lunch.  Our local stores stopped carrying it, so we are now happy to learn it can be ordered through Amazon!
I love this product. I drink 1 gal of water a day, so this is a good switch in taste. I use 1 packet per half gal, it's a little weak but works well. I like the fact that it is sweeten with Truevia.

After moving away from the east coast, I was delighted to learn that Amazon carried Sunsational Sunflower Milk. I received my first shipment last week and am waiting for another three cases to arrive. A perfect addition to my fruit smoothies - or in a glass all by itself. Thanks Amazon for carrying this product. -- A happy Hawaiian customer!

Review of Sunsational non-Dairy Sunflower Milk (Vanilla Flavor): Delicious, the Vanilla is just a delectable hint at the tip of your tastebuds, The milk itself is of a light grey complexion but other than that the taste is just as creamy and satistfying as regular Dairy Milk, I prefer the trace of nutiness from the sunflower seeds to the aftertaste usually found in Dairy Milk, Soy Milk, Almond Milk etc...I highly recommend this product, My son has allergies to various foods including Nuts and Dairy and so I ordered this milk for him to have something to drink and put on his cereal and he absolutely loves it. I think it works perfectly as a Milk Substitute, My family uses it in our cereal, as a regular glass to dip with cookies etc. I would give it a 5/5 but it would be better if they offered a smaller package size to start with, I was a bit hesitant on ordering a large case since I wanted to taste it first, I have only had the package a month and already have gone through 3 packs/bottles but I understand the hesitation some would feel ordering it the first time

These peppercorns are a beautiful rosy color, which clues you in before you even get a chance to open the package that they're not the peppercorns you've known all your life. When you do pull open the bag and inhale their aroma, you'll find they combine the scent of pepper with a wonderful fruity, almost floral overtone. It's hard to describe, and even harder to imagine until you've experienced it. The lovely part is that the flavor profile doesn't diminish in use; when I ground and steeped these Sichuan peppercorns for a dark chocolate mousse (grind finely, and steep in the heavy cream for 30 minutes before straining the cream into the chocolate) their vibrant peppery fruit/floral scent was the top note of the mousse. It was a memorably different flavor. Now I'm looking for ways to add them to more dishes, to see what new nuances they can impart to old favorites.

This came packed in 4 plastic bags inside a "Bubble Envelope". The weight of the entire package - unopened and undamaged - was 14.2 ounces. Don't know about China, but in the USA that's well short of a pound. Not going to bother with trying to get my money back, but you need to be aware of this.
I searched everywhere for these peppercorns and i stumbled upon them on Amazon.com and I was just thrilled to death and I will alsway order more of these, great product.

column9: This product is of desired quality
column10: The peppercorns arrived just a few days after ordering. The husk is all there is, just like it should be. However there are a few of the black pits left, but the are very few. It is just like the couple of stones you find in a pound of lentils. I am happy with this product and will probably order other spices from this company.

I weighed the peppercorns upon receipt as one reviewer said he received less weight than the package was advertised.  The weight was exactly 16 oz, the peppercorns are good, the shipping was quick.  I am satisfied with my purchase.

When I opened the package a wonderful aroma was greeting me! This was the first time I experimented with Szechuan Peppercorns. They are not really peppercorns but husks. You have to dry roast them for a few minutes then grind them. I used them in a oil based marinade for my chicken dish...very yummy and pleasantly unusual. Delivery was fast and the peppercorns appear to be super fresh.

Although these are said to be "hull-only," there are still a lot of seeds--so much so that I can't cook with these until I have sorted through and removed all the little black devils lurking amongst the delicious hulls. If you find that your dishes have an unpleasantly gritty texture, the seeds are to blame. Delicious, but not as advertised.

I thought I wrote a review but it magically disappeared. Anyway, here it goes again. These peppercorns are okay but lack the punch of better ones I have had in the past. Those are hard to find though. You taste them in dishes like shuizhurou in authentic Sichuan restaurants, also hard to find.

Szechuan peppercorns are different than anything within the usual American spice repertoire.  If you haven't tried them before; do so!  They are wonderful. These peppercorns were just as expected; seemed fresh.  The price was right.  Shipping was fine.

My, oh my, what a deliciouos aroma pours out of this bag of peppercorns.  Nothing has the taste of a toasted Szechuan peppercorn.  They arrived in excellent condition and very, very fresh.  Love them!

JR Mushrooms earned my undying devotion when they noticed I had clicked the order button twice and ordered two pounds of peppercorns.  Just as I was realizing this, they emailed to ask if I REALLY wanted two pounds.  Great Work!  The peppercorns came quickly and are fresh and fragrant--and a lifetime supply.  Since then, I ordered vanilla bean pods too.  Also, good value and quickly delivered.

Sichuan peppercorns are magical. If you've been to a good Sichuan restaurant you'll hopefully have at least one dish that has the great flavor of Sichuan peppercorns along with the strange and wonderful tongue numbing sensation. If you're interested in making great Sichuan style Chinese food at home, this is a must have ingredient. They come well packaged, and it's enough to last for along time.
Exactly as described and extremely fast shipping. Came two days after I ordered.  Very impressed and very pleased customer!
I'm very pleased with my purchase of Szechuan Peppercorns. They are perfect. I don't use them every day but they are here when I need them

I ordered an 8 oz. package of peppercorns...wow, just wow...that is a LOT of peppercorns. Unless you expect to use these a lot, think about a smaller package! I may be using these in the nursing home.My package arrived quickly, and was well packed. Looking at a previous review that insisted the package was lightweight, I weighed my bag of peppercorns upon arrival and it was exactly 8 oz. So I wouldn't be too concerned about a lightweight package.These peppercorns are beautiful, with a lively flavor and plump appearance. They are not shriveled like many peppercorns. I used them to make Kung Pao chicken and ZING they about burned my face off! But in a good way. Such peppery, fresh, citrusy hot flavor. Love them!!!If I ever run out (ever)...I will reorder from this seller!

Peppers arrived in good shape, sourced from Olive Nation - checked the weight before opening because of other reviewer's concern and it was dead on at 8oz net, and the aroma/taste were very good.  There are a few black centers still but it's much better quality than the local Asian grocery at roughly the same price.  As someone else noted 8oz. is a LOT of pepper -- it may take a while to use all this up.

These are wonderful! I've had a recipe for many years for roasted turkey in a brine including these peppercorns. In the past I have just used black peppercorns, not knowing the difference. When I found these online, I decided to use the real thing. I am so glad that I did! My Thanksgiving turkey was so delicious and a big hit!

I bought these peppercorns to make Asian dan dan noodles and the noodles came out great.  The peppercorns add a definite spicy flavor, very tasty for those who like spicy foods.  Will plan to include these peppercorns in more dishes.

Beautiful pink and reddish color, exotic scent, very floral.  I bought this to make a chinese pickled cucumber dish, but 8 oz. of this product is a LOT of product.  I ground them in my mortar and pestle as per the recipe, but the peppercorn shells stuck in my throat and made me cough.  Next time I will take the time to remove the shells afater grinding.
This is the best spice on pork you have ever tried. You will never want to be without it.

If you doctor this tea up with a lot of sugar, you can begin to taste a chocolaty flavor, mostly an aftertaste.  If left alone though, it just tastes like a nice black tea that smells like chocolate candy.

column9: If you like sesame, you'll probably like Halvah
column10: Product: Halvah - a confection bar made primarily from sesame seeds.  It is of a fine/smooth consistency, kind of like some peanut butter bars.  Not quite as dry as a cookie, but about that kind of texture.I've liked Halvah since childhood.  Halvah keeps fairly well.Most of these were vacuum packed in emergency supplies.

column9: Healthy, But Doesn't Taste Like Carrot Juice At All
column10: I love pure carrot juice, and have been drinking it for years, either fresh squeezed or refrigerated.  This is the only non-fresh, non-refrigerated form of carrot juice I've ever encountered.  It contains nothing but organic carrot juice and 1% lemon juice.  I like the fact that it's organic, because carrots tend to accumulate chemicals (such as pesticides), and since it takes a lot of carrots to make a serving of juice, I'd rather not drink non-organic carrot juice.Unfortunately, I don't like the taste of the product at all.  It's sour, probably because of the lemon juice, and lacks any of the sweetness or carrot flavor I associate with carrot juice. I asked the company about this and, to its credit, it promptly informed me that the product includes lemon juice to lower the pH and allow it to be flash pasteurized, which in turn allows storage without refrigeration, but greatly affects the flavor. I'm sure the company would offer a better-tasting bottled carrot juice without refrigeration or preservatives if it could, but until it does I won't buy it again.  But it does contain lots of nutrients.

column9: Even Mr. Bi...Witch & Moan Loves It
column10: A few years ago, my cat was diagnosed with food allergies that previously undiagnosed had led to IBD and then Pancreatitis. We went through just about every limited ingredient food to find one he would eat consistently.  He finally settled on Nature's Variety Instinct. Lamb and Rabbit he'll eat every time and all the time. Duck and Venison, he'll also eat just not always.He still suffers from IBD and will have pancreatitis flare ups if given chicken, but his coat is soft and shiny. He's active (at 13 yrs old). And he rarely throws up. I couldn't survive, he couldn't survive, without this food.I'm glad the company finally started to make 3 oz cans. Mr. Picky doesn't doesn't like leftovers. It doesn't hurt as much to toss out 1.5 oz as it does 4 oz.

I love giving this food to my cats, but more importantly, they love being fed this food!  It is a coarse pate and I have learned that you have to be careful when you open it, or you will get the liquid surrounding the food on you and the counter.  I just open it carefully and empty the liquid in the bowl first and then cut up the main food.  I have read some reviews where customers didn't like it being so dry, but I'm OK with that.  I always add a little water to my cats food anyway so I'm not worried about them not getting enough.  I would rather pay for food and add my own water than to get some of the foods that are over 80% moisture.  I feel like I am paying for water with those, but not with this.  Good deal for a very good food.

column9: My sickly and finnicky kitty now has a sleek coat and loves his food!
column10: We have 5 cats, all of whom are pampered and loved.  I bought this food when one of my special guys lost a lot of weight and became sickly.  His coat was ragged and sad looking, and he looked thin.  Of course, we went to the vet, and got an infection treated (thank goodness it was treatable), but the vet thought that he might have a problem with wheat.  So we tried this food, and although it is expensive, I count it as cheap because of the change that my guy has had.  The food itself looks more like meat than usual canned cat food, but the real proof is in the excitement with which my boy eats!  Now, his coat is sleek and healthy looking.  Instead of nosing the food and then walking away, he eagerly eats it.  He has gained weight. He is frisky again, which I never thought I would see.  He had been so listless, and now with a little weight on him, he is playful and happy once more.  I think that his antibiotic therapy did a lot for him, but I think that this food helped provide him the nutrition to complete his recovery.  And the wheat issue? I have no idea if it is real or not, but now I'm probably not going to go back to our old food, at least for a good long while.  Love the Nature's Valley food.

I just rescued a cat and have been trying to find a good food for him. I got him about 3 months ago. He was overweight and not very active. I had him on Blue Buffalo Wilderness, which he really enjoyed. His coat was better and he was losing weight and being more active. Then I read about how canned food is better for cats, because of the extra moisture, so I ordered Instinct for him. He's been on it for a month, and I haven't noticed any added benefits over the less expensive Blue Buffalo. Instinct canned food is so much more expensive, but I would have been willing to keep him on it if I had noticed a significant weight loss or behavior change, which I didn't. I think I'll be getting him the Blue Buffalo again. If you can afford to feed instinct canned food to your cat, it is a really high quality food. I'm just not sure it's worth the money.One tip, though, if you are trying to help your cat lose weight, definitely go with a grain-free food. He was on a Purina Prescription weight loss food when I brought him home. When I switched to grain-free, I noticed a huge difference in just a week. One big plus, the cat box doesn't fill up as fast because he eats less of the food, since it has fewer fillers and more nutrients.

column9: Higher in calories and fat compares to other Instinct cat food formulas
column10: I am a firm believer that cats should eat good meat (lots of protein, average on fat, and grain- and gluten-free) and that is why I feed my cat only grain-free canned food or raw meat.  I successfully managed to get my cat to lose weight from 19.75 lbs to 14 lbs after 10 months of strict diet.  However, after I fed him 2 packages of this lamb formula cat food, he gains 1.5 lb in 2 months.  This lamb formula has 11% of protein, 8.5 % of fat, and a whooping 141 calories per 3 oz can!  Since I give cat 2 cans per day, that is 40 calories he does not need!  No wonder he gains so much weight...  I am back to the duck, chicken, and beef formula.

column9: Cat food a dog wouldn't eat
column10: I don't know how ANYONE could rate this so-called "cat" food above a 1 star - it is CRUD.The food is cheap - stuffed full of fillers. My 4 cats prefer to eat old and dried up Fancy Feast crumbs before they even eat a bite of this junk. It comes out of the cans like a hard lump - the liquids drain out and you end up with a brick that has to be broken apart.Well, it's not so surprising this stuff ends up as hard as a brick - one of the major ingredients in ALL their "flavors" is Montmorillonite CLAY (yes, the same stuff used in oil and gas well drilling mud!) - ie, very similar to what cat litter is made from...To show how bad it is, even the raccoons and coyotes won't eat this junk - they'd rather eat carrion...Those that think this is "good" food, I can't imagine the crud you've been feeding your cats before - shame on you! Shame on anyone buying this crud - go buy a selection of Fancy Feast (Classic is hands down favorite for the majority of cats - and it's excellent quality food - puts this junk to shame) and see how quickly your cats will spurn this junk.I wish I could give this crud negative stars - it shouldn't be allowed to be sold.
They aren't telling you what is in there before you buy it and you have a case of icky food to go through.
This powder makes a wondeful chili.  Not too hot and not too mild.  it's the best chili I've ever made.

I love this cereal!  I was getting bored with oatmeal and I wanted to add different grains to my diet.  Bob's Red Mill 5-Grain Rolled Hot Cereal let me add variety to my breakfast with awesome flavor.  It cooks just like oatmeal, too, so easy for the morning.
Being one of the people who has problems with too much oat bran, I find this to be a good alternative to oatmeal in the morning.

The best hot cereal I have ever had (and I have tried quite a few!).  It can be made chunky (grainy) and chewy, or soft and watery for people desiring a soupy texture.  It tastes so great by itself that I do not even add any additional ingridients!  Fresh out of the microwave or stove top is great tasting by itself!  Highest recommendation for a healthy diet and satisfying meal in one! Use dicount code HIH374 at iHerb to get $5 off your order.

Bob's Red Mill 5 Grain cereal is wholesome warmth for the morning.  I heat mine (1 cup water to 1/2 cup dry cereal) for 3 minutes in the microwave (generous size bowl to allow for boiling) and then mix with a carton of low-fat fruit yogurt. Fast and yummy for your hungry morning tummy!

column9: Lenin is dead, long live the Prince!
column10: Sing in me oh muse on this snow day, and let me proclaim the many virtues of this fine tea. The scent and flavor of this tea are as close to my conception of ambrosia as anything else that has yet crossed my palate. It is full without being overbearing, it is seasoned without being overpowering. It's great with anything from English breakfast fare to hardy curry.Since conception, I have been in love with tea, but "the Prince" was my first fine tea. I have still not recovered from the episode in which my father-in-law-to-be proved to me that bag tea was a crime against humanity. And yet despite amorous flirtations with rare white teas and other wondrous Indian and Chinese estate varieties with unpronounceable names, it's still my favourite.Never mind the tea purist snobs who rank on it because it's flavored with spice. Would they send back a fine filet because the chef elected to use some pepper or shallots? Ignore the herbal tea-totalers who regard caffeine as sinful. They probably want to outlaw yoga on Sunday too.Of the five or so Kousmichoff varieties I've had, this one is the clear winner. I've gotten my best results using HOT water steeping for five to six minutes. The stuff is potent enough that you can get, gasp, a reasonably tannin-free second infusion.My only reservation is this; once you've entered the universe of fine tea, you can never be satisfied drinking Lipton, Salada, Twinings or Tetley again. In guise of gifts, I have managed to get many of my gastronome friends and relations addicted so that I may sup of it when I visit. Isn't it a delicious irony that perhaps the greatest bourgeoisie decadence of the Romanoff dynasty is  today preserved by our friends in socialist France? Viva la Revolution!rws, 26/1/05

I first had this tea served at the Firebird Resturant in New York. They served it in traditional Russian tea glasses with sweetened cherries from Moldavia (no sugar). This is by far the best way to enjoy this fine tea, but even when I'm in less civilized parts of the country Prince Vladimir with a spoonful of sugar is wonderful.

Smooth and full, not at all smoky; with subtle whispers of grapefruit and vanilla...I save this tea for the weekends, when I have time to sip and savor. I will chug a lesser tea from a travel mug during the morning commute, but I would never allow such vulgar treatment for my Prince Vladimir.

This is a delicious black China tea blend presented in a beautiful, highly giftable tin box.This tea is available in 35 oz, 8.8oz, 4.4oz and tea bags; I usually get the 4.4oz tin as I am the only black tea lover in the house. One tin of 4.4 oz is enough for one large cup a day for ~3 months so I am guessing ~100 cups (I use a 1.5' mesh infuser).As usual with Kusmi, the tin is beautiful, with raised flower details and old-fashioned design and colors.The blend is a glistening black tea with pieces of citrus peel.The nose is reminiscent of a bergamot Earl Grey with spicier notes that I would describe as all-spice, nutmeg and even a hint of turmeric.The mouth is smooth, low tannins, with beautiful layered flavors of vanilla and soft spices and a savory-sweet finish.Kusmi recommend a brewing temperature of 85c to 90c (~185F to 195F) so make sure the water sits for a few moments after boiling before pouring over the tea. I usually like a rather long infusion time, maybe 5 to 7 minutes. I do not add anything to this tea but a sweetener would probably work if you like.To my knowledge, Prince Vladimir was one of Kusmi's first blend in the late 1800's and remain one of the most popular. I would highly recommend it to lovers of complex flavored black teas. In particular, if you already appreciate some higher-end bagged teas (Mighty Leaf Vanilla Bean or Orange Dulce?), I think you should give this superior blend a try.Cheers!

I was not sure what to expect upon receiving a box of this tea as a gift during the holiday season, and indeed the ingredients struck me as rather unusual.  Being a person who generally likes my tea and coffee black with no flavoring whatsoever, I was rather suspicious of the orange, grapefruit, and other extra 'scents'.  However, I was delighted with the concoction.  The extras are definately present, giving a slightly citric quality to the tea but are not the least bit overpowering and provide a unique  aroma that is quite pleasing.I do recommend steeping it for a long time to get the most out of the leaves, especially if you are to get the citric scents that make it so unique.

column9: A perfect sweet treat, the best lollypops ever!
column10: I was sent a box of these by a friend in Los Angeles and I have fallen in love.  Of course, since I live in North Carolina, there is obviously no See's store here.  My favorite flavor is definitely the Root Beer, but flavors like butterscotch and vanilla are AMAZING. I never thought that anything like this could ever be consider a lollypop by North Carolina standards, but trust me, once you taste one of these, you won't want to switch back.  They have great flavors, melt in your mouth, and stay with you once you're done, and once you have one, you can't stop there.  A great gift to any friend!

I order these through Amazon since I moved away from the West Coast and can't get them locally any more.  They are wonderfully flavorful and creamy, they're silky except for the chocolate which has a very slight nubby texture as you go.  My favorites are the chocolate and the butterscotch, but the vanilla and the latte are very good. This is my favorite chocolate ever!  Much better than Lindt or any other brand.  It's smooth and milky...........perfect!!!
I bought this on a recommendation from a friend in Whales. He said this is the best chocolate over there. I'm in the US (East). Lindt chocolates better.
highly recommend this raw organic coconut oil...I enjoyed this product from the very first time i used it...better than all others I have tried

This coconut oil is the best I have purchased so far. It stays easy to spoon and has a very nice flavor. It mixes easily in any receipt, I especially like it for pancakes, I put it in the batter and also a bit in the pan and I get fantastic tasting pancakes. Cakes come out moist and tasty.

I am not a coconut oil aficionado but I can say this is easily as good as any other I have tasted.  Being Raw and Organic may be the reason.  It tastes great straight from the jar!  I originally bought coconut oil for making popcorn, Thai and Indian dishes.  No I am experimenting with a lot of other dishes.  Working my way through saute and roasted vegetables.  I used it to make grilled cheese sandwiches for the kids and they loved it. Plus it makes the house smell like coconuts!
This was very small. It was not as it is descibed 'large'. Otherwise, my dog loved it. He ate it up quickly.

These dog treats are great, especially if you have a larger dog who can chew any toy or treat to pieces in a minute.  This treats are tough, I have a pitbull and a boxer mix and they are strong and usually chew through a treat real quick but these last and last and they keep them entertained.  I highly recommend these for all dogs.  Plus the filling isn't gross sticky stuff that leaks out and gets on your carpet like some of those other filled dog treats.
My medium-sized mixed breed loved this bone.  I would recommend this--and maybe two cause they don't last long (at least at my house!)
The dog absolutely loved the bone, she had issues getting at the stuffing in the middle but i believe she enjoyed the challenge.

These bones are my dog's absolute favorite.  He is a SUPER strong chewer, although he only weighs about 60 lbs and is otherwise completely gentle.  It's sometimes hard to find bones and toys for him since he always chews them to bits within 5 minutes.  These bones last him forever, at least 3-4 months at a time.  He loves the filling and will lick it for hours.  Would recommend these bones to any large dog owner.
I have a large doberman and he spent sometime on this, not like most of the other bones he gets through to quickly... Great product.

how come this is listed at $88.40?how come its so small?how come i got the wrong flavor? my dog don't care but come on.

column9: If you like ginger like I do, these are the best...
