Not knowing if they will ever restock I found this tea online and bought 10 boxes! Tastes incredible and if you put it in the refrigerator after you make it, it has a very refreshing effect! :)

column9: No Expiration Date on the Package!
column10: We had been buying Onno Behrends teas for some time thenafter the last purchase we noticed that there was noexpiration date on the package. We contacted Amazonthey sent us new ones, but still no expiration date.We contacted them again, they contacted the importerand said that they won't be able to provide expirationdate for the teas.We consume a lot of tea and buy from all over the world.This was the first time we came across a packaged tea withno expiration date and these teas are produced in Germany.So, buyers be aware these teas might have been producedwho knows when? They may even be antique!

This tea is phenomenal. I use 4 bags for half a gallon with a bit of sweetener. Out of the fridge, addictive. The price is very good and each box contains 50 bags (not only 20, like competitors). Will certainly order again as soon as the five boxes are gone! Amazon Prime rocks!
it is rather Hibiscus than Rose Hips tea. Rose hips tea is very gentle and smooth. This one, "contaminated" with Hibiscus is rather acidic than mild and smooth.
This is the best brand of tea that I ever found on the international market. You will buy it once, you will never go for something else!

If you like a simple pot of black tea, this is the stuff. When you open the tin, the scent that rolls out is wonderful. And the fragrance from a fresh-brewed cup is perfect: bright and not bitter. Best with a little milk and sugar, but a beautiful color in a glass tea-cup, too. This is my absolute favorite daily tea, and if you get used to the loose leaf, brewed fresh, you wont even think about using dry old bags again. Sometimes this brand is hard to find in loose leaf locally, so I have bought 3 or 4 tins at a time online and it seems to store well (if you keep the metal tins sealed and away from other smells and light.) You wouldn't think there would be that much difference between one black tea and another but this very slight bergamot-tinged blend is addictive. (The green metal tins are also handy for other things, when the tea is gone.) This tea is the one item I ALWAYS want for Christmas!
Excellent tea and fast service. I just wish the shipping was less -- it's almost as much as the tea! Thank you just the same, I do LOVE the tea and can't seem to find it locally.

My husband loves Earl Grey tea, he was a twinning fan, until we tried Ahmad.  I was a orange pekoe - black tea fan.  After we tried the ceylon special with earl grey from Ahmad, my husband switched and I drink mostly earl grey.  The taste is great, and I have left the tea and over brewed it and it still taste great not bitter.I still use black tea when I make chai however.

I was delighted to find the one pound tins of Earl Grey tea by Ahmad. This is the most flavorful Earl Grey I have ever had and to get one pound tins at a good price is terrific! (The tins are very handsome, too.) This is great for the tea lover and a wonderful gift. The delivery arrived promptly and in good conditionn. I will use this service again.Judith Muniec

I have been drinking this tea for years.  The earl grey is subtle, not overpowering or artificial as it can be, and the tea is rich and delicious.  Nice large leaf tea, not dust.  The tin is fun and reusable too! A bargain for the price.

This decaf is a tad anemic and has a bit of a burnt edge to it which may produce a slight aftertaste. If made in a press pot you may find you need to increase the amount of beans, or increase the steeping time to make it richer, elsewise it will may be rather pedestrian and thin. I would not describe this product as rich or robust, however it is not poor either. Experimenting with amount of beans (probably require a tad more than usual) and/or setting time (give it an extra minute or two) may make this a bit more satisfying cup.

I ordered Larry's coffee without having had the opportunity to taste test it first. I was looking for something to replace a store bought brand that had become increasingly expensive and the flavor wasn't consistent. So I looked online at my favorite place to shop, Amazon. I found the usual many choices and after reading the reviews decided to give Larry's Fair Trade Organic - Sammy Decaf Jr. It arrived several days after I ordered it and it brewed up great. A wonderful full flavor that will satisfy my coffee taste cravings for a long time to come. In addition it was gratifying to learn that Larry's Beans is implementing all types of energy saving and environmentally friendly methods of doing business from buying fair trade, solar applications and recycling. A great article appeared in the latest issue of Solar Today on their company. A coincidence? More like serendipity. I highly recommend doing business with Larry's Beans.

column9: Larry's Beans--Organic Decaf Sammy Jr. Rock
column10: This product is great. The beans are of the highest quality and have a full flavor.

Arrived in good condition and tastes great, you can actually taste the flowers used by the bees.  My little cap is not coming off for poring the honey through the little spout so I have to unscrew the entire cap but no worries I am enjoying the product.  Maybe the next bottle will not give me this problem.

column9: High Quality Honey at a great price.
column10: This honey is not the best honey I have had (though very good), but for the price it can't be beat.Excellent quality raw (not heat treated or pasteurized) honey from a leader in the natural sweetners industry. Hives kept and harvested in the pristine wild lands of the Colorado rockies.
I needed bulk honey for a wedding favor project, but also needed the squirt top.  This was perfect.  I also tasted the honey and it was great.  I will continue using this product.
Honey water is good for your health.And this is a good product,easy to pour out and won't have resides sticking to the outside of the bottle.The last, great honey taste!
Very good honey, price is not to bad either. Sweetens everything that you might use sugar on and this is good for you.

This honey is okay.  Though I am no connoisseur,  It's kind of like supermarket honey.  I use it when I make bread or put it in my coffee.  I think it is average honey.  Probably the worst thing about this honey is the cap.  No matter how careful I am, every time I put honey into my coffee, the honey drips from the side of the cap.  So I have to rinse it off so it doesn't make a sticky mess on the counter or in the cabinet.  Sometimes my husband uses this and I have to clean up a trail of mess.  The manufacturer should have put 10 more cents into making a better bottle.
I love this energy drink!  When I"m feeling tired it gives me energy, it is very subtle.  The drink does not wire me up.

I thought I would give it a try after hearing good things about it.  Both my wife and I thought it tasted like Alka Selzer.  We iced it down but the taste is hard to get by.  Would not buy again unless they can make it taste better.  It's like taking medcine.

It tastes really good. It does not give me as much energy as a guru but I like having one of these in the morning. It does have a better taste than guru. So if you are looking for a all natural alternative to guru this is it.

Great service and product! The seller sent email instructions before the product even arrived that were very helpful.  I strongly recommend this product to anyone looking to decorate a room with little hassle and time!

this gum retains its flavour for what seems like forever, and I have a bad habit of blowing bubbles when I'm chewing gum....unconsciously of course, but it's great for that too !  I can't find this flavour of Mentos in the stores, hence I have to buy it on the net ! ! !
This Sticky Stuff used to be available from their web site. Now it is supposedly moving to stores. It can't happen fast enough.

column9: A very nice sauce for basting and finishing
column10: My father gave me this because he knows I enjoy BBQ.  And boy, did my friends and I enjoy this 'Stuff'.  We started with some pork baby backs in the oven with a simple marinade and rub for the first hour or so.  Then the real magic happened once we moved them to grill outside to do a light crust and char using the Sticky Stuff as a basting sauce.  It all came together at the dinner table when we started eating these delicious, 'shut my mouth' ribs.  Little was said and much was eaten.  Trust me, you will want the extra bottles in the six pack to share and have around for your own craving.
LAWRY SEASONING IS GREAT, HOWEVER, THE PRICE IS TOO HIGH.  I CAN BUY THE 40 0Z. BOTTLE FOR $5.12 AT SAM'S CLUB.  WHY ARE YOU SELLING FOR 9+ DOLLARS.  I WILL BE MORE CAREFUL SHOPPING IN THE FUTURE.

My grilling skills are passed down from my father who is the grill-MASTER! If there's a maranate involved, it's one story; but if ther's no maranate involved, the simplistic flavor you get from ANY meat, foul or fish you happen to throw over the coals is not complete before using the recommended PAIR of Lawry's Seasoned Pepper and Lawry's Seasoned Salt! Period. Almost without exception, my guests won't add anything additional, because it just turns out perfect EVERYTIME! Thus the:'I Wouldn't Use "Nothin'" Else!'
I love Lawry's seasoned salt. It adds great flavor to grilled hamburgers, eggs, and vegetables. I love the flavor and extra color it adds to fries.

I can't believe I actually bought this stuff in the stores. They charge half as much for less than a quarter of the product.Because it was soo expensive, I started buying proprietary blends of "seasoning salts" from spice sites around the net. Most of them were good and were comparable in price, but none of them were exactly what they were trying to emulate: Lawry's.Finally, I decided to check back to Amazon to see what the real stuff cost. I was shocked to find out that I was paying the same or more for imitation products. I immediately bought it and have never looked back.If you've never had Lawry's, you're in for a real treat. Many recipes call for "seasoning salt." Well, they are generally referring to "Lawry's' without mentioning the name. You can pretty much sprinkle this stuff on anything. It is great on fries; I mix it with flour and bread crumbs to coat chicken, It could probably be substituted for poultry seasoning.

Great staple to have on hand. It is awesome on just about anything: Grill shrimp, chicken, pork, steak and great in burgers. I like to let my meat sit in the season for about 30+ just so it can soak up more flavor.

Sprinkle this on anything and it'll taste great. Fries, chicken, salad, ANYTHING. I season my hamburgers with it. For those who don't need as much, I'd recommend a smaller container, but this 40 ounce container is definitely for people who season huge amounts of food a lot of the time.

column9: Another company lying about their product
column10: As a migraine sufferer, I have to be very careful around MSG. After reoccurring headaches and unable to pinpoint the cause I discovered the misleading claims on the Lawry's seasoning salt. "Natural Flavor" is MSG! It was giving me headaches. I stopped eating it and headaches went away. Thanks a lot Lawry for trying to hurt your consumers!

column9: Lawry's Salt Seasoning- too many additives
column10: Note: Lawry's contains sugar, soy lecithin (an additive), tricalcium phosphate (an additive to prevents caking) and a large amount of sodium. I prefer to purchase a salt seasoning such as Stephanie's Salt Seasonings which is all natural, no fillers, additives, no MSG and is available with a salt substitute. And best all of it has 4 varieties of salt- sea salt, kosher, lite and salt substitute. What else could you ask for?

column9: Good raw unfiltered honey at a good price.
column10: The price was good when I bought the honey from Amazon, and was even better because I chose to take advantage of Amazon's Subscribe & Save offer. (I've used it in the past and never had a problem canceling or changing a scheduled order, and therefore I never received an order I didn't need or want. Amazon sends an email before shipping an item you've subscribed to, giving you a chance to cancel or postpone it.)It's hard for me to find raw, unfiltered honey that is 100% a product of the US in local markets at anything close to what I'd consider a reasonable price (and that's if and when they have such honey in stock at all). I've tried a different brand of raw, unfiltered, produced in the US honey from Amazon, and while I like it and may buy it again in the future (e.g., for the sake of variety), I like the Ambrosia Honey better. I operated natural food stores in CA in the late 70's and early 80's, and the smell and taste of Ambrosia Honey reminds me of some of the good, pure honey we sold in bulk back then.The shipment of a 4-pack of 23 ounce plastic bottles (as pictured) arrived without any leaks or stickiness on the bottles at all, and I appreciate that each bottle has a pour-type cap (you just have to snip or cut the top of the spout off to the diameter you want), as opposed to honey containers that you have to use a spoon or honey dipper with. There are nice, simple instructions on the label about how to reliquify the Ambrosia Honey if and when necessary.I think anyone who appreciates really good quality pure, unfiltered honey will like this honey.

The taste can't even compare to what is in the stores as common brands, this product has just a great and clean taste which really worth trying.  With all the problems with bees these days this product is a sure winner and a good value considering the quality.  We have been buying for over five years without a problem once...

column9: Honey taste is wonderful, packaging leaves me dripping.
column10: The honey is five stars if you enjoy a lighter-colored honey with a light to medium bodied taste.  This is near the middle, tending toward light. Excellent consistency, good flow, no trouble with crystallization. Unfortunately, the twist-on cap of two of my four bottles came loose and dripped while in transit. It was a small amount, nothing to return the package over. However, I notice that even after tightening the cap, putting pressure on the bottle to squeeze the honey has created drip. This honey is quite sticky on the hands. If you have another container to place it in, I would recommend using that if it has a tried-and-true lid on it. The plastic of these bottles is very, very pliable, which can make it difficult to get honey out when the level reaches about a quarter full.In all, I think I will continue to buy this product, but I will most likely salvage some other honey bottles to use with it instead to combat the drip and pressure problem.

This honey has an exceptional flavor. It's very sooth, as well as a beautiful amber hue. The flavor resembles the common Clover Honey. It's great in teas because it has a subtle honey flavor, which doesn't hinder the flavor of the tea. I would highly recommend it if you are someone that is looking for a mellow, yet still flavorful honey.

Since this honey professes to be raw (actually, it is warmed/heated) and unfiltered (actually, they tell you on the label in small print that they filter it) I was prepared for little bits and floaters to be in it, but it is clear as a bell.  The flavor is a mild sort of wildflower flavor - but different - more mellow.  It's sweet, but not overly so and it's not as thick as many raw wildflower honeys can be.  Its color is a nice rich amber.The bottles are easy to handle but I get nervous about handling them with the pour spout when they are full as the cap isn't the most securely fitting thing in the world.  It just feels weak to me.  They arrived really well packed for transit so I didn't experience any messy losses due to shipping.The manufacturers might want to consider redoing their label as the information they provide is confusing:  Raw & Unfiltered verses the fine print stating that it is heated/warmed & filtered.  It matters a lot to some folks and is the only reason I docked a star.  Regardless, the honey rocks.

Colorado honey is mild and not too sweet.  It's smooth and has a great mellow flavor.  I eat it on toast, waffles, and use for sweetening coffee and tea.  I'll never go back to supermarket honey.  This is a great gift idea too.  It's something different and everyone loves the taste.

column9: I'm so glad that I came across this honey!
column10: While searching Amazon for raw honey options, I happened across Ambrosia's Pure Honey.  Since we are a family that consumes a great deal of honey, this item of 4 bottles of 23 oz. raw honey is ideal for us.  I signed up for Subscribe and Save with this honey and the price is too good to be true!  Did I mention that the honey is delicious?

This honey is wonderful.  Unlike the regular name brand honeys, this one actually has a 'real' honey flavor. It's smooth, not overwhelming like some raw honeys can be.  Haven't had a person yet who has tried it not like it, even those who aren't particularly fond of honey.

I purchased this honey for my daughter who loves to cook and uses honey in a lot of recipes.  I was a little worried that the taste would be so different from the regular store bought that she would have trouble adjusting to it.  When it arrived, she popped one open and tasted it.  She didn't think honey could really taste all the different.  Boy was she surprised.  She immediately started raving about the taste.  I couldn't believe how wonderful it was.  I mean, it is still honey.  It still tasted like honey.  The difference can't even be described appropriately in words.  It is like taking a bath in just warm water, or taking a bubble bath in hot water with a glass of wine and candles along the sides.  it just makes you feel that much better.  Okay, that may have been a bit exaggerated, but the effect is the same.  It is so much better than the honey from the store.Enjoy.
i love honey, had all different types from all over the world, and this is one of THE BEST honeys on earth!
This honey is heaven in a bottle. Supermarket honey is no match for the smooth pure taste of this stuff.It even makes a huge difference in the bread that I bake with honey.
This is some of the best honey I've had, and also the cheapest I've paid for. Definitely recommended.

I've been buying raw & unfiltered honey for years, from local market, Trader Joe's, and Whole Food. I seriously doubt this is raw and unfiltered honey. The raw & unfiltered honey I bought elsewhere "ALL" looked whitish and murky. When I used it with coffee, you can see some oil floating to the surface of the coffee. The coffee cup always leaves a oily residue which is not easy to wash even with detergent. I don't get that with this product at all. In fact I don't even need detergent at all. Unfiltered raw honey should have pollen, propolis, wax, and live enzymes rich in nutrient. This honey taste like regular honey except it crytalizes way too easily. I recently took this product to a local farmer and I was told this is definitely not unfiltered raw honey. I also took this honey to a famous honey producer in Delaware and I was told the same thing.For those who wrote positive reviews for this product, please do some search to see what unfiltered raw honey should look like. Some of you got cheated and you don't even know it. Unfiltered raw honey should look like creamy lard, not dark amber liquid that crystalizes easily. This is what Trader Joe's told me.

column9: Average honey; more impressed with the container
column10: Better than the cheap imported honey from China but nothing spectacular.  I was expecting complex flavors based on the reviews and only got a step above regular clover honey.  The only redeeming part is the containers; no leaks and reusable.Packaging from amazon was the best I have every seen.
Delivered quickly and the honey has a great fresh taste and will buy again. The price is good and I would recommend this to anyone who wants to buy great tasting honey.
GREAT HONEY!! MY KIDS AND I ARE ALMOST DONE WITH IT, TOOK US A BIT OVER A MONTH... USED IN BAKING BUT MOSTLY IN TEAS INSTEAD OF SUGAR.  ALSO USED IT TO MAKE COUGH SYRUP.

I first tasted this honey while visiting family in Colorado.  It was so memorable, that I placed it on my wish list for the holidays.  Now, I purchase it whenever I get the craving, which is often.  It's great to know that it can be ordered in several different sizes and quantities and shipped to my door.  If you are looking for a special reward for yourself, look no further, this is it.  Treat youself!

column9: Fabulous Honey At A Fabulous Price
column10: This is fabulous honey. It tastes like clover honey, but more fresh, as it is raw, but not overpowering. The container is nice. You cut the tip off to the size that you want. Easy to squeeze and the honey doesn't drip all over and make the bottle sticky. The price is great, especially for raw honey. It's cheaper than the pasteurized and refined clover honey at the grocery store. I will be purchasing this again.

Ambrosia Pure Honey sold locally in one store for a short time and the price was obscene. I found it on Amazon at a reasonable price. It is perfect for my homemade Honey Mustard Salad Dressing. I had to order more than usual because my dinner guests always ask for my dressing once they've tasted it.
I have bought this product before, so I like it. Bought this larger amount to use in wine making. Its perfect for that.
What is there to say!  This honey is the best.  I've went through 3 cases and it just gets better............

The package arrived in pristine condition, double packaged - in bubble wrap as well as a thick plastic wrapping. The bottles are not cracked or leaking etc. Kids (and us) love the taste of the honey. One downside (or upside?) is the expiration data is not very long, like store bought honey. Overall, very satisfied with the packaging as well as the honey.
Fantastic price for a sweetener. All of the containers were in good condition. I use it for sugar substitutions in baked goods and it works well. :)

column4: Adriane L. Mummert "so beautiful a day"
column10: As someone who uses honey regularly in baking and cooking as a replacement for traditional refined sugar, I was on the hunt for the best honey nutritionally at the best value. I am confident that this is it. Not only is the honey delicious and meets the criteria I was looking for (heated at a lower temp to preserve enzymes), but it is much cheaper when purchasing through Subscribe & Save than repeatedly buying raw/natural honey at a health food store. I am very pleased and highly recommend this buy!

this is first time trying Ambrosia Pure Honey from Colorado's W Slope, and my first implosion is great for the taste and price. However, I feel the honey is not really pure since the consistency is not as I expected when I purchased it. Overall, I like the taste and the kids do too.

column9: Can't beat it, delicious raw pure honey!
column10: Raw pure honey that has an excellent flavor.  For the shipment, each dispenser container was separately bubble wrapped. Received in perfect condition.  Gave as gifts, too!

I am very pleased with this honey.  The bottles arrived well packaged, undamaged and not leaking.  I like having a large quantity of honey packaged in smaller quantities; the squeeze bottles are fantastic!  The taste of the honey is great.  Overall, I'd recommend this to anyone if their local honey source is unavailable.
Wonderful honey with a slight cinnominy taste, well worth the money and would definitely buy again!

This is great, natural honey.  I use it to make all kinds of things more palatable like honey, cereal, toast, replacing jelly, replacing *all* added sugars, tea, etc.  Great deal on bulk too.  Warning though, this is a *lot* of honey.
The taste of this honey is fantastic! I love the easy to serve container it is very convenient.The price was good, will buy it again in the future.
Very good product, excellent value for the money, quality is very good, tastes great. Love it! Would like to recommend this honey.
This is the best honey I've ever bought. It tastes just like the one my grandma used to have when I was a kid. It's not cheap but worth every penny. The taste is great plus it's not imported.

I love this honey and I never thought that I would go through so much.  I eat it on everything and I also love that it doubles as a first aid antiseptic.  It promotes healing and kills bacteria/fungi.  A true wonder of the world that nature produces something so delicious and amazing.Cons: I cant stop eating it!

I tried this honey to see if it was as good as the seller said. It was ,so said my wife, we can buy cheaper honey but so far not better honey. Ther are several more types honey to try but we would buy this one again.
This honey has a different taste, a smoother mouth feel, than any I have had before.  In one word, awesome!!  23 ounces per bottle makes this a great deal that can't be beat.

column9: Excellent, the whole family loves it
column10: It is hard to go wrong with this all natural sweetener.My father is a bit of a honey addict.  He uses it in his coffee every morning, and penut butter and honey sandwiches are not uncommon for him.I got him a pack of these for his birthday and their is plenty to go around.  The whole family loves the taste and I love that its natural.I highly recommend this product to any honey lovers out their and I moderately recommend for everyone else just because of the amount of honey that comes with this, the package feels like it weighs 10 pounds.

I'm giving this 23 oz. version 3 stars to get someone's attention. Right now (Apr. 2, '12) this larger bottle is significantly more expensive than their 16 oz. bottles.. which I almost didn't notice before ordering (since, who in the heck charges more for the larger version of something??).GREAT HONEY.  weird pricing.

I place  order two times. First order, honey was leaking everywhere in the box. They are going to replacement. Yesterday I got second order, box was broken and honey was leaking again. I order 12 bottles (it was heavy) , but they use thin box and packed too poor. I like the honey, but packing was too poor.
The spice itself is fine but the bottle is not tall and narrow as pictured.  Instead, it is short and wide.  That makes it impossible to store on my spice rack.

I like the versatility of the planks and also the quality. They stay fresher than a box of granola and you can eat them alone, or with yogurt, or milk, or other fresh fruit. it's a good combination of grains, nuts and fruits.

column9: For packaged granola, this really is good.
column10: My wife makes the best granola. Hands down. We have a couple local restaurants that are close.  If neither one of those are available, and I HAVE to resort to a package, these Pomegranate Walnut Granola Planks will totally do in a pinch.  I especially like the instructions on the package... microwave if you want it chewier; put in the toaster if you want it crunchier.  I also really liked the fact that it held together well so there was no mess.

I would recommend trying this flavor and this product in the store before buying. The planks are chewy enough that they taste kind of stale just as a granola bar or snack by themselves. I suppose if you were hiking and really hungry they might taste better, but I bought them for a snack when I work the midnight shift at work.  They are acceptable with milk or yogurt, but I could just as easily buy regular granola and not have to break it up (they don't break easily). I wouldn't buy this again.

We love Earnest Bars!  We use about five boxes a month:  four Choco Peanut Butter Bars, and one Cran Lemon Zest.  I thought I would branch out and try something new.  Liked the idea of a bigger bar.  Ordered the Pomegranate Walnut Crisp.  I like pomegranate.  I like walnuts.  I like crispy things.  Can't lose, right?  WRONG!  I don't know if these were exposed to too much moisture or if they are actually supposed to have this consistency, but they are AWFUL!  My title says it all... instead of crisp, my bars (I had two - and ate them on different days - just to make sure the package wasn't faulty and to make sure I wasn't being overcritical).  The sunflower seeds are nice.  The almonds would be better toasted.  I don't actually see any walnuts... the fruit is flavorful.  But the overall taste is just kind of sweet and is lost to the off-putting consistency of chewy popcorn balls.  There is nothing crisp about this product.  :(

It works great as some portable energy on the go.  Great as a hiking snack or light meal.  It tastes much like a good granola cereal.  Chewy, not crunchy.  Reminds me of those rice krispy bars, or popcorn balls, but with granola and nuts.

column9: Very delicious, wish they were smaller portions
column10: These are delicious, but very rich, and should be in a smaller portion size...I would buy more if they were split in two.

I wish Amazon would provide nutritional information on its product page. I took a chance on this and they are very high in calories for the quantity. Each plank has 2 servings, 190 calories each. In other words, each plank is about 400 calories - too much for me. I won't be buying these again.
This is a great product ... use it to sweeten and spice up Cottage Pie, Stews and use it as a marinade for BBQ .... LOVE LOVE IT!

I initially found this at a farmers market in Sherman Oaks and was disappointed when I went back months later to buy another bottle and found the farmers market no longer there.  I searched all the local markets and online to find a place to buy another bottle with no results.  I was very pleased when I finally found this product on Amazon for about the same price I had paid at the local farmers market.I like basting my grilled chicken or shrimp with this sauce and adding to a salad for a quick meal.  Adds just the right amount of heat and sweetness for excellent flavor.
This product is very tasty just the way I remember it in Africa.  Unfortunately it took awhile but it was so delicious and tangy.  Goes with every kind of food,even vegetarian dishes
WAS VERY WELL PLEASE WITH MY CHERRY SPICE I HAVE NEVER TRY THIS TYPE OF SPICES, I WILL KEEP SOME ON HAND ALL THE TIME.,ALSO VERY QUICK SERVICE.

this does not even begin to resemble licorice as we know it. Nasty wee tiny hard stuff that has been flavored with licorice.So bad it will have you spitting it out in a second.This stuff is bitter and not worth a cent.

My wife made me buy a case of this tea as soon as we returned home from a trip.  She had some while in a restaurant and said that it was the finest tea she ever had.  She will not drink anything else and has since had me order other flavors.

Was a little worried this tea wasn't what I was looking for but honestly it has exceeded expectations. If you enjoy a black tea infused with flavors of peach, you will love this tea. I highly recommend as an iced tea; an excellent way to beat the heat.

column9: Great tea at a bargain price
column10: I have been searching everywhere for this tea, ever since I first tasted it in Europe. Very intense fruit flavors. I finally found it in a little local Dutch store (Pickwick is Dutch) for $8 a box. Not happy with the price I searched on the internet and found it here on Amazon for a bargain. If you like black flavored tea, you will love this tea. Every single time I serve it for friends, they always want to know what kind of tea it is, and where they can get it.

column9: Don't let Snooki deter you from trying this!!
column10: I have seen a few commercials with Snooki and Deena of the Jersey Shore advertising these biscuits and I didn't want to buy anything associated with Snooki, but I eventually caved in and gave it a try. These breakfast biscuits are surprisingly delicious. I eat a pack with some Greek yogurt and it keeps me full until lunch time. Also, instead of eating a doughnut or cookie with my morning coffee, I'll reach for these biscuits and it actually goes very well with coffee.

I got a pack from my mother-in-law one day to eat as a snack at work.  It was really good.  They look like cookies, so you feel like you're eating something that's more fattening that it is.  I can't wait to try the blueberry.

column9: Not my favorite flavor, but still tasty
column10: I absolutely LOVE the Belvita Blueberry, but when my local store was out of the Blueberry flavor recently, I decided to try the Apple Cinnamon.  Like the other "biscuits" (they are more breakfast cookies, really) in the belVita line, the Apple Cinnamon variety packs a surprisingly decent nutritional profile, with 4 grams of protein (could be better, but not bad), 3 grams of fiber, and 18 grams of whole grain. They are lower in sugar than most breakfast bars or even yogurts at 13 grams, and although the fat content is a bit high (8 grams), there is only a trace of saturated fat (.5 grams).But, the best part about these biscuits is the taste--they are quite yummy!  I as glad that the Apple Cinnamon shares the same crisp, buttery, cookie-like flavor as the Blueberry.  Unfortunately, unlike the Blueberry, which actually has little bits of berries and a distinct blueberry flavor, the Apple Cinnamon variety did not taste particularly apple-y to me at all, and I could not detect any pieces of fruit.  The base flavor was still good, but it was more like a plain butter cookie rather than the promised Apple Cinnamon.I will probably continue to buy the Belvita Blueberry when available, but this might be an option for those who prefer a simpler flavor.

column9: Tasty for breakfast or any time of day!
column10: Let me start off by saying that we have two young kids that are very picky eaters.  These even pass their tests and they love them.  There are four biscuits per pack so they can split them and are still happy.  I often forget to eat breakfast and grabbing a pack of these is a great way to have a healthy something that didn't come from a drive thru. The blueberry flavor is also very tasty.  Great for a snack or on the go, a must have for us!

These little things are delicious! I didn't expect much. My wife bought them apparently, and they were just sitting on the kitchen table. She must not have told me about them because she figured I'd eat them all. If that's the case, she's probably right. These things definitely exceeded all my expectations, and were good enough for me to immediately come here and right a review. They do seem pretty pricey here though, but I'm not sure what they run in the stores since I didn't buy them personally.
this has become my go to breakfast.  high in fiber, portable and delicious.  the golden oat flavor is also exceptional.  I do not recommend the  blueberry, chocolate or cinnamon flavors.

These biscuits are very good and my second favorite to the blueberry. These biscuits are not filling enough alone for breakfast so I eat them as a sweet snack. I wish the calories were lower, but that doesn't deter me from buying.  They are a winner.

My brother discovered these in Florida, and sent me a few (luckily they are now available locally).  My husband likes apple cinnamon best.  I like blueberry and my son likes cinnamon brown sugar (yes, a 12 year old will eat this!).  They are a great, quick breakfast before school for my son, and my husband keeps a box at work.  They are only 6 points on Weight Watchers for me, so we eat them every day.

These are tasty and I am enjoying one with my morning coffee break while I write this, but reading the nutrition facts and the ingredients list on the package, I have to think that this is more of a tasty and somewhat healthy cookie than a substitute for breakfast. According to the package, a serving is four biscuits which adds up to 230 calories. Though that includes 3 grams of protein and 3 grams of fiber, it also includes 13 grams of sugar and 8 grams of fat.They are good, tasting like a nice butter cookie with just a hint of cinnamon and apple. Still, I think I'll be more likely to have one from time to time as a little treat with my morning coffee or after dinner than to substitute a package for breakfast. There I'd more likely chose a low-fat fruit yogurt which would have more than twice the protein, less sugar and fat, and less calories.

I have had all three Belvita flavors and this is my favorite. I like the blueberry one but compared to the apple it isn't as sweet and the little blueberry pieces seem to stick to my teeth. The Honey Oat didn't have much flavor to me (these are just my personal tastes). The apple cinnamon is downright addictive! This flavor is always running out at my store so I tried ordering them online. They do break somewhat during shipping but not into crumbs, they stay in pieces. It's not a huge problem for me because I break a piece off to eat them anyway. Overall I'd prefer buying them at the store but this works when they're all out.

I love these Apple Belvitas!  You can taste the little pieces of apple in them.  They are definitely my favorite flavor and the apple tastes real and is not overpowering (like the blueberry belvitas).

column9: Sounds like Velveeta, tastes like fake apple
column10: I got a free sample of Apple Cinnamon Belvita from my gym a few months ago but had been avoiding it because I like my weekday breakfast to be less carb-heavy. Plus, the name of this product sounds suspiciously similar to a certain processed cheese substance (didn't anyone catch that in product testing?). At any rate, I was in a pinch this morning so I grabbed my Belvita and ran out the door.The first thing that hit me as I took a bite was the fake-o apple "natural flavor" this thing is infused with. It falls closer to Jolly Rancher than Jonathan on the apple spectrum. Additionally, it's a little sweet for my tastes. However, I was pleasantly surprised by the texture. I expected something too hard or overly grainy, but it actually is more reminiscent of a Biscoff cookie than anything else. And like Biscoff, it made a decent accompaniment to a cup of coffee.Because of the fake-o flavor, I didn't expect this to have any actual fruit in it, but little bits of dried apple kept getting stuck in my molars. Surprise. These are more of an annoyance than an asset, though, since I spent about 10 minutes trying to discreetly pick them out of my teeth with my tongue.Others seem to enjoy Belvita, but it's not really my thing. I have a sample of the blueberry-flavored one I'm going to try as well, but I can't see myself consistently purchasing it.
This is the best hard mint candy in the world.  Expensive, though.  I can't find it in stores.  Anyone know where I can get it off-line?

I never write reviews but felt compelled to write one of this item. I would say growing up I was a big fan of Otter Pops. These I consider Otter Pops times a hundred. They are pretty damn tastey and quenches your thirst. Awesome product.
We recently used these during a football game.  This is a great product as it not only contains electrolytes but is tasty as well.  I plan on using these for future games, workouts, and runs!!

We've used the other Sqwincher products for years at our company and so already liked the product. Returning today from working on the roof I opened our office refrigerator freezer and was surprised to see a stack of these already frozen and ready to try. Excellent - especially after being in the hot sun on a glaring roof. These truly are good. Three ounces is 90mL and each one is 45 calories of minimally food-colored mouth re-watering pleasure. I had the Mixed Berry flavor and I highly recommend them.

I bought these for my disabled daughter. She has trouble keeping food and liquids down and I was buying gatorade and powerade for her. My son is a construction worker and in this extremely hot summer his construction job started handing these out to prevent heat exhaustion and heat stroke. He brought one home to his sister and it did more to improve how she felt than all of the gatorade and powerade. It contains potassium and other electrolytes that the aforementioned products do not have. And they taste a whole lot better according to her. I started looking for a place to get them and found them at Amazon. Thank God for Amazon. I now purchase them in boxes of 150 and she benefits from them greatly. She tries to get 3 a day in and can tell a great difference if she doesn't get them all in.
I love these. at less than .50 ea. well worth it for the flavor! i. highly recommend these. they put Otto Pops to shame!

Have a very very picky food and drink child, and that includes freeze pops, I needed to find something with electrolytes, so took a chance on these, though they are a little pricey, He actually liked and ate them, so it is worth it. I will continue to buy them.

column9: Hubby loves these, especially on hot days!
column10: I got these for my husband who is a mail carrier. He tried one that a customer gave him and loved them-especially for hot days! I personally have not tried them, but he raves about them so...They are a bit pricey but work just like Gatorade :) Not your regular freeze pops!

Maybe they should call these "Ice-Pop-a-Buzz"!  Wow!  After receiving these via Amazon, I place a few of the selected flavors in the good ole' freezer.  Honestly, I didn't expect much.  Being an ole' southern boy, I figured another popcycle that would do nothing more than cool me down.  Hmmmmm....cool me down...gotta' have that in these dog hot "July days".  So, I tried one the next day.  Wowzers!  You, the reader, may not believe this but not only did it "cool" the engine, but geeze whiz "gosh-all-mighty" I felt a buzz!!  Now, I am not sure how to explain that but it was actually a high feeling!  Call it the sugar of 11 grams, or maybe the electrolytes just grabbed me.  Whatever it was I felt a freaking "buzz"!!  And, it stayed with me not just a moment or two, but for a good little bit!  Energized to say the least this ole' southern Coach was!!So, I thought maybe it was just me.  Well, later in the day, my son had one.  Folks, I didn't say anything, and about 5 minutes after he finished, he said hydrated and "ready to go"...in other words, he felt the immediate BOOM "pop-a-buzz" feeling as well!Wow, I know all the above sounds crazy.  Yet, never before with any of the other "cheap" type pops have I felt such a sensation.  And, with every single one I eat...same thing!  Errrrr....thanks Sqwincher for getting me addicted!!!As for the box, I should mention, it arrives in several flavors1) Cheery2) Lemon Lime3) Mixed Berry4) Orange5) GrapeI can only imagine, being a Coach myself, how these things may very well "take off" in athletics.  I already have plans to serve during halftime just like the good ole' sports drink we have all seen :)Bottom line is you very well are going to love these pops...For me, well, just call me crazy for the Ice-Pop-a-Buzz!!!  I am hooked!
These contain electrolytes and its what I crave  Some may ask me what is an electrolyte and I say it's what I crave. For what it's worth I think plants crave electrolytes as well.

column9: A joke as an electrolyte replacement or for hydration
column10: These look fine as freezer pops and I have never tried this product, but I looked at the nutrition information on the Sqwincher website which indicates they contain, per pop:3oz water1% sodium (does not say how many mg)15mg potassiumdoes not show other electrolyte levelsBy way of comparison, I have a tube of nuun on my desk.  When dissolved into 16oz of water (the recommended concentration), one tablet of nuun provides:16oz water14% sodium (345mg)6% magnesium (25mg)2% potassium (97g)If it's important to be hydrated and replenish electrolytes, this looks like a terrible product.  I'm giving this a 1 star review because if someone is engaging in a strenuous activity where you care about replenishing hydration and electrolytes, you need something that actually accomplishes that and this product claims to without actually doing it.  I'd recommend gatorade, nuun, or even just a glass of tap water because the electrolyte levels in these pops isn't high enough to really distinguish itself from water.

column9: "This Tea should get the Nobel Peace Prize"
column10: This is a very good tea as far as teabags go...traditionally loose tea is always better quality than teabag teas, But this is the exception...being organic as well as the least processed compared to other teas(White tea is the least processed of all teas)...teabags impart a subtle paper flavor that loose teas are free of...these bags are a cut above other teabagged teas(the subtle teabag flavor is less of a factor in this instance)... and are an excellent choice in leu of saving money...It took about six weeks to finally get delivered, but it was worth the weight...This one is a no brainer...!!!

column9: such a special gem, this one!
column10: after reading the other reviews, i'm confused and don't think that anyone was talking about THIS TEA! (sounded like most comments pertained to prince of peace green tea, and don't have anything to do with the instant dong quai and red date tea that i clicked on...that being said, this is a remarkable tea...it's delicious, it's instant (so you don't have to wait for it to steep) and it's really good for you...i just love the taste of this, but then again - i enjoy the uniquely-bitter flavor of dong quai (but this isn't bitter, it's yummy!)...for those who don't know, dong quai is considered to be "ginseng for women" beceause it's very high in vit B12 and helps to keep women from becoming anemic (due the their monthly cycle)...it also is said to help regulate irregular periods, when used on a daily basis...that said, this tea is special because it helps to "draw one's energy" downwards (and the red date, adds to this effect in that red is the color of the 1st chakra)...in other words, this tea has aphrodisiac qualities and will create pleasnt feelings when taken before bed (and it's "good for you" and it tastes good and it's a snap to make)...so what's there to be quibbling about?

column9: After at least a year drinking this tea, some thoughts.
column10: My household has this tea stocked up at all times.. not to say it's my favorite tea, but it's my favorite day to day tea. We tend to drink Green Tea for its health benefits and as Green Teas go this one is affordable and fairly high quality for tea bag types. A few notes.. you have to be fairly careful about steeping this tea, it doesn't have a whole lot of tolerance from "crisp and delicious" to "overpowering and slightly off-putting". I guess I attribute that to the freshness of the tea. I'm not sure. I've had a lot different results with loose tea in a ball and some herbal teas. While this tastes good when you get it right, if you forget the cup for a few minutes, it's not forgiving. That said, that's the only real drawback to this tea. Yes. I've had teas I would rate five stars, six if I could. Yes, they also cost 5-6x more than this easily for a quarter of the amount of tea. Bottom line, if you drink a lot of tea, this is a good brand to buy. If you don't drink a whole lot and would rather buy something really high quality for the few times you do partake of it, I'd look elsewhere.

This tea has a wonderfully strong ginger flavor.  The bags come individually wrapped in foil packets.  It steeps fast and the resulting mug of tea is murky and delightfully aromatic.  I love it and will undoubtedly use every bag in the next month or so.  The one thing I think anyone buying this product should be aware of is that they add stevia to the bags.  I am usually not a fan of stevia (to me it has a bitter aftertaste) but it was not overwhelming here.
Purchased this tea because of recommendation. Product arrived well packaged and quickly. I am very pleased with this product and will purchase it again.
I have tried this product before and I really love it. The price is fair and I enjoy it...

column9: Good tea wish it came in loose tea too.
column10: I am sensitive to Caffeine and supposedly the White teas have 1/3 approx. what Black teas contain. And about half of what the green teas contain. This probably varies all over the place however. Often a decaf tea isn't. If you want no caf you need to look for caf free teas and drinks. Look on the net this item is cheaper as are all the Prince of Peace items else where even after paying shipping which is usually reasonable. I hope they don't up the price just because everyone else's white tea is higher. I wish it was available in a loose tea too. A smooth flavored good tasting tea that reminds me of teas I had as a child and at Chinese restaurants. Beats anything I can buy in local supermarkets.I did try the organic version and no way. This one is better for some reason. Stronger and overall a better product even the bag it'self is better than the organic's.
The tea is good and fresh. We enjoy it. The shipping is fast and cost is reasonable.I recommend this product.
You get enough in each package to make a good size cup of drink.  It is consistent in its flavor and the amount you get in each packet.  I have purchased it a couple of times.
If you don't have the time to cut up ginger and boil it for it's wonderful flavor here's an alternative.  This tea is refreshing.  True ginger flavor and punch is wonderful.

I would just like to know if anyone knows if this is a good quality for being a bagged tea.  I'm not a Pu-erh expert and I am looking for something as authentic as I can get without paying an arm and a leg.  Can anyone suggest a good quality??  The only reason I gave this a 3 is because it is something you can find at your supermarket without buying a pack of 3.

column9: The worst 'tea' I have ever tried.
column10: I used quotes around the word tea because I doubt that the bags contain tea.  I wouldn't be surprised if the bags contained ground up sticks instead of tea.  I would not give this product a single star; it deserves zero stars in my opinion.This tool is not allowing me to continue without giving the product at least one star.
Good strong huckleberry smell when opening the can and good strong huckleberry taste once the coffee was brewed. Great product!

column9: Wonderful Huckleberry Coffee! Give it a Try!
column10: After trying a small portion of the huckleberry coffee, I had to buy the larger size. If you don't like flavored coffee, then skip the Huckleberry. If you savor the aroma of a flavored brew, give the Huckleberry a shot. It smells wonderful and tastes even better. It's not as acidic as other brand coffee. It's definitely unique and a great gift for anyone who goes for something different.

column9: great huckleberry coffee as a gift
column10: We received a 2 oz pkg for a gift.  This is one of the most smooth, non-acidic coffees we have ever tasted!
As my Mother-in-law says  MT is Gods' country  I know they know how to make huckleberry coffee good.. Great Job and price  with Fast shipping

I love huckleberries and luckily, the first huckleberry coffee I tasted was wonderful !!  Usually I do not like flavored coffee, so huckleberry coffee is an exception.  Unfortunately, some I have had after that have been disappointing after the first delightful one I tasted.  This one did not disappoint, and I am so glad I ordered it !! Highly recommended for any coffee lover that wants a different, delicious flavor !!
The product is as advertised.  Very good chocolate.  It is a good alternative for those who do not drink coffee.

Why didnt I find these foods sooner????My son is 18m and we are heading out of the country on vacation. I needed something easy to pack especially with the new 50 pound suitcase guidelines. I bought 4 diff flavors and distributed a small amount to each family member to carry for us in their suitcases. And it will be easy to carry in my backpack, all I will need is a spoon. And we tested them out and he loves the taste!

My daughter loves this food, and I love that its organic and made by Chef Tyler Florence.  I alsolove that its made by someone with children.  My little girl eats them right up and its so convenient tohave and keep at grandmas too.
My son LOVES these foods. He has always been reluctant to be fed food because he loves feeding himself. He'll still sit down for a bag of this stuff.

column9: Packaging Leaves Much to be Desired
column10: While the lentil seeds sprouted just fine, I ended up with only about half an order due to poor packaging.I did complain to the Sprout House but heard nothing back. I'll do my seed buying at the store from now on,I guess.

I am a candy bar addict and a sugar junkie, and when I head to the candy bar isle at the local Quicky-Mart I always pick up a 5th Avenue.5th Avenue is a wondeful blend of chocolate, peanut butter and crunch that will leave you hungry for more. 5th Avenue is unlike any other cany bar on the market, and if you've never tried one...do yourself a big favor. You won't regret it! Yum!Some history on the candy bar from Hershey's:William H. Luden (1859-1949) launched his fledgling candy business in 1879 and offered an extensive line, including cough drops, hard and soft candies, chocolates and marshmallow products. Unlike many confectioners during that time, Luden manufactured his own chocolate for his chocolate novelties and chocolate-coated candies. In 1936, he introduced the 5TH AVENUE candy bar, a milk chocolate bar with a crunchy peanut butter center.World War II forced Luden's to concentrate production efforts on Luden's menthol throat drops and 5TH AVENUE candy bars for military use. Immediately following the war, Luden's reverted to producing a full line of confectionery products including the famous Luden's menthol throat drops and 5TH AVENUE candy bar, as well as penny candy consisting of ladyfingers, pillowcases, mint patties, penny jujube novelties, penny hard candy, penny coconut novelties, cast marshmallow novelties, and a line of penny sugar-rolled jellies.Timeline1859  William H. Luden, founder, born.1879  W. H. Luden Candy Company established.1928  Acquired by Food Industries of Philadelphia, a holding company owned by the Dietrich family.1936  5TH AVENUE candy bar introduced.1980  Queen Anne Candy Company, Hammond, IN, acquired by Luden's Inc.1986  Acquired by Hershey Foods Corporation.

Is there really a better bar than this one?  Not sure - Clark bars are awesome too but I really, really love these 5th avenues. Been eating them for years and years and I'm SO glad that Hershey now has them.  Wow, what a perfect marriage!  Highly recommend!

Hershey's 5th Avenue is one of the best candy bars I have ever had the pleasure of ingesting...It's a perfect blend of chocolate, with crunchy peanut that reminds me slightly of a Chick-O-Stick, and also reminiscent of a Reesesticks...I hadn't had one in a long time, and a co-worker had shown me a box of these, and sold me a box of 36 bars for $4.00 at my work!  Amazing price, and a great candy bar.
