Be prepared for full strength licorice, full of flavor and chewy goodness. I loved the texture, just enough firmness without it being a chore to chew. We have to limit intake by putting our supply in a less than handy place to avoid polishing off a whole bag at a time. Store bought licorice fans might have to acquire a taste for the robust favor. It shouldn't take long though.
Man -- these are GOOD! I am Hooked!If you like licorice (I love it) -- you can't go wrong with these little dudes.May need rehab once I go through the whole box --

This 2-pack is an economical way to purchase this British import.  Horlicks was a "staple" in our house back home - one of those "comfort" drinks for cold winter nights.  I haven't found too many places to purchase it here in California and when I do find it, it's not inexpensive.  I haven't found an American equivalent - similar, but not close enough.  So, for me, this is the best way to buy my old favorite.  The product arrived well packaged in a timely manor.  I will continue to puchase Horlicks this way.

column9: Price is comparable to Asian imports but has packaging flaws
column10: This two-pack package totals 1600 grams, which is equivalent to more than 4.5 jars of (350 grams) Horlicks imported from some  licensed Asian manufacturers.  So in terms of price, this UK original import is comparable to the Asian import.  There is a small difference in the ratio of the ingredients, and my picky son can tell the difference (he preferred the taste of the UK version in a "blind-test").When I opened the package, I was alarmed to find some sprinkles of Horlicks power on the surface of the bottle.  I removed the shrink wrap of the bottle, and then opened the plastic cap.  To my surprise, the tin seal inside the plastic cap was broken.  Because the outside shrink wrap of the bottle that covers the cap was intact, so the power leak is not the result of a tampering act but a malfunction of the packaging process.  I will update my comments if the second bottle has the same problem.

I bought the lite version during my last trip to London, at one of their local supermarkets. When I ran out, I came here to Amazon looking for the replacement. In the absence of the Lite version, I got this one. The price is very good compared to what I paid in London. The taste is as good, but I noticed it requires more of the powder to achieve the flavor I want. But I'm not complaining. At this price I was able to buy 2 large ones. So, I'm happy. Now, if only they had the lite one I'd order it, because I feel quite guilty having this hi-calorie drink right before going to sleep. Aside from that, it is quite a treat to have. Certainly a comfort drink before going to sleep.

A million times better than the average "malted milk powder" you find in the grocery store. Tip: Never insert a wet or even slightly damp spoon into the jar or the contents will be hard as a rock the next time you want some. You can chip that out and eat it but it is not easy to get out!I am glad to have found this available on Amazon as I have only ever found it in British speciality shops which are not in my area. I have heard that it can be found in some stores in other states.

Horlicks used to be used in making malts in the old days, however they sold the company to a place in England, and they changed the taste.  Does not taste good for making an old fashioned malt, and is hard to mix by hand.  However it does make a good drink with milk hot or cold.

column9: Great concept but doesn't last too long
column10: I like the concept of this toy w/these rawhide strips but they are very expensive and after much wear on the toy the rings do not stay on well so they do not last very long.  Yes, my dogs are big agressive chewers but I was thinking the toy would last a little longer.  The strips are kind of thin so they are finished with it in about 10 minutes.

column4: Traci Freeman "Whip Cream luvs Roller Derby"
column10: I have two Chi's and they LOVE the rough rawhide ones but they ignore the smooth ones.I bought the two of the toys that these rings go with and they could care less about those.  I just give them the ring and they toss it, chase it and chew it.  I only wish they sold a pack of only the rough rawhide.

column9: Picture that Amazon had online was not the product I got.
column10: Amazon had an older picture of this product online.  There were more in each package that was pictured and different types.  What I ordered and what I got were different. What I got was overpriced for what it was.

We got our little Abby a month ago, she is a Jack Russell.  We went crazy buying toys and such.  I saw this toy on Amazon and got one for her, not thinking much about it, but it is her very favorite toy!  We got two more for our other dogs, but they really don't get to play with them, Abby swoops in and takes them before they hit the ground. I just ordered 5 more refills so I could get one free.  You really can't go wrong with this toy.

My dog gets pesky and there's nobody else to entertain him. When I went into the local pet store and asked for a busy box for my 100# lab mix, they sold me the Bouncy Bone. It took my dog less than 10 minutes to figure out that he could just grab the ring with his canines, while pinning the ball to the ground with his paws on the nylon bone on either side, and just using brute force to pull the ring until it snaps off. Gone in less than a minute. He's not interested in chewing on the nylon ends, and he could care less about that large heavy ball. Can't say I blame him.I started cutting thick chews in half and drilling a hole through the center, larger than the core of the toy. Sandwiching the gnawhide ring between the pieces slowed him down considerably, since he had to chew through a substantial amount of rawhide to get to the gnawhide.My next investment was the Bristle Bone (uses the same rings). If you haven't completed your toy purchase, get this one. It cleans their teeth, massages their gums, and conceals everything but the edge of the ring. Within 5 minutes he had cracked the middle piece that houses the bristles with his powerful jaws. The toy is still usable, although it does lose bristles. However, it only slowed him down by a few minutes.Now I cut 3/8" off the outside of the rings, and cut that into smaller pieces to hide between the bristles on the other side, and use as special mini-treats. (I'm too cheap to use more than one ring at a time.) By doing this I am assured of at least 30 minutes to two hours. He's also pretty worn out from all the licking and biting.

column9: Pet treats, baby food, supplements from China not SAFE!
column10: China recently refused to let the FDA inspect pet treat manufacturing facilities.  [...]There is no inspection, legal system, or quality control to make sure you do not give your pet toxic rawhide if the rawhide is made in China.  There are other treats on Amazon that are American or European made--buy those.I threw out the rawhide rounds and cut pieces of US-made, no toxic chemicals rawhide into rounds to slide on this.  I put edible toothpaste (liver flavor--yum! yum!)on the bristles.  It is keeping my dogs' teeth much, much cleaner.  Great product, but dangerous to give your dog rawhide from China.  Over 6000 pets have died just from jerky treats alone.
My puppy loves these.  Too bad she devours them so fast but she enjoys doing it.  Wish the holes were standardized.  Some don't fit the toy.

I have been having good luck with these with my two lab mutts.  I load a couple into a Busy Buddy for each of them and they love them.  I think it helps to keep them busy and out of trouble while I'm away.My only gripe is that they're made in China, and I really have a hard time feeding my dogs something made in China (remember the pet food recall, lead paint in toys, milk debacle, etc..).  Hopefully I can figure out a recipe to copy these things because they do work well.

Jack is a 3.5 year old papillon.  He enjoys chewing.  I found this product years ago and he still enjoys it today.  It's pet friendly and entertains him for the time he takes to chew.  Recommended for any canine that enjoys exercising his jaws!

My dog loves this toy.  She can go thru a few of these in a day if we let her.  The only problem is that she figured out how to chew them off the toy in about 1 minute.  So we tend to go thru a lot of them.

This is great to keep your puppy or older dog busy. We have 3 dogs ranging from 18 month, 8years and 12years.  Our mistake was only buying 1 bone which we will soon rectify.  They all love this. It will keep the puppy busy for at least 30-45 minutes. I would definitely recommend this product.

I previously bought the medium size of this product. I don't put it in it's bristle boy, my chihuahua loves the rings just a they are. For such a tiny dog, she's a powerful chewer. The picture of the smaller gnawhide rings looked like they were the same diameter just thicker. NOT--they are teeny-tiny. She'll be eating them, but I'm pretty disappointed in their size. Personally, I'd love the medium rings to be thicker so they'll last longer than 10 minutes!

This was a big shocker.  I got one a piece for my two dogs.  They went absolutely nuts over these things, as if they were getting a hot dog.  I used to buy them all the time until we left the toys behind on a vacation.  The dogs loved the jerky rings but not so much the cornstarch rings.  I would put the cornstarch rings on the outside and the jerky rings on the inside.  Somehow they would eat the jerky completely without touching the cornstarch.Its a good toy and treat to keep them busy and out of trouble.  The treats a fairly cheap as well as the toy.  These might be a bit big for small dogs but I strongly recommend them.  Great treat/toy.

Our two 65 pound Dogs just love this treat on their bouncy bones. Wonderful when you have to leave them and they need something to keep them busy. They just love them and we have used them for over two years now. Our daughter is using the product for her new boxer mix.

column9: Makes my dog fart like a skunk
column10: My dog loves to chew on these, but dang, they give her the worst gas I've ever smelled in my life, and it goes on for hours. They probably don't cause the same reaction in all dogs, but I won't buy them anymore.

This toy keeps my 7 month old husky/german shepherd mix fully engaged for about 20 minutes. We have to prevent her from running, jumping and playing while she recovers from a soft-tissue injury. It's very hard to keep this highly energetic and curious puppy from running around the living room out of frustration and boredom while she heals. The Busy Buddy Bouncy Ball really holds her attention and seems to burn up some of her excess mental and physical energy. She seems calmer afterwards. I can shower, get the laundry and do other chores out of her sight as long as she has her Buddy to play with. The rings are a little pricey, so I don't know if we'll continue to use it after she has healed. But for the next 3 weeks, we are devoted to this toy. I'm going to order a bunch of refill packs right now, so we don't run out! (Caution: 4 rings in 1 night seem to cause loose stools.)
My Scottie loves this toy!!!!  It keeps him busy for about a half hour and by then he has both of the rawhide thingies off of it...he goes nuts when you give this to him...it's like doggie catnip!!!

My dog Brooklyn loves this doggie chew.  He's now master it, and it would take him about 10 minutes to take it apart.As a CAUTION, these rings must be used with the Busy Buddy Toy.  Dogs can swallow this ring as a whole and it can lodge into the esophagus or intestine.

This is my dog's favorite toy.  The rings are edible and not the least bit "bad" for him.  The Busy Buddy was actually recommended to us by his trainer since he's a "strong chewer", and she was right!  It's durable and keeps him occupied for at least 30-45 minutes when he has his fresh rings.  We'll be continuing to buy these as long as he can chew.  :)

Our vet friend gave Busy Buddies to my dogs for Christmas.  What a life saver.  These things keep them busy for hours.  They love chewing on them and they drag them out in the yard to chew on them some more.When I need to be busy and can't keep my eye on the dogs, I give them their Busy Buddies and it keeps them out of trouble while I do what I have to do.Thanks for creating such a wonderful product.

This product makes a chew treat last longer when it is used withPremier Busy Buddy Bouncy Bone, Medium. The combination keeps my dogs active for an extended length of time without the need to treat often.
My pet is extremely satisfied with this product and I have ordered again and will order in the future.

column9: something to keep your Jack Russell busy for a while
column10: The Gnawhide Rings are an excellent distraction for your Jack Russell; also works as a healthy (relatively) snack.
Excellent product. My dog loves these rings and devotes his full attention to his Busy Budy Bone when I put the rings on it.

We picked up the first Busy Buddy Bone at a Greyhound meet'n-greet in Philadelphia, although our boy is a Beardie. It became his favorite immediately. By itself, it's just a good little chew toy, but the edible "Gnawhide" rings make it "new" each time. Beardies need a lot of grooming; daily in fact. This is his reward for enduring his nightly torture.
My one year old pup absolutely loves these things with or without the Busy Buddy Bone.  Of course, he spends much more time with it when they're on the Busy Buddy Bone.
My dog loves these rings, he'll work and work to chew them off until their gone usually with in ten minutes.
These are great to distract/redirect chewing puppies but they like the "rough" type one way better than the smoothe one

I don't write reviews very often -- only if I'm either very thrilled with a product or very disappointed.  In this case, I'm thrilled! :)  We just got two German Shepherd puppies -- and have tried numerous chewtoys, Kongs, etc -- but the Busy Buddy is the favorite!  I found that the pups like the rough rawhide rings better than the smooth ones... but they just chew the rough ones first & then go for the smooth.  This bone keeps them occupied for quite a while -- and they'll keep gnawing at it to get the last little bit of the ring off.  I found it lasts longer if you screw the toy together tightly -- that makes it more challenging for them to get the rawhide off.  Great toy!

When used with the Premier Busy Buddy Bone, these rings are great for keeping the dog busy! The bone can also be used alone, but adding these rawhide rings provides a lot more fun. My dog loves them! And Amazon is a great store to find them for low price and free shipping over $25.
We give these to our dog when we go out. It's the only thing we've tried that she will stop everything and start munching!!!!

I purchased the Busy Buddy Bone over a year ago for my hound dog (puppy at the time). I've purchased the inserts more than once because of her teething and it's a lot less expensive than buying rawhide bones every day.  It seems to calm her.  She is now over 60 lbs and when it's time for her to sleep she always has her bone with her.  I like the product, but I can't find it anywhere but on line in the area I live.

column9: Busy Buddy Gnawhides Great for my Dogs
column10: My dogs love the Busy Buddy Gnawhide bones.  The bones keep them occupied and happy for a while when I'm busy and can't give them the attention they want.

These work best as refills for the Busy Buddy Bouncy Bone, so if your dog likes the Bone these work great as refills for the chewy part of the toy. My Boxers don't really play with the Bouncy Bone, so I gave these to them as a treat and they love them-altgough they eat them in seconds and so aren't very ecomical!

My dog is the brainiac type.  No stuffed animals or balls for him.  He'd rather take apart a plastic bottle or a remote control.  I knew I'd have a hit on this toy and I sure do!  He's built up his speed to get the rawhide rings off the spools, but he's still interested in it and can't wait until I reload it.  Just be sure to remember which size toy you purchase...I accidently bought the wrong size replacement rings.  Luckily, they work at all sizes, but the treat after all the effort on his part is not the same.  Better than a Kong, which I'll probably be donating to the shelter dogs who would settle for less.

These Premier treats are made for the Buddy Bouncy Bone. We call them the pepperonis and my puppy gets one on the Bouncy Bone every night before bed to calm him done a bit and he just loves them!! In fact after two nights he really started craving them before bed and asks to get down to our bedroom not to sleep but for his pepperoni!!Doing two at at time can be expensive but one on one side to the bone is just right!!
This is one of our English Springer Spaniel's toys. He loved it even more when I bought these refills for the toy. They do go pretty fast, but overall I highly recommend the toy and refills.

when i read the description of this product it said "no added sugar"so i purchased it thinking it had NO ADDED SUGAR. but the ingredientslist 'high fructose corn syrup'. this is just down right devious to describe the product as having no sugar added but have hfcs in it. they didn't let you see the ingredient label online and then it's not returnable to boot. it's an out right royal rip-off and i am very HIGHLY dissatisfied with the whole transaction!!!!!

column9: THERE IS NO FLAVOR AT ALL... DON'T BUY
column10: I have been looking for a Hazelnut Flavor... this is not the one... When I got it I was really happy hoping finally I was going to be able to bake with a wonderful hazelnut flavor... but when I opened the bottle I found out that what I had was something like plain water... NO FLAVOR OR SMELL AT ALL... so now I have 4 bottles of nothing!!!! I am really disappointed.I don't usually write reviews, but this one really deserved my time... Please please don't buy... Look for something else!!!

I have been giving these treats to my two shelties(Nina and Jacob) for 7 years now and they just love them. I used them for training and for "love you" rewards. They are just the right size for multiple treating and bed time snacks without creating an overweight problem. I purchase them in the 20lb boxes and transfer them to sealed dog food storage containers which extends there shelf life considerably.

First Impression: Old Mother Hubbard Dog Biscuits are a great treat for the value and are made with wholesome ingredients. A large bag of the small biscuits lasts for weeks. Dad puts them in my Kongs, Everlasting Treat Balls, and Gatorade Bottles.Conclusion: Dad says they are well worth the money. They keep me entertained, they taste good, and Dad says they are healthy.

column9: A Horse Is a Horse Is a Snack, Of Course
column10: My dog is constantly out to get me. Keeping little miss 'Princess Paws' from rooting through the trash, diddling the carpets or wrecking the house is like trying to keep Lindsey Lohan out of dive bars, crack dens and paparazzi mug shots. In other words -- nearly impossible.But lord help me, I try.I bought a bag of these biscuits, thinking I could coax the mutt into good behavior through 'positive reinforcement'. Though the idea sort of fizzles when the dog is too finicky to eat the stupid things. She gave the tiniest of disinterested exploratory sniffs, then scrunched her furry little schnozz like I was offering her a handful of barf-encrusted crap.(Which, based on her previous dietary choices, she would actually eat. Tasty baked tidbit? No, thanks; I'm trying to keep my greyhoundish figure.The poop du jour in half-digested BLEEEH-rnaise sauce? Mmmm-mmmm! Bon appeturd!)I tried to entice her, but she wasn't having it. I even tried a little nibble myself, to prove I wasn't trying to poison her. (Yet.)And actually, the biscuit was pretty good. It's got a nice crunch, with a taste somewhere between a heavy water cracker and reconstituted horse meal. But pretty light on the 'horse meal' part. All in all, not bad. I'd give it about a four on the people-food scale -- somewhere between a stale bag of Funyuns and a plain rice cake eaten off a sweaty Clydesdale's back. I finished the first one and had another. Pretty soon I'd gone through half the bag.So this was a complete waste for the dog. But I found a new snack for TV nights. Now if I'm out of popcorn, I set out a bowl of biscuits and munch away. They're not gourmet. But they're filling, and I'm getting my recommended daily allowance of hoof meat all in one sitting. That's a winner.
Nice small size treat that helps my big dogs watch their waistline and stay healthy.
Brownie loves these, all the flavors are delicious to him.  He chose these biscuits over the Buddy biscuits and the Wellness Bites. These are also more affordable than the other 2 brands.

My doggies snubbed these biscuits initially (they always act that way) before they decided that they didn't really mind them, in fact they kind of like them...now.These are made with natural ingredients, but they do have wheat flour and oatmeal and so I don't give them too often. I don't really like giving my dogs wheat.I prefer Natural Balance L.I.T. Limited Ingredients Treats over these, but this is a good product too.
My dog loves these and they're great little cookies for a treat when she gets in from going to the bathroom.
These are low-fat, low-cal. I have never seen a dog who didn't love them. I believe they are made by the same folks who make Wellness -- which is excellent dog food.

I purchased these for my home-bound mother to have on hand when people, accompanied by their various sized dogs, visit her.  She can give the huge labs multiple small biscuits and the tiny doxies one.  There was no need for various sized treats.  The service was excellent as usual and the quality of this product is excellent.  No imported ingredients.
I've tried many different types of "natural" biscuits for my dog that has allergies.  These are by far, his favorite!

Old Mother Hubbard makes great snack for dogs, however, it seems that at least 25% of the busquits are broken & in "tiny" pieces.Guess next time I'll buy them locally, even tho they'll cost a bit more.

Got two bags of these for my dog.  For some reason they make him have to go poo almost instantly.  Tried two different flavors and the both make him sick.  He does not normally have intestinal issues.  I'm going back to regular milk bones or zukes.

There was nothing wrong with these bisquits other than the fact that they stated clearly "Small Original Assortment" on the description, but when the package arrived, it was for Large Dogs.  I have pugs and they were too big for them.  I ended up having to break them all up to feed it to them.  Please ensure for future reference the description matches the product pictured.  Thanks.Old Mother Hubbard Crunchy Classic Snacks for Dogs, Small Original Assortment, 3-Pound 5-Ounce Box
My dad loves allsorts and says that it's just like what he would buy when he was a kid (he's in his late 70's....).  That's the perfect compliment in terms of quality of the product!
Love Allsorts? stick to the full size version from the UK to get unique taste and quality of this candy.

We stopped into this cute bakery on a recent trip to San Antonio where it is located.  We bought a loaf of their gluten free white bread for our 8 year old recently diagnosed with Celiacs Disease.  He loves this bread!  When I made him a grilled cheese he said it "tastes just like a real grilled cheese!"  It has a great taste and NO BITTER AFTERTASTE as is commonly the case with other gluten free breads we've tried.  Unfortunately, it is much more expensive(about $2.50 more when buying a single loaf)than the Udi's Gluten Free White Bread we usually buy at our local grocer BUT, in its defense, the loaf is much bigger than an Udi's Gluten Free White Bread loaf (my son calls Udi's toy food sized bread).  A slice of this Little Aussie Bakery White Bread is the closest in size to a regular slice of bread that we have found since he got sick.  I wish we lived in San Antonio because I would love to be able to buy him this bread exclusively but with the expensive price per loaf and expensive shipping ($9.99 for 1 loaf) we just can't afford it:(

column9: Puree is great - getting it was another matter
column10: First of all, the puree was fabulous, and it was wonderful to be able to find something like this which is very difficult to find even in the specialty grocery stores. That was amazing.However, that being said, it took forever to get the product. It was shipped by way of the moon and came into Illinois and then left Illinois (where it was supposed to be delivered). It even changed shipping carriers. It was (finally) supposed to be delivered by UPS and on their web site it showed one failed attempt. The problem was that people were home, no one tried to ring the door bell, no note on the door, nothing. Called the post office, they said they would try to re-deliver it the following day. Ok. Stayed home the next day. Nothing. No note, no one ringing the door bell, nothing. Looked on line and the UPS site said 2nd attempted delivery. Called the post office again, complained, they said they were sending the package back because no one was home to sign for it. They finally agreed to a third attempt, and I stayed home from work for a third day (ugh!). Still no one bothered to ring the door bell - they just left the package on the door step.What a nightmare.

I use this pure regularly to make mont blanc, which I regard the king of all deserts. A unique feature of this product that it contains rum, which is missing from many competing products. It is also of ideal consistency for being pressed into vermicelli. You really only need to press it and add whipped cream. That's it.The mont blanc is NOT a healthy desert by any means, but it is the best.
I love this chestnut puree. It is the best one I tasted since moving to the US. I just ordered several from [..] since their price and shipping charge is lower compared to Parthenon Foods.

This is the best coffee ive ever had: hands downoily, aromatic, dark beansopening the bag was a pivotal moment in my life.  the aroma hit my like a sack of brick.  i wanted to roll around in a pile of these beans.the coffee i brewed was even more amazing.  the perfect medium body: the coffee i had been searching for.  oh how many other coffees i had tried before finding the blue mountain beans!!!i would just love to drink this everyday of my life, however the price excludes this reality.dont kid yourself, dont keep yourself away from this coffee.  try it at some point in your life.  have your friends over and share the experience.5/5

This Jamaican Blue Mountain is high quality, fairly fresh, and roasted perfectly. It has the characteristic smooth taste and acidity of JBM. It is a true "evening" coffee. A nice touch was that it is delivered in a vacuum seal bag with a heavy duty zip-lock on it, so it seals tight - just make sure you roll the air out of it when sealing it shut. I call it "fairly fresh" because, although the description says "roasted fresh immediately prior to packaging," I would question if they sit in the Amazon warehouse a long time due to the dryness of the beans we recieved. Keep in mind it is normal for lighter roast beans to be dry, but these were a tad extra dry. It is a good quality coffee though, and it gave us an experience that was close to when I roasted fresh.

What I received had a sour smell and, while the taste is fine, it's not the JBM that I have had before.  It is not nearly up to the calendar of other fine coffees I drink and certainly not worth the price paid.  Perhaps it was just the batch I received, but I can't recommend paying this price for this coffee.

column9: Best Jamaican Blue Mountain I ever had
column10: I used to buy the monthly Gevalia coffee shipments, and I had Jamaican Blue Mountain from them, but this was truly enjoyable.I found the Gevalia to be crap, but I wasn't certain whether that was Gevalia or Blue Mountain.This coffee was truly enjoyable, and I can now see what the hype is about.  IT has a delicate, yet brute, flavor.  Well worth the money.

This is really top quality blue Mountain beans. They are always fresh, and the quality is very consistant form batch to batch. Obviously, Jamican Blue Mountain is very expensive coffee, but this is as low a price as I have seen for it, and the beans are better than other 'budget' Blue Mountain offerings i have tried.

I purchased this coffee to see what the hype was about.  I was expecting to be blown away; however, I was not.  This was a classic case of too high expectations.  This particular Blue Mountain coffee is a great tasting medium bodied coffee with very low acidity, which I appreciated more and more over the life of the bag.  Once I returned to drinking various less expensive coffee from various parts of the world did I realize how good the Blue Mountain was.  I constantly thought "something is missing" from subsequent coffees.  The bottom line:  I would purchase again - budget permitting.

I received a bag recently as a gift.  Rarely can afford it, so I was glad to get it.  I first drank Blue Mountain 26+ years ago, it has always been my (very infrequent) favorite.  If you grind and brew these beans the correct way, you'll have no reason to complain.  The price is about what I would expect to pay.

column9: If Heaven serves coffee it will be JBM ~
column10: Upon opening the vacuum sealed bag you realize TODAY IS A GOOD DAY. These beans brew peace and happiness . Every little thing is goin' to be alright man. Jah love = Java = JBM . Savor the brew ~

I can not wait to try this so called 100% Jamaica Blue Mountain coffee.  It costs more than other Blue Mountains Coffee - over 50 per pound.  I can find cheaper price by other sellers in Amazon.  I thought it more expensive more tasty...  I am wrong.  The coffee bean is not fresh as what the seller described.  From the paper of the Package , you can tell it has been sit in storage for a while.  .. It is over price and tasted only little better than " regular "  non Blue Mountains coffee.  I purchased it based on the review from other two customers.  They gave it very high review.  Just want to post my opinion - to let other buyer know.  It is not worthy to pay that much money for it.  The true is .. you did paid more than other Jamaica Blue Mountain Coffee.. but be careful .. it does not taste better than others.  Very disappointed !!!!  Over priced !!!!!  Don't buy it.

We purchased one of these at Justice for Girls store.  The stamp is tiny, impossible to read, and hard to use. We could barely get one letter - certainly not a word or sentence.  My 9 year old tried it for 5 minutes and then just gave up.  In effect, we paid a lot for some gun and threw away the plastic case.  What a waste.

Our 10 year old diabetic cat Moo LOVES this food and is thriving on it. Blood sugar is much better, her coat and skin are beautiful and she's acting like a kitten again - racing through the house, chasing her mice, curious and playfulIt's expensive, but worth every nickel.  I don't know how much longer we'll have her, but this Blue Buffalo cat food is making however long it is a joy for all of us.

column9: Much easier to use than whole leaves
column10: I didn't even know there was GROUND bay leaves and from now on I will definitely use this product as it is much easier to add to recipes and I don't have to fish out any leaves when my food is done cooking. I primarily add bay leaves to soups and stews and a special gumbo recipe I make. I love this version of bay leaves!

It's very convenient to use.  You can put a teaspoon or two in everything including meatloaf and casseroles, and it adds a great flavor.  However, because it is in powder form, the flavor is not as bold as leaves.  It can also give your dish olive green color.  I wouldn't recommend this for stock or soup.

column9: I should have thought of ground bay leaves sooner!
column10: I've used bay leaves in stews, roasts and soups for decades, and always had to fish in the pot for them before serving, or warn my family to look for them in their bowls.  I love the flavor that bay leaves gives savory dishes, but it never occurred to me that I could find them ground into powder.  Luckily I found this item for sale on Amazon when I was looking for Cajun Spice.  I got it with free SuperSaver shipping since I ordered over $25.I used these ground bay leaves in a stew over the weekend, and I'm in love!  No more crunchy leaves hiding in the vegetables! I would have normally used 2-3 dried bay leaves, so I added about 1/2 teaspoon of the ground leaves and it was just right.This bottle from McCormick Spice company is 14 ounces, which will last me for years.  It smells fresh and has a nice shaker lid, and I plan to use it from now on.

column9: Moderately priced, will last a long time
column10: Ground bay is great for recipes like my turkey meatloaf and sauces, soups and stews from which you do not want to have to fish out the leaves just before serving.  Inasmuch as I live in a culinary hinterland, it is impossible to find.  My last purchase of ground bay over the internet ended up being flaked rather than ground. Good old McCormick's, however, is definitely ground.  It comes in a size apparently intended for restaurants, so this product will be in your pantry for a long time.  It never gets old on your shelf.

column9: What a difference in the taste
column10: I would have never guessed that there would be as much of a difference in the taste of a Thai dish using this sauce.  I did the same chicken dish using a high quality soy sauce.  Then ordered and received the Golden Mountain Sauce.  Day and night difference in the taste!  Without this sauce the dish was good.  With it it was great.  The vendor shipped it propmtly and at minimal cost.

I did not get the item pictured.  I ordered the Golden Mountain Seasoning Sauce with the green and yellow label.  I received Golden Mountain Sauce with a yellow and red label.  I don't think it is the same thing.  Both products are sold on the site, so I am not sure what happened.

This stuff works wonders!I went through a pretty rough patch in my life. I lost 2 dogs, 1 cat, and my best friend/roommate to cancer all within 2 years.My doctor placed me on Welbutrin but that stuff made me completely insane! 1 day I was angry, 1 day I was completely miserable, 1 day I was unbearably tired. I also had a horrible headache when I was taking it. I felt like was a mindless zombie on Welbutrin. I decided to stop taking the Welbutrin before it settled into my system.I figured I would try and go the more natural route after reading all the side effects of the other anti-depressant medications they have available. I first tried Kira St Johns Wort Tablets - 45 Tablets. These seemed to help, but it was very mild and not consistent in keeping my mood up.Then...there was Nature Made Sam-E. I tried some of the store brand Sam-E's to try and keep costs down, however, none of the other brands even came close to working as good as Nature's Made. And if you shop around you can usually find a buy one get one free at Walgreens, Giant, CVS, or even Amazon for a total of $45 bucks for 76 400mg tablets.This stuff helped me through the roughest time of my life. I've been using Sam-e well over 2 years now and if I even missed one dose I would immediately notice a huge change in my mood. I have been taking 1 400mg pill a day since I started. Once in a while I would take took 2 or 3 in a day.I just started taking 1 pill every other day to give my body a break because I do not like to be dependent on any type of medication. But for those super hard times, this stuff really helped to get me through.I highly recommend trying Sam-E. I prefer the 400mg. They are a better value and work much better. Especially before trying any prescription anti-depressants. It is a natural approach to overcoming depression, has low to no side effects at all (I never experienced any), and even if it does not help with improving your mental health, at least it is supporting your joints.  ;)Hope this helps!

I refuse to feed the dogs anything made in China. These went straight to the trash can. All manufacturers claim to have great inspection standards and control over what goes into their products---so I must this question: Why make something as basic as a dog treat in China? Is it THAT labor intensive to make these? I think not. I think they are made in China because the regulatory bar is so LOW.

I ordered 3 items...dasuquin glucosamine soft chews...I would recommend this product to all dog moms and dads...lamb jerky by zukes...my dog loves them...as for the broken treats, the crackers in the happy hips lamb and rice bag were all in pieces...I was disappointed...of course my dog will gobble them up...she is picky when it comes to snacks and she loves these treats...however, I like to put them in her cookie jar with other treats of the same size...sorry I am picky too...I could only put about 1/3 of the treats in the jar because they are all broken...oh well not the end of the world just a little disappointed...great price on all the products...thankful I can find a deal on dog snacks!

In my opinion, the lamb and rice strips are more digestable for the dogs.  I have two smaller dogs, both have some trouble with different foods.  These lamb & rice are "processed" like a hamburger jerky that breaks into pieces easily and then, in my opinion, digest more easily for the dogs.  The other products, JERKY, is actual strips of duck or chicken jerky.  It is very hard to tear apart and seems to have strong tendons or strips in the treats that would seem to be stringy.All in all, I would rather give my dogs the treat that breaks easily for me and they seem to enjoy without getting sick and/or not eating the next day.  Our Malti-Poo actually has noises coming from her stomach when she eats the thicker, tougher jerky treats.  The lamb & rice is my choice and, if you look close at that treats when purchasing, you'll see what this looks like compared to the tougher jerky treats.

My son works at a golf course and saw these bars in their pro shop...decided to give it a try!  WOW!  He was pleasantly surprised by not only the refreshing energy it gave him but how good it actually tasted (versus many other bars I have bought that he thought were disgusting)!  He not only works at a course, but is an avid golfer...high school team and the rest of the year, as often as he can!  I'm gonna try the 1st tee bars too since this one was such a hit!

column9: Need energy for facing te Back 9!
column10: These are "ok" my personal favorite was the 1st Tee, sold by same co. Both re great though!Had them hen we played Doral, one of our caddies was eating and shared with me! Maybe he was tird of watching me drool.

I really do enjoy these Sesame Honey Crunch.  They're hard like peanut brittle, but easy to bit into.  Because they're small, and wrapped very very well, I sometimes think I'm expending all of the calories just getting the candy out of the wrap.  But they taste great and they're really good at satisfying my craving for something sweet without my going overboard ... at least not too far overboard!

column9: Meh...  We won't order again.  Local quality & price are better.
column10: Shipping was prompt.  Packaging was good.  However, the 'bulk' product was actually more expensive (~$1 or 13% more) and not as good as available locally 'by-the-piece' in downtown Chicago.In addition, we were hoping that there would be nutritional information.  There was not.  Instead, there were 76 pieces in a plain plastic bag weighing 16.1 ounces.So, overall the vendor performed well but there was no value added.Quality Comparison-----------------------The wrapping was similar but the candy is less sweet like it contains HFCS instead of honey and the texture is noticeably coarser and seems to stick to our teeth a lot more.  This made us miss the nutritional disclosures even more.Cost Comparison--------------------Bayside Candy on Amazon = $8.59 / 76 pieces = $0.113Downtown Chicago at Kramer's Health Foods = $7.60 / 76 pieces = $0.10 or about $1 less for the same quantity and we have the flexibility to buy as many or few as we like.In short, we found no advantage and will continue to drop at in the local health food shop and get our sesame treats along with a friendly smile and without the extra packaging waste or wait for delivery.  Amazon's great, but you can't win 'em all.

I've been enjoying this candy concoction since the late 60s. One used to have to go to a health food store to buy it and it came as a larger bar. A fresh-tasting and satisfying snack. Bought from this seller, each pound is packed in a nice ziplock bag which will no doubt keep it fresh longer--not that it's going to be around that long!

column9: If you love Sesame Seeds you will love this candy!
