Since being on the Gluten Free diet he has trouble not having it. Not anymore Pamela's Bread Mix has made it possible for me to make bread for him again. Pamela's Products have become this wonderful sensation to a Gluten Free diet. I hate cooking homemade bread but it was very easy to follow the recipe. I couldn't believe the taste it was wonderful and moist just like regular bread. I know I will buy this often.

column9: Better than the gluten-filled pancake mix
column10: We really love this pancake/baking mix. It makes the best pancakes we've ever had; even better than the regular. They cook up like a dream and when I used it for cornbread it worked exceptionally well. We'll never have the temptation to cheat on the no-gluten diet... as far as pancakes are concerned anyway. I highly recommend it.

This is worth putting on subscription. Works every time in regular bread machine. No need for fancy new machine w special cycles. Just follow directions and use rapid setting, medium crust, large loaf. I've tried 4 machines and every loaf worked. Even family memebrs who don't need to avoid gluten eat this.
THE MIX IS EASY AND ALWAYS THE SAME IF YOU DO WHAT IT CALLS FOR.  I DON'T LIKE THE COLOR OR THE TEXTURE.  MOST OF MY FAM DOES.

I've tried a lot of gluten free bread mixes. This one has a chewy consistency and slightly sweet flavor.  It also works in any break maker.  It's much less expensive to buy it in quantity through Amazon than in a retail store.

I recieve it on time and I was excited to try to make some bread.I set my breadmaker on reg. setting and it turn out perfect and it taste great. I froze some of it, and when I took some out to use later, it was still spongy and not crumbly. The pie crust was good to.

I was a bit reluctant to sign up for the regular delivery of a product, but I realized that I rely on Pamela's bread mix as part of my GF diet.  Not having to mess with my own flour mixes saves me a lot of time.  Plus, the bread is GOOD.  In fact, I'm planning on using the mix to make a pizza this weekend and I'm quite excited about it.

I am familiar with Pamela's Products and have used the bread mix in the past.  The one thing that caught my attention was the price.  By purchasing in quantity the price was greatly reduced.  This mix makes excellent pizza dough and English muffins as well as bread and biscuits.  I used the mix to make a delicious gluten free apple crisp.

column9: Pamela's wheat and gluten free bread mix
column10: We've been using this product for my son with many allergies for almost 1.5 years.  As the manufacture says, it's wheat and gluten free.  My wife makes cakes, waffles, and breads.  And my son always loves it.  Now Amazon has a periodically delivered program with a good discount.  We'll keep purchasing it from Amazon and using it for my son.
This is a wonderful mix that will never let you down. If you can't concoct your own, buy this one. For newly gluten-free households, this (and all Pamela's products) are a true God-send.

column9: Works very well in bread machines
column10: No other brand comes close to being as magnificent as Pamela's for gluten free baking. I use this mix in our bread machine and not only do guests have no idea the bread is gluten free until I tell them, but they all see it is one of the best breads they have ever tasted. It really is the best! I promise that you will never feel you are having to "settle" or that you are missing out on great bread because you are eating gluten free... this mix can change your food life and help you to enjoy bread again!

column9: Finally, a way to make gluten free bread that tastes GREAT
column10: I love this mix so much, I have it on subscription here at Amazon -- see Subscribe & Save, you can even shop just for GF stuff for subscriptions ;-)I make this in my Zojirushi BBCCX20 Home Bakery Supreme Bread Machine set to the "Quick" cycle, light crust color. It comes out completely moist with a medium brown color crust, not a light one - I think maybe GF grains brown at a different rate than wheat?  A couple of caveats:1. This product package has several recipes on the side - very helpful! However, to get it to turn out using the recipe, you have to assume using JUMBO eggs, or you'll need to add some extra egg whites to get the right volume of egg product.2. EXPERIMENT some: You can play around with adding a little sugar or Agave nectar or brown sugar to tweak the taste out the way you like it, but if you use as much as the sweet bread recipe (on side of package) calls for, you'll end up with such sweetness that it really works only as a breakfast or dessert product. You can use cooking oil instead of butter in the recipe for greater moisture, and you can sub milk or soy milk or almond milk for part or all of the water requirements, as long as you don't change the total amount of liquid from the total amount called for in the recipe. Just play around with it some to get it the way you personally prefer it. Get creative and add other stuff like cheeses or olives or nuts or seasonings that you enjoy. Have fun!3. Be sure to remove the loaf from the pan immediately upon completing the baking cycle, and leave it in open air to circulate around it (for instance, on a wire rack or cool eye of the stove) until it is completely cool. This will not harden the crust much at all, but it will prevent premature molding. Then put the cooled loaf into a ziploc bag or other bread container. Doing so gives the finished loaf a shelf life of a week at room temperature for me, even though I currently live in a humid climate (where other GF breads mold in about 3 days). This is important, because GF grains usually aren't bleached, and so they'll mold faster than flours made from traditional gluteny grains like white flour, etc.This is my FAVORITE gluten-free bread mix.  :-)  My friends who don't have to avoid gluten and who typically shun whatever is gluten free actually request me to make this GF bread for them.

column9: Great Product, Great Price but Read the Ingredient List BEFORE Purchasing
column10: I have loved Pamela's Products for many years, and the bread mix is a real hit with my family.  We miss homemade bread, but gluten free baking can be complicated.  I am glad there is a mix that takes care of all the intricate mixing of flour and makes things easy for me.  Putting it together in the morning takes about 10 minutes.  YAY!The taste is really yummy, too.  Soft, moist and even textured - not like the stale bricks that pass for gluten free bread in the store.  We really like this mix and the Amazon price is a real break from the high cost of purchasing it locally.One note about allergens:  Pamela's is GLUTEN free, but not necessarily free of other allergens.  If you have other food sensitivities, be sure and read the latest ingredient list on Pamela's website, or locate a package at your local health food store and read the ingredient list carefully.  Amazon does not always post ingredient lists, and when they do, they are sometimes inaccurate.  I would post the ingredients myself, but companies often change their recipes and I would hate for something I write represent an obsolete formula in a year or two.Anyway, if gluten is your only issue, this could be a wonderful bread mix.  Enjoy!
I haven't had bread for 10 yrs due to Celiac Disease.  Now with Pamela's Bread mix, I can.  It is so good that my non-celiac husband and daughter love it too.

column9: Excellent taste and texture, but not for certain intolerances
column10: This bread mix makes a very dense, moist bread. I really like the taste. It's also very filling and when it comes out of the oven, the smell is appetizing. I love it with cream cheese.Problem: While this is wheat free-gluten free as advertised, commonly wheat allergy/intolerance/etc. occurs along with various sugar intolerances, malabsorption, etc., such as fructose malabsorption. Depending on the type of intolerance, lots of sugars can cause trouble, including honey, fruit juices, brown sugar, molasses, blue agave, maple syrup, turbinado, and even other foods you wouldn't expect, such as onion and chicory. This bread has three offenders: honey, molasses and chicory.So, I'll give it five stars for texture, taste, aroma, ease of use, etc. since it never claims to be anything more than wheat free-gluten free. But for a food that caters to people with food allergies, it's much safer to have an unsweetened bread. After all, the regular wheat bread you're avoiding doesn't have sugar in it, does it? Only dessert-type breads have that. But in any case, I enjoy other foods from this company and I'm glad it exists.

column9: Two years I have been using Pamela's Bread Mix and I am very satisfied.  The bread is easy to make and very tasty.
column10: I have added Italian Seasoning,onion and garlic powderto the batter, very tasty.  Scant on the oil.

Pamela's Products have a place of honor in my kitchen.  This Gluten Free Bread Mix is one of my favorite products.  The bread is delicious and for people who are not concerned about eliminating gluten from their regimen, they will be none the wiser that this is a gluten free product.If you want even more wonderful gluten free products for your kitchen, go to Pamela's website.  It is a Godsend and a Cornucopia of high caliber products that in addition to having health benefits just plain taste good.  Let's raise our glasses to Pamela!  Cheers!
Great versatile flour!  Use it all the time for delicious bread-maker breads for my gluten-free husband. Would definitely recommend it!

I LOVE THIS PRODUCT.  Not only does it have a good price, but "Pamela" also puts a variety of receipes on the bag.  I have tried a number of gluten free bread mix products, and this has been the best!!!
Would like the bread to be a tad lighter, but it is still delicious--especially when toasted.

I've tried many GF bread mixes and ready-to-eat brands and this mix is the best. It's also very versatile and forgiving...I've made it without eggs in the bread machine, even though the pkg cautions not to, and it was just delicious. My grandson asked, "Are you sure this is gluten free?" For a dairy free, soy free, gluten free diet, it's the best, no doubt.

By using the directions provided on the bag and my Cuisinart bread maker, we have had excellent and consistent results.  The bread rises nicely, the crust is a lovely brown.  The texture is somewhat dense, not at all crumbly, and the taste is slightly sweet.  It is very good toasted.  My only complaint is that the flavor is a little "yeasty".  Otherwise, my husband and I are quite pleased.  You wouldn't guess that it is gluten free.

column9: AMAZING--and I'm not even Gluten Intolerant!
column10: First of all, I'm not gluten intolerant, but I saw this mix in the store and was  curious.  WOW, this bread is amazingly good!  I can only imagine those who do have an intolerance what a blessing this would be!  It's simply a great product, and tastes very good, and has a great texture.  Something I've notice people say about other gluten-free breads is how they fall apart, and this bread doesn't seem to have that problem.  My husband (who is a hard sell) and kids loved it too!  I've decided to buy more through Amazon's Subscribe & Save service, since it's quite a bit  cheaper than what I would have to pay in the store.  It's a great product, very easy to use and versatile for other recipes too, which I plan to try very soon.  I also love Pamela's Pancake Mix (it tastes and looks like regular pancakes--you wouldn't guess it was gluten-free) & Namaste Spice Cake mix (also gluten-free) is very yummy!
Being new to the GF world I have tried many products for baking bread.  I'm so pleased with the results of this product. The bread comes out moist and delicious.
This was the 2nd time I tried Pamela's bread mix & it's the closest to regular bread that I have found.  Great Product.
I have made a couple of the recipes for this in the bread machine and get great tasting bread each time.  The loaves are heavier than typical bread but good and easy.

column9: Gluten free, but you wouldn't know it.
column10: We use this with our bread maker.  It is the closest thing to a wheat bread taste we could find.

This really makes great bread that is so close to the real thing.. I have 4 small kids and they all love the new bread we make, Tastes Great!! You do have to slice it pretty thin do to it being more dens, but we are all very happy!!

column9: easy to use, makes tasty bread
column10: This is an easy to use mix for those with little time or are confused in mixing your own flours. It makes a moist, although a little dense loaf of bread. However, it is slow rising. I do like it though as it is good for toasting, sandwiches, etc. Very tasty mix!

This bread has excellent flavor.  If you mix in 1/2 cup of flax flour you get a very rich flavor and bread more similar to whole grain. Results are always consistent, and works well in a bread maker. Many friends prefer the result to wheat bread.  Only downside is the price.

Over the years we've amassed several GF cookbooks each with their own takes on the "perfect" flour blends for this and that.  But in 2010 I've got one word for you:  Pamelas!  The best mix for bread machines I've found, and the instructions on the bag are spot on.  Makes a fantastic pizza crust, cinnamon rolls, and more.  Yum!

I love this product.  It taste wonderful and is easy to make.  The bread remained moist and did not crumble.  I doubled the recipe for the oven baked bread and it came out fine.  I am anxious to try the french bread, pie crust and pizza crust.

I love Pamela's gluten free bread mix!  It is the most moist mix that I have come across so far.  I put it in the bread maker and it comes out wonderful and if I refrigerate the homemade bread it lasts for quite a while.
You can make amazing bread and cinnamin rolls with this mix I have recomended it to all my gluten free frends.

I've been eating GF for about a year and was bread-deprived for most of it. Pamela's bread mix is the best and I'm so glad to be able to buy it for less in bulk!  We make about 2 loafs of bread per week and also use the flour for pizza crusts.  It is so nice to enjoy eating bread again.

We have been a gluten free familiy for years and Pamelas products tend to impress. I like this bread so much that I bought 9 bags of it and took it with me to China where we are currently living. I think it is best made in the breadmaker though... This is a bread that can be eaten as just bread for the first day or two after it is made-- many are best as toast. In response to the notes above, I did not find holes in my bags of flour.

Every year we host the family Christmas get-together at our house. About 6 months ago we discovered that our son & I are both gluten intolerant and the thought of having to bake stuff that everyone could eat AND enjoy without having to make two versions of everything almost sent me over the edge. I used Pamela's Bread Mix & Flour Blend for cookies, brownies, cakes, rolls, crackers ... EVERYTHING ... and all of the "normal" eaters enjoyed the food just as much as my son & I! I'm so thankful Amazon has the bulk bags and the subscribe & save. We already used a lot but now that I've proven just how versatile it can be I know we'll be using even more.
This is an excellent flour mix for bread & pies & cookies. We haven't tried it for anything else yet, but am sure it will be good. The pie crust is light & flakey.
It is nice to have a bread mix for an anti inflammatory diet.  I don't usually like eggs and oil in my bread, but it is better than the alternatives that you can buy.

column9: Gluten free bread that tastes good
column10: So far I have made bread, rolls, muffins and pie crust with great results.  This does not have the dry taste like every other gluten free bread mix I have tried.  It doesn't crumble and fall apart when I make a sandwich.  And the taste is so close to the fresh made wheat bread that I can't have any more.  Next I will be making the cinnamon rolls.  Yum yum!
Pamela's Bread Mix has a slightly nutty flavor.  It is easy to mix and bake with consistent results loaf after loaf.

We have tried several bread mixes.  It seems we have not had good luck with the rising of the bread.  We tried various yeasts as well thinking it could be the issue.  Just doesn't set - we get holes in the interior of the bread.  The bread tastes sweeter too.  I did find when we made bagels or rolls that they turn out good.

I love Pamela's products. I haven't been able to try this product yet to see if I like it yet. I just ordered Pamela's baking mix and bread mix  the other day and it just showed up yesterday and all 6 bags in two separate boxes had two small puncture holes in all the bags in the same spot. The holes had to have been made at Pamela's packaging warehouse because they were packaged in Pamela's shipping boxes. I called amazon and reported it to them and they were very nice and refunded my money. I really hope they fix the problem so i can order the big bag from amazon.

pamela's flour & pancake mix is the best we've ever encountered! We use it for everything! We've never tasted such wonderful pancakes! We think everyone should use it! The price is excellent at Amazon.com, as well![[ASIN:B000NMJWZO Pamela's Ultimate Baking and Pancake Mix, 4-Pound Bags (Pack of 3)

I have tried several types of gf bread mixes with no problems.  For some reason, I can't get this one to set properly.  Every one of the three attempts I had resulted in bread that was wet in the middle.  I followed the ingredients and used my tried and true bread maker.  Each time, the bread was not done inside.  I would not recommend.

I have used the individual bags of Pamela's Amazing GF Bread mix for some time, but I recently purchased the 3-pack of 4-pound bags.  I am very happy to report that the resulting bread is just as consistently wonderful as always.  Many of my non-GF friends have tasted this loaf, and they are amazed at how good it is! I use the stand-mixer-and-oven-baking method (rather than a bread machine), as I often make round loaves or rolls from the mix.  The bread is delicious, the preparation is easy, and now the cost is much more economical for me.  Just so you know (and you can do the math for yourself to see which is the better purchase for your family), there is (almost) enough flour in each bulk bag for 4 loaves, as prepared according to the directions on the back of the bag. Remember that with this product, yeast will be needed to add to the mix, along with eggs, oil, and water.  Using milk (rice, cow, soy) for all or part of the water will result in an even more tender and moist loaf.I have two loaves in the oven right now.  They smell fantastic!

I have used the Wheat Free Bread Mix and then found this in the larger packages.  I purchased it despite the different ingredients list (which isn't correct on Amazon - go to Pamela's Website for the real one).  It was very close to the Wheat Free version.  I love having the bulk bags so that I can take as much as I need.  I used the flour blend to make Apple Crisp this weekend and it was wonderful.  It makes a great bread too.  Another winner from Pamela's Products.

I've tried a lot of gluten free bread mixes, but this one by far has the best taste and texture. It's versatile. I can use the same mix to make bagels as I do for pizza crust and loaves of bread. Going gluten free isn't so terrible, having this product.

This is my favorite wheat-free bread mix. It bakes into a semi-dense, *very* tasty loaf with a toasty color. The crust is light and chewy! My wheat-eating friends and family love this bread even compared to the wheaty varieties out there.It's a tad expensive and you have to get your own yeast for the 4-pound size. I bake a loaf in a bread machine once or twice a week with 10 minutes of kneading, 70 minutes of rising followed immediately by an hour of baking, and although the results vary a bit on humid or dry days, the fresh bread is always delicious.

This mix IS amazing.  I was interested in lowering the calories a bit, so I substituted plain, non-fat yogurt in place of the oil and used the regular oven method.  It worked perfectly.  I like to use English Muffin rings and make 12 buns at a time.  Each bun turns out to be about 120 calories.  Perfect!

This mix makes the best gluten free bread I have tried yet!  There is no "icky gluten free aftertaste" like so many other products out there.  I add a few squirts of honey, a hearty pinch of flax meal and make it in my bread machine every week for sandwiches.  Let the bread cool completely before slicing so it doesn't fall apart and you will be in heaven

I've used a few different kinds of GF flour including Bob's Redmill and Gluten Free Pantry and other rice flours. This one is by far the best in terms of taste and texture for all the baking that I've done with it. I love that it has recipes on the back of the bag for all sorts of breads, bagels, and other baked goods. It even includes directions for use with breadmakers. It's so easy. And the results are tasty. The breads to turn out more dense than non-GF loaf bread from the store, but that's the case with most breadmaker breads. I love this flour - I I have it on the auto-ship option because my husband and I go through so much of it.

Wow, this makes consistently great bread! I have tried almost every recipe on the back and they are all great. The sweat bread is so close to the real thing my friends didn't believe me when I told them it was gluten free. thanks so much to Amazon for the great prices and reasonable shipping.

I read the reviews and so tried a case of this mix....not happy with it at all.  My dog likes it, that's all I can say.  I made the bread in my Emeril breadmaker, which has turned out loaf after loaf of incredibly perfect bread....until now.It is DENSE, and when you slice it, unless you slice it thick, it falls apart.  I had my husband try it, just telling him it was a new mix...he thought it was ok, he toasted it, with lots of butter, so the flavor is apparntly ok.  I will have to try it for bagels or pie crust. Maybe it will work better for that.Other than being at high altitude (and I followed the high altitude directions) I can't thinkof anything else that could have gone wrong. I used the ingrediants it asked for....

Recently my 3 year old was diagnosed with Autism. We have since put him on a gluten-free diet and it is like a miracle!  The one huge drawback was he really missed breads and cakes and cookies.  This product has been a prayer answered for our family.  I just made my first loaf of gluten-free bread following the recipe on the package exactly.  The bread came out soft fluffy and no-one could even tell it was gluten-free.  This will now be a permanent fixture in our home. As if we weren't already thrilled, the cost is very reasonable for a gluten-free product.  I wish I could give this product 10 stars I am so happy with it!!!

column9: Awesome bread!  We don't miss the store bought stuff with gluten! ;-)
column10: When we found out my wife had a gluten intolerance, we thought food as we had known it was gone forever.  WRONG!  We now have superb bread daily from this mix.  I have messed up the recipe a few times (forgot to count on the cups of mix, had too much water, etc) and it always turns out great.  We use a Panasonic bread machine (bought here on Amazon).  I will admit this bread is best right out of the machine and gets dry after a couple days (we store it in the fridge).  We always toast it before making sandwiches and it's good to go.  We now subscribe to this mix every 2 months from Amazon and the price per loaf is awesome.  We started with the single loaf bags and then went to these big boys (save $$$).  One note that we learned from the little bags is to substitute a 1/2 cup of the water with milk.  We like the results.

column9: Gluten-Free - and Feeling Deprived No More!
column10: If you're looking for a gluten-free flour mix that delivers perfect bread every time, look no further.  Pamela's is very high quality, and the best price available is the subscription.  I'm VERY happy with this product, and bake bread with my machine every four days or so - LOVE IT, LOVE IT!  Try it -- you'll see!  If you'd like a recipe I've been perfecting for eight months using this Pamela's flour mix, with tips re yeast, et al, [...].

I ordered this item two weeks ago and started using it.  It is easy to use and the bread was very testy.  I also used other GF mix; they are all strong in bean flour/smell/taste. This mix is a very good with raisins and bread stays moisture for days.  I also use this mix to make chocolate chip cookies and everybody loves it.  Jenny from NY.

column9: Warehouse issues are a problem for this product
column10: My husband has loved bread made from Pamela's Bread Mix ever since we first found it available at a specialty foods store, and we were delighted to learn of its availability in bulk, since he goes through a lot of it over the course of a year. However we have yet to make use of ANY of the bags we purchased from Amazon.com due to the fact that somewhere along the line in the supply process some sort of packing equipment being used managed to puncture every single bag we purchased. All three of the first bags we bought had identical holes in identical locations and were leaking mix out into the box. When we asked for replacements we had to wait several weeks for them to arrive, and when they did the new bags were also punctured in the same spots. Unless Amazon.com, or the manufacturer itself, is able to prompt some sort of better oversight of the equipment used to handle these bags we do not recommend you purchase this product. It's a shame that the warehouse or the operator of the equipment--whichever it is--can have turned out to be such an impediment. We were given a refund for our purchase and have discarded all six bags, unfortunately. So just beware, and check the bags as they come in. These days it seems less than prudent to use any food product that does not come in a fully sealed package.

column9: Finally, bread I can eat without it being so heavy it could break a window
column10: Over the years I have tried many different gluten free flours with pretty bad results! I only wanted to make bread that tasted like bread and wasn't so heavy that I could break a window with it! Finally I tried Pamelas. All I can say is wow! It is so easy to make a loaf a bread in my bread machine that tastes and looks like bread. There is none of the rice flour smell or taste or that gritty texture - I couldn't get over that in many of the flours I had used and although rolls are a little more cumbersome to make, they are so worth it. I make the dough in my machine and then put an icecream scoop of dough into large muffin tins, let it rise and bake it. They are a little more cake like than bread like, but the taste is good. I also add just a little more water then the recipe on the bag suggests - I hate dry rolls.I have also used it to make pancakes and cookies which have come out wonderfully. I tried muffins, but they came out too doughy, although they tasted good.Update - I made cupcakes this week and they were absolutely wonderful. In fact they came out better than ones made with wheat flour! The trick is to add an extra egg to the batter. They were light and fluffy and I ate far too many of them!

column9: Great GF Bread in Economical Packaging
column10: We've tried all the mixes over the years and I have made many homemade mixes.  This is right at the top with the best of the homemade. The only tweak I make is to add  2T bean flour to give it more springiness.Because I have the mix in the large package, I've been able to reduce the amount of mix I use; I use a smaller bread pan with taller sides.  It takes less mix to make a higher loaf than in a traditional pan, so the bread slices are tall as normal bread is. Buying it through Amazon with the regular shipping option makes the loaf price(mix only) go from $5 a loaf for the single package at my local store to $2.50 a loaf for this.

column9: Great for different options in baking
column10: This bread mix is great for many different baking options.  You can make everything from bread to cookies to pizza crusts.  I have used it in place of a flour blend from gluten free cookbooks for cookies, cakes and breads and it works well. I will continue to get this product for a long time.

column9: Why I like Pamela's Bread Mix
column10: I like Pamela's Bread Mix because the whole grains used in this mix makes it more nutritious than those used with white flours.  It is easy to use and produces a good loaf every time.  I also like to bake it in my crock pot, using the baking pan especially for crock pot baking.  The batter breads required for gluten free breads work well using this method.  I mix the dough as per directions for oven baking .  After putting it in the pan I follow directions given in my crock pot baking instructions.  Try it, you'll like it!

column9: Awesome product at a great price!
column10: This is the best bread mix and/or bread that I have found that is gluten free.  This bread mix and flour blend is extremely versatile with many recipes included.  The price at Amazon is the best I have found.  I would recommend this product, and have, to anyone looking for an amazing gluten free bread.
Very good product. Makes bread making very easy. The bread takes a little experimenting for altitude to get the right consistency but comes out very good.

column9: Best gluten free bread, great texture, moist, keeps well
column10: I fell in love with Pamela's wheat free & gluten free bread mix the first time I tried it. Great taste, moist, good texture - no big holes, etc. I mixed this with a small hand mixer, because I don't have a stand mixer which the recipe actually says to use. I still end up with a very nice bread. It is stickier than a flour based bread that you would knead. Because of that I find it hard to get a really smooth top - no kneading, no rolling, to shape. I even took my Mother a slice. She is a white bread person. She toasted the slice and really liked it. It does taste a bit like a whole grain bread, bit of a sweet tasted. The next load I make, I will probably try a variation and add sharp cheese to the mix.I would recommend this to anyone wanting a great tasting wheat/gluten free bread mix.
Excellent,taste is wonderful,wasn't prepared to for the necessity to add yeast.It's not light bread but like I said the taste is great.

We use this for yeast bread, quick breads (like zucchini bread), pizza crust, and pie crust. It is hands down the best gluten-free mix we've found. You can substitute it for wheat flour in most recipes without doing anything fancy, although it helps to add a little extra egg (when the recipe calls for 3 eggs, I add 4).One thing to note is that the dough doesn't rise that much till you put it in the oven, so don't panic about that.

column4: B. Smith "The giant on whoms shoulders your c...
column9: Good for desserts not great for bread or pizza
column10: This is a fairly good GF bread mix but it is WAY sweeter than is necessary. We have used this to make bread and pizza crusts so far. The bread is very odd when used for sandwiches made with lunch meat. The sweet bread contrasts the salty meet in not a good way. That being said, its sweetness adds a pleasant element to PB&J. Likewise, with the pizza, the crust was oddly too sweet. I have yet to make rolls or a cake with this dough mix. I believe they would be a much better application for this mix as the bread seems cakey all by itself. The dough is very messy to work worth but par for the course in the GF world. For bread and pizza crusts, I think I will use some of the more expensive and less sweet mixes that are available. I am going with 4 stars as this product does make good but very sweet products.Now that I've had a few desserts made with this mix I thought I would add an update. So far, I think sugar cookies are the best application for this mix. They have been well enjoyed by all the celiacs and glutenatious people I know. They are slightly cakier than a normal sugar cookie but I don't really find that to be an issue. So for products that are normally sweet any way, this is a good mix. For regular breads and pizza crusts, I still don't love it.

I love this bread.  Because we live in Canada and Amazon cannot ship this item to Canada, I have to drive to the USA and pick up my order at a postal outlet.  And I am willing to do it for this product.I make this bread in a Kitchen Aid stand mixer and bake in the oven.  I have changed the recipe quantities slightly to suit my purposes.  I weigh out one third of the bag and make two (smaller) loaves with this amount.  I use slightly more eggs than the recipe calls for--One time making the bread it came out even better than previously and I realized that the eggs that time were much larger than normal large eggs, so thereafter I increased them.I also let the bread fully rise before baking.  I bake for one hour and it turns out excellent EVERY time, I really cannot imagine how anyone could have a problem with this bread.  Maybe they used bad yeast???  Use fresh, good quality bread machine yeast for consistent, quality results. And ensure that your oven temperature is accurate if you have a problem.The best thing about this bread in comparison to other GF bread, is that you can make sandwiches with it and they are still fresh and tasty many hours later, even after travelling through airports and buses and taxis....  Never happened before!

column9: Amazing?! More like worst GF bread ever!
column10: After reading raving reviews ordered this thru subscribe and save, boy, i was wrong! Followed directions very carefully, (basic white mode in bread maker) it didn't rise, came out very hard and dense like a brick and burnt. Didn't care for the taste, smells weird too. Second time used KA mixer, again, followed directions, baked in the oven, (according to directions: bake for 70 minutes, 350F) , bread was already dark in 40 minutes, after 30 more minutes it would be burnt for sure. Didn't rise, again,  like a brick hard and dense.I used the same yeast to make regular French bread just to check if yeast was fresh enough. Wheat flour bread baked beautifully and was very delicious.I just don't understand all the positive reviews out there, nothing is amazing, it's the worst bread mix ever and I can't even return unopened packages :(I want to try other brand bread mixes.

I was told I was Gluten intolerant. I needed to go on a gluten free diet.I make all kinds of breads, doughs, pie crusts with Pamela flour. I have to go easy with it as it is expensive, but Amazon prices help. Being on a GF diet hashurt my budget, but Amazon helps.

Finally, a gluten free bread that does not taste like stale baking powder biscuits. This moist dough can be made either with a mixer or a bread machine into many products besides a loaf of bread, pizza crusts, hamburger buns etc. Has the texture and flexibility of real bread.

I've been using this product along with several other Pamela's products for about a year and a half. I tried nearly everything else out there including creating my own mixes and haven't found anything I like as well or better than this. Follow the recipes or experiment with your own. It makes gluten-free living a lot more fun.

I have tried many bread mixes that are gluten-free only to be left with a very bad tasting loaf. This bread works on the normal cycle in my bread machine. Do not try to get fancy and use other bread cycles. Just keep it simple and you will have no problem with the bread coming out right. Its easy to make. The flavor is wonderful. It browns on the outside of the loaf beautifully. It's really not hard to get used to having gluten-free bread when this mix tastes so good.  I highly recommend it. I put cinnamon and raisins into the "Pamela's Sweet Bread" recipe on the back of the bag. Its wonderful and smells so good while cooking. My husband's favorite recipe is the "Pamela's Sweet Bread". There are other recipes on the back of the packaging. (Chewy Pizza Crust, Gingerbread Cookies, Easy Pie Crust, Bagels, Egg-Free Bread and of course the basic recipe and the Sweet Bread recipe.  I am ordering from Amazon because the price is cheaper than locally.

Pamela's gluten-free bread mix is the best I've tried so far. I was even buying a loaf of g-f bread from a dedicated g-f bakery. It was good, but Pamela's is much softer and holds together well. It does not dry out after a few days like some of the rice breads I've tried. It also holds up well to freezing. So I can make a couple of loaves at a time and keep one on hand in the freezer.
Delicious homemade bread, no funny after taste. Stays fresh for a while.Easy to make even my husband can do it

column9: do you have celiac disease? bake your own bread!
column10: Pamela's Products Amazing Wheat Free & Gluten-free Bread Mix,  4-Pound Bags (Pack of 3)I need to (I like to) live gluten-free, and I do not like the bread I can purchase. I started to bake my own bread, trying many ways to make it. Pamela's Bread Mix I am stuck with: easy to use, tasteful, and I think you will like it too. You will find many ways to make each loaf of bread a little bit different from the last one: like adding a spoonfull Herbs de Provence, or Italian Herbs, or poppy seeds. Experiment a little bit - you will love it.

Pamela's GF flour products are THE ONLY Gluten Free flours we will use.  We tried practically every other gluten free brand as well as making our own flour blend, and Pamela's Products make the best tasting/textured GF foods.  This makes GREAT pizza crust and pie crust.  We also love Pamela's Baking Mix for pancakes, waffles, cookies, donuts, cakes, etc.  You can find TONS of recipes for the baking and bread flours on the Pamela's website.

column9: My go to Gluten Free Flour~
column10: This Flour I use for just about everything... To coating for Fryed Chicken to Pie Dough and Pizza Crust, and just about anything else I can use flour in... its a must have in my Gluten Free Kitchen, and the Plus is that my Non Gluten Free Family likes it just as much,even more that regular Flour...~ I also Love, Love, Love this Flour Mix won't be without it ~smile~

Great taste. I found the results were better when I covered the loaf  w/foil during the last 20 minutes or so and baked it five minutes longer. The loaf was too moist in the middle and the crust too dark when following the directions.

I bought this bread mix based on the reviews and therefore, expected an amazing loaf of bread. Unfortunately, the bread it produces is too sweet for my liking. It might be great for cakes and cookies, but unless you like sweet bread products, I would not recommend buying this product.
We have been using this bread mix for over 2 years and love it!! It's the best mix out there that we have found so far.

When I first went gluten free I LOVED this mix.  It's easy to put together, versitile (pizza crust, pie crust, bread etc)  However it took me many many months to realize it was this mix that was causing my stomach to still hurt.  Badly.  I don't think it's the sorghum flour I'm leaning towards the chicory root maybe?  My mom has the same reaction to this as I do.If you are new to celiac, need somthing that will work with little effort than this is the mix for you (and deserves 5 stars).  If however, you have a sensitive stomach then I think you should try another mix.  I would definately suggest trying the small bag first and if you don't blow up like a balloon think about getting a larger amount!

I purchased a loaf of gluten free bread--using cardboard would have as good.  I made gluten free bread from scratch.  The flavor was fine but it just did not have that bread texture.  This morning I made a loaf of Pamala's bread and it was wonderful!  It was so good I kept thinking "Is this really gluten free?"  I now feel that a gluten free life won't be too bad.
This is by far the best gluten free mix. I have been using this for about 6 months now and have no complaints. Amazon ships so quick.

column9: The worst gluten free bread mix ever
column10: I have purchased Pamela's products thinking that it would be great to be able to make homemade gluten free bread that tasted fresh, but I was very disappointed with this product.  It is the worst gluten-free bread product that I have ever tried.  It not only did not rise (the first time I thought it was just a bad batch, but it happened twice), and the bread doesn't cook completely, even when you extend the time.  It comes out doughie and uncooked in the center.  And don't think that I am a novice bread maker, I have been baking bread for years.  I would never buy this product or recommend it.  If you want great homemade gluten-free bread, buy gluten-free pantry bread mix.  It tastes like regular bread and works like a charm.

With just a few ingredients, this all-purpose bread mix can make a variety of breads -- pizza dough, bagels, 2-lb loaves. It doesn't have any of that chalkiness of other gluten-free bread mixes and has a yummy flavor that's close to the taste of a whole wheat bread. If you don't manage to consume the whole loaf, I recommend cutting it up into small cubes and drying it in a low-heat oven -- it makes fabulous croutons or you can grind them up to make tasty bread crumbs.

I am allergic to wheat gluten and have to do my own baking. Some breads, bagels and waffles that I have paid for in health food stores were not fit to eat.Pamela's products are always good. It is also very difficult to get the health food stores to carry this product. I made several batches of bagels by mixingmy dough in my bread machine. They were delicious! I was very happy when my son told me I could purchase these products from Amazon.

GF baking can be a real challenge.  My husband has a gluten intolerance but loves baked goods.  I felt bad for him so I researched and experimented with different products and finally discovered "Pam".  My husband and I joke that Pam is the other women in his life.  The muffin recipe is wonderful and I use this for everything...sauces, breading in place of flour.  You can pretty much use it in place of flour in all of your recipes.  Be careful not to use baking soda and salt, however, because it is alreadyincluded in the mix..so don't add anymore. Amazon has the best price in comparison that I have found.

My mom and I both have Celiac and truly love Pamela's Products. We have been using her Baking and Pancake mix for the past year, and were ecstatic to snag this one (not available in any stores near us). At this price it's impossible to pass up. Great service for a great product :)

column9: the best and easiest gluten-free bread mix
column10: Easy to use, consistent results and flexible. I use it to make raisin bread and it always comes out great. Their pancake mix is great as well.

I've tried several different gluten free breads, and had resigned myself to 'gritty' tasting products.  Boy, was I overjoyed when I baked and tasted my first loaf of bread using Pamela's Bread Mix & Flour Blend!  The loaf lasted approximately 5 minutes - a sure sign that my four teens agreed!  The bread was fluffy, yet substantial, and tasted just like the homemade loaves that I used to make before giving up wheat.  I make this in my Cuisinart bread machine, and have not had a single problem to date.  I've taught my teens to make this bread as well, and we now take turns preparing the morning loaf. Recovering from colon cancer surgery and learning to follow a celiac diet has been difficult to say the least, but this product has returned a bit of normalcy to my daily routine.
This is so far the best gluten-free bread mix I have found. While not exactly like wheat bread it is a great substitute, making large fluffy slices of bread that do not break into crumbs.

column9: easy to use and gluten free
column10: All the Pamela's Products are great. They taste good, have good texture, and most importantly they are easy to use. There are great directions on the package. There are wonderful recipes right on the package. And they are pretty easy to adapt to other recipes. There are tons of recipes created for Pamela's Products on the web on places [...].

column9: Good for Sweets--Not Exactly All Purpose
column10: I have mixed feelings about this mix. After all the hype, I was expecting a mix that was out of this world fantastic. And it had all the texture, shape, and smell of real bread, but something was off about it. It had a sweet taste to it--which I hate in bread. Pamela's is a great company and their products are fantastic, but I don't find this all purpose at all. Evaporated cane sugar, honey, and molasses have no business in something a company claims customers can use for anything from pizza to biscuits.I made the mistake of using this stuff for dredging for fried chicken. I almost threw up--sweet fried chicken? Gross. The dumplings in chicken and dumplings? Sweet enough to be unpalatable. Pizza? My 4 year old wouldn't eat it.But hey--if you're using it in something sweet like waffles or making cookies, it works like a dream. And I will sing it praises for that, but unfortunately, I need something that is truly all purpose and without added sugar.For me, I'd rather mix my own GF mix, it's cheaper and just as fast without the hit and miss issues with this mix. I'll use up the stuff I have for anything that requires sugar, but I've learned my lesson.

Excellent service. Speedy delivery and perfectly as advertised. Thank you!It makes excellent bread. My son is gluten intolerant (self diagnosed) and we have found that if you adhere to the recipe on the back of the flour, the break comes out too hard and crumbly for him. We have added an extra teaspoon of yeast, and a half cup extra of liquid. The mixture rises much better now, leaves decent sized CO2 holes in the bread and is much more pliable. He says it now testes like real bread! That is what I call a result!I suggest you experiment with the ingredients until you find your ideal mixture!

So I have really been wanting to try this. Signed up for Subscribe and Save, hoping for the best. I made it for the first time tonight and OMG. This bread is soooooo amazing!! I have done different homemade loaves and loved Udi's but was getting burnt out. I found Pamela's to be very moist, springy and does not crumble like others have. The flavor almost reminds me of a sweet version of sour dough bread. I trimmed the edges some and got the equivalent of 9 sandwiches, using my electric knife. I am absolutely thrilled with our new bread!!! It's a keeper!

This bread mix makes great tasting bread and the flour mixture works well in most recipes.  The flour can be used cup for cup to replace wheat flour.  I have even used it to make homemade egg noodles.  It has the right consistency and texture for noodles and other bread products.  No beany taste as in some other flour blends.

column9: A gluten free family life saver
column10: This is a wonderful product that the whole family loves...not just those of us who are gluten free.  EVeryone who has tried the fresh bread at our house is amazed by the wonderful taste.  Pamela's bread mix certainly makes being gluten free a whole lot easier.

This product is soooo good! After going gluten free, I tried several flours and mixes that I didn't like. I was ready to just give up baked goods all together. This mix is great! I had pizza tonight for the first time in months by making the crust with this mix. The whole family liked it! I will by this product again!

column9: THE BEST....YOU DO NOT NEED TO WASTE MONEY ON ANY OTHER BRAND
column10: I AM NEWLY DIAGNOSED WITH CELIAC DISEASE. I NEVER THOUGHT I WOULD EVER HAVE TO MAKE MY OWN BREAD OR ANYTHING ELSE. PAMELA'S IS THE BEST. I TRIED A LOT OF PRODUCTS & HAD TO THROW THEM AWAY. THAT GETS EXPENSIVE AS WE ALL KNOW. PAMELA MAKES IT EASY & OFFERS MANY RECIPES. DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY ON ANYTHING ELSE.Pamela's Products Amazing Wheat Free & Gluten-free Bread Mix,  4-Pound Bags (Pack of 3)

column9: Best Gluten-Free Bread Mix on the market!
column10: Absolutely love this bread mix!!  It makes the best tasting gluten-free bread and it does not crumble apart like others.  We love the whole-wheat recipe which uses molasses to give the bread that whole wheat taste.  Would definitely recommend this product to anyone who lives a gluten-free life.

column9: Good Bread in Two Hours Plus Five
column10: Gluten free living can be depressing if you let it. Pamela's Bread Mix and Flour Blend makes bread tasty enough to feed to people with "normal" diets. It takes about five minutes to mix it with a good stand mixer. Pour it into a prepared loaf pan, let it rise in a warm place for an hour, and bake it in a pre-heated oven for an hour. It tastes much better than what you buy from the shelf. After 18 years gluten free, this is my choice for bread.

This is by far some of the tastiest bread that you can make for either yourself or your family.  You might need to make the bread several times until you fully grasp the recipe and get everything right, which is perfectly normal.  It's normal to make mistakes the first few times.  Making bread isn't as easy as it looks because the loaf tends to fall apart.  That's why putting effort into bread-making requires determination and skill.

I just made my first loaf of bread with this mix.  The texture is close to what wheat bread is.  This is the best gluten free bread I've had so far.  I've tried in the past using various recipes but the texture of my own mixture couldn't even come close to this.  Great product.

column9: Makes The BEST Gluten Free Bread
column10: I found Pamela's Baking Mix on Amazon and was so excited because it is much cheaper than at my health food stores. Our daughter was recently diagnosed with a Gluten allergy and buying gluten free bread is ridiculously expensive. We tried other recipes for bread, but they were only so-so. This mix makes a delicious bread that tastes like fresh homemade regular bread! And most importantly? Our daughter loves it, too!

column9: Gluten Free Bread that is easy and tasty
column10: Pamela's bread mix bakes into consistent loaves of tasty bread.  I have added oatmeal and molasses to create as similar a version of my favorite oatmeal bread recipe that I can no longer eat.  The proportions and baking time have to be tinkered with a bit but the final product is worth it.  The large package makes Pamela's bread mix less costly.

And I was NOT disappointed.  I have made so many things with this mix!  I've subbed it into several conventional recipes successfully and I've tried several of the recipes that are on the bag and the Pamela's website.As an avid baker who was seriously mourning the loss of regular all-purpose flour, I can honestly say that this mix is priceless.  I have signed up for Subscribe and Save and will be receiving it on a regular basis!

column9: Product great, packaging from amazon.com not
column10: I received my first shipment of three pouches of Pamela's Products Amazing Wheat Free & Gluten-free Bread Mix,  4-Pound Bags (Pack of 3) today. One bag was split open with a few cups of flour all over the inside of the shipping box.I did let amazon.com know about the packaging.The product expiration date is March 2013, a good date from April 2012.Last week I made apple pie from this Pamela's Products flour and the crust was crispy, acceptable to the entire family.

My wife has been gluten free or close to it for several years now. We have tried several brands of gluten free breads and bread mixes, including some from companies that make other excellent gluten free products. This is the best by far. It creates a loaf that is hearty, yet remains soft. Other breads we tried would get hard and the only way to eat them was to heat each slice in the microwave. The bread that this mix makes is just delightful. In fact - gluten free isn't even the main reason to get it. It's just about the best bread you can get of any type. It is sooooo yummy.

Pamela's make the best Gluten Free all purpose flour! I love how it already has xantham gum in it so I don't have to figure out how much to put in. I'm new to the GF world so its awesome to find something that works and the entire family likes. Thanks!!

column9: I really like it; handling gas issues
column10: I really like it, the taste and texture are excellent.  When cut into chunks, oiled and toasted it works well as rusks in onion soup and seems to hold together about as well as wheat bread does.  I've been using the 19oz packets with a bread machine, switching to the larger packets.A big plus for me:  I'm sensitive to corn and this mix is corn-free, unlike many others.  For ingredients see pamelasproducts.com.Some people mention stomach-ache; the main downside of this mix for me is problems with gas (subtract one-half star).  I was able to greatly reduce that with a digestive enzyme (Houston Enzymes TriEnza).  Might also be worth checking whether you are sensitive to particular ingredients.

If you're tired of buying expensive and tiny loaves of gluten free bread, this is a great alternative. Its a little bit sweeter than I would make it if I were mixing it myself, but for the convenience, it still makes a great loaf of gluten free bread! I make two loaves at a time. Let them cool completely, and then slice them using a bread knife. I use folding (not zipping) sandwich bags, two slices per bag... slip the "flap" between the slices and fold the top over. Store these in a larger zip lock bag in the freezer. This keeps the bread easy to "grab and go" or thaw as much or as little as you need. Keeping the bread frozen keeps it "fresh" and moister than storing in the refrigerator. The bread has a good texture and doesn't fall apart if you use it for sandwiches or a make-shift hamburger bun. Enjoy!

column9: Fantastic Bread you would never know it is GF
column10: My husband became allergic to gluten a few years ago, and it has been difficult to understand how to re formulate the diet so it tastes good and is GF.  The (frozen) rice bread is just aweful and tastes like cardboard.  I started looking around at bread mixes to use with my bread maker, and Pamele's is the best out there. I was happy to find the larger bread mix bag, as it is much more economical.  Anyone that has had to follow a GF diet can relate to the confusion, need to read every label in detail, and higher cost !! as most of the GF items are in the specialty / organic area.

Pamela's bread mix is by far the best gluten free/wheat free mix available.  It is the closest to "regular" bread that I have found and I have tried a number of different mixes.  I like to use my bread maker machine and add some flax meal.  The flax gives the bread a nutty flavor and adds fiber.

This bread mix is amazing! I've made bagels, baguettes, and a pie crust with it so far, and all have been real tasty and received thumbs up from my gluten-eating family (including my husband, who does not hold back if he doesn't like something). The bagels alone were infinitely better than the frozen gluten-free variety. I've only been without gluten for a year, but knowing I can make delicious foods with Pamela's mixes has made celiac disease so much easier!
We love this mix!  We use the muffin recipe on back and make donuts with our electric donut maker~YUM. All the recipes on back are wonderful.

I don't use this too often for gluten-free bread, but it makes awesome cookies! I make cookies often enough that I am on a subscription order for three bulk bags at a time with this. I've tried many flour blends, both pre-mixed and my own, for cookies and this is the BEST.

I've only been eating gluten free for about two years.  I have tried so many products, but Pamela's products always surpasses the competition.  This mix produced a wonderfully tasty dense bread.  I followed the instructions for oven baking exactly, and it turned out great.  I allowed the loaf to cool completely, flipped it over and sliced it thin with a serrated knife.  I am flash freezing it to preserve the integrity of the bread and add convenience to my meal time.  I am so glad to have found this bread mix.  With Pamela's bread being both delicious and simple to make, I wave a glad farewell to light bread and yeast rolls!

I have been a fan of Pamela's Products baking mixes for awhile now. This bread mix is one of my favorites. It is really healthy and easy to work with. I am always guaranteed good tasting bread when I use this mix. I really think it a good deal for healthy quality food. I don't have a lot of time to bake from scratch but I do like home made break so this is a good compromise.

column9: Be Careful! Not for sensitive stomachs!
column10: I wanted to like this. I really did. The flavor was wonderful but it made my stomach feel awful and gave me a pit in the bottom of my stomach each time I ate it. Overall it is a great flour but it isn't right for sensitive stomachs and was very harsh overall. Flavor was also very sweet and made the bread I made taste like it has honey added.I wish this would have worked for me because it baked very well.

Well, let me tell you first that I was VERY skeptical of "gluten-free"  (How good can THAT be?)  The very thought... Yuk! Several of my friends are already "gluten free" and one, in particular makes her own rice flour.  I'm not so creative as that, and the work.... oh, my!  This is so easy!  I was pleasantly surprised that this bread turned out so wonderful, that I've given bags of it to friends and my daughter who is SO allergic to any food that she literally gets sick on everything.  She hasn't tried it yet, and I am hoping after a few weeks on her new diet she'll be able to actually eat this.  There is an egg-free recipe on the package, which is what she'll do when she can.  I will be buying more of this bread.  So easy.  Everything is right in the package, even the yeast, and it turns out to be a great sandwich bread.  Of course, it is not as airy as store-bought bread, but it's a whole lot healthier being it is whole grain, without the gluten, of course!

Basicly LOOKS like bread, has the texture of bread - but it is really difficult to get past the fact that it tastes terrible.  Even with the best condiments to mask over the flavor, it shines through tasting something like fish, the smell of windex, dust and sugar.  Honestly. I have made it 3 times now, wondering if it was just my technique, but no.  Sad - because the pancake baking mix is excellent, and I had my hopes up about the bread.

This is one of my favorite bread mixes.  Taste is excellent, and texture is very good.  The smell is wonderful and doesn't disappoint!! Few ingredients needed and easy to bake.  Just follow directions.  (We bake on the lowest rack.)

It seems like this will make life much easier. I haven't had this product long but used a regular recipe to make an applecake. I just replaced the regular flour with the gluten free. It was very tasty. I wouldn't have known it was gf flour if someone had served that cake to me.
Excellent product to deal with. Am new to the gluten-free game, and all Pamela's baking products are a good thing.

This bread mix is very good. So far, everything I have tried from Pamela's Products has been really good. If you haven't tried the brownie mix, you should!Pamela's Products Wheat-Free Amazing Bread Mix, 19-Ounce Packages (Pack of 6)

My 3 y.o. son and i are both allergic to gluten and find this bread, made in our bread machine, delicious.  It is a little sweet which keeps my son eating his sandwiches and me enjoying toast again.  It's easy to make and isn't rock hard.  It actually stays moist and soft for days in a bag in the fridge.  We have people over for dinner regularly and they request our (Pamela's) bread rather than the regular bagette.  I keep this and Pamela's Baking mix around at all times.

as usual, another great product by Pamela's...had a little trouble the first time because of high altitude, but called their help line and was given a couple of suggestions to try and all the other loaves have come out great! Bought my first bread maker (off amazon.com of course!) and it works well with the regular setting.

column9: Great Product - tasty/good texture GF bread
column10: I have used this in the small size bags, with yeast included, in the bread machine.  Found it got rather expensive.  I was really glad to see this in the 4 lb. size.  Just add yeast and you're good to go at a much lower price per loaf.

This is the most versatile, best tasting gluten-free bread/flour mix on the market.  It is staple of my diet.  The Baking and Pancake Mix rivals the texture and taste of Swedish pancakes.  Anyone have a recipe for popovers using this mix?

I use this flour to make sandwich bread for my gluten allergic son. He loves it. It is the only bread he eats. No weird after taste here! I put it in the fridge before slicing so that it doesn't lose its form. We also store it in the fridge because it will mold due to lack of perservatives.

I tried this bread mix for the first time a couple days ago, and followed the directions, faithfully. I did not use a bread machine, but otherwise, followed the optional directions to make it by hand. It turned out to be an extremely heavy brick, uncooked in the middle.  Tried to eat it anyways, but it was so damp and uncooked, had to give up.  Horrible!

I have two daughters with gluten allergies (ages 8 and 10).  I have had the challenge of finding a good GF bread since they were 4 and 6.  This product by far has made my life so much easier.  When making GF bread from scratch, it usually has many steps involved and many different ingrediants.  With Pamelas products, its so simple.  When making the bread, I do recommend using a stand mixer though.  The bread is moist and stays moist even 4 days after I have made it.  Freezes well.  Pamelas website has additional recipes I have used, using her bread mix.  My kids feel like they are eating "real food" again. I have also tried her GF pancake mix.....the best by far.

column9: Contains Corn Syrup despite Website Ingredients Stating otherwise
column10: Not happy that I decided to try this formula because it did not contain added sugar (per ingredient listing on the company's website).  When I received it, the ingredient list listed "corn syrup" (i.e., SUGAR).  I wrote to the company and asked about it and their response was "the amount of carbohydrates is the same" and that it was an "improved formula".  Its unfortunate that you can't even trust a seemingly small, organic company to be forthcoming about ingredients that are unhealthy for infants!

4 stars because it is too expensive.  there is also some controversy about hexane being used to extract the DHA... (do your own research)  but, as far as organic baby formula goes, i think that this and earth best are EXACTLY THE SAME.  when you look at the list of ingredients/nutrients/vitamins - with the exception of calcium (VO has slightly more) the products are the identical.  they smell and taste the same as well.  my son is 3 months old and weighs 18 lbs, so obviously he will eat whatever I give him (lol) but he likes them both equally.  he only recieves 3-4 bottles of formula per day (3.5 ounces each) because I'm not a great pumper at work and he is grow, grow, growing!  anyway, they even both use the same brand of DHA.  with subscribe and save on amazon, earths best is FAR less expensive.

I tried this formula after searching for an organic formula (with the added vitamins and minerals) to supplement my baby's feedings after I returned to work.  I have been very happy with this formula.  I can transition from my milk to this formula with no hesitation or fussiness from my little guy.  Also, I have not seen the "digestive" issues that I occasionally saw when trying a very recognizable name-brand formula.  Some other websites offer this formula at a price that makes it very competitive with the organic formulas you find in the store.

column9: Would Highly Recommend for spit up/gas issues
column10: I've tried several formulas for my baby who has had horrible spit up issues since birth. I breast feed and supplement but have to be careful what he gets because he gets gassy or constipated easily. I tried a couple of name brands, meant to specifically address these issues and they weren't working well for him, and he hated the taste. On a whim I saw this in the grocery store and decided to give it a try. I'm so glad I did. Since using this he hasn't had the issues he had with the others and he never refuses his bottle now. Would highly recommend and have approached a store to recommend they carry it too.

I purchased Emergen-C Acai Berry instead of my usual Super Orange, because this was on sale. Not a good substitute at all!! This flavor tastes much more artificial, like a too sweet candy that leaves a weird chemically aftertaste.  I like Super Orange, because it has a noticeable, yet not overwhelming, flavor...Bottom line is that I will not be purchasing this flavor again. Yuck.

I wanted to like this stuff. It sounded great. Unfortunately, it was so fizzy and artificial tasting...just not drinkable for me. Sadly, I have a box full of it. I hate to throw it out so it sits in my cabinet in hopes that I can get it down the hatch one of these days. Ugh.

column9: Smooth and Full Bodied + Caffeine Free
column10: This 100 bag sampler of organic dessert teas from Davidson's offers 8 varieties (12 or 13 bags of each) that will sure to please a wide range of tastes.  The flavors are: coconut vanilla, caramel peach, raspberry cream caramel, carob mint, vanilla cream spice, cherries jubilee and lemon ginseng.  Most of the flavors are not too strong, but are more than reminiscent of the name.  The vanilla flavors definitely taste of vanilla and I liked them the best.  The cherries jubilee was the most disappointing.  overall, I think the teas were delicious, even if some (lemon ginseng, cherries jubilee) weren't really for me.  Most notably, the teas all had a great full body and were silky smooth - qualities usually reserved for oolong and black teas.While the packaging is attractive and can be folded for presentation as a display, I found Revolution's sampler boxes to have far superior presentation.  The tea bags do not have strings attached, which may be a sadly missed conveniece to many.  However, I did appreciate the brewing time being noted on each wrapper.I love good tea and coffee, but not the caffeine that usually comes with them.  So at night, I'm usually left to chamomille or relatively few other choices.  After being impressed by Davidson's Assam loose leaf tea, I'm glad I went back to their Amazon store and found this assortment.  I highly recommend it to any tea drinker looking for something non-traditional, and especially recommend it to those looking to avoid caffeine.These items are similar as well and may be a better purchase: Davidson's Tea Assorted Dessert Teas, 8-Count Tea Bags (Pack of 12), Davidson's Tea Dessert Teas 4-pack (Pack of 3).

I love tea, so I HAD to try this company and I am SO glad I did. There is TRUE quality in every bag! My favorite flavor is Caramel Peach. The taste of this tea is light and even if you accidentally over-seep the tea, the flavor will still be light and refreshing! Makes EXCELLENT iced tea and I highly recommend as a gift or if you just want to relax after a hard day!

column9: The worst tea I've ever had. Terrible flavor combinations.
column10: I absolutely love tea, I drink at least 3 cups a day. Now that I'm pregnant I was trying to find caffeine free teas that I could drink throughout my pregnancy. This was a complete waste of money. The flavors are: coconut vanilla, caramel peach, raspberry cream caramel, carob mint, vanilla cream spice, cherries jubilee and lemon ginseng. The ONLY one that isn't absolutely terrible is the vanilla cream spice.I have no clue how anyone could give these a positive review. I like cherry tea, but cherry jubilee and raspberry cream taste like cough syrup. Carob mint and caramel peach were definitely the worst flavors. I even tried preparing the tea for friends to see if it was just me, and it wasn't. We all had a good laugh over how absolutely disgusting these teas were.If you found a bag of Halloween candy from childhood then took all the hard pieces out and boiled them in a trashcan, then you would have a cup of "Organic Dessert Tea."Don't waste your money!

These teas, which are 8 different flavors, despite the amazon listing saying 6, are all based on rooibos, which is the predominant flavor in all of them.  As a result, the fruit, caramel, carob, and mint flavors promised are greatly diluted.  If you love rooibos, you will probably like this collection, but I found it overbearing and unpleasant, and ended up giving away most of the set.  The one flavor that I did consume most of was the coconut vanilla, which turned out to go very well with double chocolate s'mores (chocolate grahams, dark Hershey's bars).  If you're looking for teas with interesting and subtle flavors, look elsewhere.  If you're looking for a more robust caffeine-free tea (I was), try a small packet of something with rooibos to determine whether you enjoy that flavor before investing in these.  One other problem I have found with Davidson teas (I have tried about 20 different varieties) is that they tend to have the bare minimum of tea in each bag.  Forget about using your extra-large mug, or getting a second cup.  These bags are good for one 8-10 ounce cup and no more.

column9: Back to Nature Crispy Wheat Crackers - 8 oz.
column10: These crackers are made by Back to Nature Foods located in Madison, WI--made in the USA! I give these crackers 4/5 for flavor, 5/5 for texture, 5/5 for maintaining Earth conscious integrity, 0/5 for truth in labeling--score 3.5The carton is made of 100% recycled paperboard and the ink is derived from vegetables. The company supports the Nature Conservancy (Protecting nature, preserving life).These are crispy wheat crackers with a sweet and mild flavor.  These are super crispy crackers that will hold up to any dip or topping.The sweetness adds just enough flavor to make your toppings pop.  I personally serve them with fish dips (salmon) and cheese toppings--yummy!The crackers are made of unbleached enriched flour and contain wheat flour, niacin, reduced iron, thiamine mononitrate (vitamin B1), riboflavin (vitamin B2), folic acid, safflower oil, raw sugar, defatted wheat germ, cornstarch, brown rice syrup, sea salt, malted barley extract, leavening (monocalcium phosphate, baking soda), natural turmeric flavor.The 8 oz package contain 8 servings--17 crackers.  Each serving contains 130 cal., 4 g fat, .5 g polyunsaturated fat, 2.5 g monounsaturated fat, 230 mg sodium, 55 mg potassium, 22 g carbs, 1 g fiber, 4 g sugars, 2 g protein.The package states that the crackers contain no artificial perservatives or flavors and no hydrogenated oils.  However, the product does contain Thiamine mononitrate which is a 'synthetic form' of vitamine B1, and medical and nutrition experts recommend a daily potassium intake of 4.7 g per/day.Don't forget to recycle the box!

I love panko! I always use it for chicken katsu or pork katsu.  Typically I coat the meat with rice flour, followed by a mixture of eggs, garlic powder & onion powder. Then I coat the meat in panko before placing it in a pan with heated peanut oil. I wait for it to turn golden brown on one side, then flip. Once it looks done I place it on a plate with paper towels, check that the meat is done and then pat the top of the meat with a paper towel to soak up oil. Using tongs to flip the meat is best, though if you flip it too much the coating might come off. The panko provides just the right crunch (and if you have katsu sauce, all the better!).

column9: This hard to find vinegar has wonderful flavor
column10: This is a hard to find vinegar that is superior to balsamic especially when rich flavor is needed. While balsamic adds sweetness and a strong vinegar flavor, sherry vinegar is a mild vinegar that adds huge flavor with a depth and richness that is unique. It can be used very much like white wine, but it adds a smooth nutty flavor similar to pecans. This can be used whenever cooking sherry is called for. I like to use it instead of beer to cook turkey brats, and when cooking cut up chicken: cover the bottom of a fry or saute pan, let the liquid reduce while browning each side; it turns out great. I haven't tried it with other meats, such as beef or pork, but I would expect the rich, mellow flavor to compliment those meats as well. The bottles are large, the size of wine bottles, and this will force you to think up ways to use it--lucky you.

I refuse to say that a product is 3 or 4 Stars. I believe a half point is significant because, after all this time, I realize that a 3 Star is like a lukewarm average rating, while a 3.5 is significantly better without having to go to 4. I decided to buy this product when I noticed that Dreamfields Pasta was not readily available anymore in amazon and the price had skyrocketed. Was using Dreamfields for quite a long time so when I discovered this product I was very intrigued and order it immediately. Love the sound of a lot of fiber and the flavors also were appealing. They come in big boxes, which I believe contain 12 ounces. Since it is standard practice to mix the pasta with some veggies the 12 ounces are quite enough for they seem to bulk up once you mix them. I like the pasta but find the texture a little hard to get used to and perhaps that is why I allocated 3.5 Stars, which by the way, in my world a 3.5 is nothing to frown upon. I was more generous with Dreamfields because I truly felt their pasta tasted like the real deal, the one you would get at any italian restaurant and that contain at least 40 grams of carbs. Dreamfields states that theirs is very low in carbs after you consider this and that. I can not say I have taken the time to analyze their statements for I figure if they are saying it, is probably true.I have tried other pastas that are similar to the FiberGourmet Light Nested Fettuccine, Garlic Parsley Flavor, 10-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6). It is reassuring that there are some companies out there who truly care for that segment of the population who prefer their pasta low low low. And I love pasta so I am always searching for the ideal one. That said, and as I already stated, I, or should I say we, eat this pasta with no problems at all. Parmesan, Marinara Sauce, with a side of fish, fowl or beef, no one ever complained or said they did not like it. I once tried it like a variation of chow mein with a tasty, guilt free sauce, and it was also tasty.  Have bought all their flavors and perhaps this kind is my favorite but they are all close. Now if I could only start working out a lot harder perhaps all this concern about eating somewhat healthier will pay its dividends. Good enough to eat, 3.5 but no quite 4 Stars? Let's say for arguments sake, that 3.5 is slightly above average.

column9: WARNING! This product is not gluten-free.
column10: I am on a strict gluten-free diet as I have gluten sensitivity. I started using this product, assuming it was gluten-free, as it is naturally and doesn't have any added ingredients. Well, after continually having problems when eating my baked goods and researching all of my products, I found my answer. This manufacturer produces many flours and they make it clear on their website that this product is not intended to be sold as gluten-free.Their statement is as follows:"Celiacs and those with a wheat intolerance on special diets can find rice flour, tapioca flour and even sweet potato flour which has been produced in dedicated, gluten free mills to prevent cross contamination."[...]Any other products from this company are at risk of cross-contamination. So, I should have done my research, but I didn't understand the need to. The lesson here is that a product cannot be accepted as gluten-free unless labeled as such. This product is not so labeled and it caused me multiple repeated health problems. I hope this will save someone else from the same issues.

column9: Tasty and pretty, these would make a nice gift too
column10: I found these t candies at World Market on the Christmas Clearance rack.
