But the bag of beans I got and that I've really tried to enjoy has proved very disappointing. I'd send it back if I could do so without paying postage. I don't mind paying double, or even triple, for a cup of coffee that actually gets me going and says 'Good morning, tastebuds! to start each day. Life's just too short to drink crap coffee unless you have to. But this so-called 'Kick-a**' Kickin' Horse is little more than donkey dung that I'll be a-kickin' on down the road.
My order arrived today and I immediately made a cup. These beans are horribly burnt. Very disappointing. Not worth the dollars.

I've ordered this coffee several times & it has been excellent every time.  It's not over-roasted/burnt tasting & the flavor is very complex.  The beans are oily, black & I found no quakers (underdeveloped coffee beans that make coffee taste awful - they stick out because they do not roast/darken properly).  That's a good test of coffee beans:  empty the bag on a cookie sheet & see how many quakers you find.  A few is "acceptable" but more than 10 is pretty bad in my opinion.  If you've always been disappointed in dark roast coffee, you may want to give this a try but if you just don't like dark roast; you will probably NOT like this one.I use the "pour over" method to brew coffee every day because at this time, there is only one non-commercial drip coffeemaker that gets water to the ideal brewing temperature of 192F to 204 F.  I use cold, filtered water, a Melitta natural brown filter, manual drip coffee filter & brew directly into my stainless carafe.  I heat the water to boiling, pour a few tablespoons over the grounds to saturate & plump up the beans, wait a minute & then flood the grounds with the rest of the water.  There is a lot of crema, the beautiful reddish brown foam that develops on top of the beans, & it smells & tastes wonderful.I brew directly in to this carafe using this coffee cone (pour over method):RSVP Manual Drip Coffee Filter Cone for Carafes or ThermosI use this grinder:Bodum Bistro Electric Burr Coffee Grinder, BlackI use this water kettle to heat the water:Oster 5965 Stainless-Steel 1-1/2-Liter Electric Water KettleI use these coffee filters:Melitta 626412 40 Count #6 Natural Brown Cone Coffee Filters

I'm not a regular coffee drinker, so I am very picky about what I do drink. I have not found a better coffee than this, and I've tried. Being a Canadian living in the States, I am so so so very excited that Kicking Horse is now available through Amazon. This has literally made my day! Bold and dark it is delicious.
We had Kicking Horse Kick Ass Coffee in Canada and fell in love with it!  Thrilled to find we can order it on amazon!  Definitely worth trying - you won't be sorry!  SO YUMMY!

I am so happy that Amazon is selling this coffee.  I LOVE dark, robust, flavorful coffees and this is perfect.  This is cheaper and more convenient than shipping from Canada or trying to find in my local grocery store. Also, I try to purchase Free Trade coffee when possible and sometimes, this forces me to compromise on taste.  Kicking Horse is Certified Organic, Certified Free Trade, and has a "Kick-Ass" flavor.  I can't ask for anything more.
Coffee was burnt, had a bad aftertaste, and very acidic.  note sure if a bad batch but this was not good coffee.
The Best Coffee in the modern world, the taste take u to unknown places like a dream come true !i promise i will buy it again and again and againGood Night and Good Luck

This is my favorite coffee hands down. My fiancee got me into "good" coffee by getting me to drink Starbucks, but I couldn't handle the acidity of the Pike's and had to get cream to prevent the heartburn, but this coffee is near acid free and smooth. I can drink several cups and not worry about heartburn, although with the kick it has I would advise against drinking too many cups :DI've yet to drink this with making a french press, but with a burr grinder and drip coffee or the Senseo it is superb. Other people complain that the flavor is plain and lacking, but if you really love the taste of coffee this is the best. It doesn't have any "hidden" flavors that leave an after taste or might make it so the coffee is good for the first few cups and then the extra flavors kill the taste. Example is the Komodo Dragon blend from SB, it's a great coffee and I love the flavor but after two cups I just can't drink it anymore.The Kicking Horse is just pure undisturbed coffee goodness!

I love Lavazza and tried this on a whim and it's delicious.  I use the modern day percolator to make my cup of coffee in the morning and this coffee is perfect for this kind of brewing.  I have never used it in a drop machine.
I have tried many,many types/brands of coffee..this is a great bold smooth tasting coffee. Surprisingly so considering it's Canadian...not especially a well known source of coffee.
strong, full-bodied and not burnt. nice clean aroma. It is dark enough so that it needs to be scraped out of the grinder: a small price to pay for a good morning.

My boyfriend loved this coffee. I made it in a French press and was pleasantly surprised to see that there were no grinds in the coffee. Then again, it might have been more the girl pressing it and less the coffee ;)

Since First Colony went out of business and the product line is now being handled by White Coffee, I had to find another good French Roast coffee. I tried Kicking Horse based on many positive reviews and I am not sorry that I chose it.  However, it's not as good as the First Colony French Roast so my next order will be for Cameron's.  I'll keeping trying other brands until I get what I was used to drinking for the past 50 years.
Not as dark deep and flavorful as I liketried ginding the beans differently but stilltoo mild for me

column9: Tastes like hot water even when made very strong
column10: I wanted to like this coffee because (A) I don't like what we've BEEN buying, (B) it came in a huge bag and (C) others said it was rich without being bitter. Unfortunately, even though we made a full grinder top (ie, strong) it tasted like hot water with coffee flavoring. It doesn't seem to have any depth.Those who love it--what am I doing wrong?
Coffee that tastes good.... but you must grind it yourself for that extra fresh taste! Yum Bum Dum Tum Sum Gum!
I'm thrilled that Amazon is carrying this product...so much cheaper thank buying in the store

column9: Great coffee if it gets to you
column10: I love this coffee. It tastes fantastic. 5 stars without a doubt. I have to take a star away because of the delivery. Amazon's delivery service here in Jersey City, NJ never delivers to my address. They deliver to a street with a similar name. Instead of 72 ***** Ave, they deliver to ?? ****** St. There is no 72 on the street. The street names are pronounced similarly, but spelled pretty different. 5 times I've had this problem. The courier always shows up with an attitude because he gets yelled at for messing up. I wont be ordering this from amazon anymore until their shipping issues are dealt with. I pay for Prime and it's taken over a week and  2 resends to get my coffee.

Just purchased it for my automatic espresso machine based on reviews on Amazon. First of all not a good bean for automatic machine too oily. Most importantly was absolutely horrid taste and would never buy the brand again. One thing it will do is jolt you if you want to stay up all night which might be the only reason i would drink it

I've had a subscription to Peet's for years. I find Starbuck's dark roast tastes burnt. I saw this coffee in the Gold Box and decided to try it based on the reviews.  It is absolutely delicious; the best coffee I've ever had.  I enjoy it in my morning latte.  It has a strong, robust smell, but blends smoothly in my latte's and mocha's.  Even better, it is ORGANIC and FREE TRADE.  How good can it get with the low price per pound and free shipping with Amazon Prime.  Closed my subscription from Peets and buying Dark Horse from Amazon from now on.  I LOVE IT!!!

column9: Not good for super-automatic espresso/coffee makers
column10: This looks like a pretty decent coffee, but its not suitable for super-automatic espresso/coffee makers.  Problem is that the beans are TOO oily.  Good if you self-grind... bad if you put the beans in a large hopper and expect them to automatically slide into the grinder when needed... The oil creates a stickiness which tends to keep the beans stationary. 5 stars if rating the coffee simply on the quality of the beans... would be unfair to downgrade the avg because they don't work with my setup.

I have purchased this coffee from the company and I am so happy that it will be available through Amazon.  The shipping is a little steep from Canada.  This is one of the best coffees I have had.  The name says it all.  Anyone who likes a strong dark coffee will enjoy this. Also good is 454 Horse Power Dark.
I like a dark oily roast and Kick Ass comes pretty close to my ideal.  Great taste, no bitterness.  I'll buy more.

I hate mornings. Picking out the right coffee is very important to me. I have tried just about everything Starbucks makes with mixed outcomes.The Amazon community steered me in the direction of this Kicking Horse product with overwhelmingly solid reviews, and I have to say they did not lead me wrong. The beans have a heavenly smell out of the bag (but the aroma of the coffee itself was more muted.) The taste is dark and full, but as many commentators pointed out, does not come with an acidity or burnt taste frequent to many dark brews. To me, this is a simple, straight up coffee that does exactly what it is supposed to. The downside is that it lacks a distinctive, exotic, or exquisite flavor. If that is what you are looking for, this probably is not the product for you.But if like me, you have given up trying to have your coffee do too many things wrong and come up short, this seems to really get the job done well. I find myself enjoying it black-- no cream or sugar needed for a very drinkable and enjoyable coffee such as this.Prime shipping and low cost with subscribe and save makes this coffee about $1/pound cheaper than Starbucks brews, depending on the bean.PROS:SmoothDeliciousDrinkableGreat AromaFavorably priced to other high end coffeeCONS:Lacking in exotic taste (if that is your thing)

I very much enjoy dark roasts.  The challenge I find is that many of them are either burnt or overly bitter from poor roasting.  This coffee does a very good job of being a strong dark roast that is full of flavor without any hint of burnt or bitter flavors.  It is very dark and oily and the small portion that did not fit in my airtight container dried out a bit and was not as strong flavored.  That took over 3 weeks though due to the volume of coffee and it was still better than other dark roasts I have tried.  I have used this for guests to eat with pies and cake over the holidays and all of them commented on its excellent flavor.  A couple who don't really like dark roast did request some cream, but still gladly had multiple cups.I would recommend this to anyone who:1.  Likes dark roast coffee2.  Doesn't know, and wants to try it3.  Wants to change it up from a medium, or god forbid, a light roast.It is a good quality product made more so because of the cost

I have had a cup of coffee like this befor and loved it. I have been trying different coffee and makers for years till now. it is just perfect. I will up my subscription to 2 bags a month. Thank you Kicking horse coffee my serch is over. Perfect, just perfect!!!

Another review supporting how great this stuff is.  When I drink coffee it has to be the good stuff.  Came across it by accident but so happy I did.  This is fantastic coffee at a great price!  Plus organic and fair trade.  Just placed my second order and sure it won't be the last.
The beans are very oily and dark, the flavor is deep, rich, but not burnt at all. Very good coffee for those who like a strong kick.

column4: Ware Carlton-Ford "Modern Day Caveman and Gou...
column10: I had never had Kicking Horse coffee before,but bought it on the strength of Amazon Prime eligibility, organic certification, and the many positive reviews.  The other reviewers are right - this coffee does not disappoint.  When I first tasted it, it seemed a little too dark, even for me, and I typically like my coffee quite dark.  However, adding just a touch of cream really opened it up, allowing the flavors to develop and mellow.  Instantly, it went from being a very good of dark coffee (when black) to being a perfect cup of rich, smoky coffee (with cream).  This is a really good coffee at a REALLY good price; just know that unlike so many coffees advertising themselves as "dark" or "strong," this one actually is.  Enjoy!

My office has a coffee club where everyone chips in and we buy coffee to try from all over. We ordered Kicking Horse Coffee Kick Ass Dark to give it a try.This coffee is roasted very dark roast without being burnt. Those of us in the office who like our coffee on the strong side really enjoyed the blend. It is a blend, I would assume of Sumatran and Costa Rican beans. The roast was actually too strong for the coffee drinkers who like light to medium roasts so we will not be purchasing this one again.I took a little of this home and tried it in the Moka pot. I personally like dark roasts and this was too strong for me when using the espresso esk method.I'm giving this three stars because it's not for everyone. I feel the blend could have been a little better (use of cheaper Central American beans) at he $11 plus per pound reduced amazon price.

I've been drinking coffee for a really long time.  I've had lots of coffee from all the major retailers and from every region of the world.  I also get coffee from local fine food stores and lots of stuff on-line.  I have multiple coffee makers, one of them, my daily workhorse, a built-in Miele coffee/cap/espresso maker.  So, I think I know coffee better than most.  This coffee is good but certainly not spectacular.  I adjusted the grind to their recommendations, and I also tried other grind levels without a significant change in my opinion.  Keep in mind that personal palette plays an important role in coffee appreciation, akin to the appreciation of wine, music, or art, so my opinion is still only one opinion.  That being said, I still believe that I can safely state that this coffee, while good, will not change your life.

This is an exceptional bean for any coffee drinker. It is easily the best price fair trade and organic option on the market, unless you want something flavorless.I primarily make espresso and this bean puts all others to shame. It takes an average-fineness grind, fine but not powdery, and preferably a HOT portafilter. Double shots are best, as it really needs to heat up to get a fine emulsion and delivers excellent crema. Fantastic as espresso, with rich chocolatey notes and a superbly smooth feel. My wife, who enjoys cream and sugar with a bit of coffee, loves this in a latte with 1 part espresso and only 2 parts milk (usual latte is about 1 to 6). After using this for the past few months, when travelling and stopping at Starbucks or Caribou, it's disgusting to drink what used to pass for good coffee. This is the best bean you could ever want.On occassion, I've also brewed using a French press and, naturally, the result was fabulous. I usually find brewed coffee quite lacking in body and flavor, but this was rich, flavorful, and absent of acidity. I actually found it to taste best after steeping for 10-15 minutes, much longer than called for.Obviously this is for people who really love strong coffee. It is a dark, dark roast but the balance of body and acidity makes it a versatile option for the skilled barista.Still yet to check out the 454 Horespower roast, could be even better, but can't compare to the great value of Kick Ass. If you're bothering to look at this bean, then go ahead and buy it. You won't be disapointed.

I have been drinking Kick Ass Dark Coffee ever since doing a 20 km trail run in Sutton, Quebec in pouring rain and cold wind. It was so good that I finished the free sample in two days. Now forget Starbucks if you want the real thing. This is it.

This is a reall kick in the ass. Jeez, I love strong coffee but seriously I had to cut down on my consumption! ER maybe it's a bit too strong when I get the shakes( especially since I drink coffee like water!!) I am torn between loving it and not wanting a hart attack! Hmm which is more important? Being awake (reallly awake) and being in a cardiac unit at the local hospital? Hmm did i pay my health insurance this month? Anyway like I said very good coffee but beware.

UPDATE:  Well, the below review was during my first brew or two of this bean.  One thing I noticed is that this particular bean tastes much better a notch coarser and brewed for about 30-60 seconds shorter than the Starbucks French Roast.  When I brew 1.5 oz of these beans with 24 oz of water for no more than four minutes, this coffee turns out smooth and delicious.  I'll report back again after I try another pound of the Starbucks for comparison.I'm sure there's nothing "wrong" with this coffee--it's just not to my taste.  I prefer my beans roasted-to-hell, so to speak.  I'm sure that roasts like that destroy any character that the beans once had, but it's what I like.I was actually looking for something as dark or darker than my usual Starbucks french roast, but this is significantly lighter than that.  You can actually tell when pouring the beans that because of the shorter roast, they are noticeably denser (more moisture inside) than the Starbucks (which presumably makes this roast cheaper per pound because they don't have to use as many beans.)

I came across this when I was doing a search for Stumptown coffee, and was excited that a product with such great reviews shipped quickly with Prime.  The coffee is a definitely a dark and oily roast.  However, opening the bag didn't give me that awesome overwhelming whiff... and the brewed cup (I've been using this for both french press and filtered water coffee maker) isn't as exciting as I hoped.  It isn't bad, but the taste is not strong, and I was hoping for a little more depth.  I tend to prefer coffee that holds its flavor even after I added milk/sugar... and this didn't hold up.  I've been playing with different amounts of coffee used, but it didn't seem to matter.  For the price of the bag, it wasn't much of a savings from the brands I already get, although the quick delivery is awesome.

column9: A bold, refreshing cup of coffee
column10: Much like the pricier brands I used to buy  this coffee is dark, bold and yet smooth at the same time. I think what attracted me to the coffee was the name, who doesn't want a caffeinated cup of joe with the words "Kick Ass Dark" on it? If you have to wake up before the crack of dawn, you want something that will kick your ass out of the pj's and into the work clothes without being bitter or chalky, or making your stomach ache from the acidity. This coffee is our new personal favorite. We've tried a few other flavors by this brand as well and enjoyed them, but Kick Ass Dark has got to be my favorite. Maybe it's just the name, maybe it's the coffeehouse flavor without the coffeehouse price, either way, I would recommend this to anyone.

I'm a bit of a coffee connoisseur. Everywhere I travel, I go in search of the best coffee in the region. And, at the moment, I live in 'coffee town' - Seattle. Of all the coffees I've tried (and I've tried a lot), this one is the best. It arrived as a Christmas present from my brother one year, and I've never looked back. Give it a try. It's delicious.

Just had my first brew of this coffee.  WOW!  This is the best coffee I've ever tasted; strong, flavorful, not bitter, absolutely delicious.  I'd call it a liquid dessert.  I'm so glad that I've put this on automatic delivery.  I'm Canadian born, so I should have known that this coffee would be simply the best.
The name of this coffee describes it the best it's kick ass. Great flavor, nice and strong. I recommend people give it a try for their first up of the day!

I read the reviews and was really excited about these beans...all I can really say is meh. My husband and I are coffee lovers. We appreciate a dark roast, a heavy aroma and of course intense flavor. This coffee lacked in all departments. Like previous reviews I will agree it is a very oily bean so be aware of that as well. For us...not kick ass at all. Will not buy again in fact I'm glad the gigantic bag finally ran out today!

column9: Good coffee, but not Deadman's Reach good.
column10: I have tried may different coffees based on reviews fro Amazon.  Kicking Horse Dark is certainly not the worst (Three Peckered Billy Goat takes this honor).  On the other hand, it certainly isn't near the top of my favorites, either.  I would rank Kicking Horse on par with your run-of-the-mill Starbucks House Blend.  Neither is offensive, but also isn't anything special.That being said, no small part of taste in coffee is the 'taste' part; which is surely very personal and subjective.  For my money, though, Deadman's Reach is still the best I've found.

If you like coffee with a good flavour, that is strong but not bitter, and that doesn't cost an arm and a leg, then this is the one for you. The beans are dark and slightly oily, with a wonderful aroma, and the finished cup is full of flavour. I have been ordering from Amazon for over a year now, using automatic monthly delivery, and have never had a bad or even slightly stale bag.I usually use a french press to make coffee, and this grinds perfectly for that, but I have also used it with a drip coffee maker and an aeropress, with very good results also. This coffee compares very well to the best beans you can buy at your local coffee shop (and is better than some), and is a very reasonable price. Honestly, I can't say enough good things about it; it is generally the only coffee I buy any more.
Kick ass and horse power dark. The best coffee ever. for people who like a really strong cup of coffee. This is my favorate coffee...and the only coffee that i will drink. yummy///

I've ordered this 5 times in a row now from Amazon. I have never found a coffee that I love this much. If you like very dark, bold coffee then you will love this. I grind it up fresh and brew it in a french press every morning. I can't believe I've never seen this in stores or heard about it before. You would think more people would know about coffee this good. I guess possibly it's just too dark for a lot of people.

column9: Unique coffee... Great to some, not to others. I love it!
column10: Philosophies on coffee, its flavor, proper roast and other variants range dramatically and there's a specific reason, everyone's opinion/preference/palate is unique. The first thing one needs to recognize when critically reviewing a coffee is that like alcohol, smoke from cigars/cigarettes, and other similar acquired tastes is that they are not naturally palatable. This means that we are all going to develop specific tastes based highly on exposure and familiarity; and moreover that all of us winced at our first sip of joe, booze (still do often), or our first inhale of fine hand-rolled tobacco. With this fact in mind, hyper-critical reviews of any such product is silly.Anyway, Kicking Horse is an amazing company based on ethical roots with clear and focused mission, to make good coffee. Their line of roasts is widely varying, but they have something for everyone. A morning without Kick Ass isn't the same for me, but I'm not a fan of the 454 Horse Power roast that is similarly a dark variant in their product line. Their presentation is fantastic, business formula great, and their social consciousness is something to be admired. Kick Ass is a wonderful roast, with a unique flavor profile. It's dark, but like any coffee won't yield a dark brew if not used properly. It's oily, but those oils are the same that carry the flavor of your coffee, and the same that will require you to clean an automatic grinder coffee maker after ever use (probably not what you'd want if you use the auto grind setups). Regardless of what you're used to, this blend of Indonesian and Central American beans will surely be different from what you've been drinking. Some have noted Kick Ass to be bitter, but that's how I'd describe most of Starbucks' roasts. For more of a reference toward my personal taste, I'd say D&D Regular blend lacks gusto and doesn't offer enough flavor, while D&D Dark tastes a little burnt (good mainstream baselines for comparison I think).When in doubt, try a smaller amount as a sample!Also, nice job utilizing Amazon and offering exclusive pricing, thanks Kicking Horse! Bring Cafes to NJ!

My father bought me a French Press for Christmas this year and I was looking for a great strong dark roast to make in it. well i found it. i have been a coffee lover for 20 years(the stronger the better) and from the first time i smelled this freshly ground i knew i had found a new favorite. i was kinda put off by the term "kick ass" in the name, thinking it was more of a novelty then actual high end coffee but i was wrong. it is bold and complex and u can almost notice a hint of dark chocolate in the aroma (not in the flavor). in my opinion this is one of the best coffees i've ever had and i look forward to trying there other varieties. in all honesty writing this has my mouth watering for a cup so i think i'll make some... FYI 4 scoops fresh ground in the french press makes the perfect brew.

Several years ago I lived out on the west coast. One of my local SF coffee shops entertained the buds with some outrageous grinds. Bold and smooth. It has been many years that I have been able to find that same satisfying good cup o' joe feeling after a fresh brewed sip. This is it my friend. This is it. I am grinding the beans just before brewing. And remember! Never freeze your bean.

This is a terrific coffee if you like a very dark roast oily bean.  I had been ordering Guatemalan dark roast from Peace Coffee in Minneapolis.  But I had to order ten pounds at a time to keep the price reasonable.  With the Kicking Horse from Amazon I get two fresh pounds a month, actually one Kilo, and I never even have to think about it.  I'm sold!The above review was written after the first bag.  The second bag was a different story.  It had an odor similar to "dirty feet", and was not good at all. I will be looking for another dark roasted coffee.  I love the auto delivery program.

If you're looking for one of the strongest whole bean coffee brands out there, look no further than Kicking Horse. This particular blend, Kick Ass Dark, is their most caffinated dark roast that they make. The flavor and strength of this coffee is nothing short of amazing, I've been drinking coffee for years, I'm sure like most of you, and for my morning cup I need a little something extra to get me going. This coffee does that and then some. Not only is it very strong, it also goes down smooth and lacks a bitter aftertaste most often associated with stronger coffee. Forget Folgers, the smell of this coffee alone will get you going in the right direction in the morning, when most of us need it the most. Couldn't recommend this brand and this particular flavor high enough.

column9: The Best Coffee...EVER, our search is over!
column10: I had never heard of this brand, but am always in search of a good whole bean coffee.  Based on the good reviews, I just ordered this coffee...it arrived yesterday and I am in heaven (at 6:30 AM).  I was so thrilled to open the bag to see that the beans have that oily look, something lacking from even some of the most expensive coffees.  The beans themselves have the most incredible aroma.  I love dark roast, but hate the "burnt" taste and lack of flavor that come with many of the dark roasts, even the big brands.  Kicking Horse has mastered the art of dark roast!  This is a really good darker roast, not burnt and not bitter...nice and smooth with great flavor.Just thought I would add one more positive review, in case anyone needs more convincing to try this coffee, I am so glad we did try it! We like it so much we just signed up for subscribe and save.:  A huge thank you to the reviewer that compared this coffee to Caribou Obsidian, it does indeed remind me of that coffee, other than being a notch better and less expensive...couldn't get any better than this!

This coffee has a very smooth flavor as compared to some other dark coffees which can be bitter and harsh - it is very tasty.  Some dark coffees have a smoky undertone and this one doesn't at all.  It has a very nice dark, yet rich flavor and is something you could drink every day and not get tired of.  When you open the bag you notice that the beans are dark and oily and they have an incredible aroma.  Overall, I would recommend this to anyone who prefers dark coffee and is looking for something they can drink every day.

My girlfriend and I absolutely love Kicking Horse Kick Ass coffee.  We're spoiled now, making other "average" coffees, well, average.  What a wonderful find.  We've subscribed to monthly deliveries.  Going to give their decaf whole bean coffee a try next.  If you love coffee drink Kicking Horse now!

column9: What's with all these good reviews?!!
column10: I love strong coffe, I really like Peets coffee so if you've had that you get the idea of what I like. Anyways, there is not anything special about this coffee. I wish I picked something else! Being organic is about it. The beans are dark and oily and I was really excited but what I got in result was not up to all the hype. I use a French press.

I'm a HUGE Starbuck's fan but thought I'd just give this a try, based on the reviews. It's now my new favorite.  Dark, bold and so smooth.  Nothing more to ask out of a coffee.  Kicking horse delivers.

column9: very good coffee at a good price
column10: Very smooth for such a bold coffee.  Too many dark roasts are bitter and acidic but this one is neither.  I was so impressed that I signed up for the monthly delivery.

I make my coffee in a french press, use a coarse grind, and watch my time. I started brewing for only 3 minutes, still a little to burnt for my tastes. I usually like the very dark roasts, but something was just too deep about this one. Still, I've had worse and rank this about average (3 stars)

When I saw this particular bag of coffee pop up so highly in the search results, and saw the high reviews, I hesitated a moment due to its high price.  But then I decided to go for it, since I'm always up for trying a new coffee, regardless of price, if it's really something spectacular.I received the coffee promptly, and loaded the beans into my high-end burr grinder.  I then brewed the grounds in a french press.  I expected something pretty amazing, or at least an above-average coffee.  Unfortunately, I found neither in this bag.Though I hate to say it, I'd put this coffee on par with Folgers, or some other budget American brand.  It completely lacks flavor...  It's very mild across the whole spectrum, and even lacks body/mouthfeel.  Simply put, it tastes about like cheap diner coffee that's been sitting on a burner for a while.  Really, really disappointing.The only reason I can come up with for the high price is that the quantity is quite high; the bag is enormous (2.2 pounds).  Unfortunately, the quality is exponentially lower.  It's a shame, too; given that British Columbia is so close to Seattle (a place that prides itself on excellent coffee), I expected this to be a great one.  Unless you really need a (giant) cool looking coffee bag design, I'd avoid this one.
Not that great; it lacks body for a better word. So far I have not tasted anything better than The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf, Hand-Roasted Espresso Whole Bean Coffee, 12-Ounce Bags (Pack of 3).
My new favorite coffee for my french press. Unfortunately since I ordered it on My 20th, it has increased in price 6.96 per bag. Really?

I first enjoyed Kicking Horse Coffees during a visit to Canada, since then I have it delivered monthly from Amazon.I am not an expert on coffee but I do drink an inordinate amount daily and this coffee is simply the best. Kicking Horse has several "flavors" and all are excellent.  I highly recommend anyone who loves their java that they give this brand a try!
Must be the best organic coffee out there - tried a couple of their other blends but this is an all time favorite

I have ordered this coffee several times and have talked it up to all of my coffee drinking friends. This last bag was so oily it was shiny when I opened the bag and the smell was nauseating. I went ahead and used it thinking that maybe slight exposure to the air and small batch grinding would help but every pot gets worse. My mouth feels like it is coated with oil and I feel like gagging even hours after drinkig my morning cup.I am relunctant to reorder so will probably just go back to Starbucks.Very disappointed.

column9: Great dark slippery roast for espresso
column10: Kick Ass is a great bean for espresso. Grinds well in my Capresso 560 Infinity conical burr grinder. Smooth with no burnt flavor. Doesn't jam grinder while leaving lingering robust flavor after drinking.

I have been drinking this coffee since discovering it at a B&B in Canada several years ago, and I started ordering it directly from the Kicking Horse Roasting Company then.  Getting it through Amazon is a great deal!  If you like a dark roast coffee, try this.

I love the look of this packaging and the name is great as well. I was skeptical of the taste but when I brewed my first cup I was sold. This stuff really has some great punch to it and had a very rich coffee taste which I love. I am replacing my old coffee with this from now on. Any k cups in the making?
I don't usually get coffee on-line, but I was already making an order and had free shipping...  Great coffee, rich flavor without that burnt edge I think french roasts can have.  Would order again!

I love dark coffee, but hate the bitterness that is often present in darker coffees.  Kicking Horse Kick Ass Dark is very dark but very smooth.  I had my second cup this morning and it was great.  There is not bitterness going down or bitter aftertaste. The beans are quite oily, so don't be surprised when you open the bag.

I love Kicking Horse's coffee beans.Out of the half dozen Kilo's and several roast varieties I've used, never a single bad bean.Kick Ass dark is my daily go-to bean.The roast is always spot on. Always rich and oily.I wouldn't say I'm a coffee snob, but this stuff might turn me into one. It's hard to drink anything else.

I am so impressed with the quality of this product, as well as the price-for-quantity!  We grind beans daily for use on our drip or espresso machines, and it is by far the best coffee I have had!  We usually purchase Britt Costa Rican coffee, which I've loved, but Kicking Horse is even better! Smooth, strong, full of flavor.

Received this nicely sized package from Amazon today. It comes vacuum sealed and in a very neat package. When you open the package, such a strong, unique aroma permeates the air. Before even using the Aeropress to brew my first cup, the kitchen smelled like a coffee house!Well, I have to say, these Canadian roasters have performed quite the amazing feat, as the coffee tastes just as bold and invigorating as the initial smell from the bag.Prepare to be amazed as this is one superb cup of coffee, without even being remotely bitter!! (This is not for the faint of heart, as it is more potent than any of the other bolder blends that I have tasted)

column9: Got it today, ready to subscribe!
column10: I ordered a two pound bag of this along with a french press from another vendor. Both arrived today. I was so excited I couldn't wait! The french press is my first, so I can't really say much about it, but this sure wasn't my first cup of coffee.I've had coffee in Europe, Asia and all over the US, and I can honestly say this is one of the all-time best. These are some beautiful dark beans. Pungent and aromatic, and glistening with oil.The brew is strong but richly smooth, not bitter.I'm sure I'm not doing Kicking Horse any justice with my review, but trust me when I say you won't be disappointed.

When I opened the bag, my wife thought I was making coffee from 3 rooms away within 30 seconds.  The beans are that oily.  I popped one in my mouth, and got zero bitterness.  With free shipping, this is significantly cheaper than buying at the grocery, and significantly better.  Before this we were drinking Starsucks Sumatra or from a local roaster.  These beans kick more ace than both.  Thanks Amazon and reviewers, you were right!

There's nothing really wrong with this coffee.That being said, I don't find it to have the flavor or heavy body that I look for in a dark roast.  Honestly, I think Starbuck's medium blends are stronger than this.  I like  dark roasts and was really looking forward to an experience more akin to what the label says to expect.  I also expected better from a boutique roaster at this price point.  This is not a bad coffee at all.  Not by a long shot.  On the other hand, there is nothing compelling about this coffee either.All things considered, I'll stick to Starbuck's.
I have been looking for organic, fair trade, dark roast coffee. So far, this is the best! Beans look right out of the bag, product is reasonably consistent (this is my second bag).

I french press my coffee and these beans have done well. A very rich flavor. I like that the beans are shade grown (less chemicals) and fair trade.I have been subscribed to receive a new bag once a month and the beans have been consistently fresh and oily.I found this to be true on all the Kicking Horse coffees so far. Highly recommended.

I live for the morning coffee.  I like it strong, deep colored, and without the frills of milk/cream, sugar/sugar substitute.  Kick Ass is heaven in a two pound bag.  I have tasted and enjoyed some brand coffees or coffee shops, but this, when ground in the morning with some filtered water is the best.  I just ordered my second bag and the only reason I do not go to subscription is I do not know the variable rate of my household consumption, guests included, so I will wait until the bag gets to a certain depth, or lack thereof, and reorder and thanks to Amazon Prime, I have it in two days!!

My son send the coffee to my wife for Mother's Day.  We opened the package full of expectation... The coffee smells pretty good, but is really lacking in the taste department.  Its taste is in the blend side, and not bitter nor flavorful.  We use a Krups Expresso machine, so we can extract most of the flavor from the coffee.  This product is no comparison to the Starbucks French Roast.

column9: Kick it up in the morning
column10: I love this coffee I need a quick wake up in the morning and this does it and the great part is I no longer run out it is always at my front door before I run out. Great stuff
This coffee tastes great. If you don't drink 64 ounces of coffee a day, consider getting a smaller size, since it (like all coffee) looses flavor over time.
very good coffee.  i would recommend this coffee to others.  it's organic and fair trade also.  go ahead and try some!

I purchased kicking horse kickass dark roast for fathers day because well i needed a gift and we weren't happy with our current brand and i have now found a new coffee.It has a srtong yet very smooth flavor and what a aroma, i just ordered my second bag and if the quality stays at this level i will be a very happy customer!

I've been a religious buyer and maker of dark coffee for 20 + years now and I have to say, this is terrific coffee. It almost tastes like cold press because of the very faint trace of acidity. If you like bold, use the same amount of beans you would for Starbucks French or a dark Tully's roast.

This coffee is pretty stout. I was trying to stay away from the starbucks beans because they are too dark roasted for my liking. The kick ass coffee is just as dark.The coffee itself is good, just not what I'm lookin for. I really wish the roast date was on the bag instead of the expiration date.

This coffee was far from the worst I have ever had, but it was not very good.  It was more bitter than most coffee, and it had an acrid, thin taste to it.  At $12.25/lb (26.96 for 2.2 lbs) it is simply not worth the price. I can buy Peet's at the grocery store or online for $10/lb and it is superior in every way.

The delivery was very prompt, and true to the description the beans were a dark oily roast.  The packaging has maintained excellent freshness, even after months in our freezer.  The beans produce a dark full bodied flavor which has earned compliments of all who have sampled it over the past six months. All in all a lot of bang for the buck.
This is a good, high quality coffee.  The roast is dark without being burnt.  The unique name is an added bonus.

I agree with some reviewers about the oiliness of the beans. They never specified if the beans were arabica or robusta, but judging from the appearance, smell, taste, caffeine content and amount of crema obtained, I think that there is a high percentage of robusta in this. That being the case, I would have been better off roasting my local beans myself, because the results are almost the same for a fraction of the price. Just came from finishing off a 2.2 lb of Lavazza and I was a bit disappointed with the taste of the Kicking Horse to be honest. Maybe other tasters have different preferences, so to each his own, but I'll stick to what I'm comfortable with.

column9: Smooth flavor but not quite bold enough for me
column10: Kicking Horse Kick Ass Dark coffee. Beans were fresh and the coffee has a very smooth flavor but I like my dark roast coffee darker/stronger flavored. Beans were not as dark or as oily as I like. Service was good and I received the order quicly.
Experimented with many types of coffee, but this type is different in taste and smell makes you feel relaxed and activity that the most beautiful cup of coffee in the morning and evening

I really like this coffee.  There's no bitter after taste, and it's great iced as well.  My sister likes it as well.  It's got a good balance of flavors yet still bold at the same time.  Definitely would recommend this product.

I recently discovered this coffee on a trip to Canada, where it is $15.95 CA per pound.  Something told me to splurge and buy it, grind it myself, and I was delighted with the result.  I looked up the Kicking Horse website, where they describe each of their coffees, some dark, some medium roast.  I am thrilled to see it on Amazon for less and already put this Kick Ass Dark in my cart!Update:  The 2 lb bag arrived in perfect condition.  I like having the option of 2 lbs, since I go through it so quickly.  The coffee is fresh, perfectly roasted, and I'm happy to wake up each morning to enjoy it.
very good coffee but it is roasted is too dark for my taste would love to try same beans with different roast
Great coffee!I must say this is some kickass coffee. Keeps you going all morning. Made some chocolate covered beans just to snack on in the afternoon to get more of a kickass.
Good tasting dark roasted coffee with quite a bite. Nice to get you started in the morning. A plus that it is organic.

We buy one 2.2 pound pouch of Kicking Horse Kick-Ass dark and one 5 pound pouch of Shock coffee each month.  Both are similar in roast and taste.  I can't tell them apart if my wife brews the coffee instead of me brewing it.  That said, this is an excellent dark roasted coffee with full body flavor.  It is robust but not bitter.  I can't find a local coffee as good.

My husband and I enjoy using our French press in the morning and have tried this coffee before.I just placed our second order and made it a birthday gift to me! (But I am more than glad to share.) We took advantage of the newer "in the bag price," and it beats Starbucks per pound price too. This is a strong but oh so smooth coffee and I have got to tell you...can't wait till it gets here! Happy Birthday to Me!

Coffee flavor and aroma are good, and I like the organic/fair trade designations. I've sampled dozens of specialty coffees from Amazon.com, and I'd say this one is in the top 5. However, if you are using a grind-and-brew coffee maker, you should know that the beans are so oily that they stick to the inside of the hopper more than other beans. To make a full flavored pot of coffee, you have to set the grinder to 2-4 cups more than the amount of water you are using (so, if you pour in 8 cups of water, set the grinder to 10 or 12 cups). The alternative is to open the top of the hopper and nudge the beans to the hole, but then you are exposing them to oxygen.

All three of my sons are in the military and thus stationed all over the states. I have twin sons that are both captains, one in the Army in Virginia and one in the Air Force in Louisana-when their birthdays come up and I need to send a gift Amazon is always trustworthy-Sent  the coffee to Louisana-My son said it was some of the best coffee he has had in years-made using his press the coffee was both aluring and tasty- It was delivered as promised!! Thank you
I had bought this brand in Toronto and luckily found it in Indiana and was happy to find it online. Breakfast coffee will never be the same. Thank you Kicking Horse.
we've tried them all, and this one beats them all!  a must try!!!  use a french press to enjoy all the dimensions.
This is type of coffee that you want to make when you have time to sit and enjoy your pot coffee.  It has a rich and deep flavor without bitterness.  Sit back, relax, and enjoy.

I tried this coffee kind of as a joke because of the name and because we have rescue donkeys and have a horse ranch.  The great surprise was the coffee was absolutely wonderful.  I love a rich dark roast and this coffee has the depth of a dark roast but has retained a very rich flavor!  Since the first bag I have not purchased anything else.  I have had some of the best dark roast coffees in the world and would rate this right at the top!  Keep doing what you are doing Kicking Horse and I'll keep buying.  If you like dark full flavor give it try.
This is great, great coffee.  Brews up like a dream in our Bunn.  Handles cream well, but also is an excellent black cup of coffee.  Worth the price.

column9: Don't discredit because of the name!
column10: As others have mentioned this is an oily bean.  The roast is quite dark.  I use the bean for espresso and I love the flavor.  Not bitter and not acidic.  I think it doesn't seem like much on first sip but the after taste is nice and lingering.

Love this coffee, was given a sample by a visiting Canadian, but it's not available in the local stores. Found coffee on Amazon and it was delivered to me in a few days.  Very happy with this product, and also with the quick service.
My husband likes coffee allots. this coffee is absolutely delicious.we are very happy to join subscription and get every month .

I drink a lot of coffee (typically 3-5 cups in the morning) so I go through a lot of beans in short time. I also like dark roasts with lots of flavor. Kicking Horse solves two problems for me a) the bag is really big b) it has a really deep flavor that I really like.

Just the aroma alone was so intensely delicious you could practically wake up on the fumes! I take it with about 1/2 tsp sugar per 5/6oz cup and this was dark and flavorful without crossing the line into that burnt roast variety (yuk!) My husband drinks espresso with a bit of sugar and he liked it, too. (We also enjoy medium roasts, so enjoy good coffee all around!)We have a 5-year-old automatic Saeco machine and it works great in this (our grind setting is 4, changed to 5 but I can't tell the difference.) The package has all kinds of instructions and precautions on how important grind size, water, machine cleanliness and amount of coffee grinds makes a difference, so if you're not happy with the first cup, be fair and try another with different amounts of water or coffee. :)

Definately a very high quality taste.  I used it with Cabot vintage choice chedder and it was to die for!  I have used that same cheese with other unsmoked pepperoni sticks and the taste just wasn't the same.  The product is not greasy, and was fairly easy to peel.  Not only do I reccomend this product, but I do recommend it with the same cheese as both flavors are great together.

column9: Wish I could still find this item!
column10: My kids are allergic to artificial dyes.  For several years, we went without drinking Kool-Aid until we discovered this product.  It is odd how the "clear" color makes it feel somewhat less festive, but it still tastes great.  I love Koolaid myself, and the grape is really good!

We had banned KoolAid in our house because of the problems with spilled drinks. The stains especially from the red and purple colored drinks would not come out of carpeting and cost a bundle to remove. The "invisible KoolAid" was available for a very short time in grocery stores. Then I could not find it anywhere until Amazon.com started carrying it. I wish it was available in more flavors but I buy both the cherry and the grape on a regular basis.

column9: Great product for those with Dye sensitivities/allergies
column10: Love the Invisible Kool-Aids because my son is sensitive to FD&C Red and Yellow dyes.  My son loves the taste and it gives me an alternative to the Clear Bursts that are flavored with artificial sweeteners.

We move a lot and rent everywhere we go. It seems that most places we rent choose light colored carpet, even in the dining room. So Invisible kool-aid has saved us sooooo much headache from kool aid stained carpets, not to mention that we get more of our security deposit.Kool-Aid had the brilliant idea to remove the artificial coloring. That is the only difference that I can tell. The flavor is the same. It is no difference in preparation, just in the appearance of the product.My kids love the kool aid just the same!
I am glad to have found these at Amazon. I had searched many different stores looking for this one and the Cherry with no success. Thanks to Amazon, I have been able to stock up!

column9: Better off with unsweetened 0.13oz packets of Kool-Aid instead
column10: Found that pre-sweetened Kool-Aid mix takes more to make 1 or 2 quart servings. Unsweetened Kool-Aid mix is easier to make,and tastes better.Presweetened container says makes 8 quarts,but I came up short of that 8 quarts. Don't pay for the sugar to be added,when you can buy it yourself & add it to your own Kool-Aid. Yes,the "Invisible" Kool-Aid flavors are impossible to find,in the unsweetened mix packets.(Raspberry,Cherry&Grape)Watermelon Kiwi can be found.
We thought we were getting grape illusion and we received invisible grape.  Amazon offered us a gift certificate and was very prompt in sending it out.  Thank you.

I bought this thinking it was way over priced, but using a few drops as a finishing sauce bringing out the flavors in the background and it goes a long way.I did a side by side taste test with 3 Crab fish sauce and this is much better, as is the 40 n Red Boat. The 3 Crab is good fish sauce and I use it in large quantities, but the flavor compared to the Red Boat  and Blis is like fresh fish in salt compared to a can of anchovy paste that leaves an aftertaste.This is a great finishing sauce for dressings or a few drops in a bowl of soup or even some cocktails like the Manhattan.

column9: Not Smarties brand! MADE IN CHINA
column10: You will not recieve the item pictured. instead, you will recieve generic candy neclaces that are MADE IN CHINA. These apparently are made by the same manufaturers as Smarties but they are NOT Smarties! is a non-returnable item. Amazon issued me store credit and I was very thankful for that.
I had purchased this at a cook store out of town and had a hard time finding it a year or so later.  This stuff is really simple to use and delicious.

Makes great matzo meal pancakes and wonderful for making fishcakes too.  Pleasant bland taste.  Takes seasoning well.Good for breading.  I just  wish it had been clearly stated that it wasn't kosher for Passover.

Here's another Wiley's product that I must have in my pantry.  I make this following the directions using ground turkey and then add either a can of rinsed black beans or rinsed black eyed peas and it's a meal in one.  SO very tasty and easy and although it has a little "bite" to it, it's not overly hot and spicy.  Even if you've never had "dirty rice", give it a try...my family loves this as do I!

I purchased this product for my mom as you can't seem to find it in any grocery or healthfood stores anymore.  The shipping was FAST and I was able to have them send it directly to mom- something Ebay doesn't offer.

The whole kit showed up as promised.  I made the recipes as instructed.  The bread was heavy like a rock, not fluffy like the Ezekial bread we buy in the store.  I discovered that to make that kind of bread, we would have to invest in a special grinding machine that costs over $200.  Well--me thinks we'll stick to buying it from the store.

This is now one of the favorites for my oldest cat.  I think that she likes the soft texture, as well as the rich smell (which equates to taste for cats).  This flavor seems to agree with her, whereas the last case of Holistic Select (purple label, but I don't remember the flavor name) caused her to have positively noxious bowel movements.  The younger cat is not very picky about canned food, so of course she loves this, too.  Both of them prefer Wellness, but this is a close second.  At a price that I can afford and ingredients that I approve of (although not as good as Wellness), I consider this to be a very good value.  (Especially as long as Amazon continues to offer Super Saver Shipping on cases.)
I normally love amazon, but I also received expired dog food. Ordered it late November, and the bag expired 9/10!  An oversight I'm sure, but very disappointing.

Horizon Legacy is high quality dog food that I am willing to pay a premium for.. However, paying a premium for expired food just doesn't seem right.  I ordered the food at the end of November, and the food that was sent expired last September.  Very disappointing.

Mix this stuff with olive oil and soy sauce (1/4 cup olive oil, 2 tablespoons of soy sauce, and 2 teaspoons of this seasoning and brush it on steaks or meats about 10 minutes before grilling). It is delicious and will rival a steak in a restaurant. Your guest will want your secret !
Good quick rub. If you tenderize your steak with a Jaccard tenderizer or equivalent, spread it (and a bit of EVOO) on the meat BEFORE your tenderize. You won't be disappointed.

column9: Burgers, Steaks, Chicken + Mccormick Montreal Seasoning = amazing
column10: Mccormick Montreal seasoning is one of the simplest, best tasting, and versatile seasoning on the planet for virtually any meat. It's awesome on burgers and steaks, but it's also very good on chicken, vegetable kabobs, pork chops, and virtually any other meat. I mix it with soy sauce for burgers, and consistently get asked by my guests what the secret is. They can't believe it when I tell them how simple it is! I also use this in the broiler with a little olive oil with great results.There are few ready made seasonings that I will use when I grill (I prefer to use homemade dry rubs or marinades) and this is one of them. It is the best of the best, and I can heartily recommend it for grilling.

im deployed in kuwait and ordered this for our cookouts we have every now and then. arrived fairly fast in about 2 weeks( about average for mail to kuwait) it has really improved the quality our our steaks. i love this stuff

Have a collection of grills on my back patio that have been idle for a number of years.  Now, am re-interested in cooking.  I got this as a result of a friend's suggestion  I love it!  I could become a world champion, with this stuff - or maybe not!  It's good product that was sent quickly and certainly was, as described.  I know that "taste" is a very individual thing. Available at most grocery chains everywhere.  Go buy a small container - give it a try.  If you like it, then you can buy a "truckload", if you like.

This is by far one of the great steak marinades I have ever used. I used it for some steaks when friends came in from out of town. They were so thrilled with the flavor and taste, that they wanted the secret, well they keep come back in town, to have a great steak.  I have also had neighbors ask what i was grillin, So do your self a favor and pick some up..

I've seen some of the information about the benefits of coconut water.  I'm sick of drinking Gatorade.  The first couple I tried were not my favorites, until an Indian friend recommended Real Coconut Water.  WOW!!!  Try it, you'll like it!
This is the best coconut water I have ever tested.It is as good as a fresh green coconut water. Very happy with this product

I have been involved with Coconut Water in many capacities from distributing Zico to taste testing Vita-Coco,ONE,Naked,Taste Nirvana and none of them compare to Real Coconut Water. My kids play Collegiate tennis and drink Coconut Water to rehydrate and stay cramp free(loaded with Potassium). They used to have to hold thir nose to get it down until they tried Real coconut water..they said "Wow-this actually tastes good"! 100% Pure Coconut water nothing added like some of the others that add sugar or are pasteurized.Try it You'll Love it!

I keep this soft peppermint puffs in a candy dish at work and everyone loves them.  They are fresh, soft with just the right amount of sweetness. I'm  repeat buyer of this product, it's good quality at a good price.
We love these mints!!  I keep them close at hand all the time.  They are great for occasional indigestion or a sweet attack!!!

I bought this to throw to kids from my car in a 4th of July parade. The red and white colors made it perfectfor the 4th. It was over 100 degress that day, and about 115 in the car, but it didn't affect the candy at all. I finished the remains about 2 weeks later and it was still very good. I will definitely buy this next year.
Love the King Leo mints.  They are delicious and worth every penny.  Fast shipping and sturdy packaging.  Everyone should enjoy these wonderful candies.

I bought this product at BJ's for 1/3 of what the Amazon seller is charging here. I cannot believe the seller is even charging almost $20 for this when you can get it for under $6 at some discount retailers. But my issue with this product is that it claims to be "Soft" Peppermint when the candy is so hard you might break your teeth biting into one. These are not the restaurant style soft mints that melt in your mouth at all. You literally have to bite into them and continue to chew them to get them to melt. If you don't mind having harder than typical soft mints than this candy does offer an OK minty aftertaste.
wE KEEP THIS IS A DISH FOR OUR CUSTOMERS AND THEY JUST LOVE THEM. SO TASTY AND MELT IN YOUR MOUTH.HAVE TO RESTOCK THE DISH EVERY DAY."THANKS" FOR A NICE LIGHT REFRESHING TREAT.

column4: Ava-Lisa F. Macon "Warning: May leap small cu...
column10: It takes me about 10 to 15 minutes finish one of these small, but complex bars. Definitely satisfying.I took my box cautiously from my weight-loss facilitor, who warned that while most program participants loved them, some reported too close a similarity to "bird seed."  I'm squarely in the "loved them" camp.  I've tried two varieties, the organic chocolate & the goji berries. Both were lightly sweetened, barely salted & packed with flavor.  A fan of granola or other nutty bars, will find these similarly enjoyable with a longer-lasting sense of fullness following consumption.Sticking to a low-carb diet is significantly helped by the addition of this snack.  I use it in the mornings w/a bottle of water to get me going, and I have another in the afternoon or evening.  Great for a quick movie snack when I'm tempted by the smell of the surrounding popcorn, or at the office to build resistance to an endless parade of sweet treats.pros: individually wrapped, portable, filling, tasty, satifies sweet & salt cravingscons: crumbles easily, relatively expensive

column9: I like them, but don't love them
column10: I really do enjoy these but they're a pain to eat. They fall apart a lot when you eat them. I understand this is because they have a very short, and relatively healthy, ingredient list; if there were more crap in there they'd probably stick together more. So, understand me when I say that they do indeed taste very good, have a decent crunch and subsequent chew to them, but at the end of the day they're not a full 5 star product. I still eat them pretty much every day though.

I wake up craving these bars. So delicious, not too sweet but enough to satisfy a sweet craving... without raising your blood sugars. They are great for road trips or hiking or when I'm home I refrigerate them which makes them crunchie. The Goji berry flavor is also divine! Enjoy!

column9: Highly recommended (chocoholic on low sugar/low grain diet)
column10: I've only had the chocolate, though I'm sure I'd like the other flavors, especially goji berry. It's the closest thing I've found to a truly nutritious, low sugar, tasty, healthy bar.  Even chocolate is an anti-oxidant.Per an earlier review, I agree that they crumble but I see that as a benefit, it proves to me that it's really whole food, I can even see the ingredients. Like whole grain granola chunks, not like the tiny crumbles of a cookie.Highly recommend these if you need a healthy snack on the go!!!!Go "Raw Crunch Bars"!

I'm so surprised people giving this a 5-star or a 4-star.... To me it tastes bland, boring, and dry. If you just like the taste of a bunch of seeds stuck together, than you might love these bars. It tastes too much like "bird food" to me though.

I love these bars. They are primarily seed based, so if you don't love seeds then you won't love these bars.  However, they are Gluten-free, Dairy-free & GMO-free if you're looking to rid yourself of any of the above mentioned items.  Also, they are vegetarian and possibly vegan depending on your stance on honey.Personally, I just wanted a snack bar that was gluten free, soy free, msg free, preservative free and tasted good.  That's what I got here!  I like the cranberry version too.They do fall apart when you eat them, as one other reviewer mentioned, but I never pull mine all the way out of the package so it usually catches the mess for me.
I live in the country and the store is very, very for from my house so i do my shopping online. These bags of chips were really, really big and they tasted good.

This oil is far superior to Spanish or Italian olive oils and to many Greek. A First Cold Pressing, there are no additives or preservatives so the oil has a light, clean taste. I use it extensively in salads and over pasta dishes.I am extremely pleased with the quality of this product.

This is by far my favourite olive oil. I used it in a restaurant i worked in, and loved it so much, i started getting it at home. It's fruity and perfect for salad dressing, bread dipping and finishing on you pasta/scrambled eggs/anything! I always cook with it too, and it's beautiful when making pestos. We go through the big tin quite quickly as we use it so liberally! It's great value at this price. GET IT.

This is by far the best olive oil I've had.  I first tried it with bread in a local Italian cafe and I really liked the flavor so we asked the server for the brand name.  I don't know how to describe it, I think it's more on the fruity rather than peppery side.  I can't find it in my local grocery store, fortunately, I can get it from Amazon.

You have to try this sauce to believe it! It starts out a little sweet with honey then your taste buds become alive with flavors of sweet onion, garlic, whiskey and a mesquite smoked flavor then just as you are analyzing all the flavors, about 20 seconds in, you get an awesome habanero kick that comes up in the back side of your mouth, that slowly rises in heat about 1 stage hotter than their Sweet Whiskey Habanero sauce, but is in no way overwhelming and leaves no bad taste in your mouth. Simply perfect!! I cant wait to try their Smoked Tennessee Maple sauce next!

Muir Glen cans are lined in plastic and leach Bisphenol A. Too bad because this was a great product and was a standard in my household. My initial conversations with them they contradicted this fact, which to me was misleading. General Mills owns Cascadian Farms as well and now I don't buy there either.Now we use BioNature in jars or Pomi products in Tetra Pak cartons. All canned tomato products use BPA and so do many of the lids of jars used in food containment.Now I also just make from scratch which is made simple by chef Andrew Carmellini in Everyday Italian. Lydia Bastianich is another favorite chef that deserves mention for simple yet big flavors.Boil, peel, freeze and store. Can manufacturing companies that I corresponded with said they were working on a solution for later this year or next year.
These are some of the best canned tomatoes I've ever had and they are organic to boot.Great price with Amazon subscription service. Enjoy!

These are my favorite canned tomatoes- just buzz them up in the food processor with a little olive oil and garlic and call it sauce!The only drawback was when I ordered from Amazon and got this great price- they were not packed very well and half the cans were dented in shipping.

I was fortunate enough to find "Muir Glen Organic Whole Peeled Tomato with Basil, 28-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)" from Amazon.  Initially, I had bought a couple of cans of this product at a health-food store which is almost a hundred miles away, and not close enough and convenient to drive to when I needed more. I have been making "Tomato Soup With Basil" and these tomatoes are excellent to use in the recipe and because they are  ORGANIC makes them safer and healthier for me to use. THANK YOU, Amazon! You are indeed  a "Friend In Need"!

Subscribed w/ Amazon to get these regularly and am very glad I tried them. Some of the tastiest, freshest canned tomatoes I have ever opened. At the subscribe and save price these 28 oz. cans are as cheap as one can buy them anywhere near where I live-and they come straight to my door instead of me having to go out and buy them. Great for storage, too. I do not like to run out of tomatoes or sauce so this is a big money/time saver for me. I just ordered Muir Glen's chunky sauce, too. These w/ basil have just enough basil to use them in almost any recipe w/ tomatoes. The basil can be tasted as just a hint of herb. The tomatoes are not sour nor are they sweet....tangy might be a good word. Nice, fresh, tomato taste. A bonus-beautiful red color...some canned tomatoes don't have this color! Easy to puree w/ my stick blender in about 15 sec. I think these would make good ketchup; which I plan on trying to make w/ them later. Good job by Muir Glen as to the amount of spice, IMO. A very reasonable substitute to having fresh tomatoes at hand all the time. I recommend these highly.

With no additives, or chemically altered substances Muir Glen delivers. These tomatoes are plump, and full of juicy goodness, with basil leaves.For allergic sensitive individuals who cannot tolerate olive oil, or garlic,which is in almost all store bought tomato brands, could use this as a base instead!

column9: A lot of flavor, little calories
column10: These are my favorite of the 100 calorie packs (so far)  Fun mix of different flavors and textures in the crackers, plus they have a nice spice mix that really gives them a nice zesty flavor.
These are very good, low calorie, easy snacks to take on the go. I have bought them 3 times on AMAZON. They are a better price than at the grocery store.
These are awesome.  Great Price when buying in bulk vs. the single box even with shipping.  These are perfect size especially for weight watcher people counting thier points.

Our family really enjoy the taste of the Ritz Snack Mix.  The packages are the right size for anyone who is watching their calorie intake.  Helpful snack when you crave something crunchy and salty with only 100 calories.

I'll preface this with the following. I bought a bunch of these 100 Calorie Packs not because I really care that they only have 100 calories, but because most portions are way, way too huge, and I like miniature food items, or kids foods because of the smaller portion sizes.The Ritz snack pack is good. I took a bunch of these hiking and they were perfect. One pouch is a good snacking amount of mix. There are pretzels, mini cheese crackers, and mini ritz. The crackers are all baked, and in smaller sizes than normal. The thing that surprised me was that the mix is a little spicy. But that makes it actually taste normal, and good.Definitely recommend these for camping, road trips, or if you need a good snack to pack in a lunch.

column9: i got only 2 boxes!!!!! I want my money back!!! I am so mad***
column10: I love this snack and when i readProduct FeaturesTwo cases of six boxes, each containing six .77-ounce bags of crackers (72 total bags) ***i got 12 bags***Low-calorie, crunchy blend of crackers, Ritz bits and pretzelsNo trans fats or cholesterolJust 100 calories per pack; all of the flavor, and none of the guiltSingle-serve packs ideal for lunchboxesi thought great deal....but today it came and i only have 2 boxes... What the heck. i can get that at walmart for 2 packages for 4.00i dont get it...what a rip off!!!  very misleading go to the store and buy it yourself. I will never buy food from amazon again last time i did it was expired i should of learned!!!!
This is a very good low calorie snack.  If you want something crunchy instead of potato chips this is a great alternative.
This snack mix was very tasty and has a good variety of items in it.  I was afraid they would be mostly pretzels, but they are definitely not.  Great snack that fills you up!
The box arrived on time, very easy company to work with, will order from them again. My tutoring children truly enjoyed the snacks.
Great to have them delivered directly to your doorstep!  This makes it so much easier to shop for healthy food choices when you aren't running in to the grocery store.

column9: Nice variety but a little salty
column10: The title says it all.  The variety is good, but you will definitely need something to drink with it.  I'm eating them and they are okay, but I wouldn't order them again.

100 Calorie Packs Ritz Snack Mix, 6-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)I ate one pack of these and decided that just because I am watching my calories it does not mean I have to eat food that I don't like.  The taste of this item was very unpleasant.  If you want something good try the Ritz 100 calorie salty and sweet snack kettle mix, absolutely delicious. These 2 items look similar but when it comes to taste they are extreme opposites.  One is awful and the other is delicious.

My product should have been delivered a month ago.  This is very bad buisness to think that you can ship something whenever you feel like it.  I am a paying customer that should have been reinbursed in some way for the mistake that your copany made.

Im not a big fan of extra strong dark chocolate, but the health benefits are many so I figured I would try a few of them out. This is by far the best one. Actually has more of a sweet taste and any bitterness is hard to even notice. Packed with antioxidants. A few squares a day is a great addition to any healthy diet.

This is a very nice chocolate. It has been cured to a nice crisp hardness. The flavor has dimension to it with a sweet overtone and minimal back end bitterness. I've very impressed. This will definitely be on my "addiction" list for reordering.

I order a package of 12 Chocolove Premium Chocolate Bars, which by the way is an excellent chocolate, but when it arrived the bars were bent and melting due to he heat of the delivery truck. I contacted the seller and without questions or argument I was sent another order. I received the order well packed and cold in 2 days. Because I was stunned to see such customer service I contacted the seller once again to offer payment for the UPS cost, but the seller refused stating that their goal is total satisfaction and that I should not pay for the shipping. Just amazing service! I will recommend this seller to anyone and ask to support them. If there were more stars to give I would had given them the max.I hope this review helps.DF

this is my favourite chocolate ever.  creamy melt in your mouth texture..plus the little squares are domed and fit perfectly against the roof of your mouth (each one has a little heart on it too).  nice dark flavour without the bitterness that can happen in the REALLY dark ones.  i like the darker ones too, but this is my favourite percentage.  the flavoured ones are really yummy as well.  my boyfriend is also addicted to this brand.  maybe you don't think you need to buy twelve at a time, but i think it's a great idea!

column9: The best chocolate bar, hands down
column10: I love chocolate.  Good chocolate.  I've tried fancy bars, local bars, hand-poured bars, organic bars, and almost everything else, and THIS is my favorite.  The chocolate is perfectly dark without being bitter, the orange has an incredibly satisfying crunch and a slight (very slight) chewiness that makes the texture of the bar divine, and the flavor of orange and chocolate together are heavenly.If only they sold it in more places!

column9: mmmmmmfor chocolate lovers you gotta try this one
column10: I am not usually a lover of dark chocolate, but when a friend gave me this chocolove premium dark (55%) orange peel as a gift, I fell in love with it. So for Valentine's I decided to buy a box and give my special friends a bar for a happy. Now they are all addicted. The orange peel gives it a special little tang and crunch at the end and I would recommend it to any chocolate lover. It was funny that each person said they could not hold out to make it last a whole day like I had challenged them to. It is just too good.

Not only have i had just about everry brand of belgian chocolate this side of the atlantic, i have had this one several times.  But this seller sent bad chocolate. It has a powdery appearance and is very brittle to touch and taste.  Can't eat it at all.  And i guess i can't return it either.

I treat myself to Chocolove at my local health food store once a month.  I am very conservative on how much sugar I have, so I make one bar last me a whole month.  Yes, it has real sugar, but it is so delightful for the amount of sugar that it has.  A taste of heaven.  I buy the 70% cacao and I am hooked! Seductive bliss!  One more thing, if you are in to dark chocolate, the taste is quite smooth, not bitter as some darks go.

column9: Delicious and sells out quickly at grocery store
column10: This is the best chocolate bar I've ever tried.  The salty taste is in perfect balance with the chocolate.  I'm not the only one that thinks so, since our local grocery store sells out of this particular bar almost as soon as they arrive.  The other Chocolove bars are fine, but this one is tops.

My husband and I occasionally enjoy a few pieces of dark chocolate in the evening and this chocolate is a real treat. It is hard to find such good chocolate at less than $3 per bar. We order a couple cases each fall and keep them in the freezer till we need a new bar. This is not bitter chocolate and just 1/6 (3 small squares) of a bar is only 80 calories and satisfies our desires for dark chocolate.

column9: Favorite chocolate bar in the world
column10: I first tried this at a small coffee shop and the memory of the taste haunted me until I found it on Amazon.  It is a wonderfully decadent treat in which to indulge, whether to forget your bad day or to reward yourself for a job well done. You can taste the real orange peel shavings in this chocolate and it is that perfect blend of dark chocolate and orange, which is the most divine combination.

So, I do A/B tests.  You know, like buy bar A and then bar B and then eat 'em both.YEARS of doing this shamelessly has led me to become a regular purchaser of Chocolove's Pure Dark.  The 55% one.I don't care much for their other bars -- they're just so-so -- but DANG! the Pure Dark is crazy-good.Do yourself a favor.  Don't just buy this bar.  Buy this bar and then buy ten other chocolate bars.  It's in the name of science, it's okay.  Take all your bars, break them up, then try them all.Yeah, that chocolate that keeps evolving and coating your mouth with subtlety and wizardry?  That's this one.

Bought some of these in New Mexico at a co-op store and couldn't find them locally in Florida. Bought on line thru Amazon at a lower price and free shipping. The candy is wonderful and it's truly a sweet deal.

I am a fanatic about fabulous chocolate and even more so when it's combined with orange. AND, boy oh boy, Chocolove has hit the nail on the head with this delicious chocolate bar! Well worth  the price. I would definitely recommend this chocolate...so fantastic!

My husband a self-proclaimed chocoholic says this is the best chocolate he's ever eaten.  And because it's so high in cocoa content, it's good for him too!  That's all he needed - another reason to eat chocolate ha! ha!  We bought it in 12-bar packs and gave it out over xmas and everyone agreed...great chocolate!

column9: Best orange chocolate i have tried
column10: Someone gave me a bar as a gift.  I had no idea it would be this good.  Better than other orange/choc combos, it has a nice crunch to the peel bits. Yum.

Bought one of these at Whole Foods about a month ago.The secret: they freeze-dry the orange peel and this leadsto a really strong orange taste with each bite. You get a littlebit of peel this way.I've loved orange chocolate since i was a kid and my Dadbrought some home from trips. This is an excellentversion.

I absolutely love dark chocolate (77% seems to be the magic number) and have tried many different varieties.  This is one of my favorites due to the complex flavor and great dense and smooth texture. Also, this pack of 12 is a economical way to purchase.

Chocolove's Orange Peel in Dark Chocolate is one of the best dark chocolates I've ever eaten. If you're a dark chocolate fan, you owe it to yourself to try this. The orange flavor really shines through and the wrapping is colorful and stylish. The price was amazing too, much less than I pay at other stores.
Best candybars. I was skeptical buying food online, but I can't get these anywhere near me except the Chocolate Show once a year in NYC. They're great - no worries!
this chocolate is a true treat to eat, perfect texture, almond toffee mix goes together perfectly. the packaging is really cute too. very highly recommended!
I am a dark chocolate person and I love this bar.  It is low in sugar and high in cocoa flavor.

column9: Best Almonds and Sea Salt chocolate bar
