column10: I have tried several and this one has just the right amount of sea salt added to not distract from the chocolate, but adds to the flavor.  It is my favorite.  I have many strong favorites for dark chocolate bars, but this one seems to be the only one to get this combination right.
I bought this for my son and he was wowed with the flavor!  He's a vegan who is very particular and prefers to use organic and fair trade products.  This one was a home run!

column9: Hard to find, glad it's in our local grocery!
column10: I must warn you - it's taken me 2 years to be quick enough to get a package of this coffee.  It doesn't matter if it's Amazon or the local grocery store with a "k" - I always miss getting one before it sells out!  Then, I'm stuck with going to trader joe's and well, their's just is a bit weak for me.  Anyway, since Millstone, in my humble opinion, makes about the best cup of coffee around, I wanted one in pumpkin spice, seeing that I'm all things pumpkin.  And, what do you know?  I got to the local grocery and picked up the VERY last one (and I even had a coupon!).  The waiting didn't disappoint - the flavor is rich, smooth, and although it comes close to resembling vanilla, the pumpkin flavors come through magnificiently.  It is not too heavy on the allspice and allows the nutmeg and cinnamon to shine. It is robust, never too weak, and has enough body to be strongly highlighted when coupled with cream and sugar.  If you use a frothing machine, no kidding, it beats Starbucks!  I like to buy enough of these fall and winter coffees before they're gone just because I like to enjoy them all winter here in cold, blustery, blowing snow down your chimney, Ohio.  Hope you can grab a bag when this comes in - it's worth the wait!  Highly, highly recommend!
this is the BEST pumpkin coffee out there. Drank all I could hold during the fall and HAD TO HAVE MORE!!!

I bought this for my two golden retrievers to share.  I took the plastic off and laid it on the lawn.  One sniffed it and walked away and the puppy licked it once then walked away.  Neither would have anything to do with it.  I had it out a few times afterwards and they wouldn't even go near it.  When I put it away in the garage, I had it on a cardboard box and there was so much grease on it that it soaked thru the box right to the floor.  Last week it went out in the garbage.  It was a waste of money.  I should have looked at the reviews and seeing two people rated it so great and it was not Amazon verified purchase they must be the seller rating it or someone from Hartz.  Don't waste your money on this and if you do, do not bring it in the house or you'll be sorry.

column9: The Best, My Dogs LOVE these!
column10: I tend to buy this a lot, while expensive, they can last a long time, given the dog of course, but even then, my Doberman, continues to go back and chew a little bit more, so in the long run I save so much money vs. raw hide etc.  And both my dogs love them.  These are a winner in my book.
Our dog loved this bone.  He didn't part for it for three days straight (unless I took it from him).

We were feeding our 8 year old female cat the Blue Buffalo salmon flavored (non-wilderness) and thought we'd try this for a bit. Normally she's a relatively slow eater (unless she decides she's being bulimic that day), but she gobbled up her quarter cup of this in about 10 minutes tops. She went crazy for it, and best part, it didn't upset her stomach!
Didn't realize that when my husband ordered this thinking it was a good deal that it is not. I can get an 11 lb bag for this price at several pet stores around town. Twice as expensive.

column9: My cats love it - and they are healthier
column10: My male cat developed what several hundred dollars of tests suggested was a food intolerance or allergy, causing a mass to form at the entrance to his stomach and resulting in him frequently barfing up the food he just ate.  Our vet recommended we try some foods that were grain free and had proteins that would be closer to what cats might ingest in the wild (i.e., no beef).  I did some research and found many anecdotal stories that praised the duck and pea combination for food intolerance issues.  We tried a couple of brands and this was the one he liked the best.  No more barfing.  The local store was out one time, so I bought a different brand - he would not eat it.  After that - it was "Hello, Amazon" where it is always in stock.  Our female cat, who before would only eat the large pieces of Science Diet Oral Care (they were no good if broken into smaller pieces - she just liked the big pieces), has switched her preference to this food, too, even though the pieces are small.

Both my cats adore this brand food in all the flavors but the duck is definitely their favorite. When I open a new bag there is much purring and pawing at the bag. My male cat has a really sensitive stomach and this food has helped keep the barfing to a minimum. This brand of food has also helped me free-feed train both my cats which at one point I had little hope of accomplishing. They enjoy eating it but for some reason with this brand they know when to stop and walk away from the bowl. Just read the ingredients to see that its really a great high quality product. I feel good knowing I'm giving them really healthy food. My only complaint is that it is no longer offered through amazon prime, but that has nothing to do with the product.

Great cat food. Both my cats gobble this stuff up. Before trying this my older cats fur was dry and she had dandruff. Her fur is now soft and the dandruff is gone. She is obese so I wish they had a wilderness food for obese cats. her energy has come back and she plays more than ever. I will continue to buy this and the other flavors from now on.

column9: Couldn't get the duck lover to eat this!
column10: Of all the foods that my Persian likes, duck is by FAR his favorite.  So, since I haven't been able to find much canned these days, I saw this bag of food and thought I'd finally saved the day.  No so! He wouldn't even TRY this stuff and it sat in his bowl for over a month! No kidding, we left him alone for a day while we were swimming and he starved himself over eating this food. About had my leg taken off when I returned home too (and if you've ever seen the size of a Persian's feet, you know that that was a near amputation...). The kibble is a bit larger on this food so if you're buying it for a cat with a smaller mouth say, oh, like a Persian, then this might be an issue. But if not, then maybe you'll have better luck than I did! Thinking the size was putting him off, I actually broke some into smaller pieces.  But, it was the taste - he wouldn't even eat it out of my hand.  It's a great natural food (but the kibble looks dark green, ewww!) without animal by products, but if they won't touch it, well, guess there's nothing you can do about that. Try it - but try it at your local petsmart first because if you get a slap from your cat as you walk by, well, they'll take it back and give you something else!  Comment | Permalink

I originally bought this based on the recommendation of a Petsmart employee -- and was congratulated several times on my choice.  I haven't been able to find it anywhere near by, so very happy to be able to order it on Amazon!  I think this is the best catfood I've ever seen, high quality ingredients and not stuffed with fillers that aren't really good for cats.  My cat loves it and he can be a bit picky about his food.  He just wants to eat this stuff all the time!

Somehow Starbucks is able to make instant coffee with microground Arabica taste more like the Arabica and less like the instant. I had high hopes for this, and I regret having purchased such a large number of cups. This tastes like any freeze-dried instant coffee you can get at the grocery store.I'm not a coffee snob, by any means, but this is awful.

My dog really loves Pegetables.  She doesn't appear to have a favorite flavor -- she likes all of them.  The product is a bit expensive, but it is a quality product -- and my baby is worth it.  Highly recommended.

Our Cocker LOVES Pegetables!  She seems to really enjoy them and from what I gather reading the package, they are healthy for her too.In these days of tainted Chinese dog treats, we owners need to be extremely careful of what our  furry babies are eating.  I don't mind spending a little more for quality products that are safe.  Pegetables seems to fit the bill perfectly.  I can't get them locally anymore, so I hope that Amazon will keep offering this product.

column9: My dogs would yell for more PEGETABLES if they could talk!
column10: You must have PEGETABLES to make your house into a tail wagging happy Home.  They have vegetables in them, are easy to chew and our dogs let us know when it's treat time.  I order multiple bags of them from Amazon so we won't run out.
My picky poodle begs for her Pegetables every night.  If she could only eat these, she would!  When we can't get her to eat anything else, Pegetables always do the trick!

My puppy really enjoys these! They don't last that long, but she really likes to eat them so I think they make for a great treat when she's being good! Also a great value to buy online, when I looked on here I noticed that I could get a bag twice the size as my local pet store for the same price!

column9: My dogs love, love, love Pegetables!
column10: Pegetables are a very special treat for the babies.They are pricey and you'd think the dogs wouldn't like them as they feel and look like vegetable shaped crayons.They're full of all sorts of goodies although if you're feeding a grain free diet the first ingredient is hydrolyzed wheat protein.

Thanks to the diet I give her, my pup is very healthy, energetic, and beautiful.  I typically alternate between these and Greenies, and give her either one on a daily basis.  She goes bonkers when I reach for either bag of chews.  The ingredients are very well put together, and I recommend that regardless of what brand you pick, always check the ingredients.  Lots of other companies put quite a lot of filler in their chews and treats.  But not Pegetables.  Grab a pack for your pups - you and your pup will love 'em!

This is hands down the best quality Guayusa you can buy anywhere today. Rich, fresh, consistent, and not too dry or too dusty.The tea has a slight nutty flavor somewhat reminiscent of Darjeeling tea, and is very tasty and grounding. It has quite a bit of caffeine, but compared to coffee it is much gentler on the body.The quality of the tea is very consistent between orders - I have received 5 orders in the last 4 months and they all were very similar and consistently excellent.

I had the extreme pleasure of going to the Ecuadorian Amazon a few years ago. During that time, I stayed in small village named Mariposa outside of Archidona in the province of Napo. I lived with wonderful healers who everyday drank Guayusa. At the time, I had never heard of it. But it became part of our morning ritual. I found that it took my hunger pangs away and gave me alot of energy. The healer I was with was over 80 years old and had tons of energy - more than me at the age of 21.The indigenous people used guayusa to treat body aches and as a mouthwash. I was told it kept their teeth clean. I can attest that during my time in the Amazon, I ate less than usual but had more energy.I was able to bring a small amount of the tea back with me but quickly ran out and was not able to find it anywhere else until last year.I was so extremely thrilled to find it for sale on Amazon. This price cannot be beat! It comes so fresh and pure.Upon reading up on the company how surprised was I to find that Runa, works in Archidona with members of the community that I was able to meet. They work with some members of the family that I lived with as well.How small a world it is.One tip- this tea does not produce any tannins (which create bitterness in other teas when boiled too long) so you can leave it in boiling water for a long time without degradation in flavor - its another way to extract all the goodness in the teas.On to my actual review of this product- I drink it almost everyday. I add a little agave to sweeten it for me. It has replaced any kind of energy drink or coffee for me. I am focused, awake and aware. I love this tea.I actually get to reuse the tea material 2 -3  times before it gets too clear and I have to use a new batch.If you need a pick-me-up, try this out. I don't think you will be disappointed.
I've been drinking this just about daily for a while now. It makes a delicious tea, never over-stimulating, and it seems it may be helping to regulate my blood pressure. I highly recommend it.

This is a great tea  - It has a mellow taste  sweet taste- I was a coffee drinker and I have tried other yerba mates but nothing comes close to this  -- It gives some mental clarity  -- you have no jitters  ----tons of energy  --  I am putting this in my daily routine  -- I have made iced tea and it tastes great  too---

column9: Thankful to have found this tea
column10: Amazing tea- all the best properties of regular tea, and the energy is more steady and less jittery.  Similar to yerba mate, but tastes much better.  Plus I have noticed it's traditional reputation as a dream enhancer.  This is a great company with an amazing plant that we are lucky to have access to.

I drink guayusa in the morning for a smooth pick me up (it's like an added presence and attention without the jitters or edge) and in the afternoon to give me more focus to get through the rest of the day.I love the clean taste, and usually drink the guayusa straight.

This is a good tea,you can make it very strong and it is still better than Yerba Mate(which I can't get used to)as for the caffeine stimulation,I prefer coffee, but I don't get negative effects from coffee,it does have a mild stimulating quality but won't keep you from falling asleep. I liked it mixed with coca tea.
Guayusa is truly a traditional medicinal rainforest tea. You can read about it on google and wikipedia. I prefer to brew it pitch dark.
I love drinking tea  but wanted an alternative with caffeine that didn't have tannins and this is perfect. You get a lot for your money and shipping was great.
This tea stays fresh, has great flavor and is loaded with antioxidants.  Can't beat the price either.  I have been able to make 3 cups with only one loading of my Keurig tea maker.

We stopped into this cute bakery on a recent trip to San Antonio where it is located.  We bought a loaf of their gluten free white bread for our 8 year old recently diagnosed with Celiacs Disease.  He loves this bread!  When I made him a grilled cheese he said it "tastes just like a real grilled cheese!"  It has a great taste and NO BITTER AFTERTASTE as is commonly the case with other gluten free breads we've tried.  Unfortunately, it is much more expensive(about $2.50 more when buying a single loaf)than the Udi's Gluten Free White Bread we usually buy at our local grocer BUT, in its defense, the loaf is much bigger than an Udi's Gluten Free White Bread loaf (my son calls Udi's toy food sized bread).  A slice of this Little Aussie Bakery White Bread is the closest in size to a regular slice of bread that we have found since he got sick.  I wish we lived in San Antonio because I would love to be able to buy him this bread exclusively but with the expensive price per loaf and expensive shipping ($9.99 for 1 loaf) we just can't afford it:(
These nuts are handy to have on hand.  I like to take a handful as a snack.  They are seasoned just right and I think they are good for me.  I would buy these again.  Two jars last me a long time.

column9: i should have checked the ingredients
column10: i expected this to contain peanuts and salt only. it has a bunch of other junk as well. it isn't horrible but it isn't great either. not as much peanut flavor as i want.
If you like caramel and chocolate chews this is an excellent product, and if purchased at Amazon and receive free shipping it is also an excellent price.

The real plus to Lucid is that it's available in almost any liquor store in the USA.  Compared to better absinthes (any of the Jades or Absinthe Duplais by Matter are personal favorites) this one isn't that good.  It IS one of the more drinkable Absinthes, and is a good starter for someone who wants to try this iconic drink.  I usually keep a bottle of this around for Absinthe based cocktails; it's a good value for that purpose.

I've only tried a few different brands. But I keep coming back to Lucid. I'm just glad it's one of the cheaper absinthe out there as quick as a bottle can disappear. Also recommend for anyone wanting to try absinthe for the first time.

After trying some true European absinthes while living in Europe, Lucid is a fantastic disappointment.  It leaves an unsatisfying after taste not present in more traditionally prepared and distilled absinthes.  Particularly when compared to Absente or its more traditional brother Grande Absente, another French absinthe, you really begin to notice the distinction. While the Absente is a slightly lower proof (@ 100) than Lucid (@124) you can accomodate by adjusting the ration of water to absinthe when preparing the drink.  Overall, I'd suggest finding something with a more traditional Verte Absinthe recipe.

column9: So Awful I Can't Come Up With a Comparison
column10: What a cute bottle! What a bad absinthe!Absinthette? Absinthe light? What ever it is, it tastes like the animal's eyes who are on the front of the bottle played an integral part in the manufacturing of such a drink. I like to imagine it involved the re-appropriation of it's bath water. But this is just conjecture.I used to have an ex who would joke about how all of his blackest nights could be found at the bottom of a bottle of Lucid, and after finally tasting the stuff I have to agree. Please save your pennies people and do not buy this. Who would want to taste misery in a bottle?

column9: Very Nice Pastries; Not Too Sweet
column10: These and La Torre's similar items are delicious!  You may eat them like a cookie; but enjoy them as a delicate pastry.  Should I say more?They are light and flaky, sweet without being tooth-hurtingly so, and will definitely make a mess on your floor or shirt.Answer: eat them over a plate.  Don't let a little mess stop you from enjoying these light and yummy pastries.  Check out the other varieties, too.

Personally,my preference has almost always favored the old fashion soft & chewy Black variety Licorice.But in my last order I opted instead for both strawberry/w,a white choc center and raspberry/w,reg.choccenter.Both types pleasently surprised me offering realistic fruity flavor while still maintaining,RJ'sfine soft&chewy texture.As alway's RJ's remains my #1

I LOVE this product as it's just the right size for me to eat for lunch or to snack on with crackers.I had bought this product from my local grocery, but if one buys enough groceries on site the shipping is free & there is usually a discount that applies so the cost was just an added benefit.I also send these to some of our guys in Iraq as they 'keep' forever, don't require any opener, package easily, and the package is compact & easy to dispose of with little room  needed.I like this smaller package so I don't have leftovers the next day.The amount is more than adequate for me to have one sandwich with enough left to snack on later.I prefer tuna in water instead of oil, and I have always hated having to squeeze the water out of canned tuna so this easy open package with very little liquid has been great.Love this product and will definitely continue to buy.

column9: Finally the help your dog needs!
column10: I have a lot of hope using this food for my dogs skin allergies and ear infections. This company has the BEST costumer service I've ever had in an online shopping experience. They had their vet talk to me about my dogs problems and help me with other ways I could help het. You need to try this for your dog if you are having constant ear infections and itchy skin. Kirby, my yellow lab, has had these problems her whole life and I just continue to pay vet bills to band aid fix her problems. This food has already reduced the itching and we have only been on it a week. It takes 12 weeks to see the full results and I'm already seeing changes. Please try this if your dog is suffering like mine was...it's a permanent fix to the problem, and I promise this company will help you every way they can to make sure you understand the product and how it works!

I'm not a gourmet chef so I don't know all the terminology I would need to make this a veritable critique, but as someone who is yet to poison her family with a badly-cooked meal, I can only say this is one of those things you just have to try before you kick the bucket.I first tried Huitlachoche(or Cuitlacoche) some 6 years ago when a very dear friend -who is actually a chef- introduced me to this Mexican delicacy. I was amazed at the silky texture and incredible taste of this deceivingly unattractive corn truffle! I was hooked-- but like most great things in life, it would be a long time until I came across Huitlachoce again.Sadly, Huitlacoche is hard to find in grocery stores in South Florida, but since you can find everything short of a genuine alien on Amazon, I've been able to purchase a couple of cans.  Yes, I know; nothing beats fresh Huitlacoche. But honestly, finding fresh corn smut is going to be difficult under any circumstances.So deal with it.Although Huitlacoche is actually good even from the can, I usually sautee finely chopped onions, garlic, cilantro and a slice or two of Jalapenos and add a dry white wine to the mix.  I then mix in the Huitlacoche and cook over slow heat for about 20 minutes.  You can have Huitlacoche with just about anything-- I served it with Parmesan Risotto and roasted lamb and got rave reviews. Mainly from my stomach- but then again, when it comes to cooking, that's our target audience.Enjoy!

This is the real McCoy!!  Many New Yorkers insist chocolate is the only egg cream...I respectfully protest.  The favorite egg cream of my youth was vanilla, and just like its chocolate couterpart, Fox U-Bet syrup is the only way to achieve that classic taste.  I was forced to travel to stores in Baltimore for this special syrup when I lived in the Washington DC area. Now that I live in the Richmond area Baltimore was no longer an option.  Imagine my delight when I discovered that you can buy 6-packs of this delicious syrup via Amazon.  I can now make authentic egg creams at home using bottled seltzer water.  My kids also love when I squirt some vanilla flavor into their plain milk.  Now only if they could deliver hot New York pizza...I may never go back to NYC to visit.

In order to encourage my children to drink milk I tried chocolate, strawberry and other syrups but they LOVE a little of this added to their milk and for all it is sugar-wise during the whole day I don't mind at all.  I never use it for anything else, however, because I would prefer a different syrup for ice-cream, coffee etc.  For us this is PERFECT and the kids and I are happy!
When buting this item it said nothing about being artifically favored i thought i was buying pure vanilla syrup used in ice cream stores to make milk shakes very disapointed never again!!!!!
This stuff is wonderful, but don't overdo it!  Seriously, a 1/4 teaspoon tops in your paprikas.

I definitely have a "thing" for the sweet/salty combination, and this bar is AMAZING. There is only one store near me that has it, so when I run out I end up ordering it here. Let the chocolate melt on your tongue. When the salt (delicious rare expensive Fleur de Sel from France!) hits your tongue, the savory saltiness combines with the smooth sweet chocolate for the most outrageous mouthwatering flavor combination. If you have ever liked things like pretzels dipped in chocolate, or any other sweet/salt combination like salted caramel, you will LOVE this!
Delivery very fast.  Chocolate is always good!  This product is not always consistently available in my area. I like to give as a small gift.

column9: Not peppermint, weak chocolate, not sweet, not creamy
column10: I have  started experimenting with different brands of Peppermint Hot Cocoa and I started with Stephen's Gourmet Candy Cane Hot Cocoa.  It was a home run.  Very peppermint, very creamy, perfectly sweet, very chocolatey, wouldn't change a thing.Next I tried Bellagio Peppermint Truffle hot cocoa (this one).  What a drastic difference.  The first problem is that it tastes more like Mint than Peppermint and even has a slight cooling affect to the mouth like brushing with mint toothpaste -- not something I expect or particularly desire from hot cocoa. I noted that Stephen's Gourmet Candy Cane Hot Cocoa has Peppermint Oil, while this one contains merely "Artificial Flavoring".The second problem is that this cocoa isn't sweet.  It isn't bitter, but it was necessary to add a little sweetener to bring out any flavor, else it was just a bland hot drink with a cooling minty affect.  Even then, the mint is more detectable by the cooling affect than by actual flavor.The third problem is that this hot cocoa isn't creamy.  I had to add a little half-and-half to make it creamy.  In contrast, Stephen's Gourmet Candy Cane hot cocoa only needed water to produce a very creamy hot cocoa -- probably because it includes Nonfat Dry Milk, while Bellagio Peppermint Truffle hot cocoa (this one) includes non-dairy creamer.The fourth and probably biggest issue is that this hot cocoa isn't very chocolatey, no where near as chocolatey as Stephen's Gourmet Candy Cane Hot Cocoa, and this is someone who actually prefers milk chocolate to dark/rich chocolate -- i.e., it is even weak by milk chocolate standards.Two stars for the following: 1) attractive and convenient packaging 2) it doesn't taste bad.Bellagio Peppermint Truffle Hot Cocoa is Made in the USA.  Directions: add 3 tablespoons of mix to 3/4 c. hot water and stir.  I also add a little sweetener and milk or cream.

If someone who will remain nameless would stop eating all mine, then I wouldn't have had to get the box of 20 Chimes ginger candy tins.  But I'm glad I did.  The packaging is cute, and makes a great small gift to hand out to a co-worker having a rough day, a client when you visit, or a friend when you stop by to watch the game.  The tins are recyclable in most locations.  The individually wrapped candies are made with cane sugar and real ginger, no high fructose corn syrup so they are in a way better for you than other candy options.  Ginger has anti-inflammatory properties and can settle a stomach and ease hearburn.  When's the last time your chocolate bar did that?
Not only are these a healthful candy to help with your digestion, they also taste great!  I am a huge ginger fan and the orange flavoring with them is wonderful

I got the 20 pack for stocking stuffers and casual Christmas gifts.  For about $2 a tin they are a good deal because the tins are very nice, (to me, worth about a buck each and then the candies work out to under 10 cents each.)  Nice MANDARIN orange flavor at first and then the heat kicks in with the ginger.  I'll prob reorder in the bulk bags but the tins make it great for giving gifts.  Each tin is bit smaller than a standard band-aid box with maybe 15 chews in them.  I don't know, I got to eating them and lost count. The chews are a bit smaller than the standard ginger chews you can find in Asian shops, but this is more than made up for in the natural orange flavor.

Where to start~~ First of all I would like to say I have always loved Ritz crackers. Secondly I believe I'm at fault by not reading the reviews before I purchased this product. With a one and one half star out of five, I should've spent time in reading the reviews and why it didn't have a better rating. No one as of yet has mentioned the fact that it's not the same Ritz cracker that you would buy in the grocery store, at least to my knowledge. This product is clearly marked "made in China". There is no information on the website I could find that said this was an imported item. Thirdly, as other reviewers have mentioned, a lot of the product (package crackers) are broken as the other reviewers have mentioned. Last but not least-the taste. To me, who've been eating Ritz crackers ever since they came out, the taste is totally different than a partial box of Ritz crackers I had in my cupboard. The only way I can describe this is more of a wheat like taste very unlike the original American made Ritz cracker. I have to say though, that Amazon.com customer service was very good about this and refunded me the money I spent as I am a person who believes in buying as much American-made product as I can. I am not a complainer and most of the items I've received from Amazon's gourmet foods have been packaged well and are as described on Amazon.com's website accurately. If you are Chinese, please do not take offense to this as most of the electronic items in my home (name brand items like Samsung etc.) are made in China or another country outside of the United States. When it comes to food however, I prefer to stick to America-made products exclusively-does that make me a bad person?. I never thought at my age ( almost 70 years old and disabled) that I would be spending time writing reviews although I'm aware that most Americans would like to know where their food is made. That's about it and good luck shopping.

column9: Good crackers, but they didn't survive being shipped
column10: I love Ritz crackers.  My complaint is that most of them were broken when I received my shipment.  Lots of crumbles in the package.  Some of them were kind of stale too.  They taste just fine, they're just broken and crumbly.  I probably won't order these online again.
Should have listened to the other review. What arrived was four boxes of crumbs.  Very few whole crackers in the shipment.  Had to just throw them out.
Shocked and disappointed that each cracker stack had bugs- eek! 4 boxes of bugs AND an expiration date of December, 2009. I grew up on Nabisco products, this is so uncharacteristic :(

column9: DELICIOUS JUST AS I REMEMBER THEM
column10: IT HAS BEEN A VERY LONG TIME SINCE I LAST USED THIS SNACK. RITZ IS JUST AS AWESOME AND GOOD AFTER ALL THIS TIME. I LIKE IT, I LOVE IT. I WANT SOME MORE OF IT!!!
THESE CAME IN TIME AND ALL WERE OK.ALL FOUR BOXS WERE IN GREAT SHAPE AND NONE WERE BROKEN,TASTED GOOD TOO.
The retail store ritz taste better. The price is affordable but the crackers them selves diddn't taste as fresh as the retail store ones.

I really LOVE the idea of this decaf sampler.  I am a new Keurig owner and a relatively new coffee drinker so I haven't tried a lot of different brands/flavors yet, and was really excited to get this sampler.  I read in other reviews that a few people received one or two expired K-cups in their sampler but because of the value and the opportunity to sample many brands I took my chances.  I was very surprised to receive SIX expired K-cups, that's 20% of my box that is undrinkable!!  Totally unacceptable to me (I would have been miffed if one or two were expired and could have lived with it-- but not six).  I hope this seller's customer service is spectacular and they make my order good.  I asked for a replacement of the six expired k-cups, and will update my review accordingly when they respond.  On the other hand, the few that I have tried were very good and am happy with the variety that was sent to me (and I double checked all of the expiration dates!  Most were 4 months out and beyond, FYI).  The packaging is sparse, they came loose in a paper bag that was stapled shut, and I'm OK with that since they are for me (I would think twice about purchasing this item if you were considering gifting it to someone).  I hope they replace the expired K-cups and maybe throw in an extra one or two to boot.  I'll probably even return to buy more if they take care of me, since I love this decaf variety so much.  More to come!!4/4 Update:I heard back from the seller of the 30 kcup deal (Deals On Call LLC) and learned that Amazon fulfills the orders for them in the warehouse, so I contacted Amazon customer service to ask for a replacement of the 6 expired cups.  (I didn't request a return since I had already drank a couple of the cups that were within their expiration date).  As always, Amazon customer service is AWESOME. They refunded my entire purchase price and offered to send me another sampler (if I chose to repurchase) with free overnight delivery, and even sent a nice apology.  They also stated that they would review procedures for filling this order to prevent others from getting expired k-cups.  So, with that, I'm changing my review to five stars- as I said before, I love the variety and the opportunity to try so many different DECAF flavors in one purchase.  I can forgive the 'oopsy' in this case since Amazon went above and beyond to keep me happy.  Love Amazon!  Enjoy!

I ordered this decaf pack by accident (curse you, one click ordering) but I am so glad I did. As a new Keurig owner, I am excited to try all the new kinds of coffee but I prefer to drink decaf coffees. This pack has a fantastic variety of coffees and flavors. There are 2-3 k-cups of every flavor/brand. Previous reviewers had mentioned finding expired k-cups in their delivery; this concerned me. When my package arrived, I carefully checked each of my k-cups' expiration dates. Every single one was not only only with in it's 'best if used by' date but many would not expire until Dec. 2012.  I am very pleased with my overall purchase.

I was excited to try this decaf variety pack but it arrived today in brown paper bag just like the other review said. some of the k-cups were slightly squished but not broke open. I was very disappointed for 2 reasons:1) The photo in the variety shows 3 of each kind of flavor/brand but my package has 7 of one, 5 of another and one or two of the other flavors. not a good "variety"2) The package i received had 7 that were EXPIRED, but not just expired, 3 months out of date! That's 7 out of a 30 pack, almost a 1/3 of the package.I think the company needs to re-think their idea of customer service as this seems to be an ongoing issue. I am not the first customer this has happened to and i dont think ill be the last.I will be calling the company tomorrow demanding a replacement for the expired ones but to send different flavors for the missing variety ones.WARNING to all future customers... CHECK THE DATES OF YOUR K-CUPS!!!Not happy at all..i will never buy from them again.

column9: DO NOT BUY, mixed in Expired Products!
column10: I bought this because I was out of my K-kup and can't wait for Kruig to ship. I have prime so I can receive it in 2 days with Amazon. However, the products came in a BROWN PAPER BAG (NOT the original green mountain box). Many of the K-cups I received are actually EXPIRED more than 2 months ago! I guess this is a bad idea to get rid of expired products this way!!!!!

column9: Great way to try different varieties of decaf cups
column10: I was iffy about ordering this, after reading some of the negative reviews.  Some previous customers said they received expired product, or it was poorly packaged.  This was not the case with my order.  I received a good variety of different cups,  all seem to be well within expiration date (couldn't tell for sure on some, but the ones that had a date are about 1 year out). The cups arrived in a sealed, heavy plastic bag, packed in a box.Overall I am very satisfied with the value of this product.  My only small complaint is that there were a couple varieties that included 5 or 6 cups - I think they should include more types with less of each to make a better sampler.
Well, I got an unmarked paper bag full of K-Cups. And only got 24 cups of the 30 I paid for. This is the first time I bought k-cups on amazon and probably the last.

The assortment is different than the description  and what is shown in the picture.  Some of the described coffees were not included in the assortment I received.  10 of the 30 K Cups I did get were not included in the description and were brands/flavors I would not have purchased.  Several of the K Cups were expired.  Very disappointed in Amazon.  Overall a bad purchase.  Do not buy this assortment.

My K-cups arrived in 2 days in excellent condition, in a brown paper bag, which was not an issue for me.  All the K-cup expiration dates were 6+ months from date of purchase.  About 3 of each flavor (30), only one of Hazelnut, which works out well for me since I do not like Hazelnut flavor.  I'm happy with my order.
These K cups came on time! I love the taste of coffee without the caffeine sending me crazy throughout the day. I love all the different varieties.

column4: Willie K. Friar "Willie K. Friar, Writer/Lect...
column10: I have been using this coffee for two years and like it very much. Shipment arrived ontime. Would order it again.

I am a big fan of Jack Link's jerky so when i saw this I was interested to see what the difference was.  Why was it called Matador now? Well, imagine someone took your beef jerky, ground it up, put some sauce in with it, and then molded it into little circles of meat.  This doesn't have the chew of real jerky, so it's pretty easy to work your way through a bag without noticing. This particular flavor stops being appealing after a few pieces, but it's not bad at all. I think I could safely call it fairly rich as well.This sells for about 6 dollars per 3 oz. bag at the store so its a fine deal to get it here.  Just know what it is before you buy it.

More than doubling the retail price is hoggish.  I wish Amazon exercised at least some control over resellers like this who hugely mark up products that can be bought elsewhere on the web, such as from the manufacturer.  I recommend you shop around, both to save more than 50% of the price and in order not to support resellers like this.  By the way, a similar review to this one was just removed from the website.  I guess the reseller doesn't want it to be known how much they mark this product up...

I discovered this tea at a local coffee shop. This is undoubtedly the best tasting mint tea that I can recall drinking. The mint flavor is much stronger than the ordinary peppermint tea that I buy in the supermarket.However this is not peppermint tea, but a combination of mint flavors. The result is amazing.The coffee shop served a huge 16 oz cup of tea. When I finished the first cup, I asked for a refill of hot water, and there still was enough strength left in the tea bag for another great cup of tea.If you like mint tea that is robust, then you will love this tea.Note: The rating on this product has unfairly been lowered by earlier reviews complaining about the price. However, the current price on Amazon of ten dollars plus a dollar for shipping is actually less than the current price with shipping on the Mighty Leaf website.

I had this lovely tea at a local restaurant, and immediately came home to order some for home.  The scent and flavor of the jasmine is heavenly, without being bitter or overpowering.  Truly the best cup of jasmine tea I've EVER had.  I can't wait for my order to get here!

column9: A really delicious tea - lots of rich and unexpected flavors
column10: This is a really excellent tea with reach and subtle flavors.  It's perfect almost any time of day, which is really nice.

I love this tea. I am disgusted by the appalling mark-up this seller has put on it. A one pound bag of this very same Mighty Leaf Organic Earl Grey, loose leaf, is available directly on their Mighty Leaf website for $24. I love shopping through Amazon; it is simple, and I (generally) feel secure that I'm getting competitive pricing from an array of reputable dealers. I often don't bother comparing to outside sources... in this case I'm glad I did!

i have bought this candy for several years now.  this year the consistency has changed and not in a good way.  the candy is tough, difficult to bit into.  you end up having to put the whole thing in your mouth and gumming it.  i much prefer the consistency the candy had in the past.

column9: A much better version of the Haribo Gummi Grapefruit slices--if you like gummis with good chew
column10: I love Haribo traditional gummis (e.g. bears, etc.), but I am not a fan of the standard grapefruit slices--they are much softer than the traditional gummi, with very little chew.This product is the special Kosher version of these gummis. As such, it can't contain geletin, and so the ingredients are much different. And so is the texture: These are extremely chewy (even hard when you first bite into them, then turning to a nice chew)--think certain forms of hard licorice. The flavor and appearance is the same as the traditional grapefruit slices, but these are (for me, anyway) much preferable.

column9: The best for the litter box
column10: We have been using this product for a couple of years now.  When we empty litter boxes and clean and dry them, we spray the boxes.  It dries almost instantly to a powder-like coating.  The litter doesn't stick to the bottom or sides when cats wet it. I'm ordering more.

column9: The Best Cat Litter Product Ever
column10: This is the very best cat litter/smell product on the market. If I could give it 100 stars I would, I find it indespensible!!!!! Because of this product my litter lasts soooo much longer before it has to be changed. It also prevents litter from sticking to the box when wet. I can not say enough good things about Stink Free Litter Spray.

column9: Stink Free Spray Litter Box Spray
column10: This product is wonderful and does the job! It was always sold at Pet Smart Stores and now they have discontinued. If this is the place to buy and it is - do try it. Works well and I have used it for over 4 years now.

I use this spray whenever I empty and clean my litter boxes.  It smells great, but the best part is that it leaves a sort of non-stick coating on the surface of the box!  It keeps the litter from sticking so bad to the bottom when you're scooping, especially older boxes that are getting scratched up and it eliminates the odor that gets trapped in all those scratches.

There are four cats in my household, which means there are four litter boxes.  Before I started using Stink Free, we lived with unpleasant odors emanating from the boxes and permeating the house, despite all our best efforts.  It made no difference that we cleaned the litter boxes daily.  We use the spray every day on the inside of the litter boxes after cleaning, and it has completely eliminated the odor problem.  I strongly recommend this product for cat owners.

I had been purchasing the Stink Free Litter Box Spray at a retail pet store, but they discontinued the product.  Thankfully I found it at Amazon . . . it really works.  I have two indoor kitties who both use one litter box.  I spray this product on the cleaned litter every morning and the litter and box smell like baby powder - so their area stays un-stinkey.

This spray is wonderful for all types of litter boxes especially for the LitterMaid automatic litter boxes.  Spray it on the bottom of a clean litter pan and on the rake that is part of the automatic boxes  and the waste will not stick. This prevents malfunction of the rake.  It also leaves a pleasant smell.  I also spray it on top of the litter everyday so my cats always have a clean smelling box. My friends say they would never know I had 2 cats in the house.

The product name could not be more accurate -- "Stink Free."  My cats' litter box has experienced many reviews, but none as positive as when using "Stink Free."  This product is absolutely unmatched.  Litter smells are immediately erased and replaced with an aromatic baby powder fragrance.  Believe it!!!!!!

Stink-free is an awesome product. I clean my cats' litter boxes & then spray on a good coat of Stink-free & it is so much easier to scoop out the waste. It doesn't stick to the sides of the box & the smell is really nice.Strongly recommend this product for all indoor cat owners. It makes & keeps the litter box odors to a minimum.

column9: keeps litter from sticking to box
column10: I love this product.  Clumping litters clump to the litter box, making it hard to scoop the stuff.  This product keeps that from happening.  When I spray the box after washing it and filling it with litter, it's like having a non-stick litter pan.  Fantastic product.

column9: The ONLY litter box deodorizer to use!
column10: This product is the BEST, and ONLY, litter box deodorizer to use! I no longer need two different products, one for spraying on the sides to create a non-stick coating, and one for sprinkling on top of the litter to deodorize the joint. This product does it all, and it does it better than all the other products I have used. Spray this on the sides and bottom of the box to create a non-stick barrier which dries almost instantly, unlike the other product I have used. Use this instead of those powdered products in shaker-type boxes to deodorize the top of the litter. Stink Free dries instantly, and the cats don't seem to mind, or notice, this product on top of their litter. I had had problems with the other litter deodorizer products in the past. Some cats just don't like the fragrance or crystals that are put into the powdered products in the shaker-type boxes. We adopted a cat colony we inherited when we moved to an acreage almost 5 years ago, one cat at a time, so I have had more experience than a previously sane person should have with cats and their litter box behaviours. It's a cast of characters, with some really bad actors, but Stink Free litter spray has been accepted by all of them.

column9: Stink Free brand litter box deoderant
column10: This is meant to cover up urine and stool smells, and I am all for that!  Just be aware that it is actually spraying powder-smells like baby powder, and it is not good to breath in. Keep kitties and face away for spraying and let it settle before you come back. Best use for this is to "season" a new little box--fills in porous areas to prevent nasties from sinking into plastic litter boxes.

I hate to write this review because if too many people start using this product, there will be less for me!  I've been using Stink Free Instantly Litter Box spray for years...religiously.  I have two cats and a keen sense of smell.  This product works well and better than any other of the similar products that I've tried over the years. I simply love it, and I think you will, too.

The first time I had a cup of this tea was at my accupuncturist's clinic.  I came in from a wet rainy day and she offered me a cup of tea.  She asked what kind, I said, "you decide."WOW!  Didn't know they made heaven in a cup!by far my favourite version of earl grey, the lavender is such a nice touch & the other brands that are similar to this one just can't touch it!

Subtle lavender flavour complements the medium-bodied black tea. Be careful not to oversteep as lavender flavour will turn soapy tasting. I steep this tea up to three times. The second steep is the best balanced according to my taste buds.
The addition of lavender really makes this tea special. Every ingredient is of high quality. A truly excellent cup.
I found this tea to have too intense a lavender taste, I guess I was expecting it to be more subtle. However, I really like it mixed with other black teas. This is a great mixing tea.

Quite tasty and very sugary. Reminded me of the crusty edge of a pan of brownies, dry and crumbly instead of moist and chewy. Unlike a previous reviewer, I did not find it lacking in chocolaty flavor. I did find however that it is hard to only eat 3, the serving size. The price at Marshalls is much more reasonable so I would suggest checking there first.

Agreed with previous reviewer, these brownies are more like cookies and they are sweet but I found them to be a satisfactory after dinner treat. I prefer them crumbled over Ben and Jerry vanilla ice cream.:-) If you are expecting a chewy rich chocolate taste and feel do not buy them, make your own brownies from the box (Betty Crocker) since I found them to be more of what I am used to as a brownie. By the way the price here is outrageous, they are way cheaper at Marshals and TJ MAX.

column9: sugary, not quite moist sweet-tooth overload
column10: I made it through one bag of these before the typical unconditional happiness of finding another gluten-free option wore off.  These are not quite brownies, more like cookies - though certainly not hard in texture, they are somewhat crumbly, not moist and fudgy.  I found them too sweet (may make your teeth hurt and give you a bit of a buzz if you are susceptible to this), and the chocolate not rich enough.  Some people may appreciate a relatively lower fat product, but if I'm gonna go for some junk, I want it to be rich and delicious and not skimp on mouthfeel and flavor.  Better as a topping or something to nibble on, than as a full-fledged dessert.

Caribou Daybreak Morning Blend coffee is one of my favorite blends.  I don't like a strong coffee, and this one is a little less than medium strength but has a really smooth rich coffee taste, it's excellent.  If you are a lover of the Starbucks strength coffee, this probably would not be one you would enjoy.
This was my first time using this coffee for my Keurig, and I am very pleased with this blend.  It is not bitter/good strength!  I would recommend this to friends.

I just LOVE this coffee!  It's just so light, not heavy and "burned" like a lot of morning coffees, but it has all the caffeine that you're accustomed to for morning.  I have always loved Caribou's coffees WAY over Starbuck's (Starbuck's is AWESOME for growing roses, however), and this one is just perfect for us.  It's not overdone, just a smooth, rich blend of some of the most awesome beans available.  If you put your nose close enough to your Keurig, this one is a delight to smell after you pull down the handle and it pierces the top. Ahhhhh!  SO LOVE this stuff, highly highly recommend!

column9: I don't have to travel to Minnesota
column10: The best coffeehouse in the USA is Caribou Coffee. That's just an opinion, but an opinion I'd challenge anyone to test. When I go to the Mall of the Americas in Minnesota, the first place I stop is the Caribou Coffee shop. I don't like Starbucks coffee at all, and usually look for any alternative.Buying these Caribou coffee pods aren't up to the in house experience, but still enjoyable (not as good as grinding and brewing your own with their blend either). This coffee pod is filled (possibly overfilled) so it's not a wimpy coffee at all. If you're looking for a great strong coffee on the mild side Daybreak may be a good option for you. My best advice is to wait till it's shipped and sold by Amazon for the best price, but if that isn't an option, you may want to get your caffeine fix with an alternative seller.

This is one of my favorite coffees. I used to buy it ground in bags locally but they stopped carrying it. It's smooth, light and not bitter at all. Beautiful caramel/nutty undertones give it a very nice after taste. I just wish this wasn't as expensive. I've recently been hooked on Tully's Kona Blend because I can get it locally at reasonable prices.
This is our regular everyday morning coffee.  It has a balanced, slightly sweet flavor that (as expected for a light roast) is relatively mild.

Caribou's daybreak morning blend is a good coffee. It is not a dark blend according to the scale on the box but it pretty strong and is sure to satisfy even the most "hardcore" of coffee drinkers. Only downside is that it tastes a little acidic.

column9: HAPPY TO FIND LIGHT ROAST COFFEE
column10: I LOVE THIS LIGHT ROAST COFFEE. IT IS VERY FLAVORFUL AND DOES NOT LEAVE A BITTER AFTERTASTE. I USE 1 KCUP AT 8 OZ. WATER WITH A SECOND K CUP AT 6 OZ. FOR A LARGE MUG IN THE MORNING. BY AFTERNOON I JUST USE 1 K CUP AT 8 OZ OF WATER FOR MY AFTERNOON COFFEE BREAK. IT IS SO HARD TO FIND LIGHT ROAST COFFEE. THE MEDIUM AND DARK ROAST COFFEES LEAVE A BITTER AFTERTASTE.

column9: Just when I thought it couldn't get any better than Caribou's signature blend, along comes Daybreak!
column10: When I picked up a box of Caribou Coffee, Caribou Blend, K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, 24-Count, I really thought I'd found the best good-cuppa-coffee to please everyone in our household.  Caribou is a coffee company that is very popular in Chicago and are known for producing great quality coffee.  With their reputation, I've always been eager to try the other blends that are available in k cup form, but they are often hard to come by.I ordered a 5 k cup sampler size of this blend directly for Keurig because I was so happy with the Caribou Blend that I couldn't wait to try the company's other offerings.  I'm so thankful I did, because the Daybreak Morning Blend just hit the original blend out the park!I enjoy a medium roast with a kick.  Just because I don't like a dark, bitter cup of coffee doesn't mean I want to skimp on flavor or aroma.  And Caribou Daybreak really delivers in both of those departments.  This tastes like a fresh brewed cup that you'd pick up at a coffee shop.  It goes great with a little skim milk, too.  A perfect compliment to breakfast with a caffeine kick to get you going in the morning.The only downside to this blend is that I haven't been able to find it in store near us.  So we have to order it online, which seems a little pricier (surprisingly).  Oh well, I still think this blend is completely worth it.  It's my new go-to k cup!

I've had my Keurig brewer for almost 2 years now. I've tried tons of k-cups from companies including Green Mountain, Timothy's, Folgers's, Coffee People, Gloria Jean's, etc. This is by far the best coffee I've found. I normally brew on the larger cup size (9.25 oz) and it is the ideal cup of coffee. Not too strong, not too weak. The aftertaste is pleasant and not bitter. I would definitely recommend this coffee to anyone and everyone.
A good anytime coffee. More on the lighter roast side,smooth and not bitter. Good flavor,my go to coffee. Best in an eight ounce cup.
Doesn't measure up to Paul Newman's arabica med. roast.  In comparison (I used to think this was great) until I tried the Paul Newman's because of a Consumers Report.

MY DAUGHTER AND I HAVE BEEN TESTING SEVERAL BRANDS AND THE CARIBOU COFFEE DAYBREAK MORNING BLEND HAS WON FOR US WHEN WE FIRST WAKE UP.  NOT TOO STRONG AND NOT TO WEAK-----JUST RIGHT THANK YOU TO GET US GOING FOR THE DAY. AMAZON HAS HIT THE SPOT AGAIN FOR ORDERING ON LINE BECAUSE THE GROCERY RUNS OUT AND THIS WAY, WE KNOW WE CAN HAVE IT WHEN WE WANT IT. I ALSO ORDER BOOKS AND FOR MY KINDLE ALSO AND HAVE NO TROUBLE RECEIVING WHEN THEY SAY THEY WILL ARRIVE. I USE AMAZON  BECAUSE I AM TOTALLY IMPRESSED WITH HOW THEY HANDLE THEIR CUSTOMERS.
not too strong not too weak just right for the morning cup of coffee better than Dunkin Donuts brand and not expensive.

I love this coffee, it's totally delicious at 6am - first sip of the day, first feeling washing over you that it's time to wake up.  It's smooth, not bitter, and makes me say AHHHH...every single time.  Want to be upfront that I'm more a medium, light, and flavored coffee drinker so I'm not sure the dark roast fans will get that same feeling.  Packaging was fine, none of the cups were damaged in shipping.
This is a good coffee, but it is a little towards the light side. It was advertised as a medium blend, but unless you pick a smaller size to brew you are going to get a light coffee.

This is one of my favorite coffees. I used to buy it ground in bags locally but they stopped carrying it. It's smooth, light and not bitter at all. Beautiful caramel/nutty undertones give it a very nice after taste. I just wish this wasn't as expensive. I've recently been hooked on Tully's Kona Blend because I can get it locally at reasonable prices.
I can't imagine starting my day with out my first cup of Caribou Daybreak Morning Blend Coffee.  It has a excellent taste.

For years, I purchased Green Mountain Coffee through a coffee club.  When they raised their prices so much, I came to Amazon to see if they sold coffee.  I tried the Caribou coffee and I keep ordering it.  Great coffee.  Great taste.  Great price!
The coffee we ordered was very good, I have used this product for over 5 yeras abd know of its quality.

Taste is a personal choice and I prefer light roast coffees. My favorite brand is Peets, but until Peets gets into the K-Cup market this will have to do. This brew is light and not bitter, however I do detect a slight, stale flavor. However this stale flavor is common in nearly all ground coffee, including the tail end of a bag of my beloved Peets coffee. I also taste a sweet note in the coffee that counteracts the typical bitter notes, potentially allowing me to drink a cup without any adjunct sweeteners or milk. This has happened when I run out of milk (cow, soy or almond) and I just don't feel like using aspartame (Nutrasweet).
If you like McDonald's coffee you will like this. It tastes identical to McDonald's coffee. It also cost less to buy it on Amazon. You won't regret it!Pros:- Flavor- Aroma- ConvenienceCons:NONE
I don't want to say it's bad, just not my favorite...my cousin loves it, so I made her a special gift of this.
This coffee is great! It is strong and bold.  If you enjoy a stronger and bolder tasting coffee then I recommend this product.

This is the first K-cup I've found that has a real coffee-house flavor.  It's not weak tasting like a lot of other brands, but it's not bitter, either.  I've been drinking San Francisco Bay pods for a while, and they're great, but Caribou Coffee Daybreak will probably be a regular addition to my coffee rotation.

column9: Part of our morning (and evening!) routine...
column10: My current preference in coffees is more towards milder brews...especially at the start of a day. Daybreak morning blend gives me what I need in that first morning coffee: a definitive coffee taste, the caffeine kickstart, and the reassuring coffee smell that lets you know another day has started...It does so without being overpowering or bitter. I also enjoy this in the evening while reading, watching TV or sitting around and talking. You get what you need from a cup, but in moderation.Highly recommended for your K-Cup rotation of flavors...
Hubby loves this K cup flavor!  Sometimes difficult to find...or out of stock on some websites, including Keurig but always worth the wait to get it!
In my opinion, this is not good coffee- I've tried it plain and tried "doctoring" it, but cannot bring myself to drink a cup of it.
I really like this flavor, it is really smooth and light, but not weak tasting... perfect morning coffee when you want to gulp down a cup of Joe...
This is my favorite by far!  I have it everyday!  I can't find it localy anymore and was glad to find it online!
was searching for a replacement coffee, I was quite pleased with this one. very good. I will buy this again. I love coffee, and this was perfect

column9: Products like this fuel the "green is a fad" sentiment.
column10: There are legitimate "earth friendly" products out there... and then there's a lot of "hippy fluff". Unfortunately these bulbs fall into the "fluff" category.Sadly, this review could have been totally different, as ONE bulb... OUT OF 12 ordered (2 packs)... met my expectations! ONE bulb looks pretty good... ironically, it was the first bulb I screwed in... and I thought "yeah, that guy who said these are dim is right, but this is acceptable"... and then I proceeded to add a second bulb to the fixture (ceiling fan)... and that bulb was almost pink in comparison to the first, much brighter, more yellow bulb. Well... to my disappointment... EVERY ONE of the remaining 11 bulbs was that same color (any early adopters to CFL know the color I'm referring to... it's a slightly depressing CFL color that makes you want to RUN, not walk, to the store as fast as you can to buy 40w incandescent Reveal bulbs.)To say that you couldn't read by the light from these bulbs (as another reviewer said) is no understatement... they are about twice as bright as a night-light! There is a less-vocal, yet common "green is a fad" attitude... and products like this fuel that view. These are functional for MOOD LIGHTING ONLY... They won't light up a small room (unless you have 6+ of them in a fixture and then it will still be HALF as bright as a 2 x 13w CFL fixture... to clarify 2 x 13 = 26 and 6 x 5 = 30... yet 6 of these will be HALF as bright as 26w of Lowe's Bright Effects CFL) These can barely light up a person sitting at the bottom of a hanging pendant light! (which is what I'll do with the 6 I don't return). Quality dimming CFL is something I've been chasing for years... but it's almost comical to think you'd want to dim these down from their maximum brightness.Just so I can leave you with a positive consideration about this product, if you have hanging pendant lights with artistic glass that you want to light up, but NOT really light up the bar/table under them... (to repeat and emphasize... MOOD LIGHTING ONLY then these will actually work out well... and for THAT use, at about $25 for 6) I could ALMOST recommend these, but if you're buying these because you want significantly usable LIGHT... hmm... I'd have to say "look elsewhere".A helpful note to Earthmate... notice where I said "met my expectations" about the one bulb... overall... the real problem here is that the product doesn't meet my expectations! Expectations based on claims right on the package. I highly suggest that products like this have wording on the packaging which directs consumers to the most likely REAL use of the product. For starters, these bulbs do NOT replace a 25w incandescent lumen for lumen... probably more like a 13w incandescent... and again, this bulb should work out well for a pendant light, like in a bar... where low lighting is desirable (and further dimming is useful)... and there are several pendants using power (when people have pendant lights they usually have many/several)... and the desire is to maintain MOOD over outright lumens. Claiming an "18w-20w" replacement on the box would go a long way to ensuring the bulb in the package meets the expectations created by the package. (I still say these are closer to a 13w incandescent, but having a number in the teens satisfies... meaning "lowers"... expectations... while having a number in the twenties satisfies the need to "sell" the product.)

Considering that they come close to the lowest price for a 40W CFL six-pack and they can be had from Amazon with 'free shipping', these Earthmates are probably near the top of the 'value' pyramid. When it comes to quality, I've only had them for a couple of months when I am writing this and the fact that all 6 are still doing fine doesn't mean much but... see the last paragraph.Talking about the bulbs themselves:- unlike many CFLs, they come on almost instantly, maybe 1/10 second after flipping the switch- once they're on, it takes a couple of minutes for them to warm up and reach full brightness- contrary to what Earthmate claims, these bulbs are not exactly 'small' - see below for exact sizes- they do NOT work well with a dimmer - they are either on or off- the light is bright, so bright, I would not stare at it directly - I did once and I saw 'ghosts' for a few minutes after that- the color of light is pretty close to what 'incandescents' deliver - 'soft white' is a fair description- unlike neon lights, there's no flicker- of course, they consumes less power when compared to an incandescentThe above were my subjective comments. What follows are specs, as the manufacturer lists them plus some of my measurements:- Light output: 2900 lumens (bright)- Energy used: 40W- Color temperature: 2700K (emulate incandescent bulbs)- Electric charge: 600mA- Life: 6000 hrs. or 5 years- Overall length - 5.75 in.- Length from base to top (the glass spiral) - 3 in.- Diameter - 2 in.- Made in ChinaMaybe I was lucky (read that many found broken bulbs), but my six-pack arrived nicely packed: a box holding the 6 individual bulbs each held inside its own recycled cardboard box, unbroken and undisturbed.It may be worth mentioning that the 5 year limited warranty statement(covers defects in materials and workmanship, whatever that means) promises to replace them if proof of purchase is provided. Since there is no mention of it, the buyer will likely cover the shipping so the warranty is by and large meaningless as it would cost more to ship the bulb out for replacement than buying a new one.The other claim is that each of these bulbs will save they buyer about $73 in energy costs over their lifetime. The assumption is that the kilowatt hour costs 11 cents and the bulb lasts for a little over 6000 hours.So far, I see no reason not to award these CFLs 5 stars but, if they begin dying on me before 5 years, it is likely that I will come back and update my review.

I bought these bulbs because the price was the best I could find - even at home depot. They arrived on time and all of the bulbs are working great. They are a bit smaller than other 40 watt CFLs I have bought, but that is a plus for me.To other reviewers: * if you found them cheaper elsewhere please let us know where, * and please don't review a product you haven't bought.
I tried two bulbs from the six pack. The first bulb performed normally. The second bulb failed after 30 seconds. I can not recommend this product!

Bulbs arrived 3 days ago. One was broken on arrival due to poor packing. I needed them so I opted not to send them all back. I installed all 5 remaining bulbs and 3 days later one has failed in a puff of foul smelling smoke and two others are flickering. Two are working well. Not a very good average. I bought them because they seemed like a good value - they were less than $5 each. If the two that are working continue to work they'll have cost more than $12 each... not so good! I'd recommend avoiding these.UPDATE: 10 days later one of the flickering bulbs has failed. 3 dead - 1 flickering - 2 good.

After over 14 months of use (an estimated 3900 hours in my application), the three bulbs I installed in the ceiling fixture in my home office last July are still going strong.This were a perfect way to get more light, reduce the unwanted heat emitted into the room, and save energy in this fixture that's on for a good part of almost every day.  The label on my fixture restricted it to 100 watt bulbs, and even the expensive screw-in halogens I was using before didn't provide all the light I wanted.These are a bit dim when starting up, but they quickly warm up to a bright light in a color that I find is almost indistinguishable from incandescent.Some other reviewers have complained of breakage during shipping and out-of-box failures, but these bulbs all arrived here in one piece, and I checked each of them upon arrival in a live socket to ensure that none of them were DOA.I'm not sure why some reviewers have complained about the cost of these bulbs.  With the electric rates here (about $0.13 per KWH), I expect to save a total of $234 over the expected 10,000 hour life of these three bulbs, while at the same time getting a cooler-burning bulb that provides a lot more light. That's a $468 savings for the 6 bulbs in the box, and is a huge return on investment in my opinion!  Plus folks on the east and west coasts where electricity rates are typically much higher will save a lot more than me.If you are satisfied with dim light, there are plenty of cheaper CFL choices, but I think these are the best bright CFL bulbs around!

column9: Good light is hard to find
column10: The savings in the new spiral bulbs are stunning, they take only 25% of the power of incandescents, an incredible improvement when compared to automobile improvements.  Let's talk watts in "old" terms, i.e. the amount of light emitted by incandescent bulbs.  This spiral one is equivalent to 150 watts, an excellent amount, and better than the 100-watter which is widely available but a little dim, unless you purchase a multi-fixture.  150-watters are almost impossible to find in the big stores, and Amazon is doing a great job selling this one, although it is expensive.

These bulbs work great, have had them for over a month now and still going strong, no failures. They take a brief amount of time to reach full brightness (5-20 seconds depending on room temperature)but are the equivalant of a 150 watt bulb.

Disclosure: I don't own any of these specific CFLs.  These Earthmate bulbs may be somewhat smaller than the usual CFL of this wattage which would of course be great in small fixtures.  But...Because this bulb is being promoted by Amazon as part of a 10 product "green" package and the *very* next thing on their list is a dimmer switch, I think it should be pointed out that conventional CFLs such as these DO NOT work and play well with dimmers.  The Earthmate site currently lists three (only) of their bulbs that are dimmer compatible, and this is not one of them.There are specific types of compact fluorescents (usually even more expensive than these ;-) called CCFLs (Cold Cathode...) that *do* work with dimmers, last even longer than regular CFLs and have less mercury to boot.  You can identify them visually by noting the significantly smaller diameter of the light tube and generally more turns.While I'm at it, 2700K is to my eye significantly more yellow than the typical incandescent (tungsten) light bulb.  I recently replaced the 2700K CFLs in my kitchen with 5500K (so-called daylight) CFLs and made my wife happy.The Earthmate bulb is undoubtedly a fine product but it may not be optimal for your application.

column9: Don't Let the Name Fool You
column10: This coffee is OK but don't let the name fool you. Blue Mountain Coffee, i.e., the genuine article, is the world's best coffee in my opinion. This coffee claims to be a blend, but I find no trace of the Blue Mountain greatness in it. If you want a decent cup of coffee at a good price, this blend suffices. Putting aside the coffee snob reviews (those folks will only be happy with their own roastings), this is superb coffee. Years ago I used to get JBM at Zabar's in Manhattan. It was considered the best. The Magnum tastes to me every bit as good.

I drink coffee a lot and I would definitely buy it again.It is definitely a million times better than Folgers, Maxwell, Sam's Choice and the generic Kroger brand, and pretty close to Starbucks coffees but cheaper. It worked out great for me so I would recommend this coffee to my friends.

Let me just say that I've never had Blue Mountain Coffee before, so I can't compare it to a full 100% blend. I'm also not a coffee connoisseur (don't roast/grind my own beans...yet), but I do like a nice light-medium roast with smooth flavor and low acidity/bitterness. From what I've heard and read, Blue Mountain coffee beans are the gold standard when it comes to that which is why I was very disappointed in this coffee. Maybe I'd built it up too much after reading all of the positive reviews, but I found it to be quite average with a moderate amount of lingering bitterness and acidity afterwards. To be honest, I would prefer Starbucks Veranda or Breakfast Blend as opposed to this. Both have a similar bitterness  and slightly more acidity (yes, I know everyone complains about Starbucks being over-roasted), but at least they have more flavor to show for it.FWIW, one of my friends (who recommended that I try Blue Mountain coffee) had the 100% stuff when he was over in Jamaica and he said that it was the best coffee he's ever had. When I told him I'd purchased this, he was very curious and excited to see how it compared (knowing that it was a blend). Having no idea of my opinion, he stated that the taste had very little similarity to the real thing and was significantly less smooth.So bottom line, at $10/pound, it's not overly expensive, but it's also nothing special. You can get as good or better for a similar price in a non-"Blue Mountain" blend.

Thhis is 10% jamaican and 90% something else, Hence the price is much lower. Like i said a good coffee but doesn't compare to the real JBM. Would i buy it again yes. Not many of us can afford to drink 100% Jamaican Blue Mountain on a daily basis.  As such, I've tried several Blue Mountain "Blends".  Based on the price none of these blends could contain more than 25% Blue Mountain beans, and most likely contain only 10% or so.  Of those I've tried, the Magnum is the truest to real Jamaican Blue Mountain.  It maintains much of the flavor of JBM and much of the smoothness with only a small amount more acidity than you would normally find in pure JBM.  The most notable difference is the strength.  JBM is so great because it pack a bold flavor without being overly dark, burnt, or acidic.  Magnum has chosen to maintain the overall flavor profile but with less boldness, I assume to keep acidity in check.  For daily use this is a good compromise to make.  Other blends go the other way and come across as burnt and acidic.  This will likely be my daily coffee for quite a while to come.

I wonder if the average person knows how difficult it is for someone with severe food allergies to find packaged preprepared foods they can safely eat?  Let alone something that actually resembles the real thing in taste and texture (without tasting like flavored cardboard).I'm allergic to soy, gluten, wheat and various other foods.  Ingesting even tiny amounts cause life threatening reactions.  As a result I cook most of my own meals from scratch, don't often risk eating out and take "safe" food with me when I travel.Unfortunately soy and gluten seem to be the foundation of most western foods.  So it's really REALLY hard to find foods that don't contain at least one of these ingredients.  So having an option like "Enjoy Life" foods is wonderful.Yes they're small and yes they're rich and calorie laden ... but they taste good and ARE SAFE for ANYONE to eat.  Believe me that's an incredibly bold statement.  So who cares how big they are?!  Besides, at Amazon's prices you can eat more if you want to ...
