Almost like eating a fluffy sugar cookie without all the "bad" indgredients.

these cookies are great for people with multiple allergies.  Pamela's cookies have eggs in them so I can't eat them.  I love Enjoy Life foods, because I cannot eat gluten, eggs, soy and dairy....so I don't have many other options so I think these cookies are great so are the Snickerdoodles!!

I am not intolerant to anything except lactose, but my baby that I'm nursing is really sensitive to dairy and eggs! I've been on a really strict diet for her but have been DYING for something sweet and decided to try out a few items from the health food store. I can't believe how tasty these are! I am VERY picky and I think considering the fact that they have no dairy, eggs, gluten etc. these are FANTASTIC! Perfect little sweet treat to satisfy my craving!

My 2 year old son is autistic and has been on a gluten and casein free diet for about 3 months now, he has a lot of sensory issues, especially with textures so he is very picky about foods and the snicker-doodles from Enjoylifefoods are now a regular part of his diet. He will not eat any other gluten free cookie even others made by this company.I also find it much cheaper to buy them from amazon since they are about $3.50 a box at the cheapest in our local grocery store. Hope this review is helpful to you.

column9: Great flavor with overly sticky texture
column10: I'll be the first to admit that I'm very forgiving of allergy friendly foods - being allergic to gluten, dairy, eggs & legumes - but these cookies would not make my desert island list. The flavor was close to what I remember of my last 'real' gingerbread cookie (of almost a year ago), the texture however, was not even close. The cookie disintegrated in my mouth and turned into a gummy mess that stuck to the roof of my mouth - not pleasant... A glass of something to wash them down would probably help, but I can't bring myself to eat another one with the double chocolate version being so much tastier.

These were inside the boxes of Enjoy Life Very Berry Chewy On The Go Bars, Gluten, Dairy & Nut Free, 5-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6) during my last order and I found them to be pretty tasty, especially compared to Enjoy Life Sugar Crunchy Cookie, 6.3-Ounce (Pack of 6).Nice balance of sweetness and good chewy texture.  Overall, I would recommend these.
These cookies tasted absolutely delicious- they were soft, good portion size, and had a nice ginger kick. I'd recommend them to anyone regardless of if you don't like dairy or wheat- very good.

This cookie is soft, chewy, spicy and tasty.  One of the few products without chocolate that is really good.  One of the best things about Enjoy Life Cookies is I don't have to worry about any of the secondary intolerance's that is so common in people with Celiac disease. So many of the non-gluten chocolate sweets are so disgustingly over chocolate, it is nice to have a tasty cookie without.Enjoy Life Soft Baked Snickerdoodle Cookies, 6-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
These cookies are a little small but they are great for kids, especially children with food allergies, or on Gluten-Free diets.  I highly recommend them.

column9: My son's favorite cookies in the world.
column10: Out of all the Enjoy Life cookies, these are my 9 year olds favorite.  He is gluten/casein/soy/nut tree.  I love Enjoy Life products and their quality is excellent.  Amazon.com gives me the best price too.

These are a life saver for peanut allergic kids!  I buy most of their products since my son is allergic to peanuts.  These cookies are very moist and flavorful.  The kids could finish a box in less than 5 minutes some days.  I just wish it was cheaper!  These are pricey for the small amount of cookies you get in each box.  However, it is worth the price to keep the allergic child safe when going to school and church functions.  I bring these with me to all functions to have enough for the other children as well.  Since I can not bring home made safe treats to schools anymore, these will do nicely.  Amazon has a great price too.  The chocolate ones are great too!

Didn't like it that it felt like I was eating dirt with a bit of flavor..I didn't even finish the pack...for something GF that's sweet, I'll just stick to EnviroKidz Crispy Rice, Schar's hazelnut bars, or Mi-Del arrowroot cookies..
These cookies are WONDERFUL!  So happy to be able to enjoy a sweet, GF Snickerdoodle!  The cookies are flavorful and soft.  I think even folks that don't follow a GF diet would enjoy.

These are the most deliceous soft ginger cookies i have ever tasted. Do not taste as spicy as hard ginger snaps. You do not need teeth to enjoy these fantastic cookies. The box says a portion is 2. I stopped at 6. Worth every penny. Sending to family and friends for Christmas joy, from Amazon of course.

column9: Delicious!! Great for dairy free diet
column10: I bought these desperate for some sort of dessert, as I am nursing my baby who has severe food allergies.They are fantastic! I would rather have these cookies than any of my other favorite name brand cookies. Very tasty.My husband and I finished one box in a day, Im glad they are sold by 6.
The picture shows the Now Even Tastier! Version of these cookies, which is an improved recipe. I didn't get this. Got the older version which I don't like near as much. Misleading...

Its sometimes hard to find decent gluten-free cookies that don't taste grainy or are too dry.  This is one of the good ones.  Not only are the cookies soft, but the texture is close to the "real thing" and, if you didn't tell people, they'd probably never know they were gluten-free.However, if you expect them to taste exactly like a home-made snickerdoodle cookie, you will be disappointed.  They don't taste like a real snickerdoodle, but they do taste yummy all the same.The cookies are little, but for a small snack or for putting out on a snack table for a party, they are just the right size.  Baking your own gluten-free goodies is often the best option, but not always the easiest.  For something pre-packaged, these cookies (and the other flavors by the same maker) are a good choice.

Very soft and yummy cookies. I bought these for my gluten-intolerant daughter and wound up liking them myself!  They have other flavors that are also very good. My daughter's favorite is the chocolate chip cookie. I think they're all good. We've also had the apple flavor.
I love most of the Enjoy Life cookies, but this is one of my favorites. They are chewy, not crumbly, moist and just the perfect little bite of a cookie. The 'No-Oats' Oatmeal is a good one, too.

My five year old son has just been diagnosed with egg, milk, and chocolate allergies.  He is now very limited in the items he can eat and had already aquired a taste for foods that are usually cooked with eggs and milk. We haved tried a few allergy friendly recipes and products and they tasted completely different that what he was used to.  The "Enjoy Life Snickerdoodle cookies" are one of the few things he can eat and actually loves!  I am a very picky eater, but tasted one and it was delicious! I am thankful that we have found a product that not only happens to be allergy free...but is actually tasty too!

My son love's Enjoy Life cookies. He has so many allergies that these were the only brand I could find that he could and would eat. I go through 2-3 boxes a week and its worth it for him to have a snack that he loves to eat.
I have multiple allergies.  Buying these locally are close to $4 a box. Subscribe and Save brings the cost down. The only negative thing is you only get about a small amount of cookies for the price

I was so pleasantly surprised!  I ordered these because I was curious, I wasn't even sure if I liked snicker doodles!Oh man these are good! As soon as the box arrived my kids and I dug right in :)I wasn't too concerned about giving them to my twin 9 month old girls or 2 year old and 8 year old ( i know a whole ton of kids right!)I read a review saying they were "too chewy", but I thought they were great!They dont break in shipping and tasted fresh and delicious!

column9: A delicious gluten-free, corn-free, dairy-free, nut-free treat.
column10: I have just placed my third order. Not being one to have a sweet tooth at all but with so many allergies, I have been searching for a ginger treat for afternoon tea. After a friend made me a scrumptious hypoallergenic ginger cake, my yearning for a ginger treat was reignited. This is a soft and delicious gift and has become a staple daily treat with my honeybush/rooibos tea. I do not miss the many foods I am unable to eat but there is certainly a joy when finding a treat that is tasty and devoid of unhealthy ingredients or allergens. I have two or three cookies every day and enjoy the experience so much. I do not have the energy to bake and so ENJOY LIFE has most certainly delivered nurture with substance on so many levels.
Love the taste, very chewy and soft. pricey for the size, great ingredients, gluten free, excellent company values. Eating 2 is enough to satisfy my hunger and need for something sweet.

I order these cookies every two weeks or so because my son has massive food allergies.  He loves these cookies with a passion and even my younger son who doesn't have food allergies loves them as well.  They are just soft and scrumptious.  I used to purchase them in a local health food store, but I found Amazon's service to be exceptional in ordering these cookies.  I am a very satisfied customer and believes that Enjoy Life and Amazon are great!

My children have multiple food allergies and it's tough finding a store-bought cookie they'll actually eat.  We were pleasantly surprised by the gingerbread spice cookies.  When fresh out of the box, they're soft, flavorful, and not as grainy as a lot of gluten-free treats tend to be.  These have been a big hit during the holiday season.  Will definitely buy again.

column9: Happy for safe choices; tastes like apple cookies
column10: We LOVE Enjoy Life and are so grateful that we can buy something food-allergy-safe that I don't have to make from scratch like everything ELSE in this house!That being said, these are delicious, but don't expect tham to taste like snickerdoodles.  What they DO taste like is very moist and sweet apple cake.  Which is ok by me, and my children love them!

column9: My husband's favorite cookie from now on!!
column10: Out of all the gluten free products manufactured, my husband says these are the best. He has to watch it or he'll eat the whole box as soon as it's opened.

These Cookies are a Soft Cookie.  I absoulutely love them and wish that I could find a similar recipe.  Enjoy life does an EXCELLENT Job coming up with foods that are always Allergy aware.  Although their other cookies are great these are by far my FAVORITE.
I love these cookies! They are a bit doughey, but then I like them that way. The taste is marvelous!

We are pretty much experts on gluten-free snacks in our home. All four of us are gluten-free and I've wasted a lot of money over on products that weren't any good. In fact, I usually make our cookies instead of buying most of them, because I can make them better than what you can buy. However, we've found these new, improved Snickerdoodles to be pretty good. They are VERY soft, and you find yourself not wanting to stop at just one.

I guess I will just have to get used to the bizarre texture and taste of gluten free items. Right now I am discouraged that this is what's available. The flavor isn't too bad, but these are grainy and there's an odd aftertaste - perhaps it's the date paste (if I remember correctly - I don't have the box in front of me). I just ate two, and I won't cry if I never eat them again.

I have allergies and my son has allergies, so we have limitations to what foods enter the house.  My son has never been a snickerdoodle fan, so he didn't like them.  I however loved them.  They tasted just like snickerdoodles, though they didn't really look like them.  The color was much darker. As for the complaints to the size, these are the exact same size as snickerdoogles usually are, so I'm happy. They were so delicious.  If you've been craving snickerdoodles and have allergies, you'll love these.

column4: Donna's Reviews "I Love Shopping on Amazon!"
column10: Not so great Lemon flavor!It's Very hard to find Soy free!This is a great Brand! I prefer the ginger much better taste!

my son eats gluten-free.  he usually doesn't like sweets.  we found this cookie & purchased it elsewhere for him to taste.  he loves them & i love saving $ buying them from amazon!very nice soft cookie, not too sweet.  i always have them in the house.

These little cookies are delicious.  They are kind of smaller than I expected, but soft and chewy and so worth it.  Plus I like that they come in convenient little individual packages to help me with portion control.

column9: hope for those new to allergies
column10: If I were to sugget one food to those that might be new to the allergy world, it would be this product.  My four year old son was just diagnosed with eosinophilic esophagitis, and tested positive for several allergies.  I'm so glad that I found these cookies during our first week of restricted diets.  And if you have a young child with many allergies, you probably will be grateful for the extra calories in these cookies.  I let my son have an abundance of these cookies in his diet in hopes to bulk him up a bit.  I have let other family members try them that don't suffer from allergies, and I haven't had a bad reaction yet.  They really are good.  My only warning would be that they are more muffin like than most cookies.  My four year old was a little upset when he saw these because he was expecting cookies that look like cookies.  Either way, he tried them, and he likes them.
These cookies are excellent!  I like all the flavors in this brand but this one is probably my favorite!

My 5 year old daughter loves these cookies! She was diagnosed when she was 2 and we had a very hard time finding snack foods that she would eat. She loves these. Soft and good texture. Not griddy sandy tasting like most GF cookies.We always have plenty of these on hand! Snickerdoodle is the only one she will try, but I am sure that the other flavors are great too!
My daughther loves the enjoy life cookies and the snickerdoodle ones the best.  Unlike a lot of Gluten free cookies these are soft and flavorful.
My son is on a GFCF diet and loves these cookies.  They are moist and sweet, but not too sweet!  I got a really great price on a Warehouse Deal, too, which makes it great for me!

column9: Great price on a great product
column10: My son (age 5) has food allergies (wheat, soy, dairy, peanut).  So he knows when he sees "Enjoy Life" on the package, he can actually have it!  And it's great for him to have options w/ different flavor cookies.  It makes it easier for me when I have to pack his lunch for school to give him something different each day.  The only thing I would love to have on the subscribe and save program is the ability to mix and match products.  But the product itself is great.  My son says they have a little bit of a bite to them, but that is how ginger cookies are.  He compares these to the Pamela's ginger snaps.  He likes both.  But sometimes he likes to have the "soft" ginger cookies...which is the Enjoy Life type.
I LOVE these cookies! They are soft and chewy and scrumptious!! I highly recommend. I could eat an entire box in one sitting.
These cookies are delicious, moist, and perfectly bite sized. Can't believe something so good exists without all the usual ingredients that most of us with food allergies have to avoid.

Thank you thank you for making a gluten free and casein free product that is edible!  More than edible, the snickerdoodles are delicious, soft, and yum!  Not crumbly.  I only wish that you got more per package or that each cookie were larger, but GFCF is not an inexpensive endeavor.

I bought the "Happy Apple," "Snickerdoodles," "Double Chocolate Brownie," and "Chocolate Chip" cookies. To me, cookies should be crispy, but if you like moist cookies, these should satisfy. They improved once the package was opened and the cookies started getting stale.  My favorite was the double chocolate brownie, and I am really not a choco-holic! They just tasted good without having to be stale first. The chips inside gave it a crispier "taste." My least favorite was the Happy Apple, even though I do like apples. I have to say that these cookies were a life saver when I was hungry and there was nothing else I could eat available. I do wonder, however, if one should find out whether they are allergic to sorgham flour...

A friend sent these to me.  I had been eyeing them on Amazon and other sites and wondering if they were any good, since I get tired of baking everything for myself.  This morning I decided to open them up and give them a go.I was surprised first to find that the cookies were packaged in 2s, each sort of glued to each other in a plastic bin.  I removed two cookies and pried one off of the other.  They were browner than the picture on the front.  And kind of sticky.When I first bit into one, the flavor was good.  It was cinnamony, and that's usually all I need.  I really love cinnamon.  But after that, the other flavors came in.  Something bitter.  Something like raisins (must be the dates).  The texture was fine--like a Lara Bar, I suppose--and I had no issue with that.  Yes, it's a little grainy, but after a while of eating wheat and gluten free products, you understand that you're sacrificing texture in most cases.The flavor is ho-hum.  If you want a snickerdoodle, I'd agree with another reviewer and say you're better off just making your own.  This isn't quite a snickerdoodle.  It's more like a cinnamon oatmeal cookie, or something with brown sugar or molasses in it.  The flavor is very dark and a bit heavy.  But if you're looking for something fast and simple and cinnamon, then this is a godsend.  I personally hate it when cookies use raisins or things like raisins to flavor them (I can always taste it), but it wasn't so overpoweringly awful in this case.I give this product three stars for being decent and edible.

I haven't had a fool proof food in a long time and once I tried these I had absolutely no symptoms whatsoever!  I'm lactose intolerant, have IBS, gluten intolerant, and might be allergic to eggs, so finding good foods that I like that taste good that I can actually eat is almost impossible...that is until know!  keep up the amazing work!
I highly recommend these if your on a gluten free diet and even if you're NOT!  They are the best cookies I've EVER had!  I'm NOT on a gluten free diet and they are a must have in my food cabinet!
These taste great! My son has Celiac disease and these are among his favorites! The cost on Amazon is a LOT better than in the stores.

column9: Great cookies for my allergic son!
column10: We recently found out that my 3 year old son is allergic to gluten and casein and these cookies have been a lifesaver!  My son has a big sweet tooth and these hit the spot for him.  They have a great taste and he requests at least two every day.  The only reason I give it four stars instead of five is because the texture is a little different for my taste... but it doesn't bother my son at all and that is all that matters! Thank you Enjoy Life for creating such a great product!!!
These are great cookies; I love them and often eat the whole box in one sitting.  I am new to being GF and thank these cookies and Enjoy Life for making it easier on me.
These cookies have a nice flavor but are VERY dry. I wish they could make them more moist, like the snickerdoodle cookie.
GFCF kids will love it. My family did not know that alot of the norm like eggs are not in it. They ate these quick.

column9: great product for allergy people but too expensve..
column10: it is great product for my daughter who allergic to soy, milk, white egg, wheat.but a little pricy..and some package  have some thing that we could not chew.. and don t know what is it..be careful for choking..

column9: it's party time for kids with severe allergies!
column10: i have a child with very severe allergies(anaphylactic to wheat, gluten, dairy, nuts and peanuts, sesame seeds, soy, eggs etc, well you get the idea)it was just a couple of month ago that he was able to eat the snicker doodle cookies by enjoy life.  We've have few years of experimental baking to meet his diet at home.  I have to say I won't even eat the stuff I baked for him.the snicker doodles were a big hit!  I often take them to play dates, park, parties etc and often share with kids who has no allergies and they seem to like them too!This individual packages only contains 2 cookies thus it is so much easier to toss them in a bag for an outing.this cookies have made my life so much easier!!!if you have a child with many allergies and haven't found treats that is safe, you must try this!!

column4: Larc Bogdan "Mom of a GF daughter"
column10: We haven't had these gluten-free animal crackers in years - for some reason, the local health food store stopped selling them.  My daughter loved them as a baby, and was thrilled to have them in her lunch box now that she's a big kindergartner! They are yummy.

Being gluten and dairy free is always a strggle as far as convience foods go. I bought these cookies as something to "throw and go" when heading out and they were great! I'm glad there are good tasting alternatives out there for those who have dietary challenges. I would definately recommed trying these if you are in need of a good snack on a restriced diet.
Soft and sweet with just enough spice. I bought one of the single serving packs and went back and bought an entire box! Non-Celiac husband loves these too.

These cookies are delicious. I originally started buying them for my daughters who both had wheat, egg and peanut allergies. They have both outgrown the wheat allergy, but I still buy them because they enjoy them so much.
These are some of the best cookies out there!  I tend to eat an entire box at one sitting.

column9: Enjoy Life gluten free cookies are great
column10: Loved these cookies and everything I bought from Enjoy Life. Saved more than $1 per box by buying from Amaxon Grocery

My daughter who is allergic to wheat, milk and eggs loves these cookies. When we are eating out and she can not have the food we have, I usually feed her meal before we go the restaurant and then she enjoys 1 or 2 of these cookies while we are having our meal. That way she is having something special and we get to eat out too without feeling bad that she is left out.
These are pretty terrible. Do yourself a favor and use some gluten free flour to make snickerdoodles yourself.

column9: I really wanted to like them but...
column10: We know a lot about gluten free products in my house, and we've tried a lot of GF cookies.  I really wanted to like these but I've had many better products before.  I was turned off by the texture and the taste.
My Daughter is 6 and has Celiac, she loves these cookies!  She feels special since they are just for her.
my hsuband isn't gluten free and even he loves these. they're soft and chewy. and not grainy like some gf cookies. and they smell like apples and cinnamon.  yum.
Absolutely the best gluten free cookie going! The best part is, they are soft and chewey instead of dry and crumbly like most GF cookies.

column4: Lover of Books, Food & Good Deals
column10: This cookie will fit the bill for many on restrictive diets. The only grains in it are sorghum and rice, and it contains no dairy, eggs, or nuts either. They're soft, chewy, sweet, and if your craving is for an oatmeal cookie, it will fill the bill! It falls one star short of five because it does unfortunately contain processed sugar, and occasionally the currents seem very hard.

We LOVE Enjoy Life cookies.  The Snickerdoodles have a wonderful cinnamon flavor and great texture.  I am SO thankful for all of Enjoy Life's products.  My son has multiple food allergies and Enjoy Life products have made such a difference in our lives!  I know they are safe for my son to eat and they are delicious.  Thank you Enjoy Life!

Very disappointed they no longer have the Vegan certification. I believe this is across the board with all their products (it's because they can't verify the sugar source). The product information on Amazon needs to be changed to show it's no longer Vegan certified.

These cookies are delicious! My kids have food allergies, so I am always looking for good products for when I don't have time or energy to make things from scratch.  We really like these cookies (and most Enjoy Life products).  They are really soft & not too crumbly, which is often not the case with GFCFEF foods.

I bought the ginger and apple cookies and they were 95% identical. The apple cookies just had some shreds of the apple. I didn't enjoy either the texture or flavor much but learnt that if you leave the cookie out, it dries up and gets a little better (to my taste).  It's a fair try but I will not buy these again. Now I just have to invite many many guests over for tea to feed off the loads of these ginger and apple cookies I got :)))
I did not care for the ingredients. I have food intolerance and something did not sit well. I gave them away.
My Daughter is six and has Celiac Disease.  She has to bring her own snacks to school and she loves these!  She loves the taste, but also the fact that they look like other kids snack packages.

The best gluten free cookies I've ever had. They are particularly delightful when lightly warmed in the toaster oven. Leave them in a few seconds after toasting so the warmth goes through the whole cookie.Or, take them on the road and you can enjoy them without touching them should your hands be dirty.

These cookies are great.  They are moist and flavorful.  They do not taste exactly like the snickerdoodle I am used to, but they are one of the best gluten free cookies I have found.  I love the idea of a snack pack (2 cookies per container).  I used to buy them in a box and simply could not stop eating them.  The snack pack helps me limit the number I eat at a time.

These are my son's favorite cookies!  He is allergic to wheat and eggs, and finding a pre-packaged cookie that he will actually eat was difficult.  These don't taste like cardboard!  The rest of my family thinks they are tasty too.  The small packs of two cookies are a bonus since I can send them in his lunch box.

I found these cookies while on vacation.  They are the best I have had for allergy-safe baked goods by far!  My whole family loves them, even those without allergies eat these cookies up.  A great choice when baking isn't an option.

column9: One star because they are soft
column10: Oh am I absolutely heartbroken that these are so terrible.  I thought from the reviews - so many, that these would be different than all the other natural, allergy free, gluten free, wheat free blah blah blah that I've tried.  When there's one or two 5 star/4 star on this kind of product I don't order it because I chalk it up to either people who never enjoyed "fully loaded food" but have always been limited in diet and so in comparison to the other choices, they probably are good - or people like some I know who really don't care about taste, as long as it says the right thing on the package, they think it's great.  Me, I've been modifying my diet relatively recently (a few years) due to severe allergies that literally make me feel like I might not recover from the reaction to some foods I have always eaten.  Everything I eat since this started is like a cross your fingers and hope it's ok, pray while I suffer through a reaction and be thrilled when it's over, or add to the list of food I can still eat and do the "I can eat it " dance. Certain preservatives are a huge culprit but so are other things so it's always a test.  I thought maybe I found one of those nothing bad in it foods that I could tolerate and would taste good.  These are terrible -I won't know until tomorrow if I can  tolerate them but it doesn't matter, I didn't even want to finish the first cookie.  They deserve a star for being soft-that's rare in low allergen foods.  But they don't taste anything like a snickerdoodle, they taste like a day old bran muffin with cinnamon on top and you can absolutely tell that they are "nothing in it" food - if not while eating it (which is obvious to me) the after taste is an absolute giveaway, just like all the rest.  The only decent thing beyond soft is a little cinnamon taste but that can't overcome the non-sweet sweeteners that curse all allergy free products in my opinion and nothing can help the grainy texture.  I'm truly heartbroken. I want a DECENT sweet that is safe! These are so grainy, cakelike but dry - not like a glass of milk could cure it dry - just grainy dry - must be the flaxseed. It's better than some products I've tried but not edible-at least not as long as I can eat other foods.  My experience with allergy free food has not been the greatest so I try everything I can and some foods that are not free of everything are tolerated while some foods that are everything free can still give me a reaction, just less likely so I'd rather have low risk experimental food-it's just such a bummer when they aren't any good.  I envy all of you who can enjoy them, I wish I could but the taste, the aftertaste and the texture are three strikes and just too much for me.

I am pretty active in health food, conscious social circles. Buying these types of foods and supporting alternative business is important to me. HOWEVER, this company consistently markets their products in HUGE boxes with tiny cookies or bars. I think the cookies are okay, but I feel this company knowingly deceives their customers by making the product look bigger. My husband and I actually laughed when we saw how tiny these things are. Regardless of how much value you get when you buy a box (Very little in my opinion), wasting massive amounts of packaging is inconsistent with the earth conscious advertisement on the package. For that reason alone, I will not buy these again.

I give these lemon cookies 5 stars because I have no 'reactivity', which is especially important for me. I have problems with the soy lecithin, mono- and diglycerides, and the soy in malted barley flour (in unbleached wheat flour). Not hives, but this soreness/pain in my shoulder and hip that are most apparent. I can  have at least 6 or more of these with no problems.I love the lemon flavor!They definitely do taste sweet, but not in an over-powering way. The tartness of the lemon is still there. More of an adults cookie than a kid's cookie. Soft, but not chewy, so that is niceI am not wowwed by the funny "bits" that are in the cookies- a textural thing. I'm not sure what those are; lemon, the nuts??? They look yellow, so probably the lemon. Again, I am happy not to be 'reactive'. I don't each them every day.And, between the lemon and the gluten =-free, they don't/hopefully won't kick up my recent stomach issue either.

I actually bought a couple of 2-packs from a local retailer. But I was very disappointed to find out that the 2 cookies are small. Too small in my opinion. If your looking for a decent 2-pack check out Pamela's instead. As far as taste is concerned I was not impressed. The small size could have been tolerated if the flavor was better.

column9: no oats oatmeal enjoy life cookies
column10: These are horrible, kinda sticky, with a sugar substitute after taste too. Nutritional info on Amazon was different from that on box and manufacturers website, supposedly because manufacturer had changed cookie recipe. I won't recommend this product. I also notified manufacturer through their facebook page, and they notified me that they had changed their recipe supposedly. First time I tried their product, but I'm never buying again. I do highly recommend, Kashi Dark Chocolate Oatmeal Wholegrain Cookies though. These are divine, and a "God Send." Thanks...

This Biscuits are perfect. My 5 months old was having a hard time teething which is the reason I purchase this, but by the time they got here she was doing better but she still love chewing on this, she is not able to break it yet which is great. But I think I love them more than she does, I will order some more for me :). The item was packed very well, and arrived weeks before estimated date.

It's icing, hard icing, atop a crunchy, sugary, flat cookie ring. It comes in assortment of colours, but they all taste the same. It's not bad, but it's not great either. Reminds me of how a ginger bread man tastes, but without the ginger bit.
