They should be boiled in water for a few minutes and allowed to cool, then they are delicious on breakfast cereals or with vanilla ice cream.
My family loves these so much more than the Mediterranean apricots because of their tartness!  Unfortunately, we can't find these in our grocery stores anymore -

I grew up in Silicon Valley back when we still had apricot trees from the old orchards, so I'm a sucker for California (not Mediterranean) apricots.  I saw this product in my local store and foolishly bought two packs without tasting it first!  The apricots were bitter; even I would have preferred Mediterranean apricots over these.  I also noticed that the packaging doesn't call them California apricots, but rather "dried halves" and "product of USA, Chile, or Argentina".Stay away from this poor-quality product and buy something really tasty (I like Mariani's California Apricots).

column9: SO much better than the Mediterranean Apricots
column10: I am a big fan of Sun-Maid California apricots!  They have just the right balance of tartness, sweetness and tangy apricot flavor.  Mediterranean apricots are mushy, overly sweet and for the most part devoid of the rich apricot flavor that is so strong and delicious in the California apricots.  You just can't beat the quality of these dried apricots.

column9: Best Apricots for Cooking and Baking!
column10: I was SOOOO glad to find these on Amazon - and even happier to see that they offered auto delivery.  I don't care for Mediterranean or Turkish apricots as much, and California apricots have become increasingly hard to find.  My local grocery store (a MAJOR chain) recently stopped carrying them, so I immediately started searching online to see where they might be available.  Of course, Amazon was the first place I looked.  I love to cook these (just boil in some water for 15-20 minutes) and maybe add some sugar or artificial sweetener and eat them - especially when a lot of fresh fruits aren't in season.  I often eat them in place of jelly on toast.  But really - if you are searching for apricots to use to make a pie or smaller fried pies, these apricots can't be beat.  They are tart, have a great flavor, and cook up much better than other types of apricots, which usually remain whole, chunky or tough, even after cooking. Thanks, Amazon, for carrying these - and Sun-Maid, please continue to make them available!
I hadn't realized I could order the CA Sunmaid Apricots on-line.  In FL they only carry the imported, cloyingly sweet Sunmaid Apricots.  From now on I will try to order more things through Amazon.

As a former Californian, I have missed the original style of true California dried apricots.  Sun-maid's California Apricots have been a great treat.  The flavor varies from time to time due to apricot conditions, but, for the most part, are as good as what we used to have in California.

My husband loves this and only this brand of dried apricots halves.  We can only find the mediterrainean style(which he doesn't like)in stores.  We were worried about the freshness but he says they are fine.

These are my favorite dried apricota and when my nearby grocery stores no longer carried them, I just knew that Amazon would not let me down; and of couse, they didn.t! Now I have a good supply that should last a good long time in my fridge.

I really prefer fresh apricots when I can find them, but the dried apricots will do as a substitute.  I have found that a fresh apricot (or two dried apricot halves) is an effective sppetite suppressent to eliminate hunger pangs if you are on a diet.  This particular brand seems a little drier than some others, but stores tend to have limited selections (you have to shop around).  These do not seem as sweet as some other brands, and individual consumers will have to judge which brands they prefer.  It does have an expiration date on the package, which in the present case was about 6 months after purchase.

column4: tantalumgirl "A weed is a plant whose virtues...
column9: Why are apricots from california so hard to find?
column10: I adore dried apricots. It seems that all I can find at the supermarket anymore is Turkish apricots, and they just aren't as flavorful as the ones from California. I don't know why that is; maybe they are a different species, maybe they're processed differently. Turkish apricots are dried whole, California apricots are cut in half. They are more expensive than Turkish apricots too, which seems counterintuitive. At any rate, they're worth it, and I'm so glad Amazon carries them

I love CALIFORNIA Dried Apricots, not Mediterranean.  Taste is entirely different.  We can't get California Dried Apricots here in Orlando for some reason.  Thrilled to have a place to order them from with reasonable price.  Also like the idea that saving a few carbon emissions if the apricots are really coming from California versus all the way from Mediterranean, but may just be different types of apricots grown here.[...]Great service from Amazon provider too.

column9: poor display of a great food
column10: Boooooo! too dry and thin and chewy. Aso, very bitter.Maybe I got a bad bag from a bad bunch, but they did not hold a candle to Sunsweet or Mariani

For our Christmas baking we need apricots.  Turkish or Mediterranean are too sweet, not enough tartness.  So we were real happy when we found them online since our supermarkets do not carry them anymore!Thank you!

Orangina is difficult to find on our shelves in NJ.  We love the light orange flavor and the light carbonation.  It is refreshing, but not like a sugary soda.  We fell in love with it in Paris and in the Caribbean. I've seen it on shelves in  the more northern states.  Why, oh why, can't we buy it on shelves in NJ????

column9: Not as good as the bottled Orangina.
column10: This is a fine drink. It's just sweet enough to be a treat, and just carbonated enough to add a bit of fizz. It doesn't taste natural to me, but it does taste good. I find a big difference between the flavor of the canned beverage compared to the bottled beverage which I'm able to get from Whole Foods. My feeling is it's not that special. I am enjoying the Santa Cruz Organic Sparkling Beverage, Orange Mango, 10.5-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24) more. At the price of $19.56 and free Amazon-Prime shipping, this drink is bound to become a favorite of my family's. I'll be cancelling our subscription for the Izze sparkling juices as they are too sweet (except the pomegranate which is too sour) for me.

These help put me through a long hot  80+ - 100 degree summer down by Palm springs California. You get 24 of these for very cheap. They are very hard to find the cans in store. Usually you can find the bottles but in very low quantity. One of the most delicious beverages you can have. I fell in love with them after I first tasted them during my trip to France.Thanks Amazon for being so awesome!
As I have said previously about thid coffee, it is great. Buy my supply every month! Try it, I highly recommend.
I was always a vanilla fan until I purchased Miss Ellie's Hazelnut coffee. It is so yummy, way better than Senseo. :-)

I tried Miss Ellie's Hazelnut pods, since I can no longer get Senseo.  Miss Ellie's actually has more flavor, very smooth and delicious .My only problem is, it cost as much to have it shipped, as the cost of the 18 pods.  Soooo not sure what to do.
I bought these trying to find pods for my Senseo brewer since I can't find them anywhere. Well, they taste great and work beautifully in my Senseo brewer, I am so glad I found these!!

I hesitated to order this avocado oil because I had never heard of this brand before and didn't want to end up with two bottles of bad oil. Well, I am SO GLAD I went ahead and placed the order because this oil is simply excellent.I have tried extra virgin avocado oils from California and New Zealand and this Mexican oil is every bit as good and at a much better price.The oil is clear and has a buttery feel and subtle flavor. I use it mostly for stir-fry because of its very high smoke point (higher than refined coconut, grapeseed, peanut, almond, safflower), but it is also perfect in dishes where the peppery fruitiness of olive oil may be too overpowering.Amazon offers a very good deal on this oil. I just placed two more orders.Great product. Highly recommended.A word about the seller (Kalamala): I have already submitted a 5-star feedback for this seller, but I wanted to let prospective buyers know that the two 1 liter glass bottles arrived in perfect condition. Kalamala carefully wraps each bottle in bubble wrap and adds packing peanuts to the box for extra protection. See the photos I posted.

Love Love Love this Avocado oil. I have been purchasing Avocado oil in a can at the local grocery store (La Tourangelle brand) but was always disappointed by the fact that it contained a lot of impurities in it that made it unusable in certain cooking situations. For instance; for use in sauteing which was a shame because Avocado oil has an extremely high smoking point. This oil is totally pure and delicious. If you like popcorn this is the best oil for it. It's high smoking point and delicious flavor make it ideally suited for it. We are on our 4th liter since purchasing. We received a call from the business about month after initial purchase checking to see how the oil was and if we were pleased with the product. Who does that?!?!?!?!?

Good,mild tasting avocado oil.Excellent value.Bottles arrived well packaged.This is a great oil for healthy stir-fries.Safe for high heat.Cheap enough to use for everyday cooking.  4-26-12:.After using this oil for last few months I upped my rating to five stars. Just placed another order for this excellent all purpose oil.This is not a misprint,the Order does include two-1 liter bottles.Great value compared to the smaller 250ml-500ml bottles sold by other companies.And no sacrifice in quality.5-1-12,I just received my new order.Again the oil tastes great.New this time was custom molded packaging-similar to egg cartons.Bottles arrived safe and secure.Will happily keep ordering as needed.

Receiving two of these for $19.99 is quite a deal.  Going to someone's house and don't know what to bring? This really is THE perfect gift.  The bottle is attractive, the contents are great tasting and the cost is ideal.  It's not your average bottle of oil, it's avocado oil.  Seriously, perfect hostess gift.  Give one away, keep one for yourself.  Give two away.  Keep two for yourself!  Super deal!

I HAD NEVER HEARD OF AVOCADO OIL BEFORE I BOUGHT THIS BRAND.  IN MY OPINION THIS PRODUCT IS EXCELLENT.  I USE IT FOR ALL OF MY COOKING AND I DO A LOT.TRY THIS IN HOMEMADE SALAD DRESSINGS.  I HAVE PROBABLY BOUGHT TEN BOTTLES AND JUST PLACED ANOTHER ORDER.  QUICK DELIVERY AND PACKAGING IS BULLET PROOF.

column9: Great Product at a Great Price
column10: The title says it all.  This is a great oil and the price is right.  My shipment came promptly.  Avocado oil is great for cooking and has many health benefits.

Great price for the amount of avocado oil you get.  You really won't find anything else cheaper.  And pretty bottle too.  It would make a nice gift.  I use the oil to make homemade mayo--it has a very mild taste so the mayo tastes like mayo.  It's not at all like using olive oil.  And it's a lot healthier than sunflower, canola, corn, and vegetable oil.  I'll definitely be ordering some more soon!

column9: Great buy on a healthy oil
column10: I have been using avocado oil instead of canola/olive oil to cook. It's a great healthy substitute!  This one is really tasty on dressings and perfect for cooking, good quality and price!

I am very happy with this, though next time I will buy it in the plastic bottles(Massimo Gusto Extra Virgin Avocado Oil, 1 Liter Bottles (Pack of 2) ) because it's cheaper.It is great for deep frying. You can get the oil really hot so things cook quicker and are less greasy when done. I've done battered flounder, potatoes, mushrooms and beer-batter onion rings, all with great results. I'm kind of new to the deep fry, I've avoided it in the past because the oils are generally not very healthy. Avocado oil is healthy, like olive oil, but you can't get olive oil hot enough to deep fry without smoking up the kitchen and making the oil bitter. No problem with the avocado oil. Highest smoke point of any commercially available oil. I've had it up over 450F with no smoke at all.I also make a balsamic/garlic/herb vinaigrette, and I made it with this oil. It was very good, better, IMO, that with olive oil.So far, the only thing I've with it that I didn't care for was aioli. There is a butterry-sweet undertone to the avocado oil that didn't belong, and there is a tangy aspect to olive oil that was missing. So, I'll be sticking with olive oil for the aioli.The price for this or it's plastic-bottled equivalent makes it possible for me to make it a regular part of my cooking. At the local grocery stores, most don't have it, and if they do it's like $16 for a 6 to 8 ounce bottle, so I just never tried it before, though I wanted to.I hope this company will keep the quality up and the price down. If they do I'll be a regular customer. Seriously, in the next month or two I am buying a dedicated fry pot and some more of this oil, and I'm going to start deep-frying on a regular basis.

I have been making an effort to eat more healthfully this year, and had done allot of reading about using the various "good" oils in cooking. Avocados are one of my favorite foods, so I wanted to try avocado oil. Not finding it in my local stores (why did I ever move to a rural place???), Amazon, once again, came to the rescue.The oil arrived well packaged! No danger of breakage here!I love the taste of the avocado oil and have used it in cooking and salad dressings. The best thing I have used it for is making a focaccia-style flax seed bread. It added a nice flavor that the recipe needed. It is also very nice for sauteing vegetable in a stir fry.The price through Amazon was no worse than good quality olive oil.

I bought this to use for frying and sauteing because of its higher smoke point. This oil, when I did the math ended up costing about as much as extra light olive oil, and its much, much safer to use. The bottles are glass, so there is no plastic leakage, and the oil is sublime! I hardly every use olive oil any more- why would I, when this does every and more, and it tastes amazing as well! I noticed that literally everything I cook tastes better when I use avocado oil- better than butter, in most cases!I've ordered it 3 times so far. Each time the bottles were a bit different, and I liked the addition of the spout thing, but I was sad to get a clear bottle instead of the darker ones- the darker bottle protects the oil from sun damage better. I'm hoping the next batch I order (because I will be ordering more) will have the darker bottles again.LOVE THIS STUFF.

column9: I really wanted to like this product
column10: This seemed like such a great deal in terms of price and smoke point that I already imagined myself making it my default cooking oil. Both bottles arrived on time and in good condition, but alas the oil smelled and tasted rancid. I really advise everybody to give it a taste before using in cooking. I tried it several times because I just couldn't believe I ended up with 2 liters of unusable oil. I guess it was too good to be true. The only silver lining is that customer service was amazing (as other reviews indicate), gave me a call hours after I posted my feedback, and eventually refunded the purchase. This is the only reason why I did not give the product 1 star.

Like this avocado oil so much I've ordered it twice and will order it again when I run out. It  has a nice mild flavor and really works well for higher heat cooking such as stir fry.  I also use it to improve my dogs fur quality.  A couple of eggs cooked in avocado oil every 2 to 4 weeks really makes his coat soft.  It does come in the dark green bottles as the picture shows.  As other reviewers have commented it comes packaged in plenty of bubble wrap and arrives fairly quickly.  A great product at an excellent price.

column9: mild...not offensive... can stand heat without oxidizing
column10: the title says it all... and the price is pretty great for avocado oil. We use this for kale chips, roasted vegetables..anytinhg with cooking.

column9: The other option is not impressive.
column10: I purchased this set thinking it would be great to have one bottle and to give another away to a friend that I know loves cooking with "exotic" oils.While the bottle/brand shown in the listing is impressive looking and would make a great gift, the other option, Massimo Gusto, looks like a cheap Mexican knock-off.I will admit that I haven't had the chance to taste the oil yet, but honestly, if I saw the brand in the grocery store, I wouldn't have bought it.
Just to make sure I am getting enough coconut oil in me I added these. I have had no problem so far.
Simple, quick review.Got these for my Diabetic spouse.Great taste.Kind of artificial taste but not to bad.Decent price.
Not that bad for sugarless candy but need a little more flavor to compete. Price still high but is worth it.

These candies are very tiny, they have so little flavor that you can barely distinguish one from the other (I tried all 6) and they do not satisfy that sweet urge at all. They are definitely not worth the price. I would recommend Walgreen's "Nice!" store brand or Jolly Rancher's sugar free candies instead.
Its a pleasure to use this oil, highly recommended . Goes well with salad.  Very light and soothing.Wish the price was  little low.

Aside from the fact that sesame oil is absolutely the most divine tasting oil, I have to hand it to this product. It tastes pretty fresh and has a rich nutty sesame oil taste and the texture is a teeny bit thick and wonderful. I like that it is organic and it is only medium refined which hopefully makes you think less chemicals were used in the refining process. I do wish they would give you more details about the refining process, storage history, freshness and any chemicals used in their oil. I think you are partially guessing here. Unrefined sesame oil is divine and tastes a little richer and more "meaty" than highly refined. To me it is kind of like the difference between whole wheat bread and white bread (though not so striking). Unrefined does not seem as smooth-tasting as a refined oil, and may have more of a distinct taste in recipes, whereas the refined sesame oil is more subtle and may blend in better with your other ingredients. However, I love this oil and if you want the sesame aspect to be the "star" of your dish this oil will add a lot.

I have purchased for both my family and for clients for the holidays and they rave about the quality.  They are shipped overnight and Geoff and Drew will only send fresh baked goods.  If you freeze the brownies, they will taste like fudge, or just nuke them for a few seconds and they will melt in your mouth.  Beware, these cookies and brownies are known to break the will power of even the most disciplined dieters.

LOVE THIS PRODUCT! I was totally sad when I realized that Boarders Cafe products were replaced with Seattle's best. I blogged to find if the mix was sold anywhere else. I finally found this brand, Big Train Spiced Chai. Seriously, it is the old purple can of Boarder's Chai! I enjoyed a glass last night. LOVE IT! Enjoy!

column9: The BEST Chai Tea your tastebuds will ever experience!
column10: I liked Chai Tea...that is until I tried Big Train Chai Tea.  It is  truely the best blend of spices with tea ever made! I've had Chai Tea at Starbucks, Borders, Jidders, Fry's Supermarket,...and other coffee houses, they were good, until I tried Big Train given to me by my sister.  The first time I tried it, it was like tasting "heaven"!  It's really that GOOD!Trust me, try it, and you'll be glad you did.  The taste is superb.  Simply mix it with water, real easy.  I drink mine double the amount suggested on the bag, ah....truely yummy.I must admit I love it so much, I only drink it while on vacation and holiday's as I drink it too much and am weight conscious.  However it really make my vacations and holidays special.The best tasting of all the Big Train brand I have found is the Spiced Chai and the Spiced Decaf Chai.  The others taste a little odd to me.  Of the two mentioned, I prefer the decaf, it has a smoother taste and I can drink it at night, whereas the other will get me awake for hours.  That being said, when I need to clean my house or yard, the Spice Chai is perfect, gives me a real lift.Buy Big Train Chai, it is simply the Best Chai Tea you'll ever drink!!!

column9: Might just be the best chai EVER
column10: So I basically always choose Oregon Chai and it was good. Then I found Oregon Chai instant which for some reason was WAY better than the concentrate versions (no sour aftertaste I got from the others). Every chai I've ever tasted after was never as good. So when Amazon was out of stock of my instant (original flavor in the purple box is the best), I decided to try out Big Train (based on reviews). It was the review that stated "even better than Oregon Chai" that sealed the deal - I had to try it.It arrived within the week and I tried it right away. It says you can make it with water or milk but I always prefer water (milk makes to too thick for my liking). It tasted very good, but also completely differently from any other chai I've ever had. So it was actually very hard for me to compare. So after a few mugs, it hit me. It was missing the cardamom/cinnamon flavors that I'm used to in chai. So I added 1/8 tsp of cinnamon and OMG, it was AMAZING. Way better than any other chai I've had!I choose the 12oz three pack (instead of the 1.9 lb 2pack) just to try it out since I didn't want to be stuck with an even larger amount if I didn't end up liking it. But you'll go through these bags fast because it uses 4 tablespoons per 8oz cup! I'm already down to my last bag and it's only been 2 weeks. I haven't tried any of the other flavors (just the spiced chai flavor), but I highly recommend this one!

We first bought this at Home Goods, but they no longer carry it.  We searched all over the place and found it at Nordstrom cafe, selling for $9.95 (it was about $4~5 at Home Goods).  We also tried other brands of Chai tea, but nothing beats this one.  It's perfect for a cold winter night, after dinner.  Highly recommend!!!
Not only is this chai easy to make and tastes delicious, you can make an extra-rich treat by making it with frothed milk.  Yum.  Best packaged chai product I've tried.

I've been looking for a powdered chai mix, and I can now say I've found it. I didn't need to add too much powder to get a rich flavour. I thought I'd have to add a few of my own touches to it, but surprisingly it's great right out of the container. I'll be sticking with this brand. Great buy.
I'm yet to discover any brand that can top Big Train Spiced Chai Tea. Absolute bliss!
This chai tea is the best I have ever had. I bought a package at a cafe when I was out of town, and had to find it online. Ships quick! Great product. :) You save a lot buying in bulk!

I decided to try this chai based on customer reviews. The shipping was fast and it was packaged rather securely--which I really appreciate. However, I was not thrilled with the taste of the spiced chai. It wasn't very sweet and had a strong, almost bitter after taste. The raspberry chai was a little better, though. Going back to my first love...
This has to be one of my favorite chai mix.  It's perfect hot or with ice and not too sweet!

I love Big Train chai! This stuff is full-bodied, and not too sweet. I'm not an Oregon chai fan, however my boyfriend is. He claims that Big Train beats Oregon.I'll leave that decision up to you. If you drink chai and are a fan, you can't pass this brand up!
Mix all of the chai teas together, Choc.Spice, Vanilla. Rasberry and put a 1/2 scoop in my coffee. give a great flavor

I've sampled several different chai mixes before, but Big Train Spiced Chai Mix is definitely the best. It has a distinct smell and taste, very sweet, but still has a bit of that tea flavor. Whenever I make a cup, the first reaction I get is, "Wow, that smells like Christmas!"I would recommend the "spiced" flavor, because that's the only one I've tried and I loved it. Got some for my friends as gifts and they love it too! Also, it was convenient that the drink came in three smaller bags, so you can give each one as gifts or keep them for yourself!! But if you plan on drinking a cup each day, or every other day, I would suggest buying the larger canisters because these go quickly!

For Christmas this year, my daughter specifically requested Big Train Chai. When she was little, I used to take her and her brother out to the coffee shop. We would drink Chai and listen to live music or play games. It was always a great time. I only had summer visitation so we made the most of it, and when they returned to their father's for the school year, I would send her a bag of Big Train Chai as a christmas present. That was about 10 years ago but some things you don't forget. This year, she told me that she wanted chai, and not just any chai, but the stuff in the purple bag that I used to send her when she was young. I shipped her two bags and kept one for myself, so that I can drink something delicious that brings back so many wonderful memories.

I bought this product based on the reviews. I usually drink Twinnings Spiced Chai but I wanted to try something that was more convenient than hot tea. I got it in the mail today and tried it as an "iced tea," not good at all. It didn't mix well and mostly tasted like milky water. So I added a little more with little difference. It's a couple hours later and I'm drinking the hot version as I'm writing this review and I still don't like it. Plus the smell isn't very appealing to me. I had to use 6 tablespoons in order to taste the flavor. I don't know about the other reviewers, but I personally won't be buying this again. Big Train can pull out the station, I'm taking the bus!

I had tried this brand of chai before somewhere, and fell in love with it!  I typically use the concentrated liquid chai that you mix with water or milk, so this was a different world to me.  But once I had some, I never wanted the liquid anymore!  The flavor is so good, it's fairly easy to make - you can mix it with hot water or milk - I prefer milk, but that's your own preferance.  Definitely good sized bags that are resealable, which is the best selling point ever.  I will definitely be buying these again since they are very hard to find in stores near me!
This chai tea is delicious served hot or cold and is even tastier with tea biscuits.:-)

column9: It doesn't get any better than this.
column10: This is an awesome product.  Best spice chai I have ever had. I am a big fan of chai and have tried it at most of the big national franchise chains around the country.  None even come close to the flavor and smoothness of Big Train Chai.  I'm ordering more today.

Japanese students gave this candy to my husband and girls a couple of years ago.  It has since become a family favorite.  Hi-chew can be ordered directly from Japan with the Japanese wrapper, but it's not necessary.  It is the same great candy!

Grape Hi-chew is THE best candy ever made!It has the taste of concord grapes.It doesn't stick to your teeth, andit isn't as hard as a rock. It is very sweetand tastes like real grapes.This is my favorite Hi-chew.Buy this candy!

This candy purchase was amazing.  It came in 2 days after ordering it and I did not even pay for speed shipping.  Everyone I gave some to loved it...too bad I have not seen anyone who sells this in stores where I live.
This taffy does not stick to your teeth at all and the flavor is awesome! My favorite is grape. Be carefull with the calories!!!

I picked a pack of these up locally.  Kind of pricey compared to other chews but at the same time worth the price.  My opinion is that this is kind of a hybrid of gum and a chew; when you first put it in your mouth it has the consistency of gum but the flavor of a chew in the center.  Great feel if you're a gum chewer and much softer than starburst and now & later which is better for dental work.Only drawbacks are the price and the fact that the US is getting domesticated flavors.  In Asia they have some very interesting flavors like Cola and Lemon drop soda which sound like they'd be a decent product for the US.  Maybe if they sell enough here they'll expand their product line to more "exotic" flavors.

column9: The Best Candy in the World!!!
column10: I originally got this candy in Japan a coupla years ago & now I can get it right here in the good ole U S of A!!! I am so geeked cuz it's the best candy ever made...And this wonderful company shipped in to me PRONTO!!! So Kudos to you guys for not making me wait for my favoritest bestest grapest...(all my own words...LOL) in the world...Thanx TB

I really enjoy the Hi-chews except in Mango.  I was happy to see this offered in grape so imagine my disappointment when I tasted a very, very strong chemical taste in these.  I would compare it to nail polish remover.  I contacted the seller with my concern but was ignored.  Don't buy the GRAPE!!I had to rate this with 1 star otherwise my review wouldn't go through, but I take it back.

Found the sweets i've been looking for in Turkish Delights!  The texture of this confection is similar to some of my favorites, but these were even better and is now one of my all time favorites; it's a soft gummy texture with just enough bite.  The rose flavor is piquant and exquisite.

I can see why the kid from narnia couldn't get enough of this stuff. if roses smell good to you, you'll like it. the texture is great, it's almost like a gummy,, but much firmer. the powdered sugar makes it all the more delicate and delicious. eating them makes you feel like royalty, for some reason! I love this stuff, and will definitely buy more in the near future.

I wanted to try Turkish Delight after reading The Chronicles of Narnia. I know so many people say that, but it's true. I heard a lot of good reviews on this product so I purchased it. It came quickly and it was very delicious. I wasn't sure what rose-flavored would taste like but I loved it. It was fresh and very delicious. I can see why Edmund was so tempted with it, now. I would absolutely get this again!

A while back, I ordered one of each of every tea-tree foot/body powder I could find, to try them all out. I was looking for a natural alternative to the various anti-fungal medicated powders I'd been using for athletes-foot and jock-itch.On first glance I was unimpressed by this product. It's rather plain looking, and the label is even kinda wrinkled up like it was badly glued onto the cardboard tube.HOWEVER, after evaluating all of the powders, this one is BY FAR my favorite one!The first thing you'll notice is that it doesn't poof clouds of powder everywhere. Secondly, it has a pleasant tea-tree oil scent - not too strong - just right. It does an excellent job of cooling, relieving itch, and healing and preventing chafing.It is labeled as foot powder, and it does that job well, but it's great for an allover body powder - not too strong even for the "sensitive" areas!

column9: Foothill Farms Blue Cheese Salad Dressing
column10: This is an excellent salad dressing mix. We all like it so much that I've placed another order. I mix the powder with yogurt and some mayonnaise and add a bit of crumble blue cheese, and we can hardly get enough of it. We even have salad for breakfast now!

column9: viable replacement for Special Teas brand
column10: This Vithanakande Estate OP1, packaged by TeaVert, is the first I've tried as a replacement for the Special Teas branded Vithanakande (Special Teas was bought out by TeaVana & unfortunately, Special Teas best teas were not continued by TeaVana).  Vithanakande was one of the very best.This one from TeaVert is quite good, but lacks some of the smooth richness of my previous favorite.  That being said, I am also aware there can be differences from season to season. I would purchase this one again, unless I came across one that I liked better.  Anyone who likes to try different teas should definitely add this one to his or her list, perhaps at the top as the next to try.  Contrary to their instructions, I steep this one for only 3 minutes in my Krups tea maker, along with a small ice cube to lower the temp just a little.  It is also quite refreshing cold.

column9: Royal Matcha from RedLeafTea relieved my lethargy
column10: I have always considered myself as the low-energy types. Some people call us lethargic.  My best friend told me about matcha tea from Japan. One evening during study and I decided to start taking it out of pure curiosity. Well, I must say that,  I feel great. It really helps when I have to be up to study at long evening hours.

I was pleasantly surprised by the high quality of this matcha. RedLeaf has a tea that finally compares to what I get from Japan.  I am more than thrilled to be able to buy delicious matcha from a U.S. source.  Make sure to use a sieve to break up any clumps. Makes a perfect cup of tea.

This is your no-frills classic powdered green tea.  This green tea is like a pearl necklace on Audrey Hepburn or Marilyn Monroe.  It's both classy and sexy and icons of a more romantic era.  While it's not the most superb matcha or the most interesting, you simply can't go wrong with Royal Matcha.  It's a comforting and energizing drink for the morning, and if you're immune to caffeine, this makes a great latte for dessert after dinner.  Like I said, you can't go wrong with this.
This is a fantastic product with a great pop up pourer which makes it extremely easy to use and reuse. But the best part of the product is the flavor, really nice product

First off, the bottle is plastic which is intolerable for olive oil.  I would not have been happy for this one reason.  But, I also think the taste of the oil is inferior to, well, most any other olive oil I've bought before.  I use it quite a bit and am not happy with this product, inside or out.I would not have ordered this if I had realized it would arrive in plastic bottles.
We love and use this olive oil all the time and were pleased to see it at such a great price.  Will be ordering this again as we use olive oil daily.

column9: Flavorful oil at a great price!
column10: I have ordered this product set twice, I love it. Great value, my only complaint is that the bottles are plastic thus you must keep the olive oil in the cupboard, so it is not exposed to light.
We always order this product but this time the juice boxes got crushed and therefore leaked all over everything in the box.

column9: Excellent Coffee if You Like Dark, Strong and Robust
column10: I like my coffee dark, strong, bold and black, no sweeteners, no cream.  This is thus an ideal coffee for me.  If you like a much milder coffee, say medium roast, you may not like it nearly as much as I do. If you like cream and sugar, that may just ruin this coffee as it will dilute its strength and "strong" is what this coffee is all about..  The statements made in the description of this coffee here at Amazon are correct, i.e. the taste of an Italian roast with hints of chocolate overlaying it. Lately I've been able to buy mine at Sam's Club locally in a big bag for $16.
I got two pack of 3, all made two years ago, and will be expired after 3 months.When I open them, all of them has fishy smell.

This is my favorite coffee of all time!  It's just perfect.  Not too strong and not too weak.  I've tried many and this is the one I always grab.  Of course you must buy the whole bean and grind it yourself because it will always taste a million times better.  I don't find the price to be a problem at all compared to other coffee brands.  I do always make sure to get it on sale AND if you happen to have a Kroger nearby you can usually get a bag for around $7.00 which if (like me)  you have a husband who doesn't do coffee, it'll last you at least two weeks! :D
Probably the best flavor offered by Starbucks.  Price is slightly better then the store (especially if you have Amazon Prime).
Apparently the seller, atoz4less2012, does this a lot. I received 2 bags of ground coffee and 1 bag of whole bean, all well past their sell-by date.
Verona is by far the best coffee made by Starbucks. Buying in bean form it has much more flavor than if bought already ground. More robust and richer taste.
It was a great buy and the coffee tasted quite fresh . Much better deal than getting in grocery store .

Starbucks Verona blend is my favorite coffee.  However, the coffee I received was outdated and stale.  The expiration date on the packages was December 2011, and I received the coffee in late April, 2012.  The coffee both smelled and tasted stale.

column9: Nice, but just get it on sale at the store!
column10: The coffee itself is good.  Bold, Robust flavor.. it's just that you can get the same thing at the store when  it's on sale for cheaper.

column9: Prepare yourself for a rich coffee experience.
column10: Starbucks Caffe Verona is one of the most full-bodied, aromatic coffees sold by Starbucks.  It can be enjoyed at any time of day, but it is best served to late-afternoon guests or after dinner with dessert.  To anyone familiar with the rich aroma of coffee beans roasting, this coffee tastes like that smell.  Few cups are as fraught with flavor and richness as Caffe Verona, short of a well-crafted macchiato.In spite of its boldness, this coffee manages to retain its distinctive characteristics.  Where some of the darker roasts tend to become uniform and mundane, Caffe Verona is unmistakably unique and memorable.  Its flavor and aroma linger long after you have finished the cup.Whether you are the kind of person who gets hooked on one coffee, or if you like to try different kinds, this pack of three is simply a great deal.  If you truly, truly enjoy coffee, I can almost guarantee you will enjoy Caffe Verona.
This coffee was a gift for my mother. She says she really liked the taste. Mom likes a bold coffee and this blend suited her just fine.
Great work coffee pot coffee.  I use this at work and whenever I have a student drag by sniffing, I give them this.  They are grateful and really like this brew too.!
Starbuck`s Caffe Verona...love that coffee and being able to get a special Amazon deal makes it extra  enjoyable.

column9: Order this yesterday and it is already here!
column10: Great service and the price can't be beat. I love this coffee and prices are going up weekly at the store. This is worth checking out if you drink coffee every day. Great value.
The package was dated Feb. and I ordered and received the coffee on the last week of Sept.On the other hand, the service from Amazon was great.

column9: Save A Trip to Starbucks - Tastes Just as Fresh I Think!
column10: We brew our own coffee but are addicted to Starbucks after my Starbucks barista son giving us free coffee for a while! Rather than make a trip to the store, we ordered here and were pleased how quickly we received and how fresh the coffee tasted.

I am a coffee fanatic who still just drips it through my Melitta cone.  After I read the reviews, I was still skeptical because this came out to a great per pound price and was supposedly similar to Petes.  This one tastes fresh, layered and stands up to a $17.99 per pound coffee I have had.  This one is a winner.

Cafe Verona is our favorite coffee. It is bold and robust without being bitter.  As far as the seller, everything was great there also. Package arrived on time, actually sooner than expected. Will buy from again. Try this coffee, you will not be disappointed.
if i could i would buy everything on amazonis quick simple and as i am aging, a rilief not to have to go out in the snow and ice of upstate ny
I try all types of dark roast, Starbucks & others. There is no other way to say it. For me, this has the most intense deep flavor. This is my ULTIMATE COFFEE!

I will always buy this 3 pack from Amazon, bought separately in the store this item is $7 or $8 a piece. This three pack is a great value, can't be beat, especially if you are an Amazone Prime member!

I dont think they make this blend at the stores anymore so this might become a collectors item.  I purchased an extra few in hopes of selling for like $100 a bag in the future.  A bunch are in my freezer staying fresh.  Oh this coffee is soooo good.  It takes care of me in the morning on my ride to work.  Only don't even try to follow the instructions on the bag for home brewing this blend because for real yo you'll get sick in the head from all the caffeine.  So to sum up, buy it while you can- its as good as gold$$!!  Yeah baby!!!

i am a fan of this coffee, and have bought it many times before in the starbucks stores.  i thought this was a good deal buying it through amazon, until i realized that these are NOT the same size bags that starbucks sells!so just be aware -- these are only 12 OUNCE bags!!!(no complaint on the coffee itself though)

column9: The course of true espresso never did run smooth
column10: Starbucks' Caffe Verona is a perfectly romantic blend. It has the boldness of forbidden love,the warmth of passion, and the bittersweetness that's redolent of most Italian coffees. It's more of a wake-up blend than Starbucks' Morning one, for this recalls Romeo and Juliet awakening after the ardor of their wedding night The Oxford Shakespeare: Romeo and Juliet (Oxford World's Classics: the Oxford Shakespeare)Romeo & JulietCaffe Verona isn't a weak coffee. It's not like a tepid romance novel. It's strong enough for the early morning... and even works in a chili with unsweetened cocoa and S & W, Bean Rr Santa Fe, 15.5-Ounce (12 Pack)Caffe Verona is bittersweet--like a good chocolate or forbidden passion. It's delicious!

column9: Think of having a peppermint starlight mint that prevents tooth decay!
column10: That's really what this product is, a healthy version of a starlight mint.  It tastes like a candy cane, but you can eat it just before you go to bed or any time of the day.  Individually wrapped, these are great breath mints for people on the go.  My kids like to grab one on their way to school.  I wish they made a chocolate mint version.

column9: Good company, but this is not one of their better products
column10: Dixie's "Plain Bread Crumbs" is a poor product.  It tasted sour when used to coat some breaded skinless boneless chicken breasts (with an egg wash as a binder), and did not hold texture at all in frying or baking (as a baking coating it got pretty soggy).  We tried it in a meatloaf recipe as well, and it added a strange sour, almost bitter, aftertaste to it.  This is simply not a good product to my taste buds.  The only reason I did not give it a 1 is that some people's tastes may vary, and the company itself did a good job on order fulfillment.If you're looking for crumbs, you're better off buying Dixie's "Bakes Quick" biscuit mix, then making biscuits and then making crumbs from those.  Its what I did before, and what I will do from now on.If you're looking for a frying coating/batter, go with Dixie's "Batter and Coating" mix - its a far better product.  I use it frequently.Sorry Dixie, in my opinion, this one's a loser.

This coffee is smooth and is not bitter at all. It is wonderfully aromatic and a rich flavor. I personally bought the beans in Jamaica but it was only $12 for 12 ounces, I have seen such inflated prices on the internet for this product and truly it is not worth it.
There is a reason they serve this coffee at the White House.  Its the smoothest, best coffee ever produced.  Low acid, smooth in the mouth, and it has the most intoxicating aroma.  Worth the price.

I was very disappointed with the quality of the coffee. I have purchased Blue Mountain coffee before from other places and it was always great. But this was totally unsatisfactory. It had a mildewed flavor to it like it had been stored for a long time in a warehouse that was damp or moldy. For the money I paid for it I was quite displeased and will NEVER buy from them again.

My son had this Jablum roasted and ground coffee brought back from Jamaica and paid a lot for it.  I have drunk blue mountain for years when I can but this was shocking.  It tasted stale when you opened the bag and even worse when you drank it.  It was definitely off.  He bought 5 bags and every one we tried was the same.  I would never buy another.  We had bought another brand in a tin from Jamaica which was fine.  I think this is a con.  You get all the rubbish about it being tested in Jamaica, well I dont know who tests it but definitely not someone who likes good coffee.  I just dont understand how people say its any good. Maybe having paid so much for it its like the emperor's new clothes.
We heard about this coffee before leaving for Jamaica so we pick up some and have fell in love with it.  The best we have had yet smooth without that bitter after taste so many other coffee have.

column9: Excellent coffee, not all that exotic, though...
column10: I love my coffee, and because of that, I have tried lots and lots of varieties although I began as a simple Folgers fantatic.  Jamaican Mountain Blue Coffee has been touted to be the best of the best world coffees out there by such highly esteemed sources as the Food Network and the kitchens of the White House.I found the low acidity of the coffee very refreshing, but the darkness of this roast has not allowed a lot of subtleness of the flavor to come out.  To me, this tastes like Folgers at its best, but nothing more than that.  Great for everyday drinking, because it is smooth and rich and leaves little acid "bite."  But still, after having tried Kona coffee with its myriad of subtle flavors, I found Blue Mountain kinda boring.I guess I disagree with experts, but hey, my coffee is important and taste is everything!  If you like exotic flavors, this isn't it.  But it you would like to have consistently smooth, rich, honest coffee, this is the one.

I am a coffee lover of many years and as such am always interested in finding good coffees.  This was my first time to try blue mountain, and purchasing it with a gift certificate allowed me to be a bit more extravagant than I otherwise would have been.While the coffee is good, I don't find it to be superior to other coffees I have ordered which are considerably less expensive.

These are some of my favorite beans. I've purchased this brand a number of times in various roasts, and I've never been disappointed. Whether you use them in your French press, your espresso maker or your conventional coffee pot, some of the best tasting coffee you can imaging comes out of this bag.Definitely recommended.

column9: Love Blue Mountain Coffee, Hate JABLUM
column10: While in Jamaica, my wife and I drank Blue Mountain Coffer every day and loved it.  We even went on a bike tour of the Blue Mountains, and purchased some coffee.  It came in a plain clear plastic bag, and we could see the darkness of the roast.  We enjoyed that coffee.In Ocho Rios, we bought some bags of JABLUM.  You can't see the darkness of the roast, and all you can smell is the burlap bag.  When we opened it up, it was a very light roast, not much fragrance, and once brewed, the coffee tasted a lot like dirt.  We were very disappointed.

I bought this coffee in Jamaica ($15 for 1 lb bag).  While I liked and enjoyed it, I prefer several coffees from my local shops at about the same price.  I think that it may have been worth the $15/lb, but no more.  Certainly not at these prices.

column9: Only 2 of 3 16 oz. received in shipment
column10: I recently ordered the 16 oz., 3 Pack.  When my FedEx order arrived on December 26, 2008 there were only two 16 oz. bags contained in my order.  I would like my missing 16 oz. bag to be sent to me or at least be refunded 1/3 of my $105 charged price.

Went to Jamaica last May and brought about 6 pounds of this and the Waldenford's Blue Mtn back with me. About half what you are paying here, but still not worth the money. It is good coffee. No question. But don't believe all the hype. I am a casual coffee drinker and someone that takes coffee more seriously might get more benefit from this coffee. To me, not the case. I order my Peet's Arabian Mocha Java online for about $14/lb and it is still my favorite coffee.
I don't get all the hype over this coffee. Not much of a head on it. Doesn't taste that great. What's the big whoop?

After getting an email from Amazon noting that this coffee was on a closeout sale at 40% off the regular price, I stumbled on an additional 20% off coupon. A 60% discount?? Too good to be true, but it all worked!Even if the coffee was a touch above average, I'd be well satisfied. It was terrific. I bought a few "on-sale" varieties from Camano Island Coffee Roasters, vacuum packed them, and put them in my freezer. A great buy on excellent coffee.

column9: Best espresso coffee I have tried
column10: I have tried a lot of vendors espresso coffee and this one has no bitter after taste. you can very the strength / taste with no bitterness.

column9: Some of the best coffee we've had
column10: Great flavor and value, anyone looking for a great coffee that's not super expensive should at least give this a whirl, well worth the price

Coffee, in general, is heavily sprayed with the always dangerous pesticides.  Was glad to find Organic in bulk.  The Coffee was decent, but needs a better container for pouring. > (Pouring from this kind of bag, can get a little messy, at this large size.)

I grew up in a polish american home with pork and cabbage a favorite.  Every Tuesday we would visit my Grandmother before we were all school age, as  it was Dads payday and the day Grandma made spare ribs and sauerkraut. The were braised and not browned before and so good.  However I failed to see the sugar in the label for this product.  If you are like me the sweet kills it!  It was sugar on the tongue why why why?  I bought it put,the pork and the canned kraut in the crockpot and  after it was done cooking was what what sugar!!  Granted its a little sugar I guess compared to lots of convience products plus I am not Bavarian cuisine by birth.  But watch out on all labels for sugar if you don't added it yourself cause if they do they ruined your dish by your tastes.  I have had other dishes unpalateable to me because a canned ingredient had sugar i didn't expect and this product does.  Only a little sugar can kill a good dish when others expect it'  That's not what i expect to happened to me.  Cause of added but  possibly authentic to you- minuscule sugar which I quess a lot of like but wow bad to me  I won't buy again.

I have loved sauerkraut and hot dogs since I was a child but didn't care for the intensity ofregular kraut anymore. Mixing the Bavarian Sauerkraut with regular makes the perfectflavor. I couldn't find Bavarian Kraut anywhere but Wisconsin when we visited my daughterso I was thrilled to find it on Amazon! The flavor is very mild, yet still has that wonderfulold time flavor I remember as a child.
Having purchased this product at local markets the qood quality was not a surprise.  Nice to pair with Gr. style meals.
Who doesn't love mail order Saurkraut? The dented semi-rusted cans make you feel as though it was delivered as part of some 3rd world NATO food drop. Nice.

I've only tried it once so far, but it seems to be lacking in flavor and you can't discern what type of poultry it is - although it doesn't have a turkey taste - closer to an extremely mild chicken.  I was hoping for a little more intense flavor than what I got.I do like the Southeastern Mills version (actually all of their flavors are good), but cannot seem to find it in a frugal size (just the small couple ounce packets for more than $1).  A 2 pound version of that at a reasonable price would be great.

column4: Margaret Mitchell "Books open my world, desig...
column10: The best product I have use for making chicken gravy. It produces better-than-home made taste with ease.

My rather fussy little dog will generally only eat people food and turns her nose up at most dog food. I've tried several brands of natural and organic dog treats with her and she's only liked two brands, one of which is Wagatha's. Of the two brands, I prefer to give her Wagatha's Senior Biscuits because I think the ingredients are better (no sugar, etc.). These organic "senior" biscuits seem especially healthy, with turmeric, flax seed, ginger, rosemary, thyme, veggies, lentils, etc. They are also wheat-free and all of the organic ingredients are U.S. sourced (except for the olive oil).

column9: Delish! If you like tangy food, you will like these chips!
column10: These chips are delicious. Lay's are better than any other brand because the hint of vinegar is perfect, not overwhelming to cause you to do the 'alum pucker'. They are just right in the blend of salt and vinegar for a snack or with sandwiches.
Everyone commented on the good quality of the filet mignons.  Made for a great barbecue!  They were delivered right on time. Omaha Steaks Filet Mignons, (4) 5 Ounce  BK
Good steaks, but too much bother when I can get the same thing in a local store for less cost, considering shipping etc.
The Omaha Steaks were ordered as a Christmas present and the person who got them loved them!  They may be expensive, but wow are they good!

My parents love steak and I wanted to gift them nice, yet affordable fancy steaks. I looked at Omaha's bacon-wrapped filets and decided against those due to a few ratings. These filets had better ratings, most importantly by my elderly parents, who aren't into local, grass-fed, trendier steaks that cost more.

I bought these for my parents and in-laws for Christmas. The steaks arrived on time, and everyone was "over-the-moon" with the gift. I'll do it again next year. I gave it 4 stars because of price. I'm pretty sure this isn't Kobe beef, but maybe I'm wrong. It had better be Kobe for the price point.

I tried this tea at a weekend we spend at The Bedford Springs Hotel in Bedford, PA.  I love Vanilla and Almond and this tea is a delicious combination of the two flavors. I highly recommend The Des Vahines Rooibos tea, just add a teaspoon of Sugar in the Raw and you've have a very flavorable, delicious, non-caffeine tea!

column9: Aunt Jemima Self Rising cornmeal mix
column10: I think this is the best cornmeal mix there is,, Just add egg, oil, and milk,, mix, bake,, easy,, and it makes the best cornbread dressing.. I wish I could find it here in Alaska. Thank you amazon for having this on your site,,

column9: Not As Good As White Lily
column10: I was actually looking for White Lily Cornmeal Mix and my Amazon search showed nothing. I was disappointed but it showed this and I know the brand just not my favorite. Bought it and it is OK.Now I search for White Lily and Amazon finds it for me! Yea, I am ordering that and donating the Aunt Jemimah.It just does not make good Southern cornbread?!

column9: If I could give it a zero, I would
column10: I was shocked when I opened the shipping box and found the box of candy surrounded only by a small amount of brown crumpled paper. I thought, "This is lousy packing for fragile candy." I was right. I get better packing on EBay from independent sellers than I did from this COMPANY. The candy was a mess, ranging from pieces broken off to shattered to crushed into powder. Not only that, the wrappers were sticky with some actually gooey. What a disappointment. I was looking forward to trying some of their retro mixes, but I'm not about to waste my money for crushed, melted candy and OVERPRICED PRICED SHIPPING with LOUSY PACKING. Phooey.

column9: not so good, not so bad
column10: This coffee is ok I guess, I'd like a bit bolder flavor.  The product is well priced and sealed and everything, but I think is almost like a folgers flavor except for the burnt taste, this coffee is better that way.  If you like folgers or maxwell house, you'd like this.  I will not buy again, I would rather look for another brand.

I received this coffee as a Christmas present and was pleasantly surprised.  I normally don't like the taste of nuts in my coffee and was expecting to not like it, but I love this coffee.  I have been drinking Folgers French Vanilla coffee for years partly because I like the smell of it brewing first thing in the morning.  The Hawaiian Hazelnut also has a wonderful smell first thing in the morning, but the taste is even better!  It does not have the slightly bitter taste that the Folgers has and I actually look forward to that first cup of coffee in the morning again - instead of just drinking it to kick-start the day.
This coffee is a 10-ounce bag, not 12-ounce.The flavor was fine.  I wrote to amazon, and they refunded 20% of my purchase price.

I purchased this coffee as an office contribution. I was a little nervous about this coffee after a co-worker's coffee was called "foot coffee."  She spent $8.25 a bag and I spent $5.31.  I make it a point to try to review something based on what it's trying to be first and what I purchased it for second.  This is tasty, teir 2 coffee at an inexpensive price, which I think it succeeds at fairly well.  I purchased it to feed the masses at work.  After "foot coffee," this is certainly a crowd pleaser.

column4: Marilyn Rucker "Author Sax and the Suburb and...
column10: I was searching for a great hot chocolate mix to replace my beloved Ghiradelli mix. I had recently learned that most American chocolate companies are still buying cocoa from slavers.  (Forbes Magazine ran a recent article about it.)  I couldn't find a good fair trade cocoa in town, but Omanhene was on amazon. I ordered it and loved it! It is not as sweet as i am used to. I use three tablespoons to make a cup.  But it is delicious, and as far as i can ascertain, the farmers involved don't enslave children.

Great taste- nice and rich- not too sweet (I don't like really sweet drinks).  The recipe does call for making with milk- not water (however, I have found that rice milk works just great).  Good price for the quality!
We discovered Omanhene years ago from a friend who knew the creator of this African product. We've never found a better cocoa product for making hot chocolate.

I first tasted this hot chocolate at a coffee shop in Portland and thought it was excellent.  It tastes like very good quality hot chocolate and the ingredient list is simple.  As an added bonus, the subscribe & save price through Amazon makes this an excellent value.

If you are searching for a chocolate indulgence that cannot be beat...treat yourself to the very best hot cocoa mix. This is the best stuff. Highly recommended. I'd spent more time telling you all about this wonderful cocoa mix but I just made myself a mug full of this hot cocoa and its time to imbibe!
this mint hot cocoa smells and tastes so good.  it has just the perfect balance of mint and cocoa.  i highly recommend it.

Omanhene is the best cocoa (also bars, baking chocolate, etc.) one can find - if one can find it.Entirely produced in Ghana - from beans - not manufactured from previously processed components in Europe.  I understand that hard-core chocolate snobs pinpoint this speck of West Africa as the mecca for the best on earth.  One can taste that.The trouble is getting your hands on some.  I'd rather deal with my grocer than Amazon.  Addictive.

column9: said to be produced without slavery; helpful product, no fructose corn-syrup' and  tastes great
column10: Lucky to find this "true and authentic hot cocoa mix". I was looking for cocoa mixes without corn syrup or dry milk.  Think I've found it in this product.The Omanhene organization has a website under that name, and the package label says the company works out of the state of Wisconsin.The label has lots of very interesting facts, such as:A) "In a unique process, our beans are fermented between banana leaves and dried in the warm African sun.  Then we roast, grind and press the beans to extract the finest natural cocoa powder available anywhere....."B). "Omanhene" (OH -mahn-HEE-nee) comes from the Twi language and is the title for the traditional king or chief, the repository of ethical and moral authority in Ghana."We've tried this at our house both with milk and with water, and thought it very good tasting, sugar not overpowering.Our order was a pack of four, 12  ounces each, nice seal under the plastic lid.Some nutrition facts are:  14 servings of 2 tbsp each per 12 ounce-container...Which works out to: 80 calories per serving, 5 calories fat, zero transfat, zero saturated fat, and 0.5 gram of fatZero cholesterol; 5 mg sodium. (Low)20 grams carb 2 grams fiber16 grams sugar 1 gram proteinMixing directions are on the label.  Again, lucky to have this alternative to corn syrup, dry milk, and standard cocoa mixes.  Recommended, and hope you like this, too.

column9: Just okay...not exactly what I hoped for
column10: I have been on a quest to find a really good hot cocoa mix. After sifting through many types and reviews I decided to try this one. Sadly, this mix is kind of blah...it is not bad but not anything better than what I buy at the supermarket. I like cocoa that is rich, mildly sweet with a hint of saltiness. I did not find this mix rich at all (yes, I followed the directions) and did not detect any salt, it was mildly sweet--maybe minimally would be more accurate. Perhaps, after trying it a couple more times the taste will grow on me? I will say it does have a uniqueness about it. All and all, I have to say that I would not suggest this product.

column9: Not white tea. Heavy on the cloves.
column10: I should have read the description better.  The ingredients list is accurate, I just didn't read it before ordering.  My bad.  It's not white tea with orange and cloves, it's white peony with orange, cloves and some other ingredients.  If you are looking for a white tea blend, keep looking.  However, it is good tea.  It's a little heavy on the cloves for my taste.  I bought two different teas from this company and the package on the other one resealed just fine.  The zipper seal on my particular bag of this, doesn't reseal properly. No big deal. I am happy with the packaging overall.

column9: the only canned food my finicky feline will eat!!
column10: i have finally found a canned food, with veggies and cranberries that my finicky cat will eat! expensive but worth it ...

These taste great. One thing I really like is that inside one package there are six smaller wrappings of the crackers, so I can eat just a few crackers without worrying about the others going stale if I don't eat them soon. These are gluten, lactose, soy and preservative free. They also have some calcium and iron. The ingredients are potato starch, rice flour, buckwheat flour, eggs, palm oil, modified corn starch, dextrose, salt, yeast, hydroxypropyl methylcellulose, sunflower lecithin, cream of tartar, ammonium bicarbonate, natural flavor. For more information go to schar.com

I am new to gluten free foods.  I was diagnosed with celiac disease in March.  I have been searching for a "normal tasting" saltine cracker.  This is as close as it comes.  These crackers are deliciouswith almost all my new gluten free diet foods.  I am so glad I found them.  I will continue my orders as long as these crackers are available.  Thanks Amazon!

My husband has been gluten intolerant since 1998.  Foods have becomemuch better than when he was first diagnosed w/celiac disease.  Wehave tried a lot of crackers & he hasn't liked any of them, we just gave up trying.I read the reviews on Schar table crackers and decided to try them.  My husbandLOVES them.  We will continue to purchase these, we have even let other peopletry them, and they are completely sold on these crackers.  GOOD JOB!!!

column9: Very good product but shipping needs improvement
column10: These gluten free crackers are very good, and this was a reorder of the product for me--so I obviously like these crackers.  However, the shipping needs to be improved, as too many of the crackers are broken upon arrival. Given this blend's orgin, the name "English" Breakfast is a bit of a misnomer, because it was a Scotsman - a 19th century Edinburgh tea master named Drysdale - who first marketed his particular blend under the name "breakfast tea." It proved so popular, however, that it was soon copied by tea houses all over Britain, many of which then added the word "English," which has been part of its name ever since.English Breakfast can contain black teas from a variety of origins, among them India, Sri Lanka, Kenya, Malawi and China. Stronger than most other teas, the blend is made to match the traditionally heavy English breakfast, which to this day often includes pork, sausages and eggs, and for this reason English Breakfast tea also maintains its flavor very well with the addition of cream or milk. It is certainly less refined than Darjeeling or even Earl Grey, but hard to beat as an everyday "work horse," and as good or better an early morning pick-me-up as any kind of coffee.

This Twinings tea is a simple pleasure that never offends. It is sturdy enough to be enjoyed with milk or sweetener, yet has little harshness when consumed black.Twinings of London was founded in 1706, and is known internationally for marketing teas of consistency and value. Twinings English Breakfast Tea was originally blended to complement the traditional, hearty English Breakfast, from which its name derives. Twinings literature tells us that this is a blend of Kenyan and Assam black teas.This Twinings loose tea has no uncut leaves. The blend uses only small particles that infuse more quickly than whole leaves. This blend approaches full strength within just a couple minutes. To avoid excessive particulate matter in your drink, use a strainer or infuser with a fine mesh. (Amazon sells Tovolo, Teeli, and Frieling/Swissgold filters with very small openings in their screens.)This product is an attractively priced and enjoyable introduction to the world of loose tea. Would I rank it as my favorite tea or even my favorite Twinings? No, but I keep some available for when I want the pleasure of plain ol' tea. (As an aside, I would rank Twinings' Earl Grey a bit higher in quality. It is a whole leaf tea with just the right amount of bergamot orange flavoring. I personally don't think of Earl Grey as an everyday tea, but I enjoy it as an occasional pleasure.) I wish you pleasure in exploring various teas.

column9: This is a good soup base
column10: I love this soup but it needs a few things added to make it great.  I use fresh veggies and some extra sharp cheese to the soup.  My kids love it and everyone thinks I have worked on it all day long!

You add milk and water and wallah!!  Instant cheddar Broccoli Soup.  HOWEVER, if you're like me and you love broccoli, I would honestly suggest you add some more.  It's light with the broccoli pieces, which if you're like my HUBBY he was very happy with the way it is without adding anymore (not a broccoli person at all but he even liked this soup!!). There's so much bad coffee in fancy packs. The package is good enough for gifts and the coffee actually taste good.

If you have never enjoyed a Stubbs product -you have no idea what you are missing. He is (was) a Cook and you will find that note on most of his products. The care that goes into his products is unsurpassed. We have purchased "smoked" flavoring at much higher prices with half the flavor. We are using it for a beef dish in the winter when we cannot smoke meat outdoors.Buy-Enjoy!
