I got interested in purchasing and caring for a bonsai after reading an article from my local bonsai society. The article pointed out that many beginners to bonsai fail to realize that these are primarily outdoor plants, requiring the same environmental conditions as their full sized counterparts. I had received a bonsai as a gift several years ago, a juniper, and, bringing it inside for the winter, I killed it. I have a nice outdoor garden, though, and, since urban gardeners don't command a lot of space, I decided that bonsai trees would be a great way for me to cultivate species that I would never otherwise have the room for.I purchased this bonsai Chinese Elm on a whim to be a companion plant to the first bonsai I ordered: A Full Japanese Juniper Bonsai Tree in an AUTHENTIC Japanese Stoneware Container. I figured, for the price, which was only $19.99 plus a nominal shipping, I could start the bonsai hobby with two plants instead of one. Great!The Chinese Elm arrived first, so here are my comments:The tree arrived by USPS Priority Mail. It shipped from California on a Wednesday and arrived on my doorstep by Friday. The tree was listed by the seller has having shipped on Tuesday, however, so that set my expectation: I would recommend that the seller mark items as shipped when they are actually shipped rather than when they are processed.The tree was packed well, with Styrofoam peanuts protecting the branches and plastic wrap containing the pot and soil. The soil was still moist, and the tree had lost only about three leaves, so no significant defoliation at all. Again, great. I found it odd that the tree was packed in a horizontal box. The tree must have spent the last few days lying down, though it seems none the worse for wear.Upon unwrapping the base of the tree, I found a slug attached to one of the drainage holes on the pot. Ugg. The tree also appears to be newly transplanted. I noticed that you can still see where the soil has been pressed into the pot, and the tree is a bit loose in its soil, so not firmly rooted in. The tree is not wired into its pot.It's a nice overcast day at the beginning of June, and we're getting a gentle, steady rain, so I have placed the Chinese Elm bonsai into its place in my garden. It will be displayed on a nice brownstone slab that I rescued from a neighbor's lot. I hope it likes it there and gets some good strong root development. I plan to update this review later in the summer after the tree has had a chance to acclimate.

Well, This was my first EVER bonsai tree, and I liked it. I was reading other reviews, and I red about bugs. This freeked  me out, but when I got mine , The first two days were good. I got a little aluminum pan to be my water catcher thing, and around the 3rd day, I noticed ants. So then I looked online for ways to get rid of them. I tried soaking the roots for 10 minuets (like 4 different times) I didnt buy anything, or look to hard around my house for anything, I just realized. the best thing to do was just cut the roots (since you need to anywyas for repotting). That got rid of them.One thing that I wish i knew ahead of time was Pruning. They say give it one growing season before re-potting, But my pot was nothing but roots. It was overflowing with roots, hardly any soil. and I got it in the winter, So i cut the roots, Re-potted, right before spring, and Man did it do amazing.The ant problem was gone, but then I noticed I had Aphids. Soo, I started researching that too. So what I ended up doing was just mixing some spices I had around my house. I found the most dryest-spiciest-most fine seasonings I had, mixed it with water, and sprayd the plant.That got rid of them, and didnt harm the plant at all.I rate this a 4 out of 5 Because, It came to me in about 6 or so days, (from Cali to Ohio) which was fine with me, but the ammount of work I needed to put in.Took to long figuring out how to get rid of the ants, and aphids.They had ants and aphids in the first place. But Cant really blame them. Its a plant, no bigdeal, I cought them before they could really wreck the plant.Just besure for when you prune the roots.I tried to get better soil, and re-cut the roots right before May 1st, and now its Dead, I think I cut tomany roots.But the bug problem was long gone, so I know it wasnt that. I waterd it daily, It had sun. So my guess would be the root pruning.But hey, I learnd alot since then, Did even more research, SoI recomend this Tree to anyone, Just besure you check the roots, and look for Aphids (mine were white tiny bugs, died if you touched them because theyre so soft, and I just shook the tree, and some of them fell off. Thats how I knew I even had them)Pardon my spelling and or grammer.

column9: Easy-to-Prepare Pad Thai that Tastes Great.
column10: Annie Chun's Classic Pad Thai Meal Kit provides the basic ingredients (rice noodles and sauce) for stir-fried pad thai. You need to add vegetable oil, tofu, chicken or shrimp, eggs, bean sprouts,  green onions, and (not essential) lime, peanuts, and fresh cilantro from your own kitchen. Choose tofu for a vegetarian pad thai or combine with shrimp or chicken as you like. Of course, it would be less expensive to make pad thai from scratch. But the pre-packaged sauce is convenient, and this ranks high among the pad thais that I've tasted. The box says that preparation takes 10 minutes, but 20 minutes is more realistic. No MSG or preservatives. All natural ingredients.There are 2 sets of instructions on the box, which is confusing. On the side panel, there are instructions for boiling the noodles. Those are for people who want to eat the noodles with sauce only. The instructions for stir-fried pad thai "with all the trimmings" are on the back of the box. This recipe instructs you to soak the rice noodles in hot water for 10 minutes. It helps if the water is boiling hot, and you will probably need to soak them longer to get the noodles soft enough. The noodles will soften a little after they are added to the other ingredients, but not much. Apart from the problem of undercooked noodles, the recipe on the box works well and tastes great.Ingredients: Noodles: rice flour, water. Sauce: brown sugar, water, tamarind, soy sauce (water, wheat, soybeans, salt), onion and shallot puree, fish sauce (anchovy, salt, water), canola oil, tomato paste, rice vinegar, garlic, corn starch, lime juice concentrate, spices, onion powder. (Manufactured in a facility that uses peanuts.) Nutritional facts per serving (3 servings per box): 230 calories, 1g total fat, 780mg sodium, 53g carbohydrates, 9g sugars, 3g protein.

After trying the 6 "Meal Kits" contained in this item, I've concluded the following: o The sauce is a tad "brackish" and doesn't leave me satisfied; I prefer a smoother, less salty taste o The name "meal kit" is misleading, since one must (as others have noted) add the other 80% of what makes a true Pad Thai o The noodles never seem fully cooked if you merely follow the directions -- rather surprising, since the noodles otherwise look the same as those I buy (for home-made Pad Thai) from the Asian Market o Home-made Pad Thai is infinitely better, so find a good recipe, and you'll understand that Annie Chun isn't saving you much time (or money) after allHope this helps a potential buyer.  We tried this item sight-unseen (it's not available at our local Whole Foods store), and kinda slogged through all six boxes over the course of a year.  Had we enjoyed them at all, they'd have disappeared quickly!

Prepared this dish with vegetables, tofu, egg and chicken, etc...trimmed with green onion and crushed peanuts. It was very meh - a perfectly functional dinner for two, but nothing spectacular. The sauce was very bland and it lacked that distinctive Thai kick provided by the sweet chili and fish sauce used in so many Thai recipes. Honestly, this tasted like it had been "watered down" to suit a presumed "American" palate. If you want a reasonably quick and easy packaged Asian meal, this is your one. Just don't expect it to taste like restaurant Thai food. I will be making my own pad thai sauce from scratch in the future.

column9: Makes a super easy jerk marinade
column10: McCormick used to make a jerk marinade mix, which they sold in packets for a fast and flavorful alternative to more complex recipes.  They stopped making this a few years ago, replacing it with the PERFECT PINCH CARIBBEAN JERK SEASONING, found in the spice aisle of the super market (or here on Amazon, of course!).  The label on the jar suggests using this seasoning as a "rub" for chicken, pork, and other meats.  But it works even better as a marinade.  Here's the recipe:3 tbsp McCormick Caribbean Jerk Seasoning3 tbsp salad oil2 tbsp soy sauce1 tbsp cider vinegarCombine ingredients in a plastic food storage bag and mix until well blended.  Add chicken or tuna (the absolute best!) and let marinate.  The longer you marinate your protein, the spicier the end result will be.  Grill the chicken or tuna, basting with remaining marinade.This really is a terrific product which makes great jerk marinade.  Highly recommended!

column9: A great change for those who love rice.
column10: At a chinese food store I bought one of those rice cookers that looks like a silver spitoon with a grass funnel shaped basket on top.  This type of rice has a flavor and texture totally different when you steam it instead of boiling. And I find that using my new rice cooker there is a wonderful grain type flaver added. I soak the rice during the day (OR for an hour using boiling water)and then dump it into the grass basket.  I have a lid from one of my pans I plop onto the top.  Then just let it steam for about 20 minutes.  It sticks together without being overcooked.  I like rolling it into a bite size ball, dip it into my soup or sauce and then pop it into my mouth.I LOVE IT and am glad to have finaly found a place to buy it.

I cooked it in my Zojirushi pressure cooker and it did not turn out as well as the Thai Sticky rice cited earlier.  Grown in California it says? Great tasting Theatre type popcorn.. If I have to say anything negative, it would be that I would like to see less kernels wasted when popping.. After the popping process, there were more than several kernels left over.. Other than that.. GREAT Tasting buttery popcorn..

I am a dark chocolate lover. These chips have too much of other things in it like vanilla and soy lecithin and too much sugar. I found an organic chocolate bar that has only organic dark chocolate and organic sugar that is perfect amount of sweetness and serious chocolate at Trader Joe's own brand.

My mother is watching her sugar, so when I ran across these doughnuts, they were perfect for her!  The price was reasonable, although I thought shipping was a little high.  The company did keep good contact with me to make sure I got my order and on time.  = )  My Mom loved them!
This is the best I have found. When the local store stopped carrying it, I had to look online and was so happy to have found it.

I feel like this K-cup variety has been unnecessarily & harshly criticized both on Amazon and the Keurig site. It's kind of like a sweetened caffeinated hot chocolate. It's like what you'd expect a kid to order in a coffee shop or like a decaf starbuck's speciality drink. If you like those sorts of sweet drinks from coffee stores then you'll like this. The coffee flavour is weak, if you prefer starbucks drinks with 2 shots of espresso... you're not gonna like this. I think it's something you can drink in the afternoon or at night that isn't going to keep you up. If you prefer a bolder coffee taste go for some of the cappuccino k-cups.

column9: Cafe Mocha is the best tasting mocha coffee!!!
column10: After having Dunkin Donuts Mocha coffee at a small fortune, I decided to try the Cafe Escapes Cafe Mocha coffee in my Keurig machine at home.  I absolutely love it!!  The taste, the price, everything is wonderful about this coffee.  Low in calories, too.  I highly recommend this coffee if you enjoy a little "chocolate" with your java!!

I really like these and always keep them in stock. Its basically coffee and hot dark chocolate combined.The coffee is a bit strong, but it's really good, especially if you're looking for a hit of chocolate in the morning.
These are my favorite. I would highly recommend them. It's kind of like Starbucks Mocha Latte... only without the milk.

I love mocha, especially in the morning.  Cafe Escapes has just enough coffee to taste in the background of the rich chocolate flavor.I gave up on Starbucks because of the inconsistancy of taste in their mocha.  A friend turned me on to Cafe Mocha - same great taste everytime.

column9: Artificially sweetened, and minimal coffee taste
column10: I didn't think to check the label when I bought these, as I do not like artificial sweeteners. But as I was drinking the first one I could tell right away that there was something artificial. Turns out these have Sucralose (a.k.a Splenda) in them in addition to real sugar. Why use both?Also, I agree with another reviewer who said it really just tastes like hot chocolate. I could hardly taste any coffee flavor at all.Very disappointing. :(
I like to use less water and add milk. It makes the mocha sooo creamy. Only problem is that I drink it in 2 swallows. Too daggone yummy!!!

I just love my Keurig coffee maker.  I find myself drinking coffee at home instead of buying expensive drinks at my neighborhood Starbucks.  I always loved their cafe mocha, but it is just loaded with calories.  I was thrilled when I found this product.  It is low in calories and delicious.  If you are a Weight Watchers person, you can have a cup of this with some fat free whipped topping for just two points.  Incredible.  I have it as a mid afternoon treat.

column9: Great coffee, don't listen to all the complainers!
column10: People are complaining of the lack of coffee taste and too-chocletey taste, well what do you expect when you order MOCHA?  It's delicious, and lives up to it's name of MOCHA with a hint of coffee.  If you want coffee, order that.  This is a pleasure drink, at only 60 calories though, it's a bargain!

column9: Hot chocolate and coffee in one.
column10: This is a perfect blend! It is coffee, with more than a flavor of chocolate- it seems to have more of a chocolatey taste. Its a delicious blend of hot chocolate and coffee!

column9: One sip and dumped the cup!
column10: Cafe mocha, I mean who doesn't enjoy a sweet cup of coffee with a delicious chocolate overtone. I sure do. I dream of them and looked forward to trying this. This was a nightmare :P  <--- that was exactly what my face looked liked.I wish companies would be at least label their products that have artificial sweetener... as in this case sucralose. Sucralose has a nasty after and beginning taste in my opinion. I don't ever buy products intentionally that have this in it. If you don't mind sucralose, then it probably wouldn't bother you.However, if you dare to continue and try your own cup. Let me warn you. It doesn't have a coffee flavor. Or maybe a mild one.I couldn't get passed the sucralose taste. It is instant coffee as well. (no grinds in the filter left)As suggested by others stick to the reg. coffee and add some Andes mints or your own favorite hot chocolate to it.
I really love this product. Wish it came in decaf so I could enjoy it in the evening along with the afternoon.

column9: Missing the coffee flavor, but I still love this
column10: This is in my top five favorite K-cups. While it does taste more like hot chocolate, I brew one of these and then immediately brew the Donut Shop bold in the same cup. Mix the two together and THAT tastes like a real mocha. I still buy these again and again.
I am not a coffee drinker because I dont like the taste. Cafe Mocha tastes great. Now I can warm up and wake up.

If you like chocolate and coffee you will love this perfect blend of both brewed hot in your favorite mug.  Add Cafe' Mocha creamer to it and it's the perfect warm treat!  I love the flavor - not too strong, not too weak.  And for me it's a good afternoon pick me up without too much caffeine.

This is really good stuff if its cocoa you want. I didnt really taste coffee at all..I found that if I make a 6oz cup of regular coffee first then add a 6oz cup of this stuff it makes the perfect 12oz cup of mocha coffee. still good as cocoa in the evening too.....Its dual purpose!!!!

I just brewed the coffee and thought it smelled and tasted awful. There is sucralose on top of sugar so it is extremely sweet and it leaves an aftertaste. To me, it was like a coffee mixed with a cheap chocolate syrup. Very disappointing...

column4: Just me in Wisconsin "Justme in Wisconsin"
column10: This is my all time favorite year around!  The only problem I have  is being be put on the waiting list because so often they run out!

The mocha was good, but a bit too sweet for my taste, so I mixed it with a small (espresso shot) k-cup of regular coffee, which made it taste like a mocha from Starbucks. I know people have knocked this in other reviews, but I actually think its pretty good stuff. column9: Cafe Escapes Cafe Mocha for Keurig

I really am enjoying my purchase of Cafe Escapes Cafe Mocha.  I look forward to my cup of mocha every morning along with a touch of peppermint mocha. If you enjoy mocha this is one sweet treat.
Tasty cafe mocha...good value, I constantly reorder :) and find it enjoyable all year long. It's a good blend of hot cocoa and a good coffee blend. Especially good early mornings and afternoons. :)
Wonderful, my favorite of the K cups.  Will order frequently.  I can honestly recommend this to those chocolate lovers who also like a touch of coffee.
This has to be one of the great inventions single serve coffee brewed so fast and the flavor is great always perfect.

I was going to Bed Bath and Beyond, they quit selling Cafe'Mocha, my nephew said Amazon sells everything so he set me up with you.Thank you for such fantastic service.** A4 **B004APZYVG

I bought this Keurig coffee pack because I was having a hard time finding the Cafe Mocha flavor. This met my needs and more! A multi pack allowed me to have my favorite coffee all the time.
Beware, this has sucralose in it and leaves a chemical after taste.  Mostly tastes like hot cocoa and has no taste of coffee in it, does not seem to have enough caffeine to be of any use.

This is my favorite of all the mocha cafe's. It is rich, smooth and has an incredible taste. Believe me, I have tried them all and I always come back to this one. column9: Get Coffee Shop flavor at home
column10: This mocha coffee is as good as any I have had at Starbucks or Dunkin Donuts at a fraction of the cost.Treat yourself to a special flavored coffee experience at home anytime.  I like to add just a little skim milk to my mug and it is even smoother.  Try it you will like it.

I love Cafe Escapes Cafe Mocha but it seems to sell-out at the stores quicker then they can stock it.  I'm used to buying the 18-Count Packs which is what they sell in the stores and when I ordered these I didn't realize they were 12-Count Packs.  The 18-Count Packs run about $11-$12 per Pack in stores so you're not saving any money here by buying 3 12-Count Packs but on the other hand, they always seem to be out of stock in my local stores so the convenience of being able to order it through Amazon was a plus and delivery was very quick!
The day cannot begin until I have a cup of this with a bit of whipped cream for a Mocha better than anything I can buy at Starbucks.  Cheaper and more convenient, too.
I have enjoyed this product enjoy the smooth chocolate taste.  Came within time frame stated and as described.  I will purchase this again.

I am not a coffee drinker but when I do drink coffee, I like it sweetened. This Cafe Mocha K-cup is a *perfect* blend. It's chocolatey-sweet coffee! And best thing is I don't need to add any sweetener or creamer. It's perfect as it is.Don't buy this if you expect it to be a more bitter coffee taste. This is more like the mocha blends you get at a coffee shop.
This item is a bit watery and needs more chocolate. It works when I mix it with another K-cup.  For 60 calories and the price I would expect a bit more flavor.

love making iced coffee with this in my keurig.. to be honest i haven't had it hot.. but it's FABULOUS and saves me a ton of money from getting an iced mocha at starbucks. definitely keeping these in stock at home!!

My mom loves this coffee/chocolate blend.  It has just the right amount of chocolate and is very smooth.  Mom adds a little cream to lighten and sits back to enjoy!  I usually can find a great price here on Amazon for a 12-pack of three and with Prime, free shipping - a perfect deal.
This product tastes better than at a coffee shop. rich and creamy. use 8oz setting on coffee machine for best results

column9: More like Hot Chocolate with a tiny coffee flavor
column10: I actually love this product, just not by itself.  I make a large coffee, by adding 6oz of a bold coffee Emeril's Big Easy Bold coffee then 8oz of Cafe Mocha.  It is now my favorite Mocha.  I have tried it with Hot chocolate, and it just doesn't do the trick.  For a little extra flavor I add in some Andes chocolate mint pieces to make a Mint Mocha.  It is worth getting up in the morning for.
Despite the name, this is just hot chocolate, not a mix of coffee and chocolate.  Also, unless you use the smallest cup sizes, it is very weak.  Chocolate infused hot water, basically.

A little too sweet for us. However we had no problem swapping it to a friend for some coffee we enjoyed much more. She actually loves the Mocha blend and drinks it frequently.We were glad to have the ability to swap it.Delivery was exceptional as always. Cannot think of a single fault of "Prime Membership".. Thanks Amazon.!!
Would prefer a bit more coffee flavor, and I add some half-n-half for a richer brew.  Great mid-day treat and a low-calorie way to indulge a chocolate craving.

column9: More synthetic than Joan River's face!
column10: I had the opportunity to try out Cafe Escapes' Cafe Mocha k cups when my boyfriend's sister gave us a couple of hers to try.  I was a little wary to begin with because I'd tried the Swiss miss Hot Cocoa K-Cup, Milk Chocolate, 12-Count and remained unconvinced that chocolate flavored powders do well in the Keurig brewing system.  But since this was a chance to try a mixture of both chocolate and coffee, I couldn't turn it down.Unfortunately the final result was much like the Swiss Miss... way too fake!  Almost a plastic-like flavor.  Just awful.  The coffee side of the mizture was either too weak or watery because the mocha just tasted like watered down hot chocolate with a (very) little bit of bite to it.  Nothing to write home about.I'm glad I was able to try a sample of these pods rather than spending money on a box only to be disappointed.  I think a great alternative would be to brew a cup of your favorite blend of coffee and then add in a spoonful of your favorite hot chocolate.  A bit more effort, but the payoff will be leaps and bounds better than this one.This k cup is a pass for me.

If you're expecting rich smooth flavor similar to what you get from a coffee shop you'll be greatly disappointed.  This stuff is basically powdered hot chocolate and instant coffee.  You're better off brewing a pot of Maxwell House and adding some chocolate milk.  I'm extremely disappointed in this stuff.  Maybe I had my hopes set too high.  Yuck!

At first sip this K-cup flavor was not that bad however after that and all I can taste is the sucralose in it and well I really dislike artificial sweeteners.  If you are sensitive to artificial sweeteners I would avoid this product.

column9: It does taste like hot chocolate

I had bought some of this locally and liked it so much that i had to lookk for a better price.  I have found the better price here on amazon.

column9: tastes great my favorite of all flavors
column10: this is my favorite flavors of all the keurig type of coffees. It goes very fast in my home I'll definitely be ordering more.

This is a mixture of half coffee and half hot chocolate and it is delicious.  I often have one in the afternoon for a treat!

column9: Not really as good as you'd expect

We all have different taste its true, and while drinkable this really wasn't close to the coffee shop quality mocha drink I was hoping for, but at less than 50 cents a k-cup I'll drink it and save money.
My wife got this for me as I like mocha coffee.  Problem is, it tastes like hot chocolate with no coffee!
This is now my favorite way to drink coffee! I love it over ice and often mix it with a 'regular' coffee and sit out on the patio and enjoy the morning.
This is fine if you brew it to use for ICED mochas but for Hot ones it taste more like hot chocolate. I wont buy it again.

PRO:  Brew on 6 oz. option on the Keurig machine, excellent texture and taste.  Perfect blend of chocolate and coffee.  CON: The calorie content for 6 oz. is rather high, but the taste is great!  Not Starbucks, but a great alternative!
I love this mocha! With only 30 calories, one can't ask for a better drink, either hot or iced. I brought the box into work to share and they all love it. You can't go wrong with buying this.
Tasty coffee.  I like that it comes in a pack of 3.  Usually better pricing than the stores.

column9: It is alright, depends on your taste
column10: I am not a huge coffee drinker but I need some caffeine every once and a while. This is alright. Sometime I will mix 2 of the small cups together to get a decent size drink. I am a fan of the Cafe Escapes line as they taste very good and don't make a mess while making. column9: Doesn't taste like a mocha on its own....

It also tastes slightly watery and I really can't taste any coffee at all.  I was bummed since this isn't really what I was looking for.Since the chocolate taste was so strong & the coffee taste was so weak, I decided make a mug filled with half Cafe Mocha and half flavored coffee by selecting the small cup size for each.  Tada!  An at home Mocha!  I will continue to buy these so I can mix them with my other coffees.  If you don't mind using two k-cups per drink, they are a good way to go for a tasty at-home mocha.  If mixing this with another cup seems to expensive or like too much trouble, then skip these ones - I would give them only 1 star on their own.

column9: The very best seasoning - incredibly flavorful!

column9: Hard to find, flavorful healthy seasoning

column9: It's okay, but not what I expected
