Great  seasoning - full of flavor without chemicals.  We received the product in a very timely way and are enjoying it on our food

This is the Best Organic Seasoning that I've ever used. In fact we've been using it for about 10 years now. The flavor is perfect with everything from fish, meats, and vegetables and so on! No MSG. Many, many benefits to this product!
This didn't seem to have the flavor that I was accustomed to in the smaller size container.  It is still a good product but just didn't seem as fresh. I have no explanation.

I don't agree too much with my son-in-law but he is right about this Swiss cooking enhancer.  That is the only way to describe this product.  If I had only one flavor product in my cabinet this would be. I do like the red label much better than just the plain herbal green one, but they both have their place in cooking.
And the organic ingredients with the real sea salt can't be beat.  Not very spicy, but a perfect blend.
One of the three containers was open and had spilled over half out all over the package..not pleased..not sure at this time if I will buy this product again..

I love this chili mix.  The flavor is great.  If you make it per the directions, it comes out more like a soup.  I doctor it up.  I add a can of black beans and a can of red or pinto beans, and some extra chili powder. Sometimes I add a can of jalapenos.  I reduce the water by about 1 1/2 cups so I get a thicker chili.  Lastly, I add a pound of cooked ground turkey meat, lean.  I put it all in my crock pot on high for 6 or 7 hours and have a perfect pot of chili for dinner.

The package arrived semi-intact. Some crushing of it but not a lot of lost treats/biscuits. The treats themselves are okay. We're still searching for the right tartar control treats since Nutro changed their formula. All in all there were fine but not ones we'd use on a regular basis.

column9: The best tea on the market
column10: For years tea lovers in the USA have had to resort to importing Dilmah, probably the finest in the world (it revolutionised the domestic tea market in Australia when it was introduced there twenty years ago). Beautifully fresh (vacuum packed for the loose-leaf teas), finest leaf, richly satisfying, fairly traded, among tea connoisseurs Dilmah is more an institution than a regular tea company. By purchasing their products, you will not only be indulging in the ultimate tea-drinker's experience, you'll also be helping a multitude of award-winning non-profit programmes instituted by Dilmah's enlightened management. There should be more products like this. Do yourself a favour and buy some today.

Yes, I can attest to the delightful sipping experience. The green tea is smooth and light. Individual foil packs keep the tea fresh. The price is right. Perhaps, the best green tea I ever sipped. I will be ordering more.

I first started drinking this when I lived in Egypt (it's hard to find in America--at least in Colorado), and it really is wonderful. It's smooth and light, and has a beautiful amber color. I pretty much drank it daily (throughout the day) for two years. Now I'm in Mauritania and it's not available, so I'm going to have to ship some over from somewhere.  Note, I only drank the green tea (I can't testify to the black).

I agree completely with the previous rave review for this fabulous tea! I discovered Dilmah tea while in Europe last winter and returned to the states with several boxes. Once I ran out I contacted the company and they have thoughtfully kept in touch with me. Just moments ago I received an e-mail from them letting me know that I could now purchase Dilmah at Amazon.com. Now, moments later, here I am! Join me and treat yourself to this delicious tea - you will be so happy you did! (BTW, the Dilmah company customer service is as personable and wonderful as the tea is grand!) ~ENJOY~

I am so disappointed!  After reading the great reviews I decided to order this tea.  I was so excited when it arrived and immediately brewed myself a cup.  It had NO flavor!  It was like drinking warm water.  I find it hard to believe that we are even talking about the same tea here.  Adding a bit of honey did give it some taste, of honey.  What was I doing wrong?  Correct temp, correct brewing time, but no taste.  To give you an idea of my tastes, here are some teas that I purchased here that I enjoy.  I really like Guayaki Greener Green Tea Blend, Tea Bags, 16-Count Packages (Pack of 6)I am getting low on that and purchased this Dilmah tea as a replacement due to a better price.  Big mistake.  The greener green is really delicious and flavorful. My favorite. I also enjoy Davidson's Tea Bulk, Gunpowder Green, 16-Ounce Bag and Davidson's Tea Bulk, Organic South African Rooibos, 16-Ounce Bag.  That is a great bedtime tea.  And I enjoy Stash Premium Fusion Green & White Tea, Tea Bags, 18-Count Boxes (Pack of 6) and Stash Premium Decaf Premium Green Tea, Tea Bags, 18-Count Boxes (Pack of 6).  All great. I also have purchasedDavidson's Tea Bulk, Silver Needles, 16-Ounce Bag, and have found that to be kind of on the weak side.  In an attempt to get some flavor in my cup of Dilmah tea I tried brewing 2 teabags.  That resulted in some flavor, but not much. I get much more flavor from a second brewing of my gunpowder tea leaves. I feel bad giving this only 1 star, but it is easily the worse tea I ever tasted.  A total waste or money.  What am I doing wrong?

This tea is terrific. I have to say usually I need to add sugar to tea to make it taste better but just this tea itself is awesome. The tea is light and flavorful. I don't think there's really anything else to say...but I will definitly be purchasing more!!

My wife and I are devoted green tea drinkers.  We discovered Dilmah Tea at a resort in Mexico.  Could not find it locally, so ordered it on Amazon.  It has the best body and flavor of any tea we have tried.  The company's founder is devoted to both the ecology and community of workers in Ceylon.  It is worth visiting their web site to learn more. (No, I do not work for them!)  Have yet to try their other teas, but will probably do so.Dr. Bill Edwards

column9: IMHO - The Best Commercially Available Tea
column10: The best teas are from Sri Lanka (Ceylon).  The best commercially available Ceylon tea is Dilmah.  The black tea has deep flavor and a smooth finish.  The green tea is surprisingly flavorful yet delicate.  You will not be disappointed.

Bought a box of Neuhaus sommelier collection chocolates for a special occasion on a trip through Brussels Duty Free.  When I opened the box I discovered that there were two empty spots in the box!  My husband and I tried two different types of the remaining 14 and were terribly dissappointed in the taste of the chocolate as well.  If you want to purchase chocolates try Godiva!

I'm wondering what size the previous commenter wears. I am a small, and all other small gloves fit fine. These fit well also, once I pull them on. It's the getting them on and off that is difficult. They have a "waist" about at the wrist - both the small and medium (which would have been too large in the fingers) are very tight, and the lining isn't quite slippery enough to offset that. They are so hard to get on and off that I gave up wearing them long before they could wear out.Too bad, since they're a better option than the "name brand", which last a month at best.

Purchased at Whole Foods because brand was labeled as "Environment Friendly Products", from "Fair Trade Rubber", and was a beautiful shade of apple green. Despite my hand width falling WELL WITHIN the Medium size on the package's chart, could not get Medium size glove on passed the knuckles, Also,these "cotton flock lined" gloves made hand feel "gritty".  Back to the store they go. I will not exchange them for a larger size as I do not wish to encourage a company which does not properly size its products.

I'll continue to buy these, they work and love that I can feel good about buying them! A few things to expect on how they differ from regular kitchen gloves:-I feel like they don't block temperature as well, granted my hot water is scalding and steamy but I can feel it a lot more in these gloves.-Like other reviews said the wrists start to curl upOtherwise they've been great I didn't think they'd hold up for as many uses as they have.

column9: Hard to put on, cuff falls over
column10: I was really wanting to like these eco-friendly gloves. They do fit comfortably while they are on and give me a good grip. They are a better fit than the (loose) yellow Safeway brand gloves. Unfortunately, they are so hard to put on. The wrist area is tight, so you have to do a bit of pulling to get it on. And although you get 3 inches of arm coverage, because the rubber is thin, the cuff will fall/fold over if you are doing scrubbing or a lot of movement. At this point, water will easily pour into the glove. It does not compare with my favorite - Playtex Living with Drip-catch cuff, which is thicker and has 5 inches of arm coverage that never falls over. But I suppose if you're not scrubbing or if you can avoid too much movement, they should be ok for use.

These gloves last three times longer than the latex gloves currently selling in the grocery stores.  They may cost slightly more than the store brands but they are well worth the extra money due to their longer life.  The best part is they biodegrade so they are also better for the environment!

These gloves deteriorate in about a month, much like other dish gloves I've tried.  The right pointer finger gets pinholes that let in moisture, and I'm left with many orphaned left hand gloves.  At least these are made from renewable and biodegradable material!I'm going to try a larger size to see if I can recycle the left hand gloves by turning them inside out and wearing them on my right hand...

I really love the fact the gloves and the packaging are environmentally friendly and FSC certified.I love these gloves for chores! I have to use gloves for dish washing due to really dry hands and I have had a problem finding gloves that last. I hated using environmentally unfriendly gloves that lasted maybe a couple of weeks or so. Typically other gloves I have tried developed a hole in them within a couple of weeks or so and then had to be thrown in the trash. I am still on the first pair out of the 6 I picked up from Amazon, so far 3 months and going. I have never had a pair of gloves last this long!These gloves do a very good job at staying on and not trying to slip off as I have had problems with other gloves doing. Also because of the way they fit I have not had a problem with water getting in these. (Unless of course I accidentally get the opening right under the faucet while it is running or submerge the glove)I wear a medium and found these medium sized gloves fit well. I believe that they are designed to fit closely on your hands so that they do not slip while using them, so if mediums are typically a little on the tight side trying a large might be better.As someone commented they do have a "waist" approximately at the wrist, which actually I really, really like. I found they take a couple of more seconds more to get on and off, but they are well worth it.Some stores sell these individually so picking up a single pair to try for size and then purchasing another pack of 6 here might work better.I have also bought other items made by If You Care and so far have been equally pleased. These are well made gloves that I will continue to purchase and hopefully they never discontinue them!

This is a solid product.  They are strong and roomy. I have plenty of room inside the gloves for circulation. I have been using them for a few months and have not experienced the doom of a leak.The greatest aspect of this product is that it provides a direct income for the individuals that make the gloves.Made in Sri Lanka

These bully sticks aren't as fat as previous ones that I've purchased. Our medium-sized dog chews through one in about five minutes. They don't provide much benefit as a dentifrice, but they are good for a doggy dance and a few tricks.

If you are a guava jelly fan, this is by far the best brand.  I had a lot of trouble finding it in stores, so thank goodness Amazon has it. I spend a lot of time in Hawaii and have tried many other brands of guava jelly, none of which compare to the Goya.  It is worth the effort of ordering it online.  It came safely wrapped against breakage.
My being a Florida native, I KNOW Guava Jelly.  The contents of the jar is jelly, but without the label, I would not know it to be Guava Jelly.

column4: E. Hamilton "CLT Gal in God's Country"
column10: I used to purchase the Goya brand Guava Jelly at my local supermarket but they stopped carrying the Guava a while back.  When I finally used up the last of what I had in the pantry I checked Amazon.com and sure enough, located this 3-pack.Arrived with no issue -- perfect toast and jelly!

i love this tea. i had bought the loose leaf chai prior to this, which was also delicious, but i wanted a nice light green tea. wish it came in a loose leaf option, but the tea pyramid bags are easy to use and taste just as good as loose leaf.

Sushi at home?Branch out from just fish!These japanese prepared vegetables (zuke) add an authentic touch to homemade sushi. Great miso-like flavor and a fun crunch. Million times better than cucumber and lots easier to get than ika (squid) if you like a bit of crunch in your sushi.

I recently went to our local (Del Mar) fair, in July, and purchased my first tin of this award winning product for the first time, and all I could say is, "WOW! This is the what cinnamon should taste like." I took a very 'small' sample on my finger, and tasted it right from the can - it has a wonderful and naturally 'sweet' taste to it!WATKINS uses only the finest cinnamon bark with the highest oil content and then processes it to a consistently fine powder. Their premium grade sweet 'korintje' cinnamon has an intense aroma and is MUCH MORE flavorful than the ceylon cinnamon (generally sold in supermarkets). This 2 ounce tin is a nice 'sampler' size, if you have never tried it before.This stuff is GREAT for baking desserts (i.e. cinnamon rolls, apple pies), and is a wonderful flavoring in gourmet or home cooked dishes, such as beef stews, chili's etc.WATKINS has enjoyed a stellar reputation (since 1868, when it first made it's debut), and for good cause:Watkins possible has the finest cinnamon product sold on the open market, and worth every penny!Highly recommended.PRODUCT DESCRIPTIONWatkins CinnamonWeight: 2 Ounces

column9: This low-carb follower can now enjoy the classic American condiment again
column10: Just received this in the mail from Amazon (actually, it was sent directly from retailer CarbSmart).  Simply put, Heinz's reduced sugar & reduced carb ketchup tastes just like regular Heinz ketchup, making me wonder why Heinz doesn't make all its ketchup this way.  Anyway, this controlled-carb enthusiast is now regularly enjoying ketchup on his (alas, still mostly bunless) burger patties again; just using mustard was getting a little tiring.  While some low-carb versions of previously favorite foods take some getting used to, this one doesn't, so don't hesitate to order this product.  The price isn't all that bad, either.

column9: Available at Wal-Mart supercenters for under 3 dollars
column10: This product is great for diabetics (like me), but be aware that you can probably buy it at your local Wal-Mart Supercenter for around $2.40. I've found it at every Oregon Supercenter I've been to.
Tastes great!  Can't tell the difference from regular ketchup.  Doesn't taste like a low-carb product at all!

column9: Tastes like the Original - but low carb!
column10: I'm currently on a high protein, low carb diet (Ideal Protein Diet).  Carbs were restricted, but as I'm allowed to work them back into my diet, this is one condiment that is allowed (One Carb Heinz).  Before now, I tried the Walden Farms ketchup and that was pretty bad - but this Heinz tastes just like their regular ketchup only it's low carb, reduced sugar - so it's less bad for you.  I will say that this item is available in most Walmart stores for $2.88 per bottle, which sure beats having to buy in bulk OR having to pay for shipping.  So if you choose to try this product, I suggest getting it at Walmart.

This is the best reduced sugar ketchup I have tried. I've tried several reduced or no calorie ketchup and most of them are to thin and not enough flavor. This one if side by side to a regular ketchup you couldn't tell the difference. It's that good.

column9: Amazing, all ketchup should be like this!
column10: There is only one reason all ketchup isn't made with no added sugar like this...money.  It's much cheaper for the manufacturer to use high fructose corn syrup instead of tomatoes.  This ketchup tastes fresher and overall better than "normal" ketchup.  I tested it on a variety of friends and they all agree that this ketchup is better than the usual ketchup by far, plus you're not putting extra sugar in  your system needlessly.

column9: Great for People on a Low Carb Diet
column10: Taste's pretty good for being low carb however, it is a bit pricey by the time you add shipping fees to it. Overall taste is very good.
This product is even better than the original ketchup. The tomato taste is far more intense than the original though. I will be ordering more in the future.

This is one of those rare products that exceed even the original version. You would never know that this was the reduced sugar variety if you already did not know it. Absolutely amazing and it helps me reduce my sugar intake because I'm a Ketchup fanatic and I eat a lot of the stuff. 5 big stars for the product.I was hoping to find this by the case at Amazon to maybe save a bit of money over the grocery store, but alas, there is (at the time of this writing) only one '3rd party vendor' selling this on Amazon...(CarbSmart - Low Carb, Sugar Free, & Diabetic Market)...unfortunately they are selling the product for nearly three times the amount I pay at my local grocery store for each 14 oz. bottle, and on top of that, they are charging nearly $6 to ship EACH ONE! INSANE ! -5 stars for this vendor.But this is a totally awesome product. Try it and you will never use the super-high corn-syrupy version again.

column9: Buy it at the store for 2.50
column10: I love this Ketchup.. but it is available in most grocery stores for about 2.50... to bad it only comes in this small size package.. but its great..love it..
I thought this was really good. I couldn't tell it from the regular ketchup and either could my picky " I hate tomatoes but I love ketchup " kid.

You might say its only ketchup but its not.  It is so hard to find a lower calorie ketchup and I just cant enjoy a lot of foods without it so thank you for the great flavor and for making this available.I can not find this in any store around my area.

Seriously, this is the best "low sugar" ketchup on the market! It tastes JUST LIKE THE ORIGINAL except this is so much tastier due to the fact that there is no high fructose corn syrup in the mix! I cannot wait until heinz jumps on the "stevia" band wagon and makes a ketchup with that sweetener instead of splenda... but for now, I am set!I am so obsessed, I made a video about it! [...]
Just to reiterate what the others are saying, this ketchup is really good. I too am wondering why all ketchup isn't just made this way when it tastes this good. Try it and you won't be disappointed.

This is a great tasting lower sugar, lower carb ketchup, no difference in taste in my opinion, even my children enjoy it (of course they don't know its better for them).  I only wish the price was lower.

We use this ketchup all the time at our house in order to cut down on sugar.  It tastes just like the regular ketchup to us.  The bottle with the wide head is handy, because you can easily store it upside down.  That makes it easier to squirt out the remaining ketchup.
I HAVE ALREADY WRITTEN HEINZ AND TOLD THEM I LOVE THIS STUFF. AS A DIABETIC WE NEED MORE PRODUCTS LIKE THIS.

column9: Amazing! Great for low carb diets!
column10: Tastes Great - Less Filling!  Seriously, the ketchup is excellent!  Buy with confidence.

My fiance & I purchased this from a local retailer to add to our low-carb lifestyle.  We both agree that it tastes like regular ketchup.  Finally!  Something I don't have to sacrifice!  Also, because there is less sugar, it isn't so hard to rinse off of our dishes.  Another plus!  We definitely recommend!
I bought this ketchup because I was on atkins and wanted no carbs for a couple weeks. This ketchup has less carbs than the original and taste, in my opinion, the same. I would recommend it.

column9: Love it, especially when on Atkins or any Low Carb and Low Sugar diet
column10: This Ketchup tastes great, it really does!  You can't tell the difference between this and regular ketchup, and the benefit is that there's only 1 carb per serving and much fewer calories too.  This is great stuff and I am really happy with how great it tastes.  Going Low Carb can be difficult with no condiments, this really helps.  This tastes so good that we've stopped buying regular ketchup and keep this in the fridge now instead since the kids can't tell the difference anyway.This is an item that might be available locally at your big box retailers, if so you can probably find it for less there.  I know it's available in the stores around here.5 stars, great product and great tasting.

column9: You can tell by the taste that it has sweetener in it.
column10: I grabbed this off a shelf at a grocery store when I was in a hurry to get back to my place and put a meatloaf in the oven. I have been trying to eat better and one major was is to reduce my sugar intake. I never drink diet sodas, and I avoid sweeteners at all times because I dislike the taste.I naively thought that "Reduced Sugar" meant just that - they put less sugar in it. But there is more to it than that; they should call it, "Reduced Sugar, but Increased Sweetener". Sucralose is listed on the ingredients. So, a more fitting name for this is really "Diet Ketchup".I was in a hurry and did not read the ingredients in the store. So yes, purchasing this item when I know I can't stand sweetener flavor was my fault. But I still feel justified in the low review because of the actual taste of the ketchup. NOT KNOWING that it had had any artificial sweeteners, I could tell from the first bite of my favorite meatloaf recipe that sweeteners had somehow made it into my meal! There is not that much ketchup sauce on the loaf and I could still taste it - I am pretty sure I am going to follow the course of the other negative reviewer and buy a new bottle of "regular" ketchup.If you don't mind sucralose, then maybe this is a great option for you.

This is a fantastic product that I buy whenever I buy ketchup.  Maybe it is not as sweet as regular ketchup, and I'm not a huge ketchup lover, and part of that has always been that disgusting moment when you bite into something and realized it's basically got corn syrup on it.  Old ketchup used to have enough sugar in it to balance the acidity and saltiness, but since the advent of corn syrup, it just seemed to me like you could dip your fries in Karo syrup.  (Sorry for the rant, :)  Anyway, while low carb dieting, I discovered that there were lots of meats to eat, but sometimes it is a drag to eat a plain burger or steak.  What really motivated me was when I made a pork roast into pulled pork and realized you can't make it into really barbeque because that would totally blow your carbs when you add sauce.  So, I found this ketchup and created my own barbecue and steak sauce which basically involves using this product mixed with other ingredients including Liquid Smoke.  Viola!  An ultra-low carb BBQ/steak sauce.Granted the price fluctuates wildly here on Amazon, depending on the seller and the shipping costs. As other reviewers have mentioned, it is widely available at the big bad box store we all love to hate, and thank goodness for it.  I had just had to give a shout out this product, and the Heinz folks, because this fills a need, however you get it to your house!

column9: Great stuff  - my 7 year old son loves it!
column10: My son prefers this to the original ketchup, which is too sweet.He prefers it to any other condiment, especially with fish, fries, and chicken.  "Best sauce in the world", he says.

column9: Taste exactly like Heinz regular ketchup to me!
column10: It will taste like regular ketchup to most people.  To those who have a severe aftertaste to splenda (sucralose), it will probably not taste like regular ketchup.  The product is sweetened with sucralose, which for me and my family, is fine.  If you are one of those people who have a severe aftertaste with sucralose, I'll bet you have a different experience than most of the people writing these reviews.

I must have ketchup with my scrambled eggs in the morning, but I wanted something that was low in sugar/carbs and had no HFCS. I tried some organic ketchups, but they didn't taste as good and were more expensive. Then I found this. Amazing! Tastes just like the original so much its scary. And you wonder why Heinz is pretty much the only ketchup brand in America? They just own too hard.My only gripe is it doesn't come in that huge Costco value-sized container like the original, but I guess its because it isn't as popular -- yet.

column4: C. Jackson "A mom and loving it!"
column10: I love this stuff. I can tell the difference but barely. The reduced sugar has a little tiny bit of spiciness to it. I'm very sensitive to anything spicy as it makes me sweat. LOL! This makes me sweat after a while. It's so yummy, though. Both my husband and I love it. Wish it were cheaper and came in bigger bottles.

No appreciable difference from any other ketchup you would find on the store shelf. This is ketchup in all its glory.I will echo others.. I do not get why this is not the heinz standard ketchup. Why add something completely unnecessary to ketchup to sell it to people.

column4: Denise Every "Act as if what you do makes a d...
column10: Excellent flavor, I truly could not tell the difference between this and regular Heinz ketchup.

I've always used a lot of ketchup with my food. This is a great way to cut some of the calories off. This has only 5 calories per tablespoon, while regular Heinz ketchup has 15 calories per tablespoon. And honestly? I can't taste the difference!

I try and follow a low carb diet and I love ketchup. This is a perfect product for me. Heinz One Carb Ketchup tastes, to me, the same as Heinz' regular ketchup. (I just wish it was widely available in local stores.) Sure, the small size of the bottle makes this a spendy proposition, but then it really is the only way to go for that "real" ketchup taste. I adjust by using less ketchup than I would have in the past, and purchase it in bulk to minimize shipping costs. I have been drawing down a case for nearly a year now, and have a few bottles left. Like all ketchup, it stores well. I wholeheartedly recommend this for anyone who wants/needs to eat low carb and desires to continue using ketchup as a condiment.

column9: Deceptive labeling -- shame on you Heinz
column10: As other reviewers have stated, this "Reduced Sugar" ketchup contains sucralose.  Why they don't state this plainly on the bottle I have no idea.  I would not have purchased this product if I knew it contained sucralose as I don't want my kids eating that junk.  On the back of the bottle they have a clever little note that sucralose is not found "in normal ketchup".  That's for sure.  It's really wrong that they did it this way and frankly there was no reason -- what they thought we'd never notice??  It lowers my opinion of Heinz which I always thought was an honest company, guess I was wrong?  Oh and did I mention, the ketchup tastes disgusting?  Sucralose may be low calorie but it is way, way too sweet. Stick with the original version you can't go wrong.Anyway I think I'm going to try Annie's or another brand of organic ketchup, with fewer calories than Heinz, and see how my kids like it.

column9: They dont mention the Gobs of Artificial Sweetner.
column10: Like being misled much? If they are willing to mislead you from the start, what else are they doing that they arent telling you about?The front of the bottle says "reduced sugar"The promotional literature says "This Ketchup recipe has 75 percent less sugar than our classic Ketchup, but 100 percent of that rich tomato flavor. Just like all Heinz® Ketchup varieties, it contains no artificial colors, flavors or preservatives."Notice something?? They dont mention that they replace sugar with sucralose; a chlorinated sweetener (chlorine has a byproduct dioxin which the EPA found to be 300,000 times as carcinogenic as the pesticide DDT.-mercola)When i wrote Heinz to suggest they print "artificially sweetened" below their massive 'reduced sugar banner' their response to me was search for the fine print on the back of the bottle. Does that sound forthright to you? Does that sound like they are trying to keep the customer fully informed? Kind of a shady practice and a shady response from the company.

We bought this as a low carb substitute for the 17-Day Diet program. My wife and I could not believe how genuinely terrible this stuff tastes when compared to regular Heinz Ketchup. We either had to forego ketchup altogether or just cheat on the diet with regular Heinz. We chose the latter and lost weight on the program anyway. We had absolutely no hesitation in dumping this product right in the garbage.

Sure, we're all too busy to make our own ketchup (with Stevia, a healthy sweetener with no carb or glycemic load), but it would be much better to try to do so especially if you're feeding kids too. For those needing low carb, low or no sugar, watch out for the ingredients "sucralose" or "splenda" (and of course most already know about the harmful effects of aspartame, saccharine and "Equal"). Don't believe me? Do your own web search to find out more. A great site is the EWG, Environmental Working Group, a non-profit group which tests many products for toxicity levels. Also check out [...].If you think it's all hogwash or not so important, oh well, I tried to warn ya!
I ordered these for my son's penguin themed birthday party and they were a hit!  They were soft and fresh.  The peach flavor was GREAT!

Yes, it's the real thing! This is the genuine UK-made Lea & Perrins, and it tastes so much better than what we buy at supermarkets in America.  Most people don't realize it's a totally different recipe, with a rich, smooth flavor that complements even the most delicate foods, meats and seafood.Grab a bottle of your USA-made L&P and compare the ingredients to these of the real UK-made product: Malt Vinegar (from Barley), Spirit Vinegar, Molasses, Sugar, Salt, Anchovies (Fish), Tamarind Extract, Onions, Garlic, Spice, Flavouring.Notice there is no high-fructose corn syrup!Once I tasted this, I just couldn't buy the American version ever again. The shipping cost listed above blows me away, but the product is superb. If you can get this product from whatever source, you'll love it.

column9: good, even better when warmed up
column10: These are great-tasting snack bars, and are even better when you warm them up (remove from wrapper, microwave for 10-15 seconds), which makes them much softer and smoother, like a treat that just came out of the oven. They have lots of fiber and protein and nutrients, and plant sterols that lower cholesterol.

I am trying to watch what I eat, so for breakfast I have a Corazonas Oatmeal bar with my coffee and I am satisfied until lunch.  I love the oatmeal, the banana walnut and cranberry flax bars. I have tried other breakfast bars but they were just not as hearty and filling as the Corazonas bars. Corazonas  has a "just right" taste and texture I love.

I bought these as a healthier substitute for the breakfast bars that I usually have in the morning.  The label drew me in, with just the right amount of fiber/fat/sugar for a good start.  The bonus was that, when I tried them, they were delicious.  Also got the cranberry flax squares and they were amazing as well. Highly recommend.

I love these Peanut Butter Oatmeal Squares and I crave them for breakfast almost every morning.  They are also a delicious and portable snack for later in the day.  I was alarmed the last time I tried to order and saw they were in short supply.  I hope Corazona doesn't discontinue this flavor, since I think it's the best one!

I love the Corazonas  Peanut Butter AND Banana Walnut oatmeal bars.  They are nutrious and they have an excellent taste.  I take the bars (one a day) to work and have it with fruit for my lunch.  They are also an excellent source of fiber which is a plus. I have recommended these bars to a friend at work and her son went online and ordered them from Amazon plus other bar flavors as well.

column9: Pass on this Peanut Butter Treat
column10: I love the Cranberry Flax version of these, but thought this one was not very flavorful and a little dry. It needs something added to it; banana, date, or chocolate on top?

i got these initially at costco. have not been able to find them there so went on amazon. i think they are delicious and easy to take when on the run or to work. they also have a chocolate chip flavor but i like this better. wish they weren't so high in calories but maybe that is why they are so tasty!

Wasn't crazy about the Corazonas Oatmeal Squares, Peanut Butter Bar!  It tastes okay, but quite dense.  I will not buy this item again.  A friend of mine tried one and she liked it, but also wasn't crazy about it.

Saw these featured on Hungry Girl and decided to order them for my office snack drawer. The bars have a decent amount of fiber and protein compared to others that contain mostly sugar.They taste delicious. Not too sweet, not too sticky, not too chewy. The peanut butter flavor is not overwhelming. I like these better than my old favorite snack bars(Quaker's crunchy granola bars) and way better than a protein bar taste-wise.Although they are not too sweet I imagine kids will also love them.
These make a quick filling breakfast when I go to the gym and then straight to work. I like them, but don't love them.

I am not a fan of breakfast. Never have been, probably never will be. But I have started new medications that must be taken in the morning and must not be taken on an empty stomach. So I shopped around and after a few poor choices, stumbled across these Oatmeal Squares. Now I love the taste of raw oatmmeal and I have never met a peanut anything that I did not love so I decided to give these little treats a try. What a wonderful surprise! These squares are soft and chewy, not overly sweet, I believe they are sweetened with brown rice syrup, date puree and cane syrup so the sweetness is not overpowering. I don't heat them up or anything, just open the wrapper and enjoy. As for the complaint about not tasting peanut butter, I was a bit surprised that there is not a pronounced peanut butter flavor but there is a peanut flavor. And when I thought about it, if there had been a more pronounced peanut butter flavor it would mean that there would be more fat so I guess peanut flavor is probably better for me than peanut butter flavor. I also love the Oatmeal Chocolate Chip variety of these squares. These bars run @$1.30 each but I added them to my Subscribe and Save account and lowered the price by @ 20 cents each.
VERY VERY DISAPPOINTED WITH THIS PRODUCT. I DID NOT TASTE A HINT OF PEANUT BUTTER.I FELT I WAS MISLED. I HAD NO IDEA.

These oatmeal squares grew on me, but still don't thrill me.The first one I ate as a treat but I did not finish because I didn't enjoy the taste.  The 2nd one I ate out of desperate hunger while cooking dinner and it was pretty good.  I guess these should be eaten as filling bars, rather than desserts.  They certainly satisfy hunger - they are dense and heavy.Because there are still a few sitting on my shelf a month or so later, I guess I really didn't grow to like them as much as I'd hoped.  I guess I was secretly hoping for a more sugary, peanut-butter taste.After saying all that, I would definitely recommend this product for the pure peanut butter lovers.

I was really looking forward to getting these because I am a complete, over-the-top fan of all the fabulous Corazonas chips.  Unfortunately, I found these squares to have a slightly odd flavor undertone.  After mulling it over, I decided it was a tiny bit reminiscent of the cod liver oil my mom foisted on my when I was a kid.  If it weren't for that odd flavor, I would like these just fine.  Maybe they can tweak the recipe.  Then I would buy them.  Sorry, Corazonas, but I had to tell the truth.
This coffee tasted disgusting and a bit like licorice.  I was very disappointed as I have had delicious banana nut coffees before.  Shame it was a two pack.  Waste of money!

This coffee is quite flavourful, but you can taste the nut flavour more than the banana. I found this a bit dissapointing. As well, I like my coffee weak, but find I need to add more than my usual amount to get the strength I like.

I liked the taste of melon syrup in my Green Tea Latte's. Many people said that it ruined the taste, but I think not.  My only gripe was the $10+ dollar shipping fee. I didn't see that until I placed the order. So, be aware that $9 bottle of syrup will cost you $20+ when it arrives. However, it was shipped very well.

column9: Tried them all & no need to freeze
column10: I have tried every brand of so-called "homemade noodles" over the past 10 years.  My wife made noodles for years with her great grandmother's recipe.  Now we travel(for 10 years) full-time in our motor home and it is not as easy to hand make them.  The Buggy brand is within an eyelash of what her family made for generations.  I have tried the "Amish Type" and other knock-off brands and they are little better than store bought.  These are the real thing and well worth the price.  We buy in the 10 lb. package and then re-pack in well-sealed baggies.  NO NEED TO FREEZE.  Actually, they will keep up to a year 'on the shelf' if you repackage well.  Call the people at "Buggy Brand" in Illinois and they will also tell you this.  Nice folks.
THIS PASTA WAS GREAT. I REALLY LIKED THE WIDER ONE. IT IS VERY HEALTHY AND IT COOKS GREAT.

This is a great product, healthy, low sodium, great taste... from the only manufacturer in the US which does not use cans lined with a Bisphenol A epoxy.None of the other "Organic" suppliers bother to use packaging without BPATry their garbanzo beans and black beans as well!

Butter beans look like lima beans, but are sweeter and avoid the slime factor of canned limas. These beans are the best I have ever found--they are firm and well-cleaned, ready for use. I have an old Shaker recipe for a butter-bean-potato salad: I use a can of these beans, some boiled and diced red potatoes, and the corn cut from a fresh ear of corn. The dressing is mayonnaise, a little olive oil, and lemon juice, with salt and pepper. Eden makes it possible to do this recipe at any time with these hard-to-find beans. They're great!

A word of warning: These are NOT the large, rich, and tasty Habas Grandes that Goya, for instance, calls Butter Beans.These are small Petit Lima Beans with very little flavor. The texture is on the mushy side as well.On the plus side, they mash more easily than a lot of beans if you want to use them to provide the body and bulk for patties or dumplings where spicing and other ingredients provide the flavor. That is the best use I have found for them.Bottom line: I won't have any problems finishing the case I bought, but doubt I will buy these again.

column9: Exactly what I was looking for
column10: I've gotten to try similar twists from a well known food retailer that we don't have in the Houston area.  Thank goodness I found these online -- they're exactly the same, and what an awesome price!Very light and crispy -- and a perfect snack at 30 calories each, with no sodium or cholesterol!

column9: One of the best snacks ever made!!!!!!
column10: I found these in bags in the supermarket and fell in love with them.  They are healthy and delicious!  Only problem with the boxed ones is they are smaller and harder than the ones you buy in the market.  Buying them in bulk saves as much as a $1.20 per box but the taste isn't as good.  So, I've gone back to buying them in the store.  Only other suggestion could be that they might be just as good with slightly less sugar even though the sugar content is low. All that aside, I've gotten about 20 people addicted to them as I am.  One of the best tasting products on the market and HEALTHY.Barry's Bakery French Twist, Original, 4.5-Ounce Box (Pack of 12)
An excellent choice when you want a sweet treat that is low in sugar. These light crispy little twists fit well into a low sugar plan and are great with hot or iced tea, too!
These french twists taste so good that it's hard to believe they're not unhealthy!  I love them - they fit into any diet plan and taste sweet, despite not having excessive amounts of sugar.

The quality of the Twist was its usual good quality, but they would have survived the transport much better had they been in the plastic tubs, as advertised and as we have been used to getting them while they were still available locally.  The other plus for the plastic container is its value as a container after the Twists are gone.

I thought I was ordering 12 boxes of the larger twists, which come individually wrapped and are 60 calories each.  However, I received 12 boxes each containing a bag filled with small 30-calorie twists.  They are indeed delicious!  I agree with other posts that these are so good it's hard to stop without eating the whole bag, so I probably won't order again as this presents too much of a temptation!  But yes they are very, very good!(It would be nice if these were offered in lots of 6, instead of 12, then different flavors could be tried without having to order so many.)

OMG THEY ARE DELICIOUS, ITS LIKE FILO DOUGH WITH A CINNAMON TASTE, THEY SHIPPED IT SO QUICKLY, BEFORE I KNEW IT, IT WAS AT MY DOOR, WELL WORTH THE MONEY, IT AVERAGES OUT TO AROUND $1.25 A BOX, WHAT A STEAL
I really like these, but the rest of my family won't eat them.  If you like cinnamon and flaky pastry, you'll like these (or not, cause my family likes cinnamon but won't try these).
I purchased the rasberry flavor as well as this and they are both good.  Used them while on weight watchers.

So I ordered these after trying them from a single 4.5 oz package from my local grocer and yeah...I find the only way I can actually stop eating these is when I have no more of them to eat! Seriously though, you're going to get addicted if you're into cinnamon flavored pastries! ENJOY! :)

column9: You'd Never Know These Are "Better For You"
column10: I purchased a tub of Barry's Original French Twists from Boney's Marketplace yesterday. I was craving something sweet, but didn't want to blow my diet completely with a typical pastry or cookies from the bakery. My husband and I decided to try Barry's French Twists in the Original flavor. We were both pleasantly surprised! We, along with our 18 month old, polished off the entire tub on the drive home. These are simply devine!

i have been enjoying these delicious and healthy Barry's Bakery French Twists for a number of years.I was able to, once upon a time, purchase this product in Walgreen's, until they suddenly stopped stocking/selling them.  I was so disappointed, and then I found them here on AMAZON.com for a very reasonable price.They are so yummy.  My favorite flavors are the original and the raspberry.Enjoy a few Barry's Bakery French Twists, when you need/want a light snack that is sweetly satisfying.And,,,,,,,they are great for those who, like me, enjoy dunking their edibles in some tea or coffee, even hot cocoa.something yummy, healthy, and without the guilt...

I am absolutely addicted to these pastries!  I was so upset when I could no longer buy them at our local grocery store.  I was having to drive an hour to buy them until I discovered them on Amazon!  They're less expensive on Amazon but you have to buy a larger quantity than you would normally buy at the grocery store.  It doesn't matter because they seem to stay fresh.  I am a Weight Watcher's member and these work out great for a quick low-cal breakfast.

I really have not much to add to all the other reviews.  The original flavor are my favorite.  They are so addictive I can polish off a box in one setting. Which reminds me, these are packaged in boxes, not tubs as described. These are much cheaper thru Amazon.  I pay $3 at the local store and they are sold in the paper sleeve.  I like the box because they protect the contents.  My order thru Amazon arrives in better condition than the store bought.  I have ordered direct from the company and with postage they are very expensive; but available in tubs if that is your preference. Be sure to close a partial package securely because they quickly pick up moisture and lose their crispness and become chewy. I hope these will continue to be available.

These are just wonderful. Being a vegan, there aren't a lot of good pastries around, and these are great. They're as close to the diary made equivalent (palm ears/elephant ears) as you can get. They're really crispy and full of flavor. The only problems is they taste so good, you'll eat the whole box at one sitting!  We've had the original, California Amond and Raspberry flavors, and can't wait to taste the others.

The cupcakes are good, but be aware it is not 4 pounds as it is described in the shipping weight. It is a tiny box that makes 6 regular size cupcakes OR 12 tiny cupcakes...I squeezed 7 cupcakes out of it. It is not worth the $4.94 I paid and you would be crazy to pay the $14. regular price. I would never buy this again. The box says 6 ounces cake mix and 1 ounce frosting mix to a total of 7 ounces. Where they got the 4 pound shipping weight I can not figure out. I did not find a brick in the box, but it came in huge cardboard box.

column9: A Top of the Line Food
column10: Some dog owners may find it strange to feed their dog(s) a fish based formula, but I learned years ago that dogs can enjoy eating fish and can thrive on a diet of kibble with fish as the main protein source. Our bichon had been suffering from skin allergies, and a helpul employee at our local pet store suggested a fish based Wellness formula. Within a few weeks Evie's skin problems improved dramatically.The by Nature kibble is less expensive than the Wellness, but is a premium food too in its own right. The protein sources are salmon and ocean fish, and the included grains are: ground barley, ground oats, ground brown rice. Also included in the many wholesome ingredients is one of my favorites - SWEET POTATOES.We like the small size of the kibble, perfect for our petite-mouthed shih tzu and bolognese girls.The maker guarantees satisfaction or your money back, and the food is made in the USA.By Nature dry dog food is formulated to meet the nutritional levels established by the AAFCO  Association of American Feed Control Officials) dog food nutrient profiles for all life stages.

column9: Excellent Salmon and Sweet Potato Dog food; my dog really likes it.
column10: My dog really likes this by Nature Salmon dog food. The dog food is in small pellets; easy for a big or small dog to eat. I like the ingredients from the salmon and other ocean fish to herring (fish) oil, alfalfa, flaxseed, fruit and vegetables as well as with minerals and vitamins (no corn or soy too.)  It is a high quality food that my dog gets excited about. He also likes Nature's Domain (also salmon and sweet potato.) I am positively impressed with it; it is also made in the USA.

column9: Salmon Dog Food with Fruit and Vegetables; healthy food made in USA
column10: I usually buy Nature's Domain dog food (Salmon & Sweet Potato); but I tried this brand Nature with Salmon and Yogurt which also has sweet potatoes as well as fruit, vegetables, minerals and vitamins. My dog really likes both the Nature's Domain and Nature Salmon Ocean Fish and Yogurt Dog food with alfalfa, flax seed, herring (fish) oil, etc.The size of the dog food nuggets are small suitable for small or large breed dogs where as the Nature's Domain Dog food nuggets are about twice as large as the Nature brand.

I bought this product because my husband has been raving about a butterfinger coffee that he used to drink while in school.  I have been searching for a good substitute and I found this particular brand on Amazon.  Unfortunately, it did not live up to our expectations.  It didn't taste like butterfingers and the smell was definitely not there.In all fairness, we are not big coffee drinkers but will indulge in a good cup of java anytime.In the meantime...we are still looking for Butterfinger.

Since eating Gluten Free, I have tried a lot of different products.  Most are not very tasty!  I do not believe that anything can beat the taste and texture of these biscuits when it comes to being gluten free!  If you are really missing bread - you have to try these!  I have tried so many different bread mixes and may have to live without bread.  I can do that as long as I have these biscuits!  They are awesome!  They also included recipes to make Cinnamon Buns, Sausage Balls, Chicken and Dumplings and Chicken and Biscuits.  You can also use this for Pigs in a blanket or for breakdfast sandwiches.  I have only used them as a biscuit so far and the best biscuit I have ever eaten.  They are also much better then the biscuits made with Gluten Free Bisquick Mix!

I've been baking gluten-free and egg-free for six years, and this is my favorite product, hands down. The biscuits are buttery and light, and only need a very short rising. I mix in herbs and sprinkle with coarse salt, for a savory biscuit - or sprinkle with shredded cheese, for a cheese biscuit. A real winner, even with friends and family!

My husband bought these for me for Valentine's Day, and I have to say that they are absolutely, ridiculously delicious!  I am a chocoholic, and these were truly the BEST truffles I have ever had in my life...  buy them!

These truffles were excellent, especially for the ease of buying them through Amazon.  I had been ordering truffles from the west coast, which (the truffle maker said) had to be shipped in dry ice.  The cost of the shipping was higher than the cost of truffles.  We were so pleased when we tasted these truffles---good chocolate, no hassle--thanks!

I got this so I can have some snacks as I study.  The thing I like about this package of 6 is that it has the best price per ounce compared to the other packs, ie. pack of 3 larger ounce jars.  Also as I eat from one jar, the others stay fresh and sealed, unlike larger containers.  Though freshness isn't much of a problem if you do eat these at a decent pace.  When I scanned the UPC with my iphone's RedLaser app, the cheapest price it found was $3.99 each so for 6 it would be $24!  So I really saved quite a bit with Amazon paying only $17.76 and free 2 day shipping, definitely better than being in the crowded Costco!  You can also give these away to friend and family which they will very much enjoy!  The dimensions for each jar is about 5.75" tall x 3.5" wide x 3.75" deep so you can get an idea of the size of each jar, I know it is hard to gauge just with the weight.
My husband can eat an entire container in one sitting.  He just loves them.  Have to keep them on hand all the time.  Enjoy.
had these at a friends party and had to find them.  looked here first and there it was.  very good.  a little pricey for what you get but, i will buy them again they are so good!

I was skeptical because of the other reviews, and I really like hot chocolate rather than cocoa, but this was great!  Make sure you have your Keurig set to the 8 oz setting because larger mugs will water-down the flavor and you will not like the taste.  Would highly recommend!

column9: gotta put some work into it
column10: If you make it as directed with 8 oz water it's not great - very watery.I put 2 oz half and half in the cup first and then do 6 oz water and it's very yummy.Not as luscious as a good powdered cocoa but worth the convenience.I drink one every evening.Best pricing is if you can find it in Target or Walmart.
I did not like the taste of this hot chocolate and my kids didn't either.  I will not buy again.

column9: Fantastic rich nutty flavor and 7 grams of fiber/slice!
column10: This stuff is absolutely delicious toasted!  Here is how you eat it:  toast it 2 or 3 times on the high setting in your toaster watching it carefully until it just caramelizes on the edges, not burning it.  Then put butter on it which dissolves beautifully when it is very hot and sprinkle with a little Splenda or your favorite jam.  It's out of this world!  And, 7 grams of whole soluble fiber per slice.  Four slices of this and you can quit for the day, it has so much fiber.  I have it for breakfast every day that I do not have steel-cut oatmeal.  That way I start the day off with my fiber.  Fiber has the ability to suck up 15% of the fat in your diet.  It's like natural Alli Weight-Loss Aid, Orlistat 60mg Capsules, 90-Count Starter Pack (prescription Xenical) without the pricetag.Brenda Watson and her book The Fiber35 Diet: Nature's Weight Loss Secret has a whole line of fiber products that Amazon carries.  She should just adopt this bread and put it into the diet.McCann's Steel Cut Oatmeal, Traditional, 28-Ounce Tins (Pack of 4) has much more fiber than regular oatmeal.  You just need to soak it overnight or cook it an extra 5 minutes.

I'm the kind of guy who can eat the same thing often.  So I'm glad to find a convenient way to have 12 loaves of bread which last several months.  It's delicious and hearty, but thin; so it is not too overwhelming.  Great with spinach, mayo (Dukes!), mustard, turkey and swiss.  Once open, wrap and put in fridge.  Holds up good for a solid week.  Will buy again, maybe same variety or try another.

column9: bread with guts, flavor, and hardly anything bad
column10: I've eaten a great deal of Mestemacher pumpernickel over the past several years. It's flavorful and healthy whether you eat it alone, as a sandwich, or toasted. The slices are thin and dense. It's real food, not the kind of bread that keeps something else from getting on your fingers. You have to chew it before you swallow it. In terms of health, this particular brand has no sugar, lots of fiber, and a respectable amount of protein (considering it's just bread). It does contain some whole wheat flour, unlike a competing brand that contains only rye.

We always have a supply of this bread in our home. I make sure we never  run out. Ordering it from Amazon has been a good experience. Always fast and dependable delivery . Our family could not live without this bread.

I have been eating this bread for a few years and I find it full of taste and longlasting if keept in a sealing bag or put into the frige. Cut thin it's good for toasting or with ham and cheese. This is a good price much better than the store price that is anywhere from 3.00 to 4.50

I just like bread that is natural, gives you something to chew and not bite off a piece sqeeze it between toung and gum and swollow it. The chewing process is so important to the whole digestive procedure. Besides that the bread also has NO preservatives and still stocks very well. My kind of bread, I LOVE IT SO DOES MY FAMILY.John Healthguruom@yahoo.com

I love this bread heated up in the microwave.  I eat it for a quick breakfast, by itself. It's substantial, like a heavy cake, and it has lots of fiber.  It has a nice tang to it, which I like.  It also compliments mustard very well if you want to use it on a sandwich.

Pumpernickle isn't my favorite bread but I do buy this when they're out of the Mestemacher Rye at my local grocer.  It is a dense, heavy bread with a slight sour taste.  My favorite sandwich to make with this?  Liverwurst!  Just a little bit of mayo, mustard and a few hearty rounds from an 8oz chub - and I'm in heaven :).  I really love how neat and square these make my sandwiches - like something you might serve at tea.  You cut the bread in half to make sandwiches since the individual slices are rectangle in shape.I'd like to point out that the ingredients listed by this seller is incorrect.  There is no whole meal wheat flour in this bread.  The ingredients for Mestemacher Pumpernickel (at least according to the package that I currently have) is as follows:Whole Kernel Rye, Water, Wholemeal Rye Flour, Salt, Oat Fiber, Malt Extract, Yeast.Mestemacher also makes a Westphalian version of this bread, aptly named Mestemacher Westphalian Pumpernickle (it comes in a black package).  Personally, I think the Westphalian version has a little more flavor and for those who were disappointed with this version, you may want to give the Westphalian version a try.  It is a separate recipe with different ingredients which are as follows:Whole Kernel Rye, Water, Sugar Beet Syrup, Salt, Malt Extract, Yeast.The only thing I really don't like about these breads is the limited shelf life once opened (5 days, refrigerated).  Though...  it's nice knowing that it's preservative free and truth be told, I've never had a problem going through a loaf in under 5 days (there isn't THAT much bread in each of these packages).  Enjoy!

It took me a while to get used to the fermented taste of this bread, but now I cannot live without it. A slice of this toasted (3 cycles on the toaster to make it crispy), good butter, an egg, raisins and a couple cups of tea is breakfast that lasts me to lunch without getting hungry.

I think this bread is terrific!  It has great flavor and texture.  My German wife loves it too.  She says it is very close to what her mother would send her to pick up at the baker before WW II.  It is kind of rough for making sandwiches, however.

It ain't what I remember, from when I emigrated from good ol Germany in 1976. But it is still better than the caramel colored abomination the bakers over here try to peddle as "pumpernickel". Even though it is a far cry from the real westphalian stuff that used to be baked long and slow with the maillard reaction providing the sweetness and caramelization and not some bottle from the laboratory.Nevertheless, the real stuff from a german noble bakery probably fell victim to industrialization, like so many things in this world. Schade.It will still give you a pleasant source of fibre in your bread, but real Pumpernickel it ain't, more like a very heavy KOMISSBROT.Kuechenmeister Kuntze.

As a child in Baltimore, we bought Pumpernickel from a German Deli in the Lexington Market.  The loaf was about 2-1/2" X 2-1/2" X 9", that you could almost drive nails with.  The flavor and texture was unforgetable.  The baker retired back to Germany, and took his recipe with him.  I've searched for more than 20 years for that bread.  Finally, I came upon the Mestermacher Pumpernickel, and it's like meeting an old friend.  I WILL be keeping an adequate supply on hand, from this time on.

I had looked everywhere to find a good Pumpernickel Bread and this is the very best.  Living in California it is very difficult to find and thanks to Amazon, there it was.  Try toasting it in the morning with some Cottage Cheese on it and a sprinkle of Salt on top.  Fabulous and healthy.
Pumpernickel bread the way it used to be - great in a sandwich and great toasted with butter!  Gave a few loaves as gifts!

We were paying $5 a loaf in a local store.  This price is a significant savings.The bread has a very strong pumpernickel taste, is very moist with small grains.  We find it very tasty.  This is NOT the standard bread that you find in bakeries or in stores.The bread freezes well.  This does not alter the taste or consistency.

column9: good bread, but price is outrageously high
column10: This bread is delicious, and has a very strong flavor. As other reviewers have said, it crumbles very easily, and I would suggest toasting it well to keep it together.As a side note, the price keeps increasing on amazon. I paid $30 a few months ago for this 12 pack.

column4: Angela L. Walker "Big Mama to Rocky and Romeo"
column10: One of the things I love from living in Germany.  Excellent!  So yummy and chocolaty.  High quality also.  Just wish the box was bigger. =)

I have three cats,one that is overweight and I am trying to feed them better food with less fillers and fat. I tested 6 different companies cat food and this was the overall winner with all three.  I don't feed them much canned food and if I have leftovers I always refrigerate. This was one of the three that they would eat after refrigeration. Of the three this seemed to be the most healthy. They liked the Wellness brand and ProPlan(cheapest and had fillers and byproducts). This is the most expensive of the lot, but when you open the can you can actually see the prawns and the flakes of tuna it's worth the extra money.

column9: 2 cats wouldn't eat it; kitten got diarrhea
column10: I tried this recently when it was on sale at a local big box pet supplies store.  I liked that it had healthy ingredients.  When I opened the can I was impressed by how appealing the food looked.  But my 2 adult cats refused to eat it.  My kitten loved it but it gave her diarrhea (the next meal she had her regular food and was fine).  About a week or so later I opened another flavor hoping they would like it better and same thing - cats would not eat it and kitten got diarrhea.  The rest of the cans went back to the store.  Hopefully your cats won't have these issues.

My three cats are excessively picky,so it is hard to find anything all three like.  They love this avoderm tuna with prawns.  After one week, I noticed their coats were absolutely beautiful and it cleared up their chronic dandruff-amazing! I split one small can of the tuna & prawns for the three cats daily, and I stir in one cranberry capsule(seems to prevent UTI's that one cat used to regularly get). I also use the dry avoderm cat food. We will be a regular buyer, love it!
Healthy all natural beef jerky at a low price. Snackmasters beef jerky has no preservatives, nitrate free and  high protein snack. I'm a big fan and will always buy snackmasters beef jerky.

column9: Best beef jerky I've ever tasted!!
column10: I'm a huge beef jerky fanatic and in my quest to find the best beef jerky brand I found snackmasters. Simply the best!!

This jerky has more gristle than I thought was possible to find in beef.  Every bite of the 2 oz. package I tried was almost impossible to chew, and I LIKE very chewy jerky.  Every bite I took also had a significant portion that was just impossible to chew, and so I ended up spitting it out.

These noodles are just OK but better than the La Choy ones. The price is really good for 12 packs.I am trying to find out what other dishes I can make to use up these noodles, maybe use themas chips with the Thai sweet chili sauce.

column9: Close to restaurant as you get
column10: Only 4 stars because chow mein noodles in a cello bag will never match getting them from a restaurant. These are the next best thing, however. And these are the better wider noodles with good flavor, not the thin hard La Choy type that you usually find in supermarkets.

I was anxiously awaiting the arrival of these, the wide noodles are hard to find. Apparently they're hard to find for Amazon, too, because these are not the noodles I got. Got the plain old skinny ones. And they can't claim they were packaged wrong, package doesn't claim to be wide style.  I'm going to try elsewhere to find what I wasted my money on this time.
this is a pretty bland product. they taste like cardboard...any resemblance to the real thing is purely coincidental!the manufacturer should go back to the drawing board on this one!

column9: My dogs think they're really yummy!
column10: Healthy, tasty treats. I usually break them in half. I have four dogs, and they all go crazy for these bars. I highly recommend them!

My dog loves them a little too much.. when she sees me get the bag she gets so excited she almost takes my fingers off!! And I feel good giving her treats I know are healthy for her unlike the weird processed ones from other brands.

I received these just a few days ago for Christmas for my dog, Sunny, and he already knows which bag these are in. He loves them! He somehow knows the different bags of treats I have regardless if I make any noise taking them from his cupboard. He senses the treats being taken out and he sits nicely by my side waiting for me to give him one. He then runs to his place and eats it until every last crumb is gone! I'm definitely going to get more of these treats and also try some other flavors.

I have a difficult time finding BLUE products in our area. And when I do they frequently don't have exactly what I am looking for.So I was thrilled to find Amazon had several products available.How disappointing to receive the product and find that it was several months past the date stamped on the packaging. As a longtime Amazon shopper I was surprised...I have come to expect great delivery and quality product. I won't order the blue again from this source.
My dog hugo turned his nose up after trying one of these bisquits.  So I gave them to a friend.  Her dogs turned their noses up too.
My dog absolutely enjoyed these cookies every time I gave her one! I would recommend buying that for your animals because they are healthy!
My dog loves this product from blue.  I do have to break them in half for him to eat them.  He might be a little spoiled too.

I have been pleased with everything I have tried in the Blue Buffalo line.  These bars are particularly pleasing to both my puppy and my geriatric pooch.  I have also tried the salmon and the chicken flavors and they were also well received by dogs and owner alike.

These are healthy snacks for dogs, but not something that my dogs just love.  They eat them, but not as quickly as they do ther types of snacks.  I make it a habit to only feed my dogs dog food, no table scraps or people food of any kind.  So they aren't picky eaters, they are used to eating dog food.  My Doberman didn't eat the ones with cinnamon it them at all, but my Schnauzer would eat those after leaving them sitting for a while.

column9: Another great product from Blue Buffalo
column10: Great cookies.  Our dog absolutely loves these and we can give them to him guilt-free knowing they're from blue and made with great ingredients.  They are rather large, so small to medium size dogs may need to have them broken in half or given less frequently.

My two dogs love these.  I'm not 100% sold that I would call these health bars.  I try to give these to the dogs in moderation.  They go crazy whenever I go for the bag.  The bars are pretty big in size there fore there aren't too many in a 16-oz bag.  I've found breaking them in half or quarters makes things last a little longer.  I'll definitely continue to buy these based on how happy the dogs are when they are treated to one.

The chocolate was very good.  However Langs should inform us of the tiny size of the cups.  I was expecting at least the cup to be an ounce.  The cups barely hold one half teaspoon.  Entirely too small for the money.

Package arrived very quickly and well protected. The only issue I had was that 3 of the chocolate cups arrived mis-shaped. However, I set them in the window for a very short time, and they softened just enough to be moldable. I also think that there was no way to prevent it since the heat wave temperatures were so high the week they were in shipment. I would not have paid for any "overnight" expensive delivery no matter what and any kind of "thermal" packaging would make them too expensive. I recommend these to anyone and will order again.

These cookies are absolutely delicious! They are festive and perfect for serving at my annual Christmas get-together, not to mention my family! They are a bit pricey, but worth the convenience! Yum!! I'll be getting them every year!!
Could have never had made a better and more beautiful cookie!!!! The people who received these as gifts were so impressed and i was proud to say they came from [...].Why to go!!!!!!!

column9: Excellent alternative to regular hamburger buns
column10: These sandwich thins are a great alternative to bleached, high fructose corn syrup induced hamburger buns for sure. I eat these on top of organic veggie burgers from Amy's, and the taste of the burger mixed with the whole grain sandwich thins is incredible. I'm sure these can be used for multiple other things, even PB+J. The health content in them is exceptional and unlike other buns, you don't have to worry about fishy ingredients. The price in the store I got these from was around 2 dollars, and for these that is a great price.

column9: Tasty but why doesn't it mold?
column10: I bought a large pack from Costco. While I like that they are low in calories and firm enough to hold any sandwich fillings, I tooam growing concerned because it's been over 2 months since I bought this huge pack and they are not getting moldy. ShouldI be concerned that they come from "Bimbo Bakeries"? - check the label there are a lot of preservatives so I'll probably have topass on these in the future.

My mother-in-law brought these down on her trip because she loves them and wanted us to try them. They are great in theory, but I'm becoming pretty alarmed by the fact that it's been over three months and they have shown not even a single bit of spoiling. No mold will grow on them. They look and feel perfect. I don't know about you, but putting something that is virtually un-spoilable in my body is pretty darn scary.

My baby loves this flavor of Gerber juice. I dilute 4 oz of this juice with equal amounts of water and let her drink it with meals. In between, I let her have plain water. These 4 oz are equal to a serving of fruit, which I really like. It is MUCH cheaper to buy this in bulk in this size than buying the small 4 oz bottles. Would definitely recommend.

My baby likes it but I think it's too much sugar. It's made from concentrate, so it tastes artificial. Try fruitables instead. It has vegetable and fruit juices, less sugar, and tastes much better. Good price on Amazon.

I bought this at a store in the area to see if my daughter would like it, not only does she like it, she LOVES it.  She has already drank alot of the bottle.  I'm so happy that she likes since its veggies and juice in one cup.  The reason for leaving this review is because I am on Amazon looking for juice in bulk to see if its cheaper.

This juice is one of my baby's favorites. I used to buy the 4oz bottles but this is way cheaper. I like the fact that 4oz gives her a serving of fruits. The max amount of juice that babies should drink in a day is 4oz, so I fill up a bottle with equal parts of water and juice and let her drink it with her meals throughout the day. In between I also give her plenty of plain water.

column4: Cant find it? Check Amazon! "Frequent Amazon ...
column10: When my much older children were little, Gerber sold a sweet potato juice they loved! Go Vitamin A! Gerber has changed their offerings many times over the years giving this particular item ingredient and name changes. My daughter adjusts to the changes, but will prefer this juice over all others. And now when her friends come over, they leave telling their parents, "I love carrot juice!" Unfortunately fewer and fewer stores are caring the item as the Gerber line continues to change and update . I was so glad to find it still available on Amazon. Try it. I think you will be surprised and your own child's response.
These sugar cookies are not soft;  they are light and crumbly (but not fall apart in your hand crumbly), with a pleasant flavor with a hint of lemon.
they are sliced very thin, you need to wash them in a colander first before you use them as they stink a little bit, but delicious when cooked up.
Love the mushrooms but half the cans arrived badly dented.  Wish they could fix this issue.  I shall miss them as cannot find them in local grocery stores or supermarket.
The shpping package was fine. But the original package was battered and damaged. The cans were bent and dinged. Making the contents suspect.

I first bought this bread at Whole Foods and loved it.  Then, they had a problem with their supplier and week after week had no bread.  I checked on line and found that Amazon had it, at a price lower than Whole Foods.  So I bought a case (12 packages) and am now on my second case.  It is so delicious --I love the chewy whole rye berries and the thin dense slices.  Every morning I eat a slice with either peanut butter or a slice of good cheddar cheese.  One thing I love about it is that it has a shelf life of 6 months or more.  This is because it is pasteurized after being packaged.  Once opened, it is fine for a week.  If your like whole grain breads, try this--you'll love it!

5/15/12:  I received the black truffles I ordered and am very disappointed with them.  They have absolutely no aroma at all and they taste like dirt smells.  RIPE truffles have a wonderful, earthy, garlicky, distinct aroma.  These were void of any aroma at all.  I was really counting on these being ripe when they arrived as I was hosting a dinner party and the menu contained truffle dishes (so I had to completely revise my menu).I contacted the supplier (which took many attempts) and they said their truffle expert (who is currently traveling back from Italy) would need to address the issue.  I am awaiting their response and will finish my review of this product based on their customer service and the end result of the truffles (assuming they finally ripen).  For now, I have rated this item 1 star but will upgrade the rating if warranted.Will update this post when I hear back from the supplier. . . . .5/16/12:  Here's an update. . .Part 1:  After several attempts to contact the supplier (FungusAmongus), I was finally able to get a response after sending an inquiry through their contact webform.  FungusAmongus sent me an email and asked that I speak with their truffle expert (name withheld).  The expert proceeded to tell me that the product was actually a "summer" truffle and that summer truffles don't have a smell or taste.  I know this is absolutely UNTRUE as I have used both summer and winter truffles and both have very distinct and pronounced tastes and aromas (though black winter truffles are "louder").  At any rate, the expert said he would authorize a refund and that I just needed to work out that part with FungusAmongus.  So I left several voice mails, email messages, and even tried to contact them through their own contact webform.  NO RESPONSE.Part 2:  I contacted Amazon's customer service and within 5 minutes they generated a full refund.  PROBLEM SOLVED!FINALLY:  I will never do business with this supplier because their products are very poor, are misrepresented, and their customer service is terrible.Dear Amazon:  thank you SO MUCH for your help in getting this issue resolved and for providing excellent customer service!

The Pods arrived quickly. I am delighted with them. Nice healthy plump green ones with a taste perfect for making chai tea.

This product is positively wonderful!  Use it anywhere you might use ordinary balsamic, but use it sparingly as it packs a very fruity punch.  Apply just a bit to some fresh berries and pour it over vanilla ice cream for a fantastic desert treat.

I like both the flavor and consistency of this syrup. With other sugar free syrup, Log Cabin or Aunt Jemima, I find I use tons of syrup, but I find a small amount of this brand as flavorful as regular syrup.

If you have to have sugar-free syrup this is the one! I've tried several different brands but this is the best -- now don't expect it to taste like the thick, rich maple syrup from Vermont - but a great alternative.

column4: mas "I have lived my entire life in Arkansas....
column10: Cary's Sugar Free Syrup, 12-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 12)I received this order very quickly.  Everything was in good shape, very happy with provider.

I started drinking this when I was stationed in Korea. It was a quick way to get my morning coffee. It is just enough for one small cup. One stick has instant mocha coffee, powdered cream and a little sweetener. I would add some half&half and a little vanilla flavoring to make it even nicer. My stomach can't handle brands like Nescafe so I was happy to discover I could tolerate this. It is more expensive, of course, to buy it this route. But, sometimes when the craving hits, it's worth the extra cost.

I never reqularly drank coffee until I ran across this product while in Korea.  It's coffee with the sugar and cream already added.  All I do is heat up one measuring cup of water and add two packets of the mocha gold.

We lived in South Korea for a few years. After a recent visit, I realized how much I missed this. I have stomach issues, and I can drink this with no problem. Just make sure you only fill your cup half way...
