column10: Very good, but $24 is too expensive for this product.The identical product could be had for $18 on Ebay.

column9: One of the best instant coffees out there
column10: I was introduced to this coffee several years ago by a visiting scholar from Korea, and I have been drinking it ever since.I used to have a local way to purchase it, but then was forced to start looking online.You don't need to add anything to these little packets, they are already preflavored.I do mix in some flavored creamers from time to time, but you don't have to.I have probably drank over 1000 of these instant packets over the past several years and couldn't reccommend them more.
This coffee is very mild and it a nice taste coffee Not bitter at all. This is my 4th time ordering this coffee. Its shipped real fast.
A Korean friend turned me on to this coffee, but it's too far to the Korean market to get more. I love that I can get great a great cup of fru-fru coffee in minutes.  Delivery was very fast too.
this is jasmine oolong tea that tastes good, smells wonderfull and has a mild bite. use almost boiling water and do not oversteep. a very good buy at 18.07/5 oz.

This is a delightful jasmine tea, that although an oolong, clearly has the taste and flavor of a green tea.  The jasmine fragrance is delightful while the tea is steeping and while drinking.  I get two infusions from the same pearls and find the tea to be smooth (not at all bitter like another reviewer reported).  While expensive, this is well worth the cost.

You are getting quantity over quality in this pack.  I purchased this and Rishi Tea Organic Jasmine Pearl Loose Tea, 3-Ounce Tin (Pack of 2) by accident at the same time.  I prefer Rishi over Adagio.  But I believe Rishi is a bit more expensive.  So if you want quantity go with this. Quality go with something else.It's OK, just not recommendable.

The Jasmine Pearl tea from Adaigo is a decent tea. It comes in a pretty little tin that I will use for other teas after I have finished this batch, however, it doesn't really have a great tea taste. It is there, but it isn't strong and it relies heavily on the jasmine to make the experience of drinking it enjoyable. The jasmine is potent, smells great, and indeed as a sweet taste during and after drinking, but it should be an additive to the tea, not the experience.  It was almost like I was drinking jasmine juice or something....unless you oversteep it. It still doesn't have a strong taste, but it is bitter as all hell. This is unusual for something that claims to be a an oolong tea (but would be typical of a green tea.)If you want a good jasmine tea at better price, get some of Numi's stock. Their Jasmine Pearls or Monkey King are both superior and almost half the cost.
Very dishonest vendor. Received damaged package. Had to throw away most contents because they were damaged from packaging. Refused to rectify. Wasted $50.
Good salt, dispenser works well with 3 different openings. Size is very good for table top use, as well as for cooking area.

My sister-in-law introduced me to the Wellness products in Palm Beach FL.  After reading the ingredients I had to buy a bag and try it for my 6lb Yorkipoo.  She loves it!  She used to be a finicky eater with a sensitive stomach.  On Wellness - no problems, and she's very healthy.  Only down side is I couldn't find it anywhere around where I live.  Thank goodness it's easy to order on-line!

I absolutely love this product. I've been a faithful customer of Fantastic Foods since 1991, and I have always loved these beans. Like all refried beans, they do need salt. But they are seasoned, have a luscious texture and taste fresh - unlike that awful stuff in a can that always has an odd odor and tastes tinny. If you have never tried anything other than the canned, you owe it to yourself to try these refried beans. Did i mention they are ridicously easy? 1 3/4 cup of boiling water and 5 minutes. Perfection.

I never thought I would spend the extra money for instant beans.I've been eating these for 15 or 20 years and they are amazing.No canned taste and they're seasoned but,not hot.With tortillas in the freezer and these beans in the cupboard,I always have comfort food in the house.I don't bother boiling water,I just microwave.Fantastic Foods is awesome.

column9: WAY better than canned (Correct preparation instructions included)
column10: I used to buy this product in bulk from Wild Oats, but haven't been able to find it in several years (Wild Oats was bought out by Whole Foods and the one near me doesn't carry this in bulk). I was so happy to find this product in bulk on Amazon (whether buying 12 7oz. boxes or buying the 3 3.3lb bags which is what I bought). Yes, it's a ton of mix, but I make this so often and it lasts practically forever provided it's kept sealed.The flavor is so far superior to anything canned and, dare I say, even better than refried beans made at home. This is mainly due to the extra flavorings added to the mix whereas home recipes usually only add salt and/or garlic. This product is perfect for anyone who loves refried beans and wants a convenient way to prepare them. I think it's incredible that something this easy and fast to prepare actually tastes better than something you can make at home (that also takes much longer). It's great for quick bean and cheese burritos or breakfast burritos (bean, cheese, and egg with some red sauce) and also great for campers. Plus, if you buy the 3 3.3lb bags, you can divide this product up and make as much or as little as you need.Preparation information:  Many sites I researched for this product said to mix 1.75C boiling water with 1C of mix in a bowl, cover, and let sit for 5 mins.  However, THIS IS INCORRECT and results in runny beans.  I contacted the good folks at Fantastic Foods and was forwarded preparation instructions which are as follows.Pour 1.75C boiling water of 1 1/3C of mix in a bowl.  Stir well, cover and let sit for 5 mins.I haven't tried this ratio yet as I just received the email and wanted to post a review including the instructions since they all seem to be incorrect everywhere I look.  If the beans are still too runny for you, increase to 1.5C of mix and try that.  I personally like my beans very thick for both eating plain and in burritos.
Love this product, but grocery stores stopped carrying it, even Whole Foods.  Glad I could find it at amazon, cheapest price for getting it online!

If you make the beans per the recipe on the box, just mix some right into any rice and it will make your rice a star.And given that this is a dry product you can use a little at a time which is what I do for rice.I use this product in an unusual way to make the best brown rice.  I needed a way to make the rice more interesting.  It was not enough to just saute some garlic and onions / mushrooms in small amount of water/oil with salt or soy sauce, hot pepper and mix the cooked rice in. That's ok but something was missing.  So during the saute, I put a few of tablespoons of Fantastic Refried bean mix in the liquid, not worrying about proportions because this product cooks up well in just a couple of minutes and I can add more water or boil it off if needed.  Then mix in the cooked rice and this is a very good meal on it's own. The refried beans give this dish lot's of body and flavor.  Everyone I tell about this loves it.

I never thought I would love refried beans this much! In the past I had used canned refried beans and they either tasted bland, metallic, or both. A few years ago I discovered these and never used canned refried beans again. They are seasoned just enough, have a great texture when prepared, and never have a metallic taste because they haven't been sitting on some shelf in a can for who-knows-how-long. I use them in burritos, with corn and guacamole,  and even just topped with vegan cheese (Daiya). I don't know what I would do without these delicious beans. The "subscribe & save" option here on Amazon just makes it even better because now I can get them for cheaper than in any store where I've found them. Nutritious, delicious, and cheap - it doesn't get better than this!

I wouldn't be w/o this on my Baja kayaking expeditions. When it's my night to cook I put some of the boiled water from breakfast into the dried beans and a dash of EVO, mix and the beans continue to soften in the plastic container until dinner for burritos or whatever. Water is precious in Baja when you are kayaking for 2-3 weeks and this product doesn't seem to need as much H2O as some other dehydrated food.I use this so much I buy it in bulk and keep it in my pantry.It can be added to soups also.This is NOT bland at all. May not appeal to those who enjoy refried beans out of a can which are quite insipid. I doubt that Fantastic could appeal and sell to enough consumers if it went either way in spiciness. IMOA it is JUST RIGHT.
Great product with many uses. The long shelf life makes it a great protein to stock for emergency food.I've tried other Fantastic products and never been disappointed.
I love to take this mix backpacking. It has a very good flavor and is also gluten free which for me is very important.

I crave bean burritos regularly, I guess there's something in them I need. Great idea to keep a case of Fantastic Food's Instant Refried Beans on hand.  Today I had a package for the day for 780 calories total (of FF Refrieds, that is.) Three mini burritos: soft-taco size wrap tortillas filled with refried, for lunch. For dinner, two big grilled burritos: full size tortillas, fill with refried, fold and cook in skillet of veg spray, flip, makes toasty 'grilled' burrito.  I think this mix is scrumptious!  The texture is just as good as canned, [and not watery like Taco Bell!] and flavorful, salty and seasoned enough and I don't need to add anything.  Fresh home made to compare doesn't enter into this equation because of the cook time, amount needed, inconsistent results of home made and its other variables, LOL...  Anyway,  I may add to FF's refrieds, some brown rice, salsa, chopped tomatoes and onions, picante, chopped fresh spinach, Green Giant mexicorn, vegan 'meats,'  or any other things depending on what I have on hand and hankerin for.  Most often it's been just refried and Tabasco before folding up the burrito.  Hits the spot and fixes that craving very nicely until next time!

Great bundle Price, Cheap relatively speaking. My mexican friend loves it which is saying something about the authenticity of this instant mix of beans. I love it I cook with it its a great deal in this bundle. Very unique flavour profile.
needs more flavoring. taco sauce, tomatoes, cayenne would all be a good addition. i suppose this is easy for campers to use.

column9: great taste & great for medicine cabinet too!!
column10: Not only have i used this on my morning oatmeal, I have also used it on my face and body.  I take a thin spatula and put some on any shaving cut, or blemish that hasn't healed, and cover it over night.  By morning it is ten times better. Keep repeating at night, and in a few days you notice that not only are you healed, but also there is no remaining scar!!

This is my first time purchasing this product. I researched it online. I used it for a wound and rash. Just 24 hours later it looks and feels better. I love the natural remedies. I will use this stuff forever. Great price and fast shipping too.

First time trying guayusa tea - just as described, smooth and stimulating.  Much easier on the stomach than coffee, no jitters (even though I drink 2-3 cups throughout the morning).  Delicious taste, too.  Even if I haven't slept well, the tea helps me feel energetic throughout the morning and afternoon.  Definitely lives up to its reputation.

I have fallen in love with these Runa Teas  - I do mine loose  - I have the original  -- excellent nice gentle smooth taste  -  this is the same with lemon grass and hint of cinnamon  it is so smooth  -- these have become my go to drink in morning  no more coffee ---  I love the spice mix of this  - It doesn't overwhelm the tea itself  just adds to it  ---  these are excellent products  ! this one doesn't require any sweetener  --  I love when you can have a tea just the tea -- enjoy

The spice variety is one of my favorites-- it has a nice cinammon quality without being too overpowering like a lot of spice teas i've had. also, guayusa is a pretty amazing product in itself. Big thumbs up.

Runa is a brand new tea that I drink everyday. I love the balanced, energizing feel I get from it. Apparently guayusa has been drunk for thousands of years in the rain forests of Ecuador and is now making its way to market in the US for the first time. Runa also seems to have a great back story of environmental conservation and social empowerment of indigenous groups. In fact I just heard a story covered on NPR's Marketplace about the partnership between Runa, the socialist Ecuadorian government and the farmers.The Amazon Spice has a nice cinnamon undertone with high notes from the lemongrass, the Ginger Citrus is also really good and slightly spicier from the ginger with clean citrus zest flavor, the traditional is good to see what guayusa by itself tastes like- smooth and naturally, subtly sweet with no tannin. I've never had the spearmint but I bet its good for people who like mint tea.

Although I enjoy its flavor, I have never been able to drink coffee because it makes me feel jittery and nervous instead of energetic. Guayusa tea, on the other hand, is a different story, full of pleasure only. Drinking one or two cups of guayusa in the morning gives me energy all day long, without any buzz or jittery feeling. The flavor of this tea is also smooth and sweet, with perfectly balanced hints of cinnamon and lemongrass. It tastes nice hot but I find that I like it best cold.

My two dogs: a ten-year-old Papillon, and a two year old Maltese, love these treats. I give them to them as their breakfast. If I am lying around in bed too long in the morning, they oftentimes, try to pull be out of bed, so I can go give them their Dogswell treats. I love seeing them grab their treat, and run to the couch, where they devour them. Great product!

I am in search of a good German Christmas stolen. Such a stolen should have powdered sugar on it and dried fruits inside. The consistency should be cake like and firm. This stolen was a complete waste of my money (with shipping, almosty $30).The sugar covering was not powdered by a glaze that cracked when I cut it. The cake was dry and tasteless and crumbled when I cut it. I was okay with paying $30 for what I thought would be a good stoeln but this was not good at all. The stolen looks nothing like the picture and was a huge disappointment.My suggestion is, if this is the only stolen you can find, forget about buying one as you will be disappointed.
Got these for my sister as a personal gift to my older sister. We used to (and still occasionally) do eat these by the ton, so I was glad to find a bulk amount at a pretty decent price.
Great salad dressing mix.  Simple to make and it is all organic so it is good for the body and over all over health,

column4: The Wizard of Rock and Roll "bigbill947"
column10: On one of my many trips south of the Border, actually my first trip down to the Baja ! Previously , I had enjoyed train and busing it aeround the Oacaxa Palenque , Merida to Isle Mujeres areas.so hear we are in the midway town of LaPaz , camped out in our tent in what's more a Winnebago or Caravan kind ofplace, but we did have the HONDA Civic....Actually ,we got real good at putting up our tent. Our friendly neighbors invited us for beer and margaritas , but I like my TQillya straight back then , before I knew any better I guess.After drinking and talkin' , our hostess put out some tortillia chips and the littlest can of ,she said salsa.I said I never saw a salsa in a can , querying more  I said its probably tinny !  Well, not at all , what I tasted was one of the best tasting chunky enuff, moderate on the heat, smooth tasting salsas I ever had tried . Get some and try it for yourself, we all can't be liking the same things , else we'd get caught up in the rush!!!!

I bought several of the food tek items a few months ago, but frankly bought them for emergency situations.  I had not tried any of them until tonight when we wanted corn bread with our soup.  My last gluten free corn bread attempt had been a disaster, so I thought what the heck let's try the food tek cornbread it can't be much worse.It truly was easy to mix, and it cooked up in 1 minute. I toasted the cornbread for just a couple of minutes to give it a more normal oven baked cornbread look.It was sweeter than I would like, but definitely better than I had made from scratch.  My husband does not have to eat gluten free and he said "get some more of these", so I just placed my order for this and several other of the food tek items.If you don't like sweet cornbread, you won't like this.  It is very sweet.

column9: Pretty good corn bread and it does not get easier than this
column10: I tend to stay away from mixes in general so I can't say this has the quality of the real thing, but given my low expectations for corn bread made in a microwave oven, the Food-tek corn bread definitely surprised me and tasted pretty yummy.  My daughter -who can actually have as much gluten as she wants- raves about it and loves that she can just pop a serving in the microwave and take it to school for lunch without any further preparation.

Its everything they say it is.  We loved it!  Its light and spongy and sweet.  Quick and simple to make, and also dishwasher safe.  If you have special dietary needs you cant go wrong with this one :)
After reading reviews, I purchased.  Big mistake.  It tastes awful & a bit too spondgy.
Easy to make and tastes great. A real boon for people on special diets! Good portion size and always fresh, since you only make as much as you need.

This is about the easiest thing possible to make - add water, shake, microwave for a minute, eat.  When you want to have something fresh and warm and nothing else is around, this is wonderful to have in the cupboard.The texture is more like angel food cake than corn bread, and it doesn't have nearly the intensity of flavor that real corn bread has, but if you treat it on its own merits without comparing it to other corn breads, it's quite tasty.

These are delicious! You can really taste the strawberry and they make a great snack or part of my breakfast. They aren't the biggest bars though so I don't find them to be super filling. As far as pricing, if you can get these on sale at your grocery store, then it's pretty similar but you can't beat having it delivered to your front door.
These are hands down the best granola bars I have ever tried. I would highly recommend purchasing and telling a friend about them.

These actually taste really good, tastes like strawberries and berries and granola and sweet yogurt. No real complaints here, they are tasty.Price here is ridiculous though, I can get these for under $3 at Walmart.

I just opened a box, and I think this is my new favorite granola bar. You can really taste the berries. It's very sweet, which I love, but it only has 140 calories. It makes for a great snack. Or, add a small piece of fruit and maybe a hard boiled egg for the protein- and you've got a quick breakfast built for those on the go.
Nice to have these organic granola bars.  My kids love them and they are a healthy snack.  I give them at their lunch for an extra cookie treat.

column9: Backs up the promise of strawberry tastiness...
column10: It has a nice strawberry flavor, but the frosting drizzle you see in the picture is not what you get on the actual bar.  It is also too sticky.  There is a fine line you can cross with these granola bars and when you cross it, it can become too much.  The gooiness of the bar is a tad offputting at times.  The bar literally sticks to the wrapper and comes apart merely trying to open the wrapper.  That said, I really like the flavor.  Too often these rolled oat bars can taste bland despite any flavor profiles they claim to have.  This actually backs up the flavor it claims to have on the box, and I appreciate that above all else.  Texture may be an issue, but taste is not, which is why this gets four stars from me.  It is also healthier for you than other breakfast bars, and for those of us who like a low calorie snack that is filling, these are bars we can reach for.

These are easily my favorite granola bars. Delicious granola and berries with yogurt drizzled on top. I have one almost every day. They stopped carrying the granola bars at our local stores, so I started ordering packs from here. I'm not much for buying in bulk, but now, I just order more as soon as I have just one box left. It works out quite well.

They are beyond delicious. A nice strong berry flavor, mixed with granola. You cant lose if you like both. Its sold at Stop and Shop in the organic/health food aisle, but I think this is cheaper here atm.
Kids enjoy eating these. They have a bit too much sugar for my liking but we'll continue to buy them.

If I was just reviewing the noodles, TEN out of FIVE stars. SERIOUSLY. I'm an Asian Noodle connoisseur, and these are BY FAR the BESTTT noodles I have ever had!!! SOOO delicious. Seeing as noodles are my favorite food, and these are my favorite noodles... These just make me happy.You cook them by soaking in warm-hot water until they are soft, and then cook them in whatever soup base (or pan fry with water + stir-fried veggies) and they always come out to the best chew state. Not too hard, and not mushy. They are pretty quick to make as well, so as a student they are perfect.HOWEVER, the price here really really REALLY sucks. You can get them for $2-4/bag, which would make $12 MAX at any Chinatown nearby (if there is one). AND you don't have to pay the (ridiculous! these are light) >$8 shipping fee to make the total well over $20.BUT if you do not have ANY sort of Asian food store near by, then I guess it's all right. For my favorite noodles? It would be worth it.. maybe once a year.

column9: OK taste but has Red Dye #40
column10: Though I have ordered, and consumed Wel-Pac Pickled Ginger, I will not do so again.  Red Dye #40 is bad for your health, is banned in many European countries and not a necessary food additive.  Many sushi bars and restaurants will no longer serve dyed sushi ginger, there are a few brands that leave their ginger natural and pickle with organic raw sugar and vinegar.

This is the best brand of pickled ginger we have ever tried, so now it's the only one we buy. Besides eating with sushi, I enjoy snacking on it as it comes from the jar. It looks and tastes just like the kind available in fine sushi restaurants -- perfect even thin slices with just the right flavor.I like that it has Aspartame (Equal) as a sweeter because of the need to watch my glucose levels. Unfortunately, so many people have been taken in by controversies spread through elaborate health scares and Internet smear campaigns involving hoax e-mails. Fortunately, Aspartame is approved in over ninety countries throughout the world, so I am not worried that nay-sayers will cause it to go away. Our entire family has been using it since it was first marketed. Equal and Splenda are the only sweeteners we trust.On the other hand, high fructose corn syrup, which has been proven a problem for many people, is in almost all processed foods, even ones that don't require sweetening. So happy it didn't find its way into Wel-pac.

Well executed but cloying and saccharine."The Cross" was an instrument of torture, and at the end the deposition it was coated with blood and excrement.Hard for me to swallow it as a cookie, but then again some folks "Christianity" begins and ends in sentiment.

Sadly, I've come to think of myself as a 'bully stick connoisseur.'  Some bullys are too thin, some not the length promised, and others stink to high heaven.  At under $37 for 15 braided twists of 3 TRUE 6" bullys which seem low odor, these are a steal.  My dog will mow down a bully stick in about 10 minutes.  These last about 30 minutes, so we get 3x the value.You can bet we'll be back for more!

column9: Great price for a great chew
column10: I've gotten these in a stick form before from my local specialty pet store & my dog tore through it.  He's a 1 year old lab so I wanted something that kept him entertained longer than 10 minutes (the time it took him to get through a typical bully stick.  These fit the bill.  He works on it for a bit, getting it to "un-braid" & then has 3 individual sticks to work on.  These keep my active chewer busy for a long time.  They have a mild odor while he's chewing on them (and they get wet) but normally they don't have a smell (and the mild odor isn't unpleasant).Anyway - for the price, these are a great deal.  I'm about to order my second batch & figured I should write a review at the same time. :)

column9: Great value for braided bully sticks.  High Quality.
column10: these bully sticks are my dog's favorite and I can feel good about giving them to her as they are not unhealthy and the price is very reasonable considering what you would pay if you purchase the same number in a pet supply store.
I have a dachshund and a lab. They both love these bully sticks!  I highly recommend them for small or large dogs.

I had previously ordered the single bully sticks and they were no longer available.  It was suggested I get the braided.My dog bit off the end and, wha-la three tiny stick he gobbled in a matter of minutes. Expensive for what I got.Respectfully,Sharee Peterson

I have a crazy dog.  This is the ONLY thing that slows her down and gives me peace.  It lasts hours and hours!  I love these things.  I will be re-ordering more as she is ONLY 4 months and it will be awhile before she starts acting like a lady!  :-)

As a Celiac I have to miss out on alot of my favorite foods. Giving up oatmeal cookies was especially difficult but finding this product was such a joy for me. They are easy to make and taste just as good as my favorit recipe (no really!)

This coffee tastes fairly good for sugar-free decaf, but its first two ingredients - which are present in the largest quantity -  are very unhealthy for people's cardio-vascular system: PARTIALLY HYDROGENATED COCONUT OIL, CORN SYRUP SOLIDS.One would think that at the price General Foods charges for it, they'd manufacture something that people could drink a few cups/day without worry. It seems they pay more for the pricey metal tin, than better ingredients. I would not mind at all buying the coffee in a nice bag instead.

This International coffee is perfect for me!  It meets my dietary restrictions without compromising the flavor. It satisfies my chocolate cravings. It is delicious.  At this price it is a wonderful buy.

There is no amount of hydrogenated or partially hydrogenated fat that is safe in the human diet.  Many studies (New England Journal of Medicine, Journal of the American Medical Assn) have been done, and the data is considered conclusive.  The FDA has refused to ban its use due to intense lobbying by the food industry. Keep that in mind as you sip this coffee.
None of the stores sell this flavor.  Thank goodness I found it on Amazon!!

I had been checking out all of the stores in my area.  My town is very small.  We have just one store.  But, I shop in El Paso and Midland-Odessa usually once a month.  I was dismayed to find all of the large supermarkets in that area do not carry the decaffeinated Suisse Mocha Coffee Drink Mix made by General Foods International.  Then I said to my self.  Where did you find the Campbell's Butternut Squash soup?  Amazon.com.  I got on the computer and sure enough there it was -  my decaffeinated Suisse Mocha.I am so thankful everyday that I usually can find "hard to find" items on Amazon.  The delivery is fast, the product is packaged wonderfully and the product is delicious.  Thank you again Amazon.comSincerely,Carolyn Delaware

I used to drink the regular suisse mocha, and then the decaffeinated only.  I try to watch what I drink so when they came out with the decaf sugar-free drink I tried it and loved it. I have been drinking this for many years but sometimes have a hard time finding it, so when I found it online through Amazon, I jumped at the chance to have it delivered to me whenever I wanted it.

My wife has been drinking Decaffeniated, Sugar free Suisse Mocha (General Foods International Coffee) for years, but the latest batches we purchased are significantly different than earlier mixes.  The coffee has a much sweeter and very unpleasant flavor.  In addition, after drinking a small amount from three different cans, she became quite nauseated.  At first we thought we had simply gotten a bad batch when we ordered through Amazon, but we purchased more from a local grocery store and it was the same story.  We also noticed that a label on top of the cans now reads: "Coming up this summer! Look for our same great-tasting, indulgent cafe-style beverages under our new name:  Maxwell House International Cafe."From this, I assume General Foods has sold "International Coffees" to Maxwell House.  Whatever has happened, the change in formulation has ruined what was an excellent beverage.  I realize taste is a matter of personal preference, but the fact that the coffee mix made my wife ill (three different cans of it, purchased from different places) leads me to believe that others should avoid this product.
Must have daily.I make double strength.Would like low fat or non-fat version.

column9: I wish that it was healthier
column10: This product is the perfect way to end my breakfast and linger over Suduko.  I try not to drink anything with caffein because it keeps me awake all night.  In addition, I am very concerned about calories.  This is a wonderfully tasting treat which is very low in calories.  But it is too good to be true.  The first ingredient is a partially hydrogenated oil which makes it not such a good choice.  It is the only thing that I use with partially hadrogenated oil so I have one cup a day.  If it was made without the oil, I would use it all day long.  Maybe they can remove the ingredient. The flavor is marvelous.  It mixes a little slowly, but don't give up because eventually it all dissolves.
Fast shipment and nicely packaged.  I drink this on cold nights - no caffeine and it's low cal. Can't beat it.
It's good for the number of calories, but I infinitely prefer the French Vanilla. It's divine.I found this in my local Target for much cheaper than here.

I have been drinking international coffee, suisse mocha sugar free decaffinated coffee since it was introduced by general foods.  I love the taste and make iced coffee during the warm months. I was not a coffee drinker until I tried this years ago. Now I look forward to this delicious cup of flavor.

column9: Sugar Free Decaf Suisse Mocha Coffee Drink
column10: I love International Coffees but cannot find the decaf, sugar free Mocha in my local supermarkets. I love being able to get it on line!

I love the taste of something chocolatey and sweet after I eat but because I watch my calorie intake, I rarely eat dessert.  I've found that this product satisfies bmy sweet tooth and makes me feel as though I've had a treat.  I also enjoy a cup as an afternoon snack.  I've tried the other sugar-free flavors of GF coffees but this is the only one I really enjoy. Unfortunatly, my local area supermarkets only seem to carry the full-calorie version so I was delighted and grateful to find this on Amazon!  Hooray!
Not much snow here but still very tasty, nice combo of chocolate and coffee and low cal.

This flavor isn't as good as the French Vanilla.  Although you can tweak it with a bit of cocoa powder and if you have a sweet tooth like me, a packet or two of Splenda depending on serving size.  Since there isn't a large market for sugar-free decaffeinated coffee out there, one can't bee too picky.
Finally SUGAR FREE AND DECAFFEINATED coffee.  This is so hard to find in the stores.  Would have given it 5 stars but it was a bit pricey and not quite as chocolately as I would have liked.
This is the worst tasting coffee ever made. It has a distinctly metal taste, and I'd never buy it again.

column9: Excellent Green Tea with a hint of Raspberry
column10: My favorite green tea.  The raspberry flavor is very light and aromatic.  Storing it in a tin keeps it fresh.  We re-use the tins for other purposes when we are finished.

Even if you think Indian cooking is too spicy and exotic, try this, it will change your mind about Indian cooking.  Buy a deli roasted chicken, some basmati rice, and frozen naan bread from the store and make homemade "fast food" even the pickest member of the family will love.  This is my absolute favorite korma cooking sauce in the world and Sharwood's Sweet Mango Chutney goes wonderfully with the meal.  Also try Sharwood's Tika Masala cooking sauce.  And this review comes from a meat and potatos Midwesterner!
This coffee was dilivered in good time and condition and is a good quality product. It was as we expected and we are enjoying it.smooth transaction
This is by far the  best cat food my cats ever had.  One cat had urinary tract problems, and this food helped him get back on track.  They love it!
Very salty. Can't taste cinnamon or sugar. don't waste your money. Better off buying pork rinds at the store.Very disappointed.

Bought these for a friend as a gift and he loved them! Said he loves the heat that they bring because it is so different from others that he has tried. It was highly suggested that he be given this as a gift from this point forward.

If you into hot, spicy pickles, these are for you!  Crunchy, fiery, with a very strong after-kick! They're highly addictive (the FDA made me say that). - After you get over the burn from the first one, you long for a second one & so on!  These are hard to find and this' the best deal out there as far as price & convenience!  Everyone other than fire-eaters be warned!  These are delicious, but HOT!

column9: wow...Harold brought the heat with these bad boys!
column10: I've tried all of the pickles from Conscious Choice Foods and I give them all five stars.  These however are a tad too hot on their own, which is normally how I eat my pickles, right out of the jar.  That said, if you pair these bad boys with something like salami, they are perfect.  I just want to warn people, that Harold doesn't fool around when he labels his pickles "SUPER HOT"!!!

The Clark Bar; once advertised by Tony the Tiger; was always a favorite of mine.  They are hard to find, but I found them on line.  They are delicious.  They arrived quickly and all in excellent condition; that is none of them were broken as a result of the shipping.  I will soon order another box of Clark Bars.  Thank you Clark Bar and Amazon for providing a way to get them.

column9: not hard to find thanks to amazon
column10: these Clark bars are impossible to find in my area... every local place is like "yeah we have those" then they realize that they don't. ordering these online made my life a lot easier. all the bars arrived in great condition, with an ice pack included that preventing any melting! i'm not a Clark bar purist... not sure if the formula has changed, but these taste good.

Well, what else am I going to say to fill up 20 words?  It's a bit expensive, but worth it for the lack of salt.  For some reason I just recently realized the kind you buy in the grocery store does have salt in it.

Description misleads buyers. It states "It's what is inside that counts - natural flavors, pure cane sugar and filtered water. Only the best ingredients." Upon receiving, the ingredients listed are; Water, Sugar, Natural and Articficial Flavors, Propylene Glycol, Benzyl Alcohol, Alcohol, Ethanol, Dextrose, Gum Arabic, Gum Xanthan, Vegetable Gum, Ester Gum, Vegetable Oil, Food Starch, Glyceryl, Abletate, Citric Acid, Phosporic Acid, Tartaric Acid, Tannic Acid, Malic Acid, Ascorbic Acid, Potassium Sorbate, Tartrazine, Triacentin, GHA, Yellow#5, ..... and the list goes on. My opinion is if a product is described as such, than the ingredient list should be all natural - not composed of natural occuring and synthetic chemical compounds to make up the product. I am returning this product as "NOT AS DESCRIBED".

I have 4 dogs, 3 of which are puppies - 3 different breeds and they all love these bones.  Maltese Morkie Cava-Tzu Don't get me wrong, they like to eat, they're dogs after all but they LOVE these bones.  I found them "on accident" at T.J. Max and figured what the heck..........Great choice!!http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B004MUF3FG/ref=cm_cr_rev_prod_img
These chewies were a huge hit with my goldendoodle!!  They last her quite awhile and give me time to get things done while keeping her busy!

I bought three flavors just to try them out, this flavor was good. I liked them. If your looking for a sweet snack that is filling and yummy I'd go with the Cinnamon flavor, LOVE those. I would NOT buy the Zesty ranch, those tasted awful. All packs are low in carbs and sugar and have good amounts of fiber and protein.([...])

Nutritionally speaking, these snacks are pretty good. At 130 calories, 4g fat, 16g carbs, 3g fiber, and 8g of protein, they seem like they live up to the claims on the product package. They "control hunger," and help you "avoid blood sugar highs and lows." Unfortunately, to me, it was like eating cardboard. They texture is like packing peanuts, and the taste isn't much better. They are rather bland, and I couldn't taste even a hint of white cheddar. Now, I've eaten many products of this type before, and I don't expect them to be gourmet or taste like regular snacks, but I cannot eat these crisps. They might be better in another flavor, but the white cheddar crisps are not edible, in my opinion.

I'm on a low-carb diet and was looking for some low-carb snacks to get me through my hunger spells. I thought that white cheddar would be a good flavor, but upon receiving my order and trying them, I can't bear to continue eating them. The flavor is very artificial tasting and kind of sweet! I don't mind the texture of them though, they remind me of rice cakes. Also, these snacks are better suited for a diabetic, not someone on a low-carb diet - each bag actually has 16g of carbs!

These are awesome little pick-me-ups for when you're on the go and need to make sure you have something balanced to eat. I'm hypoglycemic and need to make sure my blood sugar doesn't get too low. I also travel a lot for work. I pack these and the extend bars with me in case I find myself on a plane or a cab at meal time. They're high in protein and fiber with a balanced amount of carbohydrates. They also taste like yummy little chips!

These have a very light flavor and are just like eating a rice cake, but without the carbs.  The crunch is good and satisfying, and you'd honestly never know you're eating low carb.  The white cheddar flavor is light but good.
These really help with keeping hunger levels down. They are a little expensive, but they are the best testing ones out there.

column9: alot like Quaker's white cheddar soy crisps that were discontinued
column10: These white cheddar Extend Crisps are so delicious! I'm not even diabetic, but i'm addicted to these high protein/low calorie snacks! They remind me of the white cheddar soy crisps that Quaker used to make...I was super bummed out when they discontinued them...so i'm super excited about these Extend Crisp white cheddar soy crisps!

column9: Very close to the real thing
column10: I really like the Cheddar, and the Cinnamon flavors.  If not for the expense, and the excessive use of shipping materials (necessary so that the chips don't all break), I'd order and eat these more often.
Expensive and not that yummy, I decided not to order this item again, it is always hard for me to understand how a snack item that weighs an ounce can be so costly.
These are "okay" and can give you a fix for a (slightly) salty, crunchy craving. They are not offensive in any way ... just nothin' like the real thing (baby.)

column9: Picky Rescue Dog will eat nothing else but Blue Buffalo
column10: My picky greyhound-shepherd mix I rescued from the pound 2 years ago tried many different foods when I first got her. She wouldn't eat ANYTHING for 2 weeks. Various other brands made her stomach upset or she just wouldn't eat. Now she loves a can of Blue Buffalo stew mixed with a cup of the dry food in Sweet Potato and Fish. This stuff actually smells really good too!

I have looked for sugarfree cherry flavored drinks for years.  Finally, I ran across Wyler's Light Cherry - tasted it and loved it.  I ran out and bought a different brand (Target) and it was awful.  I couldn't find the Wyler's at the store so I bought it from Amazon.  I am grateful that I could find it again.  Yum!
This is the greatest cherry flavor drink mix and I can't find it anywhere! It's great!

I got this honey because I thought it is different from what you get from walmart but actually its taste and smell is  the same and if you are looking for something that tastes and smells like real honey it is not yours.

I'm not going to begin by comparing these to home-made mashed potatoes.  They're not, nor will they ever be.  But they are a very tasty side in their own right.These work great as a quick addition to a meal, or as a snack all on their own.  I eat these for lunch occasionally, and they're great for camping/hunting/etc.  All you have to do is pour them into the container of your choice, and boiled water, and let it absorb.  The nice thing is you don't really have to measure, either.  Just add water until the potatoes are of the consistency you want.  Make sure to stir thoroughly while you do though, because otherwise you may end up with powder spots in the middle which aren't very enjoyable.With the variety pack, you get enough different flavors that you don't get tired of them as quickly, and all of them are fairly good.  Definitely worth it for their taste and convenience.

If you are a comfort food eater, these mashed potatoes cook up one, two, three and are delicious. You only need to add water and they taste as if you put much more work into them. I appreciate the variety pack and Amazon's subscribe program that offers a discount and the choice of how often you want this product automatically delivered.

Due to working two jobs, I needed something that could sit on the shelf without going bad. Found them on sale for $1.00 a pouch at my local grocery store. I have to say I was pleasantly surprised at the quality. With just two cups of water and a microwave safe bowl I had an instant side dish, or on late nights an actual meal. I have tried all the varieties and have liked each one. Quick and easy, perfect for the family on the go that needs to add variety to their meals. I will admit I do add a bit of pepper for a little kick to it, but many will find this perfect straight from the pouch.  I have even added to home made mashed potatoes to stretch them when unexpected guests have shown up for dinner. They are light weight so a great addition to backpacking trips and emergency survival packs. I would recommend this to everyone.
This product is really good till the last bit. Very easy and in 4 minutes you have a great prooduct.

This is the best commercially available beef jerky around. It's drier than most products out there (Pemican, Jack Daniels) and much more authentic. Sadly, it seems that Trader Joe's has stopped carying it and started using their own, inferior brand. Honestly, it'g going to reduce the number of trips I make to trader joe's by 1/2. Anyway, if you like authentic beef jerkey (like the kind you used to find in the glass jars at gas stations) this is the only brand for you!
I love this brand of beef jerky. It's healthy and great tasting snack. I buy snackmasters from gelson in Los angeles and its always fresh and great tasting!

column9: Best beef jerky on the market!!
column10: I love this brand of beef jerky!! It's healthy, high in protein and has low saturated fat!! I always buy from gelsons and have never been disappointed.

I can't claim that this is the best tasting Jerky for anyone since everyone has their own opinion/tastes, but I am not afraid to admit that I buy beef Jerky anytime I see it within reach.Been a huge fan of beef jerky since I was a little kid since I was on plenty of road trips from New Mexico to Colorado because of family.  Jerky was the perfect snack.  From 20 years ago to now, I always have had a passion for Jerky and never surprised by any Jerky until this came around.Was only able to find this Jerky in my company's cafeteria.  Then they stopped carrying it and immediately looked online to find it.  Yes it might be expensive, but its totaly worth it.  Even their customer service is great because one time I got a bad package from the cafeteria and reported it on their site.  They ended up sending me 4 fresh packages (all different flavors) to make up for it.This is worth a try if you want something new.  Unfortunately I can't afford to get this all the time.  Maybe its a good thing because I ordered 2 orders of the Jerky (24 packages) and went through it in 3 days.

I first tried this in CA. It was carried for a while in VA but was no longer carried a few years ago. I hope it continues to sell since it is by far the best beef jerky. It is high quality meat (not too soft, not to fatty) and has a nice flavor.
The jerky is good but the worcestershire sauce is a bit much, it dominates the flavor instead of complementing it.  If your like Worcestershire sauce a lot then you will love this jerky!
I like the Snackmasters Turkey Jerky much better.  The beef was pretty tough, though if you like beef jerky better than turkey it still is one of the few jerkys available that is nitrite free.

I discovered Snackmasters Beef Jerky almost 10 years ago at BJ's.  They stopped carrying it several years ago and now only stock Slim Jim and Pemmican. column9: Foreign Matter Found in Dog Food
column10: I had been feeding Blue Buffalo Wilderness wet food to my dog for about 9 months with mixed results. Two months ago, I noticed white chucks of matter that I did not recognize and had not seen before in the food. After contacting Blue Buffalo customer service, I was told that these items were bone fragments (even though the BB website claims that they use no animal by-products). Last month I discovered a 2" x 3" piece of packing tape/heavy paper inside the can with the wet food. I did a fair amount of research online and decided to stop feeding my dog BB and only use dog food from companies that do not outsource their manufacturing.

column9: Great quality food for my picky eaters!
column10: We switched to all Blue Buffalo grain free food for our dogs after getting a new Frenchie puppy who was raised on grain free food. One of our dogs, a minature schnauzer, is SUPER picky about what he'll eat...some days he'll eat his food other days he won't. Since switching to Blue (we feed a mix of dry Blue Salmon grain free and canned) he eats every time. Also, I LOVE the high quality of this food. Our dogs are our family and it makes me feel good to be able to provide them with such good nutrition. I highly recommend the Blue Buffalo products.

column9: Great for my dog's sensitive stomach
column10: My lab has a very sensitive stomach, and for the first year that we had her we were at the vet every month because we could not get her gastrointestinal system under control.  We were feeding her Purina Pro Plan dry, which is what the breeder started her on, and sometimes it gave her no problems, and sometimes she had horrible diarrhea.  The vet put her on prescription food to make her more regular, which usually worked, and then when we'd switch her back to the Purina she'd be fine for 2 weeks, and then get sick again.  I started looking into alternatives to regular dog food, without wanting to commit to cooking her chicken and rice two times a day or keeping her on the prescription pet food forever.  I found some great reivews of the Blue Buffalo Wilderness formula, tried it, and we haven't looked back.  Right now she's eating a combination of the wet and dry salmon recipe.  It has made her much more regular, we haven't been to the vet for a stomach ailment since we made the switch, and she loves it.  The dry food smells funny, but the wet food smells just like canned salmon that humans would eat.  The appearance of the food is not consistent from can to can, but I think that's okay because that just tells me that the food isn't over-processed.  Even though this food is a little more expensive, it's still cheaper than monthly vet visits and medication.

column9: My dog loved the food but...
column10: The food gave him such bad gas I ended up donating it to my local shelter and going back to his old brand.  Change is not always good! lol

Add a little of this syrup to ice water and you get a fantastic refreshing drink in the summer.  Incidentally, the 0% sugar version is just as delicious!  Growing up in France, I spent many afternoons sitting at cafes sipping this mint drink.  35 years later, it's still as wonderful!
I discover the mint syrup in France and really I love it ! the taste of mint is so great !!Don't hesistate to try it....

I had to have this mint syrup for my home ! Whenever I am in France I order a "menthe au l'eau" which is mint syrup and water and it is a very refreshing and pretty drink ! Fast delivery and nice memeories ! Great seller !

I tried writing a review previously but I focused on how recieving a bottle w a busted cap and dents on my product didnt make me super happy. Its wasnt a HORRIBLE drink, but its not a mint julep to me. It just didnt taste like the ones Ive had. Taste combined w a shabby bottle didnt work for me.
Friend came back from France and brought 2 bottles of this. He let me try some, and lets say I'm addicted. I drink it with milk it reminds me of peppermint in the winter.

Yes it's bright green, yes it is full of sugar, but by gum is this mint syrup delicious! Like several other reviewers, I grew up in Europe where this can be considered a fairly common drink. Most cafés in France, Belgium and even Italy will carry a mint syrup, and no, they don't use it in coffee! Add a dash (or four) to cold water (flat or sparkling) and you have created what is easily one of the most refreshing drinks imaginable. The mint tastes is not overly sugary, making it excellent as a cocktail mixer/modifier (alcoholic or virgin). Use Teisseire mint syrup to add a punch in flavor and presentation!I highly recommend that you give this sirop de menthe a try!!

First of all, I want to start off by saying that I'm not crazy!!!  I am a homebrewer and in my free time I enjoy day dreaming up the next great beer.  One day after eating girl scout thin mint cookies, an idea hit me.  I could add this Mint Teisseire to my Chocolate Stout beer and have a perfect Mint Chocolate Stout!!!!  I've got to say, it turned out perfectly!!!  This mint syrup did not disappoint, even in an odd use such as mine!  To me, that's the mark of quality!  Yummmmm!

Teisseire is a French company that still makes the best syrups out there, with no nasty ingredients in them. High quality products for at least 20 years!Mint syrup is my favorite, and I used to drink a ton of it when I lived in Belgium and France. Add it to ice water or, even better, to sparkling water for delicious, refreshing soft drink. Highly recommended! And if you'd like to try another flavor, get the grenadine flavor (that one can be added to vanilla ice cream for a delicious treat).

We all love Teisseire syrups in our family. I grew up in France and my grand-mother used to serve me these drinks during summer. Now, my parents bring these when they come visit from France for my kids. I love that I can find the syrups on Amazon too as they're pretty heavy to carry in a luggage! My favorite flavors are mint, grenadine and anis. These are the classic flavors but the truth is that they are all amazing. All the fruity flavors are great: strawberry, red fruit, orange, lemon, etc...
Great product, I use it to put steep loose tea in my tea pot.  I've used it for years. The seller got it to me quickly & with no problems.

My cat is a total taste and texture snob when it comes to grain-free options but had no hesitation when we tried this.  He practically inhaled it and seemed satisfied afterwards.  I liked that the texture was larger so he had to work his jaws more than with pate foods.

I'm not a fan of powdered splenda so I was hesitant to try this but am glad I did. I've used this in all my iced tea and coffee drinks this summer and will keep buying it as long as they keep making it.

It kills most fruit or water-based drinks (i.e., horrible in lemonade where it leaves a plasticine finish), BUT it works perfectly fine in lattes, cafe au laits, or just a plain coffee with milk.It is worth a try if you have a coffee every morning... saving yourself from a teaspoon of sugar 365 times each year is an easy weight loss point.

column9: A Really Good Wine For People On A Budget
column10: Cabernet is by far my favorite wine, and I chanced upon Rex Goliath at my local Publix Supermarket, on sale for $6.19 a bottle.  Having recently learned that I have been hired for a great job, I bought a bottle to celebrate.As someone who has become accustomed to Oak Leaf and "Three-Buck Chuck", this was a change for me; spending twice the usual price for wine.  I know, I know, wine snobs will laugh, but try keeping up a wine habit with no income.But I digress...Rex Goliath was uncorked and shared with great enjoyment and delight.  It is very smooth, yet still as full as you expect a Cabernet to be.  I was very pleased with the taste, and the bottle was finished off in quick fashion.I will be purchasing this wine again, gladly.  And now that I am employed again, it can become my every day wine, as it is affordable as well.

column9: Liked it so much I bought stock in the company
column10: Yes, it's true:  I've never been so impressed with a consumer gadget in my life.  In fact, it changed my life, awakening an interest in urban gardening.  Having proceeded to get up to my chin in hydroponics, I bought 5000 shares in Aerogrow (pretty cheap at its current price).I received my first Aerogarden (I have two) as a gift.  The first thing I grew was lettuce.  You don't know what you're missing until you've yanked fresh leaves off of living lettuce right on your kitchen counter to put in your sandwich!  So simple, so fresh (no refrigeration!).  Anyone who buys lettuce regularly should consider replacing that habit with this, the 7-pod Aerogarden.The complaints that interest me the most are those regarding the cost of seed kits, the failure of supplied seeds to germinate, or the failure of plants to grow adequately.  Currently I have one Aerogarden going.  The only Aerogarden-supplied plant in there is a cherry tomato.  The others I supplied myself: three pods are growing miniature Mexican sour gherkins (a sort of miniature cucumber) and another is growing purple tomatillos.  The remaining two pods I am using for experiments.  I asked myself, could I germinate fruit trees in my Aerogarden?  The answer is yes.  An apple seed (simply from a grocery store apple) is now a four-inch "tree", and an orange seed is just starting to get going.  I have also grown small varieties of eggplant and sweet peppers to (delicious!) maturity.  So, I recommend that you acquire your own seeds rather than rely on the Aerogarden seed kits.  (Do consider whether a given plant will fit the dimensions of the Aerogarden.  I started an okra plant in it and it did too well, too fast--for one thing, I didn't know that okra leaves are gigantic!)  In fact, I think the company should give up on the seed kits and just concentrate on selling the basic things you need to plant your own seeds (like the sponges).  They do already offer these items, by the way.The Aerogarden is not a Ronco-like novelty item.  It is simply hydroponics made simple.  There is currently, to my knowledge, no other all-in-one hydroponics setup available.  The closest competitor was the Prepara Power Plant, now no longer manufactured.If you were to put together a similar set-up yourself (which you can do, as the construction is easy to understand), you would find that your $100 would not buy much more than a proper lighting fixture and light bulbs.  Incidentally, the light has a marvelous daylight quality which I find brightens the mood of the room.  This might be a consideration for you if you live far north (esp. in Seattle, I would think!).I haven't noticed any reviews that mention placing an Aerogarden in an office.  While the 3-pod and 6-pod models might be slightly too noise for that setting (they operate on a different principle), the 7-pod model is whisper quiet and would, I think, be just as welcome in an office or lobby as an aquarium.

i love the aerogarden.  sure it's expensive and it takes up a lot of room in my kitchen ... but it's all so worth it.  however, my herbs aren't quite as lush and prolific as the picture on the box might indicate.  nonetheless, i love this product.  so far, all i've tried are the herbs that my aerogarden came with.  also, i should mention that the herbs have a relatively short shelf life of only 4 mos. or so.

It is great to have fresh, clean herbs on my counter top anytime.  As a long-time gardener and cook, I really missed my fresh herbs when winter came.  I bought an aerogrow garden in February and love it.  Now that warm weather is here and I can grow herbs outside, I plan to grow salad greens, bug and dirt free.  The garden looks attractive on the kitchen counter, doesn't take up much room and has been fun for me and my grandaughter.  I highly recommend it. Would make an excellent gift.

I have had the aerogarden for three months. Maybe I am doing something wrong but the yield does not justify the cost. The  seeds cost about $20. Running 100 watts for about 18 hours a day is expensive. You can do much better buying organic food at Whole Foods.It is a good conversation piece.

column4: James Beswick "In my day, we had 9 planets."
column9: A great little unit though not perfect
column10: If, like me, you have little outdoor space and/or lack a green thumb (me too!) you'll be delighted with the AeroGarden. It's more or less fool proof in that you supply water and nutrients when the light flashes on the front. The newer units are very quiet so they're perfect for a kitchen or office and yield maybe $100 of herbs over the course of a harvest. The lights operate on a timer so it really is very simple to operate.Here are a few kinks and quirks:- The life-cycle could last much longer if they gave you more nutrient. While I understand the desire to sell more pods, it's somewhat wasteful to kill the plants just because there's no more feed left.- Some of the seed kits are bland - out of 7 pods, one I ordered had three different types of basil. I like basil but not that much basil! Others have a better variety so definitely check before ordering.- Spiders and bugs do like attacking the plant and I haven't found much information on what to do about this. I had a million little spiders living in the thing during the final harvest so had to dump the crop.- Pods are not foolproof - some simply do not grow. To the manufacturer's credit, they'll replace any that don't germinate so don't forget to contact them if this happens to you.Still it's a good system and I can only believe it will get better with subsequent iterations. If I could buy the pods for half the price or get the nutrient in bulk, it would be perfect, especially given the inflated price of herbs in supermarkets.

going 2 years now. still works great, no problems. I've reordered bulbs and herb seed kits. I have fresh pesto sauce anytime I want. The globe basil is a prolific grower, luckily, pesto sauce freezes well.

Easy to set up after a little head scratching. The universal seed kit plastic holders must really be pressed down to click into place.The system is very simple with automated timers for light and reminder timers for nutrients and water level. Never had such an easy hydroponics system. I am spoiled.Started with lettuce but fortunately knew to thin the extra sprouts in each pod. You still have to know a little about gardening. Lettuce growth is faster than a soil garden. I look forward to my first harvest.

column9: The Classic Garden 7 Pod with Gourmet Herb AeroGarden
column10: I bought the AeroGarden in hopes of starting my own indoor garden since I live in a highrise apartment and off the ground.  I also get the morning sun so growing plants on my balcony is hard to do.  I searched the internet in hopes of a indoor garden for myself and I came accross Amazon.com they had on their site the AeroGarden.  I purchased the AeroGarden and within a few days it arrived and wow!! I'm still impressed with it I put it together the same day I got it wich was March 31/11.  within the first 5 days I saw seedlings.  On April 22/11 I transplanted my plants into a flower pots.  I will purchase another 7 pod black AeroGarden again soon. I had a bit of a problem with setting the timer other than that it was eay to assemble.  I highly recommend the AeroGarden to anyone who wants to start their own indoor Garden.  The AeroGarden is the right thing to own it's the size of a meduim sized plant and it sits on a end table. I bought the Gourmet Herb seeds and I found that the Dill and Mint took the longest to grow but they did come through ok and now they are bigger then the other plants. I'm so happy that I got this AeroGarden it's the best investment I had ever made.
