column9: Video Review By a 3-Year-Old: I Like It
column10: Length:: 1:10 MinsVideo Review by 3-year-old Anders: He likes it. His grandma and dad like it too. Our conclusions:1. Great tasting2. A little tart; very strong flavor3. No sugar added, but still pretty sweet and sticky.4. A new-found favorite. We'll definitely be getting more.

We got the twenty-four-piece multi-pack, which comes with four flavors: Mixed Berry, Tropical Twist, Strawberry, and Sour Apple.The ingredients for the Mixed Berry, Tropical Twist, and Strawberry are:"organic apple puree, organic apple juice concentrate, organic flavor, pectin, colored with fruit and vegetable juice."  Also, some vitamins and minerals are added.Sour Apple ingredients are exactly the same, except there is no coloring added.The "organic flavor" ingredients are not specified, nor are the fruit and vegetable juices used for color.  We can assume that these ingredients do vary among the different flavored fruit ropes, but we don't know what they are.These fruit ropes do not have the fruit taste we thought they should.  Our family didn't like them very much.  They aren't terrible -- we just don't think they're good enough to purchase again; but maybe that's just because we're accustomed to natural foods.The ingredients aren't bad either, but they're nothing exciting -- as far as we can tell, they're just apple (pectin comes from apples) with anonymous color and flavor enhancers (and the supplemental vitamins and minerals).Additionally, among the Tropical Twist flavored fruit ropes were several that had not been packaged properly.  The ropes were sticking out the bottoms of the wrappers, having been squished along with the wrapper when the machinery pressure/heat sealed them.The reviewers who thought these were very chewy must have gotten stale ones.  The fresh ones are on the softer side, but still sticky.  (Braces wearers, beware.)For small, individually-wrapped dried fruit treats, I would recommend Stretch Island fruit leather instead.  These contain the fruits named in their flavors (e.g. the ingredients in Stretch Island's "orchard cherry" fruit leather are: apple puree concentrate, cherry puree concentrate, orange puree concentrate, natural black cherry flavor) and they taste like those fruits, too, without being too sweet or tart or sticky.

This is a great tasting snack that you will never mind giving to your kids. Made out of organically raised fruit, they have lots of the right things (vitamin B & vitamin C) and none of the wrong things (no added sugars, no artificial colors, no preservatives). So, if you are a parent, and want some really good snacks that you will feel good about giving your children, then get Clif Kid Twisted Fruit Ropes. I highly recommend them!

These are great fruit snacks. They are like fruit roll ups but a lot denser. It's organic, all natural and contains no extra sugar and/or high fructose corn syrup or artificial sweetener. They have a nice tart taste and not overly sweet. Flavors included are Strawberry, Sour Apple, Mixed Berry.

column9: My kids love it...they think of it as candy
column10: These are great tasting snacks. I always have some in my diaper bag and my kids think of these as candy.  I've tried different flavors of the Clif Kid twisted fruit ropes and they all seem to be a big hit.  These are better tasting then some of the other fruit treats out there and I feel good about giving these to my kids since they provide a serving of fruit and have no added sugar.  I just wish they would now create one that tasted this good but provided a serving of veggies.
These are pretty good, kind of pricey, and in my opinion not near as good as fruit roll ups. But hey.. fruit roll ups arent 'organic'.

I got the Sour Apple version of the Clif Kid Twisted fruit, and even though I'm not a "Kid" exactly, I still take these to work for lunch.  They do taste good.  The first two ingredients are Apple Puree and Apple Juice, and the rest of the ingredients are added vitamins & minerals (plus pectin and wax to give the juice and puree structure).  Yes I know, these are full of sugar - apple juice concentrate is another way of saying "sugar - apple flavored".  But as far as a sugary treat goes, this one at least has some vitamins and even a smidge of fiber hidden inside.  It's tasty and I get my candy craving out of the way.  It's mostly organic, so I don't have to worry about my treat putting pesticides into the environment.  Maybe a real apple is better for you, but this will do in a pinch.
I bought this product and sent it to my daughter that is currently attending college. She was very grateful for the present and said she really likes it.
Our son is serving with the Army in Iraq and we order this candy on a regular basis as this is his favorite snack.
My whole family LOVES the Clif Twists!  Tropical Twist is one of the big favorites in our house.
My 3 yo and 22 month old enjoy these all the time.  They have been eating them as a snack for about 6 months now.  They are a bit hard so may not work for kiddos w/o teeth.

column9: Best snack and lunch box filler
column10: I really love these Clif fruit ropes and so does my son.  They're easy to pack and not at all messy to eat.  He finds the sour apple a little too sour but I love all the flavors.  For traveling, you can't beat these as a snack. For lunchboxes, they're a great "extra" treat without being too sugary.

I have been craving candy and this is a super answer; they taste great and have super ingredients. Also try Annie's Homegrown Berry Patch Organic Bunny Fruit Snacks, 5-Count Pouches (Pack of 4) I prefer the citrus.

I tried these at the local food coop in New London CT (where you do not have to be a member to shop BTW!), eighty five cents ea. there. Great to satisfy a sweet tooth, no added sugar, very grape-y, sweet and tart. Didn't see any reviews mentioning the grape, so for the naysayers, try those before you write these off your shopping list!

column9: Tart...the adults liked them more than the kids did
column10: The texture is great, really substantial.  I liked that it had a tart taste instead of being really sweet, but none of my kids liked them very much.

This is a great deal for some quick, healthy snacks to go.  My wife and I gobble these down on hikes and just as an everyday afternoon snack.The sour apple is the only one that is just ok.But the rest are great!I can only imagine once we have kids how often we will buy these.Clif is also a quality company that I'm proud to support.
these were all really good except the apple ones.  i only made it through one apple one until i gave the rest away.

I was quite excited when I found these.  Organic, made of real fruit instead of sugar and high fructose corn syrup, and cheaper than the Fruitabu rolls that my girls had been eating.  These are great in concept, and the taste is great, but unfortunately, my daughters prefer to unroll fruit snacks, rather than just bite the end of fun twisty things.I would -definitely- continue to buy them, if only my girls would eat them consistently.

column9: Not the most nutritious but better than others
column10: I realize that these snacks sort of straddle the line between fruit and candy, but they are better than most "fruit roll-up" type snacks with all the added sugar. At least these ones have no added sugar and are mostly fruit.My kids like all four of the flavors in the multi-pack, including the Sour Apple which I had thought they would reject. I personally find it way too sour for me but they love it!These snacks are individually wrapped which makes them great for tossing in a lunchbox or taking along on outings. And they are thicker and chewier than most "fruit leather" or similar type snacks, which makes them more satisfying to eat. I find them a pretty good compromise in terms of price, nutrition value, and taste.

It's a great way to get organic fruit!! ALL the flavors except the sour apple were loved by all my grandchildren and me.  No one liked the sour apple.  Next time I'll order  boxes with one flavor at a time.

I worried that these would be like some other fruit strips we've tried and hated. Some fruit strips taste like they have a helping of sand added to the mix. But not these! They taste awesome and are not grainy at all. The kids LOVE them. I love them, too. And they are not strips at all but a large twist (think Red Vines only fatter and better). We got the variety pack and haven't had a bad flavor in the entire box. They are super fruity, slightly tart, but still sweet. The texture isn't too soft or gummy. They're just right. These make great snacks for school or anytime. I'll definitely be ordering them again and again.

column9: A nice alternative to sugary fruit rolls
column10: We purchased the variety pack (strawberry, mixed berry, tropical, and sour apple) and overall are quite pleased with these. My daughter really enjoys the strawberry, berry and tropical flavors. However, no one likes the apple. It's not the sour factor (I love sour things), there's a weird bitter aftertaste in this particular flavor that's not appealing. I love how dense and chewy each rope is; they're surprisingly filling and are a very nice healthy alternative to the regular 'fruit' rolls on the market. We'll definitely be buying these again, although next time I'll buy each flavor separately to avoid the apple.

Our family loves these fruit ropes.  They are very chewy and tasty, and because of the way they are wrapped, you don't get your hands or mouth sticky eating them.  The are a great snack for when you are on-the-go.  The price on Amazon, with the free shipping, by far is the best price for these I have been able to get.  We just buy two boxes at a time to get the free shipping.  Highly recommended!

I would highly recommend these in place of fruit rolls ups or other gummy fruit snacks that are full of sugar. These are all fruit, no added sugar and have a strong, excellent, fruity-tarty taste. I like them as much as my granddaughter. Walmart used to carry them. I requested that they continue stocking them but have not had any luck. So I have to purchase them from Amazon.com. A bit expensive but delicious and healthy!

These tasty treats are great alternatives to the gluten packed fruit snacks etc. They are all natural and organic. My daughter (2 1/2) loves them and I prefer she eats these over the sugar filled snacks
I was excited to see these on Amazon. My kids love these fruit ropes & I have a hard time finding them in the store.
I was very disappointed in these. I love fruit snacks, these did not measure up.

column9: My kid didn't like them...but I loved them.
column10: My 4 yr old daughter disliked these. But, I have been snacking on them since I received them. I must say they are a little on the tart side and perhaps that is why she disliked them. Yet they fit my tastes just perfectly.

We love these fruit snacks! They are a great, healthy "sweet" snack for the kids and I am very happy that they are organic. These sell for 0.99 each in the store so they are a great deal on Amazon. The flavors are very tasty, but sour apple is my least favorite (it's quite sour).
These are like the Gerber graduate fruit twists but better quality and taste along with a better price. I highly recommend them if you kid likes fruit bars.

This is a great alternative to the "juicy treats" as my soncalls them, that are marketed for toddlers. My son loved all theflavors and the are easy to eat on the run without a big mess.Its nice to give snack thats a healthy alternative when regularfresh fruit isn't an option. Thanks for offering them at such agreat price!!
I love these! My boyfriend and I ate the whole box in a week. I just ordered more. They taste great and they are better for you than a lot of other fruit snacks.

These are absolutely wonderful.  Well- my son likes them, anyhow... I don't really.But, they are so much healthier than the awful fruit snack you can buy in the grocery store.  There is nothing in these besides fruit.  I am not a 'health nut'- but I do try to avoid high fructose corn syrup, and unnecessary sugar.  Which makes getting things for my son's lunch very difficult.Anyhow, my son has one of these in his lunch almost every day.  His teacher noticed that his fruit snack was actually made of fruit- and so has been recommending them to parents- (his school has a 'no candy' lunch policy, and the fruit snacks that you can buy in the grocery store fall into the candy group).They are expensive.  I don't particulary like them myself (I've never liked fruit snacks of any sort though, so that isn't indicitive of the product's worth at all!).  I find that they leave my son with sticky hands.Even with those negative points- they are still a 5 star snack.  They are healthy, and my son loves them- what more I can ask?

column4: T. Bowles "vegan child of the King"
column10: i got the variety and they were all tasty and sour apple was sour but it was nice to know i was eating something healthy i would definitely recommend them for anyone wanting a healthy snack

MAde by the great brand that does adult snacks now for kids. all natural and organic. have great flavor and are good for you. my kids love them and I have ate a few myself. definately worth the price when u compare it to the cheaper not good for them fruit snacks.
These taste better and have better texture than fruit rollups.  My kids will pick these anyday!  I love them too!  We went through 2 boxes in 2 weeks!
A little expensive but very convenient.  My 5 year old would eat the whole box if I let him (and he is a super picky eater).

column9: Pass if your child has reflux
column10: These twits are good but VERY sour (at least the strawberry ones are) as they are made with apple juice concentrate. I gave up on the idea of giving them as a snack to my little girl who has reflux... Apple juice is not easy on little tummies suffering from reflux.

I bought the 24 piece variety pack and each of my four kids did not finish their rope. We eat a lot of organics but they each turned up their noses at these. They are very soft and sticky but there is not a lot of taste. Fruitabu and Stretch Island are better.
my 2 yr old grandson loves these and asks for them.  he does not seem to find them too tart at allmuch cheaper than buying the gerber fruit strips .

column9: Great fruit snacks; not just for kids
column10: It's nice to see Clif branching out into a different range of products (like not just energy bars) without sacrificing the quality of ingredients that go into them.  These fruit snacks were great; nice flavor, not too small or too big, and obviously made from real strawberries.  There's not much else to say, other than that I'm not a kid and I'd buy these for myself.  Don't judge me!

One of our favorite treats especially on the go and it's good for you.  One of these fruit ropes meets the daily requirement for a piece of fruit.  Obviously, it is best to eat fresh fruit.  If you don't have the time or have a little one who is picky, then these are great.  Mixed Berry and Strawberry are my favorites with just the right mix of sweet and tart.  Personally, I can't stand the Sour Apple, but luckily my kid likes it.  Looking forward to trying all of the other flavors!

column9: "Daddy the fruit rope makes my tummy hurt."
column10: What can I say, I got caught up when this was a gold box item and I didn't take the time to research the product.  Essentially these 0.7 ounce about 60 cent each fruit ropes are pulverized apple guts and apple juice with a few other vitamins and flavors.  They may be organic, but they weren't well received in our house.  The line above is from my three year old after she ate one. We'll stick to real fruit (fresh and dried) from now on.

My 26 month old son LOVES these! He used to like the Gerber graduates fruit strips and twists, and still does, but prefers these if he has a choice. I've tried one of these myself and they taste good for adults too. The only bad thing about these.... my son keeps asking for more!!!
Great, quick snack for my toddler.  He loves them and I feel "good" about giving it to him.

While I was pregnant with my son I constantly carried fruit leather. Not this product, but similar. Remembering and wanting some I went searching for them and found these instead. My children LOVE them. They call them candy. They are even better than the fruit leather since the texture is easier for my children. THey are good for them, taste good, and now I can use them as rewards when my children ask for Candy. Personally, I like all of the flavors I've tried (have not tried pineapple). My children have one or two each that they do not prefer, but this is all a matter of Personal Tastes. I recommend these to everyone I know with children as a candy substitute and to all of my friends as a healthy snack to carry around that will also satisfy their sweet tooth. If you don't like the first flavor you try, try another since they really are a great product. I can not buy this brand locally for less than a $1 each, but they are worth it. Candy costs the same, so why not pay to get something Good for you?
Bought it for the kids to enjoy. Only sour apple was a hit with the kids. Rest of them i finshed it. I loved it. My 2 cents... but it for Adults, not for the kids to be guranteed hit
I loved these just as much (possibly more) than my 4 year old.  Have them on subscribe and save and can't wait to get the next shipment.  They're definitely a little sour and chewy, but awesome!
I feel better giving this to my daughter than other fruit snacks with artificial colors/flavors.  It also tastes good!

My daughter loves these snacks. She doesn't care if something is sour she will eat it if she thinks or knows its a snack just for her. I love these because they are better for her than majority of the other fruit type snacks out there and they are organic. They aren't as sticky or messy as other items in their group either which I love. I can keep a few in my purse on busy shopping days and just hand her one is her car seat and she is happy for a good while. I recommend them to any parent looking for a healthy and tasty snack for their kids.

This is a really great snack for kids.  The fact that they are organic is a big plus and it takes no arm-twisting at all for the kids to eat them.  Only complaint I have is that they are a bit expensive.
My daughter loves these and they're good for you too....Even I've become addicted to them.

Ordered these for my daughter and ended up sharing them with my autistic niece who is on a gluten free, dairy free, dye free diet.  No dairy, no gluten and no food coloring in these only natural fruit, a tiny bit sour but great tasting for entire family!!!

Clif Kid Twisted Fruit Ropes Variety Pack Of Strawberry, Tropical Twist, Sour Apple, And Mixed Berry, 0.7-Ounce Wrappers (Pack of 24) This is a great product. Bought them for my grandkids, and ate them myself--best tasting 1 serving of fruit especially as a lunch or snack at work. Or about any other time. Nice and soft, could eat it with  my braces.
Organic, soft, and chewy.  Perfect snack at a much better price than in stores.

column9: The whole family loves this product!
column10: We love these fruit ropes so much that we bought 2 boxes instead of one. They taste great, not too sweet & great texture that makes us feel like we are eating candy! My kids are 13 yrs., 16 yrs and 19 yrs. and they all love them. I wish the product was around when they were younger!

My kids can't get enough of these twisted fruit ropes.  The price is great as they go for 99 cents a piece at my local grocery store.  They are convienient too.  I keep some in my bag and in the glove box in the car for when the kids want a snack on the go.
My daughter loves these fruit twists . I was pleased to find them in bulk at a great savings , in the super market they cost nearly a dollar each!!!

I ordered the Sour Apple twists and they were delicious!  Very dense and chewy.  I expected them to be more artificial-tasting, almost like Sour Straws, but they were quite fruity.  These are worth the extra cost.
these are sooo good!! i couln't stop eating them! I was looking for a snack that was healthy and organic and this snack is so good my fav is mixed berry! :)
my four kids ages from 4-14 all like them, of course they have their favorite flavors.  i am very serious about what i let them eat and you have to have the good stuff available

These are the best snack ever!  They are delicious and don't have the bad ingredients some other fruit snacks do.  I usually buy these at Costco because it's cheaper there but there have been some great promotions on Amazon.

column9: Yuck! Have a funny after taste.
column10: I love the packaging for this brand, but yuck!  The flours used in this mixes has a really bad after taste.  They were so bad we threw the whole pancake batch out and the rest we didn't use.  If I could give it no stars for taste I would.  The only good is the healthful organic ingredients part of the mixes.

I would recommend this product to anyone who enjoys trying new recipes for snacks and appetizers.  It is great with meatballs and wings.  Can add plenty of ingredients to it to change it to make it spicier or sweeter.  Love it.

column9: Cattlemen's Carolina Tangy Gold BBQ Sauce
column10: Cattlemen's Gold BBQ sauce is a tangy, mustand and honey dipping sauce and basting sauce. It is particularly FANTASTIC on grilled chicken! It is the sauce that many local restaurants serve and gives you a new taste to mundane chicken at home!
I was expecting it to be a little "zingier" which it was not but it was still good.  My mother went to the McIlhenny factory and brought some product back for me; this is what led me to purchase.
The overall flavor is ok, but there isn't nearly enough spicy heat from the tabasco. When put on a sandwich, one can barely taste the spicy heat at all.

column9: Oh so good Gimmee Jimmee's cookies
column10: I first received Gimmee Jimmee's cookies from the salesman after I bought a new car from Freehold Ford in Howell, NJ as a thank you. They are very delicious cookies. Packed very well and always received fresh. The chocalate chip and oatmeal are to die for. I have gone on to send their cookies to others to commerate birthdays, get well etc. I think you will be pleased with your purchase if you give them a try.Blanche

Of the two that I have already made, this was difinatly the best.  Has great color and very nice flavor.  You get everything in this kit.  This and the other wine I ordered made me decide to try two other ones that I am putting together as we speak.  I dont think you can go wrong with this wine if you like Reds especially.

What a great kit.  The directions are easy and the results are delicious.  I am very happy with the price.  It is an additional savings that the corks are included.  Friends are impressed by the presentation (labels and cork covers) and I feel like a vintner.  I am making a Gewurzraminer now and ordering more kits.

column9: Cheap wine at a great price.
column10: My family likes the wine and I like making it.  I do some changes ie 5.5 gallons and raisins.

This kit is good for the price. It was easy to follow instruction. I love the fact that it included labels & corks. The wine has good taste, but does not have much body. I'll probly try some more kits from Vino Italiano, but will most likely make 5 gal instead 6.
Great wine, have been making wine for years from kits and fresh fruits. I worked it longer than 4 weeks, added oak cubes instead. Very good wine! Will buy again, amazingly fast shipping.
read the directions and you cant fail. Yep you do have to buy the carboy and some parts. Its a hobby and its fun.

I think this wine is the best deal I've seen on Amazon. I've made several fruit wines from fresh fruit over the last couple of years, and wanted to try making a kit grape wine for some time. The $120 price tag on the premium kits are a bit steep for a first-timer. You can't beat the price on these Vino Italiano kits, and the corks alone retail for $7.50.Following some suggestions for other Vito Italiano reds, I made mine to 5.25 gallons in the primary. I've racked mine at least 3 times so far, so I just add water to top them up during racking. I added 2 oz. oak chips for 3 weeks. At the latest racking, it still has good body and a strong, but young flavor. I'm looking forward to tasting this after a few months in the bottle.Once I have a few of these made, I'll have the confidence to order a premium kit. Having these cheaper kits available will give the premium kit time to age out as well

I purchased 4 of these kits to make wine for my June wedding. I added oak chips as recommended from another review and "WOW" what a great tasting wine... Very, very happy and cant wait to try it once it ages a few months. I have the Tropical Riesling fermenting now and cant wait to try that as well. The corks, labels and shrink caps are great. Really impressed for the money and will be buying more of these for sure!!!!
I only just started to drink the Donut de-caf and like it very much as do I the regular! this will always be my favorite.
I think this is my favorite kind of coffee, I prefer it to both Starbucks and Dunkin. The only problem is having to restrain myself from having too much.
Good for a regular non flavored coffee.  Not too strong but not too weak. Great keurig coffee cups for the price.

Awesome taste. Awesome product. Awesome service. Just awesome! I always loved the raisin bran from Kelloggs and never tried from Post. I have to tell you, try this and you will agree with me. Awesome!
First time I'd tried Post Raisin Bran. Fresh, tasty and plenty of raisins.Convenience shopping and nothing bad to say at all!Look for deals... some of them are very good.This cereal is very good. :)
I like Raisin Bran for what it provides, fiber and taste. The raisins do provide some sweetness and also fiber. I have been eating this cereal for many years and highly recommend it.
Delivered to my front door with no cost to me. Priced less then I would have had to pay at any store. Fresher then the cereal I find at the stores. No tax. What more could I ask for?

The coffee is very good. My whole family thinks it is great. I am not happy with the price that I was charged. I paid $5.99 for the coffee in California at a grocery store, and on your website it cost's $7.50.

I purchased 2 packages of this coffee and was shocked when it arrived after I read the ingredients. Tongkat Ali is touted for its many health benefits.But this coffee has creamer made with "HARDENED VEGATABLE FATS (coconut, palm kernel Oil)" How could they put this terrible oil in what is supposed to be a healthy product? Do not buy this product if you are looking for health benefits. I also purchased from the same vendor 2 packages of their "Gold Choice Instant Tongkat Ali Ginseng Coffee" and it does not look any healthier with a "mixture HYDROGENATED VEGETABLE FATS". Why couldn't they let us put our own creamer in? Why did they have to ruin this coffee with terrible HARDENED VEGATABLE FATS?Also, I purchased several packs at one time because of the expensive shipping charges it made sense to get more packages and pay a little extra shipping. However, now I have to pay return shipping and an 18% restocking fee!I will remember this next time I am buying something that is supposed to be healthy yet they do not list the complete list of ingredients. They listed the good ingredients on the website but failed to mention the BAD ones!

column9: Great service- I love the product..thank you
column10: I got my order promptly -the quality is great and I need to get me some more...thank you.... M.K.
These new protein bars are good, but not as good as the Crispy Chocolate South Beach protein bars that were discontinued.  The crispy ones were much bigger, and there were 6 in the box instead of 5.
I love these bars.  They are very tasty, low in calories, sugar, carbs and fat.  Also, they don't make a mess when you eat them. I always keep them on hand.

column9: South Beach Diet Meal Bar, Chocolate Flavored, 5-Ct (Pack of 8)
column10: South beach is a great protein bar and hard to find in stores, but AMAZON comes through as usual. Thanks to William Beaudin (WeSell4Less) for a day earlier delivery than estimated.  Small issue, but has to be noted, one of the 8 boxes of 5 is missing 2 bars and the box was in pristine, untampered with condition.  So should that cost William Beaudin a whole star, or any star, I don't think so. I am going with the "fluke theory" that there's no way for anyone to know this occurred but for possibly someone at the factory!  South Beach Diet Meal Bar, Chocolate Flavored, 5-Count (Pack of 8); I paid $48 / 40 bars = $1.20 each. $2.40 due back or 2 bars due here! Thanks, that's it. Signed, Sandbox (the MRS) for the guy buying.

I purchased the South Beach Diet Meal Bar, Chocolate flavored to try out different protein bards. It only has 12g of protein which is high for regular bars, but low compared to protein bars which have around 20g of protein. I like that it has 9g of fiber which should help me feel full. The calories are only 180. I'm not sure if this bar is suppose to replace a meal. The calories are extremely low as a meal replacement, but could work if it doesn't make me feel hungry afterward. I'll have to try that. I eat the meal bars as a snack. The flavor is crunchy, and decently good tasting for a protein bar. But it could taste better. The price for these bars are quite expensive so I probably won't buy these again.
We got these in hopes of getting some more protein in our kids diets.  It worked - they love them!
These are sooooo good. I can't believe they are actually VEGAN!! They are such a wonderful treat and don't taste artificial or like a health food at all. LOVE THIS PRODUCT

Finally a vegan cookie that has flavor options and have some good, nutritional stuff in them. We've tried all of the flavors of these and they are all delicious. Pumpkin is my personal favorite.  My daughter's favorite is the lemon poppy, my husband the peanut butter and my son the chocolate/chocolate chip. We just buy them all now. :) We are vegan and there is no sign of animal products that we can find. These need to be split in two, but we love to share in our house anyway. I sometimes split mine in two and eat 1/2 with my coffee and then half for dessert later. They have so much fiber and protein in them, I'm surprised at how good they are.

These cookies, I normally like.  I ordered them from here a few months ago.  I still have five left.  I would have more, but I was forcing myself to eat them.  Even after warming them up for 15 seconds, they were still hard, and just not enjoyable.  Normally I like these cookies, but for whatever reason, when I order them off Amazon, sometimes they come to me stale.  Definitely not getting these again, as it happens most often with the Double Chocolate and the Oatmeal Raisin.

column9: Taste bad but it's good for you
column10: The cookie was dry, bland, and over just nasty. It's not what I expected especially after having both the chocolate chip cookies and the muscle brownies.
These cookies are dry and not very flavorful.  While it can be nice to have a quick and easy vegan snack, at over 400 calories each, I can find better alternatives!

I have been using this for months making cookies that my husband takes to work to sell for me. I have had absolutely wonderful results. This stuff is great! No changes in my dough and fantastic flavor. I get more requests for my Orange Cream Angel cookies than anything! My cookies do rise a bit like they are supposed to. This has been my experience and I would buy again. I don't know where the stars are on my comment here, but I rate it a 5!

I bought this emulsion to enhance the flavor of my orange and vanilla bean sugar cookies and was told by experienced bakers it would NOT change the consistency of my cookie but it did! They didn't rise as they usually do - the flavor was definitely there but they didn't rise as they usually do! Since I can't return the product, I will use it in my buttercream and cakes but definitely not for my sugar cookies.

This is such a great gift and HUGE bang for your buck if you compare this price to other licorice gift baskets. It's like the box was bottomless, more and more things kept appearing, it's chockfull of items, so so happy and such a steal!

column9: Even Bigger than it Looks in the Picture!
column10: This is a great assortment of licorice-flavored products.  The box is even bigger than it appears in the photo, and is very cute. All of the pictured items are included.  This makes a great gift for anyone who loves licorice!
This extract was a little better than the other extracts I purchased. However, the maple flavor was very faint. I ended-up using regular maple syrup and threw this away.

column4: A. Tran "happiness makes up in height, for wh...
column9: High Quality but flavor profile may not be to your liking
column10: This product is impressive. On the tin can, it lists the following:Classified D.O.P. - by the European Union. The D.O.P symbol guarantees superior quality and integrity of this product. Olive variety "Koroneiki".Awards: Great Taste Awards - UK, 1 star gold award, 2008etc etc - the awards go onThe MOST IMPORTANT PART...Flavor Profile - peppery, green fruits, bitter almond, green appleAND MY GOD, THIS OIL TASTES EXACTLY LIKE THE DESCRIPTION.Do I care for it? Not really. I wish someone had listed the profile earlier so I could know BUT the product is exactly as it says.I hope this helps someone make the right decision.
I purchased this as a sale item for use where a fine-tasting olive oil is appropriate. It is more delicate than most and has little bitterness. An excellent buy.

This is delicious olive oil and it's a HUGE can! I bought this on lightning deal to have a "dipping" olive oil. It definitely fits the bill. It's wonderful for dipping nice bread in. I was expecting it to taste like kalamata olives, but it is actually from Kalamata, Greece and just tastes like regular nice olive oil.

This is a terrific olive oil, with robust Greek flavor, well balanced acidity, and is nimble; it's just as at-home in the saute pan is it is drizzled on fresh greens.  I'm not a big celebrity chef groupie, and I was skeptical that this oil bore the name of a celeb chef - even one I like to watch - but I'll give it to Chef Cora.  She chose to endorse a terrific product. This is a delicious oil and well worth the price.

column9: Excellent oil for salads or breads.
column10: I normally order from a local olive grove but due to a poor season, the production was down.  Step in Amazon and Cat Cora's olive oil - excellent oil and does indeed have a peppery taste that enhances the flavors of salads and breads.  I also loaded up the Misto sprayer and have been using it in sauteing vegetables and eggs.  We are very satisfied and for the price, it is a deal!
I really liked this EVOO.  Thought it had a great flavor.  We used it in everything, but where it is really good, is in salads.  Great stuff!

Well now a days it is difficult to buy anything for under $20 bucks..if you like a robust olive oil that taste as described this is it, the Italians are good but to match the quality you will need to double the price. I use it on everything but grilled meats and cold waterfish like sardines it brings them to another level, it is amazing when it reaches a warmer temperature provided by what you have just grilled all the aroma and flavors come alive ,also on salads,bread(bruscheta)Oh and on top of a good quality feta cheese...Delizioso...this oil taste like it just been pressed. A great find!

Although it was kind of expensive for oreos, it was well worth it as a gift for my boyfriend. He ate the whole thing! He said they were very very good! Im going to keep them in mind for future gift giving times!

The product is very bland to start with, and the few tidbits of clams included (believe the most i noticed in any given can was 5 pea size or smaller pieces), just leaves too much to be desired. What a disappointmentin this product to say the least, it may be healthy, which I don't reallybelieve, but there is certainly little quality except in the outrageous profit margin! Oh, but plenty of potatoes to fill the space, and they aren't very tasty either! Final thought, if you don't wish to be irritated, avoid this product, unless you like exceptionally overpricedoverrated and overvalued items!!
Pro: a convenient low fat clam chowderCon: it tastes like a can of low fat clam chowder

column9: Very watered down, does not taste like clam chowder
column10: Purchased a case b/c it was on sale just to try it.  Taste very bad. I had to add whole milk just to make it taste creamier.  I would not buy again.

I love new england clam chowder, and when I can buy a healthy version of it as opposed to the more fattening ones, and have it be just as good if not better, I'm all over it like white on rice! Healthy Choice has come through with another fine product....I will definitely be buying this one again :-)

This product tastes okay; not great. It's definitely not the same texture or taste of Chunky New England Clam Chowder Soup. Once you add enough Saltines and pepper to the soup it tastes better but it's more watery and bland because it's healthier.

One word: Boo.  I wish I had read these reviews before I spent my money on this garbage.  The Campbell's Healthy Choice clam chowder is a total waste of cans.  One has to do way too to make up for all of the things removed to make it "healthy".  Don't spend your money.  Either go for the regular Campbell's or Progresso.

column9: pretty good, i'd buy it again
column10: I thought this was one of the better flavors of healthy choice soup, i just added a little pepper to give it a kick.  not bad, and it's healthy!

If you must eat low sodium this product is OK, but my husband and I found it lacking in flavor, and a little thin for chowder.  Expected low salt but couldn't taste the clams.  I assume there are some in there but not much.

I am not a finicky eater, and I love most soups. This stuff is terrible. Very thin consistancy, very few potatoes, an occasional bit of celery, ALOT of clam grit. I don't mind an occasional CRUNCH with my clam chowder, but with EVERY bit of clam? The taste is so bland (well of course - low sodium) I am giving the remaining cans to our local food bank. I am not even going to waste my time trying to "doctor it up." Weird that I feel guilty about donating food, but there it is.
Probably the worst soup I've had. Potatoes in goo.  Campbell's makes a low fat NE Clam Chowder far superior.  I couldn't get through the 12 cans.
Nothing special about this item. Tastes fairly bland. It is not bad but just not anything special and not worthy of buying again.

column9: Delicious, just the can isn't large enough
column10: Healthy Choice New England Clam Chowder Soup, 15-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)Delicious Clam Chowder. The only drawback is there isn't enough in the can.

Yep, this is thin clam chowder; that's why it's Healthy Choice and doesn't have a lot of calories compared to others.  I am watching my calories and I really like this; it's what I usually go for when I want some soup.
I like this chowder with crackers and sometimes I just heat it and pour it over a baked potato.

i still cant believe this is so low fat! the web page lists the total fat at 3g/can, which is already low, but its actually even lower [2g/can] - and it tastes just like the full fat versions! obviously it does have lactose though, so if you're intolerant like me, take a lactaid pill beforehand and you should be fineand at under $2/can [with subscribe and save], free shipping, and 2 min microwave prep time, it couldnt be a cheaper, easier, tastier meal

column9: Five stars for a light soup, but cans come dented.
column10: Excellent flavor and it's filling.  A whole can is only 220 calories and 2grams of fat.  How do they do it?

column9: Yummy yummy yummy - this stuff's a honey!
column10: Growing up in Georgia, I've eaten a lot of honey.  This stuff is awesome.  The Sourwood is my favorite; the honey has a really complex flavor that's of course sweet (after all, it IS honey) but much more mellow than many of the honeys I buy (such as Orange Blossom, even Wildflower).  I've been using it in a variety of teas (by the way, I love Teavana) and it's awesome.  This honey's addictive - I could eat it all day long (of course, I'd be bouncing off the walls, but at least I'd be happy!).I've bought this locally in Atlanta, but am so glad it's avaialable on Amazon as it's easier than hunting for it (usually only the higher-end stores carry it).
Very good honey, has a nice deep taste, can taste this is a pure and natural product.Bottle is great for easy use.

I bought sourwood honey from the company's president at Peachtree Center in Atlanta last week and let me tell you, this stuff is worth every penny it costs - delicious, clean taste, sweet but not cloying, and a perfect topping to a buttered biscuit or in a cup of organic tea. I couldn't recommmend the product or the seller more highly. Get some!
This is one of the best tasting Honeys you would ever want. I buy a lot of honey and this by far is one of my favorites. YOU WON'T BE DISSAPOINTED IN THIS HONEY.GREAT GREAT

So these are jelly with little pieces of lychee, pretty simple and delicious, but its way too overpriced here. You can find it online at other stores for $6 for the same sized box. Don't buy it from amazon.

I first had these when a Chinese co-worker brought some in...  First taste: Think perfume-scented Jell-o.  Odd, fragrant, unsure.  Second taste:  A little better, but still unsure.  Third taste: Hooked!  They are an acquired taste, but I crave them all the time.  Two jellies are the perfect pick-me-up anytime during the day.  I can't really eat more at a time and fewer somehow falls short.  I finally found some in an Asian market in Florida for way cheaper than here... bummed at the price.  Still, you can't go wrong with these!  My wife hates 'em.
These are not exactly like the ones I remember eating in Dubai, but they're quite tasty. These would be great for kids, just serve them up cold!!
I love these jellies and so do my children.  They were shipped promtly and I revieved them within 2 weeks of placing my order, I will definatly be ordering these again.
These are so good. The flavor is not strong, but I find myself craving them. The only problem is that my teenage son loves them too. I need to get some more fast!

column9: actual food and even the cat likes it
column10: My dog is allergic to grains so I have to look for grain free products for her - this stuff is great - simple ingredients and she loves it.  I mix some in with her dry food and the cat noses in and tries to get some  before the dog can eat it all up.  I would say that is some pretty good dog food.

My pomeranian loves this food. I mix it with her Wellness dry and she always cleans the dish.There are chunks of sweet potato in the food she loves sweet potatoes. I know this is a healthy nutritious brand of dog food.

I purchased this in a local health foods store, and loved it right away. I've tried other almond milks, and always found them to have a gritty or grainy aftertaste. Not so with this drink. It's very smooth. I could have this in cereal or my fave chai latte's or straight out of the box. Love it!

I saw this product at a local store and tried it.  I couldn't believe how good it is.  It practically tastes like cow's milk to me and I thought it was superior to unsweetened almond milk.  I enjoy it in coffee as well as straight up.  I am glad to find it available on Amazon.

I tried it, and it was good. Interesting, but I would rather buy the straight up unsweetened blue diamond almond milk. I am a simple guy, what can I say. It was on the prime shipping thats why I tried it. Would not buy again only because Its not my favorite plain almond.

I've been making pizza at home for over 30 years. I have eaten pizza all over Italy. All the good pizza books recommend double zero flour.This is the best flour I've ever used. Case closed.PS. Use San Marzano tomatoes, fresh mozzarella, and fresh basil on your pizza. Do it, period!

This by far is the best Flour if you want a great pizza.If you are into making your owen pizza dough this is the flour to use. Its a bit pricy but it is worth the extra cost for the best pizza dough. Enjoy!

This is great 00 flour for making pasta, and yes- you can tell the difference in your home made pasta between this and regular flour off the store shelf. The price was better than I could find anywhere else online, and unfortunately the only retailer selling it wanted twice per pound what this cost.  Delivery was quick too!

column9: The only flour to use for Authentic Italian Pizza
column10: There is no question about it - this is the authentic Pizza Dough flour to use - Our family was in the restaurant business 40 years - Italian Family - this is the real thing!  Enjoy!

I love this flour!  I initially learned of OO flour by watching the food channel.  I had never used it before and just thought that I would give it a try.  I am so glad that I did.  It is a bit pricey but the flavor definitely makes up the extra money that you spend on it.  If you make your own pizza crust or pasta noodles, I would recommend giving this flour a try.

I guess I do!  I didn't think there was a difference in "bread" flour, but based on many tries with many different flours and recipes for pizza on the grill this pizza flour really does make the best pizza dough.  It was easy to mix, pliable, rose very nicely, and most of all, baked very well.  I can't really believe I'm buying special flour to make pizza on the grill, but I am, and will continue to do so!

I think it is okay.  If you are in America, just stick with bread flour or all purpose.  If you have 00 in your local store, try it out, it is okay.  It makes a good thin crust pizza.  You will need a really hot oven to go with it.  I like "all purpose" better.  You may be better off with a "special" yeast as well.  I use Red Star and it just doesn't rise like I expect.  I don't need ten bags of any flour when I order anyway.  Try it, maybe you will like it better than me.  It is much better than whole wheat flour for pizza. 00 does okay. All purpose is better for pizza.

column9: Good flour, not the best for pizza.
column10: This is an excellent flour, but not the best for pizza.  This is more suitable for pastry, whereas the Type 0 flour would provide a better texture for pizza crust.

I have had a life-time love affair with peppermint.  And, by far, these peppermint filled straws are some of the most delicious that I have ever tasted!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!When I received my order, not one of my peppermint stripe filled straws were broken.  It was very well packaged, fresh, and, it is hard to stop at just one peppermint.  I usually eat 3.Anyway, buy it and try it.  You will not be disappointed.
Would have been great for baking or making ice cream, as most of the mints were smashed beyond all recognition.

I was really reluctant to give these treats to my cat. It's really important to me that she eats a very healthy diet, and while I'm not doing the raw food diet, I do scrutinize labels for meat by-products, BHA, and useless fillers. With that said, my cat couldn't care less for those "healthy" treats that had passed my inspection. I have a cupboard full of treats I felt comfortable giving her that she ended up saving so she could play with them later. So, out of desperation, I bought these; a treat is, after all, a treat. And she goes berserk over them. She's runs to the kitchen whenever I simply open a cupboard, hoping I'm about to give her one of her precious treats. I've also finally taught her to Come on command! And, to be honest, other treats (including this brand's regular treats) have a lot worse ingredients.

I have 4 cats and finding a treat that all of them will eat has been impossible for years.  I decided to try these, and every cat, including the finickiest of the 4, LOVES these treats.  I give each cat 2 of the treats in the morning, and they gobble them up.I gave these 5 stars because they serve their purpose well, which is making my cats think they're getting something special every day.  Keep in mind, these are not as healthy as some of the high end treats that contain no meal or by-products, so I don't want to mislead anyone on the health value.  Moderation and coupled with a high quality food, these make a nice little treat.Once these are gone, I will try some of the other flavors in the All Natural line; however, the Free Range Chicken Flavor will always be in my cupboard.  If you try these, I hope your cat(s) enjoys them as much as mine do.

I bought this All Natural Temptations Wild Alaskan Salmon Flavor Treats for Cats by accident thinking they were treats for dogs  But, my MinPin, Bandit, thinks their the greatest treat in the world.  I can get him to do anything for a few of these!! He would probably even stand up and dance. He's crazy about them!!! It's not just a one time thing either, as I had to go back and buy a few more packages of them. He is so picky about everything else. They should advertise for Cats and Dogs also.
My cat is very happy to eat them.  I start opening the bag, she comes running.

spoiled little sensitive stomach shelter kittie, begs for these when the bag is first opened because the outside IS crunchy and theinside is creamy. He carefully studies his little cache of 3 or 4 and nibbles each one slowly, savoring w his eyes closed. He dropped one and with a petulant mew jumped down from his chair and went searching for it. He 'talks' to himself all the time, mewing and grunting if things are out whack...he couldnt find his little nibble so I pointed to it and he snatched it up like a greedy little thing. These treats are so loved and comforting, given along with Pet-Ease Paw Gel which I use for anxiety. This little guy was a litter runt and caged alone when I was at the shelter. These huge blue eyes and the worst smelling coast-he was sick and it seemed the vets had given up. He's a roly poly muscle bound little smarty pants now at 6 yrs and these treats keep his coat shiny and the paw gel keep him calm...if frustrated or bored he will shred paper or find some clear manner to show his upset.

column9: Another flavor from Temptations my cats love
column10: I think my cats are addicted to these treats. If they are sleeping and they hear me holding the bag, they came running, if they are playing, they stop playing and come running. It doesnt matter what they are doing, these treats are their priority in life. I cannot run out from these treats, they dont even allow me to sleep if I dont give them some treats before going to bed. And these natural ones seem delicious!!

column9: Definitely gets the cat - and human - seal of approval
column10: I volunteer at a cat shelter so over time I've had some experience with what cats like and what they don't.  With a few rare exceptions, it is hard to find cat treats that are popular with mostly all of the cats.  So far, Natural Temptations Wild Alaskan Salmon Flavor, Natural Temptations Tuna Flavor and All Natural Temptations Chicken Flavor are proving to be three of the rare exceptions.  Just about all the kitties love these things and will follow me around when I'm handing them out so they can cadge more.  Because they are all natural and only 2 calories per treat, they are a reasonably safe and nutritious treat.  Because they are inexpensive, I can afford to bring enough for everybody at every visit!  And apparently they taste awesome.  I can buy these at my local grocery, Target, Walmart or pet store for around $1.50 to $2.00 a packet and each packet contains enough treats to provide every kitty in the shelter with a generous serving of treats. There is one negative - these treats contain a lot of grains and as a result some kitties will vomit them up after an hour (some kitties tummies will not tolerate food or treats containing grain, or more than very small amounts of grain); over the last few months I've had 3 or 4 kitties through the shelter with this issue.  Once I've identified a kitty who is grain-intolerant, I naturally do not feed it these treats or anything similar.  Note that there are several versions of the Whiskas treats that are not all natural; the kitties like them also but I prefer to feed the all natural version.

We have a very picky cat who adores these snacks.  It's hard for us to find these locally.  The bags are large, or huge compared to the ones our WalMart sometimes carries, and much less expensive too.  Thanks to Amazon subscribe and save - Muffin reliably gets her snacks, so we're all happy.  If your cat loves chicken flavored anything, try these.

2 out of 3 of out cats love them. As far as finicky cats go, I consider that a success. They've only been enjoying them for a few days, but so far they haven't caused any vomiting as many of the other treats tend to do.
Look out once they sample these all the other treats are just ordinary. She turns her nose up at every other brand now...........LOL
I foster cats for a local animal rescue and have never met any cat or kitten that doesn't LOVE Temptations. I am never without them!

column9: My cats are hooked on this stuff
column10: I shudder to think what might happen if I ever run out of these treats.For my cats, the day is not complete until we have had treat time with Temptations.They let me know when it's time, loud and clear.MEOW!MEOW!MEOW!MEOW!
All 3 of my cats really like these, even my super-finicky 17 year old who won't eat the same thing twice.

I have one cat who is addicted to these Temptation treats. Either the tuna of the salmon, I dont know what's in these little crunchy pillows, but he forsakes all food if he thinks there's any possibility I'll cave and slip him a few for being the cutest little meatball. His companion, a snooty long hair wont touch them and if he smells them on meatball's breath he gives him a swat for snacking between meals. So his coat seems very shiny, some months back he had flakiness which seemed to be dry skin, but the treats seem to have alleviated that. One thing I would caution is they're probably high in fat so offer them sparingly. (...right)

The previous review, faulting the Campofrio lomo because of its hardness, is accurate, and I was at first equally disappointed. But I hit on the idea of microwaving a slice, much as one might microwave stale bread to soften it. This works! I microwave a slice (a little tough to cut, but I use a sharp knife and keep my fingers safe) on high heat for about seven seconds. It softens, becomes easily chewed, and the flavor comes out fully. I've become addicted!

column9: Very hard... but flavor is good
column10: I had previously bought the Lomo Iberico which was approximately $80.I bought this one because it was a lot cheaper, and Campofrio is a known brand in Spain.I was disappointed because it was very hard which made it difficult to cut. Also, the lomo had a deep fold across the length of it (a small fold is normal), which coupled with the hard texture made it difficult to serve to guests (even the fat around the edges was hard).The flavor was good, but it was not excellent.Next time, I will buy the Iberico again. Yes, it's more expensive, but it's smoother, has better flavor, and a lot easier to cut and prepare for serving guests.

column9: Poor service ... Upgraded to not bad!
column10: On June 16, 2011 I ordered 12 jars of the Bite back Tartar Sauce, and 6 jars of the Lemonaise. My account was charged immediately for the full amount. There was no communication from Taylor's, but about one week later I received a box with only the Lemonaise and a scribbled note saying that they would send the tartar sauce "when they could". I've heard nothing since.They listed this product as available when I ordered it, and it is still listed that way. And I'm still waiting for the jars I paid for weeks ago.As far as the product goes, I've had it before, and it's probably the best tartar sauce I've ever tasted. Now if I could only get my hands on some.Update: The Ecommerce Manager at Taylor's, Brian McNeil, heard about my problem with their service, contacted me and got it fixed right away (on Jul 4th!). He also credited my account with all shipping charges. I'm a happy camper.Now to make some crab cakes.

I was able to find this sauce from Taylor's Market after our stores in Connecticut stopped carrying it. It is indeed the best tasting tartar sauce ever. Also, Taylor's Market is a delight to order from. The sauce is protected by the careful packaging and shipped as quickly as possible.
Discovered this at Whole Foods and when they no longer stocked it mail ordered it from Taylor's before they were an Amazon store.  Absolutely great tartar sauce and perfect accompaniment to all fish.

For being over 70% cocoa this is really extraordinary in tasty, texture, and creaminess.  So many other high cocoa chocolates have a tree bark quality to them, but I don't want to stop eating this one!

column9: Yummiest dark chocolate I've ever found!
column10: I first tried Ritter Sport Fine Extra Dark at an airport in Amsterdam. It was smooth, almost creamy, not chalky like some dark chocolates. Although normally I prefer chocolate with a cacao percentage of 60-65%, this 71% bar lives up to its "Fine" designation and is extremely delicious and melts in your mouth the way milk chocolate does. I have tried many, many dark and bittersweet chocolates for eating out of hand (not baking), and this is by far my favorite. I searched for it in Phoenix when I returned home, and although many other flavors of Ritter Sport chocolate are widely available, not the Fine Extra Dark. I had to either drive 50 miles roundtrip to a specialty German bakery or find it online. Amazon offered the best price with (at the time) Prime shipping. I highly recommend this if you're a fan of dark chocolate.

Excellent quality and flavor. This chocolate has none of the fillers you will find with other off the shelf brands.Buying these in bulk and storing them in a cool, dry place is the way to go.Another nice feature is each square is perforated so you don't have to snap off chunks like some other bar type brands.I look forward to trying other Ritter Sport varieties in the future.

Of course these are the best chocolates known to man, and this is my second box.At$30 a box...however, why is the box WELL .........not filled? There "should" be13 EASILY in these packets.  Why only 11?  The box hold 13 EASILY, with space left over...so...it's kinda frustrating at the prices. I won't order these again..it's too expensive...unless they FILL the box up.....then I will. :)yummy though.
One of the very best dark chocolates available.  Try it, you'll like it!!Ritter Sport, Fine Extra Dark Chocolate 71% Cocoa, 3.5-Ounce Bars (Pack of 11)
Reminds be of when I was a boy at my Grand Parents farm where they did there own meat. Store Meats just don't have that old time flavor.

Great new product, I have tried all 4 flavors... TROPICAL CITRUS; FRUIT PUNCH; ACAI, GRAPE POMEGRANATE and Energy PEACH GREEN TEA. I work in a high school and I am always getting sick. I have been drinking Vitamin Squeeze for several months now and HAVE NOT BEEN SICK ONCE...this is the only thing I have done differently! I don't like the taste of the tap water at the school, so this product is ideal for changing the tap water into a drink that is delicious and motivates me to drink more water. Finally, a truly great drink, which is much better than MIO and half the price of Vitaminwater! All it takes is a "little" squeeze for me. Vitamin Squeeze does not leave an aftertaste like some 0 calorie products. 0 calorie, 0 carbs, 0 sugar! Love it! My teens think the Tropical Citrus tastes like Tang or a Creamsicle. I am headed back to Safeway to get more! I highly recommend this product!

column9: It tastes like the restaurants!  Great!
column10: It tastes just like the restaurants.  I love it.  I put about 8 tea bags together in the coffee/tea maker pot.  The best!

Well worth the cost, pink peppercorns have sort of a sweetness to them.  I think I heard somewhere that is because they are not true peppercorns and are actually dried berries of some sort.  They have a great flavor on almost everything you would use pepper on, like steaks or chicken.They are great mixed with green and black peppercorns too of course, but sometimes you just want the flavor on its own.

column9: These peppercorns add a splash of red
column10: to any food.  I purchased these mainly because of the red color.  My pepper mill peppercorn hopper is a clear plastic so I get to view the pretty red peppercorns even when not using the mill.
I really like this product.  Great in coffee or on fruit. I can't eat refined sugar, and Cactus Gold Honey Powder is my choice for a substitute.
Exactly the felt bone that my min-pin has to take to bed with her every night. Originately she was small er than the bone. The present one is wearing out. Now we can all relax.

column9: Vibrant sparkles that don't add much sparkle.
column10: Like other reviewers have pointed out, these are not sparkles. They just add a little shimmer. The flakes are large, not glittery. No taste or crunch either. They just kind of fall on icing and look like really thin shards of glass. Not pretty, just shiny purple. My mother-in-law thought it was plastic that fell on the cupcake and was picking it off until I told her what it was. Not very impressive!

column9: Nice color but not so sparkly
column10: Purchased this lavender sugar to put on lavender sugar cookies. The cookies were great, but the lavender shgar wasn't that sparkly. I was looking for edible glitter; this is not it.

These sparkles work very well as cake decor, but be aware that they have no taste.  They are edible, but I usually use decor that is sweet, or made of types of candy, and these were just there.  Don't worry, they're inoffensive!  You barely notice their existence, flavor and texture-wise.  They are just for pretty.  And for that, they're great!  The tiny bottle also gives you more glitter than you might think.  I glitterated 18 cupcakes with one half of one bottle.  A great deal!

For my son's 2 year birthday party I ordered this and dipped cupcakes frosted in white frosting in these sprinkles to make it look like asphalt.  In the jar the sprinkles look green, but end up looking black once there are enough of them in the frosting.  We then put painted lines with icing and set tiny Car's characters one each side of the road.  They were a hit.
These sparkles made my cake look great, but were not what I was expecting. The picture led me to believe that they were sparkly but they really just looked like black opaque crystals.

I am Scots and I have used this product all my adult life.  It makes the best gravy ever and I use it in Scots recipes and any others that call for gravy.  It comes in power and granules.  I prefer the powder as do all the other people I have introduced to it.  I ordered 7 of these and they came in 2 boxes.  They were packaged so poorly one box had a hole in it's side and the other was so smooshed 1 box had been punctured and most of the powder had leaked from the box.  The company it was bought from did replace it immediately.  I was very angry because you have to pay shipping on each item (so 7 x shipping costs) even although they came from the same location and in only 2 boxes.  There was only 1 strip of tape around the boxes closing them and they had come loose on top.  I have not had packaging problems with other products I have ordered from the UK.  Fantastic product - gggggggggggggggreat taste!!!  I usually buy Bisto in a British shop here but they are having trouble getting it from their supplier so that's why I was willing to pay such a high price for it.  I'll never do it again.
This product makes the best brown gravy possible.As an ex pat englishmen I am very accustomed in using this product for roasts etc. It is good to be able to buy this product in the USA on Amazon

My mother's dog (a black German Shepherd mix) will go through a "normal" sized rawhide chew in one night.  So I got him this one.  Weeks later one knuckle is still left and well chewed.  So I think this is good value for the money.  Warning, it IS very large.  Give it to a Chihuahua and have your camcorder ready so you can post to YouTube. LOL
I have a one year old lab/pit bull mix who will chew up a 10" rawhide in a day.  We've purchased two of these 24" rawhide's and they each lasted about a month.

column9: Just what I (and my dogs) needed
column10: My two border collies can eat through 10-inch "rawhide rolls" in one evening (that's one bone per dog). That gets expensive! These 24-inch bones with knotted ends are a better deal. I give one to each of my two dogs and the bones last 3 weeks. I ordered these at the end of September. Noticed the Amazon price went up by $1.72 per bone in October. Not happy with the price jump, but it's still a better deal than the 10-inch bones.

column9: Doesn't last very long with a very aggressive chewer
column10: I bought this 24" rawhide because several reviewers said their dogs worked on it for a very long time.  Unfortunately, this was not the case with my 100 lb. Labrodane.  He was pulling off large shreds within 2 minutes, had it broken in half within 10 minutes and chewed one half down to the knot in less than an hour.  While I don't think this is a bad quality bone, the rawhide is not as thick as other bones I have purchased, which I am assuming is why he was able to tear it apart so fast.

Got this for our retriever / doberman mix...she loved it!  At first it was so large that I think she was a bit intimidated by it, but after a few days of coming up with an attack strategy she went right to town....and finished it in 3 days.Typically a large rawhide lasts about 4-5 hours for her, so it was definitely a value.  Also, it was hilarious to watch her run around the house holding onto it.Bought it for one of our friends pitbulls too, it's a great dog gift!

column9: Puppy Loves It But Eats It Too Fast
column10: My 45 lb lab mix loves these 24" rawhide bones but they only last 48 hours at best. She's like a wood chipper when she gets going. So according to her it is a 5 star product based on how much she loves it. But in my judgement it is sort of expensive for 2 days of chewing. I will buy this product occasionally but will seek a more economical alternative. My guess is that most dogs will not chew it up as quickly.
My dog loved this large bone! It actually lasted 2 weeks or so before it was gone.

Have a doberman mix that chews most bones in one night. This one will take a little while for her. Shipping was quick and the price was great compared to smaller bones for the same cost. Will be buying more.

column9: An orange bitters worthy of the Angostura name
column10: I think it's fair to say that Angostura's ubiquitous aromatic bitters are the standard against which all other aromatic bitters are judged.  And with the release of Angostura's orange bitters, I believe that the company has created a new standard in that area as well.These bitters are zesty, sharp, and deliver a gigantic orange punch.  I am a huge fan of Regan's orange bitters, but where those go off into a deeper, spicier direction, Angostura's offering stays laser focused on orange, orange, and more orange.  Brilliant.  I highly recommend these bitters for anyone who needs a bit more orange accent in your cocktails -- and really, who doesn't?

column4: Lynn Hoffman, author:The Short Course in Beer
column10: a single drop in the glass before you pour a wheat beer (belgian style) does the job much better than a slice of orange. the flavor hit is pure aromatic orange without the nasty taste of the pith.failed experiments included:*more than one drop: over the top*in a glass of budmillcoor lite: weirdly bitter and flavorless at the same time*in a trappist ale: puts the beer out of balanceLynn Hoffman, author The Short Course in Beer

column9: A Dash of Brilliance from Angostura
column10: Angostura has been a brand name well-known to my family for generations. As a child, I remember my grandfather and keeping a bottle around. These days, I always have one on hand and so do most of my friends. Recently my local grocery store stopped carrying Angostura regularly so I looked online for it (as almost everything is available online these days) and much to my surprise it was available in original and orange flavor!  I haven't yet tried any other brands or flavors of bitters, but I do know that I thoroughly enjoy Angostura orange bitters and will be buying another bottle. In fact, I may have been converted to orange. I find it versatile in that its great for cocktails, non-alcoholic mixers, and flavoring carbonated water such as club soda and seltzer. Like the original, the more you add, the more pronounced the flavor can be so the flavor can range from a delicate hint to bold.

I have been working my way back to classic cocktail recipes ever since reading David Wondrich's book Imbibe! on the great Professor Jerry Thomas and his cocktail recipes and techniques.  A wealth of information there and a beginning of a long journey to try to recreate the cocktail prior to the great disaster called Prohibition.  As a martini drinker, I naturally wanted to explore the tastes of the original drink so I began with orange bitters.  In my market there were no retailers who carried orange bitters, so I had to rely on the ever more expensive places that will ship the stuff to your door.  I started with Fee Brothers orange bitters and then tried the Peychaud version of Gary Regan's orange bitters (no. 6).  Finally about 3 months ago a local liquor and wine store chain started stocking the new Angostura orange bitters.  Thinking it would be easier and less expensive to support a local merchant and also wanting to try the bitters, I picked up a bottle.  I was a little taken aback when I saw the retail price, $11 versus $7 for Fee Brothers and $6 for Regan's.  I decided to try it anyway.Upon opening the bottle I realized that the bottle itself was orange colored and the internal contents were virtually colorless.  Having made many fruit and peel extractions for liqueurs, I was very suspicious.  Forging on I sniffed the aroma from the open bottle.  The first smell is definitely orange, with an underlying clove aroma and something cloying behind those aromas that does not seem to work well.  In the drink the orange flavor is good and the bitterness that is necessary in a quality bitter is apparent.  But it seems to me that it is quickly overwhelmed by something like a passion fruit flavor that definitely does not belong in a martini.  I would consider using this product in drinks that have some fruit juice and will experiment some with it. I think wit would compliment a splash of pineapple juice in a drink like the Cobalt, but I would not use it in a martini.

column9: When you can't find something in a store - go to Amazon
column10: So maybe I live in a small town, Olympia, WA - I'm often frustrated by how poorly stocked our local retailers can be ... must not be very many people in Olympia interested in mixing CLASSIC cocktails (shaken in stainless, served up in stemmed crystal COCKTAIL glassware).  I could find the original Angostura Bitters at every retailer.  Couldn't find anything like the Angostura Orange Bitters.  In addition to the Angostura Orange Bitters ... Amazon.com has a fine selection of specialty products and accessories for the home bartender. I've become a big Amazon.com fan after hosting just a few cocktail parties.The Angostura Orange Bitters are excellent in mixed cocktails ... if your recipe calls for a dash, use a half, if for two use only one.  Angostura produces a robust product.  I read several taste test articles before deciding on the Angostura brand.  Hands down difficult to beat a true original.  Do visit the Angostura web site too!  I printed a file packed with mixology know how, tips on what to mix with what to achieve various flavors, and, certainly many uses for Angostura products.Cheers!

I found a great recipe for a Manhattan using orange bitters. I looked every where but couldn't find any. Finally, I looked on Amazon.com and they had not only the original and orange but other flavors as well. Order came in quickly and was correct. Getting ready to place a second order - I'm hooked! Recipe as follows: 2&1/2 oz of Woodford Reserve Bourbon Whiskey, 1/2 oz sweet vermouth, 1/2 oz orange bitters. Shake over ice and pour into glass with an orange peel. Enjoy!!Angostura Orange Bitters, 4-Ounce

I was happy to find this newer creation of the renowned Angostora bitters brand. This type of orange bitters is quite clean and bright, very different from their traditional bitters recipe. It adds an orange flavor without overpowering the flavor of other liquors when used; definitely worth a try.
This tasteful bitters make an even better Old Fashioned. I would buy this product again.  Very yummy and a great addition to any drink.
Not too bitter, not too sweet.  Perfect flavoring for martini's, old fashions, beer, etc.  Can't go wrong by selecting this product.

column9: GREAT Quality at a GREAT price
column10: Bitters have been so strong in the craft-cocktail scene these days, and we are always searching for the best quality and flavors to put behind our bar.  This version of Angostura Bitters (Orange) contributes a wonderfully tart and sweet hint to any drink.  We are incredibly happy with the results that have been shown when using these.  The Price point on this bottle wins all the starts however, as our wholesale purveyors carry the same product for about $5 higher than Amazon's list-price.

We were re-introduced to the Old Fashioned at a local restaurant. We got a basic recipe which called for straight Kentucky Rye whiskey and orange bitters and the real Italian Luxardo Maraschino cherries. This orange bitters and the real cherries and a good straight rye whiskey makes a wonderful cocktail. Most restarants will butcher this cocktail. But this product will help you make the Real Thing!
After a very long wait Angostura finally started making orange bitters again! Now my martinis taste great as I remember them.

An excellent addition to any liquor cabinet.  Add a few drops of Angostura Orange Bitters to an Old Fashioned or even just a glass of soda to make an ordinary drink exceptional.  I highly recommend this!

They include: Tisano Organic Chocolate Tea, SerendipiTea ChocolaTea, Chocolate, Vanilla, Rooibos & Black Tea, 4-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 2), and Bigelow White Chocolate ObsessionTea, 1.6-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6). column9: Elegant white tea AND raspberry . . . so very good!
column10: After trying to find a green tea that I could actually drink and enjoy, I found white tea. It has all the health giving benefits of green tea -- maybe even more -- and it's so very enjoyable! Of all the white teas I have tried, this is my absolute favorite. The white tea is smooth: it has none of the bitterness or sharp taste of green tea, and the addition of raspberry is a brilliant touch. To enhance the raspberry flavor, try adding a little sweetener -- your choice. Drinking a cup of this tea is like giving yourself a present. Thanks Stash, you really do create world-class teas.P.S. Remember NOT to boil the water for this tea: it's far too delicate for boiling water. Instead, use water just under the boiling point and only brew for no more than 4 minutes -- it does make a difference.

I always drink decaf tea and that limits my options. That's why I was more than happy when I found this great tasting decaf vanilla tea. I don't even add sugar or milk to this tea, I drink it as it is and it's really delicious.

I LOVE this tea.  It's delicious both hot and cold.  I go through a box in less than a week, so buying on Amazon, especially with Subscribe and Save is awesome!Thank you Stash, for yet another fabulous tea!

This tea is very good.  The flavor is great and it's quite calming and soothing, especially in a nice bubble bath after a rough day!
