column9: Best snack out there, but buy elsewhere!
column10: We love Ella's! Amazingly pure and delicious portable snack. But this price is crazy - it is cheaper at our Whole Foods in Manhattan! Eek!

column9: My Baby Doesn't Care For It
column10: But I love that it is organic. I didn't think it was that bad, I will just stick to other flavors ;)
I hope it's really healthy because my 1 yr old seems to love them - we just tried them and the package is already gone!  recommend!
My son LOVES these but Amazon's price is ridiculous!!!  You can get them on sale for a dollar a piece.  Yikes!!  I'm shocked!!

column9: Healthy food, happy Kids, no mess - happy mom too.
column10: My kids love Ella's Kitchen Apple Banana sauce.  We have purchased various flavors and various brands of this type of product - fruit sauce in a pouch.  There are only a couple they like.  And this is one of their favorites.  They are older children (not babies).  They love the taste and the packaging.  They like it so much that they beg for it.  It is so easy to give this to them in the car.  Healthy food, happy Kids, no mess - happy mom too.

My baby LOVED the Ella's kitchen items, especially the peaches & bananas.  I love that it is all organic!  The consistency is very runny...so it mixes well with things like oatmeal & other baby cereals.  The cap will go back on the package, but must be kept upright in the fridge or it will leak.
Love all Ella's Kitchen products...my babies LOVE it.......can't find stage 2 in the stores or online....but the Drugstore 911 prices are really outrageous..more than half the normal cost ><
My baby is a picky eater and LOVES, especially this flavor.  I try everything that I give her and these are something I would eat too!

column9: Ella's Kitchen Organic Baby Food Strawberry and Apples
column10: My son loved this. He actually likes this more than any other baby fruit. This is also very convenient. If you do not use it all at one time, then you just put the cap back on and put it in the fridge. They also take up less space in the diaper bag, and you do not have to worry about the jar busting.

column9: My Toddler Vegetable Snob is a BIG Fan!
column10: These little pouches are great for toddlers who refuse to eat their vegetables in the conventional way. My son started getting picky around 18 months and I was on the verge of desperation when I found these at BRU. (They are also carried at a certain big box store that has a bulls eye logo.) Yes, they are marketed for babies, and are almost two bucks a pop, but my son ALWAYS finishes these pouches, which is more than I can say for most things he eats, and I feel much better knowing he ingested something green! Yay for Ella's kitchen! Oh. and I also recommend the pumpkin version. Super yummy!

My toddler, my 9yo daughter, and I all love this!  Delicious.  A little pricey, but worth it right now while my little guy won't really eat "real" fruits and veggies :)  The Subscribe and Save price here is the best I've found.
Tastes just like what it is, but my will not even touch a vegetable nevermind eat one daughter sucks these down. I'm happy!

My 21 month old son absolutely loves these - he will happily eat them right out of the package, but I also use them to make yogurt smoothies or to flavor oatmeal and he love that as well.  I love that there really isn't a lot of sugar and that they have so many truly YUMMY flavors - we've probably been using them since he was about 12 months old - only wish I had known about them even sooner!

I have an 11 month and 3.5 year old. These pouches make for a great yummy snack. My kids love to eat them right out of the pouch. My older child eats her whole veggies and also these pouches. My baby, is not a huge veggie fan like my eldest.. she loves these however. When I cook for the baby if I don't hide the veggies well, she will reject the meal. So, when I can't get my baby to eat the organic veggies I have made or when I need a quick snack while shopping or out and about, Ella's takes great care of us! Def a must have. Oh, I just give my baby the whole tube and she sucks it all out.. great for the baby who had always refused me feeding her.
My toddler loves these, great snack for during the day and easy to take in the car as a bribe :)

My son is almost 18 months old and these are great for healthy snacks on the go. They are a great combination of fruits and vegetables without all the extra water and junk that comes in other baby food.  It's like a special treat for my little guy and I'm happy he's eating something healthy.  Only complaint is I wish they weren't so expensive.

My child took to this flavor of Ella's immediately, moaning with delight with every slurp. Soon enough, she was able to drink down the container on her own using the spout, which was a new skill of hers I can attribute to the spinach, apple and rutabaga Ella's!

I just started buying this product. It is not available in local stores. I went to Target last Sunday and saw these so I decided to gave it a try. My baby happen to love these as much as Happy Baby products. I am surprised to see it here on Amazon. So next time I will buy it from here. It tastes great. My baby loves it. Yeah it is kind of expensive but if your child loves it then I would buy it for the child. They do go on sale too. If you have WIC ( Women , Infant and Children) You can buy these from Target Because only Target carry these here. I am not sure if Amazon accepts WIC.  Over all a great product I would recommend it.
Product is great.  Amazon price was overpriced- once calculated on per pouch, it turned out to be twice that of Whole Foods pricing.  Not worth it.

column9: I Love Pistachios and this seller is awesome!!!
column10: Not as lightly salted as I would like but fresh and delicious and at the price, they deserve a 5 star rating. They were extremely fresh and I even found an excellent recipe from Emeril to make Pistachio Ice Cream, my absolute favorite. I enjoyed all 10 pounds and I will buy them again. Fast Shipping too!!!! Thank you!!!!

column9: Delicious, soft and chewy.  Slightly larger than gummy bears.
column10: If you or your kids want to have some reasonably healthy candy snacks, these fit the bill.  All three versions (Orchard, Tropical, and Fruit Medly) are good.  Remember, sugar is a natural ingredient.  Just keep the intake to reasonable levels.  Sure beats the synthetic sweeteners (Sucral..., Acusul...-K, etc).  If sugar makes you feel fat, get more active and burn off the calories.  You will feel better all around.

These fruit gummies are the best....great taste, and texture.  I found some at a local store and bought a couple of bags just to try.  When I went back, they didn't have them anymore and I was so happy to find them on Amazon!

column9: Talking Rain is excellent sparkling water
column10: This is a handy way to get sparkling water (via the UPS man)!  And this product is truly delicious - no after taste just.  I like plain carbonated water, but to add flavor, I just thoroughly mix a little one-serving package of Wyler's or Crystal Light or Miro in a little plain water and then pour in the TalkingRain and I have orange or lemon or whatever calorie-light soda.  My first shipment was not packaged properly and some cans were damaged and leaking but Amazon took care of that by sending out a replacement shipment right away which arrived thoroughly bubble wrapped and in the proper size box.  I'll reorder this fine product.

column9: Helped me break my Diet Cola habit
column10: This lovely little can of carbonated water has helped me break my addiction to Diet Colas. It tastes great on its own but I prefer to mix it with fresh lemon and lime juice or iced tea.One other thing I like is that it has no sodium in it like other sparkling waters.And the delivery of it is great, right at my front door. Looks like it's time to sign up for the Subscribe & Save option.

column4: C. Lane "Be the change you want to see in the...
column10: It's been many years since I've had a coke or pepsi, liquid chemicals that don't do your body good at all. Now I make my own using this unflavored sparkling water mixed with grape juice, tart cherry or blueberry concentrates. Delicious,refreshing and nutritious especially for hot summer days. I'm ready to order my forth case and its so convenient to have them delivered right to my front door.
I use this as my refreshment of choice and get four cases shipped to me every month. I could easily drink a dozen a day.

Talking Rain sparkling water is the most bubbly sparkling water I've tried.  The other brands (Perrier, San Pellegrino, and other random brands I've picked up from the grocery store) have a disappointing lack of bubbliness.  Club soda (which has sodium bicarbonate or another alkaline salt added) is bubbly, but it tastes weird.  The talking rain cans hiss when you open them, and when you pour the water into a glass, it foams up nicely.  It's perfect for making homemade ginger ale.
From what I can tell, this is the best value for pure seltzer water on Amazon Prime sold in 12-oz cans.

I was thinking to myself the other day "Why don't they make canned water?"Well, now they do!  My only complaint is this is carbonated water and I would prefer just plain water in a can, but I can deal with a bit of the bubbly.The cans arrived on time with no dents. My purpose for these was to keep with my other canned food in case of hurricanes or other emergencies where I may lose power and utilities to my home.Unfortunately these are so tasty I have been drinking them every day, ruining any plans I had for long term storage.  I really like that there are no additives, no corn syrup, and no artificial sweeteners. Just delicious, bubbly, water.EDIT 10/2012 - I have now ordered 4 shipments of this water, and have received only one shipment that was not damaged or leaking.  The most recent shipment had 4 cans burst, soaking everything in the package. Thankfully there was nothing else in the box (like food or electronics) that was damaged.  The one shipment that was not damaged came in about 7 layers of bubble wrap.  All the others (the leaky ones) had only a single layer of wrap, which is not even close to being adequate protection.  My UPS guy gets rather concerned when packages make hissing noises and leak fluid all over his truck... he was relieved when I informed him it was just water.  Until Amazon fixes their packaging issues I will not be ordering this product again.

column9: Quality Sparkling Water - But Shipping Beware
column10: TalkingRain Sparkling Water is of high quality across all their flavors. I drink this water daily and enjoy both the Natural (product reviewed) as well as their Lemon-Lime. However, be aware that ordering 24 cans may have some leakage during shipping.  About one or two cans per order is received empty.  Even with a couple duds in the batch, this is still a great buy!

column4: Laura M. Place "Tea, cat, dark fantasy, and k...
column10: There is a reason that they call this "Talking Rain" seltzer.  It is one of the loudest cans of carbonated beverage that I have ever opened.  Since I love very carbonated water, I think this is great!However, if it's possible to switch to a home carbonation system, I'd recommend that.  I'm a bit worried about consuming so much trace aluminum.  That's the reason I gave it four stars - because I think it's worth going for carbonated water that doesn't have aluminum or BPA exposure as a required part.

column9: Most affordable sparkling water. Shipped free!
column10: Super Saver shipping makes this one heck of a deal.I love water, and I love Soda, who doesn't love Soda? But the problem is the sugar...  Sparkling water satisfies my thirst for bubbles/fizz in my beverage but buying it at the grocery store can be just as expensive as buying soda. Then i found this sweet deal on Amazon.I read some reviews from people who obviously never had "sparkling water" before...  what NOOBS!!! *facepalm*. Sparkling water HAS a "taste", some people don't like it. If you are one of those people, you were looking for WATER, not sparkling water! All sparkling/seltzer water taste the same, no matter what brand. The benefit here is that its really cheap.PLEASE, DO NOT confuse sparkling water with "tonic water". These are two different things. They look and feel the same, but taste much different. They are made differently too, (see: greatist.com/health/dangerfood-tonic-water-032712/). If you don't like sparkling water you will probably HATE the sour taste of Tonic water. They are easily confused because they appear to be the same, but they aren't.PRODUCT CONS: I noticed that the effervescence of Talking Rain faded away very quickly compared to "other waters" I consume. So if you open a can, you have to consume it quickly or else it will just be warm and flat. No good.That is it! I am glad I found this product!!!

What can I write? It's simple carbonated water that taste great; and for me, a perfect beverage especially on a diabetic diet. I miss the bubbles; and was turned on to Talking Rain at Costco. For some reason, Costco dropped the beverage in SoCal. When I saw this on Amazon Prime, it was at a great price and with Prime delivery and set up on a "subscription" I get two cases per month! I even ordered extra; and here they are! I highly recommend the drink! Cheers!

The only reason I bought this stuff was because it was 1.50 on clearance at my grocery store. I just tried it on some cupcakes and omg it was better than the canned frosting. I could not stop tasting it! It almost had a sweet fruity flavor to it but not really. Kind of hard to explain. I am definitely going to try the other flavors it comes in. The best part about it is is makes the cupcakes look like they came from a bakery! So happy I found this stuff.

I was skeptcial of this spice,however i am always searching for new ways to spice up meats and meals.LOOK no more this spice is awesome!! i used it  in meat i was using to make fajitas.i used about 1/2 teaspoon to one and half pounds of shreaded beef.that small amont really gave the meat a very differnt  very good taste.while the container of this spice did not suggest this,i am more than pleased with the quality of the taste of this spice.

column9: Best paste for Dan Dan Noodles that I've found.
column10: I do lots of cooking from Fuscia Dunlop's "Land of Plenty" Sichuan cooking cookbook. Sesame paste is an essential ingredient for many recipes, and I have found this Greek brand to be better for them than some of the Chinese brands I have tried. Very creamy, very fresh (subjectively anyway.)

The title of this review says it all.  Krinos has always made excellent tahini.  You do need to stir this stuff once you open it to mix the more solid stuff that settles to the bottom.  Don't be freaked out by the oil because it's the type of oil that's good for you.
Delivery was fast, and my order arrived intact and unbroken. The product was of very good quality.

This Tahini has made the best hummus I've ever had.  Even my Armenian friends thinks it is great.  My hummus recipe is 1/4 cup of chicken broth, 14 oz. can of chickpeas (garbanzon beans) drained, 3-4 cloves of garlic, 2 TBS lemon juice, 3 Tbs of this Tahini, and a pinch or two of cummin, and all mixed very well.  I have a high power blender that really makes this extremely creamy and good.
great taste and consistency.  would like to know its shelf life both refrigerated and non-refrigerated.

This is a good tasting powder for the money you pay.  It's one of the best deals on Amazon for onion powder to be sure.  The powder itself carries very little in the way of onion aroma, but more importantly tastes much better with a sample on your tongue, and in your recipes.  I have never tasted any real difference between a pure talc like powder like this is, and a granulated one that a lot of people seem to prefer.  Granulated sometimes costs a little more, so I would advise you to make sure that's what you want before ordering this brand.  It's certainly not the best I have ever had, but a good powder at a very reasonable price here on Amazon, and well worth it for your kitchen in my opinion...Recommended

I bought this product thinking that the onion powder is a granulated powder, but it is actually a fine powder, which I usually don't use while cooking.  This is a very good product if you are looking for a fine powder, but not if you are looking for a granulated powder.  It has good flavor, and I have used it in cooking, but it isn't so great to sprinkle on pizzas and pasta.

I've only found this in powder form and have tried it in my coffee both with and without sugar. Either way, this is a great creamer. It's very similar (if not just like) the taste of International Delight York flavor. I suppose it comes down to which brand one prefers best. Since I like them both, I will probably buy the one that's on sale or cheapest next, ha ha.
I love how they come out with the holiday editions. It's like you can constantly be surrounded by the seasons with coffee-mate.

I'm not the biggest fan of powder creamers, but Coffee-Mate has always been the best of all I've ever used.  That being said, my wife purchased this for me to compliment the flavor of any unpleasantly cheap coffee I would subjected to while deployed overseas, and I was thankful for it.  While it did the job of making plain coffee taste better, I was disappointed by the lack of peppermint flavor (she got it for me specifically because of my love of mint).  The smell is sweet, and you get hints of both mocha and a little peppermint.  However the flavor of peppermint is lacking, and you're more or less left with a mocha creamer that only tastes slightly different than an ordinary mocha creamer.It may not completely live up to its name, but I would still recommend it.

I would like it if there was more peppermint flavor, especially this peppermint. But it is still good. The blend of the mocha is so subtle. I bought it to salvage the nasty bitter and acidic taste of an expensive but cheap coffee. This creamer wasn't able to completely camaflouge the cigarette taste, but probably would have if I had used half the bottle. It did a better job at disguising one of the decaf coffees, though. I found a small bottle of it at Schneuks tor $2.50. I think it was 16 oz. I'd buy this again, as well as buying a peppermint syrup.

Our cute mischievous morkie Rexie has the finicky eating habits of a Maltese!!! He is half Maltese and half Yorkie and trust me, he is just too cute for words.  He likes to snack on these and the carrots.  I try to avoid the corn since I read corn can cause allergies in some dogs.

I recently dined at the Melting Pot Fondue restaurant. I ordered this yummy martini, and it was so good, I asked for the recipe. They were very kind to share it with me, but said I would NEVER find the secret ingredient Monin raspberry syrup. Well, that drink was so good, I was determined to lay my hands on this syrup! Luckily, I found it on Amazon!! Here is the recipe:Lemon Raspberry Martini2 oz Limoncello1/2 oz Grey Goose vodka1/4 oz Monin Raspberry syrup1 oz cranberry juice1/2 oz sweet sour mix (liquid)Mix all ingredients together in a shaker with lots of ice. Strain into two martini glasses. Add a twist of lemon and ENJOY!!!

I don't recall now why I originally bought Monin's Raspberry Syrup, but once it arrived, it soon became an indispensable member of the pantry. We love it as an ice cream or frozen yogurt sauce (it's surprising how many flavors work with raspberry - try peach, in particular), as well as on fruit or in dessert recipes. It's highly concentrated so a little goes a long way. I also carefully freeze fresh raspberries when they're at the peak of the season and this is as good as the syrups that I've labored to make at that time of year. It does tend to be a bit sweet; this simply encourages us to use less.
I have a new Raspberry Lime Ricky obsession. This syrup has a great flavor for the drink. I use a tbls of syrup with raspberry lime seltzer with sliced limes. Delicious and refreshing

I love this syrup. I make individual sodas at home and a good raspberry flavor has been a challenge.  Torani Syrup, Raspberry, 25.4-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 3) has an acceptable but still very artificial taste. The Monin syrup produces a well flavored very pale pink soda. I use less than a tablespoon to 8 oz of seltzer and it's perfect. No weird aftertaste, nothing overpowering. Excellent product.
I like rasbery syrup on ice cream and saw this product on line.It 's way way too sweeet ,,full of cane sugar...i woud not reccomend this or any other of their products.

We used to buy this seasoning at our local Sam's club under the "Tone's Citrus Grill" name. Tone's & Durkee are owned by the same company so it was a no brainer when I found this product on Amazon as Sam's does not carry the Durkee brand and Tone's does not make it any more. Glad I found this on Amazon as we use this seasoning a lot!

A well crafted spice mix. Not too salty; good citrus high notes with hints of dill and bell pepper. Mix 50-50 with a cajun spice mix and olive oil for a superb baked fish marinade! Wonderful for grilled vegetables too!
We use this on turkey burgers- makes them awesome, and on chicken, fish- even pork. Usually when we grill, which we do year round. Great flavor, leaves the meat juicy and not too salty.

I have used this seasoning for years, and when I ran out of it,  I could NOT find it! Looked all over for it, and finally decided to go online.  I was so happy to locate this item on Amazon and immediately ordered the product.  I am now very happy that I once again have my favorite seasoning for my fish!!!!

column9: Excellent and useful on lots of things
column10: Folks are writing here that this is great on fish, poultry, veggies; this stuff is great on most anything!  We sprinkle on rice (with oil or butter), on cottage cheese, potato salad, macaroni salad, on mac n' cheese, on baked (any style actually) potatoes, on eggs, on pork, on beef...  rather than salt reach for this stuff.  As others have mentioned, we can no longer find it at Sam's Club -- which was frustrating.  This is an indispensable item in our kitchen.
Love this seasoning. Great on fish. They use to sell it at Sams Club, but not anymore. It's even cheaper on Amazon.
Great seasoning. So glad Amazon is carrying this product. First bought at Sam's club and really did like. They quit carrying it. Hope Amazon does not stop. My friend tried it and is ordering also.

This economical source of Citrus Grill is excellent.  It is the same as Jone's and much less costly.  Since we use a lot of it, for all kinds of foods, salads as well as fish, etc., and since Jone's chooses to take theirs off the market from fall to spring, this is the perfect answer.  We use it year round.

Great stuff ~Try sprinkle on a green salad, it's delightful.Mix it in orange juice for an outstanding glaze on chicken.The best part about finding this great seasoning combo on Amazon is that you get 2 HUGE jars. I was going to give one to a friend but decided to keep both for myself and put in another order for her.

column9: Give new life to fish and chicken
column10: This citrus grill seasoning is the best stuff I have found for giving a great taste to white fish, in fact just about any fish, and chicken. Even my kids were crazy about it.

column9: Excellent seasoning for fish or chicken
column10: We used to buy this spice at Sa_'s Club and when they stopped carrying it - had given up. I even contacted the company, but with shipping charges, it seemed too expensive, but Amazon was cheaper with the free shipping, we're fans again. This is an excellent way to season chicken, fish, especially salmon. You don't even need time to marinade... Just pour the Citrus Grill on frozen chicken breasts and throw them on the bbq grill. Flip and season again. I cooked a batch for some coworkers a year ago and 5 ended up buying the seasoning for themselves. Your chicken will be every bit as good as restaurants... Fish is also excellent, again no prep time, just season and cook. Your guests will be amazed.

I've been using this seasoning for several years now and it is the very best for grilled chicken or fish.  I also use it when I do a rotisserie chicken and when I do a stir-fry of fresh veggies (green beans sugar snap peas, broccoli, etc.)  Getting very difficult to find, however, so when I found it on Amazon, ordered two large (18 oz.) containers!

We used to buy this seasoning at our local BJs club called "Tone's Citrus Grill".  We LOVE IT, but haven't been able to find any for a while.The Durke brand has the same ingredients, but is not as finely ground like it was with "Tones".  We use it on fish, steak and chicken.  It's mild and taste great!

Citrus Grill is great on grilled chicken and on broiled fish. On the chicken, marinade it first in Italian dressing then add the seasoning. If you live in a humid area, keep seasoning in the fridge to keep fresh.
This is the best seasoning ever!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Love that I can buy it in enough bulk to use it for everything, thanks!

I started buying this at our local Sam's Club and sprinkle it on salmon for a fast, fabulous weeknight meal.  Start with a nonstick pan, add a little white wine for moisture and flavor.  Salmon filets go in, sprinkle on the Citrus Grill, and poach until done.  It's an easy working Mom's meal and very healthy.  The whole family loves it!  The blended flavors of lemon, dill, garlic, and bell pepper are a weekly favorite for us.  Nothing too spicy, and it's been my son's favorite dinner since he was 3.

I happened to buy a small bottle of this a few years ago and was frustrated that I was never able to find it again, until now.  This seasoning is amazing on fish, chicken, shrimp and vegetables. Very bright and citrusy with a peppery kick!

Durkee Citrus Grill Seasoning makes a great grilled salmon. I usually put it on one side and grill only with the unseasoned side down, only because turning it over on the grill manages to knock and scrape much of it off. Add plenty of fresh minced/grated garlic and apply lemon juice liberally along with the Citrus Grill. Let this all sit on the salmon for a half an hour before grilling. Mmmmmmm, good!

I ordered 2 packs of 2, 18-ounce containers of this wonderful seasoning.  One pack of 2 was fine but the second pack had one container that clearly did not have 18 ounces.  There was only 14 ounces in the container.  Was this a glitch in the process?  If this is done on each order, then the company will make a lot more money.I wonder if Durkee will contact me about this problem?Cathy
This is milled flax seed, plain and simple. The reclosable package is nice.The product is kosher, certified by the Star-K.
Excellent product. Nearly 50 years ago i had it the first time. wonderful reminder at my youth. I recommend this product.

The shipping is always excellent, and the product is amazing! My family loves the white chocolate coconut clusters, and only a membership to Weight Watchers is preventing me from ordering it more frequently!

If you love good chocolate and raspberry together Whippet Cookies with Raspberry are for you!  I serve them as dessert on many occasions and since we cannot purchase them in US supermarkets they are an extra treat.  Actually, they are BETTER than sliced bread!!!!
I LOVE this cookie and can't find it.  Sooo I would like a notification when it's available.
This product arrived in excellent condition and is delicious. I have trouble finding this product or anything even close to it. It is also reasonably priced
I love these cookies.  So I decided to order them in bulk.  They arrived stale and smashed.  I will be cancelling my next order.  I was very disappointed.

This cookie has a thin graham crust with a slim layer of raspberry topped with a lot of marshmallow and covered entirely in dark chocolate.  If these ingredients work well for you, you will love this cookie.  I was hoping it would have more raspberry and less marshmallow but that wasn't the case...I could only give it a 3 star.

I had given up finding these cookies, searched everywhere. Couldnt believe I found them here. Other than having to buy them in bulk, these cookies are marvelous. Fresh and tasty. We went thru two boxes already.Thank you for carrying them. I highly recommend these if marshamallow and chocolate are your thing. The raspberyy is a bonus. YUMMY.

I have been looking for these cookies for a decade- finally found them here. They were great- just like I remembered them. The chocolate coating was cracked, probably due to shipping, but that didn't detract from the taste! Will probably order more soon!

I love these cookies!  It is just the right amount of raspberry to accent the flavor.  Plus it is like a raspberry jelly and not just some red colored stuff. The cookie is flaky enough without being too brittle. The chocolate is not waxy like American chocolate can be. And of course, the marshmallow is fresh, soft, and luscious. It properly melts in my mouth. Should I be embarrassed that I order these cookies by the case?

On a visit to Quebec, I discovered those "melt in your mouth" cookies and had to find out where I could find them here in the US. The pure dark chocolate alone is heaven. Even my husband who rarely eat cookies loved them. You eat one you're hooked.
These are the best cookies I have ever had.  The chocolate melts away in your mouth as you taste the whisper of marshmallow.  The cookie is moist and the raspberry - yummy.  I love this cookie.

Most the Monin syrups I've tried have had a very identifiable flavor. This one is slightly confusing on the palette but still good all in all. If you're looking for a nice strong mocha this isn't for you- it's far more nutty than chocolatey.However, half a shot of Monin chocolate solves the problem!

column9: healthy food from a company wow
column10: Keep up the good work of non salt foods as there are just not enough and the demand will grow fast as we Americans realize salt is only a habit and kills us prematurely, so thank you for helping to keep us alive and healthy.

This candy definitely provides a sugar fix if you have a sweet tooth. It was not as fresh as some Mike & Ike candy I have had, but not stale either. These are tiny boxes--great for portion control, Halloween or throwing into a purse or lunch or backpack.

If you're looking to make coffeehouse style frappes, you need to get a mix! I'm a big fan of McDonald's frappes, but the money and calorie content made me rethink my indulgence. I was looking for a lo-cal frappe mix and could only find this one. I struggled with purchasing this one as it was a 3 pound bag and if I didn't like it, then what? But I'm very glad I made the purchase. I tried it as soon as it arrived- mixed 3 scoops (just shy of 1/4 cup) with 1/2 cup frozen coffee cubes, 1/2 cup milk, and 1/2-1 cup ice cubes- then to make it pretty I topped with fat-free Redi-Whip and a drizzle of Hershey's lite syrup. Tastes great, creamy, not gritty as I've had with some other mixes. And to top it off it's low fat and low cal!

I bought this for my husband because he's looking for treats that are low calorie, low fat.  It's perfect for him, I think it's 100 calories for a 16 oz blended drink, and there's 45-50 servings in this bag.  That's about 55 cents per drink, not counting the milk he puts in it.  He doesn't feel guilty having one every day and it keeps him from snacking on cookies or other higher calorie goodies.  Perfect!  He loves the taste and even though this is a mocha flavor with coffee in it, he's even added 1/2 a banana to his frappe and he really likes that too.For me, I'm sensitive to the flavor of aspartame (I'm fine with it in diet sodas, but not in anything else for some reason... like my beloved Wrigley's Juicy Fruit gum?  Even the non-sugarfree Juicy Fruit now has aspartame, it's a yucky aftertaste).  If they'd used Splenda as the only sweetener I would've loved this frappe mix, but aspartame is the last ingredient in the list and even though I didn't know that it was in the mix, as soon as I took the first sip I could taste the aspartame.  That was a bit of a disappointment.  Since I bought this for my hubby and I never intended to use it myself, I didn't dock a star for it.  But, if you don't like aspartame, be forewarned.  If you're looking for a good cold treat for yourself and you're watching your calorie intake and you're fine with aspartame, this is a great mix to use.

This is my favorite of all the coffees for the tassimo machine.It has a good coffee taste but it ain't starbucks.I used to buy Gevalia dark house blend but this is better.Also it makes a larger cup,11 ounzes I think and you get 16 discs to the pack.Best place to buy in my opinion is Bed bath and beyond for 9.99 and if you use the 20% off coupon it's even less.

Really wonderful and authentic tasting Upma.......one complaint however- i wish they would not use trans-fat hydrogenated oils. They should use coconut oils or regular oils. It would be MUCH healthier

column9: Excellent ..simple to make and tastes like mom's
column10: Simply saute diced onion and diced potato with a little bit of oil, Thai chili and salt to taste. Add 500 ml water and follow instructions. Eat with pickle. It is done in 10 mins. You can add frozen vegetables etc as per taste.
It is very easy to cook and tastes pretty good. Could have been little more spicier, but we can always add some extra ingredients and make it as we want!

Very pleased with this food!  We feed this to four very large (over 100 lbs each)  german shepherd indoor dogs! We're fans of all the Blue food for dogs! Dogs eat every bite and they are picky eaters who also eat a raw diet in addition to this!
This a fantastic product and has a great shelf life.  It is absolutely perfect for frothing when making a cappucino.
I consistantly use this product in place of fresh milk.  It lasts longer, and tastes just as good.  Unfortunately I can't always find it in local grocery stores.

No more, "Omigawd it's 6 am and we just ran out of milk!  Nothing's open until 8!  What will my little girl have on her cereal?"Put this in your pantry and you're good for a year.  Tastes great, lasts a long time.  What's not to like?  Good for packing on car-camping trips too.I can't believe I can't find this in stores in SF.

column9: UHT milk should be long life! this is not.
column10: I bought UHT milk on-line because - amazingly - it does not seem to be ubiquitous in stores in the US as it is in the rest of the world. I need it for my disaster preparedness kit, the food supplies we store against disasters such as earthquakes which would leave us without access to electricity (including refrigerator), water, gasoline or shopping for several days. We need milk for cereal, drinks and children. I was extremely disappointed to find that, instead of a 'Use Before' date of 2 or 3 years, as I have always found on UHT milk bought in other countries, the expiry date on this product, bought in August 2011, is February 2012. This means I will have to repurchase the milk every 6 months, making it much too expensive.It is maddening that buying the item on-line one cannot check (or ask about) the 'Use Before' date.  I would of course check this if I could buy the milk in a store. This reminds one once again of the disadvantages of shopping on-line, with no recourse to asking questions of a person and getting essential information which affects the choice to purchase.I do feel that sellers on UHT milk should give their customers the LONG LIFE product they expect.

I just had a baby and thought this would be a great soup to try in my first week postpartum. I was right, not only was it easy to toss into my slow cooker, but it gave me the comfort food I was really looking for after a lackluster hospital experience! I savored every tasty drop.

This soup is really yummy - and very "pretty" too, with the 21 bean variety.  I have 2 boys, ages 11 and 9, who are VERY picky eaters, and they truly liked it, which says a lot!  My 9 year old and my husband were asking if we had any leftovers the next night.  I really appreciated the clear Shopping List (list of ingredients needed to put the soup together) on the box.  And, as a novice cook, I also really appreciated the detailed instructions with the Gourmet Tips about soaking the beans the night before for softer beans and how best to use a crock pot (don't open the lid during cook time for best results... who knew?!).  The Shopping List and clear directions made it so easy to make, and it was very delicious.  We made the meat version the first time, and we can not wait to make the vegetarian version next time.  Great soup mix - easy and delicious!
It's true...I can't list all 21 beans, but they are TASTY!I skipped the chicken and used all sausage plusI used chicken broth instead of water. DELISH!!

I made this soup mix and took it to work. The aroma filled up the office with this fabulous smell. It was very tasty and really pretty easy to make - just had to add a few ingredients like chicken, sausage, tomatoes and celery. Everybody liked it and a few asked for order information. I would recommend cooking it on low for longer rather than on hign for a less amount of time - it will result in a thicker yummier soup. It's generously loaded with beans. Enjoy!
If you follow the directions (ahem) the beans get perfectly tender, the flavors are great, the suggestions are healthy, awesome product

I bought a case of this for my family and it went fast.  Everyone loves it.  It's crunchy, sweet,and the raisins are good.  Makes a great late-night snack for Dad and a quick breakfast grab on the way out the door for the kids.  A good choice for camping grub, too.  Healthy adults might need two packs for a good breakfast, but my kids seem fine with one.I eat mine straight out of the box with my coffee and it's great.  The Granola was fresh and tasty and the raisins added a nice bit of flavor.  It's just what you expect and good.  Recommended.

This product is almost 30% sugar! (18 grams out of 63 grams in the single-serve box) That's a greater sugar content than in ice cream or pecan pie, and much more than in Frosted Mini-Wheats. It's over four teaspoons of sugar. This single small box has 240 calories. Be careful with fat-free or low-fat products---they are often high in sugar and calories.
Loved this cereal on cruises, could never find in stores...so a great way to stock up on single-serving boxes of Granola.
The cereral is great for breakfast or a snack. Very filling cereral with lots of nuts and very crunchy. Would highly recommend.

When my local Giant and Safeway stores stopped selling my favorite granola, I had to resort to other means to get it!  I simply cannot live without this particular granola to put in my cereal...I'm so happy Amazon has it...this granola is the best tasting, and it has no hydrogenated fats or other bad stuff in it!Thank you Amazon!

I would give it no stars if that were possible. I found Enchantacat in California and my cats loved it when we would bring it home. I ordered it the first time from an Amazon Prime seller and it arrived looking like someone broke into it thinking it was something other than catnip. The seal was busted. My cats wouldn't touch it and after putting it outside by a garbage can where the stray cats in my hood congregate, and seeing it untouched, I figured it was just a bad batch.My boyfriend ordered it from another seller. This time it arrived sealed, but it was just nothing the cats wanted any part of. I am not sure if the forumula is different now, or if my cats are just used to bad catnip, but two batches have had no effect on drawing out cats to engage in it.Other catnips, when we put it down, my cats will smell it from the other side of the house. They didn't like Enchatacat. Not a fan and will no longer order it---from anywhere.
the chips are just ok to me.  tho ya don't get many.  better get ur spoon out for tha CHIPS, not the dip.

column9: Great Taste and Good for Health
column10: This is our favorite cereal! It is low in sugars, tastes great, and is very good for your health. We highly recommend it.

BOTH of my dogs, American Bulldogs, LOVE the Blue Buffalo Large Breed Chicken & Rice Dry Dog food! My 5 year old female American Bulldog is a picky eater and was initially hesitant when she first tried it. After taking a few sniffs and nibbles, she went for broke.  My 2 year old male American Bulldog likes almost anything so he was not a concern.  The price is reasonable and the vendor ships QUICKLY which are two thumbs up in my book.  This was a great experience all around.

My two dogs love this stuff.  One had a little bit of trouble getting used to it (the oatmeal, cranberries, and other goodies in there kind of "loosened" things up a bit, if you know what I mean, and I didn't have enough of his old food to mix the new stuff in as slowly as I'd have liked), but after a few days he returned to normal.  Now, they're both very happy with it.  And if the boys are happy, then everybody's happy.

I switched my dogs to Blue Buffalo from about a year ago because of skin issues my German Shepard was developing. At this point I can't remember what I was feeding him. He was about a year old at the time was around 110lbs. We walk between two and four miles a day and have been sense he was seven or eight months. After the switch I noticed his coat did gradually begin to look better. Also he lost almost 15lbs and has a lot more energy. I included his age because I am not sure if it was the food or him just growing, but it did seem more that just a coincidence. I have always had dogs and I spend a lot of time with them being very conscientious of how they are feeling. In general the other food seemed to have the same affect on him that eating fast food does on me, tastes good but I am so run down later.I have tried the other varieties of Blue Buffalo, but this seems to be their favorite.
I've ordered this item (Healthy Weight Large Breed Dry Dog Food) for a couple months now and my dog LOVES ITAlso, shipping is always fastHighly recommended

column9: Dog won't eat it (Updated: but likes other brands)
column10: I bought this with high hopes in my quest for a dog food that won't aggravate my dog's allergies. Unfortunately, he doesn't like this food and won't eat it until he's starving and even then he eats only a little at a time. He's never been picky about his food before until now. Then today, after about 3 days, he vomited the food a few hours after eating an entire bowl.Warning: If you are a first time buyer, I would recommend buying a small package to test with. Unfortunately, I purchased the 30 lb. bag that will be wasted money. I may try to see if a local shelter wants the food, but they are usually picky about feeding the dogs multiple varieties.I did just buy a 15 pound bag of the Blue Buffalo Fish and Sweet Potato and will give that shot before giving up on Blue Buffalo. But so far, I'm disappointed.------------UPDATE 1/1/2012I bought the Fish/Sweet Potato food and my dog likes it! I'm glad that I can stop searching for decent, wholesome dog food and buy Blue Buffalo from now on.I bumped this rating to 3 stars from 2 even though my dog doesn't like this particular brand. But I believe the company is trying to do the right thing and they can't please every dog's palate. I'm giving 5 stars for the Fish/Sweet Potato food.
Great product, my dogs loves it. They loved the Wilderness duck recipe, but it has is very high in fat content.

Prior to Blue Buffalo, my dog had a tendency to vomit after every meal.  The vet told me to experiment with different brands of dog food to see which one worked best for my labrador.  Due to his sensitive stomach, Blue Buffalo was the only brand my dog could eat without throwing up afterwards.  It's a bit pricey, but he loves the stuff.
My dog is enjoing this Blue Buffalo  and it is the second time I order it. I will get it again.

Good food. My dog loves it and the big bonus is that he eats less of it. It's worth it to spend a little more money knowing my dog is getting good, REAL food. Super fast shipping! Awesome deal on Amazon.

My family (me, wife, and four kids) love this product. We use it to make muffins and pancakes. It is "just add water" easy to make muffins, and there is a simple recipe for pancakes on the back. We sometimes make chocolcate-chocolate chip muffins by adding a tablespoon of cocoa powder to the mix before adding the water. We usually use a mini-muffin pan to cook the muffins and the kids love to eat them for breakfast and for snacks. All of the muffins and pancakes we make come out tasting delicious. This product was hard to find in our local grocery stores, so we were delighted to see Amazon carry it and we use the subscribe&save to make sure we don't run out. Twelve thumbs up from our family!

column9: Excellent product, package a bit confusing though
column10: Purchased these because the 5 kids across the street are bored to tears this summer. Ages 4-14, Dad is laid off and the Mom is working nights unloading trucks at a Target 5 towns away. To give the Dad a break once/week, I get all 5 kids together and we make a ton of these all at once. What they don't eat coming right out of the oven while still warm, we manage to cool and freeze so they have some all week. (I got a few other flavors, too, so they have a variety).  These are good with a fair amount of choc chips in them and couldn't be easier to make: just add water and spritz the muffin tins.Note:  The package shows a white/vanilla muffin with chocolate chips, however, the mix is actually a chocolate muffin with choc chips. Still pretty good, just looks different than the package. To keep the kids a bit busier for a while, we add other stuff: chopped nuts, cocoa powder for even more choc flavor, added choc morsels. Then, of course, we must all 'taste' the batter before placing it in the muffin tins. Good thing I bought cases of this stuff! Gonna keep it on hand from now on: it is that good and easy.

Tastes great! This is my kind of product..."Just add water".....can't beat that!  This is the easiest way to make muffins or a loaf. I've even used the mix in my breadmaker on the quick bake setting and made two packages at the same time with great results. Allows you to have cake any time and especially nice for unexpected company (don't need anything but water).Bakes in less than 25 minutes even in my convection oven. The choc chip is delicious and there are 4 or 5 other flavors. Impossible to get in the grocery stores. I hope Amazon keeps offering these.
So I'm deployed and happened to come across the lovely cupcake maker Sunbeam makes - amazing - and this just add water mix has made my entire unit happy!  Especially me, a huge chocolate lover.

I made 2 packs of this muffin mix, and made mini muffins. When I mixed it up, I noticed there were hardly any chocolate chips in the packages.We've eaten 15 of the 30 mini muffins, and only found TWO chocolate chips. It doesn't look like there are any in the remaining ones either. I will be calling Better Crocker in the morning to voice this complaint. My children were very disappointed
These are so easy and cook in 10 minutes in my muffin maker.  I've even heated the mix in the microwave to melt the chocolate chips and then bake; voila chocolate muffins.  Yum!

column9: Not as good as expected. Taste has diffrent.
column10: I found them first time at target and like very much and ordered it on Amazon (bulk quantity). I received them quickly but when I tried, it was not the same taste. I do not know what was missing but did not like it at all.

I WAS ATTRACTED BY THE CONVENIENCE OF "JUST ADD WATER." PLUS, BETTY CROCKER, CHOCOLATE CHIPS, AND A YUMMY LOOKING GRAPHIC, ALL COMPELLED ME TO JUMP.HOWEVER, THE CAKE IS SPONGE LIKE WITH GREAT TASTING CHIPS. I WAS HOPING FOR A MOIST CAKE TEXTURE.
