Of course m&ms are always good, but did you know that 1 tube holds $14.00 worth of quarters, so it makes a very good moneymaking project for charities, churches, etc.
Bought the whole box of these mini M&M's for my mom cause they are hard to find as singles. She loves it and a great energy booster for her.

column9: Better than ghirardelli's, but still not what I am looking for
column10: I received an espersso maker for Christmas and have been on a mission to find the right white chocolate sauce to make my Iced White Mocha's Starbucks style.  I wanted to cut back on spending $4-$8 a day on Iced Venti White Mochas but I have yet to find the right sauce.  I already have the right coffee but both Torani and Ghirardelli are not the same sauce Starbucks uses.  However, Torani was better that Ghirardelli's.  Who would have thought it!!  Ghirardelli's tasted like condensed milk and was transparent.  Torani was a lot thicker and white.  Please add your comment to this review if you can help me find the right sauce.  I'm going broke here buying all these sauces.Thanks!!

I can make Starbucks at home!!!  I love this sauce!  So cheep and so worth every penny!  Make sure you get the pump to go with it though it is very thick and will drizzle and drip!  It also lasts for months!
OH the white chocolate flavor is so good...it is like a small piece of heaven in pump bottle.  I just wish it lasted longer.
Best deal out there.  Good price and definetly best white chocolate sauce on the market, only had a couple of issues with shipping.  Shipped direct for the manufacture.

I ordered the Starbucks syrup before this...both are good.  I went for this one because it was cheaper at the time...now they are both about the same price.  Just make sure you order a pump for either. This one only comes with a cap and the Starbucks one doesn't reach the bottom.
got on time... only thing was that for the price i paid and for the pure size of the bottle i would have thought a bottle pump would have come with it..other then that everything was great.
I have been searching for a product to use in hot chocolate and milk shakes and this is it! I love the flavor and now have to buy this giant size because my family is addicted to it too.
Not fully what I was expecting, but now I know what 'cracked' means when it comes to wild rice.  Not full grain, but still tastes pretty decent.  The price is good for what you get.
We love wild rice!  We ordered it here becuase it is hard to find around our area at a good price. Price is great compared with local stores.  Cooks well and tastes great!

column4: Ray F. Mihulka III "Ray F. Mihulka III"
column10: Love the rice and the price is exceptional.  Cooks in my Zorushi rice cooker but takes a little longer.  I soak it for awhile before cooking and itcomes out great.
This rice is broken pieces, and really doesn't taste very good.  Really inferior quality, and I won't purchase again.  Too bad.
Its all cracked up (not whole long kernels), but good taste and a great value at about $4 per pound for wild rice.
I love the crunch and nutty texture of this wild rice. It's a great alternative to regular rice and healthier too. It has a distinctive aroma when cooking.

I started out buying one jar of this fabulous stuff...quickly ordered a 3 jar pack almost immediately upon tasting it. This stuff has quickly become one of my very favorite snacks - I like it spread on slices of apple. I have shared a jar with a couple of family members who like it very much. My immediate reaction was LOVE and now I require it just about daily! So on my last order, I signed up for subscribe & save on this. I don't want to run out. It's not as smooth as peanut butter, has a little different consistency...but it's not like chunky peanut either. Just a little grainy, and FABULOUS.
This is the best almond butter I have ever had! I love the hint of maple in it. Will definitely purchase again!
This maple almond butter is fantastic.  It is soooo much better than peanut butter - at least to a grown-up palate.
We had a hard time finding this product locally recently. We ordered two packs of the dummies and they arrived quickly and were very fresh.

column9: real deal dr. pepper for your sodastream
column10: you can make dr. pepper just the way you like it. i add a shot of vanilla.if you are using this for sodastream Sodastream Fountain Jet Soda Maker Starter Kit (not the dispenser it was made for) this is what i had to do:1. with a drill, carefully drill out a large hole (warning, i wouldn't use a knife) in the dispenser cap2. pour the syrup into a secondary container. then use that to fill your sodastream bottle.3. if i was missing something plz let me know as i will be re-upping on this item.tip: try dr. pepper and chocolate ice cream for a decadent treat.

column9: Dry, not much fruit, but convenient...
column10: I used to eat these in high school for breakfast and I loved them. I bought 6 boxes of these to have to eat as a snack and for breakfast on the drive to work. So these are great for that purpose.However, these aren't a quality food product. They are dry, there is very little fruit filling in them, and the bars are very small. Sometimes you take a bite and can't even taste the fruit filling because there is hardly any in there.But, I will probably buy these again just for breakfast and emergencies. Honestly, though, they're not that great.

column9: Quite Good. Nice and Fresh and Flavorful.
column10: We always keep a supply of cereal bars around for our little boy (4 years old). His eating can be somewhat erratic  and there are times when I don't think he's getting enough to eat and he refuses to eat anything else. Well, I can almost always get him to eat a good cereal bar. I've bee using the Fresh and Easy bars and they're quite good and the boy likes them. Well, this time, they had a small display of Kellogg's Nutri-Grain bars and they were on a deep discount sale. I bought a couple including this blueberry variety. The bars are quite good. Nice and fresh and flavorful. They certainly didn't last long with the boy. They'll do. Nice mix of ingredients too.Gary Peterson
These Nutri-Grain bars were a good deal, especially with the on-line "special coupon" that was available when I bought them.  Saving money on a good product is a good thing!  :
Nothing beats a good cup of coffee in the morning with macadamia nut syrup and a hint of coconut (which is also a monin product).

This tea has a light strawberry taste.Soothing and comforting.I use a Mr. Coffee maker to brew our teas. Works really great.  Sometimes I mix different tea bags.Just toss the tea bags in with no filter, put the brew strength on, use spring water and it always comes out great!I will be purchasing this tea again.Thank you Amazon for having this available!

This really is the best tea on the market.  I've only tried the strawberry, but I would be willing to guess that all the other flavors are as brilliant and tasty as this.  When I run out, I steal it from my mother's.  It's that good.

Wonderful tasting, and a wonderful smell.  The Kahlua Mocha coffee also makes the best tasting frappucino's ever (complemented with Splenda mocha flavor sticks)!!  I've not been able to find this brand in my local stores and was so greatful to find it on Amazon - no other coffee has compared to this for my iced coffee drinks.
Absolutely love the flavor of this coffee! I have tried many chocolate/mocha flavored coffees and this trumps the others. Especially delicious with a little vanilla almond milk and agave.

I received one bag as a gift (regular) and now got the mocha. This coffee is remarkably rich, perfectly ground and an incredible surprise. Better than many of the other costlier coffees I've purchased by a long shot. Surprising stand out.
I have been looking for Kahlua flavored coffee since Millstone stopped making it. I Googled it and it led me to Amazon. I love it! Finding it in a two pack was a huge perk!

The taste is okay, but the caffeine was, for me, intolerable. I had a large cup of Kahlua Mocha at around 10 AM. A short time later, I found myself telling my sister-in-law things she didn't need know. In the afternoon, still hopped up on caffeine, I broke a measuring cup that had survived years of use. When I went to bed at 1 AM, I was wide awake. An hour and a half later, I dosed myself with Nyquil so I could get some sleep.I'm admittedly caffeine sensitive, but one cup of coffee has never hit my so hard for so long - I'm giving it away to a beloved coffee addicted neighbor!

This coffee is great but I prefer the Original Kahlua better than the mocha enhanced version. It takes away from the Kahlua taste instead of adding to it. Still great though but I will stick with the original on my reorder.
This is the best mocha coffee I have ever had.  I have tried at least 5 others and Kahlua is the best.
So many people have complimented me on my coffee and it is always Kahlua mocha.  What a great coffee!!!!!  I drink it myself and I serve it to company, it is a crowd pleaser.

column9: Bold, Flavorful , Everything you want in a flavored Coffee
column10: I have to say until I saw this product in the Gourmet section of a Department store, I'd never heard or seen of Kahlua Mocha, Gourmet Ground Coffee. Now i'm wondering where i've been all this time.I've tried many gourmet flavored Coffees, This is the best bar none.And i've tried many!Bold in coffee taste, Rich in mocha flavor, this particular item is a must for any flavor-coffee connoisseur.Sometimes flavored coffees seem to be a toss up in compromise, flavor means less coffee strength, or coffee strength overpowers the flavor. Not so for this particular product.The Perfect Marriage of Coffee And Flavor - Congratulations and Well Done!
All we could taste in the coffee was some yukky chemical thing--i was very disappointed as ive tried their other coffees and was impressed.  Have one more bag to get rid of--any takers?

Who knows how you would like it.. but Ugh.. Not a fan. and trust me.. I LOVE Kahlua. It sounds real good.. but the taste was blah. Other people who I made it for thought it was "alright". I will not be ordering this again.

On our vacation we bought a package at a health food store.  We enjoyed the taste so much that we bought more.  Some fibre and low in calories.  Now I am looking at Amazon to order some and am happy that they are available.

The first time I learned about this product was in Lima-Peru when I came to the States I researched for the coffee and I like it very much. Its healthy and has a good taste.I wonder if all the virtues that this coffee has are scientifycally proven.Gio

This was a great product and I will certinely order more. Their price was good and speed of delivery was exceptional. Without question I would recommend this product and company to anyone looking for a healthy choice in coffee.
This is one of the best drink i have ever tried. Great for people with high blood preasure, diabetes, fibromyalgia, fatigue syndrom and stress. You pick.La cochocha
I love this coffee is a healthy coffee, smells like coffee, I love it!!! and if we add the ganoderma of the best I've tasted!

I was introduce to this coffee by my best man at my wedding.  It is deliecious and is cost effective for me to maintain my addiction without going broke.  Instead of paying over $5 a day at starbucks.  I get by on .50 a day.
This stuff tastes great by itself or mixed in coffee. I will buy Gano again and recommend this to anybody.

Easy and quick to make, I just heat up some water and empty a sachet into it. Lot less messy than making regular coffee, and this stuff is a lot better for you, too. Several of my family members really like this stuff, and plan on stocking up on it in the future. I just wish I could find it in our local grocery store, but something tells me they'd still be cheaper on here with the free shipping on $25+ orders.20 sachets per box.

the flavor is amazing, but I was shocked how small these popcorn kernals are once they are popped.  They are little bigger than fresh peas or blackeyed peas...as the other review said, they are not really for snacking!  But the flavor is amazing...they have others like the purple that pop up larger and taste as good...so depends on what you want them for...

column4: Dame Jayne of the Divine Chocolatier
column10: This blue kernel popcorn pops very small and very white with a nice nutty flavor. They are a bit too small for regular popcorn snacking but they'd be wonderful for popcorn balls or caramel popcorn.
This is great tasting popcorn, but kernals are tiny and HARD! If you have dental issues of any kind, I would avoid this one.
Strinkingly white popcorn with very slight blue-colored undertones to the color rendering of final pop.Great taste and not stale at all.
These are petite kernals pop up fluffy and have a special crunch and a different taste.  Yummy.  They work good in my air popper if I tilt it backwards a bit as it pops.  Work great on stove top.
This is very high qulity pop corn, I recomend it.  Almost all kernels pop and they are a crisp white when they pop.  Very healthy and yummy!

I am a huge popcorn lover and eat it all the time as a snack. I was looking forward to getting this because I really like hull-less popcorn much better and this just sounded the best. I didn't seem t have much luck making it in the microwave (I use the brown paperbag method). It kept burning or just didn't pop right. The kernels are much too small for snaking for me, but my 2 1/2 year old loves it and the kernels are actually just the perfect size for her little fingers. I went and bought myself a jar of regular kernels from the supermarket and designated that the blue popcorn was for her. She enjoys is much more then I did I think. It does have a wonderful aroma and taste though!

column9: Great product, shipping a little high
column10: The product is wonderful.  Wish shipping was a little less, would purchase more often.
I didn't have much luck with this popcorn in the microwave. I think it may have been old. I would not purchase a 2nd time.

I am a huge fan of popcorn and eat it at least 3 nights a week.  And I was really looking forward to receiving this popcorn.  And it is good popcorn, but I am disappointed at the size and type of corn.  This is very small kernel corn, which means that it doesn't pop up to the same volume as regular corn.  And because the kernels are smaller, it is almost impossible to use with my air popper (it will actually blow it out of the machine un-popped because it is so light).  And while the taste is good, the price does not justify it.  There is other store bought popcorn that is just as good and a better value.

This European licorice product is excellent especially as it is "sugar free."  However, one must remember that this is not like the cheap licorice products one may find in their supermarket and that it may contain elements unfamiliar to the average American palate. But, in any event I am thankful that I can purchase this product in quantity without having to travel a distance to a specialty food store for it and at competitive pricing.Gustaf's makes other licorice products, e.g. "Double Salted" which is also an acquired taste as the ammoniate in it is more discernible both taste and in odor for some.I saw one review that complained that the product gave them gastric distress.  Well, licorice is a cathartic and if you get carried away in consuming it, you will have that problem.  As for me, I will probably continue to enjoy Gustaf's products.

column9: Can't tell it is sugar free!
column10: This licorice was the best sugar free I have ever had. Loving licorice and being diabetic was terrible. Now that I have discovered Gustaf's, it isn't so bad anymore!

I LOVE LICORICE! I also don't what all the calories and side effects. These are tasty little bits that give me all the taste without the guilt. A whole 7 oz cup keeps me for about 10 days of satisfying "chewiness". Better than weight watchers "fruities". I eat maybe a point a day.

I was crossing my fingers when these arrived that they wouldn't be like gummy bears.  They weren't.  They are like tuff dots.  Like licorice should be.  I really had to do a double take at the package to make sure they were indeed sugar free.  I just couldn't tell.  I haven't eaten them in great amounts maybe 10 at a time and haven't had any intestinal problems like some other sugar free candy does.  This is my new favorite candy.

column9: Sent wrong thing......said you were sending right, and didn't!
column10: I love the sugar free licorice and order them frequently.  This last order, the regular ones were sent, not the sugar free.  I contacted Amazon and they said that they would send me the sugar free ones without charge.  That was a couple of weeks ago and I have not recieved them yet.Susan

I am a diebetic and love licorice, black real licorice, the licorice bears are good once you get passed the strange oder. I have had some licorice nibs made in Germany that top the licorice bears. All in all these are good if you don't want that waxy taste of the common U.S. makers of sugarfree licorice.

I have sent this product several times to diabetic family members. They are always pleased and have made no complaint about the flavor. The 6 sealed containers help keep product fresh & allow for more wise snacking. A great hard-to-find item that makes many people happy.

Being from Europe, I absolutely love these... they taste great, and being sugar-free is an added bonus.I understand why some Americans may not like these, as Americans in general prefer sweeter foods than Europeans, but if you're unsure I definitely recommend you try them.
I've always been a fan of licorice bears.  These are perfect--salty and dense.  You really can't tell that they are sugar free.

Gustaf's Sugar Free Licorice Bears are the best sugar free licorice I have ever tried. No weird after taste and the texture is like any other licorice product. I wish it was available at more stores but I'll continue to order it on Amazon.
If you are a fan of black licorice then you will really enjoy these licorice bears. They are soft yet chewy with a rich licorice flavor.
This is the best snack for me that has come along.  My blood sugar is not affected at all by eating thesa and they taste great too!
If you love black licorice but can't or don't want the sugar you really should give these a try.  Me and my brother think they are great.  They are soft and have a good flavor.
Licorice is not overly sweet even a little bitter but just riught for me.  No ammonia taste.  I like the hardness.

column9: Best Sugar Free Licorice on the Market
column10: My wife and I just love this product and have just made our 3rd large bulk purchase of this item thru Amazon.  It is not too sweet and great for myself who has no sugar issues and great for my wife who can't have sugar.  We are glad Amazon sells it!

If you like Licorice, DON'T buy these.  If the manufacturer had spent another nickle on licorice extract this candy might be palatable.  The consistency is fine, like a soft gummy bear.  The flavor is severely lacking.  What flavor there is is almost acrid.  The manufacturer also missed the mark on the nutritional information.  Each package is 7 oz.  The per serving information is listed for a 42 gram serving with no indication as to how many pieces that is.  There is also caution about eating too much will cause you lower tract distress, but again, there is no indication as to how much is too much.  Since there were both positive and negative reviews I thought I'd take a chance.  I did and I lost.  Be forewarned and don't make the same mistake I did.

I hesitate to rate this product because taste is an individual thing. However, I tried to give this product away to anybody who would take it at work...and no one would take it!The licorice flavor is very different, if one could really call it licorice.I would not recommend you invest in a quantity of this product unless you KNOW that you like the flavor.

column9: Finally good black sugar free Licorice
column10: This is the best sugar free black licorice I have found to date. This has a good strong licorice flavor up front with a good salt taste in the back of the flavor. I also did not detect any funky after taste. My only complaint is the delivery system. And that is the only reason for the four stars. I found I needed to put about four of those little bears in my mouth at a time to have a small mouth full. And the problem with that required me to chase them around in my mouth while eating them. They are also not all that soft and chewy. And require pretty good teeth to eat them. But all in all they are very good and I would never hesitate buying them again. And I am very particular! I am still looking for some really good sugar free Red Licorice?
it was a great produce, the only problem that i had with it was that i did not think that it had any calories in it but it did,

column9: Gustaf's Sugar-free licorice bears from Amazon make me smile!
column10: Gustaf's Sugar Free Licorice Bears fill the need for this diabetic to indulge herself, to reward herself for good nutritional behavior and to fill that need for something sweet which is not overpowering nor hurtful.  One must follow the rules and not overdo it - read the label carefully to make sure you do not indulge in behavior which results in diarrhea!  I do not always chew them - I suck them while they are in my mouth, which yields a much greater and longer satisfaction.  It probably is an acquired taste, but my bears keep me happy!
This sugar free licorice was a present for my diabetic sister-in-law. She loves it. I like the nice smaller size tubs, so she is not tempted to eat it all at once.
With pre-diabetes in our family and we love licorice, these sounded like a perfect treat, but not to be. Not tasty or even pleasantly sweet.Will discard and not purchase again.

I bought this for my husband and he absolutely loves it.  It ran out quickly because the guys at work kept eating it on him.  Everyone loved his Gustaf's Sugar Free Licorice as much as he did.  I will be ordering more real soon.

I purchased these candies hoping for a good tasting soft licorice candy.  Ummm...no on both accounts.  Taste was miles away from any of the licorices Ive had and these things were hard as rock.  Oh well...at least I tried them.

I am a great lover of licorice.  And I don't know what this stuff is, but it ain't licorice. It has a strong ammonia taste, and reminds me more of droppings in a cat's litter box than any sort of candy. I've been told this is just a 'different' sort of licorice, and it's meant to be slightly salty, instead of sweet. But I'm not confusing ammonia with salt. This definitely has a urine odor, and since I've never tasted cat urine, I can only guess this is what it would taste like. Don't waste your money. This might make you ill.
my dog would not eat it.  he took one snif and tried to cover it up--don't waste your money.
I ended up throwing them all out because they were extrememly tough and not very tasty.

YOU CAN'T CALL THIS PRODUCT LICORICE...HAS AN AMMONIA TASTE AND GAVE ME GAS.  IN RETURNS IT SAYS THERE ARE NO RETURNS, YOU WILL BE STUCK WITH THE MOST HORRIBLE TASTING BLACK BEARS.  ANY ONE THAT GAVE THIS PRODUCT A FAVORABLE REVIEW IS LACKING THE SENSE OF TASTE.  I HAVE BEEN BUYING THE VINE BRAND LICORICE WHICH IS GREAT, AND WILL THROW GUSTAF'S SUGAR FREE BEARS IN THE TRASH BIN.
I am not sure how good something can be for you that tastes distinctly like amonia.

First of all they weren't soft at all and they stuck to me teeth.  Second, they upset my stomach where I had cramps.  Third, they gave me gas all night, bad enough to keep my wife up all night.  I wouldn't recommend this candy to anyone unless they were an enemy.

column9: Don't waste your health, time or money
column10: Some caused gastrointestinal disturbances.Some cans may have only a few pear slices: Some cans may have many.I discovered the discrepancy too late to return to amazon.comSuspected recalled product but can find no evidence.Bought halves and slices of pears: discovered fruit cocktail in one can labeled pears.Beware.
when i receive the product half of the contence was leaked out and soaked all over the box it came in. So i only got half the bottle. Other than that i enjoyed the rest of the bottle.

column9: One thing I like about China
column10: Dole has provided another great service to the consumer, MANDARIN ORANGES, in 15 ounce cans.  The orange segments are large, juicy and tasty.  So good with many other foods, salads, and nearly decadent, when eaten as a bowl of oranges.  A good source of Vitamin C, and the mineral potassium...Summer, or winter, Dole has given me something I can't remember eating in my youth (Many, many years ago!), a delight for my tongue and taste buds, as well as my good-health and well-being.  Thank you to Amazon for providing the means to an end.

I bought this for my fiance because it says non-dairy and my fiance is allergic to milk. I made him a cup and he immediately broke out in a rash, then started wheezing and coughing! I looked at the bag and noticed the ingredients listed sodium caseinate and noted it was a milk derivative! This is one of the milk proteins that people with allergies are allergic! So do not order this if you need it parve or non-dairy or if you are allergic to milk!On the upside, it does taste good and shipping was very fast!

This was on sale for a reason.  It's big enough for...one!  I thought I was getting something bigger but the seller cleverly didn't list the ounces.  A nice bite but won't work for my holiday party as I had hoped. Beware.

column9: Zero calorie, refreshing and cheap flavored seltzer
column10: This product is fantastic. Basically, it's just zero calorie, flavored seltzer, so for those who love the carbonation of seltzer, but none of the nasty high fructose corn syrup, this is what you want and probably already buy at the supermarket.But what makes this so great is the handy 16.9 oz bottle size to bring with you everywhere (as opposed to 2L seltzer bottles), the four-flavor variety pack and the fact that Amazon, at least when I bought this, is selling it cheaply, at about fifty cents a bottle. I'll definitely keep buying this as long as Amazon keeps stocking it and keeps the price reasonable.Flavors included are: Lemon-line, berry, tangerine and natural (unflavored).

column9: Best and most refreshing carbonated water on the market and even better because it's all natural and NO SUGAR!
column10: I have purchased Talking Rain from Costco for years and now they no longer carry it.  For all of you who are looking for a fruit flavored carbinated drink, all natural and with NO sugar......THIS IS THE PRODUCT FOR YOU!! Best product to come on the market in a LONG time and I am amazed that Costco no longer carries it.

I really love this sparkling water. It is very satisfying and quenches thirst quickly with a slight flavor. It isn't sweet and is calorie free with out disgusting fake sugars. I have been drinking these instead of soda and it has really helped me kick that bad habit. I am so happy that I can buy them online with a subscription!

I read a bunch of reviews questioning the taste of the waters before buying and was rather concerned and only made the purchase because I couldn't find any other good alternative. Even expecting and thinking each sip would be bad not only were the flavors fine they were actually good. Even more they contain natural essences and oils (according to the bottle) so don't have sucralose or other artificial sweeteners which is a big time plus for daily drinking.

column9: For people who don't want sweetened (artificially or otherwise) drinks
column10: If most of what you drink is sugared or full of artificial sweeteners, you probably won't like these, but if you think that stuff is the devil's spawn and largely drink water, this is a nice change. They're flavored but not cloyingly sweet. Make sure to drink them chilled, as they're not very tasty at room temperature.Talking Rain is comparable to Perrier but it's less expensive and there's more flavor variety. The natural is a little bland, so you might want to toss a lemon wedge into your glass.The only downside, IMO, is that these come in plastic bottles (unlike Perrier), though that makes them more convenient for the gym or someplace glass would be frowned upon. I'd also prefer another flavor to the "natural," but that's just a matter of personal taste.

Love the automatic re-delivery system which enables me to receive this seltzer on a regular basis.  Product is always here when needed and I have the convenience of changing delivery date if necessary.  No more lugging a case of seltzer home from the grocery store....and the price is great!!

This is a product that competes directly with Calistoga, Crystal Geyser, or Perrier spring waters, not sweetened flavored waters. It only has essence flavor, which is a hint of the natural flavor. Anyone who drinks and enjoys plain carbonated spring water will enjoy this. It's a great product. For those that have to have a sweetened flavored water, you will not enjoy this. How can people not make this distinction is beyond me. Don't downgrade a product and give a bad review simply because you weren't able to recognize this basic distinction.

column9: wonderful value for great sparkling water
column10: really tasty and delicious.  delivered without hassle and ready to refrigerate and enjoy with friends or just when you feel like something refreshing and cool.

The only thing I really liked soft drinks for was the carbonation. But a few sips and they were just too sweet to quench the thirst.  Like drinking a candy bar! And the diet drinks with the fake sugar left odd after-tastes.  So I tried this Talking Rain.  No sweetener, no color, just a hint of flavor.  There's very little taste, so be prepared for that. If I want an ice-cream float, the carbonation provides the fizz and the only sugar I get is from the ice-cream.  I also like the screw-top cap which lets me keep a bottle to go back to in the fridge. If you close it tightly it will keep the fizz for a couple of days.  I keep the case stored in the basement where temperatures stay even.  I wouldn't store it in a garage or any warm place. I also like the fact that it's manufactured in the USA.  Don't want the French or Italian carbonated water.  The same company also puts out a drink called ICE, but I don't care for the more intense flavor.  (Sort of like a fruity Fresca.) So give the clear Talking Rain a try.

My experience of TalkingRain Sparkling Water is that the flavors are refreshing and enjoyable to drink. In fact, I ordered a second case after quickly finishing the first one. I drink seltzer water on a daily basis and have tried a number of brands. While the flavors are comparable in quality with others that I drink, I do prefer slightly more carbonation. The carbonation is sufficient upon opening, but tends to lose its effect by the end of the bottle. I am hopeful that this water will continue to be offered to Amazon Prime customers.
I have had other sparkling water products but Talking Rain is far superior in taste and quality! I order online because my local supermarket isn't on board with supplying outstanding products!

I was looking for something flavorful that had no calories or artificial sweeteners. I was getting sick of plain water. I tried other soda substitutes without great results. However, the TalkingRain Sparkling water was just what I was looking for. It has plenty of fizz and a great fruit taste. I enjoy all the flavors, but berry is by the far the best. I am drinking more water now. The only downside is plain water has much less appeal than before.

I bought this to get over a soda habit.  I am surprised that I like it so much.  I especially like the tangerine and lemon-lime flavors.  My husband likes the natural flavor.  There is a somewhat strong taste from the carbonation, which takes some getting used to if you are expecting the taste of non-carbonated water.  The package had 10 natural, 10 lemon-lime, 5 berry, and 5 tangerine bottles;  I don't know if all the packages have the same flavors.

I am a fan of HiBall Energy Water and wanted a similar natural flavored sparkling water, but without the caffeine.  I decided to try this variety pack and I am very happy with my purchase.  It contains 10 "Natural" (no flavor), 10 Lemon-Lime, 5 Berry and 5 Tangerine (tastes a bit like orange to me.)  I wish the assortment had more Berry and Tangerine as those are my favorites, but they are all quite good.  The flavor is the perfect amount, and there is NO after-taste.  And if you seal the cap tight, it will remain fizzy enough to drink the next day.  Exactly the healthy drink I was looking for!
This Talking Rain is carbonated water with a hint of flavor on three of the four types with the fourth being natural water.All tastes like bubbling water.

column9: Thank you, thank you, thank you!
column10: I am soooooo glad to learn that I can still find Talking Rain!  I've been buying from Costco for years and was so disappointed when I checked our two local Costco stores and couldn't find it.  I'm placing my order today for TWO cases!  I love all the flavors and what I really want is Zero calories plus lots of carbonation! Thanks so much for making this available.

I have to start this review by saying that I disliked sparkling water until I tasted Talking Rain. It is delicious, refreshing, and doesn't leave an after taste.  Best of all it satisfies my craving for "soda" without the sugar.  It's amazing.  The box contains berry, lime, orange and natural water. They all taste great.  I will definitely buy it again.

If you have been searching for a refreshing drink that isn't full of sweeteners, chemicals and who knows what else, check out Talking Rain.  It couldn't be any more simple or pure...carbonated mountain spring water and fruit essences from natural oils and extracts.  Amazon's price is competitive with big box stores (if they even carry it) and they deliver to my home free. Enjoy!
This is the best sparkling water on the market. If you like a variety of flavors, this is the one to buy.
These cans of carbonated juice are the perfect size for my daughters lunch box and they aren't overly sweet like soda. As soon as we tried a can we ordered more, so we wouldn't run out.
I am a cokeaholic and have been looking for many years for a no calorie sparkling beverage- this is it!Lemon lime is my favorite but they are all fabulous!

This is great water that has a wonderful light flavor.  The best thing about this water is that there is no salt!  I have been on a low-sodium diet for over 20 years; until I found this water, I was unable to drink carbonated water because all I could taste was the salt.  This is wonderful sparkling water with a very delicate flavor that enhances the taste and does not overwhelm the "water" experience.  I love water - this is the best sparkling water that I have ever tasted.
Love this seltzer, my only complaint is that it's not carried in stores locally where I live.  Glad I can get it online!

column9: LOVE this stuff, but don't buy it here!!!!
column10: Talking Rain is an awesome product.  It's sparkling water with a hint of flavor.  Don't expect this to be sweet or full of artificial flavors - it's all natural.  Think squeezing a lemon into your club soda for degree of flavor.Amazon's price on this is ridiculous.  Over [...]for the 30-pack?????  You can get it at Costco for less than $12.So DO buy Talking Rain....just don't get it here - unless home delivery is worth paying more than twice the price!

column9: TalkingRain Sparkling Essence is simply the BEST
column10: There are many products like this around, but I have found NONE better than TalkingRain!  I first found this product in my local Club store.  They were test marketing it, but never followed through with carrying it.  I contacted the company and begged them to bring it back.  One day while surfing the web, I found it on Amazon.  Best day of my life!  I now have it delivered on a regular basis (free shipping, by the way)!For anyone who loves sparkling water (no calories, no fake sweeteners), TalkingRain is awesome!  I'd buy stock in their company if I could.  Give TalkingRain a try!

column9: Double jeopardy with bad change coming
column10: My elderly father and I love these sparkling drinks.  I take them everywhere because living with So Texas weather mandates we keep hydrated. Now I have NO  taste for sodas and either does my sister in law.However, since Amazon is now charging taxes in Texas I will stop buying from Amazon on a regular basis.

column9: Tastes bitter like baking soda!!! Blech!!!
column10: We bought this based on the ratings, and we were sorely disappointed. This was a complete waste of money. It arrived promptly and was packed well. But the first bottle we opened (tangerine) tasted like pure baking soda water - think alka seltzer. So I opened a bottle of a different flavor thinking maybe there was a problem at the bottling facility and the mixture was wrong on the tangerine batch. The second bottle (cherry) was just as bad as the first. Everyone who tried it spit it into the sink and walked around for a few seconds with sour looks on their faces. I will never buy this again and do not recommend it to others. I hope we just got a bad shipment, I can't imagine that so many people would drink this on purpose.

I am glad I tried the TalkingRain Variety pack...I thought the plain seltzer was good and the other flavors were just ok...I prefer a stronger flavor and lots of carbonation both of which were lacking in my opinion.
This water had no flovor at all as compared to the Sparkling Ice.Plus when you get the variety pack 12 bottles are plain water.
This is very good tasting sparkling water.I wasn't so sure I would like it, but it is very good.I've got it comig regularly.

I thought this was great until I came to the tangerine flavor.  Wow what a disappointment!  It ruined the whole batch.  It tasted like, ...mmm fish oil! The smell was tangerine, but the taste, not so much.  I didn't understand that I had ordered this to come once a month, so now I am getting another 3, yes 3, 30 packs!  I just have to throw out the tangerine.  What a waste of money.  I read some of the other reviews and I guess the tangerine might taste like baking soda.  But I didn't even think it was that good.

There is barely any flavor to these drinks. Even when it is ice cold, the drink is hard to swallow. The carbonation is harsher than a soda and the drink leaves an aftertaste. In fact, the aftertaste is stronger than the flavoring of the drink. lol.

My grocery store stopped carrying my favorite flavored sparkling water so I decided to try TalkingRain Sparkling Essence. None of the flavors tasted natural,left a bad aftertaste & the carbonation was harsh in the mouth. I gave some bottles to a good friend who called me up to say that she was throwing the bottles away because the taste was so awful. Don't waste your money. This ranks as one of the worst sparkling waters I've ever tasted!.

I bought this water because I'm always looking for 0-calorie flavored water without sugar substitutes.  I tried this water based upon the reviews of other bloggers.  I bought the 28-bottle variety pack with berry, tangerine, lemon lime and natural flavors).  The berry flavor is my favorite.  The water is OK but if I can only purchase it through the Amazon website, I won't be buying more because the shipping and handling cost as much as the water!

column9: great product but too expensive through Amazon
column10: My son can't have fructose so we had to find something for him to drink besides plain water. This has worked out great. Only problem was I found it for 1/2 the Amazon cost somewhere else and they wouldn't cancel the order. I had to refuse the shipment. Product is great service was bad!

"4" and "flavor" are misleading. They all tasted exactly the same: like nothing. The only difference was the scents they each gave off, which were surprisingly pleasant. It's too bad the flavor didn't follow suit.
The taste of all the flavors is disgusting. If you want sparkling water, try the Sparkling Ice, Black Raspberry. It is delicious.
This water is awful. I bought it by mistake and not able to return it. Tried to drink it, but OMG! Disgusting!

I recommend using a grinder for this very coarse salt. It does not dissolve as well in cooking as kosher salt does. It also has a very strong salty taste, which is fine, but I was expecting more of a smoky taste than this has.Good quality, but not worth the money in my opinion.
Very pleased with this product. The plant was delivered in a timely manner and arrived in very good condition. It now happily eats flies and whatever else

Don't buy this product.  They crumble into pieces and do not hold the pills.  I tried to mold the pieces around the pill, and it still crumbles.  Now I use them as treats.  PurLuv HideNTreats were good, but the Sentry brand are useless.

As any native of the Aloha State will tell you, locals put Li Hing Mui Powder on anything and everything.  This sweet/sour/salty spice packs quite a punch; once you've had it, your mouth will forevermore water at the thought of it.  Literally. This spice goes well with all types of food, though it's at its best on fruit, candy and the rims of margarita glasses.  I highly recommend it with fresh oranges: slice them up and sprinkle some of this on them.  You'll never think of fresh fruit the same way again.

I was about 14 years old when I first tried Li Hing Mui powder.  I grew up in Oregon and had never heard of it but my best friend was from Hawaii and introduced the powder to me.  Dipping nectarine slices in the powder is an excellent snack - very tasteful and surprising for first timers.  I have been searching for the powder locally for about 10 years but have not been able to find it.  Believe me, you HAVE TO try Li Hing Mui - it's unlike anything you have ever tasted before in your life.

I love , love , love this spice and one of my fav ways to use it is to rub pork loin and pineapple slices with the powder and grill them. While they grill I put 1/2 cup pineapple juice, 1 tbs corn starch and Li Hing Mui to taste heat all ingredients until thick serve over pork and pineapple.  WONDERFUL!

I first tryed this when I went to Hawaii.  Was at the Dole plantation and they put this on pinapple slices. WOW your mouth will water for more.  I brought a pack right then, Ordered 3 more packs from dole online site when I got back to the mainland.  Also good on ham.
Nothing is better than a li hing mui margarita by the pool.  Left Hawaii three years ago and still order this online because we miss it so much!

column9: Natural Li Hing Mui where are you
column10: No one seems to mention that this stuff isn't even made from any natural ingredients.  The stuff on Hawaii is natural, at least the Li Hing Mui powder I saw in some of the stores there.  This stuff here is about as good for you as MSG.
Product just as promised!  My son loves Li hing Mui powder and plans on taking it back to college with him Thanks

I grew up on Li Hing... put it on gummy candy, fruit, everything.  Moved to midwest for work and can't find it anywhere.  TY Seller!Not exactly like what I was used to in Hawaii... but close enough.  Don't notice enough difference to say anything negative :)
Old fashioned popcorn popped right on the stove in olive oil!  Then seasoned with nutritional yeast, taco seasoning, little garlic (salt or powder) and Li Hing Mui!  THE VERY BEST POPCORN EVER!!!

column9: Good knock-off but not the "real deal" Li Hing
column10: As another member wrote, there's nothing really natural in this product. It's a "knock-off" of the true Li hing you get in Hawaii. This product has aspertame and licorice, two ingredients not in the original formula used all over Hawaii. However, they DO use this brand too in Hawaii, but not at the quality locations.

column9: not very nice pineapple tasted better without the powder i rekon i could make i better powder with sugar, salt and flavour
column10: i rekon i could make i better powder with sugar, salt and flavours out off the shelf from the local super market. tho item was well packed and turned up at mt door faster than i thought it would. just not my taste

column9: Don't be fooled - this sauce rules!
column10: I just got back from a trip to St. Maarten and on the table at a restaurant there was a bottle of this sauce.  It was love at first taste.  I put it on my tuna filet and was totally in hot sauce heaven.  I brought 2 bottles back with me and I am not sure they will survive the month.  I will be ordering much of this incredible sauce!

The main flavor of this sauce is the aged, pickled, Scotch Bonnet peppers. It has a delicious, complex, fruity flavor from these peppers. Although there is some sugar in it (cane sugar, not corn syrup), I think most of the sweetness actually comes from the pepper. I don't know what the scofield rating is, but it's quite  a bit hotter than most readily available hot sauces in the U.S., such as Habanero Tobasco. Unlike a lot of the hotter hot sauces, there is no sacrifice of flavor for heat. It is delicious AND hot.

column9: Great hot sauce in a league all its own.
column10: This stuff is hard to find, but worth the hunt. Matouk's is an extra thick concentrated and very very hot calypso type sauce. Its great on pork, shrimp, and all sorts of vegetables, even collard greens and beans. Use sparingly and build up a tolerance, its worth the pain. 5 Ribs

The first time I tried this was in some small restaurant in the Carribean years ago, and felt I was lucky to be able to get it regularly from the Fiesta markets in Houston. It's hot and flavorful and even many years later, one of my favorites. I'm glad I found somewhere that I can get it again.

I FOUND THIS HOT SAUCE ON THE TABLE AT THE BEACH FRONT RESTAURANT AT COOPER ISLAND IN THE BVI -- IT IS ABOUT THE BEST I HAVE EVER HAD, INCLUDING ALL OF THE HOT SAUCES AT HOME HERE IN TEXAS -- ITS BEST USE IS IN BLOODY MARY'S -- USE MR & MRS T'S MIX AND ADD A TEASPOONFUL OF THIS SAUCE -- DOC

I've been eating all kinds of hot sauces all my life. I really like HOT. Matouk's is a spicy kind of hot that has a pleasent taste as well. I'm not after the burn alone. I want the burn with flavor. Matouk's does that pretty well. Remember, the best hot sauces burn the next day too! Think about it.

column9: Simply the best hot sauce in the world
column10: It's HOT but has a complicated flavor profile. Takes you to the Caribbean in every bite. This is not a Central American type flavor- the heat comes from distinctly island ingredients.

This stuff is the best. My sister from the Caribbean loves this too. Tastes like home. I originally found it in Sint Martin...at a restaurant. It was sold out in all the grocery stores on the island so I got some from Amazon. Very, Very hot, but has a nice flavor..not just heat.

column9: IM FROM TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO AND THIS IS ONE OF THE WOST HOT SAUSE I EVER HAD THERE SO MUCH  BETTER ONE IN TRINIDAD
column10: IM FROM TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO AND THIS IS ONE OF THE WOST HOT SAUSE I EVER HAD THERE SO MUCH  BETTER ONE IN TRINIDAD  IT NOT  EVEN TASTY LIKE THE OTHERS IF FULL OF FOOD STARCH  .. IT NOT EVEN THAT HOT

....this sauce is, well, bad. Granted it's different from the gazillions of other hot sauces out there, and it IS spicy, but it seemed to flavor all of my food with the slight aftertaste of rotted vegetables.

If you've never had Wafu you need to give it a try!  BEST salad dressing ever and just like what you get in Japanese restaurants.  I've served this at home or when we have guests and it's a total hit every time.  I used to use it mainly as a salad dressing, but there are so many ways to cook with it.  Dip with sushi or veggies.  We've marinated chicken overnight or made Wafu burgers - major BBQ attraction!  They've got more flavors (GINGER CARROT and WASABI EDAMAME), and there is a Light version of ORIGINAL that has 43% less fat if you're counting calories (although the non-Light version is pretty healthy, too).  You can't go wrong.  Recipes are on the website [...]

I have tried other brands (Stonewall Kitchen, Harry and David, etc) and my family likes this mix the best.  They are fluffly and taste wonderful.  I've only bought the mix from Dancing Deer because I didn't know Amazon carried it.  It is a much better price from Amazon.

My wife got this in a holiday gift basket she won a her office holiday party a few years ago and we've been hooked ever since.  It's quick and easy to make up, the recipe on the can scales well if you need to double a batch when company is over and the waffles freeze and reheat well if you end up with more than you can eat in one sitting.We've ordered multiple times and they have always showed up quickly and in good condition.

Amazing deal when it is available as Gold Box deal.  Still a good price when not.  The product makes some amazing pancakes that are fluffy as long as you follow quantity directions.  You can get creative with additives and you should.  Nothing wrong with adding mini chocolate chips. Better than paying a lot at the stores.
It's OK but makes a thicker pancake than I'm used to.  I prefer another brand and will not be ordering this brand again.
i am NOT a fan of pancakes nor waffles but i bought it for my husband after reading all the reviews.  this is one yummy mix!  we LOVE it!!!

column4: Big Mac Real Investments LLC "Real Estate Mom"
column10: I ahve tried many waffle mixes Dancing Deer is the best-will not even consider any other mix-I think this product is just the best

column9: not as good as my scratch recipe
column10: I have a wonderful scratch waffle recipe.  I bought this mix for a quick back-up.  It is not as fluffy and light as my own recipe, but it is good.One complaint I have is with the packing method.  All three cans were put into one box, and when my package arrived, one of the cans had been crushed, the sealed lid was forced off, and the contents were spilled inside the box.  More packing was needed to prevent the cans from moving around during shipping.
I love this mix and I love the story of this company and how they have survived and prospered. This mix tastes as good or better than made from scratch. I will definitely recomend it to my friends.

If you want a candy bar that melts in you mouth, the Cadbury Crunchie bar is it.  Great product and the best service I've gotten from a company in a while.  I grew up eating these and it was a special treat to get some delivered to my home.  They are unavailable where I live now.  The company went above and beyond in their packaging too and they arrived safe and in the best condition.  Would buy these from this company again.

I had the pleasure of trying this bar for the first time in Halifax, Nova Scotia in 1999.  Now, whenever I am outside of the United States, I specifically look for these candy bars (I have eaten it in Europe in a couple of places).  I found a Asian Food Store locally that surprisingly carries it (2 weeks ago).  I am surprised that this is not sold widely on the US Market.This is a chocolate covered honeycombed bar with toffee undertones.  The bar lives up to its name, Crunchy!  The taste is so good it's worth traveling outside of the country for!Cadbury, are your executives reading this?  You need to market this in the United States.  What are you guys waiting for?This is a great candy bar.  You have to try it!Highly recommend!

column9: Delicious Honeycomb covered in Milk Chocolate!
column10: In the UK this is one of the most popular chocolate bars.  It is a light honeycomb bar covered in Cadburys Milk Chocolate. If you like toffee and chocolate you will love these!

column9: When you bite into a Crunchie
column10: It goes, mmmmmmm in your mouth. It also goes CRRRR in you mouth. It's delicious! The chocolate is not as sweet as Hershey's and does not have that odd waxy gritty feel Hershey's has. The honeycomb is delicate in the middle and will melt on your tongue, and is satisfyingly crunchy around the edges. This is one of my all time favourite chocolate bars, and I am thrilled to have found them on Amazon!

I ordered these after reading the item desciption and thinking, "Hmm. Honeycomb, that's interesting." Well, they're delicious--not too terribly sweet and good Cadbury chocolate on the outside. My whole family tried them and everyone gave positive comments. "Different but good" seemed to be the concensus--and we're all a bunch of sugar loving Okies.

column9: Mmm... One of my all time favorite chocolate bars! :-P~
column10: For those of you not familiar, "crunchie" bars are solid honeycomb coated with a relatively thin layer of milk chocolate. Personally, I love 'em! They're one of my all time favorite chocolate bars. They're popular both in England and here in Australia where I live.Not much more to say except that you can buy crunchies in a variety of pack sizes (size being determined by the number of bars included), and this 12-pack is kinda mid sized. The larger sized packs generally offer better value. Although prices on Amazon do fluctuate over time, as of the time of writing, this 12-pack will wind up costing you just a fraction of a cent over $1.66 a bar. Weirdly, despite the general "more is cheaper" principle, currently the 6-pack offers significantly better value at under $1.40 a bar. Freaky. So it pays to be a careful shopper!Just don't forget that it's not like these are a health food. So please... However many you buy, enjoy in moderation! ;-)Theo.
Nowhere near as good as Violet Crumble from Aust. but a good subsitute as it's off the market.  The chocolate is good, the honeycomb, a little sweet.

I am a Brit in USA and was craving a little bit of home so a friend recomended this website to me. Very good delivery, they were packaged in bubble wrap and a box with newspaper around for extra padding, they were all intact and the delivery was fast (free shiping was a big bonus!)  tasted like home :)  I have since ordered more .
For a Brit on a budget that CRAVES the best candy bar in the world, I want to say THANK YOU!  The price was amazing.  The shipping was great.  Would definately buy again.

These are the absolute best candy bars I've ever had. EVER. Snickers are trash compared to this (My old favorite bar). They have a mild honey taste, creamy chocolate, and the consistency of Lucky Charms marshmallows. They are very crunchy, like the name suggests, however they are not hard or ruff to the palate. I will have to stock up on these for sure, so I can avoid the trash candy we Americans are provided. I highly recommend this candy. I mean it. BUY IT NOW!On another note, I ordered from Pharmacy Place, the candy came quickly and in good shape. No melted bars. :D

This candy was delicious! Even better than crunchies I have had in the UK. :-)I was really impressed at how quickly I got the package, too. It arrived approx 4 weeks before it was expected!! :DUnfortunately, my brother ate 5 of the 12 while I was out of town for the weekend, so now I have to get more...oh well! Best, best, best crunchie ever on earth!!!!!!

This was the first time I tasted this chocolate and I must say I am very happy with the taste. I could have given a 5-star rating but a few of the chocolate bars had a white coating over their surfaces which did not make them look very fresh. I will definitely order again but I would like to get all bars new and fresh.
The crunchie bars were shipped very quickly.  They were packed well and arrived in perfect condition  Crunchie bars were fresh and tasted great!
Please see my other review for Crunchie bars, these are similar, just from a different source:)  Still more sugar :)

Having greatly anticipated trying these at the recommendation of some New Zealand friends, I can definitely say I was not disappointed. These chocolate bars are delicious. If you don't eat them too fast, they melt in your mouth. They don't sell these in the states for some crazy reason, so I was very glad to find them here. They shipped quickly, and arrived in perfect condition.

column9: It's okay, too sweet for me.
column10: They are just like US candy bars, but the honeycomb center really does taste like honeycomb, which I really liked. But these candy bars are intensely sweet, and are much sweeter compared to many US candy bars, at least to me. I wanted to try anyway to see how they taste different from the US candy bars, but I wasn't too impressed about these. I loved the food there when I was in the UK, but I guess I don't care for their candies as much.

Hey there!  This is an Australian/New Zealand candy bar that is fantastic.  Have any of you ever eaten sea foam candy here in the United States? That is what this tastes like.  Excellent chocolate with, crunchy, "honeycomb"center.  Hard to describe the taste, honestly.
Very Disappointed!!!! I order these candy bars twice a year for my adult children. This is the second time I have received expired or about to expire merchandise:(

Just received my box of Cadbury Crunchie I've been waiting for. Every review was glowing which sold me on these and made me willing to take a 37.00 chance on 24 candy bars (shipping).Ripped into the box, ripped open a bar, oh man, let me tell you, well, just let me say, Brits, you can keep your health care system AND your Cadbury Crunchies.Serious man, I am only writing this to save some other poor sap of a Yank from thinking that you will like these. Bland bland bland, unless you like the flavor of a bitter burnt sugar center, which is all the flavor the crunchy center has. The chocolate outside is not a sweet chocolate at all, and the only word for it is bland.I am glad to take this rating down a notch or two, as it deserves to be. Keep looking, don't stop here if you want something good and interesting. Seriously, move along folks, there is nothing to see here.

I have lost 70 pounds and this stuff helps keep me from snacking on bad stuff.  I keep it out in plain sight (stored in glass container) for easy access, and it is good enough to satisfy a sweet tooth.

I constantly look for more ways to increase the value of my Prime membership.  Getting grocery items is one of them.  It is the same Kashi Go Lean Crunch Honey Almond Flax I buy in the supermarket, but it is delivered to my door and it contains two regular packages of cereal.  Nothing wrong with that.

column9: So good for you and is Delicious!
column10: I've been eating this once a week for the past two months and can tell the difference it makes. Don't worry you won't have to sit near the toilet cause of the fiber..lol I highly recommend that you include this in your day to day or start out week to week like I do.  The price in a supermarket around here is about $3.50-$5 for a 12-15 OZ

I prefer it dry as a snack although some pieces are hard and large enough to make one think it could break a tooth. A caution is one cup has 200 calories and trust me it would be easy to eat 2-3 times that amount while mindlessly watching a movie. This specific cereal does has quite a bit of sugar which could be reduced without any negative flavor effects. It also has 8 grams of fiber if you are trying to get 20-30 grams per day. This is my second favorite Kashi cereal with Kashi U Cereal, Black Currants & Walnuts being number one. I think Kashi in general makes wonderful products (okay some of their "bars" aren't so hot)and though most aren't organic, I think their brand is safer and healthier than most other non-organic brands.

This is the largest box of cereal that I have ever seen. There are 2 bags of cereal inside the huge box. And it definitely is crunchy! You can break your teeth on it so let the chunks absorb some milk first.

Beware...the "Crunch!"  is for real.  So real, I broke a tooth eating the stuff.  It seemed good, maybe I received an over cooked batch.  Too scared to try it again.  It has ended up being the most expensive cereal I ever purchased:(

I love angel hair pasta and am also looking for healthier alternatives.  Colavita Whole Wheat Capellini is delicious and has a nice, firm texture.  It is not gummy like other whole wheat pastas I have tried.  Even my son, who normally doesn't like whole wheat pasta, likes this one.  You may ask, "what will I do with 20 packages of pasta?"  I included one each in holiday gift packages to my friends.  They would also work as part of a housewarming gift along with olive oil, balsamic vinegar, Parmesan cheese, etc.

Hometown Favorites / Crossroads Market has $5 shipping for seemingly as many jars as you order (I ordered 5).  Save almost 50% off this item (comparing final prices at checkout) with huge difference in shipping ($33 vs $5).  Oh --- the pickles are great!

I have ordered these particular pickles several times from Amazon.  My hometown used to carry them but quit doing so five plus years ago.  I love these pickles.  They are a little salty but this is to my liking. The shipping is a little high.  It cost more to ship than to buy the pickles. However, they are worth it.  If you like the pickles your grandmother or mother used to can, these are for you.  They remind me so much of my grandmother's canned pickles which I loved.  I will keep buying these as long as Amazon can get them.

column9: Taste just like the red label Genuine Dills
column10: I ordered the red label Heinz Genuine Dills and got these instead.  They taste just like the red label sour and delicious.

column9: Cold brine process produces crisper pickles
column10: Cold brine processing takes longer but makes pickles crisper and crunchier.  Todays mass marketed pickles are produced using heat, which cooks the pickles and makes them soggy.

My order came very well packaged,not one jar damaged. Seeing as the grocery stores in my town don't carry these pickles,I was forced to order them online. Don't know why they don't carry a good brand of pickles anymore but no problem. I just won't be buying my pickles at these grocery stores. Am very happy with my stash of favorite pickles!

column9: Love these pickles.  Already on jar #3 They have a salty taste and are crunchy.
column10: Looked everywhere for these pickles and found them on amazon.  I love the salty taste and they are crunchy too. Similar to the pickles I had once at a New York deli.Loved them.

None of the big box retailers in the Cincinnati area will carry these, even after numerous requests and offers to buy the whole shipment at their exorbitantly inflated mark -up.BUT! ! !  There is hope.  A local store named Jungle Jim's that specializes in hard to find stuff has 'em.  And lots of 'em!  $4.79 a jar, but it's SO worth it to me.  My macaroni salad depends on it.  If I can't serve these, I refuse to serve pickles at all because they are all second class.Hope this helps someone!  My mouth is watering as I leave to go get about 10 jars!  Life is good.

from Jonny Bowden, PhD, C.N.S.:Agave syrup (nectar) is basically high-fructose corn syrup masquerading as a health food.Sorry. Don't kill the messenger.It's easy to understand how agave syrup got its great reputation. Even the word "Agave" has a fine pedigree, coming from the Greek word for noble. The blue agave species- considered the best for the making agave nectar -- flourishes in rich volcanic soil. (It's also the only variety permitted to be used for the making of tequila.) And extracts from the agave plant have been shown to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.Unfortunately there's zero evidence that any of those compounds are present in the commercially made syrup.Agave nectar is an amber-colored liquid that pours more easily than honey and is considerably sweeter than sugar. The health-food crowd loves it because it is gluten-free and suitable for vegan diets, and, most especially, because it's low-glycemic (we'll get to that in a moment). Largely because of its very low glycemic impact, agave nectar is marketed as "diabetic friendly". What's not to like?As it turns out, quite a lot.Agave nectar has a low-glycemic index for one reason only: it's largely made of fructose, which although it has a low-glycemic index, is probably the single most damaging form of sugar when used as a sweetener. With the exception of pure liquid fructose, agave nectar has the highest fructose content of any commercial sweetener.All sugar -- from table sugar to HFCS (high-fructose corn syrup) to honey -- contains some mixture of fructose and glucose. Table sugar is 50/50, HFCS is 55/45. Agave nectar is a whopping 90 percent fructose, almost -- but not quite -- twice as high as HFCS.Fructose -- the sugar found naturally in fruit -- is perfectly fine when you get it from whole foods like apples (about 7 percent fructose) -- it comes with a host of vitamins, antioxidants and fiber. But when it's commercially extracted from fruit, concentrated and made into a sweetener, it exacts a considerable metabolic price.Research shows that it's the fructose part of sweeteners that's the most dangerous. Fructose causes insulin resistance and significantly raises triglycerides (a risk factor for heart disease). It also increases fat around the middle which in turn puts you at greater risk for diabetes, heart disease and Metabolic Syndrome (AKA pre-diabetes) .And fructose has been linked to non-alcoholic, fatty-liver disease. Rats that were given high fructose diets developed a number of undesirable metabolic abnormalities including elevated triglycerides, weight gain and extra abdominal fat.In the agave plant, most of the sweetness comes from a particular kind of fructose called inulin, which actually has some health benefits -- it's considered a fiber. But there's not much inulin left in the actual syrup. In the manufacturing process, enzymes are added to the inulin to break it down into digestible sugar (fructose), resulting in a syrup that has a fructose content that is, at best, 57 percent and -- much more commonly -- as high as 90 percent."Agave syrup is almost all fructose, highly processed sugar with great marketing," said Dr. Ingrid Kohlstadt, a fellow of the American College of Nutrition and an associate faculty member at Johns Hopkins School of Public Health. "Fructose interferes with healthy metabolism when (consumed) at higher doses", she told me. "Many people have fructose intolerance like lactose intolerance. They get acne or worse diabetes symptoms even though their blood [sugar] is OK".Agave nectar syrup is a triumph of marketing over science. True, it has a low-glycemic index, but so does gasoline -- that doesn't mean it's good for you.

column9: Can Make Some People Unbelievably Sick
