There are many products in her line, but Belizean Heat has become a staple on our table at home. There are hotter products available, but none combine the all the aspects as well.
A friend of ours went to Belize and brought us back some Marie Sharp products.  This is the best stuff onthe planet.  It is spicy but so smooth.  We order it often and the service is fast.
Taste is in the mouth of the beholder, this is one of the best tasting, most flavorful hot sauces I ever had, and I've had many.

I love Whoppers, but the chocolate part is just too much.  All I really want is the malted milk ball part.  So I found these and they're very tasty.  They're exactly what they say they are.My only concern is that there is no nutritional information provided (beyond an ingredients list)...is that legal?  I've eaten about half the bag in the past week and I assume that's probably a lot of calories and maybe fat, but I don't really know.  I'd like to have an idea of the damage at least!

I love malts better than shakes because I love the malt flavor I also love the inside of Whoopers and Robin Eggs. I didn't know they made just the inside. Now I don't have to eat the chocolate and candy coatings to get to the middle.
I never have to nibble off the chocolate outer layer again to get to the malt ball centers, yummy.. this is a great idea. I am totally ruined now, these are so good to snack on.

I have been a fan of chocolate covered malt balls ever since I can remember. When I found out that "naked" malt ball centers existed, I had to try some! I was not disappointed. Crunchy and crisp and delightfully malt-y, I keep trying to think of ways I could use these, but really, eating them by the handful seems as good as anything! Just plain delicious.

When looking for pink grapefruit juice, I wanted 100% juice with no added sweetners.  This product seemed to fit the bill, since it is listed as Florida's Natural Ruby Red Grapefruit Juice.  While it does not have added sugar, it is loaded with high fructose corn syrup.  There is a little blurb on the upper right hand side of the label that states the product is Pink Grapefruit Juice Cocktail.  I am selling this product to a friend and feel that this product was mis-represented by Amazon.com.

3 days late in arriving, and was Ruby Red Grapefruit Juice Cocktail from concentrate ( with other natural flavors ), not juice.Disappointing to say the least, especially at ~&1.33 per bottle and considering the product description.
We will keep these on hand 'always' - best mint candy around by far. (Wouldn't it be great if they were from the U.S.)
These are the best and most minty hard candies I have found in the USA. Almost as good as the eskimo mints available in Europe and Canada, but not here.

The directions on the package lead you to believe that this goes in the fridge one color and then comes out green, but that is definitely not the case.  The second you add milk, it turns green.  Not nearly as fun or exciting for the kids as we thought it was going to be.  It's got the nasty taste you get with black frosting too, but the kids didn't seem to mind.

column9: Not worth it - stick to basic pudding
column10: The pudding changes to the green color immediately - very misleading description on the box.  It also made my son's poop turn the same color as the pudding (greenish/teal) and actually stained his bottom green too! (He wears diapers). So not worth it.

The instructions tell you to add the milk and the pudding mix, stir for 2 minutes and then say the magic words and watch the pudding change color.  In reality, as soon as you add the milk, the green powder turns into green pudding.  Super lame.  The kids were bummed.

I love the non-dessert items from Kitchens of India, but this dessert was not nearly as good.  It was very oily and greasy yet also mushy and grainy.  The flavor also tasted a bit fake--like plastic or something synthetic.

column9: Great taste of saffron, although it's a bit on the oily side
column10: This product is teeming with saffron flavor. People who value saffron will love this mung dal halwa. I wish they would use ghee instead of vegetable oil.
I liked it because it had true authentic taste, although it was too greasy, you can see oil all over the bowl after 1 minute.But overall taste was good and would love to buy again.

column9: I have the perfect solution to Kitchens of India Desserts!
column10: I used to agree with most who state that Kitchens of India should stay OUT of the dessert kitchen---and keep their feet planted firmly on the savory side. However, I cannot seem to resist both the Yellow Lentil Pudding, as well as the White Pumpkin and Milk variety.  While not perfect on their own, just take a few moments to combine with one magical ingredient and VOILA---divine desserts! The secret? WHIPPED HEAVY CREAM!!! Mix the lentil variety with about one cup of VERY lightly sweetened whipped heavy cream that has also been made with the scrapings of 1/2 of a vanilla bean. Mix the pumpkin variety with about one cup of COMPLETELY unsweetened whipped heavy cream without the vanilla.  And in both cases.....well, it's just very special! Indian in flavor, taste, color and aroma. And THAT certainly hits the spot, for us after a meal of roast lamb or tandori style chicken. Oh yes I almost forgot---I choose to cook these by boiling the bags exclusively--have tried it other ways and I find that it messes with the texture. And I always "pour off" any residual oil (lentil variety) or butter (pumpkin)~~but I don't obssess about it~~this is definitely a once-in-a-while type of selection, so no need to worry about calories!  I encourage you to give this a go!!

This desert will make your tongue stand up and say HI!  It is different than anything western, but wonderful to the palate.  You must have an open mind and enjoy well seasoned food, as much on Indian food is, and you'll be rewarded with desert so good, you're tempted to save it for special occasions.  But you may enjoy it as part of your regular diet since all the work has been done for you.

column9: I'm having fun with this product
column10: Excellent cocktails I am preparing and having fun with my girlfriend and friends.Great price and quality! I highly recommend this syrup for your lychee martinis.
Lychee has a unique flavor, and this syrup is ok. I haven't found anything better. To me, it has a similar flavor to the aloe vera drinks you might see as Asian markets.
This syrup is really great tasting. It tastes exactly like root beer, and is excellent ice cream or in milk shakes. This was a creative idea.

White tea is not for everyone. Not because some will find the flavor objectionable, but because it's expensive, particularly if its genuine, and the flavor is mild and very subtle.  This is a meditative tea, not something to be used as an everyday drink to accompany food.  Not that is can't be consumed that way, but the subtle flavors of white tea will be like so much hot water if all it is doing is washing down food.Some will find it to be almost without taste while others will delight in a series of flavor notes that will not smack you over the head but can be pretty wonderful.White tea is made from very select tea leaf tips and might be described as "beyond green." Indeed, if you're turned off by green tea's vegetative taste you may love white tea.If you're going to spend money on white tea you should make sure that you buy the real thing and Dilmah is one of my trusted suppliers.  I've loved their Ceylon teas for years, originally ordering them direct from Sri Lanka before they were available for direct sale in the U.S.Experiment with the balance between water and tea and with steeping times to get what you like.  It's worth the price and effort for serious tea drinkers.
This is the best tea I have ever tasted.  An excellent choice for any tea lover. I have already purchased this product for my friends and recommended it to everyone I work with.

column9: Make your own sugar free drinks at home...
column10: My friend enjoys making Torani Sugar Free syrups to add to a morning smoothie or in iced teas and now Cherry Lime for an afternoon pick me up. The Customer Service with this company was excellent. They answered my questions about delivery times as this was a gift and I received it in no time flat...Thank you again.
Light in flavor, not bitter at all.  If you like the sort of tea often served in Chinese restaurants, this is a good choice (not to mention, pretty cheap!).

This is the first rawhide that has lasted more than an hour - I have Standard Schnauzers - heavy chewers.  There is absolutely no splintering and the dogs love them.  (plus they are 100% American)  These will be the only ones I buy from now on!
These are really thick rawhide rolls that last a very long time, even with active chewers. Plus, they are from the USA which is reassuring.

I was purchasing these for $9 a piece for my 3 Standard Poodles from a feed store 30 miles from where I live.  They are the only ones that do not give the boys diahrrea.  These also seem to last substantially longer than the other brands.The company gave us VERY quick shipping and professional packaging.
The roll was ,Itself, thick, but the hide was not. My dog can eat one in a couple of hours. I bought one from another co. that had very thick hide.It lasted 3 weeks!
I give them out as a Gift. You can't beet them, all there candy is the Greatest.

column9: Great product line but my dog's allergic to this one food
column10: I bought Acana Wild Prairie for Dogs almost two months ago, having used Acana's Grasslands with great success for my 9-year-old Maltese.  I received Wild Prairie from Whole Healthy Pet within two days -- much earlier than expected -- and their customer service turns out to be excellent.  However, my Maltese began licking her paws the day she started eating Wild Prairie. Since it was fall, and I wasn't sure but what mold or leaf mold or grasses could have contributed to her sudden allergy, I worked on eliminating her exposure to everything else that could be causing it. But she continued to lick her paws.  So I ordered Acana's Grasslands, again sent from Whole Healthy Pet, and, as before, it arrived immediately. Within two days of switching back to Grasslands, her paw-licking ceased.  Acana has a great product line -- and I will continue to use Acana's Grasslands, and Whole Healthy Pet -- but about 10 pounds of the 15.4 pounds of Wild Prairie has been given to a neighbor with a non-allergic dog.

I received some of this olive oil from a friend and used it to flavor my roasted cauliflower -- it's fabulous! Not too much heat, not too little heat -- absolutely perfect!  Now I'm buying some because I used up all of the gift in very little time.

column9: Simply the best at the best price!
column10: I got hooked on Green Mountain Southern Pecan coffee when my husband and I lived in Maine. I stocked up on it when we moved back to the South and continued to order it in bulk until a couple of months ago when I got my Keurig. Brewing it one cup at a time is the next best thing to living in Maine and being able to go to just about any convenience store and take my pick of the flavors (I almost always chose Southern Pecan). I've ordered the K-cups from Amazon three times now and just placed my fourth order, the second with this company. The last arrived in record time and the price can't be beat--believe me, I've checked. Add in the free shipping and you have a definite winner!
Excellent coffee!  This coffee has the best flavor of any coffee I have ever tried!  I love it!

Green Mountain Coffee Southern Pecan, 24-count K- cups for Keurig Brewers (pack of 2) is a delightful product. The K-cups are sturdy and they don't leak when you remove them from the brewer. The flavor is great and they arrive on time.
I love this flavor.  I like trying different coffee flavors and this is ranked one of my fav's. I dont' like strong coffee and this is just perfect. Works really well with flavored creamer as well.

I was a little hesitant at first since they didnt have a small sampler of it.  The Keurig web site is always out of it.  But from the first cup to the last little bit in the mug it has proven to be worth the gamble.  In my opinion it is a very smooth coffee.  Perfect for those Saturday or Sunday Mornings sitting on the porch.  It has a nice flavor with a nice hint of pecan but not overpowering. Doesn't seem to leave a unpleasant aftertaste just a craving for another cup.  If you are on the fence and not sure, just jump off and give it a shot.  Worth the money.

A few years ago, I worked in a bed and breakfast and one of my favorite parts was the southern pecan coffee. I have since been trying to find a coffee that is comparable. This is it! Like one of the other reviewers, I don't care for super strong coffee. This coffee has a very smooth flavor and the pecan flavor does not take over the coffee...the two work beautifully together!
Clients love this coffee and it arrived fast.  I will be ordering it again. It is so much more affordable to order coffee from Amazon.

WHEN WE WERE LOOKING FOR A FLAVOR SHE WOULD LIKE,WE STARTED TO READ THE REVEIWS AND BOTH THOUGHT THIS WHAT WE WANTED FOR OUR BREAK AND DINNER COFFEE. WE DIDN'T GO WRONG OUTSTANDING. SOUTHERN PECAN IS TOPS.

column9: Whether you're a southerner or not!
column10: The coffee has a lovely hint of nuttiness - it's really great!  I got this brand in one of those mixed bag boxes of coffees and was afraid it might be bitter.  I made it for my self and tried it and was surprised at it's smoothness and wonderfully rich taste.  I gave my husband a sip as well and he loved it too.  So we turned around and bought two whole boxes of it!  Goes nice with my large mug!
One of the best K Cups that I have tried. It was not overwhelming and you could just taste a hint of pecan without it tasting artificial. This was a light blend. Will purchase this again.

This is by far my favorite coffee to start the day with. It's nutty and smooth and not very strong. I'm not a fan of very bold blends of coffee so if you are, this is not the pod for you. It's delicious!

column9: Nice and smooth, yet a great 'wake me up coffee' in the morning
column10: As I said above it is nice and smooth, yet a great 'wake me up coffee' in the morning; I don't know what more I can add other than it's also a wonderful coffee  for a relaxing cup of coffee in the afternoon as well
This coffee was in the sampler pack when I first purchased the Keurig.  And it was one we rated very highly.  It is just as remembered.  Yum!

What a wonderful taste these little pods have.  It's a pleasure to bring a little southern flava' up to New England!  Almost made me wish I hadn't gotten rid of my keurig! After it broke a second time and seeing how devastating these are to the environment, I'm all set!  But to each their own, if use keurig, these pods are delicious.
this coffee is very good, smooth, smells wonderful, tastes great, sweet but not too sweet, the caramel vanilla by green mountain is still my favorite, but this would be a second

column4: Kimberly J. Karas "a New England mom"
column9: Love the smell & like the flavor
column10: I gave this four stars based on the flavor (according to my own taste preference of course) but I would give ten stars to the aroma!  It fills the kitchen with such a wonderful scent.  Back to the flavor though, it's a gentle pecan taste with a just under medium roast flavor.  So to many I believe it would be considered weak.  You could brew a smaller cup or more likely if you like your coffee strong, you probably are not looking at this product anyway!  If you are looking for strong order a variety that is bold or extra bold.  I like to have a variety of K cups without paying the sampler pack prices and this fits the bill for my home.  I have started with a 50 pack of a known favorite and then 24 packs of other flavors that I think I would like to try and have to offer to company.UPDATE: After running through a number of varieties I can tell you we ran out of the Pecan pretty quick.  I still love the aroma and like the flavor and it's definitely one I would order again.
this coffee is very tasty if you like flavored coffees but I must say that the Hazelnut is still my all time favorite and I will probably go back to it next order.
Subtle butter pecan flavor in a mild coffee. My favorite K-Cup coffee flavor. Don't know what else to type, but has to be 20+ words...

column9: Green Mountain Coffee Southern Pecan, for Keurig Brewers
column10: Green Mountain Coffee "Southern Pecan", for Keurig Brewers is an excellent medium brewed coffee.  I enjoy the "Southern Pecan" flavor that compliments a variety of foods and is a treat on its own.  Unlike some flavored coffees that claim to have flavor...I have found that "Green Mountain" pulls of the balance of richness, aroma, good taste and flavor.
I thought I' try this flavor in the K-cups because I haven't done so in the past.  It is a little light-weight on the flavor unless your set your Keurig at the "stronger" setting.

These used to almost never be in stock.  Inventory has improved, making them more predictable.  It is a delicious flavored coffee, not too much flavor since I normally drink my coffee black.  Quite good, give it a shot!
Purchased for a friend searching for this flavor in a instant coffee but could not find it. When brewing the aroma is wonderful and the taste is great.
This coffee smells wonderful. The pecan flavor isn't as strong as I would like but it is still a good cup of coffee.

column9: Great Coffee for a Flavored Coffee
column10: This is a medium roasted coffee, those that call it a light roast must be used to a heavier tasting cup of coffee. When first brewed, it has a very pleasant nutty aroma that fills the room and gets your expectations going. I have the Keurig with 3 cup sizes, if you brew it on the smallest setting, it's like a little shot of nutty espresso (on the milder side)...on the second setting it's a more intense flavor that Starbucks people could probably relate to...on the largest setting it is ready for you to add what you desire and still get a very good, subtle nutty tasting, rich coffee. I add a bit of sugar while drinking it black and it's a delight...when you are in the mood for something different. I find I don't like it as much as my first cup of the day...but every once in a while I like a cup in the afternoon and this is where I find it stands out. Not a heavy, burnt tasting roast...milder than that heavy stuff and flavorful WITHOUT knocking you out with an added fake flavor that doesn't belong there...it seems to really go together, pecan & coffee. Let's just say it's a nice cup of coffee with a bit of a nutty tone...PS: I'm not a real lover of flavored coffees but this one is done right...on the lines of Island Coconut, who would think that coconut & coffee flavors would go pleasantly together?...but they do!
I liked this coffee very mush! It has a nice nutty pecan flavor and doesn't tatste cheap! I will definately purchase again. Oh, thanks Amazon. Your shipments are always on time and undamaged++++
It has a nice aroma but the flavor seems a bit light and its a light roast to boot. great expectations but short on delivery.
This is the best coffee. You will love the taste of Southern Pecan taste. I will buy it again in the future.

I had my first cup of Green Mountain Southern Pecan at my daughter's house after a marathon shopping expedition.  The flavor was rich, warm and comforting, and it was love at first taste.  As soon as I got home, I went online and ordered my own Southern Pecan K-Cups from Amazon.This coffee has definitely become one of my top favorites.  In fact, I'm enjoying a cup of Southern Pecan right now.
These are the best elbows I've ever tasted.  The price is right.  I mix them with oil, milk and powdered chedder cheese.  Delicious!
This was a good deal,  it 20 percent of the packages were opened and dumped in the box. It came quickly, but I do not like not being able to use everything I order. What a waste!!

Dilmah's Ran Watte tea is exactly how they describe it, "Golden orange color. Elegant structure, like a fine Champagne".  It is not your traditional tea!  For tea drinkers who don't like BIG tea's, this is an excellent choice.  It's light, flavorful, delightful to drink and is a real leaf tea.  You'll know what I mean after you brew a cup.  I brew mine in an IngenuiTEA maker for a perfect cup.

so far i have bought the ran and meda watte varieties, as well as the supreme ceylon, several other Dilmah over the counter teas.it is very light and not the least bit tannic. the flavor and color is more similar to a Ten Ren green tea than your typical ceylon tea.that said if you like your teas stronger, or milky this and even the darker the Meda watte are too light. personally  i drink this on warm afternoons, as for winter mornings, its too light or me.

Well, good tea to drink w/o sugar or milk a couple of times in the afternoon. Though it will not keep you awake if one has lots of heavy brain works in the evenings. For the latter get one from Eastern Europe. I have been trying other teas as I used to drink strong tea with sugar. Since recently I drink this tea everyday in the afternoon w/o sugar - it is enjoyable! Dilmah Tea, Ran Watte Tea, Loose Leaf, 4.4-Ounce Tins (Pack of 3)

I love to try new experiences like a new restaurant, a new wine or a tea that I've never tasted before.  While this can be delightful, it can also be a disappointment at times.My first taste of Ran Watte was not delightful.  Then I realized the problem was not the tea.  Being unfamiliar with this larger leaf, I had used to much tea & brewed it to strong.  The second try was perfect for my taste.This tea reminds me of a very light Jasmine tea.  It is wonderful to sip without amendments but a touch of honey would make a great compliment, also.  Most teas this light seem to have little taste which leaves me wondering at the attempt to market them.  This one shows an interesting character, lightly brisk & the slightest hint of salty aftertaste that is unusual but not at all unpleasant.  For my preference, this tea is a great 'afternoon with a good book' kind of tea.

I received this tea for a Christmas present. Dilmah is packed in Ceylon, therefore can carry the seal (see it above the name) of authentic Ceylon tea. I had never tried it before. Delighted to find it a clear, orangish color, smooth, with a pleasant 'wine' aroma, as well as smooth, light taste. No tannic aftertaste. The tin it comes in makes me equally happy, with a hinged lid and insert to help keep out air and light. Very lovely gift for yourself or someone special. Enjoy!

Nice and mellow buttery Ceylon flavor, single high grown estate tea. My first Dilmah Tea purchase and I am impressed. Nice packaging keeps tea ultra fresh; shrink wrapped, with hinged lid and inner lid, and to top it off the tea is sealed inside in a foil bag. Needs the full five minute steep time as recommended on bottom of package. The three pack is a pain; but just give one to a friend and keep the other two. This is a premium tea and a premium product.

On a tour of the Dilmah facilities in 2005 I learned a lot about tea. I was given the full tasting experience, and had the chance to sample all 36 basic types of tea. When we got to the Watte line, all of the hints and flavors became more pronounced.The Watte teas are from different elevations, and the Ran Watte come from the highest. Only a small number of acres produce this blend.It is the champagne of teas, light in color, but strong in its character; there is nothing sharp or demanding about this tea other than your difficulty finding more.The best tea I've ever had.

I keep several orthodox whole leaf teas around all the time, but like to have a decent quality ctc for those who can't appreciate my 3x as expensive teas. and occasionally I drink some ctc just to "repair" the budget.  When I saw that I could buy some "orthodox" high mountain Ceylon at such a reasonable price, I decided to give it a try. How bad could it be? First, not orthodox-it's ctc. Secondly, even with lowered expectations (Ceylon used to be my favorite tea before quality decreased over the last few years), this is disappointing. It is simply  a commercial product. It lacks any of the distinctive qualities of decent Ceylon. I couldn't coax a respectable cup of liquor from the leaves no matter how I brewed them. I'll use it to make a black tea mix for friends, but I won't calculate it's final cost vs quality. That way I won't have to add an antidepressant to my tea habit.I think generally speaking, Amazon is not the place to buy tea. This tea may be very old and may not have been handled properly. Tea is very susceptible to heat (warehouse). This was hot tot he touch when it arrived. There are other retailers who take great care in turning over inventory so as not to ship old tea. This is true even when purchasing inexpensive tea.

I was in a very nice restaurant for lunch the other day and ordered hot tea.  When presented with the selection, all the teas were from Novus and I selected this one.The tea is wonderful !!  The tea tastes great and I love the fact it is loose leaf tea (much more flavorful than "regular" tea bags) that is contained in a mesh bag so there is no mess.I loved it so much I kept the packet so that I would be able to order some for drinking at home.

I tore open the package and this wonderful aroma of the flowers drifted out of the envelope. The teabag was designed as a pyramid of sheer cloth, that didn't leave any aftertaste.  The flavor exceeded expectations.  I'm ordering more!

The spray does what it's meant to do.  Give your chocolates a golden shiny look.  But you need to put on more than 1 coat.  Had originally did light dusting on milk chocolate, but after a 2-3 hours, golden color was barely visible.  Even more so when you put chocolate into cellophane bag.  Do 2-3 layers (spray lightly over 2-3 times, instead of 1 very heavy application).  If you put too heavy of application, it runs and looks messy.  Overall, made favors look very nice, even though I felt it was a bit expensive for the can.

This Hershey's "Holiday Assortment" is perfect for filling Christmas candy dishes since it contains small chocolate kisses, miniature milk chocolate bars, miniature special dark chocolate bars, miniature Krackel bars, and miniature Reese's Peanut Butter Cups (which seem to always go first).These were fresh tasting and the small sizes makes them a fun treat rather than a diet buster!Highly Recommended!CFH
YUM, What else is there to say other than I am required to have 20 non repeated words. They are good

I purchased this bag of candy at Christmas to compliment a cookie assortment I was sending in to my husband's work.  Seeing as I had already had a bunch of sugar that day I just loaded up the plates with both the chocolate and the cookies without sampling one.  When my husband got to work he sent me an email asking where I got the chocolates becase they tasted stale.  I checked the date on the bag and it said use by May of 2012...I am not sure what happened but these were already rancid.
Came quickly and factory fresh.I will give it a five star rating since it was gone in a few days:)
Three of the best holiday chocolate miniatures thrown together in a variety pack. There's no way you can go wrong with this assortment.

Here's a quite good drink that I picked up at a nearby Fresh and Easy Neighborhood Market It's Aloe Gloe (Crisp Aloe) Pulp-Free Aloe water. It has a nice light, somewhat fruity, only slightly sweet flavor and is quit good tasting and very refreshing. It test out at only 35 calories per 15.2-ounce container, so is very low in calories. It's certified organic, gluton free, and provides a variety of health benefits as listed on the side panel. Plus, it's delicious!Gary Peterson
Great tasting tea, with or without stevia. I drink it hot and cold. Product arrived very quickly. I have 1 or 2 cups daily.  I probably should have ordered 2 boxes!

100 bags of Oolong tea for this price?  Lets keep the secret.  I love Oolong tea, and this does not disappoint.  Its very tasty.  Its not better than any other good tasting oolong tea.  Its just a bunch of Oolong tea.  I happen to like it, so it gets 5 stars.  Plus it claims to be Organic.  No idea what that means in a product coming out of China.  Though we like to think of Asia as being more "organic" than the US in general.  Not so much today.

column9: Forget the time saver, add a  couple of steps for a much better product!
column10: First of all, I can't understand why this is so expensive since it's less than $2 in the grocery store. But anyway, I bought a couple of these when they first came out and were buy one get one free. Made the cinnamon ones to take to church this morning. I didn't pay attention to the nutritional listing and didn't know that they only made SIX muffins! Who packages a muffin mix to only make 6? The container is tall so that you have room to shake (I realized after opening it) and it gives the illusion of having much more in there. So... to try and stretch it out to look like more, I made a  batch of minis for the small group that I meet with. The really bad part is that you can't scrape the batter with a spatula like you can when it's in a bowl. You can easily leave a whole mini-muffin in there! I have a skinny spatula that I had just bought, so I was able to get most of it but it was terribly awkward and I still left some batter. It makes me wonder if these things are tested out in a college dorm. After cooking I drizzled white icing and shook out a cinnamon/sugar mixture on top. That's the only thing that made them special, as they would have been pretty plain without the topping. Needless to say, I wouldn't buy again.

As a fan of the "After Dinner Linda's Lollies" I thought I'd start a new adventure and try 48 exciting flavors. These are perfect for every occasion and especially if you crave a wide range of flavors, but don't have time to always make Coconut Crème Pie or run to the store for Root Beer.Some of the flavors in this delicious 48-count box (mine arrived in a plastic bag) include: Watermelon, Buttered Popcorn, Green Apple, Caramel, Spearmint, Fruit Punch, Cotton Candy, English Toffee, Apple Cinnamon, Root Beer, Red Hot Cinnamon, Pink Lemonade, Pineapple, Peppermint (perfect), Blueberry, Wild Cherry, Milk Chocolate, Strawberry, Raspberry, Pink Grapefruit, Vanilla (so creamy), Limeade, Root Beer Float, Lemon Meringue Pie, Orangeade, Tutti-Fruity (cute and fun), Peanut Butter, Banana, Lemon Lime, Cherry Cheesecake, Butterscotch, German Chocolate Cake, Licorice, Chocolate Covered Banana, Concord Grape, Chocolate Marshmallow Sundae, Bubble Gum, Cinnamon (deliciously spicy), Pina Colada and Peach.Sound delicious? They are all dreamy sweet and smooth and taste delicious. One of the lollipops actually has coconut in it, so that is the only one I've noticed so far that had an interesting texture. I'd love to be able to buy a bag of any specific flavor - because you may notice you have favorites!A lollipop for every mood and occasion! Also try the Dessert and After Dinner varieties to get the full range of flavors.~The Rebecca Review, enjoying Banana Crème Pie

column9: As advertised by missing an opportunity for bulk sales.
column10: Great product and very fast shipping. These are exactly as advertised, and exceeded my expectations. My only complaint is price. $36 for 48 is a good bulk price for these, but $10 shipping is too high. I would also like to see options for larger quantities.They did a great job in selecting a variety of product, and they seem very fresh (whatever that means in a lollipop).
Yes, salt is salt. But when you use this you don't need use nearly as much. The thin flakes spread out when you sprinkle them over your food and they make for great presentation.
I loved this as a teenager and now its available on Amazon. Tastes the same as I remember it and brings back a trip down memory lane.

column9: Absolutey T-H-E Best cat food you can buy at any price.  Royal Canin is expensive, but worth every penny.
column10: Absolutey T-H-E Best cat food you can buy at any price.  Royal Canin is expensive, but worth every penny

column9: Very good -  Green Tea Frappuccino addict
column10: I have used this matcha daily for about 6 weeks now. It is very good for what I use it for. I make my own version of Starbucks Green Tea Frappuccino. (Once that drink name started to roll of my kids' tongues easily - I realized I was spending too much money on these drinks - and daily!)I am not familiar with various grades of matcha, but did not want something pre-sweetened or modified because I wanted to control the sugar, etc. I make my frappuccino like this: sorry - I do not measure - so you may have to modify these amounts because I am guessing!1 1/2c milk2 heaping spoonfuls (the spoon that's included) green tea powder1/8c simple syrup (I make it myself and keep in fridge for week or so)10+ice cubes (adjust to your taste - depends on size of cubes)Blend this in a blender - longer than you think - pulse first then blend for a bit - I scrape down a bit bc the powder flies around a little and you don't want to lose any. (Simple syrup is 1c water, 1c sugar heated until sugar dissolves) It is much easier than it may sound - I make these daily in the morning. I hope this helps anyone else out there who is addicted to the GT Frappuccino - it is slightly different (I think they use a different gt powder and a honeydew syrup), but I liked mine MORE within the first week of having them!

column9: Great for the price & health benefits!
column10: I suppose I'm unsophisticated about matcha teas since this is the first I've tried, but I really, really enjoy this matcha. It's smooth, mellow, and slightly sweet. I'm picky about loose green teas for steeping; some of those are bitter, & I DON'T like bitter tea. So my favorite teas are this matcha & white loose leaf teas. The cost is honestly too steep for me to buy other better rated matcha for the flavor, so I'm happy I can get this much tea for the price (I've got 3 kids & a lot of other priorities; maybe when I retire...). And for the price, I'm getting all the health benefits of any other matcha (you get all the antioxidants out of matcha since you ingest the whole leaf; brewing teas often makes the extracted antioxidants bitter), plus I don't feel too guilty using it on my face, either. Perfectly nice matcha for the beginner & the frugal. Gave some to my sister, also a novice to matcha, & she loved it too. Worth a try for the price.

column9: Not the best quality, but okay for the price
column10: Teas vary greatly in quality and the price reflects that.  This is a moderately price matcha tea so don't except the best flavor.  It is nutritious so it may be better as a flavor additive to drinks, desserts, broth, etc.  Real matcha can also be bitter and an acquired taste.  Japanese often drink it with tiny sugar candies to offset the bitterness.  Matcha also contains a lot of antioxidants so it may be helpful to some to stat incorporating it into their diet.  If you don't like the taste an easy drink is to mix it with orange juice.

This matcha powder came in very nice packaging with a measuring spoon to use as well.  The quality of the green tea powder was a bit less than I expected (compared to my past experiences with matcha), but I think its all about quantity here - I've done a lot of creative stuff with the powder thusfar, my favorite being the homemade green tea ice cream.

This tea is so good! I had always had a giant mug of matcha tea that I got from Whole Foods. That tea was Allegro brand. I thought it was good until Whole Foods was late getting my order in, and I bought this tea from Amazon.I will never drink anything else! I found out what they used to make them and decided to try to make them myself.This green tea tastes the same as Starbucks and now I make them at home all the time. However, if you're used to a ceremonial matcha, this definitely isn't it and I would go elsewhere.I agree with the reviewer before in that the shipping from Pier Mall was superfast. I was used to buying a green tea latte pre-mix from Korea. Couldn't get it anymore, so I tried this one. I just use hot, almost boiling water and the little spoon that came with itfot the matcha. I  add about a tablespoon of milk and some splenda and it is pretty good stuff.

This is an EXCELLENT product! A little powder goes a long way. I used one heaping teaspoonful and it made a GALLON with powder floating on the bottom which means one level teaspoonful should be adequate. A great healthier alternative to sugary sodas or Lipton any day of the week. Light and grassy with a not terribly unpleasant aftertaste. And when drunken frequently, can eliminate smokers' breath. Buy two and you will have enough for a year easily!

I got hooked on matcha but found the habit price prohibitive.  I was paying $8 for 1 oz. Then I found this matcha on Amazon and I made my first cup last night and I hated it.  Then I made my second cup this morning a discover the secret of perfect matcha.  The secret is don't use too much of the emerald green powder or you will have one heck of a bitter cup of tea, which is what I did with my first cup.  A dainty scoop (about 1/8 of a tsp) is all you need for a delicious cup and if it tastes bitter use less.  This is medicine, this is pure pleasure and relaxation and a little goes a long way making this a great deal.  I figured if 2 containers weighing 10.58 oz each would have cost me about $160 if I paid the $8 per 1 oz that I was paying when I got hooked on matcha.  So this deal saves me about $120...now I wonder how long will this purchase of matcha last since I feel free to drink as much as I want and am no longer limited to one cup in the morning and one cup in the evening.A good read that explains the philosophy of tea (Teaism) is The Book of Tea, free for kindle and written over 100 years ago.  It explains the 3 historical periods of tea, which matcha being the second period.  The 3 periods of tea refers to the way the tea was prepared.  The first period is caked tea, then whipped tea (matcha), then steeped tea.  Matcha is an ancient way of preparing tea.Consider purchasing the bamboo whisk to whip your matcha because if you don't whip it you will get little clumps.  I drink my matcha from a small bowl purchased at the local Asian store which allows for the whipping of my matcha and is the traditional way.

This is the first matcha powder I've used so I am unable to comment on it's quality compared to other products. You do get a LOT for your money. These two boxes will last me at least 6 months.I read about this in Muscle & Fitness magazine for its numerous health benefits, mainly it's high content in anti-oxidants, cancer prevention, detoxification, increased fat metabolism and energy. One tiny measuring spoon of this stuff is 10 times more potent than regular green tea and it's noticable. I have been using green tea extract in capsule form and it is no comparison to the matcha powder. I feel more energized and alert without any jitters or insomnia. I feel less food cravings over the course of the day. My metabolism has increased. I am able to eat 100-200 additional calories per day (yes, I'm one of those calorie counters) yet my body fat has decreased by 2%. I also believe it enhances your immune system as I have made it through the entire flu season without getting sick from any of my contagious co-workers.The powder is easy to use. I micro-wave 1/3 cup of filtered water in a small cup, stir in a measuring spoon of matcha powder, then dump it into ice water or protein shake. The taste is creamy and does not require sweetener for my taste. I am a matcha convert for life. My next project will be making green tea ice cream with this stuff.

column9: Price is OK, flavor a bit bitter
column10: Got some matcha in Japan from the airport and it was surprisingly tasty.  Still, you are told not to steep green tea for more than a couple minutes or else the bitter flavor comes out.  So, with matcha it's just gonna happen, since you can't take out the tea bag.That said, the Japan matcha was more granular than a "powder", more like sand really, and did not produce much bitterness even after ten minutes in hot water.  This Taiwan tea by comparison is a true powder.  It is difficult to dissolve, clumping a quite a bit, and produces a flavor that within a few minutes in hot water becomes bitter, then later even more bitter.UPDATE: It turns out you use a lot less of it than you do of the Japanese matcha I had.  The powder, since it is so fine, goes much further.  To help you with this, they have a spoon in the box to right-size the servings.  I was using a much larger teaspoon instead previously.  Using the smaller amount, it works great for hot tea and does not become bitter.

We are avid Matcha drinkers in my house. While this Matcha is slightly lower grade of tea than what we usually buy from Malden Teas or other tea vendors, the price is very good. The taste is palatable and can be consumed without other flavorings. Overall, if one is a matcha drinker on a budget, this is a good choice.

column9: Matcha Green Tea Powder is great
column10: With so many Green Tea powders on Amazon, I mostly rely on the customer comments. This tea is exactly what I was looking for and the price was reasonable compared to others. My neighbor and I were trying to recreate the StarBucks green tea latte and we both agree that this tea is almost identical.  We will buy again!
I absolutely love this product and would highly recommend it to anyone!  Fast shipping too!

column9: $45 for two - rid off big time
column10: I bought this from amazon and i thought i got a good deal until my wife went to the Chinese super market and found that they are selling $9.95 per box.  more than 100% mark up.oh well cant return them now because I have already opened one box and use 1/3 of it.

You get what you pay for with this product.  I drink Matcha Tea daily and absolutely love it.  When I saw the price and reviews I thought I had found the perfect product at a great price.It has a dirty/muddy flavor that is disappointing to say the least. Try DoMatcha 2nd Harvest, good price and much better flavor at a good price.

I've got everyone in my office hooked on this stuff, and I drink it daily. It's a stronger stimulant than coffee, and has a smoother, less-jittery feel to it thanks to the Theanine and general nutritional content. It's quite tasty and a great deal for the price.I love the product but don't really follow the tradition whatsoever. I prepare mine in a metal, insulated thermos. One scoop of matcha per coffee-cup sized glass of hot water. Put lid on thermos and shake vigorously. Shaking has provided the absolute smoothest, foamiest blend I've seen so far and gets rid of any clumping. I cut the flavor a bit with honey, but really it just tastes like strong tea. It's important not to add too much matcha to your water or you'll end up with a thick sludge of green tea at the bottom of your glass.The only downside to this beverage is that if you drink it first thing in the morning on an empty stomach, it can make you feel very nauseous. Eating a piece of toast can fix this, though.Another recipe that cures the nausea is: One cup water, Two cups vanilla almond milk. Add honey/sugar and ice. Delicious!

Many other reviewers have compared this matcha to Starbucks and I agree it has good flavor but the dissolution is very poor regardless of how you make ie hot or cold blended stirred shaken etc...I have watched them make iced green tea lattes at Starbucks and their powder dissolves even when added after the syrup milk and ice...This product just does not dissolve completely and you end up either with a layer of tea at the bottom or if you keep stirring while consuming a flim of grittness in your mouth...Yes is a bargain for the amount you get at the price and flavor.. But I would not buy again and would appreciate any suggestions as to a different matcha that dissolves completely.....

column9: This is very LOW QUALITY matcha
column10: This matcha is terrible compared to real Japanese ceremony-grade matcha. It is bitter, gritty, and generally doesn't taste good.So, why did I give it 5 stars?Quality matcha can easily cost USD $2.00 per GRAM. At that price, 10.53 oz. (the amount in a single ~$21 box of Vita-Life) would cost about USD $600.00!The trade off is that this is really bottom-end quality that a Japanese tea aficionado would scoff at. That said...who cares? If you want the Matcha experience, go elsewhere, but if you want all well-documented health benefits of matcha/green tea as well as the convenience of having a powder that will mix with many other foods, this is a great deal.I use about a teaspoon of powder on my morning breakfast cereal, on smoothies, and I use about a quarter of a cup per batch of cookie dough. To date I am on my 24th box since February 2, 2009.About caffeine:Green tea (and therefore matcha) does contain caffeine. Very roughly, one teaspoon contains about as much caffeine as a 6oz cup of black coffee. The caffeine in matcha tends to be released more slowly, though -- over a period of about 6 hours vs. 2 to 3 for coffee. Do not use this in anything you will be consuming before going to sleep!
This is not Matcha. It's just bad green tea powder. Might be okay to mix with something but trying to fix it like Matcha is a disaster. I threw mine away.

It's pretty decent considering the price- this is a LOT of matcha. It'll last a while. I find that it does better in blended drinks and baked goods than as a hot tea, however. When I made it hot, there would be clumps of tea that wouldn't mix and if it sat too long it'd get bitter. As a cold blended latte, however, it's great, and rivals Starbucks' green tea frappuccino.
Great for the price! Less tasty than the kind I usually get, so tea snobs lookout. I'm not a tea snob and will be buying more as soon as I run out!! Matcha on a budget
well...i am no gourmand...but i thought this tea to be very good and at an excellent price.  mixes well, good taste, long lasting, will purchase again!

column9: Tastes awful but it's good for you

It is the Japanese leaves that are noted for the healthy properties; I'm not sure they are replicated in Taiwan. I ignore a lot of the ritual stuff and just scoop and pour hot water. A few drops of lemon helps with what is otherwise an unappealing taste.

and also used in the simple and beautiful Tea Ceremonies, Matcha is worth its weight in gold.Try adding sugar to cut the bitterness, or use honey -- this can also be made into a "Matcha Paste" and spread on bread or biscuits for a unique treat.And don't forget the Green Tea ice Cream -- easy to make (I let the vanilla IC get soft, than add sugar and Match) and it even takes away some of the "guilt" of eating ice ream, if ice cream is not on your diet (think of all those wonderful antioxidants you are getting -- and truly a little ice cream is good for the soul, yes?). Or for fewer calories, a sorbet can easily be made as well.Add it to your morning oatmeal or other cereal -- green cereal? Why not? <:-)You can cook with it as well, but since I am a sugar addict, I will rest my case with the ice cream/sorbet suggestions.And of course, this is a WONDERFUL brew, just as is, hot from the pot and into your cup.
Good price, fast shipping. Good instructions with tea. Needed since I had neve drank this kind of tea before.

This product has a great flavor and consistency. Great alone or added into smoothies. Reasonably priced, I would buy it again.

column9: Good For Upping the Nutritional Ante

I did this once, and got a major tummy ache. Let my experience make you wiser. :)And Enjoy.
This tea was what I was hoping for-something to cook with and add to smoothies.  I don't use it to make tea, so I don't know if it is suitable for the tea connoisseur.  Great tea for the price!
This product was introduced by my mom and a friend of mine.  I was a coffee drinker - starbucks.  I have not yet gone back.  Much healthier and it has the caffine as well.  No headaches, yeah.

Not only does it taste just as good, I use Splenda and Stevia to sweeten it, add skim milk, and a bit of protein powder to actually make it a yummy healthy drink instead of the calorie ridden, sugar-fest that you get from Starbucks!  Yummy!

great product, wonderful taste, beautiful packaging, and they even give you a spoon to measure out 2g (1 serving).  my only complaint is that i found it cheaper ($6) at an asian supermarket, but this is the best green tea powder option on amazon.com

The powder is very versatile and one only needs to use a small amount (I can't imagine using more than this box in one year...great value).The tea powder comes in a convenient and attractive box. So, if you are a decaf lightweight...I'd recommend that you test a small quantity to see how your body reacts to it. I love it!

This powder was not really what I was expecting. When I say that, I mean that I really didn't care for the taste nor the color. This was my 3rd order of matcha green tea powder (3 separate orders from 3 separate vendors). My first order was from MatchaTeaSource and was premium grade matcha green tea powder,I also paid a premium price for this as well as premium shipping costs. My second order was the Teavana DoMatcha, through Amazon and although I liked this equally as well, the price for a small tin of tea was also at a premium plus shipping. I use 2-3 tsp of the matcha green tea powder, 8 oz cold nonfat milk and one Truvia sweetener - I mix this using a latte whip or a martini shaker (if iced). It's awesome!

I have tried 2 other matcha powders and this is the best so far. It is also the cheapest one if you buy it in this package. The package is beautiful and seals very nicely between uses. It also tastes pretty darn good (at least compared to the other 2 I have tried!).

I had powered matcha tea at my local coffee shop and this was nothing like what I expected.  It tasted quite a bit like seaweed. I managed to drink a little of this but it needed much doctoring.  It became tolerable if I added sugar, ginger and milk. It also did not dissolve well even when I used my hand held blender.  I would not recommend it unless you are creative with adapting seaweed for other uses.

This wasabi is soooo much better than the stuff that comes in a tube - there is no comparison.  If you want real top-quality Japanese wasabi - just like in the Sushi Bar, then this is exactly what you are looking for.I am very pleased and will definitely be ordering it on a regular basis.Update: Feb 11, 2011  The ten .88 oz cans lasted me over three years and the quality never waned!  I just ordered ten more.  This wasabi is definitely the best.  TEN STARS!!

this wasabi was hot and fresh.  i like there that are no colorings or preservatives.  i also like the small can.  unused portion stays fresher and can is very useful after the product is gone.

These Tiara lollopops may appear to be all pretty and pink. You would think that they would taste delicious but don't be decieved. One bite had myself and my kids wondering if they had been laced with Pepto Bismol. All i can say is ICK!

column9: ...and I'm not all that fond of blueberries.
column10: The packaging and product description will tell you there's all sorts of ways to use this stuff, and I tried most of 'em. But here's the skinny: sure, it works as a cereal (or a garnish for a flake-based cereal) and all those other things, but this stuff was put on Earth for the sole purpose of being a yogurt mix-in. Good healthy snack.  Good plain, and also I tried mixing with plain yogurt and honey which is a great snack and adds a bit of protein to the meal.
As granola snacks go, this was ok. I didnt care for the flax seed part of it, but the blueberry taste was nice. Would make for a healthy snack or cereal replacement, but I doubt I would buy it.

This granola is very fresh and tasty.  I liked the idea that it had walnuts, quinoa and chia seeds.  It has crunchy clusters of oatmeal with mostly unrecognizable other ingredients.  The chia seeds were hiding at the bottom of the bag.  It is tasty even though I could not identify the ingredients.
This tastes really good on my yogurt.  It is so hard to find gluten free granola but I love the Kind brand.

column9: A healthy, tasty, granola like snack.
column10: I thought this was very good.  It was really crunchy, and I could taste the blueberries.  I also liked how there were several different grains -this gave it some variety (and the flaxseed raised up the levels of Omega-3s, which is great).It was also low in sodium, had NO saturated fats, and had FIVE grams of fiber per serving.  This is a great midday snack to give you the complex carbs that you need (without a large blood sugar spike) to get you to the next meal.I would definitely buy these in the future and would throw them in my luggage as a snack on a plane, or a treat to munch on when hiking.No chocolate chips needed in this granola snack! Recommended.

Right. I know what you're going to say: it's granola.  How exciting can granola be?This stuff is delicious. Heck that's what I did with half this bag!

I really enjoyed these cinnamon oat clusters! The cinnamon flavor was not overwhelming, I found it to be the perfect topping for yogurt and also perfect on its very own. I will definitely purchase this again in the futre.

column9: Tasty and healthy treat or cereal
column10: While this product didn't feature a lot of big clusters, I found it quite tasty and loaded with healthy ingredients.  It had enough cinnamon to complement the taste, but not too sweet.  With nearly as much fiber (15g) as sugar (18g) per cup, and 9g of protein, one could definitely do worse.Apparently one of the issues that comes with relatively low sugar granola is that the clusters don't stick together so well.  However, this is not much of an issue if you're eating this with yogurt or milk.Overall, a great product worth recommending if you like granola.

column9: YOU HAVE TO TRY IT TO EXPERIENCE HOW SUPERIOR THIS PRODUCT REALLY IS !!
column10: I really was blown away with how incredibly tasty the Kind Healthy Grains Vanilla Blueberry Clusters with Flax Seeds was ! By far the best granola type food I've ever eaten and it's super healthy. I eat it sprinkled on nonfat plain yogurt that I infuse with cinnamon, with soy milk, or by itself, of course. I sometimes make up an on the go snack bag which varies but always has these tasty clusters in it and some kind of dried fruit, raw, unsalted pecans, almonds or walnuts, goji berries, etc. I will be trying the other flavors soon. A great product all around & Amazon's price for a 3 pack of 11 oz. bags is a bargain.

column9: Healthy portions of flavor despite healthiness
column10: This is a tasty cereal with all kinds of vitamins and minerals. The grains and seeds make for a healthy breakfast (even by modern The Evolution Diet: All-Natural and Allergy Freestandards). I expected more in the vanilla blueberry clusters, which were noticeably sparse. Fortunately, the flavor is still there, and so makes up for the lack of clusteration.

This product has a wonderful mix of flavors and textures in every bite.  It is a mix of whole grains, blueberries, and flax seeds that are then lightly flavored with vanilla.  The different ingredients all have different tastes and consistencies that make this mix feel good in your mouth.  It has a very lightly sweetened taste that makes it delicious as a "munchy".  It's also wonderful on top of yogurt or eaten like a cereal.  It's very healthy and keeps well over a period of time.  I wholeheartedly recommend this product.

column9: Delicious, but not really THAT healthy
column10: Granola is awesome, KIND is a great company and this was delicious, but this is perhaps not the healthiest choice. There's a surprising amount of sugar in here, and not to be super-picky, but the flax seeds pretty much just get stuck in your teeth, where they have minimal health benefits. This was also rather on the tough side as far as chewing, which can be a concern for some.

The Oat and Honey clusters reminds me of the granola cereal that I used to love as a kid, but this has much less fat and still tastes great.  It's gluten free on top of it!  Since I am Celiac, my breakfast cereal choice is somewhat limited.  I was looking for something different to break up the monotony and decided to give this a try.  I am glad I did.  The only downside to this is that it is a bit expensive.  I think it is worth it though.  I just ordered the Maple Walnut clusters and looking forward to trying them.

Maybe I got a bad bag but... the flavor of the vanilla blueberry was unpalatable. I love granola and was looking forward to trying this healthy version but it tasted old, almost as if it had "turned." If it weren't so expensive, I would try it again. I love the idea of including flax seeds in the granola.

Best granola on the market! Would never guess it's gluten free. I order six bags at a time to make sure I never run out. I eat it straight from the bag as a snack, put it on top of yogurt, and eat it as cereal with milk. Tried many other brands I could find locally but none even come close, so I will continue to order Kind.

As a lover of Kind bars, I was excited to see this granola. I'm generally not a fan of grains unless they're sprouted grains, but this was great. Low glycemic and tasted SO good. It's full of amaranth, quinoa and millet as well as flax which provides the Omega 3. I love how the blueberries add a nice sweet/tart taste but was disappointed to learn that they're blueberry puree as well as apple and plum puree. I wish they were just dried blueberries.All in all, it's a great granola and has a nice depth / complexity of taste.

I'm not really experiencing anything while eating this granola that makes it in any way stand out from any other granola brands that I've tried.I taste cinnamon.The clusters are relatively small & loose.It gives me gas.Checking the label against Bear Naked Fit Vanilla Almond Crunch Granola I see similar ingredients but do not see any mention of the Bear Naked products being gluten free. (If that is something that is important to you.)

column9: The Flavor Sneaks up on you
column10: Good solid granola that has more flavor than you would initially think.  Upon first bite it just tastes like normal granola-but the flavor jumps in as an aftertaste and is use right.  For the granola fan, tough to go wrong here as long as pricing is in line with other quality brands.

column9: Vanilla covering mars the texture and taste of the snack
column10: I wanted to like this healthy snack, and perhaps I chose the wrong flavor.  The blueberries were nice -- tangy and flavorful.  The grain is crunchy.  But the vanilla covering (or glue or whatever it is that is sticking the grains together) has an unpleasant rough, starch-like texture and a bland aftertaste, kind of like that chalky aftertaste you get from Pepto-Bismol (although NOT that flavor.)I think I will give this brand another try in another flavor.

I'm not a health nut. In fact I'm a foodie who wouldn't give up anything in the name of health. I do tend to think that stuff like this sacrifice taste and don't buy them. So why did I get this? the description had said they could be sprinkled on yogurt and I do eat lots of yogurt.Surprisingly, however, these taste good. I like them. For the most part, I ate these with milk as morning cereal or I snacked on them. I never got to put them on yogurt (which was my original intention). If these come with the subscribe and save plan, i'll order it just to have them over. Otherwise, they'll be an as needed buy.A little goes a long way with these. The didn't taste like raw bran or some "healthy" cereal completely robbed of taste. Instead, even a sweet tooth like me liked it. Just a reference, I don't drink skim milk because i think it taste like water so that should give a little idea of where i'm coming from.My only con with these: they packages aren't big. Not like regular cereal bags. They're much smaller.  I wish they came a little bigger which is why i took of a star. But then you don't need to eat much to feel full so i guess....Anyway, If you're the kind of person who avoids stuff like these because you think they taste bad, try this and be amazed. If you're a health food junkie, well, now you don't have to sacrifice taste.Cheers!

column9: This is an HONEST, kind, product!
column10: I find myself searching grocery store shelves. I read the labels, scour the freezers and even the so-called healthy products-aren't. This wonderful granola type snack is different. It contains healthy grains but is minus the un-healthy sugars, syrups and fats. I found that it tasted great. In fact I prefer it over the sickening sweet alternatives marketed by the food packing giants. With flax seeds it is uber healthy with so many essentials. The cinnamon taste is pleasant and if I am not mistaken, cinnamon is thought to be a "fate burner"!Be kind to yourself and give Kind Healthy Grains Cinnamon Oat Clusters a chance!

I'm in love with this! I love it on my frozen yogurt even had it on ice cream when the yogurt was gone LOL I'm not a "fresh" yogurt person but it would be good mixed with the fruit too.Just a hint of cinnamon but just right IMO Lots of flax seed so was crunchy enough too.I recommend this!

This is a lovely little granola. Just enough sweet, but not TOO much. The vanilla/blueberry clusters add taste interest without being overpowering. I can take or leave the flax seeds since they aren't well digested in whole form for most folks. Ground whole flaxseed sprinkled on your food, or flax seed oil are both more beneficial since they are more easily digested and utilized by the body. The whole flax seeds do give some good textural interest along with the grains. Very nice with Greek yogurt and fruit and NOT "cardboard-y" at all. Definitely a two thumbs up rating from me.

I'm not a granola expert of fanatic, but I thought I might enjoy this product more because I like blueberry and vanilla.When I opened it, it smelled musty, like a year-old box of cereal.  I found that very odd, but plunged ahead anyway.  It was disappointing, because I picked up on pretty much no blueberry flavor (or blueberries, for that matter).  It tasted like really dense granola.  From a pure flavor and eating enjoyment aspect, I did not really care for it.From a health standpoint, this product is free of everything "bad" and full of "good stuff"...heavy on flax.  I'm not a health food fanatic, so again, this was lost on me.  But my son, age 24, really seemed to enjoy it.  He's much more attentive to what he consumes, and I think he liked the taste as well.  He ended up being the only consumer of this product.  (My wife liked it less than me.)I have to conclude, based on the non-scientific study of my family, that this product appeals to folks accustomed to more "healthy" snack foods...and not folks like me who have no problem with more "commercial, processed" snacks.  I had hoped that KIND would be both tasty and healthy...but it fell short.  I'd be a two-star reviewer...my son would be 4...so I'm splitting the difference.

I love Kind Vanilla Blueberry Clusters with Flax Seeds!  These are just perfect sprinkled over yogurt and it keeps you full all morning.  Also, they are just sweet enough without being sticky sweet.  You can also munch on it through the day whenever you want something sweet and it is also super crunchy.

My son and I both enjoyed this granola as cereal in the morning. The clusters stayed crunchy in milk and it was quite flavorful. We could see bits of blueberries and their flavor was noticeable while not too overpowering. The flax seeds did sometimes stay in the milk afterwards but as long as you drink the milk you get their full benefit. We both enjoyed the taste and the variety of grains included. It is relatively healthy and we've always been satisfied with KIND products. This is a tasty granola option.

I love having something in my pantry I can take out and munch on without guilt--this is exactly my kind of snack.The best thing about Healthy Grains Clusters is how healthy they are. They're made with whole grains, including quinoa, one of the healthiest grains out there. The flax seeds are an excellent way to get important omega-3 fatty acids into your system.They're also a very good source of fiber. Best of all, they're made with all-natural ingredients.Besides being good for your diet, these crunchy clusters are addictively good--both by themselves and as a yogurt topping. I wasn't sure how'd they would actually taste, as I've had plenty of bland health foods. They turned out to be one of my new favorite snacks!Overall, this is an excellent granola that satisfies your sweet tooth.

After the taste, the best thing I like about this product is that it is low glycemic and would be a good choice for people with certain kinds of diabetes. That surprised me as it did not have the cardboard taste of other low glycemic products. This is one of the best tasting granolas that I have ever had. The people at Kind are changing the way we eat, and in a positive fashion. I tried the Vanilla Blueberry and look forward getting the Maple Walnut next. This isn't breakfast, it's dessert!

I couldn't believe it when my picky kids finished this package in a single day.  They liked it THAT much.  Unlike some granola, the Kind Healthy Grains Vanilla Blueberry Clusters tasted delicious and wasn't so hard that it damages your dental work.  I would definitely buy this product as a healthy snack or breakfast alternative.  I can't wait to try more of the flavors, but the blueberry vanilla is a great flavor combination that seems to go over well in my household.  Thanks, Amazon, for carrying such a great selection of Kind products.

These oat clusters are truly delicious. An all natural way to get the fiber you need and satisfy the munchies between meals. I have also added this to plain low fat vanilla yogurt and it makes for a very satisfying lunch when combined. Fresh all natural flavor and good for you. How can you lose?

column4: Peggy Bowes "Author of The Rosary Workout"
column9: Nice crunch and better than Bear Naked Granola
column10: For years I have been eating Bear Naked Granola (Fruit and Nut, in the orange bag) with vanilla yogurt and berries as one of my favorite breakfasts.  When I was offered an opportunity to review this similar product, I was skeptical that anything could top my favorite granola.  Instead, I was pleasantly surprised at how much I enjoyed the Kind Cinnamon Oat Clusters granola.  It actually tasted fresher than Bear Naked and I can eat 1/3 of a cup for roughly the same calories as 1/4 cup of Bear Naked.  (The rest of the nutritional info is roughly the same between the two brands.)  The Kind granola has a nice crunch and didn't get soggy when mixed with yogurt.  The cinnamon flavor is subtle and not overpowering.  It's packed with whole grains, Omega 3 and other healthy ingredients.  It would also be good served as a cereal with milk.  It's a bit more expensive than Bear Naked, but if both were on the same shelf, I would definitely reach for the Kind Cinnamon Oat Clusters.  I would also be interested in trying other versions/flavors of this product.
I'm not a big granola eater, but this stuff was great! Lots of flavors and textures and supposedly good for me as well. Yum!

column4: K. Peterson "Never too old to learn"
column10: I do not eat gluten, so it was important to me that this product be non-gluten.  I looked the package over and nowhere did I see "without gluten" on it, except in the ingredients where it lists the whole grains used to make this product, it did say "gluten free oats" but still I wondered about the other grains.  Another ingredient was amaranth, which has no gluten (neither do oats, but they easily become contaminated by gluten in processing) so I checked this site and lo and behold, it says that it is non gluten!  So, not on the package (unless I am missing it?) but yes, on this site.I took this bag of granola with me to my daughter/husband's house and they tried it too.  It was a very nice tasting cereal, loaded with whole grains.  I did not experience what some other reviewers said, with having no clusters in their bag (in other words, some got kind of a granola dust, but mine were big chunks, just like they are supposed to be).  Mine was packed in a box with some of those air pocket things, so it came through just fine.  I also didn't notice any funny aftertaste.  The cost is $16.56 for 3, 11 oz bags, or $14.08 through "subscribe and save" ($4.69 per bag).  I think this is a little higher than our local Walmart Bear Naked granola, but not that much higher.  Also, Bear Naked granola isn't gluten free (the oats are not gluten free, to my knowledge), whereas the Kind variety is.Although the variety of this cereal that I had (Cinnamon and Oat Clusters with Flax Seeds) did not have glycerin as an ingredient, I noticed that my bag of Bear Naked fruit and nut granola did have glycerin, apparently with the raisins and cranberries that were in it.  I have to admit, I had always associated glycerin with soap (like Neutrogena) but note too that nitroglycerin (an explosive) has glycerin.  Glycerin is also, apparently, a sweetener (probably why they use it with raisins and cranberries).In the end, I would say that if you like the taste of this granola, the price on this one isn't bad.  And taste is a matter of, um, taste.  Because it is non-gluten, I may just buy this instead of the Bear Naked granola that I usually buy (yes, I know that Walmart's Bear Naked granola isn't non-gluten, but I like it and it is cheap and for reasons that I do not understand, I do not have to absolutely abstain from gluten, although I usually do).  I would definitely give this granola a chance and if you like the flavor, go for it!

column9: A bit too sweet and pricey, but it's a delicious all-natural product
column10: PROS:- It's a very natural product. Just look at the ingredients: Whole grains (gluten free oats, brown rice, gluten free oat flour, buckwheat, amaranth, millet, quinoa), evaporated cane juice, flax seeds, chicory root fiber, canola oil, vanilla extract, molasses, blueberry puree, apple puree, plum puree, apple juice, glycerine, sea salt, Vitamin E (D-Alpha Tocopheryl Acetate), citrus fiber, citrus pectin.- It tastes delicious. The cinnamon comes through nicely.CONS:- I felt it was slightly too sweet. Obviously, that's subjective, so look at the sugar content: 5g of sugar in a 29g serving. The good news is that "sugar" isn't in the list of ingredients. The product gets its sweetness from the juices in the ingredients. It claims it's "low glycemic," but you might want to be skeptical about that.- Only 2-4 realistic servings per package. Most cereals have a serving size of 3/4 cup. Here's it's just 1/3 cup. On the other hand, the serving size is 29 grams, which is comparable to the average serving size weight for other cereals. The package claims 11 servings. Sure, if you're just nibbling. But if you have a standard bowl of cereal, you'll find that it only has 2-4 realistic servings (depending on your bowl size). So it goes quick! This makes it somewhat pricey and lowers the overall value.CONCLUSION: If you're not concerned about the relatively high price and you like a sweet cereal, then this is a perfect product!

column9: Tasty, healthy product with multiple uses
column10: Though I'm in the latter phases of the Atkins approach to eating and can now be a little more relaxed about my carbohydrate intake (people slam the Atkins plan for being unrealistic, but it's only the initial phases that are truly restrictive), I still keep an eye out for needlessly excessive carb counts.Kind Healthy Grains Cinnamon Oat Clusters with Flax Seeds are therefore right up my alley.  They're tasty and crunchy, perfect for stirring into my plain yogurt, sprinkled over hot cereal, or just enjoying in a flavorful small handful every now and then. A third of a cup serving- more than enough for the uses I mentioned- contains only 17 grams of net carbs (22 grams of total carbs minus the 5 grams of fiber).  For calorie watchers (like my wife), total calories for that amount aren't bad, either (about 130).As I've said in the past when I was pleased with a free sample of a product from the Amazon Vine program, I'm definitely open to picking up a fresh supply of these healthy, good-tasting clusters at my own expense once my free supply runs out.

I wasn't sure how this wold taste since it seemed to be so "healthy" but it was awesome.  I ate it several ways - alone, with my morning yogurt, on my salad and in my smoothie - in every way it was delicious. Worth the price and good for you too.

My 13-year-old daughter has decided that she likes granola. She's been happy to help me finish off this bag, and it's a good a snack as any for her.I like that it's not too sweet, and has some of the less-common good-for-you grains like Flax.In addition to eating it straight out of the bag, I tried it with milk, and it was good.

I am not a health food fanatic. In fact like many Americans I am overweight. Deciding to make my forties a healthier decade means making some changes. So I am exploring healthy food options.Kind vanilla blueberry clusters is healthy but is it tasty?The first morning I had it with milk. Crunchy, tasty but a waste of time. Even though it was soaked in milk it wasn't really a cereal and it was still dry. How? I wound up drinking the milk from the bowl at the end. - fail.I bagged some and took it as a snack. Better. Great and crunchy. Tasty but have a drink handy - Good.The next morning I had Greek fat free yogurt and sprinkled some on top. It required some hands crumbling clusters but not really that much work. It added a bit of flavor to the creamy goodness that is Greek yogurt (not the other kind of tangy yogurt) and it gave it some crunch. Not thirsty after words ) the best way to have it.Over all if you like crunch and want to add some healthy omegas to your diet this is a good way to do it. Especially if you eat yogurt or like snacking. If you are looking for an alternative to sugary cereal or hate dry food look elsewhere this just won't cut it.Personally I would keep it but not as a breakfast food.

column9: Good eating made from good stuff.
column10: This is good food that is also good for you.  Better than any granola I have had in recent memory, it reminds me of the first time I tried granola as a kid, because it is like tasting granola for the first time.The clusters are big and hold up to milk well, but they are also great popped into your mouth.The motto on the bag says that you can pronounce and see all the ingredients in their products.  I simply pronounce it good eating.

I've been eating KIND bars for a couple of years.  They are a truly healthy alternative to the many so-called health & energy bars that have flooded the market in the last decade.  KIND is also a socially conscious company which donates portions of its proceeds to worthy causes.  They've now added cereals to their line of bars.  I tried the Cinnamon Oat Clusters with Flax Seeds.  It was tasty & satisfying.  It was tasty with milk, or on yogurt (Greek in my case), or as a stand alone snack.  However, the portion sizes listed on all food products are ridiculous & don't reflect real life.  At least not the life I know.  However, even doubling the portion size the result will still be a filling meal which is low in calories, high in protein, low in sodium, low in sugar, with 0 sat. fat & 0 trans fat.  That the package is just 11 oz. in size is one of my major complaints.  This is a healthy alternative to many of the granolas which are on the market.

I was really excited to try this product as I am a HUGE fan of their bars. It was very good. It's always great to find a source for Omega 3 's. The amazing variety of grains used in this is a selling point to me, I like the variety and it's not over-sweet. I do like granola that's not all broken up into tiny little pieces, but has some chunks in it, which this does have.Kind granola is also gluten free and vegan friendly. If you are on a restricted diet this is perfect. I thought the cinnamon was just the right amount, not overpowering. To me, things that are 'healthy' for you aren't very useful unless they taste good too, this tastes good. Enjoy it on yogurt, or out of the bag, or with milk. I put it in little baggies and throw it in my backpack for a snack at school.

column9: Great For you and Great Tasting!
column10: My family loves the entire line of Kind Healthy Grains products! These natural ingredients products are great tasting and great for you, especially if you are on the look out for gluten free food. I found the Cinnamon Oat Clusters delicious coming in close as a first compared to the Maple Walnut Clusters which currently lines my cupboards.I feel this product is a great addition to add to my yogurt, to eat with milk as a breakfast cereal, and it's also a good stand along snack. It's got a great crunch, the texture is desirable, and the flavor is pretty tasty. My 3 year old which a picky eater loves this stuff so you can be sure that I'll probably be taking advantage of the awesome subscribe and save deal that Amazon.com offers!If you are wanting to try it before subscribing, you can find this product in most stores. I was thrilled to find at my local Market of Choice grocery store and am so glad to see it here on Amazon.

Unlike some of the other reviewers' experience, the product I received had nice big clusters and a good crunch to it.  It seemed slightly bland to me, though, so I added an extra dash of cinnamon and a little nutmeg, which made it taste much better in my plain Greek yogurt.Overall, I like the oat clusters and I like the extras that are in it, such as the flaxseed and Omega-3,  which make the calories worthwhile.

column9: It took some time to find the right combo...
column10: I wasn't fond of this with yogurt, but it's SUPER with milk and a splash of fruit/nut mix. I let it soften a little and snarfed it all up! Very highly recommended.

column4: David G. Schwartz "I like reading more than w...
column10: I received one pack of Vanilla Blueberry Clusters with Flax Seeds through Amazon Vine, and it made a great breakfast for me. Very tasty, and the flax seeds gave it some texture as well. My only regret is that I didn't get more--it was so delicious that I ate it all in one serving. I'll probably be ordered some more soon.

column9: not a granola fan, but I liked this one
column10: I've always thought I should like granola, but I had never found a packaged one that really did it for me. I'm a big fan of KIND bars, so I was excited to hear that KIND had a new granola product line. Finally, I've found it, a package granola product worth eating.As with other KIND products, I like that their granola is made of natural ingredients. As their slogan says "ingredients you can see and pronounce." But, of course, that only gets you so far if the taste isn't there. KIND granola comes through on the taste to though. It's sweet but not too sweat, and I liked (unlike some other reviewers) that the blueberry flavor wasn't too strong.
