column10: Just heat and serve this wonderful hearty, low fat soup! We chilled it thoroughly first to congeal the fat (so we could remove it) and guess what? There were NO fat solids! Amazingly good low sodium, low fat meal! You will not be disappointed. Recommended!

Love getting my pet food this way! Our 8 dogs love Pedigree and I love getting it delivered to my door. Per can, it costs a bit more, but when I consider cost of gas, as well as load it into my cart, unload at checkout, load back into the cart, load into car, unload at home...makes me tired just to write about it...home delivery is a fantastic bargain!

My dogs are very picky. This is the first canned dog food, except for expensive Little Caesar, that they'll eat. Still, they hold out for table food as long as they can! My worry is that Pedigree has only 6-7% protein. Recommendation is 27-28%. Notably, the can does not say "nutritionally complete"!
My dog loved this brand and flavor.  However, beware of AMZN's packing/handling because I've received dented cans which broke seal making several of the cans in the package go bad.

Pedigree chicken and rice is good product.  My dogs love it.  I wanted Pedigree Weight Management Chicken and Rice but it was recalled and I don't know when Pedigree will start to release again.  My dogs don't know the difference of Pedigreen Chicken and Rice regular or weight management.  I can also use Pedigree Health Weight Chicken and Rice but it comes from Peto and that costs over $18 in shipping whereas Amazon if over $25 does not charge shipping Love that.

column9: Pedigree Traditional Ground Dinner Chicken & Rice Food for Dogs, 13.2-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24)
column10: Great food for my older dog and my dog with digestion problems. The chicken and rice is the best I've found. Other wet dog foods that are beef/liver/lamb or anything dark colored or artificially colored upsets their stomachs. My dogs love this!

My dogs like this flavor of Pedigree canned food a lot.  It's a very good deal with Amazon's subscribe and save program.  Much cheaper than Walmart or Kmart.  However sometimes the cans are dented.  I don't know whether this is Amazon, UPS, or the manufacturer.  I've gotten dented cans in 12 or 24 packs in local stores so it could be anyone tossing them around.
Great product, convenient and cost efficient.  Good quality.  Will order this product again.  Fast on delivery. Dogs love it and have no issues with it.

I had previously purchased this Pedigree chicken dog food for my finicky 1-year-old german shepherd and she loved it.  When my shipment arrived from Amazon I immediately opened a can from the end of the plastic-encased 24-pack and presented it to my dog.  She sniffed it and refused it, so I left it out for her. She kept begging for food, but I would each time point out that she had food in her dish.  She finally ate it, reluctantly, the next evening and then was up all night vomiting. The next day we smelled a dead animal odor that we couldn't locate. Sugar (the dog) sniffed it out for us at the top of the cabinet and we discovered that at least one of the Pedigree cans had burst open and was full of squirming white worms and rotting, oozing liquid that permeated the entire package. I felt so guilty for making Sugar eat something that made her sick, and threw away the entire package. Now I'm afraid to buy the brand again.
The product was exactly as described. It arrived promptly and in perfect condition. I would buy from this seller again.

I am a jam connoisseur and I have to say that this is the most sugary jam I have ever tasted in my life. Also, when I bought the jam, I thought it would be packed with luscious fruit, but the whole top third of the jar was like jelly! It was totally clear with no friut at all. I gave it to my mother and she said it was way too sweet for her as well.[...]

This is by far the best jam I have ever tasted. I have been buying it for years ever since I first discovered it on a trip to Ohio. I'm from California so there is a shipping fee but it's well worth it.  They even make a sugar free product which is excellent!  Can't be beat!!
I loved this product. Its a non GMO product that tastes great. I intend on trying other flavors as well. Thumbs up!

column9: Carcinogenic, but nice taste and texture!
column10: Yes, this product can give you cancer, but so can toothpaste and a lot of other things we take for granted. You're gonna die some day from something, so if you really like this gum, why not, right? It's probably safer than smoking cigarettes."Titanium dioxide dust, when inhaled, has been classified by the International Agency for Research on Cancer (IARC) as an IARC Group 2B carcinogen possibly carcinogenic to humans." -- Wikipedia.Of course, Xyloburst is by no means the only gum with titanium dioxide. Spry has it too, and so do a lot of other brands, with the notable exception of xylichew, which does not. So if cancer isn't your thing, then buy Xylichew. For my part I have noticed that I cough a lot more after chewing a lot of gum, probably because of all the titanium dioxide dust that gets stirred up by chewing. What is the titanium dioxide for? Why, color. The manufacturer has determined in his infinite wisdom that our brains will explode if we see a piece of gum that is not perfectly white. So he put a carcinogen in a purported "health food" product, making fools out of all the trendy folks that pay a premium for a one-way ticket to the cancer clinic.I give three stars, because I really did like the texture, flavor and the fact xylitol was used instead of sorbitol. I think Xyloburst is pretty close to being worth a try, just not there yet. The cancer thing is kind of a buzzkill, you know?

This was really fabulous!  I went on the company's website and found some great recipes for most of the "dips" etc. they have available.  I tried this one mixed with cream cheese and butter, sprinkled with the bacon topping, spread on strips of white bread, rolled up, wrapped in bacon and baked for about 5-7 minutes.  They were absolutely amazing - I made some for myself to test them out, made more the next day, then made a tray for a party and they all were gone in minutes.  I've been craving them ever since.  ..it's really, really good and really really easy.Wind & Willow BLT Cheeseball Mix8 oz. cream cheese4 T. butter or margarine4 slices of white sandwich breadDIRECTIONS:Pre-heat oven to 425. Combine BLT Mix with 8 oz of cream cheese and 4 Tbs. butter. Trim the crust from 4 slices of white sandwich bread. Cut into 3 equal strips. Spread each strip with BLT mixture and sprinkle with Herb and Tomato Topping. Roll up from the short end of the strip. Wrap with 1/2 strip of bacon and secure with a toothpick. Back for approximately 10 minutes or until bacon is done. Your guests will fight for the last Bite
Love this product!  I make it up as a dip instead of the cheeseball recipe!  Always a BIG HIT! =) Great price too!!

I received Hill's Science Diet Ideal Balance Dog Food to try as a BzzAgent.  I'm feeding this to my terrier as he tends to show the results to changes in his diet quicker than my Corgi or Belgian Sheepdog.  I've been a dog mom for more than 20 years, including participating in dog sports such as sled dog running, agility and dog shows.  Proper nutrition is vital to dogs' health and ability to participate in things they love to do.  While I currently don't do these activities with my dogs, I still am very picky about what they eat.When I received my BzzKit, a 4lb bag of Hill's Science Diet, Ideal Balance Dog Food, I checked the ingredients.  The first listed is chicken (good!) followed by brown rice and whole grain wheat (not as good as a meat ingredient, but better than it being corn).  Next is cracked pearl barley, soybean meal and chicken meal.  I have to admit I paused at the soybean meal.  In my experience, soy has not been a positive addition to dog food.  I find that foods that contain it result in looser stools of greater volume, and the dog's overall condition is not as high as one fed a food without soy.  It's an inexpensive ingredient that is associated with "filler" in the dog community.  I was curious to see how my terrier would handle and fare on this food. 3 stars for only one meat ingredient in the first 5 ingredients, and for the inclusion of soy.Rex, my terrier, became immediately interested when I opened the bag.  He was VERY anxious to see what was in there, so the smell must have been very enticing.  He's not a picky eater, so I anticipated he'd like the Ideal Balance, but didn't anticipate how eager he was to get it!  I slowly, over the course of days, switched him to Ideal Balance from his previous food (to reduce stomach upset from a diet change), and found he ate the Ideal Balance nuggets first before cleaning his bowl.  It may be because it was new and novel, but it may have been because he liked it better.  He's a dog...he couldn't tell me.  He seems to like it so much that I can even use Ideal Balance as a training treat.  5 Stars for taste.Rex has been eating Ideal Balance for a couple of weeks now.  It's not long enough for a complete picture of its impact on his condition, but long enough to get an idea of how it's going for him.His coat is very nice.  It was nice before, and I haven't seen any change in the coat condition.  The Ideal Balance diet is at least maintaining his coat in good condition.  We need more time to see the food's long term impact in Rex's coat.  4 stars for coat maintenance.Rex has a tendency to gain weight.  We really have to watch how much he eats.  And Ideal Balance helps him pack it on!  This means I can feed him less, which means I'm buying less food in the long run.  But I really have to watch his weight.  And it means that he is getting a lot out of the food.  The crude protein is 21.5% and crude fat is 12.5%.  The protein is not high, but the fat content is maybe a little higher than I'd seek for him.  I might choose a weight control version of Ideal Balance if this becomes his regular diet (and if one exists).  5 stars for body weight maintenance.Now the down and dirty part of the review...stools.  A dog's stool can tell you a lot about how he is tolerating his diet.  Rex's stools on Ideal Balance are firm, maybe a little larger than they were on his previous food, and do not smell any more objectionable than normal.  This tells me he is digesting the food normally, as well as close to optimally.  They could be a little smaller, but not so much that if I wasn't looking for a change that I'd have necessarily noticed it.  5 stars for stool quality.Overall, I give Hill's Science Diet Ideal Balance Dog Food 4 stars.  If there were a 2nd meat source and/or soy wasn't present, I could in good faith give it 5 stars, based on Rex's condition on the diet.  If you do try it, be sure to monitor your dog's weight, and adjust how much you feed accordingly.

I tried this food for free through BzzAgent. My dog is about a year old but VERY active, so have him on puppy food still because he's smallish and has trouble keeping weight on. He is allergic to something, I'm not sure if it's environmental or food, but he didn't have a reaction to this food. This is corn-free so I'm wondering if that's what he's allergic to.He did very well on it, and had nice solid stools and wasn't excessively flaky or itchy. He tends to bolt his food so the very small pieces weren't that great. He wouldn't chew it and then ended up vomiting afterward; I had to give him small amounts at a time. I'd rather they had kibble size options, but I'm being picky now.I'm not thrilled that the second ingredient is wheat, but at least it's not corn. Sagan seemed to do well on it. If it was less expensive than the food I have him on now (that he also does very well on), I'd have no problem using or recommending this food.

If you've bought the new formula of Hill's Science Diet dog food, you may have noticed an extreme fragrance.  It is unpleasant to humans, but the dogs seem to like it (if you get my drift--think, "base of a fire hydrant").  This is unnecessary because the dogs liked it before and it had a tolerable dog food odor for humans to smell.  The new stuff is odiferous in a disgusting way.  I don't want that fragrance in my house, let alone the kitchen, which is where the dogs eat.This new stuff is probably the same as the old stuff only now you get less of it and it costs more.  Sigh.  So you pay more for less food, but at least it isn't stinky.  The dogs like it just as much as they did before.I hope Amazon will begin to carry this product in the large size.  We have two "mature" labs, so we will always need a supply of this food.  The local pet store isn't open 24 hours and doesn't always have what we want.This would be a terrific item for "Subscribe and Save".

column9: Better Ingredients But More Room For Improvement
column10: I received a sample bag as a BzzAgent. I should first say that both of my dogs LOVED this food. They gobbled it up and didn't have any problems with digestion or itching, etc. I was happy to see that the first ingredient was real chicken. You can also compare your current dog food with Ideal Balance on this handy chart located here: [..] I am excited that the first ingredient is real chicken but I wish this product did not also contain chicken meal.

column9: Food You Can Feel Great About Feeding Your Dog
column10: I have a 8.5 year old Jack Russell who I view as one of my 'children' and not just a dog. She is very food motivated and we're yet to find a dog food she won't eat, however, she's struggled with acid reflux issues and all night 'hiccups' for most of her life. So I was excited for the opportunity to try HIlls Science Diet Ideal Dog Food to see if it would help her with this issue. I am also very pleased to be feeding her food with NATURAL and REAL MEAT ingredients as it makes me feel better about what she's taking in and the quality of the food. Not surprisingly she took to the food right away. I've never been one to like the smell of dog food, but I certainly didn't find the smell to be any more offensive than any other food like the other reviewer mentioned. I actually placed out a piece of 3 different types of food in front of my dog and she immediately whe went for the Hills Science Diet Ideal Balance food, so I'm guessing that she found it to be more appealing too. Although I haven't seen a HUGE improvement on her reflux issue, it has seemed to helped a bit and I'll take any help I can at this point. In fact, she's only been on the diet a few weeks now, and I know it generally takes a bit longer for it's full effects, so I'm very optimistic that it will provide even more improvement in the future. The only negatives I have about the food are that I had a hard time opening the bag and the top actually ripped open so I wasn't able to use the reasealable closure (but that could've been due to my impatience), and it seems to be a bit pricey. BUT, it's worth it for the quality and if it helps. Definitely would recommend! I am a buzzagent and did receive a free 4 lb bag and coupons to try the product.

column9: May be great for your dog...
column10: I received Hill's Science Diet Ideal Balance Dog Food to try as a BzzAgent.My small Pomeranian has allergies to a lot of things including wheat so he was itchy on this food, however, the lab I have did GREAT on this food.She loved the taste, ate it very well, and I noted an improvement in her skin and coat. She also has itchy problems for a lot of the year but improved with the use of this food.I also noted that my girl seemed to need less of this than most other brands of dog food out there. This means I'm buying less food in the long run which makes the food comparable in price to less healthy alternatives.The only complaints I have is the use of the wheat ingredient plus the soy. I really would like to see this product use another protein source that is more within the natural diet of a canine.
This cheeseball mix is wonderful.  I was unable to purchase it locally and I found it was available on Amazon.  Product arrived in a timely fashion and price was good.Thanks

I bought this dip and a specialty coffee shop on a trip to the Chesapeake Bay. We made the dip at a friends and went out on a beautiful boat ride. It was FANTASTIC!!! Everyone enjoyed the fabulous flavor. On my return i tried to purchase it locally in North Carolina and also in California. I found it on Amazon and bought six packages.... Why is no longer available???  I need more! It's been a huge hit all summer :)

These are very yummy noodles!  Like ramen noodles in texture, but without a soup base.  They contain a vegetable I've never heard of before, called moroheiya, touted on the package to be "...highly nutritious"...prized by the Egyptians for its health and beauty benefits."  Don't know how it ended up in a Japanese noodle product but I'm glad it did since it's very delicious, vegan and the 20 moroheiya leaves the package says it contains are organically grown.  (Would have given it 5 stars if the entire product were organically grown.)  Because there's no soup base, I've been using them in a variety of dishes - including soup.  Love them with scrambled tofu and vegetables!  Excellent product.

column9: Good texture, flavor - but expensive to try
column10: I tried these because I saw them mentioned in Reader's Digest. For those that love those cheap ramen (Nissan, Maruchan, etc.) these will likely give you what you are looking for as a healthier option. They have a similar texture to cheap ramen, but not the unhealthy fats. They also have 6g of fiber per serving. Low-carb dieters beware: they are high in carbs, even considering the fiber.They have a bit of a 'vegetably' taste and odor to them, but I don't mind. I usually take the seasoning packet out of the Maruchan ramen and use that with these. They sell these noodles with soup base on other listings, but I suggest trying them plain and/or using your preferred seasoning before buying those.They're expensive to try out at first, but once you become addicted it's easier to get them cheaper by buying the plain noodles in bulk, directly. Give them a shot!

Wish more people know about these great noodles. Usually buy the plain noodles and am amazed at how versatilethey are besides being nutritious. Made with moroheiya, unlike other ramen noodles, they are steamed and air dried instead of being pre-fried and have no added preservatives, food colorings or MSG. Also great because they're vegan and produced under environmentally friendly conditions.Have been using these noodles in salads, as pasta (without the guilt) as well as in soups. They are quick cooking and keep well after boiling. Usually boil up a batch and refrigerate them.  The noodles only need to be dunked in hot water for a few minutes and they are ready to go with whatever sauce or trimmings you want for that meal.
It's great not to feel guilty about eating noodles! Their tasty and healthy to boot, what more can you ask for.
Stinky fish sauce...mildly disgusting and of questionable origin just like it's supposed to be.  Use in miso soup instead of dashi and it's pretty close on the taste.

Didn't really like this jerky. Too dry and the flavor was off, it's like repackaged dog treats! I usually buy Jack Links Master Ridge Farms Turkey Jerky, it's MUCH better than this Bridgford brand. Don't waste your money, buy Jack links instead.

I absolutely love this jerkey - just enough flavor without being too spicy. Consistency in piece size and thickness is great. However, it should be noted that proper research shows it is $4 cheaper to buy this product from Bridgeford than anywhere else that I've found. Wal-mart used to be about 5 cents cheaper per package, and you could buy individual packages, but the ones around me have dropped it - so sad!

I have always been a huge fan of Bridgford Turkey Jerky. In the past couple years it has gotten harder and harder to find in stores and has all but disappeared. When I saw it advertised on Amazon I was surprised and looked it up right away. It comes in a pack of 6-3oz packages and qualifies for Amazon's free shipping which is a bonus and for $35.56 which is a bit cheaper than the last store I found it in months ago. True to form, Amazon shipped it out promptly and I could not have been happier with the transaction. Great product at a fair price and flawless transaction. No complaints and well satisfied. Another satisfied costumer and thanks again Amazon.

column9: The best tasting jerkey out there and healthy too!
column10: I've searched for a jerky that actually has a tasteand is not just a tough salty piece of meat. This is by far the best tasting and healthiest out there. It's packed with protein and has a considerably lower amount of sodium.

column9: Product is good but the weight is wrong
column10: This is good turkey jerky in my opinion.The problem is, I received 6 3.0 oz packages instead of 6 3.5 oz packages.Amazon quickly refunded a fair amount for the shortage.However, I am surprised the description is still incorrect afterseveral weeks (unless they are now really shipping 3.5 oz packages).The reduced stars are only because of the product shortage.

column9: YUM!!  another great mix..another excellent appetizer
column10: I made a fantastic appetizer with this and was really surprised at how great it was...The wind and willow website has many more recipes but here's the one I tried and everyone loved it...it disappeared fast, I had four slices before I even put it out.  I used lettuce, tomato, and black olives as the toppings and cut it into squares rather than pizza slices.  The worst part about making it was by far trying to cut it with all the toppings on it.  I would recommend putting the cream cheese mix/topper on it, cutting it and keeping the pieces altogether, and then putting the veggies on top and separating the pieces-or separating and sprinkling the veggies on top.Cold Santa Fe Appetizer Pizza slicesINGREDIENTS:1 can refrigerated pizza doughOld Santa Fe Cheeseball & Appetizer Mix8 oz cream cheese1/2 cup sour cream3 cups chopped fresh veggies (lettuce, tomatoes, black olives)1 cup shredded cheddar or Monterrey jack cheeseDIRECTIONS:Bake pizza crust as directed and allow to cool.Combine Old Santa Fe Seasoning mix, cream cheese, and sour cream.Mix until creamy.Spread Santa Fe mixture onto cooled pizza crust.Top with chopped veggies, black olives, cheese, and contents of Topping packet.Refrigerate until ready to serve. Cut into 2 to 3" mini pizza slices.Serves 12 to 16

Down to my last can of this 5.5 oz Hill's Science Diet Kitten Culinary Creations Roasted Chicken in Gravy Canned Cat Food, when this order finally got here today.Problem:the ad fails to mention any size of the cat food cans. but the picture shows a 5.5oz can.So, I ordered it based on the picture: which is CLEARLY 5.5 oz cans.What I got is 2 cases of 24 2.9oz cans,this is not what I ordered.and now, I need the cat food! I have hungry cats here!I ordered it online since it's not available locally.I am NOT happy!I can't return it for refund, it would take way too long.what do you suggest?
This is the best cocktail sauce I've ever tasted!  Now I can't eat shrimp cocktail with any other sauce.

Out of the gold foil package, this matcha smells amazingly fruity. Super fruit amazing! The smell reminds me of really tarty berry yogurt. Brazilian Acai matcha appears slightly darker in powder form.I prepared this as a traditional hot cup. This matcha didn't froth up very well nor maintain froth, but I didn't really care. Interestingly, this matcha prepared has a different colour than normal, a dark forest green, probably from the acai berry powder. By the way, I used 1/4tsp plus 175f water.The taste of  Brazilian Acai matcha is quite fruity. A mix between a tropical flavor and blackberries or blueberries. There is also a natural sweetness to this matcha - adding any additional sweetener would be overkill I think. With the fruityness and natural sweetness, this hot cup is very refreshing! There is no tart or bitterness to this matcha! I honestly was expected this to taste tart or puckery.In the end, this was surprisingly good! Is this matcha totally cheating with getting a double whammy of healthy energizing matcha and acai? Don't pass up this matcha - I'm thinking this is up there on being one of my fav flavors from Red Leaf Teas!

Okay, so, fair warning. I'm not overly familiar with the acai berry or how it should taste. I've had acai berry/blueberry juice before, and loved it, so I'm hoping I'll love the berry on its own. Of course now, all I can think of when it comes to this tea is RuPaul's Drag Race with all the different queens trying to say "acai" for a TV commercial. It's like the Pink Dragonfruit from Tealish. I've never had dragonfruit, but it smelled amazing and so I tried it and I loved it. Now I'm on the hunt for an actual dragonfruit to try. So while I can tell if I like the tea and if it tastes good or not, I have no real way to tell if it tastes like the actual fruit at all. But that's okay! Everyone should be open to new experiences, and I am looking forward to this one.Okay, yum! It's kind of like blueberry on steroids? I don't know, it's got this amazing berry flavor with a round tartness....yes, round. It was the word that came to mind as I sipped it. It's just...lovely and unexpected. The flavor is very bold and very...unique. I don't quite know how to describe it, but I liked it. I definitely want to try more acai flavored things if this is what I have to look forward to! I'm not sure if I need to restock on this ASAP, but it's definitely in the running for my must-have list.

WooooowI love this tea!  This is the product, that can be really good for the body: it possesses the antioxidant, and vitamins. In addition, it also tastes good. You must try this tea, and you will not be disappointed.
They're impossible to find locally, so paying a little more is doable to get my hands on these delicious refried black beans.  They're a little on the thick side which is just the way I like them.
I like the flavor of white matcha but I wouldn't say it's white.  It is loaded with antioxidants and definitely has many health benefits.

If you prefer a less earthy matcha and the health benefits of a white tea this is the way to go! I want to address that Red Leaf Tea has an excellent QUALITY tea provided to you! Customer service is excellent as well! I was very pleased with my purchase of this white matcha from Red Leaf Tea.

My sister bought me the small one, of 30g. I was looking for a natural product to help me with some slightly increased blood sugar level. I was drinking it for a period of one month (one cup per day, skipped few times so you can say that 30g is good for about 30 cups) and my blood results were indeed better. Was it this tea or my general sugar issue awareness - I can't tell, but this was one of the best teas I have ever tasted.
I have been drinking this tea exclusively since the day I first got it.  It's got a nice, herbal flavor, smooth finish, and subtle, citrus aftertaste.
I really like this tea.I like the unique flavor, not your everyday tea.Highly recommended, and would make a great gift.

column9: Best budget meal for one or two
column10: Tasty Bite Punjab Eggplant is delicious and spicy.  Try adding a bit of plain yogurt.  Serve with rice or bread (nan or pita work well) and you have a brilliant meal that costs only a few dollars.  This is true of all of the Tasty Bite Indian Entrees.  I wish the Tasty Bite Thai Meals came as Entrees (i.e. without the rice or noodles) so I could streach them out into a big meal by adding my own rice or noodles.Tasty Bite Entrees are really easy to keep on hand, since they don't have to be refrigerated.  Buying in bulk works well for these.

column9: Super tasty, but kind of a small meal
column10: I ordered several Tasty Bite items and they were all great, and very convenient to take to work since they do not need refridgeration.  The eggplant in particular was delicious, just a hint of spice.  However, it does not come with rice, which helps make it a more filling meal.

column9: Love it Love it Love it
column10: What can I say, I just love this product.  Ideally for ME I would like it to be a little bit more tomato-ey and a tad less spicy, but when I taste it I remind myself that it is truly more authentic in its current state and I can taste the eggplant more despite the spiciness as I've gotten used to it.  Sometimes I just eat it as is without heating it up, which also lessens the spiciness level.  But it is SO good, I just ordered one of the vegetables packets and I doubt it can be as great as this one but it's worth a try.  It has a comforting smooshy testure to it, with bits of well-cooked onions intertwined in it.

This is the best of the Tasty Bite Indian retort-packaged dishes.  It is moderately spicy and has a wonderful flavor of eggplant.  It is a bit oily, like some Indian foods can be at times.  The texture is sort of creamy/lumpy because of the eggplant seeds.It is wonderful with a little microwaved frozen broccoli added to bulk up the meal, along with brown rice and some frozen naan.  Yum!This same item is sold camouflaged at Trader Joe's.
Best I've ever tasted! Truly "Fit for a King" kind of food! Everyone to whom I've recommended it agrees with me.

Have ordered a variety of these Indian meals and love them all.  Fast and easy to prepare and thetaste is just great.  Was very surprised at how good they were when I started using them.  Reallysolved my problem of loving Indian food but no take out nearby and my husband hates eating out.

I've enjoyed trying various food items from Amazon lately, and this is hands down my favorite. The little pouches are sooo convienent; the product stays fresh and tastey until you want to use it, and it is just the right size to prepare a dish for two, or clips it shut (I use a clothes pin, or a paper clip) to eat later.The Punjab Eggplant is a bit spicey, especially if you are eating it by itself. I use it as a side dish, rather than an entree, or I pour it over brown rice or the like.  For example, when I got my first shipment of foods from Amazon, we were in a hurry to get out, and we didn't have time to make a meal.  Looking through my stuff, I pulled out the Punjab egglant, a jar of whole wheat couscous, and a tin of sardines.  I heated up the egglant during the five minutes it takes to prepare couscous, put the cousous on two plates, added a couple of sardines for protein, and viola, a super quick tastey and nutricious meal!

Vegan. All natural. Convenient foil package. Heat & serve. Great on toast, with tortillas, pitas, or Indian bread, or with rice. I like to add small cubes of organic tofu for extra protein. Great flavor. Those who like Indian eggplant will be surprised and pleased. This review is out there for those for whom this makes a difference. See all of my reviews for more great choices. Check out "Vegan Grocery Favorites" and "Vegan Grocery Top Ten" in Listmania. Your "helpful" votes count and will be greatly appreciated to benefit the search of others. Thank you.

column9: Taste ok, a bit too mushy
column10: It tastes ok, a bit too mushy (can't make out the eggplant). Also beware of the high saturated fat (14-15%).

I served this with snack crackers as a dip to two different groups and received unanimous praise for its spicy deliciousness.  Works great as either hot or cold dip.  Five stars as a dip.As a main or side dish, I agree with another reviewer that the eggplant taste is obscured.  However, it still makes for a tasty meal.  Four stars.
I found it spicy though I'm a big wimp in this department. It's probably only a medium. It's pretty much all eggplant with some onion and spices. Great if you love eggplant.

Tasty Bite makes a "Jaipur Vegetables" that is soooo delicious.  It is the best of all the others ie: eggplant, lentil, spinach.  OK it is a tad high in salt but the seasoning is just perfect.  I am trying to get away from rice (need to diet) so I crumple up a slice of dried Ezekiel Bread in a bowl and pour the pouch over it.  it sops up the sauce and makes it more robust.  Sometimes I add some freshly cooked vegetables.  No preservatives at all and a cinch to prepare in boilable silver foil pouch which is also easy to open.  I rate this selection 4 star...no 5!

column9: Good meal for one hungry person,
column10: I bought this specifically because it didn't come with rice.  Rice is one of the most inexpesive food items on the planet and it's so easy to make.  The reviewer who said it didn't taste like eggplant has obviously never eaten Indian food before.  This is a non-refridgerated item that is priced right and tastes pretty good.  I prefer it over other Tasty Bite entrees.

column9: Very good flavor. Serve over rice.
column10: I'm a big fan of Tasty Bite and I've tried a lot of their offerings. This one is very good.. especially over rice. My disclaimer is that they were all tried over rice.  My absolute favorite is the Madras Lentils. (With or without rice) Than the Channa Masala and Punjab Eggplant. Beans Masala & Basmati Rice Ready Meal is also very good. The ones that I didn't like sooo much were the Jaipur Vegetables, Vegetable Korma, and Kashmir Spinach.  I really wanted to like the Bombay Potatoes but even over a generous helping of rice it's just too spicy, It has a good flavor but there's just too much heat in the mix. As a little side note, it looks like Tasty Bite is in the process of changing their packaging from envelopes in boxes to just envelopes. Good for the environment but WOW! the edges will cut you up. I'm still nursing a good size cut  from simply turning the package over to read ingredients. Hopefully they work on the design a bit more.

column9: Great curry, already went through 8 boxes in under 2 weeks
column10: I've ordered several ready-made packages from Amazon and they are mostly hit and miss. This is one of the hits. The curry flavor is authentic and goes well with rice. It get's even better if you slice a few small 1.5"x1.5" cubes of Asian eggplant on some olive oil and chili or crushed peppers with onions.

column9: Would have liked the eggplant to have more texture
column10: I love eggplant and I know it's not difficult to see from the picture that it's mostly pureed, but I had hoped it would have a little more texture.  Overall, this one was just 'ok' for me.  A few cubed pieces or hardy chunks of eggplant would have made all the difference.  I also found the flavor to be a little more mild then what I prefer and in comparison to some of the other Tasty Bite entries.  I could see myself repurchasing this item, but mostly just to maintain a decent variety in my otherwise lacking 'lunch' habit.  It's just not my favorite Tasty Bite.

I ordered this a while ago and absolutely loved it. The spices are wonderful and the dish with rice and Naan bread make an excellent meal. However I recently discovered you can order directly from Tasty Bite and their 12-Pack is half the price. As you might have guessed, I will be ordering from them instead of amazon. I gave it 3 stars because of the price. If it were just about the product, it would be 5 stars.

column9: not what I expected, too sweet
column10: I regularly order the Bharta Makhni at our favorite Indian restaurant and assumed this would be like that, No. This lacks the spice and proper seasoning. It ends up just being a rather disgustingly sweet variation on that dish. I will not be ordering it again.

column9: one of my favorite tasty bite meals
column10: the Punjab Eggplant with a serving of rice and some cashews makes a perfect, budget friendly vegan meal .... one of my favorites from Tasty Bite - not too spicy, just the right amount of heat . and the 90 second microwavable pouches makes this a quick, healthy and delicious meal !!
Bought a single-pack from my local Whole Foods. Its a little too sour for my taste, although otherwise feels fine. In two minds as to whether I should buy this again.

I absolutely love Tasty Bite's Punjab Eggplant. When I first came across it at a Whole Foods one day, just the sample I had made me completely hooked. Its smoky, spicy, warm, flavorful. I can't think of enough adjectives to describe it. I usually eat it straight out of the microwave or with a flour tortilla. I have tried the Kasmir Spinach which is really tasty and a potato one that I can't seem to remember the name of. LOVE LOVE LOVE IT!!

This is ok and good when you are short on time. Add some bread to make it a more filling meal. It's a bit spicy, but not over the top. For context: I prefer the "mild" salsa and find "hot" way too much. Judge your own preference. It has 510 mg/sodium per serving and one bag is two servings. Something to keep in mind. Cut back on salt the rest of the day if you plan to eat a package of this for lunch or dinner. The brand's spinach paneer dish is better.

This looks awful, tastes much better than it looks; but I couldn't taste the eggplant at all.  If you're thinking of buying this because you love eggplant, you will probably be as disappointed as I am.

(Im sorry for my english, im not from eua)This is very pretty, but teast like nothing, are just to see, not to eat! i used for my 2 year old b. party for my daghter, the theme was snow white, i used to put in the whitch table as a magic potion! it was beautifoul, i gave 4 stars just for the taste, if u want to buy to eat, dont, it teast like nothing!

This company is so awesome. Upon request they sent me some samples and information.  I love and am responsible for what I give to my loved dachshunds. It feels good to know a great company that really cares turns out a great product for me to share with my dogs.  I can not THANK them enough.  I love them and the product and my dogs love the product which makes them much healthier.  WIN-WIN!!!

column9: We thunk the Franoia Extra Virgin is slightly inferior to the Sacilian.
column10: From our experience the Extra virgin, while very good, is slightly lacking in the flavor and fruitiness of the Sicilian also by Frantoia and available at a slightly lesser price from Amazon.  Maybe it is just us - what do others think?

column9: The Best that Money Can Buy
column10: Not sure what the previous reviewer was referring to, but the Frantoia is first cold pressed extra virgin olive oil from Sicily.  It's expensive, but worth every penny.  Olive oil doesn't get any better than this.

column9: What could be better than ice cream that doesn't melt?
column10: As the title says  what could be better I mean if its good enough for our astronauts then I'd think it was good enough for me.think about it, how is it made ? did they take some cows and shoot them in to space?? Hey they did it with pigs and monkeys why not cows ?I know that's utterly ridiculousness.As for the taste its good, you can tell that it was once a real piece of ice cream that they dehydrated. This is the same stuff that your likely to find at air and space museums. There was only one issue I had with it,  During shipping or packaging the ice cream got pretty crunched up. lots of little pieces rather tan a solid chunk.  This is purely cosmetic and doesn't effect the taste at all. A tad bit on the pricey side but its one of those num nums that you should treat your self to every blue moon. This one was for my wife but I plan on purchasing a couple for both of us, there great to throw in your lunch and there relay not all that bad fat/cal wise compared to say chunky monkey by B&J. Enjoy it it was made just for you by  space cows.
I was able to get a bottle for $1.00 through a relay for life food sale.  This is the best juice ever!

I don't consider myself a coffee snob and I can't afford to drink Starbucks everyday. For the everyday fix, I know where to get my cheap diner coffee or I make my own at home. I was hoping this instant coffee would be a great way to get a quick cup in when all I had access to was the hot water from the water cooler at work. I ended up dumping the entire first cup. I mixed together the recommended water and powder and was hopeful when I smelled the pepperminty aroma. But the first sip was nothing more than hot water. So I added a little more.  Then a little more.  The water got sweeter (but grainer) and the scent got stronger but coffee did not. When I dumped the contents of my mug, the bottom was covered with the lumpy "latte" mix. If all you need is the smell of coffee and peppermint to perk you up, this will do. But if what you want is an actual cup of coffee, don't bother.

The Peppermint Mocha latte from Maxwell House is okay, but it's not the greatest. I used the 4 teaspoons that the package reccommended and to me it tasted like hot sugar water. I added a few more teaspoons with no result in change of flavor. The peppermint flavoring starts out strong, but by the end you can barely taste it. I think the flavoring is strongest in the foam that forms at the top of the drink after the hot water or milk is poured. The mocha flavor is basically non-existant. I could not detect any mocha or chocolate flavor throughout the drink. A hint of coffee flavor is present but the whole drink was pretty bland to be honest. My brother tried the drink as well. He took a few sips then poured the rest of his mug down the sink drain. It just wasn't that great.It's a quick go to drink for those cold winter nights but I rather stick to my regular coffee or hot chocolate.

column9: Very nice for a quick coffee drink without visiting a coffee shop.
column10: If you are used to getting your coffee in a coffee shop, this may not be the product for you.  But for someone like me who lives at least 30 minutes away from the nearest little drive-thru coffee place, and 45 minutes from the nearest Starbucks......well, a product like this is a nice change of pace.  In a few minutes (long enough to heat up some water), I can cuddle up with a book and a peppermint-smelling cup of coffee, and I don't have to get dressed or drive anywhere.I thought the peppermint taste was about perfect... definitely there, but not overpowering.I thoroughly enjoyed this.I also threw a couple tablespoons of the mix into a chocolate cake I made for my son's birthday... that left a very subtle peppermint flavor that he thought was pretty fun.Very nice for a quick coffee drink without visiting a coffee shop.

column9: A delightful flavor to warm you to your toes
column10: This "Peppermint Mocha Latte" has a delicate flavor.  I expected it to taste like Maxwell House's "Suisse Mocha" would taste with a candy cane stirred in but I was incorrect.  It does not have the heavier chocolate flavor of "Suisse Mocha".  This beverage exudes the delightful aroma of peppermint, but the peppermint is almost an illusion as I could not taste it while in my mouth, but it lingered on my tongue after swallowing.  A really nice balance of light flavors that I thoroughly enjoyed.Grab yourself a cup, throw on your snuggie and settle down to a good book this winter.Here are the stats:Serving Size =  1 1/3 TablespoonCalories = 50Fat Calories = 15Total Carbs = 9 gramsSugars = 7 gramsSodium = 40 mgContains milk

Maxwell House International Coffee Peppermint Mocha Latte comes just in time for the first frosty mornings of November. I tried the latte mix two ways: once with water and again with milk. I used four teaspoons of mix to six ounces of water for my first cup. The flavors were weak and the drink thin. I added one more teaspoon of mix to get a more satisfying flavor. When I tested the latte mix with milk, I used five teaspoons of mix in eight ounces of milk. This gave a drink with a nice consistency and a good flavor.If you prefer a stronger peppermint flavor, then make the latte with water. If you prefer the mocha flaver to predominate, then use milk. Using whole milk brings out the deep chocolatey end of the complex flavors.Regardless of the liquid used to make the latte, the foam on top developed quickly and lasted until the last sip. The latte is a satisfying treat for coffee lovers who want a more festive beverage to drink during this time of year.

column4: ChibiNeko "Sooo many books, so little time!"
column10: If you're looking for an instant coffee/latte beverage that'll knock your socks off, this probably isn't the one that will do it. It's good, but not great.The drink is made easily enough, which is what it has going for it most of all. I like that I'm able to measure out my own amount of powder, something that I can't do with so many of the individually packed brands out there. It's not as travel-friendly, but it does have a convenience factor to it.What kind of gets me is the drink's taste. The peppermint flavor is very strong (which I love) but the rest of it is a little on the weak side as far as taste goes. This tastes good enough for me to want to drink a second cup but I can't help but feel that with all of the various instant flavors out there and all of the coffee additions you can buy nowadays (in specific flavored creamers) this just doesn't stand out as much as I wanted it to.It's not a "meh" drink but it is mediocre. I can't help but feel that if the mocha flavor was just a teensy bit stronger the drink would have been a lot better.

I love the peppermint mocha flavor of this latte powder mix.  Three rounded spoonfuls in my mug, some boiling water, a little stir, and I've got a mug full of deliciousness to savor.  It's a perfect treat for the evening hours on a cold dreary night.  It doesn't have a strong coffee flavor, although it is present.  It also works well as a flavor additive to my coffee.

Wonderful foam, tasty blend of mocha and peppermint make this a hit.  Everyone I've served it to has been appreciative.  This is certainly a wonderful treat to keep on hand for the holidays.  It mixes well, without having to "chase down" those little lumps of mix that so many dry mix drinks leave behind in a cup of hot water even after stirring for an eternity. The only reason I don't give this 5 stars is because it takes so much to make a standard mug of coffee. The box says 17 servings per container --- in a child size teacup perhaps! If you haven't tried International Coffee for a while this is a good one to start with.  I find this one easier, tastier, and quicker (not to mention cheaper) than going through the drive-thru at my favorite coffee stand.

I bought a few containers of this brand a few months ago because they were on clearance (apparently because Maxwell House changed the look of the product) and I loved them. I hadn't tried the peppermint mocha though, and I love this too. I like the plastic container better than the metal one they had before and the design is more appealing.I am not a morning straight up coffee person. I like my caffeine kick as much as the next person, but I prefer it to be in the form of a mocha or some other equally expensive coffee based drink. This product does the job for me. It does not have much of a coffee taste at all, so if that's what you're looking for, you might not enjoy this. Also, as with most mixes and mochas, this is full of sugar (in fact, it's the first ingredient). According to the nutrition facts, this product has 50 calories, 1.5g of fat, 40mg of sodium, 9g of carbs, 7g of sugar and 0g of protein per serving. A serving is 4tsp (1.3tbsp) of mix to 6-8oz of water.Somehow, this mix foams up when mixed in, which makes it seem more like a mocha/latte than the usual mix. I like the taste a lot, I just wish it wasn't so expensive.

column9: Not so much taste in this box
column10: I am huge fan of peppermint mocha and was really excited to try this product. After taking a few sips, I was left wanting for more. I thought both the chocolaty taste of a mocha and the peppermint were both lacking in intensity. I prefer having the Trader Joe's peppermint hot chocolate with some coffee or the well crafted peppermint mocha at Starbukcs instead. This just doesn't give the power packed taste that a peppermint mocha should.

I don't usually drink any of these coffee mixes, but I am a big fan of anything chocolate and mint so I gave it a shot.  Adding it to boiling water as told in the instructions I would just give it two stars.  When I added it to a cup of coffee with cream it was a little better.  The scent is pretty good and actually smells like mint and chocolate.  The aftertaste tastes like it's supposed to be mint, but not quite.  One look at the ingredients doesn't exactly make your mouth water.  I'll use up the rest of it, but it'll never show up on my shopping list.

No, it doesn't take like what you would get at the coffee shop. It's got things in it like hydrogenated oils and other unpronouncible ingredients. So it's not wonderful, in regards to taste or natural ingredients. However, it is convenient. There are times when convenience trumps quality. When you just want something you can stir into hot water for a quick treat, this is great. Peppermint mocha is my husband's favorite flavor. I like to have this on hand for when we don't want to go out for "frou-frou" coffee or take time to make it from scratch.

column9: Not much body for a latte'
column10: I really have mixed feelings about this product. The peppermint flavor is nice and does not overwhelm the mocha latte' flavor. However, the mix is very watery as directed and there is no latte' flavor. In order to get any latte' flavor at all you have to use two or three times the recommended amount.It seems with as many latte' brands out there Maxwell House would have come out with something a little better tasting.

The Peppermint Mocha Latte is mediocre when it comes to coffee flavor.  It takes more like a cocoa mix because it lacks a certain edge I expect from coffee, even if it is a latte.  I put 4 heaping teaspoons in an 8 oz. mug and it's still bland.  It's not a diet product so I expected a richness but it's pretty flat.  The fat, calorie, and sugar content is not bad, at least. For 1 1/3 tbs. you get 70 calories, 2% fat, and 7 g. sugar.  It's a nice thing to have on hand for the holidays but if you are looking for flavor, you are probably better off brewing your own coffee and dropping a Starlight mint in your cup and a squeeze from the good old Hershey syrup bottle.

This product is just slightly beyone acceptable.  There actually is a hint of peppermint in it but what else?  The main ingredient is sugar.  Just reading the label made me feel as if I was participating in a science experiment.  It also left a chemical aftertaste.  I would not recommend this product.

I had just left a review for the Maxwell House International Coffee Pumpkin Spice Latte, 9-Ounce Cans (Pack of 6) saying that I wasn't a fan, but for Peppermint Mocha - 5 Stars all the way.  I am a big fan of the Christmas / holiday seasonal flavors (Gingerbread, Peppermint Mocha, etc.) and couldn't pass up trying this.  I can say that even though this is not as good as Starbucks, I was still satisfied with the balance of flavor and low cost.  The peppermint is a little strong, but not enough to over power the chocolate.  The balance is so good, that the more you use the richer the taste - the peppermint never got overwhelming for me.  I couldn't recommend the the pumpkin spice, but I will recommend this.  If you are a huge fan of this holiday flavor, but get tired of paying 5 dollars a cup from chain stores, then give this a try.  Not quite as good, but definitely very worthy at this price.  And when those high dollar bistros discontinue the peppermint mocha, then you can still have a stock pile sitting in the pantry.  I will definitely be buying more while it's still available!

Not too sweet, not too strong, just the right mix.  A fantastic treat anytime, I hope it's available all winter.  I don't think it's really a latte more of a fancy/flavored coffee. Lattes are usually stronger. Two teaspoons seem to work in a normal coffee mug and it adds up to about 80-100 calories, which you figure is the same as a glass of reduced fat milk.

column9: Tastes good, a nice holiday treat
column10: Normally I'm not a fan of instant coffee, but decided to give this a try.  Following directions, it makes a nice, frothy cup of latte.  It's not too sweet, which I like, and has a nice peppermint aftertaste.  Good beverage on those cold fall/winter mornings!

column9: yum ... a nice treat for the holidays
column10: I LOVE coffee but it needs to be strong with flavor so I decided to be a rebel and use this product in a different sort of way. I put 1 heaping TBS of Peppermint Mocha in a coffee cup and brewed 2 shots of espresso right into it, then added warm milk and topped it with whipped cream. The flavor came through in just the right amount.. only downside is the additional 150 calories so this will be a seasonal treat only.

A fine instant coffee of just the type that should please almost anyone -- who, note carefully, knows what they're getting into.If you wouldn't enjoy this type of instant mix from a can, then this won't be for you.But honestly, it's delicious.  It has just the mild, sweet sort of flavor I'd imagine pleasing almost anyone.  It's exactly the type of mild, comforting beverage I could see one person or a few people enjoying while a family or a group hung out together for the holidays.  It would be just the sort of pleasant taste to have in a cup at your side.The mocha's not strong, the peppermint's not strong, but both are pronounced and noticeable flavors.  I mix mine with heated milk; it's the perfect "creamy" complement to the coffee mix itself.  One time I added some honey; it didn't over-sweeten it, although some might think so.  You could add spices: cloves, cinnamon, just about anything.  Or drink it on its own.The only "full disclosure" I'd make in committing myself to this review is that I've always loved these types of instant mixes out of a can.  You're reading someone, right now, who enjoys instant mashed potatoes and whatnot; artificial flavorings don't bother me.  And in the instant case, I fully appreciate that the coffee powder has been mixed to perfection; that you can drink it mixed into either water or milk; that the taste isn't too strong.  The flavors are quite smooth.So what can I say?, but ... recommended!

column4: K. Peterson "Never too old to learn"
column9: Not as strong as I would like, but great as an addition to coffee.
column10: As some others have commented, if you make coffee with this product using the amount advised (4 tsps. per 6-8 ounce cup) it makes a very weak coffee.  I think I would sooner mix that amount of the mix in a cup of freshly made coffee.  Adding more of the mix would make this a very expensive route to one's morning cuppa!I mixed this coffee up for 4 friends (two teenage boys, 1 teenage girl and 1 mom, like myself) and me.  We started with the prescribed 4 teaspoons.  Everyone tasted and said, "Too weak."  The boys took theirs and did not add any more mix (ran off downstairs), the girl added quite a bit (although I lost track of exactly how much).  The mom/friend did not add any more mix, but then she said that mint wasn't her favorite flavoring, so it didn't appeal to her anyway.  I added more mix, although maybe not quite as much as the teenage girl.  Amongst the 5 of us drinking coffee, we used about half of the container (which, using the 4 teaspoon amount, makes 17 cups).  So, obviously, if you use more than the 4 teaspoons suggested on the package, one of these packages would make probably 10 or so servings at the most.Although, this doesn't sound very practical, this IS a convenience food.  It is easier than using a coffee maker when you are on the sledding slope!I liked someone's suggestion of using this as a Christmas gift with a mug (and spoon?).  And although I have not tried this, using it to flavor baked goods, like mint brownies or cookies also sounds like an interesting thing to try.

I have often got a peppermint mocha from a coffee house of something as a pre-Christmas treat. When I first opened this and made me a cup I was so happy. All it was really missing was the whipped cream and the mint chocolate sauce dribbled over the top. If you love peppermint mocha then this is the product for you and you can play with the strength to suit your taste. I have made it with just three heaped teaspoons and then added a dash of milk and it was great for me. This is a indulgence I will have again.

I have tried this a couple of times now since I have enough to enjoy over and over, but I have to say overall it is just okay for me. The coffee flavor is not present and the peppermint is very weak in taste. I used the exact amount of water and scoops of coffee, and it is very weak. I had to add extra coffee for flavor and still not great. For those who like a weak coffee drink and a hint of flavor they may enjoy this, but I felt it was average at best. I will admit I like overly strong coffee usually, so it may just be my own taste that is interfering in liking this coffee. I would have enjoyed it more if it had more of a peppermint taste as well.

Totally yummy pepperminty flavor!  I have been a fan of these kinds of coffee for some time now, and it was nice to try some new flavors.  The only "complaint" that I have is that the packaging is harder to repurpose.  I used to be able to use the metal ones for change holders, marble holders, ect...and the plastic doesn't hold up to that. But, the coffee itself is wonderful, and a total "do again"!

I love mint-anything -- and I definitely love mint and chocolate together. So I was really looking forward to trying this one, having also enjoyed various varieties of similar coffee mixes over the years.The powder even smells like mint! As you pour in the water, the consistency and appearance is more like hot chocolate than latte, and the level of foam is definitely more akin to hot cocoa. As far as the taste, the mint flavor comes through nice and strongly -- yes!!! Love that. (By contrast, recently I purchased a peppermint holiday liquid creamer for coffee, and the mint taste is so subtle I feel I have to add half the bottle -- not a good thing.) And actually, because the chocolate taste here is fairly robust, this drink really does remind me more of mint-laced hot cocoa. Not a bad thing for me, but if you're expecting more of a latte feel here, as advertised ...At any rate, because it's mint and because it's chocolate and because it's tasty, I give it a high mark.

column9: As directed is never strong enough> Still tastes good with tweaking.
column10: I've always liked International coffee products but tend to use a lot of the product to make the taste of the drink stronger.I used this in my regular coffee in place of sweetener. I got instant flavor and it was delicious.I also tried the Peppermint Mocha in my morning chocolate nutrition shakes. It gave it an extra kick.When I used it with water, I had to triple the amount I used.  I think it would be best with warm almond milk...that way it would taste more like a latte.This is a great occasional treat. This flavor is especially good right now that the weather is transitioning from fall to winter.Also, the new containers are no longer metal. Which is nice. That was always nasty when I would put up a tin and bring it back down later to use and find the metal was icky,I would buy this on occasion.  I'm not a big fan of everything on the nutritional label but in moderation and on occasion, it would be fine.

column9: coffee, hot chocolate or flavored water?
column10: I'm not sure exactly what this drink is supposed to be so I probably wouldn't tell my friends about it. It is made by Maxwell House and says that it is a cafe style beverage mix. What kind of drink, i'm not sure.When made like the instructions say...4 teaspoons per cup of water, the drink is little more than colored water with a whiff of peppermint. I did a bit of experimenting and added twice that much into a cup of water. Still not enough flavor for me but it was hot and got me a little warmer.Another thing that is interesting about this drink mix is that it does have coffee in it. About 16 down on the ingredients list so I'm thinking they just passed a bean over this container. I went a bit further and added some already made coffee and a little more powder to my concoction and it was quite good.This drink smacks of chocolate drink mix.  Looks almost exactly like nestle quik only a little finer.  Being 7.1 ounces, it doesn't take long for this powder to be gone.The nutrition facts are a little strange in that the serving size is 1 1/3 tablespoons per 8 ounce cup which is what they consider a serving. With that, there are 17 serving in this little box and 50 calories, 1.5 grams of fat, 40 mg. of sodium , 7 sugars and 9 carbs. The first three ingredients are some sort of sugars.Would I get this again?  No! It is good but only the way I make it.

This really does smell like the Starbucks Peppermint Mocha, although the mocha flavor is not quite as strong here.  I tried it both with water, and with milk, and liked it both ways, but found that the chocolate taste was stronger for some reason when made with milk.  The peppermint flavor is overall stronger than the chocolate flavor, so that might be an issue for those who prefer their mocha with just a hint of mint.  I loved the flavor of it and found it leaves you with a refreshing aftertaste, sort of like you've just eaten a peppermint patty or a Thin Mint cookie.  It makes a nice foam on top so it feels like an authentic coffeehouse drink-- it foams even more (and tastes a lot richer) when made with milk.  A perfect treat for chilly winter days.

I was so looking forward to receiving the sample of Maxwell House International Coffee Peppermint Mocha.  Sadly, I was not all that impressed with it.  It has a very strong peppermint flavor with very little mocha or coffee flavor at all.  If you are a fan of peppermint this product will be right up your alley.  For my taste I more than likely will use the remaining product as an added flavor boost to my regular coffee when I am in the mood for peppermint.  Or I suppose you could add coffee to a cup of the Maxwell House International Peppermint Mocha, it would also be nice to add a spoonful to a cup of hot chocolate.  As a stand along coffee drink I do not like it.

This is a tasty little instant coffee. You can smell the light and refreshing mint as soon as you start stirring it up. The chocolate flavor is delicious and the mint is very uplifting. I felt like I was experiencing a little bit of aromatherapy! It's almost a slight menthol sort of fresh, clean, peppermint scent and flavor.While regular hot chocolate is cozy and warm, this has a bit more caffeine from the coffee and with the energizing peppermint added to it, it makes for a really nice afternoon pick-me-up.And compared to getting coffee out at big name coffee shops (as much as I enjoy that coffee too), this is very economical. Gotta love an affordable indulgence! Thank you, Maxwell House!yum! :)

This Peppermint Mocha is so delicious!  Mint mixed with chocolate is one of my top favorite combinations.  I agree with other reviewers that this doesn't really taste like coffee - in fact, it doesn't have any coffee flavor that I can tell at all.  I don't mind, because it tastes like minty hot cocoa!  It can be hard to find really good mint flavor in cocoas, and this one is just right!I only was able to make 10 cups from one canister, while the product information says there are 17 servings per canister.  I used 3 spoonfuls instead of the recommended 4, the flavor was strong and I still had some mix leftover in the bottom of my cup.  It always bothers me when directions say "Measure 4 teaspoons into a cup..." as I am never totally sure if they mean a literal measuring teaspoon (who has one of those hanging around their office breakroom, anyway?) or a regular eating spoon (which my mother always called "a teaspoon").  I think this accounts for the discrepency of servings per can that I experienced.Overall, I would love to have this to drink all year round for a special treat!

column9: not too sweet and just the right mint....
column10: I love these coffees for camping, or in the winter time.  I've tried most of the flavors and chose this one because the hubby is a pepermint/chocolate fan.  A couple things I noticed with this coffee, it is a bit foamy on the top, which I like and the taste is not as sweet as some of the other flavors.  I liked the fact you didn't get a slam of sweet, it was just perfectly sweetened with a nice taste of peppermint without being over-powering.  This would be lovely at breakfast or on a cool evening, souped up with a little extra libation for an adult kick.  I would purchase this item and would recommend it for a chilly evening....delicious!~

column9: Light on the latte but still an enjoyable treat
column10: I rarely buy lattes at any of the major coffee chains but frequently turn to instant mixes for an occasional change of pace. I've tried a variety of brands and flavors. However, this is my first experience with Maxwell House. Overall it was a very good one.I am a fan of peppermint and chocolate, seperately and or combined. That is why, despite the fact that this mix doesn't really have a strong coffee taste, I'm giving it a five star rating. I found it to be light on latte taste but, nevertheless, it was an enjoyable treat.The label recommends 4 teaspoons for a six to eight ounce cup. All of the instant products that I've used tend to be a little watery without adding more mix. When I made my first cup with 4 heaping teaspoons and it tasted better than I'd expected. Some might prefer 5 teaspoons. You have the option to adjust it according to preference. I've stuck with the 4 heaping teaspoons and enjoyed a cup every evening since it arrived.With 7 grams of sugar and 50 calories, per serving, Maxwell House Peppermint Mocha latte is one of our new favorite evening beverages.

The powder does taste very very good when mixed with milk. I really like the combination of peppermint and mocha. It tastes much better than Starbuck. However, it is a little too sweet for me. Maybe because I don't consume much sugar in my daily diet, so I'm not a fan of sweet food. But I think if you drink coffee regularly, you won't find any issue with the taste. Last thought, Starbuck and Mc Donald already made a lot of money, so spend yours on something more affordable (this maxwell coffee) plus, you don't even have to drive to get your coffee.

column4: Desired FX "Call me Don. It's shorter than Is...
column9: Very pleasant but takes some experimentation to find your preferred strength.
column10: When I first prepared a mug of Maxwell House International Coffee Peppermint Mocha Latte, I guessed at what would be the right amount of product to mix with the water. I got a strong peppermint taste with overtones of chocolate and almost no coffee flavor, and the hot water at the heart of it was very obvious. I had clearly used an inadequate amount of the product.I didn't want to swing too far the other way with the next mug, so I boosted it by a teaspoon, and ended up with much better results. I'll probably try one teaspoon more, but I'm worried the peppermint will overwhelm the flavor at that point. We'll see.I'm not a big fan of the package or the serving technique: it comes in a plastic container with a plastic/foil seal on top that is virtually impossible to tear without removing it, so you don't have the option to partially open the container--making it easier not to spill and to control your portions--unless you use a knife or scissors to cut the foil. I would probably mind that less if not for the 3"x2" opening at the top of the cotnainer that makes it very easy to spill. In fact, in peeling off the foil, the container "breathed" a cloud of product into the air and onto the tabletop.In the long run, this is a pretty decent product, but it doesn't hold a candle to the better instant hot cocoas and doesn't really have enough coffee flavor to compete with a true Mocha Latte from a local shop. Of course, it also doesn't come with the coffee shop's price tag...

column9: kinda bland, was hoping for more flavor
column10: I made the peppermint mocha latte as directed but found it to be a bit bland, so I added another 1/2 tsp of the powder. I then added a packet of Splenda and it definitely tasted better, but the peppermint and mocha flavors are both really muted. My teenager agreed and added a mini candy cane to his to boost the peppermint flavor! I am surprised by the reviews where people say the peppermint flavor is too strong...I could hardly taste it. Peppermint + chocolate is one of my all-time flavor combinations, so I'm disappointed that this didn't do it justice.

column9: Very tasty. Ok to have before bedtime.
column10: This product tastes good. It has a very nice balance between the flavors but it does taste more of mocha than coffee for sure. The peppermint is very nice.I think what I like best is that despite the instant coffee ingredient the caffiene is so low that you can drink this before bed without getting a buzz or hyped up at all.

This blend really has too much peppermint taste to it. So much so that it became overpowering and took away from the overall taste. If you are someone who would like a lot of peppermint taste, then this one would be for you.

column9: Relaxing, tasty, and definately for Christmas
column10: I like the fact that although there is the suggested amount for 6 to 8 oz of water, you can add as much as you want. It can be as weak or strong as you want. I like it a bit stronger, so I added an extra teaspoon or two and added it warm milk instead of water and it worked well. The flavor of peppermint is not very strong. I think it is just right, not over powering. It definitely ideal for the Christmas, especially since I live in Upstate New York and at Christmas, we will most likely have snow on the ground and it will be cold. It will be nice to have something nice to drink, since I am not a big coffee drinker, I am the type of person that likes something a bit more fancy.

I saved this for my night off, to savor in front of a movie on a chill evening. It did not disappoint. A nice balance of mint and mocha makes this a great alternative when you don't want to fuss, but want a little coffee or cocoa.There have been flavors in the Maxwell House specialty line I was more fond of than others, but the Peppermint Mocha Latte will surely be one of those highly favored. Very nice.

This isn't strictly a latte, but it's not too bad.Anyone who likes the flavor of peppermint will enjoy this selection.Make a great stocking stuffer for Christmas.Nice little treat on a cold winter evening.thanks Maxwell House for a good product.

i have never tried this product before. i first made it with milk and it wascomforting. now,i add it to my morning coffee and it makes it taste very nice. nottoo harsh of a flavor or smell. It's there but it is smooth. I'm eager to try the other flavors

A great tasting foam-topped latte that is very easy to prepare by just adding water to a few teaspoons of mix.  With the new lock-in fresh pack, it stays fresh longer and keeps the great taste.  The flavor isn't over powerful, just the right amount.  However, if you want a stronger taste, add more mix.  You can also use milk for a creamier latte, which I prefer. Great product!

I love this flavor! It's delicious!Just the right amount of peppermint to compliment the mocha, so it's not overbearing like some other flavored coffees.  I am a big latte drinker, and many added flavors are too sweet. It has a taste similar to pepermint chocolate bark.This will definately be in my household for the holiday season. I will be using it with the hot water from my Keurig, as I do with the regular Suisse Mocha flavor!!

Maxwell House International Coffee Peppermint Mocha is a delicious winter morning (or anytime) treat. Even if you don't care for coffee, you'll love this. It tastes more like hot chocolate (with a hint of mint) than a coffee. Very easy to prepare and even easier to enjoy. I will be picking up more of this for the winter. It's a seasonal flavor so get it while you can, you'll be glad you did!!!

This mixes three of my favorite flavors in one decadent, yummy drink that would be perfect for a cold winter's night.  I was a bit leery at first, hoping the peppermint wouldn't over power the other tastes, but it doesn't.  The only problem I found with this product is the price, but it is nice to splurge and treat yourself every once in a while.

Let me start off by saying that I didn't mix this according to the directions. I made it the way I make the other flavors; according to my taste. I feel that's the best way to test it.This flavor was well done. At first you taste the mocha, then you get the peppermint taste. The drink had just the right amount of both, and the smell was warm and inviting. I would definately buy this.P.S. I added some evaporated milk to mine. This makes it taste richer without interfering with the taste of the coffee.

I am not usually a coffee drinker, or an instant drink person at all. So, I originally bought this for my coffee loving wife and mother. Today, however, I was barely keeping my eyes open while I was home with the baby. I decided to give this a try. And, it was wonderful.It was not Starbucks good, but it was better than most coffees or hot chocolates. And the next time I really need a cup of coffee, I will grab some more of this peppermint mocha again!

The newly repackaged General Foods International Coffees (now by Maxwell House) are always good for a treat. This one tastes like peppermint with a hint of chocolate (and plenty of caffeine). Good value for the price...but slightly deceptive nutrition info:50 calories a serving sounds great! But a serving is 1 1/3 tsp. And to make a serving according to the directions, it takes 4 tsp...so in reality an actual serving is 150 calories...but with treats who is counting.I will come clean and say that I usually use this as creamer in my regular coffee...extra caffeine bang and a fainter peppermint flavour.
"CHRISTmas in a cup" is the words I found when drinking this!  I used milk in place of water to make a creamy cup of mocha.  Not too minty and so easy to make!

I LOVE flavored coffee! The one thing I love more than flavored coffee is seasonally flavored coffee. When I saw that Maxwell House was coming out with a peppermint mocha for this winter, I knew that I had to try it. I usually don't like instant coffee and for that reason I don't typically buy Maxwell House. However, if this is anything like their other products...Maxwell House, you have a new convert! The flavor is fantastic, it is easier to make than hot chocolate, and it perks me up in the morning.The only issue that I think some drinkers may have with this product is that the peppermint is very pronounced. I absolutely love mint so this was just another plus for me. However, if you're looking for a more mocha flavor with a hint of mint...this may not be your cup of coffee. Being that it comes in packs of four, you may want to taste someone else's before you commit. But for me, this is four stars!

column9: Chocolate + Peppermint A No Miss Drink
column10: I have several favorite flavors of Maxwell House International Coffee.  One is Suisse Mocha so when I saw Peppermint Mocha I had to give it a try.  With the first swallow I got the familiar mocha taste followed by a strong peppermint aftertaste.  Since I like both mocha and peppermint I liked the combination and the balance of the two flavors.  If I had to choose between Suisse Mocha and Peppermint Mocha I would choose the Peppermint.  If you are a fan of Maxwell House International Coffee give this one a try.  If you have never tried any of the flavors this would be a good one to start on.

Maxwell House International Latte in Peppermint Mocha flavor adds the perfect touch to the holiday season! Quick and easy to make, just add hot water and stir. The wonderful aroma will grab your attention immediately - as well as those around you - and set a mellow and relaxing mood! A nice, creamy froth tops the mug as you stir. The peppermint flavor is very good. The mocha is OK and the coffee could be a little stronger, in my opinion. Over all, it's a fine cup of latte made for an autumn evening (or morning!), a simple pleasure at a great price. If you are a fan of peppermint and coffee, I highly recommend that you give this a try.

My husband really enjoys latte, and the taste of peppermint, and was interested in trying this. Unfortunately, it didn't suit him. He knew it was instant, but it tasted it, and that turned him off. He'll keep trying to find something else to suit his tastes.

There is no question that Maxwell House has really made some excellent flavors of coffee. But when General Foods International Coffee's changed it name to Maxwell House International Coffee, many had honestly wondered if they would absolutely change their taste. But, they have good taste. Their Peppermint Mocha Latte really tastes good. You really taste the hint of peppermint strongly in each and every sip from the cup. I absolutely liked it. Yet, I did honestly hope that I could've tasted a bit more of the mocha in the drinx mix. Still, you do get your money's worth with this great tasting beverage mix. Even though this is for a limited time, it is definitely worth it.Price: BTaste: B+Overall: B 1/2+

First of all, I believe taste in coffee is very individual, just like taste in chocolate.  Some prefer milk, some prefer dark.  When it comes to coffee, I prefer a good French roast.  I didn't have high hopes for a flavored instant coffee drink, and the best I can say about Maxwell House International Latte in Peppermint Mocha flavor is that it's drinkable.  In my opinion, it is too light on coffee flavor and much too heavy on the peppermint.  It's actually more like a hot chocolate drink than a latte.  There's a decent amount of foam after mixing in the hot water.  I added a bit of milk but did not need sugar as this was plenty sweet for me.  I'll keep it around to offer guests who might like this sort of thing, but it doesn't at all compare to a real latte.

column9: Nice for a Quick Hot Drink
column10: For my taste I could do with a little more coffee flavor and a little less peppermint in this mix. The first day I thought I didn't get enough mix in the water (when I got to work it was like drinking peppermint water.) But the 2nd day, with even more mix in the water, I realized that it is the flavor of this particular mix. While the 2nd day's attempt was much better, I still say it needs more coffee flavor to it. Still, for a quick hot drink on the go, this is not bad at all. I would buy it again.

COST: At the time of this writing this runs about $0.44 per 8oz cup. Not bad for a flavored, hot drink especially when paying nearly $2 for a plain, no flavored black house coffee at StarbucksINGREDIENTS: Sugar; Nondairy Creamer (one of the worst things to put in your body), Maltodextrin, Cocoa, Instant Coffee, Artificial Flavor, Sodium Citrate, Modified Cornstarch, Silicon DioxideALLERGY WARNING: Contains MilkPREPARATION: Add 4 teaspoons to 6oz-8oz boiling water or hot milkTASTE: Uh, no. It doesn't taste like a latte to me. Rather tastes like a peppermint flavored hot chocolate.The peppermint is nice and strong.
