I wasn't able to taste the coffee which, I guess, really isn't the point of an item like this.For a large mug you'll want to use a couple of heaping spoonfuls of powder and adjust to your taste.  It's fun and it tastes just like how you would expect a chocolate and peppermint flavored instant coffee beverage to taste.For a warm and sweet treat, this instant beverage does not disappoint.

column9: Need to add more tablespoons to get the flavor.
column10: I have to echo the sentiments of others on here, the recommended amount is not nearly enough.  You have to add 3-4 tablespoons to really get any flavor.  The first ingredient is sugar, this is a lot of calories for little taste of peppermint and none of mocha.  Also, there's very little coffee umpf if that's what you're looking for.  It would make a nice office party gift tie with some cellophane and ribbon, the price is right.  However, if you really want a good cup of joe, you're going to have to stick with Starbucks Peppermint or get the International Delights creamer.

One of their best coffees.  You can make it with one teaspoon, and it has a coffee-like texture. Thickness?  I don't know the term as it applies to liquids.  Viscosity just sounds like a icky term with which to describe coffee. If you use four, it's more of a nicely frothed latte.  If you use 2, and then add some marshmellows, it does a mighty fine impersonation of a mint hot chocolate, so nice for a winter's day.  This is going to be routinely stocked in my pantry.

column9: It's alright, but not quite what I wanted...
column10: I was kind of excited for this Peppermint Mocha MH International Coffee flavor since I'm a pretty big fan of the similarly flavored Starbucks holiday coffee flavor. I tend to use the MHI Coffee powders as flavor enhancers in my daily brew, but for once I wasn't crazy about the flavor. Actually, the first thing I really didn't care for was the "self-foaming" aspect to this one, almost as if it has some tiny peppermint-flavored pop rocks in it or something. Not needed and kind of weird to me. Overall the taste is alright, though I feel it needs to be paired with a regular cup of coffee for optimal taste. Just by itself with hot water it's kind of flat.

column4: Baivab Mitra "Save a tree, one at a time"
column10: We love the flavor with a tinch of peppermint is very refreshing. It have the right amount, the flavor of the entire drink is rich and very satisfying, although I had to add some sugar, but I want everything sweet. I made for my son one, he wanted it cold, and he loves it. I think it tastes better hot and is perfect for the upcoming nights of sitting around the thanksgiving and Christmas tree with friends and family and sharing this drink.

I'm not a fan of Maxwell House coffee.  I'm not crazy about instant "international" powdered coffees.  However I was caught off guard in sampling Maxwell House International Coffee Peppermint Mocha Latte.  It did not have too much peppermint or too much mocha - it was just right.  That said I still prefer to dilute this with some fresh brewed coffee.  I will look to get some more when this is gone.

I was excited to try this product due to my love of peppermint mocha.  I found the taste watery when mixed with 6 ounces of boiling water.  Flavor may be better with hot milk. Peppermint and Mocha flavors need to be richer in flavor.

When McDonald's launched their new Peppermint Hot Chocolate and Peppermint Mocha, I knew that I was doomed! I am addicted to peppermint in any and all forms, so a daily drive-through before work, netted me a comforting and tasty hot drink on the way to work. However, at $3.07 per day, with a weekly total of $15.35 going out of my wallet, it soon became apparent that this "treat" was more of a "trick", with a monthly total of $61.40!!!! That's a lot of groceries or gas money for one small mocha!So, when Vine offered a trial of the Maxwell House International Peppermint Mocha Latte, I jumped at the chance to save a hefty portion of that $61.40 and put it to better use!Now, I don't know how other peppermint-lovers feel about mint-flavoured products but there are times that the mint extract is SO pronounced, you don't know if you're eating/drinking toothpaste or a mint-flavoured item!!!! So, my expectations were not high. Surprise! Surprise! Surprise! The mint ratio on this product is bang-on: not too minty, not artificial tasting in the least...a perfect balance of mint and mocha! This is a 10 star product, in my opinion. I pour myself a small amount of coffee into my travel mug, add a regular plastic spoon's worth of sugar and an equal amount of the Maxwell House International Peppermint Mocha Latte to the coffee, give it a quick stir, top it off with coffee and then my normal amount of Half & Half. I would NEVER be able to tell the difference between my homemade brew and McDonald's beverage in a side-by-side taste test.Now, instead of raising McDonald's Profit Margin, I'm raising my OWN by making an equally tasty coffee drink and banking the rest of the money saved. I highly, highly recommend this product for excellent taste, quick ability to dissolve and saving me a substantial amount of money in the deal!Thanks, Maxwell House, and Thanks, amazon, for making this and selling this great new flavour addition to my morning coffee routine. :)

column9: Wonderful in Coffee or Hot Chocolate
column10: I've tried other Maxwell House International Coffee flavors before so I had a pretty good idea that this would be good.  When you open it up the powder looks pretty much just like hot chocolate and I couldn't even smell the peppermint.  So the first thing I tried it in was coffee.  I added two teaspoons to my regular cup of coffee and it was delicious.  The peppermint flavor came through well and the latte part was maybe too much but I'd already added creamer to my coffee so it's probably a suit to taste issue.  I also tried adding it to my regular hot chocolate and that was really good too.  Drinking it with hot chocolate allowed me to taste the mocha flavor along with the peppermint.  I have not tried it as a standalone product.I'd recommend this to anyone that likes peppermint.

I've found that most pre-sweetened coffee drinks taste almost the same: too sweet and have an artificial flavor. This one is actually quite good. It's sweet, but not too sweet. The peppermint and mocha combinations tastes delicious. If you stir it well, there's a little foam on top that makes it pretty close to a coffee house style latte. You can also make it with milk for a richer taste. With about 17 servings per can, if you don't want to spend $4 or more for one little latte at a coffee shop, this is a great tasting alternative.

Maxwell House International Coffee Peppermint Mocha Latte is a perfect drink for the holidays! It has just the right amount of peppermint flavor, and is smooth and creamy. And it's so quick and easy to make! Just scoop some into a cup, add hot water, stir and enjoy. This is great to keep on hand for unexpected guests or just for a special treat for yourself. This is one of my favorite flavors from the Maxwell House International Coffee product line. It would make a wonderful gift for friends and family, too!

Things have certainly changed for this brand.  First you will notice that this will not be shipped in the old school metal container; you now will get it in a plastic container much like their coffee.  The taste has also changed.  Being a person who enjoys the Peppermint Mocha Creamer I was excited to try this only to be disappointed!  I followed Maxwell Houses directions and got some clumping to go with the fizzing that creates the foam to make it a latte.  After stirring again, and again to break up the chunks, I finally go to take a sip and what do I taste is WATER!  I ended up adding two more tablespoons just to get any taste out of it, by this point almost half of the container is gone.  This is not worth the money you spend for it.

This International Coffee was a balanced blend of the taste of coffee,chocolate and peppermint.  It was smooth (no tart overpowering coffee taste) and did not leave an aftertaste as some powdered hot drinks do.  I did find that as a dedicated chocoholic that I had to put in more than the recommended amount in order to get the flavor that was satisfying to me.  When it is made with milk it becomes a rich drinking experience.  When it is made with water the flavor is much more light.  Overall I would purchase this and would recommend it to others who need their peppermint fix!

column9: Not exactly coffee but still tastes good
column10: There is almost a misnomer in the title of this product. It is not a Latte; rather, it is more of a peppermint cocoa flavored beverage. Still very good and has the hints of Christmas you would expect from something like this product. A nice clean aftertaste and refreshing for a hot beverage. Give it a try.

I am a huge fan of Peppermint- anything! This Maxwell House Peppermint Mocha Latte is extremely tasty. I make it with warmed low fat milk instead of water and I think it is really delicious that way. After you stir in the powder and let it sit, you can actually see the foam start to rise on the top of the latte! It's really neat! This drink is extremely creamy and the flavor is not too 'pepperminty'. You can add more or less powder depending on your taste or add half milk, half water for a lower calorie latte. My only comment is sometimes I wish it had a little more of a 'mocha' flavor- or even a chocolate flavor. However, this mix is perfect for latte lovers and for the upcoming Holiday Season.

column9: Flavor is excellent but you only get about 6 per canister
column10: I do love peppermint mocha.  And this definitely delivers the flavor.  Now the one thing is that each canister makes 6 8oz servings.  So for the price I find it a little expensive (cheaper than Starbucks but then the quality is also less.)Now that said here is a very important warning!!  This product foams like a latte, so you for an 8 oz drink you should use a 12 oz mug. Yes, there is that much foam.  The foam reduces drastically but you need to have a mug that will hold the initial foam.  Also, like most other similar products, the mix does not fully disolve without a lot of stirring.  But once stirred, you should only get a few nuggets of undisolved mix.For what it is, Maxwell House has made a very good product but I would not buy it at the suggested retail price.

column9: Expected a lot more from a popular coffee mfg
column10: I've had other International flavored coffee's before and have been pleased, but this one is not up to par to be included in this category. Following the directions the flavor was really weak and tasted watered down, so I added an extra scoop to the cup to get more flavor and it tasted more like hot chocolate than flavored coffee. This was a dissapointment to me and I was so looking forward to a nice holiday flavor.

column9: With a touch of my Aerolatte, this becomes cafe quality goodness
column10: I used to drink International Coffees a long time ago or should I say, my family brought them, probably to relive their memories of Jean-Luc!  I am sure I am not the first to make that joke, but hey, that commercial was a classic.  So now, I am trying International Coffees again, but this one is more seasonal and American then a trip to Paris.  It's more of a home for the holidays blend.I tried this coffee with water.  If I added what they told me to add, it seemed to weak, so I added another teaspoon or so.  I didn't find it too much to my liking.  Even when I added hot water to a cup with the powder sitting in the bottom, it wouldn't mix completely. But I then used milk and my Aerolatte To Go, Milk Frother, Black to mix up the powder.  What a difference.  Now it tastes like high quality hot chocolate you'd get at a decant cafe.  The mint taste is really nice and works well with milk.I would drink it this way all the time, as opposed to making it with water.  But I may froth the water and coffee to see if I like it better. I wish I could mix the powder up with a spoon and have it completely dissolve because part of the fun of the coffee is to see it create it's own foam on top, which is probably not in the natural order of things.  The Aerolatte blends the foam right into the cup, on that effect is gone.I give it five stars, because foamed up and completely mixed in warm milk (about 1 minute and 1/2 in the microwave, not boiling) it is fantastic.  Reminds me of my trip to the Alps and Fritz, my skiing instructor, but that is a whole other story! :)

Maxwell House International Coffee Peppermint Mocha Latte has a very nice flavor and a lovely foamy top when mixed.  It's simple and quick to make and a nice cup of coffee.  I'm more of a "little coffee with my cream and sugar" kind of person so this is the perfect type of product for me as I really didn't get much of a flavor of actual coffee.I give this item four stars as it has quite a nice flavor and makes a nice, hot, relaxing drink.

During the holiday season I drink peppermint mocha coffee from a well know coffee shop so I was thrilled to find this product available on the Vine list for review.  A lot of product is needed to create a cup of coffee (4 teaspoons) and the flavor was weak on both the mocha and the peppermint sides. No full bodied flavor here. I knew this would not taste exactly like a brew from the coffee shop but I could not have known the flavors just from taste. There was no pleasant aroma along with no full burst of peppermint mocha!

I purchased this item for a christmasgift for my husband he loves cheesecakeand he loved it. I have to say this isone of the best cheesecakes I have everhad. I would recommend this product toanyone, it is so fresh and absolutelydelicious, enjoy.
I have ordered this delicious cheesecake twice and each time it is just as good as I remembered.  I even recommend it as a gift to others. You and they won't be disappointed.
I gave this to my Brother-in-law's family for Thanksgiving and they loved. They were very happy and said that it was very good.

column9: Excellent Gift to Yourself and Others
column10: This cheesecake is the best.  I sent several orders to all my family all over the country for Thanksgiving and even ordered one for myself.  Everyone raved about it.  Good value and excellent product.  Would definitely order again.
my experience with " Omaha" it is very good, the product is excellent, good packing, fresh and delicious, I have sent to relatives in other states and were enchanted. I am very happy!

I ORDERED THIS CHEESECAKE FOR MY BROTHER FOR HIS BIRTHDAY...IT ARRIVED ON HIS BIRTHDAY AND HE REALLY ENJOYED ALL OF THE DIFFERENT FLAVORS...HE SAID IT WAS A GOOD BIRTHDAY...CHEESECAKE AND PUPPIES...HIS DOG HAD PUPS...LOL...IM GONNA SEND THIS TO HIM AGAIN AND ALSO TO MY OTHER SIBLINGS AND MYSELF AS WELL...YUM...
I purchased this to send as a gift and the recipient loved it. Taste was up to par with their palate and it was delivered in a timely manner. Will make future purchases with Omaha Steaks.

It's absolutely delicious.  This is the best cheesecake I have ever eaten.  I highly recommend it.  So, what are you waiting for?  Order it!You can thaw out the slices the way I did if you like.  At 30% power, heat 4 slices in a regular microwave for about 55 seconds.  Don't cover them while you are doing this.  Plus, there are slips of paper between each slice, so you need not cut anything or worry about adhesions.

Cheesecake arrived within a week of ordering.  Packing was amazing, ice in the pack was still frozen, and so was the cheesecake. We let it thaw to room temperature.  It is delicious, creamy, crust is perfect...but for me personally, it is super-sweet.  Typical of my taste, I just don't like super sweet anything. So, if you have a love of cheesecake that really is 'New YorK' style and really love super-sweet, then this is perfect for you.  For those of us who love creamy cheesecake with a nice crust but are more reserved on the super-sweet, think twice.

This is a resubmittal of a previous review.  Originally, when I received my cheesecake I was very disappointed with the careless way it had been packaged and delivered - and I said so in my review.  I NOW say that if anybody ever says that Omaha Steakes doesn't care about their product feedback, do NOT believe it.  After submitting my original review, I was contacted by Mr. Sendgraff of Omaha Steaks who apologized for their poor packaging and inormed me that Omaha Steaks has a 100% satisfaction guarantee on all their products and, that he was refunding my entire purchase price, including shipping.  Even after I told him we had eaten the cheesecake, and it was really quite good, he insisted that my experience had not met their 100% satisfaction guarantee standards and my refund would stand.  I say, THANK YOU, Mr. Sendgraff, you are a credit to Omaha Steaks Customer Service and have restored my confidence completely.  I'm looking forward to my next purchase of an Omaha Steaks product.

I was a little nervous about giving this as a gift imaging all the horrible things that could go wrong but I was pleasantly surprised. The package was delivered quickly everything was fresh and tasty I would definitely buy again.

column9: Very happy to be able to get this product on Amazon
column10: Used to buy this product all the time at former home, but unable to find in new state.  Now I know I can keep my supply up from this vendor.  Very pleased!

I am always looking for a good tasting low calorie drink or drink mix. I used to only drink crystal light but when I discovered the Sugar Free Hawaiian Punch mixes this is my new favorite. I enjoy all of the flavors and this berry blue is just as good as the others. I don't like plain water so I use this mixes in my water. I really like the flavor and I would consider this a good low-calorie alternative drink mix.

This tea is one of my favorites! I purchased this tea to replace a tea I received for Christmas that was seasonal and no longer available. This tea is now my favorite! It has a great mix of flavors with the Vanilla, Orange and Chocolate, yum! Comes as a loose tea, I recommend using the T-Sac Size 2 and Finum Filter Stick, super easy to spoon tea into sack, stick rests across top of mug and allows bag to hang in cup. Enjoy!
This is a delicious non-caffeinated beverage of rooibos (red) tea, chocolate, and orange.  It's sweet, but not overly so due to the tartness of the citrus. I love it.

I bought these to compare them with Marcona almonds.  I would say they are close enough that I don't feel it necessary to buy the more expensive ones instead.  I have oven roasted them with a saline solution and they were good.  I am going to try to saute them with a bit of oil to see if they would be better.  I always salt them afterward.  They are AMAZING when still warm!

I first bought this in a local Hispanic market (at $2.99) where it seemed it was the only place I could find it. I needed these 'shells' for a dessert recipe in Daisy Martinez' newest cookbook. The shells are fairly large and can be "stuffed" with any filling you find pleasing, I used a whipped cream mixture.  I made that dessert and had some shells leftover, so I pureed them and froze them to use as a 'dessert' sauce for later on.  The texture when pureed is like a thick nectar, so it makes a great alternative to using peach nectar when making the famous drink, a Bellini. With a few tbs. of guava puree at the bottom of a glass and some sparkling wine or champagne in the glass you have a simple drink.  The guava when used as a sauce, puree, or whole, has a beautiful salmon blush color, so it's a delight to the eye as well as the stomach. I mention these suggestions for use b/c it is a new food item I am just figuring out myself!

column9: Wake up call to the best Spiced Chai
column10: Absolutely the best Chai I have experienced. Full, rich flavor and decaf (important to me as I have a reaction to caffeine). Great in the morning and at night.Don't pass it up.

column9: Hill Science Diet Dry Puppy Food
column10: Have fed our Siberian Husky this food since she was old enough to eat solid food and she still eats it just fine and is in beautiful condition.

We have a 8 month old LabraDoodle and he loves this food. Prior to trying this food we tried several other brands, a few times Raja ate the food but threw up a little later. Even on the Science Diet brands we tried other variations like "Lamb Rice" formula and he did not like that at all. He would rather stay hungry than eat other food. There is something about this "original" formula.One note: make sure you keep the food in a sealed box, in cool dry place, as per instructions.
Loved loved loved this marinade!  By far the best marinade we have EVER used!  Great with steaks and chicken!  I will definately be buying this product again!

column9: Cats love this product, although very watery
column10: If you're used to purchasing cat food that comes out of the tin all in one hunk just like cranberry sauce, this product will take some getting used to. This cat food is very liquidy, and it even says on the package that you can simply pour it right out of the cup into your cat's dish. My first reaction was that this cat food must just be watered down, but after looking at the ingredients it didn't seem any more watery than other canned cat foods. And, more importantly, my cats just adored this food, much more so than any other canned cat food they've had (I like them to try different kinds).The cups or pouches of cat food have a non-metallic lid that peels back. I thought the cups were kind of small, so I would empty two cups at a time into the cat dish and the food would just disappear in no time.

I feed my three cats once or twice a day with Market Select. While the prices on here are about 4 dollars more expensive, they ACTUALLY carry it. Most of the stores around here can't keep it in stock, it is that popular. One of my acts, who was almost sickly and tiny when we got him, has now grown bigger than a small dog. And he DEMANDS his Meow Mix.
Cat loves this food.  I don't have to throw it away because she always eats it.

column9: Great Product Great price on Amazon
column10: Meow Mix wet food is great.  My cats get this as a treat once a night and they know it, so they start begging for it by 7pm or so.  There are some nice flavors, and the packaging is easier than the metal can stuff.  Also, this is not clumpy.  It looks like what gourmet cat food would look like if there was a such thing.The price on Amazon cannot be beat.  Individually these sell for 75 cents per cup.  If you buy a 12 pack in a supermarket by me it's $7.99.  It would cost $32 for 4 packages of 12 by me, but it's only $23 here on Amazon.  It's a great deal, especially with the free super saver shipping.The reason it gets only 4 stars instead of 5 is because maybe once or twice per case of 12 I find a sliver of a bone in the food.  I thoroughly look for them, just so my cats won't even have a chance to swallow them....but even if I miss it, it ends up on the plate as they know not to eat it.  I guess because it's animal food, the packaging is not as thoroughly checked...but my cats adore it, so I'm ok with checking for bones because the food makes them happy.

market selects is a pretty good brand. regular meow mix only has a little byproduct, but market selects has none, so I don't feel bad about giving it to my cats. the price is not too bad. my cats love this food - they gobble it up quickly!

column4: momC ""A SMILE and an Outstretched Hand i...
column9: Now my cat will not eat anything else
column10: Even though I made a mistake in ordering this, I ordered the kind with chunks of meat and she hardly eats any of them, but she eats the rest and will not eat anything else. Next time I will be more careful in ordering.

The two cats in this household attest that they are crazy for this stuff.  Their only complaint is that they want more of it.  As for us humans, totally convenient.  I serve it in the container it comes in, one for each cat, which keeps them busily engaged getting out every last morsel.
My cats love this cats food and clean there bowl every time and boy will they love you up!

Most of the time when I give this product to my cat she ends up vomiting it back up.  I asked my vet and she said that several of her patients have experience the same result.  I tried asking on the Internet if others had the same experience and was shocked by the number who said their cats responded the same.  I put the cat on a different product and she stopped her vomiting....  I would suggest that anyone using this product with poor results try a different cat food.  I filed a complain with the Federal Government.

column9: Your cat will love Meow Mix
column10: Meow Mix is a great product that my cat loves to eat. The portions are good sized and the packaging is easy to open.Amazon offers Meow Mix at the best price I could find any where !!

My cat finally has something she'll eat.  Usually she will just lick up the gravy and leave the bits so I wasn't hopeful when I ordered this.  I put out a dish of the chicken flavor and was amazed to see her actually eating the chunks before the gravy.  I hope the turkey and beef flavors work too.
I love the creamy flavor. Great evening treat! In fact this is my very favorite decaf coffee.. I've tried other brands but this is the best.
I really like the flavor.  Its not to light or too strong.  The only thing I wish is it was provided as a shop and save item.

I find Green Mountain, in general, to be the worst brand of K-cups.  All their coffees, but especially their flavored coffees are much to weak for me.Why not at least offer a medium or dark roast?  All their flavored coffees are available in only light roast.I must be in the minority (as usual), though, because they certainly do seem to be the best-selling brand out there.

Celestial Sweetened Lemon tea is refreshing.  It's great to have a glass of ice tea for dinner in just a matter of less than 2 minutes.There is no need to add sugar, and the tea itself is not too sweet. isn't too sweet.

I was encouraged to try this for at least two reasons: we live in an earthquake-prone area and I wanted it for our disaster supply kit. The other reason was for my convenience because we drink our fair share of coffee and cocoa (hot chocolate) and want to have a great-tasting cream available all the time. This product fits the bill on both accounts. I am also going to try the Nido full cream powder and also the Willpowder dried cream (low-carb diet). But you can't go wrong with Peak powdered milk with cream, it is delicious! ADDITIONAL REMARKS/UPDATE: I haven't yet ordered the Nido, it seems expensive. Having compared both WILLPOWDER and PEAK products, PEAK wins! Willpowder is OK but it has a strong aftertaste and consistency that got to us. Keep in mind that if you're on a low-carb diet, Willpowder is cream with zero carbs and Peak is powdered whole milk so it has carbs.

Ordered this with some trepidation, as the only other powdered whole milk we've tried was pretty bad, sort of rancid smelling, and ruined two batches of yogurt to which it had been added. (The second time I used less, but it really didn't help,) The Peak, however, is wonderful. Smells a bit like ice cream in the can, and thickens the yogurt perfectly. No off-taste. I'm a happy camper. May even try making yogurt with this milk alone.

column9: fooled me with the can size
column10: I'm sure this stuff tastes fine, based on other reviewers, but my mistake was in assuming this came in a #10 can like other powdered milk products I've purchased in the past. 400gms in the can and 17 servings per container works out to $1 US dollar for a 14oz glass of milk.Do the math!!...Crown Royal & Coke is cheaper than that for a tasty adult beverage.Couldn't believe it when the smallish package arrived for my 4 cans, and they are as big as the smallest coffee cans you see at the grocery stores. Oughta return it, but too much hassle. Live and learnI realize this is a European (Holland) company, but you'd think Amazon would show actual US measure - size of the container...and info on # of servings this item will provide.Fool me once....

I bought this instant whole milk powder specifically to replace powdered creamer.  It blends well and tastes great! I brewed my cup of coffee and sprinkled in the milk powder, stirred it with a spoon and it was good to go.  Just FYI-  the can is 14.1 oz.  Don't expect a huge can!  It's about the size of the 1 pound can of coffee in the grocery store (you receive 2 cans in your order).
This is an amazing product for hot tea.  It's nice to use something essentially natural.  I find it dissolves well in boiling water & the flavor is indescribily creamy.
I am a Backpacker and when I go on backpacking trips this is a great product for me to bring along.

A very good everyday tea for those who like strong tea, and Assam in particular, great with milk and sugar, morning and afternoon. Not overly malty or pungent, and not that distinct or subtle, though it can be brewed long and strong without going bitter. You can buy higher-grade Assams, but you'll have to spend twice or more. I've not found a better Assam this price range.

I go through a large pouch every 3-5 days and my cats love them!!! Just need to shake the bag a few times and here they come running. Yummy treats for my lil furbabies. :)I wish there were available on the 'Subscribe & Save' though (please add!).

My cat eats a 2.1 ounce bag in a couple days, and this can really add up in price.  Buying off Amazon is the best value - It comes in a box that makes storage simple; I don't have to worry about bags getting smashed.  I save about 20% buying cat treats online, and I just purchase whichever flavor is the cheapest at the time - They tend to circulate prices amongst the flavors... One goes up; another goes down.The seafood flavored Party Mix is some of her favorite.  She's a seafood fiend.  I also like that these are crunchy and seem to keep her teeth clean.  They're also lower in sugar than Temptations, if you have a diabetic or chubby kitty.  I've been buying my pet treats like this for six months, and will continue to do so at this great value.
it's really not whether i like it or not, it's about my four cats and since i buy this, literally, by the case, i'd say they LOVE IT!!!!

I like to have a few treats on hand for my 2 cats. These were a good price, and I have twice bought the multipack of Beachside Crunch, since they tend to prefer fishy flavors. I would try the other flavors if they came in a mixed multipack, in case they didn't like the other flavors. They love these (they like most 'treats' actually) and come running, as they hear the packet opening, or if I shake the bag. They are also a good way to sneakily apply their flea medicine to the back of their necks without them realizing it. They have a sixth sense about this and make themselves scarce whenever I even think about doing this. However, they also have outsmarted me when I tried to fool them into scarfing up some of their regular dry (Friskies) cat food that I spilled on the floor when filling their bowls and thought I would try and get them to eat it straight off the floor. They ignored it, so I thought I would sprinkle a few treats among it to make them think they were getting a big treat. They came running, but managed to pick out and scarf up only the treats from among the other pieces. No problem eating treats off the floor, but regular food no way!

My furbaby Missy comes sprinting in when she hears me opening the pack.I don't know what they put in em but she LOVES these.It's also cheaper to buy on Amazon than at the store as another reviewer mentioned.

column9: MY NEW CAT ABSOLUTELY LOVES BEACHSIDE CRUNCH!!!
column10: Like many of the other reviewers have said, my cat "Vie"(French for life),will come from anywhere in the house or wake up from a deep sleep for these treats. Beachside Crunch is the first flavor she has tried. I live in an old, loft, condo. One evening I shook the bag of Friskies treats and she was sailing through the air from the level above and landed on the sofa! She, apparently, had been sleeping on the ledge outside of the railing over the landing of the stairs. I am more careful now and so is she. She is only about 8 months old. I am a travel nurse and these will be perfect to take with me as she adjusts to my traveling schedule. I looked online and could not see anywhere that they are made in China. Some pets have died from treats made in China in the last few months.

The entire family of Friskies Party Mix desserts are favorites that all my cats love.  They're fattening, though, so some moderation is a good thing.  In addition, my cats do not get tired of these treats.  I use them as starters to get my more choosey critters to eat.  I don't know what's in them, but critters line up to get a bite; it wouldn't surprise me they're addictive.

All of our cats love Friskies Party Mix in all flavors.  The 6oz. pouch in a pack of 7 is a great buy.  What I don't understand is why all the other flavors are significantly more expensive than the Beachside flavor.  Anyway, the Beachside flavor is a good bulk buy since the cats love it and each gets a treat time twice a day.
cats are just so damn picky,searching for the the right food on the pet isle,well it seems beachside crunch is the winner.just shake the bag and look out.

column9: MY CAT GANG LOVES THIS STUFF !!!!
column10: They will "give me the paw" for the original flavor.  I figured they would like this one as well and hit it spot on.  The kitties love it.I do mix it with another treat to "stretch" it a bit, but they gobble it up and enjoy it as a treat never the less.  I subscribe to this so I never run out.  I highly recommend the subscription service as its cheaper than the store and free shipping.  >^..^<
We order a lot of Friskies snacks for our two cats.  This is their paws down favorite! They have been loving this stuff for years now.

column9: My cat begs for these treats!
column10: This was a better deal than I could find anywhere else. Thanks, Amazon. My cat loves them and they make a good treat.

column9: Cats love `em but price drop irks me
column10: First, I must rant about the price I paid. I subscribed to these for the additional 15% off and the day they shipped the price dropped 5 bucks. That may not sound like much but it's a 25% price drop to where the original price is even less than the subscribe price. This isn't the only item this has happened to me in the past few weeks... so end of rant.My cats love these and I have several so giving some to one is impossible because they come running when they hear the bag open. column9: Spitz are the best seeds - it's a fact.  But....
column10: I (we, I'm conveying sentiment for myself and a couple buds) have been eating sunflower seeds for many years.  Like everyone, we consumed "D*" brand (another D* slayed a giant some millenia ago..).  Anyway - we ate 'em, we loved 'em I guess.  Then, I think because we ran out and some mini-mart we found didn't have any in-stock, we tried another brand - Frito Lay as I recall. Hmmm..  These were - better.  Wow.  Fresher tasting, not so salty that your mouth and lips were pickled within the hour.  Wow.  Then we discovered "Jumbo" size, and - hey, this was kind'a cool.  More seed per shell-cracking.  Then, we discovered another brand "BIGS".  Wow, these were jumbo, and they were usually fresher, _and_ they came in different flavors, etc..  We discovered that quality/freshness varied, sometimes widely.  Probably depended on where we got them, but sometimes it was just a "bad batch".Lastly - we discovered "Spitz'".  Large, very uniform seeds (comparatively), come in variety of seasonings as well as plain/original "Salted", which are my favorite overall, though I enjoy some variety once in a while.  They use OLIVE OIL!  You can taste it.  It is heavenly (if you find a buttery-olive-oily, just slightly salty, almost popcorn but better, SF seed to be heavenly).  And yes, just satisfyingly salted, without the salt-curing of your mouth parts).  Several times I have been seed-less, and jones'ing bad, and gone to a store to find ONLY "D*" brand.  And I have learned to just walk out.  The let-down of "tiny, shriveled, often empty, often burned or actually (honest) bug-parts, and so salty it leaves your mouth numb for awhile" is enormous.  I can't even eat them anymore.  BIGS are still good usually, Frito-Lay taste great but they're still tiny-little seeds for the most part.  Spitz' -- they're consistent and tasty.BUT ----  I recently purchased two of these 5-bag packs.  Of these, two bags were actually STALE.  I am talking a just kind of unpleasant, warehouse-dust smell and taste mingled with the memory of how they're supposed to taste.  The DATES were all fine, sometime in 2012.  I don't have an explanation for it.  It's possible I guess that the bags had very small holes or something, and I might have them around to check that.  Bottom-line is that I got 8 bags of great Spitz seeds for the price (their price, which was reasonable) of 10 bags.  So, that's a bummer.  Also, when I discovered these two stale bags, I guess enough time had passed that there was no easy place to contact the seller (Amazon, usually very good at this) and convey a little disappointment.  Anyway -This is a great product.  Clearly we like them.  BUT - if you buy one of these 5-bag packages, you might find that they're not all as fresh tasting as you might like.  At least from this "provided by Amazon" seller.  I also got a 5-pack of "Seasoned" flavor, and all five were fine in our experience.  I might buy the 12-pack of 6oz bags, in hopes that they sell more of them, and hopefully they're not sitting around for any duration in someone's warehouse.

column9: The only cheese popcorn worth eatting
column10: My husband and I are popcorn junkies. But we are elitist popcorn junkies. Not just any kind will do, and to be honest, we don't eat it every day or even every week. A word of caution: using the popcorn setting on your microwave will lead to frustration, cussing, and disaster, unless you are very lucky.  Nothing smells worse than burnt popcorn. It lingers like death, but isn't nearly as pleasant. I believe the magic number on our downstairs microwave is under two minutes. The one upstairs is just over two minutes.  The trick is to listen, because when the popping noises slow down, you want to stop the cooking process, or it will burn, and it burns quickly. It also helps to have a squeaky clean microwave.  This is the best cheese popcorn on the market, and one of the only ones, sadly.  If you like cheese, this is the popcorn for you. column9: One of the best things to cook with!
column10: I absolutely love this stuff. I often eat rice and use a rice cooker/steamer and before I found ghee I was using coconut oil to make sure that my rice didn't stick to the bottom of the cooker. Coconut oil -- while extremely good for you -- didn't taste too great in my rice. I like it better in oatmeal -- it might just taste better combined with 'sweet.' Coconut oil does make an amazing butter substitute for grilled cheese, though. If you are vegan, coconut oil is also one of the few vegan choices.But if you're not a vegan, you should try cooking with ghee.Ghee by itself doesn't taste much like anything despite having a wonderful buttery scent. You need to cook with it to actually get out the flavor, and you'll definitely know that it's there once you bite into something that has been cooked with ghee. It makes everything taste better without the negative effects of butter or margarine which are commonly bought at stores.The container is made of glass with a BPA free lid. I emailed the company and they told me that it is BPA free.This lid is made of polypropylene. Polypropylene is one of the safer lids that can be offered. This is the only ghee I can find that is organic, grass-fed, and has a safe lid. Other ghee products seem to have BPA or "plastisol" food liners (plastisol contains PVC particles which is very carcinogenic and worse than BPA,) or are not 'organic grass fed.' If you're worried about lids, just try to avoid glass jars with metal lids. If it is a glass jar with a plastic lid then it is usually made of polypropylene which is much safer.There is no seal between the ghee and the lid. During hot weather the ghee will leak out of the jar. I had this happen to me because the seller shipped the ghee jar laying on its side rather than upright. I would definitely appreciate a seal. Seals also prevent any plastic leeching that might happen during hot weather shipments.

column9: For what it's worth -- more chocolate than macadamia
column10: My brother once gave me a box of chocolate-covered macadamia nuts which he picked up on a trip to Hawaii and I became an instant fan.  Two things that I love mixed together -- how great is that?  I don't really need all the sugar in chocolate, however, so when I saw this Mauna Loa (excellent macadamias) sugar-free variety, I had to try them.At 15g of sugar-alcohols in only 6 pieces, if you are sensitive to them, you might want to pass.The chocolate is quite good -- smooth, sweet and doesn't taste artificially sweetened.  And the macadamias -- well, it's hard to say.  They are either using very small macadamias or only pieces of macadamias because the pieces are small.  That means, unlike the ones I have had in the past, the chocolate coating is a much higher percentage of the whole and, in fact, there isn't much macadamia flavor there at all, just the crunch.  I struggled hard with how to rate them.  On the one hand, it is hard to find fault with something for tasting like good chocolate but, besides the fact that there should be more, the price is a lot higher than it would be for just chocolate.  I did find that if one allows the chocolate to melt in one's mouth until the nut is pretty much bare, one can enjoy both flavors but it really needs a much higher nut-to-chocolate ratio.  In the end I only dropped one star and noted the problem in the title but I came very close to dropping two stars.
