column10: I went against the poor reviews when I ordered this product for two reasons: 1)These bars have always been good when I purchased them from local grocery stores and 2)I believed Amazon would have gotten any issues resolved since the time the poor reviews were written. While I don't know what the reason for the problem is, I can indeed report on my own observation. On all of the bars, the chocolate coating looks like it disolved away, leaving behind a grainy and off putting exterior. The taste of the peanut butter bar is nothing like the bars I've purchased elsewhere...these tasted medicinal, stale, and just plain bad. Other Think Thin Bars I've purchased from Amazon are perfect but this one missed the mark by a galaxy.

Usually these bars are great... But this box was horrible. It seems that they might have melted and re hardened. The chocolate was a light brown color and flaky. The expiration date is still about 10 months out, but these were very dry. I would be hesitant to buy from this vendor again.

I love the thinkThin Creamy Peanut Butter bars - they are a tasty protein-filled, gluten-free, no sugar bar that works well to fill in for a missed meal or busy day on the go. BUT - the last 2 orders I've received from Amazon.com have been horrible - seems like the product was either past its prime and/or had melted and then re-hardened.

I absolutely love these bars BUT...the last few shipments from Amazon had very poor quality bars.  The first couple boxes I ordered were fresh and the chocolate coating was delicious.  The last couple shipments tasted awful!!! I think there may be some sort of storage or shipping problem.(Amazon did attempt to fix the problem by sending out a new box at no charge but the second box was the same as the first!)  But when delivered fresh, they are yummy!!  Creamy and chocolaty...very very tasty!!

column9: These are the best tasting protein bar!
column10: I could not believe it when i tasted a think thin bar for the first time. These are delicious, high in protein and NO sugar! They taste fantastic, although I have read a few reviews that say the amazon ones came grey and taste gross. SO if you have never tried these, maybe you should buy ONE first. (they have them at Fred Meyer). And if you do order them off amazon, they should not be grey. It should look like chocolate!

When I started eating these I did not even realized that they were sugarless and low-carb. They are so delicious. The only ones I've tried are peanut butter (I like both crunchy and smooth - don't really seem too different).I was baffled to see some 1-star reviews but when I read them I saw that everyone was saying that they LOVE these bars BUT got a terrible quality shipment from Amazon. So I should add that I only buy these in local stores - have never purchased from Amazon!
These bars are amazing.  They are low carb high protien bars that taste great.  If ever in a rush they can be a nice meal replacement.  I use them almost every morning for a quick breakfast.
These bars are great!  Lots of protein, taste good and keep you full.  Best I have found so far.
This is one of the best protein bars...easy to chew, gluten free, tastes great. I've tried 3 flavors and all were excellent.

I love these bars and eat them every morning before the gym. I ordered them on the internet to try and save some money and I either got 2 packages of old bars or they were melted previously and then got hard again. The chocolate on the outside of the bar did not taste the same nor did the peanut butter on the inside. I am still giving it 5 stars because the normal taste of these bars is excellent but I am extremely disappointed by the 2 boxes I received by mail. I learned my lesson and will continue to buy them at Wegmans where I have found they are actually the same price but they are always fresh.
I am probably the pickiest protein bar person in the world...and trying to find one gluten and sugar free....well I thought was impossible...I have these on autoship....THANK YOU THINK THIN!!!
The thinkThin Creamy Peanut Butter Protein Bar tastes like it's too good to be good for you. It's better than most other similar products that you would find at your local grocer!

Best tasting protein bars!! This flavor is the best too. It tastes more like a candy bar then a protein bar. Highly recommend! I eat one for breakfast every morning and its great dipped in coffee. = )
Creamy Peanut Butter is excellent taste it's a great filling bar as a replacement meal highly reccommended.Other flavors are available and are very good.
I thought the bars would taste better. They were good and peanut buttery taste, but felt they were a little dry. They are great protein bars and would recommend them!

column4: Angela W. Broyles "mom of 2 princesses and 1 ...
column10: I don't know if it was the bar itself or the shipping of the product because this was the first time I tried these, but these were terrible! I have tried a lot of protein bars and recently realized I have gluten sensitivities but I cannot stomach these bars!
I got this at Trader Joes. Its tastes well and has 20g of protein.The bar is think though but good enough for breakfast.

I love these best of all the thinkThin Protein Bar flavors that I've tried (Chunky Peanut Butter, White Chocolate, Tangerine Cremesicle, Chocolate Brownie Crunch, and Chocolate Espresso). I like all of them a lot, with the exception of the Chocolate Espresso, which seemed kind of dry, crumbly and not that flavorful to me. The Creamy Peanut Butter has a nice, smooth and creamy texture, and a sweet, but not too sweet, flavor. I like better than the Chunky Peanut Butter (which isn't bad) because of the smooth and creamy texture---a bit like comparing smooth and chunky peanut butter, but not exactly. Somehow it just works better in creamy form.I order these bars quite often via subscription and would say about 1 in every 5 or 6 boxes has the same issue that others have complained about with storage/overheating. It's not ideal, of course, but they are still edible and cheaper than buying as singles in a grocery store, so I continue to get them. It would be nice if Amazon could resolve the issue though.I first tried these bars as part of a low carb diet I was doing. They are SOOO much better than the Atkins Protein Bars that I found in a drugstore, which tasted so chemical and unwholesome. No comparison. They are so good, in fact, that I have to be careful not to eat too many because then, they don't really help for dieting purposes!

I find this a very convenient way to get protein when I'm out and about and unsure where I could get a healthy gluten free snack. Not the best tasting, but it's not terrible. I've tried the creamy peanut and the white chocolate chip. I would order them again because it's good to have a healthy go-to food when you have Celiac and don't want to get accidentally glutened. They keep well in the bottom of my purse.

column9: Ok if you need gluten free, otherwise I would pass
column10: I bought a couple boxes of these (Creamy Peanut Butter) when Amazon had them on their gold box deals.  I was looking for a protein bar to use after strength training workouts and thought I would give these a try after seeing some reviews.  Wow, I am surprised these get as high of reviews as they do.  Don't get me wrong, these bars have a place for those who need gluten-free or for those looking for a meal replacement and don't want to feel hungry, but if you are looking for a protein bar, there are much better choices out there that taste 20 times better.  I'm guessing there are also better tasting bars out there for meal replacement, but I haven't been in search of that so don't know.These bars are somewhat waxy on the outside (faux chocolate seems like), but I was willing to overlook this as a lot of protein bars on the market suffer from a similar fate.  It didn't help that these had overheated at some point in Amazon's hands and the outside was chalky but other than looks, this didn't matter so much.  The inside of this bar, well.....it just leaves a funky after taste (distinctly whey protein).  It wasn't different than the protein bars I had tried five years ago, but it's nowhere near some of the other protein bars on the market.  I didn't find the bar disgusting although I've seen reviews on the Internet where many people couldn't eat them.  I could eat it without thinking it was horrible, but I found at times that I just keep eating and eating and the bar never disappeared...seemed a chore to keep eating.  It is an extremely filling bar thus why I recommend possibly for meal replacement.  Since it has 230 calories, it was a little too much for me to eat as a post workout snack.  I have found that I can buy Pure Protein bars that have the same amount of protein and range from 180 to 200 calories however they are slightly smaller bars (1.76oz).  The taste of the Pure Protein peanut bars is the closest thing I've tasted to an actual candy bar without a lot of sugar (they have 2g).  I find it hard to believe people say the ThinkThin Creamy Peanut Butter bars are like a candy bar....wow, I think perhaps people need to try some other bars for comparison because you don't really know what to expect until you've tried a few others.If you need gluten-free or are looking for a meal replacement, these are ok, but I think you can do better with other products.  I'm looking forward to finishing up my last box of these so I can start eating my Pure Protein Revolution Chocolate Peanut Caramel bars and actual enjoy eating them and get less calories with the same amount of protein.

I love Think Thin bars and have ordered them many times before.  The ones I bought from Amazon were HORRIBLE!  The chocolate was literally a grey color - as if they are expired or old.  I thought the price was too good to be true and it definitely was.

column9: Chocolate showed evidence of sitting in the heat for too long
column10: I love these little bars. The creamy peanut butter is delicious! However, ordering 10 of them from Amazon.com is not going to work for me. The bars had obviously sat in the heat, the chocolate had turned white and the peanut butter filling was dried out. Very disappointing, as they were much cheaper than buying them at Trader Joe's.

My wife and I tried these and we both had the same initial though. It has a hint of a Reese's PB Cup. No, it's not as good as that but it really has a similar taste. We were pleasantly surprised by that.I thought this product had great taste and texture. It is exactly what I expected from a supplement bar. I will be buying these again.

column9: Could not taste the peanut butter at all
column10: Was rather disappointing that there was absolutely no taste of peanut butter, but for a "health" bar boosting 20g of protein the taste and texture was fairly decent compared to the other bars, soft, chewy, not overly sweet nor did it leave any after taste, and best of all it was filling.

I buy the 'Creamy Peanut' style of ThinkThin bars almost exclusively.There are a few things that attracted me to these in the first place, like 0g sugar and a good amount of the calories are protein. Vitamins to boot.But let's face it --the stuff that tastes the best is the stuff that isn't good for you. I don't want to drag other brands into my review here but many of them make me feel like I just ate a fortified cookie or a vitamin enriched candy bar -OR- some brands go the other extreme and taste chalky and dry.I've gone through quite a few nutrition bars in my day and I really feel ThinkThin (with this bar in particular) has achieved a very nice balance between healthy-tasting and good-tasting.*(Also glad there aren't any sneaky trans fats or palm kernel oils)

Ok people- NO SUGAR.... ITS GLUTEN FREE....And it has Protein!!! This bar tastes pretty good to me! I like it for those 3 simple reasons. Not a bad price where I get them, just a little higher on Amazon but worth it if you are on a diet, eating better, etc & you have Celiac Disease. Awesome! Try one.
This bar was recommended by my strength and conditioning coach.  It tastes great and ingredients are very good.

I'm not sure if I got one of the bad ones people have been talking about or not, but this bar tasted terrible. (Note: I didn't get it from Amazon, so this review has nothing to do with Amazon's distribution process, just the taste of this product.) I picked one up at the grocery store mostly because I was extremely curious how they have "milk chocolate" and "peanut butter" while also having "0g sugar." Peanuts have naturally occurring sugar in them (generally a few grams per serving), and milk chocolate usually contains large amounts of sugar as well (although it is not necessary by definition). Well, when I opened it there was a small amount of white powdery buildup on the outside of the bar, mostly on the vertical side of one end of the bar. I broke off a piece and the inside seemed a bit moist, which was reassuring. The bar is essentially a full solid (fairly thin) chocolate shell around a homogeneous filling of orange-colored peanut-smelling material. However, the bar tastes terrible. I got some cocoa flavors (_not_ chocolate) on the tongue to start, immediately followed by a very strange nutty flavor from the inside filling - I suppose it was peanuts, but wasn't clearly recognizable as such. What was recognizable, however, was the lack of sugar - it didn't taste even the slightest bit sweet. The aftertaste was extremely long (I had to get a drink to wash the taste out of my mouth after a while), and tasted bitter, sour, and a tiny bit salty. Not enjoyable at all.Again, others have been complaining that some bars taste significantly worse than others due to possible mis-handling during the shipping process, so your mileage may vary.
Not a fan of this. Tastes like a protein bar. Not tasty at all! Will most likely not buy again because there are so many protein bars out there to choose from.

column9: Can't belive these are gluetin free
column10: I have tried so many Gluetin Free products and a lot of them do not taste all that great.  These bars are awesome!  In fact, I can't keep my kids out of them and I am constantly reordering.

column9: Good for a small meal replacement
column10: These taste good, low sugar/carbs and high protein. Good for the price and with Amazon shipping you can't go wrong.

I love these bars, especially the cream pnb and the crunch pnb.  I can't eat sugar, and these contain none, so it works well for me.It is much cheaper to order through Amazon than it is to buy them in the grocery store.  They are $1.99 each there.

column9: Best high protein gluten free bar
column10: This product is the best gluten free bar I have tried..it's expensive in the grocery to to buy individually ...so even with shipping this is economical.

I've bought these bars at Whole Foods and they taste great (for protein bars).  I ordered one package from Amazon and they were dry and the chocolate was all light in certain areas.  Some of the bars were ok, but there were definitely dried out nasty ones too.  No thanks Amazon, I'll stick to buying these at places that can store them properly.

column9: old waxy chocolate & stale from amazon
column10: Yes- others have said it.  You can't buy these from Amazon.  I've gotten two shipments of 3 in which the chocolate was old and waxy.  Inedible.  Yuck!Much better if fresh from the grocery store!

I've tried about a half dozen different ThinkThin Protein Bar flavors. But, this is the only one I consistently re-order. Some of their flavors are virtually inedible, either artificial-tasting or too sweet like a candy bar. This one is just right.It makes a great on-the-go breakfast for those early mornings when I don't have a chance to eat a real breakfast. One bar in the car plus a low-fat yogurt after I get to work, and I'm set until lunch.BTW, I've never had an issue with freshness, unlike a few other unlucky reviewers. But, I do notice that Amazon now shrink wraps the boxes in a thick green plastic. Perhaps this is as a response to complaints about stale product? It's been working, in my case.

This review is for any ThinkThin Protein Bar, but particularly for my favorite flavor, Creamy Peanut Butter, which is simply the best protein bar I have yet encountered. Its taste/texture, nutritional value, the amount of protein, and the size makes it an ideal snack and protein supplement. First and foremost, it is soft and delicious like a candy bar and does not taste rubbery or artificial like some of the other bars. It contains no sugar and has fairly little unnatural ingredients. I especially like the 20g protein in its small yet sufficient size as a supplemental bar in-between meals.I have ordered this product for a long time, and the only drawback I see for ThinkThin Protein Bar-Creamy Peanut Butter is that it goes out of stock often, and as a result the price fluctuates. I hope Amazon can stock up because on top of my regular subscription, I will be asking for extra, extra shipments!In summary, I would highly recommend this bar to anyone on the go who needs some extra boost to get through the day, without the help of traditional fast/junk food.

column4: N. Solish "Without music, life would be a mis...
column10: Really a bad tasting bar.  True, it has a lot less sugar than a ProMax bar, but it really tastes awful.  You have to wash this down with a lot of water just to finish it.  I prefer Pure Protein chocolate bars to these, and I think most people would too.  Truly an awful tasting bar.

Think Thin has changed their packaging (no big deal) and unfortunately their bars (big deal). I don't believe the quality problem was due to shipping as I have ordered through Amazon before and been very pleased with the product. On this occasion, the bars were chalky and dry and maybe it's my imagination but I didn't feel they tasted like that last year (old packaging). I will not order Think Thin Creamy Peanut Butter again... but I may give Chunky Peanut Butter another shot.

I am diabetic and quite often need something to grab that is lower carb and sugar but with a good protein base.The taste is great and its very easy to pop in my bag and go on and busy day. This is the only flavor I have tried and I really like it.

First, if you live somewhere hot don't order it.  It will melt in the mailbox.  The chocolate was melted and/ or old on the outside.  The inside didn't taste good at all.  It was kind of chalky tasting.  I will not order it again.

column9: Wish I had not ignored the reviews of this product!
column10: Before purchasing these bars through Amazon, I read through nearly every review and took note of the many complaints about the weird appearance and texture.  I have always been so impressed with Amazon Grocery and the quality of all the products I receive and, despite the "bad press", I just took a chance that maybe my shipment would be different.Unfortunately, I should not have ignored the reviews! I usually purchase my bars in the grocery store and they are always moist and creamy (and delicious) but these bars are literally disgusting. They have the appearance of being melted or frozen and thawed, maybe?  There is a white film on them and the paper is actually hard to peel off.  Not only that but the corners are hard and the texture is just disturbing.  I am so glad I got these on sale and I will definitely not be purchasing these through Amazon again.  I really hope Amazon will take a look at these reviews and work to remedy the problem.  Guess it's back to the grocery store for me!  Potential purchasers of these through Amazon - take heed of the warnings from buyers!  These bars are normally delicious but Amazon managed to ruin them!

I love these bars. The nuts with white chocolate are also great; not too much white chocolate so it's perfect. The creamy peanut butter is so good. It tastes great, smooth inside, and filling.  My kids love these too!
great item. I give it to my autistic son who is gluten free. I wanted something with alot of protein. this is his favorite

These bars taste good, and they're a healthy alternative to a meal.  The peanut butter taste is very good, and the bars are chewy.  I would recommend these to anyone who wants a high protein meal replacement bar.
These were so bad, i didn't even get half-way through the bar.  I've been told perhaps it was because of a bad shipment from Amazon, but they were gritty, and had a terrible chemical aftertaste.

These can be hard to find, and taste GREAT- so good that Amazon can deliver them so I dont have to worry about finding them or running out! Packed with protein and NO SUGAR! Check out [...] for more details!

I usually love these bars and was so happy to find them on Amazon but when they arrived the chocolate on the outside was discolored and crumbly.  Maybe it was because of the warmer weather and the chocolate melted and rehardened, but I was very unhappy with the product and will never order them from Amazon marketplace again.
I really like these bars.  The only downside is that they contain Maltitol and half of the protein is Soy.  I am not a big soy fan. Peanut butter is the best.

I like that Think Thin makes many flavors for their gluten free high protein bars. This bar tastes okay. I was hoping for a peanut butter cup taste as other people had described. I didn't get that taste. The one thing I do not like is the chemical aftertaste I get. But, I know this is what all bars of this type taste like. The bars are also really sweet. It takes me about 45 minutes to finish eating one. I have to wash it down with coffee or water. But all the bars are really sweet. I wish they were more natural in ingredients.  I probably won't buy them again unless they are on sale. I will stick to more natural protein snacks (nuts, meat, etc.) even if they are not as convenient.

column9: Think Thin Creamy Peanut Butter Rocks!
column10: I was looking to increase my protein intake and came across this yummy bar. It has four times the protein of most other bars, and a good amount of calcium, iron and healthy fats!  I absolutely love this bar and would choose it any day over a Reese's Peanut Butter cup.  If you haven't tried it, you must.  You'll love it!  ~Crystal

thinkThin creamy peanut butter bars are an excellent between meal snack. They taste very good and are healthy for you. Low on the glycemic index and high on protein and organic, they make the perfect addition to any diet.

I have tried this bar before and I really liked it the first time I had it.  The chocolate coating is very thin so that could also be the reason why the peanut butter filling seems to overpower the bar. But I do like this bar for meal replacements because it provides a lot of protein per serving.

column9: Love these bars, but NOT from this seller
column10: I love love love these bars, but was VERY DISAPPOINTED when they arrived. The bars were NOT expired but had the appearance that they were. They are normally a nice smooth chocolately outside, but these looked charky and old. They did NOT taste the same at all! I ordered 2 boxes of the Creamy Peanut Butter because it is my favorite, but I will NOT order again from this seller. I asked some other people that eat these bars if that has every happened to theirs. I friend told me she had froze hers once and it looked like I described above. So I can assume they froze the bars hoping to preserve the freshness, but all it did was jepordize the great taste and appearance. My BIGGEST issue is I ordered 2 boxes about $30 and can't even return them because it is a food item. Lesson learned on my part, hope you will consider this next time you order. I also hope the seller will realize they CANNOT FREEZE this product!

I have tried different brands of protein bars since I don't eat meat, i bought 2 boxes the peanut butter and the toffee.  They both taste the same and they taste like cardboard, and there is an after taste. Their are some good bars out there but these are not.
I'm not a picky eater but these protein bars (creamy peanut butter flavor) are horrible. They smell bad too and your breath smells bad after you mangage to choke one down.

This protein bar is below average @ best. It's advertised as "creamy peanut butter", but there's nothing creamy about it...more like chalky, dense, salty, with a hint of after taste seasoning. I wasn't expecting a peanut butter cup, nor was this my first protein bar, but with all the good reviews? sometimes i think its just minions from the inside. don't be fooled i have a very broad palette and know a good product when i taste it, this isn't it. Buy 1 bar, taste it, throw it away, then thank me for not buying the entire box.

Pros: No sugar, high proteinCons: Fake sugar, gross tasteAs a kid I once accidentally ate a very dry reese's cup - instant desert in my mouth with faraway scents of peanut butter and chocolate and very real up close flavors of dust and salt. Not great, but not terrible considering the nutrition breakdown of these bars is harder to find.Overall, these are tolerable if you are desperate for a decent snack. If you are tired of thick, chewy bars, by all means try these but they are definitely not "delicious" unless you're really hungry.

I purchase this bar in spite of some of the negative reviews I've read and boy do I regret it.  It has a nasty aftertaste and a sort of wierd smell.  The first time I ate one I thought it was ok for a protein bar, but I haven't been able to eat another one. I hate wasting money so I'm trying to eat another one now, and it is taking me over 30 minutes!!  I will never buy this bar again.  It is disgusting!!  I have tried many protein bars in the past and this is by far one of the most disgusting even down to the texture.  Please don't waste your $$$ on this one.However, the mixed nut and white chocolate one is awesome!! I'm ordering more of those next week.
These tasted aweful.  you can defiantely tell that there is no sugar in these.  Left a terrible aftertaste.

We love the Think Thin creamy peanut butter, as well as the chunky peanut butter.  My issue with this particular order is that I ordered two boxes of each, but received THREE boxes of chunky, and only ONE box of creamy.

column9: so awful I have to throw the whole box away!
column10: I have never had these before but they came up as a suggestion and I thought a protein based bar would be good.  Usually I love peanut butter. THESE ARE JUST AWFUL, I can't believe how bad they taste.

column9: Not good for low carb, okay tasting
column10: I've been on a low carb diet and bought these.  I wouldn't recommend them.  They aren't bad tasting especially if your craving chocolate/peanut butter.  I get the gitters and feel awful after I eat one.  I have tried Atkin's products which also have the sugar alcohol and 3 net carbs.  I never get the gitters and it curbs my hunger.  In my opinion the Atkins taste 100 times better then the think thin bars.The Think Thin bars have 10 extra carbs then an Atkins bar.  They claim to be only 3 net carbs online but I think this is a lie.

I wanted to to like these things, I mean chocolate and peanut butter, how can you go wrong, right?  WRONG.These are way too sweet, even with no sugar added, I'm not surprised why.  I bought these too eat for breakfast, its like taking bites of a soft sugar bar.

column9: One of the worst bars I have ever tried
column10: Don't waste your money on this bar.  It has to be the worst bar I've ever tried to eat.  I had one bite.  Too bad I can't send the box back.  I even shared with a co-worker who had the same opinion and did not want more than the one bite she tried.  I was hoping they would be good.

I was considering buying these bars, and I looked at the nutrition information. It said each bar contained 23 calories. This seemed awfully low to me, so I checked the calorie content of other Think Thin bars. They were ten times that much. I think somebody left the zero off, and they're actually 230 calories.

Very satisified with this purchase. It was delivered in a timely manner and in excellent condition.Reading about the begining of the Smithfield ham products was an extra, because Virginia happens to be my hometown. So I received a history lesson as well as great reading material.

Yuck!  What a disappointment!  I ordered these because I was looking for some candy with the flavors of my childhood (Cherry, Lime, Orange, etc.,.)  I don't know what some of the flavors in this box are supposed to be, but they are *not* the Saf-T-Pops of my youth.  Even if you put that aside, the quality of these candies is poor.  The flavors are indistinct and odd, with combinations of flavorings I can only describe as "wrong, terribly, horribly, wrong".  If any one knows of a quality US, Canadian, or Western European hard candy with clean flavors which include Lime, Cherry, and Orange, please leave a comment letting me know about it, and where it might be available.  And, if you, like me, are seeking a source for same, Saf-T-Pops is not the answer.

I bought these for my 3 year old cousin about 5 months ago.  He has them all the time.  We're still on the same box but getting close to the end.  You really can't go wrong with these.One problem I had that would make me think twice about ordering this from Amazon again, though.  The shipping cost is prohibitive.  It more than doubles the price of the product.  I wish cheaper methods would be offered for this item.  If they were, this product would be 5 stars.

This is a great product for toddlers who like to eat lollipops. I don't have to worry so much that they will fall and pierce their palates. I gave this box as a gift to my son's teacher so she could hand out rewards rather than regular lollipops. I can't find them in any store!
was definitely looking forward to getting this and ended up being disappointed! i ordered this because i was trying to find the exact saf-t pops i had when i was a kid but it tasted weird.
Our toddler loves these pops as a reward for his potty training. They are safer than regular pops, but toddlers still need adult supervision while eating these.

column9: the absolute best hot sausage ever!!!
column10: I have been serving these Aidell's habanero and green chile sausages to guests over several months both, as an appetizer (cut into pieces) or whole (in hot dog buns) - without exception, every guest has raved about the taste and the texture. I get the best results if these sausages are grilled on a BBQ and not pan fried....unfortunately, the double packs that used to be carried by Costco's and Sam's Club are no longer available...would like to see them brought back SOON!!!!

At one time my local grocery store (Safeway) stocked them, and then they stopped. I went through withdrawals. I couldn't find these guys. But now, only blocks away "The Good Life Grocery" here in San Francisco has them. All the taste of a good spicy pork sausage without the heart stopping fats. I still opt for pork occasionally but with these habenero turkey sausages, I will need to much less. Thank you, thank you, thank you.

Found these at Costco.  Stupid Costco discontinues the best ever spiced-up sausage I've ever eaten, anywhere.  Turbo-charges any recipe whether used in chunks, slices, or whole on a bun.Thank you, Amazon.

This is the best honey I have ever tasted. I have tried many other types of honey, but nothing compares to "Langnese Acacia Honey." It is clear and smooth and does not leave an aftertaste. I recommend it highly.

This is a great all-purpose seasoning.  It is sodium free for those on a sodium restricted diet or even for those who are not.  You cannot even notice that there is no salt in it.I have been using Magic Seasoning Blend for years on a variety of foods and have not gotten tired of it.I recommend that you try it as well!

First off, this is not a salt substitute.  There is no burning flavor of potassium chloride here(which by the way, Doctors tell you not to consume).  This is a blend of light chiles and other spices which work best when cooked for longer intervals at slow heat.  Works fabulous on rotisserie meat and oven roasted vegetables.  I have been using this for years and my family very much enjoys the flavor. It has a southern blend of spices but not much in the way of heat.  If you need heat, add some cayenne.  If you really want to bring out the flavor put some vinegar in your dishes. Add to meats before cooking, add to vegetables and soup just before serving.

So happy to have found this product. I need to seriously eliminate salt and sodium from my diet and unlike all the other "no salt" seasonings on the market, this one adds good flavor and exceptional taste to everything WITHOUT the potassium that the others use in place of sodium.  The potassium is just as dangerous for my fragile kidney as the sodium.  Thanks Chef Prudomme!

Tried Paul Prudhome's Salt Free Magic Seasoning and it's a complete dud. Adds nothing remotely salt like to the flavor. Hard even to detect the chile pepper that is supposed to flavor it. It is as if it had been on the shelf for 10 years and the spices lost their zip, but the expiration date shows 2014 so it's fresh.Mrs. Dash is by no means great but it is far, far superiorDo not waste your money.

Tim Tams are an icon in Australia.  Great cookies (they call them biscuits) now available in the US.  Do the "Tim Tam Slam" by biting off a tiny bite on each  end, dipping one end in coffee and sucking like a straw.  The coffee is absorbed by the cookie and the taste is wonderful!

I haven't been to australia, but I have heard of this from a youtuber "itsjudytime" and she reviewed these which got me to want to try these out because she made them look that good! Luckily i read a comment that they are sold at "cost plus world market"! I remember passing by one but never really had the curiousity to go check it out until now. Found one near by, and tada...there they were! Wasn't called Tim tams but arnott's was the one i found and to my surprise...3/4 of the boxes were gone, only 3 left so that tells me..it must be delicious! They were about $3.99 at the store and lucky I found them there or else pay for big fee of shipping (but then again, i suppose these would be worth the price for how deelish they are!) so check em out at your nearest world market! I made some hot chocolate and shabam....i was in heaven. I could only eat two in one sitting but if i could..i'd eat the whole thing :) I'll forsure am going to buy some more!

column9: Tim Tams rock my face off
column10: Tim Tams are the most amazing cookie ever created. Just bite off both ends and suck a hot drink through it (like coffee or my favorite, hot chocolate). You gotta wait until it's about to fall into the drink due to over-saturation and then SLAM IT! (That means put it in your mouth and eat it.)

These cookies will surprise you, but only if you take at least 3 bites.  I shared my box with friends and family, yet each of us noticed a pattern.Bite 1 will remind you vaguely of other US cookies-candies yet you cant place the taste.  Bite 2 you'll say, "This is pretty good but not worth importing it from Australia.". By bite 3, you'll be searching for more.  Each of my friends who tried one vowed on their 3rd bite to buy them online or when the holiday season finally brings some to Target.  My coworker tried a Tim Tam slam (bite the ends then suck milk through like a straw before eating it).  She went from not impressed in bite 1 to asking me to help her order enough some from Australia.This isn't a soft or gourmet cookie.  Its similar to the simple joys of an oreo but far more addictive when you reach bite 3.  The closest comparison i can give is BERGER COOKIES from Baltimore which are simple but beyond addictive.
I had Tim Tams while traveling in Australia & New Zealand this summer.  This is the best cookie you will ever eat. I highly recommend it***

My vet of over 30 years has a mom that still works in the hospital. I adore the woman and one day she shared one of these cookies. She told me another patient's "person" brings them to her from Australia. I knew I could find and probably at a nearby deli that I use often. It has a great international selection. Since they never bothered to return a call or answer my email, I went to my old friend Amazon. Sure enough, there they were!  I bought my friend some more and also some for my Mother ( actually mother-in-law) who loves sweets. They are delicious. Worth every penny.
Tim tams are delicious , I can eat them all day I wish that Tim tams are sold everywhere in the states I know they are available in some places but they're very hard to find !
Got hooked on these in Australia. Pepperidge Farms is doing a good job making a replacement for Arnott here in the U.S., but sometimes you just yearn for the original.
These are dangerously delicious. I could eat these every day. Their crispy, sweet, chocolatey goodness is beyond compare. Thank you Australia!

Love these and am glad to be able to get them here.  If you're looking for a rich chocolate cookie, Tim Tams are it.  Not sure which American cookie to compare them to, probably a chocolate covered Oreo, but with a chocolate middle.  Lots of chocolate here.  That's actually a downside for me.  Too much chocolate.  A little goes a long way with me, so these are amazing in moderation and with a big glass of milk.

My son discovered these cookies on a trip to Australia and his suitcase on the way home contained several packages of these cookies.  We've looked for them in stores but couldn't find them.  I got him some for Christmas on Amazon.com and he was delighted.
It's official! These are my new favorite cookies! You indulge yourself with a piece of heaven every time you have a bite....So crispy, so perfect, and the smell of the chocolate is oh sooo yummy!!!!

i had these when i live in Australia for 2 years. they taste so delicious. I brought some in Australia at the wholesaler for $1.75 a pack. I ended up with a whole suit case(which is 75 packets). Within a week my family and i consumed the whole suitcase. These are the best cookies.u can also find tim tams at Asian stores.

column9: These kick Oreos in the Behind
column10: I'm not sure what "Hipcat 21" is referring to, but the Tim Tams I just ate from Australia would be pretty darn hard to suck milk through. They are a layered wafer cookie, and you'd have to have the suction of a Hoover vacuum to pull milk through those babies. But, they are amazing little pieces of heaven, even if completely worthless as a straw. They are crispy, and chocolaty, and so darned good that I would gladly give up my Double Stuff Oreos if these were widely sold in the US. Those lucky Australians!!

A month in Australia, a half-price sale at Woolies, an entire case of Tim Tams came back in our luggage.  Should have brought 2 cases back since the sale price there was less than 25% of the price in the US.  :-(  Next trip to Australia check them out in many flavors, all delicious.  Try the coffee straw technique described in other reviews.

I ordered Arnott's Tim Tam Crush Honeycomb instead I got Arnott's Tim Tam Sweet Wishes what happened? Also, I had the samething on my order form saying I oredered Crush Honeycomb not professional at all.
This is a great treat, but I tasted no difference between Tim Tam and the American version from Peppridge Farm. So I would stick with the American version to save money.

$13 dollars to ship an $8 product? They are the best I've ever had ! But it's a ridiculous price. I may buy them again, but it's a guilty pleasure and a wallet breaker for what you get.I got  $10 BONUS  credit from Amazon and decided to get another nine bars, they are so good! My boss at work get's the Pepperidge Farm versions in Canada and they are tasty, but don't compare to the variety and subtle creamy finish of the Aussie bars. I guess $13 isn't too much to ask to send something all the way from down under. I LOVE THESE BARS!

column9: Not 11 packets, but only one and it is damn good
column10: When I purchased this product I thought I was getting 11 packets since quantity said 11 and picture had 6 packets in them. The 11 is actually the number of biscuits inside the packet. So its one and not six nor 11.I informed the seller and he has promptly changed the picture, but the quantity needs to change or the term 'one pack with 11 biscuits" must be mentioned in the product description to avoid any confusion.Seller offered to give a refund but refused since I couldn't wait any longer to have them.

column9: The beverage has to be WARM
column10: Just to clear up that little misunderstanding about using TIM TAMS as a straw. The beverage (I prefer coffee) has to be warm, so the chocolate melts while sucking the liquid through. I only had TIM TAMS in Australia and from the World's Market. Never ordered them through Amazon. Just an awesome cookie! Also available in dark chocolate at the World's Market
If you have never slammed a TimTam then you have never lived. Buy these and try one!

I had Tim Tams when I went to New Zealand I ended up bringing 5 containers of them back they are really good if you bite off both ends and then use it as a straw to drink milk turning the inside into a gooey chocolaty goodness:)

column9: Tim Tams are great but you gotta wait for them.
column10: Tim Tam's are Australias beloved chocolate cookie. They are VERY good and are totally awesome used a "straw" for hot drink (just youtube tim tam straw). There is a catch with ordering them from Amazon: THEY TAKE FOREVER TO GET TO YOU. Mine probably spent 2 and a half weeks with Singapore customs. My friend who also ordered on the same day as I have experiences the same delay.  By the time i got them I had forgotten I even placed the order. Cookies were great but not really worth the wait.

column9: One of the Best Cookies I've Ever Tasted
column10: Don't be fooled. It is a biscuit...but it tastes more like a chocolate bar, and has calories to match. Yet this is probably Australia's best treat. It is very good. I was surprised. It's fun to eat and it tastes very good. The level of sweetness is just right. While I describe Tim Tam as a dense malt chocolate biscuit, with a dense chocolaty creme atop, covered in milk chocolate, I must say that it's much more than that (as far as sweets are concerned). Try it out. I'm assured that you won't be disappointed. It's also fun to bit off two end and suck in milk to make it mushy. This is definitely a classic, up there with the Oreo, or higher.
There is nothing on this earth that compares.And, yes, you MUST reserve at least one to use for a Tim Tam Slam. It's easy and yummy!Go here for a how-to video:[...]

Love Tim Tams, but as with previous buyer, I felt the quantity was extremely misleading, akin to a straight up lie.  I am pretty sure when I purchased the item, it even had an estimated price per package as ~$2 (based on the ll packages number.)  Very disappointed.  Wish I had read the other review first.

Tim Tams are fantastic, but this deal isn't honestly represented on this page. The product information says "Item Package Quantity: 11" -- turns out this means there are 11 Tim Tams in each box. I thought it meant there were 11 boxes of Tim Tams. In fact, my shipment included 6 -- making the total cost for each box significantly higher than I had expected. I called the seller and they refused to send me more.

column9: The only candy bar I eat
column10: Many years ago, when I was in college, I ate one every day. Back then, they were 1/4 pound. There was a little corner store between my classroom buildings and my dorm. Every day I got a Payday candy bar on my way back to the dorm after classes were over. To this day, Payday is the only candy bar I will ever eat. However, I live in western Canada and they are not available. When I have friends travelling to the States, I always ask them to bring back some Payday candy bars for me. I crave them.
I have tried this product, and it is the best M & M I have ever had. I can't think of a better tasting candy

I saw a package of these STRAWBERRIED PEANUT BUTTER M&M's in the check-out line of a local grocery and decided to give them a try. I love strawberries and though I enjoy the taste now and again, I'm not a huge fan of peanut butter. The taste was delicious! They are quite high in both calories and fat, but with something this scrumptious that's to be expected.  Just don't eat too many at one time. These are supposed to be a limited time candy, but I hope Mars reconsiders and adds them as a regular candy.

column9: Tastes Like Something, But Not Sweet and Sour Sauce
column10: I bought Kraft Sweet and Sour Sauce, and was completely disappointed with how it tasted.  I have never had a mouth full of toilet cleaner, but this is what I would imagine it tasting like.  Very strong chemical taste with a very gelatinous plastic-like texture, highlighted in a dull orange-brown.  I looked at the ingredients and the main ingredient is High Fructose Corn Syrup, a healthy dose of cornstarch, and some oleoresin paprika mixed in.  I found the taste to be so horrible, I threw the rest of the container away.  Yuck!
This is a product that Walmart took off their shelves. It is the best for dipping chicken strips or chicken nuggets. I am very please that I was able to purchase this through Amazon.

This dose not have the same taste that you find in restaurants,(not even close) or the little packets they send home with take out. Not sure why it is so difficult to find "real" sweet and sour sauce.
Kraft Sweet N Sour sauce is great for dipping chicken, shrimp or egg rolls. A pack of 12 is a rather large quantity, but you can share it with friends and family.
very good for making sweet and sour chicken... simmmered with a little pineapple and boneless chicken and serve over pasta or rice.

column9: NOT the Sweet 'n Sour sauce they advertise...
column10: The Sweet n Sour sauce pictured is bright red and VERY similar in looks to the Sweet n Sour sauce you get from Chinese food restaurants.  I ordered a case of this stuff for $ 19 and was very disappointed in it.  The sauce I received is a brownish color with bits of red and green pepper in it.  It's not very sweet like you would expect (and hope) it to be.  The label on the sauce I rec'd was totally different also.  The one online is the 'New and Improved' label and the one I rec'd was not.My opinion is that if you're looking for the traditional restaurant style sweet n sour sauce then this is definitely not it.  Now I have to figure out what to do with an entire case of this cruddy stuff.  It would be one thing if the sauce was just different but I actually don't like the flavor at all.  Oh well, I'll just keep looking.  :)

Just the right blend of "Sweet" and "Sour" makes this a great dipping sauce but I also love cooking with it too. I love it in Sweet 'N' Sour chicken. Makes a great marinade for cooking chicken on the grill too. Yum! 5 stars all the way!

When Jesus saved all of the holy mesiah from drowning by making Noah build a giant boat, he must have messed up and let pistachios on the boat.  Who creates such a pecular object?  The ackward shell on the outside hiding the hidious greenish brown nut on the inside.  This is the nerd of the nut family people.  Then some of them the shell doesnt have that little helper crack to make it easy to peel.  Then you have to bite it or something and get shells in your mouth.  Its horriable that a nut could be deemed livable, we should all band together and rid the world of pistachios.  Maybe if they called it something cooler i would have different views on it.  How about calling it "The Evil Nut From Hell That's Color Is Best Described As Breen, A Mix Of Brown And Green", then i would have no problem with it.  If we all band together this fantasy could become a reality.  maybe well call it tenfhtcibdabamobag for short.Actually now that i think of it, I love pistachios and the name.  Disregard everything I had just stated and go eat some NOW.

My husband is a meat lover. I got these for him last year for Christmas and they didn't last very long.He said the spices in these sausages rivaled any sausage he's ever eaten - and while I'm not a spicy sort of gal, I have to admit the spices added some really nice flavor and packed some heat.The smells that come from frying these up are just wonderful - we still have neighbors asking "what was the name of that sausage again?"It's definitely going to be a Christmas tradition in our family to ship to the meat lovers as these make the perfect gifts.The shipping is fast and they arrive frozen and ready to heat and eat.

I've been gone back to my hometown in Calabria, Southern Italy..and I always came back with a dozen or so of Mixed wild mushrooms marinated in oil!! Yummy..yummy..yummy!!! They didnt last that long!! Finding them around here is almost impossible!! After experimenting with some dried mushrooms..and doing lots of googling..I decided to give it a try to these Roland Wild Forest Mushrooms! I liked the price and the 4 pack offer from Amazon !! And what a pleasure is to marinate these forest mushrooms..and seeing my ladyfriend's reaction when she has a taste of them!! Oh..one more thing...I just put a " subscription" order for these mushrooms !!
Ate with whole pork tenderloin in a white wine/cream sause.  Great combination.  Good gormet sub for any mushroom dish.

I was really impressed with these peppercorns and they make everything taste good. I eat alot of pasta, fish and shellfish dishes. I think it works best sprinkle on salmon, or shrimp. It gives them that extra kick without adding garlic. I highly recommend these 7 ounce pouches of black peppercorns. They are just perfect and grinds very well in my peppermill. And yes I will definitely purchase these again in the future.

We go through peppercorns.  Besides going in the grinder we morter and pestal for rubs on steaks and sauces.  We have tried the fancy Penzy peppercorns but for our taste we really can't tell much difference.  We like that these are in small bags and so can be kept fresh longer which I find does more for the taste than rarity.  You can't beat the price!

It's basic black pepper. However, for the price and the amount, it is one heck of a deal. For a couple who uses a moderate amount of black pepper, this should last us well into the second Obama administration and probably well into Hillary's first term as President, so that's a lot of pepper.

My grocery only sells them in disposable grinders, can't just get peppercorns for my own grinder anymore.This is a BIG batch, but I stuck them in the freezer to keep them fresh.  Been using them for a while, and it seems to be working out.

This is the lowest price you can pay for whole peppercorns,and they are packaged nicely so you don't have to worry about misplacing the one gigantic bag of pepper (like I did with our last one.)  Nice and strong, spicy and good flavor.
Very good quality product, multiple bags ensure freshness. Product came fast and as described.  Cheapest place for great peppercorns! I will be a repeat customer for sure!

well we ordered this thinking they were vegan but hell were not so sure b/c the ingredient listing on the actual package of caramels say dairy on it.  Yes, we read the disclaimer but seriously its frustrating to spend money and wait for something that "might" be what the ad says.  Sigh.  Should of ordered from Alison's gourmet.

The Merguez are ok, but they are not from France.  I got a clue by reading the label which states "Made in USA".  I specifically ordered them because the listing states that they are from France, and I wanted to compare the authentic French version to domestic ones.P.S. They took five weeks to arrive, so order early.

column9: Hormel Compleats Roast Beef & Mash Potatoes
column10: I think that this entree is unbeatable with respect to ease of storage, and that it competes favorably against frozen TV dinners in all other respects, as well.  I don't think that you can go wrong trying these--even if you don't consider them the best fast-food alternative you've ever eaten, you can profitably tuck them away as "emergency preparedness" essentials!

column9: One of the best items in the Hormel Compleats line.
column10: I've been working through all of the Hormel Compleats with beef of one kind or another. I work at home and really am not interested in any extensive culinary efforts for lunch. In any event, I really am not much of a gourmet either. I appreciate excellent cuisine, but for lunch I just want something tasty to eat and simple to prepare. Preparation could not be easier. Punch a couple of small holes in the cover of the container, pop it in the microwave for 90 seconds and let it stand for a minute. The worst part is opening the container. There's a plastic-like sheet acting as the cover. It is miserable to pull back. The adhesive is super-strong. The container is still hot and there is the potential that giving it a hard pull will result in contents shooting everywhere. I've taken to carving off the covers with a knife. As for the meal itself, this one is yummy. There's a relatively thick slice of tender beef, carrots, potatoes and, I think, some onion. All of this is floating in a veritable ocean of brown gravy. Well, maybe not an ocean, but there's a lot of it. This entrée would pass muster at the local diner. Great for a quick, light, tasty lunch.Jerry

THIS PRODUCT IS VERY GOOD.  IT MAKES A PERFECT LIGHT LUNCH AT HOME OR AT WORK WHEREVER THERE IS A MICROWAVE.  THIS IS NOT SALTY HAS JUST ENOUGH MEAT AND POTATOES WITH GRAVY TO MAKE YOU SATISFIED BUT NOT OVERLY FULL.  I WOULD RECOMMEND THIS TO ANYONE.

column9: Not What It Used To Be
column10: I don't understand the positive reviews of this particular dinner.  It used to be my favorite, lean roast beef, creamy potatoes and good gravy.  But it's not what it used to be--the meat is still ok, but the potatoes are now a  solid pasty blob.  You have to break them down with a fork, and there's not enough gravy to do it.  In my opinion these are now inedible.  Try the chicken with mashed potatoes and gravy instead--the potatoes aren't as awful and there's plenty of gravy.

I love these things. Saves cooking time and they taste great. No dishes to wash up either! All are good but the "beefy" ones seem to be the best. Add in a $.50 mac and cheese (or some Ramen) and it's a cheap meal! I keep some in my desk all of the time, a quick trip down the hall and I'm full and happy before a meeting... Get some!

Real beef not ground up, but real cuts of beef. The mashed spuds make up about 2/3 of the 10oz; they are good but too much for me. Without the gravy this entre would be a flop, even though I would prefer a little less spice.

column9: Not the same recipe as the five star reviews
column10: I'm pretty sure that this meal has changed drastically since the glowing five star reviews for this have been made. For one, there are no carrots or onions or anything like that which are mentioned in one review. This is simply only roast beef, mashed potatoes, and gravy. That's it. Second, it's not very impressive.Maybe I got a bad batch but TWO of these meals in a row had extremely lumpy mashed potatoes. After heating (and adding extra time in hopes that would help), the mashed potatoes were in a solid block under the meat. I had to smash and stir it for about three minutes before it resembled actual mashed potatoes but they were far from creamy. The lumps left behind were small and numerous and extremely unappetizing to eat (in fact, even though today I ended up skipping breakfast and am starving, I really can't bring myself to eat them).The meat though is surprisingly good. I'm usually not a big fan of many of the red meat in the Hormel line but I really enjoyed this one. But then, it was the best thing about the meal so maybe it's raised up in comparison.The gravy is not even half as salty as the red meat gravy meals tend to be which is an extremely good thing.Honestly, the best thing about these Hormel meals is that they fill you up for a very low price, can be stored anywhere, and really can't be easier to prepare. I ate the meat and about 1/4 of the mashed potatoes in this meal and even with my skipping breakfast, I feel completely satisfied. If these were lower in calories and sodium, I would honestly say these would always be our go-to when needing to grab a meal in ten minutes between meetings.

I eat a fair number of different prepared meals for lunches at work and think this is the worst meal I have eaten in years. The meat wasn't terrible but wasn't great. The mashed potatoes and gravy were so bad, I didn't finish and threw them away. Both the texture and the taste were bad. I'm back to my frozen entrees. Sometimes I need a meal that doesn't have to be refrigerated but it certainly will not be this.
I opened one of these dishes for roast beef, mashed potatoes and gravy and found it to be SOUR.  I want credit for the 6 unit carton. Can anyone help me?Louise

Honestly when it does come down to Hormel, they've made some great foods like Chili & tamales. But sometimes when it has cmae down to some of their prepared foods, they just could've brought out more. The Hormel Compleats Roast Beef & Mashed Poptatoes is very easy to prep up in the microwave, without the aid of a freezer of refrigeration after purchase. Yet, there honestly wasn't enough roast beef in the easy to make meal. I was honestly a bit dissapointed. Not only that, I felt that it could've honestly tasted much, much better than what I got when I first tasted it. I hope Hormel does make better tasting versions of their compleats soon. It isn't bad for anyone who is on a budget or for anyone that is looking for a quick meal made ready whenever you're hungry, but more taste should've been added to it.Price: B-Taste: C+Overall: C+

column9: Salty and offputting aftertaste to the gravy
column10: The box art always makes packaged food look so delicious, but this is basically a thin slice of processed beef on top of a bed of mashed potatoes. The potatoes are very dense and not at all fluffy like the photo, but did have a substantial and hearty texture to it. It was sort of a solid block of potatoes at the bottom of the bowl and I had to break it apart with the fork. I've uploaded a photo to show you what the actual product looks out.Preparation is easy. Just poke some holes in the top and put it in the microwave for 1-1.5 mins. The texture of the beef and potato is about what I'd expect from processed food, but the gravy was very off-putting and didn't taste right. My dish was well before the expiration date of 12/06/12, but had a funny and unpleasant sour aftertaste to it. Sodium content is moderate at 830 mg (35% daily value) and tastes overly salty.I will not be buying this particular variety again. It just doesn't taste good.
