I bought these thinking they would make a nice meal at work, but was completely unprepared for what the product actually is. The picture looks like a nice meal with beef and gravy with some mashed potato, what you get is a sea of white, tasteless puree, with a little bit of brown mushy stuff anda thin butter loaded liquid which they say is gravy. It was very unappetizing.
It's OK. Not crazy about it. So far the turkey is the best. I will not order it again though.
This is an OK quick meal, but I found the meat a bit dry and lacking in flavor.  Gravy was OK, potatoes were OK.  Not bad, but not as good (to me) as some of the other items in this line.
I drink multiple different flavors of Nuun all day long. This is a nice refreshing, not too sweet flavor. When I race and will only have water, I use this for a flavor change.
This toasted sesame oil has a very intense flavor, and little is needed, compared to other brands.  You don't get much for the price, but I do like it.

I love this brand. My order didn't take too long at all. They weren't quite as fresh as I was used to (heck, I buy 5-8 boxes at a time because I give them as gifts to my black licorice loving friends) but I'll definitely buy again when they are back in stock!This is the tastiest black licorice ever!

This is the same stuff that you had as a kid back in the 50's.  It has so much licorice it is slightly bitter.  I used to purchase this $100 at a time when I would make a trip to Canada 10 years ago.  You can now get the same stuff from the comfort of your home. Really good stuff if you are a black licorice freak.

column9: These are great, like going back in time.
column10: I love these licorice cigars! I am 63 and they used to make them JUST like these (the pipes too) when I was a kid and I had been searching for them for years before I found them online. I'm so happy to find a source as I can find NO other licorice just like these, taste-wise and texture wise. I give them to my old licorice loving friends.

These arrived in the mail within a few days of our ordering them, which was rather impressive, and the moment we cracked the box, we were bowled over by the licorice fumes--in a good way! The cigars themselves are a little over four inches long, and thankfully there are plenty in the box so Dad has time to have more than one before everybody else runs them out. Since their flavor is really potent, honestly one apiece should hold you all evening. Great product and a nifty idea to include in a Wild West costume or simply as a touch of culinary elegance :)
I ordered the product on a friday and monday afternoon it was here.  Thank you so much it was one of the best transactions ever.  Would absolutely buy from them again.

You should disclose when items are not being sold from the US or shipped.  I purchased this as standard delivery with the assumption it was coming from the US not Canada because this was being shipped from Canada it did not fall into the standard shipping guidelines and was not received in time for Christmas NOW i have to take the time to contact the vendor to see if they will accept a return and pay for the shipping - this would cause me NOT to do future purchase on amazon.com

As a background, i have been preparing escargot for years at home and decided to upgrade my aging collection of olde Pyrex and metal escargot plates and to have matching dishes to serve 6 friends or family.I just received my escargot plates-had hoped that the ceramic would be superior in heat retention.My disappointment comes from the quality.  The plates themselves appear to be a heavy stoneware-like material.  They are not. Worse still when i called the vendor i was told that each plate was very heavy and that was the reason for the high shipping cost.  A lot of nonsense and hooey.The glazing was incomplete on the bottoms of three out of 6, and on one of the handles.  This may result in moisture penetrating the ceramic.  It certainly will make clean up tougher.  The depressions are small at best to hold small snails and ample butter, and downright tight for the extra large snails. There is no lip on the edge which will allow for extra butter.  Worst is that these are 4.5" in diameter-downright small.  Very disappointing and i would not recommend these.They are, however, minimally functional and appear that they would retain heat similarly but not better than glass or ceramic plates without the bowl.Also the picture seems to show a two tone dish, brown top with a more rustic grey brown lower section, like real stoneware,  as well as a taper-mine are not like this, they are evenly brown and not tapered.Not happy as there as larger plain ceramic dishes available for half the price.  I thought these were a superior product.  I would not recommend these for the above reasons.  Shipping prices posted are ridiculous.  Actually, not ridiculous, they are outrageous, as all six, in thier cehap cardboard box (which holds six-likely originally sold as sets) weighed about 1.5 lbs total. The shipping prices quoted via the Amazon portal are absurd.  These bowls are made in Taiwan, which only bearing is that the cost versus quality is apparent.  WHiel the description i accessed indicates these are made in France , they are not.IMHO a waste of money, unless you like the color and compactness. When i complained to the vendor i was dismayed at the customer service, including a claim for re-stocking fees for defective items shipped, something i have never encountered. More dismaying still, is that these items in the vendors catalog, included in my shipment , sell for almost a dollar less than listed here.  So not only does the seller charge high shipping, a handling charge, but also more than its own catalog price.  I think this is a vendor to be avoided from my experience.

column9: STRONG, BOLD, FULL BODIED DECAF for K-CUP
column10: Like many decaffeinated coffee lovers, I was incredibly disappointed when my favorite Starbucks coffees were not available in K-Cups.  Thankfully I discovered Tully's!!!  If you love Sumatra, you're going to love this blend!  I highly recommend it for any decaf drinkers who desire bold, rich, complex coffee flavor - without the jolt.
If you Have to drink decaf, this is the BEST tasting coffee.  I don't even miss the caffiene.  Recommend to others all the time.
Tulley's rich robust Decaffinated French Roast Coffee is a delight to my pallet.I look forward to  indulging in 3 or more cups a day!
If I were blindfolded, I don't think I could tell this from excellent caffeinated coffee.And the convenience of K-cups.
If decaf is your choice but you still want great flavor, you can't do better.  There aren't many decaf french roast K-cups available and this is the best I've found.

While I've enjoyed fruit and black cherries all of my life and eat them while in season, I noticed after eating a reasonable amount on two separate occassions how good I felt, no joint pain, but then after a day or two the joint pain came back. I couldn't find cherries again at the supermarket, so I tried Black Cherry Juice, Organic Knudsen's, in place of the fruit.  Within a day I started feeling great again, so I drank a small amount each day during the day (a bottle lasted a week) and continued to feel fantastic.  When I went back to the store to buy more, they were completely out - and all the other juices in the same brand were fully stocked - so apparently I wasn't the only one who believed in this cherry juice!  I've tried tart cherry as well, but it doesn't seem to offer the same relief.  I will now stay as stocked as possible on this Juice!

column9: The "ne plus ultra" of black cherry juice
column10: I love cherries. Chocolate Covered, maraschino, ripe from the tree and cherry juice.Knudson's "Just Black Cherry" is a healthy alternative to the Corn-syrup-laced drinks out there on the market. It is 100% juice and 100% black cherry.  In this day and age when "Natural" fruit drinks have Apple juice or Grape Juice as their first ingredient, it is refreshing to come across something that is EXACTLY what the label states -- 100% Black Cherry Juice.It IS sweet enough right from the bottle, but if I need more sweetness I can always add a little undiluted frozen apple cider, or honey, or raw sugar.I drink it straight, add lemon juice if I so desire, or add it to my iced tea.

This cherry juice has helped me time and time again fend off my gout attacks.  Every time i start to feel an attack coming, i drink 8 ounces of cherry juice from a 32 oz bottle, until it's gone, so for 4 days and my gout goes the other way, by day 5, it's gone... although, just to be sure i usually get a 2nd bottle of this stuff at my local vons/safeway and drink it for the next 4 days just to be sure.  If you have GOUT, TRY THIS.  I have never had to go on medication for my gout and this works great for me.  Hope that helps!

This is very tasty and has a moderate black cherry flavor with some tartness.  I understand others' comments regarding this having a slightly prune juice quality.  Kind of tastes like 70% cherry juice mixed with 30% light prune juice.  I attribute this to the pasteurization process plus it's not filtered unlike a lot of prepared juices.  Still, I like it.

column4: Desert Gypsy "A Brooklyn Girl Out West"
column9: in testing how well this works for arthritis....
column10: As someone that's been dealing with arthritis since childhood, if simply drinking cherry juice is reported to help I would happy to test that theory.Background: at age 37 I had several joints replaced in my hand with recommendations to do both hip and knees as well but I simply can't go through that again. I'm always seeking natural and holistic remedies to help with the pain and stiffness and cherry juice came up in my research as something to try. This little bottle of juice had a really big challenge here though and I went into testing it knowing that my situation may be a bit beyond the normal aches and pains people usually take this for.Results: After using drinking 1-2 six ounce glasses each day for 6 weeks I did not notice a significant reduction in pain or stiffness. If the star rating were for this aspect I would award 2.5-3 stars.The Knudsen company does not make any health claims regarding this product so as far as a beverage I would give it 4 stars. I agree with the reviews that state this does have a somewhat prune-like flavor to it. One person stated it tastes like 70% cherry and 30% prune and I would agree with that statement.Conclusion: I was pleased to see this juice had helped so many reviewers with their arthritis and gout; as a juice product only I think the cherry flavor is good but may not be for everyone because of the strong note of prune flavor.
This product does not taste like pure cherry juice but has a vegetative, prunish quality.
We use this for making pulled pork in a crock pot.  (We have an easy recipe if you like.)  Buying through this source saved us over 50% on the cost from local supermarkets.

column9: Purest liquid smoke on the market!
column10: I LOVE liquid smoke, so do most people after they've had my steak, chops or chicken; I've helped initiate more than a few fans. Last year my local store stopped carrying Wright's, but brought in 3 new brands to replace it. All three brands had soy in them and other various ingredients. Having only used Wright's in the past I was shocked to learn that not all liquid smokes are created equal. Wright's liquid smoke is allergen-free, which in my family is hugely important. I was delighted to find Wright's on Amazon, now I order by the case, save money and get the purest product on the market.
Great price, great taste would buy again.  I remember my Mother using this product when I was small and when I opened the bottle I knew it was the real deal.

column9: Best Liquid Hickory on the Market
column10: Have tried many liquid smoke seasonings, however none that compare to this one in quality and flavor.  Could not find any retail source for it here in North Texas.  Tried many other brands.  Ordered on line, and now have "smoked" food that does not taste artificial.

Wright's Liquid Smoke is the only product my Daddy would use in his BBQ sauce that was famous in Oklahoma City during the 1950s.  It is great and we love it.It is kinda hard to find locally, so it is so great to be able to purchase it over Amazon !!  And, the price is right too !!!
Great anywhere that'd you'd like to have Hickory smoked flavor.  Marinate steaks in it with a little salt and pepper...excellent!
I received the product as described, and it was very fast service. I would buy it from this seller again.

column9: Great seeds, need to wash and dry
column10: The seeds are great quality, but dirty. Full of grass or something which means they come directly from the source. The field! So you need to give them some TLC (Tender Love and Care) and wash and dry them out before using.
Very clean seeds....Sure there fine for baking...but that's it!!!!....Look elsewhere for unwashed seeds....complete Tea useless folks.....I will continue my quest....

column9: PUPPIES LOVE THEM AND THEY'RE GOOD FOR THEM TOO
column10: I breed Dobermans and Mini Schnauzers and have used these biscuits for the puppies chewing needs when they're cutting their baby teeth since my first litters were born. It's a positive chewing item for them and nutritious as well. When my puppies go to their new lives with their new families I always include a dozen or so of these biscuits along with other things to make their transition as easy as possible. I like the fact that these puppy biscuits have no dyes or other flavors added and recommend that the new owners avoid the other flavored biscuits(even prior to the peanutbutter scare a year ago!). I personally don't like the idea of dyes in food and treats because some of then can bring about allergic reactions and judging from the reaction of all the dogs and puppies- these taste so great they don't need the other flavors to enjoy their nutritious treats!

We raise Cavachons and I've found these tiny biscuits are the perfect size to slip in a pocket and break in tiny bits to use for an reward in house training puppies.  They must be delicious as puppies are thrilled with them as a treat. Positive reinforcement and praise are great, but a bite of a tasty biscuit works wonders to encourage puppies & speed their learning process!

column9: Good for easy bread or muffins
column10: This was my first introduction to gluten free baking, and the box contains about 4 recipes.  I made pancakes with this mix, that were slightly disappointing, and i all but gave up on it.  Then i made the bread recipe, which was wonderfully easy and requires no fancy equipment or techniques.  The bread recipe also doesn't use yeast, just an egg and milk and honey and oil, and it tastes wonderful!  Perfect for a hardy PB&J sandwich.  I will definitely be buying this again.

This product makes the best GF pancakes.  Our son is on a gluten free/casein free diet and he loves the pancakes made from this mix.  In fact, the entire family enjoys them.  The pancakes come out light, fluffy and tasty.  We have tried just about every GF/CF mix on the market and these are by far the best!

I struggled for a long time with gluten and wheat allergies, this Mix is the absolute best there is. I found this product at a health food store in Va, several years back. After moving out of the area, I couldn't find it. Went to Whole Foods in DC and there it was again for about 2 years. They decided not to carry it anymore. Well, I was miffed for a while. Then it came to me, "You shop at Amazon, why not try there?" Guess what, I bought a case and will be ordering a case again, and again, and again. Found some other gluten and wheat free products I use daily. Amazon, you're my place to shop for my gluten and wheat free products.Thanks, Julia-

We tried this baking mix after reading a message from another Celiac and found that we love it.  It gives your bread a very light texture.  We first tried it with a pumpkin base and then added bananas to our second batch.  Next we will attempt to use it for ginger bread.

I use this mix often to make gluten-free pancakes.I usually make a triple-batch with plain yogurt replacing some of the liquid.I have light and fluffy pancakes to last me 2 or 3 days.Probably the best baking mix I've ever used.

column9: Great yeast free gluten free bread
column10: I'm new to gluten free living and this is the first bread mix that I purchased.  I am very pleased with this product. It is very easy and quick to do, which is nice when having to bake bread just to eat is a little overwhelming.  This is yeast free and comes out a bit like a pound cake but it's good and simple for quick bread.  It makes great pancakes to!

column9: Great for pancakes, muffins, and bread...
column10: I use this mix to make pancakes often; it works wonderfully for that! I also made some really good pumpkin-pomegranate muffins with this baking mix, and those turned out so excellent that no one ever guessed they were gluten-free. This mix works well for plain bread, too. I have also used this flour to bread fish and to make the crispy topping for cherry crisp/cobbler. When it comes to making cookies and cake, though, you may want to use almond flour, coconut flour, or a white rice baking mix, because the brown rice baking mix has a distinct whole-grain taste to it. As long as you're baking something for which you want that whole-grain taste, this mix will work well for you! I suggest storing it in the refrigerator or freezer to extend the shelf life. I store a box at a time in the fridge, and the rest in the freezer, and it has stayed fresh for a long while that way.

My parents first discovered this baking mix when I was diagnosed with a wheat allergy nearly 25 years ago.  It makes THE BEST pancakes you will ever taste!  Like another reviewer said, try the pancakes with fresh fruit (my personal favorites are strawberries and blueberries) and it's almost like eating dessert for breakfast.  It's hard to find - I'm so glad Amazon is carrying it!

I love this product. It was my first venture into gluten-free baking after my celiac diagnosis. I make blueberry muffins, pancakes, and best of all - "rye" bread for my husband who really misses his trips to the deli. We keep the kitchen gluten free to keep me as safe as possible so he eats a lot of things he might not ordinarily, but really enjoys his "fake rye bread. I just add caraway seeds.

I've been making pancakes with this product for years and love it. Try adding some mashed banana and walnuts or some frozen raspberries to the pancakes. Also makes great waffles. Freeze them and you can heat any time.
Fearn Brown Rice Baking mix makes a light, delicious, wheat-free pancake that settles so well you'll want at least one more!  Try it!
It is a know great product and this was convenient way to find it as stores frequently do not carry it.

column9: Shortcut to great Mexican recipes at home
column10: Ro-Tel has a variety of diced tomatoes flavored for every taste.  For fresh, home style salsa, you can't beat their Lime and Cilantro version.  For tacos, use the Medium Hot version.  But the hands down, all around best is their Hot Diced Tomatoes with Habanero.If you love hot Mexican cooking like I do, you'll think you died and went to Heaven with this!  It is definitely NOT FOR THE FAINT OF HEART!  Habanero is the hottest of all the peppers you can eat.  It is off the Scovill Scale of hotness like Einstein is off the IQ scale.  But, at the same time, it is versatile and its uses are only limited by your imagination.  Need to tone it down, add some sour cream or Philly cream cheese, or drain off the water in the can and mix into your recipe that way.  Mix it into chili and simmer it down with lots of water for superb flavor and eye-watering heat.  For parties, stir into a pot of nacho cheese for a zip that everybody will remember.Can you tell I love this stuff? But don't take my word for it, try it yourself -- you'll love it!
Great product and really fast delivery.  I use this ofetn in many dishes for that extra kick.  Some find it a little hot, but I think it is great for queso, and other Mexican style dishes.

I love Rotel. It is great on almost anything. I use it on meat, eggs, atop a salad, as a dip, as a garnish in a wide variety of situations. If you like Pico De Gallo, you will love Rotel. I guess it's not for everyone but try a can and see. For me, it's a staple like eggs and milk.

column9: Perfect combination of Habaneros and Tomatoes
column10: I used to get these at Target, but they stopped carrying them. So, naturally, I turned to Amazon. Voila. Now I can buy them by the case and never have to worry about running out of them.Diced tomatoes, habaneros, and jalapenos. All in the same can! :-) I use this item everywhere, all of the time. Don't know how I got by without it.

We go through an unhealthy level of this stuff in my house so Amazon carrying it in 12pks at a price cheaper than going to the store is perfect. If you like spicy food the hot version is just right for you. Now, everyone I talk to doesn't seem to grasp how versatile Rotel is and thinks it's just for mixing with Velveeta and making queso dip with. How very wrong they are! (although that is a great use of it as well) Here's some of the things we regularly do with Rotel:~Add to a grilled chicken/turkey/chicken/etc and cheese quesadilla~Add to spaghetti sauce~Add a can to taco meat as the liquid portion when you add the seasoning~Use to make salsa~I use a can (along with broth) as part of the soup base when I make spicy chicken noodle soup~Use to make spicy tomato baked mac and cheese (or simply add some to a box of Kraft, it's delicious)Really anything you'd normally enjoy tomatoes with Rotel works great for and adds a spicy kick.

column4: B. Smith "The giant on whoms shoulders your c...
column10: I use rotel in chili, spaghetti sauce, and chip dips. Its a good way to spice up or stretch out spendier salsa. Its cheaper to have it delivered to my door than to pick it up at the local grocery store (which isn't even locally owned).

it is extreemely rare and difficult to find hot rotels where i live, i can find the original and mild but i like mine hot!. these were a decent price and now i will have some on hand for a while. if you like the spicy foods i recommend cooking with this.

column9: A new staple for my pantry
column10: Love these Hot Ro-Tel Diced Tomatoes...too hard to find locally, so glad I can get them thru Amazon. Gives an extra kick to soups, stews & spaghetti sauce, too!

column9: It's says it's 20% Kona and 80% (MJB barf ground?)
column10: That's what it tastes like, too.  Just get the medium roast 100% Kona pods from them, it's fantastic.  This is junk tho, IMHO. Don't know why they did it, there's Hawaiian non-Kona coffee that tastes good.  What you wanted was the larger 100% Kona variety pack version of this from Aloha Coffee Co. which costs about $39 + S&H.  Still a bargain compared to Starpucky's at about $0.75/cup.  Also look at the 100% Kona Medium roast pods which are totally delic. and comes in 1-cup and 2-cup pod sizes.

I had given up coffee but when I tasted this Cinnamon Hazelnut, I was in heaven.  I now have it everyday!  A bit expensive, but worth it.  I never to to Starbucks anymore and I look forward to my coffee every morning.  it's such a special treat.  I was a bit disappointed in how good it was because I'm back drinking coffee....but again, sooooo good.  Don't take my word for it, just try it for yourself.
This is a very simple product to use and it is the best falafel mix ever I have ever had.  It was introduced to my by Israeli's so you know its an authentic tasting product.
I love Telma Falafel mix!  The texture and taste are amazing!  I just made some for me and my boyfriend for lunch and can't wait to get another box.
I received the product that I had ordered within the time frame listed on the site.  Good service!  I would purchase again in the future from them.

I have had falafel in so many places and countries, I can't count. The best homemade falafel I ever had is in Netanya, Israel. Since I live now in the US and there is no really good falafel where I live, the best tasting falafel is made from Telma falafel mix. It's delicious and comes out a little crunchy. I am Vegan and falafel is a favorite meal of mine so I make it often. I have tried all the brands out there and Telma is the only one that is worth buying. It comes close to the best falafel I ever ate in Netanya.
I know of several restaurants that serve very good falafel but this is the first mix that get's close to that. It's delicious and easy to make.

This sampler offers 2 of each:Captivating Earl Grey DarjeelingExtraordinary English BreakfastNight Blooming Jasmine GreenExotic Tropical MangoChocolate Mint DecadenceSoothing ChamomileStrawberry SeductionTraditional Japanese GenmaichaI was so excited when I found this sampler - and the flavors sounded so yummy! Luxe is a Seattle company, another reason why I wanted to like this. Unfortunately, each kind is way too weak and flavorless. Do they use old, or poor quality tea? Was my box expired? It could be, but regardless, there is too little tea per bag. And even using 2 t-bags per cup, the flavor was still 'blah'. (I've also tried their supposed higher quality triangle bags, but the taste is the same.) To be fair, I didn't bother trying Chamomile and Earl Grey, so who knows, those could be good. The only one with a strong/good flavor and aroma is the Strawberry Seduction, but I wouldn't know how it compares with other brands as I don't care for strawberry tea.

column9: Not Impressed with the Strength of Flavor
column10: I love hot teas, and I thought I would like this sampler. While the flavors taste good, I have found none of them is sufficiently strong after brewing.  The flavors and weak and mellow even with proper brewing.  I do like the idea of the flavors and the silk bags, but will continue to drink other hot teas.

Luxe's commitment to quality is outstanding!  The silken teabags contain very high quality teas and the bags themselves are very elegant!  There are no staples in the teabags which not only looks great but it makes the bags microwaveable, too!Once you develop a preference of your favorite tea, I recommend buying a 50pc masterpack of the 5 gram triangle silken bags (also no staples).  the tea used in these are even higher quality.

column9: The best of the best! A+++++
column10: Wellness Core grain free is the absolute best wet food you can feed your dog. To my knowledge, it has the highest amount of protein of all canned dog food. My dogs love it, and I mean they go crazy for it and devour their dinner whenever I mix this stuff with their dry food. This product is also suitable for dogs of all life stages, including puppies, which is not the case with most canned dog food. It is expensive but worth the money. Wellness is a fantastic brand, free of by-products, bad preservatives and animal digest, which anyone in their right mind would not want to feed their dogs. A+++++

I have 2 boxers and mix a 1/2 a can along with their dry food for each...  They just love it!  I tried using one can each but it's too high in protein and they get the runs, so be sure to experiment with the right mix...

I give this food five stars because it is the best food for my Yorkshire Terrier. He was a very picky eater before I discovered this food but he's never picky with this food. I give him half a can of the small can in the morning and another half in the afternoon. Yorkies are prone to diabetes (everyone is) so to avoid his blood sugar from dropping, I feed him twice a day with a few healthy snacks in between and make sure that he gets exercise. This food is grain free so he looks lean and strong.

column9: Not the favorite, but still a good choice.
column10: This is the canned food that my dog(miniature schnauzer) has eaten the longest.  I began mixing it with the Core dry food, and it did well for some months.  Gradually, she lost interest, and I had to try other flavors.  I still present it about once a week, and can get her to eat it with some persuasion.  It seems to be one of the better foods for her, but not as readily accepted.

I switched to this food when my cocker spaniel was having stomach problems and vomiting often. I found that the Nutro Ultra had gluten in it and other foods we had tried had a lot of grain. She is thriving on this food and has no problems anymore. She is a high energy 3 year old and her coat is beautiful since we switched. I do not give this food to our 10 year old cocker. I think that the protein level and calories are too much for an older dog, although your vet would be better able to help you make that choice.

Have been using Core products for several years.  I supplement dry food with a little canned food and I prefer grain free for my dogs.  I've priced compared in several locations and I have not found a better deal anywhere else.

This is a great, grain-free canned dog food.  I have two small dogs who loveto eat and was trying to get their weight under control.  They've made bigimprovements with this in their diet, plus the dry food made by Wellness.The cans show up without any major dents, and the food itself actuallysmells relatively appetizing (for dog food).  Good for picky eaters, as well.

I have a 3 year old that can eat pretty much anything, but I have a 15 year old that has a very sensitive system.  I was feeding them Neuman's Organic Turkey and brown rice and realized that my old guy was having issues pretty often.  So, I have been mixing this in to transition them to just this grain free food and they LOVE it and he has had no issues at all so far.  It has been well over a month, and all is swell.  I am glad I made the switch.  And ... I just remembered, the reason I bought this was because a friend's dog was staying with us and that Golden is super allergic to grains, but was not really eating her food.  I mixed in a small amount of this with her regular dry food and she gobbled it all up.  I could not have her lose weight under my care.  I told her family and I believe they bought it to mix in her food now.  I am glad we switched!

I've tried many different dry foods with my chihuahua mix. She does okay with them for a little while, but then won't touch them. Even when she'll eat them, she takes her time and is not enthused at all. I decided to try a canned food to see if it might be more appealing to her, and since I like Wellness I tried this first. I started by mixing it with her dry food, but she went straight for the wet food, picking around the dry. She would eat some of the dry food at the end if I stood there and watched her. I kept this up for a couple weeks, then switched her over completely to the canned food, since my cat was eating her dry leftovers. She still gobbles it down after about a month, and still licks the bowl clean every night. I was concerned about switching her over to a completely canned diet, as I've heard not feeding dry food can cause problems with the teeth and gums, but I think brushing her teeth and giving her dental treats will be sufficient. It's nice that now she eats her whole meal within a couple of minutes, so I don't have to watch the bowl and make sure the cat doesn't eat it for her. I'm sticking with the turkey recipe for now, but if she starts getting picky again, I'll try the fish recipe.

My picky dog has never taken to a wet food so readily as Wellness Core. She really springs to breakfast with this stuff. We have put her on about a quarter-can a day of this along with a grain-free kibble. We're getting all grain-free in an attempt to address her flatulence. Yeah, it's worked like a charm. No more barley in my pup's diet!A couple cans were dented. I hope Amazon picks up direct selling of this item so I don't have to deal with Marketplace vendors next time.

Get what you pay for when you buy dog food, Wellness CORE is one of the few canned foods I will feed my dogs.  I lost my Airedale to melamine poisoning, thus am a rabid label reader. When you feed canned and dry, why have non meat items in the product? Less grain is better IMO.

Wellness foods, in general, seem to be as fine a quality as you can give your pet short of a completely homemade diet. A grain free diet is helpful to my golden retrievers (food allergies) and Wellness Core offers several protein options in a grain free formula. I think its important to feed canned along with kibble (and some fresh veggies - usually green beans - as well). There are many fine ways to feed dogs and cats, but this works for mine. Wellness Core is a consistently excellent product and the doggies love it.

this graiin-free food changed my dog's life for the better.  his system with dog food containing meat by-products and grain was stressed.  he now runs to his food bowl and clean his plate every meal.  i have recommended this food to friends along with the equivalent kibble.
It is okay but I wouldn't buy again, I'd rather make my own from scratch using fresh frozen fruit.

I am a big fan of chai lattes and the spices in this blend are quite tasty. If you use the recommended 8oz setting, it has a full enough flavor. My biggest complaint is the artificial sweetener. It leaves that horrible chemical aftertaste that diet sodas do. If you don't have a problem with Splenda and you like spiced chai, this is the K-cup for you! If you are like me though, and have an aversion to artificial sweeteners, it looks like we are still stuck with brewing the tea (such as Celestial's India Spice Chai) and adding our own milk and sugar.

the tea is fine, slightly weak, but how in the world did they come up with such a high price? Its foolish to buy it through Amazon sellers when there are other areas to buy it cheaper. My local grocery store (Giant) sells it cheaper!

column9: Love this Product.....But cheaper on other sites
column10: I recently purchased this item from Amazon - then found it CHEAPER somewhere else.  Amazon - please review your pricing policy on this product.  I would like to sign up for the auto delivery program - but I will NOT until you can beat the cheaper prices.  I am an avid Amazonian shopper and was very disappointed about the price difference.I LOVE this product.Please give serious consideration to this post.Thanks,

My favorite k-cup! Just really really good chai latte flavor very similar to a great cup from a local coffee shop. I also recommend it as something different than just ordinary chai tea cups. I make sure I never run out!

column9: Don't get why this has sucralose in it.
column10: I had read reviews for this before and somehow missed the fact that it had sucralose in it. Ugh. I made it and it smells great, tastes great, and all things considered it probably is very good if you can tolerate sucralose, but unfortunately I can't, even if it's the last ingredient listed (which it is on this). Why they added it is beyond me, but I'd wish they'd make a version without it.

I was really hoping to enjoy this because it was well reviewed on Amazon.  However, I honestly couldn't even finish the cup of chai... the artificial sweetener taste was really bad.  If you are the type who doesn't mind artificial sweetener, then I would say go for it, but if sucralose bugs you at all, DON'T DO IT.  I guess I'll check the labels on my K-cups more carefully from now on.

column9: Good product, but Amazon should look at their prices.
column10: This is a good product. I have been over all very happy with k-cups, but Amazon needs to evaluate their prices for their all k-cups. I love ordering on this site, but this is not a good deal. I could not find another way let Amazon know about this other than writing a review.

My hairdresser has jumped on the Keurig bandwagon, which makes sense because different people have different tastes. This chai latte tasted exactly like a more pricey cup from a coffee shop. I was very impressed how quickly it was ready, the flavor, everything!!
It's great both hot and cold.  Hot for now, cold for later from the refrigerator, two cups fit perfectly in my take along cup.

column9: Not what I thought it was
column10: First thing is that I was disappointed in myselft for not realizing that this was only 12 k-cups instead of 24 but I guess that was my error for not reading in more careful.  The other thing is that when it came, a couple of the cups did not have loose powder in them.  The powder in the cup was stuck together and hard.  The last time I used a k-cup that had hard stuck together powder...my machine overflowed from the top because the water couldn't make it through the k-cup.I love the chai latte k-cups but I paid to much for 12 k-cups and I can't use a couple of them because they have the hard powder.

column9: The Best Chai Latte in K-Cups but....
column10: This is the best chai latte available for k-cups but it is still a step back from getting a chai at a coffee shop. I think it's the powdered milk or the sweetener used that I taste differently, but the spice mix is spot on if you use the small cup setting. The big cup setting can dilute the flavor a bit and make it taste weak.If I'm headed into work and I want a chai, I'll still stop at starbucks and get one because the gap is big enough that it's worth the extra money to get a freshly made chai.
These are great love the taste.  These are hard to find in the store as they sell out fast.  my favorite

I bought this today because I am absolutely in love with a certain coffee chain based out of seattle's chai tea latte. I was hoping that this would help me save a little money and still give me that delicious taste. Wrong. This was soooo sweet. I have the biggest sweet tooth out of anyone I know and i couldn't even drink one of these. Not worth it.

column9: Worst aftertaste ever.. even more then diet drinks
column10: I love coffee. I love chai lattes. I love my Keurig. But this combination was disgusting. The taste when first prepared was STRONG. OK, I get that and could even even like it... if the aftertaste didn't kick in. I have never tasted so much artificial sweetener in any product. This is not listed as lo-cal or diet.. so it was not at all what I was expecting. I would rather have an aspirin dissolve in my mouth. I am returning this to the store. Absolutely terrible.
This tea is delicious.  It's good hot, but it's even better over ice!  I have been able to find it in stores lately (Target, Bed Bath & Beyond).
This stuff is good.  I've bought several more boxes, and this is now all the tea I drink.  I love this stuff!
This is a perfect Chai Latte!  No need to add cream or sugar. Perfect for those cool nights or when you are overwhelm with the day.  This cup of spiced tea is a perfect treat!

I've always loved Starbucks Chai Tea Latte. This tastes just like it to me. It's very creamy and very sweet. It's a great treat for me and very addicting. It's by far my favorite beverage to make in my keurig!!

column4: Marilyn Meredith "Marilyn, author and avid re...
column9: This is fhe First Thing I Drink Every Morning
column10: This is my absolute favorite hot morning drink. Yum! It ranks above the flavored coffee drinks you get in Starbucks and other specialty coffee shops. I could drink it all day, though I try to limit myself to 2 cups. Try it, you'll love it.This is what I drink when I begin my writing.Marilyn, author of the Deputy Tempe Crabtree mysteries.

I am not a big coffee fan but I wanted a Keurig maker. I absolutely love Chai Latte. I make two cups of it. I found that mixing it on the middle setting and one on the smallest cup setting mixed together makes it a perfect combination! It tastes just like when I used to buy it for 3x the price. It is creamy and the right amount of flavor. I would recommend this to anyone who is looking for a nice kick of flavor in the morning but ins't looking for the caffeine of coffee! I also enjoy this as a little treat since I am watching my weight and this doesn't make a big dent into the amount of calories I consume a day. I did wish I could find i for less expensive on Amazon as my local store has it for a better price but it is not always in stock.
This is not worth the the money. You are better off buying one that is not in Kcups and just added the water.

column9: LOVE IT LOVE IT LOVE IT
column10: EXPENSIVE - but if you like the taste of exotic coffee, OMG this is it, has a hint of clove, creame and something exotic.  I LOVE IT ITS MY ALL TIME FAVORITE!!  Goes great with a mystery book on a cold night.

So, somehow Diamond captured the perfect flavor of french toast without all the calories. Such a great flavor, after tasting only a few for the first time I immediately orderd three more. These don't even have that "Almond" aftertaste, it finishes very nice with a hint of a butter maple flavor...wow.Now: To Diamond please rename to "Buttery French Toast", as this would be much better fitting.

The flavor of these nuts is similar to cinnamon toast cereal, yet they are filling and healthy, containing little sugar and almost no salt. I would deduct a star for being priced too high both here and in the supermarket, but Blue Diamond deserves credit for their restraint in using quality ingredients and in not producing a sugar encrusted candy. Now if they would only go against the trend of charging a huge markup for minimal extra processing cost...The other reviewer seems to think these contain lactose. The ingredients:ALMONDS, EVAPORATED CANE JUICE, BROWN SUGAR, CORN MALTODEXTRIN, CINNAMON, NATURAL FLAVORS AND SALT. PEANUT FREE. MAY CONTAIN OTHER TREE NUTS. Unless OTHER TREE NUTS comes from cows, I don't think this is true.

I ordered these nuts off a whim because of the flavor. I just got into eating more nuts because I don't get enough Omega 3's. Everybody that I shared these with loved them! I went through 2 containers in a week (because of sharing). This will be a staple in my house from now on!!!
These have more net carbs than the Emerald Cocoa Roast almonds (6g vs 3g), but if you're not worried about that, these are absolutely delicious! If you like flavored nuts, you've got to try these.

I discovered these nuts by accident. They were on clearance ay my local CVS for $1. I wish I had bought them all!The cinnamon and brown sugar flavor is perfect together with the roasted almond flavor. It is not candy coated like other cinnamon almonds (making it a much healthier treat). Everyone that I have shared them with think that they arephenomenal! I highly recommend this product. It is one of the most tasty and healthy snacks you can find. I only wish Amazon would put them on their subscribe and save program.

I got these at my local Publix. They're the best tasting almonds of the bunch. The butter toffee tastes natural and the almonds are of good quality. They also make dark chocolate covered almonds. They taste like Cocoa Puffs but are still pretty good if you're looking for a cocoa kick instead.

At first, I thought these tasted a little artificial. After a few handfuls I realized I like them, regardless.I am a big fan of this company's products, and have even gone so far as to speak with one of their growers about the integrated pest management systems they employ (using the smallest amount of pesticides possible).  I will keep buying all their other flavors. The Bold line, especially the Habanero, is also excellent, as are the dark chocolate variety.

These almonds are nothing short of incredible- they are so delicious! If you are trying to follow a low-carb lifestyle (for dietary reasons or weight loss) and need a 'sweet fix' after meals, then this is a wonderful option - only 6 g. Net carbs! And the taste is so yummy! They are just sweet enough! I'm so glad that amazon sells them in bulk, because I could easily go through one container in a week!

If you want a truly healthy, filling snack, you must give these a try, as well as their sisters, the Vanilla Bean Almonds. They are both just lightly sweetened, and fragrant with either the cinnamon or the vanilla, depending on which you choose. The container is marvelous; there is a half flip top which is easy to do with one hand (like in the car). And they're not roasted in more oil, so the almonds are "meaty" and sweet. And almonds are SOOO good for you. I'd recommend that you try them, and then get an Amazon subscribe and save if you can. It's well worth it! And all natural. LOVELY!

column9: Not the same as the canned version
column10: I expected that these canisters of Blue Diamond "Roasted Almonds - Honey" would be the same product as the little cans of Blue Diamond "Honey Roasted Almonds" ( Blue Diamond Almonds Honey Roast, 6-Ounce Tins (Pack of 12) ) but they're surprisingly not the same, and have a very "off" taste.  What a disappointment!  Blue Diamond has apparently seen fit to add much more maltodextrin and "other natural flavors", which I suspect cause the odd taste, thus ruining a fabulous product.I've been having a hard time finding the small cans of Blue Diamond "Honey Roasted Almonds" at the supermarkets, despite all the other flavors being carried.  It's as if Blue Diamond just, for some reason, *wants* this product to fail.  First they make it hard to get the canned version, then they completely change the taste of a great product and package it in a canister, using a name that is so similar that it contains all the same words, but without a hint that it's not the same product.I'd contact Blue Diamond and complain, but I already know that they never respond to customers despite having a contact link on their website.  In the past, I wrote to them when they test-marketed and then removed some wonderful silvered almonds (not "slivered" but silvered, as in almonds with a very light sugary coating);  when I wrote to ask, instead of appreciating my interest as a customer, they simply ignored me.So I'm offering this review as a warning to anyone else who might make the same mistake, and think that these almonds will be like the similarly-named canned "Honey Roasted Almonds" from the same company.  The ones in the can are great;  these are just plain awful, and I'll be throwing out 2.9 canisters of 3 purchased.

column9: Nice salt on a very dry nut.
column10: OK, I like a little richness. These nuts have a flavorful salt taste, but are almost too dry to get down your throat.

I love these almonds. They are my favorite to date and I would definitely buy again. The taste is crunchy, they are well toasted and the salt that has been added is just perfect. Not too little, not too much. Best I have ever eaten!!

This is basically candy masquerading as a "healthy" snack. They taste good - because they have three different kinds of sugar in them! Blue Diamond  wants you to think that eating sugar is a healthy snack - c'mon!I purchased these thinking they were sweetened with stevia. Yeah, there's a miniscule amount of stevia (very last ingredient) - but sugars are the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th ingredient listed. These have corn maltodextrin - the worst thing there is on the glycemic index (can you say fat formation?). Now I'm stuck with 3 containers of this sugar snack.
These are the best tasting almonds. I buy them in bulk to share at work. Any time someone finds cheaper almonds, they always come back to these because they can't be beat.

I love these almonds!!  They taste just like a snickerdoodle cookie, but make for a much healthier snack!  One of my favorites of the Blue Diamond Oven Roasted varieties.  Buying them in a 6-pack is more cost-effective for me, especially now that I can't find them in my grocery store. I wish they came in the large resealable bag like some of the other flavors, but for now I'll stick with the 6 container pack.

I wouldn't call these almonds sweet, but they do have just the right hint of sweet flavor that the almond is elevated and feels like a treat.  The taste and texture of almonds doesn't particularly appeal to me, but they're such a healthy snack that I'm glad to find this delicious option.  Also, the small container is the perfect size to have on your desk or keep in the car, or use as stocking stuffers like I plan to do for a couple of my healthy eating conscious friends!

column9: You are only getting one container!
column10: I purchased 2 other types of Blue Diamond almonds on the same day, and they were both around $11 for a pack of 3. T his one was only ONE 8 oz. container, and I assumed it was at least 2-3 containers since the cost was over $8.
Nice sweet treat with some nutritional value. These are fantastic! The only thing is I can find them in more local store at a lower cost.

I LOVE the Blue Diamond Butter Toffee and The Chocolate.  This is my first try with the Cinnamon and they are fabulous!  I eat and live low carb and eat a lot of nuts...the flavored Blue Diamond Almonds are hard to find, so I am happy to find them on Amazon.  Even better to have them delivered to my door FAST & FREE!  Thanks Amazon and Blue Diamond!

I love salted and smoked almonds. I had never even heard of Butter Toffee almonds before.  But, wow, I'm glad I tried them.  They are just sweet enough to satisfy my sweet tooth without overwhelming you with a sugar taste.Another reviewer was right, they taste a lot like french toast.  I'm definately buying these again.

column9: boy these are some tasty nuts !!
column10: Ive had some tasty nuts before but these are exceptionaly good. try them ! im very happy with this product

column9: Should almost be labelled a "BOLD" flavor
column10: Butter Toffee is not a flavor I thought I would like - for some reason the name makes me think of an icky flavor. However, I became hooked at first bite. This flavor is much sweeter than the Honey Roasted. It certainly becomes my top "dessert almonds" when in need of that sweet replacement.Absolutely great for those on a low-carb or Keto diet - only 6 Net Carbs per serving. The bold, sweet flavor keeps you satisfied after only a small amount.Highly recommended!
These almonds are my favorite almonds.  Wal-Mart used to carry them, but now I have to order online.  They are the perfect balance of cinnamon and sugar without being overpoweringly sweet.

column9: If You Like Almonds and You Like Cinnamon You will like these
column10: The Almonds are very very fresh tasting.  The cinnamon adds an extra bonus of goodness to the almonds with a great flavor.  We keep them in the fridge.  We also mix them with all the other nuts we have making our own nut mixture.  Excellent snack with protein.Just ordered some more of them.

I love these for a snack. I get a nice taste of chocolate and mint (in addition to the almond, of course), but it isn't super sweet. I hope Blue Diamond keeps coming out with more flavors. The Butter Toffee is great too.

column9: A heathly snack we all love
column10: Great taste.  The Blue Diamond flavors are way better than the Emerald flavors.  Great between meals snack that we all eat.  Also grab to put in baggies for lunches.

After trying every kind of almond out there over the years, I will take these flavorful Blue Diamond almonds any day.  They are fresh, salted just right and not greasy/oily.  I try to eat a handful a day, usually as a mid-afternoon snack for optimum health benefits. The handy container is easy to use and even indicates portion size.  Unfortunately, this type of almonds is getting more and more difficult to find in my local stores, so I was happy to be able to order a 6-pack from Amazon to have in my pantry.

These are our absolute favorite almonds and love that there isn't any fake sugars in them.  I'll take more calories with real sweeteners any day over sucralose in the other brands. And this flavor is DELICIOUS.  YUM!

I ordered these lovely almonds a few weeks ago, as I often find myself jonesing for junk food, and I thought that if I had something that was good for me around, I would be less likely to grab something terrible.  These nuts are packed with nutrition, and they taste amazing.  They have just enough flavor to make me want more, but the fact that they are high in fat makes it difficult to eat too many in one sitting; I'm satiated with two handfuls.  I go through one little container every week or so.  They are perfect for anyone concerned with nutrition or trying to put on or keep muscle- they pack 6 grams of protein in 1 oz.  I will definitely be re-purchasing these nuts. I wasn't so keen on the idea of the canisters, as I don't like producing so much waste, but I have purchased nuts (peanuts etc) in the past in bulk, and they did go bad before I finished eating them.These nuts have kept me out of the icecream, chocolate chips, and other naughty sweet things that have little nutritional content.  These nuts taste like they should be bad for you, but they are more similar to vitamins than junk food; read the back for the nutritional content: 35% Vitamin E, 15% Phosphorus, 20% Magnesium, 35% Manganese....the list goes on...:)Update: I ordered my second shipment of these.  I love these and I eat a handful of these almonds after my morning banana yogurt shake and with my vitamins :)

these are a good thing for you and sometimes hard to find in a larger container at the store, so these make it much easier and there a good price here.

These are incredible!  Eating these makes me not want to eat candy.  I love these!  The price isn't that great though.  I think Blue Diamond should save money by packaging them in something cheaper than plastic.  I did notice it on Amazon in a box, but the price looks odd - over $50?  Too bad Amazon doesn't stock this, so no Free Shipping.

The almonds tastes all right. Since it is too dry, the salt can hardly stay on surface. Therefore, it is not salty enough. On the whole, it is a healthy snack. I hope this type of almonds can have subscription service and discount.

column9: Butter Toffee almonds are sooo good, but hi-carb
column10: I've tried several of the Blue Diamond jar almonds and the Butter Toffee almonds are the best.  They would probably be my favorite almond, but they're high-carb. I guess the trick is to only eat a few at a time....  We can all do that, right?  :-)I agree with the other reviewer who said that the Blue Diamond almonds in the cans are better than the ones in the jars -- my favorite are the Vinegar & Salt -- but the Butter Toffee almonds are the exception.

column9: Satisfies My Sweet Tooth in A Healthy Way!
column10: It seems impossible that there is a healthy snack that tastes like cinnamon brown sugar but they've managed to do it.  I love these and I always have my cabinet stocked.  This quenches my sweet tooth without gulit.  I highly recommend it.
Do buy the almonds.  Great for snacks and travel.  The contanier has a close top which is great for storage.
Great flavor.  I snack on these when I need a boost of energy.  They help satisfy cravings between meals.

I must say, these almonds have made me a lover of nuts!!!  I have always been a cashew girl and never cared that much for almonds. Well, being on a low carb diet made cashews a no no.  Almonds roasted only with sea salt are soooo good. Blue Diamond makes the best tasting and these are hard to find in stores.  I love the 1 lb bag of these, but can't seem to find them. Buying these in bulk was the best deal out there and I will have to purchase again.  Thanks, Blue Diamond for a superior nut!
This almond product is wonderful!  I am so excited to have healthy options that curb my sweet tooth.  It has on 5 sugars for an ounce of almonds.Wahoo!
These almonds taste good, not as well flavored as the cinnamon or vanilla flavored but a decent change of pace.  A little plain though.
I love these almonds!  Wish they sold them somewhere locally so I didn't have to buy them in bulk over the internet.
If you are an almond fan like me and like sweets as well this is a great treat.  And healthy as well.

Diamond AlmondsAlmonds are a good source of magnesium. One ounce contain approximately 20% of the RDA for an adult recommended dietary allowance (RDA)Recommended Dietary Allowance (RDA) the amounts of selected nutrients considered adequate to meet the known nutrient needs of healthy people. The RDA is based on scientific knowledge and has been presented by a committee of the Food and Nutrition Board (FNB) of the National Academy of Sciences (NAS). The Canadian equivalent is the Recommended Nutrient Intakes. RDA is generally accepted throughout the world as a valid source of information. At least 40 different nations have as well as organizations have published standards similar to the RDA.Magnesium is the fourth most abundant mineral in the body and is essential to good health. Approximately 50% of total body magnesium is found in bone. The other half is found predominantly inside cells of body tissues and organs. Only 1% of magnesium is found in blood, but the body works very hard to keep blood levels of magnesium constant.Magnesium is needed for more than 300 biochemical reactions in the body. It helps maintain normal muscle and nerve function, keeps heart rhythm steady, supports a healthy immune system, and keeps bones strong. Magnesium also helps regulate blood sugar levels, promotes normal blood pressure, and is known to be involved in energy metabolism and protein synthesis. There is an increased interest in the role of magnesium in preventing and managing disorders such as hypertension, cardiovascular disease, and diabetes. Dietary magnesium is absorbed in the small intestines. Are you taking enough magnesium in the diet? The recommended daily allowance is 300mgs/day for men, 350mgs for women. Magnesium is extremely safe by mouth - too much simply causes diarrhea. Try increasing the amount of magnesium you take by mouth until it causes diarrhea, then reduce the dose slightly so it does not. This is called taking magnesium to bowel tolerance (just like using vitamin C to bowel tolerance.Almonds are a good source of Fiber.One ounce contains approximately 12% of the RDA for an adult.So, in summary, Almonds are a very healthy snack, so what's left to say?Two things:1st be cautious about "bowel tolerance" or "happy bowels" if you prefer.2nd Taste.
