Onion flavor note is not really distinguishable by itself but adds well to the overall flavor 'symphony.' Pleasant maple sugar flavor. A delight. Highly recommended! 525 calories, 0g fat, and 24g protein per can. Labeled "vegetarian," but is vegan also. This review is out there for those for whom this makes a difference. See all of my reviews for more great choices. Check out "Vegan Grocery Favorites" and "Vegan Grocery Top Ten" in Listmania. Your "helpful" votes count and will be greatly appreciated to benefit the search of others. Thank you.

My family loves these beans and I have ordered them before. The first shipment had 2 or 3 cans with small dents. My last order had 9 of 12 cans that were severely dented. This did not happen in shipping. The box was in good condition and packaged well by Amazon. Most of the dents are on the inside cans of the package.It seems that they come this way from the manufacturer. Amazon is sending me a replacement case and I hope they are in better shape.UPDATE: My replacement case came and 11 of 12 cans have dents. Amazon has refunded my money. I contacted Walnut Creek and they said they only sell Amazon first quality products and they are not sure how the cans are getting dented. I would not suggest purchasing these beans from Amazon.

column9: WE love Walnut Acres Baked Beans!
column10: We have been purchasing these baked beans for about a year now. Typically not a big fan of baked beans in a can, we decided to give these a try. We were sold on the first can and have been buying them ever since!

These beans have a very good flavor, I mixed them up with tofu kilbasa for the franks and beans experience.  It was a satisfying meal, made in minutes.  I would highly recommend trying these great organic beans.
I love these beans! Delicious! I've used them even in soups! My grandchildren who are not lovers of beans will eat these!

Many years ago when I lived in Maine, each Saturday was the day to make bread and bake beans.  And my baked beans were excellent.  But now that I'm old, live alone but still like beans on Saturday, I found Walnut Acres beans are better than mine were. (and they make lovely sandwiches)

column4: A Research It Maven "Just the facts please"
column10: $1.74 can. 150 calories per serving (1/2 cup) and ZERO FAT! GREAT baked beans made with white beans, cane sugar, molasses, brown rice flour, onions, salt and maple syrup, and ALL ORGANIC. Nothing odd or chemical in these! Delicious vegetarian beans that are ready to serve. Fry up some bacon and onions, drain them, add to the beans, and bake for about an hour for a dish even carnivores love. Or eat them right out of the can like I do for a fast nutritious meal anytime! Great price, $1.44 a can, on Subscribe and Save! These are better tasting than the other Walnut Acres "baked beans" which are really plain: Walnut Acres Organic Baked Beans, 15 Ounce Cans (Pack of 12).

Not as tasty as Bush's.  I wanted to order Bush's but they were not available here on Amazon at the time,  They might be better for you but I'm not sure.  If it tastes worse it is usually better for you.  These taste kinda bland and raw.  I like Bush's better.  Itt has a much better taste.

column9: Severely bent cans. Amazon needs to adopt a policy of full disclosure.
column10: The cans I received were severely bent. This did not happen in shipping. The box was in good condition and packaged well. Amazon needs to indicate the condition of the canned good they are selling (or at least mention the possibility of the cans being bent, because it is starting to appear from the number I have received that they are selling damaged canned goods). I had to throw one of the cans away since the product in it smelled off.

column9: It tastes good but the can status was terrible
column10: This bean tastes really good but all 12 cans looked like being smashed by something.  That outfit definately degraded the taste of this product.

Flavor an texture are very poor.  Was hoping this whole wheat product would replace regular pasta but just does not measure up.  Buy "bionature" brand whole wheat here at Amazon and you will be very pleased with the taste and quality.

column9: Hard to Find, Good to Eat
column10: We had a lot of trouble finding whole wheat elbow macaroni.  This is easy to prepare, it tastes great and the whole wheat is better for us.  In fact, I've used it in dishes eaten by people who tell me they don't like whole wheat pasta.  They liked these just fine!  We'll buy it again and use it often.

Have ordered this several times, and while a really good product, it has arrived stale each time.  Never have found an exp. date on the bags or the case, except for a code#; but I don't have the code book.  World of difference from those purchased at the grocery store.  Really wish they would ship dated product to amazon. It is not amazons' fault.
I used them as part of a centerpiece and the 12 packages was the perfect amount to fill 12 pint jars.  They were fresh and just what I was expecting.
This is by far the best chocolate milk, I really wish they sell it here in the US, but for now I will continue to order it online.

This on top of Betty Crocker's Cherry Chip Cake is memories of a childhood spent biking and exploring the neighborhood from sun up to sundown; burning calories and staying out of my parents' and Granny's hair. You could eat it with no regrets or poundage. Can't wait for the heat streak to break so I can turn on the oven, bake a Cherry Chip cake, frost it and re-live my youth WITH middle-age poundage. Just shop around for a fair price of around TWO bucks a can and free or cheap shipping.

This is a must have frosting i buy a white cake mix and put the juice of a small jar of cherries in the mix and then use the cherries on top of the cake frosting.... It is to die for..... and doesn't last very long around this house...

Found a recipe last year that I wanted to make but couldn't find the main ingredient locally. After pondering the situation for a year, I finally broke down and ordered the frosting, even though I had to buy 8 units (which is what held me back last year). To date, I've used 6 tubs of frosting so it was well worth the wait! Arrived the day after I ordered it and in pristine condition! Recipe was Betty Crocker Super Easy Cherry Almond Fudge if you're interested. Check it out, people were raving over it and it was super easy to make!Betty Crocker Rich & Creamy Frosting, Cherry, 16-Ounce Containers (Pack of 8)

column9: Schmidt Lebkuchen as delicious as always
column10: Grateful that you are offering Schmidt Lebkuchen products after I was unable to find any in New York City this past December.

There are many Lebkuchen out there, even original German ones, but not all are equal, these from E. Otto Schmidt are the best by far. I grew up in Germany and I pretty much know and tasted most of them since I was a little child, you just can't go wrong with the Quality of this company and the customer service (if you buy directly from them). My dad is sending them to me every year now from Germany to the US and one time the delivery person (think it was FedEx) left them out in the snow and the carton got very soggy and some of the content got a little moist inside. I just emailed them and told them what happened just to let them know and they actually send me another box, no further questions asked. That kind of service is almost unheard of nowadays.
My dog loves these chews!  I love that and that they are good for his teeth.  I have shared them with his friends and they love them too.

Discovered this wonderful sauce at a Costco Road Show special in Palm Desert. Used to buy it at the factory store in San Diego, but moved out of the area. Having available through Amazon (especially with free Prime Shipping!) is great! If you ever get to meet old Smokin' Joe himself at a show, you will be smiling all day. I prefer the Spicy, but the regular and mild are equally good. Doesn't burn on the BBQ due to the low or no sugar and gives a wonderful flavor to everything you grill
This is some of the best BBQ sauce ever. Spicy is Spicy. The original is great also. The one called smokin' is ok, just seems so spicy it covers up the meat. Give it a try.

I've made a lot of bread in my day, worked my way through college in a bakery from 1100 to 0300 hrs, and this is one of the easiest and best sourdough breads that I've ever made.  Caution:  I recommend that unless you are an experienced baker, use the "basic" bread machine setting on your machine.  It always comes out perfect and tastes just like you would buy in San Francisco.  You can make it by hand, but unless you know what you are doing the results are less then the excellent product that will come out of your bread machine.  This mix is equal to your own sourdough starter made bread, and that is saying something in this day and age.  A terrific product if you like sourdough bread and do not live in Northern California.  (Oh yes, have to add that you  need to make sure the water you use is at specifically 80 degrees.  Warm tap water will do the trick too.)

column9: Very good in the breadmaker but in oven ....
column10: Before my breadmaker arrived I tried this mix by the Kitchenaid Standmixer, the dough was very sticky, so I've had to add more breadflour. Eventhought the dough was still sticky and I've let them rise almost 4 hours before baking, it came out of the oven very dry and it tasted sour... so so... not really good. The second mix I put in the breadmaker and just let the breadmaker do his job, it came out very good , the taste is perfect. If you have a breadmaker and you like sourdoug bread, you should try this mix
The mix came complete.  I just thought the finish product would be a little more sour, but I liked the product.
This sourdough bread mix was the best I have tasted. The crust was crisp and the taste was wonderful. I would recommend this to anyone that loves breads.
I love sourdough bread, but this is not close to that.  The bread has a sour, unpleasant taste, a gummy texture, and a horrible aroma.  I will never buy this again.
This is a sourdough packaged flower ready to go in a bread machine that gives great results.Great to make when you have guests!
bought 4 packages and had to share 2 of them. The aroma of the bread baking made it hard to wait for it to finish. Eating it hot out if the bread machine is the way to eat it.
Made it in a bread maker. Followed directions. Never browned even a little.Gummy and tough dough, unpleasant taste and texture.  And after all that it isn't even sourdough.Total waste.
I have used this for some time and the sambar comes out tasting good. I would recommend this to anyone wanting to cook sambar quickly and easily.

I bought couple bags of these a while back just intended to use them for Sambar soup, the south Indian breakfast soup. But I have been using it in many other types of dishes, whether they're pan fry dishes of any meat of fish or soup dishes to spice things up here and there, even to spice up canned chilli. A little sprinkle per dish goes a long way. And the two bags lasted more than a year now.  It tastes better than just typical curry powder. If you use it sparingly, it doesn't just make the dish completely like a curry dish, but adds more depth to the dish flavor.
These are wonderful!!!!!These do not make her sick, throw up or go Diarrhea like rawhides. These work great for puppies who are bored and teething. They are health and my puppy loves them!!

The flavor of this coffee is great, it's not over-powering to the point that I can't use my flavored creamers with it. It adds a hint of nut to the coffee and is becoming a favorite flavor of those who come to our house and drink it.

i didn't think my cat could possibly like anything more than weruva canned food... until he tried the weruva pouches. almost all meat with only very tiny pieces of fruit of vegetables added (the bits of pumpkin are super-fine, much smaller than in the canned food). the only downfall is that per ounce they're fairly pricey, and it's hard to get everything out of the pouch because the bottom has a deep fold the food gets stuck in. just make sure you spread out the bottom of the pouch to get everything out -- i like to swish the last bits of meat out with about an ounce of hot water, which turns my cat's dinner into a nice, warm soup.

Since my daughter is allergic to all artificial food dyes we are always looking for new products that she can have.  This not only met our expectations it blew us away!  The flavor is not too sweet, nor is there any strange after-taste.  Very tasty!  This was the first flavor we tried, now we are going to try all of the rest but in the larger bottles.  The bottle is supposed to make about 28 servings at about $5.99 per bottle, so a much better value. We liked them so much that we went through the packets pretty quickly.  The packets are a liquid, not a powder so mix very quickly and are handy.  I think we'll end up getting them off the Flavrz website though since they also have gingerale, rootbeer, cola and many other flavors not available here.  I think that they will also make great freezer pops and sno-cones!
This product is a great alternative to soda and fruit juice. I give these to my baby and that way she gets her daily water intake also.

We ordered with a discount via Amazon automatic purchase option, but it still works out to $0.57 per packet.  We make our own carbonated water and wanted a low calorie, but not artificially sweetened flavoring option.  This fits the bill nicely.  The flavor is quite good and you can split each packet in half to adequately flavor about 6 ounces of water.  However, at the equivalent of $0.57 per "can" the price kills the deal.  It is the same cost as buying high quality soda at the grocery store.  There is another option to buy in bottles which makes more dollars and sense on the surface, but shipping wipes out the cost advantage.  Bottom line, like the product, but won't be buying more due to the price.

These are wonderful! Wasn't sure about getting 6 packs of 6 at first, but they are going quickly. I prefer the 12 ounce dilution that gives you fruit juice (it is not too sweet), to the 20 ounce flavored water which tends to have a bitter edge come out.  Found that they also make wonderful cocktail mixers: over ice Vodka, Cointreau, FlavrZ, and Ginger Ale or Soda water; also mixed with red wine, brandy, & ginger ale makes a great quick Sangria.

I can't say enough about the Flavrz drink mix concentrate Cherry Berry.  Nice addition to water in a restaurant.  You can save money on drinks by carrying these packets in your purse.  You decide what strength you want depending on how much water you add the concentrate to.  Great way to get water in kids just a little sweet but not too sweet.  Certainly better than all the sugary drinks and juices out there.  I will try other flavors of Flavrz.

I get bored with plain water - and I drink a lot every day.  I tried the Cherry Berry Flavrz because I wanted a drink mix that contained NO corn syrups or artificial sweetners.  This product fit the bill AND delivered a great tasting drink.  Low cal, too!  Try it!  It really is good.

I love the smoky, intense flavor.  And it's smooth going down, too! I also love that I can buy it in whole bean so I can grind it as fine as I like. The only downfall:  I can't buy my addiction at the local grocery store.

I was buying Hawke's Special Forces Survival Handbook and figured I give his coffee a try. I'm glad I did! This is some great tasting coffee! I'm use to brewing my own fresh-ground coffee in a french press, and I really like Hawkes stuff! I just wish they sold it in whole bean. I would definitely recommend this to anyone who enjoys a great tasting cup of coffee that has some kick!

I bought this because I like strong coffee and I figured it must have some merit for Hawke to put his name on it. I was not disappointed! It has a great bold flavor with just the right hint of bitterness, it pours a rich and dusky brown, and it's very strong. The first time I made it was on our new coffee maker, which is too austerely Teutonic for me to use, and I added far too much water. Where any normal coffee might have been watered down into oblivion, Cpt. Hawke's coffee still delivered its promised smoky smoothness. Made too strong, it's like being kicked in the face by a dinosaur (which can help some mornings!), but still goes down smooth and tastes great. For the price, this coffee definitely punches above its weight. It costs less than comparable dark Italian roasts that come in shiny tins and, in the opinion of this coffee drinker, it has more personality. I only wish that Amazon carried the whole bean, as this grind is a little bit too coarse for my French press.
Its a very good coffee !!!  A little goes a long way but Im a coffee addict so the stronger the better plusits not bitter and nasty.  Great stuff !!!!!
This doesn't have a weird sugar free taste.  It's the best and I always use it.

column9: Da Vinci Sugar Free Vanilla Syrup with Splenda
column10: I feel in love with Da Vinci Sugar Free Vanilla Syrup with Splenda. I would highly recommend it to anyone.

I've tried different brands and flavors of Stevia. The Stevita brand vanilla flavored is by far the best I've purchased.My husband and I take it with us when we go out to eat or out for coffee.It allows that taste of indulgence without the concern for extra calories or blood sugar spikes.The vanilla flavored also doesn't leave the after taste as some other flavors and brands of stevia.I used to be able to find the Stevita flavored stevia in health or whole food stores,but the cost is much higher ,and they do not keep it stocked.I like the convenience of ordering it on line and being able to get enough of it to where we don't run out of it.It's our sweetner of choice!

With the chocolate and vanilla stevia, I like to make a non-caffeinated hot beverage.  Stevita brand is almost as tasty as Sweetleaf brand, which I had used previously.  The vanilla is a little more vanilla-y than the chocolate is chocolate-y.  I am just not sure, in the long run, whether Stevita's plastic bottle has/will have an effect on the flavor; Sweetleaf is in a glass bottle.

Purchased several flavors while they were on sale.  The lemon and vanilla are both quite good. I use them in tea, and these flavors hold their own. The fruit flavors (peach, mango) seem too mild to make a flavor difference.The directions say one drop per 2 oz, but I end up using closer to 8-10 drops...but I do have a sweet tooth :)

I purchased multiple flavors of the Stevita Stevia drops and was pleasantly surprised. There was no bitter aftertaste and it is indeed very sweet (although I did have to use more than 3 drops to get it as sweet as I like it). The flavor is very mild, sometimes too mild to taste which is a real problem in coffee. I do think some experimenting will take care of that tho :)If you are hesitating, don't. It's worth trying.

column9: Best I've Tried and I've Tried Most!
column10: The only powdered stevia I like is made by Sugar in The Raw. I've tried Truvia, and whatever else...I can't remember names. I only know that they all left that horrid bitter after taste. Bitter in my drug of choice (coffee!) is NOT something I'm willing to tolerate!! Don't mess with my coffee!I just received some unflavored liquid Stevita. This is the absolute BEST one I've tried. I use it in coffee, oats & cream of wheat. I like sweet, and I've been spending a small fortune on the powdered stuff. The liquid will certainly be more cost effective!If you're not a fan of stevia you might not like it. I've found it to be an acquired taste. As far as taste is concerned I still prefer Equal but aspartame has been giving me digestive issues, I can't even chew gum with it any more! So, Stevita it is!!

column9: A Little Goes A Long Way
column10: I've been using the vanilla flavored for around six weeks now to sweeten my coffee. For me it works so much better than splenda which left me with sugar cravings and an upset stomach. I do have to say that it's an acquired taste though, to me it's very sweet but with a bitter undertone that was a little hard to get used to.

I've tried the Chocolate, Cognac and Vanilla.  All leave a bitter taste in coffee.  I mix it 50/50 with liquid Splenda and it isn't bad at all though and the flavor still comes through without being overpowering.
This item has a great taste. I use it in my tea for a touch of sweetness and the essence of vanilla. Great stuff!
Had an acidic taste to me. It did ok at flavoring things, but I didn't think it was sweet enough. I wouldn't buy again.

Just like the toffee flavored, the vanilla has great vanilla bean taste...but the stevia is bitter.  I don't understand this.  I've used other forms of stevia without that bitter taste.  Something of a disappointment.  I'm sticking with my Xylitol.

column9: great Stevia, but 2x price since August!
column10: I love this vanilla-flavored Stevita brand Stevia -- I bought 10 bottles back in August! I was just going to repeat my order today when I found the price nearly doubled! ($2.95 then to $5.59 today). So I'm going to take the suggestion in some other reviews and try another brand: Sweetleaf. I think I'll add this brand to my cart as a hold item so Amazon notifies me when & if the price drops again. :)

I really love this brand.  It's much more reasonably priced than some other brands of flavored liquid stevia  (which, granted, I haven't tried but they seem to cost twice and three times as much and I seriously doubt they could taste that much better) If you use too much of it it will have a kind of bite to it but that's true of ALL types and brands of stevia. It's just the nature of the sweetener.  I wouldn't call it a "chemical" taste though, it's more like a bitter plant taste but it's only if you use too much.  It also tends to get lost in hot drinks.  I dont drink coffee but have made hot cocoa with it and ended up adding too much to get it to stand out and the bitterness came through.  HOWEVER we made the most delicious ice cream with it using 10-15 drops per cup (half vanilla, half chocolate).  You can't even tell it's not regular ice cream.  I highly recommend stevia.  It's natural and you dont have to worry about all the scary aspartame stuff which true or not is still kinda creepy and I'd rather not take the risk.  But I particularly like this brand for it's great price.

I've been using ez-sweetz for a while now, but it's almost always sold out on amazon prime.  So, after reading the reviews posted, I decided to try this vanilla stevia.  Dang!  This is the worst tasing stuff known to man.  There is nothing I dislkie more than black licorice, and this stuff is like concentrated licorice in a bottle--so incredibly NASTY there are no other words that come to mind. Oh, and as an added plus--it's not even sweet. Do yourself a favor and get the ez-sweetz.  Really.  This stuff tastes like poision.  I get chills just thinking about it.
This taste fine. I like some of the other flavors a little better though. What I love the most about this is the price.

I am a diabetic but without a customery ''sweet tooth'', but need my black decaf SWEET and other non sugar things sweetened.  This is so overpoweringly VANILLA that I can't even use in my coffee and it doesn't even sweeten it enough which is the real purpose for which I bought it.  Just beware.  I couldn't FIND any PLAIN unflavored version of this so picked my favorite flavor, vanilla but too overwhelming.  Was looking for Truvia but saw some negative reviews so tried this meanwhile.  Tasted Stevia over a decade ago and hated it, but wanted to try Truvia to see if it's improved yet and haven't.  I use Sweet & Low tablets and liquid. Dr. Richard Bernstein the diabetic guru, says NEVER use the little envelopes of ANY brand sweetner EXCEPT Stevia, nor powdered 'envelopes' of ANY product which are filled with additives for shelflife that liquids nor tablets have. Just a tip. And I believe EVERYTHING Bernstein says, as I always have about Atkins since a kid, but now the company changed and became more commercial.  Using sweetners all my life with a Diabetic mother... and this is many decades later so sweetners have always been a staple in my life since a child thanks to her.  Those are my credentials lol

Great product - zero calories, zero unnatural sweeteners.  Much better for you than sugar, equal, etc ... and for only a few dollars, what do you have to lose?!I add 5 or 6 drops to your coffee and it's perfect (not too sweet, but not too bitter either).  Be warned though that adding too many drops is just overwhelming and makes your coffee taste awful.

Many people think stevia has too much of a licorice flavor.  This vanilla flavored liquid stevia only has a sweet taste with a hint of vanilla.  I have enjoyed it in lattes, tea and with unsweetened yogurt.  Just a few drops add a lot of flavor.  This is a great stevia product.

I was nervous about buying such a small container, but it turned out to be so sweet that it really was a good deal.  The vanilla is very good, too.  My two-year-old son calls his water sippy "cake sippy" when we put only a few drops in for nap and bed time.

column9: Not very sweet and has a slight chemical taste
column10: I was disappointed with this. It doesn't taste that sweet and also has a chemical after taste. Not that vanilla tasting either. It says to use 3 or 4 drops but even using like 20 still didn't taste good

A few drops[!] from this small miraculous bottle immensely enhance your tall glass of pure, thirst-quenching ice water by leaving each sip with a nearly imperceptible splash of vanilla flavor.  Works well to add flavor boost to hot tea, hot cocoa, pancake syrup, and even yogurt.

column9: I like the taste, but the price is ridiculous
column10: The vanilla and mint flavored Stevita drops are my favorite. As with any stevia product, you must be careful of the dosage. Add too much and it will have an aftertaste described in some of the previous reviews. If it tastes funny, try adding less next time.You used to be able to buy this stuff for about $2 a bottle. Why has the price shot up so much?

I recently needed Liquid Stevia to add to a recipe, so I searched on the web for the best price. The product was shipped to me very fast and now I can enjoy my chocolate delight! When you use Stevia on your food, you don't feel like you're on a diet.

My son gave me some of this years ago because he was concerned over my artificial sweetner use (good boy).  I didn't like it and didn't use it-threw it into a drawer.  After I had radiation therapy for cancer, my body would not tolerate my usual sweetner-"you don't want to know the effect"!  I pulled the old (way old)Stevia from the drawer and tried it.  I had no ill effects and found that I actually like it now. I just ordered several bottles of the regular and one of the vanilla.  I do like it and it takes up less space, is easy to take with me in the smaller bottle, and dissolves instantaneously.  I'm convinced that this is my new sweetner and it helps that my body thinks so too.
Love this product in my coffee! The taste it good and not bitter at all. I think most people would agree, so I definitely recommend it!

I bought the vanilla flavored drops and have been using them in plain greek yogurt everyday for lunch, yummy!  It makes the plain yogurt taste sweet and delicious and I always mix in strawberries or blueberries.  Very good and healthy too!  Be careful not to use too much, I only use about 5 drops in a bowl of yogurt.

This product has such a chemical taste to it.  I decided to try a few flavors of Stevita despite some of the bad reviews.  Don't make the same mistake I did.  I'd rather put bleach in my coffee than to ever try this product again
I wasted my money....This stuff is nasty!! I tasted it once, and its been sitting on my counter ever since. I wouldn't recommend this product...

column9: I am nuetral on this product so far...
column10: although admittedly I am new to using Stevia.  I bought two brands to try and so far the other is more satisfying.  I will say in my short experience the vanilla flavor seems to come through better in my iced tea.

I truly hate to 'down' a product, as we all have our preferences.  However if you've never used stevia before and you buy this one, you may be disappointed.  Sweetleaf brand is the ultimate and you aren't spending more money since it has much richer taste and takes far less...  I keep this bottle I bought in my purse for restaurant uses and it is nice for that purpose since it is light weight and perfect size for purse.  It closes firmly as well.  So it does have it's advantages.

Unlike the other reviewer here (who obviously has little experience with this product) and a very unusual dog, I, on the other hand have been through HUNDREDS of these wonderful treats with my dogs.They are formed and roasted (baked) pork skin which is very healthy (97% protein, 4% fat) and 100% digestible!Scott Pet Products are only the BEST quality, which is one reason they don't sell rawhide of ANY kind!
All 5 of our dogs don't like them! Even the two teething puppies leave them alone. Four of our dogs are Australian Shepherd, one is a mixed-breed Chow.

We bought a 30 pack of Pork Earz and my whippet wouldn't touch them.  I even tried hiding some beef in one to get him to try it, and it wasn't worth it to him to eat it to get the beef.  They smell so horrible he was pushing it away from him.

column9: Please dont buy these for your dog
column10: There are not real pigs ears but some kind of manufactured ears out of Pork skin and chemicals.  My dog wouldnt eat them..they smell awful like a chemical smell...we thought maybe he just had to get used to them...left one in his cage..after a week he gnawed on it..eating about 1/3 rd of it and proceeded to vomit all over his cage.....PLEASE PLEASE PLEASE any product such as this  which is "made in China"  should be a red flag I wished I had seen before I fed my poor dog these things.  Arent there enough pigs ears in America?
This message is for concerned parents....I contacted Earth's Best today, and the rep indicated that BPA free packaging in their baby food jars began in October 2011.  Hope this is helpful.

Okay. Im a very cautious parent, but the fact that there is BPA in the lids doesnt affect the food or the quality of it. BPA is an element in plastics that is excess estrogen and its recently become known that its not beneficial to let it enter our bodies. However, BPA is only activated once its been heated and since you arent heating the metal lid, the BPA never enters the food. EB baby food is spectacular especially since its jar food vs frozen/fresh. There are lots of yummy flavors and your baby will probably like most of them. Both of my sons go crazy over the EB varieties and I stick by it- buying it by the case and using the amazon subscription option makes it soo much cheaper than retail! Again... dont freak out over BPA in the lids lol.

I found Earth's Best while shopping at Target and was thrilled to find USDA certified organic baby food. My son loves the apples and pears, the bananas are a little tart but I just add a little rice cereal and it's fine. I love that Amazon.com offers subscribe and save for Earth's Best and at a cheaper price than Target or Babies "R" Us. Great packing and fast delivery!

column9: No more BPA in lids as of October 2011
column10: For all those concerned about the BPA . . . I contacted them directly and was told that as of October 2011 there is no longer BPA in any amount in the lids. I recommended to them that they promote that on their website to make it clear. Otherwise, we love this company and their products, and my babies both love them. So I can only go with the highest rating of 5 stars.

I try to make most of my son's baby food, but mainly stick with veggies.  I wanted to get some good baby fruit choices and I've been really impressed with Earth's Best products.  My little guy LOVES these fruits.  This starter kit contains pears, apples and bananas. column9: Jar covers contain BPA ... So disappointing!
column10: As my baby approaches the stage at which we can introduce solids to her diet, I started doing my research on organic, prepared baby foods.  I was all set to make Earth's Best my brand of choice, since we already use some of their other products (e.g., baby wipes).  But that was until I discovered that the covers of their glass jars contain bisphenol-A (BPA), an endocrine disruptor that can cause negative health effects, especially in vulnerable infants and young children.  Apparently, Earth's Best claims that its jarred baby food has been independently-tested, and found to have undetectable levels of BPA.  However, I'm still skeptical.  In a "perfect lab" setting with a pristine jar of baby food, the BPA may not have had the opportunity to leach from the cover into the baby food.  But in the real world, by the time that jar of baby food reaches the average consumer, it has been turned upside-down and shaken up in the process of packing, shipping, unpacking, shelving, etc.  Plus, many parents warm up their baby food in the jars; and I've heard that heating can increase/speed-up the BPA leaching process.  SCARY STUFF!!  I don't see why Earth's Best doesn't just play it safe and line their baby food jar covers with a resin that doesn't contain BPA.  It's honestly not that hard to do ... Just ask Eden Organics!  The linings of many of their canned vegetables are BPA-free.  Sure, it might increase the cost of the baby food by a bit, but I'm sure I speak for many parents when I say that I'd be willing to pay a little extra just for the peace of mind of knowing that there are no harmful chemicals in my baby's food.  After all, we're willing to spend a bit more for organic baby food to begin with.Earth's Best also makes baby food in BPA-free pouches.  But, to be honest, the company's refusal to acknowledge and correct the problem of BPA in its jar covers has left me with a bad taste in my mouth (pun intended).  So I may just take my "baby-food-business" elsewhere.

This means they are loaded with antioxidants as well as added vitamins and minerals.  Whey protein is the first ingredient so you get 20% (11 grams) of your daily protein requirement.  And this little bar also has 3 grams of fiber or 12 % of your daily needs.  It does contain milk and soybeans and is made in a facility that makes other products using wheat, tree nuts, peanuts and eggs so if you have allergies to these items, don't buy this product.  If you or anyone in your family needs a quick meal (200 calories/bar) on the go....I recommend this really delicious bar.
I eat a lot of power bars, and these are pretty good after a run.

SoLo bars seem to me to be a somewhat unique combination of a high level of healthy protein with significant fiber and moderate fat and natural sweetening SoLo Bars, Berry Bliss, 1.76-Ounce Bars (Pack of 12)SoLo Bars, Lemon Lift, 1.76-Ounce Bars (Pack of 12)SoLo Bars, Peanut Power, 1.76-Ounce Bars (Pack of 12).  They do not have overwhelming amounts of any vitamin or mineral.  They are sufficiently low in iron to be healthy for a man of which I am one.  They are neither dry nor do they stick to your teeth.  I love the Berry Bliss flavor but I feel sure the other flavors are good, too.
I have tried other bars and this has great flavor and does not taste like you are giving up anything.The lemon is also good.

The Solo Lemon Lift bars are the best tasting bars out there!  Great lemon taste and a good texture.  These bars keep you satisfied and are a great snack between meals or before exercise, etc.  The Chocolate Charger is the best-tasting chocolate bar also.  I buy them both on a regular basis!
I love these.  I have to hide them from my kids or I won't get any.  They are really really tasty, filling and don't spike my blood sugar.

Solo bars are so delicious, especially the Lemon Lift flavor.  I grab one on the go at lunch time and it keeps me going until dinner.  One of the best bars of this type I have ever had.  I am a fitness trainer and I recommend them to my clients of which some are diabetics and they love the Solo bars.  They do not experience the sugar spike and drop like with other bars or like candy bars.  Great product!

This is the best tasting bar on the market.  It also has great pick-me-up.My daughter loves them and she is picky.  She wants me to order more!I also want to order more.  Thanks for a great bar.Sincerely,Rochester,ny

After trying several kinds of "breakfast type" bars, this is the one I love the best and keep coming back to.  It satisfies the need to chew and sustains you a long time.  My favorite is the Lemon, and then the Berry.  So many bars are chocolatey and I'm not a chocolate lover, or are made of nothing but lightweight cereal as the main ingredient, and that doesn't stay with you much longer than it takes to chew it.

Seeing the all the positive reviews, I figured I would give these bars a try and maybe to have an alternative bar for all Atkins bars I eat.  So much for the good reviews, and supposed use by Olympic athletes.  First thing I noticed the pronounced chocholate flavor which overpowers your taste buds.  The bars also have a rather bland and sugary taste.  I have tried all the Aktins bars, and virtually all of them are superior to this bar (I have no affiliation with Atkins).  All my family members pretty much agreed with my opinions on the taste.  These bars fit into the category of the barely edible health bars (the great majority of health bars are awful). Maybe other brands of Solo are better, but I'm not going to waste my money trying them.

I have used this product for at least six months & was delighted to find it available on the web.  I got my first one from my naturopath.  The price is the same but this was delivered right to my door.  The web said it would be 5 to 7 days but I was delighted when it arrived in 2 days!!  One jar lasts me about a month & that is with one protein shake a day.  I like to use the smoothie maker with mine & put juice in first.  I also use kefir with it.
This is a great product that I enjoy every day in a breakfast shake.  Lots of nutritional value which helps maintain my health.  Highly recommend this product.  Shipping is extremely fast!
DFH paleo cleanse has become part of my daily routine.  Nothing that I have tried - vitamins, powders, etc. has given me the energy and vitality that this product delivers.

column9: Misleading name to an awful product
column10: I am a Paleo dieter by the strictest sense, meaning I avoid grains, soy, legumes, and all other non-Paleolithic carbohydrates.  I purchased this product with the assumption that it would fall under these guidelines (that and I couldn't find a decent review that discussed what was in this product).  The main source of protein is from peas, being a legume and containing anti-nutrients and lechtins.  Why of all sources of protein this company decided to choose this plant is beyond my understanding.  Protein from plants, especially legumes, are not easily digestible and can actually cause you to gain weight, let alone get in the way of detoxifying your body.  There are unnatural percentages of vitamins and stimulants such as taurine (major energy drink ingredient) that it shouldn't be taken by any person whether following a Paleo diet or not.  And the #1 complaint of this product that shouldn't even be a factor in dismissing this product: THE TASTE!  Out of all my experiences with powdered drinks, I've never had one that 1)looked like bile/urine, 2)taste like bile, 3) mixed incredibly poor until I wasted $60 on this atrocity of a "supplement".  I'm sure there are cleanses that work out there, but do your body, taste buds and wallet a favor and steer clear from this product.  It does not belong in the Paleo diet, it doesn't belong in any healthful diet, and it's barely a supplement in the general sense.

column9: five star coffee at a one star price
column10: It's no surprise that there are so few reviews on Amazon for this coffee. While it is one of my favorite bold coffees, probably as good as Timothy's dark roasts (generally $19.00 to $23.00 on amazon in a similar pack); this price, in bulk, is fully 20 cents a serving higher than the 12 pack in my local grocery store. Don't buy it here!

I bought the Tully's Extra Bold sampler pack because I got some Tully's Kona with my Keurig and while I like all the flavors in the pack (French Roast, Kona, House Blend, and Italian Roast), Italian Roast is by far my favorite.  A little sweet, fairly strong, no bitterness or smokey flavor.  This one's going on my recurring order (along with Newman's Own Extra Bold).

column9: Bold, Espresso Coffee with clean finish
column10: This is a bold cup of coffee--very Italian: dark, sensuous, and free of the smoky aftertaste that usually plagues espresso coffees. A nice 6 oz. coffee cup to enjoy with some frothy half and half and a first-rate homemade biscotti.
Just trying some new coffee out and this stuff was pretty good. Still haven't found a favorite yet but I will mix this in every once in a while

I fell in love with Stash chocolate mint tea two years ago.  I am thrilled to be able to buy it now in an economical and environmentally friendly way.  This is used for my private use and I've felt uncomfortable with all the many boxes I've gone through in order to have my six bag a day tea fix.  If you are a tea junkie and care about our landfill situation then go for broke and purchase this way and save yourself a couple of hundred bucks.

I have tried many OOlong teas and this is by far the best.  It has a wonderfully light coconut, mango flavor.  The two flavors blend well together, neither one overpowering the other.  I will definitely buy again.
really nice tea, and smells wonderful. I enjoy it with a teaspoon of "sugar in the raw."  Stores well as is wrapped in foil. I usually buy the box of 100 teabags since it is an excellent value

column9: A ginormous box of 1,000 tea bags
column10: Stash Chamomile Herbal Tea is tea bags with dried, crushed chamomile flowers.Honestly, as far as I'm concerned, chamomile is chamomile. I suppose that when you use loose flowers you get sediment in the cup and I have seen this happen with some brands of chamomile tea bags, these don't do that.I have also had organic chamomile (this isn't) but I can't taste the difference.Each bag is individually packaged and that is either good or bad depending on how and where you use it and if you are concerned about excessive packaging.If you really, truly like chamomile tea, or own a restaurant, this ginormous box of 1,000 single-serving tea bags is a good choice.
Fast shipping. Smells good when you open the tea bag - tastes like watered down coffee with a faint mint aftertaste. Not recommended.
The item arrived very quickly as described and it was fresh, with aa expiration date that was a year out.

We too received a gift basket with many items and were skeptical as well, however everything in the basket was delicious. We especially liked the Sonoma Jacks Garlic & Herb cheese spread.  We are looking forward to buying more!

column9: The best food product in the Market
column10: Sonoma Jacks are one of the best "Pasteurized process cheese spread with Garlic & spices" on the Market.  When you spread them around crackers or bread, you feel "Garlic & Herb"  which is very delicious serving for parties or personal occasions.  These Sonoma Jacks are very rare, and can't be found in Markets or Internet.  So, ones you find them, don't hesitate to snag them or they will be gone for months.  God bless this company for bringing an excellent quality product to the Market.

We recieved a gift basket for the holidays......I was sceptical about its contents..well i was blown away with its items.....they all were exceptionally good... Especially..... the sonoma jacks  garlic & herb cheese spread..........EXCELLENT!!!!!!

My little dog gets 1/2 a denta-delicious bone every night. She gets other treats during the day, but nothing makes her more excited than getting her denta-delicious bone.  My local store stopped selling these bones so I tried replacing them with other brand bones for a while.  For her, there was no suitable replacement. So I found them here, online, and now she's happy again!  I would highly recommend these bones!

column9: Good quality Pet food, PETA APPROVED!
column10: My cats love the food, and it's on the HAPPY list of "Companies that Don't Test on Animals" linked through the PETA site, peta.org.  That is VERY reassuring.

I have 16 cats ranging from 1 to 11 yrs old and every single one of them likes this.  I have tried Wellness, Holistic, Avoderm, Chicken Soup for the..., Merck Homestyle, BG (Before Grain), California Natural, and Evangers with mixed results.  This is the first canned food that all of them will not only eat but eat all of it.  I've fed them the Chicken and Liver flavor and the Seafood flavor so far and they seem to like both equally.  I find it a bit more expensive than I had hoped it would be, but then again there is no waste and I consider that in itself a savings alone.  I'm a firm believer in better ingredients and less fillers and allergens make for less poop, less litter use, fewer trips to the vet and an overall healthier cat.UPDATE:  I have tried all the flavors on my cats and the chicken and liver seems to be the one they like the most.  They have now officially rejected all the other flavors including the seafood flavor that they originally liked.  I also wanted to add that this is a very STRONG smelling brand of cat food, almost overpowering when I open the cans at feeding time.

column9: Nice to find product thats safe
column10: Our older cat is having some health issues, which I "suspect" could have been caused by pet foods many of us buy in local stores. We've been on a mission to find a healthy pet food we could trust after all the pet food recalls. After going through way too many products trying to find one that did all it claimed to do, we found the PetGuard line of food. This one really does appear to be all it claims to be and our cats are thriving on it! Our older cat loves it and is acting more like a kitten than he's acted in years. Both of our cats fur is silky and smooth and they seem to have endless energy, not to mention they love this stuff! Our youngest cat has digestion problems and most cat foods give him horrible gas.. But not this cat food! He isn't having any digestion problems at all..Both our cats love the "fish,chicken & liver" dinner but our older cat isn't crazy about the "seafood savory dinner". He'll eat it but much prefers the fish,chicken and liver.From my point of view, the fish, chicken and liver dinner doesn't smell too bad, but the seafood savor dinner smells really bad!One problem I have with the food I've purchased from Amazon is that every single can in the case has been dented. I've purchased 2 cases and it's been the same with both cases.. I've purchased this from other vendors and never received a dented can, so this seems to be an Amazon problem.. Not sure why, but some of the cans are really hard to open!I'm relieved to finally find a food I'm not afraid to feed my pets.. I've read articles about this food that state the meat used in it is a grade that can be consumed by humans. That makes me feel much better about what my cats are eating.UPDATE:It's been about a year since we started using this and our older cat is doing very well on it. Amazon was out of stock once when I needed to reorder, so I purchased another organic brand. Not only did our older cat turn up his nose to the other brand, but so did our 2 other cats. They would not eat the other kind, so when Pet Guard was back in stock, I ordered another case and the cats were happy kitties! They all love this stuff.. I think it stinks, but apparently, that's part of the attraction for them.

column9: Good value, cats don't like it
column10: I really wanted this food to work, as it seems to have good ingredients for a decent price.  However, my cats, who are typically ravenous little mongrels, don't even bother to check it out when offered.  So much for saving a couple of bucks--now they eat Organix.

I've been using this all natural cat food for a few years when I could afford it but didn't think to shop where I buy my books.  With free shipping I only wish Amazon offered a few more flavors.  Since many commercial cat foods are made with Grade D mest (not fit for human consumption) I am delighted to have this choice.

column9: NOTHING BUT THE BEST 4 MY CATS
column10: I have found this cat food to be the purrfect choice for both my cat with IBD and my cat with Diabetes. Howard and Miss C are thriving on this diet of Turkey and brown rice and  enjoy it so much more than prescription diets. The price was great too for a premium cat food.
My cats love this food. They always lick every last morsel of it. I love it too because it is one of the best values for a high-quality canned food.

column9: Cats seem to like this food, nice to have it delivered!
column10: I have three cats... have had cats for years, this food smells better than most, my cats like it, the ingredients appear to be better than the average cat food. So far, so good! i'll continue to use it for my cats

column9: Great quality food and my cats LOVE it.
column10: I've been on the hunt for high quality cat food that doesn't cost a fortune. After a lot of research at various sites Petguard was one on my list to try, so I ordered a case from amazon and couldn't be happier. 2/3 of my cats LOVE it, the 3rd cat is a dry food addict and I'm in the process of trying to convert her but it's slow going. Be warned though, this stuff smells terrible, opening a can and dishing it out is like being slapped in the face with a week old mackerel, but that's how cats like it.Bottom line this food is reasonably priced and high quality. It has low carbs, low ash/magnesium, high protein, real human grade meat with no by-products, the vitamins/minerals are chelated for better absorption and Petguard has stated they do not use BPA lined cans. Also, contrary to what the ingredient list here on Amazon says it does NOT contain "Menadione Sodium Bisulfite" or at least the case I ordered doesn't have any listed, so they must have stopped using it, which is a big plus.

column9: Highest quality, delicious food for your cats!
column10: My cats both LOVE this food.  I've had varying success with about 7 different kinds of canned food.  This one is a hit with both.  It's natural, mostly organic, doesn't have any junk or fillers, and I have peace of mind knowing that we're giving them high quality food from an ethical company.  Since they've been on this diet they are more active, alert and happy.  Their coats are so soft and shiny and they seem to be shedding less.  Cannot say how relieved I am to have finally found a food they like that is so good for them as well.  It is pricey but if you want to save on costly vet bills down the road due to illness caused by poor nutrition, this is the way to go.

column9: kittens will eat it as a last resort
column10: bought both the savory seafood and the chicken and wheat germ, as the kittens liked the fish, chicken and liver flavor.  They are not so fond of it, but will eat if there is nothing else.  Also, they will only eat it as soon as a can is opened, there is no hope of putting half a can in tupperware and feeding it to them later. Oh, yeah, and STINKY.  But a good product if your kitty likes the taste.

column9: Cat Loved it.. BUT....Their hair started to fall out.
column10: Used for less then 2 months both cats fur began falling out bad.Stopped using it & the cats fur is back to fine.Back to feeding my cats Nature's Variety instinct.I baught this PetGaurd product at Fairway Market not Amazon.Will not use it again.

column9: 5 cats - all love it! Great food for a good value.
column10: I have 5 cats on this food as well as the seafood. This is their favorite, but they will eat the seafood as well. My old gentleman, 16 this year, loves it, and is doing very well on it. Quality ingredients for a fair price. I do agree with the one reviewer who said the cans were all dented and hard to open. Mine have been the same with every shipment. Don't know if that's why the price is so good or not.

column9: as long as he likes it...
column10: i'm giving this a solid 5, because my old but healthy cat loves this stuff and it's wicked good for him, but i'll tell you right now that this stuff looks and smells quite gross; as long as i don't have to eat it, it's all good.

column9: It's cat food, they eat it, seems pretty healthy
column10: The cats like this stuff pretty well, for the health of our felines we keep them on an all-canned food diet. This is one of their favorite flavors, I will admit that sometimes you can see bits of fish bone in the can, but the food seems to be of high quality. I wish Amazon woudl carry the organic versions of petguard canned food for cats.

column9: The cat likes it, I haven't tried it
column10: What can I say? It's cat food but without stuff in it cats shouldn't be eating. It is her favorite flavor, but that depends on the cat.

column9: So far she loves it! But....
column10: I just got this and so far my finicky cat loves it!One of my friends recommended I try this for my cat as she has allergiesthat we think are food allergies and so far nothing else has helped.Friend's cat no longer has allergies on this food and I hope the same for mine; only time will tell.Addendum:  She still loves it but for $20 plus in shipping which it now is, I'll be switching to something else.
My cats love the food, and it's referenced on the list of "Companies that Don't Test on Animals" through the PETA web site.

column9: It would be nice it they ate it
column10: I felt really good about being a good cat mommy and buying something of such quality for my sweeties... Too bad none of the would eat it, no matter what I did.Donated it to the local SPCA -- maybe a dog will eat it.

This is an excellent quality product. I have a Siberian Husky, a breed which loves fish. I have hard time finding fish in canned dog food, so I feed this food to my cat and dog and they both love it. It has rice flour but no rice in it. My cat doesn't like the foods with rice, but she loves this. Sky and Peaches highly recommend this food!
I used to order this product at 25 per box of 12 cans and now it turned into 50 dollars??? how did it double out of nowhere??

I fell in love with this coffee when I lived in Europe and was delighted when I found it at Amazon. The aroma and flavour are sensational. The canister looks nice and has a screw-on lid that keeps the coffee fresh. I kept a few of my canisters and reused them for other things. My single serve stove-top espresso maker and this coffee are all I need for the best morning pick-me-up. Restaurant coffee pales in comparison.

column9: The best burnt pretzels you will ever eat
column10: I absolutely love these pretzels. Every time I am in PA for work I pick up several bags which last no more than a couple of days since I have got a number of co-workers hooked on them.  The company also offers other pretzels that are all very good and I would suggest people check them out.  I am hooked on these pretzels for life.

I first found these pretzels in Williamsburg, VA.  Never seen them on the west coast.  Once I ran out of my first three bags, of course I looked for them on Amazon.  They are purposely cooked a little too long, giving them a wonderful burnt flavor.  If you like burnt pretzels or burnt French bread, you will love these!  And the texture is crisp, without being hard.  Only problem is that you have to order a whole case.

column9: This is not the tea storage box you are looking for!
column10: If you are looking for a tea storage box, and happen to stumble upon Amazon's subscribe and save page on two leaves and a bud tea presentation box, please note that teas are included, even though Amazon specifically says "Two Leaves and a Bud Bamboo Presentation Box (Tea Not Included)". This is a problem, as if you don't like the box, you cannot return it. And, in my case, bamboo box is poorly constructed and edges are not properly put together (gaps, rough edges, low quality construction). Definitely not what I would consider a presentation box!And, if you are wondering about the product dimensions (as they were not listed on the page, but provided by one of the reviewers), here they are (in inches):- outside dimensions: 15 3/4 x 7 x 4 1/4- inside sections: ~3 1/2 x 3 1/4 and true to the picture, there are 8 sectionsI can't comment on the tea, as I haven't tasted it yet.PS. Yes, I did think it was strange for Amazon to offer subscribe and save on a bamboo box.... But there was nothing on the product information to indicate this was anything but an empty box! And, I have seen stranger things :)

column4: A. Smothers "All who wander are not lost..."
column10: I was shocked! I was looking for a basic bamboo tea box, and I ran across this box from one of my personal favorites, "Two Leaves and a Bud", so I gave it a shot. Upon delivery, I was pleasantly surprised to notice the build quality & the size of this box. It is absolutely huge. I actually use this at my office now as my "tea chest" and currently I have 6 varieties of Green and White tea and it holds over 140 packets of bag tea at this time. I see where it was "rated" for 80 bags and with the official "Two Leaves and a Bud" packs, it does tend to fill up slightly quicker, but I still can fit at least 120 without any problem or damage to the tea inside the sections.Since there are no other pictures with this listing, it is really hard to imagine the inside. The bamboo top is hinged and made of great quality. It is very cleanly and precisely separated into 8 individual box cubes defined by hand-placed bamboo wall dividers between each section. It is quite simply a very beautiful and amazingly priced tea box that I envision will last for many years to come.The only caveat which is small (in ideology but the reason for my 1 star deduction) is the bold graphical logo. It is quite large in reality and does stretch at least 8" across both the top AND the INSIDE cover of the box. I thought that the advertising could have been more understated, almost generic and perhaps used Japanese symbols for wellness, green tea or just happiness for the interior cover instead of just another loud bit of advertising. (But this is purely cosmetic in nature and may not offend anyone else out there)Bottom-line: Here's to a wonderful box for a great price.Cheers!

I should have paid attention to the negative reviews, I guess. I was looking for an inexpensive tea chest. Nothing fancy, just a basic box. After waiting from September 24 (when I placed the order) till today, October 4, the tea chest finally arrived. The logo on the outside of the box is facing the wrong direction which is really irritating -- but even better is the fact that the logo INSIDE the chest is also facing the wrong direction (ie: it's upside down). I realize you get what you pay for but for $20 I would have expected that the logos would at least be properly applied. Beyond that, it's at least fairly well made, and the hinges line up and so on. It's just the logos totally destroy the look of the chest and you can't even remove the lid and put it on properly because of the way it's made. Don't waste your money, is my vote. Oh, and incidentally, a bunch of people were saying that the tea IS included -- it was not included with mine. Despite the fact that the tea is NOT included and the logos are improperly applied, this item is "ineligible for return" so I am stuck with the upside down logos. Swell. Save your money, unless you're willing to be stuck with it. :/

column9: Great tea chest, especially for the price!
column10: This isn't the fanciest case, but the wood is smooth and it's nice and large.  I've already ordered a second one for a gift.  The hinge mechanism is pretty smooth, but there is a little clicking sound when opening or closing the case.  The divisions inside the case were put in from the bottom before it was glued on, so they don't come out (i.e. you can't choose larger or smaller compartments), the upside being that they're nicely stable.  The brand name on the inside of the box is slightly crooked.  You may be able to tell if you look at one of the pictures closely.  It doesn't bother me.  The logos are not carved into the case.  They are more like stamps, so if you wanted to paint/decoupage over them, you wouldn't need to fill them first.  Importantly (I know I was wondering this!), the measurements of the box are: 40cm long x 18cm deep x 9.75cm high.

This box is beautiful, and designed specifically for tea bags from Two Leaves and a Bud, which are larger than normal because they are for brewing a "mug" of tea rather than a "cup" and because they put whole loose-leaf tea leaves into their tea bags instead of tea "powder" like other brands. I'm happy I got a chance to buy this box on Amazon, because the Two Leaves site is no longer offering the empty box for sale - you have to buy a more expensive set already filled with tea flavors that you might not necessarily want. I recommend this box.

My husband just bought this for me as a Christmas gift and I love it.  It is a great size and fits so many individually wrapped tea bags.  I like the look of the bamboo and don't mind the large Two Leaves and a Bud logo.  It's nice that you can really store and display a lot of tea and the lid still closes perfectly!  I love pulling out this box during a party or gathering to have my guests choose their tea from.  -Kelly

column9: Perfect for holding wider-sized tea bags
column10: Like many reviewers reviewing this product, I'm a huge tea drinker. I'm a big fan of Two Leaves and a Bud--both their tea bags and loose teas--but the primary reason I purchased this tea box is because it holds wider-sized tea bags. This is a huge plus for me and would definitely recommend the box to those who are looking to house pyramid-shaped tea bags.-Construction seems solid. Also, the logos (both on top and on the inside) are facing the correct direction and not crooked.-Love the natural, light-colored wood, but would've preferred a slightly more polished finish. (I get the sense that a splinter is in my future, hence the four-star, not five-star, review.)-Doesn't hold as many tea bags as I would like. It holds about 100 (?) right now, which is an okay, decent amount, but more is better!

Tea box arrived in perfect condition. Logos placed correctly inside and out. I LOVE the look and size of this box. No problem with the hinges either. Sorry to say no mistake was made with adding tea bags that were not supposed to be there....just received the empty box.....great deal all by itself!

This is the best strawberry jam ever.  We've tried all the gourmet brands as well as homemade jams from the farmers market but this beats them all by a mile.  It tastes less like sugar and more like ripe strawberries.  The texture is also better because the fruit is puréed so it spreads smoothly.  AND it's organic. :-)

Great product at a good price.  It used to be possible to buy edible silver and gold leaf (vark) at Indian groceries, but there seem to be problems nowadays importing it.  So I was thrilled to find it here on Amazon.  You can use the silver leaf to cover an entire cake, if you wish.  I made an Indian-inspired cheesecake, putting a thin layer of rose-petal jam on top of the cookie crumb/nut base, making a traditional cheesecake filling using rosewater for flavoring, and then covering it with silver vark.  It was an amazing success -- nobody had ever seen anything like it before and they were just fascinated by it!  To cover the cake, just carefully slide the sheets of silver onto the cake from the paper leaves they're packed on.  Smooth the silver using a brush, like a cosmetic brush.  It won't be perfectly smooth, but good enough to impress your guests.  You can further decorate the cake with some silver dragees, if you wish.  Don't overdo, but it doesn't hurt to be a bit excessive with a dessert like this!!!
This product was awful. Difficult to use without it sticking to your fingers. It tasted metallic. I am just glad I ordered one packet to test before investing. Yuk!

Bought this as a birthday gift for my sister. Nice little decadent treat for her to share on girls night. She said she isn't sharing. She will tell them they can order from Amazon.com if they want some. I have decided that Amazon Prime is the only way to go for gifts. I don"t bother with wrapping paper. No one seems to mind. I haven't had any complaints.

column9: Truffles are excellent, of course, but watch shipping conditions!
column10: Lindor extra dark truffles are among the most amazing food in the world...  Rich creamy goodness that's simply amazing.  And Amazon's prices are as good as I've seen.  However, be careful when you purchase these via mail order!  If the weather (or the shipper's warehouse, or the delivery vehicle) gets too warm, you'll have mis-shapen, messy truffles.  They still taste good, but if you're ordering these for gifts or otherwise need them to look good, I recommend you shop locally where you can check them out firsthand and you have more control of environmental conditions.
Great price!  My family loves dark chocolate and lindt products.  Gave 2 boxes as Christmas gifts and they loved them.  Can't say enough for lindt truffles.

The vendor, Penguin Mints, shipped these to me in a weird white box with tape wrapped around it.  These should have been in a sealed/unopened original Lindt box as depicted in the picture.  I can't give these away, I don't know if they have been tampered with or what.

I was not a big fan of dark chocolate but these chocs made me one! I just fell in love with them the moment I ate my first one. I ordered them to gift a friend but ended up eating all of them in just 3 days:-)The only downside is--- had to order one more box for my friend:-)

column9: Very aromatic and flavorful, and a great value
column10: Want some freshly ground nutmeg flavor but without having to grind whole nutmeg? These little nutmeg grinders are great and measure up. True, there might be some loss of aroma since the nutmeg is in chunks rather than whole, but I've found these grinders and the nutmeg they contain to be very flavorful -- and certainly much more so than the pre-ground nutmeg you get in shaker bottles.Be sure to store these in a dark cupboard, and if possible, don't store them too near the stove or other heat source, as that can degrade the quality of your herbs and spices pretty quickly. When I had a spice rack, I used to transfer any of my herbs and spices into dark spice containers to help keep some of the light out.I found these nutmeg grinders to be a great value and very convenient to use.

column9: Go with the TV cooks on this one
column10: I still have one of these sitting around from way back when whole nutmeg was only known in culinary schools. Nutmeg is particularly notorious for losing its flavor quickly when ground, so all cooks who use nutmeg regularly know that you have to use the nutmeg minutes after you grind/grate it. From this standpoint, it is better than the ground nutmeg every big-brand spice vendor under the sun sells-- which is to say, it's better than sawdust.The moment I decided never to use plastic spice grinders again was when I made some pumpkin pie with this stuff, because one of the first things I noticed was that I could feel the bits of nutmeg in the final product, kind of like tiny corn cob bits. I also noticed that while the nutmeg flavor wasn't completely gone, it wasn't as strong as it was when we first bought it, because this is filled with chunks of nutmeg rather than whole nuts-- that increases the surface area and the rate of loss of volatile flavor compounds.This stuff works okay in things like oatmeal cookies, where you're not going to notice the texture of the rather coarsely ground nutmeg. But for anything else, you're best off doing what the TV cooks do, and getting whole nutmeg and a grater like this Microplane Stainless Steel Zester and just grating a little off into the dish you're making. The flavor will be stronger, there won't be any grit from the nutmeg, and you will have a nice tool for other tasty things like citrus zest and Parmesan cheese. Plus, you can easily find whole nutmeg now online or in some brick-and-mortar markets.
