This is a good mild coffee for the drinker that doesn't like a strong bold blend in the morning.  I don't like a burnt tasting coffee and this is the one I like the best.

I buy K-cups all the time and it was nice to buy a double pack for less money than I would have paid in the store. The breakfast blend is not a bold coffee. Being rather mellow and not bitter and with no after taste. If you are looking for a mild tasting coffee this would be a good choice.
If you're more of a Dunkin Donuts or Diner-style coffee person, this is great coffee.

Good cup of coffee. If you are looking for a nice cup to wake up to, this is it. Light blend, no overpowering taste. I prefer bolder blends but my husband likes light - so this was our compromise blend, and I enjoy it as much as he does.
My preference is Green Mountain Breakfast Blend.  It is never bitter or too strong.  I like coffee, but those strong ones just don't make it with me.  Give me the mild ones any day.

I love this coffee.  I like light roast, but many of them have little flavor.  Green Mountain Breakfast Blend has a nice smooth, full taste without being harsh.  The flavor of some dark roasts leave me with the impression I could get the same effect by just licking the bottom of a dirty ashtray.  (Sorry, dark-roast lovers - I tend to be overly sensitive to bitterness.)

My favorite blend of coffee for my Keurig. I've tried about 15 different flavors but this is by far my favorite.  Very smooth and not overpowering or bitter.  Was buying at Walmart but they stopped stocking it.  Found it at Amazon for the same price.

You can't make a better cup of regular coffee flavored coffee than Green Mountain Nantucket Blend at home. I had been trying in every way imaginable for nearly forty years to accomplish this. However sometimes I feel like something a tad bit lighter for that first cup in the morning. Enter Green Mountain Breakfast Blend. It's exactly what that first cup calls fall. A slightly lighter version of Nantucket Blend, yet it still has the subtle punch you're looking for.

column9: Best value for a K-cup coffee
column10: Green Mountain Breakfast blend coffee is a mild roast that goes down easy in the morning.  My wife actually runs a cup through the Keurig twice.  Buying it this way breaks down to 50 cents per K-cup versus a dollar at any store.
Love this coffee, it has just the right amount of flavor, is not to strong or to light. I have several cups through the day and enjoy everyone of them.
Green Mountain Breakfast Blend coffee is the best!  I love the smooth, but robust taste!  I can hardly wait to smell and taste my coffee every morning!

This is my every day coffee. It's a smooth coffee with no bitter after taste. This is not the coffee for those who like a strong cup of coffee. This coffee is for those who don't like to drink coffee that has been sitting  on a burner for hours but like the first cup of fresh coffee

This particular k-cup has become my favorite and I've had just about all of them from every k-cup maker.  I still enjoy many others, but this one is perfection. I love, love, love it! Funny thing is it took me about a year to try it. Something about the packaging made me think it might be horrible. I was dead wrong. It's perfect. If you're a k-cupper, and there are lots of us now; don't let this one pass you by.

i've been using these k-cups for months now.  the breakfast blend is perfect for people who don't like a very strong bitter coffee in the morning.  the coffee from the breakfast blend is wonderful... not too strong, not overwhelming, but delicious.

column9: Green Mountain Coffee Keurig Breakfast Blend
column10: I give this 5 stars. This is my favorite of all the K cups I've tried. Trust me I have tried a lot. If you like a mild coffee you will love this one.
Great coffee. Arrives when you folks say it is to be delivered.  Will continue to purchase 2 pack from Amazon when it is on sale. Very easy to place an order.
Good Product.  For heavy coffee drinker it is a little expensive but well worth the price if you only dring 1 or 2 cups a day, Service from vendor was splendid.
This product makes a good cup of coffee at a reasonable price for the Keurig coffee maker and I would recommend it.

This is my favorite K-cup and one my husband and I can agree on (I prefer darker roast, he likes a lighter roast coffee).  It holds up well to the cream and Splenda I add.However, this price is outrageous.  Far more than I pay at the grocery store.
I have tried about a dozen different flavors of the k-cups and this one is just right. The perfect blend.
I just love the breakfast blend.  I hate bitter, strong coffee and rarely made coffee b/c it was awful.  I became a DD lover and now I have the K-cups to drink at home.

I love my Breakfast Blend coffee from Green Mountain. It light without a bitter aftertaste. It is a good everyday morning cofffee for me I would  recommend this to anyone who likes a light not bitter cooffe if you like a really strong cup of joe in the morning this isn't you coffee
This has a really nice flavor.  Would not hesitate to buy it again but probably not from Amazon or its vendors as they are overpriced.
I like this blend but the price is ridiculous. Found them at winn Dixie (and other flavors) $7.99 for a pack of 12.

After pricing out different places to purchase this coffee as a gift, we realized that Amazon was able to provide us with so many K-Cup options but we love Green Mountain it has great flavor for a morning or evening cup. Enjoy!! You will Not be disappointed in this purchase!!

column9: Great for those who don't like strong coffee in the morning
column10: My wife and oldest son don't like a strong coffee, so the Green Mountain Breakfast Blend works great for them. While I myself prefer the Coffee People's Organic, which is darker and more robust - similar to some of the blends found at Starbucks (not their regular blend). The Organic is strong enough for them to re-use once, after I've had the first brew.I also love that we can get the double pack of the Breakfast Blend 24 K-Cups inexpensively from Amazon. We purchase the Coffee People Organic in the 50-K-cup boxes.

Green Mountain Breakfast Blend is an excellent light roast coffee served in a K-Cup.  Smooth, silky,it has a gentle flavor yet enough of a robust coffee flavor to allow a very pleasurable experience.  Highly recommended.
This is my favorite keurig coffee. I prefer it over any starbucks or dunkin or any other coffee. Nice and smooth taste without a usual bitter aftertaste. I's the perfect cup of coffee.
This is the best k-cup coffee I've had.  Its bold smooth flavor is great for bkfst, but just as good to enjoy w/desserts or an afternoon pick-me-up.  I love it!

column9: Lets rate the flavor shall we. The price will always fluctuate.
column10: The price of this has been fluctuating forever on amazon. This listing is the same one that different sellers will use. Some are better than others but the reviews stay with the product regardless of who is selling it at the moment. Until it becomes available as a frustration free 50 count box from amazon this is what we will have to deal with. There is another seller that offers free shipping on the 108 count box every once and a while and its free shipping for everyone not only amazon prime members. when you see it available do not hesitate on getting it. It goes fast because of the free shipping. It is still a little high at about 57 cents per cup but 43 is the lowest I have ever seen.This is our favorite everyday coffee. It is what we call "normal" coffee. It's not mild or bold or flavored its just a great medium body cup of joe.When you register your brewer with Keurig. You will be offered some free coffee. I would suggest you get this as your free coffee. You will also be offered free shipping with that order. So buy a lot of the 5 pack samplers and get the most out of the free shipping.

It's some good Joe. If you are looking for a mild to medium breakfast coffee to start your engine in the morning, this is the real deal.  It's the kind of coffee that when you inhale the fresh steam before the first sip, you get goose bumps. Definitely full of flavor without any hint of bitterness. Drink it black and enjoy.
K-Cups are great if you only drink one cup a day otherwise it could get expensive.  This flavor is good for the basic coffee drinker, no funky flavors added, just basic coffee.
Green Mountain is one of my favorite coffee brands.  Breakfast blend is mellow and a great way to start your day.

column9: Over a dollar for a K-cup?
column10: The coffee is good but the price is ridiculous($1.25 each K-cup approx).  You can get it from Green Mountain for 75 cents a K-cup (delivered) which is still too much. Buy it for 60 cents a K-cup at Bed, Bath and Beyond or Kohls.

Do not buy this blend if you prefer dark and bold coffee and/or if you like coffee that can hold cream.  It is weak in flavor and best described as tea flavored coffee.  It is, however, not bitter and fairly smooth.
Received this item in a timely manner.  Was what I expected. Gave as a Christmas gift.  Would purchase again.
We were very pleased with this product and the short time in which we received it.

The K cups were loose and not bound in plastic wrap or cardboard box.  I was very happy to see that.  The K cups were not damaged in any way and is at least a little better for the environment given the use of them, by me, is not good for my carbon foot print. So every little bit helps.

I don't like strong coffee but this is so weak and watery, it's like drinking...something other than coffee. I tried brewing a small size, using a different size cup, adjusting my cream and sugar, nothing works! It's really disappointing because I've had other good blends from Green Mountain in the past. I'll stick with Wolfgang Puck's Rodeo Drive or Breakfast In Bed.
For anyone liking a weaker coffee,this brand would be fine, but I prefer a stronger coffee so I wouldn't choose this brand again for that reason.

column9: Good flavor - a little too weak for me
column10: Seems like the Keurig systems lend themselves to dark roasts - however, the near burnt flavor element never worked for me. I was excited to try out this light roast (enough for 48 packs of 'trial') - and indeed I loved the flavor if you stick to the small 6 oz cup size. The coffee gets too weak and watery at any of my regular sizes (middle or right-but-one button on the B70) - this is a coffee that could do with an 'extra bold' rating to up the quantity of coffee in the cup.My current alternative for this is Green Mountain's 'Our Blend' - which does seem to have got it right!
Personally I find this blend to be rather bland.  However, my wife really likes it, so I'll rate it 4 stars.
This is the best way to buy GMC.  Wish I could get it all at this price and have home delivery.
Deceptive ad.  You can buy from Green Mountain for $13.95 a box of 24.  Don't buy from these crooks.

Beware of this vendor.  All other K-Cups are sold 2 packs of 24 for this price.  I ordered several brands in one order assuming that these are the same 2 pack of 24 quantity and was surprised when I only received one box of 24.  Went back and looked at my and sure enough the description did not state 2 boxes as other brands / suppliers.  Beware when ordering and just pick a different vendor.

column4: Theodore "Life is either a daring adventure o...
column10: I got the Keurig as a present recently and have been trying all the samples that came with the unit. I like a smooth tasting coffee with lots of flavor, especially for breakfast. Unfortunately, the Green Mountain Coffee Breakfast Blend left me flat.All of the Keurig K-Cups lack the wonderful aroma that makes coffee drinking so enjoyable, but this breakfast blend is even less aromatic than others.Flavors are, of course, a personal preference, and I can see the appeal of this coffee for some. It doesn't bite you, like many coffees, so if you're looking for a mellow flavor in the morning, this may be for you. Otherwise, steer clear of this one.
13 dollars for 24 cups free shipping over 50 dollars is the going rate. These folks are pulling a swiftie
Love the coffee.Don't like the fact that I can buy this cheaper from Amazon than I can right here in Vermont!

I did not like this coffee. It is on the light side. It has too much acid or something, I felt almost ill after drinking it.  I shared it with a co-worker and he felt the same way.  I am a big coffee drinker and usually can drink very strong coffee And never have stomach upsets but do with this blend.
I have ordered Breakfast Blend over the last three years.  The last order I received through Amazon was just awful! Bitter, burnt, undrinkable.....what are they doing to my once favorite coffee??

column9: Folgers instant is at least as good as this! Horrible stuff!
column10: Since I've had my Keurig K-cup coffee brewer I have never had such horrible coffee!  Tastes like cardboard!  I usually get either donut shop k cups or Paul Neuman's Own.  Also Midnight Express, ALL good.  But this Morning Blend junk isn't ANY good at all.  Never again!
For the price you pay, the pods should make a good cup of coffee. This coffee was watery and bland.  Don't buy. I think Tulley's is the best.

column4: Arthur in Baton Rouge, La "Arthur in Baton Ro...
column9: Poor Labeling makes for a rip-off!
column10: I have used this before, and like the coffee. But was not aware of the different strengths. Saw a statement about them as I reviewed today (in "product features" it says, "Please note: 'regular', 'bold' and 'extra bold' refer to the amount of coffee in the K-Cup"). There is no way to make any choice during Amazon Prime buying (one click), or any other way i can find. So I am consuming this expensive stuff twice as fast to get the strength I want. Are you listening, Amazon? This proves to me that the arguments some make that buying in the store is better may have merit. if this were not a food item, already opened, I would return.So: WARNING: don't buy unless you are satisfied with any strength (Ironic a product this expensive would not pay more attention).Very, very disappointed!PS, the box labeling did not match the warning anyway, what I got was "Light Roast". The other choice was "Regular". Leads one to wonder if they are clearing off old, outdated product.

I've fgound the cure for drinking too much coffee inthe morning. Get this one. I thought, when I first had this, that I had accidently wiped the sugar spoon with a Mr Clean cloth, but the next day, I had one cup of Tully's and made the second cup, the Green Mountain Breakfast blend. The disinfectant taste was back. I would not buy this one again.
I have ordered Breakfast Blend over the last three years.  The last order I received through Amazon was just awful! Bitter, burnt, undrinkable.....what are they doing to my once favorite coffee??

column9: Why use a brewer for instant coffee?
column10: This stuff is NASTY.  I don't even think it's particularly good instant.  Why would anyone spend all that money on a keurig coffee maker in order to make instant coffee at home?  You just need a kettle or a microwave.  And what a waste of space in your kitchen and landfill.  The worst part is that you don't know it's instant until you taste it, look carefully at the package, and see that it's "water soluble"-- code words for instant.  Open one up, and you'll see!

This is my favorite coffee out of the 18+ Kuerig cups that I've tried. It's smooth, and not too heavy or bitter.I think this product is priced above it's value, but it's as good as Starbucks for abut 1/3 the cost.

I ordered this coffee and another brand, it seems, about three weeks ago.  I checked this morning, February 8,  and found the deliver is out into March or Apri.  I  paid for the product soon after it was ordered and have been told on checking delivery that it can no longer be canceled.  Wow!!!!!
THIS HAS BEEN MY FAVORITE COFFEE SINCE DAY ONE OF HAVING MY KEURIG. YOU CAN'T MESS IT UP. EVERY CUP IS PERFECT.
I love the Breakfast Blend because it is not real strong and does not have a bitter taste.  Another great blend is the Nantucket Blend.

My husband and I both really enjoy the taste of this coffee.  I tend to like a full robust flavor, and my husband likes his coffee on the milder side, but this coffee satisfies us both.  It is 'just right'!
This coffee is perfect for the morning. Not to strong but it gives you the perfect smooth jolt that we all crave in the AM..highly recommended.

I will admit that I like strong flavorful but not burnt tasting coffee. I give four stars to the Tully House Blend, but this Breakfast Blend is quite weak.After ordering fifty of them, my husband and I in desperation have been trying to use them up by putting a kcup on espresso setting and using 2-3 kcups on Expresso  as needed to fill up our coffee cup. I'm sure it's a  fine Kcup if you like weak coffee, but...
Excellent coffee for someone who wants a medium roast, mild tasting cup of coffee.  I do not like the dark roast, strong, bitter coffees.  This one is perfect.

The only reason I did not give it five stars is the small package (24).  I like to buy in bulk of 108 cups or more in a single box.  Much better price.  Disallowing the smaller package, I must say that the coffee will not disappoint anyone.

column9: This is our favorite k-cup coffee!
column10: We have tried many different types of K-cup coffee flavors and this is the one we keep coming back to.  Neither one of us cares for bitter, strong tasting coffee.  This has a mild, pleasant taste and it never varies from that. Definitely recommend!

column9: On the Light Side of Medium Blend Coffees.  Smooth with No Aftertaste.  Typical Breakfast Blend.
column10: If you like a lighter coffee blend, then this one is a good choice.  It is a breakfast blend, so the flavor will not compete with your food.The blend is smooth, not acidic and doesn't have an aftertaste.  It goes well with cream/sugar.Equal to Timothy's World Coffee, Kona Blend Medium K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 50) or Wolfgang Puck Coffee, Breakfast in Bed (Medium Roast), 24-Count K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 2).
The Green Mountain Breakfast Blend coffee is wonderful.  I don't like strong bitter coffee and this is just great for my coffee type.

column9: Green mountain coffee for the Keurig, breakfast blend
column10: Love this coffee. I received it within 2 days and was very happy witheverything.I would recommend this brand and also Donut People coffee.

I recently found this blend available at my local Walmart (sorry Amazon, but it had a great price). It is a light blend such as I prefer, and tastes wonderful.  I could not detect any aftertaste as you get with medium or dark coffee blends. I previously wrote a review for Green Mountain's Nantucket Blend which I recommended to those that prefer medium blends.  However, this particular blend is just right for me.  I highly recommend this blend to fellow Amazon customers that prefer light blends.

I had received a Keurig coffee maker for the holidays and have been hooked since. I am not a real strong coffee person so this morning blend is perfect. Consistant in flavor. The only reason I gave it a four is once you buy the machine you are basically locked into buying the cups.. It does have the reusable pod tho. I believe the prices could come down. In the store the prices are outrageous, but on Amazom they are reasonable somewhat..

I purchased this coffee for my teenage daughter in college.  She said it tasted OK but was weak compared to Starbucks.  She prefers a stronger coffee. It is really hard to tell the strenght of the coffe by the description.
I love this brand of k-cup! Just the right blend for me... not too strong, not too light... just right. Amazon gives you the best value when buying k-cups :)

My favorite to use in my Keurig. The Breakfast Blend is not too strong, but it isn't so weak that I can't taste the coffee after adding creamer. I do not like a dark roast, but I also don't like an incredibly weak roast. This blend is absolutely perfect for those who like a coffee that is just right. :)
Excellent taste, smooth, easy going.  I like a mild drink to start my day and this is it.  Heartily endorse this coffee.
I have tried other mild brews but this is the best by far it meets all of my requirements for this type of coffee.

I have usually ordered my K-Cups direct from Green Mountain, but thought I'd try Amazon's larger package and subscribe/save. The box of 50 works out to about a month's supply of coffee for me, with drinking a couple of cups a day.The taste is good--it's not a strong coffee, for that you need something like Green Mountain Coffee's Extra Bold.Green Mountain Coffee, Dark Magic (Extra Bold) K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig Brewers, 50-countIt's not too heavy of a coffee, but none of the cups I have brewed have been the weak water that a few other reviews suffered from. Bad batches and bad quality control may be the issue.If you double-check the prices and get a good batch, it's a better than average cup of coffee.

This is a mild coffee which I really like.  I don't care for a really dark blend as it tends to be bitter, but this breakfast blend is quite good.  I have had a few other blends and I may change and get the columbia blend some time but the breakfast blend is not bitter and so far I like it the very best.  It has a pleasing taste and aroma.

Very dissapionted in this oder.Have had this coffee before from another source,but it wasn't avaliable at the time so I odered it thru ammazon.Not the same coffee.Very stale and weak.My hhusband and I both noticed it.Wish I had not order the 50 count but something smaller

I use all sorts of K-Cups, but this breakfast blend is definately my Go-To blend!! It is perfect - not too light, not too dark. I highly recommend this, as the price for the 50-count box is pretty good!!
Always brews great in my tall cup. Many other coffees tend to be too weak when you use the larger cup settings but not this one... Like I said... Yum!!

Having lots of problems with Green Mountain cups. Coffee is fine, but plastic seems heavier than other brands and does not fully drain into cup, but drips considerably when removing to dispose. Will probably choose other brands in the future instead. Have been using K-Cups for over a year and only have had problems with this brand.
The K-cups are great. This blend was just right. Have to have at least 1 cup  a day. Enjoyed it. The taste was just right. Will definetly buy again.
Good to purchase in a larger quantity! Ease for keeping supplies in stock! Easy to obtain from Amazon without a third party involved.  Got to use my free shipping - yea.

I love this coffee.  I'm a fan of lighter roasts.  I like the lack of bitterness and higher caffeine that comes with them.  This one is my favorite.  For most K-Cups, even lighter roasts, I have to run the machine twice through one K-Cup to get a decent, not overly-strong, cup of coffee.  These come out perfect for me with one run.  I do tend to go through them more quickly because of that, but that's okay. The great coffee is worth it!
Very pleased with this product. This is not the first time I have purchased Green Mountain Coffee and it wont be the last.

I switched to Green Mountain Breakfast Blend after not being able to get Black Tiger as a super saver item.  It was a real disappointment.  Very weak and certainly not something I would want as "breakfast blend"..

I knew there was something wrong when I opened the outer packaging from Amazon an it contained loose coffee grounds.  I found the Breakfast Blend box to be leaking the grounds.  When I opened it I found several of the K-cups had lids that were applied off-center, thus not sealing the K-cups and the grounds were spilling out.  I have used LOTS of K-cups and have NEVER seen this before.  Poor quality control by Green Mountain with this batch.  Shame on the folks at Amazon for packaging up a box that was obviously leaking it's goods.

column9: Good Blend, but roast was too light.
column10: I like the taste, but the light roast was too light for me.  I find myself brewing smaller cups of coffee, hoping for a stronger taste.  Next time, I'll go for a medium or dark roast.  I think it was the medium that I had before and I really liked it.

My wife has drunk this coffee for several years.  She tried many different brands before settling on this k-cup. It is a mild great tasting brew that you will like if you like a typical donut shop coffee. Not a Starbucks brew, but a regular mild brew. Give it a try.
I love this product. No more measuring coffee in the morning.No more throwing old coffee out. Best Ideal ever.
I searched Google and found these k-cups. The price is reasonable.  Exceptionally fast delivery. I am very pleased and will order again.
Green Mountain Breakfast Blend is the best moderate blend for the Keurig Brewer.  Very good taste and not acidic.
Tried this blend as a change from routine, but did not find it as enjoyable as I had hoped, still, it was good, just not great.Pat

column9: Love Green Mountain Breakfast Blend -- Great Coffee!!!!!
column10: I just recently got my Keurig, and I've been trying the sample pack of coffee that came with it.  So far this is by far my favorite.  I nice mild coffee taste to enjoy in the morning or anytime.  I actually wish they made this coffee in a decaf version also so I could enjoy the great flavor of this one anytime!  I think this will be the main coffee in this house; I've tried some of the others and liked some of them more than others, but this is the runaway favorite.  I tend to put a good bit of cream and sugar in my coffee (can't stand it black!) but the nice flavor of this one comes through the cream and sugar.  (I've found that cream and sugar can't cover up the taste of coffee I don't like!)  I don't care for the bolder coffees at all (I don't feel like getting slapped in the face by my coffee in the morning!)I'd encourage everyone to give this a try if you like a light roast coffee with a mild, pleasant taste in the morning -- you won't be disappointed!!!
Green Mountain Coffee Keurig Breakfast Blend, 24-Count K-Cups (Pack of 2)WE LOVE THE BREAKFAST BLEND- WE'VE TRIED MOST OF THEM,THIS ONE IS IT FOR US.
Not too strong,not too weak.This is the coffee I buy my wife for her mornings.It is probably the simplest k cup brew,but sometimes that is all you might want.

These K-cups are either extremely old or they're not authentic Green Mountain K-cups. The coffee is weak and has a bad after-taste. Both my spouse and I have noticed this independently of each other.I tried to contact the seller to ask about this but couldn't figure out who it was.

I love this coffee and when I bought it, I also bought another brand. The price, around $20.00 was for two boxes of the other brand. I thought it was a pretty good deal although you can sometimes find it for $9.95 each at Target.  When they arrived, I discovered that I had paid for only one box of Breakfast Blend - a complete rip-off.  Even directly from Keurig, it's cheaper.  Will never buy this again.

column9: Do NOT buy from Mike's Grocers!!!
column10: What I received today in shipment is a joke! I have the product on the desk in front of me. I see 4 packages of Green Mountain Coffee..Breakfast Blend. The 4 packages arrived NOT in an outer box! The packages are held together with yellow strapping tape. ALL 4 packages are ripped open in one way or another. One package has the bottom ripped off almost entirely and several coffee pods are missing. This disaster of shipping  was sitting out on my front porch in 95+ heat on a very humid Texas day. Mice, giant tree cockroaches, or kitties could have been prowling around inside the boxes. I can't believe UPS even accepted such a crappy packaging attempt. PLUS...I tried to find this Mike's Grocer online. The address on the return slip is 7 Prospect ST APT #4....an APARTMENT???? How do I even know where in the heck these pods originated? I LOVE Amazon and buy almost everything from them. This is my first REALLY horrible experience. Amazon....please get rid of this retailer!!!!!! Brenda Spurlin

I was excited to see this 50 pack of coffee! Read all about how "if you like Dunkin Donuts, you'll love this".  Well its not good at all.  Comes out looking like tea. Has the flavor of coffee but its really just water.  Trust me, I am not a fan of the "Rocket Fuel" they serve at Starbucks but this is nothing like Dunkin.  Just cancelled subscription.
This is very good coffee. I don't like strong coffee, this is nice and mild, a great breakfast blend. I use cream in it and it is just great. Will buy again.
Great coffee and so easy to brew.  This coffee has great aroma and is good to the last drop.  I actually like all the brands.  This is the way coffee should taste!!
I'm never disappointed with the Breakfast Blend Coffee from Green Mountain Coffee.  It's always fresh and makes a very smooth cup of coffee, never bitter.
I use this as my morning coffee wake up call.  I continue to re-order it because I like the medium roast flavor.
The coffee fenominal, the price fantastic and the delivery was right on point!!!!! I recommended this offer to my friends n family and they jumped right in, I got my delivery first!!!
Not strong enough for the first cup in the morning.  I need something strong to wake me up. Maybe I should have found a stronger blend
This blend is not bitter to wake you up, but a mild end that makes your mornings calm.  A delightful slow approach to a busy day.  No harsh jolts.

column9: I've been buying these regularly for months now.
column10: A great way to save money on buying K-Cups - in supermarkets these go for about 8-9 bucks for 12 cups.  You save so much money buying them in bulk like this, if you use them regularly.  I just picked up the 96 count after buying the 48 count 3 months in a row.
Convenient way to buy GOOD coffee. 1 box last me a month and half. What a savings!!Saving on gas too!!
best coffee from green mountain so far i recomend this to anyone who loves coffee great taste and good price make this a great buy

This Breakfast Blend from Green Moutain coffee company is my favorite flavor of coffee when I just want a regular cup of coffee without that extra kick from a bold blend or a flavored coffee.  It has always been consistent and calming in its flavor.  It is top-notch coffee.
Usually use Timothy's breakfast blend, but the price went sky high, so we tried this brand.  Love it! Nice smooth taste, no acidity problem or burned flavor, and like the price too!
I just received a new Keurig and have tried a couple of different K-Cup varieties. I just have to say that for a smooth cup of plain deliciousness this is one of my top picks!
didn't get ,quite the taste i wanted,brought thru amazon. but overall will still keep using this product,until it runs out.
I find that I have to use the seven ounce setting on my coffeemaker to brew this coffee, since it seems like a " weak brew " to us. I am going to try the extra bold for our next order.
I love the taste of the Breakfast Blend K-Cup coffee. You can't find a better dealanywhere else. keep up the great work
This is a great tasting Breakfast Blend. I have been drinking it every since I purchased my new coffee maker. I will be buying more of it in the near future. Great way to start my stressful day.
Green Mountain is my favorite morning coffee.  It is a mild blend and is not the least bitter.  It is very smooth.

I love the coffee mild but flavorful.  A great way to wake up and great all day.  Keurig is so easy to use, my elderly neighbor love not fiddling with the paper filters in standard coffee makers. Much easier for him
i drink nothing but green mountain k-cups,nothing can even come close to the taste.Everyone should a least try it once.

I have this coffee in the past and really enjoyed it. However this one I received was so weak that neither my sister-in-law or I could drink it. It was left for my mother who likes weak coffee. It feels like it's only half full so it may have been a bad box. Like I said I've really enjoyed it the past when I've purchased it at the grocery store.

column9: Worse than the lunch room coffee at work.
column10: Something is not right. Tastes very old. Stale. Weak. Weak at 8 ounces. Weak at 6 ounces. Strength OK at 4 ounces but tastes horrible. Not only will I not buy this coffee again, I won't buy Green Mountain coffee again. Very bad.

I love this coffee it's my favorite so far I want to try them all. I don't like strong coffee and I hate bitter after taste coffee to me this is the perfect cup  of coffee. I'm not telling everyone to go out and buy it this is my own opinion.
this was a great product at a great price, i would recommend it to everyone that uses the kcups. its a great product
I love this green mountIn coffee it is so good my whole family drinks it, doesn't compare to other coffees, it is just right not too strong, I also buy the decaf brand.
both my boyfriend and I found that this coffee was way to weak and tasteless. i am back to looking for a coffee I can enjoy
This is a great tasting coffee. Not only good first thing in the morning, but anytime. Very smooth. Green Mountain puts out great tasting coffee on all flavors and blends

column9: On the Border Cafe Style Tortilla Chips
column10: I am delighted to be the first to write up a review for this product.  All I can say is that these are THE BEST-TASTING tortilla chips I have ever eaten.  My mother just purchased a 24 oz. bag from Sam's Club and we couldn't wait to try it.  We were amazed at how delicious they were. They were fresh, crispy and--best of all--low in salt, so that we could actually 'taste' the stone-ground corn.  We have tried dozens of other brands, and our search is now over.

I stumbled across On The Border Cafe Style Tortilla Chips at the grocery store recently (Meijer Thrifty Acres, to be exact).  These are excellent chips.  Don't buy them anywhere but the grocery store, otherwise you'll pay through the nose.  Here are the specifics:Sea saltGluten freeLow sodiumServing size: About 7 chipsServings per container: About 12Calories: 140Calories from fat: 60Total fat: 7 g (11% DV)Saturated fat: 1.5 g (7% DV)Trans Fat: 0 gCholesterol: 0 mg (0% DV)Sodium: 80 mg (3% DV)Total carbohydrate: 19 g (6% DV)Dietary fiber: 2 g (7% DV)Sugars: 0 gProtein: 2 gVitamin A: 0%Calcium: 2%Vitamin C: 0%Iron: 2%Ingredients: whole grain corn, vegetable oil (contains one or more of the following: canola, corn, cottonseed, safflower, and/or soybean oil) and sea salt.No artificial flavors or colors, no hydrogenated oils.I recommend these chips.

column9: the absolute best tortilla chip on the planet..
column10: i love on the border chips. the only chip in major grocery stores that taste like real authentic Mexican chips.. The ingredient are basic and the best you'd find in the store.

I wasn't a big fan of tortilla chips -(unless I'd get them a Mexican restaurant, then I'd love them)- until I found On The Border Cafe Style Tortilla Chips at my local (warehouse club). These chips are not heavily salted, so you can actually taste the delicious and  subtle corn tortilla flavor, as well as the salsa (if you are using it). These chips are just the right texture (finer rather than coarse) and have a mild fresh flavor. These are my favorite, (other than those found in Mexican restaurants), and I recommend these highly!
This chip is lightly salted, crispy, flavorful and extremely difficult to find. It was at a local Walmart for a week and disappeared.  I heard Walgreens carries them. You must try!

column9: The best store bought tortilla chips you will ever find.
column10: These tortilla chips are awesome!! They taste just like the ones you get when you go to the On The Border Mexican Grill restauraunt!! I used to think Tostitos were the best tortilla chips you could get from the store and boy was I wrong!! I will never buy anything but these chips again when I'm in need of tortilla chips!!  And Karen you are insane!! You must work for some other tortilla chip company and your just trying to bash these awesome chips!!I get mine at Walmart and Sams Club. Walmart (when you can find them) sells the 20 oz bag for $2.48 and Sams Club sells the 24 oz bag for $3.82 and they are worth every penny!!

column9: These are the best tortilla chips. (Karen = moron)
column10: I have no words to describe how stupid Karen is, nor do I have any words to describe how epic these chips are. They are low in salt but somehow taste better than any other chips out there (Tostitos are not even close). They seem almost freshly fried as if you are getting them from an authentic mexican restaurant and have an amazing texture and bold clean flavor.Please do yourself a favor and try them! Don't listen to Karen shes an r-tard.

I thought all corn chips were the same, until I had a bag from a certain Mexican-Irish restaurant chain. This eye-opening experience began my search for this taste from the grocery store.After trying everything on the shelf, I gave up. Suddenly, On The Border chips appeared at my Walmart store. These are the best store bought tortilla chips! I bought another bag, on my next grocery run, and they were still the same taste I was craving. The next week, they were gone.Walmart has just been contacted, and I am hopeful about their answer. If not, I will buy them somewhere else. No thanks A**z*n, this price is ridiculous.

column9: Do not order this item, It's a RIP OFF
column10: After opening the box this item was basicly a 24oz bag of crumbs.  This is also not what I believed I was ordering.  Who the hell would pay 14 bucks for a 24oz bag of chips (I mean crumbs).  I believed I was ordering several bags of chips as it does mention there are 18 items.  Do not purchase this item.  It's a rip-off. I'll be contacting Amazon about this one.

These were the worst nacho chips I have ever had. The chips were two-sided with a thin hollow middle section between them that broke easily. They crumbled quickly when eating and had an unpleasant flavor. The cheapest store brand is better.

I've tried several of the Hansen's sodas and I like this one the best. The easiest way to describe it would be to say it taste like a lighter, refreshing, clear version of orange Sunkist. The flavor is very nice,though I taste more orange than any mango really. I don't usually drink a lot of soda but this doesn't have a lot of the additives (high-fructose corn syrup, caffeine..etc) so I can drink these without feeling too guilty. The price is pretty reasonable too for a 24 pack. I will be getting more.

column9: Very Light Taste with No Sugar Rush!
column10: Although each can contains 44g of sugar, this soda does not cause tooth pangs nor taste overly sweet. There is a light, "clean" flavor to it as opposed to the more heavy, lab-created orange flavor of other sodas. The soda lacks any hint of mango flavor, but the orange flavor is nice without any medicinal sweetness to it. Unfortunately, some of the cans arrived with puffy tops and dents.

column9: wonderful tea--even with those stringless tea bags
column10: This tea provides a luscious and refreshing break from your daily grind and helps you relax as well. It's got a great multi-berry taste to it that is very pleasant but yet not overpowering for a good cup of tea. Let it steep about three minutes and you're bound to enjoy it as much as I do!Each bag contains all-natural ingredients; and there are no artificial ingredients. The stringless tea bags can be removed from your cup whenever you want just by using a spoon or anything similar to get them out of the cup. Stir the tea bag around and up and down a bit while it's in your cup before you drink it.The tea is also caffeine free, which is a plus for those of us who don't want caffeine in our diets. That is something I always prefer.My only wish is that these teabags DID have strings; the stringless teabag allegedly reduces waste--but by how much? It's a very small difference which amounts to a marketing ploy; the stringless teabag means you must use a spoon or some other utensil to get the teabag out of the cup.If you like a wild berry flavored tea without caffeine or artificial ingredients, I highly recommend this tea! Enjoy!

column9: Very Nice if you know how to sweeten it!
column10: This herbal tea is one of my favorites. I used to sweeten it using wild flower honey, very very amazing taste. I do not advise you to try it with sugar.

Celestial Seasonings recent zinger line is much improved from the former hibiscus/rose hip dominated sour tea.  The flavor of this purple red brew was a nice wild berry medley. The mix of natural berry flavor reminded me of kool-aid--in a good way!Celestial Seasonings gets extra points for their packaging: they utilize 100% natural recycled paperboard in their boxes and they don't package each tea bag individually. Instead they use a system of a waxed paper bag inside the box that stays shut when you fold it. It keeps the bags fresh and utilizes less packaging than individually wrapping each bag. The art they use on each box is beautiful as are the quotes and information they put on every surface.Quote from the box: "The road up and the road down is one and the same thing." Heraclitus.

column9: Fruity with a Hint of Citrus
column10: This great herbal infusion from Celestial Seasonings has a full bodied berry flavor with a hint of citrus in the finish.  Good as a hot beverage, it can also be served over ice, or in combination with sparkling water or lemon/lime soda as a refreshing cold beverage.

I bought this tea and I did not enjoy it. I like this brand a lot but for whatever reason the teas labeled as "Zinger" have a strange tart taste to them. They kind of taste like they have artificial sugar added to them. I have no idea what Zinger means and I couldn't find much information on it.I notice a big difference in flavor for the teas that don't say Zinger. I enjoyed the country peach passion and true blueberry from this brand. I would not recommend the Zinger teas.
This tea is quite tastey.  I was nervous when I saw "Zinger", but it's just the right about of Zing  :-)  I really like this tea.

column9: Fantastic Tea!  Works great for Automatic Iced Tea Makers
column10: This tea has amazing flavor.  It is bursting with flavor.  I use 7 bags in my Mr. Coffee Iced tea maker to make one large pitcher of tea.  It is plaesant to drink unsweetened or with a packet of sugar per cup.  The stringless tea bags are ideal for my style of Automatic Iced tea maker.  Also, all natural ingredients and no caffine work great for dieting.

This tea is one of my favorite flavors of Celestial Seasonings tea. It definitely is a wild and zingy (I just invented a new word) option. Whenever I brew a hot cup of this tea, I feel transported to a better place and time. I taste freshly picked strawberries, blueberries and other varieties of berry.  It is especially good when infused with a spoonful of honey for good measure. It complements the tart quality.

column9: Like Kool Aid without the nasty stuff
column10: Take 3 bags, put them in a quart pitcher of water and stick it in the fridge. In an hour you have iced tea that tastes great without sweetener! My kids love it too and no calories.

column9: By far the best price you can find for this tea
column10: I'm really darn picky with tea, and this is my favorite after trying a bunch out over the last few years. I usually burn through 1-3 bags a day, so I scoured the internet looking for the best bulk deal. This is it... by several dollars. With Prime, which I have, its even better. Way to go Amazon :)
This tastes like Kool-Aid to me, which I'm not a fan of.  This would be Good for kids but I will not reorder.

I'm long overdue for a review on this.  I love the Wild Berry Zinger tea.  I've tried some of the other ones but this is by far my favorite. (I did not like the Red Zinger at all!  The peppermint flavor overwhelmed all the over berri-ness!)  The price I get for this compared to in my store makes it a no brainer to keep on buying it from Amazon.

This tea is good, but nothing amazing, and kind of odd. I use this tea to make iced tea. I use 4-6 teabags and use a little over a half a cup of sugar in a pitcher to make this and the end result tastes like watered down Koolaid. Not exactly what I wanted or expected. I love Koolaid, but if I want Koolaid, I'll just use the regular kind, not this weird watered down version.In my opinion Raspberry Zinger is MUCH better than Wild berry.

Celestial Seasoning's Wild Berry Zinger Tea is my favorite Tea.  Since it has become hard to find and very expensive in my area, I've found that Amazon offers it at a fair price.  Shipping is both fair and fast and the total price beats what it costs in my area.

column9: Celestial Seasonings Herb Tea, Wild Berry Zinger was delicious!
column10: Celestial Seasonings Herb Tea, Wild Berry Zinger, 20-Count Tea Bags (Pack of 6)Celestial Seasonings Herb Tea, Wild Berry Zinger Tea is wonderful! I would recommend it to anyone that wants a delicious tea blend.

I had bariatric surgery a couple of months ago, and have to drink lots and lots of liquid. One of the allowed beverages is decaffeinated tea.  I've never been much of a tea drinker, but thought I'd give this Wild Berry Zinger a try. I absolutely love it. It's berry-ish, but not overwhelmingly so. It's not quite sweet enough for me so I add one packet of Splenda to make it perfect.  I find it to be soothing and calming, if that's possible for a cup of tea, and drink 4 or 5 cups of it in the course of a day - even have a cup just before bedtime. I love the flavor, I love the feel, and I don't think anyone else should buy it... because then there wouldn't be enough for me.

When I picked this one out I thought it was an assortment of berry teas. Such is not the case if I had paid more attention I would know it is a blend of fruit flavors in one teabag. It has a nice flavor as do all the Celestial "Zingers". This is good as I will be drinking it for quite some time.
This tea is delicious.  I drink it cold every day in the summer, so buying in bulk made perfect sense for me. The package arrived in good time and was packed securely. Will be buying ths again.
I love Celestial Seasonings tea and this is my favorite. It has a very fruity flavor that just right anytime of day.
I really like the taste of this herbal tea.  I have been buying it for years.

So far, I have thoroughly enjoyed all of the teas in the "zinger" series. I like Celestial Seasonings in general. Of course, the tea bags have no strings and that is something of an annoyance, but other than that, the teas are tasty and enjoyable. Zinger really is a great description of the product. It has a surprising and deeply flavorful taste and an aroma to match. The lemon has a fresh, rich lemon flavor. This one is an amazing medley of berry flavors. It might be my second favorite variety after the Red Zinger.  It is a great option for those who enjoy herbal teas.

IF YOU'RE SOY SENSITIVE LIKE ME BE AWARE THAT THIS AND OTHER HIBISCUS TEAS BY CELESTIAL SEASONINGS HAVE SOY LECITHIN. IT MAY NOT BE LISTED ON THE WEB BUT WHEN YOU GET IT IN THE MAIL AND READ THE INGREDIENTS ON THE BOX THERE IT IS, SOY LECITHIN. SOY LECITHIN DOESN'T MAKE ME ITCH AS MUCH AS SOYBEAN OIL OR SOY PROTEIN BUT IF I WANT TO GET AN ITCH FREE GOOD NIGHT'S SLEEP I STAY CLEAR OF IT.

This is a wonderful (and healthful) snack.  Crispy and tasty and low in calories. Each bag equals 1/2 cup of fresh fruit, and the dried crunchiness of these seems to intensify the flavor of the fruits.  There is also enough substance to meet the munchies moments.  I highly recommend these.

These taste great, and I've found them to be a perfect way for me to enjoy a crunchy, not-too-sweet, healthy snack.  I really like the fact that the ingredients consist of fruit - and nothing else.  No sugar, no corn syrup, just the dried fruits themselves.  I've been ordering these, along with the Organic Cherry Berry blend, in bulk (subscription) for over a year. I keep several packets of each type on the snack shelf in our pantry (in the place where I used to keep chips).  The single-serving packets are a good amount for an afternoon snack.  I also add them to breakfast cereals.

This is one of my my favorite flavors of the Sensible Foods Fruit snacks. They are gluten free which is necessary for me with Celiac Disease. I love this flavor and like to sprinkle them on yogurt for breakfast in the morning when berries are out of season and so expensive. I wish the pieces were bigger to make it easier to just eat by themselves as a snack. My daughter is diabetic and also loves this line of snacks.
My six year old son loves these.  He eats around 2 packages a day.  It makes me feel good bacause I know he it eating healthy fruit instead of junk food.
Tried them all. This package is my favorite of them all. They should try and make one with just bananas.
These were a great find!  They are tasty - natural and a great snack.

column9: Hello, I am an addict. Yes, I am addicted to this fruit
column10: Hello, my nme is S*** and I am an addict. I have been clean three hours...because I ate them all and NEED MORE !!!!I cannot get enough of this product. I only have one complaint. The bags are too small !!!!!Please send more...now...as in today... I'll wait. Right here... pleaseeeeeeeee  :)
It wasn't as tasty as other products like this it had a very sour taste to it

My fiance actually, adores these fruit pouches!  We've tried some of the others, but this Tropical Blend one is by far the best!  I'll eat some too, I'm just not a dried fruit kind of guy.  But they make great quick snacks, are healthy, travel well, and not a lot of calories/fat/points/whatever!!Overall, a great snack!!

column9: i fell in love with dehydrated fruit
column10: this is a first for me - first i bought a pack, then i bought a case. i'm thinking about a truckload

I love this product. It's loaded with flavor and is crunchy, too. As a Weight Watcher, I'm always looking for low point snacks and this is only 1 point per bag. You can fold it into yogurt or use it to top ice cream or eat it right from the bag. The Tropical Blend is my favorite. The Orchard Blend and the Very Berry are also very good, but have a lot of apples in them.  They are 1/2 serving of fruit and easily fit in a backpack or lunch box.
I love them! Totally natural with no added sugar, yet sweet and flavorful. Encourages a poor eater like me get her daily servings of fruit :P

I really like these snacks (the tropical is the best in my opinion) but I wish there would be less apple and more of the other fruits.It is a handy way to get fruit; especially when you live alone and don't want to waste fresh fruit.  This is especially great for winter fruit eating and snacks on the go. They have a nice long shelf life and you can control the calories and portions easily this way.This would be a great thing to have on hand for emergency food supplies too.

What a great idea...something crunchy and sweet but healthy too!  My three kids love these, especially the youngest.  I had "fruit snacks", you know the gummy candy type snack and a bag of Sensible Fruit Tropical Blend the other day, and my youngest child begged for these crunch dried snacks!  A+ for this one! Thanks for thinking of this!  What else can be freeze dried and still be good???
This product is a good product.  More apples than everything else. Not an even amount of different types of fruits.

My little girl had no problems eating fruit as a baby, but as soon as she entered toddler world she became very picky.  Fresh fruit texture just wasn't always to her liking and fruit leathers and other dried fruits were, in her opinion, too sticky.  In desperation, I looked for other choices and happened to come across these Sensible Foods crunch dried snacks.  I was a little skeptical, but I knew that if she didn't eat them I would.  Well, I rarely get the chance to indulge myself.  She loves these snacks!  We have tried two flavors so far, and I'm looking forward to trying the other two.  Her favorites are the apples, so she gets to enjoy some of those in every package.  I can feel confident that she is getting her fruit with no extra sugar.  Thanks, Sensible Foods!
Lots of powdery stuff at bottom of package. Bananas were a bit soft and not very crunchy.

When it comes to snacking, the crunch dried snacks are the best. Each fruit has a distinctive texture and flavor. The individual pieces are flavorful so you can nibble one tiny piece of banana and actually taste banana. There is no fat so you don't have greasy fingers.  You can take the packages anywhere.  Dried pineapples taste like pineapples.  Dried mango taste like mango. In some of the dried fruit mixes, the general taste is "blend." With Sensible Foods crunch dried snacks, you can savor the morsels slowly, one individual flavor and one individual texture at a time or eat them fast, mingling textures and tastes depending.I keep packages on hand to satisfy midnight snack urges,  to crunch instead of chips when I eat a sandwich, to snack while I watch the tube or to grab and go.  Tropical Blend is frankly delicious.  I buy regularly to always have some on hand.  It is much tastier, more interesting to the palate, and cleaner eating than nibbling on rice cakes, popcorn or chips. The product satisfies hunger, too, which makes it a close to perfect food in my world.

column9: IT IS NOT GOOD , VERY BAD TASTE  !
column10: I WAS BUYING THIS THINKING OF REAL DRIED FRUIT BUT IT WAS NOT !!!& IT DID NOT TASTE LIKE CANDY OR CHIPSTHAT WAS AWFUL SNACK FOR ME & WASTE OF MONEY

I bought this on a whim and I am glad. Davidson's tea is wonderful. It's organic and if you steep it according to the directions you get the best tea. I have purchased many other flavors for years and this is great stuff.

I absolutly love this tea! Out of all the teas i drink this is def my go to tea. Tastes and smells amazing and very comforting after a long stressful day. Will continue to buy this tea as long as i can find it on amazon. Thanks!

I absolutely love Buckhead Gourmet sauces. It's very difficult to find a decent bottled sauce that isn't sweet or hot, but savory. The Buckhead Gourmet Bordeaux sauce is wonderfully savory. I've used it on chicken on the grill, roast venison, and many other things, all with wonderful results. It's great for a quick meal that people think you slaved over. For the chicken, I toss the chicken breasts into a bowl with the sauce. Tenderize the breasts a bit with a fork so the sauce can get into the breasts, also. Toss on the grill with a bit more sauce, and serve. For the venison, I simply browned the venison, added the sauce, and cooked until not quite med/rare. It was perfect and I served it with Christmas dinner.I've tried several of their sauces, and every one has been wonderful. My only complaint is that the sauces seem to be getting harder and harder to find.

This is the first Mighty Leaf tea I've tried, and I'm looking forward to trying to rest at my local cafe. Green Tea Tropical is delicious, and unlike  some other herbal teas, its fruit flavor is really pronounced. It's just sweet enough so that you don't need an added sweetener, but it's not nearly as sweet as juice. Mighty Leaf is expensive bagged tea, but it makes for a wonderful treat.

Love the packaging of this tea - the bags are biodegradable, have no flavor, and allow for the expansion of the leaves contained inside. Yes, you read right: this tea bag contains intact tea leaves, like loose leaf, not fannings like most major bagged teas. Dream! This is def. the tea I've been waiting for. I don't know how they package these things without breaking leaves, but it's the best tea bag packaging I've seen. I actually prefer other flavors they have opposed to this one, but most people I know adore the green leaf tropical. Good buy for 3 boxes.

column9: Good Alternative to Plain Green Teas
column10: This tea is exciting to drink, and much better I think than just plain green tea.  It has tropical fruit undertones that make the taste come alive as you drink it.

column9: Good tea but pricey pouches, with enough for a cup, not pot!
column10: Mighty Leaf have positioned themselves at the high end of the tea bag market, sorry, I mean tea 'pouch' market. They do deliver good teas, but firstly they are extremely expensive - its close to 50c per bag (!)and secondly some flavors have just enough tea in the bag for a single cup, not a one person pot. Ginger Twist is like that, try and make a small pot for one, and you'll end up with flavored water. So what? well any high end tea maker should be aiming for the small pot (a tea pot is essential for quality tea drinking!) and regardless if you agree with that or not, at these prices you simply should be getting enough to make a small pot for one, without using 2 bags.It doesn't apply to all their products, but is something to bear in mind if you want to protect your pocket-book, and favor the teapot over a bag floating in a mug of water.

If you're hesitant about trying green tea just because it's good for you, then this is the one to begin with.  Subtle tropical fruit flavors combined with a mild tea equal a delicious cup of tea for any time of day.

Mightly Leaf is by far the best tea on the market!!! The Green Tea Tropical is my favorite flavor and unlike any other tea out there. I love the packaging of this tea and it's so great that the bags are biodegradable! I would 100% recommend this product to everyone.
This is a very flavorful tea. I just LOVE it! And it has a great aroma. I use the bags twice which makes it a little more economical. Try it!

column9: I've never liked tea..... till now :o)
column10: I've tried so many different teas wanting to take the healthy approach but have been shoved right back to the coffee pot due to complete lack of flavor. Tea always seemed so boring. However, this tea is so yummy I am converted. Don't get me wrong, I still enjoy coffee, but I now incorporate this tea almost daily. I love the Chamomile Citrus and Green tea Tropical!! The smell is divine and the tea bags are practically a work of art... LOVES IT!!

It is great hot, but also makes a superb iced tea.  I haven't found too many teas that I love both hot and cold.  Even my sister loves this one and she is usually prone to putting quite a bit of sugar in all her tea.  With this one, she uses just a dash because it doesn't taste bitter to her like other teas do.

Overall the tea blends made by this company are excellent. I can't get enough! The tea is of high quality and the flavor is awesome. The tea is also loose leaf tea inside the tea bag. My only complaint is about the tea bag itself. Sometimes the entire string will become saturated with tea and acts as a siphon and siphons the tea in the mug onto my desk. I'll walk away and come back to find my desk covered in tea. I have to cut the string off with a pair of scissors everytime I make tea. So the tea bag needs some looking into, but the tea is just incredible!
This is the BEST Green Tea I have ever had.  It has a lite fruity flavor & there's no green tea  after taste-  definitely my new FAV!!!!

I've been a tea drinker for almost a decade.  One thing I like about Mighty Leaf are the satin bags.  For this particular flavor I think its pretty good for a green tea, and not so bitter.  It seems as if I can taste a bit of apricot or a light citrus taste.  Its very good hot with a little sugar in the raw, but I'm sure honey would be great in it.
I love this tea. All of the Mighty Leaf teas are great but I love this the best.This price is the best I can find anywhere.

Mighty Leaf Green Tea Tropical tea is my favorite tea ever. I had a really hard time finding it this summer after having many local stores carry it in stock for the past few years. I turned to Amazon and found it available and less expensive if I order over $25.00 and get the free shipping. Not a problem! Now I order 3 packs at a time (9 boxes) and have 3-4 cups a day. Thank you Mighty Leaf and thank you Amazon!

I had been looking for this tea ever since my trip to Hong Kong in February, where I tried it for the first time at a restaurant. It's super delicious, hot or cold.  I was so happy to see it offered through Amazon!

column9: Favorite green tea for nearly 10 years
column10: The first time I've tried the Tropical Green tea was at a small cafe inside one of my universities buildings nearly 10 years ago.I'm still a fan to this day, and this is probably one of my all time favorite teas.This particular green tea has a hint of a sweet flavor brought on by pineapple, however it doesn't actually taste like pineapple. It has a very smooth and delicate flavor.Sometimes I drink it with a teaspoon of honey for extra sweetness. It also makes a wonderful cold beverage (brew hot, and let it cool naturally without adding ice)

I really enjoy this tea. I've had many green teas and this one is very pleasant. There are fruity, flowery undertones that are not too strong.For those who gave this tea a low rating, it may be because they are steeping at the wrong temperature. Different teas need different steeping temperatures, and a too high temperature can make green tea bitter. Green tea should be steeped at 150-160F degrees for 2-4 minutes.
This tea is exhilirating. I just love it. It is fruity and delicious and it DOES NOT taste like fake fruit. Buy this tea, you will not be disappointed and try it over ice...YUM!!

If I could give this 10 stars I would.  This tea is definitely the most delicious tea I've ever enjoyed. When serving it to non-tea drinkers, they get hooked. It's very fragrant and infused with tropical fruits. It's not sweet, it just smells and tastes great. Quite addicting. Downside is the price, but each bag lasts through two 12 oz refills of hot water, and it truly is worth every penny.
Love this tea! Highly recommend it! It is one of the best green teas I've had and it smells so good while you brew it!

I found this tea in a local specialty shop and fell in love it. Unfortunately, they stopped carrying it and it has been difficult to find. The Green Tea Tropical is the only Green tea that I will drink. It is not sweet like "Tropical" would imply but has a nice subtle earth flavor. For me it is well worth the price. I have since tried other Mighty Leaf teas and they are truly flavorful.

Although I love this tea, I don't buy it often because it is expensive for what you get. Amazon definitely has the best price on this tea that I've found. However, I will review the tea and not the price.The tea bags are each good for about 8oz of water, add any more water and the tea will taste weak. The tea bags are large enough to give the tea plenty of space and the tea leaves are large and not crushed. The tropical flavor is really strong. If you like sweet tea but want to cut the sugar down or out, this is an excellent tea to drink. It tastes sweet without any sweetener. The tropical flavors compliment the green tea and the outcome is delicious.If you are having a hard time cost-justifying this treat, go buy a tea in a coffee shop. It will likely cost you at least a dollar for one cup. If you buy this tea on amazon, you get a cup of tea for about fifty cents. That's still cheaper than a soda and much healthier.

Mighty Leaf has the best green tea I have ever tasted, and I have tried many green teas. It has a very unique flavor that I love. I drink it every morning, it is so delicious! If you haven't yet, you should definitely try this tea. I also love that they use biodegradable tea bags :)

This is the tea that got me completely hooked on Mighty Leaf Tea!!! The tea bags are so pretty and I love that the ingredients are natural. I drink at least two cups of this tea in the morning and usually another in the afternoon. I never liked the bitter taste of plain green teas that I had tried, and when I had Green Tea Tropical, I was totally addicted. The light tropical flavors are the perfect compliment to the green tea flavor. As with all Mighty Leaf teas, the flavor is so smooth and easy to drink. I have made so many friends try this tea, who either don't drink tea at all or hate green tea, and they've all become obsessed as well! LOVE this tea!!!

- Green tea tropical is everything its name entails, it's both a relaxing and a zinger! It's helps ease a stressful day and wakes you up in the morning. The combination of flavors enhances the green tea which I am usually not a big fan of, but with Green Tea Tropical I can get all the benefits of Green Tea with an enhanced flavor too! There is no wrong way to do this tea, I really enjoyed it iced, with and without creamer and the tea bags after wards were a very relaxing eye soother.

This green tea is so great that I bought several boxes to give away as Christmas gifts, along with mini biscotti. The pouches are elegant and the flavor of the tea leaves is outstanding. I first tasted this tea at the Nordstrom Cafe, and sometimes it's difficult to find. I was happy to learn that I can get this tea through Amazon.com.

column9: Soft and fruity taste; tea for the tea-averse!
column10: I used to HATE tea.  But Mighty Leaf is the first kind I tried and actually enjoyed (Chamomile Citrus, lightly steeped).  So decided to try a few other flavors, and now the tropical green tea is my favorite.This tropical green tea is very soft-tasting and fruity.  It's also the first tea that my husband actually likes too!  I do believe we've found a winner in our house.Tea lightweights that we are, we get about four cups of tea out of one pouch. I suggest brewing all at once, rather than a cup at a time. If you do it a cup at a time, the first cup will be VERY fruity, and the last one won't have much fruit at all.  We like it better evenly distributed among several cups.
Drinking this blend of Green Tea Tropical is an absolutelydelectable tea experience -- morning, noon and night -- ithits the spot.
This tea is a favorite of mine, and the price at Amazon is the best anywhere.  If you like a green tea with some real flavor, you'll love this one.

column9: not good at all, artificial taste and flavor

I'll say around half not as good as they claim to be.Too much artificial flavor in Mighty Leaf Green Tea! You can buy Celestial Seasonings Teas three time cheaper with the same result.Wasted money.

I used to have to drive miles to buy these candies, and the store only had them in the Spring.  Now they're available anytime I want with just a few clicks on the computer.  They are excellent candy with fruit-flavored liquid in the center of dark chocolate and a hard candy shell.  My guests love them, and they make wonderful gift candies as well.

column9: a treat that is appreciated by my whole family.
