One of the boxes was very good and fresh. The other box I recieved was very dry and you could tell it had been sitting in the shelf a little too long.  Take you chances!

Like many of Nana's other cookies these are not very sweet. To make up for the flavor, this one is loaded with chocolate--lots of chocolate chips along with cocoa powder in the cookie itself.They're tasty and filling; try one with a glass of cold milk nearby!

This cookie hits just the right note for lemon lovers. Not too sweet, with a nice tangy flavor and no bitter or "artificial" taste.It does have a granular texture from the brown rice flour, but that does not mean this is a dry cookie at all. It sort of melts in your mouth.

I stumbled on these at Whole Foods market. I was paying $2.00 per cookie, as they are sold individually. The price here was much lower. Take a chance on these cookies. I, for health reasons, started eating natural and organic foods. Treats like Nana's cookies fit nicely in to my diet. My favorite is Oatmeal, Raisin. The taste is amazing. I would recommend to anyone. Yum!

I was a little disappointed in this product.  The cookies are heavy.  The taste is fine, but the heaviness got to me.  I have to admit, I am very picky about cookies.  It is hard to find good, natural cookies.  I would recommend trying these, but I prefer other brands.
Best healthy cookie you'll find - no one I know doesn't like this, plus amazon has a great price with free shipping over $25!!!

Absolutely delicious!  I highly recommend this cookie for peanut butter lovers!  All natural ingredients and NO hydrogenated oils or refined sugar!  Sinfully good!  Excellent choice for people on restricted diets.

column9: Nana's No Wheat - No Refined Sugar - Chocolate Chip Cookie
column10: Tastes good. Fruit juice sweetened. Excellent ingredients.
these are some of the best cookies i have ever had. they taste like homemade. i can't have sugar or evaporated cane juice, and these taste like the real thing. i love all of their cookies.
best store cookie I have ever tasted & carefully selected ingredients.

Nana's no gluten lemon cookies are very delicious.  I highly recommend them.  You will also find family and friends who may not be allergic to wheat or gluten products also wanting to eat your cookies.  All of Nana's cookies are very fresh.Patricia M. - Maryland

I gave these cookies five stars because I'm someone that loves whole foods and the richness that affords. They have no wheat and harmful sugar in them. I think they taste great. I don't need (or want) something with 8 tablespoons of sugar to taste good.

It's definitely lemony, and nicely sweet. However, it's very high in fat and has a pronounced grainy texture. I found that when I keep them in the fridge, they taste better than at room temperature.I'd probably try her other cookies instead of buying these again.

I tend to love orange cranberry cookies, but this cookie recipe is not the best. It is excessively orange flavored, overwhelming the cranberry flavor. My guess is that they added too much orange flavor to the recipe. It also crunches, due to the second ingredient (puffed rice). I don't think the puffed rice crunch adds anything to the cookie. Furthermore, the cookie, although at a moderate level of sweetness, has a slight bitter aftertaste. It's not a bad cookie, but it's not particularly good either, and one I won't be buying again. IMO, it's not worth the 260 calories one gets from eating both halves.P.S. Only the first ingredient, the whole wheat flour is organic.

These are tasty, however, as per the nutrition info on the package, one serving is 1/2 a cookie! The calories for half a cookie are 140 and the fat for that half a cookie is 5 grams. So if you eat the whole thing it is 280 calories and 10 grams of fat!
I received a call that the cookies were absolutely delicious. Our "Nana" is a fantastic cook, so that is high praise indeed.
So yummy my kids love them. Best natural cookie I have ever had, just like homemade.All of Nana's cookies are very good and shipping was fast.

I really like Nana's cookies and have placed several orders.  The Peanut Butter are always dryer than the others, but, unfortunately the last batch of Peanut Butter was way too dry.The Double Chocolate are always very moist and great tasting.I have tried most of the flavors, but Peanut Butter and Double Chocolate are my favorites.  Just wish they would make the peanut butter ones a little more moist.

I absolutely LOVE these cookies!  (and, no, I'm not a relative or friend of the manufacturer).  I've eaten the chocolate chip, oatmeal-raisin and peanut butter ones - never the gluten-free, so can't comment on them.  I love that they've no refined sugar or hydrogenated fats like most other cookies.  I've been buying them locally, and my grocery store is frequently out of them, so I was delighted to find them on amazon for cheaper than at the store.  One reviewer commented on the calories.  HUH?  First of all, who on a diet buys then dings cookies?  Also, keep in mind that just one of Nana's cookies is nearly 1/4 pound (hello?).  If you were to eat 4-1/2 regular size cookies, you'd end up with the same number of calories but they wouldn't taste as good as Nana's or be as good for you.  But you can always save what you don't want for later.  Sometimes I'll just eat half a cookie and roll up the plastic bag and tape it so I can enjoy the second half later.  So far they've kept just fine for even a couple of weeks.  No worries.

Quitting sugar is HARD. Nana's cookies make it MUCH easier. I get to enjoy the sweet & chocolately taste I crave, without the sugar or chemicals in most other cookies. They are delicious and very satisfying. Because they are sweetened with fruit juice, my blood sugar does not get spiked, so I do not get a "high" followed by a crash after eating these cookies. Nor do I feel addicted to them, like I do when I eat products made with sugar. And, I like that they are gluten free, since we are bombarded by products made from wheat, and I crave a variety of grains, like oats and rice. I highly recommend these cookies - I eat them regularly and they fulfill my craving for sweets, which has been so helpful in making better food choices when I am faced with temptation. And on Amazon, they are priced very reasonably, and worth every penny.

column9: The best cookie I've ever had!
column10: I purchsed Nana's Coconut Chip cookies at Amazon and loved them. Incredibly moist, luscious and yummy, these oversized cookies are as satisfying as they are good for you. With wholesome ingredients and no refined flour or sugar, these are truely healthy treats. Chocolate chips and coconut flakes are paired perfectly while the flavor of each is allowed to shine through. Brilliant!  If you love chocolate and coconut, especially together, in one chewy concoction, you would find these cookies addictive. And they are vegan too.

column4: Evelyn  Cullet "Evelyn Cullet, author of Roma...
column10: I love this cookie.  I have tried a few varieties of Nana's cookies, but her Chocolate Chip cookie is, without a doubt, the best tasting and the best textured of all.  I've been searching for a decent sugar-free cookie for many years and have tried just about every one, but none come even close to this one. It's delicious.

These cookies are pretty good. I need something to pop in my mouth just before I run out the door to walk the dogs. I want something nutritious which won't send me into a sugar frenzy, and I want it quick.If crunch is your thing, these are not for you. I prefer the softer cookie now......I'd rather not crack my teeth on a harder version.... If you're up and out in a hurry, this little delicacy will do the trick !!!

We love these. They are very yummy! I like that they are made with organic whole grain, and sweetened with fruit juice only, with peanut butter for protein. They are a great snack or treat. They are a nice big size so it's easy for my 2 young sons to share.

My husband and I are slowly becoming addicted to these cookies. While they are, to me, just ok right out of the package, they are delectable warmed up in the microwave for 30 seconds and eaten with ice cream on top! Preferably one that has some kind of chocolate in it to boost the chocolate flavor. A great alternative to sugar free products, which can cause stomach upset, for those of us that want to stay away from refined sugar! Just don't forget that these are not a low calorie food, read your labels carefully!
My son loves these cookies I would buy them from the health food store for over 2 dollars each.  This is well worth the price.  No sugar great!
I really like this cookie. A bit dry but good the same. My granddaughter says yummy.

I challenge any chocoholic healthy or not, vegan or not to find a better cookie! It melts in your mouth. I just love it and it doesnt bother my blood sugar at all. I would be hapier if it were wheat free but it is a true gem.  A cookie that taste fabulous and that you can feel good about eating. What's not to love. I appreciate the discount pricing from Amazon, its a big help as my husband and I go through boxes of them! And no we havent gained any weight and we feel great.

Life with dietary restrictions can be tough. Products like Nana's cookies make it so easy. These cookies are soooooooooo good and truly have healthy ingredients. Some "healthy" cookies are hidden with potentially harmful sugars like evaporated cane juice which is just sugar albeit unrefined. Some can take it and some cant. As a hyploglycemic that needs that is very senseitve to sugar the "good" and the bad these cookies are such a healthy treat. I never feel sick after eating one even if I eat the entire cookie and I couldnt possibly be more satisfied if I ate a homemade cookie with unhealthy ingredients. These cookies all of them I have tried are delicious. The gluten free options are not quite as good but if you must stay away from gluten all together they are a great version. This is the ULTIMATE cookie!

Interesting thing about reviews: you can tell as much about the reviewers as the items they're writing about.I've tried almost all of Nana's products and the No Gluten Ginger Cookie is my FAVORITE.  There's absolutely no guilt for me.  Brown rice and tapioca flour?  Fruit juice?  Canola oil?  What's not to like?  If, like me, you have to avoid dairy and sugar cane, it can be difficult to find a sweet treat that satisfies.  And if your girlfriend is gluten-free?  Well, now you're really in trouble.Fortunately, along comes Nana.This cookie has a great texture (almost like a scone: the real kind, from the UK) and a little kick.  It somehow maintains that perfect balance between spicy and sweet.  (See preamble, above.)  As with most of Nana's products, there's just one problem: I would be happier if the cookie were about as big as my head.  But that's why they come in boxes of twelve: one box lasts almost a week!Nana's other gluten free, dairy free, sugar free flavors - chocolate, lemon, and chocolate crunch - are all wonderful too, but this little wanton want-one is special.  Trust me.  Don't listen to the naysayers.  They just don't appreciate perfection; moist, buttery, spicy-sweetness.(See preamble, above.)Dear Nana: whatever that "natural flavoring" is, which hits the roof of my mouth like a monkey landing on my back, please don't take it out.  I pledge my everlasting devotion to your kitchen.  I'll even wash the dishes...
Great cookies if you are a celiac.  best cookies I have found in a long time.  You must try them!
i have tryed the oatmeal, chocolate chip, coconut chip and love them all. A wonderful no sugar cookie.
so far, i've bought about 3 boxes of cookies from this brand online.  even after being delivered, they were extremely moist, far more so than i expected.
These are my favorite cookies, I have one almost every day. It's hard to believe that they are vegan, they taste much better than most non-vegan cookies!

I was diagnosed with severe gluten and egg allergies roughly a year ago and had a hard time parting with my favorite kind of baked good: cookies. I never ate many in the first place but they were a treat or desert and I was thrilled to find a lemon cookie that satisfied my desire for baked goods.The consistency can be off-putting at first but the longer I go without wheat or gluten products the less important the consistency because I have almost forgotten what a real cookie tastes like. These lemon cookies are not tart but have a very nice lemony flavor that is reminiscent of a lemon bar. They are heavy and thick like a dense cake or brownie and incredibly chewy and fresh tasting.I would usually freeze these for a couple hours before taking one to school with me to have between classes. If you're able to drink soy or rice milk then a glass of vanilla or plain flavored milk will go great with these!
These cookies are rich and chocolately. They can be dry. But a small priceto pay for a chocolate cookie that is gluten and sugar free.

this cookie opened my mind to being vegan & eating deliciously. this cookie is the best choc chip i've ever had with the perfect balance of chocolate and nuts and a grainy but delicious cookie. this was my "gateway cookie" to her others- which are also very good, like the Lemon. but i think choc chip is my fave. yum.

I originally purchased these for a friend, who recently converted to a vegan diet. She raved about it so much that I decided to try it out myself. These cookies are absolutely delicious. They have a very intense chocolate taste that is not overly sweet as some chocolate cookies can be. Highly recommended.

I didn't love these cookie like I did the lemon and ginger ones. The little rice crispies in it made it bad. The cookie is soft and moist then you bite into a hard rice crispy and "OUCH" it hurts your teeth, lol. The flavor isn't bad it's just those nasty rice crispies!!! They should replace them for chocolate chips.
Good cookie. Very filling so 1 is more than enough. Moist and chewy like a good rasin cookie should be and not overly sweet.
I have tried 4 different Nana's cookes(3 Gluten Free & 1 w/Gluten) and they all are good!  Finally a company makes a great cookie w/out refined sugar!  Thank you, Nana!!

These are the best tasting cookies ever! When I found out I couldn't have anything with gluten, dairy or refined sugars, a friend told me about these cookies. She even gave me some for Christmas because she knew I couldn't have any of the other goodies people were bringing by. Buying them on Amazon saved me a considerable amount of money as well!
This is a delicious chocolate cookie.  Very moist and tasty.  I'm amazed by it, actually.  Excellent.
Wow! These are so good.  I have no known allergies to anything but I tried them and I LOVE the grainy texture and the lemon taste is soooo good.  WOW my new favorite!
These cookies are my new favorite. Very lemony, and they have a wonderful consistency.  I will definitely buy again.  With this cookie, it's not bad not eating wheat.

I have Celiac Disease, which means no gluten.  Gluten comes from basically every grain except for Rice and Corn.  So for those of us who like "real food," we can't have it.  Nana's Cookies are Wonderful!  All of the flavors...  It's so nice to have a gluten free food...especially a sweet cake like cookie...that doesn't taste like dog food...but like a "real" chocolate cookie.

i don't eat them often.. i'm not a big cookie eater..i wasn't grown up with the holiday sweets, being asian, and growing up with grand parents..but these are great.! the ingredients are what i lovewhen i look at the nutritional packaging, its not as attractive..but the sugar and fat are from natural sources like fruit juice (which contains vitamins and minerals) and sun flower seeds and unprocessed  vegetable oil.. essential fatty acids..the taste is also good, a bit too sweet for me, but i like the chewy sunfloer seeds

column4: K. Saito "Gluten Free Mom of Three"
column9: Nana's Ginger Cookies Rock!! Go Nana!!
column10: These cookies are soooo delicious!  Due to Celiac Disease and other gluten intolerances, three members out of our family of five must be gluten free.  These cookies sure fit the bill for a treat!  They are delicious, and even though they crumble a bit (if you eat gluten free you would probably be used to this since rice flour is commonly used, and it crumbles), they still have a soft moisture to them.  The ginger flavor is really good and not any spicier than a ginger snap.  My two boys ages 9 and 11 LOVE them.  When I pull the cookies out of the grocery bag, they dance around with joy!  The true test was when my husband tried one.  He does not have to eat gluten free, nor does he care to, lol.  He really liked it, and has since requested them when I shop! A+++ for these!!  Thanks Nana!

I saw this cookie at Whole Foods and decided to give it a try. I'm not a huge lemon fan but this cookie is delicious! Plus vegan and gluten free to boot! I'll definately be having it again(and trying other flavors)

column9: The best Wheat Free, Dairy Free, Egg Free Cookies
column10: I have tasted almost every wheat free, dairy free cookie available and these are the best I have tasted.  The cookies actually taste like real homemade chocolate chip cookies:).

column9: A good cookie but the orange taste is too strong
column10: While Nana's makes generally excellent cookies, this particular formula is quite strange.  The orange zest flavor is incredibly strong and it has oddly crunchy rice-like bits in it that aren't great.  I'm sure that there are probably fans of this recipe out there, but I wouldn't order it again.

Vegan. Organic. Kosher parve. Fat Free. High protein. Great bean mixture. Very tasty & pleasing. Great as a chili or bean soup base, add water and your favorite veggies and simmer. Or heat and serve as a bean side dish or 'dal' right from the can. Try as a topping on your favorite crispbread. Made with organic pinto beans, organic kidney beans, organic black beans, and sea salt. 300 calories, 0g fat, and 21g protein per can. Labeled "vegetarian," but is vegan also. Also really like Westbrae Natural Vegetarian Organic Soup Beans, 15 Ounce Cans (Pack of 12), Westbrae Natural Vegetarian Organic Salad Beans, 15 Ounce Cans (Pack of 12), and Westbrae Natural Vegetarian Organic Lentils, 15 Ounce Cans (Pack of 12). This review is out there for those for whom this makes a difference. See all of my reviews for more great choices. Check out "Vegan Grocery Favorites" and "Vegan Grocery Top Ten" in Listmania. Your "helpful" votes count and will be greatly appreciated to benefit the search of others. Thank you.

Great beans for making (obviously) chili. Was somewhat taken aback when I opened a can to find that the beans only take up half the can. Since the net weight includes the liquid, keep this in mind for your recipes.
Tastes great.  Cans are full to the top - not sure what another reviewer was talking about.

The product is a combination of kidney, pinto, and black beans.Pros:1) Sodium content is relatively low, about 400 mg per can, or about a third of most other brands.2) Organic, free of preservatives, etc.3) Quality is good; not too soft or too firm; good taste.4) Beans empty easily from the can, unlike some other organic brands (i.e. Eden pinto), which chelate and have to be forcibly removed.Cons:The main downside is the price, but this is true of any organic products.While I don't like these as well as Eden, I like the combination of three beans.  These would make a good starter for a bean salad or possibly a vegetarian/vegan chili.

I prefer the Westbrae chili bean mix to their salad bean mix for bean salads. Salad mix has garbanzos which are not my favorite - just don't have much flavor. Rinse these guys, and add tomato, plenty of fresh rosemary, small cubes of smoked mozzarella and olive oil and a little balsamic and let sit for a while. Add whatever else - chilled small pasta, bacon, mushrooms, peppers, asparagus, shrimp... Super tasty.

Westbrae Natural Vegetarian Organic Chili Beans are a delicious blend of kidney, black, and pinto beans. They make a colorful blend for chili. I used them in a coffee/cocoa vegan chili from Veg News Magazine (Our big love issue, June 2010) recipe. The beans are rich and flavorful. They're a perfect blend for meatless chilies, or whatever calls for a combination of beans. They'd be great in a vegetarian tamale pie topped with cornbread, or tucked into burritos/enchiladas. Beans are a natural source of protein. They're also superior to most meat substitutes. The World in your Kitchen: Vegetarian recipes from Africa, Asia and Latin America for Western kitchens has many bean-based dishes, as does Jamie's America: Easy Twists on Great American Classics, and More when Oliver hits the trail in Wyoming, and makes his own twist on fireside chili. Delicious, organic and nutritious!

I ordered a case of these beans.  I was trying to figure out a way to get staples into the house without taking the time to go to a local store.  I finally got around to using these chili beans for my home made chili recipe.  I opened these cans and each of them were full of some slimey liquid, for half of the can.  I had to drain off that slime before i got to the beans.  I only had a half of a can of beans once the liquid was gone.I am cooking this now.  These beans have NO TASTE!!.  I am going to have to add a lot of salt, pepper and chili powder to save this pot of chili.  I am very disappointed.  I will never use this brand again.
Maybe I did something wrong, but this cobble was all watery peach juice.  I would have expected it to thicken.

column9: Just like the old Eagle Mills San Francisco Sourdough Bread Machine Mix
column10: While I lamented the lack of Eagle Mills San Francisco Sourdough Bread Machine Mixes on Amazon, someone had commented that the company had been acquired by Krusteaz and that I should try that mix instead.  Being unable to find it anywhere in my local stores and feeling like I had to have an alternative to homemade sourdough, I finally relented and ordered the boxes.  Whoever originally told me to do it, THANK YOU!  The Krusteaz mix IS just like the Eagle Mills was.  Taste is the same, instructions are the same, the only thing that isn't the same is the amount of the mix in the box - 14 oz for Krusteaz vs. 15 oz for Eagle Mills.  I don't miss the extra ounce too much.  While it isn't like home made sourdough, it does make a nice quick substitute when one does not have 15 hours to devote to bread.  Thank you!

column9: Not sure why this rating is so low.
column10: I've cooked 8 loaves of this bread in my bread machine and every one of them has been fantastic. Even friends that made fun of me for getting the bread machine were considering getting one themselves after tasting this sourdough.I've never cooked sourdough from scratch before, but it's extremely difficult for me to imagine that it's that much better than this bread mix. Especially when you factor in it's literally: Add a cup of water, Dump in mix, Add included yeast, Press a button. You can't really beat that. Every batch I have made rose no problem.There is only one problem I have with it. After I make a loaf, it's gone so fast, I rarely have it when I want it. But that's a great problem to have.I hardly review on amazon, but this bread deserves a higher rating than this. I've also had the white bread mix and it's extremely good too.

column9: The best tangy sourdough mix you will find.
column10: This is the best tangy sourdough mix you will find. It's super easy just add water and you have prefect tangy sourdough that's very close to making it the long hard way from starter. When you don't have time to plan ahead and make tangy SF style sourdough or need to make it in a flash, this is as good as it gets. Very happy with this mix and will be trying some of the other Krusteaz mixes. This comes with everything including the yeast, just add water. Also the tangy flavor is better if you wait to eat 4 hours or more after baking.
I live in Hawaii and crave sourdough bread. This mix works well in both a bread maker and in the oven. Delicious flavor and the right texture. I'll be subscribing for future orders.

column9: Excellent tasting bread if you like Sourdough.
column10: As good as my Mother made, maybe better, I signed up for the automatic renewal service. You won't be disappointed in the quality.

I used to be able to find this product in stores years ago.  As bread machines have lost popularity, so have the bread mixes that go with it.  As a result, it is difficult to find this product in stores.  It is great to find it here on Amazon and I don't mind buying it in bulk.  The sourdough is so yummy.  It usually doesn't last for more than a day in my house before a loaf is all gone. It goes great with spaghetti or it is good all by itself.  It is also wonderful when toasted.  If you like bread, you can't go wrong with this mix.

Tried this mix in a Zojirushi BB-CEC20 Home Bakery Supreme 2-Pound-Loaf Breadmaker, Black, with poor results. It tasted fine, but the dough fell during the final rise, so loaf came out concave and way too dense. I'm pretty sure it wasn't my error, as all you do is dump the flour mix over a cup of water, followed by a pre-measured pack of yeast on top, and run it on basic. The machine has always produced successful loaves, this one being the only exception thus far. I may give it another try, just to see if it was a bad batch.

Bought two flavors of this brand and both didn't rise, tougher then a rubber tire, smelled and tasted rancid.Other brands purchased I purchased worked perfectly.The manufacturer claims it is the consumers fault the bread fails, it should be recalled.
I love the chips however 6 of the 12 bags were open when I received them. That was disappointing. It would be nice to get them replaced.
These chips are amazing!!!!  They hold up extremely well (not breaking) when I use them in my extremely thick homemade dip and the taste is amazing without the dip.
I made all 3 kinds for a big family gathering.  Everybody liked different kinds, and worked for a mix of raw vegies and chips.  Big hit.
it wasn't bad for the price.  we got bored with it though...it was too much at once, be nice if u could buy individually

column9: Nice Fresh Flavor. Low Calorie. I'll Be Back For More.
column10: I enjoy trying new foods and beverages. I found this "Aloe gloe" water (crisp, original, pulp free) in a 15.2-ounce bottle in my local Fresh and Easy Neighborhood Market. I had to try it. I've never had anything aloe before and I was curious. Well, it's quite good. I'd say it tastes like a mild iced tea with something of a fresh, very-light minty flavor and is ever so slightly sweet. All the ingredients are certified organic. It's produced right here in California, only about a hundred miles away, in fact. Supposedly it has digestive, immune and skin benefits, and I certainly can't vouch for that after having only one bottle. But, I like it. Nice taste. Goes  down easy. Only 70 calories in a 2-serving bottle. I'll be back for more.Gary Peterson

I was somewhat surprised to discover that--among aloe's many reputed benefits were digestive, immune, and skin health advantages. Of course, these claims could be simple marketing ploys, but this Aloe Gloe Natural Aloe Water is certainly worth a try. It did strike me as somewhat curious that the water contains both "certified organic cane sugar" AND "certified organic stevia." I'm left to wonder why water requires any sweetening at all, let alone the addition of two separate sweeteners. At any rate, I drank just one bottle (approximately 35  calories; 10 grams of carbohydrates), and I suspect that's not nearly enough to reap the benefits of this product. I'm a bit skeptical, but I'd be curious to find out whether anyone who drinks this regularly notices any actual benefits.

I bought this from a local warehouse store... I took a big gulp and was shocked at the odd aftertaste, the stevia i assume. I should have looked beforehand at the 6 ingredients, stevia is the last. I don't love it and I don't hate it. It's interesting to note that each serving is 18 calories, but the front of the bottle states 35 calories for the entire bottle.

I've never been much of a soda drinker, so I'm always on the lookout for alternative beverages like juice and tea.  Lately, I've been swept up in the craze of coconut water.  When I saw this bottle of 'aloe water' I immediately wondered what the new flavor was.When I opened the bottle, I was reminded of the smell of apple juice.  Aloe Gloe has a very sweet, crisp flavor.  Considering there is a both cane sugar AND Stevia sweetening up this drink, I guess that isn't a surprise.  It's very pleasant and enjoyable, and would be extremely refreshing chilled and served on a hot summer's day.One odd note, though: if you drink directly from the bottle, there's a distinctive plastic  note to the liquid.  That was rather disconcerting.  I think that if you drink it from a glass this would probably be alleviated.

I was curious as to how this would taste - and I have to say they did a great job.  It taste clean and is refreshing, to top it off its also very good for me to drink.  I love natural products and this one fits into my narrow box of acceptability and it's taste was a pleasant surprise.Jesus' Blessings and Peace

I wanted this to be perfect...as a result of years searching for an Organic Aloe Drink that was not too thick, gloppy, and more like a medicine than a satisfying, good-for-you refresher with all the benefits to digestion and the immune system. Aloe Gloe - almost made it - a silky smooth consistency of a 35 calorie serving per container, made in California USA (Yay!), delicious alone or with food, easily digestible and tastes like the good-stuff-Aloe. But why is organic cane juice (pure sugar), and Stevia (a natural sugar sweetener) added as well to equal 4 grams of sugar? For purists admittedly, the latter can make digestion more difficult and possibly compromise the immune system as well. The taste therefore in my opinion has an over-the-top sweetness note. But if you tend to drink sweet stuff, and/or like it that way, you will probably love the product, and be far better off drinking something actually good-for-you than some carbonated, diluted, and/or chemical concoction of who-knows-what. The product is Gluten Free, has no preservatives, is certified organic Aloe along with organic water as the primary ingredients. And...to underscore, it is made in the good ole USA! Thanks!

I ordered Aloe Gloe's Natural Aloe Water through Amazon's Vine program because I was curious.  I still am.  The product has a pleasant and slightly sweet taste, but I'm left wondering what the point is.  The product is touted as having a wide variety of important amino acids.  So, why does it have to be lightly sweetened?  I'd prefer a healthy drink that has more of the natural flavor of the plant from which it's derived.  This just seems too scientific.

Typically aloe has got kind of a bitter edge to it. This product isn't bitter, butit has an odd taste. However, I can see it being used in a smoothie, so you likely wouldn't taste it. Aloe has a lot of health benefits. So if you look at it as ahealth product the taste may not be a deal breaker. But in general, the taste isn't bad, it's just odd and that is a deal breaker. I'd rather get my aloe some other way.

The taste of Aloe Gloe is excellent.  There is however a little bit of stevia aftertaste (not too bad).Like many expensive waters the amount of the healthy ingredients isn't much.  The bottle indicates 300 mg of Aloe.  I'm assuming that is for the entire bottle not.  This is actually a reasonable dosage but perhaps a bit on the low side depending on how much benefit you expect to obtain (and who's opinion on dosage you listen to).This is a good low calorie drink (only 35 calories for the entire bottle) and an entire bottle is only 8 grams of sugar.All in all this seems like a good product but due to the cost I doubt I'll drink much. I'd rather buy coconut water.

column9: Pleasant taste, not what I expected
column10: The "Aloe Gloe" water is special.  It is natural aloe water-it contains 300 mg per bottle of aloe vera. It is certified organic, and also is supposed to improve digestive, immune and skin health benefits.  Apparently this product is infused with more than 200 (perhaps 201?) biologically active amino acids, vitamins, antioxidants enzymes and minterals, according to the package.  The maker and supplier of this beverage is obviously trying to tout this as a health product.  As I am not aware of any research with this particular water actually improving someone's health I am not sure if all these added things really do improve a person's health. This product has a pleasant, sweet taste.  It also (at least to me) looks slightly green.  Although I still prefer natural water, and would not buy this product; I enjoyed the taste of this more than I expected to.  I would rate this 3.5 stars if I could.

Already an Aloe Vera fan, it does believe that it helps me with digestive problems. Originally, I saw a BBC diet show that saw that it was great for the digestion. The star recommended about 4 ounces every morning. I didn't know about its skin health benefits before. On the side of the bottle, is a list of its health benefits?Previously, I have been buying sugar free aloe vera from a Chinese grocery that was tasty. Can't remember where it is from so I do like that this is from California. This is sweetened with organic stevia, but I also noticed some "Certified Cane Sugar" on the ingredient label. Therefore, you may want to limit the amount you drink each day. It is 18 calories per 8 oz. so that is just 9 calories each day for me!One warning, when you look for aloe vera, you really need to look at the ingredient list because most aloe vera of the aloe vera drinks are super loaded with sugar.I like to put mine in the refrigerator before opening as it is really tastes, cool, clean and crisp when you do that.The only thing that I would do differently is to offer one with the pulp. I love pulp! I highly recommend this product.

column9: WILL NOT BUY THIS PRODUCT AGAIN
column10: I bought the Natural Aloe Water - Aloe Gloe at Costco.  I wanted to try another brand.  It has plastic take or yucky taste, and so I decided to mixed it with Cranberry Juice.  I will go back to ALO brand.

Aloe Gloe is very refreshing. I have not been drinking it long enough to notice the health/beauty benefits. It has a lightly sweet taste, but by no means "sugary". The only complaint I have is the bottle.If you drink it out of the bottle you get a weird plastic taste, its actually quite strong. So I pour it in a glass, problem solved.

A friend introduced me to Aloe Gloe when I was complaining about the aloe juice recommended by my doctor - pulpy, bitter, nasty stuff. The taste takes a bit of getting used to, but it's not as offensive.The benefits, however, and wonderful. Since one bottle is two servings, I usually have half a bottle's worth with my breakfast. (It tastes much better chilled.) I have noticed a small improvement in my skin and hair, in that my hair seems stronger and definitely shinier, and my skin is clearer. The bottle claims that there are benefits to the immune system; I can't vouch for that, and as for the digestive benefits, I'm pretty "regular" anyway. But I do like tossing this back regardless as a super easy addition to a beauty routine.Beauty from the inside out and all that.
This is the best of the aloe drinks.  Just wish the still made the one with the pulp in it.

This is the only pizza crust my son will eat. My non-allergy child who has had wheat pizza and this, loves it. Very easy to use. I usually pre-bake all 3 and slice, then freeze them. That way I can pull a couple pieces out, defrost and pizza is served on a whim.

I love these shells. I cook hotter than they recommend, but that's mostly a matter of which sort of cheese you use to top the pizza (I like whole milk mozzarella, which takes more heat to get bubbly & awesome). Pizza is one of those wheat products I missed most, and getting to have it again is pretty awesome.

This is not the best pizza crust I have ever had, but it is the best gluten free pizza crust. As somebody who worked my way through school at a pizzeria finding out my kids could not have gluten seemed to be the end of my love for pizza. Then I discovered this product and keep the pantry stocked with this product and my kids and I all love our home made pizza.

column9: They are good when they don't come moldy...
column10: I used to order 5 packages at a time to save money and while they are tasty, every time they got here (and I opened them right away) at least half of them were moldy. No thanks...

I have tried and was very happy with different kinds of break from this company, so I was excited to try the pizza crusts too.  Unfortunately, the crusts I got came out covered in white yeasty mold, like a few other reviewers said.  I also noticed that in the product description it says "yeast-free" though yeast is clearly listed as one of the ingredients.  Just sayin'...

I'm a pizzaholic and not ashamed to admit it :-)  Although the fact that these were gluten-free was not of concern to me, I'm trying to eat healthier, and watch calories. I like these because they're a decent portion size for a big guy like me.  (If I was trying to be good, I'd only eat half of one of these).I wasn't clear on how many I was getting, so now I can tell you:  I got 5 packages with 3 crusts in each package.  I paid $12-something for them here onAmazon, so for less than a buck each, it seems like a good deal.  I think I need to refrigerate them when open (I put each one in a gallon-size freezer bag), but apparently the non-opened packages can sit in my pantry for quite some time.  They're packaged with lots of those "stay-dry" packets that are often found in shoe boxes or other things that might not like moisture.I've long admired those who can make home-made pizza dough, roll it out, and bake it to perfection.  For me, that's too much work, and I lack the baking skills to make that happen.  However, I like creating my own pizzas on a whim and pulling this out of the pantry and putting my own toppings on is VERY handy.I'll try to update this review when I reorder to let you know whether I had any problems with the non-refrigerated ones staying mold-free.

I have tried another rice shell and liked it, but this one is closer to a "real" pizza shell. It is raised somewhat, from the yeast and has a yeasty fragrance. I pre-cook shell to try to get crispier. If you prefer a softer shell, this is perfect. It is stiff enough to hold all my toppings. I had no problem with mold or it keeping well. I sealed it shut again after using one and put in fridge. :)

column9: good start for gluten, casein and soy free pizza
column10: We are gluten, casein, and soy free and it's very difficult to find anything that doesn't have soy in it that doesn't taste and feel like cracker crumb crust.  This is very good, and very reasonable.  The family loved it, specially my 7yr. old grandson with autism, who hates almost everything (just like mikey).  Will definitely buy it again.

I would describe this tea as more of a sophisticated black tea with a flirtation of chai spice Vs. your typical knock-you-upside-the-head, spicy, hippy chai teas on the market. It goes great with milk and honey as a pick-me-up morning brew!

column9: Flavorful, Creamy & Smooth Split Pea Soup
column10: If you struggled for years using store bought green split peas and have never been satisfied with your soup, struggle no more.  For years I tried different recipes and was never satisfied with the end result because of the inferior product I was using.  My green split pea soup has never been better now that I started using this company's product.  Palouse Brand's product is hardy, tender, flavorful, creamy and smooth when cooked.  There is no dissapointment here. This farming family knows how to delivery fresh!

I love split pea soup and these peas are so fresh and cook up so well.  Can you buy cheaper split peas?  Of course you can but they likely weren't grown in the US and are probably a couple of years old.  These peas are far superior to the bag of peas in the grocery store.  These are grown in Washington, packaged in Washington and shipped from Washington.  It is worth it to spend a little more for a far superior product!

column9: As far as I can tell, these are very good split peas
column10: I have made homemade split pea soup for many years.  I recently resumed doing so after not for about a decade.  I bought organic split peas at my local market, they were tasteless.  Chicken broth was used to make that soup, too.  But these split peas were much more flavorful.  They cooked up much better as well, meaning that the first brand's peas must have been old, bcs after an hour or more they were still tough.  So, that tells me these are fresh, and superior.
My husband complained that split peas didn't have any taste anymore.  He really likes these and said they taste like split peas used to taste.  Seem to be very good quality.

These are delicious peas. I made about 6 crock pots of pea soup before the bag was finished. I hardly had to add any spices for it to taste delicious. Just some natural sea salt and a little brags amino acids. Plus I put in a few garlic cloves and it was so heart warming soup. Usually, with ordinary peas, you have to put bacon and other spices in to make it good. Not with these peas. They were delicious on their own. Also delivered timely. Thanks again.

I love making pea soups - all kinds.  I received these peas a couple of days ago from Amazon and made my first batch of curry pea soup today.  These peas are some of the cleanest and of the highest quality I've ever purchased.  I always rinse and sort me legumes before I cook them and usually find something to sort out.  Not with these.  They where all beautiful and well formed with no trace of dirt, stems or any other debris.  I'm very impressed.  Oh, and they taste wonderful.  I highly recommend you purchase them - in fact, purchase two so you qualify for Amazon's free shipping!

It would be very hard to purchase any other brand of split peas after having had the pleasure of tasting these. Each pea is perfect; no imperfect ones to toss out. The final result is mouthwatering. I made a big pot, threw in some vegetables, and can barely keep myself away from having too much now and not enough left for another day.And, being organic and GMO free, wrapped very carefully in gunny sack material inside a plastic bag, it is a healthful contributory to the diner, not a questionable one.I'm really glad I discovered these split peas. I can't imagine anything better.

These are the best-tasting green splits I've ever had.  I love creamy soups, split pea being one of my favorites, but it's not usually easy to make a delicious creamy soup without adding some sort of meat flavoring (I don't eat anything that used to have a face). These peas are delicious without having been cooked with any sort of meat/chicken-based flavorings.  Nice and fresh-no more of those gray colored little things sold in plastic bags at the grocery store. These peas even smell fresh in the bag (which is a nice drawstring muslin).

column9: This is the flour I was looking for!
column10: There is not to much you can write about flour. But this is what I need to bake bakery type breads. I am baking my own sandwich(hoagie, submarine)rolls. And finally have duplicated pizza crust!Everyone thought I was crazy to buy such a large quantity. But I broke it down in to gallon sized zip lock bags. Each bag holds five pounds. I am storing the bags in my basement freezer, should keep forever.

Amazon.com is an amazing superstore to have in one's home. I bake bread and know the value of gluten enriched flour. Bread flour makes the bread chewy, yet soft, tasty and palatable. The above product reviews assured me and a week later UPS delivered. I transferred the flour into Ziploc bags and froze to be safe. Am enjoying the bread. Amazing!

With grain prices on the increase and shortages projected worldwide, I keep this large bag of wonderful high gluten flour in my freezer so I don't worry about weekly price increases or running out of something I use very frequently; it also remains insect-free and fresh in the freezer.  This company ships for under $5 and does so very quickly following an order.
You won't believe the difference this flour makes when used in pizza crust.  Believe me you will use more than you think.  50 lbs is not too much.  It's just what I've been looking for.
It works great in bread, cakes, and other things that I have baked.  I will also use this in making meat substitute.
Excellent quality flour for bread making.  This is the 2nd time I have ordered it and will definitely continue!
Mixes great with water. Tastes great. Fiber content helped with weight loss. And a perfect amount of protein.I recommend this product for anyone.
$3.29 + $5.51 shipping?  making it $8.80 for a product you can buy in a store for $3.50?  why doesnt the seller sell by the box with a decent shipping rate and it would be worth purchasing.

column9: Great product - no so truthful vendor
column10: First and foremost, this is an excellent yeast product. It works incredibly well.The company assured me by phone contact the yeast would be recently manufactured. My expectation was that it would be within the past 3 to 6 months. It was not. The serial manufacture code implied a product made in late 2010. That's about 10 months old.Granted the yeast is still very usable and will last about another year before expiration with proper storage. It's just a disappointment for the price paid. It's a premium product.

I recieved the yeast in a few days (exactly what the fedex tracking said) when I checked the date it expired on 12/2007! and it was removed from its original packaging. I am not at all pleased with the company that sent it.
Ive been using this brand for a number of years, and have found it to be very good.  Cook's Illustrated has recommended it as the best yeast that it has tested.
I was just learning to make bread when I first bought these, and now I am a loyal fan. Bread turns out beautifully

column9: Waste of time, money and food
column10: Is there any actual yeast in this? I have used this many times from several different batches and purchased from different retailers at different times. It often comes prepacked as the yeast in pre-packaged bread mixes.  Each time I was careful to make sure that it was nowhere near the expiration date. In EVERY case, the bread has failed to rise. This is worse than garbage as it ruins all the ingredients and you have to throw it all out; there is little worse than needlessly wasting food.  When it comes with the pre-packaged mixes, I have tried throwing out this branded "yeast" packet and replaced it with other brands of yeast.  When I do this, the bread comes out perfectly.  The bread is only ruined if I actually used this brand of yeast.Bottom line, if you want to be disappointed and waste time, energy, money and food, then this is exactly what you want.Update May 2012:I have been experimenting with this brand of yeast by trying to activate in the following manner. Take one packet (about two teaspoons), add 1/4 teaspoon of sugar and 1/4 cup of water between 110 and 120 degrees. Put it in a coffee cup and get it all nice and wet and wait about five minutes. Red Star brand and Fleischmans (regular and fast rising) and the Hodgson Mill yeast in their bread machine mixes (the only other ones I have checked) yeast will rise and fill half the coffee mug. (Fast risers fill the whole cup) This brands increases its volume by just a little.I have also found that Red Star (regular, did not try the fast rise) yeast that is more than one year past its expiration date performs nearly as well as the fresh stuff. Therefore I can say with the confidence of empirical evidence that Red Star yeast that is more than one year past the expiration on the package performs better (read: acceptable) than the packets of unexpired SAF yeast I have tried (read: unacceptable).

This is the best yeast I have ever used in baking.  Introduced to this yeast when using some Gluten Free baking mixes.  So impressed with its performance I bought it for my other baking needs.  Yeast has no bitter after taste as I get with other brands.  Well worth the price and waiting to have it shipped.

This yeast seems to work wonderfully, and I love the fact that it does not contain additives like emulsifiers. I believe it is also gluten-free, which is helpful for me, as I am sensitive to gluten. I love this yeast!

This is my favorite yeast (and I've tried dozens).  It's the most consistent, and it's also made to be added to dry ingredients.  This is very convenient if you're making bread in a bread machine or with a stand mixer -- no proofing necessary, just dump it right in.  Love it!

This is the best Tikka Masala sauce I've ever had from a jar.  The flavor easily cooks into the vegetables we added, and is definitely better than others we tasted (Pataks - bland, tasty bite - needs more taste, Sharwood - slightly less bland than the Pataks).  Unfortunately, it's no longer available at my local grocer - we only find the Pataks in the discount isle and, well, the only good Pataks is the Vindaloo flavor which is still lacking).  This sauce has a slightly tart flavor which mixes very well with rice and vegetables and/or meat/tofu.  There is a bit of extra oil that never spoils the taste.  After eating this, it's hard to eat another Tikka Marsala dish without going to an authentic Indian place.

This is the best Tikka Masala sauce I have had.  Mr Kook's has the best sauce available on the market for pre-made sauces.  They are easy and delicious.  Mr. Kook's Butter Chicken sauce is phenomenal.

Dixie Carb Counters Dine 'n Dash Cream of Mushroom Soup Mix is not a cream of mushroom soup at all. It's vey watery and the taste isn't good at all. I do not recommend this product for low carb dieters.

column9: Low Carb Cream of Mushroom Soup
column10: It taste like mushroom soup, it will take the edge off of hunger. I con't care for it much because I don't like mushrooms, but, it does what it is suppose to do, and what we don't do to watch our weight. I think low carbs are over priced, but, they are well packaged and kitchens have put in a lot of work and expense to help people watch their weight. So, I just buy the products and keep on trucking.

column9: Impressive chocolate and impressive delivery service!
column10: Wow, the chocolate is AWESOME!  Once you get used to the grainy texture, it's sooo flavorful.  And the packaging was impressive.  Took several minutes with scissors to unwrapp the box/package/silver insulated bubble wrap/baggie with chocolate next to fake ice that was probably frozen at one point.  Will definitely order again.  Would really love to try the 87% dark chocolate...hint hint.

column9: Excellent! Delivery Packing and Service Fantastic
column10: I purchased this product just a few days ago. Swift product delivery and the packaging was so carefully done. The chocolate was packed in paper inside a plastic bag, then a cold pack around that inside cold preserving bubble wrap, all surrounded by packing peanuts in a small box. So very well packed that there was no way that the chocolate would get bruised or cracked. The product was perfect and smelled amazing as I opened the protective packaging.This is a really delightful sampler of delicious organic chocolate. It is just cacao beans, cane sugar and what ever seasoning makes up the flavor enhancement (cinnamon, vanilla, guajillo chili, salt & pepper, orange, chipotle chili, ginger, and cacao puro). It can be enjoyed as is or you can make a hot chocolate drink with it. "Good to Eat or Drink". So very good and of course it is healthy :). Our favorite so far is the guajillo chili. Yummy chocolate with a kick.

This sampler was a great way to try the various varieties of Taza chocolate.  I'm impressed!  Very unique, tasty flavors.  I also love that it's organic.  International Coffee & Books' packaging for this item was also impressive: the box of chocolate was tightly packed in two layers of thermal bubble wrap with an ice pack (thawed by the time it got to me, but did it's job, no melt!).

Check the description before you buy. The price I paid was for a single packet.  Don't assume that because the price is similar to what you might pay for 8 or 10 of these packets at your local grocery store that you are getting more than a single packet. That didn't pan out so well for me and I am returning the item.

These little packets are the same as the ones provided by Chinese restaurants in their take out food packages.  We were tired of asking for extra mustard and not getting enough, so we stocked up on these.  The quality is excellent and we also purchased the packets of duck sauce.

This tea is excellent for the body. Very soothing as you drink it and relaxes you instantly. I would recommend this tea to anyone. Drink it with honey, taste great! (Also, I usually drink it when I have a cold or just need to relax from a hard day @ work)!

I just wanted basic egg cups. That's all. But the basic ones were too expensive, and the cheap ones weren't basic enough.  I settled for chicken cups. Whatever.  They work fine, but the spoons break REALLY easy.
Cups are cute.  One came in broken, so packing could have been better.  Inexpensive so just superglued back together.

I haven't had any issues with the spoons or cups being too fragile -- I've run everything through the dishwasher and used them multiple times with no problems.  Combine this with the Egg Topper Cutter Clipper Stainless Kitchen Gadget and the Nordic Ware 64802 Microwave Egg Cooker and you'll have perfect soft-boiled eggs.  Use the little egg spoon to scoop the bit of egg out of the top that you cut with the cutter and then enjoy your egg in an egg cup.  So civilized and easy to eat!

The set is exactly as described and we are happy with it.  But, it arrived with a broken cup.  A replacement was very nice and shipped a replacement immediately.  However, the replacemen was also broken, so we just settled for one less cup.

column9: It's not the product but the packaging
column10: These egg cups are very pretty and the spoons are lovely, however they are not packaged properly so three of the egg cups were smashed to pieces (way beyond repair) when I received them. I won't bother reordering them as the packaging is clearly designed for a product being purchased off the shelf and not mail order. Pity.
I like this set, all holders are cute and do their job well. I dont use the spoons though, prefer my silver ones
One of the 4 was broken,was it necessary to send all of them back?  Other than that I loved them perfect size and great spoons.
The egg cups and spoons arrived broken due to very poor packaging. I was disappointed because the ones that weren't broken were very cute.

column9: Makes my kids eat their eggs!!
column10: These little cups are very cute, light weight, and fun to use.  One of my sons would not eat hard/soft boiled eggs.  Now, he requests them. Good presentation makes everything taste better.  The cups do seem a little shallow, so there is some wiggle room for the egg.  It feels like it should be a little deeper to properly hold the egg in place.  Shipping was very fast, well packaged, and I am, overall, very pleased with this product and the seller.

I'd forgotten what a joy a soft boiled egg can be.  These  porcelain egg cups work just right. The little spoons do a great job scooping the egg out of the shell. Very nice with a slice of buttered toast. The package arrived promptly, well packed and contents perfectly intact. I like this set very much.

I love the item but one egg cup was cracked when I opened the box.  It was packed well so I'm sure it's a fluke. I would still use this seller again.  I just wanted a replacement though.  However, when I went to the return area, replacement was not an option.  I hope the seller will replace this for me.  I don't want to go to the trouble and expense of sending it back.  The egg set is adorable and I'm excited to use three of them.  I obviously wish I could use all four since that is what I have paid for.  Accidents happen and I know this isn't the sellers fault.  The egg set and spoons are exactly what I wanted and are very adorable.  Love them.

column9: Very nice set - not as fragile as one might expect
column10: As a child, I regularly had soft boiled eggs in egg holders similar, though not identical to these. I probably went over 40 years without having a soft boiled egg. Recently I warched the movie "Iron Lady" where Meryll Streep portrays Margaret Thatcher. In the opening scene of that film Thatcher serves soft boiled eggs in holders similar to these and it planted the seed in me to start eating soft boiled eggs again.Yes, these are porcelain, but knowing that, they're not unusually fragile - they're  as fragile, indeed I believe LESS so, than a reasonable person would expect from porcelain. I think less so because they're actually pretty heavy. I don't envision the spoons breaking unless they're dropped. If used solely to crack eggs they're  just fine.It's a nice set and One I think represents good value when compared to others available at this Website at the time of this writing. My set came with five spoons. I don't know if that was an error on the part of the ackaging company or if they've decided to add an extra just in case.
The egg cup is very cute but I don't care much about the spoon, it's to thick and it's hard to scoop.

column9: The unfortunate circumstances surrounding a once great Belgian ale...
column10: During the late 1990's and early 2000's, this was one of my favorites.  Back then, the 750ml bottle was the only option; I would purchase it to share with friends, trying to introduce them to something new in the beer world.  Strangely, the beer then left the Minnesota markets for a couple of years.  Needless to say I was quite displeased with this.  Despite my efforts, there was just no way that I could logistically get my hands on this now precious and coveted ale.  Then just a couple of years ago, Leffe resurfaced again - this time exclusively in 6 pack form.  Moreover, it was now in virtually every liquor store that carried at least a minimal selection of imported beers.  Although I was pleased that Leffe had returned, it just didn't feel quite right; it was now too ubiquitous, and I missed the old 750 ml corked bottles.  Now, in the past year or so, the 750ml bottles have returned.  Additionally, the sticker price is surprisingly much cheaper (approximately $4 - $6) than its Belgian competitors.  Once again, I was glad to see the return of the quintessentially Belgian corked bottle for Leffe.  However, the significantly reduced cost of the ale made me a bit suspicious.  Regardless, like reacquainting with an old friend, I decided to pick up a bottle to see if Leffe was still one of Belgium's finest.  While there is no doubt that Leffe is still a quality Belgian ale, there seems to be something slightly different with this product, some subtilities that seem to be lacking.  I noticed it mainly in the finish of the beer; there seemed to be a vaguely noticeable "thinness" that I've sometimes associated with cheaper quality American brews.  I started to "smell a rat," so I decided to dig a little bit deeper into recent information about Leffe; what I uncovered made my heart sink a little bit...It seems that one major step in the wrong direction for Leffe occurred in 2004.  It was during this time that Interbrew, the company that owned the rights to Leffe, merged with the Brazilian brewing company AmBev.  Changing the company name to InBev following the merger, the conglomerate earned itself a very negative reputation as a ruthless predator in the beer manufacturing world. It is also noteworthy to point out that this was roughly the same time period in which Leffe became conspicuously absent from the shelves of Minneapolis liquor stores.  Coincidence?  Maybe, but I'm willing to bet that it wasn't.  In November 2008, InBev purchased Budweiser giant Anheuser-Busch for $52 billion. Changing the name to "Anheuser-Busch InBev" (or "AB InBev" for short), the newly formed conglomerate was now the world's #1 beer manufacturer.  Moreover, multiple resources that I read cited the fact that AB InBev was now using corn and other cost-effective measures in their brewing process for Leffe -- something that was not being done previously.  In one fell swoop, this explains the recent widespread distribution, the suspiciously low cost, and the noticeably different taste of a once great Belgian ale.  As I write this, I keep shaking my head; I feel a bit duped and betrayed (unfortunately, Leffe is just the tip of the iceberg - other quality beers such as Franziskaner, Bass,  Goose Island, and Hoegaarden are also owned by AB InBev).By most accounts that I've read, AB InBev seems to have garnered a reputation for buying up smaller beer companies and either callously altering their brewing processes (in the name of cost-effective measures) or working toward closing the products lines down altogether.  There's lots of negative information out there in regard to this company... I may need to reconsider how often ( if at all) I should purchase products that support such a dubious organization.

On April 26, the company expanded the recall to its Chicken Soup for the Pet Lover's Soul Adult Light formula dry dog food.So far, no dog illnesses have been reported, the FDA said.Pets infected with salmonella can become lethargic and have diarrhea or bloody diarrhea, fever and vomiting, according to the FDA. column10: This is our pugs' favorite toy.  They chew on the bone ends for hours at a time.  They can remove the gnawhide treats right away but don't really care because the nylon ends are their favorite part!

column9: One of the longer lasting chew toys
column10: I picked up the medium size bone for my miniature schnauzer (not realizing that there was also a small and large size as well) and overall I'm pretty impressed, but not amazed.The nylon bone threads through the tough rubber ball and is secured by simply screwing one end into place over the other.  You can fit one treat on each end as shown (for a total of two) in the picture or opt to have just one treat.Overall the profuct is very durable.  My schnauzer has an unusually strong jaw for his size, and most chew toys don't last long enough to justify their costs.  However, the Busy Buddy does stand up very well and my dog really enjoys the gnawhide treats that come with it.  It's relatively easy to clean and I don't really woryy about any choking hazards here.However, the size of the bone in relative size to the ball doesn't really make for any decent 'bouncing' as the name suggests.  It more or less 'rolls', not bounce.  And I was a bit disapointed it only came with 6 treats to start with.  Though you can buy refill packs with 24 discs, I think the initial outing should come with at least 10 or 12.The discs themselves do indeed last a bit.  Probably because of their placement within the toy itself, it may help add time that it takes yoru dog to enjoy these, giving an impression it lasts longer than other chew toys.  But my schnauzer really does enjoy the treats.  They have a rich smokey/meaty smell and will keep his attention for some time.Overall I recommend this product.

This Premier toy can be loaded with the Gnawhide treats (see my Gnawhide Treat review). We don't really play bounce with it; we just sit quitely and enjoy the "pepperoni" treat before bedtime. Very worth the price for a chewing, active puppy.

This will definitely NOT entertain your dog for hours unless they are a slightly lacking in intelligence and can't figure out how to take the treat off! It takes my dogs a matter of seconds to rip off the treats! While they are moderately entertained by the toy itself, the purpose was to entertain them for a reasonable amount of time so I could work! I would recommend the Premier Busy Buddy Bristle Bone instead . . . it takes them significantly longer to get the treats out of this toy :-)

My Vizsla puppy was given this toy and had absolutely no interest in it.  But that is not even why this Toy is junk.One afternoon in an attempt to get him to play with it, I tossed it towards him and the bone literally smashed into pieces.  The only part salvaged from this toy was the rubber ball center.  Which I now occasionally fill with peanut butter and he really love that.  What a complete waste of money, it lasted one week.  And he never even played with it.

So far my dog isn't interested in this toy at all. So I'm not sure what I'm going to do about that. Concept for the toy is great but I guess you've gotta have a dog that actually likes this to work. Maybe he'll show interest later. After all he is new to toys.

column9: My dog love all toys - but NOT THIS ONE
column10: My dog loves any toy (or anything I give him to play with like a toy).  I go this one just because it was on sale.  He loved it for about 15 seconds and just never got into it.I considered taking him to the vet because he had never (I MEAN NEVER EVER) rejected a toy before.Thankfully (and he was especially happy) before going to the vet, I tested a different toy - which he loved and destroyed, then a whole slew of toys .... just be sure ..... and he love them all.Than I gave him back this one .... he just looked at it.  I put it in his mouth, he spit it out and looked up with the saddest "no more new toys :(" .....I said "WELL OF COURSE NOT" and ended up giving him more toys to play/destroy that day (you would have had to see the disappointment on his face each time I tried to get him interested in this one to totally understand).That was just MY baby (who resembles a dog so much .... I just let people call him a dog in public) but he is my baby .... the worlds largest baby with 4 legs ... but still .... my baby just didn't like the one toy.
The item was damaged in transit and was returned to the sender by the USPS.  I had to drive 30 miles to the nearest store to purchase the product on Christmas Eve day.

My Westie can remove the chew treats in a matter of seonds - not much challenge there.  However, he does really like the nylon bone more than other bones.  Overall, this is not worth the money.  I would recommend the "Tug-A-Jug" over this.  I have a lab that loves the large one and my Westie uses the smaller size.  I can get their entire meal into the jug.  They do get quite rowdy trying to get their dinner out so you may want to use this outside or in the basement.

My dogs absolutely love this toy!  Even after they have devoured the treats that go on the ends, they gnaw on them for hours.  I have used one for almost a year now and it is still holding up well... even under a large dogs teeth!  I would recommend this for anyone with a dog who loves to chew.

I got this toy along with about 10 others between Amazon and Petco and this one by far has stood up to my dog's chewing. He is an active chewer and this toy seems to be his favorite. The only reason I gave this a 4 instead of a 5 is that the little treats that are attached go very quickly so I will have to look into some more, but he does like it either way. Note: Our dog is a 9 month old English Springer Spaniel.

Wow - my retriever mix dog LOVES this dog toy.  I was hesitant because of the price but considering bully sticks and other nylabones are expensive and don't last long, this one is worth the cost.  My dog obviously loves chewing on the rings but even when they are chewed off, she still chews on the nylabone endings all the time.  We end up only putting on a 2 rings maybe once a week as an extra special treat.  I will say this though - this thing is HEAVY, so watch your toes!  I would only recommend this size for a dog over 50 lbs and a heavy chewer.  Otherise, get the medium size.

I like this product as do both my Labs (a puppy and an elder).  They like both kinds or gnawhides treats with the busy bone (the smooth and the rough ones).  I would say the only negative is the gnawhides are not available at any local pet stores so we always have to order them on Amazon.  The Everlasting treat (another long lasting treat)is easier to find, but the dogs (especially the puppy) seem to like the busy bone better.  I usually put one treat on at a time to make the treats last longer.

Daisy is a power chewer and a youthful terrier mix. In trying to work with her to spend time indoors without driving us crazy chasing the cats and jumping on/chewing on furniture, I wanted to find a puzzle. This toy with it's rings is just that. I purchased the medium-large bone and accidentally purchased the medium rings. This was a good accident as the medium large rings were too easy for her to grab and chew off quickly. The medium rings, although they have to be jammed on there more forcefully, are better for the clever mutt. She has also been chewing on the white part of the bone and it is just awful looking BUT she has not destroyed it and that is amazing! It keeps her occupied on her spot on the carpet for an hour at a time. I will probably replace it in a few months when she finally destroys it!

column9: Good concept, poor quality gnaw hide
column10: Good concept in terms of a rubber toy with refillable ringed gnaw treats but the treats get ripped out FAST! too easy an access for the dogs.  Mine ate the first two treats within an hour & the last few within the hours of my refilling it.  If you want them to be amused for a while, better to get a Kong.  If you just want a skeleton of a plastic bone for them to lose interest in, than this is your toy.  It's too hard for him to wrap his mouth around as a gnawing toy so without the treats, its just no longer fun for him.Good quality plastic... but overall bad toy for the purpose its trying to fulfill (the purpose being to have the dog leave you alone for a while)

My dog absolutely loves this toy! I do have a few tips for making the treats last longer...I got the gnawhide rawhide rings as well as the cornstarch rings. The cornstarch rings last a lot longer but also don't have the immediate gratification that the rawhide ones do. I stack one of each on either side, this makes the treat last a lot longer and seems very enjoyable for my pup! Also, the cornstarch rings dry out really quickly and then crack on the toy. Keep them sealed in a plastic baggie.Just a side not, my dog is 5 months old and NOT a hugely destructive chewer. I would rank him as a 7 on a scale of 1-10, so this probably isn't the best toy if you have a 10 on your hands.

This is one of our 13 month old Samoyed's favorite chews/toys (my chow chow has no interest in it.)  Not only does he like to gnaw on it, but he tosses it all around and chases it. Caution though, I got the large bone and it has some weight to it (almost 2#s.) One time he let it drop, it bounced and hit a ceramic planter causing it to shatter! I took the advice of another reviewer and doubled up on the rawhide rings.  I've had it for five days and he hasn't managed to chew them off yet...but keeps trying!  So far, this has been an indestructible chew toy that has kept him occupied for hours.
i have a lab mix, with a lot of energy-and this toys actually keeps her very busy. Buy lots of refills.

I was at CVS one day and saw this toy in the dog section.  It was only $8.99 so I didn't think much about it and put it in my cart.  Got home and gave it to my dog, Happy. He absolutely loves this toy over his Kong toys, his tug-of-war toy, his tennis balls ... he chooses this toy over all the others.  I picked it up one day to smell it.  Just curious since he loves it so much.  It has a nice smell to it. I don't know what it smells like to him, but he must like it!  Definitely recommend this to anyone that has a dog that likes to chew and the challenge of getting the treats!  :)

This toy provided very little mental stimulation to my dog.  The treat is so exposed and extremely easy to eat off, and the bone so hard and ball so heavy he wanted nothing to do with it after the treat was gone.  We have a heavy chewer, but unless you have a small dog with a small light bite that takes time eating it, I just can't imagine it would be worth the price of buying their own hides to attach.  I would suggest a nylabone first to make sure your dog is interested in chewing on the bone part even when there isn't treats attached.

column9: My Samoyed only interested on the treats, and not on the bouncy bone
column10: Once the inserted jerky treats have gone, my 11 month Samoyed soon left the bone alone and never touching it again. I'm confused now. I have bought plenty variations of dog toys, either nothing lasts quite long, or my dog just doesnt like the toy.

column9: An unusual toy to entertain your chewer
column10: I bought this item (the large version) for my housemate's mixed Labrador/Spaniel for Christmas. He's a very active dog who likes to chew, sometimes even throwing toys in the air in his play.He LOVED this. It was entirely novel to him, there were lots of textures, and the treats motivated him to play for a continuous 35 minutes until he could eat them.If you're not aware of it from the picture, there's a purple ball slotted over a plastic white bone (which corkscrews to shut within the ball). The treats can be placed on the bone on either side of the ball before corkscrewing the bone into its fixed position. Extra treats come with the toy, and can be bought as needed.I found the entire thing a little heavy, and I think the dog did too. He ended up breaking apart the entire apparatus (to get directly at the treats), and then chased the ball or gnawed at the bone. I think we'll use it with the treats on special occasions, but on a day-to-day basis the dog will use the ball and the bone separately. Effectively this is two toys in one.Highly durable. Even his chewing tendencies were unable to get through each part.

This is an awesome product that my Papillon LOVES!!  It is great because it keeps him completely occupied for a good 10 minutes.  I often give it to him when we are about to eat dinner as it keeps him busy and happy.  I do wish the ends weren't as chewable as he has chewed them up pretty good, but it still works fine. What a great concept!!  Love this toy!!

I bought both the bristle bone and this one, the bouncey bone. When I bought them I thought the high price was easy to justify.  A toy that satisfies a chewing urge, smells yummy, and keeps my dog entertained sounded like a great thing.  The pieces unscrew so you can reload the rawhide rings.  My medium sized dog found it very easy to take it apart, and I found the pieces scattered while he chewed on it under my desk.  It happened so quickly that when I discovered it, he had already started to destroy one of the purple rubber rings on the bristle bone. I wanted to prevent the disassembly trick, so I screwed the pieces together more tightly.  Unfortunately the weak nylon piece broke off when I did that.  There's about $20 down the drain.  Maybe I should have stuck to Nylabones.

My dogs love these! I bought a large one for my chocolate lab and a medium one for my smaller mixed breed. They both prefer the large bone. Both dogs love the rawhide treats.  My lab can get the treats off the bone now in about five minutes or less now, so if you are looking for something to keep your dogs occupied for long periods of time I wouldn't go for this. However, as most people know labs are super smart so your dog might take longer to figure out how to get the rawhides off. It takes my smaller dog about 10-15 minutes to devour her treats.

column4: Traci Freeman "Whip Cream luvs Roller Derby"
column10: My Chi puppies ignore this toy and the smooth rawhide that comes with it BUT they love the rough rawhide.  I give them the rings and they go crazy tossing it, chewing it and chasing each other for it.

column9: Loved by Puppy & 13 Year Old Dog Alike
column10: Premier Busy Buddy Bouncy Bone, SmallWe originally bought this item for our miniature shnauzer puppy. She loves it, but having the small attention span most puppies do, it is in her rotation of favorite toys. Our 13 year old cairn terrier, who has snubbed a lot of his old toys, also loves this, so we are getting him the medium size. This is a great item for those teething puppies who just want to chew, chew, chew.
These keep my dogs busy for hours at a time...they love it!  Easy to use and it seems to clean their teeth too.

I have two labrador retrievers who demolish almost every toy instantly.  These bouncy bones (medium is the right size for my 65# boys) provide hours of entertainment.  They will eventually chew through the bone; but afterwards, they are left with a bouncing ball that stays around for a long, long time.  These toys are worth every dime.

Length:: 2:38 MinsIt was a great bone for a while, until we bought our second refill pack... It was then that our 11 year old Yorkie, Allie, figured out how to unscrew it.Now she can unscrew this bone in less than 10 minutes.(Video is sped up x4)

I purchased these based on the "good" reviews that it had received. I have a Shiba Inu who loves to chew and thought this would be the perfect answer. I did not know that the "Gnawhide treats" were so EASY to choke on. After my dog finished his treat, he was choking excessively and threw up everything. I recommend you stay away from this product. FYI, my dog is medium size and I got the so called medium sized treat.

Purchased this because of all of the great reviews, but this just isn't for my dog.  I have a pit bull who is an enthusiastic power chewer.  On its own,  she wasn't really interested in it.  I put a bit of peanut butter between the gnawhide discs and the rubber ball and she finally got it.  It took her a good 20 - 30 minutes to get both of the treats off, after which she started chewing on the hard plastic bone ends.  Unfortunately, she started gnawing little chunks off of the ends - besides the little pieces of plastic that were coming off, the chewing also peppered the texture of the hard white plastic with sharp little pieces that were cutting the inside of her mouth and gums - there was blood all over the ends of the toy.  I had to take it away from her, because, while she likes the toy, she's also destroying her mouth with it.

column9: Good Design Could Use Some Improvements
column10: These toys have been a staple in our house for years. If your dog loves to play with a ball as much as a good long two this is a little piece of doggie heaven.We have two Old English Bulldogs a 95 pound six year old, whose always had a Bouncy Bone and his partner in crime a seven month old puppy whose already over 50 pounds. They both adore these but as reviewers have mentioned the treats are gone in a blink of an eye.One of the concerns I've had with the treats themselves is that Rawhide is processed with so many chemicals - including formaldehyde. I make it a point to never buy rawhide. The bone part of the toy is great for easy to moderate chewers but for hardcore, aggressive chewers it's not going to hold up well.
