After two weeks - which is about when all of the Feline Pine pellets have dissolved into sawdust - I dump the box, scrub and sanitize it, and start over.To be honest, I'm not sure that the odor control or tracking is any better with the combination of the two litters than with Nature's Miracle alone. But I'm sticking with it for now, since the Feline Pine does seem to help extend the litter, and since I don't use it exclusively, one bag lasts a long time!** UPDATE - after I finished the first bag of Feline Pine I didn't bother buying another one. If anything, I think mixing this with the Natures Miracle just undermined the clumping of the latter. So no more Feline Pine for me. I wish it had worked for us, but it didn't. Nature's Miracle is the winner so far of natural litters, though I hope one day some genius comes up with a better one!

I've been using this litter for years.  The cat and I agree that this is the best litter - hands down.  My cat is quite picky and simply will not use many brands of litter until there is no option.  This litter was one he immediately approved of.  I like it because it doesn't track and because it disintegrates which for me is a big plus.  Two paws up for this.

I'm extremely frustrated right now. We adopted a cat 3 weeks ago & her previous owner gave us her litter box with clay litter. After doing much research, I decided to give Feline Pine a try because it's natural. I even tried doing it gradually with her old litter as the instructions suggested, but it did not work for our cat. She wouldn't use it to poop and just didn't poop one whole night. As soon as we brought out her old litter, she used it right way. And this morning, she also tried to eat the pine pellets and then vomited! Not good. This is a great idea & I'm very disappointed that it did not work for our cat as I was very excited about this product.

column9: Decent product but annoyed that shipment was lost
column10: This product isn't ideal because the little flecks of pine stuff do track across the carpet (I have reduced this via a cat litter mat, but the stuff still spreads). On the plus side, it doesn't smell at all like ammonia, which is a giant relief to me, especially since the little is in our bedroom.Shipping was a mess because the first one said delivered but never arrived. I was pleased, however, by the ease of the process for getting a replacement shipment, which showed up not too long afterward.

I have been using it along with other scoopable litter together.  I have decided it tracks too much all over the apartment so I will not be buying this product. I think Feline Pine has a regular litter I may try next times.

Best cat litter ever!  I will never go back to clay litter. Smells like a pine forest, even after my cat has filled it with c#@p!  I don't normally order it on line, but we were moving cross-country and I had it sent to the new apartment so it was waiting when we got there, which it was, which made the move a little less stressful.  At least for me. My cat still hates moving.

I just got through reviewing another brand of litter (Arm & Hammer Essentials) that I used when I ran out of Feline Pine and it was awful.  Trust me, I'm stocking up on Feline Pine because it's in another league.  First, it's not scented or perfumed in any way.  It has a slight cedary smell that is pleasant and your cat likes and is drawn to.  Second, it has large "pellets" that disintegrate when your cat pees so you can tell if they are using the box (that's important if you are concerned with urinary issues and want something natural.)  Also, if your cat has recently had surgery and you are concerned about litter getting into the stitches and impeding the healing process, try this Feline Pine or Wheat Scoop, both are natural and easy to use and will not hurt your cat.  Finally, with this litter you don't have to worry about your cat breathing in harmful dust particles that cause respiratory issues and allergies.  It is expensive litter, don't get me wrong--but I have learned over time that it's worth the cost because it is safe, easy to clean up, and your cat likes using the litter box more with Feline Pine so there tends to be less bathroom "problems".  This is not powdery and won't coat every surface with dust.  It is "chunky" and pellet-like, won't get in your animal's eyes and cause irritation, and does seem to absorb odors effectively.
I love this stuff.  It works so well and is so much better for the environment than traditional litters.  It even helps with smells naturally.

This product is a good idea but unfortunately it did not work out well for myself or my cats. I take in feral kittens and I love our planet so I was trying to do a 2 for 1 with this litter. Figured these cats would like to do their business on something more 'Earthy' since that is what they would be used to. Wrong. They used it once. It smelled and they never used it again. Pellets cannot be 'reused' like carbon litter can. Once these get pee'd on its all over, seems like it would get expensive and smell after a while.I really, really wanted to like this, I really wanted to use it but I just could not. I give it 3 stars cuz it least it is a good idea and if I run out of litter I will use whats left in my closet.

This is by far the best cat litter!  My 18 week old cat loves it.  I originally selected this litter because it was non-clumping.  Sheba is learning to use the Litter Kwitter toilet training system which requires non-clumping litter.  She will not kick this litter out of the toilet tray and there is absolutely no smell associated with the pellets.  It's great!  I highly suggest it to anyone using the toilet training systems as well.

When I could not find this product in the grocery stores, I was glad to find that Amazon.com had it available. I recently stocked up on this brand of liter. I find this product suits me well and my cat does not have any problem with it as well. This product does not have a bad smell, is easy to clean up. I know where to get my supply if I need more. Thank you Aamzon.com

I have two cats, so I really needed a litter that would control odor, and I wanted something safe for my kitties and the environment. Feline Pine is the BEST litter I could find by far. Even if you are not interested in being environmentally friendly, this is a great litter.It took a little while for one of my cats to get used to it. At first I switched them completely over and one of my kitties started going outside the box. I went back to the old litter and started gradually mixing the pellets in for about two weeks. Now both my cats use only the Feline Pine without any problems. It completely masks the smell of urine, and is pretty good at masking the smell of poop. It lasts awhile too since you really only have to scoop the solid waste until the pellets turn to sawdust.I had previously tried Nature's Miracle and World's Best Cat Litter.  Neither of them dealt well with odor. Nature's miracle clumped nicely, but it smelled soo bad! It stunk up our whole house. The WBCL had a slightly less offensive smell, but the clumping capabilities were not as good as NM. Feline Pine doesn't clump, but it doesn't need to since you don't scoop out the urine. With some litters, like WBCL, urine seeps to the bottom of the pan and creates a sticky, smelly residue; but, with Feline Pine the urine doesn't even get to the bottom of the pan since it is absorbed immediately by the pellets.It's just a really great litter, and it's not as expensive as a lot of other natural brands.

column9: Not Great Litter, Not Great for Multi Cat Households
column10: I tried this awhile back, and noticed other folks reviews.The cats don't like it (I have 3, ranging in age from 7 to 17).  At the time, I had 2 to 3 litter boxes.  The cats don't like to scratch pellets.  The litter box STOPPED BEING USED.  It seems kitties still like to scratch, dig and cover what feels natural - which is dirt.I had to finally mix clay with the Pine.  While the Pine did mask odors somewhat (helps if you use more than one litter box in multi-cat households) - scooping pee was impossible (since there is no real clumping action - the pellets stay as pellets).  And with the lack of digging by cats - the poop went straight into the scooping bag.I myself can't carry over 20 some pounds, so I highly recommend clay unscented litter - if ordering from Amazon - consider Ever Clean Extra Strength Cat Litter, Unscented, 42 Pound Box.  If you scoop daily (or at the very least - every other day), your house won't smell, and the cat litter will last longer.Unscented is best for cats (since the scented particles can be licked by cats off their fur - and the chemicals are so so).  And, while many cat owners use covered litter boxes (I USED to), its more convenient for the owners than the cats.  Cats end up not using the boxes from the smell on the lids, and they also end up spraying pee back on themselves.  So my house doesn't smell like cats (as noted by visitors), even though I have open cat litter boxes.

Picked up a bag of this on recommendation from the lady at our neighborhood pet store.This litter consists of large sawdust pellets that are too big to fall through the scooper, and as soon as they get wet, they disintegrate into damp sawdust that smells rather piny and neutral, but is impossible to scoop because it doesn't clump whatsoever. This is the opposite of how I want my litter to act. The dirty stuff falls through the scoop, while the clean stuff gets stuck in it?I don't think my cats like the damp sawdust either. They ended up peeing on their bed even though this litter was "clean".I'll be going back to my nice-smelling corn-based litter that actually acts like proper litter.

Anyway, I have the BB on auto delivery, and I get 6 boxes for less than 22.00.  I used to buy the in the pet store for 8.00 per box, plus tax.  Love amazon.  Have been shopping here since 1996, but they have yet to give me a coupon!  What's up with that!

This is a favorite for one of my dogs!  When the only store that sold them, (within 20 miles,) stopped selling them...I went to AMAZON!  They are healthy, limited ingredients - good for allergy prone dogs- and easy to break in smaller pieces if you so wish.  Cloud Star also promotes you to collect the UPCs and submit for free, fun stuff!  I definitely recommend!
These are made with just a few all natural, healthy ingredients, nothing else!  I feel good giving them to my dogs and my dogs LOVE them!  Thanks Amazon for a great price on a great product.

This is the only treat I can give my pug without him reacting to the ingredients.  Both my pugs love them.  I give them frequent treats for ringing the bell to go outside so I break the large pieces accordingly.  They love them and they don't get any skin allergy reactions from them.  I highly recommend them.

My 6 year old Boston Terrier has wheat and chicken allergies.  The sweet potato Buddy Biscuits are his only treats.  He knows exactly where I keep them and doesn't let me forget when he is supposed to get one.  Cloud Star Buddy Biscuits Dog Treats, Sweet Potato Madness, 16-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)

column9: Is it possible to give a product no stars!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
column10: My dog won't eat these.  Nor will any dog in the entire neighborhood eat these.  The biscuits are available in the grocery store so try one box first, if you must.  This purchase was one of my all-time worst!

column4: Mel Mac the Mad Scientist "Mel Mac"
column10: This tea is ok, but don't let the word matcha in the title fool you.  This has a tiny amount of matcha in each bag and it is not bright green like fresh match is supposed to be.  But for 10 bucks you can't expect too much.

I first tried Chantal's strawberry jam at her restaurant and had to bring some home for my husband.  He is the strawberry jam expert.  He has tried every one out there.  His exact words were, "this is the best strawberry jam I have ever tasted'.  I alway have 2 jars in my house because he eats it every night as a snack on toast, Ice cream or tortilla's.  If I didn't have it he would be very upset.I suggest everyone try it and they will never go back to thier favorite because this will be it!!!

column9: I Can't Believe I Almost Passed On This One!
column10: This wasn't going to be one of the many flavored Matcha that I was going to order from Red Leaf Tea.  I mean, I love Matcha, sure, but I do not drink a lot of alcohol, and while I have enjoyed many of the various alcohol-infused flavored teas that I've tried, it just isn't a flavor that I usually go for.  So, I guess, you can consider this a "stepping outside of my comfort zone" moment.And I'm so glad that I did!This is amazingly awesome!  It is really good.  The overall flavor is remarkably smooth - and while most Matcha tends to be smooth and creamy - this tastes even smoother than most.  The flavor is more "fruity" than what I'd call "alcohol-like" but it is a very smooth fruity tone, with a very smooth brandy finish.  It is sweet and delicious.  The matcha flavor here is more reserved, with the vegetative tones that usually coat the palate being a bit more in the background rather than front notes.A very enjoyable Matcha - if you're on the fence about this one, I highly recommend taking the plunge and getting it.  It's really very surprisingly good.  I like it a lot.

column9: Like Juicy Fruit Gum! Yum yum!
column10: Okay so for those of you hesitating thinking this is going to taste too much like something a staunch old man sitting in a ritzy Victorian library would drink, its not. Its also not like the stuff the teens would swill behind the bleachers in high school during winter football games. Wait, maybe that was just at my school. Anyway this stuff is GOOOOOD!Someone else said in their review it reminded them of Juicy Fruit gum and they totally hit the nail on the head with that assessment! Had this not been named "Brandy" I would have thought it was a fruit blend - not a punch like Hawaiian Punch, not even a tropical mixture, but just a really yummy sweet fruit blend of some kind. I really wish I could pick out specific fruit flavor elements to relate to you but I can't. Fruit Medley is all I can think of but there is a whipped cream like aspect to it, something that really makes you feel like you bit into some ripe juicy fruit (no pun intended) and it really does taste like that gum! This is one your kids would LOVE! Seriously if you want to get your kids or anyone in the family into matcha I would suggest this or the butterscotch matcha! Just make a latte with some milk, and some vanilla or sweet cream non dairy creamer! Add ice, stir LOVE!Now as for the Brandy aspect here. Its really not all that present to me. Yes I do get a SLIGHT and I mean SLIGHT alcohol effect - sort of a little twang or ting, but not really so much warming as brandy is known for.When I was younger, in my teens, I rode both western and equestrian, and trained horses. That was another life time ago. We would always have some brandy on us to keep warm in the winter wether out on the ranch repairing fences or preparing for a fox hunt (we did not really hunt the foxes I would have no part in that so don't worry) it was more of a Mock Hunt. LOL This matcha does bring back some fond memories of that but its not the same, and I doubt that you really could get the same result from anything but brandy itself but for all intents and purposes this is a very good flavor, a really nice experience, and one I will absolutely be ordering again! I know I say that about a lot of the matcha I have tried, and I have tried a lot of them but this along with about 5 others are THE matcha I can't be without! The "alcohol" effect is just enough for those who have had brandy to recognize but not so much that those who do not like brandy, have never had it, or should not have it, won't even notice. Its like being able to recognize any flavor, you kind of have to have experienced it before to know what it is. Without knowing what it is all you will notice is this AMAZING fruit festival in your mouth!

The smell of Brandy Matcha is really fruity and sweet - very much what Juicy Fruit gum smells like!  The taste is just as good! And don't bother adding any sweetener - this is sweet enough on its own!  The best part: There's no sugar in this matcha to begin with!I can't wait to mix this with an apple or dark berry matcha!

And the sailor said 'Brandy, you're a fine girl, what a good wife you would be..." Okay, so, that song is the only real reference to brandy I have, and that's not even the right brandy. Well, that song and the singer from the 90s...anyway. In college, one of my roommates liked to mix (cheap, horrible) brandy with her cola when she drank, and so I've had a few of those, but that's really it. I'm a whisky girl, through and through. That's what happens when you go to high school in Tennessee and college in Kentucky. But it looked interesting and I liked the brandy I've had, so I thought "why not?" If nothing else, it will be good for mixing with the apple matcha. Or the cola matcha, for when I'm having a bad day at work and need a drink but can't have one just yet. At least I can pretend. But I don't really have a flavor profile in mind when I try this matcha, so it will be an interesting experience. For instance, when I try a pineapple tea, I have in mind what I think a pineapple should taste like and I can match the tea up to that flavor profile and see how it compares. With this, I'm just shooting in the dark, though I'm sure I'll be comparing it to whisky before this review is done.Oh wow, this is good. This is goooood. Yes, the unnecessary "o"s were necessary. It's fruity and smooth and...yum. I don't quite know how to describe it. It's not what I was expecting out of brandy, but I don't really have any experience with brandy, so what do I know? I can almost taste a touch of alcohol, but that might just be my imagination. It does seem warming, which is odd since I'm drinking it cold. I love cold matcha and how easy it is to mix. Add water to matcha powder, whisk/froth, and go! Done! Yum. Saves me a ton of time in the mornings when I'm barely awake and trying to get ready for work.Anyway, yes. If this is what brandy tastes like, I need to try some as soon as possible. I think my father in law has some...it might be time to hang out with the in laws. It tastes kind of like bubble gum but...juicy fruit gum, not double bubble. Definitely one I plan to keep around.

column9: I'd have to give up coffee without this.
column10: In the last 2-3 years, I've starting having problems with acid reflux... and unfortunately realized that my daily coffee habit was a major part of the problem. I've been drinking Puroast for the past year, and it has truly saved me! Don't get me wrong. I can still enjoy a cup of normal coffee out at restaurants. But if I run out of Puroast and switch back to other brands, it only takes a day or two for the acid reflux to come back with a vengeance! In fact, I recently moved and couldn't find this coffee in stores. I went several week brewing normal coffee and had to pop acid reducers nearly every day. Once I got my hands on Puroast again, the acid reflux symptoms went away in no time!As others have noted, it's not the most delicious cup of coffee but it's decent enough if you're a coffee-aholic. I drank the regular roast for quite some time, but recently switched to the French Roast in hopes that it would have a deeper flavor. It does! I normally despise French Roast coffee, but not so with the Puroast.
I have finally found a low acidic coffee. My stomach loves you.  I cannot give up my coffee in the a.m. Thank you.

My husband and I have been drinking this product for about a year.  While the low-acid treatment truly does help us, the taste leaves us craving the real deal.  Hence, we purchase a tasty, robust French Roast elsewhere, and combine the two.  This leaves us satiated and comfortable.
This very decent vanilla is so much less expensive than prices I have been paying at the supermarket and it's organic, too!

The flavor of this vanilla goes with anything you would want to add it to.  Some other brands taste like pure alcohol and others taste to sweet.  This one maintains an authentic vanilla flavor, balanced, and at a good price.
The package of 3 is an excellent value versus purchasing at any grocery store in my area.  the quality of the vanilla extract is excellent and the product contains no corn syrup or other sweetener.

I don't find this vanilla extract to be particularly strong (it's ok but hasn't impressed me with its flavor) and would not buy it again. I was attracted by the organic label but have since done my reading and now understand that the vanilla flavors are extracted in alcohol. Thus a really good quality extract will have a high alcohol content. And from an ethical standpoint, I probably should have been looking for a fair trade label rather than an organic one.

This stuff is almost a balsamic reduction. It is very thick compared to your standard balsamic vinegar. Less bite and a big sweeter I recall as well. It went fast when I got it as a gift. Came here looking to buy more.

column9: Peppermint tea is a staple to the brew we make.
column10: Peppermint tea is a staple to the brew we make along with green tea.  It is just wonderful.  Thanks for this great product and the packaging is above standard.  Thanks!

This is a refreshing, simple, clean, true peppermint "tea." It hits the spot when you want a decaffeinated drink, and has nothing else other than peppermint so there is nothing to muddy up the flavor. A nice drink.
This was recommended to me by a relative.  It is working. Just what I needed and it arrived on time.

column9: Bigelow tea is all that it's cracked up to be and more!
column10: It's a yummy tasting, refreshing tea that is gluten free and is good for me as well as pleasant tasting for a long time!

I've always loved Bigelow Peppermint teabags. I was an avid user of a very popular brand before I discovered Bigelow and ever since, I've never looked back. I encourage everyone to try it and you'll realize what you've been missing for a very long time.

I am new to drinking tea and have been sampling many different kinds of herbal teas in the last few weeks.  Bigelow's brand peppermint tea is my absolute favorite so far.  It has a nicely strong peppermint flavor with a subtle sweetness that I love.  My current supermarket does not carry Bigelow's peppermint tea so I purchased Celestial Seasoning's figuring how different can they be...they both have "peppermint" as the only ingredient.  I was surprised to find the Celestial Seasoning brand has a much weaker flavor and lacks the slight sweetness.  I will be ordering a case of Bigelow peppermint tea from Amazon in the near future.

I'm a huge Bigelow fan...Just love love love their teas...I'm so happy I found a 6 pack of the 20-count boxes...It's a huge savings and I get to drink my favorite tea all the time...You can drink this blend hot or cold...Authentic peppermint tea...If you are a true tea lover, I wouldn't just stop at the peppermint...they have a great sampler box...Wonderful introduction to Bigelow's brand.  Enjoy!

The pita chips themselves are very, very good - flavorful, but lightly salted with sea salt and crunchy.  Almost addictive.However, when I received my packages, they were mostly croutons.  Very, very, poorly packed and were smashed in transit.  There was no packing in the box with the chip, therefore, they just sloshed around until they were small pieces of chips.I would hope that next time someone orders them you'd pack them better.I know that I won't get an answer to this as no one there really cares as long as you get your money, and that this review is just a formality.  I did contact Stacy's about the issue and got a lot of nonsense about being fragile, hard to ship (they get shipped to stores without a problem), blah, blah, blah, ad nauseam.Someone, somewhere, needs to do a quality check on packing.

Stacy's Simply Naked are the best of the pita chips available on the market.  They go well with a variety of foods from pate to spinach dip, yet are very tasty all by themselves. These pita chips are perfectly salted and are crisp without the heavy, doughy brittleness found in other pita chips.
We love these chips - crunchy, tasty, great on their own or dipped in hummus. These bags are large, but we haven't had any problems with them going stale either!

Chips were broken into small pieces. Problem isn't amazon's, it's Stacy's. Stacy (or amazon) needs to pack the original box of six better, the bags move around too much. There was room for at least two more bags in the box.Amazon packed the Stacy's box in their box very tight and good.I tried to complain to Stacy, they make it very hard, no luck.Chips taste great though, maybe I'll pour them in a bowl with milk for breakfast.
These are really a great buy. They were packaged well and arrived on time.  They are delicious and natural.  It is very hard not to eat the entire bag. They are much more expensive in the stores.

column9: Great chips, if any weren't broken
column10: The pita chips were very tasty and addictive. But, I've gone through 3 bags out of 6 and so far, I think I've found a total of 15 chips that were larger than one square inch. Obviously, it is likely a shipping issue that broke most of the chips, but the impact to me is still the same: a bag of chips that are very difficult to eat.I think my local Sam's Club has these more reasonably priced, in larger bags, and I'm more likely to get unbroken chips.

column9: perfectly packed and arrived on time
column10: I had absolutely no problems with this order. Packing was perfect so the chips were not smashed and it arrived on time. 100% satisfied.

column9: Nice to stock up during long trips
column10: This is one of my favorite chips! It is so good. I just take it in mornings or with lunch to satisfy the chip cravings if I have. I am certainly not a big chip eater, but when i want to have this ranks in top.It is not salty and has a good crunch feeling due to Pita. I like with no extra flavors and everything combined gives this a great feeling.

column9: Great plain or with a dip.
column10: These chips have a great taste, whether you eat them alone or with a dip. I usually use hummus as the dip and they are delicious together.

Everyone should order stay pita chips from amazon.com, I have such a hard time finding them in the store in the party size and have to pay more for the small bags and have to hunt them on top of that.  I live in a rural area and love these chips and have lost over 20 pounds using them.  I order them from amazon.com and they come right to my door very fast,  I will only order them from amazon.com and not buy in the stores anymore.

They were delivered quickly.  About 1/3 of the bag of chips were small pieces the rest were large.  I don't mind the small pieces they all taste the same to me.  But not to nice for serving at a party.  I would highly recommend the chip.  I found them at Target but they were in the small size and more expensive.  Could use a better packing method but I Would buy them again this way.
A good product at a good price, but few chips survived intact.  Crumbs and pieces were tasty, but still way too many crumbs and pieces.  The smaller bags travelled better with less damage.

column9: Great chips - buy them at the store

They were pretty well packaged when they arrived, but still were crushed in transit.  This isn't Amazon's fault.  It's the nature of shipping chips through UPS.  So I would recommend these chips, but your best bet is to try and find them in a store.

We have been Stacy's fans for years (better than nasty, greasy potato chips and snacks) but local stores for some reason quit carrying them!?#%&#>! Love to always shop local but we'll do what we gotta do for the Stacy's!

column9: Nothing could be easier or more economical.

column9: Product is great, delivery needs improved!
column10: I love this product but I'm really disappointed in how they were delivered.  Both boxes were crushed (Amazon and Stacey's)and when I opened the inside box, one of the bags of chips was split open at the top and chips were everywhere.  I haven't decided whether to order again this way.

Stacy's Pita Chips are the best out there.  They are more flavorful and have less sodium than other brands.  My grocery store could not keep the "Simply Naked" (my absolutely favorite) in stock, so I ordered them online.  I recommend 100%.  Stacy's Pita Chips - Simply Naked, 6 ounce bag

column10: These chips are delicious and addicting. I started eating them because I thought they'd be a good alternative and healthier snack. They do not have as many calories as most snack foods and just a touch of sea salt. The best way I can describe them is that they remind me of crunching a delicious edge of pie crust, just slightly salty and crunchy - yet harder than a pie crust texture. I started buying them at Costco but they quit selling them at the store near me so I bought a case online.

I am hooked. The "Simply Naked" pita chips are out of this world. Crunchy, tastey,just the right amount of salt. I order them by the case so I'm sure not to run out. They are amazing with dips and spreads
These chips are an excellent product.  I love them with hommus.  They arrived fast and in good shape.  Highly recommend them.

These are just great! However, I wish they were more widely distributed in the larger size...the smaller ones you can get in some places, but at a really high price, and they sure don't last very long.  The AMAZON price per bag when purchasing by the case is a great deal. I will be ordering more when my supply runs out!

column9: the best pita chips you can buy
column10: These are the best pita chips on the market, and Amazon.com is the one and only place where you can buy them.

Ok, there's part of me that wishes I hadn't discovered these. I'm not a binge eater but I can nearly polish off a bag of these in a sitting. The best crunchy/salty snack EVER. No other chip, pita or otherwise, compares.The multi-grain pita chips are tasty also as are the whole wheat bagel chips but these, I can't seem to let them go....
Very good product ! Great snack !I have tried other pita snacks,they do not have the enjoyable taste that Stacy has created! BUY THEM ! Great price and with free shipping this a great deal !

Was introduced to these while visiting in Vermont.  Could not find them in local area.  Ordered these favs online and am enjoying the salty taste in lieu of potato chips.  Chips are hard and crunchy and good eaten alone or with tuna salad, hummus etc. Ordered them in Dec. and expiration date was not until May so that wasn't too bad. I can consume them before May.
Everyone loves these that tries them. They are great all by themselves, or with whatever dip.I just wish they were whole-wheat.

column9: Great chips -- provided you have good teeth!
column10: We love these chips.  You'd better have a good set of chompers-- they're pretty hard.  I ordered some online for a pretty good price.  As one reviewer has previously stated, my shipment was "short-dated" meaning that they were close to expiration.  We have since gone back to buying them at our local warehouse store where they are much fresher.

If you like Stacy's pita chips, this is a good way to get them (reasonable price, free shipping).  This time the 6 bags were packed in 2 boxes one inside the other so there were no torn bags/spillage (which happened with an earlier batch).  My only concern was that the expiration dates on all the bags were 12/18/07.  This was OK at the time but I wouldn't want to order more bags and find out they have technically expired.
We adore this as a snack or for breakfast. Hard not to eat the whole bag!
This chips are the best, and I can't get them where I live.  In the summer, we eats tons of cucumber soup with lots of garlic, and these chips really sets off the soup.

I have been a Stacy's Pita Chip addict for just a little over a year now and cannot function without a bag of the chips in the house.  They are so crunchy and tasty I can't get enough! My favorite...just the plain ole sea salt!
The reviews were helpful.I still wanted to try them.You must have something to dip these in.Excellent in garden salads as croutons.

i found these chips years ago before they were in the stores...i love them...they fill my need for crunch and a little bit of salt..cannot live without them....just hope now that they were bought out they keep them the same!!

We have both the Sea Salt variety and the Cinn. Sugar. The Sea Salt variety are almost Toooo salty. You can only eat a couple at a time. On the other hand..the Cinn. ones are good, but you have about 7 chips in a bag that could hold about 50 !!!  Not worth the money!!!!!!
These are the best chips I've ever had.  I got my whole family hooked on them.  And on top of it all they are healthy for you.  I'd definitely recommend them to anyone.

column9: Finally chips that taste great and are healthy too!
column10: Wow, I tried to stay away from the "pita chip craze" but once I had one of these at a friend's party I fell in love.  These are great by themselves, but I personally love them with some hummus...mmm.Finally a great tasting, healthy substition for the 50% daily fat value of the regular fried chips out there!  These are thick, crispy, and my whole family loves them.  I have yet to give them to someone that didnt like them.
The chips are good but 1/3 or the bag is broken tiny pieces.  Best with dip.

I was looking for a chip that was low sodium and tasted decent. I thought these simply naked pita chips would be good, but they are not. I read the nutrition facts. 270mg for 1 oz./serving size! That's 1620mg for the bag!!!!! These 6oz. bags are not very big either! You can finish them pretty quick, like some people have said here.I really wouldn't say these chips are healthy, there is fat and saturated fat.However, these chips are healthier than cheetos, and doritos, but they don't taste as good. They are also rock hard.

I have loved Kraft Mac N Cheese since I was a child, and it has consistently stayed as delicious as always! I actually don't have children, and buy the character shapes for myself. I actually prefer the texture of the shapes to that of the traditional macaroni, so having the option with this brand is a plus. Also, Subscribe & Save is great! I work overnights, so I sleep during the day, and getting to the grocery store each week can be a pain. Getting things in bulk and delivered right to my door is perfect!

Ever since I was a kid, all Kraft Macaroni and Cheese was THE macaroni and cheese. I don't know what it is about Kraft's macaroni and cheese, but it is truly one of the best products they have on the market. It's quick, simple, and easy to make and not to mention, it actually tastes great.
Quick & easy nutrition. My kids Love it + scince spongebob is on it, it make my kids eat High Protein, Cheese, Less Fat, + NO trans Fat!!!  and this is a good dinner  =  Mac and Cheese!!  :) ;)

column9: Kraft Macaroni & Cheese Sponge Bob Square Pants Shapes
column10: We love Kraft Macaroni and Cheese and what better way to eat than to have it in Sponge Bob shapes.  My kids beg for this every day.
Sponge Bob gives kids an incentiveto eat macaroni & cheese, especiallyif they already like it.Quick & easy nutrition with protein & cheese.

You've scooped your ice cream.  You've added the whipped cream. You've poured the rainbow sprinkles.  And yet your sundae is still missing the final touch.  If you think that your dessert would be fine with just the typical Hershey's Chocolate Sauce, and that there is no further way to increase its deliciousness, then you obviously have not tried Magic Shell.  You snap off the cap and begin to pour.  The sauce looks slightly lighter than usual.  You wait for about fifteen seconds.  The liquid sauce begins to solidify from the cool contact of the ice cream.  This may surprise you at first--but you're kind of curious, right?  Go on, take a bite!The taste of ice cream and candy has found its perfect balance.  You don't have to deal with the harshness of frozen chocolate chips, because Magic Shell has a gentle crunch. The sauce is slightly salty, complementing the sweetness of the ice cream, like the way peanut butter complements the chocolate in a Reeses peanut butter cup.  The Magic Shell does not distract from the taste of any type of ice cream, but rather adds a twist to the texture that makes each flavor all the more distinct and delicious.  The froth of the whipped cream and the richness of the ice cream meet the delicious chunks of your new-found discovery.  You will never turn back.

column9: Magic does not begin to describe it.
column10: In my opinion, this is the defining invention of 20th Century America.In the words of a friend, who immigrated to the U.S. from overseas: "I was amazed when I first discovered about magic shell. I looooooove magic shell. Only America can think of such idea and is able to capitalize on that brilliant idea."Not quite fudge, not really chocolate, completely absurd. By what black art did the makers conjure the ability for something to freeze in seconds at room temperature? Begs the questions, was it invented by accident, or by a sage?
The Smucker's Magic Shell is just terrible. It doesn't even harden it just stays liquid, I waited ten minutes for it to harden and it never did.
This products is great and we love it so much a 12 pack doesn't take that long to go through. And this price is great, especially with free delivery. Much cheaper than going to the store.

I bought this product and another brand (very well known for their chocolate) and did a taste test.  The Smucker's brand was quite NASTY!  It doesn't even remotely taste like chocolate, and it doesn't harden like the other brand.  I love Smuckers Jams & Jellies, but they just don't have what it takes to make this chocolate topping.  Smuckers's, please do us a favor and stick to jams and jellies.
We purchased this to try on our ice cream and everyone loves it.  It sure is an added tasty treat while enjoying a bowl of ice cream.
My son loves this. He used to drink another brand but they changed the ingredients and he wouldn't drink the new version. I tried this one and he loves it!

My daughter is dairy allergic and used to drink another brand of hemp milk, but they changed their recipe and added carrageenan which has been upsetting her stomach.  I was so excited when I discovered Pacific Natural now offers hemp milk.  Not only is it free of carrageenan and sugar, but it tastes great!  It is also really high in calcium.  It is reassuring to know that she's getting such a great dose of nutrients and the essential omega fatty acids.

I did a comparison taste test on this Pacific Foods Hemp Milk Original and the Living Harvest Tempt Hemp Milk Original. This hemp milk has a thicker-than-dairy, smoother mouth feel due to the Xanthan gum...too thick IMHO. I can also taste the brown rice syrup sweetener which Pacific Foods puts in all their milks. In comparison, the Living Harvest milk does not have a faux creaminess agent added to it and tastes more straightly of mild, sweet hemp milk rather than brown rice syrup. For these reasons I prefer the LH Tempt milk. I like the thinner and better flavor.

Pacific Natural hemp milk is my first "purchase" choice; it is my second favorite hemp milk, though.  Tempt has a silkier, earthier flavor that I prefer (as well as unsweetened offering), but it is too pricey for current $$ (don't want to cut other food choice options).  With that said, Pacific Natural's hemp milk is my go-to and everyday hemp milk.  The flavor still has enough of an earthy base and silkiness that makes me smile every morning (and I have it every day!).  In my opinion, Pacific Natural hemp milk is the closest in texture and mouth feel to whole cow's milk; luckily, I also believe it tastes much, much better, too.  It's also a perfect substitute for cooking/baking.  I've recently tried Trader Joe's hemp milk (recent addition to their line), and it is a watered down version of hemp milk; so Pacific Natural is still my first choice.  Do your taste buds, health, and earth a big favor and make the switch.

Ive been drinking rice milk for a year, its really watery though for cooking. Then I stumbled upon Hemp milk. I tried the organic pacific from a store and thought I was buying the organic. This is just about as good. The organic has a slight less nutty flavor. It works excellent for cooking. Makes mashed potatoes very thick. Cant wait to make pumpkin pie with it. I highly recommend it. I eat every day with my cream of rice. I mix it with the rice milk 50/50.Tried another brand "Tempt". It wasnt as thick as this one. I like the thickness when using it for cooking. Didnt like the flavor of Tempt as much as Pacific brand.

column9: More than twice the calories and 5x the sodium

The pieces strike me as being a little smaller than the original.  I have not tried blowing any bubbles, but I suspect one would need more than one piece for that. The popcorn you pop in the microwave is just plain popcorn. Each bag comes with a packet of caramel--actually it's a flat, soft piece of caramel in a foil packet. You have to put the popped corn into a microwave safe container, cut the caramel piece into four pieces, lay them over the popped corn, and put it back into the microwave until the caramel is melted. Then you take two spoons and mix it up until the caramel is evenly distributed. It's a bit more messing around than I usually like to do, but the result is delicious.

I bought this cat food because of the wonderful low price and I enjoy they catchy jingle from the commercials. My cats did eat this food, but after reading the ingredients I completely regret purchasing it and feel just awful for feeding it to my cats. The first three ingredients (which indicates the most prevalent ingredients) are chicken by-product meal, corn gluten meal, and ground yellow corn. How disgusting is that?! The main ingredient is a corn filler. Corn cannot be fully digested, it is just a filler and causes pets to actually eat more to feel full, poop out more (more for us to clean in the litter box), and retain less nutrients. The only meat in Meow Mix at all is a by-product, its not even a real meat! By-products are the stuff leftover once all the actual meat is harvested. We're talking beaks, chicken feet, eyeballs, even chicken poop! I would not recommend this product to anyone, for any reason, ever. It is an absolutely awful cat food. I suppose you get what you pay for. I recommend to stay far away from Meow Mix, as it is simply a very low quality food. Even though the price is quite inexpensive, your cat will actually eat more than if you paid for a better quality food, because they will never feel full. Cats need to eat meat, and there just isn't real meat in this food. When purchasing a cat (or dog) food, the most important thing to consider is the first 3 ingredients; just make sure those first three are decent ingredients that you would eat yourself. Now that I know what to look for, I usually buy my pets all natural, foods such as Natural Balance, Blue Buffalo, Halo or Wellness. All of those brands contain real, whole meats that I myself would eat, with no added fillers or corn.
