These are just as good each time I order these. It is much cheaper to get these through Amazon.com then in the local grocery store or Wal-Mart and the beauty that they arrive at my door step. Mu husband using this for the caffeine instead of the sugary softdrinks.

This is hilarious.  I bought a variety pack of these in four different flavors (at my local Wholesale warehouse) and figured the labels, such as "Energy" were just a gimmick.  Just a little while after drinking one of these packets I couldn't figure out why I was jittery, then it clicked!  I really didn't expect it to do anything, I just wanted it because it's strawberry.  I definitely won't be needing a coffee today!  I'm very glad I didn't have both this morning or I would be wired.  I appreciate the energy, but would probably cut it to half a packet next time since it apparently does have an effect on me.Keep in mind, I am not a caffeine addict.  I don't drink soda and usually only have a cup of coffee in the afternoon as a pick-me-up/snack.  It probably wouldn't make a normal person jittery, but definitely provides a jolt considering it's just water.
I am very pleased with this product. Our local Wal-Marts rarely have Crystal Light Wild Strawberry on their shelves so it is nice to be able to find it available elsewhere.

I can't live without these!  They are exactly what I need after a night of little to no sleep, the 3pm slump, or on the weekends when I need to get motivated to clean my house on the weekends.  I can't ever find them in the grocery stores anymore so now I buy them in bulk wherever I can find them. Plus its much cheaper on Amazon!
I really enjoy the crystal light even though it has a slight aftertaste; I like to get it semi-frozen for a cool late afternoon drink that gets me through the rest of the day.

My family tends to be hyperactive. This product helps us be more focused. The younger children are better able to sit down and read and also to follow directions better. It also helps my headaches not be as bad so I don't need as much headache medicine. When you can find it, it is much cheaper at WalMart. They don't always carry this flavor however.

column4: Judy M. Villont "toes in the sand"
column9: It satisfies my sweet cravings and energies me
column10: I love it!  It helps with the 3 P.M. slump at work and satisfies my cravings for something sweet.It is easy to store, easy to fix and taste great.
I love this Crytal Light Energy Wild Strawberry.  Easy to use and gives me the boost I need on a boring day at work!

i love this stuff!!!  great taste, great amount of "kick" to it and few calories. $30 is a bit much, but because i cant find this stuff anywhere else i will pay it. (27, for product and 3, for shipping)i drink 3 of them for breakfast and it gives me enough "go" to last all day with no "jitters" and still leaves me able to go to sleep at night.does'nt really get rid of hunger but it will make you forget to eat if you're really wired on it.

I work in the food industry in a bakery where waking up at 4am is a luxury. I drink this before I do anything when I wake up and I'm feeling more awake and functional by the time I am at work. I can find it in stores still, and buy them a few at a time, but if I were ever unable to find them, I'd be sure to get them here. Its flavor is intense so early in the morning, so I usually add a bit more water to it. This stuff really gets me through the holidays and I don't know what I'd be able to do without it!
It tastes good and gives you enough energy to get you through the day. My replacement for coffee.
With 120 mg of caffeine, these packets keep me hydrated and awake throughout the day. And they taste great too.

I love these little packets of Crystal Light, they are so convienient! They make my water taste so good that I can't stand to drink my water plain anymore.  They are also very low in calories with no fat if your concerned about that.  Sometimes I can't find the two flavors, (WildStrawberry and Cherry Pomegranate) that I ordered from Amazon.com in the stores, so it was great to be able to order them in bulk at a great price!

column9: Best one I've tried so far
column10: Over the last 2 or 3 months I've tried several different brands and flavors of these individual beverage mixes. Of all of them the Crystal Light brand is the best. It has a nice flavor that actually tastes like what its supposed to. But most of all it actually disolves easily without having to shake it for several minutes like the Lipton brand. The only other one I've tried that mixes as easy as this one is the Propel. But its way more expensive too. The four different Lipton flavors that I've tried were not very good and were hard to get to dissolve in the bottle.  Some reviewers have said that they don't like that it has Aspartame in it, what ever that is. But, if your paranoid enough you can find something in just about everything that somebody will claim causes cancer, will make your hair fall out, turn your toe nails green, ruin your liver, and give you brain damage.  As for me, I like this beverage more than any of the other mixes that I've tried. For a side note, since I started trying out these mixes over the last couple of months I've dropped over 25 pounds. This one is one of my favorites and I will be buying more of it in spite of the Aspartame, what ever that is, that's in it. Its also pretty good with a shot of spiced rum in it too. [;-Þ
It allowed me to get what was not in the stores. More expansive then the stores but at least I got it.

I actually love the product itself.  It's the scam Subscribe & Save option that ticks me off.  5 stars for the product, 0 stars for the vendor.I bought the first pack of 6 boxes for $10, then with Subscribe & Save, I found my second shipment was sent for $24.  Cancel.

if you consider that we're suppose to drink 8+ cups of water a day and each serving (if mixed w/ recommended proportions), you'd get 480 mg of caffine. that's way over recommended levels.the flavor is fine, but also tangy. it mixes easily enough, seems to mix very well and doesn't seperate as far as i can tell, also, this drink contains b vitamins (which is what energy drinks use to make the caffine more efficient).The caffine content is on the label (60mg/serving), in the fine print under the nutritional facts. The label does mention caffine on the front, but it isn't clearly labeled, they put it in the fine print!I would have given this four stars if any of these were true: the caffine content was better displayed, if it had less caffine, if it wasn't so tangy, if they clearly labeled a warning / caution about the high levels of caffine / serving.If you decide you need flavor in your water and find yourself drinking huge gulps because you think: it's mostly water and you think it's healthy to drink huge ammounts of water, then don't use the recommended mix proportions. each cup of water  contains a lot of caffine, this drink isn't meant to be a "gulped" drink, it should be thought of as similar to coffee. limit your daily intake of this! and don't drink this in the evening hours! it's caffine + b vitamins. you'll probably ruin your sleep schedule if you drink this hours before you're supppose to sleep. it is more of an energy drink, not a refreshment.the first time i tried this, i mixed a full pitcher, 1/2 gallon or about 8 cups, without realizing how much caffine it had (i actually didn't know it had any, i thought the "energy" in the title was part of the name of the flavor) and it made me very jittery throughout the day. I feel this experience was partially my fault and partially the label's fault, it should have done a better job stating the important info, but i technically should have read the entire package (and the included manual, haha) before i decided to try it. But, this experience has little influence over my rating / review of this product.

My husband has used this product to replace Mountain Dew. He has been doing this for about a month now. This product has about the same caffeine amount(60 mg), much less sugar, and less expensive even with shipping and handling. In my opinion, it is worth it.

It's too bad that aspartame is what makes this drink so deliciously sweet.  I like the "to-go" idea, but there's got to be a better way to help people avoid sugar shock without the boredom of plain water.  I'd love to see this product--or some rendition of it--sweetened with stevia instead.

column9: Not bad but would not have ordered had I known about its ingredients
column10: It's been really hot (over 100 degrees) so I have keep myself hydrated by drinking lots of water. But I hate plain water, so this adds a flavorful taste to it.But I don't like that it contains caffenine and Aspartame. After I finish the rest, I won't reorder because of it. I will look for something without those two harmful ingredients.

I was looking for something to give me some extra energy for my workout and tried Crystal Light Energy - Wild Strawberry. What a mistake. While it tasted great and gave me the energy boost I wanted for my workout, after my workout I was still very jittery and felt out of it. It also started to make me feel sad and irritable! This feeling lasted for another 12+hours after my workout. I wasn't able to get to sleep until 4:00 in the morning and only slept for about 45 minutes. I drank this product with 17 oz of water and lots of ice so it's not like I didnt have enought water to help dilute it. I drank it at 1:30pm and it lasted until 4:00am when I was finally able to fall asleep for a little. I threw out the rest of the product and will never try it again. Very scary and uncomforable experience. I only gave it one star for the taste and because I had to - no option to give no stars!!!

column4: The President "of the United States of America"
column10: I love this stuff! but, this sellers price is unbelieveable. That equates to well over $7.00 per box! I can get them at my grocery store for $5 a box .. and even that was expensive.I used to buy them on amazon for about $3 per box, shipped to my house. Unfortunately amazon stopped selling it altogether, let alone under the save + subscribe umbrella. So, I have stopped drinking this great product!Oh well. ... will find some other caffinated thing to dump in my water.Dont waste your money supporting this seller, whatever you do

If you knew the dangers of aspartame you would not be consuming this drink with this artificial sweetener in it.I would recommend to do some homework on the dangers of artificial sweeteners and you will know what I am saying.  There is plenty of information on the subject.  If you have any kind of health problem,  suffer from any kind of malady and have no clue what is causing it and you consume any beverage or food that has aspartame,  nutrasweet,  splenda, sucralose any artificial sweeteners a like I would recommend stop consuming the foods and drink immediately.I personally do not like the taste of artificially sweetened foods and drink.  I have a strong sense of taste and can tell immediately if something is sweetened with this crap.  I have inadvertently consumed foods and drink that has artificial sweetener in it without my knowing and I could tell immediately by the horrible after taste it leaves me.  But besides the taste the dangers of this rubbish is what deters me from consuming it along with MSG (monosodium glutamate.

I bought a Slurpee flavored with this drink mix at 7-11 thinking I was making a healthy choice and it was not aware there was caffeine in this product and ended up sleepless and light headed for the last 24 hours. Caffeine is NOT healthy. I buy Crystal Light all of the time and I am VERY dissapointed that they have added this drug to their product. IT'S BAD FOR YOUR HEART, MIND AND BODY.
Compared to other vendors this was by far the least expensive and the shipping was fair and fast.

My dogs demand their Yip Yaps everyday when I get home from work. One of my dogs is so old, he only has five teeth left & won't eat hard food but he's the first one to be standing at the counter where the Yip Yaps are kept.

Ours is a rescue dog who is as finicky as we've ever seen... and his breath becomes a problem. Luckily he LOVES Yip Yaps! They are like candy to him and they do give temporary relief of his 'dog-breath'. And our order through Amazon was the least expensive (by far) way to get this product.This product has changed over the years... we don't feel for the better. They used to be denser, crunchier and more to the container. Our dog still enjoys them but does not 'freak out' for them like he used to.

column9: Most Important my dog LOVED it!
column10: I was a bit skeptical when we first saw these in PetsMart. My dog is still young and has not yet experienced TRUE bad doggie breath, but I'm fighting a war before it begins. She absolutely loved it, and it made her breath smell just like fresh rosemary. Now anytime she is even in the deadest of sleep and she hears that tin jingle she comes running.Also, I've noticed that it doesnt only fight the breath on the spot, but usually we give her 2 at a time, as treats for a trick or two, and we've noticed her breath smells great for atleast 2-3 days

I really had high hopes for this product, but I am sorry to say that I have no idea if this works or not. I have the pickiest dog ever, and she turned her nose up at them! I have to admit though that after I smelled them, they didn't smell too appetizing.
Not just for little dogs. I have an 80 pound Siberian Husky and he loves Yip Yaps. I had to go searching for a source; so glad Amazon has them.

I just got a tin from the local pet store because my pit has some pretty bad breath now and again. I first opened the tin with the "Now with TALKING BONES!" )meaning that they are like the chalky heart candies we get around February) and I was over whelmed with how bad it smelled. The mints smelt terrible. and they were of a brown spotty color and not like the white color you see on the box, see attached photo. Now looking in retrospect maybe this batch has gone bad. Anyway I gave one to my dog and she eats everything and anything you put in front of her and she instantly spit out the treat. I handed her another and again the same. She would not go near the third and final one. How can something worse the her breath make it smell nice?

Although I don't know if these actually function as "breath mints" I DO know that all I have to say is "Yip-Yap" and my 3 dogs come running!  The shape is adorable, facilitating their gently taking one end of the "bone."  This product is so good that I've shared it with 2 friends who now love it, as do their dogs!  It's a great treat.

My dog doesn't have a real problem with breath, but I got these cheap off the clearance rack and wanted to try them.  Unfortunately, Luna hates them.  I give them to her and she spits them out.  The only time she actually ate one was the first time I gave them to her.  Anyway, they look and smell good, but are pointless because my dog refuses to eat them.

I first bought yipyaps as they are nearly protein free, and my dog was on a low protein diet for liver failure.  But it turned out that all 5 dogs love these yipyaps!  They're cute little crunchy treats, kinda like the old Pez candies but shaped like little bones.  Now I keep a tin in my purse for treats at the vet's office or wherever.  It's great to have a purse/pocket sized treat that never rubs off on your hands with stinky greasy crumbs, like other products.

Halitosis was a major problem for me, especially when it came to socializing with fellow hound dogs.  Peeyoo!  was the general reaction I'd get as soon as I'd open my mouth to sweet talk the ladies.  It wasn't until my uncle gave me a piece of Yip Yap Breath Fresheners when my life took a sudden change for the better.  I chewed it cautiously, I still don't trust green tea, and was pleasantly surprised to feel that fresh tingly scent jackhammering away at my nasty halitosis.  Yip Yap Breath Fresheners are prepared with parsley and rosemary, and, yes, green tea, and cooked with liver.  They're shaped like miniature dog bones, though I'd prefer femur shaped bones, these miniature dog bones are shaped in the 'traditional dog bone design.'  Yip Yap Breath Fresheners also contain 1.5% crude protein, which is enough protein to last me an entire month!  My uncle then tossed me a frisbee, and I chased it down and caught it with my mouth.  I was surprised, not to mention impressed, with my newfound ability of chasing down hovering frisbees and seizing it with my sparkling teeth.  Oh, yeah, halitosis is a thing of the past.  Now, it's all about the Yip Yap.

column9: B & M brown bread plain no raisins
column10: Very good with a little whipped cream cheese...  it's a holiday tradition around our house.  Can't get it at local stores ...  only with raisins, which is a harsher flavor brown bread, more molassas flavor so we prefer it plain..  glad Amazon carries it, Prime shipping, great deal, did the 6 cans...  funny that the 12 cans or original takes 1 to 3 months... the 6 cans plain was in stock..  and the ingredients in original and plain were the same.. needed for Thanksgiving..  tickled to find it at Amazon..
So glad Amazon had this to offer. It isn't sold in any stores here. Hubby and I both love this.

In the years past most grocery stores carried Brown Bread, but now it is almost impossible to find in the stores. I'm very gladAmazon has it available. And it's every bit as good as I remember it from years ago: It's Great!Also for those on Weight Watchers the PointsPlus Points are just 3 for a 1/2 inch slice of B&M Plain Brown Bread, so it's a very good treat to have along with a meal.
This was an often eaten item in the past when we could find it is stores & was great to be able to eat it again.
i've tried O.N.E. other brand which does not compare to Brazil gourmet cashew juice. The juice is so smooth going down, with a great taste to boot. I highly recommend it!

This stuff was really hard to find!  I really like that it is actual fruit and not just juice, water and sugar.  The price was ok, but the shipping makes it a bit less desirable.  I would love to find a comparable product that is a little more affordable!

This exotic fruit juice is sweet with a very unique, actually nutty flavor that reminds one of the direct relation of the cashew apple to the nut we're all familiar with.  It's a great way for those of us who don't live in the tropics to experience the flavor of this very perishable fruit.

column9: Mix in with other juices, especially citrus
column10: Passionfruit by itself isn't as interesting as what the flavor does when mixed with other juices, especially citrus, and a little goes a very long ways. It doesn't go so well with apple juice.One of these small bottles should be enough to add an interesting taste to about 2-4 quarts of citrus-flavored beverage. It may remind you a bit of Hawaiian punch, but you can mix it much less sweet to adult tastes.

Brazil Gourmet is an awesome company. They were very attentive and quick to respond to my questions. Their Guava and Passion Fruit Juices are the only ones I've been able to find that do not contain artificial sugaring, etc. that most companies have in their nectar products. I'm very pleased with their product and service.

I bought this juice to make a drink my wife and I had while in Bora Bora, French Polynesia. It was called "Tahiti Drink" and the ingredients called for passion fruit amongst other things. The juice was priced very reasonably and arrived quickly and well packaged. The juice itself was delicious. One reviewer stated it was too sweet, I dont believe this to be true at all. It does have some sweetness to it but by no means is it too sweet. It is very refreshing, has a good balance of acidity and sweetness and did the job in recreating the Tahiti drink.

column9: It's okay but I won't buy it again.
column10: These "nectars" have the same problem as any fruit juice called a "nectar", it's way too sweet. I wanted something intense and tangy, which this isn't. It tastes good, very good, but it wasn't worth the price for me.

column9: Make your own vitamin water-like beverage.
column10: My favorite brand of vitamin water has been discontinued so I have been on a mission to create a drink of my own. In experimenting, I tried the popular brand of guava concentrate in a can, but it is so full of sugar that I just can't justify using it, even watered down. I decided to find an alternative guava product, and bought this one. It comes in square cardboard containers, which is great for storage and recyling. It's made with cane sugar as opposed to the high fructose muck. It's also inexpensive, compared to the canned nectar. If I have any complaint it's that it isn't sweet enough, but I find adding an artificial sweetener helps with that. Guava has a rich grassy aftertaste, which takes some getting used to -- especially if you're new to the taste. For those who love fresh guava, they will LOVE this product.With all my experimenting, I discovered that I also really like the flavor of passion fruit. If you're interested, here's my beverage recipe:In a 24 ounce glass container, add:1/2 cup guava or passionfruit nectar1 pkg of sweet n low (or whatever you like)2 tbls of Torani syrup (mango or passionfruit, etc.)then fill container with cold water and shake well.Serve over ice.Makes 4 - 5 servingsIt tastes better than the vitamin water I thought I couldn't live without, it's less expensive, I'm not throwing away all those plastic bottles anymore, AND I can control the amount of sugar, type of artificial sweetener, and the amount of filtered water I use to dilute it.

column9: Just like the Juice in Brazil!
column10: Last year when I visited Brazil, I got hooked on the passion fruit juice (Maracuja) they serve. I was disappointed to find that we don't really have anything as authentic or great tasting as fresh passion fruit juice here in the states. I was thrilled to find this brand however. It tastes just like the freshly served passion fruit juice from Brazil! I'm so happy it's actually available to buy here now!!!

column9: Not the real thing, but similar
column10: I love real Scottish haggis and this brand, though American made, isn't too bad.  A bit bland compared to what I've eaten in Scotland. I improve it by adding some ground pepper and a touch of nutmeg, even a few drops of scotch on occasion.  I wish I had ordered more before the price went up.  It was a good deal at first,  less expensive than buying it at the Scottish shops in N. Carolina.  I buy it much less often since the price increase.
Seriously, this stuff is really really good. Not kidding one bit. And odd item to be sure, but delicious.Just don't get the stains on your three wolf moon shirt.

This is the 4th time I have ordered this, and this stuff is great!  I have had it with fried eggs on top like hash. I also use it at a cracker topper, on toast or just plain.  This stuff is really that good.  My kids won't touch it, but they know the origin. However I was able to get my niece to try, and she liked it. If your a Scot trapped in the states this is the stuff to get!Free Scotland!

column9: Decent Flavor, HUGE Amount of Fat.
column10: First, there is no sheep's stomach so how can you call it Haggis.  Second each half cup serving (3.6 oz/ 110 g) is 330 calories 190 of which is fat.  It is WAAAAYYYY fatty, but the flavor is pretty good.  A little spicy with a flavor of oats and lamb with some pepper spiciness.  It's pretty good fried up like a hash.  It's also ground up really fine, much finer than any Haggis I have ever had.  Finer than plain hamburger.If you don't have access to the real thing, it's not a bad substitute...
I have had authentic scottish haggis before and this is very close if not almost the same . This is a very good quality product and cheaper than most other similar haggis .

This haggis is quite quite excellent. I've missed it since I ran out of what I brought back from Scotland. That brand isn't available right now (Grant's) but this is just as good. I like the shock value when I read the ingredients  of Grants to others after they try it.

I bought this haggis for my father for an X-mas gift (he's a Scotsman). When it arrived two of the three cans were dented, so I ended up giving my father only 1 of the cans. At the price I paid, that makes for an awfully expensive price for just one can. He hasn't opened it yet (saving it for Robert Burns' birthday) so I can't even speak to the flavor, etc. Just wanted to share my disappointment with the dented cans.

I cannot believe that I am having great difficulty finding this product. it has many, many different uses besides marinating. I put it in soups, stews, sauces and it is great on pork and all meats. I bought the pecan from you amazon and now I want you to stock the apple PLEASE!!!!!!  it's hard to believe such a great product is not readily available.  WOW!!!! Thank you amazon!!!!! I just got notification that you have this product in stock. Will be telling everyone I know.

it sucks, i have been eating lipton chicken noodle soup for 40 years, now they change the receipe or what ever they did, i can't find any of the old boxes, if i could find it, i would buy a case or two, i have looked everywhere in every store. i have also talked to other people very disappointed. Lipton chicken noodle w/real chicken broth is like some peoples Folgers coffee, i guess if i can't get it anymore i'll have to switch to another brand. Very unsatisfied customer. Kelly Bright

I loved the way the product was packaged; no broken bottles at all.I'm used to getting my orders withing a week but this took longerto get (almost three weeks). Apart from the delayed delivery, thisproduct is delicious. I've never tried the Malta India before but I love itand I strongly recommend it. India, Malta , 7-Ounce Case of 6 Bottles

This product was originally made in Germany, as Malzbier (Malt Bear), in the 1920s. It's very high on Vitamin B and it even has a very tasty and distinct taste. It's very sweet. And healthy. Buying more of this is the best thing in the world.
I received a completely different product than I ordered. The product is similar but is a different brand and does not taste good. I would like the product I bought  please.

Breakfast blend is no longer the mild coffee flavor that I have come to enjoy for the past few years. It is now a medium coffee with noticeable burnt flavor along with some bitterness. I don't know why Starbucks messed with a good thing but after reading that their new line of blonde coffees offers no taste at all I will now be forced into looking for a new mild blend of coffee. I bought mine from target with the new packaging that says medium. I hope Starbucks returns to the original formula that made Breakfast blend so good.

column9: Great coffee, the perfect blend. Wake up to Starbucks flavor in your home!.
column10: This is by far one of the best breakfast blends, I have tried.  The beans chosen are a perfect meld, with a low acidity.  Starbuck's did their job right in selecting beans for their taste rather than supply.  A typical pattern in many coffee house brands is to throw together a low grade more plentiful bean with a few mid to high range beans and then pawn it off as a quality brew at a higher price.  This often results in a coffee blend without taste.  Starbucks, however, did their taste test on this blend and came out with a true winner.The beans are roasted much lighter than your typical Starbucks type beyond french roast, this also helps in creating a coffee that is less acidic.  Yet while lightly roasted the beans have been roasted enough so that the oils will be released when put through a drip maker or coffee press, a problem usually encountered with lighter roast.  Their is a defint natural sweetness in the beans that are enhanced with the use of fat free milk, the lactose sugar of the milk bean the only additional sweetener need.  A full fat milk or cream would mask the complexity of the sutler flavors here and leave you with coffee that is on the taste par with any store brand stale canned bean type.This coffee's blend and flavor would make it great choice for a hearty comforting breakfast of bacon and eggs where the flavor of the foods are enhanced by a milder coffee that leaves the food as the star and not an attention grabbing bitter coffee.
Bought the coffee at Shop Rite expecting a nice brew.  This coffee had a very unpleasant aftertaste.  It was not expired.  Had it with flavored coffee creamer.

column9: Medium Breakfast Blend not the same
column10: I have been ordering the three pack of regular Breakfast Blend for some time now, but Amazon sent the MEDIUM Breakfast Blend on my last order.  I tried to make sure I ordered the right one, and did, but they sent the MEDIUM anyway.  Quick tip:  the MEDIUM blend is absolutely awful.  Don't waste your money on this one if you're a regular Breakfast Blend lover.  The real/original Breakfast Blend is smooth and mellow with no bitterness and great taste.  This MEDIUM takes more like the institutional Maxwell House.  I won't be ordering this again.

This is not the Breakfast Blend Mild Advertised but the Medium Blend which is a smokey burnt taste. I bought this thinking this may a seller with some of the Mild left. Starbucks have decided to change their coffee into 3 roasts light is Blond, med in Breakfast Blend and bold is Dark Roast. I have not tried the Blond but the reviews are not too favorable. I really liked the Mild Breakfast Blend...please bring it back!!!
Starbucks has done away with its delicious mild Breakfast Blend and instead the newly packaged Medium Breakfast Blend is bitter with a terrible burnt aftertaste. Yuck!

I should preface this by saying that I am not a coffee snob.  I used to drink instant coffee and have only recently begun making "real" coffee in a drip machine.  I decided to try a couple different types to see what I liked.  My dislike of this Starbucks variety might be exacerbated by the fact that the coffee I tried just before this one (Lavazza Qualita Rossa) was so good.  In comparison, this blend has a very harsh and bitter taste.  I won't be buying this again and wish I hadn't purchased a three-pack.
Love the coffee, however, I can buy this product cheaper at our Kroger grocery store.

Starbucks Breakfast Blend is my favorite coffee.  It's mild tasting, not bitter.  Don't get me wrong, it's not weak; it's mild & has a great aroma.  I'm brewing a pot right now.  :)If you don't have time to brew a pot of coffee you might want to try Nescafe Taster's Choice Instant Coffee, Regular, 0.07-Ounce Single Sticks, 7-Count Boxes (Pack of 12).

Star Bucks coffee is without a doubt the best coffee in the world. I do like the smell of star Bucks coffee when I return from walking my dogs.The smell of good coffee covers the room. Then when I take the first sip, I know it is time to start my day.

My husband is a big coffee guy and loves this product. But beware of ordering online... box was shipped in a flimsy mailer and therefore banged up, including damage to the k-cups. Had to return the package with the loose coffee grounds falling out to the store and exchange in person.

column4: Michelle R. Vickers "A Tony Stewart Fan"
column9: I don't drink coffee, but husband does
column10: I can barely stand the smell of coffee, let alone drink it. However, both my mom & husband drink it everyday and both enjoy this flavor, but they prefer a stronger blend.  I now purchase dark roasts for them.

Rating coffee is hard as it's like rating a piece of art - highly subjective. As background, I love the strength of Starbucks coffee as compared to Dunkin, Eight O'Clock, Pete's, and Target Brand. The issue here is that I thought I was getting the House blend (Starbucks changed their packaging) and I got the Breakfast blend. Now this was my error, so I thought I should try it. It was rather weak and had little character. Wasn't full bodied at all. Seemed like the bottom fell out of this blend. For my tastes, I had to add more coffee and just to bring this to where it was somewhat bearable.Now, there may be those who like this type and they would give it 5/5, for me, the 3/5 resulted from the loss of flavor and character. Not that it was milder, it just didn't taste good to me. I've tried the whole Starbucks spectrum of coffee and while I may not like the french roast, I can taste the "flair" associated with it. This was different. Like making clam chowder with 1% milk, something's missing.

I love Starbucks Breakfast Blend as my first cup of coffee for the day, and as a mild sipping coffee for the entire day. It is light and is low in acid, which is easy on my stomach first thing in the morning. I enjoy roasting my own coffee and have yet to duplicate this unique blend that has such wonderful finishing notes on the palate.Enjoy!

I love this coffee..light..bright..a wonderful cup in the morning. I do not care for other Starbucks coffee as it is too heavy for my taste buds...and BB hits the spot...get it on sale when you can and stock up.

Tried this Starbucks blend a few months ago, and it's the best coffee I've had in a long time.Even started ordering it from Amazon.  It's not bitter and tastes great when you make it strong.Other Starbucks blends I've tried, like French Roast, were too over-powering and bitter.To me there's a difference between a strong coffee and a strong-tasting coffee.A strong-tasting coffee can be made weak, almost see-through, yet still have an over-powering taste.Don't like this!I prefer a strong coffee that no light can pass through, and it doesn't have to be a dark-roast bean.If you haven't tried the Breakfast Blend - give it a try.

column9: Better than Pike Roast at Amazon
column10: Starbucks Breakfast Blend is a mild roast with none of the bitter aftertaste seen with Pike Place Roast. Since Pike has become the "default" blend at Starbucks locations including airport locations like ORD and IAD I've learned to search for alternatives including MacD and BK.

I have not actually tried this flavor of Starbucks coffee, so i am sorry that I don't have a specific review, but I wanted to let everyone know that Starbucks stores are now offering free taste testing of the bold, medium and blonde flavors of coffee. Also they are giving away samples of blond coffee (8-10 cup packs). So hit all the Starbucks in town and score some free coffee! I don't know how long the promotion is going on but I am sure there are more details on their website. Happy Coffee Drinking!
Very good deal for 3 12-ounce bags of Starbucks Breakfast Blend coffee. Delivered promptly and free. Couldn't ask for more!
This is one of our favorites for a mild coffee.  It's very flavorful, but not strong or bitter, and complements food very well.

column9: Best coffee I have ever had!!
column10: I thought this was the best, and most flavorful coffee I have ever drank!!  I love it and try my hardest not to run out!!

column9: It stunk and tasted just as bad
column10: I purchased this from my local market and boy, am I sorry to have done that.  This particular Starbuck's blend is awful to say the least.  I knew it wasn't going to end well when I opened the bag and was nearly overcome by the nasty aroma.  To me, coffee is supposed to smell good as well as taste good.I decided that maybe my nose was deceiving me.  So I brewed a couple of cups worth (I make my coffee at night for the next day) and waited thinking that perhaps it would taste better than it smelled.  Once it finished brewing, I took a sip of it black.  UGH!  I thought maybe sugar will help.  NOPE.  My next trick was to add vanilla flavored creamer.  NADDA!It seems as if this is a smokey blend.  The taste is very heavy and not at all appealing to me.  I think I expected a lighter, smoke free and perhaps more tangy flavor.Now I have to try to give this away....(sigh)

Needed some bulk quantity jelly beans to fill small jars for baby shower favors.  Buying them this way saved a lot of money over buying them by the pound at the local candy store.  As stated in another review, the jelly beans just come in an unlined cardboard box.  This seemed a bit odd, but there were 2 sheets of wax paper, I guess to prevent dust, etc from getting into the box through the top and bottom.  Not much else to say, they're Jelly Belly's at about half the cost of the local guy!

column9: I wouldn't buy this product again!
column10: My review on this is not based on actually trying the product and this is because the bag it came in looks like a regular goody bag which they just attached their packing labels on, which usually wouldn't bother me, but it was sealed with red tape! I just like my products to be sealed more professionally! =/

Is it me or am I not the only one who actually loves the flavor of olives? I have been eating olives since the early fifties and I love the flavor of those little beasts. I've been purchasing olives here on Amazon for some time now and have come to realize that an awful lot of olives are flavored with "stuff" that, basically, overwhelms the actual olive flavor. These olives are in that category. They taste fine, but they don't actually taste like olives. They taste more like garlic and lemon. Middle eastern olives are often flavored with lime, garlic, lemon and hot spices. I like all those spices, but I like the flavor of olives. These olives don't have that flavor.So, they are great as Mediterranean or middle eastern olives, but not as "real" olives. That's my opinion and I'm sticking to it.NT
Best tamarind candy out there. I like that they are individually wrapped, but you'll find yourself eating them until you force yourself to stop.

column9: Omg, they're more addicting than Pringle"s...U Can't have just one.
column10: Deliver was quick and I'm very satified w/the mango tamarind balls, but 10/Pks for 49.99 is way to pricey.  Will buy again but not for that price.  Would definitely buy from TAJ 4 U again.

if your tired of the same old butter and salt fare for your popcorn, then you gotta try this stuff out. the Jalapeno flavor is my favorite, even though it doesn't taste much like jalapeno. Kernel Seasons makes other flavors too. you can even find them at Walmart and Target, but for some reason they never have the Jalapeno flavor. Great stuff!

column9: This COUGH product COUGH is COUGH bad.
column10: I bought the jalapeno seasoning thinking it would be a great flavor to add to my popcorn. The good part is that it does indeed taste decent. However, the seasoning is so fine that it makes me cough whenever I try to breath; it gets into my nose and also makes me sneeze. I'm thinking about returning this as the product needs to be improved for me to even consider purchasing another one.

I've found Kernal Seasons in different flavors in the grocery store but never saw the Jalepeno flavor until going to a movie theater where they had different seasonings to add to your bag.  Loved it.  Looked all over our city in the stores for this and finally gave up and ordered it off Amazon.  A little pricier, but a good deal on shipping helped.  It's worth it.  I love this stuff on popcorn, baked potatoes, etc.  The nice thing about getting 6 shakers is that I can share!

We discovered this seasoning at our local movie theater, and now we really crave it at home too.  The jalapeno flavor is the best, but it's not spicy like you might think.  Just the right blend of salty and savory...

This product used to be Jalepeno (as described in the title) and I've happily purchased it many times.  However the last time I ordered it I got Cheesy Jalepeno instead.  I checked the product and the title did not mention Cheesy at all but the picture had been updated and, if you look closely, you can see the word Cheesy on the label. Needless to say, I won't be purchasing it again.

I make air popped popcorn without butter.  My hope was to add some flavor to the popcorn without adding calories.  This product is spicy and tastes okay, but its too powdery to be useful.  First off, it is so finely ground that it doesn't stick to the dry popcorn.  Even worse, it tends to float in the air and I end up inhaling it (which is unpleasant).  I think for this to work I'd have to wet the popcorn in some way (with water or butter?) to get it to stick, but I'm not looking for that level of effort.  I now use a low calorie 'butter' spray instead.  Much easier.

It's awesome on popcorn, and french fries. too bad there aren't any stores that sell it. I tried it at a movie theatre and was hooked. It's a six pack, it should last for a while, and will make a great gift.

I air-pop my corn at home, sprinkle salt and eat them in a "healthy" way without butter.When I sprinkle this on "dry" freshly popped corn, the powder is so fine that the powder either goes into my nose (when I breath out while eating, which we usually do as humans, try holding your breath while chewing something it's not natural) making me cringe, or into my throat (air vent) making me cough/choke.I'm guessing they expect me to eat this with layers and layers of butter so the "powder" doesn't get sucked into my nose/throat, but I eat my popcorn without butter because it is healthier!So now, for me to use this seasoning I had to use olive oil (instead of butter, as it is healthier than butter) and place them into a ziplock and shake them.  The problem is that I can't just add a little, I have to add a lot of oil so it covers all the popcorn.So if you don't mind 10 pumps of--movie theater style--butter then this might work excellently for you.  If you're looking to eat your butter without butter or oil, then this will make you choke, sneeze, gag, cough and make you frustrated you can't even enjoy your own popcorn.If you want to try something that is crazy spicy and really addictive, put some TABASCO brand Pepper Sauce - Original Red 5oz. and shake them up.  This is how a lot of people in Brazil eat their popcorn (with hot sauce) and you'll be crying because it's so spicy/hot but you won't be able to stop eating because it is so addictive good!I wanted to give 1 STAR but I guess majority of Americans eat with butter so I gave it a fair 3 STAR because with butter/oil the product works... without them, omg.... I think the 5 packs I didn't open are going to be a White Elephant gift for Christmas next year.

The Jalapeno popcorn seasoning is delicious!! I looked for it in stores but couldn't find the Jalapeno flavor. They had the other flavors from Kernel Seasons but not the Jalapeno, so I ordered it through Amazon and got a pack of 6 (what a bargain).

I have tried every flavor that Amazon offers in this brand of popcorn seasoning.  Based upon all of the salty flavors, this is by far my favorite.  It's not going to be hot and spicy like you may think, but it definitely tastes like jalapeno.
I like the zing this spice mix adds to popcorn.  I find it benefits from added cheese, so I mix this with the white cheddar.

column4: Casey "Eat, Sleep, Pictures, Video Games, Repeat"
column10: I got it once at some store and I LOVED IT! But, forgetful me, I forgot where i got it. I searched everywhere! I couldn't find it until now! I am so happy. Best Frappe's EVER!!!

I always buy this brand of frappe mix and my frappe's come out so good. I add a little cold coffee and some ice, mix and they taste just like Starbucks.  I highly recommend this brand, I always have it in the house.

If you are a hot dog fan and you're ever in Sanibel Island, Florida, go to Schnapper's Hots. They serve the best dogs ever with Weber's Hot Green Tomato Piccalilli Relish. My wife and I were there a few years ago, and I managed to eat there at least 4 times that week!
If you are from western NY, you know you can't eat a hotdog without this...

This product has a great taste and flavor.  However, it's shortcoming is that it has too much liquid and not enough actual relish.  The hot dog bun becomes saturated and soggy.  This does not replace the old no longer available picalilli from years ago.

column9: You will never eat store brand tuna again
column10: All I have to say is once you taste this rich, almost melt-on-your-tongue tuna, almost anything else you'll buy in a supermarket will remind you of fishy cardboard.

It really stinks that eating the healthiest foods costs the most but in my opinion, it's worth it.  I love these cereals.  The first case I bought from amazon was the original and I wound up eating it for breakfast, snacks, lunch, whenever, without milk or adding anything... I love the crunch and the taste. I actually ate the whole case in about 2 weeks and very little else... and it is amazing that I didn't gain weight, my bms were much better, and I had great energy and felt well- my body was craving it.  Try that on Coco Puffs, Cornflakes, and even any of the other "healthy" cereals in the healthfood stores!I actually make my own sprouted grain breads and crackers which I could easily break up to make this type of cereal- there is nothing in the world like it, but it takes 2 days of sprouting and a couple of hours to complete the food processing and spreading on the baking sheet process, and then 3-4 hours of low-heat baking.  So when I don't have time to do this, a very close second are the Ezekiel products (their bread, english muffins, cereals, and pastas).Anyone who makes health their top priority will eat very little of non-sprouted grain products (flour products).  For those interested, Amazon sells a book called the Essene Gospel of Peace which contains writings found in the Vatican archives- in this little book, Jesus teaches his followers how to make bread, and it has nothing to do with taking the dry grain and grinding it up into flour and using yeast- he teaches them to soak the grain, let the sun bring it to life, grind it up alive, and then let the sun bake it.  That makes the only truly living, healthful breads and cereals.Yes, these products will feel and taste different than most are used to, but the more one eats this type of real food, the more the body starts remembering and then one begins to really enjoy the taste and textures because they equate to life and health.  :)

I tried this cereal with coconut milk and it taste wonderful. It adds just enough sweetness without ruining the whole idea of being healthy. If you add strawberries, a banana or some blueberries it makes it even greater.  You'll get a protein serving along with a fruit serving!  Definitely worth the nearly $5/box.  Its expensive to be healthy....Pay the farmer or pay the doctor....

column9: Ezekiel 4:9 Organic Sprouted Grain Cereal, Almond
column10: Taste Great!  You only need a little cereral per serving. I add it to vanilla yogurt and fresh fruit for extra crunch.  Also good by itself or add it to your favorite cereal for extra flavor and crunch.  Would highly recommend this product.

This is my new favorite cereal. I had given up cereal when I cut way back on carbs. Plus, most of them were just full of sugar anyway. When I decided to add some healthier carbs back into my diet I was looking for a healthy cereal with protien and fiber, but without sugar. I love cutting up a banana and topping my cereal with it. That way I don't have to add any sugar or sugar substitutes. Ocassionally I use stevia if I don't have any bananas or other fruit.

Tastes dry and dense with milk, so I experimented and found that if you eat it in a bowl with some honey (however amount depending on your preference), it's delicious-  the healthiest "granola" ever!!This is my fav ezekial cereal of all the varieties

Buying this cereal by the case is $2.00 less expensive PER BOX than when I was buying it at the grocery store! If you're going to buy it anyway, this is the way to go! Thanks for free shipping, Amazon!

As an all natural product this is a good cereal.  I don't eat sweetened products so this product is fine with me.  It's hard stuff and takes a while to eat.  It's also very dense and doesn't absorb too much milk.  Try a small bowl and take your time eating it.

Being a diabetic, I have used their breads for years. Most diabetics don't cut flour from their diet. They simply don't understand that there is no difference between sugar and flour in your body. Anyway, I just happened to be shopping with my wife and came across a display of this cereal. I didn't know Food For Life even made other products. I grabbed two boxes. Making a long story short, this is simply the best cereal a diabetic can have. It tastes great with no sugar, fat free almond milk. I feel so much better eating their products. Thank you Food For Life! Your name says it all!................Lou

A friend recommended Ezekiel and I'm glad she did. Just before that, I decided I really need to eat better and have been trying to ween myself off as many processed foods as possible. This cereal is a great choice for that because the ingredients are all natural with no weird chemicals.On a separate note, I love carbs but they don't love me back. My body burns them up too quickly, and then find myself in that droopy 'low blood sugary' feeling. What's nice about this cereal is it allows me to eat carbs (38g / serving) but I never get that blood sugar dip because the sugar content is low (less than 1 g / serving) and the protein is high (8g /serving).The cereal texture is very small grains, with the paper-thin almond slices being the largest things you'll see in the bowl. Every bite is super crunchy.I have tried it in milk, but didn't really like it that way. Instead, I use a fruit variety of kefir, which is sort of like a creamy yogurt drink. I've tried Ezekiel with peach, pomegranite and mixed berry kefir varieties, and it is a tasty combination. If you want to try this, keep in mind that kefir is a bit thicker than milk. I prefer just enough kefir to moisten the cereal so that the grains remain the star of the show.Ezekiel is a very healthy cereal, perhaps the healthiest one available. It isn't going to taste like kids cereal because kids cereal isn't super-healthy. Straight-out-of-the-box Ezekiel with milk probably is hard core cold turkey if you're reforming from bad eating habits (like I am!). But, with the addition of a little fruit or some almond milk or flavored kefir, you'll find it's an enjoyable meal that also is doing good things for your body.

column9: This is a very healthy, satisfying, and nutritious cereal
column10: This stuff is great. If Ezekiel could eat these ingredients alone for over a year, then it's gotta have some good stuff in it! This is one of the few cereals in this "genre" that does not seem to be rabit food, nor be nothing more than ruffage, but really is an enjoyable eat! I would recommend a little honey and mik and warming it up for a 45 sec.

This is a really good cereal. It's good to eat with sweetened kefir or yogurt. You can use it as a topping for other cereal to get that crunch, or you can eat it as is with milk and you choice mixture of fruit topping and/or honey. I like blueberries and bananas, or blueberries and strawberries, or bananas and honey.If you're trying to stay away from white/refined flour and white/refined sugar and other really bad carbs, but you need some type of grain carb, or you need something that you can eat quickly in the mornings, or you just really like cereal and can't give it up, go for this.It taste's good and it really is good FOR you.

column9: Ezekiel 4:9  -  Sprouted grains are the best
column10: Ezekiel cereal is just plain delicious. Eat it with fruit, yogurt, or anything else you can think of. I eat mine with almond milk. I like to let it soak for a couple minutes to soften. Much softer than Grapenuts and much more flavor. It is much better than any of its competitors. Of course no one else is specifically using sprouted grain. I was trying to eat healthy and was eating oatmeal. However, oatmeal never carried me through to lunch without feeling ravenous. Ezekiel cereal keeps me feeling full.
Great cereal.  Does not get soggy when soaking overnight.  Love it with fresh apple juice and concentrate, fresh fruit, yogurt.

column9: Best cereal on the market, and only one with a complete protein nutrition
column10: This cereal is surprisingly delicious.  I love most of Food for Life's products, but this cereal takes the cake.  If you are into nutrition and exercise, and you love eating cereal with milk in the morning, go with this brand.  It has a complete protein system, what else could you ask for?  I hope to see more options for a complete protein cereal on the market in the future to see how my expectations can change, but I don't see any other brand competing for some time.  Although, having a five star review on Amazon will encourage competitors to step up and deliver the quality food people deserve, but there may not be huge profit margins in it for them, so we'll see.  It is a niche market, but the company is delivering properly.  I love their bread too, but the cereal wins!  P.S. Get the Almond because the raisins in the Raisin are sort of stale, and the flax seed in the Flax is not ground up, so you don't get the real nutritional value.  With Almond you get the value of the nuts.  I just add some fresh ground flax in there myself and enjoy!

I have been eating this for years, it's just a good way to start the day, pour on some almond milk and enjoy, similar to Grape Nuts but better tasting and better for you.  Not to mention very high priced in retail grocers, so nice to get the amazon case price.

Of course, my testimony here is going to be just anecdotal evidence, but about 6 months ago I changed my diet to reflect that of what is outlined in the books "Healthy at 100" (John Robbins) and "The China Study" (T. Colin Campbell), both of which advocate a high-complex-carb, low-fat, low-protein (yes I said low-protein - against the grain of all the low-carb craze diets) diet full of whole grains, vegetables and fruits with relatively no added sugars, oils or fats. When you start removing all this extra nonsense sugar from the SAD (Standard American Diet) it tastes a little bland at the beginning, but that is only because we have been eating so unnaturally for so long. After a little while you come to appreciate the subtle flavors of the grains, and also come to appreciate the natural sweetness and taste of other fresh fruits and vegetables. (Last week I tried a bit of some Frozt thing from Starbucks that my wife ordered and nearly choked - it was so cloyingly sweet.) This is a great cereal - thanks Ezekiel!

I love this cereal. (Note: My husband thought it too bland, but he ate it with milk only.)I used Almond milk, strawberries and a pkt of Stevia on my cereal and loved it! It is crunchy, like grape nuts. Absorbs the milk quickly and can be used hot or cold. I use 1/2 cup of cereal to 1/2 cup of milk. This is a great product for those looking for a healthier way of life and watching sugars and carbs.
Move over Kashi cereals, there's a "new cereal" in my cabinet! Especially good in yogurt with fruit, for breakfast, a snack, a desert, a treat.

I discovered Ezekiel products when I was switching over to whole grain foods and in my research found out that sprouted is actually better! I love these products, they taste great, make me feel good, and I actually crave it. I put the cereal in yogurt, eat it with milk, eat it plain, etc.  I am a huge fan. I was going through the boxes I bought for $6 at my local health food store so fast that my BF said, "hey, go to Amazon and see if you can get it by the case!" I'm saved! Its cheaper here too!

The Almond one is my favorite.  I eat it most mornings with a small box of raisins, walnuts and fat free Almond milk.  I've been eating it for about one year.  It takes getting use to at first but now the only other cereal I'll eat is the original Fiber 1 with fresh strawberries or with walnuts.  I use fat free Almond milk for all my cereal.  I don't particularly like the bread because it is hard but it is doable.  I would definitely recommend it.

After eating this kind of dry cereal all my life I was excited to try Ezekiel Cereal.  I remember it being in the Bible as a child.  When I first opened it I noticed it was very firm and granular.  However after a few minutes in milk it was ready to eat. I also tried it hot by placing a bowl with milk in the  microwave for 1 1/2 minutes.  It seemed to unlock the full flavor and was delicious. I now eat it this way. I shared some with a neighbor and they liked it and the Bible story that accompanied the box.

For me cereal is not breakfast food, but snack food. This is great snack food. Add some cinnamon and a little honey and you are in business. To take it to the next level, eat with apple slices. I love that it tastes good (with the aforementioned additions) and that it's good for me.

I love this cereal.  It tastes good and is REALLY filling.  I've never bought it in bulk before but it's so much cheaper than buying at the grocery store... you basically get one box free this way.  The cereal is made with sprouted grains and is really healthy for you.  It also contains almond slices,
Couldn't find this one in our local grocery.  Very good for you and tasty too!!

This was the first kind my family and I bought.  Lucky for me I didn't let it stop me from trying the golden flax flavor.  OMG - I eat it for breakfast, lunch, snack - it's the best way to "cheat" when you get those after hour urges.  It's sprouted grains and very nutritious with a good amount of protein.  I have it after my superfood/fruit smoothie in the morning and have a lightness about me all day that I haven't had in a while.  It makes it easy for me to eat 5 x's a day and make healthy lunch choices at my sedentary job where there is free notsohealthy food offered all the time.  Even my 12 y/o daughter who hates lentils loved this and was VERY surprised when I told her what she was eating, lol.  We both hated the almond and love the golden flax but everyone's taste buds are different.  FYI, the texture of the golden flax reminds me of grapenuts cereal. Can't remember much about the almond except that we hated it and the full box is still in my kitchen and we are currently working on box # 2 of the golden flax.  Very happy and appreciative to find something that is so healthy taste so good.  Hope this helps!Love & Light,Angel

I have healthy 45 year old teeth and broke a large chuck off my front tooth eating this cereal.  The chunks in my box reminded me of gravel it was so hard.  I have never purchased this cereal before and so not sure if I just got a bad box or this is the normal for it.  I have contacted the vendor to try to find out.  Watch out for hard chunks hard enough to break your teeth.

You might as well eat the box it came in.  If it weren't for the almonds, it would have no taste at all.It's too fine to eat dry as a snack, and too solid to eat with cold milk as a cereal.I imagine it would be a decent substitute for granola in a fruit and yogurt parfait, but I haven't tried it that way yet.But remember, it's HEALTHY.

column9: Everything's Just Ducky with this EVO Product for My Felines!
column10: Let me set the scene for you: three felines in the house, purebred, rescue, and recalcitrant- take your pick! Ages ranging from kitten to curmudgeon. All three are picky eaters - they all subscribe to the same Rule of Tongue: if they like a food it's one paw up and a proud member of The Clean Plate Club - nothing left behind!  If they don't, well, it's a replay of "Just Walk Away, Renee" - disgust, revulsion, and they vote with their feet. In all three cases here, it's one paw up, Club memberships, and total annihilation when it comes to Evo Duck for cats. Of course, ymmv, but I think it's worth a try if you aren't put off by the price, and aren't dealing with existing puss problems like diabetes, renal failure, and obesity, where a more restrictive diet may be in order. For us, it's a hit!

I bought this product at a local store, not from this seller.  I usually use Wellness canned food, but thought my cat was bored and wanted something new.  So I picked this up, knowing that Evo is a really good brand (like Wellness).It is one of the most disgusting smelling cat foods I've ever had the displeasure of using.  I was gagging while trying to put it into the bowl.  My cat took one taste and walked away, and chose to eat nothing until I replaced it 12 hours later with some dry food.  I would try another flavor of their food - since I know it's high quality - but I wouldn't buy the duck flavor again.

column9: No kitchen should be without at least two cartons of this stuff!
column10: Hands down this is the best chicken stock on the market. Forget about Emeril's and Wolfgang Puckor the generic crap you get at the grocery, this is far and away the king of the commercial stocks.A good stock is the key ingredient in soups, marinades, sauces and is used to flavor veggies likegreen beans and potato and rice dishes. This stuff is just perfect for all of the above, especiallyfor making soups like roasted garlic, white chicken chili, and kitchen sink vegetable soup. It justdoesn't get any better. Available locally for between $3-$4.One other thing I like about this product is that it is heart healthy, low sodium, and the entire 32oz.only carries 96 calories with zero fat!

I make a lot of soups that use Chicken Stock as their base, and after trying a lot of different brands, Kitchen Basics is my brand of choice. Unlike a lot of "broth" that looks like cloudy water, the Kitchen Basics actually looks and tastes like stock! I made risotto one time with a different stock and my wife commented that it wasn't as good as usual (without knowing that I had used another brand).Luckily, they sell this brand in my local Safeway, although it's not cheap. Depending on if I can get this one sale, buying in bulk from Amazon is often the best deal (if they're offering Prime shipping on it).

I prefer this chicken stock because it contains all natural ingredients.  I find it a bit ironic that other chicken stocks that actually have "all natural" written on them include a preservative or two.  This one is made up on only "real" ingredients.However, I'd been a bit frustrated as I use a lot of chicken stock and this stock is quite expensive at my grocery store.  Purchasing on Amazon is a great option as it's 30 or 40% cheaper, though you are of course ordering in bulk.  I use about one of these cartons for a single batch of soup.

In my opinion this is the best stock on the market.  I cook a lot and this time of year I make a lot of stews and cream soups.  This is the best stock to have on hand.  Although I do make my own stock often this is nice to have on hand in a pinch.

This IS the best chicken stock ever, but here's what I want to tell you about my experience with Amazon. I ordered a six pack of beef stock and a six pack of chicken stock at the same time. The total was $45 something. They were shipped separately. The chicken stock was damaged early in the shipping process. I contacted Amazon and they said the $22 something(I don't remember exactly)would be refunded. I purchased these through Amazon as the seller, which eliminated the shipping and handling charge with my Prime membership. I guess that experience with the damaged shipping sort of scared Amazon away from selling it again, because now, the chicken stock is no longer available from them. I have to use a different seller=pay shipping/handling. If they think I'm going to pay 22+ plus the $13 shipping when I just got the beef stock for a little over $22.00, well that's just not going to happen!This is not to degrade this seller(Bangella, I think it is). They are probably great and do a good job. The stock is the best. Buy it. Just try to get a good deal.

column9: The Best I've Had So Far
column10: I've tried a few of the store bought stocks including Rachel Ray's and I must say this is by far the best I've had so far. The flavor is wonderfully rich and concentrated. I've made my own stock before and I actually prefer this one, lol. It definitely steps up the level of any dish, especially soups. Only downside of the product is that it rarely goes on sale. Other than that, I recommend it highly.

column9: Great product, but can be cheaper.
column10: Excellent stock, the best flavor with the least additives I have seen. However, the price of $32 for 6 or $5.33 each is over double the price I have just paid at my local Supermarket. Would love to  see a more competitive Amazon price.

Short of making my own stock (whick I will do when I raise my own chickens), this is the next best thing. Plus, my kid who is anaphylactic to milk, peanuts , and allergic to eggs, soy, and cashews, has never had a reaction to this particular product (kitchen basics chicken stock NOT the low sodium one). Supposedly the other flavors are just as safe, but i am beginning to suspect a beef allergy, so we don't use that flavor anymore.Anyways, my grocery store hasn't restocked their supply yet, so i am on here to get more. I'm liking the price too! sure beats almost 4 dollars at my store (i mean each).

column9: Kitchen basics is a good product

My bull terriers can't get enough of these chews! I have searched high and low for the perfect chew - one that lasts and also one that is safe. I have spent a fortune on chews and the "stuffed" hooves are the best, also smoked knee bones are excellent.I have never had the hooves splinter or cause any safety problems.  This may be a potential problem with really large dogs who can really get their jaws around the hoof and crunch it maybe...so far no problems with my bullies.The natural "stuffing" is all the dried flesh and bones attached to the hoof that most brands remove, this is the best part for my pooches. They absolutely love getting all the stuff out of the hoof...takes a lot of time and distracts them for hours.Also, all of the other "chew-hooves" I have bought have a HORRIBLE death-cow-poo smell which made me want to vomit if my dog was chewing them around me. No rotten, nasty smell with these.i would definitely supervise a dog with one of these for the first time, since you never know how they will do with a new chewie.Hope this helps!

column4: ramito "Random reviews from a reluctant consumer"
column10: My Aussie loves these! They last more than a week - I don't let her go at it for more than 30 min of course. This is the only thing available that will last for days with my big obnoxious destructive dogs. After they have torn it apart (which takes hours) they enjoy the hooves for weeks. They go crazy for them, and spend several peaceful hours quietly chewing - mommy gets much needed quiet time. Totally safe, my 3 dogs are different sizes and have no problems or safety issues with the foot bones inside the hooves (they are round bones with no sharp edges - think knuckles). I've just bought a second batch of these, they are my first choice for a long lasting chew. I've gotten them years before and they have always been safe, good for any size dog, mine are medium and large mutts, but fine for little ones too - would last them for a month. WAY cheaper on here than in a TSC where they are over $5 each - and even that is a bargain compared to any other natural chewy available. Safer than rawhide because they won't get blocked up, and it is not so hard that it will hurt their teeth, as the hoof is like a nail, not like a bone. My 25 lb basenji loves this! He bores easily and doesn't take to anything for long -- toys, chews, all dead to him after 30 minutes max. But I've given him this hoof for an hour every couple days for two weeks, and he still gets excited every time. He dug out the insides the first time around, then went to gnawing on the hooves for several rounds. Now he's working on the "skin", but thankfully spitting out any chunks he manages to tear off. It's like 3 treats in one, and he's enjoying every part. I supervise him closely and have had no issues at all. Being a smaller dog, the size of the hoof alone prevents him crushing it to pieces. And, as others mentioned, there is no odor and little to no cleanup required afterwards. Pretty much a perfect treat for my dog; relatively inexpensive, long-lasting, no smell/cleanup, and keeps him independently entertained longer than anything I've tried so far (and I've tried lots).

column9: These noodles are great, but not from Amazon.
column10: I've had these noodles many, many times. From grocery stores, and even a small convenience store on my college campus. They are always SUPERB- some of the best microwavable cuisine I've eaten. The noodles are soft, the sauce is like a syrup, and the flavor is just unbelievable.Not from amazon. I purchased these noodles with high hopes. I've ordered food items before from Amazon and NEVER have they arrived to my satisfaction or expectations. With these, I figured- "Hey, how could they possibly screw up vacuum sealed microwavable noodles?" I still couldn't tell you how, but it definitely happened.The noodles were clumpy, and broke even after microwaving , even if a small bit of water was added- nothing. There was no life to them, and when your noodles are off- it's tough to enjoy a noodle dish. If that had been the end of it, though, I still would have tolerated the rest of my 6-pack, if vowing to never order them from Amazon again. But no, somehow the SAUCE managed to be terrible in this product! Rather than the viscous syrup-texture of the store-bought Annie Chun's, the packet included in this item was watery with clumps. The sauce itself was watery, yet the "clumps" were all the more noticable for lack of syrup around them. These "clumps" that do not exist in the grocery-store version refused to leave the packet without me opening it up and adding water, swirling, and then dumping out whatever one would call the ungodly mixture I had at that point.Even still- I had hope for the finished product. Surely Annie will pull through for me, regardless of where I got this particular package from! No. What emerged from my microwave took me by complete surprise. In sharp contrast to the delicious noodles resulting from the store-bought Annie Chun's was what can only be described as a disaster. The noodles, already rubbery rather than soft- dried and shriveled over their 60 seconds in the microwave. The sauce, rather than permeating through the noodles as it usually does- had slipped past and collected in a small pool at the bottom of the container. Vegetable chunks and the mysterious "clumps" shriveled and died as well, without the sauce buoying their transformation from freeze-dried to fresh.Three trials later, modifying this and that part of the instructions: soaking the noodles in warm water first, including water in the container before microwaving, mixing a bit of water and corn starch into the sauce, none of this could save what Amazon shipped to me as "Annie Chun's Chinese Chow Mein" noodles. In the end, I decided against leaving the remaining two bowls in the common room for "someone" to eat. I wouldn't want to turn them off this great product just because I made the mistake of ordering food off of Amazon. Instead, they made their way to the trash, where they belonged.As I mentioned earlier, this isn't the first time I've ordered food off of amazon- Emerald Nuts that were "off", peanut butter that was "strange", a pack of 6 jars of Nutella one of which was opened, another of which was just "different". Scooby-Doo gummies that arrived with a crusty/crunchy exterior, and now this pack of noodles. It's not the first time, but I can safely say that it will be the last. Amazon's cheap prices are great for some things, but for groceries- it's just not worth it to this buyer any longer.
