column10: Let me start by saying I love Barilla sauces. It's the only sauce I buy in the jar to use and their marinara in the jar is the best base I've ever used. This however was terrible. I was completely disappointed. I heated it as per instructions but needed to heat it another 45 seconds after mixing it up in a microwaveable bowl because it was only just warm. It is not very spicy at all and I could mainly only taste tomatoes. The pasta had a very strange taste to it, not sure how to describe it but I had to make myself finish it. I wanted to throw it out but I'm not a wasteful person so I ate it. There is well under 2 cups total to eat so if you were giving it to a very young child it may be enough but I had to go make my lunch after eating it as I felt like I had nothing to eat and, NO, I am not a big eater. Usually just a sandwich is more than enough for me for a meal. I would not buy this in a store for any price. I feel like I even wasted my electricity by heating it. Glad I got this from vine so it was free or I'd really be mad as this is expensive for what little you get even if it had been good and I'm glad I have already used Barilla products because if this had been my first taste of theirs I would never use anything of theirs.
The bottle was larger than I thought. The extract is fantastic. This makes the best cakes and french toast casseroles.  My favorite use is in lavender-butternut pound cakes.

I've bought the packs of BioNaturae Tagliatelle and the Pappardelle (wider) several times from Amazon. They are nice noodles, and have much more character than most plain pastas.The texture is slightly coarse, and the taste hints strongly of egg. Good with red, white and other sauces. Also makes a great kugel. I find that a pack serves around 3-4, depending on the dish. (This means that I use around 2/3 of a pack for dinner for two, so I often have a partial pack in my pantry.Note, of the several times I have bought, the have suffered various offenses during shipping, so sometimes the nests of pasta are totally intact and long, and sometimes they are relatively shattered, but it turns out not to matter a whole lot when you are eating. Broken pasta is still plenty long, and fine for eating.I like the wider pappardelle more, as they have a more rustic feel.

This is the pasta I use for all my noodle and pasta dishes.  It always cooks up just right and can't be overcooked because of the amount of eggs in it.  I usually buy it at the health food store or gourmet supermarket when it's on sale, but now I can get it on Amazon anytime at the same price delivered to my door.

AN excellent, well made egg pasta that stands up to all types of sauces and dishes.It works well with traditional red sause as well as variations of cheese, vegetables and oils. Use it as a dinner side staple or all by itself.

I never had high hopes for the organic products that I bought...very often flavorless and grainy textures.  Boy, were we surprised by Bionaturae!!!  The texture, flavor and cooking are perfection.  I have already ordered the other pastas...parpardelle, penne, etc.  I find that you need to add about 1 minute more to the cooking time, but you get scrumptous results.  My husband, a typical spaghetti man, has now come up with recipes for the thicker, noodle like pastas and is a convert!!  Wonderful products.

This chocolate is vegan, ethical, and sublime.  I only wish that they would disclose more details about the blend.Very balanced.  Not overly acidic like Lindt.  Not overly bass-y like others.  More flavorful and better ingredients list than Green & Blacks (our favorite before finding Theo).We had been buying one bar per week, and decided it would make more sense to buy more at a time for less money overall.  We're glad we did.  It turns out that the bars from Amazon are actually fresher than those we were finding in our local shops, which means improved flavor.Highly recommended!

column9: It wasn't as great as I thought it would be...
column10: After reading the reviews, I really hyped myself up for this chocolate.  But like the last reviewer commented about the acidic taste...it's pretty bad.  Initially it was great, but the aftertaste just lingered too much to be enjoyable.  I tolerated it long enough to just ignore it and just eat it.  Alas, I want to ENJOY and not just eat chocolate.  This will not be a repeat buy for me.

column9: The best bean to bar chocolate in america
column10: The title says it all.  I don't know another american-made chocolate that can compete.

Theo's Classic Organic Dark Chocolate (70% Cacao) is absolutely amazing! I you can find it in your budget to purchase this bar, please do so.A friend purchased a dark chocolate bar from Lindt (90% Cocao), and you can't in any way compare them. My friend's gesture was nice, however I wouldn't pay .10 for their bar after experiencing the tasteful delight of Theo's chocolate bar.Also of note, I couldn't find anything stating Lindt to be Organic. Theo is organic.Worth the price, yum!!
Yummy! This dark chocolate taste so good. I have to keep it out of reach so I don't eat too much. I will definitely order again.

This is some delicious dark chocolate with the perfect sugar to cocoa combination. Not too bitter from the 70% cocoa and not too sweet from the sugar. What's more, it's organic, vegan and fair trade certified. I bought this in the bulk size not only because I love chocolate more than my family, but also because a small serving of dark chocolate every day is supposedly good for your heart. I cherish that moment each day. Be sure to really chew and grind the dark chocolate down to a liquid consistency to get the full flavor out. Your taste buds will thank you!

column9: Very good chocolate you can feel good about
column10: Given all of the geopolitics involved in the cocoa trade, this is a very good choice. It is dark without being too bitter or too sweet, and the ethical credentials of the company are hard to beat. A good choice for the concerned chocolate connoisseur.

I just bought your chocolate and it is delicious! I used to buy Godiva but no more for me. You are my new chocolate fix!I will buy lots for my friends birthdays, not to mention the holidays are coming. Thanks for being NON-GMO verified. :)

Upon receiving a package of 12 bars, I noticed on the back of the one of the individual wrappers "Allergy Information:  Manufactured on shared equipment with products containing milk, eggs, wheat, peanuts, and other nuts."  Nowhere on Amazon nor Theo's website is this found (at least in the 15-20 minutes I spent looking).I have not tried the chocolate because I have Celiac disease so I cannot comment on the quality of the product.  I just wanted to save people some time.

column9: Good for you and the planet, maybe, but tastewise, not so much
column10: If you like your chocolate dark, rich, melt-in-your-mouth and creamy, this is not your bar. The texture was too solid, not at all melty, zero creaminess, and the chocolate itself had an odd off flavor that took me a while to figure out - it was acidic, very much so. This is chocolate in its most natural, healthy, and sadly, least tasty form.  If you are eating this for health purposes, it's the right one, but there are a thousand better tasting chocolates out there.  It's a shame since I really wanted to like this, but those European confectioners that have been tweaking chocolate for the last couple of hundred years, they knew what they were doing.

column9: Beefeaters® Chicken Liver Freeze Dried Treats for Dogs
column10: Would have rated no star if available.  Beefeaters® Chicken Liver Freeze Dried Treats for Dogs, are a product of China, and irradiated "for your protection" according to the company's hold message.  Called Amazon.com customer service, and requested a full refund with pre-paid returned shipping.  Too bad none of this is in the product description.  Amazon CSR was very helpful, and very cooperative, postage paid shipping label received via email immediately.  Thank you, Amazon.com!
Universally popular with all dogs and is the only treat my pets will eat.  Great that it is all natural.
The best treats available. Your dogs will go bonkers for these. I buy a tub a month for my little munchkins and they just love it. Good value online.

column9: Best cat treat on the market!
column10: I'm a profecinal cat trainer and have used several different treats including raw/freezdried raw  home made and comercial treats over the last 10 years. These treats take the cake and run. OMG all cats/ clients cats love these treats. They are the onlything i will ever use for training again. Best cat treat on the market. just dont forget to cut them up in little pieces there to big for your average house cat.If you have a finiky cat that dosnt like to eat. well here is your god send. Just crush some up and toss there food in it. Its a garanteed way to get them to start eating again. Dont use a ton since its high in fat.

My cats love freeze dried meats.They absolutely love these treats.They are the cheapest of all the treats I buy.The quality is good, too many small pieces though.Do not buy freeze dried beef liver as it is too hard on there tummies.I only give them a couple of pieces a day but they know what time that is!
Anyone see where theses are made? - I am avoiding treats from China because of all the problems lately. and I do not see a country of origin here.

My 3 Boston Terriers LOVE these treats!  They are natural, wholesome and soft enough to break into multiple pieces.  We keep a steady supply of them in the house ... I order at least 2 containers at a time since we don't want to run out.  Amazon's seller -- All Pets -- has the best price around.
At an early age my Beagle (yes, a beagle) was picky about eating.  crushing a little freeze dried chicken liver on his food gave him the incentive to eat.  Now it has become part of the routine.

column9: My Cat Dances for these treats
column10: I buy chicken livers for my cat. She has now learned to speak English persuasively in order to get these treats.(lol) They are economical and obviously well liked by my cat.

My dog absolutely loved these, and he would have given them a 10 rating if he could.  Unfortunately he is nolonger with us, but he thought they were great for years, and this was the best price I ever found.  Very prompt shipping, and adequate packing
My pugs are picky eaters and only like the chicken liver which is hard to find.  This is a great deal.

It came promptly, dog is very happy.  For some reason, this batch has much smaller pieces than those that we have ordered in the past.  I guess the dog thinks that is better he gets more treats at one time (even though the amout is about the same).

The deep purple/red color and hibiscus fragrance is enough to make anyone passionate about tea. Yet, is this really tea? It looks like tea, but it is really an herbal infusion made by steeping hibiscus flowers, orange peel, licorice, cinnamon, rose hips, lemongrass and red poppy in a swirling of hot water.The flavor is slightly reminiscent of hot apple cider or hot cranberry juice. This tea leaves a tingle on your tongue and I think it goes very well with a spoonful of honey.I love Tazo Teas and have been immersing myself in the mysterious experience with a sense of abandon. So far I've tried most of the flavors and have always been impressed.I do think you need two tea bags for each cup of tea to fully intoxicate the senses and experience the magic of the ingredients. Caffeine Free.You can drink this as you type into the night...~The Rebecca Review

These beautiful green seeds are my favorite although each of the flavors are good. They are so pretty and add that hot wasabi taste in tiny potent bursts. They add so much to wraps or on rice or sprinkle on any fish or meat, anything!:-)

These are fabulous.  A must have for the wasabi freak.  These are great and you will love them, i have turned many people on to these one of which was a sushi chef who now uses them in his rolls.  Thanks.  Wasabi Girl

column9: We use this product for the top of a home made burger roll we love it
column10: We make a burger roll with the wasabi sesame on top. We use the roll for a tuna buger in our restaurant in the Caribbean people love it.

Even though the shipping was super fast, it was not as good as I hoped it would be. I'm pretty sure I only received a pound and a half - definitely not the full two pounds - which I guess is fine because I don't see myself finishing what I was given. The flavor itself was decent but no where near as good as dried papaya can be. It didn't seem all that fresh, either. I probably wont be reordering this item again.

column9: I love this 2lb pack of papaya
column10: I am ordering my second bag. I like the flavor, and you can't find papaya for cheaper, so it's a good value. There is probably room for improvement in the taste department, but I really like it and that's all that matters. I buy it to share with my bunnies instead of buying the $4-$6 4oz bags when it is the same thing. They also love it :)

column9: The best is in the silk sachets but in case
column10: The Red Hot Cinnamon Sunset is the best cinnamon tea by Harney and Sons.  However, if you would like a slightly less expensive cinnamon tea this will do just nicely.  It is very robust and flavorful.  Real cinnamon.
Drinking this tea right now is like Christmas in July!! It's so sweet I had to check the packaging to see if they added sugar! But not too sweet - it's wonderful. Must buy!

Harney & Sons Fine Teas Hot Cinnamon Spice - 50 Tea bagsI have been a heavy coffee drinker for nearly 30 years, ever since I entered the workforce. On occasion I will have tea at a restaurant, but never on a consistent bases.  As I entered the last 6 months of a 2.5 year MBA program I've been buying a cup of this tea before class. It has been consistent and now I have purchased some for home.  Although I have not quit drinking coffee, I can say that I drink more of this.  Luv it!

These Hot Cinnamon Spice Tea bags were a Christmas present.  The person receiving this gift really liked this brand of tea because it has a well put together blend of spices as not to be overwhelming but satisfying.  Would order again.  Delivery was on target for Christmas.
This is a wonderful tea.  I tried it at a local coffee shop and absolutely fell in love with this. Such a nice and warm flavor,

column9: Best Dang Tea in the whole world!
column10: I promise you that Harneys Hot Cinnamon Spice is the most flavorful tea you have ever had! Try some today.
a friend gave this to me and I love it!!!  So good, doesn't need anything in it!!!

This is a very strong, spicy cinnamon tea, great for cold days.  However, you do need to really like cinnamon to enjoy this tea.  I find I have to be in the right mood for it, as it can be overpowering.  In contrast, I have a friend who LOVES it, and just bought her 2nd box of 50 bags of this tea. It's well-blended, but it's serious about its cinnamon.
this product was exactly as presented. It came in a quick manner!!! will order from again.

i tried this tea at a bagel shop, i was curious at first because i real picky when it comes down to tea, when i sip the tea i was like oh my God this tea is so awsome!!! so i ask the girl to tear of the box so i can take it home and see if i can order it on amazon and to my surprise i found it!! i was so happy that i found it on amazon,i ordered it today and i cant wait to sip on my favorite hot cinnamon spice, i paid $1.48 for one tea bag when i can buy 20 teas for 5 dollars oh my God!! Thanks harney and sons for making the best tea and thank u amazon for carring the tea!!!

column9: Need to ship the bottles better
column10: My package arrived and two of the four bottles broken box was soaked and sticky. the two unbroken bottles were good but covered in sticky soda and glass. Wasn't packed very good at all

Package arrived broken.  All bottles were broken and soda was spilled everywhere.  Box was wet and we were not even able to salvage any soda.  I gave one star due to this fact.  I'm sure the soda is good, but we wouldn't know!

I love this product. Before, I stored my little K cups in Zip Locs or boxes. Now I just go directly to my Keurig, which sits on top of the drawer. It is great. The only issue is, that if your Keurig had has the cupboard above it, and the storage drawer underneath it, the coffee maker sits too high to open the lid, so you have to slide out the unit. So think about where you are putting them.
I love this product! It is spacious, sleek and a nice fit. I can keep my coffee and tea separate. It holds my brewer well.
Item fits nicely under Keurig, not taking up any extra counter space.  Easily holds 36 pods or more if you flip some upside down.
Perfect size for the small amount of counter space in my kitchen and arrive in mint condition. Very happy with this purchase!

We love this.  My brother and I bought one, and we then bought the drawer for my father.  We love that there are lots of 'slots' for a variety of K cups, and it takes up almost no room in the kitchen- where counter space is minimal.  Thank you!

I had a storage tower that held 24 capsules and a storage rack that heldseveral boxes of coffee capsules.  Then I saw this device and decidedthat it was the best alternative because I could stack my Bunn coffee makerand my Keurig coffee maker on top of the storage drawers and not lose counterspace.  Works absolutely great.  Wish I had seen this first and saved themoney I spent for the other devices.

I love this item.  It hold the Keurig without it slipping around.  Its not large to look at, but still holds a whopping 36 K-cups.  Those boxes of K-cups were taking up valuable cupboard space.  Seems sturdy enough, I expect it will last a while.  I plan to get another for under my standard 12 cup coffee pot to hold spoons, sugar/splenda packets, non-refrig. creamers, etc.
I live in an apartment and this is a real space saver.  Very sturdy construction and fits nicely on my counter top.  I may even consider getting a second one!!

Thank you this product was exactly what I was looking for it fits well with my Cuisinart coffee brewer. Even my husband commented that it looked like I bought them together.Makes the coffee accessible and out of the way.
This is perfect for storing my K-cups. It's well built, and has a nice sort of spongy top layer for absorbing liquids.
This holder is great.  If your cabinets are tall enough you can set this underneath your Keurig and create some space on your countertops.  I also got the product in a timely manner.
Loved it!  Just as described.  Works Perfect and looks great too!  Space saving and easy to clean.  The price was great and I love good deals!
I ordered this for my office. This is a great space saver and holds a lot of k cups, I love it!
I bought one of these expecting some cheap thing. I love it. I am buying two more...they stack. Very rugged and easy open and close. I love it better than the other ones on the market.
Love my new Keurig K-Cup drawer!  It's a great way to organize my K-cups without using any extra counter space!  A+

This storage system works perfect in our space. It fits the k-cups and gives us perfect easy access to our cups as we need them. The only thing that you need to keep an eye on is your clearance from your counter to your cabinets. I had to pull my maker out a bit from the wall to make sure I could open the top of the keurig machine. If i didn't do that, I would never be able to open it enough to put the k-cup inside. That's the only draw back.. but then again, for the convince you get out of the drawer, it makes up for it.
the order shipped in a timely fashion. i love the tray it is better than the other ones because it takes no additional counter space and keeps the clutter away.

The price of this unit was a good bit cheaper then other similar Kcup organizers.  I bought it because of all the good reviews, and am very happy with it.  It's very sturdy, and it looks good.  Like some have mentioned, it won't work directly under our cabinets, it makes the coffee maker too high to open.  But we have deep counters with a lot of space so I just pulled the coffee pot out far enough for clearance and left it there.  It will hold 36 cups.  However, if you have a lot of the same flavor, (and you don't need to read the label) you can put the cups in alternating cap up, cap down, and get 6 more in.  If you set the coffee pot a little to the left or right of center on the unit, there is some room for sugar, small tea boxes, or whatever else you may want to put there.  You could also put 5 rows of coffee cups in and use the last row for sugar packets, tea bags, etc......

column9: DecoBros® 36 K-Cup Storage Drawer (ACTUALLY HOLDS 42 K-CUPS)
column10: This DecoBros® storage drawer advertizes it holds 36 K-cups, but it actually holds 42 Keurig K-cups, if you put one up and one top down into the rows.  It would be nice to place it on my counter with the Keurig coffee maker on top, but alas I know my cabinets sit too low.  I use the carousal to hold my K-cups on the countertop.I needed something to store my extra coffee/tea k-cups on the shelf in my pantry.  The two storage drawers ($14.99 each from Pretty Star Store and fulfilled by Amazon) fit perfectly stacked on my pantry shelf and I even have room on top to store several different size boxes of plastic zip bags, foil, waxed paper and plastic wrap.  The drawer slides out easily and tilts slightly so I can see the back of the rows.  I would recommend these drawers for on the counter or in the pantry.  They are sturdy, well built and have a nice rubberized top (which keeps the items stacked on them from slipping off).

column9: Great accessory for Keurig sty;e coffee machines
column10: Nice, heavier and sturdier than I expected. The only problem I had was that I couldn't sit my B70 on top of it under my kitchen cabinets...the machine was too tall. This drawer looks and works great sitting next to it though!

column9: Excellent addition to my coffee station
column10: The item was received promptly and looks exactly as pictured. I enjoy it already as it allows me so much additional storage. It is very sturdy and has no problem having the keurig right on top of it.
I really like my new coffee storage drawer. I've put under my Keurig coffee maker and I have my cups at my finger tips at all times

Product handles as it should. Keeps Kcups organized and the drawer slides out easily. The only thing better would be if I could put my Keurig on top, but it makes it too tall for use, under my cabinets. I placed other coffee related items on top, so it still works out nicely.

column4: James B. Kirk "James Bond in the House"
column9: Great Product, easy to setup and it just works.
column10: This is a great product that organizes your kitchen and also help your coffee maker look more complete.  Can't live without one of the coffee drawers, may just buy another to stack one on top of the other.
The item arrived right on time and in perfect condition.  The price was great!  It holds 36 k-cups and my Keurig can sit right on top of it.  Very happy with my purchase!

column9: Handy way to control the cups
column10: It fits neatly under my Keurig.  It's so handy to just slide out the drawer and choice one of four brews.  The rest can stay hidden in the cupboard.  The drawer glides smoothly.  I highly recommend.
The product does store the k cups nicely but the top is a soft rubbery foam and it leave indents that do not come out when you move the coffee maker.
The coffee storage drawer fits perfect under the Keurig.  Very well made, hold a lot, keeps thing organized.  Love it.

This drawer looks exactly as pictured and works perfectly.  It is worthwhile measuring, because you'd be surprised how high it can take your coffee maker, but if you have the right counter spot, it's the best solution.

I am very happy with the coffee pod drawer I bought. The price was the least expensive I've found and the quality was just as good as I've seen. Many of my family members have the same type of drawer but paid more. Holds just as many pods and just as sturdy. You don't need one made out of stainless steel because of the weight of the pods. Perfectly happy with this item.  The coffee machine sits right on top of the drawer nicely.
I was looking for pod storage that was not too big but held enough, not too visible but sleek looking, and easy to keep clean. This item met all of my needs!
I like it except that if I put it under the coffee maker it makes it too tall under the cabinet to be able to open the maker to put in the K cup.
Just perfect for keeping the countertop clean. Now the Keurig sits on top and the K-cups sit neatly in the drawer. Much better than the carosel type holders.

I ordered this drawer for my mother because she liked mine. This one is much better and I got it for a cheaper price. I may buy this model because it is better!The shipment came very fast from the seller.

This drawer sits nicely under my Keurig coffer maker.  It's ecstatically pleasing.  It's holds lots of pods.  It's nice and sturdy.  Everything as advertised.  I will probably buy another one for my other Keurig in my office.
It's pretty much exactly what I needed, and doesn't take up too much counter space as I feared it might.

Great product!  I ordered it because we have limited counter space so this really works perfectly.  My daughter has one so I had to have one, too!  It was received in perfect condition and very quickly!!
I needed a protector under my keurig machine for the new quartz counters-and here it is! great product arrived fast and new! thanks!

I absolutely love this item. I use to have 6 different boxes of K-cups on my counter, & now I just have my drawer & Keurig. I refill the drawer every week, & have less clutter. I would reccomend this to everyone.

Good storage, holds K-cups so that you can see all of them when drawer is pulled out.  Sturdy enough to place items on top. Bought it to hold the K-cup 35 sampler pack. I like it better than the one that spins, holds more.  You could put more than one on top of eachother.

I love this drawer.  Fortunately I have high cabinets, so raising my Keurig is not an issue.  This works so well for keeping my K-cup assortment easily accessible, without sacrificing valuable counter space in my kitchen.
SAVES SPACE AND VERY CONVENIENT. K cups are very accessible now and I have extra counter top usage area. Highly recommend product to the coffee drinker.

This is a great storage item for kcups. Plus the Keuring fits on it perfectly, and the mat top helps to minimize any vibrations that occur.  The only frustrating thing is to find the item 2 dollars less the next week. Oh well, I would highly recommend this items for Keuring users.
great way to store the coffee pods for my new Kuerig coffee maker.Your coffee pods are neatly stored under the coffee maker & looks like a drawer.

This is an awesome addition to a Keurig coffee unit. It allows immediate visual of choices of tea or coffees. Also practical since theCoffee maker sits on top and this is a drawer underneath. Fabulous asset if you want speed in the morning and have no time to fumble around with various boxes or other coffee containers. Choices are at the coffee maker and at the finger tip. Immediate use! The family loves this coffee drawer. Highly recommend.MJR
Great product, exactly as described. Essential for any K-cup user. Really not much else I can say about this excellent product.
I set it up as soon as I opened the box it fit well on my counter with the coffee pot on top.  Very handy to find the type of coffee I like.  I would recommend this to a friend.

The coffee drawer is the perfect "pedestal" to showcase your Keurig brewer. I gifted the drawer filled with 42 K-cups to 3 close friends/family members and they absolutely loved it! The packaging says it fits 36 K-cups but you can fit 42 if you alternate K-cups right-side up, upside down in each row. K-cups are easy to access and you can get your morning joe even faster! LOVE this! The seller also had a good price and shipped quickly.
Great quality, great price, great service! Just what I needed to keep my cups neatly on display for choosing the perfect cup to fit my mood. Thanks :)
Good looking unit that fits nicely under the Keurig brewers.Sturdy - Well worth the priceRemember it RAISES the KEURIG - be sure your unit still fits under your cabnet.

Love this product.  It is sturdy enough to set the coffemake on top of it.  Before I got this I had all of my K-cups in a basket and had to pick up each one to see what I had to drink. Now I just open the drawer (which slides easily) and I can see everything!  I love it and would recommend it!

column9: It's great, but together, they're too tall
column10: I didn't even consider the height of the combined drawer Keurig machine combo when I ordered. But we have to pull the two out from under the cabinetry to place k-cups in the machine. Not that big of a deal, but it typically sits in the middle of the counter instead of tucked nicely against the back.The functionality of the drawer is fine. It opens, closes and holds k-cups. Shipping seemed extremely fast. Very pleased with that service.

Great product of solid build and quality. I don't imagine this unit breaking with normal adult use. Only problem I can see with the unit is it does not contain smooth rolling wheels, the fact you cannot fill it from front to back without pulling the tray completely out, and the lack of you being able to take the foam pad off to wash. All these are minor problems that a swiss designer can solve for an additional $70 purchase price. If you are looking for a nice way to store those k-cups without spending $70+ this is a wonderful long lasting unit.
This storage drawer is an excellent way to keep your K-cups organized and nearby. It fits under your coffee maker saving valuable shelf space.

I greatly prefer the k-cup drawer to that tower-thing they sell.  it is neat, out of the way storage that's very convenient.  Mine's under my toaster oven so it blends in nicely.  The pad on top prevents any heat at all from entering the storage area.  I've never felt even the slightest temperature increase as a result of using the toaster oven!  This order from Pybriefs store on Amazon was my second one of these. I have stacked the 2 for more storage.  Pybriefs store shipped it VERY quickly and had the best price that I could find.

Item came quickly and was in great shape.  Excellent position right underneath my Keurig.  As with other reviewers, please note that it will lift your Keurig up an inch or two and you should also account for the open and closing of the Keurig machine was well.

This is a great item for storing K-cups within reach. Well made, sturdy, and just the right size for a spot on the counter. Your coffee maker fits easily on top. I put our toaster there for more room in our corner counter space.Holds a good amount of K-cups so you aren't always refilling. Definitely recommend this for anyone using a pod coffee pot.

Great product for organizing k-cups! My counter looks much tidier and I like having my favorite flavors right there with the machine. I have not had any significant issue with the drawer catching or being hard to open, and am pleased with the overall value.

And now a handy space to organize my favorite flavors.  I would like to of put the Keurig on top of the drawer but it wouldn't fir under my cabinets so now it holds my knife block, butter dish, and strwas.

Bought one for my husband and one for my mother in law....in three words...WE LOVE IT!  Saves a ton of time and counter space...can't go wrong with that!!  Defiantly worth it!!  Great price and Quick shipping!  =)
This storage drawer is great.  It stores all of the K-cups in an organized manner.  It also opens very smoothly.  Great product.

column9: Great product at a great price, fast shipping
column10: I ordered this product on sale.  I really love it, it's an absolute must for anyone that has a Kuerig.  Best feature would have to be the ability to sit the Kuerig right on top of the drawer.  The shipment was quick and exceeded my expectations.

column9: Great tray! No problems with seller.
column10: I got this to put under my Keurig coffee maker, and it has been wonderful in clearing up the clutter in the area. The coffee pods fit well in the tray, and it looks exactly as it does in the photo. The only problem is that the Keurig occasionally vibrates on the tray when it starts up. This is easily remedied by securing the silver part of the Keurig overflow tray (the base part you put the coffee cups on) with a little tape or just removing the overflow tray completely.The seller was great - I got the item fast and in perfect shape.
Relatively small kitchen, this drawer holds 36 kcups and fits nicely under my Keurig. Great space saver and easy to refill.
Well made.  Recommend felt pads under the rubber feet so it can slide out from under the cabinets easy.  Keurigs generally open higher than traditional cabinets allow.  Easy mod after purchase.
Not bad product, considering the price and practicality. You can put things on top of it.But it does give you that cheap feel to it.

Nice looking, durable item. We have had this for several weeks now it's it's stood up to spills and daily use. Very convenient way to keep your K-Cups organized, and we've had several compliments on it as well. Bought it on sale for $14.99 and it's a no-`brainer at that price.
This is just the ticket to free up the clutter and do it in a way without taking additional precious counter top space.

I purchased this for my Keurig coffeemaker.  It is well constructed and very well thought out.  I place my coffeemaker on top of it and have kept it fully stocked.  If you have a Keurig, this is a must have.

Received this promptly and in good condition.  It works pretty well.  Wanted to put in under the pot and it would have worked but the combination was too high so put it up on the shelf above the pot.  Drawer seems to drag just a bit so 4 stars.

This drawer works perfectly under my Keurig! It slides very easily and looks nice. It looks nice next to a different 3 tiered narrow K cup drawer that I bought from Bed Bath and Beyond. I would buy again!
This drawer saved me a lot of space in my pantry. My K-cups were taking over! It doesn't take up too much counter space, either, since it sits under my Keurig. Love it!

An excellent product that eliminates clutter and does not take up valuable space on your counter top.It is as well made as the Keurig coffee maker itself, and is a perfect match. It works as good as itlooks.
I like this drawer better than the carousel traditional k-cup holders. it is easy to find your favorite coffee k-cup. seats below the coffee machine. i am very happy with it

column9: Great product at a great price
column10: This drawer is well made and supports the weight of oour Keurig B60 coffee maker. It holds a lot of k cups and is a great value.

column9: Sleek-looking, great for the office or home
column10: We have K cups in the office and this is a beautiful drawer that is made of that office style mesh. You don't need a drawer; our coffee center doesn't have a drawer, but this sits under some other supplies and pulls out to dispense up to 36 K cups. Very tidy and useful, and the price is right.
Got our storage drawer for a great price and really like the look and functionality but......the top platform where the Keurig sits began to melt from the heat of the machine.
