I think this might be true.Also good are:Country Time Lemonade andLipton Green Tea - has caffeine I think (as it's tea), but label doesn't say that, don't drink after 12 pm (kept me up one night), was able to substitute this for coffee, and kick the coffee habit

column9: Great product for Dye Sensitive Children
column10: Love the Invisible Kool-Aid products.  I have an ADHD child that is very sensitive to FD&C Dyes, so this product is perfect for parents like me.  No Red Coloring means no off the wall behavior!

My family is trying to avoid food coloring and I cannot find this product in a local store.  I ordered (1) case of Cherry & (1) case of Grape "flavored", "Invisible",  Kool-Aid. The product arrived promptly and  both cases of Kool-Aid were clumpy and discolored.(((Sigh))) I wasn't crazy about ordering $30+ worth of Kool-Aid online (minimum purchase is one case/ 4 pk) to begin with, I should have followed my instincts.Buyer Beware.

column9: Why is this listed as Invisible?
column10: When we're looking for invisible, that means clear.  Like the clear Invisible Raspberry, and clear Invisible Grape and clear Invisible watermelon-kiwi.  This product description says it's a green powder and that it turns BLUE in water.  Blue is not clear nor invisible.  The product described is Blue Raspberry not Invisible Raspberry.  Kool-aid made an Invisible Raspberry whem they introduced the Invisible Watermelon-Kiwi, and that's what I want.

column9: NOT WHAT IT IS SUPPOSED TO BE!
column10: I after 4 months of searching for this Magic twist kool-aidwas so excited to finally find it here on Amazon for my son,who has autism and has had me and several relatives runningall over town to try to find it, and here it is! so I thoughtthe item they describe is not what you end up with at all. While at my sons holiday party at school today he told all hislittle special needs friends he was bringing Magic twist to schoolon Monday for them all to try.Much to our disappointment and shockthe package that was delivered today had NO MAGIC at all in itWhat we got was Kool-aid Invisible...The same stuff I could havebought myself from my local grocer. Shame on you Amazon due to your improper posting IYou have disappointed a class full of disabled childrenwho were so looking forward to Kool-aid Magic Twist!sincerely, magic-less kids in Minnesota!!

Ever since Brach's and A&W quit their contract for rootbeer barrels, my husband has been missing them in his candy stash.  He was very happy to find these Dad's rootbeer barrels in his stocking on Christmas :)I enjoy these more than the A&W ones, there is more to the flavor than just sweetness.  Also, they are a long-lasting candy, you can suck on one for many minutes before it runs out.

column9: Excellent Version of the classic RBB candy
column10: @OrigamiMarie:  Thanks for your review.  Based on yours, I decided to try this version of Root Beer Barrel candy.  I agree with your input - they are, imo, better tasting than the A&W version.  Thanks to your info about A&W's version, I now know why I haven't been able to find them at local stores.  If anyone out there is a RBB connoisseur like me *laugh*,  then I highly recommend "Dad's" version RBB.  I also like this quantity option for purchasing.  I didn't want a large qty before trying these out.  My grade for this candy is A+.  Once again, I found the product I was seaching for at Amazon, as well as helpful feedback & information about this item.  As with almost every Amazon order I've placed over several years, my item arrived on time and without damage.
Old fashioned candy with my favorite flavor. These have wonderful flavor and are packaged just right. Good quanity for the price too!
I bought these for my daughter.  We wanted to order A&W rootbeer barrel candies or Reed's rootbeer barrell candies but they were not available.  The ones we ordered are pretty good.

went to a claim jumpers restaurant  a while back and they had some rootbeer barrels--I had forgotten how much I enjoyed the candy--after looking on the internet, I ordered some Dad's and have to say they are really good--would buy them again--good product!

Among all the US green tea brands I tasted, I love this one the most. It is not the least bitter, and has a wonderful after taste to it. I don't know which word I could use to describe it, to me it tastes a bit like chardonnay, that's the closest thing I could use to describe this green tea. So many other brands, taste like medicine to me.

column9: The Best Whole Wheat Pasta on the Market
column10: Haven't found a whole wheat pasta you like?  Well, look no further.  Delallo brand whole wheat pasta is the best whole wheat pasta on the market (in my opinion.  The fact that it is organic is even better.  You will not be disappointed.  Even family and friends who put their nose up at whole wheat pasta love it!  I ordered a case of several varieties to give as Christmas gifts.  I want everyone to experience how delicious whole wheat pasta can be.

column9: Soft rice cake for baby!  Delicious flavor!
column10: The are small (1 inch approx) circles.  They like a soft version of a rice cake.  I have no idea how another reviewer chipped a tooth on them.  Probably something else in their mouth.  They are fabulous and great for little mouths and hands!  Even my 2 and 5 year old love them!

While giving my son his afternoon snack, I helped myself to a couple and CHIPPED A TOOTH!  And a front tooth to boot =(  Needless to say, I chucked the rest.  Anything that can chip adult teeth has no place in a toddler's mouth.

This was a gift for my girlfriend and she loves it.  I'm not a huge gum person but the flavor (at least the peppermint) does last QUITE some time.  It lasted a train a 2 hour train trip.  Either way just awesome ... (can't think of anything else to say)

column9: Promotes Fresh Breath and Healthy Teeth
column10: If you like minty gum, this option is the best.It's long lasting.  If you have dentures you mightprefer another product.
This is the second year I used the filling and I willl continue to use it as long I still bake.

column9: only if you have spare time on your hands
column10: I bought these for putting in my ice tea and I did and they didn't dissolve. I waited and waited and they didn't dissolve. So next I thought I would put them in a small bowl and put hot tap water in to melt them, I did and it took around 4 minutes to dissolve completely. That's just to long for me.If you're not using them in piping hot coffee I would suggest getting Stevia in either liquid or granulated. This I would pass on.
My wife and I have used the Knorr Chicken Base for years but we cuold not find it locally. Then I discovered it on amazon.com! We use it for soups, chicken dumplings and in Chinese stir-fry.

This product is a must have amoung your kitchen staples. Ever wondered how a Chinese restaurant makes their great chicken broth for Egg Drop soup? Here's your solution! A little goes a long way and may take some experimentation on your part, but it's a great flavor enhancer to vegatables, a pot of beans, even the base of my beef stroganoff (I add it to the beef, onions, and bacon that I cook slowly as the base of the stroganoff). Try it!

I am very, very unhappy with Knorr, which I have always thought made great products. The online Amazon product description states that there is no MSG other than that which occurs naturally in the hydrolyzed protein and autolyzed yeast extract used in creating the soup base.  I never buy products that list MSG as an ingredient, but the idea that it was simply a naturally occurring  component in the yeast and protein used seemed innocent enough.When the package arrived from Amazon I simply put the containers on the shelf ready to use because I had read the ingredient list on Amazon before purchasing the product.  The first time I pulled a canister out to use I scanned the ingredients again and was shocked to find that listed right after the first ingredient-salt-was MSG.  While there was a disclaimer in the Amazon ad by Knorr it seems dishonest to me for them to minimize the presence of MSG in that ad and then list it as the second ingredient on the canister itself.  Many people react to MSG, sometimes quite frighteningly (facial and tongue swelling, rashes, etc.)  Restaurants are generally quick to let customers know if they use MSG. Many no longer use it to enhance the flavor of food.  I never add MSG to any  food I prepare.Knorr has lost a customer.  I will never recommend their products to anyone again.  I am also writing a strong complaint to the company.  I hope others will do the same if they, too, feel that Knorr misrepresented their product.Just another reminder that advertising can be dangerously misleading.  This was an expensive lesson for me as both cans are being disposed of in the garbage.
This is a fantastic product. I love cooking with it ~ it gives my soups and stews a professional taste.

It definitely has some variation of caramel flavor, but I found it also has a strange taste that goes along with it that I can't really describe except for an extreme sugar soda aftertaste.  Unfortunately, it's this strange taste that dominates as the aftertaste, which makes it only fair as a product.Compared to Torani Sugar Free Caramel, it is not as good, but it is not so bad as to throw out by any means.  That award goes to Torani Sugar Free CLASSIC Caramel.  Avoid that stuff at any cost.Also, note that you can buy it directly from the "Monin Store" cheaper than here on Amazon if you buy a "case" which is 4 bottles (same as here).  You also get free shipping on anything else you may want to try along with the "case".  I also tried the O'free chocolate which was comparatively good, although with a bit malty taste.  It also has some of that weird aftertaste.  I also got one of their sampler packs, but in general, was not really so impressed with their line.  Torani is really hit-or-miss, especially with their reformulations.  I found DaVinci sugar-free syrups to be the top syrup, but they are expensive and fairly watered-down.Hope you found my review helpful.

A truly delicious sugar free syrup with a real caramel flavor...and no aftertaste. I was initially concerned because of the crystallized residue that collected around the threads at the top of the bottle, very similar to sugar crystals. However, I called the 800 number on the bottle and the Monin representative assured me that this residue results from the sweetener Eridex, the product is indeed sugar free and safe for those of us who must avoid sugar. This is a wonderful alternative if you are looking for something to add to your coffee!This 4 pk has the larger 33.8 (1 liter) size bottle. Monin Caramel Syrup O'free (Sugar Free, Calorie Free), 33.8-Ounce Plastic Bottles (Pack of 4) VERY good value.

If you are looking for a flavorful sugar free syrup, i would definitly recommend.  its one of the few that doesn't seem to have that chemical, artificial flavor.  it's made with splenda - i love it!  the price here is great, too, if you have amazon prime.

How perfect are these for Backyard BBQ Parties!  Clean, easy to use, caps to keep out bugs and flies, with summer coming up, I would recommend a few of these packs to keep on hand for outdoor parties and picnics!  Great idea for a three pack!
It's not the best tasting coffee I've ever had, but it's a good compromise if you suffer from GERD and refuse to give up coffee.
This is the most wonderful snack around.  I love, love these chili rice crackers.  Did I say how much I love these crackers!

I don't find this applesauce dry at all.  It has a great consistency, very moist without being watery, and the apple flavor really packs a punch.  Amazon has very few natural applesauces available for subscribe and save -not necessarily organic, just pure applesauce with no added sugar etc.  I first bought a case of Musselman's Natural, Unsweetened Applesauce and found it terrible.  It was VERY dry and mealy.  I forced myself to finish one jar and I'm still using the remainder for baking.Santa Cruz applesauces are delicious and actually fresh-tasting.  I keep a pack in my fridge at all times, and eat them as snacks when I crave something sweet or cold and refreshing.  I also occasionally eat one for breakfast if I'm in a hurry, and they're great to have on hand when you're sick or feeling a little nauseated etc.  The combination of chilled, smooth texture, and bright fruitiness has settled my stomach many a time.  I cancel many items after getting through an entire case but I'm on my third delivery of this applesauce and it's a staple.

These actually cost the same as the cheap local grocery brand do here. $4.00/pack, no tax, free shipping. However, the local brand has sugar and/or high fructose corn syrup, and I have to pay tax. I bought these to have an easy and healthy way to fix my toddler breakfast. I can mix it with infant oatmeal and viola! Instant breakfast! These are probably more expensive than where most people live, but for us it was a very good value. The applesauce itself was a little thicker, so it's best to have a utensil nearby, but the flavor is OUTSTANDING. We all love it.

I believe this to be the best-tasting organic apple sauce available currently. It has just the right balance of sweetness and tartness - - - at least to my taste. If you find it too dry (which I don't) just add a little water and stir - - - problem solved. I like to add a spoonful of apple fiber and a spoonful of organic oat bran to increase my daily fiber intake. Maybe that means I find it (and other apple sauce brands as well) a little too moist to my liking.
Though it is convenient to get this apple sauce delivered in bulk, my family can't get over the dryness of the apple sauce. It's a bit thicker than the other brands we're used to.

This product tastes good and is easy to carry as a snack.  We were traveling and needed pureed food for our grandson. This was a fruit choice and it worked out well.  I carry it along for lunch.It's a perfect portion size.

column9: My Son loves it, and I do, too!
column10: We used to buy this at our Kroger, but they aren't carrying it anymore.  They have Kashi in the natural food section (where it DOES NOT belong) and get rid of this, but this isn't a review about our Kroger.  :)This applesauce is just wholesome deliciousness.  My Son (8) loves it.  I sneak one every now and again.  Not watery, not dry, just perfect balance.  I'm glad to find it here on Amazon.
Someone opened and took one of the apple sauce cups.  Sure help yourself to my toddler's snack.  I won't order from here again.  I'm not down with the 5 finger discount.

It was rancid - horrible flavor.  We had such high hopes for it, too!Alas, we must try to locate a better brand.  We had also tried Whole Foods brand (365 brand) but it was almost as bad, although not rancid.The search continues....

I was very dissappointed with Dukan Slimming Tea.  As a Dukan dieter one of the side effects can be constipation due to lack of fiber in the diet, I thought this would help move things along. As recommended, steeped 1 tea bag with 2 cups of boiling water for 2 minutes before I went to bed, I woke up numerous times through out the night with stomach pain and discomfort which continued the following day. It does do what it is suppose to do, but with a painful price to pay. I tried this on 2 different occasions with the same unfortunate result. I won't be purchasing this again.
it does not have any artificial taste like usual indian food packets. thats why it rocks!
excellent product!  Easy to prepare and tastes very close to restaurant quality meal.  However, do note that it is over a dollar cheaper per single package  at walmart.
My favorite licorice of all.  Soft and sweet.. very yummy.  Just as I remember licorice as a kid.

Hard to find that old time licorice flavor anymore. I have ordered this twice and shared with friends who have ordered and shared with me. If you are a hard core black licorice fan, this is for you as you will not be disappointed.

I have been a licorice lover all my life and black licorice laces are my favorite type of licorice.  This product has been impossible to find where I live.  I have searched every store around but no store supplies black licorice laces.  After finding it on Amazon I ordered it immediately but I was very dissatisfied with the taste of Gustaf's licorice.  It didnt taste like the real black licorice but some artificial substitute and it was way too soft.  It didn't please me any more than the Twizzlers do.  It's just not a real licorice flavor.  I would never order Gustaf's licorice again.
Says it's grape flavored, but it tastes like black and it's horrible. Can't return. YUK YUK YUK.

column9: Wonderful if you like dark chocolate
column10: I love dark chocolate and loved this bar. I was afraid because I don't like coconut much, but it doesn't taste like coconut. My friend described it as "extreme dark chocolate" and suggested that it should only be used for baking, but I don't think you want to buy raw chocolate just to cook it.The only negative was that it was so small, for the price I wanted more, but I can understand that using high quality products has a cost. I recommend it.
I love these soy crisps, they are the perfect snack to have around and they are only 120 calories for the whole bag!

I have long been a fan of Glenny's Low Fat Soy Crisps (Sea Salt), and when I saw the Mult-Grain version, I gabbed them up.  Much to my surprise, I noted a sweet taste, and upon reading the label discovered that sugar is one of the ingredients.  I avoid all products with added sugar, and have now posted Glenny's Multi-Grain Chips on my "do not eat" list.  Why add unecessary sugar to a health food or a product that is promoted as a healthy food?  Glenny!  What were you thinking?I remain an avid fan of the original Glenny's Low Fat Soy Crisps (Sea Salt), and highly recommend them as a healthy snack food.

I bought these thinking they would be great because they are Annie's.  I usually enjoy anything made by Annie's.  But they have terrible texture and very little flavor.  Tastes like the oats haven't been cooked, and somehow the flavor of the chocolate is even masked by the lack of flavor in the rest of the bar.  They weren't so bad that I threw the rest of the box away, but I definitely won't be buying these again.Also, though the packaging says "Chewy yet crispy granola bar", I found it was NOT crispy.  Somewhat chewy, but it's so dry that you don't want to chew it any longer than absolutely necessary.

We've tried many of Annie's Organics products, and like most of them.  Hands down my 4 year old daughter loves these best.  I bought 6 boxes and they were gone within a couple of weeks.  My daughter is an only child, and asked me to put extra in her lunch so she could share with her friends at summer camp.  Other moms asked me about them because my daughter actually did share with others.  There are on back order and the shelves are empty at my local stores.

column9: My quest for the best sugar free chocolate
column10: I have tried every piece of chocolate sweetened with Stevia known to humankind. I was on a quest to find the best. I tried this sampler and loved it. I then ordered 12 bars of milk chocolate... though every flavor is great, especially mango.This milk chocolate gives you 100% of the pleasure without the sugar and without nasty sugar substitutes like Maltitol. The only problem with this guilt free chocolate is stopping before you have devoured an entire bar and start in on second. It is expensive but if you have a sweet tooth for chocolate and value your health, it's a small premium to pay. This milk chocolate is highly recommended. I would give this chocolate six stars if I could.... and the customer service is GREAT!UPDATE: I realized these bars are NOT sweetened with just stevia. I looked at the label and wondered what in the world is erythritol... A little work on google gave me my answer. Erythritol is Maltitol-lite. Needless to say I am disappointed and changed my five star rating to four. For me Erythritol is about 50% better than Maltitol with regard to digestive issues. So I can eat more of this chocolate than I could Maltitol sweetened chocolate but eating more than a few bites is not good for me. Your personal mileage will vary :-)) My quest to find the best stevia sweetened chocolate bar is not over.

I always buy this tea at a local Turkish grocery store. I am not a Turk so I just brew it 'English style' with a teapot. I have found it to be a very nice tea. When steeped for 2,5 minutes in water that is just off the boil, you get a great 'cuppa'. The taste is earthy, floral and sweet. I can easily understand why the Turks are so fond of their çay!
If you like a flavorful tea this is for you.  It seeps up dark and has much flavor not like some others that always seem watered down.

Absolutely no preservatives, pesticides or chemicals, this is the way tea has been made for centuries. The smell is sweet and floral, the taste is divine!May also be used as an exfoliating scrub on the body and face, eliminates blackheads and great for oily skin. (Not reccomended with any other teas due to the additives.)

I spent a semester in Istanbul, and this is the major brand of tea in Turkey. Friends and I would buy it every few weeks in the local market, and the tea from the bag that was shipped to me tastes exactly the same. I'm thrilled I could find a way to get it in the US.As a side note, the label "turist cay" means exactly what you would think in Turkish - "tourist tea," but it has the same label when it's sold in Turkey. It is what the locals drink.

I received this today and the package is marked "Best by 11.2011" --5 months old! I don't have enough experience with Turkish tea to be able to say whether this has any big effect on the taste, but I certainly don't appreciate being sold expired tea. I'm assuming, like most teas, you can just brew it stronger and still get the same effect. I'm doing that right now and it is still enjoyable.

The first cup of tea I brewed with this was very bland (and after adding milk I couldn't taste the tea at all). BUT I decided to try steeping it at a higher temperature with more leaf and it turned out delicious. Since this is a half kilo package (and for only 6 bucks) do not try to be skimpy with the amount of tea you use per cup. It won't turn out well. Another problem with this tea is that the leaf is very finely crushed. When I tried brewing the tea in a teaball, a fair amount of it leaked out through the teaball's holes. That being said, I recommend this tea for the price even if it has some problems.

I am a tea drinker- never coffee. I am always looking for new teas to try and prefer black teas. I drink this Rize tea black and without milk or sugar. It is ground very fine and brews up quickly. It does not however get bitter, as many fine ground teas do.It has a great aroma, full, almost smokey, flavor and a decent caffeine kick. My lady, who is a dedicated (to say the least) coffee drinker, loves the smell and flavor of this Rize tea enough that she bought herself a bag from Amazon.This is a good tea, quite different from the Indian, Chinese, Ceylon etc. I usually get. It has become a regular in my tea "rotation".

My boyfriend when to Turkey this week without me. It took him several days to get there because of tornados and cancelled flights but hopefully he is safely there with his family.I couldn't go this time. We did lots of research before he went and I discovered this tea. Everyone drinks tea there, all the time, and I enjoy a good cup of tea every day at lunch so I thought I would try something new. I am very pleased. Its different from the English tea I am used to. It has its own unique flavor and the more I drink it the more I like it.I like that its grown without any pesticides and is a natural product.Next time maybe I can go to Turkey with the family, until then I am enjoying this tea very much.
this tea is excellent. we love the flavour and taste. it replicates the taste of tea we had when we visited  turkey. we are going to re-order for sure.
I thought it was good for black tea. It was on the strong side and finely ground. It's quite a big bag. I like the idea that it's pesticide free.

I got some tea from this tea company from a friend direct from Turkey and was just so impressed at how smooth and mild it is... not bitter like most black teas.  I never thought that I would find any in the US, but leave it to Amazon.  Very nice tea and a very good price.

I have been drinking this tea for years and I am happy with the exquisite taste that comes from naturally grown Black Sea region tea. No pesticides/chemicals have been used in growing this tea, it is pure, it is natural, it is rich in taste and above all it is healthy.It is loose tea so you need to have a set of two teapots, one at the bottom for boiling water and one at the top for brewing tea.

I have purchased the St. Dalfour brand of preserves almost exclusively for the last ten years? Why? Because once you taste them it is very hard to enjoy anything else. They are made with very fresh, ripe, flavorful fruit, no corn syrup, usually no sweetening whatsoever other than fruit juice. Very basic recipe. Great taste, attractive glass jars. These small items would make great gifts or additions to a fruit basket or breakfast tray of hot rolls. The only brand I find is equal is Frog Hollow Farm - an enterprise in Northern California.

The only texture this "conserve" has is jelly like. It appears like juice and pectin. The raspberry taste is there, but you have to use the whole jar (almost) for one piece of toast.I love St Dalfour's Tea and the Jams. Next time I just won't order "conserves".

These are an absolute rip-off at over $12 a bag.  I spotted them for sale from Amazon for about $4 a bag, and brought one to try then.  I'm glad I didn't spend more.These are nice, but I was expecting something a bit "special" and they did not deliver.  The apple flavor is very subtle---although my husband claims he could taste a slight hint of apple, I couldn't taste any at all.  The caramel was nice, and there's a generous amount of it, but overall, the product is nothing remarkable.My husband is not normally a picky chocolate eater.  But he will NOT eat these at all.  He cannot stand them.  I find them enjoyable enough, (although they are a little sickly sweet) although I wouldn't bother to buy them again.  I prefer the normal fun-sized milky way packs.

These are tasty ! Exactly what I thought caramel apple would taste like in a Milky Way. It reminds me of a chocolate covered apple from Rocky Mt chocolate factory.  A new favorite!  If you like chocolate and cinnamon together you will enjoy the hint of cinnamon in the nougat . The apple Carmel and chocolate are the dominate favors IMO.

These little miniatures have moved up to first place in my favorite chocolates list - and that's quite a long list.  Perfectly sized, tasty little morsels! The caramel apple flavor is just right. I had the pleasure of tasting a couple of these the other day and have been looking for more ever since! Definitely worth a try - and plan to get hooked!

Like the others writing their comments, I was intrigued by "Caramel Apple" Milky Ways.  I thought these sounded like an wonderful treat.  I guess we all have different tastes.  Personally, I was not at all impressed with the flavor of these.  They were very sweet and the flavor was not appealing to me.  I'm glad I only purchased two bags of these.  I knew the quantities were low when I ordered.  I thought if these were as good as I had hoped, I would wish I had ordered more before they were all gone.  I'm so glad I didn't.  I will be adding the reminder to the trick or treat bags for the kids on Halloween.

column9: These are good, but nothing to faint over
column10: Well, we were immediately drawn to these, since they have a caramel apple flavor.We ordered them from Amazon, and quite frankly, a lot of the small bars arrived a bitmushed. we put them in the refrigerator to firm them back up, but that wasn't the problem.I'm not sure if it was from the cat toy (something for them to rub their faces on) in the sameshipment box could have done the smushing, or if they were improperly stored at the warehouse level.We haven't found any that didn't have the actual bar cracked, making the caramel stick to the paper.That being said -I love regular Milky Ways, so didn't think this could be too horrible.It isn't. But, it also wasn't worth the price we paid for them!I have included a photo of the inside.The taste is pleasant, for sure. I think it was the relative cost-to-candy ratio and the condition in whichthey arrived which was annoying for me. The caramel is just like a regular Milky Way and tasty.The apple part is the bottom nougat - it is a white shade, and tastes like a candy apple more than acaramel apple. So, you have a candy apple bottom with the caramel on the top.Again, good, but nothing to do a city-wide search to find.

I was so excited to get these. Caramel, apple, nougat and chocolate.. what's not to love? Unfortunately my expectations were not met with what could have been a great candy. The first time I ate one I was shocked with how strong the flavoring was. It was like the flavor was too concentrated or too artificial. It also did not taste like sweet caramel and apple. I could barely taste the caramel and I wasn't sure if I could make out apple either. It was just... odd. Second time I ate one I ate it in layers and figured out what was going on. The layers of chocolate and caramel taste like the original Milky Way. The nougat layer tastes spicy, kind of like fake cinnamon. It is so overwhelming it's hard to taste any apple. It's what I would imagine biting into a apple cinnamon candle would taste like. If they would have just added some natural apple flavor to the nougat, maybe add some extra caramel, and left out the spice I think this would have been a great idea. I hope they reformulate this and try making these again next year because Caramel Apple Milky Way's have so much potential.

Purchased this locally based on the Guittard brand. 25% of the household likes it, the rest didn't care for it. Very thick, not a pleasing chocolate taste or feel. We eat everything from Pierre Marcolini to Hershey so it's rare for a chocolate item to displease so many of us.

This is such an incredible coffee. I was a little nervous ordering it, blueberry? coffee? But as soon as the aroma hit me, I was hooked. And unlike many coffees, the taste DOES live up to the scent. I am anxious to try EVERY coffee flavor sold in k-cup form, but this one will definitely remain on my rotation. However, I'm not sure why the price here is so high. You'll do better doing an online search.

column9: Blueberries and Coffee Combine for a Tasty Beverage
column10: Flavored coffees are a vast improvement over the bitter, standardized coffee from the past. Manufacturers have created some tasty concoctions with their coffee, and Green Mountain is one of the recent pioneers in this crowded field. This company makes many different coffees; some more traditional in flavor and others a combination of fruit and other taste sensations. Wild Mountain Blueberry is one of the fruity blends and it ranks as one of my favorites in the fruit/coffee section of the market.Green Mountain Wild Mountain Blueberry Coffee sounded unusual when I first heard about it. I wasn't so sure the flavor of blueberries would match the taste of coffee. But this product easily exceeded my expectations and I can now see why so many people rave about this coffee. The scent alone is very enticing, with its blueberry muffin- like nose and caramel undertones. The taste is also very nice, with flavors of blueberry, coffee, caramel, and a touch of butter. I appreciate that Green Mountain decided to go easy on the blueberry flavor when they formulated this coffee. Too much fruit flavor would take away from the contributions from the coffee. The balance here is very nice.This coffee product is sweeter than the average brew and it would make a great beverage for a hot breakfast. My experience with this flavored coffee has been confined to the workplace, but I have sampled a cup or two in the mornings when breakfast has been served at my place of employment. The taste is perfectly compatible with most any breakfast food and it made my breakfast even better than usual.I like coffee much more today than I did in the past, and the main reason for my newfound interest is the plethora of flavors offered by so many different manufacturers. Green Mountain Wild Mountain Blueberry Coffee is one of hundreds of flavored blends and it offers a tasty alternative to the average brew. I love blueberries, and this flavored coffee offers a nicely balanced hot beverage that tastes good with food or all by itself.

column9: Smells one way, tastes another, but thankfully both are pretty good!
column10: My boyfriend really wanted to try this blend as he has always enjoyed blueberry flavored coffees in the past. We picked up one of the sample packs of this blend from keurig's website to give it a try. I was skeptical about how a berry flavored coffee would translate when being brewed in the Keurig. Fortunately, though, the end result is very good, although not at all like either of us expected.From the moment this coffee begins brewing, the blueberry scent is unmistakeable. Very nice, but that had me worried that this coffee would have some sort of artificial sweetness to it. Thankfully, however, that isn't the case. While the scent may overpower you with the fragrance of fresh blueberries, the taste is a whole different thing altogether. The taste of this coffee is incredibly woodsy with a bit of a hint of cinnamon (very subtle in the latter). It's quite pleasing although totally unexpected.All in all my boyfriend even prefers this to the coffee shop blends, which speaks volumes in my book. I think it's great and I'm sure we'll restock it when our current supply of pods runs out.
The Wild Blueberry from Green Mountain Coffee Fair Trade is wonderful, I can drink it without creamer/sugar. I have already shared it with others, we are hooked!
I like the Wild Mountain Blueberry for Keurig the best of all followed by Raspberry Chocolate Truffle. A good cup of coffee.

column9: Blueberry made a coffee drinker out of me.!!
column10: I have never liked coffee. Then Hubby ordered some EWild Mountain Blueberry and I smelled it one day and thought dang that smells great. So i made me a cup and I LOVE IT. It is GREAT. so now i just ordered another 48 cup batch.This is the best smelling and tasting coffee ever!!

column9: Reminds you of blueberry muffins, Danish pastries and warm, flaky pies
column10: Green Mountain Coffee has my wife pegged. This light roast and mouth-watering aroma appeases her afternoon taste for blueberry muffins and Danish pastries. She enjoys their Breakfast Blend but the sweet smell of blueberries that permeates our kitchen makes this flavored coffee her second favorite afternoon treat, next to Van Houtte Chocolate Raspberry Truffle.Enjoyable on Keurig's small cup (5.25 oz) and small mug (7.25 oz) settings, we're looking forward to tasting this blueberry blend over ice.Green Mountain Coffee notes on the box that it is Fair Trade Certified(tm) product, which means "you are directly supporting a better life for farming families through fair prices, direct trade, community development, and environmental stewardship."Rating: Four stars.BTW: Here are other K-cup coffees I recently reviewed for Amazon:5 stars: Van Houtte Chocolate Raspberry Truffle4 stars: Tully's Coffee Kona Blend4 stars: Green Mountain Coffee Dark Magic3 stars: Green Mountain Coffee Breakfast Blend3 stars: Green Mountain Coffee Fair Trade Gingerbread
As stated in any of my reviews, to me a good buy is a hassle free buy, not only was this a good price, but good the transaction was good and the product of good quality and in good condition.

column9: I have tried many K-Cups and this is my favorite
column10: I have tried ALOT of different flavors of K-Cups.  I keep coming back to these.  I run two 8 oz. cycles per K-Cup per mug for this coffee and then I add Splenda and Creamer.  I do not taste artificial flavoring as one reviewer stated.  This is a light-roast sweet coffee.  I usually buy my K-Cups from Green Mountain dot com but they ran out of this particular flavor.  I ended up coming to Amazon to purchase them (at a higher price) because I hated to be out of them! If you like your coffee light and sweet, I believe you will enjoy these.
I ordered this coffee for me since I love flavored coffee and flavored creamers.  I didn't expect my husband to love it just as much as I do - this was a great choice - very pleased!
Green Mountain Coffee - Wild Blueberry was great, as recommended to me.  Just has some extra flavor not in all Keurig Cups or other coffee.  Try it!

I thought, "Blueberry? Hmm. I don't kno-o-o-w." I tried it and WOW! This is great!  I like milder coffees and this is just right for me. This is one of my favorites now. To give you an idea of how my tastes run so maybe it will help you tell if my opinion will help, my other faves are Timothy's Donut Coffee, Timothy's Breakfast Blend, both Timothy's and Gloria Jean's Pumpkin. I didn't like French Toast, Cinnamon Pastry or Peach. Kahlua and Hazelnut are just okay to me. I haven't tried a K-cup chocolate yet, but I like some different chocolate coffees I've tried. I have a bottle of Raspberry syrup and I like that added in some of them. I'm going to try the Raspberry K-cup now that they have one.  French Vanilla is good, and with Raspberry syrup added in too!

I like blueberries and I like coffee, but I wasn't sure if they would go together. However, this quickly became my favorite flavor! As another reviewer stated, the coffee flavor is mild, so you may not like this if you prefer bolder, darker varieties. I think the blueberry flavor is very realistic, though. Maybe you have to use the right amount of sugar. I usually use about 2 teaspoons for a large glass, as well as a splash of milk. I love it!

I typically don't go for flavored coffees, but I love blueberries and decided to try this.The coffee is weak and has an artificial sweetener-type aftertaste.I should have stuck with normal Breakfast Blend.

I received this sample with my Keurig B40 along with other 17 samples. To give a perspective, I am coffee wimp who likes Half & Half and a sugar substitute in my coffee; now with that establish.I like to drink using my 12.7 coffee mug (using filtered water which I highly recommend)in the morning, usually two of those. My old (which I still have) Cuisinart with a coffee grinder has a flat bottom basket for the grinds. Being single and the only resident here, I use two scoops of conventional drip grind coffee which barely covered the bottom of basket so I decided to "retire" my coffee maker and purchase a Keurig B40.Back to the review. This morning I had the G.M EXTRA BOLD SUMATRAN RESERVE first, which will be the first last and and only EXTRA BOLD coffee I'll ever drink. My second my second cup-mug was the Wild Mountain Blueberry. I used the 9.25 mug setting and as the coffee started to drip in the cup the aroma of fresh blueberry's rose from the steam and, by the time the machine have finished brewing the whole kitchen was filled with the aroma of blueberries. Now I am not a fan of coffee flavored blueberries; in my pancakes and muffins yes, but not in my coffee. I was amazed how pleasant the kitchen smelled. It was a very pleasant sensation.After the first taste, the coffee had a mild and rich and smooth texture with low acidity and bitterness; well as best as I can tell. The Sumatrans bitter after taste is still lingering.After finishing my coffee I removed the used K-cup from my machine ( I don't like the odor of stale coffee to permeate into the K-cup holder) and the spent k-cup STILL smelled of blueberries.I am very impressed with this flavor; to bad I'm not a fan of blueberry coffee; if I was, I would have given it a five star rating. If you are a fan of blueberry coffee, get this one.

column9: Great! One of my favorite flavored coffees!
column10: If you like other Green Mountain flavored coffees, especially if you like the other seasonal light-roast flavors, you will probably like this one.  It seems like a great fit for the summer.  The blueberry flavor and aroma are subtle, but seems perfect.  It tastes more like coffee than blueberry.  It is definitely a coffee, not a blueberry drink.  This is a light roast.  At first I thought light would mean weak, but it seems like the perfect match for the flavor.  It is nothing like a starbucks.  So if you want a strong coffee taste above all, then this isn't one for you, but if you want a nice flavored light coffee, I think it is great.Like other flavored coffees, you should only brew this on the normal default coffee cup size (6oz) on the Keurig brewer or you will water it down if you use the mug size or larger.

column9: Green Mountain Coffee, Wild Mountain Blueberry, K-cups for Keurig Brewers
column10: Truthfully, I'm usually not into flavored coffee. I purchased this item for my grandson's visit, since he Loves this coffee. Surprise, saurprise...wow! How do I discribe this amazing product(especially if you're not into flavored coffee)Let's start with the aroma...divine! The taste,oh my!If you like Blueberries, this is for you. All combined, this is a wonderful pickup & would work wonders for your next tea party or bridge game with the ladies.Once again, thank you for reading my review. I hope you'll be as pleased with this product & "Amazon,s" fast delivery. Coffee's on, come on over.

This review is based solely on the coffee and not the price (it is available at a much better price elsewhere).If you enjoy a warm freshly baked blueberry muffin and a nice cup of coffee together, then you will love this coffee.  The aroma is smells just like a blueberry muffin and the taste matches.  This k-cup now has a permanent place on my k-cup carousel and is a favorite in my household as well as with my guests.For a super delicious cup, stir in some french vanilla creamer ... mmmmmmm!I will put this one caveat out there: if you enjoy a very dark roast or strong cup of coffee, then you will probably not enjoy this coffee.  It is best enjoyed by coffee drinkers who typically enjoy their coffee with a medium of mild roast and sweetened.

I love this flavor.  Amazon is the only place I can find this flavor, green mountain no longer sells it on their site.  If you like blueberry flavored coffee try this one.  The seller gets the product to me quicker then expected every time.

column9: Not My Cuppa Tea... Luckily, it can be exchanged!
column10: While many people on the K-Cup Exchange (an excellent Yahoo Group) like this blueberry flavor, I have to disagree. Fruity coffee just doesn't work for me. I can see how some people would like it, though. I drink Coffee People Donut Shop for the most part, and use it as a base to test all other k-cup flavors against.If you don't like a particular flavor or roast k-cup you've purchased, you can exchange it on the K-Cup Exchange. You can also learn tons of tips on brewing and where to buy k-cups cheap. There's often deals from vendors, contests, and giveaways fro the group. Find it here;(you'll need to change the "DOT" to a "." with no spaces)

The coffee flavor is awesome, one of my all-time favorites - but the price?  Almost $40 for the 2-pack, plus shipping?  C'mon gimme a break!  Order direct from Green Mountain Coffee Roasters (the people who make it) for $26 for the 2 of them ($13 each) plus shipping.  Whoever priced this so high must be smoking something!

There is no better mustard for a ham sandwich or a hotdog than Kosciusko Spicy Brown Mustard. It's a little grainy as an ingredient in cooking ... but when you want a sandwich mustard ... this puts everything else in the shade.
This tastes like Roses Lime juice to me.  I will pass. Obviously many like it, but the lime to me has that artificial aroma I get from many extracts.
Very limey and a tad sweet. Makes for a good marinade. Its my least favorite of the vinegars from this company but still worth having in the kitchen for the marinade I suggested.

the flavor of this vinegar is fantastic. It's sharp and sweet and tangy and very very delicious. I've poured it on salads, used it in marinades, sipped it out of a teaspoon, sprinkled it on rice...really, it's just wonderful. I don't know about Amazon's price, I bought it on clearance at T J Maxx. However, the large bottle of this is a GREAT price and I'm going to order it when I run out of this. I also bought their cherry vinegar, which I didn't like nearly as well.
this item,along with the laxative tea,worked very well...i used it while doing a cleanse and helped conciderably..reccomend it highly
I have been searching for this tea for ages now! I love it! Next time I order I will definitely order the bulk. Good company.. prompt and quick.

When i first started drinking this tea... I broke out.. which got me researching more on this... breaking out is a sign of it actually cleaning your system... so I love it... after i got used to the tea... i stopped breaking out...

column9: Do not like the side effects - Breakouts!
column10: The taste of this tea is 5 star however I'm giving two stars because I did not appreciate breaking out.  If it wasn't for that I would have continued taking this tea.
This tea is very yummy.  I love licorice so it was especially good to me.  It also seemed to work well.
I do not have any knowhow of the effectiveness of the ingredients included in this tea, but the tea is flavorful and high quality. Not the best I have had, but still very good.

column9: Not bad if you like bland chili
column10: Although the title of this review might sound as if I didn't like the product, that isn't true.  I did like it, mostly because I DO like my chili to be very mild due to a stomach disorder.  Which, of course, means that I can't eat most commercial chili products.  And most non-meat chili's try to make up for their lack of substance with an overabundance of veggies.  They taste more like vegetable stew than chili.  But this one is different.  Although the "bite" is almost non-existent and the taste is delicate, there are some interesting flavors hiding in the background.  For Supertasters like me (people born with ten times the normal amount of tastebuds), the taste of most foods is too strong.  If you like foods that shout out their ingredients, then this isn't for you.  But if you like subtle flavors, you might appreciate this unassuming little can.

column9: Not sure about the other rating?
column10: Tons of flavor and I have average taste bud count. It's got a little kick but not mild and not hot. One thing to note is the bell peppers in it are crunchy. I like it but some people don't care for that. Another thing I question for Eden,IS THERE IS 42g of carbs and only 3G of sugar. I find it hard to believe there is that much Spelt? Something else that tic's me off is the ingredient,"Spices" I know the FDA,"Discourages" that word but companies can and still do use it. High fiber,high protein,tastes great.

This is one of the best tasting coffees I have ever had.  It has a mellow, smooth flavor that is almost sweet compared to other ground coffees.  Even when brewed strong, it does not taste bitter.  I highly recommend it.

column9: Great treat that my picky dog loved.
column10: When we got my dog from a shelter 3 weeks ago she would barely eat or drink anything we would give her.  She had been in the shelter for 7 months so was pretty stressed out when we brought her home.On the advice of our vet we picked up these treats as a 'sure fire' treat that she would love.  And sure enough she did.The disks are a bit large about the size of a silver dollar but break apart easy enough - and they were a home run with my dog.

column9: Great for training sessions or for multiple dog handouts
column10: These treats are the perfect size for training sessions with your dog -- you can hold one and break it apart to keep a constant stream of treats coming when necessary.  I also use them on walks with my three dogs. Again, one round can be broken up and used to reward all of them.  Plus I've found that even finicky dogs like them. I highly recommend them!
My dog loves these healthy treats! Great quality for the price and no worries about the recent food scare.

All my dogs go crazy for these treats!  And I like buying them because they are much healthier than a lot of treats that are out there these days.  They are very crunchy, which all the dogs seem to especially enjoy, and we use them for training the puppies up to rewarding my eleven year old Sheltie.  We buy lots of products from this brand and I can't think of any Natural Balance complaints.

column9: For even the fussiest of eaters...
column10: I have four very picky Chihuahua's and all four LOVE this treat! Petco used to carry them but do not anymore-I am happy that I found them on Amazon, although I hate to pay shipping.
These cost as much here as they do in the stores - but in my new community they aren't available.  My dogs love these treats.
my dogs did not show any ecitement over this treat. not saying there is anything wrong with it my chihs just don't care for them.
One of my cats goes wild over these beef treats. The other two cats like them to, but have to be fast to keep them away from her.

My cat really loves these - as soon as I shake the bottle, I can hear him coming around the corner. By the time I'm screwing off the top, he's bouncing around my feet for it.You get the same excitement that reviewers claim for other products, but NONE of the corn meal or by products or COMPLETELY unnecessary things. And it sure makes my kitty happy!

column9: Halo - Purely for Pets - Liv a Littles Chicken/Beef treats
column10: Great treat for your pets. All chicken and beef, better than the junk treats that are on the market. My cats love them. Order them on-line, much cheaper than buying in pet stores (almost half the price).
My cat preferred the chicken treat over the beef.  For that reason, I'm giving it three stars.  There was nothing wrong with the product...more of my cat's preference.

I had one of these last summer and it was effective then, but I started yawning 20 minutes after drinking one of the drinks I bought here, worx doesn't always work. Go for green coffee bean extract, those are way better for you!
I love this....just make sure if you're gonna use this, drink early in the morning. The first time I used it, it was at 3pm. I didn't get to sleep until after 1am

Orleans Coffee Exchange, "Bavarian Chocolate Coffee" (Whole Bean)Is one of the "Very best" Flavored Coffee's I have ever had!The Coffee has a Full, Rich, Aroma. (Like inhaling a fresh Cacao bean)The taste moves you through many levels, (just as like eating fresh chocolate)From your first sip, one gets a pure bite of wonderful chocolate,that then moves to a light airy taste.There is no bitter taste at all, or any odd unplaced after taste.This coffee is True to it's name. A wonderful coffee for a warm winters night.Out of the many Flavored Coffee's I have experienced,I will say that the Orleans Coffee Exchange brand of this flavor,Is the "best" I have ever tasted!At one point I had to deal with the People of Orleans Coffee Exchange,and I must add, That they care about every bean they sell, You as a customer,and keeping you Happy, Is Job 1 ! They are truly Professional,They want you to have the very best experience/adventure through their coffee!

column9: Best cookies in the world? Yes.
column10: These cookies are to die for! Who said you needed to have gluten, eggs or dairy in cookie? Tastes like nothings missing. Absolutely delicious!

column9: Good product if you like smoked mussels
column10: I've used smoked mussels for umpteen years, and these are quite fine. I love them. But just beware that smoked mussels have a distinctive taste, and not everyone likes it. It's a different flavor from smoked clams.I like them as a snack straight from the can, and they can be whipped into a really tasty dip with sour cream, cream cheese, and/or mayonnaise (I prefer a combo of any 2 of these for best taste) with worcestershire sauce, soy sauce (to taste for saltiness), and optionally a touch of liquid smoke.I also like that these are a good source of iron.
Seems good quality and comparable to other store brands, but less expensive. Farm raised in China, so who knows whats in it.
I think this is a terrific item, it tastes great not only with lamb, if you are looking for a mint sauce you can't do better than Colman's fresh garden mint.

I used to buy Pemmican brand jerky, and it was great.  Then they were sold to a different owner, and now the stuff is HORRIBLE.  I have tried other "store" brands, but it is all really nasty.  SO I decided to try Buffalo Bill's.  I went with the safest version, the mild country cut.  At first, I wasn't sure how I liked it.  Then I noticed half the bag was gone!  I would describe the jerky as very moist, and almost pepperoni-like.  After you are done eating, you notice a mild "burn" in your mouth.  I am not into hot food, but I could handle it. Every piece was tender, none were bad.  So I would say give it a try.  I will most likely purchase some more in the future.
Great product.  This is my second order and delivery was quick and complete both times

As the title says, consider this a "4.5 star" review, if such was possible here.  I do very much like their jerky, but I found this flavor to be the weakest of any of the ones I've tried so far.  (I've tried the Barbeque, Teriyaki and Honey Pepper in the country cut line, finding the Teriyaki to be my personal favorite, and also their vennison jerky).  I also found this jerky to be just a tad tougher then the other flavors, I don't know if that's due to the marinade used on the others or not.  Still, this is a very good product, and I can easily see this being a 5 star product for those who prefer their jerky to not have a slighty sweet taste.

column9: Best jerky I have had...And I've had my share of Beef Jerky!
column10: This is by far the best jerky I have had. I LOVE beef jerky and this has the best combo of spice and beef flavor. It is also super fresh out of the bag. I found this item at a local grocery store and fell in love. They are not carrying it anymore so I guess I need to get it off the web. The only complaint I could state is you must spend $125 to get free shipping! I would spend $75 for THIS beef jerky to get free shipping but not $125! Maybe the company will consider that.
This beef jerky is the best I've ever had! It's tender and moist. It's peppery and salty! Perfect. Yum.

Excellent quality loose tea in a convenient sachet. After searching high and low for a suitable replacement to the cherry tea of my youth and finding nearly all tasting artificial and over done, it was a delight to discover Harney & Sons Cherry Blossom tea, a tea that is reminiscent of cherry blossom's blooming in the spring with a delicate taste that satisfies all the senses.

The family loved every bite. I'll be trying all of their products, it's a great time of year for these types of meals. Easy to fix,tasty as well as hearty, and economical, what more could you ask for???Grandma Mauds Bean Meals Red Beans & Rice, 6.2-Ounce (Pack of 12)

I discovered this little treat at my local Asian market. The texture and taste is top quality. As the person stated before, "this is a meal." Add a little rice and you are good to go! Every time I go to the store I make sure to pick one up.

If you like mackerel and Thai green curry (slightly hot)  this is a quick one person meal:  Top some cooked brown rice with the contents of one can, add a veggie or two on the side, microwave, and voila!  The curry is made with a coconut-milk base.
This is some of the best popcorn I've had in years!Reminds me of the old "TV Time" popcorn,so easy to make.I have a stir crazy popcorn machine 6qt.perfect size package for the machine!

The delivery was great, came a little earlier than I had anticipated.. I had ordered this product once before, and was very sad when I ran out of it.. and so happy to see you carry it at a great reasonable price.. thanks again Amazon!
This is great popcorn.  Orginally ordered for movie nights but we love it so much we pop it often. No need to add anything, just pop and enjoy.

column9: Good Popcorn and flavor but not a premium pop
column10: This popcorn is good but has lots of the shell. it is NOT the premium popcorn you get when you buy a quality kernel. but i did not pay a premium price. But I would have If I knew what I know now.

I grew up in Kansas City, MO, so Wolferman's English muffins were for a long time a staple in my home.  I've tried a lot of different muffin brands, from cheap store brands (not worth the money) to higher-end commercial brands.  NOTHING beats these Bays muffins!They're not fork split -- they're actually sliced, but that's not necessarily a bad thing.  They still have plenty of "nooks and crannies" for the melted butter due to the high-quality yeast they use.  Pop 'em in the toaster, and you'll get a nice crispy exterior and a chewy and flavorful interior.  The flavor is wonderful -- just the right amount of yeastiness, but no "sour" taste.  Great for breakfast with butter and a little marmalade or jam, but they also hold up well under heartier accompaniments or in sandwiches.  The flavor still comes through.I made room in my refrigerator's freezer for these, even giving up some ice cream room!  The sacrifice was worth it.

column9: Excellent and totally different tasting than other brands
column10: We went to St. Thomas USVI and this was the only brand of english muffin that was sold in grocery stores.  Thinking they would taste just so-so, we were very surprised.  Just delicious and unique tasting.  There wasn't a sour dough taste to them which most expect from english muffins but when toasted and buttered...they melted in your mouth.

column4: Tracy Lynn Kaply "Not Well At A Very Basic Level"
column10: These English muffins were on sale at my local grocery, so I tried them and OH MY GOD, they were so very delicious. Once you have tried these, there is no way you could go back to Thomas's or , heaven forbid, store brand English muffins. They simply don't stack up to the flavor and texture of Bay's English muffins.I am now ruined for regular English muffins, which is terrible because they are more expensive, but awesome because they are so delicious.

Bay's are so good, it's not fair to compare them to any other brand.  They are in a class by themselves.  Buying them here by the case is a smart choice if you have the freezer room.  They will stay fresh for well over 6 months - not that they will be around that long because you will have eaten them all before then.  Plus, even with the shipping cost they are a good deal.  No other brand is allowed in my house.
Excellent.  Best tasting English Muffin anywhere.  Unique and head and shoulders above anything else

I've bought a case of BAY'S before and they last, just like they say.  Freeze them, thaw them out and they're just as fresh as when they came through my door.  Buy BAY'S - you won't go wrong and you'll never go back to any other brand!

My husband and I grew up in Milwaukee eating Bays English Muffins.  We've lived all over the world and have yet to find another English muffin that compares to Bays.  They have little pockets that pool with the butter as it melts...fantastic!  I'm so happy that we can order them online now.

The others (Thomas' seems to have a stranglehold on the market here) are just like regular bread that's in the shape of muffins. It's well worth mail-ordering them. Better still would be if Bay's started selling muffins in Philly stores.

I think these muffins taste so much better than any other brand out there- and I believe it's because they don't use soy flour or soy oil like every other bread and muffin company out there!  I would never buy any other brand.  These are great for toasting, jams and butter and I make awesome English muffin pizzas from them. I just toast them first and then add my toppings and bake in the oven @ 375 for 14 minutes.  healthy and delicious!

I am from Michigan, where I grew up eating Bays English Muffins. I always liked them, but didn't realize how much better they were than the rest. I moved to Seattle and couldn't find Bays ANYWHERE! So, when my mom would visit, she would stuff her suitcase with Bays for me. I tried other brands that looked like Bays, but they didn't come close in taste. Now, my husband and kids love them too, so I order them online!!! They are truly the best!!!

I grew up on Thomas's, have tried other brands including the almighty Wolfermans' (Blech!). My parents moved to North Carolina and found Bays in the local grocery store. At each visit my father would push them and I resisted...should never doubt Dad...they are without doubt the best english muffin I've tried. Can't find them in my area of New York and was so happy to see I could order on-line. I too will make room in my freezer, gladly sacrificing ice cream room!

column9: Ok. I'm addicted.  Now I can't always find them!
column10: I first tried these when visiting Chicago, and got them at Jewel/Osco.  I really loved them, and was glad to find them in South Florida at Albertson's.I have been a Thomas' devotee for ages, and now I have a new absolute favorite.  I love the sourdough, whole wheat, and original. Though original i like best.  With Breakstone's whipped salted butter on it, and it's a slice of heaven!I just wish it were easier to find now that I'm back in New England!

Absolutely the best english muffin out there.  They come in 3 different flavors...I especially like the sourdough version.  Can't find them in most supermarkets in NY  but Walgeern's usually carries them in their refrigerated food section....we buy them in Florids at Publix.  Love them...every day

These muffins are made to strict quality standard.  They have not changes in taste since my great grandmother first started buying them for breakfast (thanks MirMir for the historical data!).  These muffins are never too thick or thin, and always toast up perfectly.  I will be a customer for life.  If I can't find them in my local store I allows order them on line (they are shipped fresh by the Bay's people), and they are just as good.
Some of the best muffins I have ever had. We will buy more for sure.

As anothe posted stated, you can't find a muffin any better..I too live in K C MO...and have eaten Wofferman's muffin's...the are a great product..a big muffin..but still they are not any better than Bay's. I began working for Safeway in Lawrence KS in the 60's and found then at that time...again with all of the muffin's I have tried over the year's,Bay's is still the Best...Try some...You will not be dissapointed.<>Lon<>

I learned about these muffins while visiting Costa Rica where they are sold at a local supermarket. Because they are not sold in New Jersey where I reside, I searched for them on the Internet. To my surprise I was able to buy a case and have them shipped to my home. My entire family loves them.  They have a special flavor unlike the normal English Muffins sold in NJ. They are pre-sliced so that you always have a perfect muffin to toast.  Add some imported butter and they are so deliscious.  I can't every go back to the Thomas English Muffins.

I grew up in Tulsa where Bay's were the only English muffins around -- at least at our house. I have since had to branch out to other brands because Bay's have become hard to find. Nothing is as good as Bay's. Nothing. Nada. Bother to compare, if you must, but you'll find no better, if as good, English muffin in the U.S. Whenever I am fortunate enough to find them in my local grocery, I buy every package they have. Now I can order through Amazon. Happy day!

There are no words to describe how much better bays English muffins are than the rest. The texture is better, the taste is better, and they don't even need anything but a bit of butter. The Ingredients are better quality. I love love love them!!
Bays Muffins are by far the best tasting muffins I've ever eaten.Great for breakfast with eggs and canadian bacon.  Good for aquick sandwich at lunchtime, too.

I am on this website because Target stopped selling Bays and if possible, I will never eat any other kind of English muffin....  these are the best!  They are much more generous, solid and overall just more tasty!  Even if I never eat another Bay's, I would not go back to Thomas'....I'm spoiled !!
Delicious, especially toasted. I was a little apprehensive about purchasing so many English Muffins at one time, but they stay fresh.I'm going to be a repeat customer.

There is nothing like a Bay's English Muffin! So many uses--from homemade Egg McMuffins, to toasted with homemade jelly, to burgers to individual pizzas---and all are excellent! I imagine thses would also be great in bread pudding, but I haven't tried it for that.....yet!Even with the shipping added, it's cheaper for me to buy these through Amazon than it is to buy a similar amount of Thomas' at our local stores.

These English Muffins were introduced to us by a friend originally from England. They are natural and great tasting.  They are the only kind we buy.  We toast they for breakfast, make a breakfast sandwich with boca sausage and cheese or use them to make mini pizzas--they are absolutely the best

These english muffins, to me, are by far the best tasting. They toast crisp on the crust, while retaining good texture and pockets for butter. Luckily we are a two freezer family.The shipping cost adds to the price, but still reasonable when you're hooked on a product.

Some people say less sour or I think less "doughy". The are great with just butter and jam but hold up well to heavier items. I also use them for scrambled egg and cheese breakfast sandwiches, peanut butter and jelly, egg salad, tuna.

Bay's English Muffins taste great and are so much easier to split than Thomas' Original Nooks & Crannies 6 ct English Muffins 12 oz (they come right apart). The secret to bringing out the flavor in a Bay's English Muffin is to toast it until it's really dark...not burnt, just really dark.

column9: Does it make sense to post Yet Another 5-star review?
column10: Bays English Muffins are the best English muffins!  One might consider them the only widely available English muffin in the U.S.  I don't have anything new to add besides the other excellent reviews here.  I like that they're sliced rather than split, their delicious taste and chewy texture are like real muffins, not like conventional bread in the shape of a muffin.Back in the late '80s, one of the big fast food chains offered breakfast sandwiches on croissants.  Then one day, suddenly they replaced the pastry with a hamburger bun formed in the shape of a croissant, and it just completely ruined the sandwich.  That's how I feel about the dominant brands of muffins--they're not muffins at all, just ordinary, dried out bread.We relate to poster whose mom would bring out Bays when she visited; we used to have to smuggle back Bays from Chicago to Boston, but now we've got Bays here!  If only we could get Brownberry bread out here, too--still bring home a whole sack of Brownberry as part of our carry-on baggage when we fly home.

Instead, they are consistently cut leaving a small top slice so thin that parts of it burn in the toaster.  This problem occurs in every carton I buy.

These muffins are simply the best, period.  World Class taste, texture and storage capability make this the only muffin choice for me. The local W-M and Marsh stores carried them...then they didn't...then they did...sadly, now they don't.  It is a bit more expensive to order online, but worth it if it's the only way to get them.Beware, once you've had Bay's, you will forever be ruined for any other muffin.

I had to try these muffins because the were the only kind available on Saint John in the USVI And now they are the only muffins I want to eat, they are really good.Get them at the Dolphin or Starfish market on Saint John and have a little taste of paradise in paradise.

these little bears have a real lemon taste to them! soft and chewy,(not to soft or to hard),just right.my whole family is enjoying these.wow what a GREAT price,i bought ours under the subscribe and save program.not only are these great to just eat,you can dress up cupcakes or cakes by using them for tasty decorations! also drop a few in jello or pudding cups!my kids love these any way they can get them.

This review is not about the product - the product is fantastic. This is a comment about the outrageous rip-off price. You can buy the same box of Guayaki Yerba Mate 25 Tea Bags at Trader Joes for $4.29 per box compared to the price being asked here. That's crazy. Just my 2 cents.

I really enjoy this tea. It's as stimulating as coffee but it taste better. I will drink tea instead of coffee any day. Guayaki seems to be a good brand. I visited the company's website. Guayaki is the strongest Yerba Mate' that I have tried. I strongly recommend this to anyone seeking an alternative to coffee. Descriptions of the tea suggest that it also promotes mental awareness. I found this to be true. It is similar to the feeling i get when I take Gingko Biloba.
This exact product is available at my discount health food store for half this price, which indicates that this seller may need to "sharpen their pencil".  Just a word for the budget-minded.

This stuff is pretyt nice.  I tried to kick coffee with it, but I decided I like coffee too much.  The "jolt" is real deal though.  I loke this stuff.  I toss it in with some Rooibos and go to work and I have a really nice "boost" that is very noticable.  Not in a jittery caffinated way either.

column9: Tastes great AND it's good for you!
column10: I'm sitting here this morning drinking a cool and refreshing Guayaki Yerba Mate and it reminded me that I have not yet done a review on my most favorite drink. Guayaki mate comes in many forms; dry loose-leaf tea, tea bags for steeping, and sweetened, flavored iced tea. I was first introduced to the joys of mate over a year ago by my tea-savvy sister-in-law. She was so devoted that should could not help but tell everyone she knew about the awesome powers of mate. Yerba Mate is made from a holly tree that grows in the South American Rainforest and the native people have been drinking it for centuries. In fact the natives call it the "drink of the gods." Mate contains a cousin of caffeine that many have dubbed "mateine" which wakes you mentally without all the negative side effects that caffeine has. It doesn't give you the jitters, or an upset stomach, or the sweats. It just gives your brain a little energy boost slowly but very effectively. Mate also contains many antioxidants, even more than green tea!The plain hot tea tastes very similar to plain green tea and is great on a chilly morning. They have recently started selling flavored versions of the hot tea (at least at the store near me) but I have not had a chance to try them. I know one of them is mint flavored and I would bet that it's tasty. The sweetened and flavored ice teas are beyond delicious. They come in Revel Berry, Lemon, and Mint flavors and I have tried all three. I'm not a big fan of the mint flavor, but my husband thinks it's the best of them all. My personal favorite is the Revel Berry flavor.Best of all, Guayaki is Certified Organic, Fair Trade, Kosher, and Non GMO. Guayaki is committed to helping the farmers earn a decent living as well as restore the Rainforest. According to the Guayaki can, "Guayaki's mission is to steward and restore 200,000 acres of South American Atlantic Rainforest and create over 1,000 living wage jobs by 2020". So, we can rest assured that the delicious beverage we are enjoying is going to actually HELP the Rainforest instead of ruin it. So drink up!

column9: Great Tea, but not a great price.
column10: This is an awesome tea, but I found it much cheaper at my local organic grocery.  Order here if you need it and don't have time to run to the store, otherwise, stock up when you go to the grocery.

I tried this tea after sampling one from one of my co-workers, it is great! I ordered a few boxes off of amazon since I am an avid coffee drinker and wanted to try a different alternative. Well, I haven't drank or felt the desire to drink any coffee since my first cup of yerba mate this morning.  It also suppressed my appetite; I was not running to the vending machines for my usual 3 PM pick me up.  Definitely give it a try, it is very good, and not bitter at all, some teas if I steep them too long, they become bitter, making me gag, not this tea, the bag sits in the cup all till the last drop.I love it!

The tea arrived in good timing and was delicious. Though I did find it at my local supermarket for 6 dollars. So I recommend you check out your local grocery store before you spend twice as much including shipping costs.

I buy mine at my local Trader Joe's.  It doesn't have that great a taste.  I prefer fruity teas or rooibos teas.  But it has its great uses.  Just like rooibos teas is a healthy herbal tea, yerba mate really heals me in times of heavy stress.  I hoard my batch of yerba mate tea in times of heavy stress and it works like clockwork.

column9: good way to try yerba mate
column10: I purchased this at my local supermarket for somewhere between $5 and $6. It's a good way to try yerba mate, especially if you don't have an infuser. But it's cheaper to buy it loose, if you really want to drink it regularly.

column9: BEST TEA... however pricing is too high on amazon
column10: I love this tea and have been drinking this for last 5 years. But I always get it from TRADER JOES. If you have trader joe's in your neighborhood, get it from there. For the same 'Guayaki Traditional Yerba Mate, 100% Organic, 25 tea bags,' I pay $4.49. I give it a 5* as I love this tea. I am just not happy with the pricing here on Amazon.

This yerba mate has been described by some other reviewers as smoky, and I don't really agree with that at all. I think the flavor is slightly bitter and grassy, much more like a maccha green tea than anything that could be called "smoky." I do like the caffeine level it has, but think it's important to note that it's very different than coffee caffeine, which an earlier reviewer seemed to miss when she asked why not just drink coffee. Coffee's caffeine affects me badly, making me feel shaky and tense sometimes, whereas this yerba mate actually mellows me out physically while it picks me up mentally. For more information about how it works, check the article about yerba mate in Wikipedia, and pick up a bag of this for yourself. My only reservation about it is that I think it might be cheaper to buy it loose leaf in greater bulk than this package offers.
The Yerba mate tea was OK (as expected).  It is a little expensive.  Hopefully, there is a cheaper site.

Good stuff....people in Brazil have been drinking this as americans drink soda (yuck)...tastes lie a strong green tea, a little grassy...but feels like your drinking something healthy and good for you.I recommend buying the loose tea...which is about 1/4 the price of ind. tea bags...and less waste.  Just use a coffee maker, french press, or even a strainer.High antioxidnt value.

column9: A good addition to a tea-drinker's mix
column10: I drink quite a bit of Tazo Thrive and Tazo Zen green teas.  Tazo Thrive is a nice mix of green tea, mate, and various botanicals.  My liking for this tea got me to try Mate.  I actually first tried a bottled version of unsweetened Guayaki Yerba Mate, which I like very much -- I always keep some bottles in my fridge in case I need to grab something quick on my way out the door and don't have time to heat water for tea.Hot Guayaki Yerba Mate is a different taste from the cold version, but as I understand it, is the more traditional way to drink mate.  In  any event, mate is a bit of an acquired taste, and it is one that I am acquiring.  It seems to taste better (as with many teas) if the water is not too hot -- steaming a bit but short of boiling, or allowed to cool somewhat.  In addition, one can't leave the bag in too long, as with many teas, or it will become excessively bitter.  Finally, I find that adding a bit of cool water after steeping the appropriate amount of time seems to make it taste less bitter and make it easier to drink.In any event, mate is supposedly good for appetite suppression, disproportionate to the amount of caffeine in it.  I'm not sure it is a powerful appetite suppression -- no more than green tea, in my opinion -- but as part of a regular hydration and tea-drinking regimen can only help with controlling those urges to eat.  It is certainly an invigorating drink -- again, more than the amount of caffeine in it would promise.I've not tried other mate versions, but I like this one so well that I've not been interested in trying others.
After reading about Yerba Mate in Eat This, Not That I had to try it.  It is a great tasting tea for any tea lover to add to their flavor selection.

I tried mate in South America and it was something that held my curiosity when I got home. So I found Guayaki and several other brands as bags to try. Wasn't up for the whole gourd set up. This is my favorite straight Mate by far. I don't like it as a first cup of the day too smoky but as the second cup  it is perfect and late at night it is reminiscent of a nice single malt. Definitely a sophisticated taste. First cup of the Day I like the Pixie Green Tea mate.Moira
