It's always good to have a Jack Link's in my pocket in case I get a bit hungry. And, it's better to eat this than a hamburger
This was very good, fresh perfect flavor good size, packed well and received quickly. Not too moist, not too dry and perfect chew. A+

Great Product. I am a huge Jack Links jerky fan but its a bit pricy no matter where you buy it. Since joining the subscription it costs about 8.87 for a giant bag. Its the size of 2.5 bags that cost 6.50 at a grocery store. If you love jerky, I get the peppered, then join this club.
Has a great taste, and just the right amount without devouring a huge bag! Received them very quickly. I would recommend this product for anyone looking for a portion-controlled lean protein snack.
Years ago this jerky was King B Jerky and was the best Jerky in the world.  Even with the name change, the company, Jack Link's is still the best flavored jerky.  The original flavor is my favorite!

I like the sweetness taste of the Jack Link's peppered beef jerky over their over-salted Hickory beef jerky but it had WAY TOO MUCH black pepper.  I hope that Jack Link can cut the black pepper down to more than half or that Jack Link can come up with another version with less black pepper.

I usually purchase this in store for around $10 per package and with the Subscribe and Save, you really do save money. It has an excellent taste and is the perfect pick me up for afternoon snack during school seminars.

column9: Best jerky size/brand/flavor you can get
column10: I have personally been on a mission to find my favorite jerky for a few years now.  This is by far my favorite jerky - just a little spicy, great texture, perfect size for a snack, and pretty healthy besides sodium.
Great jerky.  Not too tough... nor too salty.  Just right.  And the 100-cal packs provide the perfect amount for a snack without the rest of the bag going bad.

jack links sweet and hot jerky is THE GERATEST jerky ever! I'v had a lot of different brands and flavors but nothing compares to the taste and qualty of this jerky. I wish Walmart still carried the larger bags of it
Hard to find this product in the stores, and with the instant shipping option we have them on hand for snacking all the time.  Perfect!
This is very tasty beef jerky, but a little too expensive. If the price was lower i would order this on a regular basis.
We support a number of soldiers deployed to Afghanistan and several of them request peppered jerky above everything else.
It was more tasty than I thought. Every time when I feel boring, it was such a nice snack~!!
This Sweet Spicy Thai Jerky is the best!! Can't find it in local stores, so I got 2 packs. Not too spicy, but lets you know there is a little heat to it. I would like it even spicier!

I've tried a lot of different beef jerky products, including Mr. Z Beef Jerky from Amazon, as well as the store brand from Jewel, and a great many others, including buffalo jerky like Golden Valley Buffalo Jerky . Some of them are pretty good (especially Golden Valley products) but overall none are better than Jack Links. Reliably you get tender, tasty and fresh jerky. I like their original flavor the best. It's not too salty, too sweet, or too hard. It's 'just right' in my opinion.

This is the best beef jerky that I have found (aside from and elderly man that sells his homemade jerky once a year from a road-side stand). This is exactly what I want in a jerky. Sweet and Spicy. The texture is not too dry, which is a problem I find with a lot of jerkies. All around, a wonderful product!

This is supposed to be "Sweet & HOT" beef jerky.  It's sweet, but it's not HOT.  It's not even hot.  If you put the entire package into your mouth all at once and chew, there is no way you are gonna taste hot.  This beef jerky has about the same hotness as a small package of sweet and sour potato chips.  If I had ordered sweet beef jerky, then this would get 5 stars.  But I didn't want sweet beef jerky.  I wanted sweet and HOT beef jerky.  3 stars because at least it is edible.  But it will probably be a gift to my friend, with a BIG disclaimer about the HOT.
This is such a delicious bag of Peppered Beef Jerky. I love having a big bag of it to snack on whenever I feel like it. What a great product!!
There is decent value in the product and the packaging is first rate. However, the jerky is almost rock hard making it difficult to chew.

I had ordered 3 packages of these back in June.  No problems! ! !Now all of a sudden, they went from less than $12 a package to almost $18 a package.  A bit too steep of an increase for my blood.  I stopped by Wally world earlier on the weekend and they still have them for about half price.  So I grabbed a case for what they want for three envelopes.Guess if your hardup and no way to get to town, go for it - however, if your looking to save a buck and heading out to wally world, wait for it!

My grandson is a beef jerky addict. We don't have much to choose from here so I ordered this. He absolutely loves it!!! He says it's not hard and has such a good taste. It's not too hot which would okay with him if it was.  He'd like more but he eats it so fast that it's going to be a sometime treat for him. The first day he ate 3 bags.
This stuff is so delicious, I love it.  I've already ordered a second round of them.  Just the right amount of spice.
this was perfect for our road trips! not wanting to stop for snacks alot just pick up some jerky! yum!

column9: Best mass marketed dried meat product ON EARTH
column10: I'm normally rather "meh" about beef jerky and similar products (e.g. slim jims and their ilk), but Jack Links are always good, and the sweet and hot variety, for whatever reason, is AMAZING.  So many other varieties of beef jerky are like dry, stale wood chips that you can break your teeth on.  These have an incredible texture, with many huge cuts of meat that are still tender and moist in the center.  They still have the jaw workout that sort of defines beef jerky, but unlike so many other brands they're still recognizable as meat, and good meat at that.  The flavor is much as advertised, which may be a bit too spicy for some, but I love it.  It's heat that very slowly builds, so if you ate a couple of pieces you might not feel it, but after downing a full package you'll be reaching for a vanilla frappe.  The unfortunate thing is that they're hard to find where I live (Cape Cod/Rhode Island), the only place that routinely stocks is Cumberland Farms, and sad to say they seem to have been disappearing even from there.  It will be a real shame if they're discontinued, as in a mass produced snack world full of mediocre, predictable, unsatisfying fodder, Jack Links sweet and hot is the sort of thing you can make a satisfying meal of.

This pina colada is the first Lt. Blender's product that I've tried, but it won't be the last!  I love the concept of the freezable pouch.  In the past, there have been times where I have wanted a frozen drink but did not feel like going through the process of shaving ice, cleaning out the blender, etc.  Now this is no longer an issue.  I can freeze it in advance and take it to parties, or I can keep the whole pouch for myself and have a drink ready anytime I want.  Not to mention that the results are always consistent, unlike blender versions where your results may vary unless you measure every time.These drinks are best consumed soon after freezing.  I left my pouch in the freezer, and it was nice and slushy the first day, but on the 2nd day it was considerably more solid.  This was easily remedied by running warm water on the outside of the bag for a couple of minutes.  But don't try to manually break up the frozen product, as I initially tried to do.  I ended up making a tiny hole near the top of the pouch.Note: I did use 2 cups of rum rather than the 1.5 cups that was suggested.  I also used coconut rum and added 1/2 cup of pineapple juice to my bag (substitute for some water, not added to the water).  The end result tasted as good as a drink made from fresh pineapple and real cream.  It was very tasty and I look forward to trying some of the other flavors.  I'm glad Amazon has them in stock with free shipping.  This is the best price I have found online.

If you like Pina Colada's, you'll love this product. I found it by mistake and have been using it ever since. You add rum (I use Malibu for the coconut flavor) to the rum line. Then add water to the water line, shake and freeze. I make about 2 or 3 bags in advance and leave them in the freezer. When guests come over it takes about an hour or two and the drinks are ready. I only wish I could buy this product locally.

Went to Sam's Club and they had a taste testing of this and 5 other flovors. I bought a few bags and began experimenting in the kitchen. The Pina Colada Mix makes awesome tasting coconut shrimp!I just roll the shrimp around in a mixture of almond flour and pina colada powder after coating it with raw egg. Then I pan fry in coconut oil. SOOOOO GOOD!!!Another yummy version is steamed shrimp and a pina colada dipping sauce that I make with the mix, coconut and water (you can add a splash of pinapple juice in it too).I also plan on soaking the shrimp in coconut rum and then frying it Pina colada batter!Try it with chicken also! The Sangria version is fun to experiment with too!NOTE: I also agree with others that drink this beverage, virgin or alcohol, and say, "this is just as good as you can get anywhere"!

column9: OMG!!! So good and so easy!!!
column10: I can't recommend this highly enough!!!  It's so easy and the taste is out of this world!  You MUST try it!

I was having a cookout for about 25 family and friends and was looking for something that was easy to fix and that I could possibly make ahead of time, since most of the people who were coming for our party enjoy pina coladas I decided to try these mixes after reading the reviews. The order was not scheduled to arrive until the day before the party but I was pleasantly surprised when it arrived two days ahead of schedule.  I purchased some coconut rum (two large bottles) and some pineapple juice ( two large cans ) after reading one of the other reviewers comments.  The first bag I made I went exactly by the instructions on the bag ( 13 oz. of rum )and when it came time for the water I substituted half of the water with pineapple juice. I taste tested this first batch and boy was it yummy!, but I did feel that I could be more daring with the rum without going overboard.  On the next bag ( I did four bags altogether ) I used 16 oz. of rum and continued to use the same half water and half pineapple juice mix for the rest of the bag.  This was,for me, the right amount of alcohol, not overboard but it definately had a nice little kick. I made the third bag the same way.  The last bag I made virgin style since we have family and friends who would rather not drink but still enjoy the taste of a pina colada.  On the virgin batch I used more pineapple juice instead of the half and half substitution since I thought the people drinking it would enjoy the fruity taste. When all was said and done I had only used one large bottle of coconut rum ( there was still some left in the bottle ) for the three bags that had alcohol and all of the two cans of pineapple juice on the total four bags.  I and some friends who came early to help me set everything up for the party decided to taste test the mix before everyone else arrived. The taste was so much more than I expected.  It was creamy with a very coconutty ( Is that a word? ) flavor and tasted as good as anything I had ever gotten out at a restaurant or bar. My four bags were the hit of the party and everyone complimented me on the great taste.  ( Just a note, I got those little cocktail swords and some fresh pineapple and used those to garnish the cups) I will definately be ordering more of these mixes next time I have a party.

This is a good product. Great for outdoor events. Convenient to mix and take with you anywhere, but WOW it's loaded with calories. Though most delicious spirited drinks are, this mix is just exceptionally loaded. (At least 500 calories, most likely more, per glass.) Watch out if you are watching your weight.You can mix to taste, and it stores in the freezer well. Enjoy but know each drink requires an hour on the treadmill.... I will stick to a crisp, summer glass of wine.
The taste isn't bad but looking at the huge, clear, red eggs kind of turned my stomach.  I couldn't bear to eat it and I threw it away.

I stock up on these for the summer. They're really delicious and everyone loves them! They're perfect for a BBQ, cookout or tailgate and they travel to parties! They're also great frozen....no mess at all! These are my favorite Lt.Blenders.

I found this product in a grocery store approximately 3 years ago.  It is the best mix that I have found and everyone that trys my margarita says it is the best one they have ever tasted and wants the 'recipe'. I like the fact that even though it is a powder mix, it is all-natural. I travel to the beach quite a bit and have found that is easy to cart in a cooler (no glass) and just pour over ice.  It is also good blended with strawberries or mango puree.  When I make mine, I follow the instructions including using Triple Sec but I usually mix 2 or 3 tequilas (white and gold)and add a little Gran Marnier or Cuantro.  It is great to have it mixed up, ready to go in the refrigerator.  You can also freeze it in the bag and 'squeeze' out for a fast slushy drink.

this is a delicious margarita mix. I have shared it with many friends and they all loved it too! Bring this for your next girls' weekend, ski trip, beach party, camping trip.....everyone will rave. You can tell it's real lime...it makes all the difference, and the mix is so convenient from the freezer.
These are the best I've had.  They are tart with a kick...not for those who like sweet 'ritas.

I've tried a lot of mixes and this is the best by far.  On top of the taste, the convenience can't be beat.  My wife & I bring them along on vacations even to the all-inclusives since it sucks to drink a bad margarita, even if it is "free."
I was little leary at first on trying margarita in a bag.  However, it is really good.  Very easy to make.  Enjoy!!!!
If you like Margaritas, you'll like this easy to make mix.  It couldn't be easier.  You can make it ahead and leave in the freezer.  Tastes great!

This is the easiest and most delicious margatira mix that I have ever tasted. My first purchase was from a little gift shop and then I had a hard time locating them.. Finally found them online Yeah!!  The convience is wonderful! Easy to take along anywhere...From outside on the patio, to the lake,or to a Bed and Breakfast... that way you know exactly what you are getting and you know you will enjoy it...easy to do... just load in the ice chest and voila...Instant party wheather your are at home or away... Enjoy!!!

Great price, great taste and very convenient to order. I found this mix about a year ago at Beverages & More (aka Bevmo) and really liked how it easy it was to make. Since then Bevmo has stopped stocking the mix and I have not been able to locate it anywhere else until I did a search on Amazon.

I served this margarita on the rocks at a recent Cinco de Mayo party.  Everyone absolutely LOVED them.  I followed the directions and couldn't convince one friend the margaritas actually contained alcohol.  I really like that this mix is not sickly sweet like a lot of what's on the market.  They are so easy to make, too!  I had a bit of trouble getting the margaritas out of the one bag we chose to freeze.  Other than that, I highly recommend this product!

very hard to find Margarita in a Bag around here unless it's the small bags, which are hardly even worth it!  the single and solitary only downside to MIB's (my coined nickname for my favorite drink) is that they are very hard to open.  husband had to use pliers last time, but that's not always the case.  and once frozen it's impossible to get the beverage out.  my trick is to freeze it and then literally cut the entire top off and scoop out with a spoon.  product is great, but packaging could use some serious improvements.

I was at Samsclub recently and bought a mixed 3 pack of the Strawberry daiquiri and 2 margaritas. This is the best invention ever. I am delighted to have found it on Amazon.com. For gift ideas or a party pack, please, please consider making 3 packs mix of different flavors like pina colada, margaritas, and either the daiquiri or mojito, it would be amazing. I will definitely will be purchasing different packs to mix for gifts as well as keep it on hand for parties. Another great idea would also be to make a gift version that would include the sugar/salt mix to rim the glasses for margaritas.I would also like to add that I loved that the water and booze portions are perfect. I followed the directions to a T. We froze ours and even after using it had some left and kept it in the freezer. A perfect frozen margarita even after being kept 2 days in the freezer and taken out several times. On top of that it never got watery, like the ones you order at a restaurant. I still can't get over how amazing this product is. Keep up the good work!

I first found this mix in Stew Leonard's Market in Danbury, Ct., but they unfortunately stopped selling it. It is easy to prepare and keeps frozen for quite a while if you need to take it to a party or to the beach. To me it tastes better with Triplesec added. Its a pretty good summertime or anytime drink for the money, and with Prime, its even better.

column9: Great flavor and easy to make!
column10: I found this originally in a grocery store on sale at the end of summer.  I am into all natural beverages and was excited to find a convenient powder mix in a pouch that you just add your own alcohol and freeze!  It creates a delightful slushy drink that you squeeze out of the pouch, then screw the cap back on & replace in your freezer!  I love the natural lemon-lime flavor, no artificial color, and no HFCS!  I hate the sickening-sweet flavor of other margarita mixes, way too much sweetener.  I plan to order more of these pouches and give some away as gifts!  I'm so glad Amazon carried this and other Lt. Blender's drink pouches, now I'll have to try them all!  I only wish you could order 3 different flavors in one order!

This is the best Margarita MIX Ever! Not only is it delicious but it stores very compactly in your freezer unlike the buckets that take up so much space. They pour easily through the large spout and are perfectly slushy by running the bag under warm water in a few minutes. I keep several on hand and ready to go for those last minute gatherings. EVERYONE who has had them at my home loves them and they aren't sold everywhere. I was so happy to find them on AMAZON. They actually sell them on their website too but the prices are about the same as amazon.  The history about the product is very cool as they were developed by a military service man. Check them out at[..] . ENJOY!

column9: Best Margaritas (except for great mexican food places)
column10: These margarita are the best we've had from a mix, better than Jose Cuervo mix and other liquid mixes.  They are good with just tequila and water, but the triple sec makes them awesome.  You can either freeze them or just mix them on the spot and pour over ice.  Very convenient and delicious!

I had previously purchased Lt. Blenders Margarita mix in a store and then I couldn't remember where (and I was sober when I wanted more). This is a very tasty product, very well done, easy to mix and freeze and serve. Now that I have found it on Amazon I have been exposed to all the other products made under the Lt. Blender label and look forward to trying many of them. For best results use good products (BYOB, there is no alcohol in these, just great mixers), then be careful, because they are so good it would be easy to overdo. I recommend sharing with your friends, or people you want to get friendly with. Plan ahead if you want frozen drinks, it can take six to eight hours to freeze, well worth the wait.
Love this product, easy to make and convenient.  The bag fits in freezer easily and travels well in a cooler.

Margarita -in- a- Bag, is the BEST margarita I have ever had.  Congratulations to the maker! And the great thing it is soooooooo easy.  Just had the liquids and it is ready to go on the rocks or put it it in the freezer for 6 hours and it is truly fabulous! I have traveled around trying margaritas in famous restaurants and this is still the BEST!  I bought at Kroger stores inRichmond, but haven't seen it in a good while, thus I learned you could buy thru Amazon.  A great product!  Anyone who likes margaritas will love it! Enjoy your Margarita -in-a-Bag!

column9: Lt. Blenders Margarita in a Bag
column10: I've tried lots of margarita mixes and this one is definitely the best and most convenient.  It's nice to be able to have frozen margaritas on hand whenever I want them with virtually no waste since these are kept in the freezer.  They are easy to mix.  You can make the drinks as strong or as weak as you would like.  And they have a great taste.  My only complaint is I used to be able to find them in package stores but now I can only seem to find them online.  However, they are Amazon Prime Eligible so ordering online isn't too much of a problem.

column9: The best margarita mix out there
column10: This is the best margarita mix that I've found, and I've tried lots.This is at least as good as the best margarita I've ever been served at a restaurant. In my book, that's pretty good.It's simple to make and it's way more convenient than trying to do everything from scratch with a blender and all the ingredients.... and the results are always better.For those who've mentioned the defrost time as a negative, I've found that if you use triple sec with an alcohol content (instead of the 0% alcohol variety), the mix will not freeze completely and the defrost time is not an issue.I love this stuff. I'm going to have to try their other products.

First off, I love the taste and texture of the ultimate product of this mix.  I also appreciated the novelty of the bag concept and had no problems with the instructions.  That being said, I'm going to stick with a blender and liquid mix for most situations.  The bag concept would be great for picnics (beach or no) provided you had exactly six hours to leave it in the freezer before you left.  Otherwise the stuff is a huge pain to get out of the bag in a fashion even vaguely resembling an actual margarita.  Left in the freezer longer than the allotted time and and the stuff freezes into a pretty solid block.  I also thought the proportions listed on the bag to be a little off, my personal preference has you adding a little more tequila and the triplesec is definitely a required component (not optional, as the bag puts it).It's a product worth trying once, in any event.

column9: Way too much Lemon-Lime flavor to this mix!
column10: Way too much Lemon-Lime flavor to this mix! I was unable to finish one drink before the Lemon-Lime flavor overwhelm me and I had to toss it.

column9: Not  a good flavor  to me !
column10: Maybe it's just me , but I have not yet found a powder margarita mix I like . This stuff taste as bad as Margarita shack mix which I had great hopes for too . This stuff taste very very bitter artifical lemon flavored . I don't want lemon flavor , I want a (slightly) sweet lime flavor . I love the Jose Cuervo margarita mix . Island Oasis is wonderful too . The powdered margarita mixes I tasted were all bad . Good design with a good package but bad on my taste buds....yuck !

I thought this large jar of dried, flavored fruit would last me a long time.  However, I am munching my way through the jar quickly.  They are sooooo good, and I feel that I am getting nutrition as well as a delectable treat when I reach for this easy-to-open jar.

The product itself was great...delicious and wonderful.  I had orignially ordered 2 (two) of this product.  They only sent one.  The other was not sent until I emailed them that 2 were ordered.  No appologies were made.  They just said the 2nd one was on the way.  Customer service could use a little polishing.
Not sure if they shipped me the wrong candy, but the candy I received was not sour at all. Just normally flavored hard candy.

column9: Fresh, crispy and the perfect sweet / salty snack delivered straight to your door
column10: I love Chicago style popcorn (that perfect balance of cheese and caramel) and go to great lengths to get "the good stuff".  It is hard to get the perfect Chicago style but I am so pleased to have found KuKuRuZa and love the fact that Amazon will drop it off right at my doorstep!Finding a high quality Chicago style corn has always been a bit of a challenge.  The holiday season always brings the obligatory bucket of three flavors but the popcorn is not fresh and doesn't make my taste buds dance..  Occasionally I order from the other website (starts with a G) but it is so expensive it is hard to justify more than once a year.  Even less often I will trek out of my way to the mall and get a bag mixed up but it is a pain to fight the crowds.This popcorn was amazing!  The cheese was nice and cheesy and the caramel was light and crispy.  There was a 50/50 ratio which is typical but I like my popcorn a little saltier and tend to like 2 parts cheese to 1 part caramel but the kid and the husband picked up the slack and helped to finish the caramel that I left behind.  I will definitely order this popcorn again!  Perhaps next time I will add in an extra bag of cheddar and create my own mix.
This popcorn is delicious.  The combination of cheddar popcorn and carmel popcorn is a taste sensation.  A movie night with this popcorn is one to remember.
This stuff was so good that it didn't even need any sweetener or creamer!! And I hate black coffee! But this stuff.... Was the best. So good.

I bought this as a gift for my dad who loves irish cream coffee but doesn't want to use the flavored creamer (he's diabetic).  He told me he liked the flavor but it left a horrible oily ring in his grinder and when he added fresh cream to the coffee it made the cream curdle.  He said when he uses non dairy powder creamer he doesn't have that problem.  He said he wouldn't buy it again because of the oil and the curdling of cream in the coffee but he did like the flavor...it has just the right amount of irish cream flavor for his liking.
Excellent coffee and delivered promptly from Amazon.  I highly recommend it. Would like to get it in larger amounts to save money.

My fiance loves Irish Cream coffee and we have tried several different brands.  This coffee doesn't turn into a candy drink like some flavored coffees do.  It is still good roasted coffee with that hint of Irish Cream.

I first tried this salsa at a local market in Kemah (Boardwalk Fudge) and loved it! I bought a couple bags and made it at home, it was really simple to make and my husband loved it too. He makes a quart every week! We eat it on everything, eggs, burgers, nachos, chicken salad, gucamole. We marinated burgers with the concentrate at our 4th of July party, it was awsome.

I have 3 dogs. One of them is VERY picky, but she loves this dog food! We usually have to mix the dry kibble with canned dog food, but not this brand. She gobbles it up. It's pricier, but it has healthier ingredients. I also noticed that my dogs' fur is softer and smoother.
Simply Wild dog food is a tiny kibble, suitable for a small dog like my Yorkie.Better yet, he loves it.  Shipping was fast, I actually had the product before Iexpected it!

I've worked with different types of fondants and if you are reading reviews because you are new to the Fondant Cake process, here are some things to keep in mind:1. Satin Ice is Yummier than most2. Satin Ice is harder to work with than many3. Satin Ice shouldn't be you're first ;)I started my Fondanting adventures using Wilton's, a brand that makes most professional cake decorators cringe. It isn't yummy, but it is forgiving. If you are new to cake-ing I would recommend using Wilton's the first few times to get the hang of things before moving to the more finicky fondants. If you start by using this fondant, you may be Freudianly misspronouncing it in a loud voice: "I hate you SATAN Ice!!" Really, fondant tears may stain your cheeks.Fondants I've used in order of easiest to work with:1. Wilton's2. Elite by Fondx3. Satin Ice4. Homemade MarshmallowFondant's I've worked with in order of yummieness:1. Homemade Marshmallow2. Elite by Fondx3. Satin Ice4. (distantly) Wilton'sI would recommend the tutorial on Satin Ice website, really great:[...]If you are only buying Satin Ice to sculpt edible animals, than this would be a great one. For first time cake coverings, try Wilton's, get things down then come back to Satin Ice.Thanks for reading and good luck on your cake adventures!Jackiedomesticfits (dot) com

column9: Better than WIlton fondant, but not the best.
column10: Satin Ice is more plyable and better tasting (for fondant0 than the Wilton boxed fondant at Michael's and WalMart. If you need colors, they are vibrant and strong--their blank and read are the best.While I have used Satin Ice many times, I will say that whatever fondant is used and marketed as the "Duff" brand (from Ace of Cakes) is a MUCH better product than even Satin Ice. You can re-rool and stretch it to fit like nothing I have ever seen. It really is the easiest fondant I have ever worked with--worth waiting for the 40% off coupons from the large chain craft store and buying the Duff brand.You can find Satin Ice elsewhere on the Internet cheaper than here, but at least you know Amazon is pretty dependable.
This is a fantastic fondant.  It has a great vanilla flavor and it's easy to roll out.  Kids, who don't like almond flavored fondant, love this.  Expensive, but worth it.
I have found that some products used to decorate cakes with leave somewhat to be desired in the taste department but this has a great taste. Rolls out easily.

column9: Easy to work with and tastes good
column10: I ordered this product to make a birthday cake for my son.  I had never worked with fondant before, so I made a practice cake in advance.  The fondant was brightly colored, relatively easy to work with (with ample amounts of powdered sugar to prevent sticking), and didn't taste bad like many other fondants do.  What I especially liked was that I was able to store the remaining fondant away for nearly three weeks, and it was just as good as when I first received it.  The green is a bright kelly green.
Easy to handle and has a great taste. Ten times better than the Wilton fondant.

This was very easy to use. I do not eat fondant so I can not comment on the taste but it is just as easy to use as the wilton products and the color was great and did not run all over. I would reccomment this product

I've used Satin Ice fondant in the past and loved it! but I order this 2 lb tub and was disappointed.  I received the tub with the seal attached to the tub but the lid was cut out and place ontop, leaving the product unsealed.  Fondant was dry and crumbly !! good thing I bought the small tub and not the larger tub!!

I got this very quickly and was so excited when I got it. It came very fresh, and tasted great, fondant isn't everyones favorite icing but I think it taste great and I would recommend others to order this product from amazon. It's also a great amount, I have done two square cakes already and I still have quite a bit left. If you are thinking about it, get it!

I had such a hard time with this fondant.  I have used Wilton for years and have done many good things with it so I decided to "step it up".  Boy am I sorry I did.  I had a 4 tiered anniversary cake to do in ivory.  I HATE coloring fondant so I figured this was as good a time as any to try a new fondant that was already colored so I ordered Satin Ice (...or SATAN Ice as I now call it).  I took it out of the tub and set it on the counter.  My 9 year old twins both said WHAT is that?!  I said "It's fondant!"  Having seen me work with fondant for many years, they both said "It looks too GOOEY to be fondant!!".  Boy... even at 9 they are VERY observant.  It was very easy to roll out, but getting it ON the cake was a different story.  When I picked it up to put it on the cake it fell apart in my hands.  I attempted this 4 times.  Finally I put wax paper underneath it, rolled it out and flipped it onto the cake.  Easy enough.....or so I thought until I saw all the wrinkles transferred from the wax paper...back to the drawing board.  I ended up putting wax paper underneath, rolling it out, putting wax paper on top, flipping it over, THEN putting it on the cake....only to find that it still tore in the process.  UGH.  I'm exhausted!!  Never again.

i used this to make some figures to put on top of cupcakes and they looked great... i changed the color with wiltons food coloring and they looked amazing. Also the taste is not that bad and it easy to handle. I definetely recommend this product!!!

I got this fondant for my brother's wedding. I won't be using it until this weekend, so the only things I can comment on right now are the taste and the color and texture.First off, right out of the bucket, this fondant was very stretchy and easy to work with, I pulled out a chunk just to see out it worked, before I ordered more. I found it very nice, and I'm just beginning to work with fondant. I was very concerned with the fact that it was being delivered on a 90 degree day, but it stayed gummy and workable and didn't melt or stick to anything.The color was gorgeous. I was a little worried about it leaving a blue or green color residue or not quite being black, but it's a great color and didn't bleed everywhere.Lastly, the taste, I tried it and I have to say this is some of the best tasting fondant. I liked it so much, that I ordered the white and I plan on making the flowers out of it, because I know people will love them.*UPDATE*Worked very well. I made many flowers and other decorations for the cake with this. Everyone thought it tasted great and looked wonderful. My only complaint is that it didn't dry as hard as other products I have used, so I had to be very careful when moving them around as they easily lost shape or fell apart. I'm not sure if this was because of the fondant or because of the heat, even though i made sure they were in a cool, dry place.My other issues is that no matter what I tried, it was very sticky and stuck to the mat that I was rolling it out on. Once I let it sit out for 15min or so, it got much easier to work with and I was able to actually roll and cut ribbons without them breaking or sticking.Overall, I would buy this again, just takes a little bit of getting used to.

I love Satin Ice fondant.  The fondant arrived as promised and it was fresh and ready to use.  I needed to get the product to me quickly, so purchasing from Amazon 2 day was the most economical for me.  Which is good for when I need to try out mixing a few colors before ordering a large quantity. I used this blue along with the red to make purple which was perfectly stable to light. (unlike mixing gel colors which sometimes fade in direct light).

It was my first time rolling fondant and I did it for my 3 years old daughter's birthday. It was perfect! I used for a big cake. It was pretty challenge on rolling it at that big size but it was worth.I researched on few tips on line and used a rolling mat so it was easy to transfer from the table to the cake.
This fondant was very smooth and easy to work with along with having a good taste.  You don't always get good taste in fondant.

column9: great taste and easy to use!
column10: This was my first time rolling fondant, and I had no trouble using this product.  Some that I've tasted in the past might as well have been made from glue, but this one had a pretty decent (though sugary, obviously) taste.  After a small amount of kneading it rolled out as smoothly as I could have hoped and covered my cake beautifully.
I really don't know much about this stuff, but it seems like it did what it was supposed to do...

This is not a hot chili, but something a little more mild.  It has a very good flavor.  I've bought it for years and them moved to the midwest where I can't find it anywhere.  It's the best canned chili I've tried.

This product is easy to make and has a great taste.  I just wish it was gluten free.  A simple change in the soy sauce used would make it that way just like the General Tsao's Chicken by the same company.

column9: Where Are the 3rd Degree Burn Doritos ??
column10: The Frito Lay company is a tease-first they advertise these on the super bowl and then they don't deliver- I have checked several stores on their " where to Buy" list and the stores knew nothing about them-I wonder if they even made them?? I have emailed and got a form letter- I want my CHIPS!! The frustration has caused the hair on the wolves on my "three wolf/one moon" t-shirts hair to fall out, they look like they caught the mange and the moon is no longer full. How can I go to Wal-mart like this- I feel my wolfen power slipping away and will no longer be the babe magnet I once was. How will I be able pick up women now- Maybe I'll try at Target. All due to Frito Lay and my great disappointment in never savoring the flavor of the mythical but non-existent 3rd Degree Burn Doritos... Shame.. Shame Frito Lay.

It's the best! No one other brand compares. My Mom first discovered it a few years ago, when my older sister and her family took a trip to France. They brought back the Milka bar, and Mom and I fell in love! Now every time they go to Europe, my Mom always requests the premium "Milka Alpine Milk Chocolate" bar.Milka is produced in several European locations (i.e., Austria, Belgium, Germany, Hungary, Poland, Romania, and Turkey). Unfortunately, availability in the US is slim; best bet is thru an online candy merchant or perhaps any of your local international stores. Nowadays I don't enjoy most American based products, as they are usually artificially flavored. In contrast, Milka is 100% natural! The taste and quality is superb--rich and creamy. No one beats it.HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!!!!!

Corny title, but it's true.  I've been all over the world, tried "gourmet" chocolates, white chocolates, truffles, dark chocolates, etc.  You name it, I've tried it when it comes to chocolate.  But Milka is my absolute favorite, and anyone who buys me some is my new best friend.  The fact that this stuff is not on the shelf in every store in the US is a travesty.  We are TRULY missing out back in the states.

Milka is one of the leading producers of chocolates in the world. Founded in Switzerland in 1901, the brand quickly spread throughout Western Europe. In 1990, the company was acquired by Kraft, and their wonderful chocolate is now available throughout the world!I love Milka's Alpine Milk chocolate. It is absolutely delicious - not as sweet as many American chocolates, and with a rich and creamy texture. Want to try a great chocolate? Get Milka's Alpine Milk chocolate!(Review of Milka Alpine Milk Chocolate 100g)

I first encountered these heavenly chocolate bars in Austria back in 1990. I couldn't believe how good they were! Milka definitely beats out anything made by Lindt, Cadbury, or Hershey. (My apologies to the Swiss, English and Americans, in that order). The taste is truly unique. Very creamy and as another reviewer put it "refined". It has a great blend of a sweet and creamy milk chocolate feel with just a hint of dark chocolate flavor. It is truly fantastic and must be experienced for one's self. Up until now, I could rarely find Milka in the States, except for at the occasional gourmet food boutique. I am very happy that Amazon has made it available to the American market.
Mmmmmmmmm!!! Better than any chocolate you can buy in your local grocery store, unless your local grocery store carries this.
This is one of the best chocolate i have eaten in a long time... I would recommend this to anyone.

When I received my shipment of Milka chocolates from Euro Food Mart, they were already stale! I opened the first chocolate bar and more than half of it was discolored and obviously stale. I find it suspicious that the expiration date was coming up in six months yet the chocolate was already stale, and when i wrote to the customer service department of this company they told me I had to pay return shipping to send back the unopened chocolates for them to refund me. This is not the right way to do business and I am never buying anything from this company again. They should pay for the return shipping since I already paid a $10 shipping fee for this company to send me stale chocolates.

A friend gave me a bar of this Milka Alpine Milk Chocolate 100g, imported from Poland by his girlfriend's family. I've had lots of amazing European chocolate so I opened it with high expectations.  Yes, it has an exceptionally creamy texture and very nice mild flavor, a bit sweeter than I expected and quite milky.Milka's not the chocolate for me, though. I prefer chocolate that's less sweet, darker and more strongly chocolate-flavored; 60 or 70% cocoa. Milka is probably not more than 30%. It's a nice product for those who like that concentration.Though this may be more information than you want in a review of a chocolate bar, I'd like to tell you about the company. Milka, first created in Austria over 100 years ago, is produced in several European countries and capitalizes on the idea of creamy milk from cows raised in the pure air of the Alps (though they don't mention where the cocoa comes from). Its wrapper is, and always has been, a distinctive lilac color with a purple and white cow pictured on it (explaining the Ogden Nash in my subject line).  Since 1970 the company has been through a couple of mergers and was acquired by Kraft Foods in 1990.I went to the company website to see if they sell darker chocolate. The home page asks you to choose a country--U.K., Turkey, Russia, Germany, Poland, Bulgaria, etc. Each country's page is the distinctive Milka purple with an Alpine scene, and several have sound effects of lowing cows and chirping birds.  On the U.K. site you can follow an interactive tour and meet an Alpine cow ("Make a Moooo Mate") and there seems to be something similar on the other pages.  Each country's site has a link to other Kraft company sites.To sum up: very nice chocolate if it's the sort you like. I enjoyed it well enough but liked the website much, much more.Linda Bulger, 2010

column9: It's ok, but it's no Cadbury
column10: Just personal taste but this tastes too plain sweet, not chocolaty enough. Reminds me very much of cheap easter bunny chocolate. If you like your chocolate really rich, and more chocolate than sugar, Cadbury dairy milk is the best.
this spaetzle noodles are too heavy I expected them to be more like the regular egg noodles I ordered  before. Now I am stuck with four bags.
LIBBY's beet products are simply terrific ! The convience of having them so quickly available as a side dish can't be "Beat" !!

VERY HAPPY WITH EMMETS! If Baileys is a 10, Emmets is a 9. I loved Baileys but it is much too expensive to drink daily if you are on a limited budget.  I searched for an alternative and found Cask and Creme but it was bitter, not at all enjoyable straight, in fact I found it very difficult to finish the small bottle I'd purchased.  I drink my creme straight, cold and on ice so I actually taste it.  After this I was afraid to waste more money on bad creme but I talked to a few people who recommended Emmets. I WAS VERY HAPPY WITH EMMETS. It's very smooth and sweet.  It did seem a little bit thinner and didn't have quite the same "punch" from the Irish Whiskey but it is a truly GREAT,INEXPENSIVE ALTERNATIVE to Baileys.  I will buy Emmets for all but the very most special occasions and will enjoy it. Thank you Emmets!

I've been trying different spaghetti sauces and we loved this one so much, I'll be sticking with this one everytime. We like a meat sauce, so I always brown 1/2 pound of some italian sausage to add to the sauce. It's fantastic.

I'm not kidding! This is the best tomato spaghetti sauce ever offered in jars on supermarket shelves, and the only one I'd use unless cooking for my in-laws. But it's not sold just everywhere; most of the big mall supermarket chains don't carry it. The price here for six 14-ounce jars is roughly what you'd pay in a market, but then there's the shipping cost. Mom's also makes a puttanesca that's oxymoronically respectable.What makes it better than average? It might be just that Mom's uses real olive oil in abbondanza, rather than tasteless soya oil. In this "garlic & basil" sauce, you'll see whole cloves of garlic and rough-chopped leaves of basil, and what's better, you'll taste both. Possibly the sauce-wallahs don't overcook the tomatoes. All I know for sure is that Mom's has more gusto italiano genuino than its competitori.

I was about to purchase Wellness for puppies, but our trusted Vet gave this food her highest praise (she had liked the Wellness brand, but said the company had been sold and could not vouch for the quality going forward).  We have an Airedale puppy, who was being fed IAMS when we got her.  As you always should, we transitioned from the IAMS into HOLISTIC, and she is now solely on this food, and LOVES IT, and this food seems to love her as well!!!  Read the ingredient list.... it's top notch.  I bought this 30lb bag from Amazon since the price is comparable and the shipping is FREE!  As always...  great service.

I'm very happy with this food. Our Golden Ret was on it a year and her weight is excellent, beautiful coat, and firm stool.I used to get it at our local Petco but they stopped carrying it. It broke my heart. You know how it is when you get something you're happy with and it's no longer available.Anyway, Amazon to the rescue. No additional shipping charge with my Amazon Prime membership. I'll keep our dog on this for another year then switch to the adult formula.Now if I could only get it delivered with groceries from Amazon Fresh :>)

As an owner of a young American Mastiff pup, we had to switch to this due to some protein concerns. The more popular brands like Blue Buffalo and other brands are actually 25% higher in protein. The Holistic Select in my area can only be found in two specialty stores. Not only are they out of my way, they are about a buck higher in cost. I was hesitant about ordering from Amazon at first being a food product. I can assure you the service is outstanding. Each bag has always come inside a box and the food was protected. The shelf-life remaining on the food has always been greater than six months remaining. Plus, I save the gas money having to go get as it is left at my front door. I hope Amazon keeps this in their inventory and would be neat to see it added to their auto delivery program. Giant Breed dogs tend to do better on lamb based lower protein foods. If you are on the fence about Amazon handling this, let me reassure you that you will not find better pricing and consider the service of delivery to your door!!!

Doberman puppy had terrible diarrhea on Blue Buffalo Longevity and Purina Pro Plan. This was the last effort before putting him on a hypoallergenic food that would leave his skin dull and lifeless. This has worked wonderfully, although we feed him a little more than recommended due to the lower protein content. Cannot complain

Purchased this for an Irish Wolfhound puppy. With my older male I had a terrible time getting him on a good food and had ended up switching his food about 4 times in the first 2 years. Now that he is older he is on a higher protein diet that is not suitable for the new pup. Most of the large breed specific puppy foods I've food contain higher levels of protein and calcium that are not suitable for giant breed pups, and with my older one I did a lot of research and had him on adult diets from the start. The breeder of the new pup recommended this line and after researching the product I started our new pup on this. They have done extremely well on this diet and I am pleased with the high quality ingredients used in this product.

I have been giving this to my 11 month old Australian Shepherd now since he was 2 months old and never once has he had diarrhea or thrown up and his stool is very solid. I used to use to Iams and Eukanuba and those can't compare.

Our Great Dane puppy loved the first 30lb. bag, no problems whatsoever. The second bag, however, caused extreme projectile diarrhea(no joke), which isn't cool for anyone or thing, especially an inside dog. My wife was pretty ticked(she cleans that stuff up). Our 13 week puppy lost ten pounds and spent time in the vet hospital, just to get her digestive system back on. We will not be buying this anymore. We know for certain that it was the food. After switching to another brand, she would get better, then we'd try again. It would come back immediately. We switched to eagle pack, (red bag). It's the best!

I bought these b/c I felt a sinus infection creeping up on me...spring allergies are wreaking havoc once again. I love drinking anise tea so I saw these "Jakemans Throat and Chest" lozenges, anise flavored, and wanted to give them a try. They are deliciously smooth and have helped soothe my sore throat and another great side effect, they have really helped clear my sinus passages too. Great little lozenges, I will keep these in my medicine cabinet for sure.

These cookies have been my sons favorite since he started eating solids. Now he is 9 months and he lets them melt in his mouth. They are great. I bought a large package. I like the zipbag that they come in, so they stay fresh.

My nine month old, almost ten month old daughter loves these and has yet to get any teeth. Virtually no mess unlike other teething biscuits that seem to cover her in slime afterwards. I carry them in the diaper bag and it's one of her first finger foods that she likes to feed herself. Perfect for small hands.

column10: cookies are not mushy or messy, little ones can easily bit into them with a couple of teeth and crunch them up, they do not get mushy or slimy.  Easy to break in two and have one half at a time.

column9: Great finger food for crawlers & cruisers
column10: My daughter is 9 months and she really enjoys these cookies as a snack or treat. My mom bought them for her and I'm glad I'll buy again. shoot I even think they're tasty lol.

Cant find Arrowroot cookies in the supermarkets any more. Got them on line!Funny how the internet helps to get an old fashioned cookie!Gerber Graduates Cookies, Arrowroot Cookies, 5.5-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 6)
This was a very good buy. Good price for them and my baby absolutely loves them. She can have half every now and then and they are great.
My 10 month old daughter loves these.  They make very little mess and are especially good when she is teething.

I always taste everything I give my little girl. These are yummy, not too sweet, but tasty. They melt quickly in their mouths but crisp enough for new little teeth to get massaged. They are also the perfect size for little hands.

I bought these for my 10 month old daughter thinking they would be great for teething and snacking. These cookies gave my baby a terrible rash and the runs. She normally never has these kinds of reactions to food. Never again Gerber, never again.

I also purchased this product in glass containers. It was a bit of a mess. Mine wasn't as bad as some, but the bottle top broke. Fortunately, no glass broke and not mush of the sauce was lost. Bottles arrived shattered and were intelligently put in with everything else that was ordered, all of which was promptly destroyed.  Was told getting the actual order of hot sauce "would be very difficult to do" so in turn was cancelled.  Bubble wrap or some sort of packing material may be a good idea when shipping. Won't make the mistake or ordering this through Amazon twice.Amazon was however quick to rectify the issue and do what they could to help; which was noted and appreciated.Make of this what you will, love Red Devil though for what it's worth.
This order came quickly, the tea tastes good and we are hoping that it helps lower blood pressure with time.  I was even sent a free trial package of Hibiscus Punch Tea, and that was good as well.
GOT THIS ORDER REALLY FAST AND I LOVE THE TEA. HELPS MY BLOOD PRESSURE A LOT.I WILL ORDER MORE OF THE SAME WHEN I RUN OUT. THANKS
excellent and low sugar!  Easy to make for a superb green tea latte!  Loose powder with great flavor and tasty.  A great alternative to coffee or other types of tea.

I have an iSi Twist and Sparkle Beverage Carbonating System and wanted to make a diet cola.  Most diet cola syrups on the market for home users use splenda and/or acesulfame K which I don't like the taste of.  I'm used to and prefer the aftertaste of aspartame or saccharine.  This was the only extract I could find that was unsweetened so I could try my own sweeteners.  I ordered the cola flavor from Jack's Country Store here on Amazon.I tried making the soda with both erythritol and saccharine (sugar twin).  I couldn't get the sweetness right with erythritol, but the Sugar Twin worked fine.  The extract flavor is between a cola and a rootbeer flavor.  I used the following mix: 3.5 cups water + 1 tsp cola extract + 1/4 cup Sugar Twin (if using erythritol use closer to 1/2 cup) and optionally, juice of a lime to boost the acidity and push the flavor closer to a cola and away from rootbeer.  You could also use a bit less extract and sugar twin, I like it a bit strong.

I won't disagree with other reviewers about the wintergreen. This is an ingredient in authentic root beer and there are flavor notes in the Homebrew extract. That said, this product has been around for at least the past forty years. We used to buy this at Calico Ghost Town and Knotts Berry Farm in the '60s and it has same delicious flavor today. Try the Sarsaparilla or Birch Beer mix if you want a different old-fashioned variety. This stuff is great for flavoring homemade ice cream too.
I've been a disappointed with the extracts from this company.  This one is the best that I have had but its not that great.
I agree with the other review here.  Strong wintergreen taste not in line with any root beer I've ever had.

column9: If you got Ginger Beer, consider yourself lucky
column10: I've been making all kinds of soda for the last 5 years from various concentrates, with a home-made carbonation kit that consists of little more than a tank of CO2, some hoses, a filter and regulator.  I regularly get the Homebrew Root Beer and Homebrew Cola and have tried every other flavor they sell.  For starters, the Ginger Ale (and several others) keeps the essential oils in an alcohol suspension, yet is sold in a plastic bottle.  It doesn't take a chemist to figure out just how stupid that is.  Every bottle I've received has been partially collapsed, bubbled/sticky on the outside and has 'particulate matter' on the inside, due to the volume of alcohol migrating through the plastic.  Same with the Lemon flavor as well - it's been totally revolting.Avoid this - get the Ginger Beer instead of the Ginger Ale, use Koolaid unsweetened mixes for the fruit flavors, and really just use the Homebrew label for the Cola and RootBeer products.  Get any soda concentrate with essential oils in suspension (read: most) from a distributor that uses glass bottles.My Soda Rig:*The Carbonator - fits to 20ounce and 2liter bottles: [....]*Ball Lock Disconnect - connects the Carbonator to the CO2 tank: [....]*5lb or 20lb CO2 tank (get the 20 if you don't need your rig portable) - local beer homebrew or welding store.  Make sure it's food grade.*Dual Gauge CO2 Regulator: [....]*3-6 feet clear tubing with 1/4inch interior diameter.  It only needs to handle 50-60 psi, so it doesn't need to be reinforced.Most of this stuff can be gotten cheap from various local sources or somewhere here on Amazon ([....]).  Once you put it together, you can start carbonating just about anything.

I bought this hoping to make a Root Ber my grandkids would enjoy helping make and drink. We followed the included directions carefully. The resultant root beer was drinkable, but tasted like wintergreen, very strongly. I thought it was OK, but the grandkids wouldn't touch it after one taste. Decent wintergreen soda, but not muck like root beer, although the stuff smells great.

I'm glad they still make this mix. It has a wild cherry lifesaver kick to it that is refreshing. Use to make syrups, flavor ice cream or cocktails - Cherry Cosmo comes to mind. Be careful, a little goes a long way.

Never just made the orange by its self.  Miked it 50 50 with the cream soda made by the same company.  People were begging me for the recipy.I never follow the instructions.  i have tasted this brand of soda prepared very poorly.  not by me tho.Tip:  1 pound of sugar per gallon.  no more.  no less.  that is the master rule.

This concentrated Egg Nog Extract is difficult to find, but well worth the effort.  I have been drinking the "Home Mix Gourmet Egg Nog" by Rainbow Flavors since the late 1990's.  I like it more mild than the instructions suggest; Try 5 to 8 drops in an 8 oz mug of milk with a scant tsp of sugar and microwave 2 min on high.  Delicious--it even foams slightly!!
This is one of my favorite mixes for the holidays.Brings that festive feeling to life as you make it, serve it and drink it.It's one of my favorite treats as well as my family's.

I ordered this item, and was instead shipped a different item (ginger beer).  There is a difference, and the company that makes this makes both.  However, Amazon's warehouses are too stupid to recognize the difference.  When I politely pointed out to them that they had shipped me the wrong item, they very politely apologized, and promised to send me the right item...whereupon they sent me exactly the same wrong item again.  When I complained again, and asked them to either find the right item, or refund my money, they ignored me.  If you really want ginger ale, you can buy this mix on the Internet from other suppliers.  Don't say I didn't warn you.

I was very satisfied with this purchase.  The price was very good and it arrived quickly.  I would recommend this site to anyone looking to purchase large quantities of candy for special occasions or for any reason!

column9: Break me off a piece of that Kit-Kat bar!
column10: It's great to have my own stock of Kit-Kat bars sitting next to me in the office. They were partially melted when they arrived, but then again, I do live in SC, so it could have been worse. Delicious product!

I ordered this as a Christmas gift for a friend that loves Kit-Kat bars. The bars were good but they did not come in the retail packaging as pictured, which was largely disappointing. Instead they came packaged loosely with popcorn material in an unmarked cardboard box.
This is my second order.  I love KitKat.  The product shipped rather well-no damage and firm.  The biggest challenge is not going after the lot in one week.

I saw some negative reviews about this candy but I disagree although it is a matter of taste. I love this low sugar candy and the chocolate mint is wonderful. I have given them to many friends and their instant reaction is surprise that it tastes so good and is low sugar. I intend to purchase more as soon as I run low on this batch.

I love chocolate and Sugar Free chocolate creamsavers is my favorite.  I tried the go lightly but didn't like it.  The candy is too sticky on my teeth and doesn't have much chocolate flavor.  The candy is hard so you can't bite right through it like life savers.  I like that because it lasts longer.

I discovered Sharwood's Puppoddums while I was in Ireland this last Spring, and have been trying to get my hands on them since I got home.I just love Puppodums, and where I live it's very hard to find ANY decent Indian food, and when I find it, it's a restaurant.These puppodums really do puff up nicely in just a few seconds and they're just delicious.

column10: This is good stuff, especially when mixed with a Cinnamon Roll Dairy Creamer. It does not last long in my pantry.

column9: Donut Shop Cinnamon Roll - Worst I have tasted

I can't say it even tasted like coffee at all not much less having any type of flavor. Maybe the one I tried had something wrong but now stuck with having to toss out the rest of the box!Very disappointed!  I will stay with my Hazelnut and French Vanilla

I prepared a cup of the Doughnut House Flavor today. It tasted like water with a crayon having been dragged through it. Yuck.

Maybe its me, but I don't taste ANY cinnamon in the Donut House Cinnamon Roll coffee. In fact, it tastes like a VERY weak cup of bad blueberry coffee. I just got my first Keurig coffee maker a few months ago and have been trying new flavors like crazy. I have to say, this is the worst flavor I have tasted yet. I would never buy this coffee again.

This coffee smells amazing...really does smell like baked Cinnamon Rolls. But it taste like the tray that the rolls were baked on. Pure metallic...not even sure how or why? Just taste like i'm drinking a spoon. Skip this one.

I love the chocolate glazed donut flavor, so I thought I'd give the cinnamon roll a try.  This doesn't have a cinnamon roll flavor.  Instead, it tastes like a weak coffee, with a dash of perfume in it.  I tried adding cinnamon to the coffee (something I love in unflavored coffee) and it didn't help, either.  Yuck.

column9: Donut House Collection Coffee, Cinnamon Roll, 24-Count K-Cups for Keurig Brewers
column10: Sure disappointed with Amazon as they sent me a collection of Donut House coffee and not the Cinnamon Roll as I asked.  What is up with that?

column9: Just put some cinnamon in your coffee
column10: Not a favorite of mine, but I don't really like cinnamon in my coffee.  I purchased a Donut House variety pack and this came in the box.  Friends of mine who do like cinnamon in their coffee have tried it and thought it was good.  The coffee brews a bit weak, as well.  I do love the regular Donut House flavor, as well as the Chocolate Glazed Donut (yum!).  Overall, I think people that like a light brewed cinnamon coffee would love this.

Let me start off with the coffee itself which is pretty good. I will say that these coffee's (green mountain and such) have really huge swings. I've bought cases that were wonderful and the next will have a burnt aftertase or be noticably weaker in comparison so realize that these reviews may be reflective of the wild inconsistant nature of the brand...Now for the major point; 1.04 a cup!? I know K's have gone up quite a bit recently but not that much geez. This brand is a staple at "Bed Bath & Beyond" so you know and is 10.99 up from 9.99 for a box of 18, which is .61 a cup. But hey if ya don't wanna leave the house go for it. Oh wait you can order if from them online as well... oh well I tried gimme my star back.

If I had a choice of THIS or nothing, I'd go with nothing. Of all the K-cups I've tasted - this is the worst. Very weak and if you close your eyes and think really hard about it, maybe you can almost taste cinnamon. Blech.

I know that coffee reviews are subjective -- we all have different tastes and preferences, right? So I'm writing my review based on my own preferences for a light roast coffee with a "soft" flavor (rather than overly bitter or bold). This is currently my 100% absolutely favorite k-cup flavor. While it's brewing I get the distinct aroma of cinnamon rolls. I brew in a Keurig B40 and choose the 9.25oz serving size and think the brew strength is exactly right. My usual method of serving is to heat about 6 ounces of skim milk in the microwave for 1 minute, add about 1 tablespoon SF Torani Vanilla Syrup and froth using my Aerolatte thingie. Then I add the coffee to the milk and stir gentle. It's as good as anything I can get at Starbucks!

This is a Light Roast coffee with only a faint cinnamon like flavor. I brewed this In my B40 at the 7.20oz mug size. Adding a sugar substitute and liquid creamer and it created a mellow flavor with at best a very slight cinnamon flavor. I was expecting more. I will try this coffee at the larger 9.25 mug size and report back.I brewed a cup at the larger 9.25oz lever and still no real desirable cinnamon flavor. But as a light roast coffee alone, it has a nice smooth flavor with low acidity; just wished they'd would have put just a tad more cinnamon in it

As a serious coffee drinker, I should have read the other reviews. My coffee preferences are Bold and Dark blends. I like a strong cup of coffee and this was very watery to me. I brewed it on the smallest cup size and still thought it was weak.it smells amazing. But if you like a good strong cup of coffee do not buy this. My roommate who prefers lighter coffee, really liked this one. She can keep the extras, im going for that dark Roast cup of coffee.And if you arent sure if you are a DARK or a LIGHT roast person, if you prefer your morning cuppa at Starbucks- then you prefer a dark roast. If you prefer a cup from Dunkin or krispy, you like the lighter roasts- so this cinnamon roll would satisfy you.

I purchased these for the 1st time last week and love them!  I also bought a box for my co-workers to try and the coffee drinkers now have a new favorite (and I'm talking about some picky coffee drinkers).  If you like cinnamon and can make do with a light/medium roast I really recommend you give it a try!

I loved it and was very excited to see this flavor in the k-cups, but nervous that it wouldn't taste as good.  Well, it is just as good, if not better, and I love the smell as it's brewing and running down into my coffee cup!!  Kudos to Donut House brand!!
This is a light to medium roast coffee with nice cinnamon flavor. If you like your coffee a bit bolder, just brew on a smaller size.
I truly liked this coffee.  It does have a nice,full- not overpowering flavor of cinnamon.  I enjoyed it with Italian cream flavored creamer. Yum!
This is very good , is not real strong cinnamon, but was is a pleasant taste, will buy again.
The coffee is tasty, but it has an odd smell. I'll drink all the kcups in this box but I doubt I will buy it again.
I purchased this Cinnamon Roll coffee for my wife.  She loves it and so does my daughter. This is all they want now, which makes it easier for me to keep my favorite "Nantucket" in stock.

column9: A must have in my collection
column10: My husband and I have become K-cup addicts since I bought him the machine for Christmas. This is my favorite flavor so far. I'm not a strong coffee drinker, and I'm a total sweet-tooth. All this needs is a little splenda and some half/half and the result is a creamy, low-carb delightful treat!

I absolutely love this flavor. This is one of my favorite flavors for my keurig! And I was very happy to find it on Amazon! This one is so much better than the Chocolate Donut one. I recommend this to anyone who wants to add a little flavor to their coffee.

I like flavored coffees - those where you can really taste the flavor it claims to have.  Well, this one does.  It is delicious and you feel like you are enjoying all the calories and good taste of a cinnamon roll in liquid form - only you can rejoice because you aren't getting the calories!!!  I will be buying this item lots more!

The price was great and the flavor is good. I only really drink flavored coffee. This smells more like cinnamon than it tastes like it. But like I said for the price and 24 k cups ends up being a really good deal. The green mountain golden french toast is delicious. So if you either hate this or just think it is okay I suggest trying that.

column9: Total misrepresentation as far as flavor is concerned
column10: This is the first time I have taken the time to review something on Amazon.  This product is so bad that I consider this review to be a public service.  As the title indicates, to say that this coffee is cinnamon roll flavored is total misrepresentation.  There is a very slight scent of cinnamon roll while it is brewing, but the end product has absolutely no cinnamon roll flavor.  The end result is bitter black coffee and nothing more.  I have to wonder if the maker, Green Mountain Coffee, has ever heard of taste testers.  Based on the flavor of this coffee, and flavor of the equally bad "Chocolate Glazed Donut", I have to say no.  I think I will throw them away and take the loss rather than subject my taste buds to continued assault by choking down the remaining 23 cups.  The kindest thing I can say about this product is that it is absolutely terrible.  I intend to express my displeasure to the manufacturer as well.  For a product this bad it should be possible to give a zero star rating or better yet, a negative star rating.Based on my experience with both products I will be very reluctant to purchase another "flavored" coffee.

I tried these despite the negative reviews hoping they were wrong.  They weren't!!  Only at the very end of the cup of coffee did I detect a tiny hint of the cinnamon.  I do not know why or quite frankly how, the company ever named it cinnamon roll.

This is great coffee. I usually brew on the larger serving size and it's great. With half and half and sweet n' low it's perfect. Not too "cakey" and not too cinnamony. It is a lighter roast coffee so if you're looking for something that's going to put hair on your chest, this isn't it.

I am normally not into sweet coffee (I drink it black without any sweetener but decided to buy this flavor upon recommendations. It is definitely a sweeter coffee, but I think it is really good. It has just enough of a hint of that cinnamon roll flavor without being too much. It also smells delicious!

column9: Pretty darn good cup o' coffee
column10: This is a pretty good flavor of coffee.  The cinnamon isn't overpowering and the smell is really enticing. This is a flavor I am likely to purchase again.
Amazing experience every time. The taste of cinamaon and hint of sweetness in just the right amounts. Can't just have one cup.
This is my go to coffee when I need to pick a favorite.  Just a hint of cinnamon but enough to give it a good flavor.
I add international delight vanilla creamer to this coffee and it is so delicious!  It's a wonderful way to get my day started.  Have tried several K flavors and this is my favorite!

My husband got a Keurig coffee maker recently which prompted me to try this coffee.  I've never liked the taste of coffee, but this is amazing!  It's delicious and leaves a slight sweet taste in your mouth after each sip.  I would highly recommend it!

After trying the donut house regular coffee, I was wanting to try other flavors they offered. This was my first venture for other flavors and I was a little disappointed. Yes,,it has all the wonderful flavor of the regular and I was expecting a bolder cinnamon flavor. Sadly, very little of that cinnamon came thru. Good coffee but not the wondrous flavor I hoped for. Now I am reluctant to try the other flavors.
love this flavor but still wish someone would make a mint flavor coffee i know there is a candycane at xmas but i love mint flavor coffee and cant find it in any k-cups by anyone

The cinnamon roll coffee and flavor is mild.  I use the large size brew button on the keurig so that may have something to do with it.  It was a nice change.  I like "Jet Fuel" for my every day coffee.
This is a delicious, slightly sweet coffee with a hint of cinnamon.  The shipping time was excellent.  The best prices for K-cups are on Amazon.
This is a smooth coffee with a good taste.  I don't like overly sweet flavored coffees and this one is perfect.  It has just the right flavor and it is not bitter at all.

column10: Smells wonderful, tastes great with a little sugar and vegan creamer.Not as strong as I like but with Keurig cups, it never is.

column9: Over priced for a lousy cup of coffee.
