Good Day, extremely happy I was able to find a company that produces a particular cheese called Liederkranz. Limited selection of two or three types with various packaging sizes. The only disappointing aspect of this purchase was I expected this purchase to arrive in time for our 500+ mile drive to deliver it my father prior to Thanksgiving. The company who rec'd this order chose not to send this order out till the 29th of November thus missing out on the personal delivery by my family and instead having to be mailed again by Federal Express.I will order again from this company however I will communicate my concerns prior to ordering this time. Thanks again for the cheese. Excellent product.

We found this product initially at our local liquor store.  The nuts disappeared within three days.  The mix is exactly as advertised -- big, fresh nuts with little/no nut segments at the bottom of the tin.  The nuts are perfectly salted.  We've now ordered the four-package option four times over three months.  If you love pistachios and cashews, this is the mix for you.  I'm not a huge fan of almonds, but they add a nice dimension to the taste.

column9: I think this is a scam
column10: it's advertised as 21oz, but they sent me an 18oz container.  I don't think there are even 21oz containers.  They refunded part of the money, but still charged me the full shipping.  I'm contesting that too, but you have to watch what you get here... not sure if I'd try to buy the 21oz again, just stick to the 18oz since I know they exist... :)
I love this product. It is very healthy for you and tastes REALLY good. I have shared it with several friends who also love it!

I picked up a package at my local gym. I wasn't expecting to like it  but it was delicious. I only bought it because I was starving before my workout and knew I wouldn't be able to finish if I didn't eat something. The package is only 60 calories with 10g protein.
Lucques olives are unlike any I've ever tasted. They are not as salty as most olives and this is why they appeal to me.

i've probably eaten hundreds of lucques olives and hate to say that these were my least favorite.  the olives themselves were fine but the brine that they were soaking in had a funny taste that was different than any other i've had before.  olives - good.  brine - bad.
These olives were absolutely addictive! Fantastic flavor & exceptional quality! Thoroughly enjoyed these & will definitely be back for more! I was extremely pleased with both product & service!

Coconut water and me do not mix.  I have tried all of the brands out there and was very satisfied with this flavor mix.  I know all about the health benefits and try to drink one a day.  Much better for you than Sports drinks!  If you drink too much alcohol, try this the next morning, it will help with the recovery!  This flavor mix was very tasty and does not have a coconut after taste.  It has the Passion fruit taste throughout the whole experience.  I would recommend since the price is lower here on Amazon!
My husband and I have an intense exercise routine and these coconut water drinks are really refreshing afterwards.  The passion fruit flavor is not as sweet as the pinapple, but still tastes fruity.

I love coconut water.  It's so refreshing.  I've been wanting to try some of the flavored coconut waters and grabbed this when it was on sale.I'm sorry to say that I didn't like this flavor at all.  It had a sour taste to me that I really disliked.  I drank down one, but was not happy to think of drinking the other 11!  sigh... I gave the rest of them to my brother and I hope he enjoyed the flavor more than I did.  I wont be getting this flavor again.
My husband wasn't crazy about the taste. He said they're okaaaayyy, but not fabulous. So I just mixed them in with other juices for an added nutrition boost.

column9: Good for you and tastes good too!!!
column10: Bought this to replace gatorade and all the other sports drinks that are loaded with sugar, artificial sweeteners, artificial colors and all that other junk. This is so satisfying to drink and doesn't make you sick, you can feel the difference when you drink something so good. Lovin' it!!!!

I ordered both the coconut water and coconut water with passion fruit.  I honestly was expecting to like the plain coconut water better because I'm used to having fresh coconut water, but the coconut water with passion fruit was good.  There's a real passion fruit taste present in the drink and it brightens up the drink without being too overwhelming.  It's definitely a great drink to have to start or end the day.

column9: Hydration , what a perfect product to give instant Hydration, and is so tastey. Great for patients going through radiation thera
column10: While myself and my sister are undergoing treatment for cancer, was advised to try this product Vita Coco Coconut water, what a difference it made immediately.Hydration is so important while undergoing radiation, or chemo ,Vita Coco, fits right into a program to help hydrate and keep your vital organs, protected.Will drink it forever.Thanks Jene Fielder

For those complaining about the taste, coconut water taste very good when fresh from the Coconut  but I like mine frozen, so, I bought 2 other flavors and put them in the freezer for 45 minutes and wow... I went to heaven and back. I prefer to drink VitaCoco over other sport drinks.  I do recommend.

I got this passion fruit coconut water and it tastes horrible! You can't taste the coconut nor passion fruit!Since I don't want to through it away, I only use it when I want to make smoothies! I cannot stand its taste, it's too fake!

Amazon's product description says there is evaporated cane juice (sugar) in the Vita Coco, but I'm pretty sure it contains only coconut water and the fruit.I really like this product, I usually drink a few before playing hockey. No sugar and no dyes. After drinking this for a few months now, sports drinks taste sickeningly  sweet to me.

column9: Great option for those don't like plain coconut water! Better than sports drinks!
column10: Great option for those who don't like the taste of plain coconut water. The passion fruit is delicious and it tastes best when served ICE COLD.  Love to drink this before, during and post workout. Besides being a great hydrating tool, it helps avoid cramping as well.

column9: Better than O.N.E. Coconut Water with Passion Fruit
column10: Coconut water is high in potassium and a natural electrolyte.  It helps to rehydrate you much faster than Gatorade only wishes it could.  Depending on what you are used to drinking, you may love or hate coconut water.  I think that it's a matter of getting used to a different taste more than it being "bad" or "gross."  If you go into it thinking you're going to be drinking juice, think again.  This is more a watered down juice-like drink, but it has much less sugar and doesn't give a sugar shock that leaves you wishing for more to drink.My whole family enjoys this brand and this specific flavor combo.  We all do not enjoy plain ole coconut water and really liked the juice-like taste of this flavor.  It works for us, but your family may enjoy another flavor better.  I would try several flavors before deciding on one or none at all.  I had this as a Subscribe & Save item for over a year, until Amazon told me I no longer could buy it that way.  I was devastated.I searched on Amazon to see if I could find something comparable.  After ordering the O.N.E. Coconut Water with a Splash of Passion Fruit, 8.5-Ounce Aseptic Containers (Pack of 12) a month ago, I, as well as another family member, finally decided to try one today.  We both had the same reaction..."this doesn't taste as good as the brand we had been drinking."  Hence my coming to Amazon tonight to write a review of the O.N.E. product...  Now I wish I hadn't ordered 3 whole boxes of it!  I thought @ $10/box of 12 I couldn't go wrong.  Hmm, maybe I was wrong!But enough of O.N.E. Coconut Water with Passion Fruit, Vita Coco Coconut Water with Passion Fruit tastes so much better!  If you're sick and feeling dehydrated, this is what you need.  If you've just done a big workout and nothing can quench your thirst, this is what you need.  If you're feeling a little run done or have a headache that just won't quit, this is what you need.Luckily, my dislike of O.N.E. brand led me back to Amazon to see that I could once again order Vita Coco Coconut Water with Passion Fruit as a Subscribe & Save.  Comparably, the price difference is negligible: ounce for ounce it is just about the same.  I only wish I hadn't been ousted before!
If Vita Coco were a physical human being, I would try to marry it. It's the be all and end all of coconut waters, and far superior to Gatorade. A wonderous drink if I do say so myself.

I have tried the ZICO coconut water and it wasn't bad. the biggest problem was there distribution. The Vita Coconut water has been great. Distribution is great. The Passion fruit flavored coconut water taste really good and is a good source of hydration. I highly recommend it.
Tasted the product before, purchased for the price. With free shipping, you can't beat it!

Growing up in Asia, i had fresh coconut juice very often. This tasted funny with the passion fruit flavor. Good coconuts don't taste sour but this did. Maybe without any artificial flavors would make this juice more desirable.

My wife is pregnant and we were desparately searching for green coconut water. Then we came accross this product which we subscribed for monthly delivery. The product is awesome - genuine coconut water. But one bad point is they increased the subscription after 1st delivery and I gad to cancel it.

Gave this a try on a whim due to good reviews. I found it to be lacking in any taste whatsoever and just so-so on nutrition & hydration. Not much better than water out of the tap with some juice thrown in. Why bother?
Easy to take with me, but wish it had a nicer drink from the container option.
Great realcoconut young coconut taste. Not the usual overwhelming sweet taste seen on other coconut water canned drinks.  Good on the environment. Made in Brazil. Even better.

This juice is a wonderful rehydrator. Some people swear by it's ability to help dissolve kidney stones. I've been using it for that purpose for over a year and have not had any more stones. Drink it regularly. It tastes great cold.

column9: BEWARE! I was shipped only 11 drinks instead of 12!!!!
column10: This drink is terrific, but I RECOMMEND BUYING IT FROM ANOTHER SELLER!  AMAZON SENT ME A BOX OF 11, NOT 12 (THE NUMBER THAT'S SUPPSOSED TO BE IN THE BOX) AND OF COURSE THERE'S NO ABILITY FOR ME TO CONTACT AMAZON VIA EMAIL OR PHONE TO COMPLAIN.  SO ON THIS AND ANY OTHER PURCHASE FROM AMAZON, BUYER BEWARE!!!!!!!

column9: Almost as good as the real thing!

column9: Labeling trickery: Autolyzed yeast ingredient--another name for MSG
column10: Please note that this product while listing organic ingredients also lists AUTOLYZED YEAST EXTRACTan alternate name for D-glutamate or MSG.  Is autolyzed yeast extract organic?  I don't know, I don't know the defintion of organic for food labeling, but this is food labeling trickery.Pacific Natural Foods Organic Beef BrothIngredientsOrganic beef stock (water, organic beef), Organic beef flavor base (organic roasted beef including beef juices, organic cane juice, organic beef flavor, organic onion powder, sea salt, organic canola oil, caramel color, organic garlic powder, organic black pepper, organic paprika, flavor), Sea salt, Autolyzed yeast extract, Organic garlic powderOf course it tastes good.  Autolyzed yeast extract is a flavor enhancer.  I am still looking for a commercially made broth that does not have MSG or one of its other forms/names.  You may want to check out the [...].[...] website  for more information than I have listed here.I for one will not buy it again, sorry.  Please clean up your product, Pacific.

My husband and I absolutely love this beef broth.  I use it in my cooking.  And I also heat this up in the microwave if I want to make a quick bowl of noodle soup (I just add some cooked noodles and other cooked ingredients to the broth).  It is extremely flavorful - we always drink all the broth!

This is a very flavorful beef stock. It is USDA certified organic, which is nice. It can be a little more expensive than other beef broths in the same format. I have found that it is much lower in sodium than those others though, at least the ones carried at my local grocery stores.If you are concerned about MSG sensitivity, you should be aware of all of the possible names on labeling, and read labeling very carefully. The wikipedia page has a list of allowed USDA names for MSG. Since my family isn't MSG sensitive this isn't a concern for us.I recommend this broth, assuming you are not sensitive to MSG.
I live gluten and soy free and this broth is wonderful. Use to buy it in the store. It was cheaper to buy in the bulk (surprise-not). I would recommend this broth to anyone.

Alright I am finally sitting down and doing this review. It's only been about a week since I received my Red Leaf Tea order, but I've had this tea three separate occasions since then. Every time I went to sit down and write a review - I was already finished my cup and I didn't quite know what to say.I think I understand what took me so long. This is a seriously mysterious matcha. When I opened the package and took a whiff, I associated the sweet vanilla smell with something else, but I couldn't quite put my finger on it. I whisked up a cup between 175-185 degrees - the matcha itself was bright, vegetal, creeeamy and full of vanilla deliciousness. Definite vanilla bean or real vanilla extract - a flavour that isn't sweet but is associated with baking. When I bake with my 3 tablespoons+ of real vanilla - it always smells sooo delicious and sweet, but if you were to taste it itself - it doesn't taste how it smells. That's the opposite of this matcha - it really does taste how it smells - I think that's where the mystery came from.Finally I associated the smell with the matcha whipped shortbread I made a while back. Of course! It smells and tastes like delicious flour, sugar, matcha and vanilla! Since I ate over a dozen of those cookies, it's now obvious where that taste association comes from haha. Love it.  I really want to do a comparison of this vs the new French Vanilla matcha. Subtle but delicious differences I'm sure!Oh man I just got an awesome idea. Mini matcha shortbreads for summer, using the different flavours of matcha! Ah! I can't wait to see how the flavour translates into a simple flour, butter, sugar cookie. Paired with an iced matcha. On the front porch. Okay I don't have a front porch : ( But I have the makings of the rest of it :DI don't know if I mentioned this in my other reviews - but this matcha (and the others) has an amazing echo of taste. The aftertaste of the natural flavours lingers long after I'm finished the cup. To be honest, it kind of makes me crave more. If I wasn't already bouncing off the walls with matcha energy, I might make more! No joke. This stuff packs a serious energy punch. I've been having it every morning! I feel lucky :)

I certainly would not classify this as a "blah" tea, but when I want something flavoured it isn't what I'll reach for - the vanilla flavour is there, but I had hoped for stronger. I made some before work today, and as it cooled (I find it gets better as it cools) I just kept thinking that it tasted like extra smooth regular matcha. Like a toned-down on the grassiness matcha, which isn't necessarily a bad thing. I think this would be perfect for someone who has been newly introduced to matcha, or for someone who maybe had a bad first experience. If I had tried this as my first matcha, I think I would have thought "Ooh....matcha is awesome!". What I really thought was: "This is interesting....but I think I need to try more before I decide."The Madagascar Vanilla is definitely something that I can see being great in baking or smoothies, and I have read about a few people mixing it with other flavours such as mint (that may be something I need to try in the future!). I can also see it being a go-to tea to make when I'm not sure exactly what I want. I do wonder though how different the French Vanilla matcha is from the Madagascar Vanilla. I may have to place another order soon to compare...The best thing about this matcha is that it seems to be pretty versatile...I feel like I could probably use it to extend the life of some other kinds if I really wanted to. The taste is mellow and smooth, and there is no artificial taste to the vanilla flavoring. I recently noticed that on the Red Leaf Tea website they have an option for a "2 in 1 custom matcha", and I think this would be a really awesome option to use as one of the flavors. I'm not sure I will pick up more of this when it is gone, but that is more due to the fact that there are so many different kinds that I want to try. I could see me coming back to this sometime in the future.

This here is so good its not an "in your face" vanilla but just the right touch to allow the yummy base to shine through. The base in this matcha is far better than many other matcha I have around and then to consider all the flavors this company offers! Its astounding! This particular vanilla is not as strong as some - such as french vanilla but if you want your flavors to taste as natural as the flavor additives Red Leaf Tea uses then this is your vanilla!

For the past two days every time I walk past my tin of Red Leaf Tea's Madagascar Vanilla Matcha, I have to stop and smell it. It really is an indescribable wonderful smell!I have had this Matcha in Red Leaf's "2 in 1" option combined with Caramel Matcha and it was heaven. This time around I bought each of those flavors separately so I could use them individually or combined. This past weekend, my awesome daughter bought me a Magic Bullet blender because I have been so into making tea based drinks and smoothies etc. Already I have used this amazing flavored Madagascar Vanilla Matcha to make some super scrumptious smoothies. This morning I added it to a peach greek yogurt smoothie and it was delicious. Vanilla goes so well with so many fruits such as strawberries, blueberries and raspberries. Or this Matcha is spectacular all by itself, hot or cold. This flavor Matcha remains my top favorite and I believe I will be reordering this probably every order I place with Red Leaf because you just can't go wrong with this one. (Perhaps I should give Red Leaf's French Vanilla Matcha a chance though!)Besides tasting so yummy, one cup of Matcha tea is equivalent to ten cups of green tea, so the health rewards are astronomical!

column9: Vanilla is the one for me.
column10: So now that I've caved into a growing adoration of matcha, I gave myself permission to cave to the siren's call of Red Leaf Teas. My wife already adores them for their Earls, and Tea Equals Bliss on Steepster has nothing but good things to say about their matchas, so it was an easy next step to take. And the Madagascar Vanilla Matcha was an absolute must for me.Anyway, on to the matcha. I'm in love, y'all. My wife asked how it was, and I could only put the mug down long enough to say "Oh my gawd...." Geez, I'm starting to sound like a Paula Dean special. There was no butter added to this tea, y'all, I promise. You all know how much I love vanilla, it's my chocolate, to be perfectly honest. Especially French Vanilla....mmm. Anyway, this has a creaminess that reminds me of a good French Vanilla, but without being overwhelmingly sweet like some French Vanilla teas can be. The greenness of the matcha isn't lost in the flavoring, it's a very nice balance. It doesn't taste artificial, it just tastes delicious and creamy and smooth and everything I ever wanted in a vanilla matcha. This is definitely one I plan to stock up on, once I've tried all of the ones I want to try! Next on my to buy list is cinnamon, and I'm already dreaming about mixing the cinnamon with the vanilla and drifting off into a delicious, delicious sunset! While full of excess energy, of course! Oooh, and mint for homemade, dairy-free Shamrock shakes! Mmmm....I see a lot of possibilities with this little beauty. Anywhere you need touch of creaminess, this matcha is there! Oh man, remember the blueberry pie I made with Vanilla Oolong? It would be out of this world with this matcha. And make it healthy! Well...healthy-ish.This matcha inspires me to bake and blend my own flavors and just go crazy with matcha. I used to only drink matcha occasionally, but I think this particular tea might lead me down the road of "My Morning Matcha". There are too many possiblities! Blueberries and Cream matcha, Shamrock Shakes, Dreamscicle matcha...do you see where I'm going with this? And the baking ideas are just as endless. Matcha butter cookies....oh hey, y'all! Lookie there, there is butter in this review. Dang.  I guess I am Paula Dean. I promise I will never deep fry matcha.

column9: One of my favorite decaff brands
column10: Doctor's orders: Cut down on regular coffee with caffeine. Challenge: Find a decaff that is satisfying. Answer: Caribou decaff! Some have been okay whereas others were pretty weak and didn't have a smooth taste. Caribou has a good coffee taste and is very satisfying. Overall, this represents one of my favorite decaffs for my Keurig coffee makers. Thus, Caribou is satisfying in both the regular and decaff versions.

Finally a good decaf.  I have tried several decaf coffees that were "OK" at best.  I had just purchased the Caribou (Regular) blend and was ready for disapointment when trying the decaf version.  I was extremley pleased to find it was very similar.  What a great concept, a good decaf coffee that isn't bitter or watered down.

We like a good, hearty, cup of coffee, and we drink the Caribou Blend in caffeinated coffee; Caribou Blend satisfies both my wife and me.  I like a strong coffee, and she likes the coffee more mild; this is an excellent compromise; the decaf tasted the same as the regular, so we are happy.

This easy to cook farro grain is chewy and delicious - tastes more like pasta than a grain.  Some farro requires pre-soaking and a long cooking time. column10: Love the product, love the price.  As another reviewer said, there are no basic instructions on the package.  This is not a problem for me, as a person with near-constant internet access. Outstanding product. Many don't know about farro but it tastes great and is a power health food. Great quality. Lots of ways to use it.

People got a real kick out of it!  As a kid my birthday pinatas were usually loaded with Dubble Bubble too!

column9: This is not the Fleer Dubble Bubble of old
column10: I bought this tub expecting the nostalgic Dubble Bubble smell and taste I loved as a kid. That gum was packed in the old Fleer Baseball Card wax-packs. Concord Confections bought the rights to the name from Fleer. (Subsequently Tootsie Roll bought Concord.) Anyway, The flavor formula was changed by Concord. It's now just generic bubblegum. Not only that, the size of the gum has been reduced. With clever packaging, it looks about the same size wrapped, but the gum is no longer a solid "barrel" shape. It is now a smaller barrel with gear-like teeth around it which holds the packaging out so it seems like a more substantial piece than it is. The logo is misleading too. It says, "America's Original". The name is the same but the product is very different. Looks like we have lost a sweet bit of Americana.

What ever happened to the bubble gum of old? If you expect to find it here, you will be disappointed.Bubble gum used to be a penny a piece. The penny piece was also a decent sized piece.Now, the price has jumped and the size did shrink. This is not the same Dubble Bubble gum any more.The flavor is nice, for a few seconds. Then, nothing. The pieces are also too small to blow bubbles. You need to chew two to three pieces to get a decent bubble.Maybe I should look for Bazooka Joe? (Or is he too, just a distant memory?)
I buy this for the office and the employees love it!!  gotta love double bubble!! Sometimes you just have to have a great flavor and a great bubble and this product does both!!

column9: Great Bucket of Bubble for the Price
column10: I love various flavors of the Dubble Bubble gum.  380 pieces were definitely worth the price!  I would recommend the product to any individual or group who enjoys chewing bubble gum!!
This product is great. The flavors are wonderful. Especially the blue one. I will continue to order this product. As a matter of fact, I have to order one soon. Love It!

This is the perfect Dubble Bubble tub of gum! The flavors are delicious and it is the more economical product to buy if you need a large supply but don't want to pay alot for it. It is exactly what as advertised. It's great!
The flavor literally lasts for about 30 seconds, max.  Then you have to throw it out because it's like chewing on plastic.

I order this tub of bubble gum to keep in my office, where it is available for all of the other employees to enjoy.  I work as the Purchasing Director for a small hospital, and like to always keep this bubble gum on hand.  The nurses are especially appreciative, and usually keep a couple of pieces in their pocket, for when those hunger pangs hit.  It's always fun to chew some bubble gum, and maybe even blow a few bubbles!

This gum was amazing for the amount you get and the price it was it was just bad because the flavor did not last that long but this gum is amazing for blowing bubbles and stuffing your face with like 20!!!!

For some reason I thought that this tub would contain the original bubble gum flavored gum in addition to the fruit flavors, but it doesn't. Maybe it says that in the description and I missed it. I didn't really like the pink lemonade flavor, I don't know why it's included with the fruits! I don't think I'd buy this again to be honest, the flavors were just kind of weird overall.

I first tried this cereal when Whole Foods carried it for a few months. Then they stopped carrying it, so now I order 6 boxes at a time from Amazon. It's delicious stuff. I always loved oatmeal, but when I had to cut out gluten, it seemed impossible to find an instant cereal as good as Quaker Oats. This Eco Planet cereal is not artificially sweet, which might take people some getting used to, but it's very tasty.I did try microwaving it, but, after several messy explosions due to winging the amount of water instead of measuring properly, I went back to making it the old-fashioned way by boiling water in a kettle.

the search for a great (not just good) hot breakfast cereal that is gluten free is over.  This is the best, cooks up easy in the microwave.  I use more then the recommended 1/2 cup of water.  Try a full cup for 1min.35sec in the microwave and it gets really fluffy.
Use this instead of breadcrumbs or oatmeal to make meatloaf - always turns out great.  Let the cereal sit and absorb the liquid ingredients of your recipe for best results.
Unfortunately, this product seems to not agree with my stomach, and it provides me none of the promised digestive benefits of oatmeal.
This cereal is pretty good.  I accidentally chose the unflavored and that is why I gave it three stars.  It is great for people who like plain, hot cereal that they can flavor themselves, though.
Ate them all in a week-too good to be true. I will have to learn to pace myself. These cookies are the best! I had never tried before.

I ordered 4 bags of these cookies and 95% of the cookies in each bag was crumbled. I wasn't positive that they were all broken until we opened the last bag. I ended up discarding about 1/2 of the cookies.

Cookies tasted fine and were used to top ice cream sincethe cookies came to me all broken in very small pieces.I've ordered cookies on here before and have never encounteredthis problem until this order.

column4: Angel_Boy "Treat the people around you the wa...
column10: the cookies are dry and crispy like most of these bagged cookies are. i was hoping for more chocolate and peanutbutter taste. i would not pay more than $2ish a bag for these 13 ounce bags. i won't be ordering these by the 4 packs anymore. it would be nice if amazon offered these 4 packs with different varieties of cookies instead of all the same. They're not bad but they're not all that good either. i won't buy again- there are better cookies out there. but you might love them, or you might hate them- for me, they were middle of the road.  good luck whatever you choose.
What's better than peanut butter and chocolate. These cookies were hard to put down. Only one bag left. So I'm ordering more today.

Zuke's produces some great products. Recently, I tried the "Natural Purrz" healthy moist cat treats (Savory Salmon flavored). The nice things about these treats is that they are low-calorie (only 2 calories per little moist treat). Also, Zuke's products are made with high quality protein and grains, and all ingredients come from the US (Made in the USA!). That said, these small treats remind me of my cat's monthly Heartgard medication - it's only palatable to some cats. Seamus, my fatty tabby, likes these, but not as much as the Greenie crunchy treats. Echo, my svelt black cat, won't touch these moist treats. Overall, they are a great option for a low-calorie treat, but use in moderation. It also comes in a "tender chicken" flavor.The active ingredients in Natural Purrz (Savory Salmon) include: salmon, barley flour, rice flour, vegetable glycerin, malted barley, tapioca, gelatin, water, menhaden fish oil, brewer's yeast, natural flavors, lecithin, cultured whey, acetic acid, salt. Vitamins and Minerals: Vitamins A, D3, E, B12, taurine, ascorbic acid (Vitamin C) calcium pantothenate, riboflavin (B2) niacin, thiamine mononitrate (B1), pyridoxine hydrochloride (B6), folic acid, zinc oxide, sodium selenite (source of selenium).So, overall, one paw down for overall palability... That said, they don't go to waste - while the protein content is likely too high for my dog, JP loves these as small additions to his Kong toy...

We have lovingly dubbed these treats "kitty crack". Our 11 year old lynx point siamese goes NUTS for these treats. He will follow you anywhere and comes running if he even hears the bag being jostled. I like that they are natural, but would prefer if they were completely grain free. They are small enough to be eaten quickly, but just soft enough that they are easy to break apart for training. Definitely a favorite in our house now!

The Cats absolutely love these things! They are all natural too, which I love, and my poor male cat has almost no teeth and these are the only natural treat I can find for him that he can eat comfortably. They are soft and I cut them in half for him. They smell really good too.. Like meat!

As soon as I started opening these, my cat began sniffing the air.  The next thing I knew she was beside me begging for a treat.  She gobbled them down like there was no tomorrow.  The same thing has happened each time I get them out.  She gives them a 5 paw review.

My cat has food allergies - he can't have chicken, turkey, corn, or soy, among other things. So finding cat treats he can have has been a challenge, especially when he decided he didn't like the simple dried fish or freeze-dried beef lung type of treats. However, he goes completely wild for these! Since they use rice flour & tapioca as the binder, they don't trigger his allergies. YMMV, cats are very individual in their tastes, but if you have a cat with food allergies, you may want to give these a try.

My two kittens (6 & 7 Months) don't even think about eating these (Salmon flavor). I don't think they even recognize that they are food.The good news is, after they leave them on the floor they come back later and play soccer with them, which they do enjoy (so thats why it gets 2 instead of one star).(Bought at local pet store for about $1.50 more than amazon's price, for what its worth.

column9: Good, healthy option, but my cat does not like them
column10: I bought these as a healthier option for my cat's treats, but she won't even touch them. She does however like the chicken flavor of the same brand. If you have a finicky cat, you might want to try the other flavor.

Got my order quickly. It's difficult to find chicken free food and treats and these were a good price. Saved me trips to numerous trips to the store.  My cats loves these too. Although, I don't recall getting an invoice w the shipment, but it may have been there.

column9: Even the pickiest cats will like these!
column10: My cat does not like any cat treats.  We have tried every single one!  We purchased these treats at an SPCA benefit and tried them.  The cat LOVES them.  She will chase them around the house and savor them.  They seem siliar in consistency (and smell) to the Bil-Jac treats for dogs (although they aren't the same thing).  I think the meatiness of the treat is what my cat likes ... not a lot of fluff.

i was surprised at how much my little marlee loves these snacks ... a real winner!  these treats are definitely on the soft/moist side which is what i need for a kitty who doesn't drink water.  even though they are small, i will cut each one in half to use as small training treats.  i'll definitely be buying more of these.

column9: Human interpretation of cat behavior or yummy in my cat tummy
column10: How does one know what exactly the cat thinks of these?  I can only go by observation and 2 out of 3 cats go nuts for them, i.e. begging, meowing, jumping, meowing, circling, meowing.  I was worried they were too hard as I can hardly break one in half, but that doesn't slow them down - even my 11-year-old tabby.  The taste must outweigh the gnawing and smacking necessary.  More proof: a side-by-side taste test revealed both cats will choose these first before Whisker Lickin's brand treats.  But of course they will hog down the 2nd place treats in a blink too.  I gave a 4 star since I do think they are rather hard.  I also appreciate the free shipping. I will order again.

I have 6 cats and am always looking for new kitty items. Most of my cats loved these. Out of the 6 only 1 refused to eat them. Another ate it but did not seem real impressed and the other 4 gobbled them up like there was no tomorrow. This is an item I will buy for them again.

I got these treats for my two cats who are not really that picky.  They seemed to like them and begged for more like usual.  They are pretty firm for a semimoist treat.  They almost look wax like but the cats chows them down with pleasure.  I have ordered them more than once from Amazon already.
Cats love them - both the chicken and salmon flavors.  They also offer a glucosamine chondroitin product (for cats with joint pain) that is much less expensive than some alternatives.

column9: Kitty Doesn't Like 'Em, But I'm Sure they'd be good for her!
column10: I give this product three stars because I love Zuke's for our dog, and I am sure that if our cat would eat these, they'd be way better for her than the high fructose corn syrup crud she prefers.  But the sad truth is, she doesn't like em.  And for a cat that will steal pickles, I think that's saying something.

The spices on the peanuts detract from the peanut taste.  I have taken a handful and washed them in water to get rid of the spices.  I don't know anyone who has tried them that thought that the spices enhanced the taste of the nuts.
Is is  specially recommended for light snacks with tea. Deep roasted toast with cardamom flavour enhances the flavour. Its just awesome!!!!

Are you hankering for your mom's or grandmother's macaroni and cheese but need to eat gluten-free?  If so, this is the pasta for you.  It's been a staple in my GF kitchen for YEARS. It cooks up like a dream and tastes like the "real thing".  You won't be able to tell it from "regular" elbow macaroni.  Just make sure not to cook it much past "al dente" -- add a drop of oil to the boiling water (I use olive oil) -- and give your pasta a cold water rinse when you've reached perfect done-ness.

column9: Best price for DeBoles corn elbows
column10: Corn pasta is great in some dishes, especially macaroni and cheese. (It does have its own flavor.) Cook elbows,but not too long or they will get mushy. Add some type of "Velveeta"-tpye cheese and sharp white shredded cheddar. You'll never taste any better, with or without gluten! Mac & cheese is the whole reason we buy the corn pasta at all. It works great with cheddar. We usually use rice pastas, but the price on Amazon was even lower than what we pay for Tinkyada pastas. For us the 12-pack will never go to waste. We both can eat all the mac & cheese we want now, instead of saving it for only special occaisions because of price (and I'm not celiac).It is GF, has no MSG or related products, no aspartates.

column9: Great product for the gluten free diet
column10: We have purchased many gluten free products for my husband, who suffers from gluten alergies.  Most have tasted like sand, being very gritty and bland.  Deboles is one of the best!  All of their corn products have a great consistency and taste.  Purchasing through Amazon is the best deal around.  Yes, you have to purchase in packs of 12, but the price makes it worth it.  Our son has a 15% chance of developing the same allergy.  Therefore, we cut out as much gluten from his diet as possible.  This is an inexpensive way to get him on the right course.

I use Deboles Corn Elbows in all the recipes I liked before I discovered I was gluten-intolerant and I can hardly tell the difference.  Cook six minutes, no more, to retain just the right degree of firmness.  One of our favorite dishes is a casserole made with Deboles Corn Elbows.  It contains ground beef, chopped onion, chopped green pepper, whole tomatoes and tomato sauce, cheese, oregano and garlic salt.  I was pleased to find Deboles Corn Elbows retains its firmness if there's any left over for the next meal.  We like it so well we subscribed to regular shipments in bulk.

Product delivered as promised.  The pasta is very good holds together very well when prepared as directed.  My wife is glutton intolerant so we have a bit of experience over the last 10 years with glutton free products and this is one of the best.  The price is good - all glutton free products cost more but this one is competitive with the lowest prices we have paidl

Amazon carries a wide range of products for the gluten-free consumer. We enjoy the quality and taste of this brand of pastas and finding them available as super-saver shipped was a boon. Because they come in cartons of 12 boxes, I always know what I have on hand to use before the next shipment. I am saving over $12.00 a box over the supermarket or health-food store price. This service makes gluten-free shopping so much easier.
Very tastey.  I have celiac disease and must be very discreet in my food purchases.  This is a great deal.  I can feed three adults when served with one can of chili.Ron

I agree this product from Deboles is excellent.  Not all of their products are this good.  We don't like their rice products at all.  We stumbled across their elbow corn noodles and they are the best.  The kids and I can't tell the difference between regular noodles and these noodles.  If your looking for a great option try them.  I doubt you will be disappointed!
It is a good "al dente " alternative to rice pasta. Cooks in 7-9 minutes and it doesn't turn into mush when mixed to the sauces. My girl loves it with just Parmigiano and olive oil.

This is our favorite pasta.  It is delicious.  Myself and my daughter have gluten sensitivity.  We LOVE this.  It doesn't get mushy like rice pasta.  It really holds it's form.  My husband and other daughter really enjoy it.  My husband says he can't tell the difference between this and unbleached flour pasta.  We really enjoy it.  Hope you will too.

It says about 80 times on this page that this pasta is organic, but it's not. There's no USDA label on the box pictured and the De Boles site makes no mention of this or its other corn pasta being organic. Other than that, although I'm loyal to Mrs. Leeper's, this is good stuff and is appropriate for celiacs.

NO ONE WILL EVER KNOW IT IS NOT WHEAT MACARONI.  NO NEED TO WORRY ABOUT BUYING IN BULK...IT WILL BE GONE BEFORE YOU KNOW IT.  NO KIDDING.  DEBOLES CORN PASTAS' TEXTURE AND TASTE FAR EXCEED OTHER GLUTEN FREE PASTAS.

column9: It tastes like corn.  It's also not gluten free, as of this writing.
column10: This has a really good texture; whether you like it or not will depend on how sensitive you are to how things taste--this tastes like corn.  If you're cooking something like beef stroganoff, it's a plus that this tastes like corn. However, with tomato sauce, it's not a good combination.The other thing about this, is if you're eating it because you have celiac, you should be aware that there may be cross-contamination issues.  Deboles' pasta is made in a factory that also processes wheat pastas.  (And there are those with celiac who are convinced this pasta makes them sick.)  So, if avoiding gluten is really important, get Tinkyada rice pasta instead.Edit:  I did a challenge on this, meaning I ate only this pasta for a day.  It's not gluten free.  Note that this is a subsidiary of Hain Food Group, which, when the new FDA standard on gluten free labeling came in--20ppm or less--stopped labeling its foods with small amounts of barley and slapped on a gluten-free label--and then just waited for celiacs to get sick and get mad at them.  FDA, are you listening?

I fell in love with these mints while living in the UK this past summer. They are the perfect mix of sweet peppermintiness and blazing heat. They are like a candy cane on steroids. I particularly like how they clear out my sinuses. Seriously, I use them medicinally in conjunction with Olbus Oil so I can breath through my chronically stuffed-up nose. All this and minty fresh breath, too. Please, please Trebor folks--start selling these in the US!

column9: These are the best mints ever!!!!!
column10: I have tried every mint, breath freshener made by man and absolutely nothing beats Trebor Mints for freshness!!!!!  It's just too bad that you cannot purchase them in the US

These are good mints for the price, but when they say "extra strong" I assume they really meant "extra strong". I've had stronger mints than these, but I suppose they are good enough for me. If you really want strong mints you should look elsewhere.

My husband saw these online awhile ago, but thought they were too expensive (even though he had them in his youth).  I had to order for a Christmas gift. He loves them, and says they remind him of a good times from his youth.  He said they are just as good now as 40 years ago.  I will definitely order these for him again.

It's hard to find these in the US but this reseller was able to ship them too me.  They end up quite a bit expensive but I ration them out and then stock up when i go over.  The makes a much cheaper alternative then "just poping over to get mints".  Anyway, these are better than Altoids!

The first ingredient in this formulation is mineral oil - olive oil is the fourth. I was underwhelmed by the results of using this oil; a little goes a long way but it basically coats your hair.I don't consider mineral oil a "nourishing" property. This oil only gave my hair some sheen. I csn't say it contributed to the overall health of my hair any and it definitely didn't diminish the winter breakage. I feel better adding a little extra virgin olive oil to my hair conditioner. That yields far better results.

This is the best brand of hair oil I have ever used.My hair was very bad from chemically treating it ,due to highlights and permanent straightening. I did an extensive study of ayurvedic treatment for hair on the internet and came to the conclusion that jasmine oil was the best. I did not get jasmine oil ,but found this brand on in the Indian store I went to. It worked wonders for my hair, now my hair is long shiny and thick, I am 55 years too, and will no longer fool around with my hair.

Love this and the coconut hair oil.  I use it as a deep treatment.  Warm the oil, massage into hair, wrap with a warm towel and let sit for 30min or longer.  Shampoo/condition out and style--your hair will look amazing.  My hair is so shiny and healthy looking after this.  I use this weekly or fortnightly now.  This is a must have for me.

Magnificent smell and great for your hair, that is all I can say. Compared to coconut oil, this oil does not have harsh smell, rather it has a pleasant smell to it. Recommend it for people who would like to care for their hair.
I first got to use this oil about 3 months ago.  I love the smell of it and it is very healthy for my hair.  Great such for the price.

column9: Dabur Vatika Olive Enriched Hair Oil
column10: Dabur Vatika Olive Enriched Hair Oil contains Virgin Olive Oil and nourishing extracts of Almonds, Cactus & Lemon. Vatika's unique formulation ensures deeper oil penetration to give your hair and scalp complete natural nourishment for problem free, beautiful hair.I love using Olive Oil on my hair since I started going natural. Olive Oil keep my hair and scalp moisturized. It's great for pre shampoo treatment overnight or at least an hour before washing. Add the olive oil to your hair then cover with a plastic cap or plastic bag, the longer you leave the oil in the more moisture your hair with have especially if your washing with shampoo and not co-washing. It's also great as an added ingredient for a protein treatment. A can of coconut milk and 3 cap fulls of olive oil, mix, distribute to hair, leave in for an hour, then wash out. Try not to deep condition with heat after the protein treatment, it will cause breakage... sitting out for an hour doing chores or under the sun will help the conditioner.Olive oil is very beneficial and you will love how your hair look and feel after every use of this product. I use it so much that I purchase 3 or more at once, I can't see myself with it. While waiting when I'm out I also use GOYA cooking olive oil... it's all the same.Will definitely recommend this product!

column9: Great hair oil but with a smell
column10: This is a great hair oil. Not too greasy, but enough to keep my hair well-tamed. And the ingredients look good, except for the mineral oil perhaps. It has a noticeable smell that is not as overwhelming as that of some other hair oils I have tried, and it does not linger as much after application. But I would have liked it to not have any smell at all.

column9: Flavorful, but not the same as in restaurants
column10: My wife bought this in the hopes of recreating one of our favorite dishes at home since making butter chicken from scratch seems to be a very involved process.  While this product has a good taste, it is not a substitute for restaurant style butter chicken.  Also, the preparation was not as easy as the package instructions elude to.  The product is a spice/ oil mix that is to be wisked with water until it is smooth.  This never turned into a smooth paste for us; it did not dissolve in the water and pressing the product against the sides of the bowl was the only way for it to eventually mix with the water.  She even had to strain the water mixture to make sure there weren't clumps of spice mix in the sauce before adding the mixture to the browned chicken.We will not be buying this again mostly because it is not to our taste.  But, if you like flavorful chicken with a little bit of work, this is a quick meal preparation.

Should've figured this out- a product that is shipped unrefrigerated can't have any dairy in it, and therefore cannot contain any of the wonderful filling of real tiramisu.  It't more like sponge cake with generic, flavorless 'creme' spread inside.  No coffee taste, no liquor-soaked ladyfingers, no cool creamy dairy; boring.  Not worth the calories.

This product arrived already stale, and quickly became more stale. My prior order arrived fresh but became stale overnight. If you don't plan on immediately eating a pound of peanuts, I'd make my own chili peanuts using Planters from the grocery. Recipes are easy to find. I won't be ordering this product ever again.

This paste is wonderful - bought at our local Inidan grocer for $4.99 so this is a good deal on Amazon for anyone not in a Indian grocery store area.  You can save tons of time not having to get out all your spices, morter and pestle, etc.  We find that if we just stir-fry with a little extra oil, some onions, maybe a little slice of fresh ginger, then mix in vegetables and meat (chicken needs to be cooked/browned separately however), some water if necessary for veges, and you soon have a dish you swear someone from India prepared for you.  Tonight we had this sauce cooked with beef, mixed in cauliflower, diced up idaho potatoes, carrots slices, onions, and it was delicous.  Served with some frozen naan from Trader Joes that heats up in toaster oven in just a few minutes, along with basmati rice - browned first then add 3 cups of water to 1 cup of basmati rice and cover for 25 minutes or until scattered holes.  What a great meal and this paste is an amazing time saver.  This is the way to go.  I was just thinking of how I wished I had discovered this paste when I first discovered that I loved Indian food when I lived in NYC in my early 20's in grad school.  If only I had know the tricks such as using a paste like this, I would be making indian food at my apartment all the time.  Back then I lived in the east village and walked over (just 4 blocks away) to the famous 6th street Indian restaurants of the several times per week.  When I moved to SF, I lived luckily just a block from Shalimar for many years and was a regular customer.  Now, I'm in suburbs with kids so for indian cooking, I now use 1,000 Indian Recipes by Neelam Batra - which I call my "Joy of Cooking for Indian Food" - it has everything.  Buy this paste, along with the Vindaloo and Biryani sauce, and you'll be glad you did.  My 3 year old girl just looked at me, eating some of the cut up beef cooked in this sauce, announcing "This is good"!  Now that's a winner.

Yes, if you like Indian food, you will likely find this very good.  There is a distinct cinnamon aroma and taste to the curry, and it's quite spicy.Preparation is fairly simple--just throw some onions, chicken, and chopped tomatoes in a pan, and add only THREE tablespoons plus some water.  Simple and fast, although if you want the curry to thicken properly you may want to cook it a little longer.Since you use only a few tablespoons this jar will last quite a long time.

Another way to cook with the paste is to make it like a paella. Using a large skillet with a cover, you can saute veggies (e.g., onions, garlic, red pepper, celery, carrots or any combo thereof), add in some boneless chicken breast (or fish) cut bite-size. Then add in the paste and stir to spread it, and possibly some canned diced tomatoes. Add rice with enough water to cook it. Basmati works well. Stir occasionally to spread the mixture evenly and so the rice doesn't stick and you'll have a wonderful dish!
The spices are good, but it would be much better if you had the ground spices rather than a paste.  However, the paste is good in a pinch.  It has a good flavor and a nice kick.

I ordered this Garam Masala paste, as my husband and I have recently started cooking Indian food.  Open it's arrival at my door step, the cardboard was covered in oil. The product had leaked out through the bubble wrap. It was clearly not packaged well.  I've submitted a photo of the package and product condition.  Hoping Amazon steps up to replace it.
these are probably the best vanilla beans I have tried - moist, flavorful, and smell delicious.
These high quality beans were delivered fresh and delicious.  We mix them with vodka for homemade vanilla.
Great beans.  Nothing like homemade real vanilla.  Split them and let them soak in vodka for 5 to 6 months and you will never buy store bought vanilla again.

column9: Strong but not the same as the stores
column10: These beans aren't quite the same as what you get in the store (McCormick)  These have a slightly more bitter scent and taste to them, not quite as sweet and smooth.Still very strong, aromatic and flavorful vanilla!
These vanilla beans have become a staple in my kitchen.  The flavor is so wonderful that I no longer buy vanilla ice cream -- I make it.  There is nothing to compare!
My first purchase of real vanilla beans, and these smell so wonderful.  These are very fresh (should be moist and flexible when you receive them) and they add a wonderful flavor to your foods.

It's very filling and has big pieces throughout.  I order 2 packs every month.  My adult son is over 6'4" and he has at least 2 bowls a day.  He feels very satisfied after every meal without gaining weight.

column9: SO MUCH EXPECTATION, SO LITTLE STOCK
column10: ~ I got this after hearing how someone else liked it so much, then when I got it I realized I had gotten duuped again. Having previously vowed to never eat canned products from old favorite brands, like Campbells that changed their traditional recipes, & this was one.~ I opened the can & saw how watery, salty, & unordinarily yellow it was, which eventually turned out to be the exorbitant amount of MSG.~ After measuring the amount of stock & dumplings, by the frequency in spoonfuls, I found them lacking, whereas every spoonful was not with a chicken chunk or a dumpling. The so called chicken chunks were like little taste sizes & coming up only after maybe 5 spoonfuls of strong watery MSG, as well as the dumplings which were at largest the size of a pinkie digitalis and only coming up less frequently than the chicken bits.~ HOW I GOT OVER IT:~ When it comes to MSG I know my chemistry & I also know that sugar beet juice will neutralize it, as well as it's carcinogenic effects. (So I added enough for no more salty MSG taste or it's after effects).~ I also add a can of mixed vegetables to make up for the lack there of, then add some mayonaisse for creaminess~ Yes, you may also add more chicken & dumplings. LOL~ Campbell has permanently lost a loyal customer in me by joining the long list of food makers that cheat on taste & quality when it comes to traditional food products.

I love (nearly) all things coconut and this tea is no exception. First, the scent of this tea is phenomenal. When I received it, I opened the box and just kept sniffing the tea. It is heavenly. When I was finally able to pull my nose out of the bag, I made a cup and the earth stopped moving, all my troubles melted away and I was filled with a coconut induced happiness.The flavor is incredibly smooth. Each day, after drinking this tea, I look at my other teas and say "maybe I will resume drinking them tomorrow." I cannot resume drinking them because I enjoy this tea so much and the other teas pale in comparison. I occasionally add a little agave but I find the coconut flakes add a natural touch of sweetness to this brew.All of the packaging for this tea is eco-friendly.  So you get a deliciously crafted tea from a company that is earth friendly.  Highly recommended.

This is now my morning staple, since it is heavenly with milk and sugar.  It consists of good quality black tea and coconut pieces (shreds). It's rare to find flavored teas that are organic -- another plus!

Where to start?  This tea leaves are beautifully fragrant- but not overwhelmingly so.  Whenever you open the bag, you get a good waft of coconut, but it's not enough to make you separate it from your other teas.  The tea itself tastes very nice.  I'm usually horrible about sugar in my tea and add too much of it, but this tea was beautiful on its own.  It's a little strong, but then black tea is, and the coconut flavor was definitely present.I would buy this tea again, and I WILL as soon as I run out, which will be soon.  All of my friends have been stopping by for a cup!

column9: Great tea as an afternoon treat
column10: This is a great tea.  The coconut in it almost gives it a touch of sweetness.  The flavor of the coconut does not overwhelm the taste of the tea, instead it compliments it.  I had this tea ten years ago when working at an inn and had to make the afternoon tea service.  I would choose this tea over all the others we had on hand from this company. I was so happy to discover it again.

I bought this tea to have at work, I think I may need to buy another one for home. It is so good! The coconut taste is a perfect sweetner. I don't normally add anything to my tea and sometimes it is a bit bitter, but this is perfect!

I was a little scared to purchase this tea because it is a somewhat pricey but i have loved tea for as long as i can remember so i thought i would give it a chance. Boy am i happy i did. When i opened the box i could immediately smell the coconut. I made a cup within the first 30 mins, some soy milk and a little agave nectar and i was in heaven. This tea is a real treat. After i finish this batch i plan on trying many many different blends from this company. It says it is best to transfer this tea to a tin box which i will invest in one now, that's the only draw back. I would recommend this to anyone.

The tea tastes great-but the packaging could be better. It comes loose inside a plastic bag which does not reseal-you have to immediately transer the contents to tupperware or something that wont expose it to the air.
I love this tea.  But, I didn't know it was loose tea.  I bought my own empty tea bags and bag the tea myself.  It's worth it.  Delicious!
I was disappointed with these. They tasted somewhat stale compared to what I've had before. Won't be ordering them again.
These are so convenient for those mornings when running late or for a cranky toddler in the car or out shopping. Takes away the hungrys and happiness returns. Great for work too! Love them!

This hideous stuff is indescribably vile! Do yourself a favor and channel yer greenbacks into some flowers fer grandma!Let's take a quick look at the product's promotional spiel, shall we?Instantto Coffee Co. takes great pride in offering an assortment of gourmet coffee products for all to enjoy [BS]. Each beverage is made using only top quality ingredients [BS]. Pure coffee is a well known source of antioxidants and offers many health benefits. Every recipe begins with an Aromatic and Flavorful Columbian instant coffee, never a coffee flavored substitute [BS]. After enjoying this delectable drink, try Instantto Coffees other extended gourmet coffee lines. Always made fresh and ready for an instant "coffee house" experience at home [BS], in the office or On the Go. Always fresh, Always Instantto, [Always BS!]Now...check-out this bogus testimonial. The taste is very special and delicious [BS]! I love that I can buy it over the internet because I don't go often to AZ. The servings are exactly as you'd expect and it really has a fresh scent to it [BS].
