I love this stuff. Tastes great, I find it calming. I offer it to guests who have given it positive reviews as well. Yogi makes great teas and this is one of my favorites.

I picked this up hoping to find something that was similar to a more expensive brand.  I've found that two bags of this with a bag of peppermint steeped together is almost exactly like that expensive "natural" beauty care brand that is more than $2/serving.It is a little bit sweet, and per the other reviews, I steep it in water that's just off a boil for 10 minutes.  It's just the right strength, and a bit spicy, but the flavor is really enjoyable.  It's just the little bit of relaxation I need to be able to get ready to get some rest.  This will be on my grocery list for a long time.

I wasn't sure what to expect with this tea but I gave it a shot. After about 30 seconds of the packet seeping in the water, I was in love with the smell. I couldn't wait to try the tea and I'm glad someone sent me this tea as a gift...its delicious! It has this subtle sweet taste with just a hint of spice and is very calming to drink. I'm a huge fan of tea and coffee in general and this will now be one of my favorites to keep on stock.

I love Yogi teas in general, but this particular one (Kava Stress Relief) is a great 'pick-me-up.'  Seems to soothe mild anxiety and anxiousness.  Nice tea to have a cup or two before bed too. NOTE:  It does have a unique flavor to it...recommend adding honey, Jolly Roger candy of your flavor choice or even a peppermint hard candy...any of which I add to tea on occassion anyway.

I enjoy many teas and Kava is one of my favorites.  It has a pleasant taste and it actually sweet so you don't need to add anything to it.  It does have a nice calming effect which is also nice at times.
love this tea and it is a very good deal. I'd say by it an you won't go wrong! If you want the best deal I found it is here

I drank 2-3 cups of this on a few different occasions and I can say that to me it was really nice. I have insomnia problems so I don't think it put me to sleep as fast as it did some other I have let try this, but it's a great product and I really enjoy it. The people who have tried explained they have had some of the best sleep so I am a fan and will be purchasing more. It also came with six individual boxes which was more than I expected. They say that right on the advertising but it seemed like a great quantity for the price as well. Thanks again amazon

column9: Sleepytime Tea with One Major Drawback.
column10: I happen to love the effects of this tea. I am an insomniac and all my medicine without my sleeping pill cannot help me sleep. This with my meds (sans sleeping pill) will allow me to sleep-- which is great. The flavor is sweet and mild, however even in the 2nd sip of tea it produces this weird numb, tingling sensation. It's very bothersome to me. I'm assuming that is telling me the Kava is working, which is why I keep downing the cup-- however it stops me from enjoying it too much.However, I'm keeping it around for when I'm having trouble sleeping, run out of sleeping pills, or have a really rough day/bad pain (I also have chronic pain, and it seems to relax me a bit, which helps.)Since most people don't even note this in their reviews, I'm probably just extra sensitive to this effect.

I have used Kava for a few years.  As of the past few months, I take it at night with the two tea bags and honey, let is seep for 5 min or so and drink before bed along with Melatonin.  Within a half hour, I can hardly keep my eyes open.  I don't have a hangover or tired feeling in the morning.  I sleep right through.  I tried everything but this works the best for me.  Gave to a few friends that say it has helped them sleep as well.

I love all of Yogi teas for different reasons, and this tea definitely owns a category of teas to itself! Unlike the average "sleepy time" teas out there, this tea is very soothing and for me, calming for mild anxiety. It doesn't make me tired, but it definitely puts me in a calmed state when I sit down for this tea. I call this my "Hindu Cow" tea for that reason! Not to mention is it DELISH, unique but smooth and good, not offensive like some teas that claim to do things for the body. It's very affordable! And I like the little sayings on the tags too.
This tea is delicious, it reminds me a bit of spice chai. From the first sip to the last it calms your nerves and lets you relax. I will definitely be subscribing to this!

I love Kava tea by Yogi. I used to purchase this in the local health food store, but they stopped carrying it after negative publicity of possible liver problems from Kava. I was pleased to find it on Amazon. Free shipping and the discount for "subscribing" makes it a deal too good to pass up.As far as the product itself, I love the taste of this Kava tea. I have a cup in the evening, and it is really soothing and relaxing. I could not imagine winding down in the evening without this tea.
I love It!!!! I have a very stressfull job , It relaxes me . I recommend this 100%...I love it...The moon cycle tea for your menstrual cycle is the BEST!!!!
However its way over priced, you can find this at prices way cheaper than advertised here.
I really like this tea!! I was surprised Amazon had it for such a low price.

I am a tea lover. I drink atleast 3/4 cups of Yogi, Tazo or other brands of tea during the work day. I specifically love yogi tea...I bought a packet of this particular pack over a month ago and I actually do not care for the taste of it. It almost has a rotten, bitter taste to it although there is a sweet liquorish top taste to it. It almost tastes a bit pungent and I actually have a hard time drinking it. I feel this need to not waste money so I am trying to finish out the box and I wish that I did not have to. So I give it a 2 star. It's just not my cup of tea.

I discovered this in my basket as I was checking out at the store.  It seems one of my little darlings saw this and thought he would help mommy.  The ingredients were acceptable so I tried it.  I love it.  It tasted great and I have started sleeping through the night.
I bought the stress relief. The box says it is stress relief but when I opened it, it was breathe right!And it CANNOT be returned! What a waste of money! Don't get fooled!

This tea would be nice if wasn't so sweet.  The cinnamon tastes great but the sweetness is very strange and overpowering and ruins the tea.  I use stevia to sweeten other teas and my coffee and it's not sweet like it is in this tea.  The effects are nice however, 4 hours later I do have a bit of a headache.  I may look for another Kava tea or perhaps try it in another form.

I'm traditionally a big fan of Yogi teas, but this one was an unpleasant surprise. It tastes like it smells, a bit like a cup of hot chocolate that's gone off and has begun to sprout mold. I managed two cups, hoping I'd get used to the taste, but in the end, I had to pitch the lot as it made my entire cupboard stink. Looking at the ingredients list, I think carob, chocolate's oft lackluster understudy, is to blame.

Obviously Kava Kava has long-ago been proven to be a very effective means to relax, and this is an excellent brand in my opinion for a cup.  You've likely heard that too much Kava Kava could possibly damage your liver, if that's the case ( that you are considering same as a reason to not try Kava Kava ) and you currently have a health liver, then you might consider taking a good form of Milk Thistle extract ( Silymarin, NOW Foods brand is my preference ) 3 times a day, for a couple of months at a time perhaps bi-annually.  Taking this simple precaution is a possible way to keep your liver safe enough to enjoy a couple cups or so of Kava Kava a week.

column9: this is the best tea in the world i drink it3 times a day!
column10: like i said i drink it 3 times a day. and i got many others addicted to this tea, hehe. actually im gonna have some right now. laterz!

column9: Not all it's cracked up to be
column10: First of all, make sure you really like the taste of licorice. The licorice flavor is very strong in this, easily overpowering everything else. I could barely choke down a cup. Also, Stevia has an after taste to me. Always has, and this was no exception. Admittedly, I was hoping with all the other herbs--i.e. cinnamon and ginger amongst others--in here, those two flavors would be overpowered. I was wrong. Did this product work after I forced it down my throat? No! What worked was the two capsules I took of kava kava liquid phyto-caps from Gaia Herbs. I'll also be trying their liquid extract--in a cup of chai latte tea I make myself.
I drink all types of teas, but this is one of the worst tasting teas, in my opinion.

Please be careful, I did not read the product description so I do not know if they mentioned this but, kava can cause SEVERE LIVER TOXICITY, even without prior liver damage, please consult your physician before taking this or any other supplement!Thanks

column9: Don't blame amazon, blame the stupid third party sellers.
column10: Don't blame amazon, blame the stupid third party sellers. Amazon shouldn't allow people to sell at this stupid prices. It makes amazon look bad, since some people don't know if it's a third party seller or amazon itself.

I can buy 2 12-packs at a local EXPENSIVE grocery store for a total of $14.  I came to Amazon looking for good prices, not a rip off like this!  22 dollars for 24 bottles (plus shipping!!) is outrageous!

I spent my childhood back in Croatia and if one thing I remember is Cokolino.There are different tastes but the flakes cereal with chocolate are the best.I have a baby again and Vivian is simply addicted to cokolino.Mix it with warm milk and make it thicker or mix it in the bottle and I guarantee that your baby won't wake up hungry all night.
Young or old...this is the best cereal on this whole entire world...so creamy, so chocolaty, so good.  Kids love cokolino!!!!!

Over the years, I have been served honey in packets and cups at diners and restaurants many, many times, just as have most Americans. I've enjoyed it in tea, on biscuits, and on yummy sopaipillas. Honey really seems to bring out the wonderful flavor of good buttermilk biscuits and sopaipillas. (And if you've never had sopaipillas, RUN, don't walk to the Great Southwest and try them. They make your eyes roll back they are so good) ... but I digress.The key to honey on these great American foods is that it has to be a delicate flavored honey to complement rather than overpower them...which is what I have always experienced with these little single-serve packets of honey ... a lovely golden liquid that melts in your mouth, and is chosen for its mild flavor for exactly the use I have described. But, to put it in the vernacular, this ain't that. This honey is dark, and VERY strong. When the box arrived from Amazon today, I made a batch of buttermilk biscuits and sat down to enjoy a real treat. Unfortunately, it was no treat at all. The strong flavor of this honey overpowered the delicate flavor of the biscuits. It was very disappointing.So, if like me, you are hoping for the light golden sweetness usually provided by these little cups, look elsewhere, lest you be disappointed too. But if you like strong honey, like say, buckwheat, and you want the convenience of single serving cups, then this is for you.
As always, this product is excellent!  I order it for the pantry in my workplace's kitchen area.  Everyone enjoys having honey with their tea.

This is Turkish gum. I am living in US but Turkish and I missed a lot Turkish Gum. What is different from regular gums you can find in US or Canada is the taste of the gum, it does not include or taste any sugar products. Therefore, you can taste the taste of gum not sugar, this is really good for teeth, I strongly recommend you to taste it.

I have been eating this pasta for a year now and I have never found one that's better (and I lived in Italy for years). It is lighter and much less sticky than regular refined flour pasta and also adds beneficial bacteria to your intestinal system (or so they say).  I wish I had known about it before trying every gooey whole wheat or regular pasta on the market.

Amazon is incorrectly advertising this product as "gluten free".  The first ingredient of this product is Durum Semolina, which is well known for having the highest gluten content of all wheat products.So, Celiacs and people with gluten-allergies, DO NOT ORDER THIS!  This pasta will only make you sick!!!!

I tried this product after trying to convert my husband to healthier eating. He put his foot down on Wheat Pasta in Spagetti, so after hearing Dr. Oz mention this is the Pasta they use at home, I decided to try it and immediately We both were sold, no more white flour for us!!! It's great, light tasting. My only suggestion is the cooking instruction time is a little off. For me it's done at 8 minutes, so the first time you make it keep an eye and check for your desired doneness. I highly recommend this product!!!

I was watching Dr. Oz on TV and saw that a person who loves pasta didn't want to give it up in order to loose weight.  Dr. Oz said that his family eats Artichoke Pasta and he thinks is a great alternative to regular Semolina pasta.  The woman who loves eating pasta said that it was very good and that she would start eating the Artichoke pasta instead of the Semolina pasta due to the nutritional value of the Artichoke pasta.  I have to agree that I could NOT taste a difference!  This review is coming from and Italian woman.  I have been eating pasta since before I could talk so I am not pulling your leg that this stuff is good.  It is expensive so I will use it as much as I can afford to but if you want a great alternative to regular Semolina pasta that you and your family will like, buy some Artichoke Pasta!  I think you will be surprised at how it taste nearly identical to your regular store bought pasta but with much more nutritional value.

This product was recommended on the Dr. Oz show so I imagine that a lot of people will be looking into it.  I've been using this as an alternative to white flour pasta for quite a while now.  I've tried the whole wheat brands and just have not been able to find any that I like.  The De Boles Artichoke Spaghetti has the taste that I crave without the downside of the other choices.  This is a good product.

Has a nice taste and consistency to it.  It is very slippery after its cooked, so it definately does not stick like regular pasta. Feels a little lighter in the stomach as well, not like a giant glue ball like regular pasta. Seems to be a nice healthy alternative.

I ordered the artichoke spaghetti pasta (which I've ordered before and liked), but was sent rice gluten-free angel hair pasta in error.  I see that what I was sent costs several dollars more than what I had ordered, so I will keep it and, hopefully, enjoy it as much (or more).  My point--check your order for errors.  Apparently in the Amazon shipping departmetn, a DeBolles is a DeBolles is a DeBolles.

I tried this pasta after viewing the Dr. Oz show.  I purchased a couple of boxes and tried it out on my husband.  He loved it!  On top of being healthy, it has wonderful flavor which is very important to me.  After trying this I purchased a dozen boxes.  I will continue to buy this product because it is fabulous.  Thanks DeBoles!

Thanks to Dr Oz, I  also discovered this good pasta.  It is lighter, nice and slippery, and doesn't leave your stomach feeling bloated.  I love it.  I don't know how long it will take me to use up 12 boxes of it, we'll see.  It's still better than driving to the grocery store. finding it in the store, waiting in checkout, etc.  I love Amazon!!
This pasta is so good.Saw it on Dr.Oz show so i knew it had to be good.Love it. Thanks Amazon.
this product is overpriced, but I have to get them because of a sore throat emergency and I am no where near asian store. and it is Prime ship that save me.

The product itself was fine. Note that it isn't quite as sweet as other Ban Lan Gen because it has reduced sugar. It doesn't say this in the description, but you can kind of tell in the picture. That didn't bother me though.My main gripe is that it's incredibly overpriced. You can get bigger bags for $1.50-$2.00 in asian grocery markets or some farmers markets. I had to purchase a bag of this quickly due to a family member requesting it when they got ill. I went out the following week and picked up 10 bags for less than $15!

This is my favorite tea and I highly recommend it to any socially conscious black tea drinkers.  I first fell in love with Bewley's Tea (the green box version) while traveling in Ireland.  I brought some home with me and then started special ordering from an online tea importer.  Later, when I saw that Bewley's had a fair trade blend, I was thrilled!  I love this tea just as well as the green box version and am so happy to see that Amazon has it too.

column9: Zapata - Fire Roasted Salsas (Hot, Med. Mild & Green)
column10: First off, I greatly enjoy these salsas as my everyday salsas, especially for cooking.  We have a store in the local Cleveland area that sells them for $3.29 a jar (as of Oct. 22, 2011) ... previously they held at $2.99 for the longest time (years).  The hot is not overly hot, and the medium fits the bill for family recipes.  The green is equally enjoyable.  The mild, while good just doesn't have the bite I look for in salsa however, I could understand many friends would find this their favorite.Now, my bone of contention is with the price listed here (and elsewhere on the web) for sale - $14 for a jar of processed salsa.  Even local producers who produce a fresh product max out at $6/16 oz.  For $14, I would say run away fast ... it's good stuff, however no way is it worth $14/jar.

column9: Awesome salsa, but who pays $17 for a jar?
column10: My all time favorite salsa.  Used to get it from my local grocery store, but moved to Seattle & it isn't carried here.  Looked on Amazon & sure enough, here it is.  But, seriously, $17 for a jar of salsa?  Clearly I won't be getting it here.  Guess it is time to find a new favorite.

My wife really liked this gift basket, much to my surprise.  I have given her so many of these, that I expected another ho-hum response.She especially mentioned the beautiful basket, which she put in the corner of the bathroom vanity.
Gift was a hit.  Transaction went smoothly and sure I will be ordering from Vendor again in the future.  Was easy peasy to order and have delivered.

column9: Tastes Great on Pork, Beef, and Chicken!!
column10: This is my prime seasoning for not only pork dishes, but, beef and chicken as well. I bought this seasoning to try something new for BBQ dishes beyond the typical rubs. I expanded to using it for stews. This does not have salt in it which means I can add salt to my taste. I was blown away by the fresh black pepper scent upon opening the package and the rich smoked paprika flavorings as my dishes cook. All the spices are well blended. Buying the larger version next time!Updated 7/2012: I've been using the seasoning almost two years and I'm still very pleased with the results in dishes!

column9: Good luck with Evil Eye Beads
column10: Simple beads, good value, as advertised.  Perfect for our purpose, though not as detailed as others.  Will have to buy those in Turkey.  Quick delivery.

column9: Exact popcorn from the movies-Nothing else needed!
column10: I bought this in the 6 ounce when Amazon offered it for my 6 ounce machine.  Anyway this comes with the popcorn, oil and the salt flavoring which includes Flavacol (that secret movie theater ingredient).  I also bought extra butter topping and salt but that was a waste of money because this popcorn kit is all you need.  Any more salt is too much and the butter is perfect.  After I made it no one wanted anything extra on theirs and said it was perfect.  Also follow the directions on the popcorn package and not your machine to get the most kernels popped.  I know my 6 ounce in this popcorn made 7 small square boxes of popcorn so this makes more than that but keep in mind this popcorn tastes awesome cold too.  Keep it in a cool area so the oil side does not melt (easier to handle not messy).  It seems the first 1/3 that pops is the most buttery so after it all pops stir it up in your machine to even that out.  You will love this product if you want that perfect movie theater popcorn that is yellow, buttery, salty and flavorful.  No need to buy anything else.  I did a lot of searching on the internet to find "that" taste and now that I found it I wanted to share it with you to save you time and worry if you are getting the right thing.  So enjoy.

Recently purchased the 6 Oz. Paramount popcorn machine along with the Mega-Pop popcorn kits for my husbands 50th birthday...and he couldn't be happier!  We've only had it for about a month but are going through 3-4 packs of Mega-Pop a week.  Our Monday night football group (5 couples, not just guys!) chose this popcorn over strawberry cheesecake for dessert, and we've been put in charge of supplying the popcorn for our montly movie night.  The kids just arrived for Christmas and can't stop eating it.  Not only does this taste like real movie popcorn, it's good for a couple days after popping.  We just turn on the heat lamp in the popcorn machine and it tastes as fresh as when it was first popped.  Thank you to all who posted reviews prior to my purchase...you helped me choose a delicious and entertaining birthday present for my "hard to buy for husband!"

This is the best "at home" popcorn I have found. It tastes almost like the popcorn at my local theater. Popcorn from the grocery store doesn't even come close. It is all pre-measured so very easy to use. My kids friends come over and immediately ask for popcorn. Guaranteed if there is a movie being watched at our house, we are making a batch (or more) of this popcorn. I can't even get rid of the microwave popcorn sitting at the back of my pantry now.

column9: The right way to pop popcorn
column10: I have an old fashion theater opocorn machine (the only right way to make popcorn). This product make less work and make life a bit easier when you wanna enjoy a good popcorn when you watching a movie or something.6 Oz Corn Kit - 36 Ct
This popcorn is so easy to use and is very good. My grandkids love to make it themselves!  Thanks for offering this great product!
I will start by saying that this is the first popcorn I've popped since I've had my machine, but this popcorn tastes great.  I seem to like it even more the next day!
We buy this popcorn for our small 6 oz. popcorn popper. It pops full and crisp.  It's a bit meatier than Orville but my husband prefers it to Orville.

I very much like the flavor of this jerky.  It's very chewable without being too tough. Therefore, it lasts a long time- much longer than most jerkies.  It also leaves no mess or oil on your fingers, which is a plus for me.  Another plus is the resealable package.

column9: Buffalo Bills 3.5 oz teriyaki Western Cut Resealable Beef Jerky Pack
column10: Oh this has to be the best  tasting beef jerky I have ever tasted. It is well worth the price and the taste, YUMMY

I opened these because I was hungry but once I took the first bite I knew this was a slow chewer. Very moist and flavorful jerky with a vivid and accurate teriyaki flavor. The product arrived quickly and well packaged.
Great Beef jerky, I only wish I could order it in a bigger size. Delicious!
This jerky is the best I've ever had. We've looked all over at gas stations and only 1 place has it near us, so it's easier for us to order online. Very good stuff!

This is the best cinnamon roll mix EVER!  It is so easy to use and makes my house smell delicious.  My family was so happy to find out that they were actually homemade cinnamon rolls and not just a yummy smelling candle.  I'm so excited because I recently found out that you can go directly to Gourmetswirls.com and order 8 other delicious, user family mixes ie: orange rolls, sticky buns, dinner rolls, pizza dough, whole wheat bread, cheesy rolls, scones and donuts.  Thanks for making my family happy and my house smell like I'm a gourmet baker!

column9: Mmmm... Pretty damn good for frozen cheesesteaks
column10: These are pretty good and close to the real deal for frozen cheesesteaks. I live in South Philly, very close to Pat's and Geno's actually, and have eaten them both, in addition to Jim's on South.  While I unfortunately haven't been to Tony Luke's on Oregon, I purchased these as a gift for my father in FL to have authentic South Philly cheesesteaks.  None of the other native South Philly cheesesteakers offer their product through mail order, so Tony Luke's was it. and honestly, I enjoyed these better, or at the very least n par with the unfrozen fresh versions that I've tried.  In fact, these now have me wanting to try a fresh Tony Luke version as well just for comparative purposes.The steaks arrived pretty quickly. They are fulfilled through Rastelli, the frozen meat cataloguers.  And lucky for me, they accidentally sent me two.  The boxes they arrive in are pretty big, but that's to ensure that's to fit the styrofoam and dry ice to keep the product cold and frozen.  Beyond that, the rolls are individually packaged separately from the individual vac packs of meat and cheese. Rolls are heated in the oven and meat packs are boiled up to heat.  Put 'em together and it's as fresh as you'll get.One cautionary note, when adding the meat to roll, make sure to drain liquid from the pack before, as to not soggify the roll. Learned my lesson. Otherwise mmmm... Pretty damn good.  Add fried onions for that extra authentic add.
These cheesesteaks are easy to prepare (Microwaving works great). They are absolutely delicious.I live In Southern California & these are a refreshing memories of true Philly style.

column9: Tides me over until I can get back to Philly!
column10: I'm originally from Philly, now living in the Northwest. I can't find a decent cheesesteak to save my life out here. After reading the positive reviews, I decided to give Tony Luke's a try. It was AMAZING. Even frozen, Tony Luke's is better than anything similar I can get in the Northwest.The food was property packaged in a cooler filled with dry ice. Cooking and assembly are a snap. I'm about to place my second order, since the first one was so great!

I love the truly unique flavor of Pickapeppa.  Its relatively mild, perhaps 5/10, but it more than makes up for it with outstanding flavor.  The unique flavor comes from the mangoes, but the combination of other spices is exquisite.It's similar to A1 in thickness but VASTLY tastier.I'm a fan and I buy this by the gallon thru Pickapeppa's website.As for their other sauces, give 'em a pass.  All are too sweet for my taste, particularly their "hot" sauce.

Since trying this sauce a couple years ago I have fallen in love with it. So many flavors combined... the sweetness of the sugar and raisins, the tangy tamarind, mango, and onion, the little bit of heat from peppers... all combine for a versatile and delicious sauce. Use it alone as a condiment or steak sauce, or try blending it with other sauces. I love adding a couple tablespoons of Pickapeppa Sauce to a small jar of chunky salsa for chicken tacos, adding it ground beef before making meat loaf, or even adding it to overly sweet spaghetti sauce to mellow it out and add extra layers of flavor. Put simply, Pickapeppa is a must for my kitchen and I heartily recommend it !

I couldn't count the number of bottles of Pickapeppa original I've been though over the past dozen years -- it's that good. It's one part of day that is never boring, one part of a dish that is always delicious. Flavourful without overwhelming everything else, spicy without being relying too much on the peppers that are part of the recipe.

column9: Fabulous sauce. Must have for the pantry.
column10: I used this sauce with some green cabbage and polish sausage a while back and it really brought out the fantastic flavors of the kielbasa! It's like no other bottled sauce I've tried.

I am a huge fan of Pickapeppa sauce. Use it on everything. However, the last three bottles I have purchased contained some kind of grit in it. It looks like black sand. Hope they fix this problem, and it goes back to its usual high quality. Won't eat it until then.

Growing up in the South, this sauce is a staple in the fridge; however, after moving off, it's been a struggle to find it.  Everytime we go home, my husband and I buy 4 or 5 bottles to hold us over until our next trip home.  I was super excited to see it available through Amazon.  A versatile sauce: it can be used in gumbos, soups, casseroles, and my personal favorite, poured over cream cheese and scooped with a cracker!  Yum!
sauce was very good and well received at the party, poured it over softned cream cheese and seved with crackers.......spicy but not on fire....shipper shipped it very fast..

Love the taste, especially the mango flavour. This sauce can go on any meat. Will do nicely on hot dogs - a completely different but spicy taste compared to the usual ketchup and or mustard. It's worth its price

Pickapeppa sauce is an underrated condiment. Huy Fong Sriracha Chili Sauce, 17 Ounce Bottle (Pack of 6) is rightly revered for its kicking up of Ramen noodles, while TABASCO® brand Pepper Sauce - Original Red Gallon is the all-American hot sauce from Louisiana. Pickapeppa isn't all that spicy. It's subtle. It's not overwhelming. When I put pickapeppa on kale and yams, it tasted filling and perfect! Pickapeppa isn't the typical hot sauce based on jalapenos and other chiles--but raisins and mangoes. Yes,a hot sauce made from mangoes. No wonder it's tropical perfection! Listen to Bob Marley sing on Songs Around The World (CD + DVD) and crank up the Putumayo Presents: African Reggae, and pickapeppa is PERFECT!

I am so glad that I have finally been able to get some more Black Beans!!!  My family loves them. I can't find any other brand that has the perfect seasoning packet like Lysander's. I will be buying many more!

We could not obtain Lysanders Black Bean Soup Mix from our local Food market since they no longer carry thst brand. We tried the Internet and successfully located the mix.We have used this product in the past and continue to enjoy the end results. The Black Bean Soup Mix instructions were easy to follow and the soup results were very enjoyable. We would highly recommend this product.

column9: Outstanding! Fresh taste and a wonderful alternative to traditional seaweed wraps!
column10: I purchased these as an alternative to seaweed wraps because I had guests coming to a sushi party who did not like the traditional seaweed wraps. They were blown away by my effort to find an alternative and they LOVED them!!! They wrap very easily and seem to actually 'keep' a bit better than the seaweed wraps because they don't get as soggy by any means. Not only are there several colors, but they are SOOOO nice to use when making traditional sushi because they automatically make the sushi have a really nice contrast to the seaweed wraps. Best part: the plain ones in the package also can be used to make some sweet dessert sushi: mix some rice w/sugar (or powdered sugar sprinkled over rice), add a row of cream cheese and some pieces of chocolate or fruit inside. IMPRESSIVE!!!!! Kids will LOVE them!!!

I am so pleased with the soy wrappers that I ordered. I heard about them and couldn't find them anywhere...then Amazon came through. You can always count on Amazon.If you are on a low gylcemic or carb diet these little wrapper wrap up a sandwich very easily. Practically no taste...but they hold everything together which is wonderful.

column9: A new staple in our household!
column10: LOVE LOVE LOVE these soy wraps!! I will be ordering more... They handle beautifully, the taste is very neutral/mild, I can see them being used in many ways!  The BEST part is, that now my kids will eat healthy sushi-type meals, whereas before they would avoid it 100% due to the nori/seaweed. This chips kind of reminded me of bacon bits. The six small bags were the perfect size and there's no MSG. They were a little expensive, but considering they came from the UK it's understandable. Half the price was in the shipping. They are well worth the indulgence once in awhile.
If you like salt and vinegar crisps (chips), but would prefer the vinegar to lighter, you should love these.  Salty and slightly tangy and yummy!

This could possibly be the best tasting chip I have ever eaten. It has a nice smokey bacon flavor. I would make sure this item was always stocked in my pantry if the price was not so high for the amount you get, or if they would sell this "AMAZING" chip here in the states. I would highly recomend someone paying the price one time just to try this.
I loved the chips they were AWESOME!!! but that's just me. It arrived Earlyer than expected in the mail so that was even better, no crushed chips yay!
The crisps are awesome. Give me English crisps over american chips any day! I recommend them to everyone. The smoky bacon are my favorite but the cheddar bacon are almost as good.
Item came promptly however the crisps were 3 months past their freshness date. Was told I would get replacements.  Still waiting.

I had these wonderful chips in Ireland a few years ago on vacation and was sad that I could not find them in America.  Now that I have I will be in so much trouble ordering them all the time.  I love these chips!!!

It seems to have a high smoke point for use in frying. Good value for money. column9: The Best for True Licorice Lovers
column10: Wiley Wallaby Red Licorice is the best and buying the 10b bag is the best price/way to go.  Put it into smaller plastic freezer bags and store in a cool place.  Service was fast and the licorice was fresh.  My wife loves this stuff!
The pasta was excellent.  It is a difficult to find item and I was very pleased to find it.  I used it with a salmon with a sun-dried tomato buerre blanc and the contrast on the plate was perfect.

column9: Squid Ink Fettuccine with cream sauce
column10: After seaching long & hard for Squid Ink Noodles, I found them Amazon.  I was not dissappointed by this product, it has lived up to my expectations.  I make them according to the package directions.  I reduce heavy cream in a pan & add lemon zest & fresh chopped Rosemary.  This is truely a great tasting pasta dish!
I love this Squid Ink Fettuccine. It's rare to find in the markets but I was glad I found it on Amazon.  It cooks fast and taste good.

A few years ago, I had a shrimp with squid ink pasta dish in Barcelona that has stuck with me so I have since that dinner vowed to replicate it in my kitchen.  Problem was that squid ink pasta was amazingly difficult to find... not even my specialty stores carried it so I turned to Amazon, which solves all my "I can't find it anywhere" problems.  I was a little skeptical having never ordered from Al Dente so I didn't want a sub par pasta to ruin this memory but I gave it a shot and as soon as the package arrived, I attempted my Barcelona culinary heaven... and it was everything I had remembered... a beautiful balance of flavor and color for a dish full of delicious and beauty! I disagree with other reviews that call this mushy. It cooked perfectly fine for me, but I followed the directions: brought water to a boil, and then cooked for 3 minutes. I served this with little tomatoes and asparagus (the red and green really popped against the black). One thing: it smelled a little fishy (?) when I strained it. However it tasted fine. We did not get a strong squid ink flavor.
It has been a long time since I have been able to find squid ink pasta.  This brand is excellent - everything I remember it tasting.  It's best served with shrimp scampi.  Thanks
we could not find this in any stores in our area so were very pleased to be able to find it thriugh Amazon.
great product - price - quantity - fast delivery -perfect  harpo-madison,wisconsin

I bought the black pasta for Halloween. Everybody thought it was cool but really it is not very high quality pasta. I bought it because the price was good and I needed black pasta. In a pinch I would buy it again.

column10: I gave it one star because they don't taste like pasta at all. (They are sold in a 6-pack deal.)
This cannot be certified Kosher if it contains squid ink which is never, ever kosher. Misleading and offensive.

column9: Good News- No Reflux, Bad News- Taste is Very Mediocre
column10: This review is for the Vanilla flavored Puroast. First, I have to admit I'm not a coffee connoisseur, my favorite stuff is probably Dunkin Donuts Vanilla brewed at home.I have pretty severe reflux disease. At one point I had a choice between drinking coffee or sounding like I smoked eight thousand unfiltered cigarettes a day because of the hoarseness and wheeziness. For what it's worth, I chose to eliminate the coffee and keep my voice and lung capacity. Problem is, I love coffee both for the flavor and for the mood boost and, as my only vice, it was terribly hard to give up. I looked at a few options in low-acid coffees and went with Puroast for the good reviews on here and other sites.I'm not sure if the reviews lauding the flavor are planted or what, but this stuff tastes like watered down Folgers even when brewed strong. When I do brew it strong it's bitter and needs a lot of creamer and sugar. When I brew it in the coffee maker at home there is no intoxicating coffee aroma wafting through the house like you get with a normal coffee. I also don't feel a strong buzz when I drink it, but then again I don't, and I'm trying to be polite here, have the same sense of "urgency" to use the washroom afterward.Probably the biggest complaint I have is that the stuff simply does not taste like vanilla flavored coffee. Does not taste like it, does not smell like it. At all.I don't know if this has anything to do with it, but the bags I bought simply had a "Vanilla" sticker on top of an old label that said "French Roast". Maybe they changed the contents along with the sticker but there is no real way of knowing as again, either the vanilla they put in is extremely weak, or they just sold me some old french roast tarted up as vanilla flavored.On the plus side, and this is a big plus in spite of my complaints, I can drink coffee again. I even tried the "acid test"; orange juice and two cups of this coffee in the same day. I had very minimal reflux and it was the orange juice. If this had been normal coffee I would have been doubled over with chest and gut pain and would have sounded like a wizened female truck driver the next day. I have been drinking at least a cup of this stuff a day for over a week and have not had an episode. This is a notable difference for me.In summation, if you have reflux and are craving coffee, give this stuff a shot. It's not perfect in flavor, doesn't provide a great buzz, but it's coffee and you can drink it without killing your insides.I hope this review helps someone.
This Keurig Vue assortment was a great way to try different brands of coffee available for the coffee machine .  Arrived on time and we have enjoyed!

column9: Great way to see which cups you like best
column10: When we initially bought our Vue, we bought two of these variety packs and I am glad we did. We eventually used all 25 (of each) cups but this pack is a great way to find out which flavors/varieties you like best without having to buy an entire 12+ pack only to find out you don't like it. Definitely the best starter pack.

These are too large for a regular Keurig.  I'm not familiar with Keurig models (this was purchased as a gift). Your description should emphasize that point, visually the product image appears the same as a standard size Keurig pod.  Returning these.

True-there is a nice mild boost from Vazoom!  Great for me because I'm not looking for a jolt of energy-just a nice pick me up!  I drink it because it is a fabulous source of antioxidants!  I tried all the flavors, did not enjoy the Acai- but LOVED the Peach Mango and Cranberry!  The Green Tea flavor was also delicious-had a wonderful fruitty  taste!  In fact, I have reordered a few times now!  The little "go packs" make this very portable and a nice mid afternoon pick me up!  Nice job Vazoom!  Keep those flavors coming!

The energy boost from this stuff is fair....which is perfect for me, it's much like 2 cups of coffee....i feel better in the morning after drinking it.The bad...it has a cherry cough syrup aftertaste....not very strong, but it's there....the flavor is ok....but could be....berrier...just made that word up i think.I don't see drinking it everyday, it just isn't a good enough flavor to enjoy it like you would a coffee...but as a cold drink when i need a pick me up it does just fine...
This is a great product, crispy, tasty and all natural. The whole family enjoys it as a snack. I much prefer this product to other less healthy snack foods.
I had this at a friend's house and it was really good.  I never thought of pairing pineapple with lime, so I was pleasantly surprised. Good stuff.  Too bad it's "Out of stock"
Good price and tastes pretty good.  I like the banana versions better.  Kids like them all.

What other yummy snack has no added sugar, 100% natural, stays fresh in storage, convenient, no added colors, no preservatives, not messy for kids and is fun to crunch? Whether you like this flavor or not, freeze dried fruit is where it is at. Compared to dehydrated, it locks in more fresh flavor and nutrients. Try different freeze dried fruits and find what works for you. I personally enjoy the funky sour flavor of pineapple with lime but you won't know until you crunch one.

This product might have a funny name but it is great;it has pure ingredients and can be eaten when you get a snack attack; it is low in calories and healthier for you.  Love this product and recommend it to everyone young or old.
Tasty, healthy, low in fat and all natural! Great product! We always have it in stock at the office.  Thanks!

column9: Funky would be the right word
column10: These snacks are definitely different.  I shared them with a lot of my co-workers and we all agreed that they definitely will grow on you.  I love the slight taste of lime, but the semi-tartness of the pineapple.  I would recommend these to anyone trying to watch their weight.

column9: Great morning snack!  Funky Monkey Jivea Lime
column10: I got the Funky Monkey Banana and cinnamon snack first, because some reviews of the Jive A Lime (pineapple-lime)were kind of wishy-washy.Boy, am I glad I tried the mixed snack pack with all the flavors as I really love, love this snack with the pineapple and little lime flavor.  (For you quumquats, the lime juice/acidic keeps the nice pineapple from turning brown and is a great preservative.) There is just a hint of lime and a strong pineapple flavor.  It is sweet, but naturally so!  I have this with my oatmeal in the morning and think of Hawaii!!  I went ahead and subscribed for the monthly shipment for the Jive A Lime and hope I don't run out!!
I tried the Funky Monkey Jivealime and they are fantastic.  So crunchy and flavorful and best of not, not bad for you.  I really like them a lot.  Just ordered 2 more dozen packages.

After reading the reviews I absolutely had to write one myself. The product is awsome convenient and reasonably priced being you get 3 servings of fruit in one bag.The reason I had to write the review is due to the arrogance of the people rating this product below a 3 star rating IF YOU DON'T KNOW WHAT FREEZ-DRIED MEANS, DON'T WRITE A BAD REVIEW, DO YOUR OWN RESEARCH. You all sound like idiots, if you buy a Lamborghini you can't complain it goes too fast.

I liked these very much. However, you have to like a strong taste of lime peel (like you would taste in a caipirinha or mojito).  At first it is not as strong, but it definitely builds.  I think it is a taste that would be rare for a child to like because it is so strong but it depends on your child.

Crunchy fruit snack that gives me much of my fruit requirement for the day. Pineapple with lime is a bit tart so I'm going to try a different flavor, but very nice snack. I'm a weight watcher and this is a low-point food, great for an afternoon pick-me-up.

I am a diabetic and its hard to find something sweet and candy like that I can enjoy. I am not into all that fake sugarfree candy as if you eat more that a couple of bites it becomes a laxitive. I really enjoy Funky Monkey JiveALime Pineapple. its all natural, crunchy, it makes the mouth smile. There are no added sugars, its all natural and they freeze dry it so it has a nice crunch. There are many different flavors but I just cant get enough of the JiveALive Pineapple, its sweet and tart and just plain yummy.

I first heard about Funky Monkey from the Hungry Girl web site.  Since I'm always on the lookout for interesting and low-fat/calorie snacks, I decided to give these a go.  The combination of lime and pineapple is a great taste!  These are good for either a mid-morning or mid-afternoon snack.  They're not too heavy, but they keep the stomach from growling!

I had been wanting to try these for a while and was fortunate enough to find them at our local Hannaford supermarket the other day.I'm not quite sure what I was expecting exactly but these were very dry and crunchy, almost like a chip - I think I was expecting something a little chewier.  And I did not care for the flavor - I found it to be far too strong, more lime than anything else.  The bag was quite small for the price you pay which was a little disappointing.
These are very delish - crunchy & flavorful - easy to transport for kids lunches and helps provide the daily requirements for fruit.

column9: Not as tasty as I thought it would be
column10: Unfortunately, I couldn't find this locally, so I had to buy the box of 12 to try them.  I am not impressed.  Crunchy, yeah, but I guess I don't expect my fruit to be crunchy.
The product tasted terrible and the pineapple version made the whole inside of my mouth raw.  I couldn't even give the stuff away - nobody liked it at all!!! AND it's expensive!

I have to drink decaf coffee for health reasons; and, frankly, a lot of them leave a kind of after taste.  Tully's was really AWESOME!!!  If you haven't tried this coffee yet, give it a shot.  It's REALLY good!!!!  The French Roast Decaf has a smooth flavor, and this coffee is one I will DEFINITELY buy again!!!
This is the best coffee that we have had for our Keurig. It's full flavored with no bitterness and easy to drink black. After trying others, we keep coming back to the Tully's French Roast.
My doctor order me to cut caffine.  I hope this is swiss water process decaf.I like strong coffee.  This has a bold body.  It taste great.  If you like starbuck coffee, you would like this.  Strong.

column9: I know the other reviewers really liked this, but I didn't...
column10: I like a fairly strong cup of coffee.  Since it's French Roast, and labeled as Bold, I assumed that Tully's version would be.  Unfortunately, to me, at least, it's pretty weak stuff.  It may be better if your Keurig can be set to brew a small cup size...ours is fixed at roughly 8 oz.I personally prefer:Timothy's World Coffee, Rainforest Decaf Espresso Extra-Bold for Keurig Brewers, 24-Count K-Cups (Pack of 2),Coffee People Extra Bold French Roast Decaf for Keurig Brewers, 24-Count K-Cups (Pack of 2) andEmeril's Jazzed Up Decaf Coffee for Keurig Brewers, 24-Count K-Cups (Pack of 2) for decaf coffee.For caffeinated, I like Coffee People Organic, Extra Bold K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 50) [Amazon Frustration-Free Packaging],Coffee People Santa's Buzz K-Cup for Keurig Brewers, 24-Count K-Cups (when it's available), orEmeril's Big Easy Bold Coffee for Keurig Brewers, 24-Count K-Cups (Pack of 2).I think all six have much better flavor than Tully's French Roast.
If you like a good tasting coffee that is not bitter or too strong you will love this, you'd never know it was decaf
This is my favorite decaf, after trying several. It has a very rich and full bodied flavor. I can dilute it with the 7 oz size drink on my Keurig and it is still a great rich cup of coffee.
This is the best decaf that I have found thus far. It taste very close to regular coffee.

I have decided that Tully's coffee is my favorite.  Their decaf is smooth and full flavored - no bite like I seem to get from Emeril and Newman.  Will buy again. I also love my Keurig - but its brain seems to be having trouble deciding how much coffee needs to go in the cup.  Quirky - yet worth the fiddling.
I prefer dark, robust tasting coffee and this is by far the best decaf I have tasted to date

I am a strictly caffeine free coffee drinker. I have tried many different brands. Green Mt., Timothy's, etc...This is one of my favorites. It has a very strong yet smooth flavor. Most Decaf brands are on the weak side. I do not have to sacrifice flavor with Tully's.
If you enjoy your coffee on the stronger side, try this one.  The taste is bold without some of the bitterness or bite that you find in other dark coffees.
Of all the K-Cups, decaf, that we have tried this is our favorite.  We use about 40 per month so automatic delivery really works well for us and we save an additional amount.
Nice to have found a decaf coffee with a strong flavor. I make my coffee using the smallest cup setting on my Keurig. I highly recommend this brand and flavor.

Having tasted numerous coffees in the "K" cup design and suffered through diluted, bitter tasteless coffee, this French Roast  from Tully is really hard to distinguish from non-decaf coffee.  I drink between 6-8 cups a day, and I'm pretty finicky as to what I drink.  Frankly, I could drink this all the time and not suspect it's decaf. I like the aroma as it's brewing and the taste which calls for two cups instead of one!!  You can't go wrong trying this coffee and I think you will like it.

I'm a fan of Tully's in my Keurig, and coming up with an evening brew has rounded out the single cup beauty of the machine.  If you like the "medium roast" type of coffees, this one will please, as you hardly notice any difference in flavor except that you know that only the caffeine is missing.  It's really nice to enjoy a late night brew without the fear of a sleepless night.  Good, smooth, bold flavor, one of the best I have tried so far.  Amazon service is great as always.  The double pack saves money, and stocks the shelf as well.  I'll reorder when the first box is gone, its that good.
Tully's French roast coffee (caf & de-caf) are my favorite! Buying the K-cups through Amazon is cheaper since you can get the free shipping...and I'm happy.
I'm not a big fan of this coffee.  It has a slightly bitter flavor as well as the proverbial decaf after-taste, so I won't order again.

I was thrilled to find Tully's French Roast Decaf back in stock through Amazon.  In my opinion, it is better than Starbucks.  I like rich, bold coffee, and Tully's has a smoother finish without leaving a bitter aftertaste.  The best decaf I've ever found!

column9: One of the best Bold Roast decaf K-cups!
column10: This product has excellent bold flavor but is not bitter. I don't usually drink decaf coffee, but this is one that I certainly don't mind drinking.
I've been looking for a decaf coffee that really had some flavor.  Most of the K-cups I've tried taste like -- hot water!  This one definitely has the rich, bold flavor its name says it has.
I like strong coffee and Tully's French Roast fits the bill.  No matter if I make a small cup or a large cup (K-cup) the taste is the same.  I would recommend this coffee to all Decaf drinkers.

Having to drink decaf is easier with a hearty,bold , yet not bitter coffee ! Closest to Starbucks decaf if you like that type of stronger flavor. Have tried a lot of k-kup decafs and this is the best yet.

I have tried a number of different DeCaf K-Cups.  Most are pretty weak and rather insipid.  The Tully's Extra Bold French Roast is an exception with pretty good flavor.  Would I like it a little more bold - yes, but they are probably limited in how much coffee they can put in the container simply by the small container size.Neil Bell
This is a great tasting coffee. It does not taste like decaf, it is very full and flavorful! I will definitely get the coffee again.

column9: Great taste, not so great shipping...
column10: This was the first time I ordered "coffee" to be shipped.  I love the taste of French Roast decaf - tastes like a real cup of coffee and wasn't able to find "decaf" locally.  The vendor I used to ship it was costly and it took a long time to receive.  I've since found another supplier ..... I still love the coffee, plus I enjoy free shipping and it arrives in just days!  The best of all worlds.  I recommend this blend to real coffee lovers - it's hearty and even has the fresh brewed coffee smell - which I missed using the Keurig cups.  This has it all.

column9: Try it only If you enjoy a cup of very, very strong coffee.
column10: I am a coffee drinker and enjoy decaffeinated-preferably French Roast.This coffee was a big disappointment-more than extra bold as described wheras the flavor to me was very bitter and distasteful. In all fairness, if you add lots of sweetner to your coffee and use a flavored milk, you just might like it.I will however, will not drink it or serve to guests.

Tully's French Roast decaff is the richest, smoothest coffee we have ever tried (as far as K-Cups go).  We enjoy an after-dinner coffee and don't need the caffeine, so we fix a cup of Tully's French Roast, sit back and enjoy.
I consider myself a coffee expert and always look for coffee products that tastes full and fresh. This brand of Decaf coffee is one of the best I have tasted so far
My husband and I love this coffee it has a nice smooth taste.Sets our morning off to a good start even though it is D-cafDelivery was fine, no problems at all.

Very good decaf coffee! This is the only brewed decaf that I've actually enjoyed. Highly recommend this decaf coffee to anyone who enjoys a good cup late in the evening! Very good value as well and I received my order in just three days!
This is the best decaf I have found.  I use 8 ounces of water and have a nice, rich cup of coffee.  I will continue to use this brand, unless I find something betteer, of course.

Almost a year ago now I suffered from 4-5 debilitating cluster migraines a week that were killing me.  Then I read some article online that lead me to believe the migraines might have been triggered by caffein.  So I completely stopped drinking caffein about a year ago.  It was very hard to stop drinking caffeinated coffee (and soda) but it was worth it because it successfully reduced my migraines from several a week to about ten in a year (and two of those migraines were caused by drinking unlabeled Amish root beer which must have caffeine in it).  But, I still missed the comfort and taste of morning coffee and holding a warm mug in my hand while sitting on the porch wrapped in a blanket and the smell or going to coffee shops.  After no coffee for several months, I tired decaf for the first time and experienced no headaches, but the taste was so bland that it wasn't worth the calories.  I experimented with many different decaf brands, including Starbucks.  This past weekend, I visited my cousin who insisted I try this brand.  And, hellooooo!  This is what I remember coffee tasting like!!!  It's smooth, bold, strong without making you spit it out, it has flavor!  It doesn't leave a gross taste in your mouth!  I didn't believer her that it was decaf, but I did not get a migraine!  So here I am on Amazon to buy myself some of this, although I'd prefer to purchase a bag of these beans rather than the K-cups, which I find wasteful.  Unfortunately the bags of the coffee are currently unavailable.  I highly recommend this brand and blend of coffee.
This is one of the best decaf I have tasted.  So nice to be able to have the flavor and leave the caffeine behind
All I can say is that this does not taste like decaf coffee.  It is so rich, strong and dark and I am completely addicted to it.  You will not be disappointed with this excellent coffee.

I used to love regular coffee but have a problem with drinking too much of it.  I reluctantly switched to decaf and I can't tell the difference.  This coffee gives a nice bold flavor.  I prefer the 4th cup setting on the Keurig and it's just the perfect flavor for me.
If you like a good, robust coffee this is the one. It is so nice to finally find a coffee that is decaf and still tastes so good.

I choose French roast coffee, as in my opinion, lighter roasts become weaker flavored if one selects the larger cup size. This coffee tastes rich and smoky whether served hot or cold, and for connoisseurs of satisfying, truly flavorful coffee, this will not dissapoint. The extra bold flavor stands up well to the addition of cream, so chilled coffee beverages are delightfully flavorful.

I love bold, rich coffee--and have never liked de-caf. I really like Tully's regular French Roast, but for health reasons, decided to try Tully's de-caf French Roast. It is so good, that I actually prefer it to regular French Roast now. Great stuff!

I used to order Coffee People French Roast Decaf, but when it was no longer available on Subscribe and Save, I switched to Green Mountain French Roast Decaf.  When the price for the Green Mountain got too high, I tried the Tully's French Roast Decaf and I'm really glad I did.  I love a strong brew, one that's smooth and not bitter.  I can no longer drink caffeinated coffee, so I'm always looking for a decaf that tastes like a regular cup of coffee and this is perfect!

Strong coffee is enjoyable to me, but Tully's Decaf French Roast has an acrid, burnt taste that I don't enjoy.  I can choke it down by adding lots of creamer. Timothy's Rainforest Expresso Decaf makes a strong cup with a smoother taste.  I understand that the French Roasts have a stronger taste. I've used Starbucks French Roast in the past in my drip coffee maker and was pleased with it.  This variety is almost undrinkable!

Delicious coffee - but the box we purchased contained several k-cups that were defective - the foil top separated from the cup when it was punctured, and coffee sprayed all over the place during brewing.  There was also a problem with lots of grounds in the cup with this batch.  We purchased a box of non-decaf at the same time that did not seem to have the problem.

column9: DELICIOUS. Dark, Strong, with a tangy zip!
column10: I decided to try Tully's brand French Roast and Medium Roast decaf coffies in Kcups from my local Staples.If you like bold, dark, smokey, tangy coffee like me, you will like Tully's darker roasted coffee's.A friend also gave me a 48 box from Amazon.com. And it is just as fresh and tasty. (all well before their printed expiry dates)Both were at a cost of roughly 60-70 cents a cup. Pretty reasonable. I was able to find it at the same price in a local store, but if you cannot the Amazon price is very fair!I usually enjoy Starbucks or Newmans-Own brand dark/bold roasts. But I will now add Tully's brand to that list.

ive tried nearly all the Kcup varieties after purchasing several mixed boxes of k cups.this one is by far the most delicious ive ever tasted!!you wouldnt even know it was decaf! lovely smokey flavor, full bodied and stands up to any plain or flavored creamer.i cant recommend this variety enough! well done Tullys.

I bought a decaf sampler to try to find a decaf to my taste - STRONG and BOLD.  After wading through 24 K-Cups of varying quality, I found a fabulous one:  Tully's French Roast Decaf. It was worth the research.

This is in the top 10% of all the coffees I've tried.  It's flavor is what you might expect at a fine restaurant.  How can You beat the convenience of having it shipped right to your door?  When it arrives, try it right away and you'll be repeating Teddy Roosevelt's famous words...it's "good to the last drop!"

I have this on hand mainly for guests who drink decaf.  Sometimes I'll have a cup of this decaf when I feel like having coffee at night.  I find the flavor to be nice.  I wouldn't go so far as to call it bold, but it does have a good flavor, not watered down like some decaf coffees.  My guests seem to enjoy it as well.
We have been using Starbucks for years but now will only use Tully's French roast. Even their Decaf Is superior to any other coffee I have had.

This decaf coffee actually has better (i.e. richer) taste than the seller's regular French Roast.  A bit pricey like all of the Keurig brew cups. column9: one month of use made a nonbeliever out of me
column10: In reading all the reviews of different decaf k-cups, the opinion I came away with was that Tully's was where I should go to get a really bold, dark roasted flavor similar to Starbucks' coffee. It does get closer to Starbucks than any of the other decaf k-cups I have tried. But in a way it goes too far and results in a somewhat strange and overpowering taste.I had tried Timothy's decaf and Newman's Own decaf, with the latter vastly superior to the former. I would say Tully's beats Timothy's (which is just brown water), but probably not Newman's. I also tried Donut Shop decaf simultaneously with Tully's (I had Donut Shop at work and Tully's at home). For the first few days, I thought Donut Shop was a little weak and I liked Tully's better for its bolder flavor. But after a couple of weeks I grew tired and a little sick of Tully's strong taste - it's not just strong like a normal cup of Starbucks, it's strong almost like they added some kind of artificial chemical to it to make it taste darker or more burned than it really is. After one month I was long done with the Donut Shop and was just slowly getting through the Tully's (diluted with lots of milk).When I reordered, I only considered Newman's or Donut Shop. I couldn't bring myself to drink another cup of Tully's. It's a shame because they definitely took a step in the right direction with their stronger flavor, but it was a misstep that makes the coffee a poor choice for long-term consumption.Perhaps a good strategy for a newcomer would be to order Tully's AND another brand or two like Newman's and Donut Shop, and trade off which one they drink. That might make Tully's flavor less grating over time

column9: Good kit but follow these recommendations
column10: I make wine on the side, and at first it took a lot of research and time.If your new at wine making, get this kit but be warned you will need more than just this kit. Besides the kit, you will need a glass carboy, plastic fermentor (plastic bucket), glass bottles 25-30, corker (to insert corks) and gas release knob (to vent gas, without getting the fermentor dirty). Everything else is optional, such as pump (recommended), funnels, thermometer, filters, heat gun (for shrinking covers), etc.Also, for a better taste create 5 gallons of the kit instead of 6 (simply stop adding water at the 5 gallon mark). A common word used in the instructions is "MUST." Its simply the mixture of water, grapes, and yeast.In sum, it will cost roughly $80-120 for all the equipment (that can be reused over and over) and $40 for this kit. Doing the math, it will cost $1.50 to $3.00 a bottle, not bad for table wine.

This kit makes it easy to make a good wine. I have found the Vino Italiano kits to be slightly watered down,so instead of making 6 gallons per kit,I make 5 gallons,then it is really good. It still comes to less than $2 per bottle,and the alcohol is 12.5% instead of 11%.

column9: Outstanding Kit, and not Just for the Money, but Patience is the Rule
column10: I just bottled this kit the night before last, and even the sample I took from the bottling wand was excellent. Rich, complex, dark and a bit fruity, as a good Merlot should be. I just stretched out the aging period and degassed the wine thoroughly when it was time (heat the wine to 75 degrees F or more--CO2 doesn't come out of the wine easily at lower temps), and the kit's ingredients really shone through. My wife and I will be enjoying this batch for some time to come!Happy fermenting!

I have purchased this product several times and is now the only dog food I use. I needed a dog food that was grain free as my breed does not tolerate corn and other grains. I end up feeding both my dogs a smaller quantity and so the food goes a lot further.

column9: DOUBLED IN PRICE WITHIN A MONTH!!!
column10: I bought this dog food a month ago for 31$ it is now priced at 64$! What kind of company jacks up the price like that? I can buy much more high quality dog food for much less then this, plus better ingredients! Noone is going to pay that much for this dog food!

My 4 stars is for the original price!!! I bought a 35# bag of Hi-Tek Naturals Lamb Meal for Less Active and Large Breeds in 10/6/12 for $36.80. Only a week later it is OVER DOUBLE this price ($76.34 on 10/11/12)?? It is a good dog food, but for $36! It is not worth over 75 dollars! I hope they get such a decrease in revenue that they revert to their original price.As for this food itself, I do like Hi-Tek brand and have tried multiple foods. My dog likes all of them fine, and her stools are smaller, less frequent, less smelly. The fat content of this Less active formulation is 12% as opposed to the normal 16% ( Hi-tek chicken meal with sweet potato is my comparison, $47.38 for 30# on 10/6/12, $45.99 for 30# 7/7/2012). However, the protein is decreased from the normal food - this one is 21% and normal food is 32%. I believe this is a reflection in the decrease of the quality of ingredients. The first five ingredients in the Less active formulation are: Lamb meal, pearled barley, white rice, brown rice, whole milo (another grain) followed by pork meal and some vitamins. Seems to me, a smart person would just buy the regular food and add some rice! The first five ingredients of the regular formulation are: Chicken meal, sweet potato, peas, pork meal, egg followed by duck meal, salmon meal, and a bunch of fruits and vitamins.Bottom line: love Hi-tek, kinda upset about the price changes, this food is not worth a penny over the original formulation even though you get 5# more. In this food they just cut protein sources and fruits and added more "filler" like rice.

column9: Best Steel Cut Oats out there!
column10: First of all, whoever eats regular quaker rolled oats, BELIEVE ME, once you try Steel Cut oats, you can never go back to that mushy gooey bowl of quick cooking oats. Initially when I switched over, I used to buy the McCann's 5 minute Steel Cut Oats which are pretty good, but once I discovered these, there was no going back! The size of each grain is larger in these, and when cooked and plumped up, it has a great texture (the McCann's one in comparison is smaller and tastes slightly gritty when cooked). To speed up the cooking time, I usually do this the night before:Pour cold water over oats (+1tsp whole wheat flour/wheat or oat bran) the night before to abt 1" above the level of oats in ur bowl... then microwave for 1.5 - 2 minutes (check that it doesnt overflow!)... then boil some water in a kettle and pour enough water to fill your bowl 1/2 way or 2/3 of the way to the top... then cover and let soak overnight... the next morning, add a little more water (if necessary) and microwave again for 2-3 minutes (again, check to make sure it doesnt overflow)... then add ur toppings and flavourings and Enjoy!!!! I do this every other morning and eat my oats at work, and it's well worth the little extra prep time the night before - trust me!!!

column9: Steel Cut Oatmeal is the best
column10: When I first started making steel-cut oatmeal instead of the typical rolled oats we all grew up on, I was sure I didn't have time in the morning to cook something for 20-30 minutes, as opposed to nuking it for 3-5. It actually turned out to be pretty easy, once I adjusted my habits a bit (e.g., to start the water as soon as I get to the kitchen). And it's definitely worth a little more effort, the increased flavor and texture are phenomenal. And after trying a few brands, I am very happy with Bob's Red Mill. It has a nice nutty taste on its own, and I also like to throw in some dried fruit and sliced almonds. I'd absolutely recommend you try this, and you'll be surprised at what a difference it can make in your breakfast experience. Now I find, the only time issue is one I create myself, since I slow down to pay attention to what I'm eating! instead of mindlessly eating-cereal-and-checking-email.

I had been wanting to try steel cut oats for about a year, then I saw these at a local health food store.  I absolutely had to buy this stuff!  I love this oatmeal!  It's not slimy and mushy like rolled oats.  It has quite a nice texture to it, closer to brown rice than rolled oats.I always have mine with a pat of butter and a tablespoon or two of honey.  Sometimes I use brown sugar, but I think the honey is better.While it is much better cooked on the stove, I have determined a way of cooking it in what I think is an 1100 or 1200 watt microwave (the microwave isn't labeled with its wattage and the packaging and owner's manual are long gone):Combine 1/4 cup oats and 7/8 cup water in a dish that holds at least four cups.  Microwave 1-2 minutes, or until boiling, let stand for 2-5 minutes.  Continue microwaving for 1/2 to 1 minute intervals, letting stand at least two minutes between, until done to desired firmness. Watch carefully to make sure it doesn't boil over!  I do this in my 4 cup pyrex measuring cup, and stop the microwave as soon as the boiling water and oats come within an inch of the top.

My kids love these steel cut oats. However, I recently became aware of the differences in labeling. These oats are being sold as "100% Organic" when the actual labeling on the package is just "Organic." There's a big difference, at least, in my opinion.[...]

Hi everyone...This is the first kit I ever made..  Actually, the first WINE I EVER MADE!!!!!I have to say that I didn't have great expectations...  More of an experiment....I am suprised how good it tastes...I did make it 5 gallons, instead of six.  Also, I picked up so sparkolid as a clarifier, since there is some concern for shell fish allergies, and the use of chitosan.Other than that, I am very happy with the result.  It has been in the carboy for 4 months.I also made some Sangria with this wine... Came great!!!!!  Looking forward to drinking a lot of this, this summer....In a nutshell, for anyone starting out....  You will need equipment.  I got mine from the winemakers toy store, but any homebrew shop will have a starter kit for equipment.  I went overboard, and bought a lot of equipment, but you only need the minimal kit.The equipment, you can use over and over again.If you want to go the least expensive route, buy two of the Paklab 6 gallon carboys here on amazon for under 28 dollars each and this wine kit together, to get free shipping.  You will also need a stopper and air-lock, some metabisulphite and cleanser ( I used b-brite ).  Also, some tubing to siphon from one carboy to the other.  A carboy brush will also be helpful.Make it in one carboy but only do 5 gallons, which translates to 25 bottles of finished wine....  Transfer it to the other when racking.Now, after you do this once... You will be hooked...  So, your next step is get a starter kit, which will come with a carboy, now you will have three, meaning you will be able to brew 3 different types of wine at the same time.  ( I currently have 4 going... )Your problem now becomes, where are you going to put all of this wine?Enjoy!!!!!

column9: Mix & Match a Great Blend Has A Future
column10: We blended this 4 week Chianti & Rosso wine kits. This 50/50 blended wine has the best of both wines. It produced a wine that has full body and a smooth finish. After six weeks the tast of this wine has become more complexed with rich flavor. We also added 1/2 cup of corn sugar to increase the ach/vol of this wine it produced 68 750ml bottles.

This is my second Vino Italiano, this time I followed everyones advice and not make a full 6 gallons, but to get the sp.gr. to 1.089 or so which came to 5 and one half gallons...since I really don't prefer very dry wine, I will do what I have done to previous wines, and that is to add MD ( not 20-20 ) Concord wine, one bottle just before the clearing and stabilization step.  Its just enough. I age for 6 months and Its better than store bought wine in the below 20 dollar price range.  Great wine.

The wine was very good, too good in fact because no one is letting it age to get better.  For the price these cannot be beat.  My next purchase, today in fact will be a Barolo. As many reviewers have noted, do not attempt to make this to six gallons. This must (juice) is hardly concentrated and turned out very thin and weak when I made it to five gallons. I also added mulling spices and two, 32 ounce bottles of cranberry juice to make a total of 5 gallons prior to fermenting and it was still very light. It was good tasting though. It's a real shame that many of the Vino Italiano kits seem to be made from good grape stock, but skimp on the amount. I have had better luck with some of their other reds and whites but I still make them all to 5 gallons, not 6.

A friend of mine made this kit exactly according to the instructions, and it was pretty good.  Most red wines from kits benefit from some extra ageing (a few months), but this one was good from bottling day.When I got the kit, I decided to do something crazy with it.  In order to concentrate the flavor I decided to mix it only at four gallons instead of the instructions' suggestion of six gallons.  I had heard of others doing it to five gallons instead of six, and that was well-reviewed, but I hadn't heard of four gallons.The gravity was extremely high, about 1.120 if I recall correctly.  Since the kit comes with champagne yeast, though, I thought that they could handle it.  I oxygenated the fermenting wine three times in the primary, and believe me, it needed it!  The gravity took two weeks to drop down to 1.010, when I racked it out of the primary (bucket) fermentor to the secondary (carboy) fermentor.  It's still sitting in the secondary, waiting for the clarification steps.  It's going to be about 16% ABV, so it will no doubt benefit from ageing, but all-in-all I think it's going to resemble an "auslese" of a chianti when it's finished.Making the kit as instructed gives you thirty bottles (well, 28, really, after you lose a little from racking) of good table wine.  I've heard making it only five gallons will give you 25 bottles of improved wine, and I can confirm that making this kit to four gallons will give you 20 bottles of very strong, very tasty red wine.

I will be buying more of these kits in the future.

That means that you have to add 18L of WATER to get up to 6 gallons. I really think this hurts the end flavor of the wine. Also, it is not overly salty like regular shells & cheese or mac-n-cheese which is VERY NICE when you're trying to feed your toddler healthier options.
