My 3 year old loves these for lunch!  They're a quality product from Gerber that are easily prepared.  Great prices at Amazon too!
My son loves eating these, it is very easy to make and convenient. I will make one for myself here and there. Very good product.

My son loves these tubs of food and they are so convenient to either heat up and serve at home, or toss into the diaper bag and go.  I've used them for both my kids and they both love them.  I love the price and the convenience

My baby has serious allergies, and it's difficult to find microwaveable foods she can eat. We took a container to her allergy doctor and she okayed them for us. Tonight we tried them and lo and behold, she loved them. She ate the whole bowl, a first in her recent history. It's a pity that Gerber makes most of her products with carrots and sweet potatoes. We would have a greater choice if they didn't. However, we are willing to try more new foods in the near future. By the way, we microwaved the bowl but it did not become too runny like other reviewers said. It was the perfect texture and softness. I would even say it tasted better than Kraft's version. We all are very satisfied!

column9: Great quick meal, but it can't be reheated
column10: These are great for a quick meal for our son, however they can't be reheated. Upon reheating these they turn to mush. My son seems to love the taste of these and thinks of them more as a treat than a normal meal :). I would buy these again, but if your child is not as hungry as you anticipated, count on throwing these out right away.

My 3 yr old son LOVES these. He asks for them all the time and they are very easy especially in a pinch (30 seconds!). I take them with us when we travel incase he decides he is on a hunger strike (he never refuses these) or when we will be out and about and can't get to a restaurant. I just zap it before we go and pack it up. It can't be put in the frige and reheated even though the package says so. It turns to liquid. I don't think it tastes like much, but he sure does!
Great product.  Only reason I do not give it 5 stars is because I found it cheaper at Meijers.

If you have a sweet tooth, these are absolutely amazing - like CRAZY delicious. They break a little easier than their fruity counterparts because there isn't as much frosting to keep it together and the filling is gooier. That being said, if you cradle these while eating, they will cradle your taste buds in return like a blizzard of flavor crystals erupting with every bite.Nutritionally, I would categorize this species of pop-tart under "soul food" along with bacon waffles and ranch fries. If you're a health nut, look elsewhere.

THESE ARE BY FAR THE BEST POP-TARTS EVER MADE!!  NO, THEY DON'T EXACTLY TASTE LIKE ICE CREAM.  I WOULD SAY THEY ARE BETTER THAN ICE CREAM.  THE ONLY DRAW BACK TO ORDERING THESE ONLINE (WHICH IS THE ONLY PLACE I CAN FIND THEM NOW) IS THE COST OF SHIPPING AND THE CONDITION OF THE POP-TARTS.  THOUGH THEY WERE PACKAGED INSIDE A CARDBOARD BOX WITH SOME PACKING MATERIAL THERE WERE SOME THAT WAS A BIT SMASHED.  NOTHING TOO TERRIBLE, THEY WERE STILL EDIBLE OF COURSE.  IF SHIPPING WASN'T SO EXPENSIVE I'D ORDER MORE FOR SURE!!!

This pasta is fine in terms of taste, but the letters are so tiny that my son doesn't like them. He used to love the Trader Joe's alphabet pasta but they stopped making it. I bought this as a replacement. The letters, being so small, end up all over the place. I have to pick them out of the holes in the colander and out of the rug when he spills. This might be fun in a soup or a casserole but not as a pasta dish on it's own. I think I'll just use the rest of the uncooked noodles in a craft project. Perhaps we can sprinkle it like glitter on a greeting card.

I bought it for my son when he learned his alphabet at around 1.5 years old. The letters are way too small & he didn't care for them.  I bought better ones locally.  Not worth the money.  I'd give it less stars but since it's organic, it deserves an extra star.

One of my children wanted "letter" soup, so I ordered a case of this pasta. It is a whole grain pasta, so it is heavier on the pallet than traditional pasta. We have only cooked one box and served it with a simple pasta sauce. We all ate it for lunch (5 of us) and had leftovers...it goes a long way. The flavor is a little off from some other pastas I have tried (but we are not whole grain pasta lovers at all, so take that into account). A good way to have a little fun and change to the lunch menu. And to note...they are very small, like letters in soup. However, none made it through my strainer (not a mesh one, just a "normal" stainless steel one). Good buy for the hearty factor in my opinion!

column9: Why is alphabet pasta so hard to find?
column10: I didn't really want six boxes of alphabet pasta, but since no local store carried them, I didn't have a choice. I did not notice this pasta being smaller in size than others I have tried in the pastWhile I don't advocate letter drills during dinner, funnily enough, the pasta seems to be highly weighted toward the letter "O," which is great as that is one of the letters my child knows. The colors are also fun ("green O!" "Red O!")A good basic pasta, the fact that it is veggie and organic is probably not a significant benefit, but why not?

These taste fine, but they are tiny!  I bought them hoping to use them as small finger food for my 10 month old son.  What a waste! And, an ever bigger waste since you have to purchase a case at a time!  These are about an eighth of an inch big (about the same size as large couscous).
Cooks up quick, lots of nice colors, has letters and numbers, tastes normal, what more can your kids want?
Good clean fun - healthy enough and makes soupmore fun. Good quality and no funky dyes.Yum!

Smells and tastes like freshly baked white chocolate fudge. One thing to be aware of is that the tea bags are unevenly flavored. Some of them taste very strong and some rather weak while most of them are in between.

I absolutely love this tea piping hot & with a dash of cream! The chocolate flavor is wonderful & strong, the cream rounds it out and makes it smooth.This is a great tea for those watching their weight, but still longing for something sweet.I love to drink this tea all winter long (and even during the summer!), and it goes wonderfully with a few shortbread cookies.Hands down the BEST chocolate tea I've ever tried! (and I've tried a LOT!)

column9: A great taste of chocolate with no calories attache.
column10: I LOVE this tea.  It tastes like Hersheys kisses with a mild white chocolate flavor.  It gives me a real "pick me up" when I drink it.

I thought this might end up like the time I tried chocolate yogurt (nasty!), however, I was pleasantly surprised.  This zero calorie black tea has a strong chocolate flavor and smell.  Something's odd about it though, almost a chemical smell.  Chocolate without cream and sugar was bound to be odd!  Still, I'm on my 3rd cup.  It's not the worst tea in the cabinet, but not the best.  I'm impressed that Bigelow (known for cheap office tea) pulled off this flavor.

I am not a big tea drinker, although I know that I should be, for health reasons.I got a sample packet of this tea from someone at work and gave it a try. It is REALLY GOOD!!If you like the taste of chocolate, you will like this.I liked it so much that I put it on a 6-month auto ship.

I'm starting to doubt the legitimacy of reviews for Bigelow teas.  This is the fourth (and last) tea from this company I'll ever purchase, no matter how enticing it is.  Like the other flavors I tried, I really gave it a fair shake, brewing up several cups and sharing with friends.  We came up with the same, insipid black tea with a bizarre chemical-like smell to it each any every time.  None of us could detect anything remotely similar to white chocolate, or much of anything save for a hint of cinnamon.  Might be best to try one box first.

White Chocolate Obsession is a blend of chocolate and robust black tea. I love this tea with milk and Stevia. It also has cinnamon and carob in it. I can definitely taste the carob and black tea more than anything else. If you love tea and you love chocolate you will probably love this tea.

My mouth watered as I eagerly anticipated ordering this, just thinking of what it could taste like. I am a heavy drinker of Bigelow's Eggnog'n tea. So I couldn't even guess what this could taste like. I received the package and eagerly brewed a cup and overall was pleased, but it didn't taste how I had imagined. I noticed in another review that they said it tasted a bit like "chemicals." For the first bag I could see where they would interpret a certain aftertaste to be somewhat like a chemical, but I have not since. After a few cups (not one after another, mind you) throughout a couple weeks it just tastes like some sort of hot chocolate. Even looks that way when I add a bit of soymilk and sugar.Overall I give it a 3.5. Its not amazing. It's not bad. I suppose I just don't have acute tasting skills, but I honestly don't differentiate it too much from a cup of hot chocolate. I actually did put a bag in a cup of hot chocolate and it was definitely a chocolaty heaven. All in all it's good. I'm sure I'll go through all 6 boxes eventually, but I can't say that I'll be ordering more after that. As for the eggnog'n, however, that's an entirely different story :)If you're debating on this, I say order a small box to give it a try, then graduate to the 6-box package if you're blown away.
this product did not meet my tastes. i expected more and actually hated the taste, but i am a very picky person, it is worth a try

This is a full bodied tea with a great chocolate taste. It is not over poweringbut a mellow blend of tea, chocolate with the other spices undescernablein the background.I brewed it in my porcelain teapot for 3 minutes. Trying with and without cream,I found I liked it both ways. Great for that afternoon pick me up.

I LOVE THIS STUFF!  I drink 1 or 2 pots of this tea EVERY day :)  Doesn't even need sweetener.  It's so DEE-LISH!  I drink a pretty wide variety of teas, but this is my #1.  Hope you like it as much as I so.
Excellent tea, unlike most teas, full of flavor, like luxury Hot Chocolate without the thickness, heaviness AND calories! Wonderful tea. It's as good as a sweet treat!

I have been following a low fat no carb diet and craved something sweet after dinner.  This definitely does the trick with a little Stevia to sweeten. I would recommend this to anyone trying to cut calories but want dessert.
This tea is very good.Smells wonderful !I love to sip on tea when watching T.V. in the evening - and this one will be a favorite flavor of mine.

I think this tea is outstanding, but I'm not a traditional tea drinker.  It's probably already sweet to most people, but I add a packet of Splenda and some Almond Joy creamer to it.  Liquid candy bar I call it, with very few calories!

This one smells like hot chocolate and has a nice cocoa flavor.  I drink it unsweetened but it is good with milk and sweetener too.  I alternate this one with the Pumpkin Spice which has a bit more of a bite.  This chocolate tea has a nice mellow flavor and goes great during the cooler fall/winter and early spring months.  I have made iced tea with it as well that isn't bad, although I prefer Raspberry Royale for iced tea because it's more subtle.  But this one isn't bad for iced tea when you're in the mood for something with a cocoa flavor.  Good stuff.

This is the best chocolate tea I've ever had. I'm not a huge fan of white chocolate so I was skeptical initially, but I don't think it tastes like white chocolate particularly, just a great chocolate flavor. Add cream & sugar!

ABSOLUTELY stunning tea! It's delicious! It's the perfect, warm, hearty start to the day! It's so rich that it doesn't need ANY sweeteners or milk... it's perfect wonderful with just hot water. Also, this is an extremely good deal! Individual boxes such as these typically run around $3.50 but buying 6 of them... they come in at a whole $1 less! Bigelow needs to hire me as their brand ambassador because I have been selling this tea to everyone who I come in contact with! ha ha.
Tea tastes nothing like chocolate or white chocolate. No wonder you can't find it to buy it in stores. It isn't very good.

I do a lot of hiking and camping, and have used quite a few dried products from Barry Farms. If you don't mind the taste of dried dairy and veggie products, there is just about nothing you will not find that they haven't managed to dry and bag.  Most of the products by them I came into acquaintance with way back when my son was a youngin' and in the scouts and we did a lot of camping.  A few of the products have stayed with me as extra tasty and versatile now that I am tending to face the savage wilderness alone.  Barry's red bell pepper is one of the best items to have along on a hike, or just to have included in any survival kit.  Bell peppers dress up and add some spice to just about any meat, fish, or stew that you can manage to put together out in the wilderness. And as already noted in the other review, dried products such as this last literally for years without spoiling. This dried pepper is for some reason a lot more favorable to me than genuine bell pepper.  A lot of dried products from Barry Farms have spices added, so perhaps it is the excellent garnish they use.  In any event, a little of this pepper goes a long way.  So don't let the small 2 oz package fool you.  I not only recommend this to add some fine flavoring to whatever campfire cooking you encounter, but I also recommend checking out some of the products by Barry Farms.  They're not all worth it or as flavorful, but most of them are.  And like the other reviewer here, I also recommend you buy several products at once and save a bundle on the shipping.  Recommended...
This makes a good addition to your earthquake or desaster stocks, It is easy to use and will keep for a long time.

I haven't tried the product yet but it was delievered quickly and priced right. I would have preferred it be packed in a bag that wasn't zip-lock but this does allow you to re-seal. Good bargin. Two ounces of dried peppers is a pretty big bag.

After waiting some 3 weeks for this product, thanks in part to one reviewer who, in fact, swayed my decision with the comments "Two ounces of dried peppers is a pretty big bag."  I got some teeny, tiny little 3 x 5 or so zip-close bag with what looks like red pepper bits, flakes and DUST!  I will NEVER make this mistake again.  They even have the gall to put in the directions to "Add 1 C. red peppers to boiling water to reconsitute - - ONE CUP???!!!??? I would guess that not even the entire bag makes 1 cup and it is CERTAINLY NOT "a pretty big bag," as noted.  I was expecting luscious CHUNKS of dried red pepper dices, as advertised and I got a bunch of dust and flakes for my apparently wasted money.  NO MORE!  Do not bother.Make your own.  That's got to be a better deal.  "a pretty big bag," My Foot!
So very happy with this company and I will tell others about them. Keep up the good work and your bussiness will grow, grow and grow.
no problem with product. I ordered in cold weather because of the type of product, so no problem with melting as was one other customer's complaint.
The chocolate is amazing, tastes great, the center melts in your mouth, and the texture is perfect. To those that have a melted center, store the chocolates in a cooler temperature.
THIS IS THE LARGER BOX I ORDERED BECAUSE THEY ARE SO GOOD. EVERYONE WHO EATS THEN JUST RAVES HOW CREAMS AND DELICIOUS THEY ARE

I must say that I purchased all of the candy for myself.  I began buying it out of the store around Christmas, but I loved them so much I decided to buy in larger numbers off the internet and honestly, I've been the one who has eaten most of them.  I am not a candy lover, but these really hit me hard.  I LOVE THEM!
This is a GOOD IDEA!!! everyone who is thinking abt buying these should stop thinking and buy them.

We are fans of the Lindt Lindor Truffles Assorted chocolates with the 5 flavors and wanted to try this special white chocolate flavor for a change. We are not fans of this one. It IS their wonderful white chocolate shell and tastes 'right', however, the gooey center has an odd, almost fungal taste both during consumption and afterwards. By 'fungal' I mean almost like eating raw mushrooms in a salad: that earthy, back of your throat,'taste'. It is quite odd and none of us (there are 8 of us here) found it enjoyable enough to want a second one. We donated this box to our local soup kitchen. (Oh, we also tried the Hazelnut at the same time and that box was donated as well. We like hazelnut, but again, the chocolate shell was normal and the hazelnut center just wasn't anything to write home about. It, too, had an odd flavor and after-taste. We knew none of us would be sneaking either of these two flavors when no one was looking).  We'll stick to the assorted 5 flavors we love. Those can't be beat.

column9: Buying this is a very stressful experience.
column10: Lindt truffles is my husband's favorite chocolate.  Whenever family or friends take a trip to the US, I always  grab the chance to buy it for him.  In that past, it was hassle-free as it would be a store purchase.  Today is the first time I buy it through Amazon.com where I've had pleasant online shopping experiences in the past.  Today is a different story, I place the order at 2-day shipping thinking it would arrive at my friend's hotel by Sept. 17 or 18 at the latest.  I get an order confirmation email from Amazon telling me that the estimated delivery date would be Sept. 20-21 -- my friend would no longer be at her hotel to recieve the delivery.  So I hurriedly log on to my Amazon account to change the order details, either to make it overnight delivery so it arrives sooner or to change the delivery address.  The Amazon system was faulty and could not display my order.  Heck, it could not display any of my orders in the past year even.  It took two hours and still the website displayed sorry can not display your order.  So I place an international long distance call to Amazon customer service to see what they can do and they say it's not showing up in their system.  Great.  In a few minutes though, they email me saying that it finally showed up in their system and that they can't do anything about it since it's a third party seller (Lindt).  So they direct me instead to get in touch with Lindt.  They can change the delivery details or cancel my order altogether and I can just re-order with the correct delivery details.  So I place another international long distance call this time to Lindt, who says it's not showing up in their system.  They suggest I get back to Amazon.  Which I did and again they re-direct me to Lindt.  Back and forth a few more international phone calls later, Lindt tells me to call back in 3 and a half hours to see if it will be up in their system.  How ridiculous is this??  My bill for this order is just US$40 but I'm spending more on the phone calls just to cancel the freaking order which should not be my problem had the Amazon website been up and running instead of saying it can't display my order.What is more stressful in this entire experience is neither Amazon nor Lindt offered any smarts in problem solving or trouble-shooting.  They did not exhibit good customer service behaviour either.Very, very, very disappointing.

When I told my wife I had been searching for Pickled Green Tomatoes she asked if I had lost my mind and said "YUCK". I explained that I had some years ago and loved them. I bought the Jake&Amos 3 pack, chilled them and talked her into trying one. Since then I've only had a couple. Now I'm having to order more. If you like Pickles, you will love these. Five stars, now please rush my new order because every one else has eaten all my Pickled Green Tomatoes.
for some reason. the product is hard to find in stores nowadays....thse are very good, in an excellent brine...my friend and I have enjoyed having these

My cats are crazy for the Whisker Lickin's Crunch Lovers Salmon treats by Purina. I order them by the case and just found out when I tried to reorder that it has been discontinued. (I called Purina.) I had to find something before they ran out, and they are very picky. They won't even sniff the other flavors of the Crunch Lovers up close.Since this was salmon, I decided to give it a try and picked one up at my local grocery store. Well, my picky kitties LOVE it. One of them found the bag and tried to open it! Right then I ordered a case! (Who knows how long this will be around...)If you used to treat your cats with the disontinued Purina item, I really recommend this product!

column4: Lotacats "On the internet, no one knows you'r...
column9: Thought I'd be eaten along with the product.
column10: You know how it is when your kitty literally gets "frantic" when they find just the right eats?  This is one of those times.  I'm swamped with cats. You'd think they'd not eaten for a month. >^.^<>^.^<>^.^<

column9: Our 17 yr. old cats like this
column10: Our picky cats enjoy Friskies Natural Sensations Cat Food with Real Chicken, 2.1-Ounce Packages (Pack of 10). I give them a few every day. I was surprised when I found it on Amazon, & even more surprised when I realized I'd save money by signing up for Amazon's 'Subscribe and Save' program for this product.  I'm happy to save money, and my cats are happy for this tasty treat.

I received this item promptly and my cats love it.  I give it to them as a treat and as soon as I pick up thepackage and shake it they come running from wherever they are in the house.  The price was a lot more reasonablethan when I purchase it in the supermarket.

I have 3 cats and these treats are their favorite.  I confess, I have thoroughly spoiled my fur balls, and at the end of the day they each expect a few pieces just before our household settles in for the night.  And as any cat owner knows, you do not want to disappoint a cat.  If you do, there will be severe consequences. Being able to buy their treats from Amazon in quantity at such a good price is a great value and comfort, and it gives me time to reorder before I run out.

I just ordered the pack of 10, as I laughed out loud when reading the reviewer who said his cat would kill him if he ever ran out.  Well, I have run out, and all three of my cats are frantic. This is the only treat that has allowed me to pill my cats, even with the new cat piller, which works pretty well.  I give them each a treat after their medication, and they are now addicted to these threats.  I hope they arrive quickly...

column9: If they ever discontinue this product, my cat will kill me...
column10: This cat treat has changed my kitty's life...and mine.  I can get her to do just about anything I want her to if I have one in my hand.  She snubs any other treat, no matter now pricey or stinky it is (p.s. these aren't stinky, it's just that it seems like cat's prefer stinky food).  Lots of good nutrition here for your cat; unusual stuff like sunflower seeds and carrots.  If you have a persnickety kitty at your house -- this may change their life, too!

We have 3 indoor cats.  If one gets out, the only way i can get her back in is to open a bag of these treats and shake it. They will do anything for one of these! I hope friskies never stops making this variety.

Went to Walmart to buy the only treats that my fuzzy-buddies will eat.  They didn't have it.  I'm screwed, I thought.  But, Amazon to the rescue, again.  My guys will not eat any other treats, but with Natural Sensations they come running when I shake the bag.  Fun to watch all three enjoy them so much.
No I don't live with my mother.  She has her cat 3000 miles away. She loves her cat. He loves these. I love my Mom. The cat is happy. Mom is happy. I am happy.

Okay, I don't know what the magic ingredient is in this, but my cat is absolutely in love with it! He is one picky eater: I have tried literally all the "healthy" types of treats (Greenies, etc.) I can find in the stores, but he is either lukewarm about them or just refuses to eat them. Alas! I am wary about stuff from Friskies, since I was told that they are "unhealthy." I read the ingredients list and it didn't say "chicken by product" so I guess it's better than the average Friskies? Anyway, I have given up on "healthy" treats (I mix Greenies in his regular food now because I know they don't work as "treats." I guess I will just have to make sure I don't overfeed him with these treats, because he is addicted! My cat is not a lap cat, but he will actually deign to come and sit on my lap when he wants these treats.

My elderly cat loves these hard little treats. She will sit and look at me until she gets one. The bag has a lot of pieces but she only gets one because she swallows whole then sometimes it doesn't stay down, if she had more teeth she could have more. I gave half the first package to the elderly cat at work, she loves them too, now about half done with second package out of 10. I think I will donate some to the food bank they accept pet food because I subscribed and then send me another 10 packages that will last me 10 years or more.

My 2 yr old loves them. He loves them so much he refuses to eat regular cat food unless I mix it in, but if I mix it too much, he smells it, then sits and stares at me. If I'm out I get no end of grief from Sarge.

I LOVE THESE TREATS. I CAN EAT ONE AT A TIME OR A WHOLE  MOUTH FULL IF I AM ON THE RUN. THE TREATS CRUNCH JUST LIKE THOSE CHIPS I FOUND IN A BOWL UP ON THE TABLE. I  CAN NOT OPEN THE ZIP BAGS, BUT I AM GOOD IF IT IS NOT CLOSED ALL THE WAY. PLEASE SEND MORE... WHAT DOES PASSWORD MEAN? .....
My kitty really loves this product. It is a little hard to find in stock in town, so this was perfect. I have a months supply for him.

My "kitty girls" are both almost 16-and I promise they really ASK for these-they actually go over to the pantry door and paw at the door because they know they are inside on a shelf.  They both absolutely love them better than any treat they have ever had-I will be ordering these on line on a regular basis inasmuch as they are less expensive and I can be sure not to run out and have to face them!
We take care of and feed 5 cats.  I have never seen them respond so much to any food.

I am a soda conniseur and I like to try new sodas all the time. This is a favorite, a delicious grapefruit soda from Mexico that is commonly sold in mexican groceries and bakeries in the U.S. It is my favorite flavor from the 10 or so different varieties from the Jarritos company. It tastes kind of like Squirt or other citrus sodas, but lighter with no afterbite. The sugar tastes more authentic and light as they use the more expensive cane sugar instead of the cheap frutose sweetener most soda companies use on us now. The carbonation is a bit lighter as well and not overpowering. Jarritos is now the best selling Mexican soft drink brand in the U.S.  This offer is for a single serving of the grapefruit, but they sell other sizes and volumes at Amazon.

I have tried different types and brands of curry powder in cooking various dishes such as rice, veggies and Indian cuisine.So, far The Spice Hunter has been the best of all the brands I've tried.What makes this brand superb is that to get a quality curry flavor. I don't have to use half a jar to taste the curry, nor are the spicestoo strong.Furthermore, I also like that it is salt-free, which enhances the curry flavor instead of tasting salt.For those of you who like a saltier taste, this probably isn't the brand for you, unless you want to add salt youself.For me, this curry is perfect for my taste and at a reasonable price as well.

column9: Thank you for carrying this brand, my favorite curry
column10: This is by far my favorite curry blend. Seeing this visually in my favorite local market was a determining factor in my purchase. You can visually see the individual ingredients as it hasn't been pulverized to oblivion. So I purchased it, then I used it... OMG I don't usually get excited over bottled spice, but this brand has proven to be an exception. I've since tried and become a fan of The Spice Hunters. Unfortunately my local market quit carrying this brand. So very happy to see it here on Amazon.
The previous review and the price were determining factors for me.I've used the packaged versions and I thought it would be time for a change.I'll report back later.

The product description calls the Orangettes "Belgian Vitamin C."  Except for the luxury price, I'm sure Belgians must be pretty healthy with these around.  They're amazing!  The combination of orange peel and chocolate has long been popular, but Leonidas does it very well.  The dark chocolate is very rich, not bitter, and completely covers the orange peel (which retains a good flavor and isn't overly sweet).  Unlike other chocolatiers who often dip the peel only partially, Leonidas has made certain to put their chocolate center stage by using a generous portion.  The result is an addictive treat because the flavors linger on the palate and the Orangettes aren't so sweet as to become cloying.I don't know if these guys are really going to improve your health, but they will definitely improve your day.  In my opinion, they're worth the money as an occasional purchase and certainly worth a one-time try.The packaging is a gold box, wrapped in blue and white Leonidas paper with a gilt deep purple box.  For shipping, the package was placed inside a sturdy styrofoam shell.  Mine arrived within three days and looked like I'd purchased them at the store to give as a gift.

column9: Crisp chocolate and tender orange peel
column10: This was my dad's absolute favorite candy. He loved orange and bittersweet chocolate best of any flavors and this was, for him a match made in heaven. I adore it as well. After my dad passed away, I found a stash of them in his cupboard. They aren't easy to find, but they make a most welcome after-dinner sweet with coffee for guests.

even it is abit expensive to buy sometimes, but I find that the quality is exceptional, great taste, great packaging, and still cheaper than some other brands with a better taste. The texture and taste are just right!The shipping comes in 2 days, great wrap and bow like its for a present, comes in a foam box. I never had any shipping problems at all.
These are the best I've ever eaten.  The dark chocolate melts in your mouth and the candied orange slices are equally good--even though they do no melt. but have just the right chewiness.

This is the most delicious dark chocolate covered orange peel available anywhere.  It has a smooth, deep, rich chocolate taste with the orange peel being not too sweet.  Have ordered it before and will again many times.  Be careful, it is almost addictive. Have introduced it to friends who have love it and ordered some for themselves.  A treat at an elegant dinner or as a hostess gift.  I absolutely love it.  Yum!!!

If you crave dark chocolate with orange like I do, this is a superlative indulgence, Leonida's Belgian Chocolates, Dark Chocolate Covered Orange Peel. It is the kind of treat you have to horde in a secret refrigerator away from people who get the munchies and will eat any old thing. This is *special*. This feels very French. I was enjoying it so much one day at work that I missed a very important moment. My boss was leaving, soon to be deployed. He said, "Well, see you around." I was in chocolate oblivion. I didn't know that was The Moment to wrap up four years of working together. I watched him in disbelief as he waved his hand. I couldn't cry out, "Wait!" because my mouth was full of Leonida's Dark Chocolate Covered Orange Peel and you cannot talk, chat, email, or read a book, sharing/wasting this gastronomic experience with any mundane task. As I said, that was a big moment lost, but that chocolate was incredible, fulfilling, remarkable!

I am very impressed with this product (and the company that creates it). The packaging is gorgeous - nice enough to give as a gift as is. And the dark chocolate covered orange peels are the best I have ever tasted. The dark chocolate is rich and flavorful. column9: As hot as tabasco sauce and very sweet
column10: So how hot is this sauce? Well, this Malaysian chili sauce is as hot as tabasco sauce and very sweet. It has a lovely bright red color from chilies (and not from food coloring) and it enhances poultry and pork beautifully. No artificial flavors. The ingredients listed on the label are red chilies, sugar, vinegar and salt, in that order.TIP: I make spicy chicken wings with this sauce and they turn out delicious every time, so easy to make too:Preheat oven to 400.Line a cookie sheet with foil.Place the chicken wings in a large bowl and drizzle with some oil and sprinkle with salt.Toss the wings until well coated with the oil and transfer them to the cookie sheet lined with foil.Bake in the oven for 30 minutes, turn wings over and brush them with some Lingham's sauce.Bake for 10 minutes, turn them over again and brush with Lingham's.Bake for 15 more minutes, remove from oven and brush one last time with Lingham's.

Many years ago, when I was living in London, UK, I enjoyed coffee after dinner with Demerara sugar.  Nothing in the US has compared to the flavor of it.  Now I can play "How many lumps?" with my friends or the wildcat in Bugs Bunny cartoons.  Great stuff.

I fell in love with sugar cubes when I lived in Europe. When I returned to the US, I had the hardest time finding them in the grocery stores. I decided to search Amazon for them and was so pleased when I found this product. It is made from real sugar and dissolves quite rapidly when dropped into my tea. Using these sugarcubes also help me to be cautious and consistent in the amount of sugar that I use. Thank God for Amazon for having almost any product that I desire!
These perfect little sugar cubes are delightful. They are golden brown natural sugar cane and taste great.Also very fun to serve guests with their coffee or tea!

These woodears are top quality. They come pre-shredded, making them easy to add to soups and stir-fries. They swell A LOT when rehydrated. The texture is wonderfully hearty, the flavor exceptional. This company, Fungus Amongus, produces the highest quality products across the board. I've purchased dried mushrooms from many other companies, but their quality is the best. Should you have any inquiries, they also respond in a timely fashion. Also highly recommend the truffle salt and dried porcinis............best ever!!

This is a great product that not only works to whiten teeth and freshen my dog's breath, but she actually begs for them!!  And it's natural and good for her. These are hard to find at the pet store as they have discontinued them, and I have been searching for them for some time.  THAT'S how much my dog loves them, and THAT'S how great they work!  I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THEM

We had our dog on Pedigree Hip and Joint for the past couple of years.  When it was no longer offered as Subscribe & Save, we thought we would give something new a try.  There was a noticeable difference in our dog after being off the Pedigree and on the Cani Vitalis; a worse difference.  She doesn't get up as easy and isn't as playful and spunky.  We will have to go back to what we know works.
My dogs go crazy over these treats, and not just this flavor but every treat  cani vitalis makes. My dogs are papillons so are only about 5pounds each. Makes this the perfect size treat.

I have already written to complain about the packaging of these cans of nuts....have had no reply.The cans were stacked 4 tall and completely covered with a very sticky tape.  When I tried to remove the tape,which was not easy task, it ripped the Planters can covers off in many places.  I had wanted to use these as Christmas gifts but could not.  They looked like someone retrieved them from a dump.  I was very disappointed.However, we are eating the nuts ourselves.  The Planter products are always good.
Buying these from Amazon makes this great nuts a good value.  My only issue is from what i remember is that the amount of peanuts is a bit high.  Just my preference.

I have been hooked on Starbucks Frappucinos for years - when they recently changed the formula I was so upset. I do not like the new taste. I tried McDonalds Frappe's but didn't like the taste as much. I figured my Frappe days were over and that I would just start drinking iced mochas.When I came on Amazon a couple of weeks ago, I somehow ended up seeing that there were MOCAFE Frappe's you can make at home. I first was wondering if they would taste good, and then would they be hard to make? The 3 pound tin was on sale so I decided it would be worth a try. I am so glad I did!All you have to do is put 16 oz of ice in a blender (measurements are right on the blender), add 4 oz of coffee, milk or water, and then 2 scoops of the powder. My first try I used 4 oz of coffee - it tasted really good but had a very strong coffee taste. The next one I used milk and it was perfect! The other day I ran out of milk and used water and it tasted the same as when I used milk, so I figured it is a great way to save 60 calories or so.It costs $20 for the can, and it makes about 15 servings that are 16oz. With that in mind I realized I save $40 by not going to Starbucks and making my own - each can! Also no gas expense going to the mocha stand. I drink one a day so the savings really add up!I highly recommend you give this a try.

When you are 80 years old, you know when something taste incredibly good. Rich, smooth, and just the right amount of ingredients to make you say, "Man, that is good!"  I usually add a little more of the Wild Tribe when making this treat with a cup lined with a swirl of chocolate syrup and topped with some whipping cream. For a little extra flavor, I occasionally add a shot of espresso.

column9: Rich chocolate mix perfect for frappes
column10: This is a great blend to create a frappe. The chocolate taste is rich but not too sweet. We make ours in the vitamix blender (and awesome machine on its own), following instructions on the tin with 2% milk and it's fantastic!  It's richer than Starbucks regular mocha frapuccino and not as sugary sweet as McDonald's mocha frappe. If you are a chocolate mocha frappe lover you won't be disappointed!MOCAFE Frappe Wild Tribe Moka, Ice Blended Coffee, 3-Pound Tin

column9: Pay $0.60 per drink or pay $4.60 per drink, your choice!
column10: This mix is fantastic! I have been addicted to Starbucks frappucinos for over 10 years and it never helps that I live close to a 24 hour one. My daily visits were really taking a toll on my budget and I too was really upset when they changed the recipe to the "however you want it" frappucino.I don't know how I found this mix, but I'm glad I did. It tastes just like a Starbucks Mocha Frappucino or a Caribou Cooler. I use my Mr. Coffee Cafe Frappe, but this drink can definitely be made in a regular blender. I use one scoop of the Mocafe, two tablespoons of my favorite coffee, about 1.5 cup of ice, some vanilla soy milk, and sometimes a little bit of coconut syrup. The mix does come with a recipe, but you have to play around to create your own recipe just the way you like it. My tin did come with a scoop so I have had no measurement problems. Also, since I only use one scoop of the Mocafe and this tin contains 35 scoops, I estimated that I am paying about $0.60 per frappe if I don't include the soy milk and coffee costs (which are regular household items for me anyway). I don't know if I'll visit another coffee chain again!

My husband use to go to  mcdonalds  a few time a week to get a caramel frappe one day he saw the mocafe on amazon and wanted to try it and he hasn't bought a frappe from mcdonalds since,  we make ours with 2% milk and it's the best, plus we don't get that caffine acid reflux that you get from fast food places. we highly recommend the tahitian vanilla latte we just ordered one each of the other flavors, try some whipped cream and caramel and you'll be hook too.

I find this Frappe Wild Tribe Moka to be a good value. A good price for the amount of mix. I know a coffee house that uses this exact product and charge a lot for one cup. The taste is WONDERFUL. It has a dark roast coffee flavor with a hint of chocolate and sweetness.

This mocha frappe mix is good but I prefer the original. I drink this hot, mixed with water. The coffee flavor is heavier here. But I can taste the chocolate too! My only big problem; it doesn't dissolve well. No matter how ferociously I stir. A fine way to feed my coffee obsession.
We've tried several of frappe mixes and this is hands down our favorite.  Although I do like the low calorie version, especially if I have already eaten my quota of calories.

I ordered this trying to save money from not heading to McD's every morning for my mocha frappe fix. I am hooked. I was excited to get this, it shipped pretty quickly and I tried it out as soon as I opened the box. The instructions on the tin, weren't the right amount for me. So I have adjusted and am trying to find my amounts. The listed 2 scoops of Mocafe mix is too much for me (it turned out tasting powdery). So I have cut down on to about 1 scoop, plus a splash of choc syrup in the blender. I also found that taking time to make coffee ice cubes out of 2 or 3 ice cube trays I found at the dollar store made a wonderful mix!All in all this Mocafe is pretty darn good. Doesn't taste like the McD's frappe but I'm hooked & happy with being able to make at home instead of spending the $3.96 everyday. That gets pretty pricey after awhile.

column9: No Need to Ever Pay $$$$ For a Frappe Again!
column10: This product is great and truly "mocha" flavored.  It is not too sweet and can be altered if you prefer more of a coffee flavor, or a creamier blend by adding yogurt or ice cream. My only suggestion, to avoid a powder texture taste, is either mix it with warm liquids or mix a large quantity and store it in your fridge.  I bought this to go with my Margaritaville Mixer and I will never again pay $5 or $6, for a frappe or any frozen drink because I was able to buy the drink base on Amazon.  I suggest the Vanilla Bean, too, for a wider variety of drink options and being able to give your guests a nice treat.
I have been purchasing Wild Tribe Moka Frappe mix for years.  It has a great blend of spices making the frappe an enjoyable treat.

If you like paying $'s to have someone make you a frozen coffee drink, read no further.  This product is for those who enjoy making their own drinks, in their own home, at their own leisure.  I use my Margaritaville Frozen Concoction Maker to put this together, but it is easily made in a good blender.I saw this product being used at a coffee shop in Kennebunkport, took the name down and found it here on Amazon.In my humble opinion, it's better than the Serendipity frozen chocolate mix Oprah touts.

I have drank this for many years.My first year I bought it at Sams for a couple of bucks,they stopped selling it. I was so happy to find it right here on Amizon.The problem,I had it delivered every six months. Well now I,m out of work I cancled my subscription guess what I recieved 6 more cans after I cancled in Oct.2010 and they put it on my credit card anyway.Product great,business practice horrid.
Have enjoyed this product for several years.  Shipped in well packed box.  Also, I can make this drink at home now for alot less per serving than I was paying at my local coffee shop!

We have purchased several tins of the Mocha Frappe now and it is always a hit.  Good flavor balance, not too sweet and is even good when blended with water or plain almond milk.  Definitely a contender!

This stuff is awesome! It is just as good if not better than anything you can buy at a coffee shop and with the convenience of being able to make it at home anytime I want, I am hooked. To tell you the truth if it were to cost more than the coffee shop frappe I use to get every day I would still buy it. The fact that I am saving so much money is just over the top. Big fan here. Love this stuff! I'll be subscribing to this item for sure.
love this blended drink. one of my local coffee shops makes these and sells them for 5$ this have saved me a ton on my addiction.tastes amazing done with soymilk.
Taste exactly like Atlanta Bread's Kona Coffee frozen drink. I am so excited! Definitely will buy it again as soon as I finish the can!!!!
I bought a Mr. Coffee Frappe maker and use the blended coffee. It makes a first class frappe, albeit a little expensive.
These morels are very good.  They add  great flavor and texture to omelets, soups, and stews. I recommend soaking them overnight for best results. Happy with my purchase.

This soda... it's so great! I mean, it tastes wonderful and on the plus side, it is not as bad for you as a soda like Coke - a - Cola or Pepsi. I looked on the back, expecting it to be way worse then a soda down here, but omg! I was shocked. So in my opinion... this is a great drink. Amazing taste, cool bottle, healthier. Only bad side is you only get one... and pay for each one... but other then that, I love, love, love it!Five stars for this product!

This is a very interesting concoction. It is a piece of sponge cake, with a dollop of raspberry filling all encased in a very thin chocolate skin. The taste is OK, I mean who doesn't like raspberry filling or chocolate or sponge cake? And anyway if you didn't you shouldn't be eating this.But what's great about this is the tactile sensation. When you put it in your mouth you first taste the chocolate skin, then you bite down on it and you release the raspberry filling and finally bite down into the sponge cake. Then you masticate and mix it all up in your mouth. Trust me, the taste is good, but the tactility of this product is even better.
Definitely one of my favorite Organic Coffees EVER! Thank you Premium Organic Cafe for offering the best coffees for coffee lovers.

I love this 51% whole grain pasta by Barilla.  A nutritionist recommended switching to whole grain pasta.  Initially it was difficult to find a whole grain pasta that wasn't too gritty tasting and fell apart.  Then I stumbled upon this Barilla pasta and it has a great texture and taste.  I make a lot of healthy tomato sauces (using vegetable juice and canned tomatoes) with cut up vegetables (peppers, zucchini, onions, mushrooms, black beans etc.) and chopped turkey or low-fat ground beef to pour over the whole grain pasta.  It's a quick nutritious meal that everyone enjoys.  The pasta takes less than 10 minutes to cook.Sometimes I keep the pasta leftovers separate from the sauce as the penne, if sitting in the heavy sauce over night, breaks up.  I just pour the left-over sauce into a large glass container, put the left-over cooked penne or rotini on top and the next evening mix and microwave them for another tasty meal.  You don't have to feel guilty eating pasta as a serving is 24% of your fiber requirements, low in sodium, low sugar and low fat.  If offers 7g of protein for about 200 calories.

column9: Harney & Sons Earl Grey silk Teabags
column10: Whilst Twinings may have the better known name, this lovely product will add a touch of elegance to your entertaining because of the beautiful silk teabags which give a real sense of fine dining!
This is my husband's favorite earl grey!  I can't wait to give it to him!  I only wish they had this one in a tin as I have a thing for tea tins.

These are light and crispy and tart but sweet.  We originally ordered them in a fundraising catalog, and when they were gone, I had to hunt them down on the web.  My husband LOVES them and I order them special for him.  I have yet to find a Key Lime cookie that compares.  I'm a chocolate chip cookie gal, yet I really like these.  They are also dainty enough to impress friends when you serve them at luncheons or get-togethers.  I have tried all the flavors, and key lime is the best (although they are all good).

column9: Have something really good! Wonderful cookies! They hit the spot! Great snack, Great gift!
column10: These are wonderful little treats, elegantly packed. A treat has to be good, satisfying with 1 or 2 bites, and worth every calorie.  These certainly are!  Crispy, light and sweet-hope Amazon carries these always. The lime essence is in the powdered sugar, so be sure to enjoy that with the cookies.A collection of 6 nicely packed boxes  enables you to give a nice box to a deserving friend. And these certainly are appreciated!Note: freshness is not an issue.
Not the same drops from Flathau that I remember. The ones I was expecting had powdered sugar. I was disappointed.

These lemon snaps are some of the best cookies I've ever eaten.  They taste better than home-made, with a hint of cracked lemon candy inside each cookie.  I would serve them at one of my finest dinner parties.

These are great!  They taste very fresh and have the perfect bite of lime flavor with plenty of powdered sugar.  The packaging is very nice, which made these great gifts for our clients.  The boxes weren't packed very well for shipping to Amazon, so two of six had damaged corners, but the others were in good condition (original shipping boxes inside Amazon's shipping box).
Haven't gotten my shipment yet from Amazon but I've gotten these at TJ Max in the past and they are wonderul.  Sweet and soft.  The Key Lime ones are also fabulous!

When I received these key lime snaps I noticed they were ready to expire.  There is no way we can eat 6 boxes of these in 2 weeks.  They are very good and have a great taste.  I am very upset about this product.  I have never had a problem with any products I have bought on Amazon.  I hope Amazon does something about this. A very upset and disappointed customer.

i generally dont like the taste of coffee syrups, but, when i was working at a cafe, we had the peanut butter syrup for a short period of time, and it was the best for flavoring up coffees and lattes, mix a bit of chocolate syrup with this and you have a slammin' desert coffee.

column9: The best sauce in a jar!
column10: Our family is positively addicted to Don Pomodoro Puttanesca Sauce.  It is worth every penny!!  The ingredients are of a very high quality, you can taste the individual ingredients, and the best word to describe it is "Bright"!  My husband does not like green olives but he loves this sauce.

My dogs love this food,they share a can in the morning to take their supplements. I would give them both a whole can daily if it didn't cost so much, although this is the best price I've found. I use this can food only to mix in garlic/brewers yeast tablets and Liquid Health level 5000, (which is Glucosamine with Perna mussel, MSM & shark cartilage (chrondroitin) bromelain amoung other things)the best joint product I found for the dogs. I also put down their mouth a fish oil capsual right before they eat the can food. My dogs are big dogs, 9 years old one very active & healthy, the other is good, but allergies and going to a Chiropractor every 3 weeks( has helped him greatly (he had neck and upper back  problems; what vets call spondolous (spelling?)He is doing good. They get a primal deffense(probiotic by Garden of life)and a blue/green algae tablet put down their mouth first thing in the morning, then later I feed them the can food. I also have Natures Variety grain free dry food out for them if they get hungery they may eat,and I make patties to freez that they get,along with raw chicken necks or backs daily, (vet said raw chicken necks or backs were safe and would keep teeth clean, it's cleaning them, most of the build up is gone of the back teeth where they were getting it.)The patties are raw ground turky,flax meal, eggs, shredded corrots, brocoli, aspargus and celery blended up, along with frozen blueberries, maybe  afew cranberries, fresh apples sredded, olive oil, sea salt, garlic powder,Perfect food by G of L. mix all and make paties in freezer bags, they love to eat them frozen, it's like a treat to them.

I put a little spoonful of this on top of my dogs' serving of dry Happy Hips kibble. They go nuts for it. Even my picky JRT gobbles it down. The Nature's Variety has a "people food" smell that I think appeals to them. The ingredients are healthy and you get a good ratio of meat to gravy in each can. Some other canned foods have so much gravy that you don't really get your money's worth.
This is 650mg/salt/tsp. which is slightly lower than 850mg/salt/tsp. on regular miso.  Nice taste, flavors.  Will order again soon, as it's a big hit with low-salt lovers around here.

I love this miso!  It's still salty enough to satisfy, but because it's lower salt, you can work with it easier, add more to your soup, experiment making salad dressings.  Plus there's no MSG -- can't beat that for healthy miso soup!
My first try at making miso soup turned out great thanks to this product! Very, very tasty. I will definitely buy this again.

column9: Great, delicate flavor, not too salty.
column10: It did take a while for this Miso to get in and it came in four days after the arrival date listed as they sold out and didn't update the listing, however the seller was quick to address the issue and give a partial refund, which was great and remedied the issue.The packaging is kind of flimsy, but works well enough. I was mostly using it for a homemade vegan cheese spread and also going to try and make a vegan version of salted caramel using miso instead of butter.Overall I think it's a great value and exactly what I was looking for.

This is my first foray into the world of miso and I must say it is a godsend to bland tasteless food. I have added it to soup, rice, bulgar, and other similiar foods. Give it a try, a little goes a long way.

I'd heard about fermented soy being a regular food staple in the Japanese diet and after one purchase now consider it a necessary nutritious additive in my own. Its benefits as an antioxidant alone make this tasty treat worthwhile not to mention numerous other health-giving assets.  Spread on toast or adding its subtle flavor to soups and vegetables Honzokuri low salt miso is the best new find in the Western kitchen.

Unfortunately, the wines where the alcohol has been removed tend to have not been completely fermented before the alcohol extraction.  That leaves them very fruity and somewhat sweet.I found the FRE Merlot to be slightly sweet and somewhat palatable.  Since I can no longer drink "real" wine, this is at least something that does not totally offend the senses.

I received this item on time. It was a great price. My family loves pancakes on the weekend. We like this mix, but I have to add 2 Tbls of sour cream or yogurt to the 2 cups of mix to make it rich and moist. Before I tried adding sour cream or yogurt, my family said that this mix was just ok. column9: Best mix I have ever tried
column10: We stopped making waffles years ago because if you wanted light and crisp waffles it required whipping the egg whites until stiff. Then you folded them into the other ingredients. Then a friend let me try some of this mix, I am sold. Best, simple and when made with seltzer water they were light and had perfect taste. My boyfriend thought they were very good as well, so much that we had them for dinner! :-)) Thank you Amazon for the free shipping! Amazon is my FAVORITE place to shop for everything!  :-))

They are great by themselves, even better with coffee as a small and delicious dessert, perfect for lunchboxes, and perky stuck at an angle in a bowl of ice cream. I got a free sample of this tea at a local health food store several months ago, and tonight I finally tried it. I was with a group of women and girls at a restaurant, and we were all wowed over the scent of the tea bag. I got hot water and made the tea, and several of us tried it. I plan on trying all the Tulsi teas my local store carries, and I may mail order the rest if the ones I try are as good as this.

Shallots are a terrific addition to one's pantry. They have a nice taste, less obtrusive than some onions. They can be used in recipes in a variety of ways. I like gently sauteeing them and including them on sandwiches or in other recipes.A good addition to anyone's pantry. . . .

column9: Finally, I can feed my dog a raw diet!
column10: I have 19 month old Rottweiler mix that came to me as a rescue. (rott-boxer, I presume) When I first brought her home she was a ravenous eater who was used to literally INHALING her food so the other dogs she fostered with wouldn't steal it from her. The first few months I had her on a rotation diet of various high quality grain-free kibbles and would mix in various things from high quality canned to salmon or tuna or pumpkin. I also had the luxury of being able to mix in the various supplements into her meals without her noticing.. Sigh, those really were the easy days.At some point during this time I read about the benefits of a raw diet, and although I'm a vegetarian of 15 years I wanted to try it for my dog. Unfortunately it gave her diarrhea and she stopped eating it completely, so I gave up. Even cooked meat upsets her tummy - (which I now know that I can slow cook meat at a low temperature in a covered glass container to help keep the loss of important nutrients and enzymes through cooking to a minimum)Unfortunately after treating her for worms, which definitely was the cause of her slight frame and ravenous appetite, and a bout with coccidia she lost her appetite completely. I was at my wits end trying to feed her and tried everything and anything without much luck.After trying out everything I could think of and then some, I managed to somewhat find a solution. If I took one of her treat toys, coated the bottom with peanut or raw almond butter, put in the kibble (and some of the supplements I used to give her, although not all) and then coated the food in peanut butter she would eat. If I partially hand fed her I could get her to eat a cup of food or more, and I could increase that amount by mixing kibbles in with our training treats while out on our walks.Although I was happy to at least have a dog who was eating again (at least once every few days, which actually is probably closer to how dogs would eat in the wild) I was not happy feeding the SAME kibble and the SAME peanut or raw almond butter every day. I found a bag of Vital Essentials Beef Patties on sale at a local family owned shop and decided that the $6 investment was worth it to see if she would eat it.I started feeding it to her by crumbling up some and mixing in with her peanut butter every night. (I figured a little raw was better than no raw at all, plus adding the extra caloric content wasn't bad either) Finally one day I took out a patty and held it out to her nose to see if she was interested - and of course it was a no go. Then I got creative and smoothed some raw almond butter on top, and as soon as she smelled it her eyes got huge and she wolfed it down. I was ecstatic - FINALLY!!!! I can feed my dog raw and know that she is enjoying some of the benefits of a healthy raw diet; without having to worry about the diarrhea that always undoubtedly came.She will still occasionally turn her nose up at it, and it's not the ONLY food I feed her - But it's the one I definitely feel the best about feeding! Since her appetite and diet changed her BM's tend to be loose more often than not. Even after adding a probiotic (in pill form, since I can no longer sprinkle supplements into her food) to her diet I didn't notice much of an improvement - until she started eating Vital Essentials! Now her bm's are as they should be - very small (for her size) and can be picked up without leaving any on the grass but isn't so hard that she has a hard time getting it out.She now will typically eat it twice a day, although she will turn her nose up at it after 1 large patty or 2-3 small ones. For a dog of her size that simply wouldn't be enough food for her, and I believe in a variety diet anyway to emulate how they would eat in the wild.I love the fact that I know it is filling, which I really appreciate when I'm working and I know she's sitting at home waiting. I hate to think of her sitting there hungry, but many times would come home and find her belly gurgling as she devoured kibble out of my hand out of pure hunger.The only concerns or issues I have with the food is as follows -1) When I first bought the mini beef patties on sale I was perplexed by the packaging - I couldn't figure out if they were supposed to be reconstituted with water or served dry as is, and even the store clerk wasn't sure. Maybe some added instructions on the bag that they can be served "as is" would eliminate potential confusion.(I also couldn't picture my dog eating the patties because even for her they just seemed too thick and large - Of course all I had to do was break them up for her after coating the pieces with pb!)2 - Definitely not widely available locally. The store I originally found it in ONLY had that one bag (although still listed as a purveyor on the Vital Essentials website) and has never restocked. Of course I can and do order through Amazon but it would be nice to be able to purchase locally as well.3) Price - Of course price is going to be a concern for everyone in this economy, but I can't IMAGINE trying to feed this as her primary food. For smaller dogs I'm sure it's not nearly as bad - the mini-patties come in a bag that's around $25 with free shipping. (with prime) Unfortunately for larger dogs that may require 8 or more patties a day that bag won't last very long.... And prime shipping isn't available for the larger patties.The other option is to order to large patties but a roll of those would still only last 1-2 weeks and can cost as the Origen Regional Red kibbles she tolerates that will last a month or more!4) Sizing - It would be really nice if they made a LARGER bag of Beef mini-patties available on Amazon - I've noticed some of their other varieties will come in 14 and 16 oz. bags, but I've only found beef in the 14 oz. Even better if it would come in a 20 oz. bag and was priced in between the large patties and the 12 oz. bag of mini-patties5) Some type of frequent buyer program would be nice! (Especially considering there are other freeze dried patties out there to try!)That said, I noticed that one of the companies I buy from through Amazon for the larger patties changed their pricing so the shipping is now built into the price and they offer a 5% discount if you buy two packages and 10% if you purchase even more - I usually only buy one at a time because of the cost but since they are offering the discount I figured heck, why not?Still, I'd like to see something from the manufacturer directly, or even just an occasional coupon from their website here or there.Overall these are all MINOR issues - just wanted to point them out for people who may be considering this food. My dog LOVES their beef rolls and so do I. I love the fact that she eats it, sometimes twice daily! This is a dog that routinely sticks her nose up at steak or chicken or lamb but absolutely LOVES to chow down on grass.I love the fact that it's raw, AAFCO approved meaning it's a balanced raw diet, and that the company has such stringent methodologies of ensuring safe, nutritious food for your dog. I definitely recommend this food to at least give it a shot and see if your dog will like it - hopefully the company sends samples if you contact them.
Product arrived quickly. For my taste, was not as delicious as either theoriginal Walkers shortbread or the Walkers ginger shortbread.

I usually don't particularly like shortbread cookies, especially from Scotland, since I think they're too hard, but I buy it for my mom who loves them, so I picked a box up at Marshall's for $5 and instead of their usual, they had "vanilla shortbread." I LOOOOVE most furikake, especially on rice and for spam musubis.  Unfortunately this flavor just does not taste that good / flavorful to me.  I'd try a different type

This brand is a little more expensive than the House Foods mabo tofu sauce but it's worth it in my opinion.  I always add some extra stir fry veggies like broccoli, carrots, and water chestnuts and serve it over rice.  Super easy to make and it can serve several people.

I bought this because I'm slowly getting into doing bentos, and rice onigris seemed like something cute to try to do, but I feared they would be too bland.  I heard about furikake and it seemed like a good idea in order to give rice some taste; then the problem was: which furikake variety to choose?I like nori (the seaweed used to wrap sushi, and the one most furikakes contain if it just says "seaweed"), but I know I would be wrapping my onigris in it to avoid them falling apart. column9: Nescafé Dolce Gusto Brewers, Caffè Lungo Decaffeinato
column10: From time to time I have to switch to decaffeinated coffee. I personally am not a big fan of the flavor, but I have to admit this is one of the best decaffinated coffee's I have ever had. Most taste so sour and acidic, but suprisingly this one does not. If you prefer decaf or need to drink it I would highly recommend this one!
This coffee is OK. I have given my Nescafe machine away since I bought this coffee. It's just too much trouble to order coffee by mail when I can get the 'other' brand at the grocery store.
The coffee is great or good enough.However, I am very surprised that Amazon allows this seller to sell at this outrageous price.The coffee should be around $10 a box, not $15.

This is good coffee, made with the Nescafe Dolce Gusto piccolo coffee maker.  I like having the individual cups.  Just pop it in the freezer for a few minutes, add skim milk and ice and it's a great iced latte.  Nescafe needs more variety of decaf than just this one.

column9: Good but not quite like the real thing
column10: I was happy to find Avena smoothies available in the US, as it is a delicious, smooth and nutritious drink that blends oats and milk. The Tetra pack with straw makes it perfect at home, for school lunches or on the go. It can be drunk by the glass, in cereal, or as a snack. The long expiration date (about 6 months without refrigeration) is a big plus. It is made in the USA and distributed directly by the manufacturer, Alpina Foods, out of Miami FL.That said, I was surprised at the ingredients: water, sugar, powdrered milk, oat flour, mono & diglycerides, carragenan, guar gum, xhantan gum, salt, sodium tripolyphosphate. In terms of nutrition: 180 calories, 4 grams of fat (3 are saturated), 10 mg cholesterol, 115 mg sodium, 22 gr sugar, 1 gr fiber, 5 gr protein, Calcium 16 DV%. While it tastes similar to real avena, the overly processed ingredients give me pause. I will be looking for a recipe for real avena which is probably not that hard to make and a lot healthier.As a sidenote, you can buy this at your local supermarket (in the section of south american foods) in 8 oz containers for half the price.

column9: Premium Edge Senior Dog Food Lamb and Rice
column10: I have fed my last two dogs Premium Edge Senior dog food with lamb being the protein.  I am currently mixing it with Premium Edge large breed puppy chow which is a 27/16 protein/fat.  Typically German Shepherd's are fedlarge breed puppy chow through 15 months.  My GS has Panoesteitis (Long Bone Disease) and I needed to reduce the protein without any additional growth components while still feeding her the necessary requirements.  She eats Premium Edge Large Breed Puppy Chow Lamb based and I substitute one of her four cups a day with the Senior Light.  I discontinued her vitamins due to the excess protein and I feed her as mentioned above.  I think the added supplements for seniors helped with her limp and strengthened her bones overall.  She is 13m months old and almost done with the Panoestetis; it is a self-limiting disease and generally heals by 18mo - 2 yrs.  I am not advocating that protein causes Panoesteitis - its just one of the mentioned possible causes.I would recommend Premium Edge which is made by Diamond foods.  Google Diamond Foods and you will see all the brands they supply.

I cannot say enough good stuff about this dog food.  I've been using this dog food for over 10 years and it has been difficult at best to find.  I'm so glad to see it on amazon!My 8 yo 50 lb. mutt was showing signs of age, sleeping a lot, and basically not much else.  My vet asked what I fed him and I told him Science Diet.  He said - well that's a good food.  I was then turned onto this food (for my 65+ lb lab) and I noticed an enormous difference in my mutt.  He became the fun active dog I'd always known him to be and basically stayed that way till he died at 15.5 years old.  I totally attribute his activity and long life to this food.My lab was always active so in all honesty I did not notice any changes in her.  The food is dosed with glucosamine and chondroitin for healthy joints - which is a nice to have when you have larger breed dogs that sometimes have joint problems.

column9: Excellent food and easy on pocketbook
column10: I buy 1 bag a month for my 5 indoor dogs and they love it.  All nutritious ingredients - no junk, corn, wheat, fillers.  Only thing I add is salmon oil.  I highly recommend.  Even my Malinoiis loves this.

My Boston is 12 yrs old. Two years ago, he developed a skin condition characterized by flaking, excessive itching and bald spots on his coat. The vet prescribed methazolamide and Omega -3 fish oil: the former was toxic to his system, the latter, alone, didn't improve the condition. She then suggested Premium Edge in combination with the fish oil. I started out with the salmon (blue bag) which he's been up until this month. This time I ordered the lamb and he gobbles it up despite the fact that it's never a good idea to change your pet's diet, taste-wise anyway. Since he's been on Premium Edge, his coat has returned to normal and he no longer suffers itching. Whether or not the cessation of symptoms can be attributed wholly to Premium Edge may be coincidental but I wouldn't feed him anything else, either. I order the 35-lb bag because, for an elder 24 lb dog, it lasts months. Also, I no longer add fish oil. This food seems to provide all the nutritional requirements for a soon-to-be 13 yr old terrier.

Love this chocolate -- best sugar free chocolate by far. Usually get it at walmart for $1.50 a bar and buy like 5 or so... i wonder what it will cost when amazon starts to carry it.

For years, Russell Stover had the best Sugar-Free/Low-Carb chocolate on the market.  That was until I found this delight!  Their dark chocolate bar is so supremely rich and decadent that you'd never know it was sugar-free at all!  I prefer their dark chocolate (50% cacao) for everything.  They do have one with almonds (45% cacao) that is good for snacks.  My sister prefers their milk chocolate, but I find the dark has a much better chocolate flavor without being bitter at all.It's also FANTASTIC for cooking!  I use this bar in any recipe requiring melted chocolate or baking chocolate and it is incredible when used as a glaze or for dipping (my friends RAVED over the chocolate-covered almonds I made with this).  I used to be able to find this at Wal-Mart, but I believe they have stopped carrying it.  Hopefully, I will be able to find it locally, but if not, Amazon, get this in stock!

I love this dark chocolate bar, absolutely great chocolate taste with a creamy smooth texture. I have been a dark chocolate fan for years but this is one of the best. Bought it for months at a local grocery store but it now seems to have disappeared from the shelves. I can't get it here online and this is the only chocolate bar I really want now.
This is a great chocolate bar. sugar free and low carb and great taste. not too bitter and creamy tasting

I don't post much on any site, but I had to about this product.  I am dieting and this is the tastiest chocolate I have found with the lowest calories.  I allow myself 1-2 squares after dinner in the evening and it is so satisfying.  Only 66 calories for 2 squares! I wish more stores carried Simply Lite.

According to a newsletter article I recently received from Dr. Joseph Mercola (some of his stuff has to be taken with a grain of salt) Monsanto infiltrated the U.S. government in order to gain approval for its GMOs. I bought this brownie mix mainly so I could get free super-saver shipping on a music order.  But I made the brownies, and they were fabulous! column9: Use with caution, and close proximately to a bathroom
column10: I'm currently doing the Jorge Cruise "low sugar/carb" diet (which works)and Matlitol is called for in some of his recipes.  Well, no where did it say that if you use it, you're likely to have stomach issues, and by issues I mean severe gas and diarrhea.  Sorry to be graphic, but better you know what you're getting yourself into before hand. It took almost 24 hours to "return to normal".If you have no issues with the above, give it a try, it tasted fine.  You may want to Google Matlitol side effects for more information. I will not make any more recipes that call for this.

Buyer Beware Please! This sweetener is not for everybody. Maltitol is an alcohol sugar and can be undigestible in the body.  You will know a short time after consuming it if you are one of the unsuspecting many who cannot digest it by the extreme intestinal bloating and cramping and massive amounts of gas a person can experience.  Nausea, diarrhea & headaches can also be experienced.  I learned my lesson the hard way years ago when I fell in love with the sugar-free chocolates suzanne sommers used to sell.  I thought I'd found sugar-free chocolate nirvana at first taste but the bliss was short lived when the terrible side effects of maltitol kicked in.  The discomfort was unlike anything I had ever felt before.  I blew up like a balloon and had very painful abdominal cramping.  As the symptoms passed, this too was very unpleasant.  Though hard for me to believe a low calorie sweetener could be the culprit, all symptoms were gone when I stopped eating the chocolate.  My hunch it had something to do with the maltitol were unfortunately confirmed for me about a year later when I purchased some delicious sugar-free popcorn at my local market.  The taste was amazing and while I was looking at the label wondering what could possibly make this yummy, new sugarfree treat taste so good, my heart sank when I followed the little asterisk next to sugarfree sweetener* down to the very bottom of the label and read "maltitol" in tiny little letters!  Thank goodness I'd eaten only a little.  I still ended up with the same side-effects but for a much shorter duration.  Some people can use maltitol to their heart's content but others, like me, can have a bad reaction to it.  In case you're like me, ... it's not you ... it's the maltitol!

The walnut pieces are smaller than chopped and are perfect for toppings and in baking recipes calling for finely chopped nuts.  The order was packaged very well and arrived within two days after I placed the order.  Thanks Amazon!

This is a great nut topping for almost anything. It can be substituted for any  receipe that calls for chopped nuts. The packages are just the right size for cakes, brownies or cookies. The flavors of the tea infused is quite wonderful.  For the black teas or the Earl Greys, I typically use 2 bags; with Revolution tea, one tea bag will suffice!

I bought this for my girlfriend who loves tea. She really enjoys the different flavors that you can't find just anywhere. She also said the flavor is not over powerful or to weak. great buy all around.

Scant beams of light burn between the cracks in the boards on the lone window frame, illuminating my tattered and orange-stained clothes. column9: These are awesome, fatty, and flavorful.
column10: These little pretzel pieces are totally addictive, which is probably not a good thing because they're a lot worse for you than you'd think pretzels should be. They have around 60 fat calories and 3 grams of saturated fat in ONE ounce, which equals out to be 15% of your daily sat fat intake per serving (one ounce).The reason they're so good AND so fatty is that the mustard/onion seasoning is in an oil that permeates through the shell of the pretzel, making them extra flavorful and not dry at all. They're a little sweet, have good mustard flavor, and the onion flavor even comes through a little (they taste like they're supposed to). I try to just grab a handful at snack time and quit while I'm ahead, but I usually end up going back for more later.If you're willing to put up with a little extra fat for a lot of extra flavor, these are a perfect snack.

column9: It's like eating real hot wings!!!
column10: If you like pretzels and you like hot wings. Do yourself a favor and try these. You will not believe how much like a true hotwing they made these pretzels taste.Oh and to the 3 star reviewer who didn't like that they are hot. Umm they don't call them cool wings. They are not hot, but do have a spice to them. If you are someone that eats hotwings you will love them.

I love buffalo wings; not just the heat, but the flavor! This product, while not offering tongue-burning, sinus-clearing heat, has good bite to it. The flavor--how can I describe it? It's very addictive! I can down a whole 10 ounce package in no time. I'm not sure if I'm imagining it, but there seems to be a hint of a bleu cheese taste in there as well, which adds to the whole "hot wing" experience of the snack, in my opinion.My kids like these as well. I have to hide the bag from them sometimes just to ensure that I get my fair share.
These are delicious. Taste exactly like a buffalo wing should taste. They are not very healthy but I don't care. I love them.

I'm a girl from buffalo NY and these have true Buffalo hot wing /hot sauce flavor. I can easily eat a whole bag - although it probably would not be wise. Do yourself a favor and buy this snack! I just bought a case to give as treats to friends that enjoy a good hot wing

A large bag rarely lasts a day in my house, which isn't a good thing when they're pretty caloric.  They're so delicious you just want to stuff a whole handful in your mouth and slowly suck the flavor out of them, crunching on the remains as you look like a mad squirrel.I would go as far as to say that you could eat these every day and not get tired of them.  I would replace every meal of the day with these things if I wasn't afriad of them giving me heart disease.Try them once and you'll be hooked. This is a kind of pretzel that will make your taste buds tingle, if you honestly don't like pretzels much at all, you will love them after you try these pretzels.  They are the most excellent tasting pretzels around.  I would strongly inform people to try these amazing pretzels.
