I have to agree, some of the reviewers are DIMWITS and probably boil all their meals. Betty Crocker cooking school drop-outs. $14-$20 an ounce?  I'll guess they don't know how to measure weights either.This is an excellent 230 color saffron that is PURE Threads.  Not the cheap stuff sold elsewhere.  Very pungent and colorful.  In fact when I purchased mine it arrived in a tightly sealed, resealed in heavy plastic and bagged box.  When I opened the box I could still smell the saffron! EXCELLENT!
I picked up a 1 Oz tin of same brand for 14.99 in Dallas area

I really like this cider. It could be a little sweeter or stronger, but that is an issue at times with all K-Cup type of things I think. My daughter puts a little sugar in hers, but I don't. Last season it was very hard to find, but this year I saw it out more and stocked up. It's a nice amount and not a lot of calories... not a diet buster!!! :) If it had a little more punch I would have given it 5 stars.

column9: You Could'nt Make It Any Better
column10: I got this when I bought my Keurig as part of a 96 cup package from QVC. Out of all the Kcupsin the package I liked this one best.  Every cup was perfect and on a cold winter's night there is nothing better to drink next to a warm fire. Expensive but worth it.

This is the second or third time I have ordered this product. I just love it. Now, I find I love a cup of it right before bed. Just a bit different than the usual cup of tea. I can never get enough of this. Hope they never stop making it! Purchasing from Amazon.com is so easy. No scanning the internet for the best buy. I have always found the best buy through Amazon.com. Just ask the UPS and FedEX drivers!.

I ordered this product after I found out about it's existence. These cups taste amazing! I'm completely suprised at just how amazing this product tastes. All my guests now expect this product when they come over and I have to keep a steady supply.

This is the best parasite remover that I have ever seen. I use it everyday for my service dog Nina and works great. It is the most friendlist to my dog and do'sn't give her any discomfort what so ever.

First I tried Nissan's regular rice but it ended up in my cat's litter box because it was full of weevils. So I figured try the parboiled rice since the boiling process should kill all the eggs. Wrong. Makes a decent but expensive cat litter.

I like this pasta. It is about the size a of a pencil eraser. There is no time suggested for cooking, hence the four stars. The first package we tried was overcooked. I think 5 minutes or less is all you will need. But they give a "cook until desired doneness"... not much help. But it tasted good and I think this is good value. Perfect for pasta with lentils, now I have to get my Italian friend to give me her recipe.

I love Anna Pasta, but I have ordered this twice and each time, several bags were broken and the pasta comes out of the bag.  The first time there were 6 broken bags, the second time, I found 11 busted bags and the pasta all over the box.  Although the pasta is good, it is not sanitary to find your pasta all over a box, especially eleven bags!  Let's get with the program and give your customers what they pay for....quality.  Thanks!

Well executed but cloying and saccharine."The Cross" was an instrument of torture, and at the end the deposition it was coated with blood and excrement.Hard for me to swallow it as a cookie, but then again some folks "Christianity" begins and ends in sentiment.

I first found Porterhouse Seasoning when it was called Prime Rib Seasoning in a little fish shop on the Oregon Coast. I bought 1 and when I went back I bought out the shop.  Since then I have had a tough time finding the product.  I slather a roast in Dijon mustard and the liberally sprinkle the seasoning and the put the roast on the rotisserie. When all is said and done, I have a roast with a flavorful crust and a juicy core.What I have not been able to find is "Lemon Up" by Lindberg & Snyder.  I found Lindberg & Snyder makes a Lemon Pepper but it is not the same.  I am ordering a case for my son who is a chef in Tacoma, WA and uses it on his prime rib.  I cannot say enough about the Porterhouse Seasoning - I am glad I finally found a place where I can stock up.

column9: I have used this for years... WE ALL LOVE IT!!!!
column10: This is totally the BEST as a rub or as a seasoning! Well worth it, it is now so hard to find, I can only find it in gourmet meat depts like fresh fairs or high end meat markets.  I use it on my Standing rib roasts, my whole tri tips, rib eye streaks as a rub and as a seasoning for my chuck roasts and even for my stew meat.. I used to work in the MEAT DEPT for years, my customers always told me how much they loved this once I MADE them try it. I used to put it on their steaks before they bought them and they always came back and bought a whole bottle.  TRY IT!
This is an awesome seasoning for making beef fajitas.  Sprinkle on skirt steak and grill.  Yum!
This is by far the best rub I have ever purchased! I found it 5 years ago and have not looked back since! Try it on pork too before you grill its great! I just wish more stores carried it!

column9: The best meat barbecue seasoning made
column10: I first used this in SoCal and have been looking for it again for 6 years since I moved to Northern California.  No luck; I tried at least 5 other products; none compare.  So, I am ordering 3 bottles-one I will even share with my daughter.

column9: Lindberg Snider - best steak seasoning around
column10: This seasoning was easier to find before in supermarkets and other specialty stores in California years ago, but several stopped carrying it for some reason.  The flavor this seasoning provides on a grilled steak, roast, etc, is unbelievable.  Finally found it online, and ordered 5 bottles!

My husband puts this on steaks (not just porterhouse), and we love the way it tastes.  It's not overpowering, but really adds a punch of flavor.  Until I found it on Amazon, we were having a friend from California ship it to us.  We won't use anything else on steaks as long as we can still get this product.

One of the best seasonings I've ever user, particulary for grilling meat and a little-known and scarcely available cut called a "Tri-Tip." Sprinkle liberally on both sides of the meat, refrigerate overnight and grill at high heat on both sides for 8-10 minutes, depending on thickness and desired finish.

I really like this product for one of my favorite fish recipes and can no longer find it in the local stores.  I was very pleased to find it on line.  I didn't give a thought to the size of the container - it's huge!  And I ordered TWO of them!  I'll be sharing the seasoning and the recipe with friends :-)

I worked as a meat wrapper for 15 years in a retail/wholesale meat shop.  We would sell the seasoning Lindberg Snider Porterhouse & Roast Seasoning 14oz. to numerous wholesale accounts.  We had people come in constantly asking us what type of seasoning was on the steak, tri-tip or prime rib they had eaten at a restaurant they had visited.  I'm so glad I found it.  Try the seasoning on mushrooms...it's one of my favorites.
I use this seasoning on all meats - chicken, pork, and beef - and always get great raves about how good the meat tastes.  It's especially good on steaks and roasts.

I have used this for years! I was a meat cutter of nearly 30 yrs, so I know what tastes good on steak and roasts, I even use it in my soups! I love it, but it got harder and harder to find. I buy it by the case and sell off half the case... Im selling some now, so get yours cheap while the getting is good!

I was introduced to this seasoning on a visit to California over 10 years ago, and have been using it ever since. We just love it on beef and pork dishes. And for a Louisiana girl that is great praise.
This is a wonderful product and makes a great gift--only problem is the people receiving it want more--that is why I buy it a case at a time--not sold at Krogers--boo!
I was very impressed by how professionally my order was handle from ordering to arrival.  Amazon is the only way to go.

I first encountered this rub when applied by the gentlemen at Bisher's Quality Meats in Ramona, CA.  I loved it so much I purchased a jar off their shelves. I have since moved and the jar is now empty.... Amazon to the rescue!  This blend is the perfect complement to a fine cut of beef.

Lindberg and Snider Porterhouse seasoning is the best.  I ordered it online because I hadn't had any luck finding it in stores.This stuff is great on any meat product.  We use it with roasts, steaks, pork chops, and even chicken.  It adds just the right flavor, and inhanses the flavor of the meat.  I have even used as seasoning for my fried chicken.  I guarentee you'll love it.

This rub is amazing!!! I saw it in Bristol Farms and asked the meat guy if it was any good and he gave a rave review. I'm always on the search for great rubs and marinades and this will be a keeper. I have used it twice now, once on a porterhouse and on a flank steak and it's divine. I used to spend so much time making my own rubs but this rub takes the guess work and saves me so much time in the kitchen. It's a win win.

column9: The best seasoning and rub for a Prime Rib in the world!
column10: I've been using this product since I was first introduced to it in 1980, when I worked as an apprentice meat cutter at Herb's Quality Meats in Boulder, CO for Herb Dillard - Charlie Snider's nephew.It is a great seasoning for a simple grilled steak, but it is especially good for seasoning an entire prime rib roast.Taylor's Market delivers exceptional service, especially due to the fact that I am now living on the East coast, where nobody sells this.

I started using this seasoning in 1976 in a small No. Californian town. It is by far the best, nothing compares. It has been harder to find so buy several at a time. You do not want to run out of this product.

I am not a very good cook and have been banished to the grill by my family as a way to minimize the gustatorial impact of my cooking on friends and family. Even a bad cook can grill a piece of meat if you can simply remember how chared or raw the interior was from the last time you messed up.The best piece of meat for a bad cook to grill is the tri tip because no matter how badly you cook it, there is still a section well done for those that like it well done and practically walking off the plate for those that like it rare. (Like me) The butcher told me to sprinkle Lindberg and Snyder roast seasoning on the tri-tip and lo and behold, my family ate every piece of meat and then I caught one of my recalcitrant sons licking the chopping block in the kitchen! I havn't yet been promoted back to cooking inside yet but last night I put three tri tips with lindberg seasoning on the grill and my boys attacked them like great whites hitting pup seals off South Africa.. even my girls were growling at each other when the pickings got slim at the end of the meal.Thanks much for making me look like I know what I am doing! Now do you have a seasoning that will make my family choke down my efforts at Zuchini Casserole?  Appreciativly,  BJ in Santa Barbara
My sister-n-law gave me a bottle of this seasoning and I am hooked. I do not cook meat without it. Lindberg roast seasoning is the only flavoring I use in hamburgers, on steaks and roasts.
I put it on all steaks, hamburgers, and any other beef when I bbq.  Nothing else comes close.

I have been cooking for 50 years.I bar b q in snow storms. This may be the best for steaks on earth. Was given to me as a gift 3 years ago and will never be with out some in the kitchen. Great value, great stuff.14 oz bottle should last you 6mo to a year.Try it-you will like it. Thanks to bill johnson for the gift.
This is the best rub I have ever used. My aunt turned me onto it and I wouldn't use anything else on my Prime Rib, Filet Minon or any beef. It's the bomb!

column9: The best seasoning out there!!! Worth every penny!
column10: I had been buying this since the very early 90's from Hottinger's Meat Market in Chino, California. I could not find it once I moved to Vegas in 98 so I had to travel to get it. I have been without for so long and decided to try amazon...AMAZON is the best! I'm so glad I found it. IF you live near Chino, Ca. you gotta try that meat market out too it's the best!I put it on my meats before I bbq.

column9: Lindberg Snider Porterhouse & Roast Seasoning 14 oz.
column10: I am NEVER without this product.  It ALWAYS tastes great on steak, lamb chops etc.  I have used it for years and have not found anything better.  Enjoy!

column9: Lindberg & Snider porterhouse and roast seasoning
column10: This seasoning is GREAT. I use it on my prime rib every year and everyone loves it. My daughter uses it on all of her meat dishes and other dishes.It's reasonbly priced and I order 3 of the large bottles about every 2 years. It last a long time. Thanks Nancy Goebel CA

I've been using this seasoning for sometime now, and it is the best I've found for steak. The price is good, but they are completely screwing you on the shipping. Wife purchased without checking shipping charges. It should have been about $2.50, but they nailed her for dang near the same price as the product. The old bait and switch...

If you have never tried this, you are missing out!  I first received it as a gift and loved it. I tried to purchase more only to find that it is sold in only one place in all of Phoenix--and nowhere near my home.  Amazon came through with flying colors.It is delicious on roast beef, pork, and chicken.  My absolute favorite way to use it is on diced potatoes fried in olive oil.My only complaint is that shipping is costly; I found that ordering several at a time made it a little easier to handle.  I wish this qualified for Free Super Saver Shipping.  (Amazon are you reading this???)

I have used many different commercial and homemade rubs and this was a disappointment.  Had dinner with friends who used a Snider rub; thought I was ordering the same item.  Tried it tonight for a steak on a grill.  Not satisfied.

column9: WARNING: The Best Chocolate Chip Cookies
column10: I purchased these with the idea they would go into Christmas sacks and stockings.Then my husband and I ate them all and it is two weeks BEFORE Christmas.  They should come with a warning from the Surgeon General "Addictive and proven to add inches to your waistline".Walker's shortbread is reknown for its rich buttery taste, add some chocolate chips and what could possibility go wrong?  Nothing that my husband and I could find and believe me we did a thorough examination.We have NEVER had a better "pre-fab" chocolate chip cookie in our lives.  Just check our bathroom scales if you don't believe me!YUMMY!
Walkers is the absolute  manufacturer of quality shortbreads..this is additionally with the addition of mini chocolate chips..These are decadent!..Highly recommended

Delicious melt in your mouth shortbread cookies with wonderful chocolate drops!  Much better than any other brand of shortbread i have tried.  The packets of two cookies make them great additions to that special lunch bag or to drop in your purse for a little treat.  Perfect as a gift for the cookie lover in your life or yourself!  Love them!  Yum!

I have usually stuck with the plain Walker's shortbreads but decided to try this one as I like chocolate.  Cookie was very delicious - a nice blend of chocolate pieces in tasty Walker's shortbread.  Pleased with purchased and will order again!
I never had heard Walkers made a chocolate-chip cookie,  but I'll say these are something special.  Love the flavor,  combined with chocolate,  it's heavenly.  A little reward. Addictive.

I ordered these along with a box of the almond short bread cookies for a cancer recovering friend who loves short bread but adores chocolate too. The packages are great she said for taking to bed with a glass of milk for a before bed snack. She said none of the cookies have been broken in the packages which is a relief. So this was a real big hit with my friend and her visiting family. Will order again ! (I do hate that the price has increased a bit much in just a few weeks.....)

I am a fan of Walkers plain shortbread cookies. Decided to try these when they were on sale and these are outstanding chocolate chip cookies. I like the small packages with two in them because I can have portion control. They would fit nicely in a lunch bag and would be a great morning or afternoon pick-me-up.
Walkers Shortbread Fingers (1.4-Ounce), 2-Count Cookies (Pack of 24)These cookies are a hits with my Grandkids, they love them. I also take them to my senior's and they love them also.

I received the one free Nescafe: Memento Mocha Coffee in the mail. I'm a coffee drinker and don't really care for hot chocolate, but I enjoyed the Memento Mocha. Yes there is a chocolate taste, but it is blended in with a smooth mocha flavor. I recommend it to others.

I have been drinking a Thai version of Nescafe instant coffee and loving it, so when I saw the Memento Mocha mix I was eager to try. With anticipation I opened the package, filled with hot water, stirred and took a sip and was immediately greeted with a flavor of chocolate syrup and chalk, if there is such a flavor. I tried adding additional half and half to save the cup of coffee and that did not mask the gritty chalky flavor. I will be giving the rest away of the box, they were that bad. I am disappointed and will not even finish the 1 cup I did make.

I got a sample of this in the mail, along with the Caramel Memento Coffee.I coudln't taste much of a coffee flavor here.  If I didn't know better, I would have thought this was a hot cocoa beverage, without the sugar.  What I really like about the two Memento flavors I tried is that they don't use too much sugar, unlike most of these types of coffee drinks.  They kept the sweetness turned way down.  Unfortunately for this particular Mocha flavor, I didn't taste much of any flavor.  Was it coffee?  Not that I could tell. Was it chocolate? Mocha?  I would have been hard pressed to say exactly what flavor it was had I not already known it was supposed to be Mocha.However, it was pretty good anyway.  It was very creamy tasting.  This one won't compete with any Starbucks offerings, but it's OK, because there is a hint of something along with the cream, I'm just not sure what.The other flavor I tried, the Caramel one, was delicious and I will purchase that.  This one let me down, but I still enjoyed it.

Trying a sample pack, and using a Keurig to measure the 8oz portion of water, I found this product to be VERY mild in flavor. I actually went back to the Keurig to make sure I didn't use too much water. Memento does not compare to Café D'Vita Mocha Cappuccino Hot or Cold Cappuccino Mix 64 Oz that I got from the big box "C" store.I did not compare the ingredients, not any nutritional numbers. It could be that the D'Vita simply packs on more sugar. But, in the morning, when I want a something more than plain coffee, I'll be sticking with D'Vita.

I received a 2 pack of these new instant coffees in the mail yesterday and gave this one a shot. I like it. The chocolate/mocha taste is subtle but it is there. It's not meant to be like hot cocoa and you only use water. I plan on trying the caramel latte later before I leave for my sons bowling practice. So far, my opinion is very nice and I will buy these!!
These shells are a wonderful as the regular pasta itself.  You can use them as you would use any pasta shell in the grocery isle.  It's been very liberating for me to cook with them.

Finally bread crumbs that aren't flour consistency! I add seasoning such as salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, oregano, basil and such, whatever you like. Dip your pork chops or chicken breasts in egg then seasoned bread crumbs and fry in olive oil. YUM! Easy and delicious.

Product has egg powder in it, which is not stated in the description.  Typically panko bread crumbs do not contain eggs, so I was surprised when I read the ingredients.  Unfortunately I am allergic to eggs, so I was sad to not be able to try this product. :(  I suggest updating the info for this product and for a pic of the ingredients label be added to prevent this problem for another amazon customer.  Thank you.

First, let me say I am not a fan of Kinnikinnick's sandwich bread.  Udi's is a million times better.  But for panko bread crumbs these are FABULOUS.  They stay nice and crunchy!  I can make chicken parmesan, fish sticks, and so much more now!  Great, great, great product.
I have tried other coatings on fish and chicken, but no other product I have tried compares. Would recommend to anyone, even if not on a gluten-free diet.

It's been years since my son and I have enjoyed a crispy, delicious chicken finger. These breadcrumbs worked great! I dipped the chicken strips in Silk Almond milk, coated them in a G/F flour mix of potato and white rice flour, dipped them in  watered down scrambled egg and and coated them with these breadcrumbs. Fried up crunchy and delicious! I have also done pan fried pork chops like this. Absolutely delicious. I highly recommend these!

This was my first attempt at cooking with GF Panko and it was great!  I had my doubts when I opened the package and saw the texture of the crumbs, but one bite ended my reservations.  My daughter LOVES Chicken and Pork Katsu but was recently diagnosed with a wheat allergy.  We are so glad to have found this product in our local health food store! Not only did the food taste great fresh, we made a large batch and froze half of it to eat later.  After one week, we took the frozen katsu out and baked it for 20 minutes to heat it.  It was just as good as it was fresh- nice and crunchy just like it should be!  Why only four stars?  This mix could be improved on.  It's a great start, but it's a little more like breadcrumbs in texture than actual japanese-style panko.

column9: Great GF product for fried chicken
column10: My spouse is gluten-free and we'd tried Kinnikinnick (try saying that 5 times fast!) bread crumbs for chicken in the past, when they were sold in a plain white plastic bag, and been very satisfied with it, and were dismayed when it became no longer available. We happened to be shopping at our local health food store when I spotted this product and bought it immediately over an alternative GF product based on the Kinnikinnick name and our past experience. We followed the directions as shown on the box: dredge in sweet rice flour (aka mochiko, very cheap at any asian grocery store), then dip in egg wash, and finally in the bread crumbs. Bake for 40 minutes at 375 and yum! Very crispy coating, and as another reviewer said, you'd never guess it was GF. The only thing I would have done differently, as other reviewers have also said, is to add some seasonings for taste -- out of the box it's good, but a tad bland. To be fair, the box does suggest using your own seasonings or parmesan cheese.So if you're looking for a good GF breadcrumb for chicken or other meats, you need look no further. It does contain egg, so those with egg allergies need to avoid it, but it's GFCF so perfect for us. Highly recommended.

Love these crumbs. Season crumbs with thyme, garlic & sea salt. Soak chicken in coconut milk first, dredge in crumbs, fry or bake.. delicious over a loaded salad & dressing. Many options, many recipes to conquer.

column9: Great product but needs to be completely sealed
column10: These bread crumbs taste great and bake well.  I'm only able to give this product 1 star because the plastic bag which holds the bread crumbs inside the box, is not sealed completely.  There is a 3/4" gap at the top of the seam that runs up and down the bag.  I ordered this product thru the subscription so I received 3 boxes in one shipment.  All three boxes had the same gap (opening) in the plastic bag. This product needs to be completely sealed to ensure freshness and self-stability.

column9: Another wonderful product from this company
column10: My husband, who loves to cook found this product originally at Whole Foods.  We have been expiramenting with various ways to make a gluten free coating for chicken.  We didn't care for other gluten free bread crumbs but when he found and tried this panko style bread crumbs we won't use anything else.  This company makes the best gluten free products anywhere!  I don't feel deprived when we use these products, and my non-gluten free family and friends don't taste any difference. I know buy in bulk through Amazon to get good pricing.

I got these breadcrumbs to make a special birthday meal (paneed chicken) for my boyfriend this past weekend. I scooped some out of the package and they looked, smelled and tasted great! I was so excited to be able to make this favorite dish of mine after not having it for nearly a year. After marinating the chicken and dredging it in the breadcrumbs, I put it in the pan which was on the usual medium low, and turned my back for literally 15 seconds. When I turned back around to stir the sauce next to them, the breadcrumbs were ALREADY burnt! So I scrapped that piece of chicken and lowered the heat before trying again. The same thing happened. Maybe I can use them for stuffing or something, but I'm a little nervous about trying to fry something again. And if it was just an operator error, someone please let me know what I did wrong/what I can do to fix it!

I wonderful seasoning that is void of unnecessary sodium and chemicals.  You want chili powder and chili powder is what you get.  I season near everything with this great spice.  my only complaint in the packaging.  I much prefer a short fat jar to a tall skinny one.

my pug has always been a Big boy for a pug.  he isn't overweight by any means he is just Big and this is the only Light/Diet bone that the will eat and he LOVES them.  We call him our Boneaholic because he is so obsessed with them.  They are also Diabetic dog approved by our vet.Puggie's paw rating = 4 paws up

My 12 year old dog was never touched these treats... that is, until I had to put him on steroids (prednisone) and anti-seizure medications (phenobarbital) that made him ravenously hungry! Previous to his medications, he would turn up his nose to any of Science Diet's dry treats - they weren't palatable, were too hard and dry, and were hard to chew into. Now that he's on his medications, he'll eat them, but with no real zeal. He jumps and begs for other treats, but simply carries these dry, hard treats onto his bed, where he eats them at his leisure.So, if you have a chowhound who will eat anything, go for it. That said, if your dog has dental disease, I'd avoid them - these treats are so hard and crunch so loudly, I worry it actually hurts my dog's teeth to chew on these.My dog's review of this treats palatability: two thumbs down.

Very good tasting sardines.  No strong fishy taste or smell.  Reasonable price.  My last bulk order was the Reese sardines, but I like Roland better because they are more mild tasting.  There are 4 tightly packed sardines to a can with no wasted space.  These are the best sardines I have had in a long time.

As an athlete/fitness freak I'm always looking for a new source of protein thats easy/convenient so when a friend told me about these my curiosity was piqued but I instantly remembered the sardines my father used to eat. They were small, mushy, and tasted awful. So, I bought one can and haven't stopped eating them since. These are really nice sized and meaty. They are in a light olive oil to which I add some basil, oregano and black pepper and then eat it right out of the can most times. I go through the 20 pack in about a week. For anyone looking to add some healthy protein to their diet along with some omega-3s, you simply can not go wrong here.

These are one of a very few select brands of sardines that I consider top of the line. They are consistent in quality and have a very long shelf life. They do not have a strong "fishy" taste like some brands. They are packed nicely in a light olive oil. This is a great high protein meal/snack. I have purchased many different brands of sardines to find the best and we always come back to Roland. It does pay to try more than one kind so you will know that these are the best! We order these through Subscribe & Save so that we always have them on hand.

I have a Bernese Mountain Dog.  The food is good quality and my dog eats it as fast as possible.  His coat is shiny and he doesn't have any digestive issues.  Amazon is the best deal because of the free shipping.  Other sites are less expensive but you have shipping fees that put them over the price of the item on Amazon.

I have a 4 year old Boston Terrier/Jack Russell mix and a 2 year old Boxer/American Bulldog mix who had been eating Purina Beneful (Healthy Radiance) since I have owned them. I noticed the younger dog was emitting a nasty odor through his coat and the older dog was itching all over.After doing some research I found this food highly recommended online. The difference in the foods is the ingredients. This food contains REAL meat and by-products. Though I was skeptical because it was more expensive, it was well worth it. Both dogs gobble it up and they smell normal with no skin irritation.I recommend giving it a try and see the results!

column9: Great Results from Natural Balance Dog Foods
column10: Although my rat terrier-beagle mix came to me eating Purina Puppy Chow, I quickly switched up to Natural Balance Ultra Premium Formula for Dogs after reading various pet food reviews that panned Puppy Chow and praised Natural Balance foods.  And I am here to tell you that the praise is justified.  Although my puppy had been prone to occasional diarrhea prior to the switch, his stools have become solid, his coat has become very soft and thick, and he seems better filled out and more energetic.  He eats the food well, finishes his meals quickly and has done quite well on this food.I am very happy to have found Natural Balance Dog foods and intend to continue to feed my dog this product for the foreseeable future.Natural Balance Ultra Premium Formula Dog Food, 15-Pound BagNatural Balance Ultra Premium Formula for Dogs, 33-Pound Bag

We have been feeding our dog (Golden Retriever) Natural Balance dog food since she was a puppy.  11 years later, I can honestly say that she has never once had a digestive problem.  I believe this food has helped her stay healthy and fit!

I purchased the Ultra Premium dog food to help with my dogs allergy issues. I have tried all kinds of food to help with my Beagle dogs allergies and none worked as well as this, I have even tried much higher priced food and none did the job. She eats it easily and has no problems going outside to potty. Her allergies have cleared up a lot and I've had no repeated visits to the vet. Shes been on this food for awhile now and really loves to eat. I highly recommend this food for any dogs that have allergy issues or who are just picky eaters. I think any food that your dog likes to eat and has no issues with is a big step to a healthy happy life for your pup.

column9: Best I have found.  Loyal user
column10: We experienced spotty coats and sick dogs from some of the higher ranked and priced foods on the market.  This is the best dog food I have found.  Both dogs have not been sick since we bought this food and their coats have become full and shiney.  They love the food.  We don't even have to add anything to it.  Extremely happy with this product.

We rescued our beagle about a month ago.  Not knowing what to give her, I tried Beneful and Science Diet.  With both our dog was having digestion issues (vomitting, etc.) and had itchy skin.  A pet rescue recommended this food and since changing her to it, she is like a brand new dog.  No itchy skin, and she has a beautiful silky coat.  Not sure if it is the food but she even lost her doggie odor.  I give the food a 10 on a score of 1-10.

column9: Great food.  Our dog loves it!
column10: Our dog is a rescue and when we rescued her, the previous owners were feeding her beneful (which is supposed to be one of the worst dog foods).  We switched to Hill's Science Diet, but found out she didn't like that and would pick those out of her dish and lay them outside of the dish and not eat them.Our vet suggested our dog start eating a grain free diet because beagles are prone to allergies and skin dryness and itchiness.  This is when we found Natural Balance.  And our dog loves it!  She isn't picky about it at all like she was with the Science Diet.  I also feed her now using the fun ball so she has to work for her food and she really enjoys getting her food that way.This is a great dog food!
Emmie loves it. She is an 11 month old chocolate lab. Her coat is shiny. She has lots of energy. GOOD FOOD!
Excellent dog food.  I have a maltese (7 pounds )and a springer spaniel (35 pounds) and they both do very well on this food.  One bag for two different sized dogs.  Great!

column9: So far she likes Natural Balance more than any other
column10: My dog is almost two years old and I always tried the supposed best food for her but after a while she tried her new food she get tired of it. So far she still happy with Natural Balance and the 33 pound bag is almost empty. I guess it is going to be the first time I am going to order the same food for her once again. By the way she is a medium size Rottweiler with never digested problems.

I was looking for a quality food for my 90LBS, 3 year old, Black Lab.  I saw the reviews and thought we would give this food a try. He began scratching, then having poop issues, then throwing up.  Not for my lab, as soon as I stopped feeding him this food, he was much better.  Trying Taste of the Wild now, and that seems to agree with him better.
My dog loves this food, she has a sensitive stomach and it is the only one that causes her no problems.

I recently became vegan due to my position on animal rights and I hated funding animal cruelty when buying dog food, so I tried this product. I made the mistake of mixing my dog's previous food with gravy and olive oil to the point where he refused to eat dry food and would prefer to starve. Well, I just poured him his first bowl of Nature's Balance and he immediately ate every bite, then asked for seconds, which I gave him! I actually have to end this review early because he is currently guarding the dog food bag from my other dog, which he has never done before. Must be good stuff! I hope my dogs will have healthier skin and teeth as I have heard from other users. Will keep you posted.

I was skeptical to buy dog food by mail, given the cost. However, this supplier shipped two huge bags for only $5.00 so how could I go wrong? They shipped to me in huge boxes. I wasn't able to immediately find this brand and variety locally and wanted to try it. My dogs loved it and it got high ratings for quality and ingredients in an independent study. Better than the usual grocery store brands I had been buying but the cost of some of the other brands put me off. If you cannot find at a reasonable price locally, I'd recommend this supplier.

column9: My dogs have never begged for their food before!
column10: Duke and Chunk love this food.  I had been feeding them Beneful for a couple of years, but once I discovered the quality of the ingredients (or lack thereof), I decided that my furbabies deserved more than that.  Beneful is horrible for dogs, and made my lab constipated all the time.  Since the switch to Natural Balance, I realized how much they disliked the old food, because they actually get excited when I fill up the food dish and they look happier when they eat.  I now realize that they only ate the Beneful because that's all they had.  Imagine eating something you thought was gross for years on end.  I felt so bad.  I'll never switch back!  This food actually fills them up faster, so I actually spend about the same amount of money as I did on Beneful.  The better quality ingredients fill them up faster.  I am converted for life.  It's extra money, but it's so worth it to know that my dogs are healthy, happy, and full.  Plus, Duke poops like a champ now.

column9: My puppy loved it, but it gave him bad gas
column10: My puppy (3 months) loved Natural Balance Ultra, but it gave him stinky gas (and lots of it). I noticed that the gas moving through his intestines was making him feel uncomfortable too. I tried feeding him probiotic yogurt and it helped a little bit, but not enough. One night, as his flatulence slowly suffocated me in my bedroom, I decided to order a small bag of Chicken Soup for the Puppy Lover's Soul, and over the following week, I slowly transitioned him over. It seems to have solved his problem. Of course I can't speak for other owners, but for my puppy, I think that the lamb in Natural Balance gave him digestion issues. All other ingredients seem more or less comparable between the two brands. From this experience, I learned that figuring out what food works for a new puppy could take quite some time. I made the mistake of buying the 30lb bag, thinking that my puppy would take to it just fine as long as its high quality. Now I'm left with over half a bag of dog food that will never get eaten. New puppy owners: don't make the same mistake! Buy a smaller bag as a trial period!

Love the ingredients and love that I can feed this to my puppies AND adult dogs.  The proof is in the ingredients - chicken is the first thing listed.  This is a great dog food I can trust with vitamins and minerals that you can't find in some other brands.  And dogs love the taste (even my picky ones!)

column9: Product as stated. Image not accurate.
column10: Natural Balance is a great brand, my dachshunds love it. The title of the product and the associated image do not match though. Especially since there is another review that states they received a 33lb of dog food. At Petco, I never even seen a 30lb bag. Be aware that the image is misleading. You will only receive the stated 30lb bag.

column9: Dogs love all natural balance food :)
column10: I always bought the potato duck formula before but I bought this one because it was cheaper and came in a bigger package. Both dogs love it, but it causes the big dog (pit bull) a lot A LOT of gas!!! I probably wouldn't buy it again for him, but its perfect for my schnauzer, he loves it and digests it perfectly, this brand food is the only food, he scarfs right down, and it's so good for them :)

My oldest dog has been on this Natural Balance food since he was a puppy and he's never had a health problem and has a shiny coat and clean teeth.  He always gets excited when I take the bag out and fill his bowl - he has never gotten tired of the taste and wags his tail everyday for his Natural Balance food.  The ingredients are all holistic and I know my dog is getting the nutrition he needs.  My other dog has allergies and eats a different Natural Balance LID formula because it has limited ingredients - in my book everything they make is great.  Highly recommended!

I have been feeding this food to my six dogs for over a year now and they have thick, shiny coats and are all very healthy and energetic.  They love the food. My dogs range from chihuahuas to a boxer in size so I buy the smaller size food; original formula.

After many years of having to switch my dogs food, I have finally found something he actually loves to eat, and has calmed his allergies a great deal.  And all of this for a fair price.  It isn't the cheapest food out there but, it is the best for the wonderful ingredients it has.  My dog eats the Limited Ingredients, which is lamb and rice.  Can't rave enough about it.

column9: Great Food Delivered to My Door
column10: I used to purchase this food at a local store, but saw it on Amazon for around the same price, plus Amazon had free shipping.  I ordered it on a Monday and it was at my door on Friday.  Beats having to go to the store, lug it to the car, and then bring it into the house.  I was a little worried that ordering it online would give me a close expiration date, but when I received it I saw that the date is still 10 months away, so I'm relieved the food is fresh.  Natural Balance is a great food.  I only buy dog food on the Whole Dog Journal approved list, and this brand makes the grade. No corn, byproducts, glutens, etc.  Plus, I try to stay away from foods containing turkey and rosemary, as I read that these ingredients may bother dogs prone to seizures (I have one such dog). No one dog food is perfect for every dog, but Natural Balance is worth a try!
My dogs love it. I've never had dog food where my dogs eat it up like dog treats until now.

My dog has food issues. Nothing stayed down or she became uninterested halfway through the bag.  so far natural balance is the only dog food she has consistently ate without problems. good job Natural.

I have two dogs(babies) 1 border collie/Australian Shepherd mix & a Shiba Inu/Havanese mix, both very picky about their food and both very sensitive to what they eat. At first I was very skeptical about dog think.. I was the one who thought all dog food were the same. Boy was I wrong. Natural Balance is the meal that the dogs wait for and don't pick at. They love the food... and now I have to be careful not to over feed them since they inhale it like air. As a proud mom of the two, I'm happy that they're happy with their food now. Oh yeah, and now more skin irritations!

Two years feeding Natural balance Ultra Premium formula to my fussy American Eskimo/Beagle shelter doggie and she still greets it favorably, even if it lacks the glamor of squirrel, which is her dream nourishment but she can never catch them. This "blue bag" variety is Natural Balance's least expensive, have tried the fancier limited ingredient varieties like Duck w/sweet potato, but I swear the dog prefers the basic. Amazon's low pricing and me buying in bulk cut my dog food grocery bill in half. Also owe my thanks to Amazon Prime free shipping (30 pound bags used to cost quite a bit in freight costs)free month's trial that I got with my new Kindle Fire. Oh, and I almost forgot the reason that I am writing this review is that I am still in delighted shock that the delivery arrived at my apartment building steps in less than 24 hours. Amazing.

I think Natural Balance is one of the best dog foods on the market. The ingredients are of superior quality and well balanced. Best of all, my dogs like it and have no adverse reaction to it. Their coats are shiny and they have plenty of energy.
The dog food arrived within the expected time and the product quality was as expected and my dog liked it to the last cup!

column9: Good Food Delivered to the Door
column10: This is a high quality food that my 2 year old English Setter and Brit pup like. Both do really well eating this food.

column9: My Dog likes Natural Balance Ultra dry dog food with or without water.
column10: My dog (Labrador Retriever and Border Collie) over sixty pounds at 7.5 months old likes the Dick Van Patten's Natural Balance® Original Ultra® Ultra Premium Dry Food very much. He has had no problem with it mixed half with a chicken and vegetable dog food and half Natural Balance Ultra. I usually feed him with water added to the dry dog food; but not always.

I raise Australian Shepherds and it has been important that the food the mom eats can be fed to the puppies. ALL my adult Aussies have had skin irritations from the other (Purina) products we had used, so when my female was bred, I switched her to this food. She LOVES, LOVES, LOVES it, and now that the puppies are at weaning age, they ALSO gobble it up. GREAT STUFF!!!

This food is GREAT! I adopted my two Pomeranians and they'd been on IAMS - pretty crummy stuff. I switched them over to this and not only do they eat less of it, but their poop is much healthier looking (firmer, not runny anymore.) Their coats are fuller and the eye gook they used to get seems to have really gone away. A friend of mine told me he feeds his dog blueberries to get rid of eye slime, so I'm wondering if this food has a similar nutrient. Really great stuff! The only thing that would be better is if you actually cooked for your dog!

column9: A Godsend for Dogs with Allergies
column10: I rescued two puppies with a slew of health problems (mange, allergies, etc. etc.) Neither the vet nor myself could figure out why they were sick until we realized that it could be their food.  I was feeding them what I thought was high quality (Nutro), but it was tearing up their stomachs.  A fellow dog lover recommended Natural Balance and they've been on it ever since.  Two years with nearly no vomiting or soft stools.  I am very thankful for Natural Balance and recommend it to anyone who owns pets with allergies or stomach sensitivity.  Or anyone just looking for a healthy alternative at a great price.

For some reason the trip to the petstore is not one that I look forward to so when I found Natural Balance on Amazon I was excited.I have two yellow labs and my younger one didn't like this flavor at all. I usually buy the Lamb Natural Balance and it gets gobbled up but not so with this one. My other lab is not picky at all and will eat anything. If you don't have picky dogs then I'm sure this product will be fine for you.

column9: Saw good reviews. Made my puppy sick
column10: This product came highly recommended by my friends and the vet so I decided to purchase a 30lb. bag for my 6 month old puppy. I fed it to her the first day I got it after inspecting the good 'til date and for any contamination. Within a few hours, she had blood in her diarrhea after I took her for a walk. My dog has never had diarrhea in the month that I've had her. On top of that, she was constantly gassy throughout the day after being fed this product. On my 2nd walk with her, she had diarrhea again despite not being fed anything after the first episode. I took her off the food and her stool returned to normal. I fed this to her again today and she's passed liquid stool once more and is extremely lethargic and gassy right now. Amazon was nice enough to take care of my problem, but this item needs to be pulled. After my pup's issues, I did some more additional research and found many consumer complaints filed with consumer affairs regarding several of Natural Balance's product including this one. It's possible that I received a bad bag, but I don't know....I'm just really bothered by the similarities between my experience and what other's have posted.

I have a one year old Labrador mix and I decided to give her premium dog food to better her over all health. She has been eating it for the past 5 days.... Every day she would have diarrhea and then the 5th day she actually started puking it up. I don't know if this is a recalled bag that amazon sent out by accident or what... But I can promise you that I will not be buying this EVER again. The only time my dog puked was after she had gotten fixed and was in the car for the ride home.

ive been reading about a salmonella recall with this product. my dog had complete watery diarreah with this... i had to throw away the majority of the 33 pound bag.i heard good things about natural balance before, but with my experience giving this to my dog, the recall and the reports of diarreah with other products of theirs, i am not going give him this again.

I guess I am going to be the 'Debbie Downer' when it comes to the so far perfect reviews of this food.  My dog...who is a major eater...didn't seem to care for it much, though he did eat it always seemed to be hungry and begging for treats, after the fact.  There too, he started having two bowel movements a day instead of one.  I've always heard that two bowel movements means the dog food has more filler in it.  Not sure if it was just the abrupt switch...his old brand changed formulas which did not set well with him...or if it's the food itself.  But based on the other foods, I think it might just not be setting well with him.  That said, I would suggest trying a small bag first, as I do know it will be different from dog-to-dog.  For the record, I did receive prompt and free shipping!

I do not recommend this specific product. Especially if you have French Bulldog. Both of my frenchies got sick with poops and their ears got light infection (whenever they are sick - ears goes first).

I got these for my wedding and not only was the company an absolute pleasure to do business with, but the flowers themselves were amazing!!!The pictures just do not do them justice (esp. the deep purples).Am so glad I ordered them and would highly recomend any one else doing so who wants UNIQUE and hardy flowers!

Order received quickly - within three days of order.  I was surprised to see them delivered in a four foot rectagular box, but upon opening, the 40 purple carnations were very pretty and the size was due to the length of the stems.  Shipped with a single cold pack that sufficiently cooled the flowers for delivery during weather in the 80s where I live.  Would recommend planning to have vase or other similar items ready to arrange upon delivery rather than shipping directly to the recipient, however, as they are not shipped as final aesthetically pleasing arrangement.  I suppose that is dependent on purpose.  Mine was as a gift to my girl, so we ended up cutting and placing in vases upon arrival.  Would order again!

This tea not only tastes great it makes me feel great! I can't say that there's any scientific evidence behind it but I love this tea. My boyfriend and I bought it on a whim at our local health food store and finished the entire box in a week. Highly recommend Tulsi teas are great!

column9: Healthy dog food - delivered right to your door!  HEAVEN!!
column10: I have 3 Shi Tzu's.  Each one is a picky little fur ball, and my husband and I are often to be found on our hands and knees - begging one or the other of them to "Please eat your dinner!"  For those, like one Vet, who told us "All dogs eventually eat.  Put the food down.  If she doesn't eat it, pick it up and try again later.  She will eventually eat."Well, she proved HIM wrong!  $1,000 in vet bills later - unconscious pup with IV's, xrays, special meds - we learned that all dogs DO NOT EVENTUALLY EAT.Which is why I am putting all this nonsense in this review:  EACH OF MY PICKY PUPS WILL CHEW YOUR ARM OFF TO GET AT THIS FOOD!!  And it's delivered right  to my front door!No driving from store to store looking for it!  No begging the manager to stock it!And it costs less than my local pet store charges - SWEET!!

My 4lb. Chorkie is very picky. I get Newman's dry dog food, but she will only eat it if it is mixed with something. I should say, something that is like table food. She loves this! The real advantage is it is very healthy and nutritious, unlike many of the wet dog foods that I have bought. It does appear to look like human food. I suppose it is sad to admit that my adopted dog is so picky, but she is. Now I don't have to be concerned about her not eating or eating products that are not healthy.

Three Dog Bakery can do no wrong! My 3 dogs have eaten Three Dog Bakery products for years.  I mix this in with my dogs' dry food for dinner and call it "dinner sauce".  They LOVE THIS and stand drooling waiting.I am really particular as to what I feed my dogs and feed top quality dry foods. Both my dogs and I love Three Dog Bakery.I will buy Entree for Dogs forever more!

I also have a very picky shih tzu.  I often have to hand feed her kibble by kibble. I used to  try  and feed her expensive "good for her" dog food, but she would only eat the really cheap stuff like Beneful.  Then all of a sudden she would only eat the red and green kibble in the Beneful...no to browns and oranges!  Recently I started mixing the Three Dog Entree into the Beneful dry food and now she licks her plate clean.  I had been buying it at Walmart, but the price on Amazon is much better and I don't have to make late night runs to the store to stuck up.  Now that I know that Three Dog Bakery makes a dry kibble, I will try mixing those two together.  This is the best food ever!

column9: Hot and Fresh out the Kitchen
column10: Remix to what?  Similarly to R. Kelly's jam "Remix to Ignition" - The Orbit Strawberry Remix Sugarfree Gum is probably far more famous than the original.  That being said, I like this gum.  It is very strong-flavored, so weak gum-likers need not apply.  It is true that the flavor does not last as long as other Orbit delights like the Orbit Citrusmint Sugarfree Gum, 14-Piece Packs (Pack of 24).  You can't win 'em all.  Truth be told, that is a better gum.  This is more of a special occasion gum, when you're really feeling the need to take the vacation to flavor country.  I keep this gum at work so that I can make sure that my oral fixation always has 12 x 20 pieces on standby.  Review over.

This product falls in line with Orbit's traditional aptitude at creating a good product but the flavor doesn't last as long as some previous products (around 15 minutes compared to the 30 or so with some of their other products) and the first chew on it is an intensely overwhelming burst of strawberry flavor that almost "burns" the tongue with flavor kinda dulls the tastebuds after a little while.

column9: Good Tasting Soup From A Box.
column10: This noon for lunch I had a box of Dr. McDougall's Garden Vegetable Soup (lower sodium variety. It was quite good. The box contained two servings and only 60 calories each.I consumed both servings. Plus, it had no fat and, of course, the sodium was low. It was a good tasting soup and, together with a couple other items, made a good nutritious lunch.I like to find items like this because I can store  them in my pantry and have a good meal prepared in no time at all. Plus, I worry about proper nutrition and so many of the things you can store are so high in salt, sugar and fat. Not here! This is a good item. I've also enjoyed their lentil soup and I'll probably test a few other kinds. You wouldn't think such good soups would come in a box.Gary Peterson
These chocolate-covered cashews are excellent and the shipping was on time.  They are large and have great flavor.  I would definitely buy them again.

AMAZON.COM comes through again by offering DINTY MOORE HEARTY STEW at a good price, including shipping. The product itself is a good canned stew, and is a fine lunch or dinner item that is fast and easy to serve. This brand is about our favorite for this type of product. column9: Jeff's Review of Dinty Moore Big Bowl Beef Stew!
column10: Great for a snack food on a bun or for a meal in the microwave or on the stove-top. Has savory flavor with cubes of beef and vegetables. Excellent value for the price without a lot of calories.

I've been a fan of Dinty Moore beef stew for most of my sixty years. That has all changed since they changed the recipe. Now they are adding more sugar. When I first tasted it, I couldn't believe they did that. It tasted terrible and I fed the rest to my dog who didn't seem to care much for it either.The meat also has changed for the worse. It looks and tastes totally artificial. I will never buy this stew again unless they change it back.

This is good hurricane relief food, a part of everyone's emergency stash. Trouble is we haven't had enough hurricanes where I live to do a subscription, but I subscribed to monthly deliveries, anyway.Why? The stew is decent when doctored, that's why. With 4-5 cans, you add a stalk of celery, 2-4 carrots (depending on size), an onion, and some other vegetable. Add one smallish potato per can (keep the skins), cubed. Cook the vegetables in red wine and a little water. Mix in bay leaves, and Herbes de Provence. Add pepper to taste. Add the stew when the vegetables look done, and heat through.What you don't do is add salt. There's plenty of that in the stew, already.
great tasting stew not as good as home made but great for a quick meal well worth the money will be buying more.
these cans are $2.29ea at Winn Dixie.....$2.29 x 12 = $27.48  how do they come up with $46 ?aside from the crazy price the stew is delicious !
great for tornado relief...and for eating on the fly. (just need to keep the can opener on you too) . but overall has a good taste

Yes, the cans are cheaper but it would be more honest if the ad had stated that the cans are dented. I have received shipments where the whole set was dented. It was pretty obvious that they were not dented in the same incident. The stew itself was not affected but it would just be more honest if the advertisement had stated that these did not pass quality inspection.

when i ordered this product, i remember that it had 4.5 stars.To my disappointment, the stew isn't tasty. it's not awful, is the best description for it. The meat is cheap, ground meat high in fat.The only good thing about is that it fills you up.
My husband said this is better than the previous order we received. Less meat and less salt noticed.

I got these for emergency food rations that will last for at least a year. I try at least onecan of the products that I purchase and I must say that this stuff is nasty!! It tastes likethe plastic lining in the can. Yea I'll eat it if I'm starving but not until then. Anyone elseeven remotely like this stuff? I'd be glad to send it back or give it to my daughter for herdogs.

I was looking for a can of Dinty Moore's "Beef Stew", and found one with the original style label.  In checking the ingredients, I looked down the long list of names and found "beef" second from the bottom.  Not good in anyone's book.  Let alone a kitchen.  The main ingredient should be beef.  Not an afterthought.  Same here.  And there's always the big spoon with a large chunk of beef in it.  The beef gravy (keep in mind "gravy")here is made up of:  "Beef Gravy (Water, Beef Broth, Beef, Tomatoes [Water, Tomato Paste], Corn Flour, Salt, Modified Food Starch, Caramel Coloring, Sugar, Flavoring), Beef, Potatoes, Carrots".  Gravy is only thick soupy stuff meant to hide what ever else is in the pot.  Well, there it is again!  Beef at third from the bottom this time.  And the "Beef Gravy" is a joke!  Water is the first, then "Beef Broth, Beef".  This beef ingredient is nothing more than pureed pieces of beef to give the gravy some better flavor and maybe some substance.  And this stuff is much like the original.  Of course, everyone's taster is different.  And who knows what the formula changes have caused in the flavor?  One thing I do know.........My dog LOVES it!  He only got a taste and I threw the rest out.  Not good for him either.

These compact little bicks fit in the freezer door perfectly. I always know when I am running low. Great fresh taste having 11.3 ounce container open. I was buying the 30+ounce containers at the stores but they get stale after a week. This is better and the price is wonderful!

I am a Lapsang Souchong fan.  I enjoy the smokey flavor.  This particular version has nice subtlety to its flavor but lacks the "smoke" I desire.  I know most people are not fond of a "barbequed tea".  This brand may be one of the best for those who wish to test Lapsang Souchong but don't desire a lot of smokey flavor.  For true fans I would recommend the one from China Mist [[ASIN:B0000V1BEI Lapsang Souchong Whole Leaf Loose Black Tea].

Lapsang Souchong is what some might consider an acquired taste, because the smokiness and aroma of it are quite strong. Its aromatic reminiscence of woodsy smoke does not take away from the taste of the tea itself, which is rich, flavorful, and not at all bitter as one might suspect from the first overwhelming sniff. The taste is actually mellow and yet refreshing, the color a golden amber, and, as the reviewer below mentions, it is best when not steeped for too long. It's also best served without milk, as this takes away from the taste...but personal taste is personal taste.I must admit, I am not what you'd call a lapsang souchong snob, but I have tasted several brands, and Taylors of Harrogate offer the best I've ever tried. Their tea is divine, and I'm going to order some more of their other teas.

If you are familiar with Lapsang Souchong tea and like it you should consider this one.  It is a little lighter and smoother than some other versions of this type of tea and I like it very much.  If you have never tried Lapsang you should try a cup at a local tea shop before buying.  Lapsang has a smokey rosin sort of favor and is something of an acquired taste.  For those of us who like it, however, there is no substitute.

Lapsang Souchong tea comes from the mist-enshrouded Wuyi Mountains in the northwestern corner of China's Fujian Province (north of Guangdong [Canton] Province), whose greatest tourist draw besides its mountains is its coast line on the Taiwan Straits.This tea has an unmistakeably smokey note, which for years made it a particular favorite with the "single malt and cigars" crowd of English clubs and drawing rooms. That aroma is created during the tea's smoking process, which involves the withering of the tea leaves in bamboo baskets hung on racks over cypress or pine wood fires, after they have been rolled and placed into wooden barrels until they emit their own aroma. The finished tea leaves are characteristically thick and black. Legend has it that this smoking process was discovered by accident during the Quing Dynasty (1644 - 1911), when an army unit camping out in a tea factory interrupted the processing of the recently-arrived leaves and the workers then resulted to drying the leaves over pine fires to make up for the disruption and get to the market in time, creating an instant sensation there.Because of its potent aroma, Lapsang Souchong should not steep very long. The rule of thumb is that the paler its color, the more likely you'll truly enjoy it.

I've had Twinings Lapsang Souchang and now Taylors Lapsang Souchang.  They're both very nice teas and aren't noticeably different (unless you perhaps drink them side by side).  If you've not had Lapsang Souchang before, the concept is a bit like Earl Grey, only instead of that sort of earthy oil flavor it's smokey.  Not some sort of abstract smokiness like smoked salmon, but real "a forest is burning down somewhere nearby" smokey.  It is excellent with milk, and fine on its own.  I haven't had really expensive teas, so I don't know how this would compare to some of the "artisan" tea shops, but my guess is that if those are like great German beer, Taylors or Twinings are like a pretty decent English beer.Lapsang Souchang is also an excellent tea for coffee drinkers -- it has similar flavor characteristics of coffee, but does not have a bitter aftertaste.  Many coffee drinkers stay away from tea because it is either weak tasting or too watery -- this is definitely not weak tea, and a splash of (whole) milk will take care of the wateriness if that's a problem.My recommendation is to buy whichever of Twinings or Taylors is cheapest.  Buying the 6-pack is a good idea because it is freakin' impossible to find lapsang souchang in stores.

column9: If you like a smokey tea, you'll love this Lapsang Souchong
column10: In the world of tea, there are a few varieties that stand out like a sore thumb.  They have a very peculiar taste and probably a small subset of tea lovers partake of them.  Lapsang Souchong might very well be at the top of the list.Prior to this tea, I had sampled a few other brands and never really liked Lapsang Souchong.  For those who don't like it, you'd probably be inclined to describe it as a brew of burnt rubber or factory soot, with just a hint of campfire.  Not something you'd be craving to try again.Well, on a lark I decided to try Taylors of Harrogate Lapsang Souchong, and I'm very glad I did.  Taylors got it RIGHT.  This tea is very smooth and has a pleasant smokey aroma and taste.  You really have to stretch your imagination to conjure up thoughts of burnt rubber when sipping ANY Lapsang Souchong tea, and why would you want to when you can really enjoy it?  Comparatively, this tea is better than Twinings.  I have both and tried them side by side.  There was no contest--Taylors won.So, if you have already tried Lapsang Souchong and haven't quite found a version that suits you, look no further.  You've found it with Taylors.  :-)

I got this because I wanted to try a few different LS flavors. I brewed this in a glass pot so there's no leeching but it still tasted like burnt plastic. Going back to Adagio Lapsang Souchong - it might be a bit weak but it also doesn't taste like burning electronics.
I have used several brands of this type of tea. All of the other ones had a mild smoky flavor. This one's smoky flavor is much more intense and may not be enjoyed by everyone.

Prepare 2 boxes of rice according to directions on box, using chicken broth plus water, if needed.  While rice is cooking, debone chicken and shred with fork. I have multiple food allergies, which makes a grab-and-go breakfast...well...not possible. I wanted a meal replacement shake because I tend not to eat during the day (way too complicated) and not eating actually helps me gain weight. I also have some other health issues--like Hashimoto's--directly related to my allergies. Food is an issue for me, and so is energy and feeling well.I'm not vegan, but I prefer vegan foods for their cleanliness. I can't have soy, but many vegan products are soy-free anyway. I also like whole, organic, Non-GMO foods, and while I prefer Raw, I don't mind non-raw foods, either.I tried several vegan, gluten-free, soy-free, dairy-free shake mixes: Garden of Life, Vega, Inca Meal, RAW, etc. This is, by far, the best tasting, best "feeling" shake I've tried.I've tried all the flavors--Chocolate is my fave, then Pomegranate (sp?) Mango and Vanilla Chai, in that order. I mix mine is a shaker cup with a little mixing ball. I use Vanilla almond milk and a little agave syrup (I hate Stevia, it tastes like saccharine to me) and sometimes I throw a little extra hemp protein in, chia seeds, and flaxseed oil. I haven't bothered with a blender yet. One day, I'll put it into a blender with some fruit.Let's be real: this is a whole food shake with fruits, veggies, grasses, and hemp protein. This is not a mass-market, full-of-stuff-I-can't-pronounce homogenized drink. This is real food, synthesized down to a mixable level. Dunkin Donuts it's not. So?Truthfully, the pure, clean, feel-good energy I get from this, plus the cleansing, tonifying, and gut-health benefits are worth chugging down a slightly earthy drink every morning. Mixed with vanilla almond milk & a little agave, I actually savor the flavor--not too sweet (sweet in the morning makes me gag) chocolatey and, well, nutritious-y.Try a sample packet (you can get them at your local HFS, usually) and see which flavor suits you. I don't ever like this mixed in water--its just too thin. I DO use it on oatmeal, or stirred into yogurt. This is an awesome product. I just saved $12 over what I pay at WF, plus Amazon will deliver it to me every 15 days so I'll never run out...heaven!

Lately I've been mixing it with organic coconut water.  The quality of the coconut water affects just how tasty my "meal" turns out.  Sometimes I will add a few drops of organic liquid Stevia.I'm not sure what it is about this product that keeps me coming back for more.  I use Amazon's Subscribe & Save for it!  I'm not nuts about it, yet here I am drinking another glass!It is a quick & convenient way to get something nourishing into my body.  I find it is very refreshing.  I have never used it in a smoothie but when I do, I think it will be out of this world!  I have also mixed this with organic almond milk, organic rice milk & organic coconut milk.  The rice milk tasted the best probably because it was the sweetest.  The coconut milk was so so.  For now, I plan on sticking with the coconut water because I think it is the healthiest option & it tastes good enough for me.Overall this is a great way to get your greens & more in one quick "meal" though snack would be more appropriate as I don't find it filling for long.  Usually I pour a small amount of my liquid of choice into a glass, add a scoop of this (scoop is included), use a fork to stir it really good.  Then I add the rest of my liquid of choice & do lots more stirring.  I leave the fork in the glass & stir as needed because the fiber bits tend to settle on the bottom rather quickly.  Thankfully the amount that settles is substantially less than other mixes I've had.  I had a Organic Hemp protein shake that I flat out thought was disgusting & nearly all of it would settle on the bottom of the glass so fast I couldn't help but waste it! I'm sticking to Amazing Meal from now on.  Lesson learned!If you want to do something healthy & want to avoid all sugars & artificial sweeteners this mix is the way to go!  All Organic & GMO free!  If you are one of those sugar junkies who gets those "fast food" smoothies thinking it's healthy when it's just a sugar bomb you will surely hate this stuff.  For the rest of you health nuts lets raise a glass in good health!
